title.en: India's 2024 rape count was not 29,536. Add the 43,313 child-rape cases filed under POCSO
title.hg: India ka 2024 rape count 29,536 nahi tha. POCSO mein file hue child rape ke 43,313 cases bhi jodiye

dek.en: The rape figure in every headline leaves out almost every girl under 18. Put NCRB's two tables side by side and police registered 72,849 cases of rape or penetrative sexual assault against women and girls in 2024.
dek.hg: Har headline wale rape figure mein 18 saal se kam umar ki lagbhag koi ladki nahi gini jaati. NCRB ki dono tables saath rakhiye, toh 2024 mein police ne women aur girls ke saath rape ya penetrative sexual assault ke 72,849 cases register kiye.

statLabel.en: child-rape cases with girl victims filed under POCSO, outside the 2024 rape count
statLabel.hg: POCSO mein file hue girl victims wale child rape cases, jo 2024 ke rape count se bahar hain

label.en: cases under the rape head in 2024: the figure in the headlines
label.hg: 2024 mein rape head ke cases: yahi figure headlines mein aata hai

label.en: girls under 18 among the 29,742 victims in that rape table
label.hg: us rape table ke 29,742 victims mein 18 saal se kam ki ladkiyan

label.en: rape and POCSO penetrative-assault cases against women and girls in 2024, both tables added
label.hg: 2024 mein women aur girls ke rape aur POCSO penetrative assault cases, dono tables jod kar

claim.en: India's rape figure includes the rape of girls.
claim.hg: India ke rape figure mein ladkiyon ka rape bhi gina jaata hai.

truth.en: Almost every registered rape of a girl under 18 is filed under the POCSO Act and counted in a separate table. In 2024 that table was bigger than the rape table itself.
truth.hg: 18 saal se kam umar ki ladkiyon ke rape ke lagbhag saare registered cases POCSO Act mein file hote hain aur alag table mein gine jaate hain. 2024 mein woh table rape table se bhi badi thi.

actions.en: When you quote India's rape figure, add the POCSO Section 4 and 6 cases, or say plainly that children are left out.
actions.hg: India ka rape figure quote karte waqt POCSO Section 4 aur 6 ke cases bhi jodiye, ya saaf boliye ki ismein bachche shamil nahi hain.

actions.en: Never judge a state by its rape rate alone; check its POCSO numbers in the same report.
actions.hg: Kisi state ko sirf uske rape rate se judge mat kijiye; usi report mein uske POCSO numbers bhi dekhiye.

actions.en: Remember that the law treats everyone under 18 as a child: a child's 'yes' does not change a POCSO case.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye, law ki nazar mein 18 saal se kam umar ka har insaan bachcha hai. Bachche ki 'haan' se POCSO case nahi badalta.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them, keep them safe and call 1098 or 112. Anyone who knows of child sexual abuse must report it.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha aapko apne saath hue abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uspar bharosa kijiye, use safe rakhiye aur 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye. Jise bhi child sexual abuse ka pata ho, use report karna hi hoga.

title.en: In 96.8% of 2024 rape cases, the accused was someone the survivor knew. Here is who they were
title.hg: 2024 ke 96.8% rape cases mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha. Dekho woh kaun the

dek.en: NCRB's offender table sorts 29,536 rape cases into three groups of known men and one small column of strangers and unidentified men. What each group holds, what it hides, and the safety advice that actually fits it.
dek.hg: NCRB ki offender table 29,536 rape cases ko teen groups mein baantti hai jo survivor ke jaan-pehchaan wale hain, aur ek chhota column strangers aur unidentified accused ka. Har group mein kya hai, kya chhupa hai, aur kis group ke liye kaunsi safety advice sach mein fit hoti hai.

statLabel.en: of rape cases in 2024 named an accused the survivor knew
statLabel.hg: 2024 ke rape cases mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: of the 29,536 rape cases registered in 2024 named an accused the survivor knew
label.hg: 2024 ke 29,536 rape cases mein se itne cases mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: cases naming a friend, online friend, live-in partner or separated husband, the largest group
label.hg: cases jinmein accused friend, online friend, live-in partner ya alag reh raha husband tha; sabse bada group

label.en: cases where the accused was unknown or never identified
label.hg: cases jinmein accused unknown tha ya kabhi identify hi nahi hua

label.en: the known-accused share in 2012, before the law widened the definition of rape
label.hg: 2012 mein known accused ka share, jab rape ki legal definition abhi wide nahi hui thi

claim.en: The 'known person' figure is inflated by boyfriends and broken promises of marriage.
claim.hg: 'Known person' wala figure boyfriends aur shaadi ke toote waadon ki wajah se phoola hua hai.

truth.en: That group mixes very different cases and NCRB cannot separate them. But even without it, family members, neighbours, employers and other known men appear in more than 15 times as many 2024 cases as strangers and unidentified men.
truth.hg: Us group mein bahut alag-alag cases mixed hain aur NCRB unhe alag nahi kar sakta. Lekin us group ko hata bhi do, toh 2024 mein family members, neighbours, employers aur baaki jaan-pehchaan wale aadmi strangers aur unidentified accused se 15 guna se zyada cases mein accused the.

actions.en: Teach safety rules that cover people we know: a relative, partner, neighbour or boss has no more right to touch someone than a stranger.
actions.hg: Aise safety rules sikhao jo jaan-pehchaan walon par bhi laagu hon: relative, partner, neighbour ya boss ko bhi kisi ko uski marzi ke bina chhoone ka koi haq nahi, bilkul waise hi jaise kisi stranger ko nahi.

actions.en: If someone tells you about abuse by a person you both know, believe them first and ask what they need.
actions.hg: Agar koi bataye ki tum dono ke kisi jaanne wale ne uske saath galat kiya, toh pehle uski baat par yakeen karo aur poochho use kya chahiye.

actions.en: Before meeting an online friend alone for the first time, tell someone where you are going and share your live location.
actions.hg: Kisi online friend se pehli baar akele milne ja rahe ho toh kisi ko batake jao aur apni live location share karo.

actions.en: Know your rights: any police station must register a rape complaint, and a woman officer must record a woman's complaint.
actions.hg: Apne rights jaano: har police station ko rape complaint register karni hogi, aur aurat ki complaint woman officer hi record karegi.

title.en: Why Chandigarh 'tops' India's rape-rate table: a lesson in how states file child cases
title.hg: Chandigarh India ki rape-rate table mein 'top' kyun hai: states bachchon ke cases kaise file karte hain, uska sabak

dek.en: Chandigarh and Goa had India's two highest registered rape rates in 2024. About half or more of the cases behind those rates involved victims under 18, whom most states count under POCSO instead. How one filing habit can lift a territory to the top of a national ranking.
dek.hg: 2024 mein India ke do sabse oonche registered rape rates Chandigarh aur Goa ke the. Un rates ke peechhe lagbhag aadhe ya usse bhi zyada cases mein victim 18 saal se kam ki thi, jinhe zyadatar states POCSO mein ginte hain. Case file karne ki ek aadat kaise kisi territory ko national ranking mein sabse upar pahuncha deti hai, yahan dekhiye.

statLabel.en: registered rapes per lakh women in Chandigarh, India's highest (2024)
statLabel.hg: Chandigarh mein har ek lakh women par registered rapes, India mein sabse zyada (2024)

label.hg: Chandigarh ke 2024 ke rape cases jinmein victim 18 saal se kam ki ladki thi

label.hg: Goa ke 2024 ke rape cases jinmein victim 18 saal se kam ki ladki thi

label.hg: 2024 mein poore India ke rape cases jinmein victim 18 saal se kam ki ladki thi; bachchon ke zyadatar rape cases POCSO mein file hote hain

label.en: rape cases in Tamil Nadu involving a girl under 18; the state registered 6,969 POCSO cases
label.hg: Tamil Nadu ke rape cases jinmein victim 18 saal se kam ki ladki thi; state ne POCSO ke 6,969 cases register kiye

claim.en: Chandigarh and Goa are the most dangerous places in India for women.
claim.hg: Chandigarh aur Goa India mein women ke liye sabse khatarnaak jagahein hain.

truth.en: Their rape rates are lifted by how cases are filed: about half or more of their rape cases involved children, whom most states count under the POCSO Act instead. The ranking measures paperwork as much as danger.
truth.hg: Unke rape rates cases file karne ke tareeke se upar chadhte hain: unke lagbhag aadhe ya usse zyada rape cases mein victim bachche the, jinhe zyadatar states POCSO Act mein ginte hain. Yeh ranking jitna khatra naapti hai, utna hi paperwork bhi.

actions.en: Never quote a state's rape rate without its POCSO figures from the same NCRB report.
actions.hg: Kisi state ka rape rate usi NCRB report ke POCSO figures ke bina kabhi quote mat kijiye.

actions.en: When a small territory tops a ranking, look at how many cases sit behind its rate.
actions.hg: Jab koi chhota territory kisi ranking mein top par ho, toh dekhiye ki uske rate ke peechhe kitne cases hain.

actions.en: Before comparing two states, check what share of each one's rape cases involved girls under 18.
actions.hg: Do states ko compare karne se pehle check kijiye ki dono ke rape cases mein 18 saal se kam ki ladkiyon ka hissa kitna hai.

actions.en: Remember that the law treats everyone under 18 as a child: a child's 'yes' changes nothing in a POCSO case.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye, law ki nazar mein 18 saal se kam umar ka har insaan bachcha hai: bachche ki 'haan' se POCSO case mein kuch nahi badalta.

actions.en: If a child tells you about sexual abuse, believe them and report it to the police or call 1098: under POCSO, reporting is a legal duty.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha aapko sexual abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uspar bharosa kijiye aur police ko report kijiye ya 1098 par call kijiye: POCSO ke tahat report karna kanooni zimmedari hai.

title.en: 76.6% in Uttar Pradesh, 1.6% in West Bengal: where a woman lives can decide whether her case ends in a conviction
title.hg: Uttar Pradesh mein 76.6%, West Bengal mein 1.6%: aurat kis state mein rehti hai, isse tay ho sakta hai ki uske case mein saza hogi ya nahi

dek.en: Courts convicted in 25.7% of crime-against-women trials that ended in 2024, and 24,32,527 cases were still waiting. Inside that average is a lottery run along state lines, and the gap says more about investigation and prosecution than about women.
dek.hg: 2024 mein jo crime-against-women trials khatam hue, unme se sirf 25.7% mein courts ne saza di, aur 24,32,527 cases abhi bhi intezaar mein the. Is average ke andar state ki seemaon se chalne wali ek lottery chhupi hai, aur yeh gap auraton ke baare mein kam, investigation aur prosecution ke baare mein zyada batata hai.

statLabel.hg: 2024 mein West Bengal mein crimes against women ka conviction rate

label.hg: 2024 mein India mein poore hue crime-against-women trials jo conviction par khatam hue

label.en: conviction rate in Uttar Pradesh, the highest of any large state in 2024
label.hg: Uttar Pradesh ka conviction rate, 2024 mein kisi bhi bade state mein sabse zyada

label.en: convictions in Uttar Pradesh in 2024, nearly half of India's 45,832
label.hg: 2024 mein Uttar Pradesh mein convictions, India ke kul 45,832 ka lagbhag aadha

label.hg: crime-against-women cases jo 2024 ke end mein poore India mein trial ke intezaar mein the

claim.en: Most of these cases end in acquittal because most complaints are false.
claim.hg: Zyada tar cases mein accused isliye bari hote hain kyunki zyada tar complaints jhoothi hoti hain.

truth.en: NCRB's tables cannot tell a false complaint from a weak investigation, a hostile witness or a compromise. And conviction rates run from 76.6% in one large state to 1.6% in another: a gap that wide points to how cases are investigated and prosecuted, not to how honest women are.
truth.hg: NCRB ki tables jhoothi complaint ko kamzor investigation, hostile witness ya compromise se alag nahi kar sakti. Aur conviction rate ek bade state mein 76.6% hai toh doosre mein 1.6%: itna bada gap yeh batata hai ki cases ki investigation aur prosecution kaise hoti hai, yeh nahi ki auratein kitni sachchi hain.

actions.en: Read a state's conviction rate together with its trial backlog; a rate built on the few trials that finish says little about the cases still waiting.
actions.hg: Kisi state ka conviction rate hamesha uske trial backlog ke saath padhiye; jo rate sirf thode se khatam hue trials par bana hai, woh intezaar kar rahe cases ke baare mein kuch nahi batata.

actions.en: If you have filed a complaint, use your right under Section 193(3) BNSS to be told how the investigation is going within 90 days.
actions.hg: Agar aapne complaint file ki hai, toh Section 193(3) BNSS ke under apna haq istemaal kijiye: 90 din ke andar police ko batana hoga ki investigation kahan tak pahunchi.

actions.en: Ask the District Legal Services Authority about victim compensation: under Section 396 BNSS it can be paid even when no one is convicted.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority se victim compensation ke baare mein poochiye: Section 396 BNSS ke under yeh tab bhi mil sakta hai jab kisi ko saza na ho.

actions.en: Do not treat an acquittal as proof that a woman lied; the data cannot show why a case failed.
actions.hg: Kisi acquittal ko is baat ka saboot mat maaniye ki aurat ne jhooth bola; data yeh nahi bata sakta ki case kyun fail hua.

actions.en: Ask your MLA for your state's conviction rate and trial backlog in crimes against women, and what is being done about each.
actions.hg: Apne MLA se poochiye ki aapke state mein crimes against women ka conviction rate aur trial backlog kitna hai, aur dono ke liye kya kiya ja raha hai.

title.hg: Rape-murder mein 76.4%, rape mein 24.4%, trafficking mein 7.3%: India ke conviction rates, rank karke

dek.en: NCRB's 2024 court data, crime by crime, from the trials most likely to end in a conviction to the least likely. The top of the table carries a hard message: the system convicts most often when the woman is no longer alive to testify.
dek.hg: NCRB ka 2024 ka court data, crime by crime: kis trial mein conviction sabse zyada hota hai aur kis mein sabse kam. Table ke top par ek kadwi baat likhi hai: system sabse zyada conviction tab deta hai jab aurat gawahi dene ke liye zinda hi nahi hoti.

statLabel.hg: 2024 mein poore hue human trafficking trials ka conviction rate

claim.hg: Conviction rate kam hai, matlab zyada tar complaints jhoothi hain.

truth.en: NCRB does not record why a trial ends in acquittal. Weak investigation, hostile witnesses, a compromise or a false complaint all look the same in the data, and most cases never reach a verdict at all.
truth.hg: NCRB yeh record hi nahi karta ki trial acquittal par kyun khatam hua. Kamzor investigation, hostile gawah, compromise ya jhoothi complaint, data mein sab ek jaise dikhte hain, aur zyada tar cases kabhi verdict tak pahunchte hi nahi.

actions.en: When someone quotes a conviction rate, ask three things: which crime, which year, and how many completed trials it rests on.
actions.hg: Jab koi conviction rate quote kare, toh teen cheezein poocho: kaunsa crime, kaunsa saal, aur yeh kitne poore hue trials par tika hai.

actions.en: Do not read an acquittal as proof that a complaint was false; the data cannot tell why a trial ended that way.
actions.hg: Acquittal ko is baat ka saboot mat maano ki complaint jhoothi thi; data yeh bata hi nahi sakta ki trial waise kyun khatam hua.

actions.en: If you suspect someone is being trafficked, call 112, or 1098 if the person is under 18.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe shak hai ki kisi ki trafficking ho rahi hai, toh 112 par call karo, ya 1098 agar woh 18 se kam umar ka hai.

actions.en: If a woman you know faces dowry demands or cruelty at home, help her keep a dated record of every demand and incident, and call 181 for support.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari jaan-pehchaan mein kisi aurat se dahej maanga ja raha hai ya ghar par cruelty ho rahi hai, toh har demand aur har incident ka date ke saath record rakhne mein uski madad karo, aur support ke liye 181 par call karo.

title.en: Myth: India is the world's rape capital. Why ranking countries by rape is almost always wrong
title.hg: Myth: India duniya ka 'rape capital' hai. Countries ko rape ke numbers par rank karna lagbhag hamesha galat kyun hai

dek.en: One viral post calls India the rape capital of the world. Another says India is safer than Sweden. Both rest on numbers that measure who is able to speak, under laws that define rape differently. Here is what cross-country data can and cannot tell you.
dek.hg: Ek viral post India ko duniya ka rape capital bolti hai. Doosri kehti hai ki India Sweden se zyada safe hai. Dono aise numbers par tiki hain jo asal mein yeh naapte hain ki kaun bol pata hai, aur har desh ka kanoon rape kise maanta hai, yeh bhi alag hai. Jaano, countries ke numbers kya bata sakte hain aur kya nahi.

statLabel.en: lifetime non-partner sexual violence estimated for Sweden, against 4.1% for India (WHO, 2023)
statLabel.hg: Sweden ke liye partner ke alawa kisi aur se lifetime sexual violence ka estimate; India ke liye yahi figure 4.1% (WHO, 2023)

label.en: of women aged 15-49 in India: WHO's 2023 estimate of lifetime sexual violence by a non-partner
label.hg: India mein 15-49 saal ki auratein jinhone partner ke alawa kisi aur se kabhi sexual violence jheli: WHO ka 2023 ka estimate

label.en: the same WHO estimate for Sweden; WHO says such gaps reflect disclosure and survey methods, not only violence
label.hg: Sweden ke liye WHO ka wahi estimate; WHO kehta hai aise gaps sirf violence nahi, disclosure aur survey methods ka farq bhi dikhate hain

label.en: of 131 countries have consent-based rape laws that explicitly criminalise marital rape (UN, 2026)
label.hg: 131 countries mein se bas itno mein consent-based rape law hai jo marital rape ko bhi saaf taur par crime maanta hai (UN, 2026)

label.en: of ever-married or partnered Indian women aged 15-49 faced partner violence in the past year, among the highest rates WHO estimated for 2023
label.hg: India ki 15-49 saal ki married ya partnered auraton ne pichhle saal partner ki violence jheli, WHO ke 2023 estimates ki sabse oonchi rates mein se ek

claim.en: India is the rape capital of the world. Or the reverse: India's low numbers prove it is safer than Sweden.
claim.hg: India duniya ka rape capital hai. Ya ulta: India ke kam numbers saabit karte hain ki woh Sweden se zyada safe hai.

truth.en: No dataset can rank countries by rape. Survey figures track how freely women can disclose, and police figures track each country's own law and reporting. WHO's 4.1% for India measures silence as much as safety.
truth.hg: Koi bhi dataset countries ko rape ke hisaab se rank nahi kar sakta. Survey figures dikhate hain ki auratein kitna khul kar bata paati hain, aur police figures har desh ke apne kanoon aur reporting par tike hain. India ke liye WHO ka 4.1% jitna safety naapta hai, utna hi chuppi bhi.

actions.en: Before you share a country comparison, ask four things: survey or police record, which year, which ages, and what the law there calls rape.
actions.hg: Koi country comparison share karne se pehle chaar cheezein poochho: survey hai ya police record, kaunsa saal, kis umar ke log, aur wahan ka kanoon rape kise maanta hai.

actions.en: Answer a 'rape capital' post with the source's own warning: WHO says these gaps reflect disclosure, stigma and survey methods, not only violence.
actions.hg: 'Rape capital' wali post ka jawab usi source ki warning se do: WHO kehta hai yeh gaps sirf violence ke nahi, disclosure, stigma aur survey methods ke bhi hain.

actions.en: Never quote India's low survey figure as proof of safety. Call it a floor.
actions.hg: India ke kam survey figure ko kabhi safety ka saboot mat banao. Use 'kam se kam' wala number kaho.

actions.en: Compare a country with itself over time, using the same survey and method, never with another country's police register.
actions.hg: Kisi country ko time ke saath usi ke data se compare karo, same survey aur same method se. Kisi doosre desh ke police register se kabhi nahi.

actions.en: If someone tells you about sexual violence, believe them and help them reach 181 (Women Helpline), or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Koi tumhe apne saath hui sexual violence ke baare mein bataye, toh uspe bharosa karo aur 181 (Women Helpline) tak pahunchne mein madad karo. Emergency mein 112 call karo.

title.hg: Crime in India 2024 decoded: sexual violence ke das numbers, aur har ek kya chhupata hai

dek.hg: NCRB ki report 6 May 2026 ko aayi aur abhi bhi sabse naya edition yahi hai. Yeh rahe sexual violence ke woh das figures jo aap sabse zyada quote hote dekhenge, har ek ke saath woh ek caveat jo dohraane se pehle check karna zaroori hai.

actions.hg: Har number ko uske saal ke saath, aur woh kya ginta hai yeh bata kar quote kijiye, jaise '2024 mein register hue 29,536 rape cases'.

actions.hg: Jab bhi 18 saal se kam umar ki ladkiyon ki baat ho, rape figure ke saath POCSO figure bhi rakhiye.

title.en: When the rapist holds power: custodial rape, abuse of authority and the gaps in India's record
title.hg: Jab rapist ke haath mein power ho: custodial rape, authority ka galat istemaal aur India ke record ki kamiyan

dek.en: Since 1983 Indian law has treated custodial rape as an aggravated crime. In 2024 police recorded 27 rape cases against their own personnel. Why abuse by people with power over the victim is the hardest to report, and who the law still leaves out.
dek.hg: 1983 se Indian law custodial rape ko aggravated crime maanta hai. 2024 mein police ne apne hi personnel ke khilaaf 27 rape case darj kiye. Jinke haath mein victim par power hoti hai, unke abuse ko report karna sabse mushkil kyun hai, aur law aaj bhi kise bahar chhod deta hai.

label.hg: 2024 mein India mein police personnel ke khilaaf darj rape case

label.en: policemen among the six people convicted in the Kathua case in 2019, for destroying evidence
label.hg: 2019 mein Kathua case mein convict hue chhe logon mein se itne policewale the, jinhe saboot mitaane ke liye saza mili

claim.en: If a woman in custody did not fight off the officer, she agreed.
claim.hg: Agar custody mein kisi aurat ne officer se ladaai nahi ki, toh matlab usne haan kaha tha.

truth.en: Since 2013 the law says that not physically resisting is not, by itself, consent. And in a trial for rape by police, public servants, jail or hospital staff, once intercourse is proved and she tells the court she did not consent, the court must presume she did not.
truth.hg: 2013 se law kehta hai ki physically resist na karna apne aap mein consent nahi hai. Aur police, public servant, jail ya hospital staff ke kiye rape ke trial mein, jab intercourse saabit ho jaaye aur aurat court mein kahe ki usne consent nahi diya, toh court ko maanna hoga ki consent nahi tha.

actions.en: If the abuser is a police officer, go to a different police station: an FIR can be filed at any station, whatever the place of the crime, or sent electronically and signed within three days.
actions.hg: Agar abuse karne wala police officer hai, toh kisi doosre police station jaiye: FIR kisi bhi station par likhwayi ja sakti hai, crime chahe kahin bhi hua ho, ya electronically bheji ja sakti hai jise teen din ke andar sign karna hota hai.

actions.en: Ask for a woman officer to record the complaint, and for your statement to be taken at home or at a place you choose.
actions.hg: Complaint record karne ke liye woman officer maangiye, aur kahiye ki aapka statement ghar par ya aapki chuni hui jagah par liya jaaye.

actions.en: Write down names, dates, places and who else was present as soon as you can, and keep the free copy of the FIR you are entitled to.
actions.hg: Jitni jaldi ho sake naam, taarikh, jagah aur wahan kaun-kaun maujood tha, sab likh lijiye, aur FIR ki free copy, jiske aap haqdaar hain, sambhaal kar rakhiye.

actions.en: An officer who refuses to record a rape FIR commits a crime under Section 199 BNS. Say so, and put the refusal in writing.
actions.hg: Rape ki FIR likhne se mana karne wala officer Section 199 BNS ke tahat crime karta hai. Yeh saaf boliye, aur mana karne ki baat likhit mein darj kijiye.

actions.en: If you suspect abuse in a shelter home, hostel or hospital, tell someone outside that institution: call 1098 for a child, 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar aapko kisi shelter home, hostel ya hospital mein abuse ka shak hai, toh us institution ke bahar kisi ko bataiye: bachche ke liye 1098, emergency mein 112.

title.en: 4,262 rape cases with Dalit victims in 2024, about 12 a day. Why even that number is a floor
title.hg: 2024 mein Dalit victims wale 4,262 rape case, yaani roz qareeb 12. Phir bhi yeh number sirf ek floor kyun hai

dek.en: Police also registered 1,268 rape cases with Adivasi victims. But a rape enters India's caste statistics only when police add the SC/ST Atrocities Act to the FIR, so every case where they leave it out disappears from the count.
dek.hg: Police ne Adivasi victims wale 1,268 rape case bhi darj kiye. Lekin koi rape India ke caste statistics mein tabhi aata hai jab police FIR mein SC/ST Atrocities Act jode, isliye jis case mein yeh Act chhoot jaata hai, woh ginti se hi gaayab ho jaata hai.

statLabel.en: rape cases with Scheduled Caste victims registered in 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein darj rape case jinmein victim Scheduled Caste se the

label.en: rape cases with Scheduled Caste (Dalit) victims registered in 2024, about 12 a day
label.hg: 2024 mein darj rape case jinmein victim Scheduled Caste (Dalit) se the, yaani roz qareeb 12

label.en: rape cases with Scheduled Tribe (Adivasi) victims registered in 2024, 12.7% of all crimes against STs
label.hg: 2024 mein darj rape case jinmein victim Scheduled Tribe (Adivasi) se the, STs ke khilaaf sabhi crimes ka 12.7%

label.en: of the 4,214 rape cases with Dalit victims in 2023 involved children under 18
label.hg: 2023 mein Dalit victims wale 4,214 rape cases mein se itne cases mein victim 18 saal se kam umar ke bachche the

label.en: conviction rate in rape trials with Dalit victims completed in 2023
label.hg: 2023 mein poore hue, Dalit victims wale rape trials mein conviction rate

claim.en: Dominant-caste men would not touch a Dalit woman, so her rape complaint must be false.
claim.hg: Dominant caste ke aadmi kisi Dalit aurat ko chhuenge bhi nahi, isliye uski rape complaint jhoothi hogi.

truth.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes calls this a stereotype and says dominant-caste men have historically used sexual violence to reinforce and maintain caste hierarchies.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ki gender stereotypes par 2023 ki handbook ise stereotype kehti hai, aur kehti hai ki dominant caste ke aadmiyon ne itihaas mein sexual violence ka istemaal caste hierarchy ko mazboot aur barkaraar rakhne ke liye kiya hai.

actions.en: If you help a Dalit or Adivasi survivor report, read the FIR before you leave the station: it should include SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act sections, not only rape or POCSO sections.
actions.hg: Agar aap kisi Dalit ya Adivasi survivor ko report karne mein madad kar rahe hain, toh station se nikalne se pehle FIR padhiye: usmein sirf rape ya POCSO ke sections nahi, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act ke sections bhi hone chahiye.

actions.en: A public servant who is not SC or ST and wilfully neglects the duty to register the FIR under the correct sections, or to file a charge sheet within 60 days, can be jailed under Section 4 of the Act. Put every complaint about this in writing.
actions.hg: Jo public servant khud SC ya ST nahi hai aur jaan-boojhkar FIR ko sahi sections mein darj karne, ya 60 din ke andar charge sheet file karne ki duty mein laaparwaahi karta hai, use Act ke Section 4 ke tahat jail ho sakti hai. Iski har shikayat likhit mein dijiye.

actions.en: Ask for the protection the Act promises: the state must shield victims and witnesses from threats, and victims must be told about every hearing, including bail.
actions.hg: Act jo protection deta hai, use maangiye: state ko victims aur gawaahon ko dhamkiyon se bachana hai, aur victim ko har hearing, bail ki hearing samet, ki jaankari milni chahiye.

actions.en: Apply for victim compensation at the District Legal Services Authority. You can apply even if the offender is never traced or tried.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority mein victim compensation ke liye apply kijiye. Offender kabhi na mile ya uska trial na ho, tab bhi aap apply kar sakte hain.

actions.en: Never share a survivor's name, photo or village online, even in a post demanding justice for her.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ka naam, photo ya gaon online share mat kijiye, chahe post uske liye insaaf maangne wali hi kyun na ho.

title.en: 30.5% conviction, 92.3% pending: what happens in court to rape cases of Dalit survivors
title.hg: 30.5% conviction, 92.3% pending: Dalit survivors ke rape cases ke saath court mein kya hota hai

dek.en: In 2023 courts convicted in 508 rape cases with Scheduled Caste victims, acquitted in 1,073 and left 20,622 waiting. A 2015 law promised a charge sheet in 60 days and a trial in two months. This is where that promise breaks.
dek.hg: 2023 mein courts ne Scheduled Caste victims wale 508 rape cases mein sazaa sunayi, 1,073 mein accused ko bari kiya, aur 20,622 cases intezaar mein pade rahe. 2015 ke ek kaanoon ne 60 din mein charge sheet aur do mahine mein trial ka vaada kiya tha. Woh vaada kahan tootta hai, yahan padhiye.

statLabel.en: conviction rate in rape trials with Scheduled Caste victims, 2023
statLabel.hg: 2023 mein Scheduled Caste victims wale rape trials mein conviction rate

label.en: rape cases with Scheduled Caste victims that ended in conviction in 2023
label.hg: 2023 mein Scheduled Caste victims wale itne rape cases mein sazaa hui

label.en: such cases that ended in acquittal the same year
label.hg: usi saal itne aise cases mein accused bari ho gaye

label.en: such cases still waiting for a verdict at the end of 2023: 92.3% of those before the courts
label.hg: aise itne cases 2023 ke aakhir tak faisle ka intezaar kar rahe the: courts ke saamne maujood aise cases ka 92.3%

label.en: from the charge sheet: the time within which the 2015 amendment says these trials should end, as far as possible
label.hg: charge sheet ke baad: 2015 ke amendment ke mutaabik, jahan tak mumkin ho, itne samay mein yeh trials khatam ho jaane chahiye

actions.en: If the survivor is Dalit or Adivasi, ask the police in writing when the charge sheet will be filed. The law expects it within 60 days, with any delay explained in writing.
actions.hg: Agar survivor Dalit ya Adivasi hai, toh police se likhit mein poochhiye ki charge sheet kab file hogi. Kaanoon 60 din ke andar charge sheet ki ummeed karta hai, aur deri hui toh uski wajah likhit mein batani hoti hai.

actions.en: Ask the prosecutor in writing for the date of every hearing, including bail hearings. Under Section 15A, timely notice is the survivor's right.
actions.hg: Prosecutor se har hearing ki date likhit mein maangiye, bail hearings ki bhi. Section 15A ke tahat samay par jaankari paana survivor ka haq hai.

actions.en: If anyone threatens, pressures or offers money to the survivor, her family or a witness, write to the police and the court at once. Section 15A makes their protection the state's duty.
actions.hg: Agar koi survivor, uski family ya kisi gawaah ko dhamkaye, dabaav daale ya paise ka laalach de, toh turant police aur court ko likhit mein bataiye. Section 15A ke tahat unki hifaazat state ki zimmedaari hai.

actions.en: Apply for victim compensation to the District Legal Services Authority without waiting for the verdict. Section 396 of the BNSS allows it even when no trial takes place.
actions.hg: Faisle ka intezaar kiye bina District Legal Services Authority mein victim compensation ke liye apply kijiye. BNSS ki Section 396 iski ijaazat deti hai, tab bhi jab koi trial na ho.

title.en: Mumbai counted more women than Delhi in 2011. In 2024, Delhi registered more than twice the crimes against them
title.hg: 2011 ki ginti mein Mumbai mein Delhi se zyada auratein thi. 2024 mein Delhi ne unke khilaaf Mumbai se do guna se bhi zyada crimes register kiye

dek.en: Delhi recorded 13,396 crimes against women and 1,058 rapes in 2024; Mumbai, 6,358 and 411. Delhi has had the highest crime-against-women rate of any state or UT two years running. A line-by-line comparison, why the same Delhi cases produce two different rates, and the question the numbers cannot answer.
dek.hg: 2024 mein Delhi ne 13,396 crimes against women aur 1,058 rapes record kiye; Mumbai ne 6,358 aur 411. Lagaataar do saal se Delhi ka crime-against-women rate kisi bhi state ya UT se zyada raha hai. Line-by-line comparison, Delhi ke wahi cases do alag rates kyun dete hain, aur woh sawaal jiska jawab numbers nahi de sakte.

statLabel.en: crimes against women per lakh women in Delhi, the highest of any state or UT (2024)
statLabel.hg: Delhi mein har lakh auraton par crimes against women, kisi bhi state ya UT mein sabse zyada (2024)

label.en: crimes against women registered in Delhi in 2024, the most of any metropolitan city
label.hg: 2024 mein Delhi mein register hue crimes against women, kisi bhi metropolitan city mein sabse zyada

label.en: crimes against women registered in Mumbai in 2024, the second-highest count among the 19 largest cities
label.hg: 2024 mein Mumbai mein register hue crimes against women, 19 sabse bade shehron mein doosri sabse badi ginti

label.en: Delhi's rate per lakh women when the same 2024 cases are divided by its 2011 Census population
label.hg: Delhi ka per lakh women rate, jab 2024 ke wahi cases uski 2011 Census ki aabaadi se divide kiye jaayein

label.en: rape cases registered in Delhi in 2024, against 411 in Mumbai
label.hg: 2024 mein Delhi mein register hue rape cases, Mumbai ke 411 ke muqable

claim.en: Delhi has India's highest crime-against-women rate, so it must be the most dangerous place for women.
claim.hg: Delhi ka crime-against-women rate India mein sabse zyada hai, toh yeh auraton ke liye sabse khatarnak jagah hogi.

truth.en: A rate counts the cases police registered, divided by an estimate of how many women live there. NCRB itself warns that more registered crime is 'not an indicator' that a place is less safe. Delhi may be more dangerous, better at recording, or both; the table cannot say which.
truth.hg: Rate ka matlab hai police ke register kiye cases, jinhe is andaaze se divide kiya jaata hai ki wahan kitni auratein rehti hain. NCRB khud warn karta hai ki zyada registered crime is baat ka 'not an indicator' hai ki jagah kam safe hai. Ho sakta hai Delhi zyada khatarnak ho, ya record karne mein behtar, ya dono; table yeh nahi bata sakti.

actions.en: Compare cities only with rates from the same NCRB table, and never set a city rate against a state rate.
actions.hg: Shehron ko sirf ek hi NCRB table ke rates se compare kijiye, aur kabhi bhi city rate ko state rate ke saamne mat rakhiye.

actions.en: Do not read Mumbai's lower count as proof that it is safe, or Delhi's higher one as proof that it is the worst.
actions.hg: Mumbai ki kam ginti ko uske safe hone ka saboot mat maaniye, aur Delhi ki zyada ginti ko uske sabse bure hone ka saboot bhi nahi.

actions.en: Know that you can file a complaint at any police station, wherever the crime happened, or send it electronically under Section 173 BNSS.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye ki Section 173 BNSS ke under aap kisi bhi police station mein complaint file kar sakti hain, crime chahe kahin bhi hua ho, ya use electronically bhej sakti hain.

actions.en: If a woman tells you about violence, help her reach a police station, a women help desk or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Agar koi aurat aapko hinsa ke baare mein bataye, toh use police station, women help desk ya Women Helpline 181 tak pahunchne mein madad kijiye.

title.en: Disabled rape survivors have special rights on paper. In 15 of 17 cases, officials ignored them.
title.hg: Kaagaz par disabled rape survivors ke khaas haq hain. 17 mein se 15 cases mein officials ne unhe ignore kiya.

dek.en: The law promises a disabled survivor an FIR at home, an interpreter and a video statement she need not repeat in court. Human Rights Watch found those promises broken in almost every case it studied, and in 2024 police used the disability clause in 144 of 29,536 rape cases.
dek.hg: Law vaada karta hai ki disabled survivor ki FIR ghar par likhi jaayegi, saath mein interpreter hoga, aur uska video statement court mein dobara nahi lena padega. Human Rights Watch ne jin cases ki padtaal ki, lagbhag har case mein yeh vaade toote. Aur 2024 mein rape ke 29,536 cases mein se sirf 144 mein police ne disability wali dhara lagayi.

statLabel.en: documented cases where police and courts ignored disability accommodations (HRW, 2018)
statLabel.hg: documented cases jinmein police aur courts ne disability ke liye zaroori arrangements ignore kiye (HRW, 2018)

label.en: rape cases registered under the disability clause in 2024, out of 29,536
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein disability wali dhara mein register hue, kul 29,536 mein se

label.en: such cases in Uttar Pradesh, which registered 3,209 rape cases that year
label.hg: aise cases Uttar Pradesh mein, jahan us saal rape ke 3,209 cases register hue

label.en: cases registered under the entire disability rights law in 2024, for all offences
label.hg: cases 2024 mein poore disability rights law mein register hue, saare offences milakar

label.en: of women with intellectual disabilities had been raped, in a 2004 Odisha survey
label.hg: intellectual disability wali aurton ka rape hua tha, 2004 ke ek Odisha survey mein

claim.en: Nobody would target a disabled woman, so her rape complaint is probably false.
claim.hg: Disabled aurat ko kaun target karega? Uski rape complaint shayad jhoothi hai.

truth.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook calls this a stereotype. Disability does not lower the risk, and women whose disability affects how they communicate are particularly vulnerable.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook ise ek stereotype kehti hai. Disability se khatra kam nahi hota, aur jin aurton ki disability unke baat karne ke tareeke par asar daalti hai, unhe khaas taur par zyada khatra hai.

actions.en: Teach disabled children and relatives body safety in the way they understand: sign language, pictures or simple words.
actions.hg: Disabled bachchon aur relatives ko body safety usi tareeke se sikhaiye jo woh samajhte hain: sign language, pictures ya simple words.

actions.en: If a disabled woman reports sexual violence, ask police to record it at her home or a place she chooses, with an interpreter or special educator, on video.
actions.hg: Agar koi disabled aurat sexual violence report kare, toh police se kahiye ki complaint uske ghar par ya uski chuni jagah par, interpreter ya special educator ke saath, video par record kare.

actions.en: Ask for her statement before the magistrate to be video-recorded too, so she does not have to repeat it at trial.
actions.hg: Magistrate ke saamne uska statement bhi video par record karwaiye, taaki trial mein use sab kuch dobara na batana pade.

actions.en: Take the free copy of the FIR and check that it records her disability and the aggravated charge.
actions.hg: FIR ki free copy lijiye aur check kijiye ki usmein uski disability aur aggravated charge likha hai ya nahi.

actions.en: For free legal aid and compensation, contact the District Legal Services Authority or NALSA on 15100.
actions.hg: Free legal aid aur compensation ke liye District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) se miliye, ya NALSA ki helpline 15100 par call kijiye.

title.en: Find your state's rape numbers yourself: a walkthrough of NCRB's Crime in India tables
title.hg: Apne state ke rape numbers khud check karo: NCRB ki Crime in India tables ka walkthrough

dek.en: Most rape figures quoted in India trace back to a few tables in one free government PDF. Here is how to open it, find your state's line and read each column without being fooled.
dek.hg: India mein quote hone wale zyada tar rape figures ek hi free sarkari PDF ki kuch tables se aate hain. Yahan dekho use kaise kholna hai, apne state ki line kaise dhoondhni hai aur har column bina dhokha khaye kaise padhna hai.

statLabel.en: rape cases registered in Bihar in 2024, at 1.9 per lakh women
statLabel.hg: rape cases 2024 mein Bihar mein register hue, yaani har lakh auraton par 1.9

label.en: rape cases registered in India in 2024 (Table 3A.2)
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein poore India mein register hue (Table 3A.2)

label.en: rape cases registered in Maharashtra in 2024, at 5.0 per lakh women
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein Maharashtra mein register hue, yaani har lakh auraton par 5.0

label.en: metropolitan cities whose tables NCRB prints; the other 34 are only on its website
label.hg: metro cities ki tables hi NCRB print karta hai; baaki 34 cities ka data sirf uski website par hai

claim.en: A state with fewer registered rapes is a safer state for women.
claim.hg: Jis state mein kam rape cases register hote hain, woh auraton ke liye zyada safe hai.

truth.en: NCRB itself warns that registered crime is not the same as crime. A low number can simply mean fewer women are able to report.
truth.hg: NCRB khud warning deta hai ki registered crime aur asli crime ek cheez nahi hain. Kam number ka matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki kam auratein report kar paa rahi hain.

actions.en: Before you forward a rape statistic, open Crime in India 2024, Volume I, and find the table and row it came from.
actions.hg: Koi bhi rape statistic forward karne se pehle Crime in India 2024 ka Volume I kholo aur dekho ki woh kis table aur kis row se aaya hai.

actions.en: Read your state's line in Table 3A.2 together with its POCSO figures in Chapter 4A, where most child rape is counted.
actions.hg: Table 3A.2 mein apne state ki line ko Chapter 4A ke POCSO figures ke saath padho, kyunki bachchon ke rape ke zyada tar cases wahin gine jaate hain.

actions.en: When you quote a number, say the year, the table, and whether it counts cases or victims.
actions.hg: Koi number quote karo toh saal aur table zaroor batao, aur yeh bhi ki woh cases gin raha hai ya victims.

actions.en: Treat a low state rate as a question about reporting, not as proof of safety.
actions.hg: Kisi state ke kam rate ko safety ka saboot mat samjho. Use is sawaal ki tarah dekho ki kitni complaints police tak pahunch paayin.

title.en: Two penal codes in one year: how to read India's first crime data under the BNS
title.hg: Ek saal, do penal codes: BNS ke baad ka India ka pehla crime data kaise padhein

dek.en: NCRB's 2024 tables carry two columns, a new row, a deleted row and a split row. Here is how to compare them with earlier years without mistaking a change of category for a change in crime.
dek.hg: NCRB ki 2024 tables mein ab do columns hain, ek nayi row, ek deleted row aur ek row jo paanch hisson mein toot gayi. Purane saalon se compare karte waqt category ke badlaav ko crime ka badlaav mat samajh lena.

statLabel.en: rape cases filed under the new BNS in 2024: only one column of the year's 29,536
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein naye BNS ke under file hue rape cases: saal ke 29,536 ka sirf ek column

label.en: rape cases in 2024: 19,683 under the IPC plus 9,853 under the BNS
label.hg: 2024 mein rape cases: IPC ke under 19,683 plus BNS ke under 9,853

label.en: cases under the new Section 69 (sex by deceit or a false promise of marriage), July to December 2024
label.hg: nayi Section 69 (dhokhe se ya shaadi ke jhoothe waade par sex) ke cases, July se December 2024

label.en: 'unnatural offences' cases in 2023; the 2024 data has no figure, as the section was deleted in BNS
label.hg: 2023 mein 'unnatural offences' ke cases; 2024 ke data mein inka koi figure nahi, kyunki BNS mein yeh section hata diya gaya

label.en: cases of the five offences once grouped as 'outraging modesty' in 2024, against 83,891 in 2023
label.hg: 2024 mein un paanch offences ke cases jo pehle 'outraging modesty' mein saath gine jaate the; 2023 mein 83,891

claim.en: Only 9,853 rape cases were recorded in 2024, the first year of the new law.
claim.hg: Naye law ke pehle saal, 2024 mein, sirf 9,853 rape cases record hue.

truth.en: That is only the BNS column. Offences committed before 1 July 2024 stayed under the IPC, which recorded 19,683 more: 29,536 in all.
truth.hg: Yeh sirf BNS wala column hai. 1 July 2024 se pehle hue offences IPC mein hi register hue, jahan 19,683 aur cases hain: total 29,536.

actions.en: Before you share a 2024 crime figure, check whether it is the IPC column, the BNS column or the total.
actions.hg: 2024 ka koi bhi crime figure share karne se pehle check karo: yeh IPC column hai, BNS column hai, ya total.

actions.en: Compare years only on the same definition, and read NCRB's footnotes for new, deleted and split categories.
actions.hg: Saalon ko sirf same definition par compare karo, aur new, deleted ya split categories ke liye NCRB ke footnotes padho.

actions.en: Treat a missing category as missing data, not as proof that a crime stopped.
actions.hg: Koi category gayab ho jaaye toh use missing data samjho, is baat ka saboot nahi ki crime ruk gaya.

actions.en: To report a sexual offence, go to any police station for a Zero FIR or file an e-FIR, and ask for your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Sexual offence report karne ke liye kisi bhi police station mein Zero FIR karwao ya e-FIR file karo, aur FIR ki free copy maango.

title.en: 2,118, then 1,753, then 1,537: what India's falling gang-rape count includes and leaves out
title.hg: 2,118, phir 1,753, phir 1,537: India ka girta gang-rape count kya ginta hai aur kya chhod deta hai

dek.en: Registered gang rapes fell by more than a quarter in two years. Before anyone calls that progress, here is what the count covers, where gang rapes of children and those ending in death are filed instead, and what the law prescribes.
dek.hg: Do saal mein registered gang rapes ek-chauthai se zyada ghat gaye. Ise progress kehne se pehle jaaniye ki yeh count kya cover karta hai, bachchiyon ke gang rape aur maut par khatam hone wale gang rape kahan file hote hain, aur law kya saza tay karta hai.

statLabel.en: gang-rape cases registered in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein India mein register hue gang-rape cases

label.en: gang-rape cases registered in India in 2022
label.hg: 2022 mein India mein register hue gang-rape cases

label.en: gang-rape cases registered in 2023
label.hg: 2023 mein register hue gang-rape cases

label.en: gang-rape cases registered in 2024, 30 of them involving girls under 18
label.hg: 2024 mein register hue gang-rape cases, jinmein se 30 mein 18 saal se kam ki ladkiyan thi

label.en: minimum rigorous imprisonment for each member of a group that rapes a woman (Section 70, BNS)
label.hg: kisi aurat ka rape karne wale group ke har member ke liye kam se kam rigorous imprisonment (Section 70, BNS)

claim.en: Gang rapes are falling, so women and girls are safer.
claim.hg: Gang rapes ghat rahe hain, isliye aurtein aur ladkiyan ab zyada surakshit hain.

truth.en: Registered gang-rape cases fell from 2,118 in 2022 to 1,537 in 2024. NCRB itself warns that registered crime is not the same as crime, and the count leaves out many gang rapes of children and those that end in murder.
truth.hg: Registered gang-rape cases 2022 ke 2,118 se ghat kar 2024 mein 1,537 reh gaye. NCRB khud warn karta hai ki registered crime aur asli crime ek cheez nahi hain, aur yeh count bachchiyon ke kai gang rapes aur murder par khatam hone wale gang rapes ko chhod deta hai.

actions.en: Read a falling count as 'fewer cases registered', not 'fewer attacks', until other evidence confirms it.
actions.hg: Girte count ko 'kam cases register hue' padhiye, 'kam hamle hue' nahi, jab tak koi aur saboot iski pushti na kare.

actions.en: If a woman is attacked by more than one man, make sure the FIR records every attacker, even those she cannot name: under Section 70, each member of the group is guilty of rape.
actions.hg: Agar kisi aurat par ek se zyada aadmi hamla karein, toh pakka kijiye ki FIR mein har hamlawar darj ho, unka bhi jinka naam woh nahi jaanti: Section 70 ke tahat group ka har member rape ka doshi hai.

actions.en: If the survivor is under 18, call 1098 or 112. The law bars anticipatory bail for anyone accused of gang-raping a girl under 18.
actions.hg: Agar survivor 18 saal se kam ki hai, toh 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye. 18 saal se kam ki ladki ke gang rape ke kisi bhi accused ko law anticipatory bail nahi deta.

actions.en: Tell survivors they can apply to the District Legal Services Authority for compensation: Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh for gang rape under NALSA's 2018 scheme, and 50% more for a minor.
actions.hg: Survivors ko bataiye ki woh District Legal Services Authority mein compensation ke liye apply kar sakti hain: NALSA ki 2018 scheme mein gang rape ke liye Rs 5 lakh se Rs 10 lakh, aur minor ke liye 50% zyada.

title.en: 263 million women, 370 million childhood survivors: the world's sexual violence count, and where India sits
title.hg: 263 million auratein, 370 million childhood survivors: duniya mein sexual violence ki ginti, aur India kahan khada hai

dek.en: WHO and UNICEF have now counted sexual violence across the world, for adults and for children. India's own figures look small beside them. Here is what each global number measures, where India fits, and why a low percentage here reads as silence as much as safety.
dek.hg: WHO aur UNICEF ne ab poori duniya mein sexual violence ki ginti ki hai, adults ki bhi aur bachchon ki bhi. Unke saamne India ke apne figures chhote lagte hain. Yahan har global number ka matlab hai, India usmein kahan fit hota hai, aur yahan ka kam percentage jitna safety ka, utna hi chuppi ka sanket kyun hai.

statLabel.en: girls and women alive today who were raped or sexually assaulted as children (UNICEF)
statLabel.hg: aaj zinda ladkiyan aur auratein jinke saath bachpan mein rape ya sexual assault hua (UNICEF)

label.en: women worldwide subjected to sexual violence by a non-partner since age 15 (WHO, 2023 estimates)
label.hg: duniya bhar ki auratein jinhone 15 saal ki umar ke baad kisi non-partner se sexual violence jheli (WHO, 2023 estimates)

label.en: girls and women alive today who were raped or sexually assaulted before 18, about 1 in 8 (UNICEF, 2024)
label.hg: aaj zinda ladkiyan aur auratein jinke saath 18 se pehle rape ya sexual assault hua, lagbhag 8 mein se 1 (UNICEF, 2024)

label.en: of those childhood survivors are in Central and Southern Asia, the UNICEF region that includes India
label.hg: in childhood survivors mein se Central aur Southern Asia mein hain, UNICEF ka woh region jismein India aata hai

label.en: of women aged 15-49 in India: WHO's estimate of lifetime non-partner sexual violence, which WHO says reflects disclosure as well as violence
label.hg: India mein 15-49 saal ki auraton mein: lifetime non-partner sexual violence ka WHO estimate, jo WHO ke mutabik violence ke saath disclosure ko bhi dikhata hai

actions.en: Before you quote a sexual violence figure, check whether it counts survivors alive today or cases in one year, and which ages it covers.
actions.hg: Sexual violence ka koi figure quote karne se pehle check kijiye: woh aaj zinda survivors ginta hai ya ek saal ke cases, aur kis umar ko cover karta hai.

actions.en: Never read India's low survey percentage as proof of safety. Treat it as a floor.
actions.hg: India ke kam survey percentage ko kabhi safety ka saboot mat samjhiye. Use kam se kam ginti maaniye.

actions.en: Talk to teenagers, not only small children, about consent, grooming and online pressure: UNICEF finds that risk peaks between 14 and 17.
actions.hg: Sirf chhote bachchon se nahi, teenagers se bhi consent, grooming aur online pressure par baat kijiye: UNICEF ke mutabik risk 14 se 17 saal ke beech sabse zyada hota hai.

actions.en: Ask boys too: around 1 in 11 boys and men were raped or sexually assaulted in childhood.
actions.hg: Ladkon se bhi poochhiye: lagbhag 11 mein se 1 ladke aur aadmi ke saath bachpan mein rape ya sexual assault hua.

actions.en: If a child or teenager tells you about sexual abuse, believe them and call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha ya teenager aapko sexual abuse ke baare mein bataye, to uska yakeen kijiye aur 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye.

title.en: Before you share a rape statistic: six questions that separate data from noise
title.hg: Rape ka koi statistic share karne se pehle: chhe sawaal jo data ko noise se alag karte hain

dek.en: Every new edition of NCRB's Crime in India turns into rankings and 'rape capital' headlines. Six checks, each tested on a real 2024 figure, tell you whether a number says what the post claims it says.
dek.hg: NCRB ki Crime in India ka har naya edition rankings aur 'rape capital' headlines mein badal jaata hai. Chhe checks, har ek 2024 ke asli figure par test kiya hua, batate hain ki koi number sach mein wahi kehta hai ya nahi jo post claim kar rahi hai.

statLabel.en: crimes against women registered per lakh women in India, 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein India mein har lakh auraton par register hue crimes against women

label.en: crimes against women registered per lakh women in 2024: a rate, not a count, and per lakh women, not per lakh people
label.hg: 2024 mein har lakh auraton par register hue crimes against women: yeh rate hai, count nahi, aur har lakh auraton par hai, har lakh logon par nahi

label.en: Delhi's 2024 crime-against-women rate as a Union Territory and in the city table: the same 13,396 cases over two different populations
label.hg: 2024 mein Delhi ka crime-against-women rate, Union Territory ke roop mein aur city table mein: wahi 13,396 cases, do alag populations par

label.en: rape cases pending trial at the end of 2024; the larger 2,06,777 is every rape case before the courts that year
label.hg: 2024 ke end mein trial ka intezaar kar rahe rape cases; bada number 2,06,777 us saal courts ke saamne aaye saare rape cases ka hai

claim.en: The city or state with the highest crime rate is the most dangerous place for women.
claim.hg: Jis city ya state ka crime rate sabse zyada hai, woh auraton ke liye sabse khatarnaak jagah hai.

truth.en: NCRB itself says more registered crime in a city 'is not an indicator of its being comparatively unsafe'. A high rate can reflect better registration, and a low one can reflect silence.
truth.hg: NCRB khud kehta hai ki kisi city mein zyada registered crime 'is not an indicator of its being comparatively unsafe'. Ooncha rate behtar registration ki wajah se ho sakta hai, aur neecha rate chuppi ki wajah se.

actions.en: Before you forward a crime statistic, find its year, its table and whether it is a count or a rate.
actions.hg: Koi bhi crime statistic forward karne se pehle uska saal, uski table, aur yeh dekhiye ki woh count hai ya rate.

actions.en: Say 'registered cases', not 'rapes', for any number that comes from police data.
actions.hg: Police data se aaye har number ke liye 'rapes' nahi, 'registered cases' kahiye.

actions.en: Never rank a city against a state: NCRB divides them by population figures 13 years apart.
actions.hg: Kisi city ko kisi state ke saath rank mat kijiye: NCRB dono ko aise population figures se divide karta hai jinke beech 13 saal ka fark hai.

actions.en: Quote the conviction rate as the share of completed trials that ended in conviction, never as the share of rapists convicted.
actions.hg: Conviction rate ko poore hue trials mein conviction ka share bataiye, 'kitne rapists ko saza mili' kabhi nahi.

actions.en: When a forward gets a number wrong, reply calmly in the same group with the correct figure and its source.
actions.hg: Jab koi forward number galat bataye, toh usi group mein shaanti se sahi figure aur uska source reply kijiye.

title.en: 82% of married survivors name their husband. The law keeps almost all of them out of India's rape statistics
title.hg: 82% married survivors apne husband ka naam leti hain. Law inmein se lagbhag kisi ko India ke rape statistics tak pahunchne nahi deta

dek.en: India's health survey and its crime records give very different answers to who commits sexual violence against married women. One sentence in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita explains the gap, and it bends every national rape figure.
dek.hg: Married auraton ke saath sexual violence kaun karta hai? India ka health survey aur police records iske bilkul alag jawab dete hain. Yeh gap Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ke ek sentence se aata hai, aur yahi sentence har national rape figure ko tedha kar deta hai.

statLabel.en: of married survivors of sexual violence named their current husband (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: sexual violence jhelne wali married auraton ne apne current husband ka naam liya (NFHS-5)

label.en: of ever-married women who had faced sexual violence named their current husband; 14% named a former husband (NFHS-5)
label.hg: sexual violence jhelne wali ever-married auraton ne current husband ka naam liya; 14% ne former husband ka (NFHS-5)

label.en: of ever-married women aged 18-49 said a husband had physically forced them into intercourse (NFHS-5)
label.hg: ever-married auraton (18-49) ne kaha ki husband ne physically force karke unke saath intercourse kiya (NFHS-5)

label.en: 2024 rape cases in the only NCRB group that mentions husbands: separated ones, mixed with friends and partners
label.hg: 2024 ke rape cases us akele NCRB group mein jismein husbands ka zikr hai: sirf alag reh rahe husbands, woh bhi friends aur partners ke saath mixed

label.en: of women abused only by their current husband had ever sought help (NFHS-5)
label.hg: sirf current husband ki violence jhelne wali auraton mein se itni ne kabhi help maangi (NFHS-5)

claim.en: India's rape statistics show how much rape women face.
claim.hg: India ke rape statistics batate hain ki auratein kitna rape jhelti hain.

truth.en: They leave out almost all forced sex by husbands, the men married survivors name most often, because the law says it is not rape.
truth.hg: Inmein husbands ki zabardasti lagbhag poori tarah missing hai, jabki married survivors sabse zyada husband ka hi naam leti hain, kyunki law ise rape nahi maanta.

actions.en: If your husband forces sex on you, you can seek help now: call 181 or 112, ask about a protection order under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act, or file a cruelty complaint.
actions.hg: Agar aapka husband aapke saath zabardasti sex karta hai, toh aap abhi help le sakti hain: 181 ya 112 par call kijiye, 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act mein protection order ke baare mein poochhiye, ya cruelty ki complaint kijiye.

actions.en: If you are pregnant after forced sex by your husband, you can seek an abortion up to 24 weeks as a rape survivor, without an FIR.
actions.hg: Agar husband ki zabardasti se aap pregnant hain, toh rape survivor ke taur par 24 hafte tak abortion karwa sakti hain, bina FIR ke.

actions.en: If a friend says her husband forces her, believe her. 'He is your husband' is not an answer.
actions.hg: Agar koi dost bataye ki uska husband zabardasti karta hai, toh uski baat par yakeen kijiye. 'Woh tumhara husband hai' koi jawab nahi hai.

actions.en: Read every national rape figure as missing forced sex by husbands, except husbands living apart from their wives.
actions.hg: Har national rape figure ko aise padhiye: ismein husbands ki zabardasti gayab hai, sirf alag reh rahe husbands ko chhodkar.

actions.en: If the Supreme Court strikes down the exception, expect registered rape figures to rise, and read that rise as a change in the law, not a sudden surge in violence.
actions.hg: Agar Supreme Court yeh exception khatam karta hai, toh registered rape figures badhne ki ummeed rakhiye. Us badhat ko law ka badlaav samjhiye, violence ka achanak badhna nahi.

title.en: 24,923 in 2012, 38,947 in 2016, 29,536 in 2024: what India's rape count actually measures
title.hg: 2012 mein 24,923, 2016 mein 38,947, 2024 mein 29,536: India ka rape count asal mein kya measure karta hai

dek.en: Twelve years of police data show a jump, a peak and a slow fall. Read year by year, the line follows changes in the law, in filing and in policing as closely as it follows violence.
dek.hg: Barah saal ka police data dekhiye: pehle jump, phir peak, phir dheere-dheere girawat. Par saal-dar-saal padhiye, toh yeh line jitni violence ke saath chalti hai, utni hi law, case file karne ke tareeke aur policing ke saath bhi chalti hai.

statLabel.en: rape cases registered in 2016, the highest count of 2012-2024
statLabel.hg: rape cases 2016 mein register hue, 2012-2024 ke beech sabse zyada

label.en: rape cases registered in 2012, the last year under the old definition
label.hg: 2012 mein register hue rape cases, purani definition ka aakhri saal

label.en: rape cases in 2013, the first year under the wider definition
label.hg: 2013 ke rape cases, nayi aur badi definition ka pehla saal

label.en: rape cases in 2020, the lockdown year: the lowest count of 2013-2024
label.hg: 2020 ke rape cases, lockdown ka saal: 2013-2024 ke beech sabse kam count

label.en: adult women recorded under the rape head in 2024, more than in 2018
label.hg: 2024 mein rape head mein darj adult women, 2018 se zyada

claim.en: A falling rape count means fewer women and girls are being raped.
claim.hg: Rape cases gir rahe hain, matlab women aur girls ke saath rape kam ho raha hai.

truth.en: NCRB itself warns that registered crime is not the same as crime. Since 2018 the count has fallen because girls' cases moved to the POCSO table; the number of adult women in the rape count went up.
truth.hg: NCRB khud kehta hai ki registered crime aur asli crime ek cheez nahi hain. 2018 ke baad count isliye gira kyunki girls ke cases POCSO wali table mein chale gaye. Rape count mein adult women ki sankhya toh badhi hai.

actions.en: Before you share a rape figure, check the year, the legal definition in force then and whether child cases filed under POCSO are included.
actions.hg: Koi bhi rape figure share karne se pehle check kijiye: kaunsa saal hai, us waqt law mein rape ki definition kya thi, aur POCSO wale child cases usmein jude hain ya nahi.

actions.en: Treat a fall in registered cases as a question about reporting and filing, not as proof that violence fell.
actions.hg: Registered cases giren, toh use sawaal ki tarah padhiye: report karna mushkil toh nahi hua, cases kisi aur head mein toh nahi ja rahe? Ise violence kam hone ka saboot mat maaniye.

actions.en: Know the rule: police must record a rape complaint wherever the crime happened, and an officer who refuses commits a crime.
actions.hg: Yeh rule yaad rakhiye: rape ki complaint kisi bhi police station mein darj ho sakti hai, crime kahin bhi hua ho. Complaint likhne se mana karne wala police officer khud crime karta hai.

actions.en: If someone confides in you, believe them first, then offer to go with them to the police or a One Stop Centre, or to call 181 (1098 if they are under 18).
actions.hg: Agar koi aapko apne saath hui violence ke baare mein bataye, toh sabse pehle uspar bharosa kijiye. Phir poochiye ki kya aap uske saath police ya One Stop Centre chalein, ya 181 par call karein (agar woh 18 saal se kam ka hai, toh 1098).

title.en: Kerala tops India's tables for reported child abuse and harassment. That may be what reporting looks like
title.hg: Reported child abuse aur harassment ki tables mein Kerala sabse upar hai. Shayad reporting aisi hi dikhti hai

dek.en: Kerala registered child sexual abuse at about three times the national rate in 2024 and led India in registered harassment cases at offices and on public transport. Surveys of women tell a different story. The high numbers may describe a state where complaints get written down.
dek.hg: 2024 mein Kerala ne child sexual abuse ko national rate se qareeb teen guna rate par darj kiya, aur offices aur public transport mein harassment ke darj cases mein poore India mein aage raha. Aurton ke surveys kuch aur kehte hain. Ho sakta hai yeh bade numbers ek aise state ki tasveer hon jahan complaint likhi jaati hai.

statLabel.en: POCSO cases per lakh children in Kerala, the highest of any state (2024)
statLabel.hg: Kerala mein har lakh bachchon par POCSO case, kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada (2024)

label.en: POCSO cases per lakh children registered in Kerala in 2024; India: 15.6
label.hg: 2024 mein Kerala mein har lakh bachchon par darj POCSO case; India: 15.6

label.en: sexual harassment cases in public transport registered in Kerala in 2024, the most of any state; Delhi: 18
label.hg: 2024 mein Kerala mein public transport mein sexual harassment ke darj case, kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada; Delhi: 18

label.en: of India's 616 criminal cases under the Domestic Violence Act in 2024 came from Kerala
label.hg: 2024 mein Domestic Violence Act ke tahat India ke 616 criminal cases mein se itne Kerala ke the

label.en: ever-married women in Kerala who reported physical or sexual violence by a husband in NFHS-5 (2019-21); India: 29.2%
label.hg: NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein Kerala ki shaadishuda aurtein jinhone pati ki physical ya sexual violence report ki; India: 29.2%

claim.en: The state with the most reported abuse must be the most dangerous one.
claim.hg: Jis state mein sabse zyada abuse report hota hai, wahi sabse khatarnaak hoga.

truth.en: NCRB itself says a rise in registered crime and a rise in crime are two different things. A high count can mean that people complain and police write it down.
truth.hg: NCRB khud kehta hai ki darj crime ka badhna aur crime ka badhna do alag cheezein hain. Zyada count ka matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki log complaint karte hain aur police use likhti hai.

actions.en: Before you share a 'most unsafe state' ranking, check whether it uses counts or rates, and what surveys say about the same state.
actions.hg: Kisi 'sabse unsafe state' wali ranking ko share karne se pehle check kijiye ki woh count use kar rahi hai ya rate, aur usi state ke baare mein surveys kya kehte hain.

actions.en: Harassed on a bus or at work? You can complain to the police. At work, a woman can also go to the Internal Committee, or to the district's Local Committee if the workplace has fewer than 10 workers.
actions.hg: Bus mein ya kaam par harassment hua? Aap police mein complaint kar sakte hain. Kaam ki jagah par aurat Internal Committee ke paas bhi ja sakti hai, ya agar workplace mein 10 se kam workers hain toh district ki Local Committee ke paas.

actions.en: If you are a teacher, doctor or counsellor and a child tells you about sexual abuse, POCSO requires you to report it. Do not promise to keep it secret.
actions.hg: Agar aap teacher, doctor ya counsellor hain aur koi bachcha aapko sexual abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh POCSO ke tahat aapko report karna hi hoga. Use secret rakhne ka vaada mat kijiye.

actions.en: If a protection order under the Domestic Violence Act is broken, report the breach to the police: breaking the order is a crime in itself.
actions.hg: Agar Domestic Violence Act ke tahat mila protection order toda jaaye, toh police ko report kijiye: order todna apne aap mein crime hai.

actions.en: When your own state's numbers are low, ask your police and child-protection officers who is not being heard.
actions.hg: Jab aapke apne state ke numbers kam hon, toh apni police aur child-protection officers se poochhiye ki kiski baat suni nahi ja rahi.

title.en: Kolkata registered 12 rape cases in 2024, Hyderabad 358: what two cities reveal about how rape gets counted
title.hg: Kolkata mein 2024 mein 12 rape cases register hue, Hyderabad mein 358: do shehar batate hain ki rape ki ginti kaise hoti hai

dek.en: Kolkata's rape count has stayed at about a dozen a year for three years, while the same city records far more child sexual abuse cases. Hyderabad's has more than tripled in two years. Neither number is a safety rating. Both raise questions only the police can answer.
dek.hg: Kolkata mein rape cases ki ginti teen saal se lagbhag ek darjan par atki hai, jabki usi shehar mein child sexual abuse ke kahin zyada cases record hote hain. Hyderabad ki ginti do saal mein teen guna se bhi zyada ho gayi. Dono mein se koi number safety rating nahi hai. Dono aise sawaal uthate hain jinka jawab sirf police de sakti hai.

statLabel.en: rape cases registered in Kolkata in 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein Kolkata mein register hue rape cases

label.en: rape cases registered in Hyderabad in 2024, more than three times its 2022 count
label.hg: 2024 mein Hyderabad mein register hue rape cases, 2022 ki ginti se teen guna se bhi zyada

label.en: registered rape cases per lakh women in Kolkata in 2024, the lowest of India's 19 largest cities
label.hg: 2024 mein Kolkata mein har lakh auraton par register hue rape cases, India ke 19 sabse bade shehron mein sabse kam

label.en: POCSO cases with girl victims registered in Kolkata in the same year
label.hg: usi saal Kolkata mein register hue girl victims wale POCSO cases

label.en: of the crime-against-women cases police in Kolkata disposed of were charge-sheeted, the highest of the 19 cities
label.hg: Kolkata police ne jitne crime-against-women cases dispose kiye, unme se itne mein charge-sheet hui, 19 shehron mein sabse zyada

claim.en: Kolkata registers only a dozen rapes a year, so it must be India's safest city for women.
claim.hg: Kolkata mein saal mein sirf ek darjan rape register hote hain, toh yeh India mein auraton ke liye sabse safe shehar hoga.

truth.en: A registered count shows what reached the police books, and under which section. NCRB itself warns that more registered crime is 'not an indicator' that a city is less safe; by the same logic, a tiny count cannot prove that a city is safe.
truth.hg: Register hui ginti sirf yeh dikhati hai ki police ke records mein kya pahuncha, aur kis section mein. NCRB khud warn karta hai ki zyada registered crime is baat ka 'not an indicator' hai ki shehar kam safe hai; isi logic se, bahut chhoti ginti bhi yeh saabit nahi karti ki shehar safe hai.

actions.en: Never share a city 'safety ranking' built on registered rape counts alone.
actions.hg: Sirf registered rape counts par bani kisi 'city safety ranking' ko kabhi share mat kijiye.

actions.en: When a number looks too low or jumps too fast, check the same city's POCSO cases and total crimes against women in the same NCRB table.
actions.hg: Jab koi number bahut kam lage ya achanak bahut badh jaye, toh usi NCRB table mein usi shehar ke POCSO cases aur total crimes against women bhi dekhiye.

actions.en: If a police station will not register a rape complaint, say that registration is mandatory and that refusing is an offence under Section 199 BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police station rape complaint register karne se mana kare, toh kahiye ki registration mandatory hai aur mana karna Section 199 BNS ke under offence hai.

actions.en: Remember that you can report at any police station, wherever the crime happened, or send the complaint electronically under Section 173 BNSS.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye: Section 173 BNSS ke under aap kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakti hain, crime chahe kahin bhi hua ho, ya complaint electronically bhej sakti hain.

actions.en: Ask your city police, through an RTI application, how many sexual-violence complaints they registered under each section last year.
actions.hg: RTI application ke zariye apni city police se poochiye ki pichhle saal unhone sexual violence ki kitni complaints kis section mein register ki.

title.en: 28,046 rape cases in 2020: the lockdown low that was not good news
title.hg: 2020 mein 28,046 rape cases: lockdown wala 'low' jo achhi khabar nahi tha

dek.en: In the COVID-19 year, police registered the fewest rape cases of 2013-2024 and courts posted the highest rape conviction rate of 2012-2024. Neither number shows that women were safer: courts finished far fewer trials, and fewer registered cases are not the same as less crime.
dek.hg: COVID-19 wale saal mein police ne 2013-2024 ke beech sabse kam rape cases register kiye, aur courts ne 2012-2024 ka sabse ooncha rape conviction rate dikhaya. Dono mein se koi bhi number yeh nahi dikhata ki aurtein zyada safe thi: courts ne bahut kam trials poore kiye, aur kam registered cases ka matlab kam crime nahi hota.

statLabel.en: rape cases registered in 2020, the lockdown year
statLabel.hg: rape cases 2020 mein register hue, lockdown wale saal mein

label.en: rape cases registered in 2020, the lowest count of 2013-2024
label.hg: 2020 mein register hue rape cases, 2013-2024 ke beech sabse kam count

label.en: crimes against women registered in 2020, against 4,28,278 in 2021
label.hg: 2020 mein register hue crimes against women, jabki 2021 mein 4,28,278

label.en: conviction rate in rape trials completed in 2020, the highest of 2012-2024
label.hg: 2020 mein poore hue rape trials mein conviction rate, 2012-2024 mein sabse zyada

label.en: rape cases that ended in conviction in 2020, down from 4,640 in 2019
label.hg: 2020 mein conviction par khatam hue rape cases, 2019 ke 4,640 se kam

claim.en: 2020 was a good year: fewer rapes were reported and more rape trials ended in conviction.
claim.hg: 2020 achha saal tha: rape ke kam cases report hue aur zyada rape trials conviction par khatam hue.

truth.en: Fewer registered cases do not mean fewer rapes: 2020 was the lockdown year, and the count was back to 31,677 in 2021. The conviction rate rose because courts finished far fewer trials: 3,814 convictions in 2020 against 4,640 in 2019.
truth.hg: Kam registered cases ka matlab kam rape nahi hota: 2020 lockdown ka saal tha, aur 2021 mein count wapas 31,677 par aa gaya. Conviction rate isliye badha kyunki courts ne bahut kam trials poore kiye: 2020 mein 3,814 convictions, jabki 2019 mein 4,640.

actions.en: When a crime count falls, ask first whether reaching the police or the courts became harder that year.
actions.hg: Jab koi crime count gire, toh sabse pehle poochiye: kya us saal police ya court tak pahunchna mushkil ho gaya tha?

actions.en: Read a conviction rate together with the number of convictions and the number of trials completed.
actions.hg: Conviction rate ko hamesha convictions ki sankhya aur poore hue trials ki sankhya ke saath padhiye.

actions.en: Save 112 (emergency) and 181 (Women Helpline) where you can call them quietly, and share them with the women in your family.
actions.hg: 112 (emergency) aur 181 (Women Helpline) aise save kijiye ki chupchaap call kar sakein, aur ghar ki aurton ke saath bhi share kijiye.

actions.en: Remember that a complaint can be made at any police station, or sent electronically as an e-FIR and signed within three days, wherever the crime happened.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye: complaint kisi bhi police station mein ki ja sakti hai, ya electronic tareeke se e-FIR ke roop mein bhej kar teen din ke andar sign ki ja sakti hai, crime chahe kahin bhi hua ho.

actions.en: If a friend lives with someone who hurts her, check in with her at fixed times and agree on a signal that means 'call for help'.
actions.hg: Agar aapki koi dost aise insaan ke saath rehti hai jo use hurt karta hai, toh fixed time par uska haal poochte rahiye aur ek signal tay kijiye jiska matlab ho 'madad bulao'.

title.en: Tamil Nadu, Nagaland, Gujarat: why India's lowest crime-against-women rates are not proof of safety
title.hg: Tamil Nadu, Nagaland, Gujarat: India ke sabse kam crime-against-women rates safety ka saboot kyun nahi hain

dek.en: Nagaland, Manipur, Gujarat and Tamil Nadu sit near the bottom of India's 2024 police tables for crimes against women. Set a national survey beside them and the low numbers split in two: some track less violence, others less reporting.
dek.hg: 2024 ki police tables mein women ke khilaaf crime ke maamle mein Nagaland, Manipur, Gujarat aur Tamil Nadu sabse neeche ke aas-paas hain. Inke bagal mein ek national survey rakhiye, toh yeh kam numbers do hisson mein bant jaate hain: kahin yeh kam violence dikhate hain, kahin kam reporting.

statLabel.en: registered rapes per lakh women in Tamil Nadu, 2024
statLabel.hg: Tamil Nadu mein har ek lakh women par registered rapes, 2024

label.en: crimes against women registered per lakh women in Nagaland in 2024, India's lowest (national rate: 64.6)
label.hg: 2024 mein Nagaland mein har ek lakh women par darj crimes against women, India mein sabse kam (national rate: 64.6)

label.en: of ever-married women in Tamil Nadu reported physical or sexual violence by a husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: Tamil Nadu ki ever-married women jinhone pati ki physical ya sexual violence ke baare mein bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: the same figure for Manipur, where police registered 12.0 crimes against women per lakh women in 2024
label.hg: Manipur ke liye yahi figure, jahan 2024 mein police ne har ek lakh women par 12.0 crimes against women darj kiye

label.en: of Indian women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5)
label.hg: Indian women jinhone physical ya sexual violence jheli, par na kabhi madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya (NFHS-5)

claim.en: The state with the lowest rate of crime against women is the safest state for women.
claim.hg: Jis state mein women ke khilaaf crime ka rate sabse kam hai, wahi women ke liye sabse safe state hai.

truth.en: A registered rate counts complaints that became FIRs. Where most women never tell anyone, a low rate can measure silence as easily as safety, and NCRB itself warns against ranking places on its numbers.
truth.hg: Registered rate sirf un complaints ko ginta hai jo FIR bani. Jahan zyadatar women kabhi kisi ko batati hi nahi, wahan kam rate safety jitna hi khamoshi ko bhi naap sakta hai, aur NCRB khud apne numbers ke dum par jagahon ki ranking karne se mana karta hai.

actions.en: Treat every 'safest state for women' list as a question: check the state's NFHS survey figures before you share it.
actions.hg: 'Women ke liye sabse safe state' wali har list ko ek sawaal ki tarah lijiye: share karne se pehle us state ke NFHS survey figures check kijiye.

actions.en: Read a state's rape rate together with its POCSO cases and its crime-against-women rate from the same NCRB report.
actions.hg: Kisi state ka rape rate, uske POCSO cases aur uska crime against women rate, teeno ek hi NCRB report se saath mein padhiye.

actions.en: Look at how many cases sit behind a low rate before you trust it.
actions.hg: Kisi kam rate par bharosa karne se pehle dekhiye ki uske peechhe kitne cases hain.

actions.en: If someone tells you about violence at home, believe them first, and share 181 (Women Helpline) and 112 (emergency).
actions.hg: Agar koi aapko ghar mein ho rahi violence ke baare mein bataye, toh pehle uspar bharosa kijiye, aur 181 (Women Helpline) aur 112 (emergency) ke number share kijiye.

actions.en: Any police station must register a complaint about a cognizable offence wherever it happened (Zero FIR), and a woman's complaint of sexual violence must be recorded by a woman officer.
actions.hg: Cognizable offence ki complaint har police station ko darj karni hi hoti hai, chahe incident kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR), aur kisi aurat ki sexual violence ki complaint ek woman officer hi record karegi.

title.en: Jaipur, Indore and Delhi top India's city rape rates. The rankings rest on a 2011 headcount
title.hg: Jaipur, Indore aur Delhi shehron ki rape rate list mein sabse upar. Par yeh ranking 2011 ki ginti par tiki hai

dek.en: NCRB's 2024 tables give Jaipur a registered rape rate of 34.2 per lakh women, nearly twice that of Indore, the next city.
