But every city rate divides this year's cases by the 2011 Census population, and 34 of the 53 cities NCRB tracks never appear in print. Here is how to read your own city's line.
dek.hg: NCRB ki 2024 tables ke hisaab se Jaipur ka registered rape rate har ek lakh women par 34.2 hai, agle shehar Indore se lagbhag do guna. Par har shehar ka rate is saal ke cases ko 2011 Census ki aabadi se divide karke nikalta hai, aur NCRB jin 53 shehron ka data jama karta hai, unmein se 34 print mein kabhi aate hi nahi. Apne shehar ki line kaise padhein, yahan samajhiye.

statLabel.en: registered rapes per lakh women in Jaipur, highest of 19 metros (2024)
statLabel.hg: Jaipur mein har ek lakh women par registered rapes, 19 metros mein sabse zyada (2024)

label.en: rape cases registered in India's 19 printed metropolitan cities in 2024; Delhi alone had 1,058
label.hg: 2024 mein print hone wale India ke 19 metro shehron mein darj rape cases; akele Delhi mein 1,058

label.en: Delhi's 2024 crime-against-women rate as a city (2011 Census base) and as a union territory (2024 projection), from the same 13,396 cases
label.hg: 2024 mein Delhi ka crime against women rate, shehar ke roop mein (2011 Census base) aur union territory ke roop mein (2024 projection), dono ek hi 13,396 cases se

label.en: metropolitan cities whose tables NCRB prints; the other 34 are only on its website
label.hg: metro shehar jinki tables NCRB print karta hai; baaki 34 sirf uski website par hain

claim.en: The city with the highest crime rate is the most dangerous city for women.
claim.hg: Jis shehar ka crime rate sabse zyada hai, wahi women ke liye sabse khatarnaak shehar hai.

truth.en: City rates divide this year's cases by the 2011 population, and NCRB itself says more registered crime is not an indicator that a city is less safe. A high rate can reflect a city that has grown, or police who write complaints down.
truth.hg: Shehron ke rates is saal ke cases ko 2011 ki aabadi se divide karte hain, aur NCRB khud kehta hai ki zyada registered crime is baat ka indicator nahi ki shehar kam safe hai. Oonche rate ka matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki shehar 2011 ke baad bahut badh gaya, ya police complaints likh rahi hai.

actions.en: Before forwarding an 'unsafe city' ranking, check whether it uses NCRB's city tables, and remember those rates divide by 2011 populations.
actions.hg: Kisi 'unsafe city' ranking ko forward karne se pehle check kijiye ki woh NCRB ki city tables par bani hai ya nahi, aur yaad rakhiye ki un rates mein 2011 ki aabadi se divide kiya jaata hai.

actions.en: Compare your city with its own earlier years, not with a state: NCRB says city and state rates are not comparable.
actions.hg: Apne shehar ko uske hi pichhle saalon se compare kijiye, kisi state se nahi: NCRB kehta hai ki city aur state ke rates comparable nahi hain.

actions.en: Read your city's rape count, its POCSO count and its charge-sheeting rate together, not the rate alone.
actions.hg: Apne shehar ka rape count, POCSO count aur charge-sheeting rate saath mein padhiye, sirf rate nahi.

actions.en: If your city is not among the 19 in print, look for its figures in the tables NCRB posts only on its website.
actions.hg: Agar aapka shehar print wale 19 mein nahi hai, toh uske figures un tables mein dhoondhiye jo NCRB sirf apni website par daalta hai.

actions.en: If you or a friend is assaulted, any police station must register the complaint wherever it happened; call 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar aapke ya kisi dost ke saath assault hua hai, toh koi bhi police station complaint darj karne ke liye bound hai, chahe incident kahin bhi hua ho. Emergency mein 112 par call kijiye.

title.en: What NCRB's 'false' rape cases really are: 3,776 police closures, not 3,776 proven lies
title.hg: NCRB ke 'false' rape cases asal mein kya hain: 3,776 police closures, 3,776 saabit jhooth nahi

dek.en: Every year one column of India's crime tables is passed around as proof that women lie about rape. Here is what that column records, what it cannot tell you, and how to read the headline built on it.
dek.hg: Har saal India ki crime tables ka ek column is baat ka 'saboot' bana kar ghumaaya jaata hai ki aurtein rape ke baare mein jhooth bolti hain. Yahan samjhiye ki woh column asal mein kya record karta hai, kya nahi bata sakta, aur uspar bani headline ko kaise padhein.

statLabel.en: rape cases closed by police as 'false' in 2024, out of 30,272 disposed
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein police ne 'false' bata kar band kiye rape cases, kul 30,272 disposed cases mein se

label.en: rape cases police closed as 'false' in 2024: an investigating officer's label, not a court finding
label.hg: 2024 mein police ne 'false' bata kar band kiye rape cases: yeh investigating officer ka label hai, court ka faisla nahi

label.en: of rape cases police disposed of in 2024 ended in a charge-sheet (24,614 cases)
label.hg: 2024 mein police ke dispose kiye rape cases jinmein charge-sheet file hui (24,614 cases)

label.en: crime-against-women cases closed as 'false' by Rajasthan police alone in 2024, a third of India's 36,895
label.hg: 2024 mein akele Rajasthan police ne crime-against-women ke itne cases 'false' bata kar band kiye, India ke 36,895 ka ek-tihai

label.en: conviction rate in rape trials completed in 2024; an acquittal is not a finding that the complaint was false
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials mein conviction rate; acquittal ka matlab yeh nahi ki complaint jhoothi thi

claim.en: NCRB data proves that thousands of rape complaints are fake every year.
claim.hg: NCRB data saabit karta hai ki har saal hazaaron rape complaints fake hoti hain.

truth.en: In 2024 police closed 3,776 rape cases with a final report calling them 'false'. That is the investigating officer's conclusion, not a court's, and NCRB does not record why any case got the label.
truth.hg: 2024 mein police ne 3,776 rape cases ko final report mein 'false' likh kar band kiya. Yeh investigating officer ka nateeja hai, court ka nahi, aur NCRB yeh record nahi karta ki kisi case ko yeh label kyun mila.

actions.en: Before you share a 'false cases' number, ask two questions: did a police officer or a court decide it, and what is it a share of?
actions.hg: Koi 'false cases' number share karne se pehle do sawaal poochhiye: yeh police officer ne tay kiya ya court ne, aur yeh kis ginti ka hissa hai?

actions.en: If police close your complaint, ask for the reasons in writing. You are owed an update on the investigation within 90 days, and a lawyer can tell you how to challenge the closure.
actions.hg: Agar police aapki complaint band kar de, toh likhit mein wajah maangiye. 90 din ke andar investigation ka update paana aapka haq hai, aur ek lawyer aapko bata sakta hai ki closure ko kaise challenge karein.

actions.en: If police accepted that the crime happened but never traced the accused, you can still apply to the District Legal Services Authority for compensation, even with no trial.
actions.hg: Agar police ne maana ki crime hua tha par accused ko kabhi trace nahi kiya, tab bhi aap District Legal Services Authority mein compensation ke liye apply kar sakti hain, bina trial ke bhi.

actions.en: Do not read an acquittal as proof that a survivor lied. Courts acquit when guilt is not proved beyond reasonable doubt.
actions.hg: Acquittal ko is baat ka saboot mat maaniye ki survivor ne jhooth bola. Court tab acquit karti hai jab guilt reasonable doubt se pare saabit nahi hota.

actions.en: If someone tells you they were assaulted, believe them first. A delay in reporting is not a sign of lying.
actions.hg: Agar koi aapko bataye ki uske saath assault hua, toh pehle uspar yakeen kijiye. Report karne mein der hona jhooth ki nishaani nahi hai.

title.en: Among India's highest POCSO rates, fewest 'known' offenders: the Northeast breaks the pattern
title.hg: India ke sabse oonche POCSO rates mein shaamil, sabse kam 'jaan-pehchaan wale' accused: Northeast pattern tod deta hai

dek.en: Arunachal Pradesh registers rape at more than double the national rate, Nagaland and Manipur at some of India's lowest, and three north-eastern states sit near the top for child sexual abuse cases. What small numbers, police practice and surveys can and cannot explain.
dek.hg: Arunachal Pradesh mein rape national rate ke double se bhi zyada rate par register hota hai, Nagaland aur Manipur mein India ke sabse kam rates par, aur child sexual abuse cases mein teen north-eastern states top ke kareeb hain. Chhote numbers, police ka kaam karne ka tareeka aur surveys kya samjha sakte hain, aur kya nahi.

statLabel.en: share of Nagaland's rape cases with a known offender, India's lowest (2024)
statLabel.hg: Nagaland ke rape cases jinmein accused jaan-pehchaan wala tha, India mein sabse kam share (2024)

label.en: rape cases registered per lakh women in Arunachal Pradesh in 2024, against 4.3 nationally
label.hg: 2024 mein Arunachal Pradesh mein per lakh women register hue rape cases, jabki national rate 4.3

label.en: POCSO cases per lakh children in Sikkim in 2024, second only to Kerala among states (India: 15.6)
label.hg: 2024 mein Sikkim mein per lakh children POCSO cases, states mein sirf Kerala se peeche (India: 15.6)

label.en: of ever-married women in Manipur reported physical or sexual violence by a husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: Manipur ki ever-married women jinhone pati ki taraf se physical ya sexual violence report ki (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: rape cases registered in the whole of Nagaland in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein poore Nagaland mein register hue rape cases

claim.en: The Northeast is one region with one story: safer for women and children than the rest of India.
claim.hg: Northeast ek region hai aur uski ek hi kahani hai: baaki India ke muqable aurton aur bachchon ke liye zyada safe.

truth.en: Its states sit at both ends of India's tables. Arunachal Pradesh's registered rape rate is more than double the national rate, three states rank among the five with the highest POCSO rates, and Manipur's low police figures sit beside one of India's highest survey rates of violence by husbands.
truth.hg: Iske states India ki tables ke dono siron par baithe hain. Arunachal Pradesh ka registered rape rate national rate ke double se zyada hai, teen states sabse oonche POCSO rates wale paanch states mein hain, aur Manipur ke kam police figures ke saath pati ki violence ka India ke sabse oonche survey rates mein se ek dikhta hai.

actions.en: Read a state's rate together with its case count: where there are only a few dozen cases, a handful more or less can swing the rate.
actions.hg: Kisi state ka rate hamesha uske case count ke saath padhiye: jahan sirf kuch dozen cases hon, wahan do-chaar cases kam ya zyada hone se rate bahut hil jaata hai.

actions.en: Before calling any state safe, check its low police figures against survey data such as NFHS.
actions.hg: Kisi state ko safe kehne se pehle uske kam police figures ko NFHS jaise survey data se milaa kar dekhiye.

actions.en: If a child tells you about sexual abuse, report it to the police or call 1098: under POCSO, reporting is a legal duty, not a betrayal.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha aapko sexual abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh police ko report kijiye ya 1098 par call kijiye: POCSO ke tahat report karna kanooni zimmedari hai, dhokha nahi.

actions.en: Any police station must register a rape complaint wherever the crime happened (zero FIR), and a woman officer must record a woman's complaint.
actions.hg: Koi bhi police station rape ki complaint register karne ke liye bound hai, crime chahe kahin bhi hua ho (zero FIR), aur aurat ki complaint ek woman officer hi record karegi.

actions.en: If someone tells you about violence, believe them first. Most survivors never tell anyone.
actions.hg: Agar koi aapko apne saath hui violence ke baare mein bataye, toh sabse pehle uspar bharosa kijiye. Zyada tar survivors kabhi kisi ko nahi batate.

title.en: Myth: the police figure is India's rape count. Fewer than 1 in 100 women who face violence go to the police
title.hg: Myth: police ka figure hi India ka rape count hai. Sach: violence jhelne wali 100 mein se 1 se bhi kam aurat police ke paas jaati hai

dek.en: NCRB's 29,536 is the number of rape cases police registered in 2024, not the number of rapes. India's own health survey shows how few women ever take violence to the police, and the law leaves out even more.
dek.hg: NCRB ka 29,536 un rape cases ki ginti hai jo police ne 2024 mein register kiye. Yeh rapes ki ginti nahi hai. Desh ka apna health survey dikhata hai ki kitni kam auratein police tak jaati hain, aur kanoon kitna kuch gin hi nahi paata.

statLabel.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence told no one (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali auraton ne kisi ko kuch nahi bataya (NFHS-5)

label.en: rape cases registered by police in India in 2024
label.hg: rape cases jo police ne 2024 mein India mein register kiye

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali auraton ne na help maangi, na kisi ko bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of the women who did seek help went to the police (NFHS-5)
label.hg: help maangne wali auraton mein se bas itni police ke paas gayi (NFHS-5)

label.en: estimated share of sexual violence survivors in India who report it to the authorities
label.hg: India mein sexual violence survivors ka andaazan hissa jo police ya authorities tak report karta hai

claim.en: 29,536 rapes happened in India in 2024.
claim.hg: 2024 mein India mein 29,536 rapes hue.

truth.en: 29,536 is the number of rape cases police registered in 2024. Most women who face violence tell no one, fewer than 1 in 100 go to the police, and forced sex by a husband on a wife aged 18 or older is not rape in law.
truth.hg: 29,536 un rape cases ki ginti hai jo police ne 2024 mein register kiye. Violence jhelne wali zyada tar auratein kisi ko nahi batati, 100 mein se 1 se bhi kam police ke paas jaati hai, aur 18 saal ya usse badi wife ke saath pati ke zabardasti sex ko kanoon rape nahi maanta.

actions.en: When you share an NCRB figure, call it 'cases registered', give the year, and add that most violence never reaches the police.
actions.hg: NCRB ka koi figure share karo toh use 'registered cases' bolo, saal batao, aur saath mein likho ki zyada tar violence police tak pahunchti hi nahi.

actions.en: Do not multiply the police count by 100 or any other number. Say plainly that the true count is unknown.
actions.hg: Police ke number ko 100 ya kisi aur number se multiply mat karo. Seedha bolo ki asli ginti kisi ko nahi pata.

actions.en: If an adult tells you about sexual violence, believe them, let them decide about the police, and help them reach a doctor or 181 (Women Helpline).
actions.hg: Koi adult tumhe apne saath hui sexual violence ke baare mein bataye, toh uspe bharosa karo, police ke paas jaana hai ya nahi yeh faisla use karne do, aur doctor ya 181 (Women Helpline) tak pahunchne mein madad karo.

actions.en: If the person is under 18, the law requires the abuse to be reported to the police; the Child Helpline 1098 can also help.
actions.hg: Agar woh 18 saal se kam ka hai, toh kanoon ke hisaab se police ko report karna zaroori hai; Child Helpline 1098 bhi madad kar sakti hai.

actions.en: Remember that any police station must record a rape complaint wherever it happened (Zero FIR), and refusing to record it is a crime under Section 199 BNS.
actions.hg: Yaad rakho: rape ki complaint koi bhi police station register karega, chahe ghatna kahin bhi hui ho (Zero FIR), aur complaint record karne se mana karna Section 199 BNS ke tahat crime hai.

title.en: Why rape-murders and most child rapes are missing from India's rape count: the principal offence rule
title.hg: Rape-murder aur bachchon ke zyadatar rape India ke rape count se gayab kyun hain: principal offence rule samjhiye

dek.en: NCRB counts each FIR once, under the offence with the heaviest punishment. So a rape that ends in murder becomes a murder statistic, and according to a 2022 study, even the 2012 Delhi gang rape case was recorded as murder, not rape.
dek.hg: NCRB har FIR ko ek hi baar ginta hai, us offence ke naam par jiski saza sabse bhaari hai. Isliye jis rape ke baad murder hota hai, woh murder ka statistic ban jaata hai, aur 2022 ki ek study ke mutabik 2012 ka Delhi gang rape case bhi rape nahi, murder ke roop mein record hua.

statLabel.en: rape-murder cases in 2024, counted outside the rape head
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein rape-murder cases, jo rape head se bahar gine gaye

label.en: cases of murder with rape or gang rape in 2024, with 274 victims
label.hg: 2024 mein murder with rape ya gang rape ke cases, 274 victims ke saath

label.en: gang-rape cases involving girls under 18 in the 2024 rape table, out of 1,537
label.hg: 2024 ki rape table mein 18 saal se kam ki ladkiyon ke gang rape cases, kul 1,537 mein se

label.en: POCSO penetrative-assault cases with girl victims, counted in a separate table
label.hg: POCSO mein girl victims wale penetrative assault cases, jo alag table mein gine jaate hain

claim.en: Every rape reported to the police shows up in India's rape count.
claim.hg: Police tak pahuncha har rape India ke rape count mein dikhta hai.

truth.en: Only if rape is the most serious offence in the FIR. Rapes that end in murder, and most rapes of children, are counted under other heads.
truth.hg: Sirf tab, jab FIR mein sabse serious offence rape ho. Jis rape ke baad murder hota hai, aur ladkiyon ke rape ke zyadatar cases, doosre heads mein gine jaate hain.

actions.en: Quote the published rape count as a minimum, never as the full number.
actions.hg: Published rape count ko hamesha 'kam se kam' bol kar quote kijiye, poori ginti bol kar nahi.

actions.en: Before comparing years or states, put the rape, murder-with-rape and POCSO figures side by side.
actions.hg: Saalon ya states ko compare karne se pehle rape, murder with rape aur POCSO, teeno figures saath rakhiye.

actions.en: If you file a complaint, ask for your free copy of the FIR and check that it records every offence you described.
actions.hg: Agar aap complaint file karte hain, toh FIR ki free copy maangiye aur check kijiye ki aapne jo-jo bataya, sab usmein likha hai.

actions.en: When you talk about a case, use the legal category, not graphic detail, and never share anything that could identify the survivor, even after death.
actions.hg: Kisi case ki baat karte waqt legal category use kijiye, graphic detail nahi. Aur survivor ki pehchaan batane wali koi bhi baat kabhi share mat kijiye, uski maut ke baad bhi nahi.

title.en: Rajasthan: India's highest rape count three years running, and a third of the country's 'false' closures in crimes against women
title.hg: Rajasthan: teen saal se India mein sabse zyada rape cases, aur auraton ke khilaf crimes ke 'false' closures ka ek-tihaai

dek.en: In 2024 Rajasthan's police registered the most rape cases in India, accounted for a third of the country's crime-against-women cases closed as 'false', and charge-sheeted the smallest share. What those numbers can and cannot prove, and what the state should publish.
dek.hg: 2024 mein Rajasthan police ne India mein sabse zyada rape cases register kiye, desh mein 'false' bolkar band kiye gaye crime-against-women cases ka ek-tihaai hissa usi ka tha, aur chargesheet sabse kam hisse mein hui. Yeh numbers kya saabit kar sakte hain, kya nahi, aur state ko kya publish karna chahiye.

statLabel.en: crime-against-women cases closed as 'false' by Rajasthan police in 2024
statLabel.hg: crime-against-women cases 2024 mein Rajasthan police ne 'false' bolkar band kiye

label.en: crime-against-women cases Rajasthan police closed as 'false' in 2024, a third of India's 36,895
label.hg: crime-against-women cases Rajasthan police ne 2024 mein 'false' bolkar band kiye, India ke 36,895 ka ek-tihaai

label.en: Rajasthan's charge-sheeting rate for crimes against women in 2024, the lowest of any State/UT (India: 77.2%)
label.hg: Rajasthan ka 2024 mein crimes against women mein chargesheeting rate, kisi bhi State/UT mein sabse kam (India: 77.2%)

label.en: rape cases registered in Rajasthan in 2024, the most of any state for the third year running
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein Rajasthan mein register hue, lagaatar teesre saal kisi bhi state se zyada

actions.en: If police refuse to register a rape complaint, write to the Superintendent of Police and then approach a magistrate. Refusing to record it is a crime under Section 199 BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police rape ki complaint darj karne se mana kare, toh Superintendent of Police ko likho aur phir magistrate ke paas jao. Complaint darj na karna Section 199 BNS ke tahat crime hai.

actions.en: If you have filed a complaint, ask the investigating officer, in writing, for the progress update the law entitles a victim to within 90 days.
actions.hg: Agar tumne complaint ki hai, toh investigating officer se likhit mein woh progress update maango jo kanoon victim ko 90 din ke andar dilata hai.

actions.en: If police say they will close your case, ask for the reason in writing and speak to a lawyer at once about challenging the closure in court.
actions.hg: Agar police kahe ki tumhara case band kiya jaayega, toh wajah likhit mein maango aur turant kisi lawyer se baat karo ki closure ko court mein kaise challenge karein.

actions.en: When you quote Rajasthan's figures, put registrations, 'false' closures and charge-sheeting side by side, never one alone.
actions.hg: Rajasthan ke figures quote karo toh registration, 'false' closures aur chargesheeting teeno saath rakho, kabhi koi ek akela nahi.

actions.en: Never share a 'false' closure figure as proof that women lie: it is a police label, not a court verdict.
actions.hg: 'False' closure ke kisi figure ko is baat ka saboot bana kar share mat karo ki auratein jhooth bolti hain: yeh police ka label hai, court ka faisla nahi.

title.en: Myth: the state with the most rape cases is India's 'rape capital'. Counts, rates and the trap between them
title.hg: Myth: jis state mein sabse zyada rape cases, wahi India ki 'rape capital'. Count, rate aur dono ke beech ka jaal

dek.en: Rajasthan registered the most rape cases in 2024. Per lakh women, Chandigarh and Goa rank above it and Uttar Pradesh falls below the national rate. How to read a state ranking without being fooled by it.
dek.hg: 2024 mein sabse zyada rape cases Rajasthan mein register hue. Lekin har lakh auraton ke hisaab se Chandigarh aur Goa usse aage hain, aur Uttar Pradesh national rate se bhi neeche hai. State rankings ko bina dhokha khaye kaise padhein.

statLabel.en: rape cases registered in Rajasthan, the highest of any state in 2024
statLabel.hg: rape cases 2024 mein Rajasthan mein register hue, kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada

label.en: rape cases registered in Rajasthan in 2024, the highest count of any state
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein Rajasthan mein register hue, kisi bhi state ka sabse bada count

label.en: rape cases per lakh women in Chandigarh, the highest rate of any State/UT, from 96 cases
label.hg: rape cases har lakh auraton par Chandigarh mein, kisi bhi State/UT ka sabse ooncha rate, sirf 96 cases se

label.en: rape cases per lakh women in Uttar Pradesh, below the national 4.3 despite the second-highest count
label.hg: rape cases har lakh auraton par Uttar Pradesh mein, national 4.3 se kam, jabki count mein woh doosre number par hai

claim.en: The state with the most registered rape cases is India's 'rape capital', the most dangerous place to be a woman.
claim.hg: Jis state mein sabse zyada rape cases register hote hain, wahi India ki 'rape capital' hai, yaani aurat ke liye sabse khatarnaak jagah.

truth.en: A count grows with population and with how readily police register complaints. Per lakh women the ranking changes, and NCRB itself says comparing states on its figures alone is 'too simplistic'.
truth.hg: Count population ke saath badhta hai, aur is baat ke saath bhi ki police kitni aasaani se complaint darj karti hai. Har lakh auraton ke hisaab se ranking badal jaati hai, aur NCRB khud kehta hai ki sirf uske figures par states ko compare karna 'too simplistic' hai.

actions.en: Before you share a 'rape capital' post, check whether it ranks states by count or by rate per lakh women.
actions.hg: 'Rape capital' wali koi post share karne se pehle check karo ki woh states ko count se rank kar rahi hai ya har lakh auraton ke rate se.

actions.en: When a small territory tops a rate table, look up how many cases sit behind that rate.
actions.hg: Jab koi chhota territory rate table mein top kare, toh dekho ki us rate ke peeche kitne cases hain.

actions.en: Read a state's rape figure together with its POCSO figure, because states record child rape differently.
actions.hg: Kisi state ke rape figure ko uske POCSO figure ke saath padho, kyunki states bachchon ke rape ko alag-alag tarah darj karte hain.

actions.en: Judge a state by what happens after a complaint, from FIR to charge-sheet to verdict, not by its place in a ranking.
actions.hg: Kisi state ko ranking se nahi, is baat se parkho ki complaint ke baad kya hota hai: FIR se chargesheet tak, aur chargesheet se faisle tak.

actions.en: If police refuse to register a rape complaint, write to the Superintendent of Police and then approach a magistrate. Refusing to record it is a crime under Section 199 BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police rape ki complaint darj karne se mana kare, toh Superintendent of Police ko likho aur phir magistrate ke paas jao. Complaint darj na karna Section 199 BNS ke tahat crime hai.

title.en: 29,536 FIRs, 5,032 convictions, 1,85,785 still waiting: India's rape justice funnel, stage by stage
title.hg: 29,536 FIRs, 5,032 convictions, 1,85,785 ab bhi intezaar mein: India ka rape justice funnel, stage by stage

dek.en: Follow one year of rape cases through India's police stations and courts, and the numbers shrink at every gate. Here is each stage of 2024, where cases leak out, and why dividing convictions by FIRs gives the wrong answer.
dek.hg: Ek saal ke rape cases ko India ke police stations aur courts se guzarte hue dekhiye, aur har gate par number chhota hota jaata hai. Yahan 2024 ka har stage hai, cases kahan se nikal jaate hain, aur convictions ko FIRs se divide karna galat jawab kyun deta hai.

actions.en: Report at any police station: a Zero FIR or an e-FIR is your right, and your copy of the FIR is free.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein report kijiye: Zero FIR ya e-FIR aapka haq hai, aur FIR ki copy aapko free milti hai.

actions.en: If police refuse to register a rape complaint, tell them that refusing is a crime under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police rape complaint register karne se mana kare, to unhe bataiye ki aisa mana karna BNS ke Section 199 ke tahat crime hai.

actions.en: Ask the investigating officer for an update; the law entitles a victim to one within 90 days.
actions.hg: Investigating officer se case ka update maangiye; kanoon victim ko 90 din ke andar update ka haq deta hai.

actions.en: Apply to the District Legal Services Authority for victim compensation: you can claim it even if the accused is never traced or the trial ends in acquittal.
actions.hg: Victim compensation ke liye District Legal Services Authority ko apply kijiye: accused kabhi na mile ya trial acquittal par khatam ho, tab bhi aap claim kar sakti hain.

actions.en: When you quote a conviction rate, say it is a share of trials completed that year, not of complaints filed.
actions.hg: Conviction rate quote karte waqt bataiye ki yeh us saal poore hue trials ka hissa hai, file hui complaints ka nahi.

title.en: The law gives police two months to investigate a rape. At the end of 2024, 8,905 cases were still open
title.hg: Law police ko rape ki investigation ke liye do mahine deta hai. 2024 ke end mein 8,905 cases ab bhi khule the

dek.en: Since 2018, every rape investigation in India has had a two-month deadline, and no consequence for missing it. Here is what happens between the FIR and the charge-sheet, what the 81.3% charge-sheeting rate hides, and what a survivor can demand while she waits.
dek.hg: 2018 se India mein har rape investigation ki do mahine ki deadline hai, aur use miss karne par koi consequence nahi. Yeh raha FIR se charge-sheet tak ka raasta, 81.3% charge-sheeting rate kya chhupata hai, aur intezaar ke dauraan survivor kya maang sakti hai.

statLabel.hg: 2024 ke end mein ab bhi police investigation mein pade rape cases

label.hg: 2024 ke end mein ab bhi police investigation mein pade rape cases

label.hg: 2024 mein police ne jitne rape cases dispose kiye, unme se itno mein charge-sheet file hui

label.hg: 2024 mein police ne itne rape cases 'false' bata ke band kiye: yeh police ka label hai, court ka faisla nahi

label.en: the legal deadline for a rape investigation, counted from the day police record the information
label.hg: rape investigation ki legal deadline, us din se jab police information record karti hai

actions.en: Note the date and time your FIR was recorded: the two-month investigation clock starts then.
actions.hg: Note karo ki tumhari FIR kis date aur time par record hui: investigation ki do mahine ki ghadi tabhi se chalti hai.

actions.en: If you hear nothing within 90 days, ask the investigating officer in writing for a progress update and keep a copy; the law entitles you to one.
actions.hg: Agar 90 din mein kuch sunne ko na mile, toh investigating officer se likhit mein progress update maango aur uski copy rakho; law tumhe iska haq deta hai.

actions.en: You cannot be made to go to the police station for questioning: police must come to where you live, though you may choose to go.
actions.hg: Poochhtaachh ke liye tumhe police station jaane par majboor nahi kiya ja sakta: police ko tumhare ghar aana hoga, haalaanki tum chaaho toh khud ja sakti ho.

actions.en: If police say they are closing the case, get legal help at once from a lawyer or your District Legal Services Authority.
actions.hg: Agar police kahe ki case band kiya ja raha hai, toh turant kisi lawyer ya apni District Legal Services Authority se legal madad lo.

actions.en: If a police station refuses to register a rape FIR, remember that the refusal is itself a crime under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar koi police station rape ki FIR register karne se mana kare, toh yaad rakho ki yeh inkaar khud BNS ke Section 199 ke tehat crime hai.

title.en: Myth: rape is a big-city problem. In 2024, India's 19 metros registered 3,886 of its 29,536 rape cases
title.hg: Myth: rape bade shehron ki problem hai. 2024 mein India ke 19 metros mein 29,536 mein se 3,886 rape cases darj hue

dek.en: Delhi, Mumbai and Kolkata fill the headlines. But nearly seven in eight of India's registered rape cases come from outside its 19 metros, and in almost every case the accused was someone the victim knew.
dek.hg: Headlines mein Delhi, Mumbai aur Kolkata chhaaye rehte hain. Lekin India ke har aath registered rape cases mein se lagbhag saat 19 metros ke bahar se aate hain, aur lagbhag har case mein accused victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha.

statLabel.en: of India's 29,536 registered rape cases in 2024 were in its 19 metropolitan cities
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein India ke 29,536 registered rape cases mein se itne uske 19 metropolitan cities mein the

label.hg: 2024 mein India ke 19 metropolitan cities mein darj rape cases

label.en: rape cases registered in the whole of India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein poore India mein darj rape cases

label.hg: 2024 mein 19 metros mein girl victims wale POCSO cases, poore desh ke 67,809 mein se

label.en: of rape cases registered in India in 2024 in which the offender was known to the victim
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein darj rape cases jinmein offender victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

claim.en: Rape is a big-city problem. Keep women away from the city and they will be safe.
claim.hg: Rape bade shehron ki problem hai. Auraton ko shehar se door rakho, woh safe rahengi.

truth.en: In 2024 India's 19 metros registered roughly one in eight of the country's rape cases. Most come from smaller cities, towns and villages, and in 96.8% of all cases the accused was someone the victim knew.
truth.hg: 2024 mein India ke 19 metros mein desh ke har aath rape cases mein se lagbhag ek darj hua. Zyada tar cases chhote shehron, kasbon aur gaon se aate hain, aur 96.8% cases mein accused victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha.

actions.en: When a city case trends, look up your own state's numbers in NCRB's Crime in India tables, not just the metro table.
actions.hg: Jab shehar ka koi case trend kare, toh sirf metro table nahi, NCRB ki Crime in India tables mein apne state ke numbers bhi dekhiye.

actions.en: Judge a woman's safety by the people around her, not her pin code: in village and city alike, most accused are men she knows.
actions.hg: Kisi aurat ki safety uske pin code se nahi, uske aas-paas ke logon se aankiye: gaon ho ya shehar, zyada tar accused woh aadmi hote hain jinhe woh jaanti hai.

actions.en: Remember that a survivor can report at any police station, wherever the crime happened (Zero FIR), and must get a free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye ki survivor kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakti hai, crime chahe kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR), aur use FIR ki copy free mein milni chahiye.

actions.en: Find out where your district's One Stop Centre (Sakhi) is, and save 112 and 181 on every phone in the family, including in the village.
actions.hg: Pata kijiye ki aapke district ka One Stop Centre (Sakhi) kahan hai, aur family ke har phone mein 112 aur 181 save kijiye, gaon mein bhi.

title.en: Since December 2012: tougher rape laws, Rs 7,990.85 crore, and convictions still near one in four
title.hg: December 2012 ke baad: sakht rape law, Rs 7,990.85 crore, aur conviction ab bhi lagbhag chaar mein ek

dek.en: After the 2012 Delhi gang rape, India widened its rape law, raised sentences, added the death penalty and built a fund for women's safety. The courts show how little of that reached the verdict: about 24% of rape trials ended in conviction in 2012, and 24.4% in 2024.
dek.hg: 2012 ke Delhi gang rape ke baad India ne rape law ka daayra badhaya, sazaayein badhaayi, death penalty jodi aur aurton ki safety ke liye ek fund banaya. Courts dikhate hain ki isme se kitna kam verdict tak pahuncha: 2012 mein rape trials ke lagbhag 24% conviction par khatam hue, aur 2024 mein 24.4%.

statLabel.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials mein conviction rate

label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials conviction par khatam hue; 2012 mein yeh lagbhag 24% tha

label.hg: rape trials 2024 mein acquittal par khatam hue, jabki conviction sirf 5,032 mein hua

label.hg: 2013-14 se Nirbhaya Fund ko allocate hue; July 2026 mein lagbhag Rs 1,288 crore ab bhi kharch nahi hue the

claim.en: Since 2012, tougher punishment has made it far more likely that a rapist is convicted.
claim.hg: 2012 ke baad sakht saza ki wajah se ab rapist ko conviction milne ke chances kaafi badh gaye hain.

truth.en: The law got harsher, but the chance of conviction did not rise: about 24% of rape trials ended in conviction in 2012 and 24.4% in 2024, while 1,85,785 rape cases were still waiting for trial at the end of 2024.
truth.hg: Law sakht hua, par conviction ka chance nahi badha: 2012 mein rape trials ke lagbhag 24% conviction par khatam hue aur 2024 mein 24.4%, jabki 2024 ke end mein rape ke 1,85,785 cases ab bhi trial ka intezaar kar rahe the.

actions.en: Judge every new promise on rape law by three numbers: trials completed, convictions and cases still waiting.
actions.hg: Rape law par har naye vaade ko teen numbers se parakhiye: kitne trials poore hue, kitne convictions hue, aur kitne cases ab bhi intezaar mein hain.

actions.en: If you are helping a survivor, ask for the free copy of the FIR she is owed, and note the date: police must finish a rape investigation within two months.
actions.hg: Agar aap kisi survivor ki madad kar rahe hain, toh FIR ki free copy maangiye, jo uska haq hai, aur date note kijiye: police ko rape ki investigation do mahine ke andar poori karni hoti hai.

actions.en: Remember that victim compensation can be claimed from the District Legal Services Authority even if the accused is never traced or tried (Section 396 BNSS).
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye: victim compensation District Legal Services Authority se maanga ja sakta hai, chahe accused kabhi pakda na jaaye ya uska trial hi na ho (Section 396 BNSS).

actions.en: Find your district's One Stop Centre or call 181: support through a long trial is part of reaching a verdict.
actions.hg: Apne district ka One Stop Centre dhoondhiye ya 181 par call kijiye: lambe trial mein saath milna bhi verdict tak pahunchne ka hissa hai.

actions.en: Ask your MP or MLA what your state has spent from the Nirbhaya Fund, and on what.
actions.hg: Apne MP ya MLA se poochiye ki aapke state ne Nirbhaya Fund se kitna kharch kiya, aur kis cheez par.

title.en: 274 women and girls were raped and murdered in 2024. Where, and what the courts did
title.hg: 2024 mein 274 aurton aur ladkiyon ka rape karke murder kiya gaya. Kahan, aur courts ne kya kiya

dek.en: NCRB files these killings in a table of their own, outside the rape count. Its numbers show which states lead it, a conviction rate three times rape's, and how many families are still waiting for a verdict.
dek.hg: NCRB in hatyaon ko rape count se bahar, ek alag table mein rakhta hai. Uske numbers batate hain ki kaunse states sabse aage hain, iska conviction rate kaise rape se teen guna hai, aur kitne parivaar ab bhi faisle ka intezaar kar rahe hain.

statLabel.hg: 2024 mein murder with rape ya gang rape ke victims

label.hg: 2024 mein murder with rape ya gang rape ke 266 cases mein maari gayi aurtein aur ladkiyan

label.en: such cases in Madhya Pradesh, the most of any state, followed by Rajasthan with 38
label.hg: Madhya Pradesh mein aise cases, kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada; uske baad Rajasthan mein 38

label.en: conviction rate in murder-with-rape trials completed in 2024, against 24.4% for rape
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue murder-with-rape trials mein conviction rate, jabki rape mein yeh 24.4% tha

label.en: murder-with-rape cases still pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: 2024 ke aakhir tak trial ke intezaar mein pade murder-with-rape cases

claim.en: Men who rape and kill walk free because Indian courts go easy on them.
claim.hg: Rape karke murder karne wale chhoot jaate hain kyunki Indian courts unpar narmi baratti hain.

truth.en: When these trials end, most end in conviction: 76.4% in 2024. The failure is speed. Courts finished only 55 such trials that year, and 1,574 cases were still waiting at its end.
truth.hg: Jab yeh trials khatam hote hain, toh zyada tar conviction par khatam hote hain: 2024 mein 76.4%. Asli naakaami raftaar ki hai. Us saal courts ne aise sirf 55 trials poore kiye, aur saal ke ant mein 1,574 cases ab bhi intezaar mein the.

actions.en: Never share the name, photo or village of a woman killed after rape, even as a tribute. The Supreme Court bars it even after her death and even with her family's consent.
actions.hg: Rape ke baad maari gayi kisi aurat ka naam, photo ya gaon kabhi share mat kijiye, tribute ke taur par bhi nahi. Supreme Court ne iski manaahi ki hai, uski maut ke baad bhi aur parivaar ki marzi ho tab bhi.

actions.en: If a family you know has lost a daughter this way, tell them they can apply to the District Legal Services Authority for compensation without waiting for the verdict.
actions.hg: Agar aap kisi aise parivaar ko jaante hain jisne apni beti is tarah khoyi hai, toh unhe bataiye ki woh verdict ka intezaar kiye bina District Legal Services Authority mein compensation ke liye apply kar sakte hain.

actions.en: When you quote India's rape count, add that rapes ending in murder are counted separately, under murder with rape or gang rape.
actions.hg: India ka rape count quote karte waqt yeh bhi bataiye ki jin rapes ke baad murder hota hai, woh alag se, murder with rape ya gang rape mein gine jaate hain.

actions.en: Ask your MP and state government about trial delays, not only harsher sentences: the law already allows the death penalty for these crimes.
actions.hg: Apne MP aur state government se sirf sakht sazaon ke baare mein nahi, trials mein deri ke baare mein bhi sawaal poochhiye: law in crimes ke liye pehle se death penalty ki ijaazat deta hai.

title.en: 1,85,785 rape cases are waiting for a verdict. At 2024's pace, clearing them would take about nine years
title.hg: 1,85,785 rape cases verdict ka wait kar rahe hain. 2024 ki speed se inhe clear karne mein lagbhag nau saal lagenge

dek.en: Indian courts disposed of 20,992 rape cases in 2024 while police sent them 24,614 new ones. The law says each trial should take two months. Here is the arithmetic of the queue, how it grew, and what it means for anyone whose case is charge-sheeted today.
dek.hg: 2024 mein Indian courts ne 20,992 rape cases dispose kiye, jabki police ne unhe 24,614 naye cases bheje. Law kehta hai ki har trial do mahine mein khatam ho. Yeh raha queue ka hisaab, yeh kaise badhi, aur jiske case mein aaj charge-sheet file ho rahi hai, uske liye iska matlab kya hai.

statLabel.hg: 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending rape cases

label.hg: 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending rape cases, courts ke saamne wale cases ka 89.8%

label.hg: 2024 mein courts ne itne rape cases dispose kiye

actions.en: Apply to your District Legal Services Authority for victim compensation without waiting for the verdict: it does not depend on a conviction.
actions.hg: Victim compensation ke liye verdict ka wait kiye bina apni District Legal Services Authority mein apply karo: yeh conviction par depend nahi karta.

actions.en: If you have a lawyer, ask for your free copies of the FIR, police report and statements; the law sets a 14-day deadline after the accused first appears in court.
actions.hg: Agar tumhara lawyer hai, toh FIR, police report aur statements ki free copies maango; accused ke court mein pehli baar pesh hone ke baad law 14 din ki deadline deta hai.

actions.en: Keep one file with the charge-sheet date and every hearing and adjournment, so your lawyer can show the court how long the case has waited.
actions.hg: Ek file banao jisme charge-sheet ki date aur har hearing aur adjournment likha ho, taaki tumhara lawyer court ko dikha sake ki case kitne time se wait kar raha hai.

actions.en: When a leader promises speedy trials, ask how many rape cases are already pending in your state's courts.
actions.hg: Jab koi neta speedy trial ka promise kare, toh poocho ki tumhare state ke courts mein pehle se kitne rape cases pending hain.

title.en: From under 6 to 60-plus: the ages of the 29,742 rape victims police recorded in 2024
title.hg: 6 saal se kam se lekar 60-plus tak: 2024 mein police ki darj ki gayi 29,742 rape victims ki umar

dek.en: Police tables record survivors in every age band, from girls under six to women aged 60 and over. Here is the age profile band by band, what the bulge at 18 to 30 really measures, and why the smallest numbers signal silence, not safety.
dek.hg: Police tables mein har umar ki survivors darj hain, chhe saal se chhoti bachchiyon se lekar 60 aur usse upar ki auraton tak. Jaaniye har age band ka hisaab, 18 se 30 wali bheed asal mein kya naapti hai, aur sabse chhote numbers safety nahi, chuppi kyun dikhate hain.

statLabel.en: of the rape victims police recorded in 2024 were aged 18 to 30, about two in three
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein police ki darj ki gayi rape victims 18 se 30 saal ki thin, yaani lagbhag teen mein se do

label.hg: rape head ke tehat darj victims 2024 mein 18 se 30 saal ki thin

label.hg: bachche, 16 se 18 saal ke, 2024 mein POCSO mein penetrative sexual assault ke victims darj hue, yaani aise sabhi bachchon ka 52.7%

label.hg: auratein, 60 saal ya usse upar ki, 2024 mein rape victims ke roop mein darj huin

label.hg: saal: NFHS-5, yaani India ke national family health survey, ne sirf isi umar ki auraton se sexual violence ke baare mein poochha

claim.en: Rape happens to young women. Small children and older women are not at risk.
claim.hg: Rape sirf jawan auraton ke saath hota hai. Chhote bachchon aur badi umar ki auraton ko koi khatra nahi.

truth.en: Police recorded victims in every age band in 2024, from girls under six to women aged 60 and over. Small numbers at the edges reflect who gets reported, not who is safe.
truth.hg: 2024 mein police ne har umar ki victims darj kin, chhe saal se chhoti bachchiyon se lekar 60 aur usse upar ki auraton tak. Kinaron par chhote numbers yeh dikhate hain ki kiski complaint darj ho paati hai, yeh nahi ki kaun safe hai.

actions.en: When you read an age statistic, check whether it comes from the rape table or the POCSO table: most child victims are counted under POCSO.
actions.hg: Umar wala koi bhi statistic padho, toh dekho ki woh rape wali table se hai ya POCSO wali se. Zyada tar bachche POCSO mein gine jaate hain.

actions.en: Do not wait for a young child to find the words. If you suspect abuse, POCSO requires you to tell the police; the Child Helpline 1098 can also help.
actions.hg: Chhote bachche ke bol paane ka intezaar mat karo. Abuse ka shak ho toh POCSO ke hisaab se police ko batana zaroori hai; Child Helpline 1098 bhi madad kar sakti hai.

actions.en: Check on older women in your family privately, away from other relatives. Abuse at 60 is still abuse, and still a crime.
actions.hg: Family ki badi umar ki auraton ka haal akele mein poochho, baaki relatives se door. 60 ki umar mein abuse bhi abuse hai, aur crime hai.

actions.en: Believe a survivor of any age. Offer to go with an adult survivor to a hospital, a One Stop Centre or the police, and let them decide.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi umar ki survivor par bharosa karo. Adult survivor ko hospital, One Stop Centre ya police tak saath chalne ki offer do, aur faisla unhe karne do.

title.en: 39% of never-married survivors named a relative, not counting fathers or brothers. Police recorded 2,134 rape cases against family members
title.hg: Jinki shaadi nahi hui, un survivors mein 39% ne kisi relative ka naam liya, father ya brother ko chhodkar. Police ne family members par rape ke 2,134 cases darj kiye

dek.en: The national health survey and the police record both point inside the home. Here is what each shows, why abuse by a relative is so hard to report, and what to do when someone tells you.
dek.hg: National health survey aur police record, dono ghar ke andar ki taraf ishara karte hain. Jaaniye dono kya dikhate hain, kisi relative ke khilaf complaint karna itna mushkil kyun hai, aur koi aapko bataye toh aap kya karein.

statLabel.hg: unmarried survivors ne father ya brother ke alawa kisi aur relative ka naam liya (NFHS-5)

label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein aise darj hue jinmein police ne family member ko accused likha

claim.en: Rape by a family member is rare. Families protect their own.
claim.hg: Family ke andar rape bahut rare hai. Family toh apno ki hifazat karti hai.

truth.en: Never-married women in NFHS-5 named relatives more often than anyone else, and police recorded family members as the accused in 2,134 rape cases in 2024.
truth.hg: NFHS-5 mein unmarried auraton ne sabse zyada relatives ka naam liya. Aur 2024 mein police ne rape ke 2,134 cases mein family member ko accused darj kiya.

actions.en: If a child tells you a relative abused them, believe them, keep them away from the accused and report it to the police, as POCSO requires. Child Helpline 1098 can help.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha bataye ki kisi relative ne uska abuse kiya hai, toh uski baat par bharosa kijiye, use accused se door rakhiye, aur police ko report kijiye, jaisa POCSO mein zaroori hai. Child Helpline 1098 bhi madad kar sakti hai.

actions.en: If an adult tells you, offer to go with them to a hospital, a One Stop Centre or the police, and let them decide.
actions.hg: Agar koi adult bataye, toh hospital, One Stop Centre ya police tak saath chalne ki baat kahiye. Faisla usi par chhodiye.

actions.en: Get medical care fast: HIV prevention medicine (PEP) must start within 72 hours, and emergency contraception works up to 5 days after.
actions.hg: Ilaaj mein der mat kijiye. HIV se bachane wali dawa (PEP) 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye, aur emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karta hai.

actions.en: Tell children and teenagers plainly that a relative can commit sexual abuse, and that telling is never a betrayal of the family.
actions.hg: Bachchon aur teenagers ko saaf bataiye ki relative bhi sexual abuse kar sakta hai, aur yeh baat batana family se dhokha nahi hai.

actions.en: Never push a survivor into a family 'compromise' with the person who abused them.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor par abuse karne wale se family mein 'compromise' karne ka pressure kabhi mat daaliye.

title.en: Myth: a rise in rape cases proves women are less safe. What happened when women got a voice
title.hg: Myth: rape cases badhna saabit karta hai ki auratein kam safe hain. Jab auraton ko awaaz mili, tab kya hua

dek.en: When states reserved a third of panchayat seats for women, recorded rapes rose 23%. Researchers traced the rise mainly to more reporting, not more rape. Why a rising line can mean someone has started listening, and what to ask when a number falls.
dek.hg: Jab states ne panchayat ki ek-tihai seats auraton ke liye reserve ki, toh recorded rapes 23% badh gaye. Researchers ne paaya ki iski main wajah zyada reporting thi, zyada rape nahi. Badhti line ka matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki koi sunne laga hai, aur number gire toh kya poochna chahiye.

statLabel.en: rise in recorded rapes after women got a third of local council seats
statLabel.hg: badhe recorded rapes, jab auraton ko local councils ki ek-tihai seats mili

label.en: rise in recorded rapes after states reserved a third of panchayat seats for women
label.hg: badhe recorded rapes, jab states ne panchayat ki ek-tihai seats auraton ke liye reserve ki

label.en: rise in documented crimes against women in the same study, driven mainly by more reporting
label.hg: badhe auraton ke khilaaf documented crimes, isi study mein, zyada tar zyada reporting ki wajah se

label.en: rise in police reports of crimes against women after all-women police stations opened, with no change in killings of women
label.hg: badhi auraton ke khilaaf crimes ki police reports, all-women police stations khulne ke baad, jabki auraton ki hatyaon mein koi badlav nahi aaya

label.en: Women Help Desks set up in police stations by March 2025
label.hg: Women Help Desks March 2025 tak police stations mein banaye gaye

claim.en: If rape cases go up, women are less safe.
claim.hg: Rape cases badhe toh auratein kam safe hain.

truth.en: Registered cases can rise because more women report and police record more. When women got a third of panchayat seats, recorded rapes rose 23%, mainly because of more reporting.
truth.hg: Registered cases isliye bhi badh sakte hain kyunki zyada auratein report karti hain aur police zyada record karti hai. Jab auraton ko panchayat ki ek-tihai seats mili, toh recorded rapes 23% badhe, aur iski main wajah zyada reporting thi.

actions.en: Read a rise in registered rape cases as a question, not a verdict: ask what changed in reporting, policing or the law that year.
actions.hg: Registered rape cases badhein toh ise verdict nahi, sawaal samjho: us saal reporting, policing ya kanoon mein kya badla?

actions.en: Treat a steep fall with the same suspicion as a steep rise.
actions.hg: Tez giravat par bhi utna hi shak karo jitna tez badhotri par.

actions.en: Find out whether your nearest police station has a Women Help Desk, and share the station's number with the women in your family.
actions.hg: Pata karo ki tumhare nazdeeki police station mein Women Help Desk hai ya nahi, aur thane ka number ghar ki auraton ke saath share karo.

actions.en: If a station refuses to register a rape complaint, remember that refusal is a crime under Section 199 BNS: write to the Superintendent of Police, then approach a magistrate.
actions.hg: Agar police station rape complaint register karne se mana kare, toh yaad rakho ki yeh Section 199 BNS ke tahat crime hai: Superintendent of Police (SP) ko likho, phir magistrate ke paas jao.

actions.en: Judge leaders by charge-sheets, convictions and the speed of trials, not by low crime counts.
actions.hg: Netaon ko kam crime figures se nahi, chargesheets, convictions aur trials ki speed se judge karo.

title.en: 2,347 rescued from sex trafficking in 2024. Courts convicted in 43 trafficking cases all year.
title.hg: 2024 mein sex trafficking se 2,347 log rescue hue. Poore saal courts ne sirf 43 trafficking cases mein saza di.

dek.en: Sexual exploitation was the biggest single reason India's rescued trafficking victims had been trafficked in 2024. In plain words, it is rape, repeated, for someone else's profit. The law prescribes at least seven years. Courts convicted in 43 trafficking cases all year.
dek.hg: 2024 mein India mein rescue hue trafficking victims ko sabse zyada sexual exploitation ke liye traffic kiya gaya tha. Seedhe shabdon mein, yeh rape hai, baar-baar, kisi aur ke munafe ke liye. Kanoon kam se kam saat saal ki saza kehta hai. Poore saal mein courts ne sirf 43 trafficking cases mein saza di.

statLabel.en: rescued victims who had been trafficked for sexual exploitation, 2024
statLabel.hg: rescue hue victims jinhe sexual exploitation ke liye traffic kiya gaya tha, 2024

label.en: people rescued in 2024 who had been trafficked for sexual exploitation, the largest single purpose
label.hg: 2024 mein rescue hue log jinhe sexual exploitation ke liye traffic kiya gaya tha: trafficking ka sabse bada single maksad

label.en: conviction rate in trafficking trials completed in 2024: 43 cases out of 586
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue trafficking trials ka conviction rate: 586 mein se 43 cases

label.en: human trafficking cases recorded in 2024 from states' Anti-Human Trafficking Units
label.hg: human trafficking cases jo 2024 mein states ki Anti-Human Trafficking Units ke data se darj hue

claim.en: If she agreed to go, it is not trafficking.
claim.hg: Agar woh khud jaane ko raazi thi, to yeh trafficking nahi hai.

truth.en: Section 143 of the BNS says the victim's consent is immaterial in deciding whether trafficking took place. A person tricked or pressured into going is still a trafficked person.
truth.hg: BNS ka Section 143 kehta hai ki trafficking hua ya nahi, yeh tay karte waqt victim ki consent ka koi matlab nahi. Jise dhokhe ya dabav se le jaaya gaya, woh bhi trafficked person hi hai.

actions.en: If someone you know is offered a job, modelling work or marriage far from home, check the employer independently and agree on regular calls before they leave.
actions.hg: Agar aapke kisi jaanne wale ko ghar se door naukri, modelling ka kaam ya shaadi ka offer mile, to employer ko khud alag se check kijiye aur jaane se pehle regular calls tay kar lijiye.

actions.en: If you suspect someone is being trafficked or held for sex, call 112. For a child, call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar shak ho ki kisi ko traffic kiya ja raha hai ya sex ke liye band karke rakha gaya hai, to 112 par call kijiye. Bachche ke liye 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If police refuse to record a trafficking complaint, tell them that refusing is a crime under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police trafficking ki complaint darj karne se mana kare, to unhe bataiye ki aisa mana karna BNS ke Section 199 ke tahat crime hai.

actions.en: If you are ever offered sex with someone who seems controlled, underage or afraid, leave and report it: knowingly exploiting a trafficked person is a crime under Section 144.
actions.hg: Agar kabhi aapko kisi aise insaan ke saath sex offer kiya jaaye jo kisi ke control mein, nabalig ya dara hua lage, to wahan se nikliye aur report kijiye: jaante hue kisi trafficked insaan ka shoshan karna Section 144 ke tahat crime hai.

title.en: 83,908 cases, about 230 a day: the sexual violence India counts outside 'rape'
title.hg: 83,908 cases, roz lagbhag 230: woh sexual violence jo India 'rape' ke bahar ginta hai

dek.en: Police registered almost three times as many cases of assault, harassment, disrobing, voyeurism and stalking as rape in 2024. The yearly total has barely moved in nine years, and more than nine in ten cases on trial are still waiting for a verdict.
dek.hg: 2024 mein police ne assault, harassment, disrobing, voyeurism aur stalking ke cases rape se lagbhag teen guna zyada register kiye. Nau saal se yeh total wahin ka wahin hai, aur trial wale har das mein se nau se zyada cases abhi bhi faisle ka intezaar kar rahe hain.

statLabel.en: assault, harassment, disrobing, voyeurism and stalking cases registered in 2024
statLabel.hg: assault, harassment, disrobing, voyeurism aur stalking ke cases 2024 mein register hue

label.en: cases of assault to outrage a woman's modesty (Section 74 BNS) in 2024, more than the 29,536 rape cases
label.hg: cases 2024 mein aurat ki modesty bhang karne ke iraade se assault ke (Section 74 BNS), jo rape ke 29,536 cases se bhi zyada hain

label.en: of assault-to-outrage-modesty trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: assault-to-outrage-modesty ke jo trials 2024 mein poore hue, unmein se sirf itnon mein conviction hua

label.en: assault-to-outrage-modesty cases still pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: assault-to-outrage-modesty ke cases 2024 ke end mein trial ke intezaar mein pending the

actions.en: If someone keeps following, watching or messaging you after a clear no, save the dates, screenshots and names of anyone who saw it. Stalking is a crime under Section 78 BNS.
actions.hg: Agar koi saaf 'na' ke baad bhi tumhara peecha kare, tumhe ghoorta rahe ya message karta rahe, toh dates, screenshots aur dekhne walon ke naam save karo. Stalking Section 78 BNS ke tahat crime hai.

actions.en: Report at any police station, even far from where it happened, or file an e-FIR, and ask for a woman officer to record your statement and for a free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein report karo, chahe woh ghatna ki jagah se door ho, ya e-FIR file karo. Maango ki tumhara statement ek woman officer record kare aur FIR ki free copy tumhe mile.

actions.en: For harassment at work, give a written complaint to your employer's Internal Committee within three months of the last incident.
actions.hg: Kaam ki jagah harassment ho toh aakhri incident ke teen mahine ke andar employer ki Internal Committee ko likhit complaint do.

actions.en: For stalking, threats or image abuse online, report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.
actions.hg: Online stalking, dhamki ya image abuse ke liye cybercrime.gov.in par report karo ya 1930 par call karo.

actions.en: If a friend tells you she was touched, followed or filmed without consent, believe her first and help her write down what happened while it is fresh.
actions.hg: Agar koi dost bataye ki use bina consent chhua gaya, uska peecha kiya gaya ya use film kiya gaya, toh pehle uski baat par yakeen karo, aur jo hua use taaza yaad rehte likhne mein uski madad karo.

title.en: 6% of women versus 4.3 per lakh: why surveys and police records disagree on sexual violence
title.hg: 6% auratein vs har lakh par 4.3: sexual violence par survey aur police records alag-alag baat kyun karte hain

dek.en: One number comes from a household survey, the other from police registers. They answer different questions, both miss a great deal, and setting them side by side the wrong way produces nonsense. Here is how to read each.
dek.hg: Ek number ghar-ghar jaakar kiye gaye survey se aata hai, doosra police registers se. Dono alag sawaalon ke jawab hain, dono bahut kuch miss karte hain, aur inhe galat tarike se saath rakhoge toh bekaar ka nateeja niklega. Yahan samjho ki kis number ko kaise padhna hai.

statLabel.en: rape cases registered per lakh women in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein India mein har ek lakh auraton par register hue rape cases

label.en: of women aged 18-49 said they had ever experienced sexual violence (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 18-49 saal ki auraton ne bataya ki unhone kabhi na kabhi sexual violence jheli (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: rape cases registered per lakh women in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein har ek lakh auraton par register hue rape cases

label.en: of ever-married women who faced sexual violence named their current husband, whom the rape law exempts if she is 18 or older (NFHS-5)
label.hg: sexual violence jhelne wali ever-married auraton ne apne current husband ka naam liya; wife 18 ya usse badi ho toh rape law pati ko chhoot deta hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: share of households implied by NCRB records for harassment of girls in 2005, against 12% who told a survey
label.hg: gharon ka hissa jo 2005 mein ladkiyon ki harassment ke liye NCRB records se nikalta tha, jabki survey mein 12% gharon ne yeh bataya

claim.en: Police register only 4.3 rapes per lakh women, so sexual violence must be rare in India.
claim.hg: Police har lakh auraton par sirf 4.3 rapes register karti hai, matlab India mein sexual violence kam hai.

truth.en: 4.3 per lakh counts rape FIRs in one year. Surveys ask women about their whole lives and find far more, and even surveys undercount.
truth.hg: Har lakh par 4.3 ek saal mein register hui rape FIRs ki ginti hai. Surveys auraton se unki poori zindagi ke baare mein poochte hain aur kahin zyada violence paate hain, aur surveys bhi poori violence nahi pakad paate.

actions.en: Before you quote a sexual violence number, ask four things: survey or police record, which year, which people, which definition.
actions.hg: Sexual violence ka koi number quote karne se pehle chaar cheezein poocho: survey hai ya police record, kis saal ka hai, kin logon ka hai, aur kis definition se gina gaya.

actions.en: Never divide a survey percentage by a police rate, and never rank states or countries on either number alone.
actions.hg: Survey ke percentage ko police ke rate se kabhi divide mat karo, aur sirf ek number ke basis par states ya countries ko rank mat karo.

actions.en: Quote survey figures as a minimum: 'at least 6% of women aged 18-49'.
actions.hg: Survey figures ko minimum ki tarah quote karo: 'kam se kam 6% auratein (18-49 saal)'.

actions.en: If you want support without going to the police, call 181 (Women Helpline); in an emergency, call 112.
actions.hg: Police ke paas jaaye bina support chahiye toh 181 (Women Helpline) par call karo; emergency mein 112 par.

title.en: When women seek help after violence, 61% turn to their own family. Only 2% go to a doctor
title.hg: Violence ke baad jab auratein help maangti hain, 61% apni family ke paas jaati hain. Doctor tak sirf 2% pahunchti hain

dek.en: India's real first responders to violence are mothers, sisters and brothers, not police stations or hospitals. Nobody trains them, and the medicines that work only in the first few days wait on what they decide.
dek.hg: India mein violence ke baad sabse pehle help karne wale police stations ya hospitals nahi, balki maa, behen aur bhai hain. Inhe koi training nahi deta, aur jo dawaiyan sirf shuru ke kuch dinon mein kaam karti hain, woh inhi ke faisle par tiki hoti hain.

statLabel.en: of women who sought help after violence turned to their own family (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: violence ke baad help maangne wali auratein apni hi family ke paas gayi (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women who sought help after physical or sexual violence went to their own family (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: physical ya sexual violence ke baad help maangne wali auratein apni family ke paas gayi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of those women went to a doctor or medical staff; another 2% to a lawyer (NFHS-5)
label.hg: unmein se bas itni doctor ya medical staff ke paas gayi; lawyer ke paas bhi sirf 2% (NFHS-5)

label.en: of sexually assaulted children in the government's 2007 study had told no one
label.hg: sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein sexual assault jhelne wale bachchon ne kisi ko kuch nahi bataya tha

label.en: rape cases registered in India in 2024 in which the accused was a family member
label.hg: rape cases jo 2024 mein register hue aur jinmein accused family ka hi member tha

actions.en: If someone tells you, say 'I believe you' and 'it is not your fault' before you ask anything else.
actions.hg: Agar koi aapko bataye, toh kuch bhi poochne se pehle kahiye: 'Mujhe tum par bharosa hai' aur 'Isme tumhari koi galti nahi hai'.

actions.en: Go to a hospital the same day, before any family meeting: treatment is free by law, and HIV PEP must start within 72 hours.
actions.hg: Family meeting se pehle, usi din hospital jaiye. Kanoon ke hisaab se ilaaj free hai, aur HIV PEP 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye.

actions.en: Never push a survivor to stay quiet, 'settle' or marry the accused. Even courts are barred from suggesting it.
actions.hg: Survivor par chup rehne, 'settle' karne ya accused se shaadi karne ka pressure kabhi mat daaliye. Courts bhi aisa suggest nahi kar sakti.

actions.en: If the survivor is under 18, POCSO requires you to report it to the police; Child Helpline 1098 can help. Tell the child first and stay with them.
actions.hg: Survivor 18 se kam umar ka hai toh POCSO ke hisaab se police ko report karna zaroori hai; Child Helpline 1098 ismein madad kar sakti hai. Pehle bachche ko bataiye aur uske saath rahiye.

actions.en: Get support for yourself too: Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free and open round the clock.
actions.hg: Apne liye bhi support lijiye: Tele-MANAS ka number 14416 free hai aur din-raat chalta hai.

title.en: Seven things India's rape statistics cannot tell you
title.hg: Saat cheezein jo India ke rape statistics aapko nahi bata sakte

dek.en: Wives, adult men and transgender survivors, most children, women who were also murdered, disabled survivors, the many who never report, and everything after 2024: who sits outside India's official rape figure, and whether the law or the counting put them there.
dek.hg: Patniyan, adult mard aur transgender survivors, zyadatar bachche, woh auratein jinka murder bhi hua, disability wale survivors, report na karne wale bahut saare log, aur 2024 ke baad ka sab kuch: kaun India ke official rape figure se bahar hai, aur unhe bahar law ne rakha ya counting ne.

label.en: rape cases registered in India in 2024: the official figure, with its edges
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein register hue rape cases: official figure, apni seemaaon ke saath

label.en: POCSO cases of penetrative assault on girls in 2024, counted outside the rape figure
label.hg: 2024 mein ladkiyon par penetrative assault ke POCSO cases, jo rape figure se bahar gine gaye

label.en: rapes that ended in murder in 2024, counted as 'murder with rape' instead
label.hg: 2024 mein woh rapes jinke baad murder hua, jo 'murder with rape' ke roop mein gine gaye

label.en: of the 29,536 rape cases in which police used the clause for a survivor with a disability
label.hg: 29,536 rape cases mein se itne cases mein police ne disability wale survivor ka clause lagaya

actions.en: Paste a one-line caveat under any rape statistic you share: the year, 'registered cases', and who is left out.
actions.hg: Jo bhi rape statistic share karein, uske neeche ek line ka caveat jodiye: saal, 'registered cases', aur kaun chhoot gaya.

actions.en: Before you call any figure India's rape count, add the POCSO and murder-with-rape numbers from the same report.
actions.hg: Kisi figure ko India ka rape count kehne se pehle, usi report se POCSO aur murder-with-rape ke numbers bhi jodiye.

actions.en: Never read a missing group as a safe group: ask whether the law or the count has left them out.
actions.hg: Kisi group ke gayab hone ko uske safe hone ka saboot mat maaniye: poochiye ki law ne ya counting ne use bahar toh nahi rakha.

actions.en: If a wife, a man, a transgender person or a disabled person tells you they were sexually assaulted, believe them. What happened is real whether or not a table counts it.
actions.hg: Agar koi patni, koi mard, koi transgender vyakti ya disability wala koi insaan bataye ki uske saath sexual assault hua, toh unpar bharosa kijiye. Jo hua woh sach hai, chahe koi table use gine ya na gine.

actions.en: Help an adult survivor reach medical care and support first, and respect their decision about going to the police.
actions.hg: Kisi adult survivor ko pehle medical care aur support tak pahunchne mein madad kijiye, aur police ke paas jaane ka faisla unpar chhodiye.

title.en: Skin-to-skin, a rakhi for bail, 'only viewing': the High Court rulings on sexual offences the Supreme Court had to reverse
title.hg: Skin-to-skin, bail ke liye rakhi, 'sirf dekhna': sexual offences par High Courts ke woh faisle jo Supreme Court ko palatne pade

dek.en: A High Court narrowed a word, attached a rakhi to bail or cut down a charge. Five such orders in cases of sexual or gender-based violence, from 2021 to 2026, read side by side: each was corrected only because someone carried it to the Supreme Court.
dek.hg: Kisi High Court ne ek shabd ka matlab chhota kar diya, bail ke saath rakhi jod di ya charge kaat diya. 2021 se 2026 ke beech sexual ya gender-based violence ke cases mein aise paanch orders, ek saath rakhkar padhe gaye: har ek isliye theek hua kyunki koi use Supreme Court tak le gaya.

label.en: the day the Supreme Court restored a case the Madras High Court had quashed, calling the ruling an 'egregious error'
label.hg: jis din Supreme Court ne woh case bahaal kiya jo Madras High Court ne quash kar diya tha, aur us faisle ko 'egregious error' kaha

label.en: the day the Supreme Court said efforts to sensitise judges 'have not borne the fruit that was expected'
label.hg: jis din Supreme Court ne kaha ki judges ko sensitise karne ki koshishein 'have not borne the fruit that was expected'

label.en: POCSO cases pending trial in India's courts at the end of 2024
label.hg: POCSO cases jo 2024 ke end mein India ki courts mein trial ke liye pending the

claim.en: If a judge misreads the law in a sexual-offence case, a higher court will automatically correct it.
claim.hg: Agar koi judge sexual-offence case mein law galat padh le, toh higher court use apne aap theek kar degi.

truth.en: Higher courts see only what someone brings to them. The orders in this story were corrected after the Attorney General, other petitioners and a child-rights alliance went to the Supreme Court, and in one case after the Court acted on its own.
truth.hg: Higher courts wahi dekhti hain jo koi unke saamne laata hai. Is story ke orders tab theek hue jab Attorney General, doosre petitioners aur ek child-rights alliance Supreme Court gaye, aur ek case mein Court ne khud kadam uthaya.

actions.en: If a court order in your case looks wrong, ask a lawyer how to challenge it in a higher court. For free legal aid, call the NALSA helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Agar aapke case ka koi court order galat lage, toh lawyer se poochiye ki use higher court mein kaise challenge karein. Free legal aid ke liye NALSA helpline 15100 par call kariye.

actions.en: If anyone, in court or at a police station, suggests 'compromise', marriage or contact with the accused in a sexual-offence case, refuse and tell your lawyer. In 2021 the Supreme Court told courts never to suggest compromise or marriage in such cases.
actions.hg: Agar court ya police station mein koi sexual-offence case mein 'compromise', shaadi ya accused se milne ki baat kare, toh mana kariye aur apne lawyer ko bataiye. 2021 mein Supreme Court ne courts se kaha ki aise cases mein compromise ya shaadi ka sujhaav kabhi na dein.

actions.en: If a bail order requires the accused to visit or contact you, tell your lawyer at once. The Supreme Court ruled in 2021 that bail conditions must not require or permit such contact.
actions.hg: Agar bail order mein accused ko aapke ghar aane ya aapse contact karne ki shart ho, toh turant apne lawyer ko bataiye. Supreme Court ne 2021 mein kaha tha ki bail ki koi shart aisa contact na maange, na uski ijaazat de.

actions.en: If a child tells you about sexual touching, report it to the police or call the Child Helpline 1098. Over clothes or under them makes no difference in law.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha aapko sexual touching ke baare mein bataye, toh police ko report kariye ya Child Helpline 1098 par call kariye. Kapdon ke upar se ho ya neeche se, law mein koi fark nahi.

actions.en: Never save or forward child sexual abuse material. Report it at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.
actions.hg: Child sexual abuse material ko kabhi save ya forward mat kariye. cybercrime.gov.in par report kariye ya 1930 par call kariye.

title.en: Five promises to rape survivors, one report card: what Indian law guarantees and what the 2024-2026 numbers show
title.hg: Rape survivors se paanch vaade, ek report card: Indian law kya guarantee karta hai aur 2024-2026 ke numbers kya dikhate hain

dek.en: A crisis centre in every district. An investigation in two months. A trial in two months. Compensation without a conviction. Anonymity. We marked each promise against the latest official figures: one is late, one has failed, two cannot be checked on the figures available and one is barely enforced.
dek.hg: Har district mein crisis centre. Do mahine mein investigation. Do mahine mein trial. Conviction ke bina compensation. Aur pehchaan ki hifazat. Humne har vaade ko latest official figures se jaancha: ek late hai, ek fail ho chuka hai, do ko maujood figures se jaancha hi nahi ja sakta aur ek mushkil se enforce hota hai.

statLabel.en: approved One Stop Centres were operational in July 2026, more than six years after the Supreme Court's deadline
statLabel.hg: yaani 1,033 approved One Stop Centres mein se 985 July 2026 mein chal rahe the, Supreme Court ki deadline ke chhe saal se bhi zyada baad

label.en: approved One Stop Centres operational in July 2026
label.hg: yaani 1,033 approved One Stop Centres mein se 985 July 2026 mein chal rahe the

label.en: rape cases still under investigation at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases 2024 ke end par abhi bhi investigation mein the

label.en: of rape cases before the courts were still pending at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases, jo courts ke saamne the, 2024 ke end par bhi pending the

label.en: cases registered in July-December 2024 for revealing a rape survivor's identity
label.hg: cases July-December 2024 mein rape survivor ki pehchaan zaahir karne par register hue

claim.en: A rape survivor's rights begin only when the accused is convicted.
claim.hg: Rape survivor ke rights tabhi shuru hote hain jab accused convict ho jaye.

truth.en: Most of them start on day one. A One Stop Centre, a progress update within 90 days, compensation even if the offender is never traced, and anonymity do not depend on a verdict.
truth.hg: Zyada tar rights pehle din se shuru ho jaate hain. One Stop Centre, 90 din ke andar progress update, offender kabhi na pakda jaye tab bhi compensation, aur pehchaan ki hifazat, inme se kuch bhi verdict par depend nahi karta.

actions.en: Save the Women Helpline 181 in your phone and ask it for your district's One Stop Centre. In an emergency, call 112.
actions.hg: Women Helpline 181 apne phone mein save kijiye aur usse apne district ke One Stop Centre ka pata poochiye. Emergency mein 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Ask the investigating officer in writing for a progress update. The BNSS gives a victim the right to one within 90 days.
actions.hg: Investigating officer se likhit mein progress update maangiye. BNSS ke tahat victim ko 90 din ke andar update paane ka haq hai.

actions.en: Apply for compensation at your District Legal Services Authority (NALSA helpline 15100). You do not need an arrest, a trial or a conviction.
actions.hg: Compensation ke liye apni District Legal Services Authority mein apply kijiye (NALSA helpline 15100). Iske liye arrest, trial ya conviction zaroori nahi hai.

actions.en: If a survivor's name, photo or address is being shared, do not forward it. Save a screenshot and give the police a written complaint citing Section 72 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar kisi survivor ka naam, photo ya address share ho raha ho, toh use forward mat kijiye. Screenshot save kijiye aur BNS ki Section 72 ka hawala dekar police ko likhit complaint dijiye.

actions.en: Keep one dated file: the FIR copy, the charge-sheet date and every hearing date. Delay is easier to challenge when it is on paper.
actions.hg: Ek file rakhiye jisme date ke saath sab kuch ho: FIR ki copy, charge-sheet ki date aur har hearing ki date. Deri ko challenge karna tab aasaan hota hai jab woh kaagaz par ho.

title.en: Not only the rapist: how Indian law punishes those who join in, film, cover up or stay silent about sexual violence
title.hg: Sirf rapist nahi: jo saath dete hain, video banate hain, sach chhupate hain ya chup rehte hain, Indian law unhe kaise saza deta hai

dek.en: The man who kept watch, the friend who filmed, the policeman who made the evidence disappear, the adult who knew about a child and said nothing. Indian law has a section for each of them, and the numbers show how rarely some of those sections are used.
dek.hg: Jo aadmi darwaze pe pehra de raha tha, jo dost video bana raha tha, jo policeman evidence gayab kar raha tha, jo adult ek bachche ke abuse ke baare mein jaanta tha aur chup raha. Indian law mein in sab ke liye ek section hai, aur numbers dikhate hain ki kuch sections kitne kam use hote hain.

statLabel.en: POCSO cases in 2024 under the sections on abetment, attempt, failure to report and false complaints
statLabel.hg: POCSO cases 2024 mein abetment, attempt, report na karne aur jhoothi complaint wale sections ke under

label.en: minimum sentence for every member of a group that rapes a woman (BNS Section 70)
label.hg: kam se kam saza us group ke har member ke liye jo kisi woman ka rape kare (BNS Section 70)

label.en: maximum on a first conviction for sending sexually explicit material online (IT Act Section 67A)
label.hg: tak ki jail online sexually explicit material bhejne pe, pehli conviction mein (IT Act Section 67A)

label.en: policemen jailed for five years each for destroying evidence in the Kathua case (2019)
label.hg: policemen ko Kathua case mein evidence mitane ke liye paanch-paanch saal ki jail hui (2019)

label.en: POCSO cases in 2024 under the sections on abetment, attempt, failure to report and false complaints
label.hg: POCSO cases 2024 mein abetment, attempt, report na karne aur jhoothi complaint wale sections ke under

claim.en: If I did not touch her, I did nothing illegal.
claim.hg: Maine usse chhua tak nahi, toh maine kuch illegal nahi kiya.

truth.en: Every member of a group that rapes is guilty of rape. Filming, forwarding, destroying evidence, naming the survivor and, when the survivor is a child, failing to report are each separate crimes.
truth.hg: Rape karne wale group ka har member rape ka doshi hai. Video banana, forward karna, evidence mitana, survivor ka naam batana, aur agar survivor bachcha hai toh report na karna, yeh sab alag-alag crimes hain.

actions.en: If a video or photo of an assault reaches you, do not forward it, even to condemn it: report it on the platform and at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930.
actions.hg: Agar kisi assault ka video ya photo aap tak pahunche, toh use forward mat kijiye, condemn karne ke liye bhi nahi. Platform pe aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report kijiye.

actions.en: If you know a child is being sexually abused, report it to the police or the Child Helpline 1098: under POCSO this is a legal duty, not a favour.
