actions.hg: Agar aapko pata hai ki kisi bachche ka sexual abuse ho raha hai, toh police ya Child Helpline 1098 ko bataiye. POCSO ke under yeh legal duty hai, ehsaan nahi.

actions.en: Never post a survivor's name, photo, school, workplace or address, including in a 'justice for' post.
actions.hg: Survivor ka naam, photo, school, workplace ya address kabhi post mat kijiye, 'justice for' wali post mein bhi nahi.

actions.en: If a police station will not record a rape complaint, say 'Section 199 of the BNS' and 'Zero FIR' out loud, and complain about the refusal in writing to a senior police officer.
actions.hg: Agar police station rape complaint likhne se mana kare, toh zor se 'BNS Section 199' aur 'Zero FIR' boliye, aur mana karne ki complaint likh kar kisi senior police officer ko dijiye.

actions.en: If you saw or heard something, write down the date, time and names today and offer it to the survivor; in an emergency call 112.
actions.hg: Agar aapne kuch dekha ya suna, toh aaj hi date, time aur naam likh lijiye aur survivor ko offer kijiye. Emergency mein 112 pe call kijiye.

title.en: 2,561 attempt-to-rape cases, 62% from two states: what West Bengal and Rajasthan's numbers say about how police charge sexual assault
title.hg: 2,561 attempt-to-rape cases, 62% sirf do states se: West Bengal aur Rajasthan ke numbers batate hain ki police sexual assault ko kaise charge karti hai

dek.en: West Bengal and Rajasthan registered most of India's attempt-to-rape cases in 2024. The numbers cannot show that attackers cluster there. They can show how differently states file sexual assaults, and the section police write decides the punishment the accused can face.
dek.hg: 2024 mein India ke zyada tar attempt-to-rape cases West Bengal aur Rajasthan mein register hue. Yeh numbers nahi dikha sakte ki attackers wahin zyada hain. Yeh dikhate hain ki alag-alag states sexual assault ko kitne alag tareeke se file karte hain, aur police jo section likhti hai, wahi tay karta hai ki accused ko kitni saza ho sakti hai.

statLabel.en: share of India's 2024 attempt-to-rape cases registered in West Bengal and Rajasthan
statLabel.hg: India ke 2024 ke attempt-to-rape cases ka hissa jo West Bengal aur Rajasthan mein register hua

label.en: attempt-to-rape cases registered in India in 2024
label.hg: attempt-to-rape cases jo 2024 mein India mein register hue

label.en: of them in West Bengal, the highest of any state
label.hg: inmein se West Bengal mein, kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada

label.en: in Rajasthan, the second highest
label.hg: Rajasthan mein, doosre number par

label.en: cases of assault to outrage a woman's modesty registered in the same year
label.hg: assault to outrage a woman's modesty ke cases usi saal register hue

claim.en: The sections written in an FIR are a technicality. The court will sort out what really happened.
claim.hg: FIR mein likhe sections bas ek technicality hain. Asal mein kya hua, woh court dekh lega.

truth.en: The section sets the punishment the accused can face and shapes the whole trial. In 2026 the Supreme Court had to step in after a High Court reduced an attempt-to-rape charge in a child's case to lesser offences.
truth.hg: Section hi tay karta hai ki accused ko kitni saza ho sakti hai, aur poora trial usi se shape hota hai. 2026 mein Supreme Court ko beech mein aana pada jab ek High Court ne ek bachche ke case mein attempt-to-rape charge ko chhote offences mein badal diya.

actions.en: Ask for your free copy of the FIR and check which sections police have written. Attempt to rape, assault to outrage modesty and assault to disrobe carry very different punishments.
actions.hg: FIR ki free copy maangiye aur dekhiye ki police ne kaun se sections likhe hain. Attempt to rape, assault to outrage modesty aur assault to disrobe ki saza mein bahut farak hai.

actions.en: If the sections do not match what happened, say so in writing to the station and to the Superintendent of Police, and keep a copy.
actions.hg: Agar sections hue waakye se match nahi karte, toh station aur Superintendent of Police ko likh kar bataiye, aur uski copy rakhiye.

actions.en: When the magistrate records your statement, describe everything that happened in your own words. That statement can matter when the court decides the charges.
actions.hg: Jab magistrate aapka statement record kare, toh jo kuch hua sab apne shabdon mein bataiye. Court jab charges tay karta hai, tab yeh statement maayne rakh sakta hai.

actions.en: Get a free lawyer from the District Legal Services Authority. A lawyer can raise the charge question before the trial is set in stone.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer lijiye. Lawyer trial pakka hone se pehle charge ka sawaal utha sakta hai.

actions.en: If you were attacked as a child, or are helping a child, the case belongs under POCSO. Call the Child Helpline 1098 for support.
actions.hg: Agar aap par bachpan mein attack hua, ya aap kisi bachche ki madad kar rahe hain, toh case POCSO ke under aata hai. Support ke liye Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

title.en: Will he get bail? What the law lets a survivor ask for, and when
title.hg: Kya use bail mil jaayegi? Law survivor ko kya maangne deta hai, aur kab

dek.en: After the FIR, the first fear is that the accused will be back on the street. The law shuts out bail in advance for two offences and under the Atrocities Act, leaves the rest to a judge, and since 2021 forbids any bail condition that lets him contact the survivor. What to ask for, and what to do when a condition is broken.
dek.hg: FIR ke baad pehla darr yahi hota hai ki accused wapas sadak par hoga. Law do offences mein aur Atrocities Act ke under advance bail ka darwaaza band karta hai, baaki judge par chhodta hai, aur 2021 se aisi koi bail condition mana hai jo use survivor se contact karne de. Kya maangna hai, aur condition tootne par kya karna hai.

label.en: if the girl is below this age, a man accused of raping her cannot get anticipatory bail (Section 482(4) BNSS)
label.hg: ladki agar is umar se kam hai, to uske rape ke accused ko anticipatory bail nahi mil sakti (Section 482(4) BNSS)

label.en: of rape cases before the courts were still pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: court ke saamne wale rape cases 2024 ke end mein bhi trial ke liye pending the

label.en: the day the Supreme Court barred bail conditions that require or permit contact with the survivor
label.hg: jis din Supreme Court ne survivor se contact maangne ya allow karne wali bail conditions par rok lagayi

label.en: of the Atrocities Act gives Dalit and Adivasi victims the right to notice of bail hearings
label.hg: Atrocities Act ka ye section Dalit aur Adivasi victims ko bail hearings ka notice paane ka right deta hai

claim.en: Once a rape FIR is registered, the accused stays in jail until the verdict.
claim.hg: Rape FIR register hone ke baad accused verdict tak jail mein hi rehta hai.

truth.en: The law bars only anticipatory bail, and only for the rape of a girl under 16, the gang rape of a girl under 18 and offences under the Atrocities Act. Otherwise a judge decides, and since 2021 any bail given must not allow contact with the survivor.
truth.hg: Law sirf anticipatory bail par rok lagata hai, aur woh bhi sirf 16 se kam umar ki ladki ke rape, 18 se kam umar ki ladki ke gang rape aur Atrocities Act ke offences mein. Baaki mein judge decide karta hai, aur 2021 se di gayi koi bhi bail survivor se contact allow nahi kar sakti.

actions.en: Before the bail hearing, give the investigating officer and the public prosecutor a written, dated note of every threat, visit or call from the accused's side.
actions.hg: Bail hearing se pehle investigating officer aur public prosecutor ko accused ki taraf se aaye har threat, visit ya call ka likhit, dated note do.

actions.en: Ask for specific bail conditions: no contact by any means, and staying away from your home, workplace and college.
actions.hg: Specific bail conditions maango: kisi bhi tarah ka contact nahi, aur tumhare ghar, workplace aur college se door rehna.

actions.en: If the case is under the SC/ST Atrocities Act, insist on notice of every bail hearing; Section 15A gives you that right.
actions.hg: Agar case SC/ST Atrocities Act ke under hai, to har bail hearing ke notice par zor do; Section 15A tumhe ye right deta hai.

actions.en: If a condition is broken, save the proof and ask in writing for bail to be cancelled; call 112 if you are in danger.
actions.hg: Condition tooti to proof sambhaalo aur likhit mein bail cancel karne ki maang karo; khatre mein ho to 112 call karo.

actions.en: Ask the District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer; you do not have to face a bail hearing alone.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer maango; bail hearing akele face karna zaroori nahi.

title.en: July 2024 to November 2026: a timeline of India's new criminal laws and what they changed for sexual-violence cases
title.hg: July 2024 se November 2026: India ke naye criminal laws ki timeline, aur sexual violence ke cases ke liye unhone kya badla

dek.en: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita arrived with one new sexual offence, one deleted section and deadlines nobody enforces. In 28 months the deleted section has been to two courts, the first data mixing both codes has come out, and the fast-track courts have been extended to 2031.
dek.hg: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ek naye sexual offence, ek hataye gaye section aur aisi deadlines ke saath aayi jinhe koi laagu nahin karwata. 28 mahinon mein hataya gaya section do courts tak pahunch chuka hai, dono codes ka mila-jula pehla data aa chuka hai, aur fast-track courts 2031 tak badha di gayi hain.

statLabel.en: cases registered under the new deceit offence, Section 69, in its first six months
statLabel.hg: cases naye deceit offence, Section 69, ke under uske pehle chhe mahinon mein darj hue

label.en: cases registered under Section 69 of the BNS between July and December 2024
label.hg: cases July se December 2024 ke beech BNS ke Section 69 ke under darj hue

label.en: of the 29,536 rape cases registered in 2024 were filed under the BNS; the other 19,683 were under the IPC
label.hg: 2024 mein darj 29,536 rape cases mein se itne BNS ke under file hue; baaki 19,683 IPC ke under the

label.en: rape and POCSO cases pending before Fast Track Special Courts at the end of 2025
label.hg: rape aur POCSO cases 2025 ke end mein Fast Track Special Courts mein pending the

label.en: fast-track courts provided for under the scheme extended in November 2026 to 31 March 2031
label.hg: fast-track courts tak ka provision us scheme mein hai jo November 2026 mein 31 March 2031 tak badhayi gayi

actions.en: Check the date of the offence: before 1 July 2024 the IPC applies, on or after it the BNS. Ask police which sections your FIR uses.
actions.hg: Offence ki date check karo: 1 July 2024 se pehle ka ho toh IPC lagta hai, us din ya uske baad ka ho toh BNS. Police se poochho ki tumhari FIR mein kaun se sections lage hain.

actions.en: Use what the new procedure code gives you: report at any police station or by e-FIR, and ask in writing for the investigation update due within 90 days.
actions.hg: Naye procedure code ka poora fayda uthao: kisi bhi police station mein ya e-FIR se report karo, aur 90 din ke andar milne wala investigation update likh kar maango.

actions.en: If you are a man or a transgender person who was sexually assaulted, report it anyway, and ask a lawyer or the District Legal Services Authority which sections can apply.
actions.hg: Agar tum man ya transgender person ho aur tumhare saath sexual assault hua hai, toh phir bhi report karo, aur lawyer ya District Legal Services Authority se poochho ki kaun se sections lag sakte hain.

actions.en: If you are under 18, POCSO protects you whatever your gender. Call 1098.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh POCSO tumhe protect karta hai, gender koi bhi ho. 1098 par call karo.

actions.en: Read 2024 crime numbers with care: they mix two codes, and a new row is not a new crime wave.
actions.hg: 2024 ke crime numbers dhyan se padho: unmein do codes mile hue hain, aur nayi row ka matlab nayi crime wave nahin hota.

title.en: Two laws for one crime: why a girl who is raped is covered by both the BNS and POCSO, and a boy only by POCSO
title.hg: Ek crime, do kanoon: jis ladki ka rape hua use BNS aur POCSO dono cover karte hain, aur ladke ko sirf POCSO, aisa kyun

dek.en: A girl under 18 who is raped stands under two statutes at once. A boy of the same age has one, because the penal code still defines rape as something done to a woman. The sentences have matched on paper since 2019. Here is what still differs.
dek.hg: 18 se kam umar ki jis ladki ka rape hota hai, woh ek saath do kanoonon ke neeche khadi hoti hai. Usi umar ke ladke ke paas ek hi hai, kyunki penal code ab bhi rape ko aisa kaam maanta hai jo aurat ke saath hota hai. Kaagaz pe sazayein 2019 se barabar hain. Jo ab bhi alag hai, woh yahan hai.

statLabel.en: cases with girl victims recorded under the rape head (BNS or IPC) in 2024, against 43,313 under POCSO
statLabel.hg: girl victims wale cases jo 2024 mein rape head (BNS ya IPC) ke tehat record hue, jabki POCSO ke tehat 43,313

label.en: cases with girl victims under 18 recorded under the rape head in 2024
label.hg: 18 se kam umar ki girl victims wale cases jo 2024 mein rape head ke tehat record hue

label.en: POCSO penetrative-assault cases with girl victims in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein girl victims wale POCSO penetrative assault cases

label.en: boys recorded as victims of penetrative sexual assault under POCSO in 2024
label.hg: ladke jo 2024 mein POCSO ke tehat penetrative sexual assault ke victim record hue

label.en: minimum sentence under both laws when the child is under 16
label.hg: dono kanoonon mein kam se kam saza jab bachcha 16 se kam ka ho

claim.en: POCSO is the law for girls. If a boy is abused, there is nothing the police can do.
claim.hg: POCSO ladkiyon ka kanoon hai. Ladke ke saath abuse ho to police kuch nahi kar sakti.

truth.en: It is the other way round. POCSO protects every child under 18, and for a boy it is the only law that does. The rape sections of the BNS cover only women and girls.
truth.hg: Baat ulti hai. POCSO 18 se kam ke har bachche ko protect karta hai, aur ladke ke liye to yahi akela kanoon hai. BNS ke rape sections sirf auraton aur ladkiyon ko cover karte hain.

actions.en: If a child of any gender tells you about sexual abuse, report it to the police or the Child Helpline 1098. Under POCSO, knowing and not reporting is itself an offence.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi gender ka bachcha aapko sexual abuse ke baare mein bataye to police ya Child Helpline 1098 ko report kijiye. POCSO mein jaante hue report na karna khud ek offence hai.

actions.en: Ask for the free copy of the FIR and check that POCSO sections are written in it, for a boy as much as for a girl.
actions.hg: FIR ki free copy maangiye aur check kijiye ki usmein POCSO ke sections likhe hain, ladke ke case mein bhi utna hi jitna ladki ke case mein.

actions.en: Ask the police to record the child's statement at home or a place the child chooses, by an officer out of uniform. Section 24 of POCSO requires it.
actions.hg: Police se kahiye ki bachche ka statement ghar pe ya bachche ki pasand ki jagah pe le, aur officer uniform mein na ho. POCSO ka Section 24 yahi kehta hai.

actions.en: Take the child to a hospital at once. Every hospital, public or private, must treat a child survivor free of cost.
actions.hg: Bachche ko turant hospital le jaaiye. Har hospital, sarkari ho ya private, ko child survivor ka ilaaj free mein karna hota hai.

title.en: Kolkata 98.5%, Jaipur 55.7%: how India's big-city police finish crimes-against-women investigations
title.hg: Kolkata 98.5%, Jaipur 55.7%: India ke bade shehron ki police crimes-against-women ki investigations kaise khatam karti hai

dek.en: Police in India's 19 biggest cities filed charge-sheets in 76.8% of the crimes-against-women cases they closed in 2024. In Kolkata it was 98.5%, in Jaipur 55.7%. That gap decides how many complaints ever go to trial. It does not tell you which force is doing better.
dek.hg: 2024 mein India ke 19 sabse bade shehron ki police ne jitne crimes-against-women cases nipataaye, unme se 76.8% mein charge-sheet file ki. Kolkata mein yeh 98.5% tha, Jaipur mein 55.7%. Yahi gap tay karta hai ki kitni complaints kabhi trial tak pahunchti hain. Yeh nahi batata ki kaunsi police behtar kaam kar rahi hai.

statLabel.en: charge-sheeting rate for crimes against women in Jaipur in 2024, the lowest of 19 big cities
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein Jaipur mein crimes against women ka charge-sheeting rate, 19 bade shehron mein sabse kam

label.en: of crimes-against-women cases disposed of by police in 19 big cities were charge-sheeted in 2024
label.hg: 19 bade shehron mein police ke nipataaye crimes-against-women cases jinme 2024 mein charge-sheet file hui

label.en: Kolkata's charge-sheeting rate, the highest of the 19 cities
label.hg: Kolkata ka charge-sheeting rate, 19 shehron mein sabse zyada

label.en: Jaipur's charge-sheeting rate, the lowest of the 19 cities
label.hg: Jaipur ka charge-sheeting rate, 19 shehron mein sabse kam

label.en: West Bengal's conviction rate for crimes against women in 2024, the lowest of any state
label.hg: 2024 mein West Bengal mein crimes against women ka conviction rate, kisi bhi state mein sabse kam

claim.en: A police force that charge-sheets almost every case is doing its job well.
claim.hg: Jo police lagbhag har case mein charge-sheet file karti hai, woh apna kaam achhe se kar rahi hai.

truth.en: A charge-sheet only sends a case to court. Andhra Pradesh charge-sheeted 94.4% of crimes-against-women cases in 2024 and its courts convicted in 5.4% of completed trials. The rate also cannot see complaints that were never registered.
truth.hg: Charge-sheet case ko sirf court tak bhejti hai. Andhra Pradesh ne 2024 mein 94.4% crimes-against-women cases mein charge-sheet file ki, aur uski courts ne poore hue trials mein se 5.4% mein saza di. Yeh rate un complaints ko bhi nahi dekh sakta jo kabhi register hi nahi hui.

actions.en: Take your free copy of the FIR before you leave the station, and note the investigating officer's name and phone number.
actions.hg: Station se nikalne se pehle FIR ki free copy lijiye, aur investigating officer ka naam aur phone number note kar lijiye.

actions.en: Ask police in writing for a progress update. The BNSS gives a victim the right to one within 90 days.
actions.hg: Police se likhit mein progress update maangiye. BNSS victim ko 90 din ke andar update paane ka haq deta hai.

actions.en: In a rape or POCSO case, note the date two months after the FIR. That is the legal deadline for the investigation; ask in writing if it passes.
actions.hg: Rape ya POCSO case mein FIR ke do mahine baad ki date note kar lijiye. Yeh investigation ki legal deadline hai; agar yeh nikal jaaye toh likhit mein poochiye.

actions.en: If police close your case with a final report, ask for a copy and take it to a lawyer straight away. It is a police classification, not a court verdict.
actions.hg: Agar police aapka case final report ke saath band kar de, toh uski copy maangiye aur turant kisi lawyer ko dikhaiye. Yeh police ki classification hai, court ka faisla nahi.

actions.en: Do not read a city's high or low numbers as proof that it is safe or unsafe. NCRB itself warns against that.
actions.hg: Kisi shehar ke zyada ya kam numbers ko is baat ka saboot mat maaniye ki woh safe hai ya unsafe. NCRB khud iske khilaaf chetaavni deta hai.

title.en: Cognizable, non-bailable, non-compoundable: the three legal labels that decide what happens after a sexual-offence complaint
title.hg: Cognizable, non-bailable, non-compoundable: woh teen legal labels jo tay karte hain ki sexual-offence complaint ke baad kya hoga

dek.en: Every offence in Indian law carries three labels. They decide whether police must act without a magistrate's order, whether the accused can claim bail as a right, and whether anyone is allowed to 'settle' the case. Here is how to read them.
dek.hg: Indian law mein har offence par teen labels lage hote hain. Yahi tay karte hain ki police magistrate ke order ke bina action legi ya nahi, accused bail ko apna haq bata sakta hai ya nahi, aur kisi ko case 'settle' karne ki ijaazat hai ya nahi. Inhe padhna aise seekhiye.

statLabel.en: cruelty-by-husband cases that ended in compromise in 2024, against 10,689 convictions
statLabel.hg: cruelty-by-husband cases jo 2024 mein compromise par khatam hue, jabki conviction sirf 10,689 mein hua

label.en: cruelty-by-husband cases that ended in compromise or compounding in Indian courts in 2024
label.hg: cruelty-by-husband cases jo 2024 mein Indian courts mein compromise ya compounding par khatam hue

label.en: cruelty-by-husband cases that ended in conviction in the same year
label.hg: cruelty-by-husband cases jo usi saal conviction par khatam hue

label.en: rigorous imprisonment for a police officer who fails to record an FIR for rape or sexual assault (Section 199 BNS)
label.hg: rigorous imprisonment us police officer ke liye jo rape ya sexual assault ki FIR record na kare (Section 199 BNS)

label.en: notice a citizen or organisation must give the authority before taking a sex-selection complaint to court
label.hg: ka notice jo ek citizen ya organisation ko sex-selection complaint court le jaane se pehle authority ko dena hota hai

claim.en: If both families agree, a rape case can be closed with a compromise.
claim.hg: Agar dono families maan jaayein, toh rape case compromise se band ho sakta hai.

truth.en: The Supreme Court has told judges not to suggest or entertain compromise, including marriage, in sexual-offence cases. A deal between families is not a verdict.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ne judges ko kaha hai ki sexual-offence cases mein compromise, shaadi samet, ka na sujhaav dein aur na use entertain karein. Families ke beech ka samjhauta koi verdict nahi hai.

actions.en: Read the sections on your free copy of the FIR, and ask a free legal-aid lawyer whether each one is cognizable, bailable and compoundable.
actions.hg: Apni FIR ki free copy par likhe sections padhiye, aur free legal-aid lawyer se poochiye ki har section cognizable, bailable aur compoundable hai ya nahi.

actions.en: If police ask for a court order before registering rape or sexual assault, say the offence is cognizable and that failing to record it is punishable under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police rape ya sexual assault register karne se pehle court order maange, toh boliye ki yeh offence cognizable hai aur FIR record na karna Section 199 BNS mein punishable hai.

actions.en: If the accused gets bail, ask the public prosecutor what conditions the court set. A condition that makes him contact you can be challenged.
actions.hg: Agar accused ko bail mil jaaye, toh public prosecutor se poochiye ki court ne kya conditions lagayi hain. Jo condition use aapse contact karwaaye, use challenge kiya ja sakta hai.

actions.en: Do not sign a 'samjhauta' paper at a police station or panchayat. Speak to a free lawyer at the District Legal Services Authority first.
actions.hg: Police station ya panchayat mein kisi 'samjhauta' paper par sign mat kijiye. Pehle District Legal Services Authority ke free lawyer se baat kijiye.

actions.en: For sex selection, complain in writing to the district Appropriate Authority under the PC-PNDT Act and keep proof of the date.
actions.hg: Sex selection ke liye PC-PNDT Act ke under district Appropriate Authority ko likh kar complaint kijiye aur date ka proof sambhal kar rakhiye.

title.en: Ordered, then ignored: a timeline of court directions on sexual and gender-based violence that governments failed to carry out on time, 1997-2025
title.hg: Order hua, phir ignore hua: sexual aur gender-based violence par courts ke woh directions jo sarkaron ne time par poore nahi kiye, 1997-2025 ki timeline

dek.en: The Supreme Court told governments to set up harassment complaints committees in 1997, fast-track courts for honour crimes in 2018, a crisis centre in every district by December 2019 and local harassment committees by January 2025. Years later, courts and Parliament were still being told the work was unfinished. Here is the record, and how citizens can use it.
dek.hg: Supreme Court ne sarkaron se 1997 mein harassment complaints committees banane ko kaha, 2018 mein honour crimes ke liye fast-track courts, December 2019 tak har district mein crisis centre aur January 2025 tak local harassment committees. Saalon baad bhi courts aur Parliament ko yahi bataya ja raha tha ki kaam adhoora hai. Yeh raha poora record, aur yeh bhi ki citizens ise kaise use kar sakte hain.

label.en: after the Vishaka guidelines (1997), the Supreme Court found several states had still not complied (2012)
label.hg: yaani 15 saal: Vishaka guidelines (1997) ke itne saal baad bhi Supreme Court ne paaya ki kai states ne compliance nahi kiya tha (2012)

label.en: after the Shakti Vahini judgment (March 2018), Delhi still had no fast-track courts for honour-killing cases (December 2025)
label.hg: yaani 7 saal: Shakti Vahini judgment (March 2018) ke itne saal baad bhi Delhi mein honour-killing cases ke liye fast-track courts nahi the (December 2025)

label.en: approved One Stop Centres operational in July 2026; the deadline for one in every district was December 2019
label.hg: yaani 1,033 approved One Stop Centres mein se 985 July 2026 mein chal rahe the; har district mein ek centre ki deadline December 2019 thi

label.en: states and union territories where Local Committee compliance was unclear in May 2025: Delhi, Haryana, Jharkhand and Kerala
label.hg: states aur union territories jahan May 2025 mein Local Committee ka compliance saaf nahi tha: Delhi, Haryana, Jharkhand aur Kerala

claim.en: Once the Supreme Court orders something, governments have to do it, so it gets done.
claim.hg: Supreme Court ek baar order de de, toh sarkaron ko woh karna hi padta hai, isliye kaam ho hi jaata hai.

truth.en: An order creates a duty, not a result. Complaints committees ordered in 1997 were still missing in several states in 2012, and fast-track courts for honour crimes directed in 2018 did not exist in Delhi in December 2025. Orders are carried out when someone keeps checking.
truth.hg: Order se zimmedari banti hai, nateeja nahi. 1997 mein jin complaints committees ka order hua, woh 2012 mein bhi kai states mein nahi bani thi, aur 2018 mein honour crimes ke liye jin fast-track courts ka direction diya gaya, woh December 2025 mein Delhi mein maujood nahi thi. Orders tab poore hote hain jab koi lagataar check karta rahe.

actions.en: Ask your collectorate or district women and child development office in writing who the District Officer under the POSH Act is and whether a Local Committee exists.
actions.hg: Apne collectorate ya district women and child development office se likhit mein poochiye ki POSH Act ke tahat District Officer kaun hai aur Local Committee bani hai ya nahi.

actions.en: File an RTI application asking when the Local Committee was constituted, who its members are and where your district's One Stop Centre is.
actions.hg: RTI application lagaiye aur poochiye ki Local Committee kab bani, uske members kaun hain aur aapke district ka One Stop Centre kahan hai.

actions.en: If you work somewhere with fewer than ten workers, or your harasser is the employer, take a written complaint to the Local Committee within three months of the incident (the committee can allow up to three more months if you could not complain in time), or file it on SHe-Box.
actions.hg: Agar aap aisi jagah kaam karti hain jahan das se kam workers hain, ya harass karne wala khud employer hai, toh incident ke teen mahine ke andar Local Committee ko likhit complaint dijiye (agar aap time par complaint nahi kar paayin, toh committee teen mahine aur de sakti hai), ya SHe-Box par file kijiye.

actions.en: If a couple you know is threatened over an inter-caste or inter-faith relationship, call 112 and ask the district police chief in writing for protection, citing Shakti Vahini v. Union of India (2018).
actions.hg: Agar aapke jaanne wale kisi couple ko inter-caste ya inter-faith relationship ki wajah se dhamkiyan mil rahi hain, toh 112 par call kijiye aur district police chief se likhit mein protection maangiye, Shakti Vahini v. Union of India (2018) ka hawala dekar.

actions.en: Ask your MLA or MP how many One Stop Centres your district has and whether they are open at night.
actions.hg: Apne MLA ya MP se poochiye ki aapke district mein kitne One Stop Centres hain aur kya woh raat ko khule rehte hain.

title.en: Death for rape, 2013 to 2025: how India kept adding the death penalty to its rape laws, and what courts did with it
title.hg: Rape ke liye maut ki sazaa, 2013 se 2025: India apne rape laws mein death penalty kaise jodta gaya, aur courts ne uske saath kya kiya

dek.en: After the 2012 Delhi gang rape, Parliament added death to the rape laws four times in ten years. Courts, deciding one case at a time, kept asking whether a crime was the 'rarest of the rare'. The law and the verdicts, year by year.
dek.hg: 2012 ke Delhi gang rape ke baad Parliament ne das saal mein chaar baar rape laws mein maut ki sazaa jodi. Courts, ek-ek case dekhte hue, poochhte rahe ki kya yeh crime 'rarest of the rare' hai. Kaanoon aur faisle, saal dar saal.

label.en: convicts in the 2012 Delhi gang rape case hanged at Tihar Jail on 20 March 2020
label.hg: 2012 Delhi gang rape case ke convicts jinhe 20 March 2020 ko Tihar Jail mein phaansi di gayi

label.en: Shakti Mills death sentences of 2014, commuted to life by the Bombay High Court in 2021
label.hg: Shakti Mills ki 2014 ki death sentences, jinhe Bombay High Court ne 2021 mein life mein badal diya

label.en: age of a girl whose gang rape can carry death under the BNS; under the 2018 law the limit was under 12
label.hg: ladki ki umar jiske gang rape par BNS ke tahat maut ki sazaa ho sakti hai; 2018 mein yeh under 12 thi

claim.en: Once the law allows death for rape, the worst rapists will be hanged.
claim.hg: Jab kaanoon rape ke liye maut ki sazaa allow karta hai, toh sabse bure rapists ko phaansi ho hi jaayegi.

truth.en: A judge must still decide whether each crime is the 'rarest of the rare'. In the RG Kar case in 2025 a court said it was not, and in the Shakti Mills case the High Court replaced death with life.
truth.hg: Judge ko phir bhi har crime ke liye tay karna hota hai ki kya woh 'rarest of the rare' hai. 2025 mein RG Kar case mein court ne kaha nahi, aur Shakti Mills case mein High Court ne maut ki jagah life di.

actions.en: When a rape case makes the news, ask how far the investigation and trial have got, not only what sentence the accused might face.
actions.hg: Jab koi rape case news mein ho, toh sirf yeh mat poochhiye ki accused ko kya sazaa mil sakti hai; yeh poochhiye ki jaanch aur trial kahan tak pahunche.

actions.en: If you are a survivor or a family member, ask the District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer and ask the prosecutor for the date of every hearing.
actions.hg: Agar aap survivor ya parivaar se hain, toh District Legal Services Authority se free vakeel maangiye aur prosecutor se har hearing ki date poochhiye.

actions.en: Report the sexual abuse of a child to 1098 or the police at 112. The penalty is for the court to decide; the report is yours to make.
actions.hg: Bachche ke sexual abuse ki report 1098 ya police ko 112 par kijiye. Sazaa court tay karega; report karna aapke haath mein hai.

actions.en: Before sharing a post that demands hanging, check what sentence the law already provides and where the case actually stands.
actions.hg: Phaansi ki maang wala post share karne se pehle check kijiye ki kaanoon mein pehle se kya sazaa hai aur case asal mein kahan tak pahuncha hai.

title.en: Privacy, integrity, dignity: how the Supreme Court turned constitutional rights into rules for treating rape survivors
title.hg: Privacy, integrity, dignity: Supreme Court ne kaise constitutional rights ko rape survivors ke saath bartaav ke rules mein badla

dek.en: Parliament wrote the rape law. Many of the rules on how a survivor must be examined, named, protected at work and treated inside a marriage were written by judges, by reading fundamental rights into everyday practice. Here is how that happened, case by case, and how to use those rulings when a hospital, newsroom or court forgets them.
dek.hg: Rape ka law Parliament ne likha. Lekin survivor ka medical exam kaise hoga, uska naam kaun nahi le sakta, kaam ki jagah pe use kya protection milega aur shaadi ke andar kya rape hai, inme se kai rules judges ne likhe, fundamental rights ko roz ki practice pe laagu karke. Yahan case-by-case samjho yeh kaise hua, aur jab hospital, newsroom ya court inhe bhool jaaye toh in rulings ko kaise use karna hai.

label.en: between the Vishaka guidelines of 1997 and the workplace harassment law Parliament passed in 2013
label.hg: 1997 ki Vishaka guidelines aur 2013 mein Parliament ke workplace harassment law ke beech ka gap

label.en: the age below which sex with a wife is rape, after the Supreme Court's 2017 ruling
label.hg: Supreme Court ke 2017 ruling ke baad, is umar se kam wife ke saath sex rape hai

label.en: the abortion limit for rape survivors, which since 2022 includes a wife raped by her husband
label.hg: rape survivors ke liye abortion ki limit, jisme 2022 se pati dwara rape ki gayi wife bhi shaamil hai

actions.en: If a doctor proposes a 'finger test', refuse and complain in writing to the hospital head: the Supreme Court has said anyone who conducts it is guilty of misconduct.
actions.hg: Agar koi doctor 'finger test' ki baat kare, toh mana karo aur hospital head ko likhit complaint do: Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki yeh test karne wala har insaan misconduct ka doshi hai.

actions.en: If a news report, post or reel names a survivor or gives clues to who she is, report it to the platform and the police; even a hint is barred.
actions.hg: Agar koi news report, post ya reel survivor ka naam le ya uski pehchaan ke clues de, toh platform aur police ko report karo; ishara dena bhi mana hai.

actions.en: Rape and POCSO trials must be held in camera and, where practicable, before a woman judge. If they are not, ask the prosecutor to raise it: it is the rule, not a favour.
actions.hg: Rape aur POCSO trials in camera, aur jahan tak ho sake woman judge ke saamne, hone chahiye. Agar aisa nahi ho raha, toh prosecutor se yeh mudda uthwao: yeh rule hai, ehsaan nahi.

actions.en: If a judge suggests a 'compromise' or marriage with the accused, tell the lawyer to cite the Supreme Court's 2021 ruling that forbids it.
actions.hg: Agar koi judge accused ke saath 'compromise' ya shaadi ka sujhaav de, toh lawyer se Supreme Court ka 2021 ka ruling cite karwao jo ise mana karta hai.

actions.en: A woman pregnant after rape by her husband can seek an abortion up to 24 weeks like any rape survivor. Ask the doctor, not the family.
actions.hg: Jo aurat apne pati ke rape se pregnant hui hai, woh bhi kisi bhi rape survivor ki tarah 24 weeks tak abortion maang sakti hai. Doctor se poocho, family se nahi.

title.en: Rs 3,788.04 crore, up to 850 courts, 2,45,579 cases waiting: does India's 2026-2031 fast-track court plan add up?
title.hg: Rs 3,788.04 crore, zyada se zyada 850 courts, 2,45,579 cases line mein: kya India ka 2026-2031 fast-track court plan hisaab mein fit baithta hai?

dek.en: On 4 November 2026 the Cabinet funded five more years of fast-track courts for rape and POCSO cases. We ran the sums on the government's own figures: what each court gets, how many cases each must close a month, and what a count of courts leaves out.
dek.hg: 4 November 2026 ko Cabinet ne rape aur POCSO cases ke fast-track courts ko paanch saal aur fund kiya. Humne sarkar ke apne figures pe hisaab lagaya: har court ko kitna milta hai, har court ko mahine mein kitne cases close karne honge, aur courts ki ginti kya chhupa leti hai.

statLabel.en: new cases that reached fast-track courts in 2025, against 66,500 disposed of
statLabel.hg: 2025 mein fast-track courts mein aaye naye cases, jabki sirf 66,500 dispose hue

label.en: outlay approved for Fast Track Special Courts from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2031
label.hg: 1 April 2026 se 31 March 2031 tak Fast Track Special Courts ke liye approve hua outlay

label.en: courts the plan provides for at most; 779 were working in November 2026
label.hg: plan mein zyada se zyada itne courts; November 2026 mein 779 chal rahe the

label.en: rape and POCSO cases pending before these courts on 31 December 2025
label.hg: 31 December 2025 ko in courts mein pending rape aur POCSO cases

label.en: cases the courts disposed of in 2025, down 22% on 2024
label.hg: 2025 mein courts ne itne cases dispose kiye, 2024 se 22% kam

actions.en: When a new fast-track court is announced, ask two questions: how many cases are already waiting, and how many does each court close in a month.
actions.hg: Jab bhi naye fast-track court ka announcement ho, do sawaal poocho: kitne cases pehle se wait kar rahe hain, aur har court mahine mein kitne cases close karta hai.

actions.en: Ask your MP or MLA for your state's three numbers every year: cases registered, disposed of and pending in its fast-track courts.
actions.hg: Apne MP ya MLA se har saal apne state ke teen numbers maango: fast-track courts mein kitne cases register hue, kitne dispose hue aur kitne pending hain.

actions.en: If your case is in the queue, keep one file with the FIR, the chargesheet date and every hearing date, and ask the prosecutor why each adjournment was given.
actions.hg: Agar tumhara case queue mein hai, toh ek file rakho jisme FIR, chargesheet ki date aur har hearing ki date ho, aur prosecutor se poocho ki har adjournment kyun mila.

actions.en: Apply for victim compensation at the District Legal Services Authority now. It does not depend on the verdict.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority mein victim compensation ke liye abhi apply karo. Yeh verdict pe depend nahi karta.

actions.en: Judge the 2026-2031 plan by one figure: whether the count of pending cases falls.
actions.hg: 2026-2031 plan ko ek hi figure se judge karo: pending cases ki ginti girti hai ya nahi.

title.en: Every man in the group is guilty: what Section 70 of the BNS says about gang rape
title.hg: Group ka har aadmi doshi hai: BNS ka Section 70 gang rape ke baare mein kya kehta hai

dek.en: The law does not ask which man did what. If a group rapes a woman, each member is treated as having raped her and faces at least 20 years. What makes an attack gang rape in law, how the sentences work, and the bail and investigation rules that follow.
dek.hg: Law yeh nahi poochta ki kis aadmi ne kya kiya. Agar ek group kisi aurat ka rape kare, toh har member ko rape ka doshi maana jaata hai aur har ek ko kam se kam 20 saal ki saza hai. Law mein gang rape kya hai, saza kaise kaam karti hai, aur bail aur investigation ke rules kya hain.

statLabel.en: minimum sentence for each man convicted of gang rape
statLabel.hg: gang rape mein convict hue har aadmi ki minimum saza

label.en: minimum rigorous imprisonment for every member of a group that rapes a woman (Section 70(1), BNS)
label.hg: kisi aurat ka rape karne wale group ke har member ke liye kam se kam rigorous imprisonment (Section 70(1), BNS)

label.en: deadline for police to complete a gang-rape investigation (Section 193(2), BNSS)
label.hg: police ke liye gang-rape investigation poori karne ki deadline (Section 193(2), BNSS)

label.en: compensation range for a gang-rape survivor under NALSA's 2018 scheme
label.hg: NALSA ki 2018 scheme mein gang-rape survivor ke liye compensation ki range

label.en: gang-rape cases registered in India in 2024, 30 of them involving girls under 18
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein register hue gang-rape cases, jinmein se 30 mein 18 saal se kam ki ladkiyan thi

claim.en: A man who did not rape her himself can only be charged with helping.
claim.hg: Jis aadmi ne khud rape nahi kiya, us par sirf madad karne ka charge lag sakta hai.

truth.en: Under Section 70 of the BNS, every member of a group that rapes a woman is deemed to have committed rape, whatever his own part, and each faces at least 20 years.
truth.hg: BNS ke Section 70 mein, kisi aurat ka rape karne wale group ka har member rape ka doshi maana jaata hai, uska apna role chahe jo ho, aur har ek ko kam se kam 20 saal ki saza hai.

actions.en: Tell the police about every man involved, including those you cannot name. Describe them. Section 70 applies to each member of the group.
actions.hg: Police ko har us aadmi ke baare mein bataiye jo shamil tha, unke baare mein bhi jinka naam aap nahi jaanti. Unka huliya bataiye. Section 70 group ke har member par lagta hai.

actions.en: Read the FIR. A group attack should be recorded under Section 70 of the BNS, or Section 376D of the IPC if it happened before 1 July 2024.
actions.hg: FIR padhiye. Group ka hamla BNS ke Section 70 mein darj hona chahiye, ya agar woh 1 July 2024 se pehle hua tha toh IPC ke Section 376D mein.

actions.en: If the survivor is under 18, say so and give proof of age. The accused cannot get anticipatory bail. Call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar survivor 18 saal se kam ki hai, toh yeh bataiye aur umar ka proof dijiye. Accused ko anticipatory bail nahi mil sakti. 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Ask the investigating officer in writing for a progress update. The law entitles the victim to one within 90 days.
actions.hg: Investigating officer se likhit mein progress update maangiye. Law victim ko 90 din ke andar update ka haq deta hai.

actions.en: Apply to the District Legal Services Authority for compensation. You do not have to wait for an arrest or a verdict.
actions.hg: Compensation ke liye District Legal Services Authority mein apply kijiye. Iske liye arrest ya verdict ka intezaar zaroori nahi hai.

title.en: 3,17,491 cases waiting: why stalking, harassment and assault-on-modesty trials sit at the back of India's court queue
title.hg: 3,17,491 cases intezaar mein: stalking, harassment aur assault-on-modesty ke trials India ki court queue mein sabse peeche kyun hain

dek.en: More than nine in ten cases of stalking, sexual harassment and assault on a woman's modesty were still waiting for a verdict at the end of 2024. These offences have no two-month deadline, no fast-track court and, since July 2024, a possible 14-day wait before the FIR. We followed one complaint to the back of the queue.
dek.hg: 2024 ke end mein stalking, sexual harassment aur aurat ki modesty par assault ke das mein se nau se zyada cases faisle ka intezaar kar rahe the. In offences ke liye na do mahine ki deadline hai, na fast-track court, aur July 2024 se FIR se pehle 14 din ka intezaar bhi ho sakta hai. Humne ek complaint ko queue ke aakhir tak follow kiya.

statLabel.en: assault-to-outrage-modesty cases pending trial at the end of 2024
statLabel.hg: assault-to-outrage-modesty cases 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending the

label.en: assault-to-outrage-modesty cases pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: assault-to-outrage-modesty cases jo 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending the

label.en: of stalking cases before the courts were still pending at the end of 2024
label.hg: courts ke saamne ke stalking cases jo 2024 ke end mein bhi pending the

label.en: of stalking trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue stalking trials jo conviction par khatam hue

label.en: police may spend on a preliminary enquiry before an FIR, for offences punishable with three to under seven years
label.hg: itne din police FIR se pehle preliminary enquiry kar sakti hai, un offences mein jinki saza teen se saat saal se kam tak hai

claim.en: Stalking and 'eve-teasing' are small matters. Police and courts have real crimes to deal with.
claim.hg: Stalking aur 'eve-teasing' chhoti baatein hain. Police aur courts ke paas asli crimes hain.

truth.en: They are crimes that carry prison terms of up to three or five years, and police registered 83,908 cases across the five 'modesty' offences in 2024, roughly 230 a day. What makes them look small is the procedure: no deadline, no fast-track court, and a queue where more than nine in ten cases are pending.
truth.hg: Yeh crimes hain jinme teen ya paanch saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai, aur 2024 mein police ne paanch 'modesty' offences mein 83,908 cases register kiye, yaani roz lagbhag 230. Inhe chhota procedure banata hai: koi deadline nahi, koi fast-track court nahi, aur aisi queue jahan das mein se nau se zyada cases pending hain.

actions.en: If you are in immediate danger, call 112. For support and referral, call the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Agar aap abhi khatre mein hain, toh 112 par call kijiye. Support aur referral ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Keep a dated log of every call, message, new account and sighting, with screenshots. Give police a written, signed complaint and keep a stamped copy.
actions.hg: Har call, message, naye account aur har baar dikhne ka dated log rakhiye, screenshots ke saath. Police ko likhit, signed complaint dijiye aur stamped copy apne paas rakhiye.

actions.en: If you are told 'enquiry first', ask which Deputy Superintendent approved it, on what date, and when the 14 days end.
actions.hg: Agar kaha jaaye 'pehle enquiry hogi', toh poochiye ki kis Deputy Superintendent ne ise approve kiya, kis date ko, aur 14 din kab khatam honge.

actions.en: Ask for your statement to be recorded before a magistrate under Section 183 of the BNSS, and ask police in writing for the progress update due within 90 days.
actions.hg: BNSS ke Section 183 ke under magistrate ke saamne apna statement record karwaane ko kahiye, aur police se likhit mein woh progress update maangiye jo 90 din ke andar milna chahiye.

actions.en: Report every new incident in writing. Do not wait for the first case to move.
actions.hg: Har nayi ghatna ki likhit report kijiye. Pehle case ke aage badhne ka intezaar mat kijiye.

title.en: Convicted of what? How to read the verdict in a sexual-violence case, using Kathua, Hathras and RG Kar
title.hg: Convicted, par kis cheez ka? Sexual-violence case ka verdict kaise padhein: Kathua, Hathras aur RG Kar se seekho

dek.en: A headline gives you one word: convicted, or acquitted. A judgment gives you a list of charges, each with its own finding and its own sentence. Three verdicts show why that list changes what a case means, and how to share one without exposing the survivor.
dek.hg: Headline tumhe ek shabd deti hai: convicted, ya acquitted. Judgment tumhe charges ki ek list deta hai, har charge ka apna finding aur apni saza. Teen verdicts dikhate hain ki yeh list case ka matlab kaise badal deti hai, aur survivor ko expose kiye bina verdict kaise share karein.

label.en: accused convicted in the Kathua case in June 2019, on three different kinds of charge
label.hg: Kathua case mein June 2019 mein convict hue accused, teen alag tarah ke charges pe

label.en: men found guilty of gang rape or murder in the Hathras verdict of March 2023
label.hg: March 2023 ke Hathras verdict mein gang rape ya murder ke liye doshi paaye gaye aadmi

label.en: of rape trials completed in India in 2024 that ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein poore hue rape trials jinka ant conviction mein hua

claim.en: If the accused is convicted, the court has found that the rape happened.
claim.hg: Agar accused convict ho gaya, toh court ne maan liya ki rape hua tha.

truth.en: A conviction is always for specific sections. A man can be convicted of one offence while the charge of rape is found not proved, as in the Hathras verdict.
truth.hg: Conviction hamesha specific sections mein hota hai. Ek aadmi ek offence mein convict ho sakta hai jabki rape ka charge saabit na ho, jaise Hathras verdict mein hua.

actions.en: Before you share a verdict, find out which sections each accused was convicted under and which charges failed.
actions.hg: Verdict share karne se pehle pata karo ki har accused kin sections mein convict hua aur kaunse charges fail hue.

actions.en: Read 'acquitted' as 'not proved beyond reasonable doubt', and check whether an appeal is pending before calling a case closed.
actions.hg: 'Acquitted' ko 'reasonable doubt se pare saabit nahi hua' padho, aur case ko band bolne se pehle check karo ki appeal pending hai ya nahi.

actions.en: Never post a survivor's name, photo, village, school or workplace, even if others already have. It is a crime under Section 72 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Survivor ka naam, photo, gaon, school ya workplace kabhi post mat karo, chahe doosre kar chuke hon. BNS ke Section 72 mein yeh crime hai.

actions.en: Do not share leaked FIRs, statements or screenshots of evidence from a rape case.
actions.hg: Rape case ki leaked FIR, statements ya evidence ke screenshots share mat karo.

title.en: Intent to outrage, intent to deceive, sexual intent: why the accused's state of mind decides so many sexual-offence cases in India
title.hg: Modesty outrage karne ka iraada, dhokhe ka iraada, sexual intent: India mein itne sexual-offence cases accused ki niyat par kyun tay hote hain

dek.en: Many sexual offences turn not only on what a man did but on what he meant. Nobody can read a mind, so courts read conduct. Sometimes that protects the accused from a wrong conviction. Sometimes a narrow reading has shrunk the law until the Supreme Court stepped in.
dek.hg: Kai sexual offences sirf is par nahi tikte ki aadmi ne kya kiya, balki is par ki uska matlab kya tha. Mann koi nahi padh sakta, isliye courts bartaav padhti hain. Kabhi yeh accused ko galat saza se bachata hai. Kabhi tang reading ne law ko itna chhota kar diya ki Supreme Court ko beech mein aana pada.

statLabel.en: of assault with intent to outrage modesty registered in 2024
statLabel.hg: modesty outrage karne ke iraade se assault ke cases 2024 mein darj hue

label.en: cases of assault with intent to outrage a woman's modesty registered in 2024
label.hg: cases 2024 mein darj hue, aurat ki modesty outrage karne ke iraade se assault ke

label.en: in prison for assault with intent to outrage modesty (Section 74 BNS)
label.hg: ki jail, modesty outrage karne ke iraade se assault ke liye (Section 74 BNS)

label.en: for sex obtained by a promise of marriage made with no intention of keeping it (Section 69 BNS)
label.hg: shaadi ka aisa vaada karke sex ke liye jise nibhaane ka iraada hi nahi tha (Section 69 BNS)

label.en: for intentional sexual touching of a Dalit or Adivasi woman, knowing her caste or tribe (SC/ST Act)
label.hg: Dalit ya Adivasi aurat ko uski caste ya tribe jaante hue jaan-boojh kar sexual tareeke se chhoone ke liye (SC/ST Act)

claim.en: If there was no skin contact, it was not sexual assault.
claim.hg: Agar skin contact nahi hua, toh woh sexual assault nahi tha.

truth.en: In 2021 the Supreme Court said the important ingredient of sexual assault on a child under POCSO is sexual intent, not skin-to-skin contact.
truth.hg: 2021 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki POCSO ke tahat bachche par sexual assault ka important ingredient sexual intent hai, skin-to-skin contact nahi.

actions.en: When you report, describe exactly what was said and done before, during and after. Intent is proved from that conduct.
actions.hg: Report karte waqt bilkul theek-theek batayiye ki pehle, beech mein aur baad mein kya kaha aur kiya gaya. Intent isi bartaav se saabit hota hai.

actions.en: Save messages, call logs and screenshots that show what the accused planned or promised. Do not delete them, even if they hurt to keep.
actions.hg: Woh messages, call logs aur screenshots sambhaal kar rakhiye jo dikhate hain ki accused ne kya plan kiya ya kya vaada kiya. Unhe delete mat kijiye, chahe unhe rakhna dard de.

actions.en: Read the sections on your FIR. If the facts show sexual intent and only a minor section is written, ask for it to be corrected.
actions.hg: Apni FIR par likhe sections padhiye. Agar facts sexual intent dikhate hain aur sirf chhota section likha hai, toh use theek karwane ki maang kijiye.

actions.en: If you are Dalit or Adivasi and the accused knew it, ask that Section 3(1)(w) of the SC/ST Act be added.
actions.hg: Agar aap Dalit ya Adivasi hain aur accused yeh jaanta tha, toh SC/ST Act ka Section 3(1)(w) jodne ki maang kijiye.

actions.en: If you find child sexual abuse material on any device, report it on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930. Do not forward it.
actions.hg: Agar kisi device par child sexual abuse material mile, toh cybercrime.gov.in par report kijiye ya 1930 par call kijiye. Use forward mat kijiye.

title.en: IPC or BNS? Why a rape reported in 2026 can still be charged under the 1860 code
title.hg: IPC ya BNS? 2026 mein report hua rape ab bhi 1860 ke code ke under kyun charge ho sakta hai

dek.en: The new penal code took over on 1 July 2024, but the date of the offence, not the date of the complaint, decides which code a case is charged under. What that changes, and what it does not, for the definition, the sentence, Section 69 and your rights at the police station.
dek.hg: Naya penal code 1 July 2024 se lagu hua, lekin case kis code ke under chalega yeh offence ki date tay karti hai, complaint ki date nahi. Isse definition, saza, Section 69 aur police station par tumhare rights mein kya badalta hai aur kya nahi, yahan padho.

statLabel.en: rape cases registered under the old IPC in 2024, against 9,853 under the BNS
statLabel.hg: rape cases 2024 mein purane IPC ke under register hue, BNS ke under 9,853

label.en: rape cases registered under the IPC in 2024, the year the BNS replaced it
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein IPC ke under register hue, usi saal jab BNS ne uski jagah li

label.en: rape cases registered under the BNS in 2024
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein BNS ke under register hue

label.en: cases under the new Section 69 (sex by deceit) in July-December 2024; it cannot be used for earlier acts
label.hg: cases naye Section 69 (dhokhe se sex) ke under July-December 2024 mein; yeh section pehle ke acts par nahi lag sakta

label.en: minimum sentence for rape under both codes: the IPC since April 2018, the BNS under Section 64
label.hg: rape ki minimum saza dono codes mein: IPC mein April 2018 se, BNS mein Section 64 ke under

claim.en: The IPC was scrapped in 2024, so every rape case is now filed under the BNS.
claim.hg: IPC 2024 mein khatam ho gaya, isliye ab har rape case BNS ke under file hota hai.

truth.en: The date of the offence decides. A rape committed before 1 July 2024 is charged under the IPC even if it is reported years later; in 2024 itself, 19,683 of the 29,536 rape cases were IPC cases.
truth.hg: Offence ki date tay karti hai. 1 July 2024 se pehle hua rape IPC ke under charge hota hai, chahe report saalon baad ho; khud 2024 mein 29,536 rape cases mein se 19,683 IPC ke cases the.

actions.en: Before you go to the police, write down the date, or the closest period you can give, of each incident. It decides which code's sections go on the FIR.
actions.hg: Police ke paas jaane se pehle har incident ki date, ya jitna kareeb ka time period yaad ho, likh lo. Isi se tay hota hai ki FIR par kis code ke sections lagenge.

actions.en: Do not accept 'the old law is gone' as a reason to turn you away. An offence from before 1 July 2024 is registered under the IPC.
actions.hg: 'Purana law khatam ho gaya' sunkar wapas mat lauto. 1 July 2024 se pehle ka offence IPC ke under register hota hai.

actions.en: Report at any police station (Zero FIR) or by e-FIR, and take your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein (Zero FIR) ya e-FIR se report karo, aur FIR ki free copy zaroor lo.

actions.en: Read the sections on your FIR copy. If the abuse happened on both sides of 1 July 2024, ask why only one code appears.
actions.hg: FIR ki copy par likhe sections padho. Agar abuse 1 July 2024 ke dono taraf hua hai, toh poocho ki sirf ek code ke sections kyun lage hain.

actions.en: For free advice on which sections apply to your case, call the NALSA legal aid helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Tumhare case par kaun se sections lagte hain, is par free advice ke liye NALSA legal aid helpline 15100 par call karo.

title.en: Five months for RG Kar, a queue for everyone else: how fast India's headline rape trials moved while 1,85,785 cases waited
title.hg: RG Kar ke liye paanch mahine, baaki sab ke liye lambi line: India ke headline rape trials kitni tezi se chale, jab 1,85,785 cases intezaar karte rahe

dek.en: A Kolkata court sentenced the RG Kar convict about five months after the crime. Kathua and Muzaffarpur had verdicts about a year after the Supreme Court stepped in. At the end of 2024, 89.8% of the rape cases in India's courts were still waiting. What did the famous cases get that the rest do not?
dek.hg: Kolkata ki court ne RG Kar ke convict ko crime ke kareeb paanch mahine baad saza suna di. Kathua aur Muzaffarpur mein verdict Supreme Court ke dakhal ke kareeb ek saal baad aa gaya. 2024 ke end par India ki courts mein 89.8% rape cases abhi bhi pending the. Famous cases ko aisa kya mila jo baaki ko nahi milta?

statLabel.en: of rape cases before Indian courts were still pending at the end of 2024
statLabel.hg: rape cases, jo India ki courts ke saamne the, 2024 ke end par bhi pending the

label.en: rape cases pending trial in Indian courts at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases 2024 ke end par India ki courts mein trial ke liye pending the

label.en: rape trials Indian courts completed in 2024
label.hg: rape trials India ki courts ne 2024 mein poore kiye

label.en: new rape cases police sent to court with a charge-sheet in 2024
label.hg: naye rape cases police ne 2024 mein charge-sheet ke saath court bheje

label.en: the legal limit for finishing a rape trial once the charge-sheet is filed
label.hg: yaani do mahine: charge-sheet file hone ke baad rape trial poora karne ki legal limit

claim.en: Rape trials in India take years because that is how long a proper trial takes.
claim.hg: India mein rape trials saalon isliye chalte hain kyunki ek sahi trial mein itna hi time lagta hai.

truth.en: The law allows two months from the charge-sheet. A Kolkata court sentenced the RG Kar convict about five months after the crime, and the Kathua verdict came about 13 months after the Supreme Court ordered day-to-day hearings. Most of the 1,85,785 cases pending at the end of 2024 get no such attention.
truth.hg: Law charge-sheet ke baad do mahine deta hai. Kolkata ki court ne RG Kar ke convict ko crime ke kareeb paanch mahine baad saza sunayi, aur Kathua ka verdict Supreme Court ke day-to-day sunwai wale order ke kareeb 13 mahine baad aaya. 2024 ke end par pending 1,85,785 cases mein se zyada tar ko aisi koi tavajjo nahi milti.

actions.en: If your case is still with the police, ask the investigating officer in writing for a progress update. The BNSS entitles a victim to one within 90 days.
actions.hg: Agar aapka case abhi police ke paas hai, toh investigating officer se likhit mein progress update maangiye. BNSS ke tahat victim ko 90 din ke andar update paane ka haq hai.

actions.en: Once the charge-sheet is filed, ask the public prosecutor to request day-to-day hearings and to oppose adjournments, citing the two-month limit in Section 346 of the BNSS.
actions.hg: Charge-sheet file hone ke baad public prosecutor se kahiye ki woh day-to-day sunwai maange aur adjournments ka virodh kare, BNSS ki Section 346 ki do mahine wali limit ka hawala dekar.

actions.en: Keep one file with the FIR number, the charge-sheet date and every hearing and adjournment date, so that delay can be shown on paper.
actions.hg: Ek file rakhiye jisme FIR number, charge-sheet ki date aur har hearing aur adjournment ki date ho, taaki deri kaagaz par dikhayi ja sake.

actions.en: If the trial stalls, ask your District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer (NALSA helpline 15100) and what can be done if the trial stalls.
actions.hg: Agar trial atak jaye, toh apni District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer maangiye (NALSA helpline 15100) aur poochiye ki trial atakne par kya kiya ja sakta hai.

actions.en: When 'instant justice' is cheered, remember that a killing in custody ends the trial that could have proved who was guilty.
actions.hg: Jab 'instant justice' par taaliyan bajein, toh yaad rakhiye ki custody mein hui maut usi trial ko khatam kar deti hai jo saabit kar sakta tha ki doshi kaun tha.

title.en: Does 'life' mean life? Remission, early release and 'the rest of natural life' for rape convicts, answered
title.hg: Kya 'life' ka matlab sach mein poori zindagi hai? Rape convicts ke liye remission, jaldi rihaai aur 'baaki natural life', sawaal-jawaab mein

dek.en: In August 2022, 11 men serving life for a gang rape and 14 murders walked out of a Gujarat jail on a government order. In 2024 the Supreme Court sent them back. Five questions on what remission is, who signs it, what 'natural life' adds to a sentence and what a survivor can do.
dek.hg: August 2022 mein ek gang rape aur 14 murders ke liye life sazaa kaat rahe 11 aadmi ek sarkaari order par Gujarat ki jail se bahar aa gaye. 2024 mein Supreme Court ne unhe wapas bhej diya. Paanch sawaal: remission kya hai, kaun sign karta hai, 'natural life' sazaa mein kya jodta hai, aur survivor kya kar sakti hai.

statLabel.en: life convicts freed early in the 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape case in August 2022, before the Supreme Court sent them back
statLabel.hg: life convicts jinhe 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape case mein August 2022 mein jaldi chhoda gaya, phir Supreme Court ne wapas jail bheja

label.en: men serving life who walked out of Godhra jail on 15 August 2022 on a state government's remission orders
label.hg: life sazaa kaat rahe aadmi jo 15 August 2022 ko state government ke remission orders par Godhra jail se bahar aaye

label.en: minimum sentence for gang rape since 2013, extendable to imprisonment for the remainder of natural life
label.hg: 2013 se gang rape ki minimum sazaa, jo baaki natural life tak ki qaid tak badh sakti hai

label.en: aggravated forms of rape in Section 64(2) of the BNS where 'life' is defined as the rest of the convict's natural life
label.hg: BNS Section 64(2) mein rape ke aggravated roop, jahan 'life' ka matlab convict ki baaki natural life hai

claim.en: 'Life imprisonment' and 'imprisonment for the remainder of natural life' are the same sentence.
claim.hg: 'Life imprisonment' aur 'baaki natural life tak qaid' ek hi sazaa hai.

truth.en: A plain life sentence can be cut short by a government's remission order: 11 life convicts left jail that way in 2022. Since 2013 the rape law spells out 'remainder of natural life' for its gravest forms, to say the sentence is meant to end only with the convict's death.
truth.hg: Saadi life sazaa ko sarkaar ka remission order beech mein khatam kar sakta hai: 2022 mein 11 life convicts aise hi jail se nikle. 2013 se rape law apne sabse gambhir roopon ke liye saaf likhta hai 'baaki natural life', yeh batane ke liye ki sazaa convict ki maut ke saath hi khatam ho.

actions.en: After a conviction, keep certified copies of the judgment and the sentence order, and note which state's court held the trial. That state's government decides any remission.
actions.hg: Conviction ke baad judgment aur sentence order ki certified copies sambhaal kar rakhiye, aur note kijiye ki trial kis state ki court mein hua. Remission ka faisla usi state ki sarkaar karti hai.

actions.en: If you hear that a convict may be released early, ask the District Legal Services Authority for free legal aid at once. A remission order can be challenged in court.
actions.hg: Agar suna ki convict jaldi chhoot sakta hai, toh turant District Legal Services Authority se free legal aid maangiye. Remission order ko court mein challenge kiya ja sakta hai.

actions.en: Report any threat from a convict or his family to the police in writing and keep a copy. In an emergency call 112.
actions.hg: Convict ya uske parivaar ki taraf se koi bhi dhamki ho toh police ko likhit mein bataiye aur copy rakhiye. Emergency mein 112 call kijiye.

actions.en: Apply to the State or District Legal Services Authority for victim compensation. It does not depend on what happens to the convict's sentence.
actions.hg: Victim compensation ke liye State ya District Legal Services Authority mein apply kijiye. Yeh convict ki sazaa ke saath kya hota hai, us par nirbhar nahi.

title.en: Who sees a rape survivor's medical file? The examination report, HIV test and abortion record, and the law on each, answered
title.hg: Rape survivor ki medical file kaun dekhta hai? Examination report, HIV test aur abortion record, aur har ek pe law, jawaab yahan

dek.en: After an assault, a survivor's body becomes evidence, and the fear of who will read the results can keep her away from a hospital. The law does not treat her file as one thing: some of it must go to the police, some of it is locked by statute.
dek.hg: Assault ke baad survivor ka body evidence ban jaata hai, aur results kaun padhega, yeh darr use hospital se door rakh sakta hai. Law uski file ko ek cheez nahi maanta: kuch hissa police ko jaana hi hai, kuch hissa law ne lock kar rakha hai.

statLabel.en: deadline for the doctor's examination report to reach the investigating officer
statLabel.hg: ke andar doctor ki examination report investigating officer tak pahunchni chahiye

label.en: deadline for the doctor's examination report to reach the investigating officer (BNSS Section 184)
label.hg: ke andar doctor ki examination report investigating officer tak pahunchni chahiye (BNSS Section 184)

label.en: maximum prison term for a doctor who reveals the identity of a woman who had an abortion (MTP Act Section 5A)
label.hg: tak ki jail us doctor ke liye jo abortion karwane wali woman ki identity bataye (MTP Act Section 5A)

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5)
label.hg: women jinhone physical ya sexual violence jheli, unhone kabhi madad nahi maangi ya kisi ko nahi bataya (NFHS-5)

label.en: cases registered for revealing a sexual-violence survivor's identity, July-December 2024
label.hg: cases July-December 2024 mein sexual violence survivor ki identity kholne ke liye register hue

claim.en: If I go to a hospital after an assault, everything the doctors find goes to the police and my family.
claim.hg: Assault ke baad hospital gayi toh doctors jo bhi dhoondhenge, sab police aur meri family tak jaayega.

truth.en: The examination report goes to the investigating officer, and only with your consent to the examination. An HIV result cannot be forced out of you, an abortion record is protected by law, and your family has no right to any of it.
truth.hg: Examination report investigating officer ko jaati hai, aur examination sirf aapki consent se hota hai. HIV result aapse zabardasti nahi nikalwaya ja sakta, abortion record law se protected hai, aur aapki family ka in mein se kisi pe koi haq nahi hai.

actions.en: Go to any hospital, public or private: treatment after rape is free and immediate under Section 397 of the BNSS, and refusing it is a crime.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi hospital jaiye, government ho ya private: BNSS Section 397 ke under rape ke baad treatment free aur turant hai, aur mana karna crime hai.

actions.en: You may refuse all or part of the medical examination; ask the doctor to explain each step and to write down what you agreed to.
actions.hg: Aap medical examination poora ya uska koi hissa mana kar sakti hain. Doctor se har step samjhane aur aapne kya maana yeh likhne ko kahiye.

actions.en: Ask for your HIV test in private and know that no one, not police, family or employer, can make you disclose the result without a court order.
actions.hg: HIV test private mein maangiye, aur yaad rakhiye ki police, family ya employer, koi bhi court order ke bina aapko result batane pe majboor nahi kar sakta.

actions.en: If a doctor, hospital or official leaks your details, write down who, when and to whom, and complain to the police under Section 72 of the BNS; for HIV-related breaches, also approach your state's HIV Ombudsman or call 1097.
actions.hg: Agar koi doctor, hospital ya official aapki details leak kare, toh likh lijiye kisne, kab aur kisko, aur BNS Section 72 ke under police mein complaint kijiye. HIV wale breach ke liye state ke HIV Ombudsman ke paas bhi jaiye ya 1097 pe call kijiye.

actions.en: If you are under 18 and need an abortion, you and your guardian can ask the doctor not to put your name in the report to police.
actions.hg: Agar aap 18 se kam hain aur abortion chahiye, toh aap aur aapke guardian doctor se keh sakte hain ki police ko jaane wali report mein aapka naam na daale.

title.en: Refusing a rape FIR is a crime. So is turning a survivor away from a hospital.
title.hg: Rape FIR se mana karna crime hai. Survivor ko hospital se lautana bhi.

dek.en: A police officer who will not write a rape FIR, a hospital that asks for a deposit, a principal who hushes up abuse: Indian law treats each as an offender, not just a bad official. Who owes a survivor which duty, what the punishment is, and what to put in writing when the duty is ignored.
dek.hg: Rape FIR likhne se mana karne wala police officer, deposit maangne wala hospital, abuse ko dabaane wala principal: Indian law in sabko sirf bura official nahi, offender maanta hai. Survivor ke prati kiski kaunsi duty hai, saza kya hai, aur duty ignore ho to likhit mein kya dena hai.

statLabel.en: in prison for a police officer who fails to record a rape FIR (Section 199 BNS)
statLabel.hg: jail us police officer ke liye jo rape FIR record nahi karta (Section 199 BNS)

label.en: rigorous imprisonment for a public servant who fails to record an FIR for rape, sexual assault, acid attack or trafficking (Section 199 BNS)
label.hg: rigorous imprisonment us public servant ke liye jo rape, sexual assault, acid attack ya trafficking ki FIR record nahi karta (Section 199 BNS)

label.en: the most a hospital in-charge can get for refusing free treatment to a rape or acid-attack survivor (Section 200 BNS)
label.hg: rape ya acid-attack survivor ko free treatment se mana karne par hospital in-charge ki maximum saza (Section 200 BNS)

label.en: of 69,191 POCSO cases in 2024 fell under Sections 17 to 22, the group that includes failure to report
label.hg: 2024 ke 69,191 POCSO cases mein se itne Sections 17 se 22 ke group mein the, jismein failure to report bhi aata hai

label.en: the maximum fine for an employer who sets up no Internal Committee under the POSH Act; there is no jail term
label.hg: POSH Act ke under Internal Committee na banane wale employer par maximum fine; koi jail term nahi

claim.en: When the police or a hospital sends a rape survivor away, it is bad behaviour, not a crime.
claim.hg: Jab police ya hospital rape survivor ko lauta dete hain, to woh bas bura behaviour hai, crime nahi.

truth.en: Failing to record a rape FIR carries 6 months to 2 years in prison under Section 199 of the BNS, and the person in charge of a hospital that refuses free treatment faces up to 1 year under Section 200.
truth.hg: Rape FIR record na karne par BNS ke Section 199 ke under 6 months se 2 years tak jail hai, aur free treatment se mana karne wale hospital ke in-charge ko Section 200 ke under 1 year tak ki saza ho sakti hai.

actions.en: If police refuse a rape FIR, hand in a written complaint that cites Section 199 of the BNS, and note the officer's name, rank, station and the time.
actions.hg: Agar police rape FIR likhne se mana kare, to BNS Section 199 cite karte hue likhit complaint do, aur officer ka naam, rank, station aur time note karo.

actions.en: At any hospital, public or private, say that Section 397 of the BNSS requires immediate free treatment, and ask the person in charge to put any refusal in writing.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi hospital mein, sarkari ho ya private, bolo ki BNSS ka Section 397 turant free treatment zaroori banata hai, aur in-charge se refusal likhit mein maango.

actions.en: If a school or hostel hides the abuse of a child, report it yourself to the police or Child Helpline 1098; a head who stays silent risks up to 1 year in prison.
actions.hg: Agar school ya hostel kisi bachche ka abuse chhupa raha hai, to khud police ya Child Helpline 1098 ko report karo; chup rehne wale head ko 1 year tak jail ho sakti hai.

actions.en: If you are a Dalit or Adivasi survivor, ask in the complaint itself for the Atrocities Act to be applied.
actions.hg: Agar tum Dalit ya Adivasi survivor ho, to complaint mein hi likh kar maango ki Atrocities Act lagaya jaaye.

actions.en: At work, ask HR by email who sits on the Internal Committee, and keep the reply.
actions.hg: Office mein HR se email par poocho ki Internal Committee mein kaun hai, aur reply sambhaal kar rakho.

title.en: A falsified FIR, destroyed evidence, a night cremation, a staged 'encounter': what happened to the police in India's landmark sexual-violence cases
title.hg: Jaan-boojh kar galat likhi FIR, mitaye gaye saboot, raat mein cremation, ek staged 'encounter': India ke landmark sexual-violence cases mein police ke saath kya hua

dek.en: In five cases the whole country followed, the police were part of the harm. Courts convicted police personnel in two of them. In the others the record shows a High Court rebuke, a death in custody and a commission's recommendation. Here is what followed for the officers, and what a survivor can do when she does not trust the local station.
dek.hg: Paanch aise cases jinhe poore desh ne follow kiya, unme police khud nuksaan ka hissa thi. Do cases mein courts ne police walon ko convict kiya. Baaki mein record mein High Court ki daant, custody mein ek maut aur ek commission ki sifarish hai. Officers ke saath kya hua, aur jab survivor ko local thane par bharosa na ho toh woh kya kar sakti hai.

statLabel.en: in the 2019 Hyderabad 'encounter', according to the Supreme Court's inquiry commission
statLabel.hg: 2019 ke Hyderabad 'encounter' mein maare gaye chaar mein se teen nabalig the, Supreme Court ke inquiry commission ke mutabik

label.en: jailed for five years for destroying evidence in the Kathua case (2019)
label.hg: ko Kathua case mein saboot mitane ke liye paanch saal ki jail (2019)

label.en: acquitted at trial in the 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape case, then convicted by the Bombay High Court in 2017
label.hg: 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape case mein trial mein bari hue, phir 2017 mein Bombay High Court ne convict kiya

label.en: should be tried for murder, said the Supreme Court's commission on the 2019 Hyderabad 'encounter'
label.hg: par murder ka trial hona chahiye, 2019 Hyderabad 'encounter' par Supreme Court ke commission ne kaha

label.en: in prison for an officer who fails to record a rape FIR (Section 199 BNS)
label.hg: ki jail us officer ko jo rape ki FIR darj na kare (Section 199 BNS)

claim.en: An 'encounter' is quick justice for the victim.
claim.hg: 'Encounter' victim ke liye fatafat insaaf hai.

truth.en: The four men shot dead near Hyderabad in 2019 were accused, never tried. A Supreme Court-appointed commission found the firing deliberate and three of the dead to be minors. No court ever decided who committed the crime.
truth.hg: 2019 mein Hyderabad ke paas goli se maare gaye chaar aadmi sirf accused the, unka trial kabhi nahi hua. Supreme Court ke banaye commission ne firing ko jaan-boojh kar ki gayi paaya aur maare gaye logon mein teen ko nabalig. Kisi court ne kabhi tay hi nahi kiya ki crime kisne kiya.

actions.en: Take the free copy of the FIR the same day and photograph every page. Police must give it to you.
actions.hg: FIR ki free copy usi din lijiye aur har page ki photo kheench lijiye. Police ko yeh copy deni hi padti hai.

actions.en: If a station refuses to record a sexual-offence complaint, write to the Superintendent of Police, then go to a magistrate. Refusing is a crime under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar thana sexual offence ki complaint likhne se mana kare, toh Superintendent of Police ko likhiye, phir magistrate ke paas jaaiye. Mana karna BNS ke Section 199 ke tahat crime hai.

actions.en: Ask for the survivor's statement to be recorded by a magistrate as early as possible. That record is not in police hands.
actions.hg: Survivor ka statement jitni jaldi ho sake magistrate se record karwane ki maang kijiye. Woh record police ke haath mein nahi hota.

actions.en: If the survivor is Dalit or Adivasi, ask in writing for protection and for notice of every hearing under Section 15A of the SC/ST Act.
actions.hg: Agar survivor Dalit ya Adivasi hai, toh SC/ST Act ke Section 15A ke tahat likh kar protection aur har hearing ki notice maangiye.

actions.en: To ask a higher court to move a case or change the investigating agency, get a free lawyer through NALSA's legal aid helpline, 15100.
actions.hg: Case ko doosre court mein bhejne ya investigating agency badalne ke liye higher court jaana ho, toh NALSA ki legal aid helpline 15100 se free lawyer lijiye.

title.en: No bail, no trial, hang them? Five popular beliefs about men accused of rape, checked against Indian law
title.hg: No bail, no trial, phaansi do? Rape ke accused aadmiyon ke baare mein paanch popular baatein, Indian law ke saamne check ki gayi

dek.en: After every case that makes the news, the same claims about the accused fill WhatsApp groups and TV debates. Most are wrong. Here is what the law actually says, and why getting it right matters most to survivors.
dek.hg: Har news wale case ke baad accused ke baare mein wahi claims WhatsApp groups aur TV debates mein bhar jaate hain. Zyada tar galat hain. Law asal mein kya kehta hai, aur ise sahi samajhna sabse zyada survivors ke liye kyun zaroori hai.

statLabel.en: conviction rate in rape trials completed in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein India mein poore hue rape trials ka conviction rate

label.en: conviction rate in rape trials completed in India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein poore hue rape trials ka conviction rate

label.en: rape cases pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases jo 2024 ke end mein trial ka intezaar kar rahe the

label.en: minimum sentence for rape under Section 64 of the BNS
label.hg: BNS Section 64 ke tahat rape ki minimum saza

claim.en: A man accused of rape gets no bail, must prove himself innocent, and should be hanged, and if police shoot him, justice is done.
claim.hg: Rape ke accused ko bail nahi milti, use khud apni innocence prove karni padti hai, use phaansi honi chahiye, aur agar police use goli maar de toh insaaf ho gaya.

truth.en: Most rape accused can seek bail, the prosecution must usually prove guilt, most rapes carry 10 years to life, and a killing by police ends the trial that alone can establish what happened.
truth.hg: Zyada tar rape accused bail maang sakte hain, guilt aam taur par prosecution ko prove karna padta hai, zyada tar rape ki saza 10 saal se life tak hai, aur police ki ki gayi killing us trial ko khatam kar deti hai jo akela sach saamne la sakta hai.

actions.en: Before forwarding a post about a case, check the claim against the law; anger built on wrong facts helps no one.
actions.hg: Kisi case par post forward karne se pehle claim ko law se milao; galat facts par bana gussa kisi ki madad nahi karta.

actions.en: Judge a government's response by investigation quality and trial speed, not by how harsh its slogans sound.
actions.hg: Government ke response ko investigation ki quality aur trial ki speed se judge karo, uske slogans kitne sakht lagte hain usse nahi.
