actions.en: If you are a survivor, know that the case is the state's to prove, and your complaint must be recorded by a woman officer, you can give your statement at home or a place you choose, and you can apply for victim compensation even if no one is caught.
actions.hg: Agar tum survivor ho, toh yaad rakho ki case prove karna state ka kaam hai, aur tumhari complaint woman officer ko record karni hogi, tum ghar par ya apni chuni hui jagah par statement de sakti ho, aur victim compensation ke liye apply kar sakti ho chahe koi pakda na jaaye.

actions.en: Never share the name, photo or address of a survivor, even when the accused's details are everywhere.
actions.hg: Survivor ka naam, photo ya address kabhi share mat karo, chahe accused ki details har jagah ghoom rahi hon.

actions.en: If you are in danger now, call 112; for a child, call 1098.
actions.hg: Agar abhi khatra hai toh 112 par call karo; kisi bachche ke liye 1098.

title.en: When the rapist is a relative, guardian or teacher: what Indian law treats as aggravated, and how to report from inside the home, answered
title.hg: Jab rapist rishtedaar, guardian ya teacher ho: Indian law kise aggravated maanta hai, aur ghar ke andar se report kaise karein, sawaal-jawaab mein

dek.en: The law punishes rape by someone in a position of trust more harshly and shifts the burden on consent. But the same law's default is to take her statement at home, where he may live too. Questions and answers on the aggravated charge, giving a statement somewhere safe, leaving the house and holding firm when the family pushes back.
dek.hg: Bharose ki position wale insaan ke rape ko law zyada sakhti se saza deta hai aur consent ka burden badal deta hai. Lekin wahi law default mein uska statement ghar pe leta hai, jahan shayad woh bhi rehta hai. Aggravated charge, kisi safe jagah statement dena, ghar chhodna aur family ke pressure ke saamne tike rehna: in sab pe sawaal aur jawaab.

statLabel.en: rape cases registered against family members in 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein family members ke khilaaf register hue rape cases

label.en: rape cases in 2024 in which the accused was a family member
label.hg: 2024 ke rape cases jinme accused family member tha

label.en: rape cases in 2024 against family friends, neighbours, employers or other known persons
label.hg: 2024 mein family friends, padosi, employers ya doosre jaan-pehchaan walon ke khilaaf rape cases

label.en: minimum sentence for rape by a relative, guardian or teacher; the maximum is the rest of natural life
label.hg: rishtedaar, guardian ya teacher dwara rape ki minimum saza; maximum hai baaki poori zindagi

label.en: One Stop Centres operational across India in July 2026
label.hg: July 2026 mein poore India mein chal rahe One Stop Centres

actions.en: If you are in danger now, call 112. For a child, call 1098; for a woman, 181.
actions.hg: Agar abhi khatra hai, toh 112 call karo. Bachche ke liye 1098; aurat ke liye 181.

actions.en: Tell the police where you want your statement recorded: a relative's home, a friend's place or a One Stop Centre, not the house the accused lives in.
actions.hg: Police ko batao ki tum apna statement kahan record karwana chahti ho: kisi rishtedaar ke ghar, dost ke yahan ya One Stop Centre mein, us ghar mein nahi jahan accused rehta hai.

actions.en: Ask for a woman officer and for your statement before a magistrate to be recorded as soon as possible.
actions.hg: Woman officer maango, aur maang karo ki magistrate ke saamne tumhara statement jaldi se jaldi record ho.

actions.en: Find your district's One Stop Centre through 181 for shelter, medical care and legal help in one place.
actions.hg: 181 ke through apne district ka One Stop Centre dhoondo, jahan shelter, medical care aur legal help ek hi jagah milti hai.

actions.en: If elders demand a 'compromise', write down who said what and when, and give it to the prosecutor.
actions.hg: Agar bade log 'compromise' ki maang karein, toh likh lo kisne kya aur kab kaha, aur woh prosecutor ko do.

title.en: A conviction is not the end: how appeals work in India's rape cases, from the six-month rule to the RG Kar death-penalty appeals
title.hg: Conviction par kahani khatam nahi hoti: India ke rape cases mein appeals kaise chalti hain, six-month rule se RG Kar ki death-penalty appeals tak

dek.en: Since 2018 the law has said an appeal against a rape sentence should be decided within six months. The biggest cases have waited years, a life sentence has been suspended mid-appeal, and prosecutors have gone back to court to ask for death. Who can appeal, to which court, how long it should take, and what happens to the sentence meanwhile.
dek.hg: 2018 se law kehta hai ki rape ki saza ke khilaaf appeal chhe mahine mein tay honi chahiye. Sabse bade cases ne saalon intezaar kiya hai, ek umrqaid appeal ke beech mein suspend hui, aur prosecutors death maangne dobara court gaye. Kaun appeal kar sakta hai, kis court mein, kitna time lagna chahiye, aur tab tak saza ka kya hota hai.

statLabel.en: the time the law gives a court to decide an appeal against a rape sentence
statLabel.hg: itna time law court ko rape ki saza ke khilaaf appeal tay karne ke liye deta hai

label.en: the time the law has given courts to decide an appeal against a rape sentence since 2018
label.hg: 2018 se law ne courts ko rape ki saza ke khilaaf appeal tay karne ke liye itna time diya hai

label.en: the day the Bombay High Court decided the appeals against the 21 January 2008 verdict in the 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape case
label.hg: jis din Bombay High Court ne 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape case mein 21 January 2008 ke faisle ke khilaaf appeals tay ki

label.en: the day the Calcutta High Court dismissed West Bengal's appeal for the death penalty in the RG Kar case
label.hg: jis din Calcutta High Court ne RG Kar case mein death penalty ke liye West Bengal ki appeal dismiss ki

label.en: rape cases pending trial at the end of 2024, before a single appeal is counted
label.hg: rape cases jo 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending the; isme ek bhi appeal gini nahi gayi

claim.en: The law says a rape appeal must be decided in six months, so it is.
claim.hg: Law kehta hai ki rape ki appeal chhe mahine mein tay hogi, toh aisa hi hota hoga.

truth.en: The six-month limit has been in the law since 2018, but nothing happens when a court misses it. In the Unnao case, sentenced in December 2019, we could find no decision on the convict's appeal as of 20 November 2026.
truth.hg: Chhe mahine ki limit 2018 se law mein hai, lekin court ise miss kare toh kuch nahi hota. Unnao case mein saza December 2019 mein hui thi, aur 20 November 2026 tak humein convict ki appeal par koi faisla nahi mila.

actions.en: After a conviction, ask the public prosecutor's office whether an appeal has been filed and note its number. You can follow the dates on the High Court's website.
actions.hg: Conviction ke baad public prosecutor ke office se poochiye ki appeal file hui hai ya nahi, aur uska number note kariye. Dates aap High Court ki website par dekh sakte hain.

actions.en: If you are the survivor and the verdict or sentence seems wrong, ask a lawyer at once whether you can appeal in your own right, and by what date.
actions.hg: Agar aap survivor hain aur verdict ya saza galat lage, toh turant lawyer se poochiye ki kya aap khud appeal kar sakti hain, aur kis tareekh tak.

actions.en: For a free lawyer at any stage, including an appeal, call the NALSA helpline 15100 or go to the District Legal Services Authority.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi stage par, appeal mein bhi, free lawyer ke liye NALSA helpline 15100 par call kariye ya District Legal Services Authority jaiye.

actions.en: If the convict asks for his sentence to be suspended, ask the prosecutor or your lawyer how you can be heard before the court decides.
actions.hg: Agar convict apni saza suspend karne ki maang kare, toh prosecutor ya apne lawyer se poochiye ki court ke faisle se pehle aapki baat kaise suni ja sakti hai.

actions.en: Follow bail and appeal hearings, not only verdicts, and never share a survivor's name while you do.
actions.hg: Sirf verdicts nahi, bail aur appeal ki hearings bhi follow kariye, aur aisa karte hue kabhi kisi survivor ka naam share mat kariye.

title.en: Girlfriend, live-in partner, ex, separated wife, wife: how India's rape law protects a woman less the closer she gets to marriage
title.hg: Girlfriend, live-in partner, ex, alag rehti wife, wife: shaadi ke jitna kareeb, India ka rape law utna kam protect karta hai

dek.en: The same act, forced sex by a man she knows, is punished with at least 10 years, with 2 to 7 years, or not as rape at all. What decides it is not what he did but what she is to him.
dek.hg: Ek hi act, jaan-pehchaan ke aadmi ka zabardasti sex, kabhi kam se kam 10 saal ki saza laata hai, kabhi 2 se 7 saal, aur kabhi rape hi nahi maana jaata. Faisla is baat se hota hai ki woh uske liye kaun hai, is baat se nahi ki usne kya kiya.

statLabel.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a friend, online friend, live-in partner or separated husband
statLabel.hg: rape cases 2024 mein jahan accused dost, online dost, live-in partner ya alag reh raha husband tha

label.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a friend, online friend, live-in partner or separated husband
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein jahan accused dost, online dost, live-in partner ya alag reh raha husband tha

label.en: the sentence for forced sex on a wife living separately (BNS Section 67), against a 10-year minimum for rape
label.hg: saza alag rehti wife ke saath zabardasti sex pe (BNS Section 67), jabki rape ki minimum saza 10 saal hai

label.en: of ever-married women said their husband had physically forced them to have intercourse (NFHS-5)
label.hg: ever-married women ne kaha ki husband ne unhe zabardasti intercourse ke liye physically force kiya (NFHS-5)

label.en: cases registered in all of India in 2024 under the Domestic Violence Act
label.hg: cases 2024 mein poore India mein Domestic Violence Act ke under register hue

claim.en: Once you are in a relationship with a man, forced sex is a private matter, not rape.
claim.hg: Ek baar relationship mein aa gayi toh zabardasti sex private matter hai, rape nahi.

truth.en: Forced sex by a boyfriend or live-in partner is rape under Section 63 of the BNS with the full punishment. The law steps back only for husbands: partly for a separated wife, and fully for a wife who is 18 or older.
truth.hg: Boyfriend ya live-in partner ka zabardasti sex BNS Section 63 ke under rape hai, poori saza ke saath. Law sirf husbands ke liye peeche hat-ta hai: alag rehti wife ke case mein thoda, aur 18 ya usse badi wife ke case mein poora.

actions.en: Remember the definition: consent is an 'unequivocal voluntary agreement', and not fighting back is not consent, whoever he is to you.
actions.hg: Definition yaad rakhiye: consent ek 'unequivocal voluntary agreement' hai, aur resist na karna consent nahi hai, chahe woh aapka kuch bhi lagta ho.

actions.en: If an ex is following you or has shared intimate images, report it at any police station or at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930; stalking and non-consensual sharing are crimes in their own right.
actions.hg: Agar koi ex aapka peecha kar raha hai ya intimate images share kar chuka hai, toh kisi bhi police station pe, cybercrime.gov.in pe ya 1930 pe report kijiye. Stalking aur bina consent share karna apne aap mein crimes hain.

actions.en: If you are married and being forced, contact a One Stop Centre or the Women Helpline 181 and ask about a protection order under the Domestic Violence Act, a civil remedy that runs alongside any criminal complaint.
actions.hg: Agar aap married hain aur aapke saath zabardasti ho rahi hai, toh One Stop Centre ya Women Helpline 181 se contact kijiye aur Domestic Violence Act ke protection order ke baare mein poochhiye. Yeh ek civil remedy hai jo kisi bhi criminal complaint ke saath-saath chal sakti hai.

actions.en: If you are living apart from your husband, tell the police that Section 67 of the BNS applies to forced sex during separation.
actions.hg: Agar aap husband se alag reh rahi hain, toh police ko bataiye ki alag rehne ke dauraan zabardasti sex pe BNS Section 67 lagta hai.

actions.en: Keep a dated record of every incident, with messages and medical papers, somewhere he cannot reach.
actions.hg: Har incident ka date ke saath record rakhiye, messages aur medical papers ke saath, aisi jagah jahan uska haath na pahunche.

title.en: Ten years to death: how BNS Sections 64 to 71 decide the punishment for rape
title.hg: Das saal se death tak: BNS ke Sections 64 se 71 rape ki saza kaise tay karte hain

dek.en: Indian law has no single punishment for rape. It has a ladder, and the rung a convicted man reaches depends on the survivor's age, the position he held over her and what the attack did to her. A section-by-section walk up it, in plain words.
dek.hg: Indian law mein rape ki koi ek saza nahi hai. Ek seedhi hai, aur convict hua aadmi kis paaydaan par pahunchega, yeh survivor ki umar, us par uski position aur hamle ke nateeje se tay hota hai. Section-by-section, seedhi bhasha mein.

statLabel.en: the minimum sentence for rape under Section 64 of the BNS
statLabel.hg: BNS ke Section 64 mein rape ki kam se kam saza

label.en: minimum rigorous imprisonment for rape under Section 64(1) of the BNS; the maximum is life
label.hg: BNS ke Section 64(1) mein rape ke liye kam se kam rigorous imprisonment; zyada se zyada life

label.en: aggravated forms of rape in Section 64(2), each punishable with 10 years to the rest of natural life
label.hg: Section 64(2) mein rape ke aggravated forms, har ek mein 10 saal se baaki natural life tak ki qaid

label.en: minimum for raping a girl under 16, for rape that causes death or a vegetative state, and for gang rape
label.hg: 16 saal se kam ki ladki ke rape, maut ya vegetative state tak pahunchane wale rape, aur gang rape ki minimum saza

label.en: years: how far the 2018 amendment raised the minimum sentence for rape
label.hg: saal: 2018 ke amendment ne rape ki minimum saza itni badhayi

claim.en: The punishment for rape in India is seven years.
claim.hg: India mein rape ki saza saat saal hai.

truth.en: Seven years was the minimum until 2018. Today the floor is 10 years under Section 64 of the BNS, 20 years if the girl is under 16, and the top rungs allow imprisonment for the rest of natural life or death.
truth.hg: Saat saal 2018 tak minimum tha. Aaj BNS ke Section 64 mein floor 10 saal hai, ladki 16 se kam ki ho toh 20 saal, aur upar ke paaydaanon par baaki natural life ki qaid ya death tak ki saza ho sakti hai.

actions.en: Read the FIR and check the sections written on it. If the accused is a relative, teacher, police officer or hospital worker, or the survivor is pregnant or disabled, Section 64(2) should be named.
actions.hg: FIR padhiye aur dekhiye us par kaun se sections likhe hain. Agar accused rishtedaar, teacher, police officer ya hospital staff hai, ya survivor pregnant ya disabled hai, toh Section 64(2) likha hona chahiye.

actions.en: Hand over proof of age early, such as a birth certificate or school record. A girl under 16 moves the case to Section 65 and bars anticipatory bail for the accused.
actions.hg: Umar ka proof, jaise birth certificate ya school record, jaldi dijiye. Ladki 16 se kam ki ho toh case Section 65 mein jaata hai aur accused ko anticipatory bail nahi mil sakti.

actions.en: Apply to the District Legal Services Authority for victim compensation. Under Section 396 of the BNSS, a survivor can claim it even if no trial takes place.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority mein victim compensation ke liye apply kijiye. BNSS ke Section 396 mein survivor yeh tab bhi maang sakti hai jab koi trial na ho.

actions.en: If police refuse to register a rape FIR, complain in writing to the Superintendent of Police, and then to a Magistrate. The refusal is itself an offence under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police rape ki FIR likhne se mana kare, toh Superintendent of Police ko likhit complaint dijiye, aur phir Magistrate ke paas jaaiye. FIR na likhna khud BNS ke Section 199 mein offence hai.

actions.en: In an emergency call 112. Women can call 181 and children 1098.
actions.hg: Emergency mein 112 par call kijiye. Women 181 aur bachche 1098 par call kar sakte hain.

title.en: Her past is not evidence: how Indian law stopped putting rape survivors' character on trial, from 1983 to the 2023 evidence code
title.hg: Uska ateet saboot nahi hai: Indian law ne 1983 se 2023 ke evidence code tak rape survivors ke character ko trial par rakhna kaise band kiya

dek.en: For decades a rape trial could turn on a survivor's past, her lack of injuries and whether she fought back. Four changes in the law took those questions out of the courtroom, at least on paper. What each one did, and what a survivor in the witness box is protected from today.
dek.hg: Dashakon tak rape trial survivor ke ateet, uski chot na hone aur usne virodh kiya ya nahi, is par tik sakta tha. Kaanoon ke chaar badlaavon ne yeh sawaal courtroom se bahar kiye, kam se kam kaagaz par. Har badlaav ne kya kiya, aur aaj witness box mein survivor ko kis cheez se suraksha hai.

label.en: the day courts began presuming no consent in custodial rape trials
label.hg: woh din jab se courts custodial rape trials mein maanne lagin ki consent nahi tha

label.en: the 2013 rule that made a survivor's character and sexual history irrelevant to consent
label.hg: 2013 ka niyam jisne survivor ke character aur sexual history ko consent ke sawaal par irrelevant bana diya

label.en: of the 2023 evidence code: no cross-examination on a rape survivor's 'general immoral character' or sexual past to prove consent
label.hg: 2023 ke evidence code ka: consent saabit karne ke liye rape survivor se uske 'general immoral character' ya sexual ateet par cross-examination nahi

claim.en: If a woman has had sex before, or did not fight back, a court will see her rape claim as doubtful.
claim.hg: Agar aurat pehle sex kar chuki hai, ya usne virodh nahi kiya, toh court uske rape ke daave ko shak ki nazar se dekhega.

truth.en: Since 2013 the law says her character and sexual history are irrelevant to consent and that not resisting is not consent. The 2023 evidence code bars the defence from asking about her sexual past to prove consent.
truth.hg: 2013 se kaanoon kehta hai ki uska character aur sexual history consent ke liye irrelevant hai, aur virodh na karna consent nahi hai. 2023 ka evidence code defence ko consent saabit karne ke liye uske sexual ateet par sawaal poochhne se rokta hai.

actions.en: If you are a survivor going to court, ask your lawyer or the prosecutor to object at once if the defence asks about your past relationships or 'character' to suggest you consented.
actions.hg: Agar aap survivor hain aur court ja rahi hain, toh apne vakeel ya prosecutor se kahiye ki defence agar aapke purane rishton ya 'character' par sawaal karke consent dikhane ki koshish kare, toh turant objection karein.

actions.en: Remember that freezing or not fighting back does not mean you agreed. The law says so in writing.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye ki jam jaana ya virodh na karna, iska matlab yeh nahi ki aapne haan kahi thi. Kaanoon yeh likhit mein kehta hai.

actions.en: Ask the District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer if you cannot afford one. Rape trials are held in camera by law; tell the court if strangers are present.
actions.hg: Agar vakeel ka kharcha nahi utha saktin, toh District Legal Services Authority se free vakeel maangiye. Rape trials kaanoon ke hisaab se in camera hote hain; agar anjaan log maujood hon toh court ko bataiye.

actions.en: If a judge, police officer or lawyer repeats a rape myth, note the words and date. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook lists such myths as false.
actions.hg: Agar koi judge, police officer ya vakeel koi rape myth dohraaye, toh uske shabd aur taareekh note kijiye. Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook aise myths ko galat bataati hai.

title.en: Caught twice: how Indian law punishes repeat sexual offenders, from stalking and voyeurism to rape and sex selection
title.hg: Do baar pakde gaye: Indian law repeat sexual offenders ko kaise saza deta hai, stalking aur voyeurism se lekar rape aur sex selection tak

dek.en: Across sexual and gender offences, Indian law raises the punishment for a second conviction, up to natural-life imprisonment or death for rape. Every one of these rules assumes the first case ended in a conviction. Most completed rape trials do not.
dek.hg: Sexual aur gender offences mein Indian law doosre conviction par saza badha deta hai, rape mein natural-life imprisonment ya death tak. Lekin yeh har rule maan kar chalta hai ki pehla case conviction par khatam hua tha. Poore hue rape trials mein se zyada tar aise khatam nahi hote.

statLabel.en: punishment for a second rape conviction under Section 71 of the BNS
statLabel.hg: BNS ke Section 71 ke under doosre rape conviction ki saza

label.en: for anyone convicted of rape a second time (Section 71 BNS)
label.hg: jo bhi doosri baar rape mein convict ho (Section 71 BNS)

label.en: for a repeat voyeurism conviction, up from 1 to 3 years the first time
label.hg: voyeurism ke repeat conviction par, pehli baar ke 1 se 3 years se badhkar

label.en: of rape trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials mein se itne conviction par khatam hue

claim.en: A man who keeps harassing or assaulting women will eventually be caught and locked away for good.
claim.hg: Jo aadmi baar-baar auraton ko harass ya assault karta hai, woh aakhir mein pakda jaayega aur hamesha ke liye andar jaayega.

truth.en: Tougher punishment for a repeat offence applies only after a first conviction. In 2024, only 24.4% of completed rape trials ended in one, so most men who face a rape trial leave court with no conviction a later judge can count.
truth.hg: Repeat offence ki sakht saza tabhi lagti hai jab pehle conviction ho chuka ho. 2024 mein poore hue rape trials mein se sirf 24.4% conviction par khatam hue, isliye rape trial face karne wale zyada tar aadmi court se aise conviction ke bina nikalte hain jise baad mein koi judge gin sake.

actions.en: If a man has harassed or stalked others before, tell the police and the prosecutor, and ask whether earlier cases against him reached a verdict.
actions.hg: Agar kisi aadmi ne pehle bhi doosron ko harass ya stalk kiya hai, toh police aur prosecutor ko bataiye, aur poochiye ki uske khilaaf pehle ke cases ka verdict aaya ya nahi.

actions.en: Do not agree to withdraw or 'settle' a complaint under pressure. A case that ends without a verdict leaves no conviction on record for the next woman.
actions.hg: Dabaav mein complaint withdraw ya 'settle' karne par raazi mat hoiye. Jo case bina verdict ke khatam hota hai, woh agli woman ke liye record par koi conviction nahi chhodta.

actions.en: Ask the public prosecutor to put any previous conviction of the accused before the court at sentencing.
actions.hg: Public prosecutor se kahiye ki sentencing ke waqt accused ka koi bhi pichla conviction court ke saamne rakhe.

actions.en: Report a clinic offering sex determination to the district Appropriate Authority under the PC-PNDT Act, in writing.
actions.hg: Sex determination offer karne wale clinic ki complaint PC-PNDT Act ke under district Appropriate Authority ko likh kar kijiye.

actions.en: If your employer has no Internal Committee, raise it in writing and keep a copy. Failing to set one up is punishable under the POSH Act, and a repeat failure doubles the penalty.
actions.hg: Agar aapke employer ke paas Internal Committee nahi hai, toh yeh baat likh kar uthaiye aur copy rakhiye. Committee na banana POSH Act mein punishable hai, aur dobara yahi galti karne par penalty double ho jaati hai.

title.en: Presumed guilty, presumed unwilling: four places where Indian law shifts the burden of proof in sexual and gender crimes
title.hg: Guilty maan kar, 'na' maan kar: chaar jagah jahan Indian law sexual aur gender crimes mein saboot ka bojh palat deta hai

dek.en: Normally the prosecution must prove everything. In child sexual abuse, rape by people in authority, abortion after rape and sex selection, Parliament told courts and doctors to start from a presumption instead. Here is what each one does, and why convictions stay low all the same.
dek.hg: Aam taur pe sab kuch prosecution ko saabit karna hota hai. Lekin bachchon ke sexual abuse, authority wale logon ke kiye rape, rape ke baad abortion aur sex selection mein Parliament ne courts aur doctors se kaha ki ek presumption se shuru karo. Har presumption kya karta hai, aur phir bhi convictions kam kyun rehte hain, yahan samjhiye.

statLabel.en: conviction rate in POCSO trials completed in 2024, despite the presumption of guilt
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein poore hue POCSO trials ka conviction rate, guilt ke presumption ke bawajood

label.en: of POCSO trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction, under a law that presumes guilt
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue POCSO trials jo conviction pe khatam hue, us kanoon ke tehat jo guilt maan kar chalta hai

label.en: conviction rate in rape trials completed in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials ka conviction rate

label.en: the year Parliament first told courts to presume absence of consent, in custodial rape trials
label.hg: woh saal jab Parliament ne pehli baar courts se kaha ki custodial rape trials mein consent na hona maan kar chalo

label.en: cases police registered under the PC-PNDT Act in 2024
label.hg: cases jo police ne 2024 mein PC-PNDT Act ke tehat register kiye

claim.en: Under POCSO the accused is presumed guilty, so a complaint is as good as a conviction.
claim.hg: POCSO mein accused ko guilty maan liya jaata hai, isliye complaint ka matlab hi conviction hai.

truth.en: The presumption can be rebutted, and it cannot replace evidence. In 2024, POCSO trials ended in 25,476 acquittals against 12,672 convictions.
truth.hg: Is presumption ko rebut kiya ja sakta hai, aur yeh evidence ki jagah nahi le sakta. 2024 mein POCSO trials 25,476 acquittals aur 12,672 convictions pe khatam hue.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, report it early and keep the child's age documents safe. Section 29 helps only when the case reaches court with its evidence intact.
actions.hg: Koi bachcha aapko abuse ke baare mein bataye to jaldi report kijiye aur bachche ki umar ke documents sambhaal kar rakhiye. Section 29 tabhi kaam aata hai jab case apne evidence ke saath court tak pahunche.

actions.en: If the accused is a police officer, public servant, relative, guardian or hospital staff, ask the prosecutor whether Section 120 of the BSA applies to the charge.
actions.hg: Agar accused police officer, public servant, rishtedaar, guardian ya hospital staff hai, to prosecutor se poochhiye ki kya charge pe BSA ka Section 120 lagta hai.

actions.en: An adult woman pregnant from rape does not need an FIR or a court order to ask a registered doctor about a legal abortion.
actions.hg: Rape se pregnant hui adult aurat ko kisi registered doctor se legal abortion ke baare mein baat karne ke liye FIR ya court order ki zaroorat nahi hai.

actions.en: If your husband or in-laws push you towards a sex-determination test, the law presumes you were compelled, not that you chose it. Call the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Agar pati ya sasural wale aapko sex-determination test ki taraf dhakel rahe hain, to kanoon yeh maanta hai ki aapko majboor kiya gaya, yeh nahi ki aapne chuna. Women Helpline 181 pe call kijiye.

actions.en: Even if a trial ends in acquittal, a survivor can apply to the District Legal Services Authority for victim compensation.
actions.hg: Trial acquittal pe khatam ho, tab bhi survivor District Legal Services Authority se victim compensation ke liye apply kar sakte hain.

title.en: One assault, four legal doors: how a survivor's age, caste and gender change what Indian law calls the same act
title.hg: Ek hi assault, chaar kanooni darwaze: survivor ki umar, caste aur gender se kaise badal jaata hai ki Indian law usi act ko kya kehta hai

dek.en: Rape if the survivor is a woman. A POCSO offence if the person is under 18. 'Sexual abuse' capped at two years if the survivor is transgender. And since July 2024, no specific offence at all if he is an adult man.
dek.hg: Survivor aurat ho to rape. 18 se kam umar ka koi bhi ho to POCSO ka offence. Survivor transgender ho to 'sexual abuse', jiski saza do saal pe ruk jaati hai. Aur July 2024 se, agar woh adult aadmi hai to koi specific offence hi nahi.

label.en: minimum sentence when the survivor is a woman (rape, BNS Section 64)
label.hg: kam se kam saza jab survivor aurat ho (rape, BNS Section 64)

label.en: minimum when the survivor is a child under 16 of any gender (POCSO)
label.hg: kam se kam saza jab survivor 16 se kam umar ka bachcha ho, kisi bhi gender ka (POCSO)

label.en: maximum for 'sexual abuse' when the survivor is a transgender person
label.hg: zyada se zyada saza 'sexual abuse' ke liye jab survivor transgender ho

label.en: maximum for hurt, one of the general charges left when the survivor is an adult man
label.hg: zyada se zyada saza hurt ke liye, jo un general charges mein se ek hai jo survivor adult aadmi ho to bachte hain

claim.en: Rape is rape in Indian law, whoever the survivor is.
claim.hg: Indian law mein rape to rape hai, survivor koi bhi ho.

truth.en: Section 63 of the BNS covers only a woman assaulted by a man. Children of any gender have POCSO, transgender survivors have a law capped at two years, and adult men have had no specific offence since 1 July 2024.
truth.hg: BNS ka Section 63 sirf us aurat ko cover karta hai jis par kisi aadmi ne assault kiya ho. Kisi bhi gender ke bachchon ke paas POCSO hai, transgender survivors ke paas do saal pe rukne wala kanoon hai, aur adult aadmiyon ke liye 1 July 2024 se koi specific offence nahi hai.

actions.en: If the survivor is under 18, of any gender, POCSO applies in full: call the Child Helpline 1098 or the police.
actions.hg: Survivor 18 se kam ka ho, kisi bhi gender ka, to POCSO poori tarah lagta hai: Child Helpline 1098 ya police ko call kijiye.

actions.en: Ask for your free copy of the FIR and read its sections: POCSO for a child, the SC/ST Act if the accused knew the survivor's caste or tribe.
actions.hg: FIR ki free copy maangiye aur uske sections padhiye: bachche ke liye POCSO, aur agar accused survivor ki caste ya tribe jaanta tha to SC/ST Act.

actions.en: Whatever the law calls the act, get medical care fast: HIV PEP must start within 72 hours.
actions.hg: Kanoon is act ko jo bhi naam de, medical care jaldi lijiye: HIV PEP 72 ghante ke andar shuru hona chahiye.

actions.en: Adult men and transgender survivors can still file a police complaint, and any victim can apply to the District Legal Services Authority for compensation, even if no one is ever tried.
actions.hg: Adult aadmi aur transgender survivors bhi police complaint kar sakte hain, aur koi bhi victim District Legal Services Authority se compensation ke liye apply kar sakta hai, chahe kabhi trial ho ya na ho.

actions.en: For emotional support, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and open round the clock.
actions.hg: Emotional support ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call kijiye, free hai aur chaubees ghante khula hai.

title.en: Not only marriage: Section 69's other deceits, from a false job offer to a hidden identity, answered
title.hg: Sirf shaadi nahi: Section 69 ke baaki dhoke, jhoothe job offer se chhupi identity tak, sawaal-jawaab mein

dek.en: Almost all the talk about Section 69 of the BNS is about broken promises of marriage. The same section also makes it a crime to get sex through a false promise of a job or a promotion, or by marrying while hiding who you are. Five questions on what has to be proved, how it differs from rape and from a workplace complaint, and how to report it.
dek.hg: BNS ke Section 69 pe zyada tar baat shaadi ke toote promise ki hoti hai. Lekin yahi section naukri ya promotion ka jhootha promise karke, ya apni identity chhupakar shaadi karke sex haasil karne ko bhi crime banata hai. Paanch sawaal: kya saabit karna padta hai, yeh rape aur workplace complaint se kaise alag hai, aur report kaise karein.

statLabel.en: maximum sentence for sex obtained by deceit under Section 69 of the BNS
statLabel.hg: BNS ke Section 69 mein dhoke se haasil kiye sex ki maximum saza

label.en: the maximum sentence under Section 69, whether the lie was about marriage, a job, a promotion or an identity
label.hg: Section 69 mein maximum saza, chahe jhooth shaadi, naukri, promotion ya identity ke baare mein ho

label.en: cases registered under Section 69 from July to December 2024; NCRB does not say how many involved a job or an identity
label.hg: July se December 2024 tak Section 69 mein register hue cases; NCRB nahi batata ki inme kitne job ya identity wale the

label.en: rigorous imprisonment under Section 68, for a person in authority who abuses his position over a woman in his custody or care
label.hg: Section 68 mein rigorous imprisonment, us authority wale insaan ke liye jo apni custody ya care mein rahi woman pe apni position ka galat use kare

label.en: the time limit for a POSH Act complaint, extendable by up to 3 more; Section 69 depends on no workplace committee
label.hg: POSH Act complaint ki time limit, 3 mahine aur badh sakti hai; Section 69 kisi workplace committee pe nirbhar nahi

claim.en: Section 69 is only about boyfriends who promise marriage and back out.
claim.hg: Section 69 sirf un boyfriends ke liye hai jo shaadi ka promise karke peeche hat jaate hain.

truth.en: The section's own Explanation lists a false promise of a job or a promotion, and marrying while hiding one's identity, as 'deceitful means'. A recruiter or a manager can be charged under it.
truth.hg: Section ki apni Explanation naukri ya promotion ke jhoothe promise, aur identity chhupakar shaadi karne ko 'deceitful means' mein ginti hai. Recruiter ya manager pe bhi yeh charge lag sakta hai.

actions.en: Never offer a job, a role or a promotion in exchange for sex. Under Section 69 that offer can cost up to 10 years in prison.
actions.hg: Sex ke badle kabhi job, role ya promotion offer mat karo. Section 69 mein us offer ki keemat 10 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai.

actions.en: If a job or promotion was used to get sex from you, keep the advertisement, emails, chats and call logs, and write down dates and who said what.
actions.hg: Agar job ya promotion ke naam pe tumse sex haasil kiya gaya, toh advertisement, emails, chats aur call logs sambhaal ke rakho, aur dates aur kisne kya kaha, likh lo.

actions.en: Report at any police station. You are entitled to a free copy of the FIR, and the offence does not depend on whether you were ever hired.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein report karo. FIR ki free copy tumhara haq hai, aur offence is baat pe nirbhar nahi ki tumhe kabhi naukri mili ya nahi.

actions.en: If there was force, a threat or fear, say so plainly to the police: that is rape under Section 63, not deceit.
actions.hg: Agar zabardasti, dhamki ya darr tha, toh police ko saaf batao: woh Section 63 ke under rape hai, dhoka nahi.

actions.en: For harassment at work, also complain in writing to the Internal Committee or the district Local Committee within 3 months.
actions.hg: Kaam ki jagah harassment ke liye 3 mahine ke andar Internal Committee ya district ki Local Committee ko bhi likhit complaint do.

title.en: At work, at home, on the street, online: which Indian law covers sexual harassment where it happens, and where to complain
title.hg: Office mein, ghar par, sadak par, online: sexual harassment jahan ho, wahan India ka kaun sa law lagta hai aur complaint kahan karni hai

dek.en: The same act has four legal homes, each with its own forum and its own clock. A workplace complaint must be filed within 3 months; a police complaint can go to any station. A map for choosing the right door, and for using two at once.
dek.hg: Ek hi harkat ke chaar legal ghar hain, aur har ek ka apna forum aur apni deadline hai. Workplace ki complaint 3 months ke andar deni hoti hai; police complaint kisi bhi station mein ho sakti hai. Sahi darwaza chunne ka, aur do darwaze ek saath khatkhatane ka, ek map.

statLabel.en: to file a written workplace complaint under the POSH Act, extendable by up to 3 more
statLabel.hg: ke andar POSH Act ke under workplace ki likhit complaint deni hoti hai; yeh time 3 months aur badh sakta hai

label.en: deadline for a written complaint under the POSH Act, extendable by up to 3 more
label.hg: POSH Act ke under likhit complaint ki deadline, jo 3 months aur badh sakti hai

label.en: sexual harassment cases registered by police in India in 2024; 81% were recorded at 'other places'
label.hg: sexual harassment cases police ne 2024 mein India mein darj kiye; 81% 'other places' ke khaane mein likhe gaye

label.en: cases registered under the Domestic Violence Act in India in 2024, 496 of them in Kerala
label.hg: cases 2024 mein India mein Domestic Violence Act ke under darj hue, jinmein se 496 Kerala ke the

label.en: for a platform to remove nude, sexual or morphed images after the person's complaint, since 20 February 2026
label.hg: ke andar platform ko us insaan ki complaint par nude, sexual ya morphed images hataani hoti hain, 20 February 2026 se

claim.en: Sexual harassment law is only for offices. Anywhere else, nothing can be done.
claim.hg: Sexual harassment ka law sirf office ke liye hai. Baaki kahin ho toh kuch nahin ho sakta.

truth.en: The workplace law is one of four routes. The Domestic Violence Act covers sexual abuse at home, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita covers harassment anywhere, and the IT Act covers intimate images online.
truth.hg: Workplace wala law chaar raaston mein se ek hai. Domestic Violence Act ghar ke andar sexual abuse ko cover karta hai, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita harassment ko kahin bhi, aur IT Act online intimate images ko.

actions.en: Write down what happened, where, when and who saw it on the same day, and save messages and screenshots somewhere off your phone.
actions.hg: Usi din likh lo ki kya hua, kahan, kab aur kisne dekha, aur messages aur screenshots phone ke bahar bhi kahin save karo.

actions.en: At work, give a written complaint to the Internal Committee within 3 months. If your workplace has fewer than 10 workers, or the harasser is the employer, go to the district's Local Committee or use SHe-Box.
actions.hg: Workplace par 3 months ke andar Internal Committee ko likhit complaint do. Workplace par 10 se kam workers hon, ya harass karne wala khud employer ho, toh district ki Local Committee ke paas jao ya SHe-Box use karo.

actions.en: For harassment in public, report at any police station or by e-FIR, and ask for a woman officer and your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Public jagah par hue harassment ki report kisi bhi police station mein ya e-FIR se karo, aur woman officer aur FIR ki free copy maango.

actions.en: For images online, report to the platform first, then on cybercrime.gov.in or 1930, and keep every acknowledgement number.
actions.hg: Online images ke liye pehle platform par report karo, phir cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par, aur har acknowledgement number sambhaal kar rakho.

actions.en: In immediate danger call 112. For support call the Women Helpline 181, or 1098 if you are under 18.
actions.hg: Turant khatra ho toh 112 call karo. Support ke liye Women Helpline 181, aur 18 se kam umar ho toh 1098.

title.en: From a Rs 20,000 fine to death: India's sexual-offence laws ranked by how hard they punish
title.hg: Rs 20,000 ke fine se death tak: India ke sexual-offence laws, saza ki sakhti ke hisaab se ranked

dek.en: Sort the punishments in India's sexual-offence laws from lightest to heaviest and a hierarchy appears: which harms Parliament treats as grave, which it treats as minor, and how the same act draws a very different sentence depending on who was harmed.
dek.hg: India ke sexual-offence laws ki sazaon ko sabse halki se sabse bhaari tak lagaiye, toh ek hierarchy dikhti hai: Parliament kis nuksaan ko gambhir maanta hai, kise chhota, aur ek hi harkat par saza kaise badal jaati hai is baat se ki nuksaan kiska hua.

statLabel.en: the most a court can give for breaching a domestic-violence protection order
statLabel.hg: domestic-violence protection order todne par court zyada se zyada itni saza de sakta hai

label.en: maximum fine for breaching a domestic-violence protection order; the jail term stops at 1 year
label.hg: domestic-violence protection order todne par zyada se zyada fine; jail 1 saal par ruk jaati hai

label.en: for sexual abuse of a transgender person under Section 18 of the Transgender Persons Act
label.hg: Transgender Persons Act ke Section 18 mein transgender insaan ke sexual abuse ki saza

label.en: for a husband who has sex with his separated wife without her consent (Section 67, BNS)
label.hg: us pati ke liye jo alag reh rahi patni ke saath uski consent ke bina sex kare (Section 67, BNS)

label.en: minimum for rape (Section 64, BNS) and for an acid attack (Section 124)
label.hg: rape (Section 64, BNS) aur acid attack (Section 124) ki minimum saza

claim.en: Indian law punishes every sexual assault severely.
claim.hg: Indian law har sexual assault par sakht saza deta hai.

truth.en: The punishments run from a Rs 20,000 fine to death. The same act can start at 10 years, stop at 2 years or not count as rape at all, depending on whether the person harmed is a woman, a wife, a transgender person or a man.
truth.hg: Sazaayein Rs 20,000 ke fine se death tak jaati hain. Ek hi harkat par saza 10 saal se shuru ho sakti hai, 2 saal par ruk sakti hai ya woh rape gini hi nahi jaati, is par depend karta hai ki nuksaan ek aurat ka hua, patni ka, transgender insaan ka ya aadmi ka.

actions.en: Report the 'small' offences too. Sexual harassment, stalking and voyeurism each carry up to 3 years, and a second stalking conviction up to 5.
actions.hg: 'Chhote' offences bhi report kijiye. Sexual harassment, stalking aur voyeurism, teeno mein 3 saal tak ki saza hai, aur stalking ki doosri conviction par 5 saal tak.

actions.en: If someone shares or threatens to share your private image, complain at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930. Section 77 of the BNS (for women) and Section 66E of the IT Act (for anyone) can apply.
actions.hg: Agar koi aapki private image share kare ya share karne ki dhamki de, toh cybercrime.gov.in par complaint kijiye ya 1930 par call kijiye. BNS ka Section 77 (aurton ke liye) aur IT Act ka Section 66E (kisi ke bhi liye) lag sakte hain.

actions.en: If a husband breaches a protection order, tell the police and the magistrate. The breach is a crime in itself.
actions.hg: Agar pati protection order tode, toh police aur magistrate dono ko bataiye. Order todna khud ek crime hai.

actions.en: If you are a man or a transgender person who has been sexually assaulted, get medical care first. You can still file an FIR; ask a lawyer which sections fit.
actions.hg: Agar aap aadmi ya transgender insaan hain aur aap par sexual assault hua hai, toh pehle medical care lijiye. Aap FIR phir bhi likhwa sakte hain; lawyer se poochiye ki kaun se sections lagenge.

actions.en: Do not read a maximum as a promise. Ask what the minimum is, and how many trials end in conviction.
actions.hg: Maximum saza ko promise mat samajhiye. Poochiye ki minimum kya hai, aur kitne trials conviction par khatam hote hain.

title.en: Marital rape, khatna, the missing offence for men: the sexual-violence cases India's courts have yet to decide, November 2026
title.hg: Marital rape, khatna, mardon ke liye missing offence: sexual violence ke woh cases jin par India ki courts ka faisla abhi baaki hai, November 2026

dek.en: Who Indian law protects from sexual and gender-based violence is being argued in five courtrooms. Here is each case as it stood on 20 November 2026: what is being asked, how far it has got, and what a ruling either way would change for survivors.
dek.hg: Indian law sexual aur gender-based violence se kise bachata hai, is par paanch courtrooms mein behas chal rahi hai. Yahan har case ka 20 November 2026 tak ka haal hai: kya maanga gaya hai, baat kahan tak pahunchi hai, aur faisla kisi bhi taraf jaaye toh survivors ke liye kya badlega.

statLabel.en: the dates the Supreme Court named for fixing the final marital rape hearing
statLabel.hg: woh dates jo Supreme Court ne marital rape ki final hearing tay karne ke liye batayi

label.en: the dates the Supreme Court named for fixing the final hearing on the marital rape exception
label.hg: woh dates jo Supreme Court ne marital rape exception par final hearing tay karne ke liye batayi

label.en: the day nine Supreme Court judges reserved the judgment that will shape the khatna case
label.hg: jis din Supreme Court ke nau judges ne woh judgment reserve kiya jo khatna case ki disha tay karega

label.en: of ever-married women aged 18-49 said their husband had physically forced them to have intercourse (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 18-49 saal ki ever-married aurton ne bataya ki pati ne unhe physically force karke intercourse kiya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of 804 acid-attack cases on women before the courts in 2024 were still pending at the end of the year
label.hg: 2024 mein courts ke saamne aurton par acid attack ke 804 cases mein se itne saal ke end tak pending the

claim.en: If something is this wrong, Indian law must already ban it.
claim.hg: Agar koi cheez itni galat hai, toh Indian law mein woh pehle se banned hogi.

truth.en: In November 2026, forced sex by a husband on his adult wife is not rape in law, no specific law bans khatna, and an adult man has no rape offence to turn to. Each gap is before a court, and none has been closed.
truth.hg: November 2026 mein adult patni ke saath pati ki zabardasti law mein rape nahi hai, khatna par koi specific law nahi hai, aur adult aadmi ke liye rape ka koi offence nahi hai. Har gap kisi court ke saamne hai, aur abhi tak koi band nahi hua.

actions.en: Do not wait for a verdict to get help. In danger, call 112; the Women Helpline is 181 and the Child Helpline is 1098.
actions.hg: Madad ke liye faisle ka intezaar mat kariye. Khatre mein 112 par call kariye; Women Helpline 181 hai aur Child Helpline 1098.

actions.en: Forced sex in marriage: the Domestic Violence Act, 2005 counts sexual abuse as domestic violence and is open to you today. If you live apart from your husband, forced sex is already a crime under Section 67 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Shaadi mein zabardasti sex: Domestic Violence Act, 2005 sexual abuse ko domestic violence maanta hai aur aaj bhi aapke liye khula hai. Agar aap pati se alag reh rahi hain, toh zabardasti sex BNS ke Section 67 ke under pehle se crime hai.

actions.en: If you are a man or a transgender person who has been sexually assaulted, go to a hospital and the police anyway; for free legal aid, call the NALSA helpline 15100. If you are under 18, POCSO protects you whatever your gender.
actions.hg: Agar aap aadmi ya transgender person hain aur aap par sexual assault hua hai, toh phir bhi hospital aur police ke paas jaiye; free legal aid ke liye NALSA helpline 15100 par call kariye. Agar aap 18 se kam hain, toh POCSO aapko protect karta hai, aapka gender jo bhi ho.

actions.en: If you fear a girl is about to be cut, call the Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar aapko dar hai ki kisi bachchi ka khatna hone wala hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call kariye.

actions.en: When each ruling comes, read what the court actually did: struck a law down, set a test, or sent the question to Parliament.
actions.hg: Jab bhi koi faisla aaye, padhiye ki court ne asal mein kya kiya: law strike down kiya, test tay kiya, ya sawaal Parliament ko bhej diya.

title.en: The State versus the accused: why a rape survivor is only a witness in her own case, and the rights the law has added for her
title.hg: State versus accused: rape survivor apne hi case mein sirf ek witness kyun hai, aur law ne uske liye kaun se rights jode hain

dek.en: In an Indian criminal case the State prosecutes. The survivor does not choose the charges, the prosecutor or whether to appeal a sentence. Since 2013 the law has given her a few firm footholds. Here is where she has a voice, where she does not, and how to use what exists.
dek.hg: India ke criminal case mein prosecution State karta hai. Survivor na charges chunti hai, na prosecutor, na yeh ki saza ke khilaaf appeal ho ya nahi. 2013 se law ne use kuch pakki jagah di hai. Kahan uski awaaz hai, kahan nahi, aur jo hai use kaise use karein.

statLabel.en: a survivor's right to hear how the investigation is going
statLabel.hg: survivor ka haq ki use pata chale investigation kahan tak pahunchi

label.en: within which police must tell the survivor how the investigation is going (Section 193(3) BNSS)
label.hg: ke andar police ko survivor ko investigation ki progress batani hai (Section 193(3) BNSS)

label.en: within which a survivor with a lawyer must get free copies of the police report and statements
label.hg: ke andar lawyer wali survivor ko police report aur statements ki free copies milni chahiye

label.en: for a legal services authority to decide compensation, even when no trial takes place
label.hg: mein legal services authority ko compensation par faisla karna hai, trial na ho tab bhi

label.en: compensation for a rape survivor under NALSA's 2018 scheme
label.hg: rape survivor ka compensation, NALSA ki 2018 scheme ke tahat

claim.en: It is her case, so she decides what happens in it.
claim.hg: Case uska hai, toh usme kya hoga yeh woh tay karti hai.

truth.en: A rape case is prosecuted by the State. Police and the public prosecutor take most decisions. The survivor has specific rights to information, to be heard and to compensation, and she has to ask for them.
truth.hg: Rape case ka prosecution State karta hai. Zyada tar faisle police aur public prosecutor lete hain. Survivor ke paas information, sunwaai aur compensation ke specific rights hain, aur unhe maangna padta hai.

actions.en: Take the free copy of the FIR the day it is registered, and write down the name of the investigating officer.
actions.hg: Jis din FIR darj ho, usi din uski free copy lijiye, aur investigating officer ka naam likh lijiye.

actions.en: If you have heard nothing within 90 days, ask the investigating officer in writing for a progress update.
actions.hg: Agar 90 din mein kuch sunne ko nahi mila, toh investigating officer se likh kar progress update maangiye.

actions.en: Get a lawyer of your own, free if needed, through the District Legal Services Authority, so you receive the police report and statements within 14 days.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority se apna lawyer lijiye, zaroorat ho toh free, taaki 14 din mein police report aur statements aapko milein.

actions.en: Apply for interim compensation to the District Legal Services Authority. You do not have to wait for a verdict.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority mein interim compensation ke liye apply kijiye. Faisle ka intezaar zaroori nahi.

actions.en: If the survivor is Dalit or Adivasi, ask in writing for notice of every hearing, including bail, under Section 15A of the SC/ST Act.
actions.hg: Agar survivor Dalit ya Adivasi hai, toh SC/ST Act ke Section 15A ke tahat likh kar har hearing ki notice maangiye, bail hearing ki bhi.

title.en: In camera in 1983, free treatment in 2013, a 90-day update in 2023: how a rape survivor's rights were written into Indian law
title.hg: 1983 mein in camera, 2013 mein free treatment, 2023 mein 90 din ka update: rape survivor ke haq Indian law mein kaise likhe gaye

dek.en: Every right a rape survivor in India can claim today arrived through a specific change in the law, usually after a case made the gap impossible to ignore. Here is each one, with its year and its section, and the ones survivors still find hardest to enforce.
dek.hg: India mein rape survivor aaj jo bhi haq maang sakti hai, woh law mein ek specific badlaav se aaya, aksar tab jab kisi case ne us gap ko nazarandaaz karna namumkin bana diya. Yahan har haq hai, uske saal aur section ke saath, aur woh haq bhi jinhe survivors ke liye laagu karwana aaj bhi sabse mushkil hai.

label.en: the day in-camera rape trials and a ban on revealing a survivor's identity came into force
label.hg: woh din jab in-camera rape trials aur survivor ki pehchaan chhupaane ka law laagu hua

label.en: rigorous imprisonment since 2013 for a police officer who refuses to record a rape complaint
label.hg: 2013 se us police officer ke liye rigorous imprisonment jo rape complaint darj karne se mana kare

label.en: the time within which police must tell a victim how the investigation is going, under the BNSS
label.hg: BNSS ke under woh samay jiske andar police ko victim ko investigation ka haal batana hota hai

label.en: rape cases pending trial in India at the end of 2024
label.hg: 2024 ke ant mein India mein trial ke intezaar mein pade rape cases

actions.en: If a police station refuses to register a rape complaint, ask for the senior officer, note the officer's name and time, and know that refusing is itself an offence.
actions.hg: Agar police station rape complaint darj karne se mana kare, toh senior officer ko bulao, officer ka naam aur time note karo, aur yaad rakho ki mana karna khud ek offence hai.

actions.en: Report at any police station, wherever it happened, and ask for your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein report karo, chahe ghatna kahin bhi hui ho, aur FIR ki free copy maango.

actions.en: Any hospital, government or private, must treat a rape survivor immediately and free of cost. Do not let anyone send you away for money or for an FIR first.
actions.hg: Koi bhi hospital, sarkari ho ya private, rape survivor ka turant aur free ilaaj karne ke liye bandha hai. Kisi ko bhi paison ya pehle FIR ke naam pe tumhe lautaane mat do.

actions.en: If you have heard nothing in 90 days, ask the investigating officer in writing for an update on the case.
actions.hg: Agar 90 din mein kuch sunne ko na mile, toh investigating officer se likhit mein case ka update maango.

actions.en: Ask the District Legal Services Authority about compensation; you can apply even if the accused is never caught.
actions.hg: Compensation ke liye District Legal Services Authority se poocho; accused kabhi na pakda jaaye tab bhi tum apply kar sakti ho.

title.en: 'More of a social issue': what the Union government has told courts and Parliament about sexual-violence law, from khatna to marital rape
title.hg: 'More of a social issue': khatna se marital rape tak, Union government ne courts aur Parliament ko sexual-violence law par kya kaha

dek.en: The Union government drafts the criminal law and also defends it in court. Five positions it took between 2018 and 2024, read against the text of the law, show where it spoke, where it stalled and how citizens can answer back.
dek.hg: Union government criminal law draft bhi karti hai aur court mein uska bachaav bhi karti hai. 2018 se 2024 ke beech uski paanch positions, law ke text ke saath padho, toh dikhta hai ki woh kahan boli, kahan ruki, aur citizens kaise jawab de sakte hain.

label.en: cases of 'unnatural offences' registered under IPC Section 377 in 2023, the last full year before the BNS dropped the section
label.hg: 'unnatural offences' ke cases jo 2023 mein IPC Section 377 ke tahat register hue, BNS ke section hataane se pehle ka aakhri poora saal

label.en: time the Delhi High Court gave the Centre on 28 August 2024 to decide whether to restore punishment for non-consensual 'unnatural' sex
label.hg: jo time Delhi High Court ne 28 August 2024 ko Centre ko yeh tay karne ke liye diya ki non-consensual 'unnatural' sex ki saza wapas laani hai ya nahi

label.en: age from which a wife falls under the marital rape exception in Section 63 of the BNS
label.hg: woh umar jisse BNS Section 63 ka marital rape exception biwi par laagu hota hai

actions.en: Read the government's affidavit or parliamentary answer itself, not only the headline, and check each claim against the text of the law.
actions.hg: Sirf headline nahi, government ka affidavit ya parliamentary answer khud padho, aur har claim ko law ke text se milao.

actions.en: Write to your MP and ask them to put a question in Parliament on marital rape, the missing offence for male and transgender survivors, or a law on khatna.
actions.hg: Apne MP ko likho aur kaho ki woh Parliament mein marital rape, male aur transgender survivors ke liye missing offence, ya khatna par law ke baare mein sawaal poochhein.

actions.en: Support groups that file intervention applications in pending cases; individual Bohra women have done so in the khatna case.
actions.hg: Un groups ko support karo jo pending cases mein intervention application file karte hain; khatna case mein Bohra community ki kuch aurton ne aisa kiya hai.

actions.en: Watch for India's reply to the UN CEDAW Committee, due on 3 February 2027, and compare it with what the government told the Supreme Court.
actions.hg: UN CEDAW Committee ko India ka jawab 3 February 2027 tak due hai. Usko dekho aur compare karo ki government ne Supreme Court ko kya kaha tha.

actions.en: If you are being harmed now, call 112 or the Women Helpline 181; the gaps in the law do not cancel the remedies that exist.
actions.hg: Agar abhi tumhe nuksaan pahunchaya ja raha hai, toh 112 ya Women Helpline 181 par call karo; law ke gaps se jo remedies maujood hain woh khatam nahi hoti.

title.en: When a rape survivor dies: her family's rights over her name, her last rites, the case and compensation, answered
title.hg: Jab rape survivor ki maut ho jaaye: uske naam, antim sanskar, case aur compensation par family ke rights, seedhe jawab

dek.en: A family that loses a daughter to sexual violence inherits a police case, reporters at the door and a set of rights nobody explains. Five questions, answered from the Supreme Court's 2018 ruling, the Hathras and RG Kar court records and the new criminal codes.
dek.hg: Jis family ki beti sexual violence mein chali jaati hai, uske hisse mein ek police case, darwaze par reporters aur aise rights aate hain jo koi samjhata nahin. Paanch sawaal, jinke jawab Supreme Court ke 2018 ke faisle, Hathras aur RG Kar ke court records aur naye criminal codes se liye gaye hain.

statLabel.en: compensation a Kolkata court ordered the state to pay the family in the RG Kar case, January 2025
statLabel.hg: compensation jo Kolkata ki ek court ne RG Kar case mein state ko family ko dene ka order diya, January 2025

label.en: cases of murder with rape or gang rape registered in India in 2024, with 274 victims
label.hg: murder with rape ya gang rape ke cases 2024 mein India mein darj hue, jinmein 274 victims the

label.en: compensation range in NALSA's 2018 scheme for the family of a woman who is killed
label.hg: NALSA ki 2018 scheme mein us woman ki family ke liye compensation ki range jiski jaan chali gayi

label.en: ordered for the family in the RG Kar case by a Sealdah court on 20 January 2025
label.hg: RG Kar case mein family ke liye, Sealdah court ka order, 20 January 2025

label.en: within which police must tell the informant or the victim how the investigation is going
label.hg: ke andar police ko informant ya victim ko batana hota hai ki investigation kahan tak pahunchi

claim.en: Once a rape victim has died, anyone can publish her name and photograph, especially if her family agrees.
claim.hg: Rape victim ki maut ke baad koi bhi uska naam aur photo chhaap sakta hai, khaas kar agar family haan keh de.

truth.en: The Supreme Court ruled in 2018 that her identity stays protected after death, even if her next of kin authorise disclosure, unless a Sessions Judge decides that it is justified.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ne 2018 mein kaha ki uski identity maut ke baad bhi protected rehti hai, chahe next of kin ijazat de dein, jab tak Sessions Judge yeh tay na kare ki disclosure justified hai.

actions.en: Do not post or forward her name, photograph or address, and ask relatives and reporters not to. If the family wants her named, apply to the Sessions Judge first.
actions.hg: Uska naam, photo ya address na post karo, na forward karo, aur rishtedaaron aur reporters se bhi yahi kaho. Agar family chahti hai ki uska naam liya jaaye, toh pehle Sessions Judge ke paas application do.

actions.en: Put every request to the police in writing: for the body to be handed over, for the free FIR copy, for the investigation update due within 90 days.
actions.hg: Police se har request likh kar karo: body family ko saunpne ki, FIR ki free copy ki, aur 90 din ke andar milne wale investigation update ki.

actions.en: Get a lawyer early, through the District Legal Services Authority if you cannot pay, so the family receives the case papers and is heard in court.
actions.hg: Jaldi lawyer karo, paise na hon toh District Legal Services Authority ke zariye, taaki family ko case ke papers milein aur court mein uski baat suni jaaye.

actions.en: Apply to the District Legal Services Authority for compensation. You do not have to wait for an arrest or a verdict.
actions.hg: Compensation ke liye District Legal Services Authority mein apply karo. Iske liye arrest ya faisle ka wait karna zaroori nahin.

actions.en: If grief becomes too heavy for anyone at home, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar ghar mein kisi ke liye bhi dukh bahut bhaari ho jaaye, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call karo, free aur 24 ghante.

title.en: Sessions court, POCSO court, fast-track court, atrocities court: which court hears which sexual-offence case, and why it matters
title.hg: Sessions court, POCSO court, fast-track court, atrocities court: kaun sa sexual-offence case kis court mein jaata hai, aur isse fark kyun padta hai

dek.en: India has built a patchwork of courts for sexual offences, one law at a time. The court a case lands in sets the deadline on paper, the way a survivor is questioned and sometimes the sentence. Here is the map, and the queue behind each door.
dek.hg: India ne sexual offences ke liye courts ka ek patchwork banaya hai, ek-ek law karke. Case jis court mein pahunchta hai, wahi kaagaz par deadline tay karta hai, survivor se sawaal kaise pooche jaayenge yeh tay karta hai, aur kabhi-kabhi saza bhi. Yeh raha naksha, aur har darwaze ke peeche ki line.

statLabel.en: fast-track courts reserved for POCSO cases, November 2026
statLabel.hg: fast-track courts sirf POCSO cases ke liye reserved, November 2026

label.en: Fast Track Special Courts functioning in November 2026, 399 of them only for POCSO cases
label.hg: Fast Track Special Courts November 2026 mein chal rahe the, jinme se 399 sirf POCSO cases ke liye

label.en: for a POCSO Special Court to record the child's evidence after taking cognizance
label.hg: ke andar POCSO Special Court ko cognizance lene ke baad bachche ka evidence record karna hota hai

label.en: POCSO cases pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: POCSO cases 2024 ke end par trial ke liye pending the

label.en: rape cases pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases 2024 ke end par trial ke liye pending the

claim.en: Every sexual-offence case goes to the same kind of court and follows the same rules.
claim.hg: Har sexual-offence case ek hi tarah ke court mein jaata hai aur ek hi rules par chalta hai.

truth.en: The survivor's age, her caste or tribe and the age of the accused can each send a case to a different court, with a different deadline and a different way of taking evidence.
truth.hg: Survivor ki umar, uski caste ya tribe, aur accused ki umar, teeno case ko alag court mein bhej sakte hain, jahan deadline alag hoti hai aur evidence lene ka tareeka bhi alag.

actions.en: Ask the investigating officer or the public prosecutor which court your chargesheet has gone to and which Acts are on it. The answer tells you which deadline applies.
actions.hg: Investigating officer ya public prosecutor se poocho ki tumhari chargesheet kis court mein gayi hai aur us par kaun se Acts lage hain. Jawab se pata chalega ki kaun si deadline lagu hai.

actions.en: In a POCSO case, ask the Special Court for an early date for the child's evidence and for the video link, screen or curtain the Act provides.
actions.hg: POCSO case mein Special Court se bachche ke evidence ki jaldi date maango, aur woh video link, screen ya curtain maango jo Act deta hai.

actions.en: If the survivor is Dalit or Adivasi, check that the Atrocities Act sections are on the FIR. They decide the court and your right to notice of bail hearings.
actions.hg: Agar survivor Dalit ya Adivasi hai, toh check karo ki FIR par Atrocities Act ke sections lage hain. Inhi se court tay hota hai, aur bail hearings ke notice ka tumhara haq bhi.

actions.en: Keep a dated record of every hearing and adjournment. Delay is easier to challenge when it is on paper.
actions.hg: Har hearing aur adjournment ka date ke saath record rakho. Deri ko challenge karna tab aasaan hota hai jab woh kaagaz par ho.

actions.en: For free legal aid at any stage, contact your District Legal Services Authority (NALSA helpline 15100).
actions.hg: Kisi bhi stage par free legal aid ke liye apni District Legal Services Authority se contact karo (NALSA helpline 15100).

title.en: The woman officer, the doctor, the magistrate, the judge: who does what in a rape case under India's new criminal laws
title.hg: Mahila officer, doctor, magistrate, judge: India ke naye criminal laws ke under rape case mein kaun kya karta hai

dek.en: A rape case passes through many hands, and since July 2024 the law gives each of them a named duty and often a deadline. Meet them in the order a survivor does, with the section that binds each one, so you know whose job it was when a case stalls.
dek.hg: Rape case kai haathon se guzarta hai, aur July 2024 se law har ek ko ek tay duty aur aksar ek deadline deta hai. Unse usi order mein milo jis order mein survivor milti hai, us section ke saath jo har ek ko baandhta hai, taaki case atke toh tumhe pata ho ki kaam kiska tha.

label.en: within which police must send a rape survivor to a doctor, who may examine her only with her consent
label.hg: ke andar police ko rape survivor ko doctor ke paas bhejna hota hai, jo sirf uske consent se examination kar sakta hai

label.en: for the doctor to send the medical report to the investigating officer
label.hg: ke andar doctor ko medical report investigating officer ko bhejni hoti hai

label.en: for the Legal Services Authority to finish its inquiry into a compensation claim, with or without a trial
label.hg: ke andar Legal Services Authority ko compensation claim ki inquiry poori karni hoti hai, trial ho ya na ho

label.en: approved One Stop Centres operational in July 2026
label.hg: approved One Stop Centres July 2026 mein chal rahe the

claim.en: Once the FIR is filed, 'the system' takes over and the survivor can only wait.
claim.hg: FIR file hote hi 'system' sab sambhal leta hai aur survivor sirf intezaar kar sakti hai.

truth.en: There is no single system. Each stage has a named person with a duty written into the BNSS, and most stages have a deadline you can ask about in writing.
truth.hg: Koi ek system nahi hai. Har stage par ek tay insaan hai jiski duty BNSS mein likhi hai, aur zyada tar stages ki ek deadline hai jiske baare mein tum likhit mein pooch sakte ho.

actions.en: At the station, ask for a woman officer to record your complaint and take the free copy of the FIR before you leave.
actions.hg: Station par kaho ki tumhari complaint mahila officer record kare, aur nikalne se pehle FIR ki free copy lo.

actions.en: At the hospital, remember that the examination needs your consent. Ask the doctor about emergency contraception and HIV PEP on the first visit.
actions.hg: Hospital mein yaad rakho ki examination tumhare consent se hi hoga. Pehli visit par hi doctor se emergency contraception aur HIV PEP ke baare mein poocho.

actions.en: Keep one dated list: FIR, medical examination, magistrate's statement, chargesheet, each hearing. Ask the investigating officer in writing for the 90-day progress update.
actions.hg: Dates ki ek list rakho: FIR, medical examination, magistrate ka statement, chargesheet, har hearing. Investigating officer se 90 din wala progress update likhit mein maango.

actions.en: Apply to your District Legal Services Authority for compensation and free legal aid (NALSA helpline 15100). You do not need an arrest or a conviction.
actions.hg: Compensation aur free legal aid ke liye apni District Legal Services Authority mein apply karo (NALSA helpline 15100). Iske liye arrest ya conviction zaroori nahi hai.

actions.en: Call the Women Helpline 181 or the emergency number 112 and ask for your district's One Stop Centre.
actions.hg: Women Helpline 181 ya emergency number 112 par call karo aur apne district ke One Stop Centre ke baare mein poocho.

title.en: 13,980 acquittals in one year: the weak points where India's rape trials fall apart
title.hg: Ek saal mein 13,980 acquittals: woh kamzor kadiyaan jahan India ke rape trials toot jaate hain

dek.en: Courts convicted in 5,032 rape trials in 2024 and acquitted in 13,980. An acquittal says guilt was not proved beyond reasonable doubt. It does not say the woman lied. We took one case past the four points where the law itself expects a rape trial to break, and what it offers at each.
dek.hg: 2024 mein courts ne 5,032 rape trials mein saza di aur 13,980 mein accused ko bari kiya. Acquittal ka matlab hai ki guilt 'beyond reasonable doubt' saabit nahi hua. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki aurat ne jhooth bola. Humne ek case ko un chaar points se guzaar kar dekha jahan law khud maanta hai ki rape trial toot sakta hai, aur har point par law kya deta hai.

statLabel.en: rape trials ended in acquittal in 2024, against 5,032 convictions
statLabel.hg: rape trials 2024 mein acquittal par khatam hue, jabki convictions 5,032 the

label.en: rape trials that ended in acquittal in India in 2024
label.hg: rape trials jo 2024 mein India mein acquittal par khatam hue

label.en: of the 20,587 rape trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue 20,587 rape trials mein se itne conviction par khatam hue

label.en: of rape cases registered in 2024 named an offender the woman knew
label.hg: 2024 mein register hue rape cases jinme offender aurat ka jaana-pehchaana tha

label.en: rape cases pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases jo 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending the

claim.en: If the court acquitted him, she must have lied.
claim.hg: Agar court ne use bari kar diya, toh ladki ne zaroor jhooth bola hoga.

truth.en: An acquittal means the prosecution did not prove guilt beyond reasonable doubt. NCRB's tables do not record why a trial failed: late medical evidence, a witness worn out by years of hearings and a family that was pressured to 'settle' all end up in the same column.
truth.hg: Acquittal ka matlab hai ki prosecution guilt ko 'beyond reasonable doubt' saabit nahi kar paaya. NCRB ki tables yeh record nahi karti ki trial kyun fail hua: der se mila medical evidence, saalon ki tareekhon se thaka hua gawah aur 'samjhaute' ke liye dabaaya gaya parivaar, sab ek hi column mein aate hain.

actions.en: After a sexual assault, get a medical examination as early as you can. It needs your consent, police have 24 hours to arrange it, and the 'two-finger test' is banned.
actions.hg: Sexual assault ke baad jitni jaldi ho sake medical examination karwaiye. Iske liye aapki consent zaroori hai, police ke paas ise arrange karne ke liye 24 ghante hain, aur 'two-finger test' banned hai.

actions.en: Ask for your statement to be recorded before a magistrate under Section 183 of the BNSS in the first days, and note the date.
actions.hg: Shuru ke dino mein hi BNSS ke Section 183 ke under magistrate ke saamne apna statement record karwaane ko kahiye, aur date note kar lijiye.

actions.en: Keep one dated file: FIR copy, medical examination date, charge-sheet date, every hearing date. Ask police in writing for the progress update due within 90 days.
actions.hg: Ek dated file rakhiye: FIR ki copy, medical examination ki date, charge-sheet ki date, har hearing ki date. Police se likhit mein woh progress update maangiye jo 90 din ke andar milna chahiye.

actions.en: If the accused or his family approach you to 'settle', tell the investigating officer and the public prosecutor in writing. Bail conditions must not permit contact with you.
actions.hg: Agar accused ya uska parivaar 'settle' karne ke liye aapse sampark kare, toh investigating officer aur public prosecutor ko likhit mein bataiye. Bail conditions mein aapse contact ki ijaazat nahi ho sakti.

actions.en: Questions in court about your character or past sexual experience to suggest consent are barred by Section 149 of the BSA. The prosecutor can object, and the court must not allow them.
actions.hg: Consent dikhane ke liye court mein aapke character ya pichhle sexual experience par sawaal poochna BSA ke Section 149 ke under mana hai. Prosecutor object kar sakta hai, aur court ko aise sawaal allow nahi karne chahiye.

title.en: Between the FIR and the verdict, a rape survivor protects herself
title.hg: FIR se verdict tak, rape survivor ko khud ko khud hi bachana padta hai

dek.en: In 96.8% of rape cases registered in 2024 the accused was someone the survivor knew, and nine in ten rape cases in court were still waiting at the end of the year. The law gives her a closed courtroom and a no-contact bail rule. Outside the court, most protection has to be asked for. Unnao shows the cost of that gap.
dek.hg: 2024 mein register hue 96.8% rape cases mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha, aur court mein pade har das mein se nau rape case saal ke end tak pending the. Law use band courtroom aur no-contact bail ka rule deta hai. Court ke bahar zyada tar protection maangni padti hai. Unnao dikhata hai ki is gap ki keemat kya hai.

statLabel.en: of rape cases registered in 2024 had an accused known to the survivor
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein register hue rape cases mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: of rape cases registered in 2024 (28,597 of 29,536) had an offender known to the survivor
label.hg: 2024 mein register hue rape cases (29,536 mein se 28,597) mein offender survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: rape cases pending trial at the end of 2024, 89.8% of those before the courts
label.hg: rape cases 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending the, court ke saamne wale cases ka 89.8%

label.en: the sentence given in March 2020 to a former MLA and six others over the death in custody of the Unnao survivor's father
label.hg: ki saza March 2020 mein ek former MLA aur chhe aur logon ko mili, Unnao survivor ke father ki custody mein maut ke liye

label.en: pages of the 295-page Hema Committee draft were withheld to protect witnesses and those accused
label.hg: pages Hema Committee ke 295-page draft se witnesses aur accused ko bachane ke liye roke gaye

claim.en: Once the FIR is registered, the system keeps the survivor safe until the trial ends.
claim.hg: FIR register hote hi system trial khatam hone tak survivor ko safe rakhta hai.

truth.en: The law protects her inside the courtroom and in the bail order. Outside it, most protection has to be asked for in writing. The plainest state duty to protect victims and witnesses sits in the Atrocities Act, which covers only Dalit and Adivasi survivors.
truth.hg: Law use courtroom ke andar aur bail order mein protect karta hai. Bahar zyada tar protection likhit mein maangni padti hai. Victims aur witnesses ko bachane ki sabse saaf state duty Atrocities Act mein hai, jo sirf Dalit aur Adivasi survivors ko cover karta hai.

actions.en: Keep a dated log of every threat, visit, call or 'offer' from the accused's side, with screenshots, and share it with someone you trust the same day.
actions.hg: Accused ki taraf se har threat, visit, call ya 'offer' ka dated log rakho, screenshots ke saath, aur usi din kisi bharose wale ke saath share karo.

actions.en: Report each contact in writing to the investigating officer and the public prosecutor, and ask for bail to be cancelled if a no-contact condition is broken.
actions.hg: Har contact ki report likhit mein investigating officer aur public prosecutor ko do, aur no-contact condition tootne par bail cancel karne ki maang karo.

actions.en: Ask the court by name for an in-camera hearing and, for a child, a video link or screen.
actions.hg: Court se naam lekar in-camera hearing maango, aur bachche ke liye video link ya screen.

actions.en: If the case is under the SC/ST Atrocities Act, cite Section 15A and insist on notice of every hearing.
actions.hg: Agar case SC/ST Atrocities Act ke under hai, to Section 15A cite karo aur har hearing ke notice par zor do.

actions.en: Get a free lawyer from the District Legal Services Authority; in immediate danger, call 112.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer lo; turant khatre mein ho to 112 call karo.

title.en: The 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape case: 11 life convicts freed on Independence Day 2022, sent back to jail by the Supreme Court in 2024
title.hg: 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape case: umrqaid wale 11 convicts Independence Day 2022 par reha, 2024 mein Supreme Court ne waapas jail bheja

dek.en: A conviction in 2008, upheld in 2017. Compensation ordered in 2019. Then remission, and a walk out of jail on 15 August 2022. How one verdict had to be won again and again over 22 years, and what remission really is.
dek.hg: 2008 mein conviction, 2017 mein High Court ki muhar. 2019 mein compensation ka order. Phir remission, aur 15 August 2022 ko jail se bahar. Ek verdict ko 22 saal tak baar-baar kaise bachana pada, aur remission asal mein hota kya hai.

statLabel.en: life convicts released on Independence Day 2022, back in jail by 21 January 2024
statLabel.hg: umrqaid wale convicts jo Independence Day 2022 par reha hue aur 21 January 2024 tak waapas jail mein the

label.en: relatives of the survivor murdered during the 2002 Gujarat riots, for which 11 men got life sentences
label.hg: survivor ke rishtedaar jinka 2002 ke Gujarat riots mein murder hua; iske liye 11 logon ko umrqaid mili

label.en: police personnel and doctors acquitted at trial in 2008 and convicted by the Bombay High Court in 2017
label.hg: police personnel aur doctors jo 2008 mein trial mein bari hue aur 2017 mein Bombay High Court ne convict kiye

label.en: compensation the Supreme Court ordered Gujarat to pay the survivor in 2019, with a government job and housing
label.hg: compensation jo 2019 mein Supreme Court ne Gujarat sarkar ko survivor ko dene ka order diya, saath mein sarkari naukri aur ghar

claim.en: Once a court sentences someone to life, the case is closed.
claim.hg: Court ne ek baar umrqaid de di, toh case khatam.

truth.en: A government can cut a sentence short through remission. In this case 11 life convicts walked out of jail in 2022, and it took a Supreme Court ruling in 2024 to send them back.
truth.hg: Sarkar remission dekar saza beech mein khatam kar sakti hai. Is case mein umrqaid wale 11 convicts 2022 mein jail se bahar aa gaye, aur unhe waapas bhejne ke liye 2024 mein Supreme Court ka faisla laga.

actions.en: When you file an FIR, read it before you sign and ask for your free copy. A police officer who refuses to record a rape complaint commits a crime under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: FIR file karte waqt sign karne se pehle use padhiye aur apni free copy maangiye. Rape complaint record na karne wala police officer BNS ki Section 199 ke under crime karta hai.
