actions.en: Any survivor can apply to the State or District Legal Services Authority for compensation, even if the offender is never traced and no trial takes place.
actions.hg: Koi bhi survivor State ya District Legal Services Authority mein compensation ke liye apply kar sakti hai, chahe offender kabhi pakda na jaye aur koi trial na ho.

actions.en: Never share a survivor's name, photo or village online. Revealing a rape survivor's identity is a crime under Section 72 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ka naam, photo ya gaon online kabhi share mat kijiye. Rape survivor ki identity kholna BNS ki Section 72 ke under crime hai.

actions.en: Watch what happens after a verdict: remission orders can be challenged in court.
actions.hg: Verdict ke baad kya hota hai, us par bhi nazar rakhiye: remission orders ko court mein challenge kiya ja sakta hai.

title.en: Hyderabad 2019: the 'encounter' a Supreme Court commission found deliberate, and the three minors among the dead
title.hg: Hyderabad 2019: woh 'encounter' jise Supreme Court ke commission ne jaanbujhkar ki gayi firing maana, aur marne walon mein teen minors

dek.en: Telangana police shot dead four men accused of a rape and murder before any court had tested the evidence. A commission later said the firing was meant to kill and that three of the dead were minors. Why an encounter is not justice, for the murdered woman's family or for anyone else.
dek.hg: Telangana police ne rape aur murder ke chaar accused ko goli maar di, isse pehle ki koi court saboot parakh paati. Baad mein ek commission ne kaha ki goli jaan lene ke iraade se chalayi gayi thi, aur marne walon mein se teen minor the. Encounter insaaf kyun nahi hai, na maari gayi aurat ki family ke liye, na kisi aur ke liye.

statLabel.en: accused shot dead by the police were minors, the commission found
statLabel.hg: police ki goli se maare gaye accused mein se minor the, commission ne paaya

label.en: accused shot dead by the police were minors, the commission found
label.hg: police ki goli se maare gaye accused mein se minor the, commission ne paaya

label.en: police officers the commission said should be tried for murder
label.hg: police officers par murder ka trial chalane ki sifaarish commission ne ki

label.en: cases of murder with rape or gang rape recorded in India in 2024, each owed a trial
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein rape ya gang rape ke saath murder ke darj case, har ek ko trial ka haq hai

claim.en: Encounters give the families of rape victims quick justice.
claim.hg: Encounter se rape victim ki family ko jaldi insaaf milta hai.

truth.en: An encounter ends the trial, not the crime. In the Hyderabad case no court ever tested the evidence, so no court will ever say who raped and killed her, and a Supreme Court-appointed commission found the four were deliberately shot.
truth.hg: Encounter trial ko khatam karta hai, crime ko nahi. Hyderabad case mein kisi court ne kabhi saboot nahi parkhe, isliye koi court kabhi nahi batayegi ki uska rape aur murder kisne kiya. Aur Supreme Court ke banaye commission ne paaya ki chaaron ko jaanbujhkar goli maari gayi.

actions.en: When someone cheers an encounter, ask them: who now proves what happened, and who checks the police?
actions.hg: Jab koi encounter par taali bajaye, toh poochiye: ab yeh kaun saabit karega ki hua kya tha, aur police par nazar kaun rakhega?

actions.en: Demand speed through the courts: the BNSS asks for rape investigations within two months and trials within two months of the charge sheet.
actions.hg: Jaldi insaaf court ke raaste maangiye: BNSS kehta hai ki rape ki investigation do mahine mein aur trial chargesheet ke do mahine mein poora ho.

actions.en: If a child is accused of a crime, insist the case goes to the Juvenile Justice Board. Children keep their rights even when accused of terrible crimes.
actions.hg: Agar kisi bachche par crime ka aarop hai, toh zor dijiye ki case Juvenile Justice Board ke paas jaaye. Serious aarop ho tab bhi bachchon ke haq khatam nahi hote.

actions.en: Never share the names or photos of a survivor, or of a child accused of a crime.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ka, ya crime ke accused kisi bachche ka naam ya photo kabhi share mat kijiye.

title.en: The Aparajita Bill promised death for rapists. West Bengal's courts convicted in 1.6% of crimes-against-women trials
title.hg: Aparajita Bill ne rapists ko death ka vaada kiya. West Bengal ki courts ne crimes-against-women trials mein sirf 1.6% mein saza di

dek.en: Weeks after the RG Kar case, West Bengal's Assembly voted unanimously for mandatory death sentences. NCRB data show where the state's system was actually failing: the lowest conviction rate for crimes against women of any state, and the largest pile of such cases waiting for trial in India.
dek.hg: RG Kar case ke kuch hi hafton baad West Bengal Assembly ne ek raay se mandatory death sentence wala Bill pass kiya. NCRB data dikhata hai ki state ka system asal mein kahan fail ho raha tha: crimes against women mein kisi bhi state se kam conviction rate, aur India mein trial ka intezaar karte sabse zyada aise cases.

statLabel.en: crimes-against-women cases awaiting trial in West Bengal at the end of 2024
statLabel.hg: crimes against women ke cases jo 2024 ke end mein West Bengal mein trial ka intezaar kar rahe the

label.en: conviction rate in crimes-against-women trials in West Bengal in 2024, the lowest of any state
label.hg: 2024 mein West Bengal mein crimes-against-women trials ka conviction rate, kisi bhi state mein sabse kam

label.en: crimes-against-women cases waiting for trial in West Bengal at the end of 2024, the most in India
label.hg: crimes against women ke cases jo 2024 ke end mein West Bengal mein trial ke intezaar mein the, India mein sabse zyada

label.en: convictions in crimes-against-women trials in West Bengal in 2024, against 12,301 acquittals
label.hg: 2024 mein West Bengal mein crimes-against-women trials mein convictions, jabki 12,301 mein accused bari ho gaye

label.en: conviction rate in crimes-against-women trials across India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein poore India mein crimes-against-women trials ka conviction rate

claim.en: A death sentence for rapists is what stops rape.
claim.hg: Rapists ko death dene se hi rape rukega.

truth.en: The Verma Committee advised against the death penalty for rape, noting that it may not have a deterrent effect. What West Bengal lacked in 2024 was convictions: only 1.6% of its crimes-against-women trials ended in one.
truth.hg: Verma Committee ne rape ke liye death penalty ke khilaaf salaah di thi aur kaha tha ki iska deterrent effect shayad na ho. 2024 mein West Bengal mein kami convictions ki thi: crimes-against-women trials mein sirf 1.6% mein saza hui.

actions.en: When a leader promises death for rapists, ask for the state's conviction rate and the number of cases waiting for trial.
actions.hg: Jab koi neta rapists ko death ka vaada kare, toh poochiye: state ka conviction rate kya hai, aur kitne cases trial ke intezaar mein hain?

actions.en: Check your own state's figures in NCRB's Crime in India tables before you share a claim about crime or punishment.
actions.hg: Koi claim share karne se pehle apne state ke figures NCRB ki Crime in India report mein khud check kijiye.

actions.en: If you have filed a rape complaint, ask the police for an update: the law entitles you to one within 90 days.
actions.hg: Agar aapne rape complaint file ki hai, toh police se investigation ka update maangiye. Law kehta hai ki 90 din ke andar aapko update milna chahiye.

actions.en: Ask your MLA what is being done to clear pending trials, not only to raise sentences.
actions.hg: Apne MLA se poochiye ki pending trials clear karne ke liye kya ho raha hai, sirf saza badhane ke liye nahi.

title.en: Bail if he gets a rakhi tied: the 2021 Aparna Bhat ruling that barred judges from pushing survivors to compromise
title.hg: Rakhi bandhwao, bail paao: 2021 ka Aparna Bhat faisla, jisne judges ko survivors par compromise ka dabaav daalne se roka

dek.en: A High Court released a man accused of sexual assault on condition that he visit the complainant's home and ask her to tie a rakhi on him. In March 2021 the Supreme Court struck that down and set rules for every court. Five years on, the court says efforts to sensitise judges have fallen short. Here is what a survivor is owed when the accused asks for bail.
dek.hg: Ek High Court ne sexual assault ke ek accused ko is shart par bail di ki woh complainant ke ghar jaakar usse rakhi bandhwaane ki request kare. March 2021 mein Supreme Court ne ye shart radd ki aur har court ke liye rules banaaye. Paanch saal baad court khud kehta hai ki judges ko sensitise karne ki koshishein kam padi hain. Jaaniye, jab accused bail maange toh survivor ke kya haq hain.

label.en: the day the Supreme Court struck down the rakhi condition and ruled that bail must never require or permit contact with the victim
label.hg: woh din jab Supreme Court ne rakhi wali shart radd ki aur kaha ki bail ki koi bhi shart victim se contact ki maang ya ijaazat nahi de sakti

label.en: cruelty-by-husband cases that ended in compromise or compounding in 2024, against 10,689 convictions
label.hg: cruelty-by-husband ke cases jo 2024 mein compromise ya compounding par khatam hue, jabki conviction sirf 10,689 mein hua

label.en: crime-against-women cases still waiting for trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: crime-against-women ke cases jo 2024 ke end tak trial ka intezaar kar rahe the

claim.en: A rakhi, an apology or a marriage can settle a sexual assault case.
claim.hg: Rakhi, maafi ya shaadi se sexual assault ka case settle ho sakta hai.

truth.en: The Supreme Court ruled in 2021 that courts must not suggest or entertain any compromise, including marriage. Its 2023 handbook says: 'Marriage is not a remedy to the violence of rape.'
truth.hg: Supreme Court ne 2021 mein kaha ki courts kisi bhi compromise ka, shaadi ka bhi, na sujhaav dein na use jagah dein. Uski 2023 ki handbook kehti hai: 'Marriage is not a remedy to the violence of rape', yaani shaadi rape ki hinsa ka ilaaj nahi hai.

actions.en: If the accused, his family or anyone acting for him contacts you to 'settle', save the messages, note the dates and tell the investigating officer and the public prosecutor.
actions.hg: Agar accused, uska parivaar ya uski taraf se koi bhi aapse 'settle' karne ke liye contact kare, toh messages save kariye, dates note kariye aur investigating officer aur public prosecutor ko bataaiye.

actions.en: If a bail order requires or allows any contact with you, tell your lawyer at once: the Supreme Court has ruled that bail conditions must not.
actions.hg: Agar bail order aapse kisi bhi tarah ke contact ki maang kare ya ijaazat de, toh turant apne lawyer ko bataaiye: Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki bail ki shartein aisa nahi kar sakti.

actions.en: If police have told you nothing within 90 days of the case being registered, ask for an update in writing; the BNSS requires them to inform you.
actions.hg: Agar case darj hone ke 90 din ke andar police ne aapko kuch nahi bataaya, toh likhit mein update maangiye; BNSS ke under unhe aapko batana zaroori hai.

actions.en: If your case falls under the SC/ST Atrocities Act, insist on timely notice of every bail hearing; Section 15A of that Act gives you the right.
actions.hg: Agar aapka case SC/ST Atrocities Act ke under aata hai, toh har bail hearing ki samay par jaankari maangiye; us Act ka Section 15A aapko ye haq deta hai.

actions.en: Ask the District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer, or call the NALSA helpline, 15100.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer maangiye, ya NALSA helpline 15100 par call kariye.

title.en: An open letter, a petition, an audit, an RTI: the citizens behind India's landmark sexual-violence rulings
title.hg: Ek open letter, ek petition, ek audit, ek RTI: India ke landmark sexual-violence faislon ke peeche khade aam log

dek.en: Four law teachers, petitioners in the Supreme Court, a university team and a collective of film workers changed how India handles sexual violence. How they did it, and how a student, teacher or employee can use the same tools.
dek.hg: Chaar law teachers, Supreme Court ke petitioners, ek university team aur film workers ke ek collective ne badla ki India sexual violence se kaise nipatta hai. Unhone yeh kaise kiya, aur koi student, teacher ya employee wahi tools kaise use kar sakta hai.

statLabel.en: minor girls whose sexual abuse at a Muzaffarpur shelter home a university audit revealed (2018)
statLabel.hg: naabaalig ladkiyan jinke Muzaffarpur shelter home mein hue sexual abuse ka khulasa ek university audit ne kiya (2018)

label.en: law teachers who wrote the September 1979 open letter to the Chief Justice of India
label.hg: law teachers jinhone September 1979 mein Chief Justice of India ko open letter likha

label.en: minor girls whose sexual abuse at a state-run Muzaffarpur shelter home an outside audit revealed
label.hg: naabaalig ladkiyan jinke Muzaffarpur ke sarkari shelter home mein hue sexual abuse ka khulasa ek bahari audit ne kiya

label.en: between the Vishaka guidelines (1997) and the POSH Act (2013)
label.hg: ka faasla Vishaka guidelines (1997) aur POSH Act (2013) ke beech

label.en: pages removed from the Hema Committee report before its release under the RTI Act (2024)
label.hg: pages jo Hema Committee report ko RTI Act ke under release karne (2024) se pehle hataye gaye

claim.en: Laws on sexual violence change only when governments decide to change them.
claim.hg: Sexual violence ke kanoon tabhi badalte hain jab sarkar unhe badalna chahe.

truth.en: Many of India's biggest changes began with citizens: an open letter, public-interest petitions, a university audit and the right to information pushed courts and governments to act.
truth.hg: India ke kai sabse bade badlaav aam logon se shuru hue: ek open letter, public-interest petitions, ek university audit aur Right to Information ne courts aur sarkaron ko kadam uthane par majboor kiya.

actions.en: Read the judgment or report itself before you campaign on it, and quote it exactly.
actions.hg: Kisi judgment ya report par campaign karne se pehle use khud padhiye, aur bilkul sahi quote kijiye.

actions.en: Ask your college or workplace, in writing, who sits on its Internal Complaints Committee.
actions.hg: Apne college ya office se likh kar poochiye ki uski Internal Complaints Committee mein kaun-kaun hai.

actions.en: Use the RTI Act to ask government bodies for records they have not published, and appeal if they refuse.
actions.hg: Jo records sarkari bodies ne publish nahi kiye, unhe RTI Act se maangiye, aur mana karein toh appeal kijiye.

actions.en: If you suspect children are being abused in a home or hostel, call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar aapko lage ki kisi home ya hostel mein bachchon ka abuse ho raha hai, toh 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Never name or show a survivor, even in a post that supports her.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ka naam ya photo kabhi share mat kijiye, us post mein bhi nahi jo uske support mein ho.

title.en: 'A peaceful affair': how a 1978 Supreme Court acquittal pushed India to rewrite its rape law
title.hg: 'A peaceful affair': 1978 ke ek Supreme Court faisle ne India ka rape law kaise badalwaya

dek.en: In 1978 the Supreme Court acquitted two policemen accused of raping a girl in police custody, noting that she had no injuries. Four law teachers answered with an open letter, and the rape law began to change. Here is what that history means for anyone held by people with power.
dek.hg: 1978 mein Supreme Court ne do policewalon ko bari kar diya. Un par police custody mein ek ladki ke rape ka aarop tha, aur court ne note kiya ki uske body par chot ke nishaan nahi the. Law padhane wale chaar teachers ne ek open letter likha, aur rape law badalna shuru hua. Jaaniye, ye history aaj har us insaan ke liye kya matlab rakhti hai jo kisi taqatwar ki custody mein ho.

statLabel.en: law teachers whose 1979 open letter is credited with starting India's rape-law reform movement
statLabel.hg: law teachers, jinke 1979 ke open letter ko India mein rape law reform movement ki shuruaat maana jaata hai

label.en: Supreme Court judges who acquitted the two policemen on 15 September 1978
label.hg: Supreme Court ke judges jinhone 15 September 1978 ko dono policewalon ko bari kiya

label.en: the day in-camera rape trials and the ban on disclosing a rape victim's identity took effect
label.hg: is din se rape trials band kamre mein hone lage aur rape victim ki pehchaan kholna crime bana

label.en: rape cases registered in India in 2024 under the 'rape by police personnel' category
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein 'rape by police personnel' category mein darj rape cases

claim.en: If she didn't fight back and has no injuries, it wasn't rape.
claim.hg: Agar usne fight back nahi kiya aur chot ke nishaan bhi nahi hain, toh woh rape nahi tha.

truth.en: Since 2013 the law says a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting. Section 63 of the BNS keeps that rule.
truth.hg: 2013 se law saaf kehta hai: agar aurat ne physically resist nahi kiya, toh sirf is wajah se uski consent nahi maani jaayegi. BNS ka Section 63 bhi yahi rule rakhta hai.

actions.en: Never ask a survivor 'Did you fight back?' or 'Where are the marks?' In law, not resisting is not consent.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor se kabhi mat poochiye 'Tumne fight back kyun nahi kiya?' ya 'Nishaan kahan hain?' Law mein resist na karna consent nahi hai.

actions.en: Rape by someone with power over you, such as a police officer or public servant holding you in custody, jail or hospital staff, a teacher or a guardian, is aggravated rape in law. Report it.
actions.hg: Agar rape karne wala aap par taqat rakhne wala tha, jaise aapko custody mein rakhne wala policewala ya sarkari karmachari, jail ya hospital staff, teacher ya guardian, toh law ise aggravated, yaani aur bhi serious rape maanta hai. Complaint zaroor kariye.

actions.en: You can report rape at any police station. If the station will not register an FIR, send your complaint in writing to the Superintendent of Police; an officer who refuses to record it commits a crime under Section 199 BNS.
actions.hg: Rape ki complaint aap kisi bhi police station mein kar sakte hain. Agar station FIR darj na kare, toh Superintendent of Police ko likhkar complaint bhejiye; FIR likhne se mana karna policewale ke liye BNS Section 199 ke under crime hai.

actions.en: Never share a survivor's name, photo or village, even in a post that supports her. Section 72 BNS makes it a crime.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ka naam, photo ya gaon kabhi share mat kariye, chahe post uske support mein hi kyun na ho. BNS Section 72 ke under ye crime hai.

actions.en: Read a judgment before you share an opinion on it. The 1979 open letter that began India's rape-law reform did exactly that.
actions.hg: Kisi faisle par opinion dene se pehle use padhiye. 1979 ka woh open letter, jisse India mein rape law reform shuru hua, yahi karke likha gaya tha.

title.en: The 2012 Delhi gang rape case: what it changed, and what four hangings could not
title.hg: 2012 Delhi gang rape case: isne kya badla, aur chaar phaansiyan kya nahi badal paayin

dek.en: In 2020, four men were hanged together for the crime. Here is how the case moved through the courts, what it changed in law and money, what it left untouched, and why her name was never needed.
dek.hg: 2020 mein is crime ke liye chaar aadmiyon ko ek saath phaansi di gayi. Jaaniye, case courts se kaise guzra, isne law aur paise ke maamle mein kya badla, kya jaisa tha waisa hi chhod diya, aur uske naam ki kabhi zaroorat kyun nahi padi.

statLabel.en: convicts hanged together at Tihar Jail on 20 March 2020
statLabel.hg: convicts ko 20 March 2020 ko Tihar Jail mein ek saath phaansi di gayi

label.en: the day the Supreme Court confirmed the four death sentences
label.hg: is din Supreme Court ne chaaron ki death sentence confirm ki

label.en: years the juvenile accused spent in a correctional home before his release in 2015
label.hg: saal juvenile accused correctional home mein raha, phir 2015 mein release ho gaya

label.en: the government's first contribution to the Nirbhaya Fund, proposed in the 2013-14 Budget
label.hg: Nirbhaya Fund mein sarkar ka pehla contribution, jiska proposal 2013-14 ke Budget mein aaya

label.en: of the Nirbhaya Fund's Rs 7,990.85 crore allocation released and used by July 2026, per a Rajya Sabha reply
label.hg: Nirbhaya Fund ke Rs 7,990.85 crore mein se July 2026 tak release aur use hua hissa, Rajya Sabha ke ek jawab ke mutaabik

claim.en: Hanging the four convicts will stop rapes.
claim.hg: Chaar convicts ko phaansi dene se rapes ruk jaayenge.

truth.en: The Verma Committee, set up after this very case, advised against the death penalty for rape, noting it 'may not have a deterrent effect'. In 2024, courts convicted in only 24.4% of rape trials they completed.
truth.hg: Isi case ke baad bani Verma Committee ne rape ke liye death penalty ke khilaaf salaah di thi, ye note karte hue ki iska 'may not have a deterrent effect', yaani darr ka asar shayad na ho. 2024 mein courts ne jin rape trials ko poora kiya, unme se sirf 24.4% mein conviction hua.

actions.en: Call it 'the 2012 Delhi gang rape case'. Never post or forward her real name or photo; publishing it is a crime under Section 72 BNS.
actions.hg: Ise '2012 Delhi gang rape case' kahiye. Uska asli naam ya photo kabhi post ya forward mat kariye; ise publish karna BNS Section 72 ke under crime hai.

actions.en: Talk about the system, not the attack: share the court timeline and the changes in law, never details of the violence.
actions.hg: Baat system ki kariye, hamle ki nahi: court ki timeline aur law mein aaye badlaav share kariye, violence ki details kabhi nahi.

actions.en: If you see someone being attacked or find someone hurt, call 112. Any hospital, public or private, must give a rape survivor free treatment immediately.
actions.hg: Agar kisi par hamla hote dekhein ya koi ghayal mile, toh 112 par call kariye. Har hospital, sarkari ho ya private, rape survivor ka turant free ilaaj karne ke liye bound hai.

actions.en: Ask your state government how it has used its Nirbhaya Fund money for One Stop Centres and fast-track courts.
actions.hg: Apni state government se poochiye ki usne Nirbhaya Fund ka paisa One Stop Centres aur fast-track courts par kaise kharch kiya.

title.en: Hathras 2020: a cremation at night, a CBI gang-rape charge, and a 2023 verdict with no rape conviction
title.hg: Hathras 2020: aadhi raat ka antim sanskar, CBI ka gang-rape charge, aur 2023 ka faisla jismein kisi ko rape ki sazaa nahi hui

dek.en: Police cremated a 19-year-old Dalit woman at night, without her family's consent. Two and a half years later, a special court acquitted three of the four men the CBI had charged and convicted none of rape. What the first hours of a case decide, and what the law owes a Dalit survivor and her family.
dek.hg: Police ne 19 saal ki ek Dalit ladki ka antim sanskar raat mein, uski family ki marzi ke bina kar diya. Dhai saal baad ek special court ne CBI ke chaar accused mein se teen ko bari kar diya, aur rape ke liye kisi ko sazaa nahi di. Kisi case ke pehle kuch ghante kya tay kar dete hain, aur law ek Dalit survivor aur uski family ko kya haq deta hai, padhiye.

statLabel.en: of the four men the CBI charged; none convicted of rape (2023)
statLabel.hg: CBI ne jin chaar aadmiyon par charge lagaye, unmein se teen bari, ek convict; rape ki sazaa kisi ko nahi (2023)

label.en: men the CBI charged with rape, gang rape and murder (December 2020)
label.hg: aadmiyon par CBI ne rape, gang rape aur murder ka charge lagaya (December 2020)

label.en: of the four convicted of gang rape or murder (March 2023)
label.hg: chaar mein se itne gang rape ya murder ke doshi paaye gaye (March 2023)

label.en: of the convicted man's fine, ordered for her mother
label.hg: convict ke jurmane mein se itni rakam ladki ki maa ko dene ka order

label.en: rape cases of Scheduled Caste women and girls registered in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein Scheduled Caste auraton aur ladkiyon se rape ke darj case

claim.en: The SC/ST Act is only about caste insults.
claim.hg: SC/ST Act bas caste ke naam par gaali-galoch ke baare mein hai.

truth.en: It also covers sexual violence against Dalit and Adivasi women, can send non-SC/ST officers who wilfully neglect their duties under it to jail, and gives survivors and families the right to protection and to notice of every hearing, including bail.
truth.hg: Yeh Dalit aur Adivasi auraton ke khilaaf sexual violence ko bhi cover karta hai. Is Act ke tahat apni duty mein jaanbujhkar laaparwahi karne wale non-SC/ST officers ko jail bhijwa sakta hai. Aur survivors aur families ko protection ka haq deta hai, saath hi bail samet har hearing ki jaankari ka bhi.

actions.en: After a rape, ask the police to send the survivor for a medical examination within 24 hours, only with her consent. The law requires it.
actions.hg: Rape ke baad police se kahiye ki survivor ka medical exam 24 ghante ke andar karaye, sirf uski marzi se. Law yahi kehta hai.

actions.en: Ask for her statement to be recorded by a magistrate as early as possible, and take the free copy of the FIR that police must give.
actions.hg: Maangiye ki uska statement jald se jald magistrate record kare. FIR ki free copy zaroor lijiye; police ko yeh deni hi hoti hai.

actions.en: If the survivor is Dalit or Adivasi, check that the FIR includes the SC/ST Act. A non-SC/ST officer who wilfully neglects this duty can be jailed.
actions.hg: Agar survivor Dalit ya Adivasi hai, toh check kijiye ki FIR mein SC/ST Act laga hai ya nahi. Jo non-SC/ST officer jaanbujhkar yeh duty na nibhaye, use jail ho sakti hai.

actions.en: Families have the right to notice of every court hearing, including bail. Ask the prosecutor for the dates in writing.
actions.hg: Family ko bail samet har court hearing ki jaankari ka haq hai. Public prosecutor se dates likhit mein maangiye.

actions.en: Never share a survivor's name or photo, even after her death. Courts have fined media houses for it.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ka naam ya photo kabhi share mat kijiye, uski maut ke baad bhi nahi. Courts iske liye media houses par jurmana laga chuki hain.

title.en: The Hema Committee report: nearly five years unpublished, 63 of 295 pages withheld, and a 'power group' of 10 to 15 men in Malayalam cinema
title.hg: Hema Committee report: lagbhag paanch saal tak dabi rahi, 295 mein se 63 page roke gaye, aur Malayalam cinema mein 10 se 15 aadmiyon ka 'power group'

dek.en: Kerala asked a retired judge what women face in its film industry. Her committee's answer reached the government in December 2019 and the public in August 2024. Here is what it found, how it stayed buried, and what the law already demanded of every film set.
dek.hg: Kerala ne ek retired judge se poocha ki uski film industry mein aurton ko kya jhelna padta hai. Committee ka jawab December 2019 mein sarkar tak pahuncha aur August 2024 mein public tak. Jaaniye report mein kya mila, woh itne saal kaise dabi rahi, aur law har film set se pehle se kya maangta hai.

statLabel.en: pages withheld when the report was finally released in 2024
statLabel.hg: page roke gaye jab 2024 mein aakhirkaar report jaari hui

label.en: men in the all-male 'power group' of directors, producers and actors the committee found controlling the industry
label.hg: aadmi, directors, producers aur actors, us all-male 'power group' mein jo committee ke mutabik industry ko control karta hai

label.en: between the report reaching the government (December 2019) and its release (19 August 2024)
label.hg: lage, report ke sarkar tak pahunchne (December 2019) aur jaari hone (19 August 2024) ke beech

label.en: workers: above this, each film's production unit must have an Internal Committee (Kerala High Court, 2022)
label.hg: workers: isse zyada hon toh har film ki production unit mein Internal Committee zaroori hai (Kerala High Court, 2022)

claim.en: A film set is not an office, so workplace harassment law does not apply there.
claim.hg: Film set koi office nahi hai, isliye workplace harassment ka law wahan laagu nahi hota.

truth.en: The POSH Act's definition of 'workplace' expressly covers entertainment businesses, and in 2022 the Kerala High Court held that each film's production unit must have an Internal Committee if it engages more than 10 workers.
truth.hg: POSH Act ki 'workplace' wali definition mein entertainment ka business saaf taur par shaamil hai, aur 2022 mein Kerala High Court ne kaha ki jo film production unit 10 se zyada workers rakhti hai, usme Internal Committee honi hi chahiye.

actions.en: Working on a film, serial, ad or web shoot? Before the shoot starts, ask the production who sits on its Internal Committee.
actions.hg: Film, serial, ad ya web shoot par kaam kar rahi hain? Shoot shuru hone se pehle production se poochiye ki uski Internal Committee mein kaun hai.

actions.en: If your complaint is against the employer (on a film, usually the production), or the unit has fewer than 10 workers, take it to your district's Local Committee.
actions.hg: Agar complaint employer ke khilaaf hai (film mein aksar production hi employer hoti hai), ya unit mein 10 se kam workers hain, toh apne district ki Local Committee mein jaaiye.

actions.en: Complain in writing within three months of the last incident (the committee can extend this by three more), and keep dates, messages and the names of witnesses.
actions.hg: Aakhri incident ke teen mahine ke andar written complaint kariye (committee ise teen mahine aur badha sakti hai), aur dates, messages aur witnesses ke naam sambhaal kar rakhiye.

actions.en: Not sure where to go? File on SHe-Box, the government's online complaint portal.
actions.hg: Samajh nahi aa raha kahan jaayein? Sarkar ke online complaint portal SHe-Box par complaint kariye.

actions.en: If a colleague speaks up, stand with her in public. The committee found that fear of losing work kept women silent.
actions.hg: Agar koi colleague awaaz uthaye, toh khule mein uska saath dijiye. Committee ne paaya ki kaam chhin jaane ka darr aurton ko chup rakhta tha.

title.en: From 2013 to 2017, sex with a 15-year-old wife was not rape in law. The Independent Thought case ended that
title.hg: 2013 se 2017 tak law ki nazar mein 15 saal ki patni ke saath sex rape nahin tha. Independent Thought case ne yeh khatam kiya

dek.en: In 2013 Parliament made 18 the age of consent for every girl except a wife. How the Supreme Court closed that gap in 2017, what it left open, and why the ruling matters in a country where 20.1% of women aged 20-24 were married before 18.
dek.hg: 2013 mein Parliament ne har ladki ke liye consent ki umar 18 kar di, sirf patni ko chhodkar. Supreme Court ne 2017 mein yeh gap kaise band kiya, kya khula chhod diya, aur us desh mein yeh faisla kyun maayne rakhta hai jahan 20-24 saal ki 20.1% aurton ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui.

statLabel.en: the wife's age from which, until 2017, the rape law exempted her husband
statLabel.hg: patni ki woh umar jisse, 2017 tak, rape law uske pati ko chhoot deta tha

label.en: the age from which a wife was left out of the rape law's protection, 2013 to 2017
label.hg: woh umar jisse 2013 se 2017 tak patni rape law ki protection se bahar thi

label.en: of women aged 20-24 were married before 18 (NFHS-6, 2023-24)
label.hg: 20-24 saal ki aurton ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui (NFHS-6, 2023-24)

label.en: FIRs filed in Telangana for 4,440 child marriage cases over three years, as cited by the Supreme Court in 2024
label.hg: FIRs Telangana mein teen saal ke 4,440 child marriage cases par, jaisa Supreme Court ne 2024 mein bataya

label.en: after turning 18: the window in which a girl married as a child can ask a court to annul the marriage
label.hg: 18 saal ki hone ke baad: woh samay jismein bachpan mein byaahi gayi ladki court se shaadi radd karwa sakti hai

claim.en: Once a girl is married, what her husband does with her is not a crime.
claim.hg: Ek baar ladki ki shaadi ho gayi, to pati uske saath jo bhi kare, woh crime nahin hai.

truth.en: Since the Supreme Court's 2017 ruling in Independent Thought, sex with a wife under 18 is rape. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita now writes that age into the law.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ke 2017 ke Independent Thought faisle ke baad se 18 se kam umar ki patni ke saath sex rape hai. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ab yeh umar law mein likhti hai.

actions.en: If you hear of a child marriage being planned, call 1098 or 112 before the wedding day. Magistrates can issue orders to stop it.
actions.hg: Agar aapko kisi child marriage ki planning ka pata chale, to shaadi ke din se pehle 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye. Magistrates ise rokne ke orders de sakte hain.

actions.en: Know the rule: sex with anyone under 18 is a crime, and a wedding does not change that.
actions.hg: Rule yaad rakhiye: 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath sex crime hai, aur shaadi se yeh nahin badalta.

actions.en: Tell any girl married before 18 that she can ask a district court to annul the marriage until two years after she turns 18.
actions.hg: 18 se pehle byaahi gayi kisi bhi ladki ko bataiye ki woh 18 ki hone ke do saal baad tak district court se shaadi radd karwa sakti hai.

actions.en: Remind families and priests that anyone who performs, promotes or permits a child marriage faces up to two years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of up to Rs 1 lakh.
actions.hg: Pariwaron aur shaadi karwane walon ko yaad dilaiye ki child marriage karwane, use badhawa dene ya ijaazat dene wale ko do saal tak ki rigorous imprisonment aur 1 lakh rupaye tak ka fine ho sakta hai.

title.en: From the IPC of 1860 to the BNS of 2024: a timeline of India's rape law, and the cases that forced its changes
title.hg: IPC 1860 se BNS 2024 tak: India ke rape law ki timeline, aur woh cases jinhone ise badalne par majboor kiya

dek.en: India's rape law has moved in bursts, and its two biggest rewrites came after cases the country could not ignore, not after anyone read the data. What each burst changed, what the 2024 code carried over under new section numbers, and who is still left outside it.
dek.hg: India ka rape law ek-ek jhatke mein badla hai, aur iske do sabse bade rewrite data padhne se nahi, balki aise cases ke baad aaye jinhe desh ignore nahi kar saka. Har jhatke ne kya badla, 2024 ke naye code ne kya naye section numbers ke saath aage badhaya, aur kaun abhi bhi iske bahar chhoot gaya hai.

statLabel.en: the rise in the age of consent in the 2013 law
statLabel.hg: 2013 ke law mein age of consent 16 se badhkar 18 saal hui

label.en: minimum sentence for rape since 2018, up from seven
label.hg: 2018 se rape ki minimum saza; pehle yeh saat saal thi

label.en: the day the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita replaced the Indian Penal Code of 1860
label.hg: jis din Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ne 1860 ke Indian Penal Code ki jagah li

label.en: rape cases registered in 2024 under the old IPC and under the new BNS
label.hg: 2024 mein purane IPC aur naye BNS ke under darj rape cases

label.en: the sentence for sexual abuse of a transgender person; raping a woman carries at least 10 years
label.hg: transgender insaan ke sexual abuse ki saza; ek aurat ke rape par kam se kam 10 saal

claim.en: The BNS rewrote India's rape law from scratch in 2024.
claim.hg: BNS ne 2024 mein India ka rape law bilkul naye sire se likh diya.

truth.en: Mostly it renumbered the old law. Section 63 keeps the 2013 definition and the exception for husbands. The real changes were few: a new offence of sex by deceit, death for gang rape of any girl under 18, and the loss of Section 377 with nothing in its place.
truth.hg: Zyada tar usne purane law ko naye number diye. Section 63 mein 2013 wali definition bhi hai aur patiyon ko mili chhoot bhi. Asli badlav kam the: dhokhe se sex ka naya offence, 18 se kam umar ki kisi bhi ladki ke gang rape par maut ki saza, aur Section 377 ka hatna, bina kisi replacement ke.

actions.en: Learn the new numbers: rape is Section 63 of the BNS, its punishment is Section 64, and publishing a survivor's identity is a crime under Section 72.
actions.hg: Naye numbers yaad rakhiye: rape BNS ka Section 63 hai, uski saza Section 64 mein hai, aur survivor ki pehchaan chhaapna Section 72 ke under crime hai.

actions.en: A crime committed before 1 July 2024 is still prosecuted under the IPC, so an older case may cite Section 376 instead of Section 64. Both are valid.
actions.hg: 1 July 2024 se pehle hua crime abhi bhi IPC ke under chalta hai, isliye kisi purane case mein Section 64 ki jagah Section 376 likha ho sakta hai. Dono valid hain.

actions.en: Know what still applies: sexual abuse of a transgender person is a crime under Section 18 of the Transgender Persons Act, and every child under 18, of any gender, is covered by POCSO.
actions.hg: Jaaniye ki kya abhi bhi laagu hai: transgender insaan ka sexual abuse Transgender Persons Act ke Section 18 ke under crime hai, aur 18 se kam umar ka har bachcha, chahe uska gender kuch bhi ho, POCSO ke under protected hai.

actions.en: Follow the Supreme Court's final hearing on the marital rape exception, which the court said it would take up on 9 or 10 December 2026. It will decide whether the exception for husbands survives.
actions.hg: Marital rape exception par Supreme Court ki final hearing par nazar rakhiye, jise court ne 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko lene ki baat kahi hai. Usi mein tay hoga ki patiyon ko mili chhoot bachegi ya nahi.

actions.en: When the next case shakes the country, ask what the conviction data says before you demand a harsher punishment.
actions.hg: Agli baar jab koi case desh ko hila de, toh kadi saza ki maang karne se pehle poochiye ki conviction ka data kya kehta hai.

title.en: Just Rights for Children Alliance, 2024: the ruling that said viewing child sexual abuse material is a crime, and retired 'child pornography'
title.hg: Just Rights for Children Alliance, 2024: woh faisla jisne kaha ki child sexual abuse material dekhna bhi crime hai, aur 'child pornography' shabd ko retire kiya

dek.en: In January 2024 the Madras High Court quashed a case against a person found with child sexual abuse material, treating private viewing and storage as no offence. In September the Supreme Court called that an 'egregious error'. What the ruling says about possession, words and platforms, and what to do if such material reaches your phone.
dek.hg: January 2024 mein Madras High Court ne child sexual abuse material ke saath pakde gaye ek insaan ke khilaaf case khatam kar diya, ye maan kar ki akele mein dekhna aur store karna koi offence nahi. September mein Supreme Court ne ise 'egregious error', yaani gambhir galti, kaha. Faisla possession, shabdon aur platforms ke baare mein kya kehta hai, aur agar aisa material aapke phone par aa jaaye toh kya karna hai.

statLabel.en: convictions in 2024 for publishing or transmitting child sexual abuse material (IT Act 67B)
statLabel.hg: convictions hue 2024 mein child sexual abuse material publish ya transmit karne ke cases mein (IT Act 67B)

label.en: cases registered by police in 2024 for publishing or transmitting such material, with 1,123 child victims
label.hg: cases police ne 2024 mein aisa material publish ya transmit karne ke liye darj kiye, jinme 1,123 bachche victim the

label.en: such cases still pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: aise cases 2024 ke aakhir tak trial ke intezaar mein pending the

label.en: CyberTipline reports the US-based NCMEC attributed to India in 2024, the most of any country
label.hg: CyberTipline reports US ke NCMEC ne 2024 mein India se jodi, kisi bhi desh se zyada

claim.en: Watching it privately is not a crime as long as you don't share it.
claim.hg: Akele mein dekhna crime nahi hai, jab tak aap use share nahi karte.

truth.en: The Supreme Court held in 2024 that viewing such material online can amount to possession, and that keeping it without deleting or reporting it can show an intent to share. Each image is a record of a child being abused.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ne 2024 mein kaha ki aisa material online dekhna bhi possession maana ja sakta hai, aur use delete ya report kiye bina rakhna share karne ka iraada dikha sakta hai. Har image ek bachche ke abuse ka record hai.

actions.en: If such material reaches your phone, do not download, save, screenshot or forward it, not even as 'proof' or to warn others.
actions.hg: Agar aisa material aapke phone par aaye, toh use download, save, screenshot ya forward mat kariye, 'saboot' ke liye ya doosron ko warn karne ke liye bhi nahi.

actions.en: Note where it came from: the group, username, number or link. Leave the chat undeleted.
actions.hg: Note kariye ki ye kahan se aaya: group, username, number ya link. Chat ko delete mat kariye.

actions.en: Report it with the app's report button and at cybercrime.gov.in, or call 1930.
actions.hg: App ke report button se aur cybercrime.gov.in par report kariye, ya 1930 par call kariye.

actions.en: If you know of a child in danger, call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar aap jaante hain ki koi bachcha khatre mein hai, toh 1098 ya 112 par call kariye.

actions.en: Say 'child sexual abuse material', never 'child porn'.
actions.hg: 'Child porn' kabhi mat kahiye; 'child sexual abuse material' kahiye.

title.en: Tried as an adult at 16: what India's juvenile justice law changed after the 2012 Delhi case
title.hg: 16 ki umar mein adult ki tarah trial: 2012 Delhi case ke baad India ke juvenile justice law mein kya badla

dek.en: Since the 2015 Act, a 16- or 17-year-old accused of rape can be sent for trial as an adult, but only after a Board's assessment, and never to a death sentence. What three cases show about teenage accused, and why a harsher court is not the same thing as justice for survivors.
dek.hg: 2015 ke Act ke baad rape ke accused 16 ya 17 saal ke bachche par adult ki tarah trial chal sakta hai, lekin sirf Board ke assessment ke baad, aur death sentence kabhi nahin. Teen cases teenage accused ke baare mein kya dikhate hain, aur kyun zyada sakht court ka matlab survivors ke liye justice nahin hota.

statLabel.en: spent in a correctional home by the juvenile in the 2012 Delhi case before his release in 2015
statLabel.hg: 2012 Delhi case ke juvenile ne correctional home mein bitaye, phir 2015 mein rihaa hua

label.en: spent in a correctional home by the juvenile in the 2012 Delhi case before his release in 2015
label.hg: 2012 Delhi case ke juvenile ne correctional home mein bitaye, phir 2015 mein rihaa hua

label.en: age from which a child accused of a 'heinous' offence can be assessed for trial as an adult
label.hg: is umar se 'heinous' offence ke accused bachche ka assessment ho sakta hai ki us par adult ki tarah trial chale ya nahin

label.en: minimum punishment that makes an offence 'heinous' under the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015
label.hg: itni ya isse zyada minimum saza ho to Juvenile Justice Act, 2015 us offence ko 'heinous' maanta hai

label.en: accused shot dead by police near Hyderabad in 2019 were minors, a Supreme Court-appointed commission found
label.hg: accused, jinhe 2019 mein Hyderabad ke paas police ne goli maari, minor the: Supreme Court ke banaye commission ki finding

claim.en: A 17-year-old accused of rape can never be tried as an adult in India.
claim.hg: India mein rape ke accused 17 saal ke ladke par kabhi adult ki tarah trial nahin chal sakta.

truth.en: Since the Juvenile Justice Act of 2015, a Juvenile Justice Board must assess any 16- or 17-year-old accused of a 'heinous' offence and can send the case to a Children's Court for trial as an adult. What the law still bars is a death sentence, or life imprisonment without the possibility of release.
truth.hg: Juvenile Justice Act, 2015 ke baad se Juvenile Justice Board ko 'heinous' offence ke har 16 ya 17 saal ke accused ka assessment karna hota hai, aur woh case Children's Court bhej sakta hai, jahan adult ki tarah trial ho sakta hai. Law ab bhi do cheezein rokta hai: death sentence, aur aisi life imprisonment jisme release ki koi possibility na ho.

actions.en: If a 16- or 17-year-old is accused of a serious offence, find out which Juvenile Justice Board has the case and make sure the child has a lawyer before the preliminary assessment.
actions.hg: Agar 16 ya 17 saal ke kisi bachche par serious offence ka aarop hai, to pata kijiye ki case kis Juvenile Justice Board ke paas hai, aur pakka kijiye ki preliminary assessment se pehle bachche ke paas ek lawyer ho.

actions.en: Keep every child's birth certificate and school records safe. Age decides which court hears a case, for an accused and for a survivor.
actions.hg: Har bachche ka birth certificate aur school records sambhaal kar rakhiye. Age se tay hota hai ki case kaun si court sunegi, accused ke liye bhi aur survivor ke liye bhi.

actions.en: If a child tells you about sexual abuse, call Child Helpline 1098 or 112. Police must record the complaint at any station, wherever it happened.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha aapko sexual abuse ke baare mein bataye, to Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 call kijiye. Crime kahin bhi hua ho, police ko kisi bhi station mein complaint darj karni hogi.

actions.en: Survivors and families can apply to the District Legal Services Authority for compensation even when no trial takes place.
actions.hg: Survivors aur families District Legal Services Authority se compensation maang sakte hain, trial na ho tab bhi.

actions.en: When people call for an 'encounter', say what it costs: no trial, no tested evidence and no verdict for the survivor's family.
actions.hg: Jab log 'encounter' ki maang karein, to bataiye ki uski keemat kya hai: na trial, na parkha hua evidence, na survivor ki family ke liye koi faisla.

title.en: Kathua 2018: an eight-year-old's murder, a trial moved to Punjab, and three policemen convicted of destroying evidence
title.hg: Kathua 2018: aath saal ki bachchi ka murder, Punjab bheja gaya trial, aur evidence mitaane wale teen policemen ko saza

dek.en: Three of the six men convicted in the Kathua case were policemen who destroyed evidence. What a trial moved out of Jammu and Kashmir and a closed courtroom protect, and how to keep evidence safe when you cannot fully trust the people collecting it.
dek.hg: Kathua case mein convict hue chhe aadmiyon mein se teen policemen the, jinhone evidence mitaya tha. Jammu and Kashmir se bahar bheja gaya trial aur band courtroom kya bachate hain, aur jab evidence ikattha karne walon par hi poora bharosa na ho, tab evidence kaise bachayein.

statLabel.en: accused convicted, three of them policemen who destroyed evidence
statLabel.hg: accused convict hue, inmein teen policemen jinhone evidence mitaya

label.en: accused convicted by the Pathankot court on 10 June 2019
label.hg: accused ko Pathankot court ne 10 June 2019 ko convict kiya

label.en: prison term for each of the three policemen convicted of destroying evidence
label.hg: evidence mitaane ke liye convict hue teeno policemen mein se har ek ki saza

label.en: rape cases police closed in 2024 as true but with insufficient evidence or the accused untraced
label.hg: rape cases jinhe police ne 2024 mein sach maana, par evidence kam hone ya accused na milne par band kar diya

claim.en: If you did not commit the assault, hiding or destroying evidence is no big crime.
claim.hg: Agar assault aapne nahin kiya, to evidence chhupana ya mitana koi bada crime nahin.

truth.en: Destroying evidence is a crime in itself. In the Kathua case, three policemen were sentenced to five years each for destroying evidence.
truth.hg: Evidence mitana khud mein ek crime hai. Kathua case mein teen policemen ko evidence mitaane ke liye paanch-paanch saal ki saza hui.

actions.en: Report a crime against a child at any police station, or call 1098 (Child Helpline) or 112. Police must register it as a Zero FIR wherever it happened.
actions.hg: Bachche ke saath hue crime ki complaint kisi bhi police station mein kijiye, ya 1098 (Child Helpline) ya 112 call kijiye. Crime kahin bhi hua ho, police ko Zero FIR darj karni hogi.

actions.en: Ask for your free copy of the FIR, and keep copies of every medical and police paper, with dates and the names of the officers you met.
actions.hg: FIR ki free copy maangiye, aur har medical aur police paper ki copy rakhiye, dates aur jin officers se mile unke naam ke saath.

actions.en: If police refuse to register a rape complaint, say that refusing is a crime under Section 199 of the BNS, then write to the Superintendent of Police and, if needed, go to a magistrate.
actions.hg: Agar police rape complaint darj na kare, to boliye ki mana karna BNS Section 199 mein crime hai, phir Superintendent of Police (SP) ko likhiye aur zaroorat ho to magistrate ke paas jaiye.

actions.en: Never share a child victim's name, photo, school or village, even after her death, and report posts that do.
actions.hg: Kisi bachchi ka naam, photo, school ya gaon kabhi share mat kijiye, uski maut ke baad bhi nahin, aur aisi posts report kijiye.

title.en: Rs 50 lakh, Rs 17 lakh, Rs 40,000: what courts ordered in four landmark cases, and what any survivor can claim
title.hg: Rs 50 lakh, Rs 17 lakh, Rs 40,000: chaar landmark cases mein courts ne kya order kiya, aur koi bhi survivor kya claim kar sakti hai

dek.en: The Supreme Court ordered Rs 50 lakh, a job and a home in one case. In another, a trial court directed part of a convict's fine to the victim's mother. Most survivors never reach such courts, but the law already owes them compensation. How much, and where to claim it.
dek.hg: Ek case mein Supreme Court ne Rs 50 lakh, naukri aur ghar ka order diya. Doosre mein trial court ne convict ke fine ka ek hissa victim ki maa ko dene ko kaha. Zyadatar survivors aisi courts tak kabhi nahi pahunchtin, lekin law unhe pehle se compensation ka haq deta hai. Kitna, aur kahan claim karein.

statLabel.en: compensation for a rape survivor under NALSA's 2018 scheme
statLabel.hg: NALSA ki 2018 scheme ke under ek rape survivor ka compensation

label.en: compensation the Supreme Court ordered Gujarat to pay a gang-rape survivor in 2019, with a government job and housing
label.hg: compensation jo Supreme Court ne 2019 mein Gujarat sarkar ko ek gang-rape survivor ko dene ka order diya, saath mein sarkari naukri aur ghar

label.en: the state was ordered to pay the victim's family in the RG Kar case (2025)
label.hg: jo RG Kar case mein state ko victim ki family ko dene ka order hua (2025)

label.en: of the Hathras convict's fine set aside for the victim's mother (2023)
label.hg: Hathras convict ke fine mein se victim ki maa ke liye rakhe gaye (2023)

label.en: higher compensation limits under the NALSA scheme when the survivor is a minor
label.hg: zyada compensation limit NALSA scheme mein, jab survivor minor ho

claim.en: A rape survivor gets compensation only if the accused is caught and convicted.
claim.hg: Rape survivor ko compensation tabhi milta hai jab accused pakda jaye aur use saza ho.

truth.en: Under Section 396 of the BNSS a survivor can apply to the State or District Legal Services Authority even if the offender is never traced and no trial takes place.
truth.hg: BNSS ki Section 396 ke under survivor State ya District Legal Services Authority mein apply kar sakti hai, chahe offender kabhi trace na ho aur koi trial na ho.

actions.en: Apply for compensation at your District Legal Services Authority, even if no one has been arrested and no trial has begun.
actions.hg: Apni District Legal Services Authority mein compensation ke liye apply kijiye, chahe abhi tak koi arrest na hua ho aur trial shuru na hua ho.

actions.en: Keep copies of the FIR (the police must give the victim one free), the medical report and every treatment bill. The authority will ask for them.
actions.hg: FIR (police ko victim ko iski free copy deni hoti hai), medical report aur treatment ke har bill ki copy sambhal kar rakhiye. Authority yeh sab maangegi.

actions.en: If the survivor is under 18, say so in the application: the scheme's limits are 50% higher for minors.
actions.hg: Agar survivor 18 se kam umr ki hai, toh application mein yeh zaroor likhiye: minors ke liye scheme ki limits 50% zyada hain.

actions.en: Ask the legal services authority for a free lawyer to help with the claim and the criminal case.
actions.hg: Legal services authority se free lawyer maangiye, jo claim aur criminal case dono mein madad kare.

actions.en: If there is no decision within two months, follow up in writing and keep a dated copy of every letter.
actions.hg: Do mahine mein faisla na aaye toh likh kar follow up kijiye, aur har letter ki date wali copy rakhiye.

title.en: Split 1-1 in Delhi in 2022, final hearing due in December 2026: the marital rape challenge, step by step
title.hg: Delhi mein 2022 ka faisla 1-1 se bata, December 2026 mein final hearing honi hai: marital rape challenge, step by step

dek.en: One line of Indian law says a husband cannot rape his adult wife. Courts have argued over it since 2017, and two judges on the same bench gave opposite answers. Here is each step, each side's case, and what the Supreme Court must now decide.
dek.hg: Indian law ki ek line aaj bhi kehti hai ki pati apni adult patni ka rape nahi kar sakta. 2017 se courts is line par behas kar rahe hain, aur ek hi bench ke do judges ne ulte jawab diye. Yahan har step hai, dono pakshon ki daleel hai, aur woh sawaal bhi jinka jawab ab Supreme Court ko dena hai.

statLabel.en: the Delhi High Court's split on the marital rape exception (11 May 2022)
statLabel.hg: marital rape exception par Delhi High Court ka bata hua faisla (11 May 2022)

label.en: of ever-married women who had faced sexual violence named their current husband as the perpetrator (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: ever-married aurtein jinhone sexual violence jhela, unhone apne current pati ko zimmedaar bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of ever-married women aged 18-49 said their husband had physically forced them to have intercourse (NFHS-5)
label.hg: 18-49 saal ki ever-married aurton ne bataya ki pati ne unhe physically force karke intercourse kiya (NFHS-5)

label.en: the sentence when a husband forces sex on a wife living separately, against a 10-year minimum for rape
label.hg: ki saza, jab pati alag reh rahi patni par zabardasti sex kare; jabki rape ki minimum saza 10 saal hai

label.en: the dates on which the Supreme Court said it would fix the final hearing
label.hg: woh dates jin par Supreme Court ne final hearing tay karne ki baat kahi

claim.en: The Supreme Court made marital rape a crime in 2017.
claim.hg: Supreme Court ne 2017 mein marital rape ko crime bana diya tha.

truth.en: The 2017 ruling protected only wives under 18 and expressly left adult wives undecided. For a wife aged 18 or older, forced sex by her husband is still not legally rape.
truth.hg: 2017 ka faisla sirf 18 se kam umar ki patniyon ko protect karta hai, aur adult patniyon ka sawaal usne saaf taur par khula chhod diya. 18 ya usse zyada umar ki patni ke saath pati ki zabardasti aaj bhi law mein rape nahi hai.

actions.en: Forced sex in a marriage is not your fault, and you do not have to wait for a verdict to get help: call Women Helpline 181, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Shaadi mein zabardasti sex aapki galti nahi hai, aur madad ke liye kisi faisle ka intezaar zaroori nahi: Women Helpline 181 par call kariye, emergency mein 112.

actions.en: The Domestic Violence Act, 2005 and the cruelty law (Section 85 BNS) are open to married women today; a One Stop Centre or a lawyer can help you use them.
actions.hg: Domestic Violence Act, 2005 aur cruelty ka law (Section 85 BNS) shaadi-shuda aurton ke liye aaj bhi khule hain; One Stop Centre ya koi lawyer inka istemaal karne mein madad kar sakta hai.

actions.en: If you live apart from your husband and he forces sex on you, that is already a crime under Section 67 BNS. Report it.
actions.hg: Agar aap pati se alag reh rahi hain aur woh aap par zabardasti sex karta hai, toh ye Section 67 BNS ke under abhi bhi crime hai. Report kariye.

actions.en: Pregnant after forced sex by your husband? The abortion law treats you as a rape survivor up to 24 weeks, and no FIR is needed.
actions.hg: Pati ki zabardasti se pregnant hain? Abortion law aapko 24 hafte tak rape survivor maanta hai, aur iske liye FIR ki zaroorat nahi hai.

actions.en: When the Supreme Court rules, read what it actually decided, not just the headline, and talk about consent in marriage before anyone you know gets married.
actions.hg: Jab Supreme Court faisla de, toh sirf headline nahi, poora faisla padhiye, aur apne jaan-pehchaan mein kisi ki shaadi se pehle shaadi mein consent par baat kariye.

title.en: A minister sued, a journalist was acquitted: the 2021 #MeToo verdict that said a woman may speak up 'even after decades'
title.hg: Minister ne case kiya, journalist bari hui: 2021 ka #MeToo faisla jisne kaha ki aurat 'even after decades' bhi bol sakti hai

dek.en: In 2018 a Union minister answered a sexual harassment allegation with a criminal defamation case. In 2021 a Delhi court acquitted the journalist and put a woman's dignity above a man's reputation. His appeal was listed for final hearing more than five years later. Here is what the verdict says about silence, delay and speaking up.
dek.hg: 2018 mein ek Union minister ne sexual harassment ke ilzaam ka jawab criminal defamation case se diya. 2021 mein Delhi ki ek court ne journalist ko bari kiya aur aurat ki dignity ko aadmi ki reputation se upar rakha. Uski appeal paanch saal se zyada baad final hearing ke liye list hui. Jaaniye ye faisla chuppi, der aur awaaz uthane ke baare mein kya kehta hai.

label.en: the day a Delhi court acquitted the journalist of criminal defamation
label.hg: is din Delhi ki court ne journalist ko criminal defamation ke case se bari kiya

label.en: from the acquittal to the appeal's final-hearing listing on 24 September 2026
label.hg: bari hone se lekar 24 September 2026 ko appeal ki final hearing ki listing tak

label.en: to file a written complaint under the POSH Act, extendable by 3 more
label.hg: milte hain POSH Act ke under written complaint ke liye, jo 3 mahine aur badh sakte hain

claim.en: If it really happened, she would have complained at the time.
claim.hg: Agar sach mein hua hota, toh woh usi waqt complaint karti.

truth.en: A Delhi court held in 2021 that a woman may raise her grievance 'even after decades', and the Supreme Court's 2023 handbook calls the belief that a woman who delays reporting rape is lying a stereotype.
truth.hg: 2021 mein Delhi ki ek court ne kaha ki aurat apni shikaayat 'even after decades', yaani dashkon baad bhi utha sakti hai, aur Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook is soch ko stereotype maanti hai ki rape ki der se report karne wali aurat jhooth bol rahi hai.

actions.en: If you are being harassed at work now, complain in writing to your Internal Committee within three months of the last incident; it can extend the deadline by three more.
actions.hg: Agar abhi kaam ki jagah par aapka harassment ho raha hai, toh aakhri incident ke teen mahine ke andar apni Internal Committee ko likh kar complaint dijiye; committee ye deadline teen mahine aur badha sakti hai.

actions.en: Keep a private, dated record of what happened and whom you told, even if you are not ready to complain.
actions.hg: Jo hua aur aapne kis-kis ko bataya, uska ek private record dates ke saath rakhiye, chahe abhi complaint karne ke liye taiyaar na hon.

actions.en: No Internal Committee, or the complaint is against your employer? Go to your district's Local Committee, or file on SHe-Box.
actions.hg: Internal Committee nahi hai, ya complaint employer ke khilaaf hai? Apne district ki Local Committee mein jaaiye, ya SHe-Box par complaint kariye.

actions.en: Before you name someone in public, get legal advice; legal services authorities, including NALSA, offer free legal aid.
actions.hg: Kisi ka naam public mein lene se pehle legal salaah lijiye; NALSA samet legal services authorities free legal aid deti hain.

actions.en: If a friend tells you years later, believe her. Delay is not evidence of lying.
actions.hg: Agar koi dost saalon baad aapko bataye, toh uska yakeen kariye. Der se bolna jhooth ka saboot nahi hai.

title.en: Muzaffarpur 2018: a university audit, 34 abused girls in a state-funded shelter, and 19 convictions
title.hg: Muzaffarpur 2018: ek university audit, state-funded shelter mein 34 ladkiyon ka abuse, aur 19 convictions

dek.en: The sexual abuse of girls in a Bihar shelter home came to light through an outside social audit, not a police complaint. What the audit found, how a Delhi court convicted 19 of 20 accused, and who is legally bound to report abuse inside an institution.
dek.hg: Bihar ke ek shelter home mein ladkiyon ka sexual abuse kisi police complaint se nahin, balki bahar se aaye ek social audit se saamne aaya. Audit ne kya paaya, Delhi ki court ne 20 mein se 19 accused ko kaise convict kiya, aur kisi institution ke andar abuse report karna law ke hisaab se kiski zimmedari hai.

statLabel.en: minor girls sexually abused in one state-run shelter home, exposed by a 2018 audit
statLabel.hg: naabaalig ladkiyon ka ek state-run shelter home mein sexual abuse, jo 2018 ke audit se saamne aaya

label.en: minor girls whose sexual abuse at the Muzaffarpur shelter home the TISS audit revealed
label.hg: naabaalig ladkiyan, jinke Muzaffarpur shelter home mein sexual abuse ka khulasa TISS audit ne kiya

label.en: accused convicted by a POCSO court in Delhi's Saket on 20 January 2020
label.hg: accused ko Delhi ke Saket ki POCSO court ne 20 January 2020 ko convict kiya

label.en: convicts in the case sentenced to life imprisonment
label.hg: convicts ko is case mein life imprisonment ki saza mili

label.en: of POCSO trials that ended in 2024 led to a conviction
label.hg: POCSO trials mein conviction hua, jo 2024 mein khatam hue

claim.en: Children in a government-funded home are safe, because the government is watching.
claim.hg: Sarkari paise se chalne wale home mein bachche safe hain, kyunki sarkar nazar rakh rahi hai.

truth.en: In Muzaffarpur, the sexual abuse of 34 minor girls in a state-funded shelter home came to light only when an outside audit, commissioned by the state, went in to look.
truth.hg: Muzaffarpur mein ek state-funded shelter home ki 34 naabaalig ladkiyon ka sexual abuse tabhi saamne aaya, jab state ka bheja hua ek bahar ka audit andar dekhne gaya.

actions.en: If you know or suspect that a child in a hostel, shelter or school is being sexually abused, report it to the police or call 1098 or 112. Under POCSO, reporting is a legal duty, not a favour.
actions.hg: Agar aapko pata hai ya shak hai ki kisi hostel, shelter ya school mein kisi bachche ka sexual abuse ho raha hai, to police ko report kijiye ya 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye. POCSO ke hisaab se report karna legal duty hai, koi ehsaan nahin.

actions.en: If you run or work in an institution, report abuse by a colleague at once: a head of institution who fails to report a subordinate's offence faces up to one year in prison.
actions.hg: Agar aap kisi institution ko chalate hain ya wahan kaam karte hain, to kisi colleague ke abuse ki report turant kijiye: jo institution head apne neeche kaam karne wale ke offence ki report nahin karta, use ek saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai.

actions.en: Ask any home, hostel or school you are connected to how children can complain privately, and who from outside checks on them.
actions.hg: Jis bhi home, hostel ya school se aap jude hain, wahan poochhiye ki bachche private mein complaint kaise kar sakte hain, aur bahar se kaun unki khabar leta hai.

actions.en: Never share the name, photo, school or home of a child rescued from an institution, even in a post meant to help.
actions.hg: Kisi institution se bachaaye gaye bachche ka naam, photo, school ya ghar kabhi share mat kijiye, madad ke liye likhi post mein bhi nahin.

title.en: Nipun Saxena, 2018: why no one may identify a rape survivor 'even in a remote manner', and why only 11 cases were filed in 2024
title.hg: Nipun Saxena, 2018: rape survivor ki pehchaan 'even in a remote manner' bhi kyun nahi khol sakte, aur 2024 mein sirf 11 cases kyun darj hue

dek.en: Naming a rape survivor has been a crime since 1983. In December 2018 the Supreme Court had to spell out that hinting at who she is counts too, that her death does not end the protection, and that rape and POCSO FIRs stay out of public view. Under the new criminal code, police registered just 11 such cases in its first six months.
dek.hg: Rape survivor ka naam chhaapna 1983 se crime hai. December 2018 mein Supreme Court ko saaf karna pada ki uski pehchaan ki taraf ishaara karna bhi galat hai, ki maut ke baad bhi ye suraksha khatam nahi hoti, aur ki rape aur POCSO ki FIRs public nahi hongi. Naye criminal code ke pehle chhe mahine mein police ne aise sirf 11 cases darj kiye.

statLabel.en: identity-disclosure cases registered in India under BNS Section 72, July-December 2024
statLabel.hg: BNS Section 72 ke under India mein darj identity-disclosure cases, July-December 2024

label.en: the day the Supreme Court barred identifying a rape survivor 'even in a remote manner'
label.hg: woh din jab Supreme Court ne rape survivor ki pehchaan 'even in a remote manner', yaani ishaaron mein bhi, kholne par rok lagaayi

label.en: in prison, at most, plus a fine, for publishing anything that identifies a rape survivor (Section 72 BNS)
label.hg: tak ki jail, saath mein fine, rape survivor ki pehchaan kholne wali koi bhi cheez publish karne par (BNS Section 72)

label.en: One Stop Centres running in July 2026, of 1,033 approved; the court had asked for one in every district by December 2019
label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein chal rahe the, 1,033 approved mein se; court ne December 2019 tak har district mein ek centre maanga tha

claim.en: If I don't write her name, I'm not identifying her.
claim.hg: Agar naam nahi likha, toh pehchaan nahi khuli.

truth.en: The Supreme Court ruled in 2018 that no one may disclose, 'even in a remote manner', facts that could identify her. Its own examples: an exam rank with the state named, a village name, relatives shown on camera.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ne 2018 mein kaha ki koi bhi aise facts 'even in a remote manner', yaani ishaaron mein bhi, nahi bata sakta jinse uski pehchaan ho sake. Court ke apne examples: state ke naam ke saath exam rank, gaon ka naam, camera par dikhte rishtedaar.

actions.en: Before you post, forward or comment on a sexual-violence case, ask: could anyone who knows her recognise her from this? If yes, don't.
actions.hg: Kisi sexual-violence case par post, forward ya comment karne se pehle sochiye: kya use jaanne wala koi bhi isse use pehchaan sakta hai? Agar haan, toh mat kariye.

actions.en: Never share an FIR, medical report or court paper from a rape or POCSO case, or a screenshot of one.
actions.hg: Rape ya POCSO case ki FIR, medical report ya court ka koi bhi kaagaz, ya uska screenshot, kabhi share mat kariye.

actions.en: Don't guess at who she is in the comments, and don't tag people who might know her.
actions.hg: Comments mein ye andaaza mat lagaaiye ki woh kaun hai, aur un logon ko tag mat kariye jo use jaante ho sakte hain.

actions.en: Report posts that identify a survivor to the platform, and at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930.
actions.hg: Survivor ki pehchaan kholne wale posts ko platform par report kariye, aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par complaint kariye.

actions.en: If you need help after sexual violence, call 112 in an emergency or the Women Helpline, 181.
actions.hg: Sexual violence ke baad madad chahiye toh emergency mein 112 par call kariye, ya Women Helpline 181 par.

title.en: The Nirbhaya Fund by the numbers: Rs 1,000 crore in 2013, Rs 7,990.85 crore allocated, Rs 1,287.83 crore unspent
title.hg: Nirbhaya Fund numbers mein: 2013 mein Rs 1,000 crore, ab tak Rs 7,990.85 crore allocate, Rs 1,287.83 crore kharch hi nahi hue

dek.en: Set up after the 2012 Delhi gang rape, the fund has paid for police help desks, One Stop Centres, compensation and fast-track courts. Where the money went, what is still unspent, and how to use what it built.
dek.hg: 2012 ke Delhi gang rape ke baad bana yeh fund police help desks, One Stop Centres, compensation aur fast-track courts ka kharcha uthata hai. Paisa kahan gaya, kitna abhi bhi pada hai, aur isse jo bana uska istemaal kaise karein.

statLabel.en: allocated to the Nirbhaya Fund for 2025-26; it began with Rs 1,000 crore in 2013
statLabel.hg: 2025-26 ke liye Nirbhaya Fund ko mila allocation; 2013 mein shuruaat Rs 1,000 crore se hui thi

label.en: allocated to the Nirbhaya Fund from 2013-14 to 2025-26
label.hg: 2013-14 se 2025-26 tak Nirbhaya Fund ko allocate hue

label.en: of that still unspent in July 2026
label.hg: isme se July 2026 tak kharch nahi hue the

label.en: Women Help Desks set up in police stations by March 2025
label.hg: March 2025 tak police stations mein bane Women Help Desks

label.en: One Stop Centres running in July 2026, out of 1,033 approved
label.hg: July 2026 mein chal rahe One Stop Centres, 1,033 approved centres mein se

claim.en: The Nirbhaya Fund money was never spent.
claim.hg: Nirbhaya Fund ka paisa kabhi kharch hi nahi hua.

truth.en: Most of it was released: Rs 6,703.02 crore, or 83.9%, by July 2026. The real questions are what 'released and used' measures on the ground, and why Rs 1,287.83 crore still was not.
truth.hg: Zyada tar paisa release hua: July 2026 tak Rs 6,703.02 crore, yaani 83.9%. Asli sawaal yeh hain ki 'released and used' zameen par kya naapta hai, aur Rs 1,287.83 crore ab tak kyun nahi lage.

actions.en: At any police station, ask for the Women Help Desk. The Nirbhaya Fund paid for 14,658 of them, most headed by women officers.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein Women Help Desk ke baare mein poochiye. Nirbhaya Fund se aise 14,658 desks bane hain, jinme se zyada tar ki head women officers hain.

actions.en: Find out where your district's One Stop Centre (Sakhi) is before anyone needs it. In an emergency call 112; the Women Helpline is 181.
actions.hg: Zarurat padne se pehle hi pata kar lijiye ki aapke district ka One Stop Centre (Sakhi) kahan hai. Emergency mein 112 par call kariye; Women Helpline 181 hai.

actions.en: Apply to your District Legal Services Authority for victim compensation even if no one has been arrested. The law gives it two months to decide.
actions.hg: Victim compensation ke liye apni District Legal Services Authority mein apply kariye, chahe koi arrest hua ho ya nahi. Law ke hisaab se use do mahine mein faisla karna hota hai.

actions.en: Ask your MP or MLA, or file an RTI request, about how much of your state's Nirbhaya Fund money has been used, and on what.
actions.hg: Apne MP ya MLA se poochiye, ya RTI daaliye, ki aapke state ko mile Nirbhaya Fund ke paise mein se kitna use hua, aur kis par.

title.en: Rajasthan, 1992: the gang rape that built India's workplace harassment law, and the court that acquitted all five accused of rape
title.hg: Rajasthan, 1992: woh gang rape jisse workplace harassment ka law bana, aur woh court jisne paanchon accused ko rape ke charge se bari kar diya

dek.en: A village-level worker in a Rajasthan government programme campaigned against child marriages and was gang-raped. A Jaipur court acquitted all five accused of rape. Her case led to the Vishaka guidelines and then the POSH Act, which on paper protect every working woman in India. Here is how far that paper has reached.
dek.hg: Rajasthan sarkar ke ek programme mein kaam karne wali village-level worker child marriages ke khilaaf campaign chala rahi thi, aur uske saath gang rape hua. Jaipur ki court ne paanchon accused ko rape ke charge se bari kar diya. Unke case se pehle Vishaka guidelines aur phir POSH Act bana, jo kaagaz par India ki har working woman ko protect karte hain. Jaaniye, woh kaagaz asal mein kahan tak pahuncha hai.

statLabel.en: accused, all acquitted of rape by a Jaipur court in 1995
statLabel.hg: accused, jinhe 1995 mein Jaipur ki court ne rape ke charge se bari kar diya

label.en: the day the Supreme Court laid down the Vishaka guidelines against sexual harassment at work
label.hg: is din Supreme Court ne workplace sexual harassment ke khilaaf Vishaka guidelines di

label.en: from the Vishaka guidelines (1997) to the POSH Act (2013)
label.hg: lage, Vishaka guidelines (1997) se POSH Act (2013) tak

label.en: states and union territories reported in August 2025 to have finished the court-ordered district survey of Internal Committees
label.hg: states aur UTs, jinke baare mein August 2025 mein report hua ki unhone court ke order wala Internal Committees ka district survey poora kar liya

label.en: maximum fine for an employer who fails to set up an Internal Committee, doubled on repeat
label.hg: tak ka fine us employer par jo Internal Committee nahi banata; dobara galti par double

claim.en: Workplace harassment law only applies to big offices with an HR department.
claim.hg: Workplace harassment ka law sirf bade offices par laagu hota hai jahan HR department hota hai.

truth.en: Every workplace with 10 or more workers must have an Internal Committee, and every district must run a Local Committee for smaller workplaces, complaints against the employer and domestic workers.
truth.hg: Jis bhi workplace par 10 ya usse zyada log kaam karte hain, wahan Internal Committee honi chahiye. Aur har district mein Local Committee honi chahiye: chhoti workplaces ke liye, employer ke khilaaf complaints ke liye, aur domestic workers ke liye.

actions.en: Ask your employer who sits on your workplace's Internal Committee and how to reach them. If a workplace with 10 or more workers has none, the employer is breaking the law.
actions.hg: Apne employer se poochiye ki aapki workplace ki Internal Committee mein kaun hai aur unse kaise contact karein. Agar 10 ya usse zyada logon wali workplace mein committee hi nahi hai, toh employer law tod raha hai.

actions.en: Work somewhere with fewer than 10 workers, or in someone's home? Ask the District Officer's office for your district's Local Committee.
actions.hg: 10 se kam logon wali jagah par ya kisi ke ghar mein kaam karti hain? District Officer ke office se apne district ki Local Committee ke baare mein poochiye.

actions.en: Write down dates, messages and witnesses, and complain in writing within three months of the incident, or of the last one if it kept happening.
actions.hg: Dates, messages aur witnesses ke naam likh kar rakhiye, aur incident ke teen mahine ke andar written complaint kariye; agar harassment baar-baar hua, toh aakhri incident ke teen mahine ke andar.

actions.en: Do not accept money to drop a complaint. The POSH Act forbids any monetary settlement as the basis of conciliation.
actions.hg: Complaint wapas lene ke liye paise mat lijiye. POSH Act mein saaf likha hai ki conciliation ka basis paison ka len-den nahi ho sakta.

actions.en: You can also register a complaint on SHe-Box, the Ministry of Women and Child Development's online portal.
actions.hg: Aap Ministry of Women and Child Development ke online portal SHe-Box par bhi complaint register kar sakti hain.

title.en: Pathankot, Delhi, Mumbai: what happened when four of India's most-watched sexual violence trials left the state of the crime
title.hg: Pathankot, Delhi, Mumbai: jab India ke chaar sabse zyada dekhe gaye sexual violence trials us state se bahar chale jahan crime hua tha, toh kya hua

dek.en: Four landmark cases were tried outside the state where the crime took place. Each trial ended in convictions, and in two of them policemen were among the convicted. What those verdicts say about local power, and the protections a family can ask for.
dek.hg: Chaar landmark cases ka trial us state ke bahar chala jahan crime hua tha. Har trial convictions par khatam hua, aur do mein convict hone walon mein policewale bhi the. Yeh verdicts local power ke baare mein kya batate hain, aur ek family kaun si protections maang sakti hai.

statLabel.en: accused convicted in the Muzaffarpur shelter home trial, held in Delhi (2020)
statLabel.hg: accused convict hue Muzaffarpur shelter home ke trial mein, jo Delhi mein chala (2020)

label.en: accused convicted by the Pathankot court in the Kathua case (2019), three of them policemen convicted of destroying evidence
label.hg: accused ko Kathua case mein Pathankot court ne convict kiya (2019); inme teen policewale the, jo evidence mitane ke doshi paaye gaye

label.en: accused convicted by a POCSO court in Delhi in the Muzaffarpur shelter home case (2020)
label.hg: accused ko Muzaffarpur shelter home case mein Delhi ki ek POCSO court ne convict kiya (2020)

label.en: men sentenced to life in Mumbai in 2008 for the 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape and murders
label.hg: log jinhe 2002 ke Gujarat riots gang rape aur murders ke liye 2008 mein Mumbai mein umrqaid mili

label.en: prison for a former MLA and six others over the death in custody of the Unnao survivor's father (2020)
label.hg: ki jail ek former MLA aur chhe aur logon ko, Unnao survivor ke pita ki custody mein maut ke liye (2020)

claim.en: If the local police and powerful people are against you, nothing can be done.
claim.hg: Agar local police aur taaqatwar log aapke khilaaf hain, toh kuch nahi ho sakta.

truth.en: The Supreme Court can move a trial to another state, as it did in the Kathua, Unnao and Muzaffarpur cases, and the law gives victims rights of their own, including an in-camera trial and updates on the investigation.
truth.hg: Supreme Court trial ko doosre state mein shift kar sakti hai, jaise usne Kathua, Unnao aur Muzaffarpur cases mein kiya, aur law victims ko unke apne haq deta hai, jaise in-camera trial aur investigation ke updates.

actions.en: If you or your family are threatened over a case, write down every incident with its date and report each one in writing to the police and the court.
actions.hg: Agar case ki wajah se aapko ya aapki family ko dhamki milti hai, toh har ghatna date ke saath likhiye aur har ek ki likhit shikayat police aur court ko dijiye.

actions.en: Ask for the protections the law already promises: a closed (in-camera) trial, an update on the investigation within 90 days and, in cases under the SC/ST Act, notice of bail hearings.
actions.hg: Woh protections maangiye jo law pehle se deta hai: band kamre mein (in-camera) trial, 90 din ke andar investigation ka update aur, SC/ST Act ke cases mein, bail hearings ki soochna.

actions.en: If a fair trial seems impossible where you live, ask a legal services lawyer whether you can apply to have the case moved. The Supreme Court has moved trials to another state.
actions.hg: Agar aapke shehar mein fair trial namumkin lage, toh legal services ke lawyer se poochiye ki kya aap case shift karwane ke liye apply kar sakte hain. Supreme Court pehle bhi trials ko doosre state mein bhej chuki hai.

actions.en: Support a survivor's campaign without ever sharing her name, photo or village.
actions.hg: Survivor ke campaign ka saath dijiye, lekin uska naam, photo ya gaon kabhi share mat kijiye.

title.en: RG Kar, Kolkata 2024: a doctor killed at work, a national task force, and a judge who refused the death penalty
title.hg: RG Kar, Kolkata 2024: kaam ki jagah par ek doctor ka murder, ek national task force, aur ek judge jisne death penalty se mana kiya

dek.en: A trainee doctor was raped and murdered inside the hospital where she worked. Five months later a Sealdah court chose life over death and warned judges against public pressure. What the case changed, and what a safe hospital means in law.
