dek.hg: Ek trainee doctor ka usi hospital mein rape aur murder hua jahan woh kaam karti thi. Paanch mahine baad Sealdah court ne death ki jagah umrqaid chuni aur judges ko public pressure se bachne ki warning di. Is case ne kya badla, aur law ke hisaab se safe hospital ka matlab kya hai.

statLabel.en: cases of murder with rape or gang rape registered by police in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: rape ya gang rape ke saath murder ke cases jo 2024 mein poore India mein police ne register kiye

label.en: cases of murder with rape or gang rape registered by police in India in 2024
label.hg: rape ya gang rape ke saath murder ke cases jo 2024 mein poore India mein police ne register kiye

label.en: rape cases pending trial across India at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases jo 2024 ke end mein poore India mein trial mein pending the

label.en: police cases of sexual harassment at office premises in all of India in 2024
label.hg: office premises par sexual harassment ke police cases, 2024 mein poore India mein

claim.en: Sexual harassment law is for offices and companies, not for hospitals.
claim.hg: Sexual harassment wala law offices aur companies ke liye hai, hospitals ke liye nahi.

truth.en: The POSH Act's definition of 'workplace' expressly names hospitals and nursing homes, so every hospital employer has duties under it.
truth.hg: POSH Act mein 'workplace' ki definition mein hospitals aur nursing homes saaf likhe hain, yaani har hospital employer par is law ki duties laagu hoti hain.

actions.en: If you work or train in a hospital, find out who sits on its Internal Committee under the POSH Act and how to reach them.
actions.hg: Agar aap hospital mein kaam karte hain ya training le rahe hain, toh pata kijiye ki POSH Act ke under wahan ki Internal Committee mein kaun hai aur unse kaise contact karein.

actions.en: Put safety problems on duty, such as unlit corridors, no safe rest room or no guard at night, in writing to the administration and keep a copy.
actions.hg: Duty par safety ki problems, jaise andhere corridors, aaram ke liye safe room na hona ya raat mein guard na hona, likh kar administration ko dijiye aur uski copy apne paas rakhiye.

actions.en: Report sexual harassment at work in writing to the Internal Committee within three months of the incident.
actions.hg: Kaam ki jagah par sexual harassment ho toh incident ke teen mahine ke andar Internal Committee ko written complaint dijiye.

actions.en: In danger, call 112. Any hospital, government or private, must give a rape survivor immediate treatment free of cost.
actions.hg: Khatra ho toh 112 call kijiye. Har hospital, sarkari ho ya private, rape survivor ka turant aur free ilaaj karne ke liye bound hai.

actions.en: Never share a rape victim's name, photo or video. It is a crime under Section 72 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Rape victim ka naam, photo ya video kabhi share mat kijiye. BNS ki Section 72 ke under yeh crime hai.

title.en: Shakti Mills, Mumbai: the first death sentences under the repeat-rapist law (2014), and why the High Court commuted them (2021)
title.hg: Shakti Mills, Mumbai: repeat-rapist law mein pehli death sentences (2014), aur High Court ne unhe kyun badla (2021)

dek.en: A Mumbai court used India's new repeat-offender clause for the first time and sentenced three men to death. Seven years later the Bombay High Court said public opinion cannot decide punishment. What the case teaches about protecting the next woman.
dek.hg: Mumbai ki ek court ne India ka naya repeat-offender rule pehli baar lagaya aur teen aadmiyon ko phansi sunayi. Saat saal baad Bombay High Court ne kaha ki saza public opinion se tay nahin ho sakti. Yeh case agli aurat ko bachane ke baare mein kya sikhata hai.

statLabel.en: death sentences, the first under the 2013 repeat-offender clause (2014)
statLabel.hg: death sentences, 2013 ke repeat-offender rule mein pehli baar (2014)

label.en: death sentences on 4 April 2014, the first under Section 376E
label.hg: 4 April 2014 ko di gayi death sentences, Section 376E mein pehli baar

label.en: conviction rate in rape trials completed in India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein poore hue rape trials ka conviction rate

label.en: conviction rate in trials for crimes against women in Maharashtra in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein Maharashtra mein crimes against women trials ka conviction rate

claim.en: A life sentence for rape means a few years in jail.
claim.hg: Rape mein life sentence ka matlab bas kuch saal jail.

truth.en: For gang rape, aggravated rape and repeat offenders, the law spells out life imprisonment as the remainder of the person's natural life.
truth.hg: Gang rape, aggravated rape aur repeat offenders ke liye law saaf likhta hai: life imprisonment matlab bachi hui poori natural life jail.

actions.en: If a survivor chooses to report, help her do it: only a recorded and proved case lets the law treat a repeat attacker as one.
actions.hg: Agar koi survivor report karna chahe, to uska saath dijiye: sirf record aur prove hua case hi law ko batata hai ki agli baar attacker 'repeat' offender hai.

actions.en: Any police station must register a rape complaint as a Zero FIR and give a free copy. Refusing is a crime under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Koi bhi police station rape complaint Zero FIR ke roop mein darj karega aur free copy dega. Mana karna BNS Section 199 mein crime hai.

actions.en: After a rape or sexual assault, go to any hospital, government or private, for immediate free treatment, and call 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Rape ya sexual assault ke baad kisi bhi hospital jaiye, sarkari ho ya private, wahan turant free ilaaj milega. Emergency mein 112 call kijiye.

actions.en: When outrage demands a hanging, ask instead how many rape trials in your state end in conviction.
actions.hg: Jab gusse mein log phansi maangein, to poochhiye: aapke state mein kitne rape trials conviction par khatam hote hain?

actions.en: Never share a survivor's name, photo or any detail that could identify her. Section 72 of the BNS makes it a crime.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ka naam, photo ya pehchaan batane wali koi bhi detail share mat kijiye. BNS Section 72 mein yeh crime hai.

title.en: 'Skin-to-skin': the Bombay High Court ruling that shrank child sexual assault, and the Supreme Court's 2021 reversal
title.hg: 'Skin-to-skin': Bombay High Court ka woh faisla jisne child sexual assault ko chhota kar diya, aur 2021 mein Supreme Court ne use kaise palta

dek.en: In January 2021 a High Court said touching a child over her clothes was not sexual assault under POCSO. That November the Supreme Court said what counts is sexual intent. In 2026 it was correcting another High Court. Here is what the law covers, and what to do when a child tells you.
dek.hg: January 2021 mein ek High Court ne kaha ki kapdon ke upar se bachchi ko chhoona POCSO ke under sexual assault nahi hai. Usi saal November mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki asli baat sexual intent hai. 2026 mein woh ek aur High Court ki galti sudhaar raha tha. Jaaniye law kya cover karta hai, aur jab koi bachcha aapko kuch bataaye toh kya karna hai.

statLabel.en: of POCSO trials ended in conviction in 2024
statLabel.hg: POCSO trials 2024 mein conviction par khatam hue

label.en: the day the Supreme Court set aside the 'skin-to-skin' test
label.hg: woh din jab Supreme Court ne 'skin-to-skin' test ko radd kiya

label.en: POCSO cases registered in 2024 under the sexual assault sections (8 and 10), the offence the ruling had narrowed
label.hg: 2024 mein sexual assault wale sections (8 aur 10) ke under darj POCSO cases, yaani wahi offence jise is faisle ne chhota kar diya tha

label.en: POCSO trials that ended in acquittal in 2024, against 12,672 convictions
label.hg: POCSO trials 2024 mein acquittal par khatam hue, jabki conviction sirf 12,672 mein hua

claim.en: If the touching happened over clothes, it isn't sexual assault.
claim.hg: Agar chhoona kapdon ke upar se hua, toh woh sexual assault nahi hai.

truth.en: The Supreme Court ruled in November 2021 that the key ingredient of sexual assault under POCSO is sexual intent, not skin-to-skin contact.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ne November 2021 mein kaha ki POCSO ke under sexual assault ka sabse zaroori hissa sexual intent hai, skin-to-skin contact nahi.

actions.en: If a child tells you someone touched them, believe them, stay calm and don't ask whether it was over or under clothes. In law, it makes no difference.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha bataaye ki kisi ne use chhua, toh uski baat par yakeen kariye, shaant rahiye, aur ye mat poochiye ki kapdon ke upar se tha ya andar se. Law mein isse koi farak nahi padta.

actions.en: Report it to the police the same day or call the Child Helpline, 1098. Under POCSO, an adult who knows of child sexual abuse must report it.
actions.hg: Usi din police ko report kariye ya Child Helpline 1098 par call kariye. POCSO ke under, jis adult ko child sexual abuse ki jaankari ho, use report karna zaroori hai.

actions.en: Don't confront the person yourself or make the child repeat the story to relatives; let the police and trained counsellors take the statement.
actions.hg: Khud us insaan se jhagda mat kariye, aur bachche se rishtedaaron ke saamne baar-baar kahani mat sunwaaiye; statement police aur trained counsellors ko lene dijiye.

actions.en: Tell children, boys and girls alike, that they can come to you about any touch that felt wrong, even over clothes, and that they will not be in trouble.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko, ladkon aur ladkiyon dono ko, bataaiye ki jo bhi touch unhe galat lage, chahe kapdon ke upar se ho, uske baare mein woh aapse baat kar sakte hain, aur unhe koi daant nahi padegi.

title.en: 'Eve teasing', 'chaste woman', 'provocative dress': the Supreme Court's 2023 handbook against rape myths in Indian courtrooms
title.hg: 'Eve teasing', 'chaste woman', 'provocative dress': Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook, jo Indian courtrooms ke rape myths ke khilaaf hai

dek.en: In August 2023 the Supreme Court gave judges a list of words to stop using and myths to stop believing, and quoted a 2022 bail order to show why. In February 2026 it admitted that sensitising judges had not worked as hoped. What the handbook says, and how to use it in your own speech, posts and reporting.
dek.hg: August 2023 mein Supreme Court ne judges ko un shabdon ki list di jinhe bolna band karna hai, aur un myths ki jin par yakeen band karna hai, aur samjhaane ke liye 2022 ke ek bail order ka hawala diya. February 2026 mein court ne maana ki judges ko sensitise karne ki koshishein umeed ke mutabik kaam nahi aayin. Handbook kya kehti hai, aur aap ise apni baaton, posts aur reporting mein kaise use kar sakte hain.

label.en: entries in the handbook's glossary of words and phrases judges should replace
label.hg: entries hain handbook ki glossary mein, un shabdon aur phrases ki jinhe judges ko badalna chahiye

label.en: of rape cases registered in India in 2024 in which the offender was known to the survivor
label.hg: rape cases mein, jo 2024 mein India mein darj hue, offender survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: cases of sexual harassment of women registered by police in 2024
label.hg: cases auraton ke sexual harassment ke, jo police ne 2024 mein darj kiye

claim.en: 'Eve teasing' is harmless fun, and the way a woman dresses can invite assault.
claim.hg: 'Eve teasing' bas mazaak hai, aur aurat ke kapde hamle ko nyota de sakte hain.

truth.en: The Supreme Court's own handbook calls it 'street sexual harassment', and says a man who touches a woman without her consent cannot defend himself by pointing to her clothes.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ki apni handbook ise 'street sexual harassment' kehti hai, aur kehti hai ki bina consent kisi aurat ko chhoone wala aadmi uske kapdon ka bahaana bana kar apna bachaav nahi kar sakta.

actions.en: Say 'street sexual harassment', not 'eve teasing', and 'rape', not 'forcible rape' or 'ravished'.
actions.hg: 'Eve teasing' nahi, 'street sexual harassment' kahiye; aur 'forcible rape' ya 'ravished' nahi, sirf 'rape'.

actions.en: Never ask what a survivor was wearing, drinking or doing. The Supreme Court calls that a stereotype.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor se kabhi mat poochiye ki usne kya pehna tha, kya piya tha ya kya kar rahi thi. Supreme Court ise stereotype kehta hai.

actions.en: Do not judge a survivor by whether she cried, reported late or stayed in touch with the accused. There is no 'correct' way to behave.
actions.hg: Survivor ko is baat se mat aankiye ki woh royi ya nahi, usne der se complaint ki, ya accused se baat karti rahi. 'Sahi' bartaav jaisa kuch nahi hota.

actions.en: When you post or report about a case, describe what the accused did, never the survivor's character, and never anything that could identify her.
actions.hg: Kisi case par post ya report karte waqt batayiye ki accused ne kya kiya; survivor ka character kabhi nahi, aur aisi koi baat kabhi nahi jisse uski pehchaan ho sake.

actions.en: Call out stereotyped words in news, posts or reels by quoting the handbook: it is a public Supreme Court document.
actions.hg: News, posts ya reels mein stereotype wale shabd dikhein toh handbook quote karke tokiye: ye Supreme Court ka public document hai.

title.en: Condemned in 2013, called misconduct in 2022: why the Supreme Court had to rule twice against the two-finger test
title.hg: 2013 mein condemn kiya, 2022 mein misconduct kaha: two-finger test ke khilaaf Supreme Court ko do baar faisla kyun dena pada

dek.en: In 2013 the Supreme Court said the test violates a rape survivor's dignity. Nine years later it had to say so again, make it misconduct and order hospitals and medical colleges to catch up. Why one judgment rarely ends a practice, and the rules that bind every examination in 2026.
dek.hg: 2013 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki yeh test rape survivor ki dignity ko violate karta hai. Nau saal baad use yahi baat dobara kehni padi, ise misconduct banana pada aur hospitals aur medical colleges ko sudharne ka order dena pada. Ek judgment kisi practice ko aksar khatam kyun nahin kar paata, aur 2026 mein har examination par kaun se rules laagu hain.

statLabel.en: year the Supreme Court first held that the two-finger test violates a survivor's dignity; in 2022 it had to rule again
statLabel.hg: jis saal Supreme Court ne pehli baar kaha ki two-finger test survivor ki dignity ko violate karta hai; 2022 mein use dobara faisla dena pada

label.en: year of the Health Ministry guidelines the Supreme Court ordered sent to every hospital in 2022
label.hg: Health Ministry guidelines ka saal, jinhe Supreme Court ne 2022 mein har hospital tak bhejne ka order diya

label.en: for police to send a rape survivor for a medical examination, which needs her consent
label.hg: ke andar police ko rape survivor ko medical examination ke liye bhejna hai, jiske liye uska consent zaroori hai

label.en: for the doctor to send the examination report to the investigating officer
label.hg: ke andar doctor ko examination report investigating officer ko bhejni hai

claim.en: A doctor can tell from an internal examination whether a woman is used to sex, and that helps decide whether she was raped.
claim.hg: Doctor andar ke examination se bata sakta hai ki aurat sex ki aadi hai ya nahin, aur isse tay karne mein madad milti hai ki uska rape hua ya nahin.

truth.en: The Supreme Court has said the two-finger test has no scientific basis and neither proves nor disproves rape. Since 2013 the law has also made a survivor's sexual history irrelevant to consent.
truth.hg: Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki two-finger test ka koi scientific aadhaar nahin hai aur yeh rape ko na saabit karta hai, na jhuthlata hai. 2013 se law ne survivor ki sexual history ko consent ke sawaal par irrelevant bhi bana diya hai.

actions.en: Refuse any 'virginity' or finger test, whoever suggests it. The Supreme Court has said anyone who conducts it is guilty of misconduct.
actions.hg: Koi bhi 'virginity' ya finger test refuse kijiye, chahe koi bhi suggest kare. Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki ise karne wala misconduct ka doshi hai.

actions.en: Remember that a medical examination after rape needs the survivor's consent; the law does not permit one without it.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye ki rape ke baad medical examination ke liye survivor ka consent zaroori hai; law uske bina examination ki ijaazat nahin deta.

actions.en: If the test is done or suggested, write down the date, the hospital and the names, and complain in writing to the hospital head and the State Medical Council, citing the Supreme Court's 2022 ruling.
actions.hg: Agar test kiya gaya ya suggest kiya gaya, to tareekh, hospital aur naam likh lijiye, aur Supreme Court ke 2022 ke faisle ka hawala dete hue hospital head aur State Medical Council ko likhit complaint kijiye.

actions.en: If you are a medical student or doctor, check what your forensic medicine notes and hospital formats say about 'virginity', and ask for anything outdated to be removed.
actions.hg: Agar aap medical student ya doctor hain, to dekhiye ki aapke forensic medicine notes aur hospital formats 'virginity' ke baare mein kya kehte hain, aur purani cheezein hatwane ki maang kijiye.

title.en: Unnao 2017: an MLA jailed for life for raping a minor, and the 'public servant' argument that got his sentence suspended in 2025
title.hg: Unnao 2017: minor ke rape mein MLA ko umrqaid, aur 'public servant' wali woh daleel jisse 2025 mein uski sazaa rok di gayi

dek.en: A Delhi court sent Kuldeep Singh Sengar to prison for the rest of his life in 2019. Six years later, two words in the law got that sentence suspended until the Supreme Court stepped in. How power presses on a rape case, and what the law calls 'aggravated'.
dek.hg: Delhi ki ek court ne 2019 mein Kuldeep Singh Sengar ko baaki zindagi jail mein rehne ki sazaa di. Chhe saal baad law ke do shabdon ke sahaare yeh sazaa rok di gayi, jab tak Supreme Court beech mein nahi aaya. Power ek rape case ko kaise dabati hai, aur law kise 'aggravated' rape maanta hai, padhiye.

statLabel.en: fine on the former MLA, with imprisonment for the rest of his life (2019)
statLabel.hg: former MLA par jurmana, saath mein baaki zindagi ki jail (2019)

label.en: fine, with imprisonment for the remainder of his life (Delhi court, 20 December 2019)
label.hg: jurmana, saath mein baaki zindagi ki jail (Delhi court, 20 December 2019)

label.en: the day the Supreme Court stayed the High Court order suspending his sentence
label.hg: is din Supreme Court ne sazaa rokne wale High Court order par rok lagayi

label.en: of POCSO trials that ended in 2024 ended in a conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein jin POCSO trials ka faisla aaya, unmein se bas itnon mein conviction hua

label.en: rape cases registered in 2024 under the aggravated category for rape by police personnel
label.hg: 2024 mein police walon ke kiye rape ki aggravated category mein darj case

claim.en: Once a powerful man is convicted of rape, the case is closed.
claim.hg: Ek baar powerful aadmi ko rape ki sazaa ho gayi, toh case khatam.

truth.en: A sentence can still be suspended while the appeal waits. In 2025 the Delhi High Court suspended this life sentence on a reading of the words 'public servant', and only the Supreme Court's orders restored it.
truth.hg: Appeal ke intezaar mein sazaa rok bhi di ja sakti hai. 2025 mein Delhi High Court ne 'public servant' shabdon ki apni samajh par yeh umrqaid rok di. Supreme Court ke orders ke baad hi yeh sazaa phir se laagu hui.

actions.en: If the accused holds power where the survivor lives, ask a lawyer about moving the case: the Supreme Court moved every Unnao trial to Delhi.
actions.hg: Agar accused survivor ke ilaake mein powerful hai, toh lawyer se poochiye ki case doosri jagah kaise le jaaya ja sakta hai. Unnao ke saare case Supreme Court ne Delhi bheje the.

actions.en: If you know a child is being sexually abused, report it to the police or call 1098. Under POCSO, an adult who knows and stays silent commits an offence.
actions.hg: Agar aapko pata hai ki kisi bachche ka sexual abuse ho raha hai, toh police ko bataiye ya 1098 par call kijiye. POCSO ke tahat koi adult jaante hue bhi chup rahe, toh yeh khud ek offence hai.

actions.en: Never share a survivor's name, photo, village or family details, not even years after the case. The law forbids it.
actions.hg: Survivor ka naam, photo, gaon ya family ki details kabhi share mat kijiye, saalon baad bhi nahi. Law iski ijaazat nahi deta.

actions.en: Follow appeals and bail hearings, not just verdicts. A sentence can be suspended while an appeal waits.
actions.hg: Sirf verdict nahi, appeal aur bail ki hearing par bhi nazar rakhiye. Appeal pending rehte bhi sazaa roki ja sakti hai.

title.en: The Verma Committee said the death penalty may not deter and the marital rape exception should go. Parliament ignored both
title.hg: Verma Committee ne kaha tha ki phaansi se rape rukna zaroori nahi, aur marital rape wali chhoot khatam ho. Parliament ne dono baatein nahi maani

dek.en: In about a month, three people drew up a plan to remake India's rape law. Parliament passed new crimes and hospital duties, but added the death penalty and kept the marital exception. The Supreme Court has said it will hear the marriage question on 9 or 10 December 2026.
dek.hg: Lagbhag ek mahine mein teen logon ne India ka rape law nayi tarah se likhne ka plan banaya. Parliament ne naye crimes aur hospitals ki zimmedari waala law paas kiya, lekin death penalty jod di aur marital exception rehne diya. Supreme Court ne kaha hai ki woh shaadi wala sawaal 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko sunega.

label.en: the wife's age from which the marital rape exception Parliament kept in 2013 applied (read up to 18 by the Supreme Court in 2017)
label.hg: wife ki woh umar jisse marital rape exception laagu hota tha, jise Parliament ne 2013 mein rehne diya (Supreme Court ne 2017 mein ise 18 kar diya)

label.en: the age under which raping a girl became punishable with death in 2018
label.hg: is umar se chhoti bachchi ke rape par 2018 mein death penalty judi

label.en: of rape trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials mein conviction hua

label.en: of ever-married women who faced sexual violence named their current husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: sexual violence jhel chuki ever-married women ne apne current husband ka naam liya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: Hanging rapists is what stops rape.
claim.hg: Rapists ko phaansi do, rape apne aap ruk jaayenge.

truth.en: The Verma Committee advised against the death penalty for rape, noting it may not have a deterrent effect. The bigger gap is conviction itself: courts convicted in 24.4% of rape trials completed in 2024.
truth.hg: Verma Committee ne rape ke liye death penalty ke khilaaf salaah di thi, ye note karte hue ki iska darr ka asar shayad na ho. Asli kami conviction mein hai: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials mein se sirf 24.4% mein saza hui.

actions.en: Know the 2013 protections that still apply: any hospital, government or private, must treat a rape survivor at once and free of cost.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye, 2013 ki ye protection aaj bhi laagu hai: koi bhi hospital, sarkari ho ya private, rape survivor ka turant aur free ilaaj karega.

actions.en: If a police station will not record a rape complaint, say clearly that refusing is a crime under Section 199 of the BNS, then send the complaint in writing to the Superintendent of Police, or call 112.
actions.hg: Agar police station rape complaint likhne se mana kare, toh saaf kahiye ki ye BNS Section 199 ke under crime hai. Phir Superintendent of Police ko likhkar complaint bhejiye, ya 112 par call kariye.

actions.en: When a leader promises hanging after a terrible case, ask about the 1,85,785 rape cases pending trial at the end of 2024 and the 24.4% conviction rate.
actions.hg: Kisi bhayanak case ke baad jab koi neta phaansi ka vaada kare, toh poochiye: 2024 ke end mein trial ke intezaar mein pade 1,85,785 rape cases aur 24.4% conviction rate ka kya?

actions.en: If your husband forces sex on you, you still have options today: the Domestic Violence Act counts sexual abuse as domestic violence and lets you seek protection, residence and maintenance orders. Call 181 (Women Helpline) or 112.
actions.hg: Agar aapka husband aapke saath zabardasti sex karta hai, toh aaj bhi aapke paas raaste hain: Domestic Violence Act sexual abuse ko domestic violence maanta hai, aur iske under aap protection, residence aur maintenance ke orders maang sakti hain. 181 (Women Helpline) ya 112 par call kariye.

actions.en: Follow the Supreme Court's marital rape hearing, listed for 9 or 10 December 2026, and read what the judges actually decide, not only the headlines.
actions.hg: 9 ya 10 December 2026 ke liye listed marital rape hearing follow kariye, aur sirf headlines nahi, judges ka asli faisla padhiye.

title.en: X v. Principal Secretary (2022): how one unmarried woman's 22-week petition ended marital status as a test for abortion between 20 and 24 weeks
title.hg: X v. Principal Secretary (2022): ek unmarried aurat ki 22 hafte wali petition ne 20 se 24 hafte ke abortion se shaadi ki shart kaise hatwayi

dek.en: In July 2022 the Delhi High Court told her it 'cannot go beyond the Statute'. On 29 September the Supreme Court read the same rules by their purpose and put single women on the same footing as married women. The case history, the question it left to another bench, and why the woman who won is still only 'X'.
dek.hg: July 2022 mein Delhi High Court ne usse kaha ki woh 'cannot go beyond the Statute', yaani law ke likhe shabdon se aage nahi ja sakta. 29 September ko Supreme Court ne unhi rules ko unke maqsad ke hisaab se padha aur single auraton ko shaadishuda auraton ke barabar khada kar diya. Poori case history, woh sawaal jo doosri bench ke liye chhoda gaya, aur jeetne wali aurat aaj bhi sirf 'X' kyun hai.

statLabel.en: abortion limit the ruling opened to unmarried women and to wives raped by their husbands
statLabel.hg: ki abortion limit, jo is faisle ne unmarried auraton aur pati ke rape ki shikaar patniyon ke liye khol di

label.en: weeks pregnant when the Supreme Court let her end the pregnancy on 21 July 2022, subject to an AIIMS board
label.hg: hafte pregnant thi woh, jab 21 July 2022 ko Supreme Court ne AIIMS board ki shart par use pregnancy khatam karne ki ijaazat di

label.en: categories of women allowed abortion between 20 and 24 weeks under Rule 3B (2021); none named single women
label.hg: categories, jinhe Rule 3B (2021) ke under 20 se 24 hafte ke beech abortion ki ijaazat thi; inme single auraton ka naam nahi tha

label.en: maximum prison term, since 2021, for a doctor who reveals the name of a woman whose pregnancy was terminated
label.hg: tak ki jail, 2021 se, us doctor ke liye jo abortion karwane wali aurat ka naam bata de

claim.en: After 20 weeks, abortion is only for married women, widows and divorcees.
claim.hg: 20 hafte ke baad abortion sirf shaadishuda auraton, widows aur divorced auraton ke liye hai.

truth.en: Since 29 September 2022 the Supreme Court has held that unmarried and single women have the same access between 20 and 24 weeks as married women. It called the difference 'artificial'.
truth.hg: 29 September 2022 se Supreme Court ka faisla hai ki unmarried aur single auraton ko 20 se 24 hafte ke beech wahi access milega jo shaadishuda auraton ko. Court ne is fark ko 'artificial' kaha.

actions.en: If a clinic says abortion after 20 weeks is only for married women, name the ruling: X v. Principal Secretary, Supreme Court of India, 29 September 2022.
actions.hg: Agar koi clinic kahe ki 20 hafte ke baad abortion sirf married auraton ke liye hai, toh faisle ka naam boliye: X v. Principal Secretary, Supreme Court of India, 29 September 2022.

actions.en: If your husband forced the sex that caused the pregnancy, you can tell the doctor. For the abortion law it is rape, and no FIR is needed.
actions.hg: Agar pregnancy pati ki zabardasti se hui hai, toh aap doctor ko bata sakti hain. Abortion law ke liye yeh rape hai, aur iske liye FIR ki zaroorat nahi.

actions.en: Go early to a registered doctor or a government hospital. Never take abortion pills without a doctor.
actions.hg: Jaldi kisi registered doctor ya sarkari hospital jaiye. Doctor ke bina abortion ki goliyan kabhi mat lijiye.

actions.en: If you are under 18, you and your guardian can ask the doctor to keep your name out of the POCSO report to police.
actions.hg: Agar aap 18 se kam hain, toh aap aur aapke guardian doctor se keh sakte hain ki POCSO ke under police ko jaane wali report mein aapka naam na likha jaaye.

actions.en: Do not hunt for, guess or share the name of a woman who goes to court for an abortion. She is 'X' for a reason.
actions.hg: Abortion ke liye court jaane wali kisi aurat ka naam dhoondhne, andaaza lagaane ya share karne ki koshish mat kijiye. Woh 'X' kisi wajah se hai.

title.en: 15.6 million abortions, 7 lakh on record: India's invisible abortion count
title.hg: 15.6 million abortions, record mein sirf 7 lakh: India ke woh abortions jo kahin gine nahi jaate

dek.en: The Health Ministry recorded 701,415 abortions in 2014-15. A national research estimate for 2015 puts the number at 15.6 million. Here is where the missing abortions happened, why the official count missed them, and what a country loses when it cannot count.
dek.hg: Health Ministry ne 2014-15 mein 701,415 abortions record kiye. Lekin 2015 ka ek national research estimate yeh number 15.6 million batata hai. Baaki abortions kahan hue, official ginti se woh kyun chhoot gaye, aur jo desh gin nahi pata woh kya khota hai.

statLabel.hg: abortions ka estimate hai India mein 2015 ka, jabki 2014-15 mein official record mein sirf 701,415 the

label.hg: abortions ka estimate hai India mein 2015 ka (14.1 se 17.3 million ke beech)

label.hg: abortions Health Ministry ke record mein darj hue, 2014-15 mein

label.hg: abortions 2015 mein kisi hospital ya clinic ke bahar, pills se hue (estimate)

label.hg: last pregnancies, aurton ke hisaab se, abortion par khatam hui (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

actions.en: If you need an abortion, see a registered doctor early. Abortion pills are approved up to nine weeks of pregnancy, on a doctor's prescription.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe abortion karwana hai, toh jaldi kisi registered doctor se milo. Abortion pills pregnancy ke 9 hafte tak, doctor ke prescription par, approved hain.

actions.en: Do not take abortion pills on a chemist's or friend's advice alone. If you already have, get a check-up at a government hospital or approved clinic.
actions.hg: Sirf chemist ya dost ke kehne par abortion pills mat lo. Agar le chuki ho, toh sarkari hospital ya approved clinic mein check-up karwao.

actions.en: If you have problems after an abortion, get treatment at once. In an emergency, call 112.
actions.hg: Abortion ke baad koi bhi problem ho, toh turant ilaaj karwao. Emergency mein 112 par call karo.

actions.en: Know your privacy: a doctor may not reveal your name or details to anyone not authorised by law.
actions.hg: Apni privacy ka haq jaano: doctor tumhara naam ya details kisi aise insaan ko nahi bata sakta jise law ne permission na di ho.

actions.en: Ask your MLA and MP why official records catch fewer than one abortion in twenty, and how India plans to count the rest.
actions.hg: Apne MLA aur MP se poocho ki official records bees mein se ek abortion bhi kyun nahi pakad paate, aur baaki ko ginne ka plan kya hai.

title.en: Pregnant at 16: how POCSO's reporting rule pushes girls towards quacks
title.hg: 16 ki umar mein pregnancy: POCSO ka reporting rule ladkiyon ko jholachhap doctors tak kaise dhakelta hai

dek.en: Every pregnancy under 18 must be reported to the police, and in 2022 the Supreme Court acknowledged that this can leave girls and their families choosing between a registered doctor and an unqualified one. Here is the court's partial fix, what it leaves broken, and what a sister, friend or parent can safely do.
dek.hg: 18 se kam umar ki har pregnancy police ko report karni padti hai, aur 2022 mein Supreme Court ne khud maana ki isse ladkiyon aur unke parivaaron ke saamne registered doctor aur jholachhap ke beech chunne ki naubat aa sakti hai. Jaaniye court ka aadha-adhoora hal, usme kya ab bhi toota hai, aur behen, saheli ya mummy-papa safely kya kar sakte hain.

statLabel.hg: saal ki woh umar jisme abortion complications se maut ka khatra sabse zyada hai (UNFPA India)

label.hg: saal: is umar ki ladkiyon ko abortion complications se maut ka sabse zyada khatra hai (UNFPA India, 2022)

label.hg: 2024 mein POCSO penetrative assault cases ke child victims mein se itne 16-18 saal ke the

label.hg: POCSO cases 2024 ke aakhir mein trial ka intezaar kar rahe the

claim.en: If a girl under 18 agreed to sex, a doctor can keep her pregnancy secret.
claim.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki ne sex ke liye haan kaha tha, toh doctor uski pregnancy chhupa sakta hai.

truth.en: Under POCSO any sexual act with a person under 18 is an offence whatever she said, so a doctor must report the pregnancy to the police. If she seeks an abortion, since 2022 her name can be left out of that report if she and her guardian ask.
truth.hg: POCSO mein 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath sexual act jurm hai, chahe usne kuch bhi kaha ho, isliye doctor ko police ko report karna hi padta hai. Lekin agar woh abortion karwa rahi hai, toh 2022 se, ladki aur uske guardian ke kehne par report mein uska naam likhna zaroori nahi hai.

actions.en: Never take her to an unqualified provider or buy abortion pills without a doctor: girls aged 15-19 face the highest risk of dying from abortion complications.
actions.hg: Use kabhi jholachhap ke paas mat le jaaiye, na doctor ke bina abortion pills khareediye: 15-19 saal ki ladkiyon ko abortion complications se maut ka sabse zyada khatra hai.

actions.en: Go early to a registered doctor or a government hospital, with a parent or guardian, whose written consent the law requires.
actions.hg: Jaldi registered doctor ya sarkari hospital jaaiye, mummy-papa ya guardian ke saath, kyunki kanoon unki likhit consent maangta hai.

actions.en: If she seeks an abortion, she and her guardian can ask the doctor to leave her name and details out of the police report, as the Supreme Court allowed in September 2022.
actions.hg: Agar woh abortion karwa rahi hai, toh woh aur uske guardian doctor se keh sakte hain ki police report mein uska naam aur details na likhein, jaisa Supreme Court ne September 2022 mein allow kiya.

actions.en: If she was abused or has no safe adult at home, call the Child Helpline 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar uske saath abuse hua hai ya ghar par koi bharosemand bada nahi hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Stay with her: no blame, no lectures, no gossip. Tell only the people who need to know in order to help her.
actions.hg: Uske saath rahiye: na blame, na lecture, na gossip. Uski baat sirf unhe bataiye jinka jaanna uski madad ke liye zaroori hai.

title.en: Under 1 death or over 200 per 100,000: what unsafe abortion costs, and where India's 1971 law stands
title.hg: Har 1 lakh abortions par 1 se kam ya 200 se zyada maut: unsafe abortion ki keemat, aur India ka 1971 ka kanoon kahan khada hai

dek.en: About 73 million abortions take place worldwide every year. WHO's numbers show where the danger lies: not in abortion itself, but in abortion done unsafely. India opened a legal route in 1971, yet UNFPA India still ranks unsafe abortion as the third leading cause of maternal deaths here.
dek.hg: Duniya bhar mein har saal lagbhag 73 million abortions hote hain. WHO ke numbers dikhate hain ki khatra kahan hai: abortion mein nahi, unsafe tareeke se hue abortion mein. India ne 1971 mein kanooni raasta khola, phir bhi UNFPA India ke mutabik yahan maternal deaths ki teesri sabse badi wajah ab bhi unsafe abortion hai.

statLabel.en: induced abortions worldwide every year (WHO)
statLabel.hg: induced abortions duniya bhar mein har saal (WHO)

label.en: induced abortions take place worldwide every year (WHO)
label.hg: induced abortions duniya bhar mein har saal hote hain (WHO)

label.en: of induced abortions worldwide are unsafe; more than half of all unsafe abortions happen in Asia (WHO, 2010-2014 estimates)
label.hg: induced abortions duniya bhar mein unsafe hote hain; saare unsafe abortions mein se aadhe se zyada Asia mein hote hain (WHO, 2010-2014 ke estimates)

label.en: deaths per 100,000 abortions where unsafe abortion is common, against under 1 for safe abortion (WHO)
label.hg: maut har 1 lakh abortions par, jahan unsafe abortion aam hai; safe abortion mein 1 se bhi kam (WHO)

label.en: leading cause of maternal deaths in India is unsafe abortion, by UNFPA India's 2022 estimate
label.hg: India mein maternal deaths ki wajahon mein unsafe abortion ka sthaan, UNFPA India ke 2022 ke andaaze ke mutabik

claim.en: Once abortion is legal, unsafe abortion disappears.
claim.hg: Abortion legal ho jaaye, toh unsafe abortion apne aap khatam ho jaata hai.

truth.en: India legalised abortion in 1971, yet UNFPA India estimated in 2022 that unsafe abortion was still the third leading cause of maternal deaths in the country, with close to eight women dying every day.
truth.hg: India ne 1971 mein abortion ko legal banaya, phir bhi UNFPA India ne 2022 mein andaaza lagaya ki desh mein maternal deaths ki teesri sabse badi wajah ab bhi unsafe abortion hai, aur isse roz kareeb aath auratein marti hain.

actions.en: If you need an abortion, go to a registered doctor or a government hospital: in India it is legal up to 20 weeks on one doctor's opinion, and up to 24 weeks for rape survivors, minors and other listed groups.
actions.hg: Agar aapko abortion chahiye, toh registered doctor ya sarkari hospital jaaiye: India mein ek doctor ki raay par 20 hafte tak yeh legal hai, aur rape survivors, minors aur doosre listed groups ke liye 24 hafte tak.

actions.en: Do not take abortion pills without a doctor: the pill combination is approved up to nine weeks when a qualified doctor prescribes it.
actions.hg: Doctor ke bina abortion pills mat lijiye: qualified doctor ke likhne par yeh pill combination 9 hafte tak ke liye approved hai.

actions.en: Remember that an adult woman's own consent is the only consent the law needs; no husband or in-law has to sign.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye ki adult aurat ki apni consent hi kanoon ke liye kaafi hai; pati ya sasural walon ke sign ki zaroorat nahi.

actions.en: If anyone feels unwell after an abortion, take her to a hospital at once, and do not let fear of questions delay it.
actions.hg: Abortion ke baad agar kisi ki tabiyat bigde, toh use turant hospital le jaaiye, aur sawaalon ke darr se der mat kijiye.

actions.en: When abortion bans come up in an argument, bring WHO's two numbers: under 1 death per 100,000 safe abortions, over 200 where unsafe abortion is common.
actions.hg: Jab abortion ban par behas ho, toh WHO ke do numbers saamne rakhiye: har 1 lakh safe abortions par 1 se kam maut, aur jahan unsafe abortion aam hai wahan 200 se zyada.

title.en: Her consent is the only one the law needs. NFHS-5 shows who else is deciding
title.hg: Law ko sirf uski consent chahiye. NFHS-5 dikhata hai ki faisla aur kaun le raha hai

dek.en: India's abortion law asks for one signature: the woman's. National survey data show husbands, mothers-in-law and son preference still reaching into that decision.
dek.hg: India ka abortion law sirf ek signature maangta hai: aurat ka. Lekin national survey ka data dikhata hai ki pati, saas aur bete ki chahat aaj bhi is faisle mein dakhal deti hai.

statLabel.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion said the main reason was that their husband or mother-in-law did not want it (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: aurton ne, jinki last pregnancy abortion par khatam hui, kaha ki main wajah yeh thi ki pati ya saas yeh pregnancy nahi chahte the (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion said the main reason was that their husband or mother-in-law did not want it (2019-21)
label.hg: aurton ne, jinki last pregnancy abortion par khatam hui, kaha ki main wajah thi: pati ya saas yeh pregnancy nahi chahte the (2019-21)

label.en: of men aged 15-49 said a husband has the right to use force to have sex if his wife refuses (2019-21)
label.hg: mardon (15-49 saal) ne kaha ki biwi mana kare tab bhi pati ko zabardasti sex karne ka haq hai (2019-21)

label.en: of men agreed that contraception is "women's business" (2019-21)
label.hg: mardon ne maana ki contraception "aurton ka kaam" hai (2019-21)

label.en: of women abused only by their current husband ever sought help (2019-21)
label.hg: aurton ne hi kabhi madad maangi, jinke saath violence sirf current pati ne ki (2019-21)

claim.en: A married woman needs her husband's signature to get an abortion.
claim.hg: Shaadishuda aurat ko abortion ke liye pati ka signature chahiye.

truth.en: The MTP Act asks only for the adult woman's own consent. A guardian signs only if she is under 18 or mentally ill. The law gives no role to a husband or in-laws.
truth.hg: MTP Act sirf adult aurat ki apni consent maangta hai. Guardian tabhi sign karta hai jab woh 18 se kam umar ki ho ya mentally ill ho. Law mein pati ya sasural walon ka koi role nahi hai.

actions.en: If you are 18 or older, sign the abortion consent form yourself. The law does not ask for your husband's or in-laws' signature.
actions.hg: Agar aapki umar 18 ya usse zyada hai, toh abortion consent form par sign aap khud karein. Law pati ya sasural walon ka signature nahi maangta.

actions.en: Hiding pills, forcing sex, or pushing a woman to end or to continue a pregnancy is abuse. Call Women Helpline 181 or go to a One Stop Centre (Sakhi).
actions.hg: Pills chhupana, zabardasti sex karna, ya pregnancy girane ya rakhne ka pressure dalna abuse hai. Women Helpline 181 par call karein ya One Stop Centre (Sakhi) jaayein.

actions.en: If your husband forced sex and you are pregnant, you can seek an abortion up to 24 weeks as a rape survivor, without filing an FIR.
actions.hg: Agar pati ne zabardasti ki aur aap pregnant hain, toh aap rape survivor ke taur par 24 hafte tak abortion karwa sakti hain, bina FIR ke.

actions.en: For free legal help, including a protection order under the Domestic Violence Act, call NALSA on 15100.
actions.hg: Free legal help ke liye, Domestic Violence Act ke protection order ke liye bhi, NALSA ki helpline 15100 par call karein.

actions.en: If you are the husband, ask her what she wants, then say it to your family out loud.
actions.hg: Agar aap pati hain, toh pehle biwi se poochiye ki woh kya chahti hai. Phir family ke saamne khul kar uski baat rakhiye.

title.en: A safe abortion does not cost you your fertility. Unsafe abortion can.
title.hg: Safe abortion se fertility nahi jaati. Unsafe abortion se ja sakti hai.

dek.en: Women are warned that one abortion will ruin every future pregnancy. The evidence draws a different line: not abortion versus no abortion, but safe versus unsafe. Here is what each myth gets wrong, and what actually protects fertility.
dek.hg: Aurton ko daraya jaata hai ki ek abortion aage ki har pregnancy bigaad dega. Evidence ek alag line kheenchta hai: abortion ya no abortion nahi, balki safe ya unsafe. Har myth mein kya galat hai, aur fertility ko asal mein kya bachata hai.

statLabel.en: deaths from safe abortion, according to WHO
statLabel.hg: safe abortion se maut ka rate, WHO ke mutabik

label.en: success rate of the approved two-medicine method in early abortion, up to nine weeks (Health Ministry, 2023)
label.hg: approved do-dawaiyon wale method ka success rate, shuruaati abortion mein, 9 hafte tak (Health Ministry, 2023)

label.en: deaths per 100,000 abortions where unsafe abortion is common, against under 1 when abortion is safe (WHO)
label.hg: maut har 100,000 abortions par, jahan unsafe abortion aam hai; safe abortion mein yeh 1 se bhi kam hai (WHO)

label.en: of women getting post-abortion care in six Indian states in 2015 were being treated for serious complications such as sepsis
label.hg: aurtein jo 2015 mein chhe states mein abortion ke baad care le rahi thi, sepsis jaisi serious complications ka ilaaj karwa rahi thi

label.en: adults worldwide experience infertility in their lifetime, for many different reasons (WHO, 2023)
label.hg: adults duniya bhar mein zindagi mein kabhi na kabhi infertility jhelte hain, kai alag wajahon se (WHO, 2023)

claim.en: One abortion ruins every future pregnancy.
claim.hg: Ek abortion aage ki har pregnancy bigaad deta hai.

truth.en: A safe abortion does not normally affect future fertility. What can damage it is unsafe abortion, and complications such as infection left untreated, which is why early, safe care matters.
truth.hg: Safe abortion se aam taur par aage ki fertility par koi asar nahi padta. Nuksaan unsafe abortion se hota hai, aur infection jaisi complications ka ilaaj na karwane se. Isliye jaldi aur safe care zaroori hai.

actions.en: If you need an abortion, see a registered doctor or an approved facility early: the abortion pills are approved only up to nine weeks of pregnancy.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe abortion chahiye, toh jaldi kisi registered doctor ya approved facility mein jao: abortion pills sirf 9 hafte tak ki pregnancy ke liye approved hain.

actions.en: Never take abortion pills without a doctor first checking how far along the pregnancy is and that it is inside the uterus.
actions.hg: Abortion pills tab tak mat lo jab tak doctor yeh check na kar le ki pregnancy kitne hafte ki hai aur uterus ke andar hai.

actions.en: After an abortion, go to a hospital the same day for heavy bleeding, fever, severe pain or a foul-smelling discharge, and tell the doctor what was taken. In an emergency, call 112.
actions.hg: Abortion ke baad bahut zyada bleeding, bukhaar, tez dard ya badboo wala discharge ho, toh usi din hospital jao aur doctor ko batao ki kya liya tha. Emergency mein 112 par call karo.

actions.en: Ask for contraception at the same visit if you do not want another pregnancy soon: pregnancy can happen again soon after an abortion.
actions.hg: Agar abhi dobara pregnancy nahi chahiye, toh usi visit par contraception maango: abortion ke kuch hi samay baad dobara pregnancy ho sakti hai.

actions.en: If a year of trying brings no pregnancy, both partners should see a doctor. An old abortion is not a diagnosis.
actions.hg: Agar ek saal koshish ke baad bhi pregnancy na ho, toh dono partners doctor ko dikhayein. Purana abortion koi diagnosis nahi hai.

title.en: Illegal unless you're married? Five abortion-law myths, checked clause by clause
title.hg: Shaadi nahi hui to illegal? Abortion law ke paanch myths, clause-by-clause check kiye gaye

dek.en: Abortion has been legal in India since 1972, for single women too, and an adult needs no signature but her own. Here are five myths you will hear at home and sometimes at a clinic, the clause or judgment that answers each, and what to say back.
dek.hg: India mein abortion 1972 se legal hai, single aurton ke liye bhi, aur adult aurat ko apne signature ke alawa kisi ke signature ki zaroorat nahi. Yahan paanch myths hain jo tum ghar par aur kabhi-kabhi clinic mein bhi sunogi, har ek ka jawab dene wala clause ya faisla, aur palat kar kya kehna hai.

label.en: the year abortion became legal in India: the MTP Act came into force on 1 April
label.hg: jis saal India mein abortion legal hua: MTP Act 1 April ko lagu hua

label.en: weeks: the limit up to which unmarried women have the same access as married women, since September 2022
label.hg: hafte tak unmarried aurton ko shaadishuda aurton jaisa hi access hai, September 2022 se

label.en: is the maximum prison term (or a fine, or both) for a doctor who reveals a woman's identity (Section 5A, MTP Act)
label.hg: sabse zyada jail (ya jurmana, ya dono) us doctor ke liye jo aurat ki pehchaan bataye (Section 5A, MTP Act)

claim.en: Abortion is illegal in India unless you are married, and even then only with your husband's signature.
claim.hg: India mein shaadi ke bina abortion illegal hai, aur shaadi ke baad bhi sirf pati ke signature se hota hai.

truth.en: Abortion has been legal since 1972, unmarried women have the same access as married women, and an adult woman's own consent is the only consent the MTP Act asks for.
truth.hg: Abortion 1972 se legal hai, unmarried aurton ka access shaadishuda aurton jaisa hi hai, aur MTP Act adult aurat se sirf uski apni consent maangta hai.

actions.en: If you are 18 or older, sign the consent yourself: the MTP Act asks for no one else's signature.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 ya usse badi ho, to consent par khud sign karo: MTP Act kisi aur ka signature nahi maangta.

actions.en: If a clinic says you must be married, bring your husband or file an FIR first, go to another registered provider or a government hospital the same day.
actions.hg: Agar clinic kahe ki shaadi zaroori hai, pati ko lao ya pehle FIR karwao, to usi din kisi doosre registered provider ya sarkari hospital jao.

actions.en: If you are a rape survivor, you do not need an FIR or a court verdict before an abortion. See a registered doctor as soon as you can; the hospital must inform the police, but your abortion does not depend on an FIR being registered.
actions.hg: Agar tum rape survivor ho, to abortion se pehle FIR ya court ke faisle ki zaroorat nahi. Jitni jaldi ho sake registered doctor se milo; hospital ko police ko batana hoga, lekin tumhara abortion FIR register hone par tika nahi hai.

actions.en: If you are under 18, a guardian must consent and the doctor must inform the police, but you and your guardian can ask for your name to be kept out of that report.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 se kam ho, to guardian ki consent chahiye aur doctor ko police ko batana padega, lekin tum aur tumhara guardian maang sakte ho ki us report mein tumhara naam na ho.

actions.en: Never let a myth push you towards a quack: an abortion by an unqualified person is both illegal and dangerous.
actions.hg: Kisi myth ki wajah se quack ke paas kabhi mat jao: unqualified insaan ka kiya abortion illegal bhi hai aur khatarnak bhi.

title.en: Abortion is legal in India, but not on request: why every gate opens on a doctor's opinion
title.hg: India mein abortion legal hai, par sirf maangne se nahi milta: har gate doctor ki opinion se hi kyun khulta hai

dek.en: Abortion has been legal since 1972, but never simply because a woman asks. At every stage a doctor must agree that a legal ground applies. Here is how that rule works, and why courts keep having to step in.
dek.hg: 1972 se abortion legal hai, lekin kabhi bhi sirf isliye nahi ki aurat ne maanga. Har stage par ek doctor ko maanna padta hai ki law mein likha koi ground lagu hota hai. Yeh rule kaise kaam karta hai, aur courts ko baar-baar beech mein kyun aana padta hai, yahan samjho.

label.en: the year the MTP Act came into force (on 1 April): abortion became legal, but only on a doctor's opinion
label.hg: MTP Act lagu hone ka saal (1 April): abortion legal hua, par sirf doctor ki opinion par

label.en: weeks: up to this point, one registered doctor's opinion is enough (since 2021)
label.hg: hafte tak ek registered doctor ki opinion kaafi hai (2021 se)

label.en: doctors must agree between 20 and 24 weeks, and only for women in categories listed in the rules
label.hg: doctors ki haan chahiye 20 se 24 hafte ke beech, aur woh bhi sirf rules ki list wali aurton ke liye

claim.en: Abortion is legal in India, so any adult woman can get one just by asking.
claim.hg: Abortion legal hai, to koi bhi adult aurat bas maang kar karwa sakti hai.

truth.en: The MTP Act allows abortion only when a registered doctor forms the opinion, in good faith, that a legal ground applies. Her consent is required, but on its own it is not enough.
truth.hg: MTP Act mein abortion tabhi hota hai jab registered doctor good faith mein opinion banaye ki law mein likha koi ground lagu hota hai. Aurat ki consent zaroori hai, par akele usse kaam nahi chalta.

actions.en: See a registered doctor at an approved hospital or clinic as early as you can. The earlier you go, the fewer opinions the law asks for.
actions.hg: Jitni jaldi ho sake, approved hospital ya clinic mein registered doctor se milo. Jitna jaldi jaogi, law utni kam opinions maangta hai.

actions.en: Tell the doctor plainly why you cannot continue the pregnancy. The law itself links contraceptive failure and rape to grave harm to mental health.
actions.hg: Doctor ko saaf batao ki tum yeh pregnancy kyun continue nahi kar sakti. Law khud contraceptive failure aur rape ko mental health par gambhir chot se jodta hai.

actions.en: If you are 18 or older, only your consent is needed: not a husband's, a partner's or a parent's.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 ya usse badi ho, to sirf tumhari consent chahiye: pati, partner ya parents ki nahi.

actions.en: If one doctor refuses, go to another registered provider or a government hospital, never to an unqualified one.
actions.hg: Agar ek doctor mana kare, to doosre registered provider ya sarkari hospital jao, kisi unqualified insaan ke paas kabhi nahi.

actions.en: Do not take abortion pills without a doctor's advice.
actions.hg: Doctor ki salah ke bina abortion pills mat lo.

title.en: Just take the kit from the chemist? The real risks of abortion pills without a doctor
title.hg: Chemist se kit lo aur kaam khatam? Bina doctor ke abortion pills ke asli khatre

dek.en: The pills work, which is exactly why so many people treat them like a home remedy. What makes them safe is the check before and the safety net after. Here is what a doctor does that a counter cannot, and the signs that mean hospital now.
dek.hg: Pills kaam karti hain, aur isi wajah se bahut log inhe ghar ka nuskha samajh lete hain. Inhe safe banata hai pehle ka check aur baad ka safety net. Doctor kya karta hai jo counter nahi kar sakta, aur kaunse signs ka matlab hai abhi hospital.

statLabel.en: of post-abortion care patients in six states were being treated for serious complications (2015)
statLabel.hg: post-abortion care ke patients ka ilaaj chhe states mein serious complications ke liye ho raha tha (2015)

label.en: success rate of abortion pills in early pregnancy, approved up to nine weeks on a qualified doctor's prescription (Health Ministry, 2023)
label.hg: shuruaati pregnancy mein abortion pills ka success rate, 9 hafte tak qualified doctor ke prescription par approved (Health Ministry, 2023)

label.en: of post-abortion care patients in six states were being treated for serious complications such as sepsis and shock (2015)
label.hg: post-abortion care ke patients ka ilaaj chhe states mein sepsis aur shock jaisi serious complications ke liye ho raha tha (2015)

label.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion reported complications (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: aurton ne, jinki last pregnancy abortion par khatam hui, complications batayi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of rigorous imprisonment for an abortion by anyone who is not a registered doctor, or at an unapproved place (since 2002)
label.hg: ki rigorous imprisonment, agar abortion registered doctor ke alawa koi aur kare, ya bina approval wali jagah par ho (2002 se)

claim.en: Abortion pills from the chemist are a home remedy: take the kit, rest for a day, and it is done.
claim.hg: Chemist se li abortion pills ghar ka nuskha hain: kit lo, ek din aaram karo, kaam ho gaya.

truth.en: The pills are effective, but India approves them only up to nine weeks, on a qualified doctor's prescription, because someone has to confirm how far along the pregnancy is, rule out a pregnancy outside the uterus and be ready if something goes wrong.
truth.hg: Pills effective hain, lekin India mein yeh sirf 9 hafte tak, qualified doctor ke prescription par approved hain, kyunki kisi ko confirm karna hota hai ki pregnancy kitne hafte ki hai, uterus ke bahar wali pregnancy ko rule out karna hota hai, aur kuch galat ho toh taiyaar rehna hota hai.

actions.en: See a registered doctor or a government hospital before taking any abortion pill. If you are 18 or older, your consent is the only one the law asks for.
actions.hg: Koi bhi abortion pill lene se pehle registered doctor ya sarkari hospital jao. Agar tum 18 ya usse zyada ki ho, toh law sirf tumhari consent maangta hai.

actions.en: Know your dates: the nine-week limit for pills is counted from the first day of your last period, not from the day of sex.
actions.hg: Apni dates jaano: pills ki 9 hafte ki limit tumhare last period ke pehle din se gini jaati hai, sex wale din se nahi.

actions.en: After pills, go to hospital at once for bleeding that soaks pad after pad, fever, severe or one-sided pain, foul-smelling discharge or fainting. In an emergency, call 112.
actions.hg: Pills ke baad pad par pad bhigo dene wali bleeding, bukhaar, tez ya ek taraf ka dard, badbudaar discharge ya behoshi ho, toh turant hospital jao. Emergency mein 112 par call karo.

actions.en: Tell the doctor exactly what you took and when. Do not take extra tablets to 'finish it'.
actions.hg: Doctor ko saaf-saaf batao ki tumne kya liya aur kab. 'Kaam poora karne' ke liye extra tablets mat lo.

actions.en: If a friend is in this situation, go to the hospital with her. Do not let fear of being judged keep her at home.
actions.hg: Agar koi dost is haalat mein hai, toh uske saath hospital jao. Judge hone ka darr use ghar par na roke.

title.en: Will my family or the police find out? Abortion and privacy under Indian law, answered
title.hg: Kya ghar walon ya police ko pata chal jaayega? Abortion aur privacy par Indian law, sawaal-jawaab mein

dek.en: Will the clinic call home? Will the police come? Indian law answers both, mostly in the woman's favour. Here is who must be asked, who may be told, and what changes under 18.
dek.hg: Kya clinic ghar phone karega? Kya police aayegi? Indian law dono sawaalon ka jawaab deta hai, aur zyada tar aurat ke haq mein. Jaano kiski ijaazat chahiye, kise bataya ja sakta hai, aur 18 se kam umar mein kya badalta hai.

statLabel.en: year in prison, at most, for a doctor who reveals a woman's abortion (Section 5A, MTP Act)
statLabel.hg: saal tak ki jail, us doctor ko jo kisi aurat ke abortion ki baat khol de (Section 5A, MTP Act)

label.en: year in prison, at most, for a doctor who reveals a woman's abortion to anyone not authorised by law
label.hg: saal tak ki jail, us doctor ko jo abortion ki baat kisi aise insaan ko bataye jise kanoon ne ijaazat nahi di

label.en: of India's estimated abortions in 2015 were medication abortions done outside health facilities
label.hg: India mein 2015 ke andaazan abortions hospital ya clinic ke bahar dawaiyon se hue

label.en: cases police registered in July-December 2024 for revealing the identity of a sexual-offence survivor
label.hg: cases hi police ne July-December 2024 mein darj kiye, sexual offence survivor ki pehchaan kholne par

claim.en: A doctor has to inform a woman's husband or parents before an abortion.
claim.hg: Abortion se pehle doctor ko aurat ke husband ya parents ko batana hi padta hai.

truth.en: An adult woman's own consent is the only consent the MTP Act requires, and since 2021 Section 5A makes it a crime for a doctor to reveal her abortion to anyone not authorised by law.
truth.hg: MTP Act mein adult aurat ki apni consent hi kaafi hai, aur 2021 se Section 5A ke tahat doctor agar uska abortion kisi aise insaan ko bataye jise kanoon ne ijaazat nahi di, toh yeh jurm hai.

actions.en: If you are 18 or older, sign the consent form yourself. No husband, parent or partner has to sign.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 ya usse badi ho, toh consent form par khud sign karo. Husband, parents ya partner ke sign ki zaroorat nahi hai.

actions.en: Choose a registered doctor or a government hospital over a chemist's counter: the MTP Act's secrecy rule binds doctors.
actions.hg: Chemist ke counter ki jagah registered doctor ya sarkari hospital chuno: MTP Act ka raaz rakhne wala rule doctors par laagu hota hai.

actions.en: If you are under 18, ask at the first visit for your name to be kept out of the police report. You and your guardian can request it.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh pehli visit mein hi kaho ki police report mein tumhara naam na likha jaaye. Tum aur tumhare guardian yeh maang sakte ho.

actions.en: If a doctor reveals your abortion, save the evidence (messages, names, dates) and complain to the police: it is a crime under Section 5A.
actions.hg: Agar doctor tumhare abortion ki baat khol de, toh saboot sambhalo (messages, naam, dates) aur police mein complaint karo: Section 5A ke tahat yeh jurm hai.

actions.en: If someone publishes your identity after rape, report it: Section 72 of the BNS makes that a crime.
actions.hg: Agar rape ke baad koi tumhari pehchaan publish kar de, toh report karo: BNS ka Section 72 ise jurm banata hai.

title.en: Sin, shame, silence: how stigma turns a legal abortion into a hidden risk
title.hg: Paap, sharam, chuppi: kaise stigma ek legal abortion ko chhupa hua khatra bana deta hai

dek.en: Abortion has been legal in India since 1 April 1972, yet many families still call it 'paap'. That silence shows up in the data, at the chemist's counter and inside clinics, and it pushes a safe procedure towards danger. Here is how, and what one sentence at home can change.
dek.hg: India mein abortion 1 April 1972 se legal hai, phir bhi kai ghar ise 'paap' kehte hain. Yeh chuppi data mein dikhti hai, chemist ke counter par aur clinic ke andar bhi, aur ek safe procedure ko khatre ki taraf dhakel deti hai. Jaano kaise, aur ghar mein bola gaya ek vaakya kya badal sakta hai.

label.en: the day the MTP Act came into force, making abortion legal within its conditions
label.hg: woh din jab MTP Act laagu hua, aur uski sharton ke andar abortion legal ho gaya

label.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion said they did it themselves (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: auraton ne kaha ki abortion unhone khud kiya, jinki pichhli pregnancy abortion par khatam hui (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of maternal deaths worldwide in 2009-2020 were linked to abortion; WHO says stigma hides many such deaths
label.hg: maternal deaths duniya bhar mein 2009-2020 ke beech abortion se judi thi; WHO ke mutabik stigma aisi kai maut chhupa deta hai

label.en: in prison, at most, for a doctor who reveals a woman's abortion to anyone not authorised by law
label.hg: tak ki jail, us doctor ko jo kisi aurat ka abortion kisi aise insaan ko bataye jise kanoon ne ijaazat nahi di

claim.en: Abortion is illegal in India, or allowed only for married women.
claim.hg: India mein abortion illegal hai, ya sirf shaadishuda auraton ke liye allowed hai.

truth.en: Abortion has been legal under the MTP Act since 1 April 1972, within its conditions, and today the law treats married and unmarried women alike.
truth.hg: MTP Act ke tahat abortion 1 April 1972 se, uski sharton ke andar, legal hai, aur aaj kanoon married aur unmarried auraton ko barabar maanta hai.

actions.en: Call it what it is: abortion is legal healthcare in India, and has been since 1972.
actions.hg: Jo hai, wahi naam do: India mein abortion legal healthcare hai, aur 1972 se hai.

actions.en: If someone confides in you, answer with 'It's legal. Let's see a doctor', and offer to go with her.
actions.hg: Agar koi tumse apni baat share kare, toh kaho 'Yeh legal hai. Chalo doctor ko dikhate hain', aur uske saath chalne ki offer do.

actions.en: Learn the danger signs after an abortion (very heavy bleeding, fainting, fever, severe pain) and go to a hospital at once if they appear.
actions.hg: Abortion ke baad ke danger signs (bahut zyada bleeding, behoshi, bukhaar, tez dard) yaad rakho, aur dikhte hi turant hospital jao.

actions.en: Never share someone's abortion with family, friends or a WhatsApp group; it is her story to tell.
actions.hg: Kisi ka abortion family, doston ya WhatsApp group mein kabhi share mat karo; yeh uski kahani hai, wahi batayegi.

actions.en: If a doctor reveals a woman's abortion to someone not authorised by law, report it: it is a crime under Section 5A of the MTP Act.
actions.hg: Agar koi doctor kisi aurat ka abortion kisi aise insaan ko bataye jise kanoon ne ijaazat nahi di, toh report karo: MTP Act ke Section 5A ke tahat yeh jurm hai.

title.en: After 24 weeks: who decides, how fast, and why rape survivors must go to court
title.hg: 24 hafte ke baad: decision kaun leta hai, kitni jaldi, aur rape survivors ko court kyun jaana padta hai

dek.en: Past 24 weeks, India's abortion law keeps one planned route open, and only for a substantial foetal abnormality. For a girl or woman who was raped and found out late, the way out runs through a courtroom. Here are the questions families face at that point, answered.
dek.hg: 24 hafte ke baad India ka abortion law sirf ek planned raasta khula rakhta hai, aur woh bhi sirf foetus mein substantial abnormality hone par. Jis ladki ya aurat ke saath rape hua aur jise der se pata chala, uska raasta courtroom se hokar jaata hai. Us waqt families ke saamne jo sawaal hote hain, unke jawab yahan hain.

statLabel.en: days: a Medical Board's deadline to give its opinion on a request to end a pregnancy after 24 weeks
statLabel.hg: din: 24 hafte ke baad pregnancy end karne ki request par Medical Board ko itne din mein opinion deni hoti hai

label.en: weeks: past this, a rape survivor or a minor has no route in the MTP Act except to save her life, and must otherwise go to court
label.hg: hafte ke baad rape survivor ya minor ke liye MTP Act mein jaan bachane ke alawa koi raasta nahi; warna use court jaana padta hai

label.en: days for a Medical Board to give its opinion on a request beyond 24 weeks
label.hg: din mein Medical Board ko 24 hafte se aage wali request par opinion deni hoti hai

label.en: days from the request for the abortion to be done, if the board approves
label.hg: din ke andar (request ke din se) abortion ho jaana chahiye, agar board haan kahe

actions.en: Treat a missed period as urgent: take a pregnancy test within days and see a registered doctor straight away.
actions.hg: Period miss ho to ise taaliye mat: kuch hi dinon mein pregnancy test kijiye aur turant registered doctor se miliye.

actions.en: After rape, do not wait for an FIR before seeing a doctor about a pregnancy: the MTP Act's rape ground does not need one, and every week counts.
actions.hg: Rape ke baad pregnancy ke liye doctor se milne se pehle FIR ka wait mat kijiye: MTP Act ke rape ground ke liye FIR nahi chahiye, aur har hafta keemti hai.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 is pregnant, still go to a registered doctor. If she seeks an abortion, she and her guardian can ask for her name to be kept out of the police report.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki pregnant hai, tab bhi registered doctor ke paas hi jaaiye. Agar woh abortion chahti hai, to ladki aur uske guardian keh sakte hain ki police report mein uska naam na likha jaaye.

actions.en: Past 24 weeks, contact a lawyer the same day. Free legal aid is available through NALSA's helpline 15100.
actions.hg: 24 hafte nikal gaye hon to usi din lawyer se baat kijiye. NALSA ki helpline 15100 par free legal aid milti hai.

actions.en: Call Child Helpline 1098 or Women Helpline 181 for shelter, counselling and support, whatever she decides.
actions.hg: Shelter, counselling aur support ke liye Child Helpline 1098 ya Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, decision chahe jo bhi ho.

title.en: After an abortion: normal recovery, danger signs and the follow-up visit, step by step
title.hg: Abortion ke baad: normal recovery, danger signs aur follow-up visit, step by step

dek.en: In NFHS-5, 15.6% of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion reported complications, and nearly nine in ten of them sought treatment. Here is what normal recovery looks like, which signs mean hospital now, and what the follow-up visit is for.
dek.hg: NFHS-5 mein jin auraton ki pichhli pregnancy abortion par khatam hui, unmein se 15.6% ne complications bataye, aur unmein se lagbhag das mein se nau ilaaj ke liye gayin. Jaano normal recovery kaisi dikhti hai, kaun se signs ka matlab hai abhi hospital, aur follow-up visit kis liye hoti hai.

statLabel.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion reported complications (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
statLabel.hg: auraton ne complications bataye, jinki pichhli pregnancy abortion par khatam hui (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion reported complications (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: auraton ne complications bataye, jinki pichhli pregnancy abortion par khatam hui (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of those women sought treatment, 70.6% of it in the private sector
label.hg: un auraton mein se ilaaj ke liye gayin, aur us ilaaj ka 70.6% private sector mein hua

label.en: of early abortions with the mifepristone-misoprostol combination succeed; the follow-up visit catches the rest
label.hg: early abortions mifepristone-misoprostol combination se kaamyaab hote hain; baaki ko follow-up visit pakadti hai

label.en: deaths per 100,000 abortions where unsafe abortion is common, against under 1 for safe abortion (WHO)
label.hg: maut har 100,000 abortions par, jahan unsafe abortion aam hai; safe abortion mein 1 se bhi kam (WHO)

claim.en: Heavy bleeding after an abortion is normal, so it is best to wait it out quietly at home.
claim.hg: Abortion ke baad zyada bleeding normal hai, isliye chupchaap ghar par intezaar karna hi theek hai.

truth.en: Some bleeding is expected. Bleeding that soaks pads very quickly, or comes with fainting, fever or severe pain, is an emergency that needs a hospital the same day.
truth.hg: Thodi bleeding normal hai. Lekin agar pads bahut jaldi-jaldi bheeg rahe hain, ya saath mein behoshi, bukhaar ya tez dard hai, toh yeh emergency hai: usi din hospital jao.

actions.en: Keep the follow-up appointment even if you feel fine: it is how an incomplete abortion is caught.
actions.hg: Follow-up appointment par zaroor jao, chahe tum theek mehsoos karo: incomplete abortion isi se pakda jaata hai.

actions.en: Go to a hospital or call 112 for very heavy bleeding, fainting, fever, severe pain or a foul-smelling discharge. Do not wait for morning.
actions.hg: Bahut zyada bleeding, behoshi, bukhaar, tez dard ya badbudaar discharge ho toh hospital jao ya 112 par call karo. Subah ka intezaar mat karo.

actions.en: Tell the doctor exactly which tablets you took and when, including any bought without a prescription.
actions.hg: Doctor ko saaf-saaf batao ki tumne kaun si goliyan kab li, bina prescription wali bhi.

actions.en: Choose a contraceptive method before you leave the clinic: you can get pregnant again before your next period.
actions.hg: Clinic se nikalne se pehle contraception ka koi method chun lo: agle period se pehle hi tum phir pregnant ho sakti ho.

actions.en: If your mood stays low or you think of harming yourself, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and open round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar mood lagaataar low rahe ya khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ke khayal aayein, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call karo, yeh free hai aur din-raat khula hai.

title.en: Blamed for daughters: the myth that a mother decides her baby's sex, and the sex selection it feeds
title.hg: Betiyan hone ka blame: yeh myth ki bachche ka sex maa tay karti hai, aur woh sex selection jise yeh badhava deta hai

dek.en: A woman with 'only daughters' is still taunted, pressured and taken for illegal scans. Biology says her body never chose. Here is what does decide, where the blame leads, and what to say when it starts.
dek.hg: 'Sirf betiyon' wali aurat ko aaj bhi taane milte hain, pressure milta hai, aur illegal scan ke liye le jaaya jaata hai. Biology kehti hai ki uski body ne kabhi kuch choose hi nahi kiya. Padhiye ki asal mein kya tay karta hai, yeh blame kahan le jaata hai, aur jab yeh shuru ho toh kya kehna hai.

statLabel.en: of women in a seven-state survey said having at least one son is very important (2014)
statLabel.hg: aurton ne ek saat-state survey mein kaha ki kam se kam ek beta hona bahut zaroori hai (2014)

label.en: of women, and 76% of men, said having at least one son is very important (seven states, 2014)
label.hg: aurton ne, aur 76% mardon ne, kaha ki kam se kam ek beta hona bahut zaroori hai (saat states, 2014)

label.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion openly named a female foetus as the main reason (2019-21), almost certainly an undercount
label.hg: aurton ne, jinki last pregnancy abortion par khatam hui, khul kar kaha ki main wajah pet mein ladki thi (2019-21); asli figure almost pakka isse zyada hai

label.en: girls went 'missing' at birth in India every year between 2013 and 2017 (UNFPA)
label.hg: ladkiyan India mein 2013 se 2017 ke beech har saal janam ke waqt 'missing' hui (UNFPA)

claim.en: A woman who keeps having daughters is to blame: her body, her diet or her fate decides the baby's sex.
claim.hg: Jo aurat baar-baar betiyan paida karti hai, galti uski hai: uski body, uska khana ya uski kismat bachche ka sex tay karti hai.

truth.en: A baby's sex is set at fertilisation by the sperm, by chance. Every egg carries an X chromosome; each sperm carries an X or a Y. Nothing a woman eats, prays for or does can change which sperm reaches the egg.
truth.hg: Bachche ka sex fertilisation ke waqt sperm se, chance se, tay hota hai. Har egg mein X chromosome hota hai; har sperm mein X ya Y. Aurat kya khaati hai, kya dua maangti hai ya kya karti hai, isse yeh nahi badalta ki kaun sa sperm egg tak pahunchega.

actions.en: When the blame starts, say the biology plainly: the sperm, by chance, sets a baby's sex. Nobody's body chooses.
actions.hg: Jab blame shuru ho, toh biology saaf-saaf boliye: bachche ka sex sperm chance se tay karta hai. Kisi ki body choose nahi karti.

actions.en: Refuse any scan or 'test' meant to find out the baby's sex. Revealing it is a crime, and so is asking for it.
actions.hg: Bachche ka sex pata karne wale kisi bhi scan ya 'test' se mana kar dijiye. Sex batana crime hai, aur iski maang karna bhi.

actions.en: Report a clinic or person offering sex determination to the district Appropriate Authority, the health officials who enforce the PC-PNDT Act.
actions.hg: Sex determination offer karne wale clinic ya insaan ki report district Appropriate Authority ko kijiye, yaani un health officials ko jo PC-PNDT Act lagu karte hain.

actions.en: If you are being pushed to test or end a pregnancy because it may be a girl, call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 if you are in danger.
actions.hg: Agar aap par test karwane ya pregnancy girane ka pressure hai kyunki ladki ho sakti hai, toh Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, ya khatre mein hon toh 112 par.

actions.en: If it is your bhabhi, sister or friend, talk to her alone first, then stand beside her when the family raises it.
actions.hg: Agar yeh aapki bhabhi, behen ya dost ke saath ho raha hai, toh pehle usse akele mein baat kijiye, phir jab family yeh baat uthaye toh uske saath khade rahiye.

title.en: The condom broke: how India's abortion law treats contraceptive failure, from 'married woman' in 1971 to 'any woman' in 2021
title.hg: Condom phat gaya: India ka abortion law contraceptive failure ko kaise dekhta hai, 1971 ki 'married woman' se 2021 ki 'any woman' tak

dek.en: For 50 years the MTP Act gave a failed contraceptive special legal weight only if a wife or her husband had used it. Since 2021 it covers any woman and any partner. Here is how that ground works at a clinic, where it stops, and the step that comes before it.
dek.hg: 50 saal tak MTP Act ne fail hue contraceptive ko khaas legal weight tabhi diya jab use biwi ya uske pati ne use kiya ho. 2021 se yeh har aurat aur har partner par lagu hota hai. Padhiye ki clinic mein yeh ground kaise kaam karta hai, kahan ruk jaata hai, aur usse pehle wala step kya hai.

statLabel.en: of women named contraceptive failure as the main reason for their abortion (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
statLabel.hg: aurton ne abortion ki main wajah contraceptive failure batayi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women named contraceptive failure as the main reason for their abortion (2019-21)
label.hg: aurton ne apne abortion ki main wajah contraceptive failure batayi (2019-21)

label.en: named an unplanned pregnancy, the most common answer (2019-21)
label.hg: ne unplanned pregnancy batayi, jo sabse aam jawab tha (2019-21)

label.en: how far one doctor's opinion reaches; contraceptive failure alone does not open the 20-24-week window
label.hg: tak ek doctor ki opinion kaafi hai; sirf contraceptive failure se 20-24 hafte wali window nahi khulti

label.en: women relying on the external condom get pregnant within a year of typical use (WHO)
label.hg: aurtein jo external condom par nirbhar hain, typical use mein ek saal ke andar pregnant ho jaati hain (WHO)

claim.en: If you are not married and your contraception failed, the abortion law does not cover you.
claim.hg: Agar aap unmarried hain aur aapka contraception fail ho gaya, toh abortion law aap par lagu nahi hota.

truth.en: Since 2021 the MTP Act's contraceptive-failure ground covers 'any woman or her partner'. Up to 20 weeks, a doctor may presume that an unwanted pregnancy after a failed method gravely injures her mental health.
truth.hg: 2021 se MTP Act ka contraceptive-failure ground 'any woman or her partner' par lagu hota hai. 20 hafte tak doctor maan sakta hai ki fail hue method ke baad hui unwanted pregnancy aurat ki mental health ko gambhir nuksaan pahunchati hai.

actions.en: If a condom breaks or slips, get emergency contraception as soon as you can. It works up to five days afterwards, and sooner is better.
actions.hg: Agar condom phat jaaye ya slip ho jaaye, toh jitni jaldi ho sake emergency contraception lijiye. Yeh paanch din baad tak kaam karta hai, aur jitni jaldi utna behtar.

actions.en: If there is any chance of HIV exposure, see a doctor urgently: PEP has to start within 72 hours.
actions.hg: Agar HIV exposure ka zara bhi chance ho, toh turant doctor se miliye: PEP 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye.

actions.en: If your period is late, take a test and see a registered doctor early. You do not need to be married or to bring your partner.
actions.hg: Period late ho toh test kijiye aur jaldi kisi registered doctor se miliye. Iske liye na shaadishuda hona zaroori hai, na partner ko saath laana.

actions.en: Do not wait past 20 weeks. After that, contraceptive failure on its own is no longer a legal ground.
actions.hg: 20 hafte se aage mat jaane dijiye. Uske baad sirf contraceptive failure legal ground nahi rehta.

actions.en: Never take abortion pills without a doctor's prescription and follow-up.
actions.hg: Doctor ke prescription aur follow-up ke bina abortion pills kabhi mat lijiye.

title.en: From 'lunatic' to reproductive autonomy: how India's abortion law treats women with disabilities
title.hg: 'Lunatic' se reproductive autonomy tak: India ka abortion law disabled aurton ke saath kaisa bartaav karta hai

dek.en: In 1971 the law let a guardian decide for an adult woman it called a 'lunatic'. Today a separate law makes it a crime to end a disabled woman's pregnancy without her express consent. Here is what changed, what did not, and what to insist on at a hospital.
dek.hg: 1971 mein law ne jis adult aurat ko 'lunatic' kaha, uska faisla guardian ko de diya. Aaj ek doosra law kehta hai ki disabled aurat ki saaf consent ke bina uska abortion karna crime hai. Kya badla, kya nahi badla, aur hospital mein kin baaton par tike rehna hai.

label.en: weeks: the limit up to which women with major physical disabilities and mentally ill women may end a pregnancy (Rule 3B, 2021)
label.hg: hafte tak: serious physical disability wali aur mentally ill aurtein abortion karwa sakti hain (Rule 3B, 2021)
