label.en: years in prison, at most, for ending a disabled woman's pregnancy without her express consent (RPwD Act, 2016)
label.hg: saal tak ki jail, agar koi disabled aurat ki saaf consent ke bina uska abortion kare (RPwD Act, 2016)

label.en: of Indians were counted as disabled in Census 2011, against a 15% global estimate
label.hg: Indians ko Census 2011 ne disabled gina, jabki duniya ka estimate 15% hai

label.en: cases registered across India under the entire disability rights law in 2024
label.hg: cases 2024 mein poore India mein darj hue, disability rights wale poore law ke under

claim.en: A woman with a disability cannot decide about her own pregnancy, so her family decides for her.
claim.hg: Disabled aurat apni pregnancy ke baare mein faisla nahi le sakti, isliye family hi decide karegi.

truth.en: Under the MTP Act, a physical disability does not take away an adult woman's right to consent. Ending a disabled woman's pregnancy without her express consent is a crime, except in severe cases with a doctor's opinion and a guardian's consent.
truth.hg: MTP Act ke hisaab se physical disability kisi adult aurat se consent dene ka haq nahi chheenti. Disabled aurat ki saaf consent ke bina uska abortion karna crime hai. Chhoot sirf severe disability ke cases mein hai, aur woh bhi doctor ki raay aur guardian ki consent ke saath.

actions.en: If she is an adult with a physical disability, she signs her own consent form. No relative can sign in her place.
actions.hg: Agar woh adult hai aur use physical disability hai, toh consent form par sign woh khud karegi. Koi rishtedaar uski jagah sign nahi kar sakta.

actions.en: Ask the hospital to explain her options in a way she understands, such as sign language, simple words or audio, and to speak to her, not only to the family.
actions.hg: Hospital se kahiye ki use uske samajhne ke tareeke se sab bataya jaaye, jaise sign language, aasaan shabd ya audio. Aur doctor seedha usse baat kare, sirf family se nahi.

actions.en: Do not lose time: women with major physical disabilities and mentally ill women can seek an abortion up to 24 weeks, with two doctors' opinion.
actions.hg: Der mat kijiye. Serious physical disability wali aur mentally ill aurtein 24 hafte tak, do doctors ki raay par, abortion karwa sakti hain.

actions.en: If she was sexually assaulted, police must record her complaint at her home or a place she chooses, with an interpreter or special educator.
actions.hg: Agar uske saath sexual violence hua hai, toh police ko uski complaint uske ghar par ya uski chuni jagah par, interpreter ya special educator ke saath, darj karni hogi.

actions.en: For free legal help, call NALSA on 15100.
actions.hg: Free legal help ke liye NALSA ki helpline 15100 par call karein.

title.en: The emergency pill is not an abortion pill: what each one does, and why mixing them up costs time
title.hg: Emergency pill abortion pill nahi hai: dono kya karti hain, aur dono ko ek samajhne se waqt kyun barbaad hota hai

dek.en: One works before a pregnancy exists; the other ends a pregnancy that does. They run on different clocks and different rules, and confusing them burns the days that matter most.
dek.hg: Ek pill pregnancy shuru hone se pehle kaam karti hai; doosri shuru ho chuki pregnancy ko khatam karti hai. Dono ki ghadi alag hai, rules alag hain, aur dono ko ek samajhne mein woh din nikal jaate hain jo sabse zyada keemti hain.

statLabel.en: the approved limit for abortion pills, used under a doctor's care (Health Ministry, 2023)
statLabel.hg: abortion pills ki approved limit, doctor ki dekh-rekh mein (Health Ministry, 2023)

label.en: the window for emergency contraception after unprotected sex; the sooner, the better (WHO)
label.hg: unprotected sex ke baad emergency contraception ka time; jitni jaldi, utna behtar (WHO)

label.en: the approved limit for abortion pills, counted from the first day of the last period (Health Ministry, 2023)
label.hg: abortion pills ki approved limit, last period ke pehle din se gini jaati hai (Health Ministry, 2023)

label.en: estimated pregnancies in India in 2015; nearly half were unintended
label.hg: pregnancies ka estimate, India mein 2015 mein; lagbhag aadhi unintended thi

label.en: of pill abortions done outside health facilities in 2015 used a ready-made combipack
label.hg: pill abortions mein, jo 2015 mein health facilities ke bahar hue, ready-made combipack use hua

claim.en: The morning-after pill and the abortion pill are the same medicine; one is just stronger.
claim.hg: Morning-after pill aur abortion pill ek hi dawa hain; bas ek zyada strong hai.

truth.en: Emergency contraception delays ovulation and cannot end a pregnancy that has already begun. Abortion pills end a pregnancy, and India approves them only up to nine weeks, prescribed by a qualified doctor.
truth.hg: Emergency contraception ovulation ko delay karti hai aur shuru ho chuki pregnancy ko khatam nahi kar sakti. Abortion pills pregnancy khatam karti hain, aur India mein yeh sirf 9 hafte tak, qualified doctor ke prescription par approved hain.

actions.en: After unprotected sex, a condom that broke or forced sex, take emergency contraception as soon as you can. It works up to five days later, and sooner is better.
actions.hg: Unprotected sex, condom phatne ya zabardasti hue sex ke baad, jitni jaldi ho sake emergency contraception lo. Yeh 5 din baad tak kaam karti hai, aur jitni jaldi lo utna behtar.

actions.en: Ask a doctor or government health centre about a copper IUD within those five days: it is the most effective emergency contraception.
actions.hg: Unhi 5 dinon ke andar kisi doctor ya sarkari health centre se copper IUD ke baare mein poocho: yeh sabse effective emergency contraception hai.

actions.en: If your period is late after taking EC, take a pregnancy test and see a doctor. EC cannot end a pregnancy.
actions.hg: EC lene ke baad period late ho, toh pregnancy test karo aur doctor ko dikhao. EC pregnancy khatam nahi kar sakti.

actions.en: Never take an abortion kit 'just in case' after sex. Abortion pills are for a confirmed pregnancy, on a doctor's prescription.
actions.hg: Sex ke baad 'just in case' abortion kit kabhi mat lo. Abortion pills confirmed pregnancy ke liye hain, doctor ke prescription par.

actions.en: Treat EC as a backup, not a routine. Ask a doctor about a regular method that suits you.
actions.hg: EC ko backup samjho, routine nahi. Doctor se apne liye sahi regular method ke baare mein baat karo.

title.en: Legal clinic or dangerous quack? How to find a safe abortion provider in India
title.hg: Legal clinic ya khatarnaak jhola-chhaap? India mein safe abortion provider kaise dhoondhein

dek.en: Only a registered doctor at an approved place may end a pregnancy, and anyone else risks two to seven years in prison. Yet in NFHS-5, 26.2% of women who had an abortion had it at home. Here is how to find the right clinic, and when to walk out of the wrong one.
dek.hg: Pregnancy sirf registered doctor hi khatam kar sakta hai, woh bhi approved jagah par; baaki kisi ke liye do se saat saal ki jail ka risk hai. Phir bhi NFHS-5 mein, jin auraton ka abortion hua, unmein se 26.2% ka abortion ghar par hua. Jaano sahi clinic kaise dhoondhein, aur galat clinic se kab uth kar chal dein.

statLabel.en: of rigorous imprisonment for an abortion by an unqualified person or at an unapproved place
statLabel.hg: ki rigorous imprisonment, agar abortion koi unqualified insaan kare ya kisi unapproved jagah par ho

label.en: of rigorous imprisonment for an abortion by an unqualified person or at an unapproved place (since 2002)
label.hg: ki rigorous imprisonment, agar abortion koi unqualified insaan kare ya kisi unapproved jagah par ho (2002 se)

label.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion had it at home (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: auraton ka abortion ghar par hua, jinki pichhli pregnancy abortion par khatam hui (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of those abortions were performed by a doctor
label.hg: abortions hi doctor ne kiye

label.en: the limit for abortion pills prescribed by a qualified doctor, under Health Ministry guidelines
label.hg: tak ki pregnancy mein hi qualified doctor abortion pills de sakta hai, Health Ministry ki guidelines ke hisaab se

claim.en: Any clinic with 'Dr' on the board, or a chemist with the right pills, can provide an abortion.
claim.hg: Board par 'Dr' likha ho toh koi bhi clinic, ya sahi goliyon wala chemist, abortion kar sakta hai.

truth.en: Only a registered medical practitioner, at a place approved under the MTP Act, may end a pregnancy. Anyone else risks two to seven years of rigorous imprisonment.
truth.hg: Pregnancy sirf registered medical practitioner hi khatam kar sakta hai, woh bhi MTP Act ke tahat approved jagah par. Baaki kisi ko do se saat saal ki rigorous imprisonment ho sakti hai.

actions.en: Start with the gynaecology department of a government hospital, or a private clinic that can show its approval for MTP.
actions.hg: Shuruaat sarkari hospital ke gynaecology department se karo, ya aise private clinic se jo MTP ka approval dikha sake.

actions.en: Before paying, ask for the doctor's registration number and how they will confirm how many weeks pregnant you are.
actions.hg: Paise dene se pehle doctor ka registration number poocho, aur yeh bhi ki woh kaise confirm karenge ki pregnancy kitne hafte ki hai.

actions.en: Walk out of any place that sells a 'kit' without examining you, refuses to plan a follow-up, or hints at the sex of the foetus.
actions.hg: Jo jagah bina examine kiye 'kit' bech de, follow-up plan karne se mana kare, ya foetus ke sex ka ishaara de, wahan se uth kar chal do.

actions.en: If you are 18 or older, sign the consent form yourself; no husband or parent has to sign.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 ya usse badi ho, toh consent form par khud sign karo; husband ya parents ke sign ki zaroorat nahi hai.

actions.en: If something goes wrong after any abortion, go to a government hospital or call 112, and tell the doctor exactly what you took.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi abortion ke baad kuch gadbad ho toh sarkari hospital jao ya 112 par call karo, aur doctor ko saaf-saaf batao ki tumne kya liya.

title.en: From the Shah Committee to the Supreme Court: India's abortion law, 1964-2022
title.hg: Shah Committee se Supreme Court tak: India ka abortion law, 1964-2022

dek.en: Every turn in India's abortion law answered a specific failure, from a committee that called the old law too restrictive to a Supreme Court that read in reproductive autonomy. Follow the timeline and you can also see which failures are still waiting.
dek.hg: India ke abortion law ka har mod kisi khaas failure ka jawab tha, us committee se jisne purane law ko 'too restrictive' kaha, us Supreme Court tak jisne reproductive autonomy ko law mein padha. Timeline follow karo, toh yeh bhi dikhta hai ki kaun se failures ab bhi jawab ka wait kar rahe hain.

statLabel.en: India's abortion law came into force on 1 April that year
statLabel.hg: is saal 1 April ko India ka abortion law lagu hua

label.en: the year the Shah Committee called the old abortion law 'too restrictive'
label.hg: jis saal Shah Committee ne purane abortion law ko 'too restrictive' kaha

label.en: weeks: the ceiling set in 1971, unchanged until 2021
label.hg: hafte: 1971 mein set hui limit, jo 2021 tak nahi badli

label.en: years of rigorous imprisonment for abortions by unqualified providers since 2002
label.hg: saal ki rigorous imprisonment, 2002 se, jab abortion koi unqualified insaan kare

label.en: the BNS section that, since 2024, keeps the old crime of causing miscarriage
label.hg: BNS ka woh section jo 2024 se miscarriage cause karne ka purana crime bachaye rakhta hai

claim.en: India legalised abortion in 1971, so abortion is no longer a crime.
claim.hg: India ne 1971 mein abortion legal kar diya, toh ab abortion crime nahi hai.

truth.en: The MTP Act shields registered doctors who act within its conditions. Outside them, causing a miscarriage is still a crime under Section 88 of the BNS, copied word for word from the old Indian Penal Code.
truth.hg: MTP Act sirf un registered doctors ko protect karta hai jo uski conditions ke andar kaam karte hain. Unke bahar miscarriage cause karna aaj bhi BNS ke Section 88 ke under crime hai, jo purane Indian Penal Code se word for word copy hua hai.

actions.en: Use the protection the law gives: go to a registered doctor at a government hospital or an approved clinic, where an abortion within the Act's conditions is legal.
actions.hg: Law ki protection use karo: sarkari hospital ya approved clinic mein registered doctor ke paas jao, jahan Act ki conditions ke andar abortion poori tarah legal hai.

actions.en: Take abortion pills only on a qualified doctor's prescription: they are approved only up to nine weeks, and a prescription keeps you inside the law's protection.
actions.hg: Abortion pills sirf qualified doctor ke prescription par lo: yeh sirf 9 hafte tak ke liye approved hain, aur prescription se tum law ki protection mein rehti ho.

actions.en: Never ask a clinic to reveal a foetus's sex: telling it, even by a sign, is a crime under the PCPNDT Act.
actions.hg: Kisi clinic se foetus ka sex batane ko mat kaho: ishaare se batana bhi PCPNDT Act ke under crime hai.

actions.en: If you are past 24 weeks after rape, get legal help at once: half a century on, outside a medical emergency, a court is still the only route.
actions.hg: Rape ke baad 24 hafte nikal gaye hon, toh turant legal help lo: aadhi sadi baad bhi, medical emergency ke alawa, court hi akela raasta hai.

title.en: Not a crime, yet rape under abortion law: the 2022 ruling for wives forced into pregnancy
title.hg: Pati ki zabardasti se pregnancy: police ke liye rape nahi, par abortion law mein hai

dek.en: Indian criminal law still says a husband cannot rape his adult wife. The Supreme Court has read the abortion law to say he can. Here is how a wife pregnant from forced sex can use that ruling, and what the December 2026 hearing could change.
dek.hg: Criminal law aaj bhi kehta hai ki pati apni adult wife ka rape nahi kar sakta. Lekin Supreme Court ne 2022 mein kaha ki abortion law mein yeh rape hai. Jaaniye, aisi wife is faisle ka use kaise kare, aur December 2026 ki hearing se kya badal sakta hai.

statLabel.en: of ever-married women reporting sexual violence named their current husband (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: sexual violence jhel chuki ever-married auraton ne apne current husband ka naam liya (NFHS-5)

label.en: of ever-married women aged 18-49 who reported sexual violence named their current husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: sexual violence jhel chuki 18-49 saal ki ever-married auraton ne apne current husband ka naam liya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of ever-married women said a husband had physically forced them to have sex (NFHS-5)
label.hg: ever-married auraton ne kaha ki husband ne zabardasti sex kiya (NFHS-5)

label.en: weeks: the abortion limit for a rape survivor, which since 2022 includes rape by a husband
label.hg: hafte: rape survivor ke liye abortion ki limit; 2022 se isme husband ka rape bhi shamil hai

label.en: of women abused only by their current husband ever sought help (NFHS-5)
label.hg: auraton ne hi kabhi madad maangi, jinke saath sirf current husband ne hinsa ki (NFHS-5)

claim.en: A husband cannot rape his wife, so a wife forced into pregnancy has no special right to end it.
claim.hg: Pati apni wife ka rape nahi kar sakta, isliye zabardasti pregnant hui wife ko abortion ka koi khaas haq nahi hai.

truth.en: Since 29 September 2022 the Supreme Court has read 'rape' in the abortion law to include marital rape, so she can seek an abortion up to 24 weeks as a survivor, with no FIR and no proof in court.
truth.hg: 29 September 2022 se Supreme Court ke hisaab se abortion law mein 'rape' mein marital rape bhi shamil hai. Aisi wife survivor ke taur par 24 hafte tak abortion kara sakti hai. Na FIR chahiye, na court mein saboot.

actions.en: If you are pregnant from sex your husband forced on you, tell the doctor: the abortion law treats it as rape, up to 24 weeks.
actions.hg: Agar pati ki zabardasti se aap pregnant hain, toh doctor ko saaf bataiye: abortion law ise rape maanta hai, 24 hafte tak.

actions.en: You do not need your husband's signature or an FIR. If you are 18 or older, your own consent is the only consent the law asks for.
actions.hg: Pati ke signature ya FIR ki zaroorat nahi hai. Agar aap 18 ya usse zyada umar ki hain, toh law sirf aapki apni consent maangta hai.

actions.en: If a clinic hesitates, name the ruling: X v. Principal Secretary, Supreme Court, 29 September 2022.
actions.hg: Agar clinic hichkichaye, toh faisle ka naam bataiye: X v. Principal Secretary, Supreme Court, 29 September 2022.

actions.en: Do not take abortion pills without a doctor. Go to a registered doctor or a government hospital.
actions.hg: Doctor ke bina abortion pills mat lijiye. Registered doctor ya sarkari hospital jaaiye.

actions.en: For safety, shelter or a free lawyer, contact a One Stop Centre or the District Legal Services Authority, or call Women Helpline 181. In an emergency, call 112.
actions.hg: Safety, rehne ki jagah ya free lawyer ke liye One Stop Centre ya District Legal Services Authority se contact kijiye, ya Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye. Emergency mein 112 par call kijiye.

title.en: Odisha 153, Kerala 30: in India, where a woman lives sets her odds of surviving pregnancy
title.hg: Odisha 153, Kerala 30: India mein aurat kis state mein rehti hai, yahi pregnancy mein uske bachne ke chances tay karta hai

dek.en: India's maternal mortality ratio has stalled at 88, 88 and 87 in the last three bulletins. Behind that average, a woman in Odisha faced about five times Kerala's risk in 2021-23, and the newest figures reshuffle the top of the ladder without closing the gap.
dek.hg: India ka maternal mortality ratio pichhle teen bulletins mein 88, 88 aur 87 par atka hua hai. Is average ke peeche, 2021-23 mein Odisha ki aurat ko Kerala se kareeb paanch guna khatra tha, aur naye figures ladder ka top to badalte hain, par gap band nahi karte.

statLabel.en: maternal deaths per 100,000 live births in Odisha, against 30 in Kerala (2021-23)
statLabel.hg: maternal deaths har 100,000 live births par Odisha mein; Kerala mein 30 (2021-23)

label.en: maternal deaths per 100,000 live births in India in 2021-23, unchanged from 2020-22
label.hg: maternal deaths har 100,000 live births par India mein 2021-23 mein, 2020-22 jitna hi

label.en: lifetime risk of maternal death in Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh in 2021-23, against 0.18% for India
label.hg: Madhya Pradesh aur Uttar Pradesh mein 2021-23 mein maternal death ka lifetime risk; poore India ka 0.18%

label.en: maternal deaths per 100,000 live births in Uttar Pradesh in 2022-24, against 24 in Kerala
label.hg: maternal deaths har 100,000 live births par Uttar Pradesh mein 2022-24 mein; Kerala mein 24

label.en: of abortions in Chhattisgarh were classed as unsafe in 2007-2011, the highest of nine states studied
label.hg: abortions Chhattisgarh mein 2007-2011 mein unsafe maane gaye, study wale nau states mein sabse zyada

actions.en: If you or someone at home is pregnant, register the pregnancy early at a government health centre and go to every check-up.
actions.hg: Agar tum ya ghar mein koi pregnant hai, to pregnancy jaldi kisi sarkari health centre mein register karwao aur har check-up par jao.

actions.en: Before the due date, plan how you will reach a hospital that can handle an emergency, day or night. In an emergency, call 112.
actions.hg: Due date se pehle hi plan kar lo ki din ho ya raat, emergency sambhaal sakne wale hospital tak kaise pahunchoge. Emergency mein 112 call karo.

actions.en: If a pregnancy is unwanted, see a registered doctor early instead of buying pills over the counter or going to an untrained provider.
actions.hg: Agar pregnancy nahi chahiye, to counter se pills khareedne ya kisi untrained insaan ke paas jaane ke bajaye jaldi registered doctor se milo.

actions.en: When you share a state's maternal death figure, give its period and its range, and compare groups of states rather than single ranks.
actions.hg: Kisi state ka maternal death figure share karo to uska period aur range bhi batao, aur akeli rank ke bajaye states ke groups ki tulna karo.

title.en: 81% by pill: how medication abortion quietly replaced the clinic in India
title.hg: 81% pills se: kaise medication abortion ne India mein chupchaap clinic ki jagah le li

dek.en: In 2015 four in five abortions in India were done with tablets, most of them taken far from any clinic. The law still pictures a doctor and an approved site. Here is how the shift happened, what it fixed, what it left exposed, and why the answer is safer pills, not fewer.
dek.hg: 2015 mein India mein har paanch mein se chaar abortions tablets se hue, aur zyada tar kisi clinic se door. Law aaj bhi ek doctor aur approved jagah ki tasveer dekhta hai. Yeh badlav kaise aaya, isne kya theek kiya, kya khula chhod diya, aur jawab kam pills nahi, zyada safe pills kyun hain.

statLabel.en: of India's estimated abortions in 2015 were medication abortions
statLabel.hg: India ke 2015 ke estimated abortions medication abortions the

label.en: of India's estimated 15.6 million abortions in 2015 were medication abortions
label.hg: India ke 2015 ke lagbhag 15.6 million abortions mein se medication abortions the

label.en: medication abortions were done outside any health facility in 2015
label.hg: medication abortions 2015 mein kisi bhi health facility ke bahar hue

label.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion said they performed it themselves (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: aurton ne, jinki last pregnancy abortion par khatam hui, kaha ki unhone yeh khud kiya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: success rate of the two-medicine method in early abortion, approved up to nine weeks (Health Ministry, 2023)
label.hg: do dawaiyon wale method ka success rate shuruaati abortion mein, 9 hafte tak approved (Health Ministry, 2023)

actions.en: If you need an abortion, see a registered doctor or a government hospital early: abortion pills are approved up to nine weeks, counted from the first day of your last period.
actions.hg: Agar abortion karwana hai, toh jaldi kisi registered doctor ya sarkari hospital mein jao: abortion pills 9 hafte tak approved hain, jo tumhare last period ke pehle din se gine jaate hain.

actions.en: Do not take an abortion kit until a qualified doctor has checked how many weeks pregnant you are and that the pregnancy is in the uterus.
actions.hg: Jab tak koi qualified doctor yeh check na kar le ki tum kitne hafte pregnant ho aur pregnancy uterus mein hai, tab tak abortion kit mat lo.

actions.en: After taking pills, go to a hospital at once for very heavy bleeding, fever, fainting or pain that keeps getting worse, and say exactly what you took.
actions.hg: Pills lene ke baad bahut zyada bleeding, bukhaar, behoshi ya badhta hua dard ho, toh turant hospital jao, aur saaf batao ki tumne kya liya.

actions.en: If you work at a chemist's counter, send anyone asking for an abortion kit to a registered doctor or a government hospital.
actions.hg: Agar tum chemist ke counter par kaam karte ho, toh abortion kit maangne wale har insaan ko registered doctor ya sarkari hospital bhejo.

title.en: 45.8 million missing: India's lost daughters, by the numbers
title.hg: 45.8 million missing: India ki khoyi hui betiyan, numbers mein

dek.en: UNFPA counts 45.8 million 'missing' females in India. Pew counts at least 9 million missing births in 20 years. Both can be right, because they measure different things. Here is what each number means, and why no two estimates agree.
dek.hg: UNFPA ke hisaab se India mein 45.8 million females 'missing' hain. Pew ke hisaab se 20 saal mein kam se kam 9 million births missing hui. Dono sahi ho sakte hain, kyunki dono alag cheezein naapte hain. Har number ka matlab kya hai, aur koi do estimates match kyun nahi karte.

statLabel.en: 'missing' females in India in 2020 (UNFPA)
statLabel.hg: females India mein 2020 mein 'missing' (UNFPA)

label.en: 'missing' females worldwide in 2020: China 72.3 million, India 45.8 million (UNFPA)
label.hg: females duniya bhar mein 2020 mein 'missing': China 72.3 million, India 45.8 million (UNFPA)

label.en: female births 'missing' in India between 2000 and 2019 because of sex-selective abortion (Pew)
label.hg: female births India mein 2000 se 2019 ke beech sex-selective abortion ki wajah se 'missing' (Pew)

label.en: of the world's 1.2-1.5 million missing female births a year are in China and India (UNFPA)
label.hg: duniya ki har saal ki 1.2-1.5 million missing female births China aur India mein hoti hain (UNFPA)

label.en: boys born per 100 girls in India in NFHS-5 (2019-21), against about 105 in nature (Pew)
label.hg: ladke har 100 ladkiyon par paida hue India mein NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein, jabki natural level lagbhag 105 hai (Pew)

actions.en: When you quote a 'missing girls' number, give its year and say whether it counts missing births only or deaths after birth too.
actions.hg: Jab bhi 'missing girls' ka koi number quote karo, uska saal batao, aur yeh bhi ki woh sirf missing births ginta hai ya janm ke baad ki maut bhi.

actions.en: Treat a sick daughter exactly as you would a sick son: take her to a doctor just as fast, and spend as much on her care.
actions.hg: Beemar beti ke saath bilkul waisa hi bartaav karo jaisa beemar bete ke saath karte: utni hi jaldi doctor ke paas le jao, aur uske ilaaj par utna hi kharch karo.

actions.en: If a clinic offers to reveal a foetus's sex, report it to the district Appropriate Authority under the PC-PNDT Act.
actions.hg: Agar koi clinic foetus ka sex batane ki offer kare, toh PC-PNDT Act ke district Appropriate Authority se complaint karo.

actions.en: If you are being pushed to find out a baby's sex, or to end a pregnancy because it is a girl, call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 in danger.
actions.hg: Agar tum par baby ka sex pata karne, ya ladki hone ki wajah se pregnancy khatam karne ka dabaav hai, toh Women Helpline 181 par call karo, khatre mein 112 par.

title.en: The 0.8 million: India's most dangerous abortions have not disappeared
title.hg: 0.8 million: India ke sabse khatarnak abortions abhi khatam nahi hue

dek.en: Pills changed how India ends pregnancies, but not for everyone. The best national estimate still found 0.8 million abortions done by methods judged probably unsafe. Who ends up there, what the law threatens, and what would bring every woman to safe care.
dek.hg: Pills ne badal diya ki India mein pregnancy kaise khatam ki jaati hai, lekin sabke liye nahi. Sabse achhe national estimate mein bhi 0.8 million aise abortions mile jo 'shayad unsafe' maane gaye methods se hue. Wahan kaun pahunchta hai, law kya dhamki deta hai, aur har aurat ko safe care tak kya laayega.

statLabel.en: abortions in India in 2015 used methods judged probably unsafe
statLabel.hg: abortions 2015 mein India mein aise methods se hue jinhe shayad unsafe maana gaya

label.en: abortions in India in 2015 used methods researchers judged probably unsafe
label.hg: abortions 2015 mein India mein aise methods se hue jinhe researchers ne shayad unsafe maana

label.en: of post-abortion care patients in six states were being treated for serious complications (2015)
label.hg: post-abortion care ke patients ka chhe states mein serious complications ke liye ilaaj chal raha tha (2015)

label.en: of induced abortions worldwide are unsafe; a third of those happen in the least safe conditions (2010-2014)
label.hg: induced abortions duniya bhar mein unsafe hote hain; unmein se ek-tihaai sabse unsafe halaat mein (2010-2014)

label.en: cases registered by police under the MTP Act in all of India in 2024
label.hg: cases poore India mein police ne 2024 mein MTP Act ke under darj kiye

claim.en: Now that abortion pills exist, dangerous abortions are a thing of the past in India.
claim.hg: Ab abortion pills aa gayi hain, toh India mein khatarnak abortions beete zamaane ki baat hain.

truth.en: In 2015 an estimated 0.8 million abortions used methods researchers judged probably unsafe, and in six states studied, 4-16% of women in post-abortion care were being treated for serious complications.
truth.hg: 2015 mein andaazan 0.8 million abortions aise methods se hue jinhe researchers ne shayad unsafe maana, aur jin chhe states ki study hui wahan post-abortion care mein 4-16% aurton ka serious complications ka ilaaj chal raha tha.

actions.en: Heavy bleeding, fever, severe abdominal pain or fainting after an abortion or after taking pills means a hospital now. Go to the nearest government hospital or call 112.
actions.hg: Abortion ya pills ke baad bahut zyada bleeding, bukhaar, pet mein tez dard ya behoshi ka matlab hai abhi hospital. Sabse nazdeeki government hospital jaiye ya 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Tell the doctor exactly what was taken or done, and when. Doctors need it to treat her, and since 2021 they are barred from revealing her name to anyone not authorised by law.
actions.hg: Doctor ko saaf-saaf bataiye ki kya liya ya kya kiya gaya, aur kab. Ilaaj ke liye doctor ko yeh jaanna zaroori hai, aur 2021 se law doctor ko uska naam kisi aise insaan ko batane se rokta hai jise law ne authorise nahi kiya.

actions.en: Never send anyone to an untrained provider. Up to nine weeks, a qualified doctor can prescribe abortion pills at an ordinary clinic linked to an approved facility.
actions.hg: Kisi ko bhi untrained provider ke paas kabhi mat bhejiye. Nau hafte tak qualified doctor kisi aam clinic se, jo approved facility se juda ho, abortion pills prescribe kar sakta hai.

actions.en: If she is under 18, a trusted adult or Child Helpline 1098 can help her reach a registered doctor. Her name can be kept out of the police report if she and her guardian ask.
actions.hg: Agar woh 18 se kam hai, toh koi bharosemand bada ya Child Helpline 1098 use registered doctor tak pahunchne mein madad kar sakta hai. Agar woh aur uska guardian kahein, toh police report mein uska naam nahi diya jaayega.

title.en: 20 weeks, 24 weeks, no limit: India's MTP Act in plain words
title.hg: 20 hafte, 24 hafte, phir koi limit nahi: India ka MTP Act simple words mein

dek.en: India's abortion law is not one right but a row of gates, each with its own time window and its own number of doctors. Here is what each gate asks, who decides, and what the law still will not give you.
dek.hg: India ka abortion law ek seedha right nahi, balki gates ki ek line hai, aur har gate ki apni time window aur apne doctors hain. Jaano har gate kya maangta hai, decide kaun karta hai, aur law aaj bhi kya nahi deta.

statLabel.en: categories of women may end a pregnancy between 20 and 24 weeks (Rule 3B, 2021)
statLabel.hg: categories ki women 20 se 24 hafte ke beech abortion kara sakti hain (Rule 3B, 2021)

label.en: weeks: the limit for an abortion on one registered doctor's opinion
label.hg: hafte tak: ek registered doctor ki opinion par abortion

label.en: weeks: the limit for listed categories of women, with two doctors' opinions
label.hg: hafte tak: listed categories ki women ke liye, do doctors ki opinion par

label.en: categories of women listed in Rule 3B for the 20-24 week window
label.hg: categories hain Rule 3B mein, 20 se 24 hafte ke liye

label.en: year in jail, at most, for a doctor who reveals a woman's identity
label.hg: saal tak ki jail, agar doctor woman ki identity bata de

claim.en: A married woman needs her husband's signature for an abortion.
claim.hg: Shaadishuda woman ko abortion ke liye pati ka signature chahiye.

truth.en: The MTP Act asks only for the woman's own consent if she is an adult. A guardian's written consent is needed only if she is under 18 or mentally ill.
truth.hg: MTP Act adult woman se sirf uski apni consent maangta hai. Guardian ki written consent tabhi chahiye jab woh 18 se kam ho ya mentally ill ho.

actions.en: Count pregnancy weeks from the first day of the last period, and see a registered doctor early: the gates close at 20 and 24 weeks.
actions.hg: Hafte last period ke pehle din se gino, aur jaldi kisi registered doctor se milo: gates 20 aur 24 hafte par band ho jaate hain.

actions.en: If you are 18 or older, only your consent is needed. No husband, parent or in-law has to sign.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 ya usse badi ho, toh sirf tumhari consent chahiye. Pati, parents ya sasural mein kisi ke signature ki zaroorat nahi.

actions.en: Go only to a government hospital or a clinic approved under the MTP Act, and ask whether the clinic is approved if you are unsure.
actions.hg: Sirf sarkari hospital ya MTP Act ke under approved clinic mein jao. Doubt ho toh pooch lo ki clinic approved hai ya nahi.

actions.en: After rape, you do not need an FIR to use the rape ground. Tell the doctor, and do not wait if you are close to 20 or 24 weeks.
actions.hg: Rape ke baad is ground ke liye FIR zaroori nahi. Doctor ko batao, aur 20 ya 24 hafte paas hon toh bilkul der mat karo.

actions.en: If you are past 24 weeks after rape, get legal help the same day: outside a medical emergency, the only route left is a petition to a High Court or the Supreme Court.
actions.hg: Rape ke baad 24 hafte nikal gaye hon, toh usi din legal help lo: medical emergency ke alawa ab bas ek raasta bachta hai, High Court ya Supreme Court mein petition.

title.en: Fifty years, then a rewrite: what the 2021 MTP amendment changed and what it left out
title.hg: 50 saal baad ek rewrite: 2021 ke MTP amendment ne kya badla aur kya chhod diya

dek.en: For half a century India's abortion law spoke of 20 weeks, two doctors and a 'married woman or her husband'. Set the 1971 text beside the 2021 one and you can see exactly what Parliament fixed, and who it still left outside.
dek.hg: Aadhi sadi tak India ka abortion law 20 hafte, do doctors aur 'married woman or her husband' ki baat karta raha. 1971 aur 2021 ke text ko side by side rakho, toh saaf dikhta hai ki Parliament ne kya theek kiya, aur kise ab bhi bahar chhod diya.

statLabel.en: the day India's amended abortion law took effect
statLabel.hg: jis din India ka amended abortion law lagu hua

label.en: years the 1971 week limits stood before the 2021 rewrite
label.hg: saal tak 1971 ki hafton wali limits nahi badli

label.en: weeks: how far one doctor's opinion reaches, before and after 2021
label.hg: hafte: ek doctor ki opinion kahan tak chalti hai, 2021 se pehle aur baad

label.en: weeks: the outer limit with two doctors' opinions, before and after 2021 (now only for listed categories)
label.hg: hafte: do doctors ki opinion ke saath outer limit, 2021 se pehle aur baad (ab sirf listed categories ke liye)

claim.en: Before 2021, abortion was legal in India only for married women.
claim.hg: 2021 se pehle India mein abortion sirf married women ke liye legal tha.

truth.en: The 1971 Act's grounds applied to any pregnant woman. What it kept for wives was the contraceptive-failure presumption, which spoke of 'any married woman or her husband' until 2021.
truth.hg: 1971 Act ke grounds har pregnant woman par lagu the. Sirf contraceptive-failure wala presumption wives tak limited tha, kyunki 2021 tak usmein 'any married woman or her husband' likha tha.

actions.en: If anyone tells you abortion is only for married women, point to the law: since 2021 it says 'any woman or her partner', and the Supreme Court confirmed equal access in 2022.
actions.hg: Koi kahe ki abortion sirf married women ke liye hai, toh law dikhao: 2021 se usmein 'any woman or her partner' likha hai, aur 2022 mein Supreme Court ne bhi equal access confirm kiya.

actions.en: Do not wait out the weeks: up to 20 weeks one registered doctor's opinion is enough, and after that the rules get narrower.
actions.hg: Hafte nikalne ka wait mat karo: 20 hafte tak ek registered doctor ki opinion kaafi hai, uske baad rules aur tang ho jaate hain.

actions.en: Between 20 and 24 weeks, ask the doctor which Rule 3B category applies to you; survivors of rape and minors are covered.
actions.hg: 20 se 24 hafte ke beech ho, toh doctor se poochho ki Rule 3B ki kaunsi category tum par lagu hoti hai; rape survivors aur minors covered hain.

actions.en: If you are past 24 weeks after rape, or caring for a pregnant girl who is, get legal help at once: outside a medical emergency, a court is still the only route.
actions.hg: Rape ke baad 24 hafte nikal gaye hon, ya tum kisi aisi pregnant ladki ki care kar rahe ho, toh turant legal help lo: medical emergency ke alawa, court hi ab bhi akela raasta hai.

actions.en: Expect privacy: since 2021 a doctor who reveals your identity can be jailed for up to a year.
actions.hg: Privacy expect karo: 2021 se agar doctor tumhari identity reveal kare, toh use 1 saal tak jail ho sakti hai.

title.en: She's pregnant and doesn't want to continue: a guide for the man in the room
title.hg: Woh pregnant hai aur continue nahi karna chahti: uske saath khade mard ke liye ek guide

dek.en: Indian law asks for her consent and nobody else's. It gives you no signature and no veto. What it leaves you is a job: get her to a doctor in time, pay your share, keep her secret, and stop treating contraception as her problem.
dek.hg: Indian law sirf uski consent maangta hai, kisi aur ki nahi. Aapko na signature ka haq milta hai, na veto ka. Aapke hisse mein kaam aata hai: use time par doctor tak pahunchana, apna share pay karna, uska raaz rakhna, aur contraception ko 'uski problem' samajhna band karna.

statLabel.en: of Indian men agree contraception is 'women's business' (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: Indian mardon ne maana ki contraception 'women's business' hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: of men aged 15-49 agreed that contraception is "women's business" (2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ke mardon ne maana ki contraception "women's business" hai (2019-21)

label.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion said the main reason was that their husband or mother-in-law did not want it (2019-21)
label.hg: auraton ne, jinki last pregnancy abortion mein khatam hui, kaha ki main wajah yeh thi ki husband ya saas ko woh pregnancy nahi chahiye thi (2019-21)

label.en: of currently married women relied on male sterilisation, against 37.9% on female sterilisation (2019-21)
label.hg: currently married auratein male sterilisation par nirbhar thi, jabki 37.9% female sterilisation par (2019-21)

label.en: approved limit for abortion pills, counted from the first day of her last period (2023 guidelines)
label.hg: abortion pills ki approved limit, uske last period ke pehle din se gin kar (2023 guidelines)

claim.en: A husband or boyfriend has to sign for an abortion, so he can also stop one.
claim.hg: Abortion ke liye husband ya boyfriend ka signature zaroori hota hai, isliye woh abortion rok bhi sakta hai.

truth.en: The MTP Act asks only for the adult woman's own consent. A partner has no signature and no veto, and causing a miscarriage without her consent is a crime.
truth.hg: MTP Act sirf adult aurat ki apni consent maangta hai. Partner ke paas na signature ka haq hai, na veto ka, aur aurat ki consent ke bina miscarriage karwana crime hai.

actions.en: Ask her what she wants and let her finish. Then tell her it is her decision and that you are staying.
actions.hg: Usse poochiye ki woh kya chahti hai aur use poori baat kehne dijiye. Phir bataiye ki faisla uska hai aur aap uske saath hain.

actions.en: Help her see a registered doctor this week. Abortion pills are approved only up to 63 days from her last period. Do not buy a kit from a chemist for her.
actions.hg: Isi hafte use registered doctor tak pahunchne mein madad kijiye. Abortion pills uske last period se sirf 63 din tak approved hain. Uske liye chemist se kit mat khareediye.

actions.en: Pay at least half without being asked, take the day off, go with her if she wants you there, and stay reachable for the days after.
actions.hg: Bina kahe kam se kam aadha paisa dijiye, us din chhutti lijiye, woh chahe toh saath jaiye, aur baad ke dinon mein phone par available rahiye.

actions.en: Tell nobody without her permission: not your friends, not your parents, not a WhatsApp group.
actions.hg: Uski permission ke bina kisi ko mat bataiye: na doston ko, na parents ko, na kisi WhatsApp group mein.

actions.en: From now on, contraception is your job too. Use a condom every time, and if your family is complete, ask a doctor about vasectomy.
actions.hg: Ab se contraception aapka bhi kaam hai. Har baar condom use kijiye, aur agar family complete ho chuki hai toh doctor se vasectomy ke baare mein poochiye.

title.en: 31 police cases in 2024: why India's three-decade-old ban on sex selection barely bites
title.hg: 2024 mein sirf 31 police cases: sex selection par India ka teen dashak purana ban asar kyun nahi dikhata

dek.en: The PC-PNDT Act makes it a crime even to hint at a foetus's sex, and can cost a doctor their registration. Police registered 57, 30 and 31 cases under it in three years. The law's own design explains much of that silence, and what it hides.
dek.hg: PC-PNDT Act ke tahat foetus ke sex ka ishaara karna bhi crime hai, aur doctor ka registration tak ja sakta hai. Phir bhi teen saal mein police ne iske tahat 57, 30 aur 31 cases darj kiye. Is khamoshi ki badi wajah khud law ki banawat hai, aur yeh numbers bahut kuch chhupa lete hain.

statLabel.en: police cases under the PC-PNDT Act in all of India in 2024
statLabel.hg: police cases PC-PNDT Act ke tahat, poore India mein, 2024 mein

label.en: cases registered by police under the PC-PNDT Act in 2022, 2023 and 2024
label.hg: cases police ne PC-PNDT Act ke tahat 2022, 2023 aur 2024 mein darj kiye

label.en: girls a year went 'missing' at birth in India in 2013-2017, by UNFPA's estimate
label.hg: ladkiyan har saal India mein janm ke waqt 'missing' hui, 2013-2017 mein, UNFPA ke estimate ke mutabik

label.en: maximum jail for a doctor's first offence, with registration suspended once a court frames charges
label.hg: tak ki jail doctor ke pehle offence par, aur court ke charges frame karte hi registration suspend

label.en: notice a citizen or social organisation must give the authority before taking a clinic to court
label.hg: ka notice dena hota hai kisi citizen ya social organisation ko, clinic ko khud court le jaane se pehle

actions.en: If a scan centre or doctor hints at a foetus's sex, in words, signs or any other way, write down the name, the date and exactly what was said or done.
actions.hg: Agar koi scan centre ya doctor foetus ke sex ka ishaara kare, shabdon se, signs se ya kisi bhi tareeke se, toh naam, tareekh aur jo bhi kaha ya kiya gaya, sab likh lo.

actions.en: Report it to the district Appropriate Authority under the PC-PNDT Act; the district health office can tell you who that is.
actions.hg: Iski complaint PC-PNDT Act ke district Appropriate Authority se karo; district health office bata dega ki woh kaun hai.

actions.en: If the authority does not act, a person or a social organisation can take the clinic to court directly after giving the authority 15 days' notice.
actions.hg: Agar authority kuch na kare, toh koi bhi insaan ya social organisation authority ko 15 din ka notice dekar clinic ko seedhe court le ja sakta hai.

actions.en: If your family is pushing you towards a sex test, call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 in danger. The law presumes a pregnant woman was compelled and does not punish a woman who was forced.
actions.hg: Agar family tum par sex test ke liye dabaav daal rahi hai, toh Women Helpline 181 par call karo, khatre mein 112 par. Law maanta hai ki pregnant aurat par zabardasti hui thi, aur jis aurat ko majboor kiya gaya use saza nahi deta.

actions.en: Do not forward ads or posts offering sex determination. Advertising such services, including online, is itself banned.
actions.hg: Sex determination offer karne wale ads ya posts forward mat karo. Aisi services ka advertisement, online bhi, khud ek crime hai.

title.en: Week 9, week 20, week 24: how pregnancy is counted and why every day matters under Indian law
title.hg: Hafta 9, hafta 20, hafta 24: pregnancy kaise gini jaati hai aur Indian law mein har din kyun maayne rakhta hai

dek.en: Doctors and the law count a pregnancy from the first day of your last period, not from the day you had sex. That one rule decides which options are still open. Here is how to work out your week, and what each deadline means.
dek.hg: Doctors aur law pregnancy ko aapke last period ke pehle din se ginte hain, us din se nahi jab aapne sex kiya. Yahi ek rule tay karta hai ki kaun se options abhi khule hain. Yeh rahi guide: apna hafta kaise nikaalein, aur har deadline ka matlab kya hai.

statLabel.en: the approved limit for medication abortion, counted from the last period (MoHFW, 2023)
statLabel.hg: medication abortion ki approved limit, last period se gin kar (MoHFW, 2023)

label.en: approved limit for abortion pills, counted from the first day of the last period (2023 guidelines)
label.hg: abortion pills ki approved limit, last period ke pehle din se gin kar (2023 guidelines)

label.en: up to this point, one doctor's opinion is enough (since 2021)
label.hg: is point tak ek doctor ki opinion kaafi hai (2021 se)

label.en: the limit for listed categories of women, with two doctors' opinion (since 2021)
label.hg: listed categories ki aurton ke liye limit, do doctors ki opinion ke saath (2021 se)

label.en: for a Medical Board to give its opinion on a request after 24 weeks (2021 rules)
label.hg: 24 hafte ke baad ki request par Medical Board ko apni opinion dene ke liye (2021 rules)

claim.en: If you had sex four weeks ago, you are four weeks pregnant.
claim.hg: Agar aapne chaar hafte pehle sex kiya tha, toh aap chaar hafte pregnant hain.

truth.en: Doctors and the law count from the first day of your last period, which comes before conception. So on paper a pregnancy is always further along than the time since sex.
truth.hg: Doctors aur law last period ke pehle din se ginte hain, jo conception se pehle aata hai. Isliye kaagaz par pregnancy hamesha sex ke baad guzre waqt se aage hoti hai.

actions.en: Note the first day of every period in your phone or a diary. It is the first date any doctor will ask for.
actions.hg: Har period ka pehla din apne phone ya diary mein note kijiye. Koi bhi doctor sabse pehle yahi date poochega.

actions.en: If your period is late, take a home pregnancy test now. If it is negative and your period still has not come, repeat it after a few days.
actions.hg: Period late hai toh abhi home pregnancy test kijiye. Agar negative aaye aur period phir bhi na aaye, toh kuch din baad dobara kijiye.

actions.en: If you are pregnant and do not want to continue, see a registered doctor within days, not weeks. Pills are approved only up to 63 days from your last period.
actions.hg: Agar aap pregnant hain aur continue nahi karna chahti, toh hafton mein nahi, dinon mein kisi registered doctor se miliye. Pills sirf last period se 63 din tak approved hain.

actions.en: Never take abortion pills from a chemist without a doctor. Heavy bleeding, fever or severe pain after pills means a hospital now, or call 112.
actions.hg: Chemist se bina doctor ke abortion pills kabhi mat lijiye. Pills ke baad bahut zyada bleeding, bukhaar ya tez dard ho toh abhi hospital jaiye, ya 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If you are 18 or older, you need no one else's signature, and unmarried women have the same access as married women.
actions.hg: Agar aap 18 ya usse zyada ki hain, toh aapko kisi aur ke signature ki zaroorat nahi, aur unmarried aurton ko bhi shaadishuda aurton jaisa hi access hai.

title.en: Pregnant after rape: your rights in India, from the first test to the 24th week
title.hg: Rape ke baad pregnant: India mein aapke haq, pehle test se 24ve hafte tak

dek.en: No FIR, no proof in court and, for an adult, no one else's signature: the law demands none of them. What it does demand is speed. A step-by-step guide for a survivor who finds she is pregnant, and for the friend helping her.
dek.hg: Na FIR, na court mein saboot, aur adult hain toh na kisi aur ka signature: law inmein se kuch nahi maangta. Woh sirf ek cheez maangta hai: jaldi. Ek step-by-step guide, us survivor ke liye jise pata chala hai ki woh pregnant hai, aur us dost ke liye jo uski madad kar raha hai.

statLabel.en: compensation set by NALSA for a pregnancy resulting from rape
statLabel.hg: NALSA ka tay kiya compensation, rape se hui pregnancy ke liye

label.en: compensation in NALSA's 2018 scheme for a pregnancy resulting from rape, with limits 50% higher for a minor
label.hg: NALSA ki 2018 scheme mein rape se hui pregnancy ke liye compensation; minor ke liye limit 50% zyada

label.en: weeks: the limit up to which a survivor of rape, sexual assault or incest can end a pregnancy under the MTP rules
label.hg: hafte: MTP rules ke tahat rape, sexual assault ya incest ki survivor is limit tak pregnancy khatam kara sakti hai

label.en: days: the deadline for a Legal Services Authority to finish a compensation inquiry under NALSA's scheme
label.hg: din: NALSA scheme ke tahat Legal Services Authority ko compensation ki inquiry itne din mein poori karni hoti hai

label.en: One Stop Centres for women were operational across India in July 2026
label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein poore India mein chal rahe the

claim.en: A rape survivor must file an FIR, or prove the rape in court, before a doctor can end her pregnancy.
claim.hg: Rape survivor ko pehle FIR karni padti hai, ya court mein rape saabit karna padta hai, tabhi doctor uski pregnancy khatam kar sakta hai.

truth.en: The Supreme Court ruled in 2022 that the MTP Act needs neither. Her own statement that the pregnancy was caused by rape is enough for the law to presume grave injury to her mental health.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ne 2022 mein kaha ki MTP Act inmein se kuch nahi maangta. Survivor ka apna bayan, ki pregnancy rape se hui, kaafi hai: law maan leta hai ki isse uski mental health ko gambhir nuksaan pahunchta hai.

actions.en: Take a pregnancy test as soon as a period is late, and see a registered doctor the same week: every legal deadline counts in weeks of pregnancy.
actions.hg: Period late ho toh jald se jald pregnancy test kijiye, aur usi hafte kisi registered doctor se miliye: har legal deadline pregnancy ke hafton mein gini jaati hai.

actions.en: Tell the doctor the pregnancy was caused by rape. If you are 18 or older, you need no FIR, no court order and no one else's consent.
actions.hg: Doctor ko bataiye ki pregnancy rape se hui hai. Agar aap 18 saal ya usse badi hain, toh na FIR chahiye, na court order, na kisi aur ki consent.

actions.en: Do not take abortion pills without a registered doctor's prescription.
actions.hg: Registered doctor ke prescription ke bina abortion pills mat lijiye.

actions.en: Apply for compensation to the District Legal Services Authority without waiting for an arrest or a trial. NALSA's helpline 15100 gives free legal aid.
actions.hg: Compensation ke liye District Legal Services Authority mein apply kijiye; kisi arrest ya trial ka intezaar mat kijiye. NALSA ki helpline 15100 par free legal aid milti hai.

actions.en: If the pregnancy is close to 24 weeks, contact a lawyer the same day: after that, ending a pregnancy from rape needs a court's permission, except in a life-saving emergency.
actions.hg: Agar pregnancy 24 hafte ke kareeb hai, toh usi din lawyer se baat kijiye: uske baad rape se hui pregnancy khatam karne ke liye court ki permission chahiye, siwaay jaan bachane wali emergency ke.

title.en: Raped, pregnant and under 18: the shelter, care and compensation India promises child survivors
title.hg: Rape ke baad pregnant, aur umar 18 se kam: India child survivors ko shelter, care aur compensation ka kya vaada karta hai

dek.en: Police registered 43,313 child-rape cases involving girls in 2024. For the girls among them who become pregnant, a 2023 scheme promises shelter, care and schooling, and compensation does not have to wait for a conviction. A family's questions, answered.
dek.hg: 2024 mein police ne ladkiyon ke saath child rape ke 43,313 cases darj kiye. Inmein se jo ladkiyan pregnant ho jaati hain, unke liye 2023 ki ek scheme shelter, ilaaj aur padhai ka vaada karti hai, aur compensation ke liye conviction ka intezaar zaroori nahi. Ek parivaar ke sawaal, aur unke jawaab.

statLabel.en: POCSO cases of penetrative sexual assault on girls registered in 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein ladkiyon ke saath POCSO ke tahat penetrative sexual assault ke itne cases darj hue

label.en: POCSO cases of penetrative sexual assault on girls registered in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein ladkiyon ke saath POCSO ke tahat penetrative sexual assault ke darj cases

label.en: of child victims of penetrative sexual assault in 2024 were aged 16 or 17
label.hg: 2024 mein penetrative sexual assault ke child victims mein se itne 16 ya 17 saal ke the

label.en: NALSA compensation for a pregnancy resulting from rape, with limits 50% higher for a minor
label.hg: rape se hui pregnancy ke liye NALSA compensation; victim minor ho toh limit 50% zyada

label.en: the limit up to which a minor or a rape survivor can end a pregnancy under the MTP Rules
label.hg: tak MTP Rules ke tahat koi minor ya rape survivor pregnancy khatam kar sakti hai

claim.en: Compensation comes only after the accused is convicted.
claim.hg: Compensation tabhi milta hai jab accused ko saza ho jaaye.

truth.en: Under Section 396 of the BNSS, a survivor can apply to the Legal Services Authority even if the offender is never traced and no trial takes place, and the authority must decide within two months.
truth.hg: BNSS ke Section 396 ke tahat survivor Legal Services Authority mein apply kar sakti hai, chahe offender kabhi pakda na jaaye aur trial hi na ho, aur authority ko do mahine ke andar faisla karna hota hai.

actions.en: Call the Child Helpline 1098 or 112 and ask for the 2023 care and support scheme for pregnant child survivors by name.
actions.hg: Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye aur pregnant child survivors ke liye 2023 ki care and support scheme ka naam lekar madad maangiye.

actions.en: Apply for compensation at the District Legal Services Authority now, not after the trial; for free legal aid, call NALSA on 15100.
actions.hg: Compensation ke liye abhi District Legal Services Authority mein apply kijiye, trial ke baad nahi; free legal aid ke liye NALSA ko 15100 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Take her to a registered doctor or a government hospital early: treatment for a POCSO survivor is free, and a minor can end a pregnancy up to 24 weeks with a guardian's written consent.
actions.hg: Use jaldi registered doctor ya sarkari hospital le jaaiye: POCSO survivor ka ilaaj free hai, aur minor guardian ki likhit consent se 24 hafte tak pregnancy khatam kar sakti hai.

actions.en: Ask for counselling for her, and call Tele-MANAS on 14416 whenever she needs someone to talk to.
actions.hg: Uske liye counselling maangiye, aur jab bhi use kisi se baat karni ho, Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Never share her name, photo or school with anyone, and ask the officials on her case to put her education support in writing.
actions.hg: Uska naam, photo ya school kabhi kisi ke saath share mat kijiye, aur case sambhaal rahe officials se uski padhai ki madad likhit mein maangiye.

title.en: Ladka hai ya ladki? Is it a crime to ask? India's sex-selection law, answered
title.hg: Ladka hai ya ladki? Kya poochna bhi crime hai? India ka sex-selection law, sawaal-jawaab mein

dek.en: Families still ask, hint and pay for an answer that a 1994 law forbids. Here is what the PC-PNDT Act says about asking, telling, advertising and complaining, and why none of it makes abortion illegal.
dek.hg: Families aaj bhi us jawaab ke liye poochti hain, ishaare karti hain aur paise deti hain jise 1994 ka ek law mana karta hai. Yeh raha PC-PNDT Act poochne, batane, advertising aur complaint ke baare mein kya kehta hai, aur kyun inmein se kuch bhi abortion ko illegal nahi banata.

statLabel.en: maximum first-offence fine for seeking sex selection, with up to 3 years in prison
statLabel.hg: tak ka fine pehli baar sex selection karwana chahne par, saath mein 3 saal tak ki jail

label.en: maximum first-offence fine for anyone who seeks sex selection, with up to 3 years in prison
label.hg: tak ka fine pehli baar mein, har us insaan ke liye jo sex selection karwana chahe, saath mein 3 saal tak ki jail

label.en: maximum first-offence fine for a doctor or clinic owner, who also faces up to 3 years in prison and loss of registration
label.hg: tak ka fine pehli baar mein doctor ya clinic owner ke liye, jise 3 saal tak ki jail aur registration jaane ka khatra bhi hai

label.en: notice a person or organisation must give the authorities before taking a sex-selection complaint to court
label.hg: ka notice authorities ko dena hota hai, kisi insaan ya sanstha ko sex-selection ki complaint court le jaane se pehle

label.en: cases police registered under the PC-PNDT Act in 2024; most prosecutions start as court complaints instead
label.hg: cases police ne 2024 mein PC-PNDT Act ke under darj kiye; zyada tar case court complaint se shuru hote hain

claim.en: The ban on sex determination means abortion is illegal in India.
claim.hg: Sex determination par ban ka matlab hai ki India mein abortion illegal hai.

truth.en: The PC-PNDT Act bans finding out or revealing a foetus's sex, and choosing by sex. Abortion itself is legal under the MTP Act: up to 20 weeks on one doctor's opinion, and up to 24 weeks for specified categories of women with two doctors.
truth.hg: PC-PNDT Act foetus ka sex pata karne ya batane, aur sex ke hisaab se chunne par ban lagata hai. Abortion khud MTP Act ke under legal hai: 20 hafte tak ek doctor ki raay par, aur tay categories ki aurton ke liye do doctors ki raay se 24 hafte tak.

actions.en: Never ask a doctor or scan centre to reveal the baby's sex, and never pay anyone who offers to: seeking it is itself an offence.
actions.hg: Doctor ya scan centre se baby ka sex kabhi mat poochiye, aur jo batane ki offer kare use kabhi paise mat dijiye: sex jaanne ki koshish khud ek offence hai.

actions.en: Do not skip pregnancy scans out of fear of this law. Scans to check the baby's health are legal; only finding out or telling the sex is banned.
actions.hg: Is law ke darr se pregnancy ke scans mat chhodiye. Baby ki health check karne wale scans legal hain; ban sirf sex pata karne ya batane par hai.

actions.en: If a clinic, middleman or website offers to reveal a baby's sex, note the date, the name and what was said, save screenshots, and report it to your district health officials, the Appropriate Authority under the PC-PNDT Act.
actions.hg: Agar koi clinic, dalaal ya website baby ka sex batane ki offer kare, toh date, naam aur kya kaha gaya, note kijiye, screenshots sambhaliye, aur apne district ke health officials ko report kijiye, jo PC-PNDT Act mein Appropriate Authority hain.

actions.en: If your family is forcing a sex test or an abortion because the baby is a girl, call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 if you are in danger. The law presumes you were compelled.
actions.hg: Agar family ladki hone ki wajah se sex test ya abortion ke liye majboor kar rahi hai, toh Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, ya khatre mein hon toh 112 par. Law maan kar chalta hai ki aapko majboor kiya gaya.

actions.en: If you need an abortion, go to a registered doctor or a government hospital. Abortion is legal under the MTP Act; sex selection is not.
actions.hg: Agar aapko abortion chahiye, toh registered doctor ya sarkari hospital jaiye. MTP Act ke under abortion legal hai; sex selection nahi.

title.en: Uttarakhand 868, Delhi 872, Haryana 884: where India's girls still go missing at birth
title.hg: Uttarakhand 868, Delhi 872, Haryana 884: India mein ladkiyan aaj bhi janm ke waqt kahan gayab ho rahi hain

dek.en: India's official birth survey shows a gap that runs from the hills to the capital to Maharashtra. Here is the state map, what women told a national survey, and why one state's number can mislead.
dek.hg: India ka official birth survey ek aisa gap dikhata hai jo pahadon se le kar rajdhani aur Maharashtra tak faila hai. Yeh raha states ka map, aurton ne national survey ko kya bataya, aur kyun kisi ek state ka number aapko gumraah kar sakta hai.

statLabel.en: girls born per 1,000 boys in Uttarakhand, lowest among bigger states (SRS 2021-23)
statLabel.hg: ladkiyan paida hui har 1,000 ladkon par Uttarakhand mein, bade states mein sabse kam (SRS 2021-23)

label.en: girls born per 1,000 boys in India in 2021-23, the official SRS estimate
label.hg: ladkiyan paida hui har 1,000 ladkon par India mein 2021-23 mein, official SRS estimate

label.en: girls born per 1,000 boys in Uttarakhand in 2021-23, the lowest among bigger states
label.hg: ladkiyan paida hui har 1,000 ladkon par Uttarakhand mein 2021-23 mein, bade states mein sabse kam

label.en: Uttarakhand's sex ratio at birth in NFHS-5 (2019-21): same state, different survey
label.hg: Uttarakhand ka sex ratio at birth NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein: wahi state, alag survey

label.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion named a female foetus as the main reason (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: aurton ne, jinki last pregnancy abortion par khatam hui, main wajah batayi ki pet mein ladki thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: If a state's sex ratio looks normal in a survey, sex selection is not happening there.
claim.hg: Agar kisi survey mein state ka sex ratio normal dikhe, toh wahan sex selection nahi ho raha.

truth.en: State figures rest on small samples and can disagree sharply: NFHS-5 put Uttarakhand at 984, while the official SRS put it at 868 for 2021-23. One number can show a pattern; it cannot clear a state, a district or a clinic.
truth.hg: State ke figures chhote samples par tike hote hain aur aapas mein bahut alag ho sakte hain: NFHS-5 ne Uttarakhand ko 984 par rakha, jabki official SRS ne 2021-23 ke liye 868 par. Ek number pattern dikha sakta hai; woh kisi state, district ya clinic ko clean chit nahi de sakta.

actions.en: Before you quote a state's sex ratio, check three things: is it the ratio at birth, which survey is it from, and which years does it cover.
actions.hg: Kisi state ka sex ratio quote karne se pehle teen cheezein check kijiye: kya yeh ratio at birth hai, kis survey se hai, aur kin saalon ka hai.

actions.en: Read a low state figure as a warning about a pattern, never as an accusation against every family or community in that state.
actions.hg: Kisi state ke kam number ko ek pattern ki warning samjhiye, us state ki har family ya community par ilzaam nahi.

actions.en: If a clinic or scan centre offers to reveal a baby's sex, report it to your district health officials, who act as the Appropriate Authority under the PC-PNDT Act.
actions.hg: Agar koi clinic ya scan centre baby ka sex batane ki offer kare, toh apne district ke health officials ko report kijiye, jo PC-PNDT Act mein Appropriate Authority hain.

actions.en: If you are being pushed to find out your baby's sex, or to end a pregnancy because it is a girl, call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 if you are in danger.
actions.hg: Agar aap par baby ka sex pata karne ka, ya ladki hone ki wajah se pregnancy khatam karne ka pressure hai, toh Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, ya khatre mein hon toh 112 par.

title.en: From 904 to 917: girls are slowly returning to India's birth records, but son preference has not left
title.hg: 904 se 917 tak: India ke birth records mein ladkiyan dheere-dheere laut rahi hain, par bete ki chahat abhi gayi nahi

dek.en: Official data, a Pew estimate and a sharp shift among Sikhs all show sex selection falling. A survey of what families want shows the wish for a son still running deep. Here is what has changed, and what it will take to hold.
dek.hg: Official data, Pew ka estimate aur Sikhon mein aaya tez badlaav, sab dikhate hain ki sex selection ghat raha hai. Lekin families kya chahti hain, us par hua survey dikhata hai ki bete ki chahat ab bhi gehri hai. Kya badla hai, aur ise tikaaye rakhne ke liye kya chahiye, yeh raha.

statLabel.en: girls born per 1,000 boys in India in 2021-23, up from 904 in 2017-19 (SRS)
statLabel.hg: ladkiyan paida hui har 1,000 ladkon par India mein 2021-23 mein, 2017-19 ke 904 se upar (SRS)

label.en: girls born per 1,000 boys in India in 2021-23, up from 904 in 2017-19 (SRS)
label.hg: ladkiyan paida hui har 1,000 ladkon par India mein 2021-23 mein, 2017-19 ke 904 se upar (SRS)

label.en: girls 'missing' at birth in India in 2019, down from about 480,000 in 2010 (Pew estimate)
label.hg: ladkiyan 2019 mein India mein janm ke waqt 'missing' thi, 2010 ke lagbhag 480,000 se kam (Pew ka estimate)

label.en: boys born per 100 girls among Sikhs in 2019-21 (approximate), down from 130 in the 2001 census (Pew)
label.hg: lagbhag itne ladke paida hue har 100 ladkiyon par Sikhon mein 2019-21 mein, 2001 census ke 130 se neeche (Pew)

label.en: of women, and 76% of men, said having at least one son was very important (seven-state survey, 2014)
label.hg: aurton ne, aur 76% mardon ne, kaha ki kam se kam ek beta hona bahut zaroori hai (saat states ka survey, 2014)

claim.en: Now that more girls are being born, son preference is over.
claim.hg: Ab zyada ladkiyan paida ho rahi hain, toh bete ki chahat khatam ho gayi.

truth.en: A birth ratio measures what families do, not what they want. In a 2014 seven-state survey, 81% of women and 76% of men said having at least one son was very important, and UNFPA estimates that about a third of India's missing girls are lost after birth, not before it.
truth.hg: Birth ratio yeh naapta hai ki families kya karti hain, yeh nahi ki woh kya chahti hain. 2014 ke saat states ke survey mein 81% aurton aur 76% mardon ne kaha ki kam se kam ek beta hona bahut zaroori hai, aur UNFPA ke andaaze se India ki 'missing' ladkiyon mein se lagbhag ek-tihaai janm ke baad kho jaati hain, pehle nahi.

actions.en: Compare like with like: set an SRS figure only against earlier SRS figures, and say which years each one covers.
actions.hg: Same cheez ko same se milaiye: SRS ke figure ko sirf SRS ke purane figures se compare kijiye, aur bataiye ki har figure kin saalon ka hai.

actions.en: When a girl is born in your family and someone says 'next time, a boy', answer it, even if it was meant as a joke.
actions.hg: Jab family mein beti paida ho aur koi kahe 'agli baar beta', toh jawaab dijiye, chahe baat mazaak mein kahi gayi ho.

actions.en: If anyone blames a mother for having daughters, say it plainly: no woman chooses her baby's sex, and a daughter is nobody's failure.
actions.hg: Agar koi maa ko betiyon ke liye blame kare, toh saaf kahiye: koi aurat apne baby ka sex nahi chunti, aur beti kisi ki naakaami nahi hai.

actions.en: If a clinic offers to reveal a baby's sex, report it to your district health officials, who act as the Appropriate Authority under the PC-PNDT Act.
actions.hg: Agar koi clinic baby ka sex batane ki offer kare, toh apne district ke health officials ko report kijiye, jo PC-PNDT Act mein Appropriate Authority hain.

actions.en: If you are being pushed to have a son, or to end a pregnancy because it is a girl, call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 if you are in danger.
actions.hg: Agar aap par beta paida karne ka, ya ladki hone ki wajah se pregnancy khatam karne ka pressure hai, toh Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, ya khatre mein hon toh 112 par.

title.en: Tripura 21.9%, West Bengal 16.4%: India's teenage pregnancies are a child-marriage story
title.hg: Tripura 21.9%, West Bengal 16.4%: India mein teenage pregnancy asal mein child marriage ki kahani hai

dek.en: By 19, one in five Indian women had already begun childbearing in NFHS-5, and the states with the most teenage mothers are the states where girls are married before 18. Two national surveys show why the maps match, and what would change them.
dek.hg: NFHS-5 mein 19 saal tak har paanch mein se ek ladki maa ban chuki thi ya pregnant thi, aur jin states mein teenage maayein sabse zyada hain, wahi states hain jahan ladkiyon ki shaadi 18 se pehle kar di jaati hai. Do national surveys dikhate hain ki dono naqshe ek jaise kyun hain, aur inhe kya badal sakta hai.

statLabel.en: of girls aged 15-19 in Tripura had begun childbearing, India's highest (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: Tripura mein 15-19 saal ki itni ladkiyan maa ban chuki thi ya pregnant thi, India mein sabse zyada (NFHS-5)

label.en: of 19-year-old women in India had already begun childbearing (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: India mein 19 saal ki itni auratein maa ban chuki thi ya pehli baar pregnant thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women aged 15-19 were mothers or pregnant in NFHS-6 (2023-24), against 6.8% in NFHS-5
label.hg: 15-19 saal ki itni auratein NFHS-6 (2023-24) mein maa thi ya pregnant thi, NFHS-5 ke 6.8% ke mukable

label.en: of women aged 20-24 in West Bengal were married before 18, India's highest (NFHS-6)
label.hg: West Bengal mein 20-24 saal ki itni auraton ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui, India mein sabse zyada (NFHS-6)

label.en: of married girls aged 15-19 had an unmet need for family planning (NFHS-5)
label.hg: 15-19 saal ki shaadishuda ladkiyon mein itni ki family planning ki zaroorat poori nahi ho rahi thi (NFHS-5)

claim.en: Child marriage is falling, so teenage pregnancy will take care of itself.
claim.hg: Child marriage kam ho rahi hai, toh teenage pregnancy apne aap kam ho jaayegi.

truth.en: Marriage before 18 fell from 23.3% to 20.1% between NFHS-5 and NFHS-6, but the share of girls aged 15-19 who were mothers or pregnant barely moved, from 6.8% to 6.7%.
truth.hg: NFHS-5 se NFHS-6 ke beech 18 se pehle shaadi 23.3% se ghatkar 20.1% hui, lekin 15-19 saal ki jo ladkiyan maa thi ya pregnant thi, unka hissa lagbhag wahi raha: 6.8% se 6.7%.

actions.en: If a girl you know is about to be married before 18, call the Child Helpline 1098 or 112: a child marriage can be stopped before it happens.
actions.hg: Agar aapki jaan-pehchaan ki kisi ladki ki shaadi 18 se pehle hone wali hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye: child marriage hone se pehle roki ja sakti hai.

actions.en: Help girls stay in school: in NFHS-5, 17.6% of girls aged 15-19 with no schooling had already begun childbearing.
actions.hg: Ladkiyon ko school mein bane rehne mein madad kijiye: NFHS-5 mein bina schooling wali 15-19 saal ki 17.6% ladkiyan maa ban chuki thi ya pregnant thi.

actions.en: If you are married and not ready for a child, ask about contraception at an Adolescent Friendly Health Centre in a government health facility.
actions.hg: Agar aapki shaadi ho chuki hai aur aap abhi bachcha nahi chahti, toh sarkari health facility ke Adolescent Friendly Health Centre mein contraception ke baare mein poochiye.

actions.en: Know the law: sex with a wife under 18 is rape, and a girl married as a child can ask a district court to annul the marriage until two years after she becomes an adult.
actions.hg: Kanoon jaaniye: 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex rape hai, aur jis ladki ki shaadi bachpan mein hui, woh adult hone ke do saal baad tak district court se shaadi annul karwa sakti hai.

title.en: Single and pregnant at 22 weeks: what the Supreme Court's September 2022 ruling means for unmarried women
title.hg: Single aur 22 hafte pregnant: Supreme Court ke September 2022 ke faisle ka unmarried aurton ke liye kya matlab hai

dek.en: For 50 years India's abortion law kept its contraceptive-failure clause for wives. In 2022 a single woman more than 22 weeks pregnant took the gap to the Supreme Court and won equal access for every unmarried woman. Here is what you can ask for, at which stage, and what to say if a clinic asks for your husband.
dek.hg: 50 saal tak India ke abortion law ne contraceptive-failure wala clause sirf wives ke liye rakha. 2022 mein 22 hafte se zyada pregnant ek single aurat yeh gap Supreme Court tak le gayi aur har unmarried aurat ke liye barabar access jeet layi. Tum kya maang sakti ho, kis stage par, aur clinic husband ke baare mein pooche to kya kehna hai, yahan jaano.

statLabel.en: weeks: the window the Supreme Court opened equally to unmarried women on 29 September 2022
statLabel.hg: hafte: woh window jo Supreme Court ne 29 September 2022 ko unmarried aurton ke liye bhi barabari se khol di

label.en: the year the MTP Act wrote its contraceptive-failure clause for 'any married woman or her husband'
label.hg: woh saal jab MTP Act ne contraceptive-failure clause 'any married woman or her husband' ke liye likha

label.en: weeks pregnant: the unmarried woman the Supreme Court allowed to seek an abortion on 21 July 2022, after the Delhi High Court refused
label.hg: hafte pregnant thi woh unmarried aurat jise Delhi High Court ke mana karne ke baad Supreme Court ne 21 July 2022 ko abortion ka raasta diya

label.en: the Article of the Constitution (equality) that a married-only reading of the rules would violate, the Supreme Court held
label.hg: Constitution ka woh Article (equality) jise Supreme Court ke hisaab se rules ki 'sirf married' wali reading todti hai

actions.en: If you are 18 or older, only your consent is needed: no husband, no partner's signature, no marriage certificate.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 ya usse badi ho, to sirf tumhari consent chahiye: na husband, na partner ka signature, na marriage certificate.

actions.en: Between 20 and 24 weeks, tell the doctors how your circumstances have changed. Since 29 September 2022, single women have the same access as married women.
actions.hg: 20 se 24 hafte ke beech doctors ko batao ki tumhare halaat kaise badle hain. 29 September 2022 se single aurton ko bhi married aurton jitna hi access hai.

actions.en: If a clinic asks for a husband, name the ruling: X v. Principal Secretary, Supreme Court of India, 29 September 2022.
actions.hg: Agar clinic husband ke baare mein pooche, to ruling ka naam batao: X v. Principal Secretary, Supreme Court of India, 29 September 2022.

actions.en: If one clinic refuses, go the same day to another registered provider or a government hospital, never to an unqualified one.
actions.hg: Agar ek clinic mana kare, to usi din doosre registered provider ya sarkari hospital jao, kisi unqualified insaan ke paas kabhi nahi.

actions.en: If you are under 18, you and your guardian can ask the doctor to keep your name out of the police report.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 se chhoti ho, to tum aur tumhare guardian doctor se keh sakte ho ki police report mein tumhara naam na likha jaaye.

title.en: 9.4% of wives want no baby now but use nothing: inside India's unmet need for contraception
title.hg: 9.4% wives abhi baby nahi chahti, phir bhi koi method use nahi karti: India ki contraception wali 'unmet need' ke andar

dek.en: NFHS-5 counts the married women who want to wait or stop but have no method at all. Among teenage wives the gap is nearly double. Follow it from a sterilisation-first programme to the abortions that come after.
dek.hg: NFHS-5 un shaadishuda aurton ko ginta hai jo rukna ya bas karna chahti hain, par jinke paas koi method hi nahi. Teenage wives mein yeh gap lagbhag double hai. Sterilisation par tike programme se lekar uske baad hone wale abortions tak, is gap ko follow kijiye.

statLabel.en: of married women have an unmet need for family planning (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
statLabel.hg: shaadishuda aurton ki family planning ki zaroorat poori nahi ho rahi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of currently married women wanted to delay or stop childbearing but used no method (2019-21), down from 13% in 2015-16
label.hg: currently married aurtein bachcha rokna ya bas karna chahti thi, par koi method use nahi kar rahi thi (2019-21); 2015-16 mein yeh 13% tha

label.en: of married women aged 15-19 had an unmet need, nearly double the national figure (2019-21)
label.hg: 15-19 saal ki shaadishuda ladkiyon ki unmet need, national figure se lagbhag double (2019-21)

label.en: of married women relied on female sterilisation, against 5.1% on the pill and 2.1% on an IUD (2019-21)
label.hg: shaadishuda aurtein female sterilisation par tiki thi; pill sirf 5.1% aur IUD 2.1% use kar rahi thi (2019-21)

label.en: abortions in India in 2015, the most recent national estimate
label.hg: abortions India mein 2015 mein hue, yeh sabse recent national estimate hai

actions.en: If you want to wait before a first or next child, ask a doctor, ANM or ASHA worker about methods for spacing: condoms, the pill, an IUD or the injectable.
actions.hg: Agar aap pehle ya agle bachche se pehle rukna chahti hain, toh doctor, ANM ya ASHA worker se spacing ke methods ke baare mein poochiye: condom, pill, IUD ya injectable.

actions.en: Men: condoms and vasectomy are your methods. Do not leave contraception to her alone.
actions.hg: Mard: condom aur vasectomy aapke methods hain. Contraception sirf uske bharose mat chhodiye.

actions.en: Find out where to get condoms and other contraceptives before you need them: a government health centre, a pharmacy or your local health worker.
actions.hg: Zaroorat padne se pehle pata kar lijiye ki condom aur baaki contraceptives kahan milte hain: sarkari health centre, pharmacy ya aapke area ka health worker.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 is about to be married, call the Child Helpline 1098. A child marriage can be stopped.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki kisi ladki ki shaadi hone wali hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye. Child marriage roki ja sakti hai.

actions.en: If a pregnancy is unwanted, see a registered doctor early, and never take abortion pills without a prescription.
actions.hg: Agar pregnancy nahi chahiye, toh jaldi kisi registered doctor se miliye, aur bina prescription ke abortion pills kabhi mat lijiye.

title.en: Close to eight women a day: why unsafe abortion is still India's third-biggest cause of maternal death
title.hg: Roz kareeb aath aurtein: unsafe abortion aaj bhi India mein maternal deaths ki teesri sabse badi wajah kyun hai

dek.en: Abortion has been legal in India since 1972, and done safely it almost never kills. Yet unsafe abortion still claims close to eight women a day by UNFPA India's estimate, and the official share of maternal deaths rests on data from 2001-03.
dek.hg: India mein abortion 1972 se legal hai, aur safe tareeke se ho to isse maut lagbhag hoti hi nahi. Phir bhi UNFPA India ke andaaze se unsafe abortion roz kareeb aath aurton ki jaan leta hai, aur maternal deaths mein iska official hissa 2001-03 ke data par tika hai.

statLabel.en: women die from causes related to unsafe abortion in India (UNFPA India estimate)
statLabel.hg: aurtein roz India mein unsafe abortion se judi wajahon se marti hain (UNFPA India ka andaaza)

label.en: of maternal deaths are put down to unsafe abortion, a share based on cause-of-death data for 2001-03
label.hg: maternal deaths unsafe abortion ke khaate mein daali jaati hain; yeh hissa 2001-03 ke cause-of-death data par tika hai

label.en: of abortions in nine poorer states were classed as unsafe in 2007-2011
label.hg: abortions nau gareeb states mein 2007-2011 ke dauraan unsafe maane gaye

label.en: deaths per 100,000 abortions where unsafe abortion is common, against under 1 when abortion is safe (WHO)
label.hg: maut har 100,000 abortions par jahan unsafe abortion aam hai; safe abortion mein 1 se bhi kam (WHO)

claim.en: Abortion is risky, so it is safer to handle it quietly at home or through someone you know.
claim.hg: Abortion risky hota hai, isliye ghar par ya kisi jaan-pehchaan wale ke zariye chupchaap nipta lena zyada safe hai.

truth.en: Deaths from safe abortion are negligible, under 1 per 100,000, the WHO says. Women die when abortion is delayed, hidden or done without proper medical care.
