truth.hg: WHO ke mutabik safe abortion se maut na ke barabar hai, har 100,000 par 1 se bhi kam. Aurtein tab marti hain jab abortion mein der hoti hai, use chhupaya jaata hai, ya sahi medical care ke bina kiya jaata hai.

actions.en: If you might be pregnant and do not want to be, see a registered doctor early: prescribed abortion pills are approved for the first nine weeks.
actions.hg: Agar tum pregnant ho sakti ho aur bachcha nahi chahti, to jaldi kisi registered doctor se milo: doctor ki likhi abortion pills pehle nau hafton ke liye approved hain.

actions.en: Never use pills bought without a prescription, and never go to an untrained provider, however quiet or cheap it seems.
actions.hg: Bina prescription kharidi pills kabhi mat lo, aur kisi untrained insaan ke paas kabhi mat jao, chahe woh kitna bhi chupchaap ya sasta lage.

actions.en: After any abortion or miscarriage, go to a hospital at once for heavy bleeding, fever, fainting or severe pain. Waiting is what turns a complication into a death.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi abortion ya miscarriage ke baad bahut zyada bleeding, bukhaar, behoshi ya tez dard ho to turant hospital jao. Intezaar hi complication ko maut mein badalta hai.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 is pregnant, take her to a registered doctor, not a quack. The doctor must inform the police, but she and her guardian can ask for her name and details to be left out of that report.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki pregnant hai, to use quack ke paas nahi, registered doctor ke paas le jao. Doctor ko police ko batana padega, lekin ladki aur uska guardian maang sakte hain ki us report mein uska naam aur details na diye jaayein.

title.en: Private 52.9%, home 26.2%, public 20.3%: where Indian women get abortions, by the numbers
title.hg: Private 52.9%, ghar 26.2%, sarkari 20.3%: India mein auratein abortion kahan karwati hain, numbers mein

dek.en: NFHS-5 asked women where their last abortion took place and who performed it. Government facilities came last, behind private clinics and women's own homes. Here is the map, number by number, and what it says about the public hospitals women walk past.
dek.hg: NFHS-5 ne auraton se poocha ki unka last abortion kahan hua aur kisne kiya. Sarkari facilities sabse peeche rahi, private clinics aur auraton ke apne gharon ke baad. Yeh raha poora naksha, number dar number, aur yeh un sarkari hospitals ke baare mein kya batata hai jinke paas se auratein guzar jaati hain.

statLabel.en: of women who had an abortion said they performed it themselves (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: auraton ne, jinka abortion hua, kaha ki unhone khud kiya (NFHS-5)

label.en: of abortions women reported in NFHS-5 (2019-21) were performed by a doctor
label.hg: abortions, jo auraton ne NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein report kiye, ek doctor ne kiye

label.en: of rural women who had an abortion said they performed it themselves (NFHS-5)
label.hg: gaon ki auraton ne, jinka abortion hua, kaha ki unhone khud kiya (NFHS-5)

label.en: of abortions in health facilities in 2015 took place in private ones (national estimate)
label.hg: health facilities mein hue abortions 2015 mein private jagahon par hue (national estimate)

label.en: of women treated for abortion complications got that treatment in the private sector (NFHS-5)
label.hg: auraton ne abortion complications ka ilaaj private sector mein karwaya (NFHS-5)

actions.en: If you need an abortion, see a registered doctor early. Pills prescribed by a qualified doctor are approved up to nine weeks of pregnancy.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe abortion karwana hai, toh jaldi kisi registered doctor se milo. Qualified doctor ke prescription par pills pregnancy ke nau hafte tak approved hain.

actions.en: Do not take abortion pills bought over a counter without a doctor's advice.
actions.hg: Counter se khareedi abortion pills doctor ki salaah ke bina mat lo.

actions.en: After any abortion, go to the nearest hospital or call 112 if there is very heavy bleeding, fever, severe pain or fainting. Tell the doctor exactly what was taken and when.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi abortion ke baad, agar bahut zyada bleeding, bukhaar, tez dard ya behoshi ho, toh sabse nazdeeki hospital jao ya 112 par call karo. Doctor ko saaf batao ki kya liya tha aur kab.

actions.en: Find out now which government hospital near you offers abortion care, before you or a friend needs it.
actions.hg: Abhi pata karo ki tumhare paas kaunsa sarkari hospital abortion care deta hai, isse pehle ki tumhe ya kisi dost ko zaroorat pade.

actions.en: If you are under 18, a trusted adult or the Child Helpline 1098 can help you reach a registered doctor.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh koi bharosemand bada ya Child Helpline 1098 tumhe registered doctor tak pahunchne mein madad kar sakte hain.

title.en: Unplanned 47.6%, last child too young 9.7%: why Indian women end pregnancies, by the numbers
title.hg: Unplanned 47.6%, pichhla bachcha bahut chhota 9.7%: Indian auratein pregnancy kyun khatam karti hain, numbers mein

dek.en: NFHS-5 asked women the main reason for their last abortion. Nearly half said the pregnancy was unplanned; only 3.6% blamed a contraceptive that failed. Read each answer as a family's story and most of them point to the same place: a family-planning gap, not a moral failing.
dek.hg: NFHS-5 ne auraton se unke last abortion ki main wajah poochi. Lagbhag aadhi ne kaha ki pregnancy unplanned thi; sirf 3.6% ne fail hue contraceptive ko wajah bataya. Har jawab ko ek parivaar ki kahani ki tarah padho, toh zyada tar ek hi jagah ishaara karte hain: family planning ki kami, koi naitik galti nahi.

statLabel.en: of women said their abortion was for an unplanned pregnancy (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: auraton ne kaha ki unka abortion unplanned pregnancy ki wajah se hua (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women whose last pregnancy ended in abortion named an unplanned pregnancy as the main reason (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: auraton ne, jinki last pregnancy abortion par khatam hui, unplanned pregnancy ko main wajah bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: named contraceptive failure as the main reason (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: ne contraceptive fail hone ko main wajah bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of married women wanted to avoid or delay a pregnancy but used no method (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: shaadishuda auratein pregnancy taalna ya rokna chahti thi, par koi method use nahi kar rahi thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: pregnancies in India in 2015, nearly half of them unintended (national estimate)
label.hg: pregnancies hui India mein 2015 mein, jinmein se lagbhag aadhi unintended thi (national estimate)

claim.en: Women who have abortions are careless, or have something to hide.
claim.hg: Abortion karwane wali auratein laparwaah hoti hain, ya kuch chhupa rahi hoti hain.

truth.en: In NFHS-5 the commonest reasons were an unplanned pregnancy (47.6%), the woman's health (11.3%) and a last child still too young (9.7%). These are family-planning and health problems, not moral ones.
truth.hg: NFHS-5 mein sabse aam wajahein thi unplanned pregnancy (47.6%), aurat ki apni sehat (11.3%) aur pichhla bachcha abhi bahut chhota hona (9.7%). Yeh family planning aur sehat ki problems hain, naitik nahi.

actions.en: Choose a contraceptive method before you need one, and ask a doctor or your nearest government health centre to explain the options.
actions.hg: Zaroorat padne se pehle hi koi contraceptive method chuno, aur doctor ya apne paas ke sarkari health centre se options samjho.

actions.en: Do not rely on withdrawal alone: with typical use it fails far more often than an IUD, an implant or the pill.
actions.hg: Sirf withdrawal par bharosa mat karo: typical use mein yeh IUD, implant ya pill se kahin zyada baar fail hota hai.

actions.en: If a condom breaks or no method was used, take emergency contraception as soon as possible, within five days. It is not an abortion.
actions.hg: Agar condom phat jaaye ya koi method use nahi hua, toh jitni jaldi ho sake, paanch din ke andar, emergency contraception lo. Yeh abortion nahi hai.

actions.en: If a pregnancy is unplanned, see a registered doctor early. Up to 20 weeks, one doctor's opinion is enough, for married and unmarried women alike.
actions.hg: Agar pregnancy unplanned hai, toh jaldi kisi registered doctor se milo. 20 hafte tak ek doctor ki raay kaafi hai, shaadishuda aur unmarried, dono auraton ke liye.

actions.en: Men: contraception is your job too. In NFHS-5, just 0.3% of married women relied on male sterilisation.
actions.hg: Mardon ke liye: contraception tumhari bhi zimmedari hai. NFHS-5 mein sirf 0.3% shaadishuda auraton ne male sterilisation par bharosa kiya.

title.en: Counted only if married: how India's contraception data leave out young unmarried women
title.hg: Shaadi hui toh hi ginti mein: India ka contraception data young unmarried aurton ko kaise chhod deta hai

dek.en: India's headline family-planning numbers are built around married women. The few that also count the young and unmarried show a knowledge gap, an attitude gap, and a law that has moved faster than the clinic.
dek.hg: India ke headline family-planning numbers shaadishuda aurton ke hisaab se bante hain. Jo thode numbers young aur unmarried logon ko bhi ginte hain, woh ek knowledge gap, ek soch ka gap, aur ek aisa law dikhate hain jo clinic se aage nikal chuka hai.

statLabel.en: of young women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom, against 87.3% of young men (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: young aurton (15-24 saal) ko pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai, jabki young mardon mein yeh 87.3% tha (NFHS-5)

label.en: of young women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom (2019-21)
label.hg: young aurton (15-24 saal) ko pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai (2019-21)

label.en: of young men aged 15-24 knew where to get one (2019-21)
label.hg: young mardon (15-24 saal) ko pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai (2019-21)

label.en: unmet need for family planning, measured only among currently married women (2019-21)
label.hg: family planning ki unmet need, jo sirf currently married aurton mein naapi jaati hai (2019-21)

label.en: of men agreed that women who use contraception may become promiscuous (2019-21)
label.hg: mardon ne maana ki contraception use karne wali aurtein "badchalan" ho sakti hain (2019-21)

claim.en: Teaching young people about contraception makes them have more sex.
claim.hg: Young logon ko contraception ke baare mein padhane se woh zyada sex karne lagte hain.

truth.en: UN guidance built on reviews of dozens of studies and trials finds that sexuality education does not increase sexual activity. It increases the use of condoms and contraception.
truth.hg: UN guidance, jo dozens studies aur trials ke reviews par tiki hai, kehti hai ki sexuality education se sexual activity nahi badhti. Isse condom aur contraception ka use badhta hai.

actions.en: Learn your backups before you need them: where the nearest chemist or government health centre is, and that emergency contraception works up to five days after sex, the sooner the better.
actions.hg: Zaroorat padne se pehle apne backup jaan lijiye: sabse nazdeeki chemist ya government health centre kahan hai, aur yeh ki emergency contraception sex ke baad paanch din tak kaam karti hai, jitni jaldi utna behtar.

actions.en: Buy and carry your own condoms. They need no prescription, and they are the method that also cuts the risk of STIs.
actions.hg: Apne condoms khud khareediye aur saath rakhiye. Inke liye prescription nahi chahiye, aur yahi woh method hai jo STIs ka risk bhi kam karta hai.

actions.en: If you are under 18: asking about contraception is not a crime, but a health worker who learns you are sexually active must report it. For pressure or abuse, call Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar aap 18 se kam hain: contraception ke baare mein poochna crime nahi hai, lekin health worker ko pata chale ki aap sexually active hain toh use report karna padta hai. Pressure ya abuse ho toh Child Helpline 1098 par call karein.

actions.en: If contraception fails, the abortion law's contraceptive-failure ground covers unmarried women too. See a registered doctor early; do not rely on pills from a chemist alone.
actions.hg: Agar contraception fail ho jaaye, toh abortion law ka contraceptive-failure wala ground unmarried aurton par bhi lagta hai. Jaldi kisi registered doctor ke paas jaiye; sirf chemist ki pills ke bharose mat rahiye.

actions.en: Men: a condom is your job too. Do not leave contraception to her and then judge her for using it.
actions.hg: Mardon ke liye: condom aapki bhi zimmedari hai. Contraception uske bharose chhod kar, phir use karne par use judge mat kijiye.

title.en: Boys recorded as child-rape victims rose from 414 to 892 in two years. India's last national survey suggests that is still a fraction
title.hg: Police record mein child rape ke shikaar ladke do saal mein 414 se 892 hue. India ka aakhri national survey ishaara karta hai ki yeh ab bhi asli number ka chhota sa hissa hai

dek.en: Police records count boys as about 2 in every 100 child victims of penetrative sexual assault. The government's own 2007 study found boys were more than half of the children who reported sexual abuse. Here is what sits inside that gap, and what helps a boy tell.
dek.hg: Police records mein penetrative sexual assault ke shikaar har 100 bachchon mein lagbhag 2 hi ladke hain. Sarkar ki apni 2007 ki study mein sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein aadhe se zyada ladke the. Is gap ke andar kya chhupa hai, aur ladka apni baat bata sake, iske liye kya madad karta hai.

statLabel.hg: ladke, 2024 mein penetrative sexual assault ke shikaar record hue 44,567 bachchon mein

claim.en: Boys don't get sexually abused, or it is very rare.
claim.hg: Ladkon ka sexual abuse nahi hota, ya bahut kam hota hai.

truth.en: Boys were 52.94% of the children who reported sexual abuse in the government's 2007 study, and UNICEF estimates about 1 in 11 boys and men worldwide were raped or sexually assaulted in childhood. Police records show how rarely it is reported, not how rarely it happens.
truth.hg: Sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein 52.94% ladke the, aur UNICEF ka estimate hai ki duniya bhar mein lagbhag 11 mein se 1 ladka ya aadmi bachpan mein rape ya sexual assault ka shikaar hua. Police records batate hain ki yeh kitna kam report hota hai, yeh nahi ki kitna kam hota hai.

actions.en: Tell the boys in your life, plainly, that sexual abuse can happen to boys and is never the child's fault.
actions.hg: Apne aas-paas ke ladkon ko saaf shabdon mein bataiye ki ladkon ka bhi sexual abuse ho sakta hai, aur ismein bachche ki kabhi galti nahi hoti.

actions.en: If a boy tells you something, believe him. Do not laugh it off as 'masti' or ask why he did not fight back.
actions.hg: Koi ladka kuch bataye to uski baat maaniye. Use 'masti' keh ke mat taaliye, aur yeh mat poochhiye ki usne virodh kyun nahi kiya.

actions.en: Watch for changes in any child: sudden fear of one person, sleep problems, not wanting to be alone with someone.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi bachche mein badlaav pe nazar rakhiye: kisi ek insaan se achanak darr, neend ki problem, ya kisi ke saath akele rehne se katraana.

actions.en: Warn teenage boys about sextortion: stop replying, do not pay, tell an adult, and call 1930.
actions.hg: Teenage ladkon ko sextortion ke baare mein bataiye: reply band karo, paise mat do, kisi bade ko batao, aur 1930 pe call karo.

actions.en: If you know or suspect abuse of any child, call 1098 or 112, or go to the police.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi bachche ke abuse ka pata ho ya shak ho, to 1098 ya 112 pe call kijiye, ya police ke paas jaaiye.

title.en: In 96.6% of child-rape cases recorded in 2024, the accused was someone the child knew. 'Stranger danger' is the wrong first lesson
title.hg: 2024 mein child rape ke 96.6% cases mein accused koi aisa tha jise bachcha jaanta tha. 'Stranger danger' pehla lesson nahi hona chahiye

dek.en: Police recorded an unknown or unidentified accused in only 1,492 of 44,126 cases. Here is how to read NCRB's offender table, and how to rebuild child-safety rules around access, trust and secrecy.
dek.hg: Police record mein 44,126 mein se sirf 1,492 cases mein accused anjaan tha ya pehchana nahi ja saka. NCRB ki offender table kaise padhein, aur bachchon ki safety ke rules access, trust aur secrecy ke hisaab se kaise banayein.

claim.hg: Bachchon ko sabse bada khatra strangers se hai.

truth.en: In 2024, police recorded an unknown or unidentified accused in only 1,492 of 44,126 POCSO penetrative-assault cases. The rest named someone the child knew.
truth.hg: 2024 mein POCSO penetrative assault ke 44,126 cases mein se sirf 1,492 mein accused anjaan tha ya pehchana nahi gaya. Baaki sab cases mein accused koi aisa tha jise bachcha jaanta tha.

actions.en: Teach every child that no adult, including family, may ask them to keep a secret about touch or their body.
actions.hg: Har bachche ko sikhaiye ki koi bhi bada, ghar ka ho ya bahar ka, unse touch ya body se judi baat secret rakhne ko nahi keh sakta.

actions.en: Keep one-to-one time with tutors, coaches, drivers and relatives easy to see and easy to interrupt.
actions.hg: Tutor, coach, driver ya relative ke saath bachche ka akele ka time aisa rakhiye jise koi bhi dekh sake aur beech mein aa sake.

actions.en: Watch the adult who gives one child special attention, gifts or private chats, not only the stranger at the gate.
actions.hg: Sirf gate pe khade stranger pe nahi, us bade pe bhi nazar rakhiye jo kisi ek bachche ko special attention, gifts ya private chats deta hai.

actions.en: Ask about online friends calmly and often, without threatening to take the phone away.
actions.hg: Online friends ke baare mein aaram se aur baar-baar poochhiye, phone chheenne ki dhamki diye bina.

actions.en: If you know or suspect abuse, call 1098 or 112, or go to the police. Under POCSO, reporting is everyone's duty.
actions.hg: Abuse ka pata ho ya shak ho, to 1098 ya 112 pe call kijiye, ya police ke paas jaaiye. POCSO mein report karna sabki zimmedari hai.

title.en: 831 victims under six: protecting children who are too young to tell, or who tell in ways adults miss
title.hg: Chhe saal se kam umar ke 831 victims: un bachchon ki hifaazat jo bataane ke liye bahut chhote hain, ya jinki baat adults samajh nahi paate

dek.en: In 2024 police recorded 831 child victims of penetrative sexual assault under six and 3,438 aged six to 12. Toddlers cannot name what happened, and disabled children are often not understood when they try. Their safety depends on adults who notice, on safer daily routines, and on legal safeguards many families have never heard of.
dek.hg: 2024 mein police ne chhe saal se kam umar ke 831 bachchon ko penetrative sexual assault ke victims ke roop mein darj kiya, aur chhe se 12 saal ke 3,438 ko. Chhote bachche bata nahi sakte ki kya hua, aur disabled bachche jab batane ki koshish karte hain toh aksar unhe samjha nahi jaata. Unki hifaazat aise adults par tiki hai jo dhyaan dein, rozmarra ki safer routines par, aur un kanooni safeguards par jinke baare mein kai parivaron ne kabhi suna hi nahi.

claim.en: Children under six are too young to be targeted for sexual abuse.
claim.hg: Chhe saal se chhote bachche sexual abuse ka nishana banne ke liye bahut chhote hain.

truth.en: Police recorded 831 victims of penetrative sexual assault under six in 2024, and 3,438 aged six to 12. These are minimum counts, because the youngest children rarely tell.
truth.hg: 2024 mein police ne chhe saal se kam umar ke 831 bachchon ko penetrative sexual assault ke victims ke roop mein darj kiya, aur chhe se 12 saal ke 3,438 ko. Yeh kam se kam ginti hai, kyunki sabse chhote bachche shayad hi kabhi bata paate hain.

actions.en: Teach every child the correct names for private parts, in words, signs or pictures, and a way to say 'no' and 'someone hurt me'.
actions.hg: Har bachche ko private parts ke sahi naam sikhaiye, shabdon, signs ya pictures mein, aur 'na' aur 'kisi ne mujhe dard diya' kehne ka tareeka bhi.

actions.en: Keep bathing, changing and toileting to a few named adults, and tell the child who they are.
actions.hg: Nahlana, kapde badalna aur toilet karana kuch chune hue adults tak seemit rakhiye, aur bachche ko bataiye ki woh kaun hain.

actions.en: Ask day cares, schools, hostels and van operators which adults are ever alone with your child.
actions.hg: Day care, school, hostel aur van walon se poochiye ki kaun-kaun se adults kabhi aapke bachche ke saath akele hote hain.

actions.en: If a disabled child is abused, insist on a statement at home, an interpreter or special educator, and a video recording.
actions.hg: Agar kisi disabled bachche ka abuse hua hai, toh ghar par statement, interpreter ya special educator, aur video recording ki maang par adey rahiye.

actions.en: If you notice signs, call 1098 or 112. You need suspicion, not proof.
actions.hg: Agar aapko signs dikhein, toh 1098 ya 112 par call kariye. Sabut nahi, shak kaafi hai.

title.en: 3,658 child-rape cases in 2024 named a family member. Why abuse at home so rarely reaches the police
title.hg: 2024 mein child rape ke 3,658 cases mein accused family ka hi member tha. Ghar ke andar ka abuse police tak itna kam kyun pahunchta hai

dek.en: It is the smallest row in NCRB's table of known abusers, and probably the biggest undercount. The adults the law expects to report are often the abuser's own wife, mother or brother. What the number hides, why silence is strongest at home, and what helps a family break it.
dek.hg: NCRB ki known abusers wali table mein yeh sabse chhoti row hai, aur shayad sabse badi undercount bhi. Law jin logon se report karne ki ummeed karta hai, woh aksar abuser ki apni biwi, maa ya bhai hote hain. Yeh number kya chhupata hai, ghar mein chuppi sabse gehri kyun hoti hai, aur family ko yeh chuppi todne mein kya madad karta hai.

statLabel.hg: child rape cases 2024 mein, jinmein accused family member tha

label.hg: POCSO ke child rape cases 2024 mein, jinmein police ne family member ko accused darj kiya

claim.en: Abuse by a family member is rare, and when it happens the family deals with it.
claim.hg: Family member ka kiya abuse rare hai, aur ho bhi jaye toh family khud sambhal leti hai.

truth.en: Police recorded a family member as the accused in 3,658 child-rape cases in 2024, and those are only the cases someone reported. Keeping it inside the family is not an option the law allows.
truth.hg: 2024 mein police ne child rape ke 3,658 cases mein family member ko accused darj kiya, aur yeh sirf woh cases hain jo kisi ne report kiye. Baat ko family ke andar dabana law allow nahi karta.

actions.en: If a child names a relative, believe them, and make sure that person cannot reach the child tonight, even if someone has to leave the house.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha kisi rishtedaar ka naam le, toh uska yakeen kijiye, aur pakka kijiye ki woh insaan aaj raat bachche tak na pahunch sake, chahe kisi ko ghar chhodna pade.

actions.en: Report it to the police, 1098 or 112 yourself. The duty to report covers relatives, and you do not need the family's permission.
actions.hg: Police, 1098 ya 112 par khud report kijiye. Report karne ki duty rishtedaaron par bhi laagu hoti hai, aur iske liye family ki permission nahi chahiye.

actions.en: Never let elders settle it inside the family or push the child to take back what they said.
actions.hg: Bado ko yeh maamla family ke andar 'settle' mat karne dijiye, aur bachche par apni baat wapas lene ka dabaav mat banne dijiye.

actions.en: If the accused is the family's earner, apply to the District Legal Services Authority for compensation; it does not depend on a conviction.
actions.hg: Agar accused hi ghar ka kamane wala hai, toh District Legal Services Authority mein compensation ke liye apply kijiye; yeh conviction par depend nahi karta.

actions.en: Tell children, girls and boys alike, that no one in the family may ask them to keep a secret about their body.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko, ladkiyon aur ladkon dono ko, saaf bataiye ki family ka koi bhi insaan unse unki body ke baare mein koi secret rakhne ko nahi keh sakta.

title.en: When the abuser is a father, uncle or brother: what a parent must do to protect the child, step by step
title.hg: Jab abuser father, chacha ya bhai ho: bachche ki hifazat ke liye parent ko kya karna chahiye, step by step

dek.en: Abuse by a relative brings choices no other case does. The accused may pay the rent, elders may demand silence, and the child may still live under his roof. What to do in the first hours, with the police, under family pressure, and in the long months after.
dek.hg: Rishtedaar ka kiya abuse aise faisle saamne laata hai jo kisi aur case mein nahi aate. Accused shayad ghar ka kiraya bharta ho, bade chuppi ki maang karein, aur bachcha shayad abhi bhi usi ki chhat ke neeche rehta ho. Pehle kuch ghanton mein, police ke saath, family ke dabaav mein, aur uske baad ke lambe mahinon mein kya karna hai.

claim.en: When the abuser is family, it is better to settle it quietly at home.

truth.en: The law makes no exception for relatives: anyone who knows of child sexual abuse must report it, and the Supreme Court has told courts never to suggest compromise or marriage in sexual offence cases.
truth.hg: Law rishtedaaron ko koi chhoot nahi deta: jise bhi child sexual abuse ka pata ho, use report karna hoga, aur Supreme Court ne courts se kaha hai ki sexual offence ke cases mein kabhi compromise ya shaadi ka sujhaav na dein.

actions.en: Believe your child, and make sure the accused cannot reach them tonight, even if that means leaving the house with the child.
actions.hg: Apne bachche ka yakeen kijiye, aur pakka kijiye ki accused aaj raat uske paas na pahunch sake, chahe iske liye aapko bachche ke saath ghar chhodna pade.

actions.en: Report to the police, 1098 or 112. The duty to report child sexual abuse has no exception for family.
actions.hg: Police, 1098 ya 112 par report kijiye. Child sexual abuse report karne ki duty mein family ke liye koi chhoot nahi hai.

actions.en: Tell the police the child's statement must be taken away from the accused, and ask the prosecutor for bail conditions that keep him away from the child.
actions.hg: Police se kahiye ki bachche ka statement accused se door liya jaye, aur prosecutor se aisi bail conditions maangiye jo use bachche se door rakhein.

actions.en: Write down every plea, offer or threat to 'compromise', with dates, and give it to the police and the prosecutor.
actions.hg: 'Compromise' ke liye har guzarish, offer ya dhamki ko date ke saath likh lijiye, aur police aur prosecutor ko dijiye.

actions.en: Apply to the District Legal Services Authority for compensation, which does not depend on a conviction, and ask it about free legal aid.
actions.hg: Compensation ke liye District Legal Services Authority mein apply kijiye, jo conviction par depend nahi karta, aur wahin free legal aid ke baare mein bhi poochiye.

title.en: Child sexual abuse peaks between 12 and 17: three data sources, one warning for parents of teenagers
title.hg: Bachchon ka sexual abuse 12 se 17 ki age mein sabse zyada hota hai: teen data sources, teenagers ke parents ke liye ek warning

dek.en: A 2007 government study, UNICEF's 2024 global estimate and India's police records all point to adolescence. Why the risk climbs after 12, and what protection looks like for a 14-year-old rather than a toddler.
dek.hg: 2007 ki sarkari study, UNICEF ka 2024 ka global estimate aur India ke police records, teeno teenage ki taraf ishara karte hain. 12 ke baad risk kyun badhta hai, aur 14 saal ke bachche ki protection ek chhote bachche se alag kaise ho.

claim.hg: Bachche sabse zyada risk mein tab hote hain jab woh chhote hote hain. 13-14 saal tak woh apna khayal khud rakh sakte hain.

truth.en: All three data sources point the other way: in the 2007 government study abuse rose from age 10 and peaked at 12-15, UNICEF finds a spike at 14-17, and police records peak at 16-18.

actions.en: Keep body-safety talks going after 12: update them for phones, coaching, hostels and first relationships instead of stopping at 'good touch, bad touch'.
actions.hg: 12 ke baad bhi body-safety ki baat jaari rakhiye: 'good touch, bad touch' pe rukne ke bajaye phone, coaching, hostel aur pehle relationships ke hisaab se baat update kijiye.

actions.en: Agree a code word or a no-questions-asked pickup, so your teenager can leave any situation and call you at any hour.
actions.hg: Ek code word ya no-questions-asked pickup tay kijiye, taaki aapka teenager kisi bhi situation se nikal kar kisi bhi waqt aapko call kar sake.

actions.en: Notice any adult who singles out one teenager for special attention, gifts, private chats or secrets, online or offline.
actions.hg: Aise kisi bhi adult pe dhyan dijiye jo kisi ek teenager ko special attention, gifts, private chats ya secrets deta ho, online ho ya offline.

actions.hg: Agar koi teenager aapko abuse ya blackmail ke baare mein bataye, toh calm rahiye, uski baat pe bharosa kijiye aur 1098 ya 112 pe call kijiye. Online abuse ki report cybercrime.gov.in pe ya 1930 pe kijiye.

title.en: The child grooms nobody talks about: 15.9% of Indian men aged 25-29 married before 21
title.hg: Woh child grooms jinki baat koi nahi karta: India mein 25-29 saal ke 15.9% mardon ki shaadi 21 se pehle hui

dek.en: Child marriage is talked about as a girls' problem. But India's 2006 law calls any man under 21 a child, and the newest national survey finds nearly one in six young men married before that age. Who they are, what the law offers them, and why leaving them out of the conversation fails girls too.
dek.hg: Child marriage ko ladkiyon ki problem ki tarah dekha jaata hai. Lekin India ka 2006 ka law 21 se kam umar ke har ladke ko child maanta hai, aur sabse naya national survey batata hai ki lagbhag har chhah mein se ek young man ki shaadi us umar se pehle hui. Yeh kaun hain, law unhe kya deta hai, aur unhe baatchit se bahar rakhna ladkiyon ko bhi kyun nuksaan pahunchata hai.

label.en: of men aged 15-49 said a husband can be justified in beating his wife (NFHS-5), up from 42%
label.hg: 15-49 saal ke mardon ne kaha ki pati ka patni ko maarna sahi ho sakta hai (NFHS-5), pehle yeh 42% tha

claim.en: Child marriage is only about girls.
claim.hg: Child marriage sirf ladkiyon ka mudda hai.

truth.en: Indian law treats any man under 21 as a child, and 15.9% of men aged 25-29 surveyed in 2023-24 had married before 21. Their marriages are child marriages too, and the attitudes young husbands bring into them shape girls' lives.
truth.hg: Indian law 21 se kam umar ke har mard ko child maanta hai, aur 2023-24 ke survey mein 25-29 saal ke 15.9% mardon ki shaadi 21 se pehle hui thi. Unki shaadiyan bhi child marriages hain, aur young pati jo soch shaadi mein lekar aate hain, woh ladkiyon ki zindagi ko shape karti hai.

actions.en: If a wedding is being fixed for a girl under 18 or a boy under 21, call 1098 or 112, or tell the district Child Marriage Prohibition Officer, before the wedding day.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki ya 21 se kam umar ke ladke ki shaadi tay ho rahi hai, toh shaadi ke din se pehle 1098 ya 112 pe call kijiye, ya district ke Child Marriage Prohibition Officer ko bataiye.

actions.en: If you are under 21 and your family is fixing your marriage, say no and ask for help: a magistrate can stop the wedding with an injunction.
actions.hg: Agar aapki umar 21 se kam hai aur family aapki shaadi tay kar rahi hai, toh mana kijiye aur madad maangiye: magistrate injunction dekar shaadi rok sakta hai.

actions.en: If you were married as a child and want out, get legal advice at once: the window to ask a court to annul the marriage is short.
actions.hg: Agar aapki shaadi bachpan mein hui thi aur aap usse bahar nikalna chahte hain, toh turant legal advice lijiye: court se shaadi annul karwane ki window chhoti hai.

actions.en: When your school, panchayat or NGO talks about child marriage, ask about the groom's age and his family's role too.
actions.hg: Jab aapka school, panchayat ya NGO child marriage ki baat kare, toh dulhe ki umar aur uski family ke role ke baare mein bhi poochiye.

actions.en: Tell the young men in your family that contraception and a wife's safety are a husband's business.
actions.hg: Apni family ke young mardon ko bataiye ki contraception aur patni ki safety pati ki bhi zimmedari hai.

title.en: Telangana counted 4,440 child marriage cases and filed 149 FIRs: why India's child marriage law is barely used
title.hg: Telangana ne 4,440 child marriage cases gine aur 149 FIR darj ki: India ka child marriage law itna kam kyun istemaal hota hai

dek.en: One in five young women surveyed in 2023-24 had been married before 18. Yet police registered 1,499 cases under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act in 2024, and courts convicted in 209. What the states told the Supreme Court, why police and families avoid the law, and whether more FIRs should even be the goal.
dek.hg: 2023-24 mein survey ki gayi har paanch mein se ek young woman ki shaadi 18 se pehle ho chuki thi. Phir bhi police ne 2024 mein Prohibition of Child Marriage Act ke tahat 1,499 cases register kiye, aur courts ne 209 mein conviction di. States ne Supreme Court ko kya bataya, police aur parivaar is law se kyun bachte hain, aur kya zyada FIR hi asli goal honi chahiye.

statLabel.en: convictions under the child marriage law in all of India in 2024
statLabel.hg: convictions, 2024 mein poore India mein child marriage law ke tahat

label.en: cases registered under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act across India in 2024
label.hg: cases 2024 mein poore India mein Prohibition of Child Marriage Act ke tahat register hue

label.en: convictions under the Act in 2024, against 625 acquittals, with 8,553 cases pending trial
label.hg: convictions 2024 mein is Act ke tahat, 625 acquittals ke muqable; 8,553 cases trial mein pending

label.hg: Telangana ne teen saal mein itne child marriage cases report kiye, aur itni FIR darj ki (Supreme Court, 2024)

label.en: of India's 6,038 child marriage cases in 2023 were registered in one state, Assam
label.hg: cases, 2023 mein India ke 6,038 child marriage cases mein se, ek hi state Assam mein register hue

claim.en: If child marriage were still common, police would be filing thousands of cases.
claim.hg: Agar child marriage aaj bhi aam hoti, toh police hazaaron cases darj kar rahi hoti.

truth.en: Police registered 1,499 cases in 2024, while one in five women aged 20-24 surveyed in 2023-24 had been married before 18. FIR counts measure what police do, not how many girls are married.
truth.hg: Police ne 2024 mein 1,499 cases register kiye, jabki 2023-24 mein survey ki gayi 20-24 saal ki har paanch mein se ek woman ki shaadi 18 se pehle ho chuki thi. FIR ki ginti yeh batati hai ki police kya karti hai, yeh nahi ki kitni ladkiyon ki shaadi hoti hai.

actions.en: If a child marriage is being planned, call Child Helpline 1098 or 112 before the wedding date: a magistrate can order it stopped.
actions.hg: Agar kisi child marriage ki taiyari chal rahi hai, toh shaadi ki date se pehle Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye: magistrate use rokne ka order de sakta hai.

actions.en: Ask your district administration who the Child Marriage Prohibition Officer is, and where their quarterly reports are published, as the Supreme Court directed in 2024.
actions.hg: Apne district administration se poochhiye ki Child Marriage Prohibition Officer kaun hai, aur unki quarterly reports kahan publish hoti hain, jaisa Supreme Court ne 2024 mein direct kiya tha.

actions.en: Do not perform, arrange or help organise a wedding where the bride is under 18 or the groom under 21: the law can punish everyone who promotes or permits it, not only the groom.
actions.hg: Aisi kisi shaadi ko na karwaiye, na arrange kijiye, na organise karne mein madad kijiye jismein dulhan 18 se kam ya dulha 21 se kam ho: law sirf dulhe ko nahi, shaadi ko promote ya permit karne wale har vyakti ko saza de sakta hai.

actions.en: If you were married before 18, you can ask a district court to annul the marriage until two years after you turn 18. Speak to a lawyer early.
actions.hg: Agar aapki shaadi 18 se pehle hui thi, toh aap 18 ke hone ke do saal baad tak district court se shaadi annul karwane ki maang kar sakte hain. Jaldi kisi lawyer se baat kijiye.

title.en: West Bengal 36.4%, Bihar 34.6%, Tripura 34.0%: the NFHS-6 map of where Indian girls are still married as children
title.hg: West Bengal 36.4%, Bihar 34.6%, Tripura 34.0%: NFHS-6 ka naksha, jahan Indian ladkiyon ki shaadi aaj bhi bachpan mein ho rahi hai

dek.en: Nationally, one in five women aged 20-24 was married before 18. In three states it is more than one in three, and in rural West Bengal about four in ten. What the provisional NFHS-6 state data show, and what they cannot tell us about why the numbers fell.
dek.hg: Desh bhar mein 20-24 saal ki har paanch mein se ek woman ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui thi. Teen states mein yeh har teen mein se ek se zyada hai, aur rural West Bengal mein lagbhag das mein se chaar. Provisional NFHS-6 state data kya dikhata hai, aur numbers kyun gire, iske baare mein woh kya nahi bata sakta.

statLabel.en: of women aged 20-24 in West Bengal were married before 18 (NFHS-6, 2023-24)
statLabel.hg: West Bengal mein 20-24 saal ki women ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui thi (NFHS-6, 2023-24)

label.en: of women aged 20-24 in West Bengal were married before 18, the highest of any state (NFHS-6, 2023-24)
label.hg: West Bengal mein 20-24 saal ki women ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui, jo kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada hai (NFHS-6, 2023-24)

label.hg: poore India mein 20-24 saal ki women ki shaadi 2023-24 mein 18 se pehle hui thi; 2019-21 mein yeh 23.3% tha

label.hg: Indian women (20-24 saal) ki shaadi 15 saal ki umar tak ho chuki thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: Child marriage is a thing of the past in India.
claim.hg: India mein child marriage ab purani baat ho chuki hai.

truth.en: One in five women aged 20-24 surveyed in 2023-24 had been married before 18. In West Bengal, Bihar and Tripura, it was more than one in three.
truth.hg: 2023-24 mein survey ki gayi 20-24 saal ki har paanch mein se ek woman ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui thi. West Bengal, Bihar aur Tripura mein yeh har teen mein se ek se zyada thi.

actions.en: Look up your own state's row in the NFHS-6 fact sheets: the national 20.1% can hide a state at 36.4%, or one where the rate is rising.
actions.hg: NFHS-6 fact sheets mein apne state ki row dekhiye: national 20.1% ke peeche 36.4% wala state bhi chhupa ho sakta hai, ya aisa state jahan rate badh raha hai.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 is about to be married, call Child Helpline 1098 or 112 before the wedding date, not after it.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki kisi ladki ki shaadi hone wali hai, toh shaadi ki date se pehle Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye, baad mein nahi.

actions.en: Help a girl you know stay in school past Class 10, whether that means fees, a bus pass or a scholarship form.
actions.hg: Apni jaan-pehchaan ki kisi ladki ko Class 10 ke baad bhi school mein bane rehne mein madad kijiye, chahe woh fees ho, bus pass ho ya scholarship ka form.

actions.en: If you were married before 18, you can ask a district court to annul the marriage until two years after you turn 18.
actions.hg: Agar aapki shaadi 18 se pehle hui thi, toh aap 18 ke hone ke do saal ke andar district court se shaadi annul karwane ki maang kar sakte hain.

title.en: 'Child marriage only happens in poor, backward states': NFHS-6 shows it rising in Delhi, Punjab and Himachal
title.hg: 'Child marriage sirf gareeb, pichhde states mein hoti hai': NFHS-6 dikhata hai ki Delhi, Punjab aur Himachal mein yeh badh rahi hai

dek.en: The national rate fell to 20.1%, yet provisional survey data show it rising in eight states and union territories, among them places rarely described as poor or backward. What the rises show, how far to trust them, and why the myth costs girls time.
dek.hg: Desh ka rate girkar 20.1% pe aa gaya, phir bhi provisional survey data dikhata hai ki aath states aur union territories mein yeh badha, aur unmein aisi jagahein bhi hain jinhe shayad hi kabhi gareeb ya pichhda kaha jaata hai. Yeh badhat kya dikhati hai, is pe kitna bharosa karein, aur yeh myth ladkiyon ka waqt kyun chheen leta hai.

statLabel.hg: Delhi mein 20-24 saal ki itni women ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui (2023-24), pehle yeh 9.9% tha

label.hg: India ke towns aur cities mein 20-24 saal ki itni women ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui (2023-24), bilkul Delhi jitna hissa

label.hg: poore India mein 20-24 saal ki itni women ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui (2023-24), pehle yeh 23.3% tha

claim.en: Child marriage only happens in poor, backward states and remote villages.
claim.hg: Child marriage sirf gareeb, pichhde states aur door-daraz ke gaon mein hoti hai.

truth.en: About one in nine young women in India's towns and cities was married before 18, and provisional NFHS-6 data show the share rising in Delhi, Punjab and Himachal Pradesh while it fell nationally.
truth.hg: India ke towns aur cities mein lagbhag har nau mein se ek young woman ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui thi, aur provisional NFHS-6 data dikhata hai ki Delhi, Punjab aur Himachal Pradesh mein yeh hissa badha, jabki desh bhar mein gira.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 or a boy under 21 is about to be married, call 1098 or 112 before the wedding date, in a city flat as much as in a village.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki ya 21 se kam umar ke ladke ki shaadi hone wali hai, toh shaadi ki date se pehle 1098 ya 112 pe call kijiye, chahe woh shehar ka flat ho ya gaon ka ghar.

actions.en: Before you repeat that child marriage is a village problem, look up your own state's NFHS-6 figure.
actions.hg: Yeh kehne se pehle ki child marriage gaon ki problem hai, apne state ka NFHS-6 figure dekh lijiye.

actions.en: If a classmate stops coming to school and there is talk of a wedding, tell a teacher or counsellor you trust.
actions.hg: Agar koi classmate school aana band kar de aur shaadi ki baat chal rahi ho, toh kisi bharose ke teacher ya counsellor ko bataiye.

actions.en: Find out who your district's Child Marriage Prohibition Officer is and how to reach them, before you need to.
actions.hg: Zaroorat padne se pehle hi pata kar lijiye ki aapke district ka Child Marriage Prohibition Officer kaun hai aur unse kaise contact karein.

actions.en: Read single-state survey rises with care, especially in small states and union territories, but do not wait for certainty to act.
actions.hg: Kisi ek state ki survey badhat ko dhyaan se padhiye, khaas kar chhote states aur union territories mein, lekin action ke liye pakki certainty ka intezaar mat kijiye.

title.en: Valid until challenged: why India's 2006 law leaves most child marriages standing, and punishes so little
title.hg: Challenge hone tak valid: India ka 2006 ka law zyadatar child marriages ko kyun bana rehne deta hai, aur itni kam saza kyun deta hai

dek.en: Performing a child marriage is a crime, but the marriage itself usually survives unless the person married as a child goes to court before turning 20. A clause-by-clause guide to the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, its light penalties and the gaps the Supreme Court has flagged.
dek.hg: Child marriage karwana crime hai, lekin shaadi khud aam taur pe bani rehti hai, jab tak jis insaan ki shaadi bachpan mein hui woh 20 ka hone se pehle court na jaaye. Prohibition of Child Marriage Act ki clause-by-clause guide: uski halki sazaayein, aur woh kamiyan jinki taraf Supreme Court ne ishaara kiya.

statLabel.en: after reaching adulthood: the window in which a child marriage can be annulled
statLabel.hg: adult hone ke baad: itne samay ke andar child marriage annul karwayi ja sakti hai

label.en: after turning 18: the deadline for a person married as a child to ask a court to annul the marriage
label.hg: 18 ka hone ke baad: bachpan mein byahe gaye insaan ke paas court se shaadi annul karwane ki itni hi deadline hai

label.en: maximum fine for an adult groom or anyone who performs or promotes a child marriage, with at most 2 years in prison and no minimum
label.hg: adult dulhe ya child marriage karwane ya uska badhawa dene wale pe maximum jurmana, saath mein zyada se zyada 2 saal jail aur koi minimum nahi

label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue child marriage trials ka conviction rate: 625 acquittals ke muqable 209 convictions

label.en: child marriage cases pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: 2024 ke end mein child marriage ke itne cases trial ke intezaar mein the

claim.en: A child marriage is automatically invalid in India.
claim.hg: India mein child marriage apne aap invalid hoti hai.

truth.en: Most child marriages are voidable, not void: they stand unless the person married as a child asks a district court to annul them before turning 20. Only narrow cases, such as a child sold or forced into marriage or a wedding held against a court injunction, are void from the start.
truth.hg: Zyadatar child marriages voidable hain, void nahi: woh tab tak bani rehti hain jab tak bachpan mein byaha gaya insaan 20 ka hone se pehle district court se unhe annul karne ki maang na kare. Sirf kuch khaas cases, jaise bachche ko shaadi ke liye becha gaya ho ya zabardasti shaadi karwayi gayi ho, ya shaadi court injunction ke khilaaf hui ho, shuru se hi void hote hain.

actions.en: If a child marriage is being planned, call 1098 or 112, or ask for a court injunction: a wedding held in breach of one is void.
actions.hg: Agar child marriage plan ho rahi hai, toh 1098 ya 112 pe call kijiye, ya court se injunction maangiye: injunction todkar hui shaadi void hoti hai.

actions.en: If you were married as a child, get legal advice as early as you can and before you turn 20; the Women Helpline 181 can help you find support.
actions.hg: Agar aapki shaadi bachpan mein hui thi, toh jitni jaldi ho sake aur 20 ka hone se pehle legal advice lijiye; Women Helpline 181 support dhoondhne mein madad kar sakti hai.

actions.en: Keep proof of your age, such as a birth certificate or school record, somewhere safe outside your in-laws' house.
actions.hg: Apni umar ka saboot, jaise birth certificate ya school record, sasural ke bahar kisi surakshit jagah pe rakhiye.

actions.en: Do not treat an engagement fixed for a child as harmless: the Supreme Court has asked Parliament to consider outlawing child betrothals.
actions.hg: Kisi bachche ke liye tay ki gayi sagaai ko maamooli mat samjhiye: Supreme Court ne Parliament se child betrothals ko ban karne pe vichaar karne ko kaha hai.

actions.en: Remember that sex with a wife under 18 is rape. A girl in that situation can call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye ki 18 se kam umar ki patni ke saath sex rape hai. Is haalat mein koi bhi ladki 1098 ya 112 pe call kar sakti hai.

title.en: CWC, DCPU, SJPU, JJB, 1098: a map of India's child-protection system, and who does what when a child is at risk
title.hg: CWC, DCPU, SJPU, JJB, 1098: India ke child-protection system ka poora map, aur bachche par khatra ho toh kaun kya karta hai

dek.en: When a child is abused, a chain of offices is supposed to act, most of them on a legal deadline. Here is who they are, what they owe the child, and where families fall through the gaps.
dek.hg: Jab kisi bachche ka abuse hota hai, toh kai offices ko ek ke baad ek kaam karna hota hai, aur zyadatar ke liye kanoon ne deadline tay ki hai. Jaaniye yeh kaun hain, bachche ke liye inki kya zimmedari hai, aur families kahan uljhkar reh jaati hain.

statLabel.en: districts the 1098 helpline covered in March 2023, when it was to be extended to every district
statLabel.hg: districts tak March 2023 mein 1098 helpline pahunchi thi, jab ise har district tak le jaana tha

label.hg: ke andar police ko POCSO case ki khabar Child Welfare Committee aur Special Court ko deni hoti hai

label.hg: mein police ko POCSO sexual assault ki investigation poori karni hoti hai

label.hg: POCSO cases jo 2024 ke end mein trial ka intezaar kar rahe the

claim.en: Only the police can act when a child is abused, and compensation comes only after a conviction.
claim.hg: Bachche ke abuse par sirf police kuch kar sakti hai, aur compensation tabhi milta hai jab accused ko saza ho.

truth.en: Anyone can call 1098 or 112, police must tell the Child Welfare Committee within 24 hours, and a Legal Services Authority can pay compensation even if no trial ever takes place.
truth.hg: 1098 ya 112 par koi bhi call kar sakta hai, police ko 24 ghante mein Child Welfare Committee ko batana hota hai, aur Legal Services Authority compensation de sakti hai, chahe trial kabhi ho hi na.

actions.en: If a child is in danger right now, call 112. For any child at risk, call 1098.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha abhi khatre mein hai, toh 112 par call kariye. Kisi bhi bachche par khatra ho, toh 1098 par.

actions.en: Ask for the free copy of the FIR, and remember you can report at any police station.
actions.hg: FIR ki free copy maangiye, aur yaad rakhiye ki aap kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakte hain.

actions.en: Write to the Child Welfare Committee, which police must inform within 24 hours, and ask what it has decided about the child's safety.
actions.hg: Child Welfare Committee ko likhkar poochiye ki bachche ki safety par usne kya faisla liya; police ko 24 ghante mein use case ki khabar deni hoti hai.

actions.en: Apply to the District Legal Services Authority for compensation and a free lawyer without waiting for the verdict.
actions.hg: Compensation aur free lawyer ke liye District Legal Services Authority mein application dijiye, verdict ka intezaar mat kariye.

actions.en: If the police have not updated you on the investigation within 90 days, ask in writing: the law requires that update.
actions.hg: Agar 90 din mein police ne investigation ka update nahi diya, toh likhkar maangiye: kanoon yeh update dena zaroori banata hai.

title.en: 'She still hugs him, so nothing happened': why abused children often stay close to the person hurting them
title.hg: 'Woh ab bhi unke gale lagti hai, to kuch hua hi nahi': abuse jhelne wale bachche aksar usi insaan ke kareeb kyun rehte hain jo unhe nuksaan pahuncha raha hai

dek.en: Families, and sometimes police and courts, read a child's affection for an adult as proof that nothing happened. But most abusers are relatives, neighbours and family friends children depend on, and grooming is built to look like love.
dek.hg: Families, aur kabhi-kabhi police aur courts bhi, kisi adult ke liye bachche ke pyaar ko is baat ka saboot maan lete hain ki kuch hua hi nahi. Lekin zyadatar abusers rishtedaar, padosi aur family friends hote hain jin par bachche depend karte hain, aur grooming ko jaan-boojhkar pyaar jaisa dikhne ke liye banaya jaata hai.

label.en: POCSO penetrative-assault cases in 2024 in which the accused was a family member
label.hg: 2024 ke POCSO penetrative-assault cases jinmein accused family member tha

label.en: cases in which the accused was a family friend, neighbour, employer or other known person
label.hg: cases jinmein accused family friend, padosi, employer ya koi aur jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: of 44,126 cases in which the accused was unknown or unidentified
label.hg: 44,126 cases mein se itne cases jinmein accused anjaan tha ya pehchana nahi ja saka

claim.en: If a child still hugs, visits or speaks fondly of an adult, that adult cannot be abusing them.
claim.hg: Agar bachcha ab bhi kisi adult ke gale lagta hai, unke ghar jaata hai ya unki taarif karta hai, to woh adult uska abuse kar hi nahi sakta.

truth.en: An abused child may stay close to the abuser because the child loves, depends on or fears that person. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook tells judges there is no 'correct' way for a survivor to behave.
truth.hg: Abuse jhelne wala bachcha abuser ke kareeb reh sakta hai, kyunki woh us insaan se pyaar karta hai, us par depend hai ya usse darta hai. Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook judges ko batati hai ki survivor ke behave karne ka koi 'sahi' tareeka nahi hota.

actions.en: Never treat a child's affection for an adult as proof that nothing happened.
actions.hg: Kisi adult ke liye bachche ke pyaar ko kabhi is baat ka saboot mat maaniye ki kuch nahi hua.

actions.en: Do not force any child to hug, sit with or visit anyone, relatives included.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi bachche ko kisi ke gale lagne, unke paas baithne ya unke ghar jaane ke liye majboor mat kijiye, rishtedaar bhi shaamil.

actions.en: If a child discloses abuse, report it to 1098, 112 or the police even if the child still loves the person. Under POCSO it is a legal duty.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, to 1098, 112 ya police ko report kijiye, chahe bachcha ab bhi us insaan se pyaar karta ho. POCSO ke tahat yeh legal duty hai.

actions.en: Keep the child away from the accused yourself; do not wait for the child to ask for distance.
actions.hg: Bachche ko accused se door rakhna aapki zimmedari hai; is intezaar mein mat rahiye ki bachcha khud doori maange.

actions.en: Tell the child plainly: you can love someone and still tell the truth about what they did.
actions.hg: Bachche se saaf kahiye: tum kisi se pyaar karte hue bhi uske kiye ka sach bata sakte ho.

title.en: Should two 17-year-olds be criminals? The case for and against a close-in-age exception in POCSO
title.hg: Kya do 17 saal ke teenagers ko criminal maana jaana chahiye? POCSO mein close-in-age exception ke haq aur khilaaf daleelein

dek.en: For more than a decade, no 'yes' below 18 has counted in Indian law, and more than half the child victims in POCSO penetrative-assault cases in 2024 were 16 or 17. What the data can and cannot show, what each side argues, and what any change would still have to protect.
dek.hg: Das saal se zyada se Indian law mein 18 se kam umar ki kisi 'haan' ki koi keemat nahi hai, aur 2024 ke POCSO penetrative-assault cases mein aadhe se zyada child victims 16 ya 17 saal ke the. Data kya dikha sakta hai aur kya nahi, dono side kya kehti hain, aur koi bhi badlaav kin cheezon ko phir bhi bachaaye.

label.en: of child victims of penetrative sexual assault recorded under POCSO in 2024 were aged 16 to 18

label.hg: woh umar jisse Juvenile Justice Act ke hisaab se 'heinous' offence, jaise penetrative sexual assault, ke accused bachche ko adult ki tarah trial ke liye assess kiya ja sakta hai

claim.en: Most POCSO cases are really teenage love affairs.
claim.hg: Zyada tar POCSO cases asal mein teenagers ke love affairs hain.

truth.en: Nobody knows. NCRB does not count adolescent relationships separately, and its 'friends and partners' group, half of POCSO penetrative-assault cases in 2024, also holds adults who groomed children online or promised marriage.
truth.hg: Kisi ko nahi pata. NCRB adolescent relationships ko alag se nahi ginta, aur uska 'friends aur partners' wala group, jo 2024 ke POCSO penetrative-assault cases ka aadha tha, un adults ko bhi shaamil karta hai jinhone bachchon ko online groom kiya ya shaadi ka vaada kiya.

actions.en: If you are under 18 and an adult is pursuing you, calling it a relationship does not change what it is: call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 se kam ho aur koi adult tumhare peeche pada hai, toh use 'relationship' kehne se sach nahi badalta: 1098 ya 112 par call karo.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 is pregnant, take her to a registered doctor, not an unqualified provider. If she has an abortion, she and her guardian can ask the doctor to leave her name out of the report to police.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki koi ladki pregnant hai, toh use registered doctor ke paas le jao, kisi unqualified (jhola-chhap) provider ke paas nahi. Agar uska abortion hota hai, toh woh aur uske guardian doctor se keh sakte hain ki police ko jaane wali report mein uska naam na likha jaaye.

actions.en: Teach teenagers the signs of grooming: an older person who wants secrecy, gives gifts and asks for photos is not a boyfriend.
actions.hg: Teenagers ko grooming ke signs sikhao: jo badi umar ka insaan raaz rakhne ko kahe, gifts de aur photos maange, woh boyfriend nahi hai.

actions.en: Ask your MP and your state's child rights commission to press for crime data that shows the age of the accused next to the age of the victim.
actions.hg: Apne MP aur state child rights commission se kaho ki crime data mein victim ki umar ke saath accused ki umar bhi dikhayi jaaye.

title.en: 1,87,702 crimes against children in 2024, and the biggest share is not POCSO but kidnapping
title.hg: 2024 mein bachchon ke khilaaf 1,87,702 crimes, aur sabse bada hissa POCSO ka nahi, kidnapping ka hai

dek.en: Missing children, trafficking, child marriage and online abuse: what each 2024 number says, what it leaves out, and where the system leaks.
dek.hg: Missing bachche, trafficking, child marriage aur online abuse: 2024 ka har number kya batata hai, kya chhod deta hai, aur system mein kahan-kahan chhed hain.

claim.en: If police numbers for crimes against children go up, children must be less safe.
claim.hg: Agar bachchon ke khilaaf crime ke police numbers badhte hain, toh matlab bachche pehle se kam safe hain.

truth.en: NCRB itself says a rise in registered crime and a rise in crime are two different things. More FIRs can mean more children are being heard.
truth.hg: NCRB khud kehta hai ki registered crime badhna aur crime badhna do alag baatein hain. Zyada FIR ka matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki ab zyada bachchon ki baat suni ja rahi hai.

actions.en: If a child goes missing, go to the police at once and insist on an FIR: since 2013 the Supreme Court has required one for every missing child.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha missing ho jaaye, turant police ke paas jaiye aur FIR likhwane pe tike rahiye: 2013 se Supreme Court ne har missing bachche ke liye FIR zaroori ki hai.

actions.en: Call 1098 (Child Helpline) or 112 if a child is in danger, being trafficked or about to be married. A child marriage can be stopped before it happens.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha khatre mein hai, uski trafficking ho rahi hai ya uski shaadi hone wali hai, toh 1098 (Child Helpline) ya 112 pe call kijiye. Child marriage hone se pehle rukwayi ja sakti hai.

actions.en: Report child sexual abuse material at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930. Never forward or download it, even to 'expose' someone: that is itself an offence.
actions.hg: Bachchon ke sexual abuse wala koi video ya photo dikhe toh cybercrime.gov.in pe ya 1930 pe report kijiye. Use kabhi forward ya download mat kijiye, kisi ko 'expose' karne ke liye bhi nahi: aisa karna khud ek offence hai.

actions.en: Read crime numbers as a count of reports, not of children harmed, and ask what the count leaves out.
actions.hg: Crime numbers ko reports ki ginti samjhiye, nuksaan jhelne wale bachchon ki nahi, aur hamesha poochiye ki is ginti mein kya chhoot gaya.

title.en: Death for raping a girl under 12 since 2018: why harsher sentences may not protect children abused by people they know
title.hg: 2018 se 12 saal se kam umar ki bachchi ke rape pe maut ki saza: sakht sazaayein shayad un bachchon ko kyun na bacha paayein jinka abuse jaan-pehchaan wale karte hain

dek.en: Parliament answered public anger with the death penalty, first for the rape of girls under 12, then for aggravated penetrative assault on any child. But most abusers are relatives, neighbours and family friends, and a possible death sentence can make a family's decision to report even harder.
dek.hg: Logon ke gusse ka jawab Parliament ne death penalty se diya, pehle 12 se kam umar ki bachchiyon ke rape ke liye, phir kisi bhi bachche pe aggravated penetrative assault ke liye. Lekin zyadatar abusers rishtedaar, padosi aur family friends hote hain, aur maut ki saza ki sambhavna family ke liye report karne ka faisla aur mushkil bana sakti hai.

claim.en: The death penalty will frighten abusers away from children.
claim.hg: Death penalty ke darr se abusers bachchon se door rahenge.

truth.en: The Verma Committee noted in 2013 that the death penalty for rape may not deter. Most child abusers are people the child knows, and in 2024 about two in three POCSO trials ended without a conviction.
truth.hg: Verma Committee ne 2013 mein kaha tha ki rape ke liye death penalty ka shayad deterrent effect na ho. Zyadatar child abusers bachche ke jaan-pehchaan wale hote hain, aur 2024 mein lagbhag har teen mein se do POCSO trials bina conviction ke khatam hue.

actions.en: Judge every child-safety promise by speed and certainty, how fast cases are tried and how many end in conviction, not by the harshest sentence on paper.
actions.hg: Child safety ke har waade ko speed aur certainty se parkhiye, yaani cases kitni jaldi chalte hain aur kitne conviction pe khatam hote hain, kaagaz pe likhi sabse sakht saza se nahi.

actions.en: If a child names a relative, believe the child and report it. Child Helpline 1098 works around the clock.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha kisi rishtedaar ka naam le, to bachche pe bharosa kijiye aur report kijiye. Child Helpline 1098 din-raat chalti hai.

actions.en: Back the parent who reports with money, housing or legal help, so the family does not depend on the accused.
actions.hg: Report karne wale maa ya baap ka saath dijiye, paise, rehne ki jagah ya legal madad se, taaki family accused pe nirbhar na rahe.

actions.en: Teach children the words for their bodies and for abuse, and ask their school to do the same.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko unke body parts aur abuse ke liye sahi shabd sikhaiye, aur unke school se bhi yahi karne ko kahiye.

title.en: Why the world's child marriage rate is falling: Southern Asia's progress, India's curve, and the distance left
title.hg: Duniya mein child marriage ka rate kyun gir raha hai: Southern Asia ki progress, India ka curve, aur kitna raasta baaki hai

dek.en: The UN says the world's fall in child marriage came largely from Southern Asia, and one in three women alive who were married as children lives in India. India's own curve has dropped far, then slowed. Here is what drove it and how far there is still to go.
dek.hg: UN kehta hai ki duniya mein child marriage mein jo giravat aayi, woh zyadatar Southern Asia se aayi. Aur bachpan mein byaahi gayi jitni women aaj zinda hain, unmein se har teen mein se ek India mein rehti hai. India ka apna curve kaafi neeche aaya, phir dheema pad gaya. Yeh kis wajah se hua, aur abhi kitna raasta baaki hai.

statLabel.hg: young women ki shaadi duniya bhar mein bachpan mein hui thi, 2015 mein yeh 22% tha (UN Women, 2026)

label.hg: ladkiyon ki shaadi har saal duniya bhar mein 18 se pehle ho jaati hai

actions.en: If a girl you know is being married before 18, call Child Helpline 1098 or 112 before the wedding date, not after it.
actions.hg: Agar aapki jaan-pehchaan mein kisi ladki ki shaadi 18 se pehle ho rahi hai, toh shaadi ki date se pehle Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 pe call kijiye, baad mein nahi.

actions.en: If a family is pulling a daughter out of school, ask the school and the panchayat what help exists to keep her enrolled. Girls' education is one of the drivers the UN credits for the fall in child marriage.
actions.hg: Agar koi family apni beti ko school se nikaal rahi hai, toh school aur panchayat se poochiye ki use padhai mein bana rehne ke liye kya madad mil sakti hai. UN child marriage mein giravat ka credit jin drivers ko deta hai, unmein ladkiyon ki padhai bhi ek hai.

actions.en: Refuse dowry in your own family's weddings. Where younger brides cost less in dowry, poor parents are pushed to marry daughters early.
actions.hg: Apne parivaar ki shaadiyon mein dahej se mana kijiye. Jahan kam umar ki dulhan ka dahej kam lagta hai, wahan gareeb maa-baap pe betiyon ki jaldi shaadi karne ka pressure padta hai.

actions.en: When someone says child marriage is a thing of the past, ask for your own state's NFHS-6 figure. A falling national line can hide a place that has not moved.
actions.hg: Jab koi kahe ki child marriage ab purani baat ho gayi, toh apne state ka NFHS-6 figure maangiye. Girti national line ke peeche koi aisi jagah chhupi ho sakti hai jo zara bhi nahi hili.

title.en: For nurses, ASHAs and young doctors: recognising child sexual abuse in the clinic, and the duties the law puts on you
title.hg: Nurses, ASHAs aur young doctors ke liye: clinic mein child sexual abuse ko kaise pehchaanein, aur kanoon aap par kaun si zimmedariyan daalta hai

dek.en: Abused children rarely walk in and say so. They come with stomach aches, bedwetting or a pregnancy at 15. What to notice, how to ask without leading, what treatment and examination the law requires, and what you must report.
dek.hg: Abuse jhel rahe bachche aksar khud aakar nahi batate. Woh pet dard, phir se bistar geela karne ya 15 saal ki umar mein pregnancy ke saath aate hain. Kis baat par dhyaan dein, bina leading sawaal ke kaise poochhein, kanoon kaun sa ilaaj aur examination zaroori maanta hai, aur aapko kya report karna hai.

claim.en: If the doctor finds no injuries, the child was not sexually abused.
claim.hg: Agar doctor ko koi chot nahi mili, toh bachche ke saath sexual abuse nahi hua.

truth.en: Direct physical signs of sexual abuse are uncommon; changes in behaviour are the usual clue. And the two-finger test proves nothing: the Supreme Court has said it has no scientific basis, and conducting it is misconduct.
truth.hg: Sexual abuse ke seedhe physical sanket kam hi milte hain; aam taur par asli ishaara bartaav mein badlaav hota hai. Aur two-finger test kuch saabit nahi karta: Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki iska koi scientific aadhaar nahi hai, aur ise karna misconduct hai.

actions.en: Ask open questions ('Tell me more about that') and write down the child's exact words, the date and who was present.
actions.hg: Open sawaal poochhiye ('Is baare mein aur batao') aur bachche ke exact shabd, tareekh aur kaun maujood tha, yeh likh lijiye.

actions.en: If an older child agrees, see them alone for part of the visit: the adult who brought them may be the one causing harm.
actions.hg: Agar bada bachcha maan jaaye, toh visit ke kuch hisse mein usse akele baat kariye: jo adult use laaya hai, nuksaan pahunchane wala wahi ho sakta hai.

actions.en: Treat first, free of cost, and inform the police; never perform a two-finger test.
actions.hg: Pehle ilaaj, muft mein, aur police ko soochna; two-finger test kabhi nahi.

actions.en: Do not promise total secrecy; tell the child, in words they understand, whom you must inform and why.
actions.hg: Poori tarah secret rakhne ka vaada mat kariye; bachche ko uski samajh ke shabdon mein bataiye ki aapko kise batana hoga aur kyun.

actions.en: Report suspicion the same day to the police or 1098; a pregnant minor's identity can be kept out of the report if she and her guardian ask.
actions.hg: Shak ho toh usi din police ya 1098 ko report kariye; agar pregnant minor aur uske guardian kahein, toh report mein uski pehchaan chhupayi ja sakti hai.

title.en: Sleepovers, home tuition, the school van: rules that make child abuse harder, set by adults rather than children
title.hg: Sleepovers, home tuition, school van: woh rules jo child abuse ko mushkil banate hain, aur jinhe bachche nahi, bade tay karte hain

dek.en: Most children who are sexually abused are harmed by someone their family let in. Here are the rules adults can set for tuition, sleepovers, bathing, phones, drivers and the school van, and how to bring them in without accusing anyone.
dek.hg: Jin bachchon ka sexual abuse hota hai, unmein se zyadatar ko koi aisa insaan nuksaan pahunchata hai jise family ne khud ghar mein aane diya. Tuition, sleepovers, nahana, phone, driver aur school van ke liye bade kaun se rules bana sakte hain, aur kisi par ilzaam lagaye bina unhe kaise laagu karein.

claim.en: Teach children to say no and shout for help, and they can protect themselves.
claim.hg: Bachchon ko 'na' kehna aur madad ke liye chillana sikha do, phir woh apni hifazat khud kar lenge.

truth.en: Body-safety lessons matter, but a six-year-old cannot decide who tutors her, who drives her or where she sleeps at a wedding. Adults control those settings, so adults have to set the rules.
truth.hg: Body-safety lessons zaroori hain, lekin chhe saal ki bachchi yeh tay nahi kar sakti ki use kaun padhayega, kaun gaadi mein le jaayega ya shaadi mein woh kahan soyegi. Yeh sab bade tay karte hain, isliye rules bhi badon ko hi banane honge.

actions.en: Hold home tuition at a table in a shared room, with the door open and another adult at home.
actions.hg: Home tuition kisi common kamre ki table par rakhiye, darwaza khula ho aur ghar mein koi aur adult maujood ho.

actions.en: At weddings and family stays, children sleep with their parents or with children their own age, never in a bed with an adult guest.
actions.hg: Shaadi aur family visits mein bachche apne parents ke saath ya apni umar ke bachchon ke saath soyein, kisi adult mehmaan ke saath ek bistar par kabhi nahi.

actions.en: Learn the van driver's and attendant's names and numbers, and find out which child is dropped last.
actions.hg: Van driver aur attendant ke naam aur number jaaniye, aur pata kariye ki sabse aakhir mein kis bachche ko utaara jaata hai.

actions.en: Tell children: no grown-up may ask you to keep a secret from us, and you never have to be alone with someone who makes you uneasy.
actions.hg: Bachchon se kahiye: koi bhi bada tumse humse secret rakhne ko nahi keh sakta, aur jis insaan ke saath tumhe ajeeb lage, uske saath tumhe kabhi akele nahi jaana padega.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them and call 1098 or 112 the same day.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh us par bharosa kariye aur usi din 1098 ya 112 par call kariye.

title.en: Gifts, secrets and 'helping the family': how grooming works, stage by stage, and the six red flags
title.hg: Gifts, secrets aur 'ghar ki madad': grooming kaise hoti hai, step by step, aur chhe red flags

dek.en: Most people who sexually abuse children are not strangers who snatch them. They are let in, step by step. Here is how grooming works, what it looks like in an Indian neighbourhood, and how to break it without accusing anyone.
dek.hg: Bachchon ka sexual abuse karne wale zyadatar log aise strangers nahi hote jo bachche ko utha le jaayein. Unhe khud ghar mein aane diya jaata hai, dheere-dheere. Jaaniye grooming kaise kaam karti hai, hamare mohallon mein yeh kaisi dikhti hai, aur kisi par ilzaam lagaye bina ise kaise todein.

claim.en: You would notice a groomer. They seem creepy, and they go after children, not parents.
claim.hg: Groomer toh door se pehchaan mein aa jaata hai. Woh creepy dikhta hai, aur bachchon ke peeche padta hai, parents ke nahi.

truth.en: Grooming is built to look like kindness: special attention, gifts, a listening ear and help for the family. On the surface it can look like a close relationship between the adult, the child and the parents.
truth.hg: Grooming jaan-boojhkar kindness jaisi banayi jaati hai: special attention, gifts, sunne wala koi, aur family ki madad. Upar se yeh kisi adult, bachche aur parents ke beech ek close rishte jaisi dikh sakti hai.

actions.en: Route gifts, rides and tuition through yourself: 'Thank you, I'll drop him myself.'
actions.hg: Gifts, lift aur tuition apne through hone dijiye: 'Thank you, hum use khud chhod denge.'

actions.en: Make one family rule for every adult, relatives included, so no one is singled out or accused.
actions.hg: Har adult ke liye ek hi rule rakhiye, relatives bhi shaamil, taaki kisi ek par ungli na uthe.

actions.en: Watch how an adult reacts to a boundary. Respect is reassuring; sulking or working around it is a warning.
actions.hg: Dekhiye ki koi adult kisi boundary par kaisa react karta hai. Respect kare toh theek; rooth jaaye ya chupke se raasta nikaale, toh savdhaan.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them and call 1098 or 112. Report online grooming at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh us par bharosa kariye aur 1098 ya 112 par call kariye. Online grooming ki complaint cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par kariye.

title.en: India last studied child sexual abuse nationally in 2007. Nineteen years on, nobody knows the true scale
title.hg: India ne child sexual abuse par aakhri national study 2007 mein ki thi. 19 saal baad bhi kisi ko asli scale nahi pata

dek.en: Police registers count complaints, not abuse, and the one government study was never a national rate. What India cannot answer without a proper survey, and how one could be done.
dek.hg: Police registers complaints ginte hain, abuse nahi, aur sarkar ki ekloti study kabhi national rate thi hi nahi. Bina proper survey ke India kin sawaalon ka jawab nahi de sakta, aur aisa survey kaise ho sakta hai.
