claim.en: POCSO figures show how much child sexual abuse there is in India.
claim.hg: POCSO ke numbers batate hain ki India mein bachchon ka sexual abuse kitna hota hai.

truth.en: They show how many cases reached a police station and were registered. In the 2007 government study, only 3.4% of sexually assaulted children had gone to the police.
truth.hg: Yeh numbers sirf yeh batate hain ki kitne cases police station tak pahunche aur darj hue. 2007 ki sarkari study mein sexual assault jhelne wale bachchon mein se sirf 3.4% police tak gaye the.

actions.en: Treat police figures on child abuse as a floor, not a measure of how much abuse happens, and check whether any number comes from police records or from asking children.
actions.hg: Bachchon ke abuse par police ke numbers ko 'kam se kam itna' samjhiye, poora sach nahi, aur har number ke liye check kijiye ki woh police records se aaya hai ya bachchon se poochkar.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them, keep them safe and call 1098 or 112. Under POCSO, an adult who knows of abuse must report it to the police.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha aapko abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uski baat pe bharosa kijiye, use safe rakhiye aur 1098 ya 112 pe call kijiye. POCSO ke under, jis adult ko abuse ka pata hai, use police ko report karna hi hoga.

actions.en: Teach children words for their bodies and for abuse, so that if something happens they can say it and know whom to tell.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko unki body aur abuse ke liye sahi words sikhaiye, taaki kuch galat ho toh woh bol sakein aur unhe pata ho ki kisko batana hai.

actions.en: Ask your MP or MLA when India will run a national survey on violence against children, covering boys and girls and repeated every few years.
actions.hg: Apne MP ya MLA se poochiye ki India bachchon ke khilaaf violence pe national survey kab karayega, jismein ladke aur ladkiyan dono hon aur jo har kuch saal mein repeat ho.

title.en: Khatna: the cutting of young girls that no Indian law names, and a Supreme Court petition pending since 2017
title.hg: Khatna: chhoti ladkiyon ki cutting jise koi Indian law naam se nahi pehchaanta, aur 2017 se Supreme Court mein pending ek petition

dek.en: In 2017 the government told the Supreme Court it had 'no official data' on female genital cutting in India. Nearly nine years later, no law names the practice and no verdict has come. What khatna is, why a doctor's 'small nick' is still harm to a child, and what survivors and parents can do now.
dek.hg: 2017 mein sarkar ne Supreme Court ko bataya tha ki uske paas India mein female genital cutting ka koi official data nahi hai. Lagbhag nau saal baad bhi koi law is practice ka naam nahi leta, aur koi verdict nahi aaya. Khatna kya hai, doctor ka 'chhota sa nick' bhi bachchi ke liye harm kyun hai, aur survivors aur parents abhi kya kar sakte hain.

statLabel.en: girls and women alive today who have undergone female genital mutilation (UNICEF, 2024)
statLabel.hg: ladkiyan aur women aaj zinda hain jo female genital mutilation se guzar chuki hain (UNICEF, 2024)

label.en: girls and women alive today who have undergone female genital mutilation (UNICEF, 2024)
label.hg: ladkiyan aur women aaj zinda hain jo female genital mutilation se guzar chuki hain (UNICEF, 2024)

label.en: survivors worldwide, about one in four, were cut by health personnel (UNICEF)
label.hg: survivors, yaani duniya bhar mein lagbhag har chaar mein se ek, ki cutting health personnel ne ki thi (UNICEF)

label.en: girls undergo female genital mutilation every year, more than 2 million of them before the age of five (UN, 2025)
label.hg: ladkiyon ki har saal female genital mutilation hoti hai, jinme se 2 million se zyada paanch saal se kam umar ki hoti hain (UN, 2025)

label.en: the year a petition asked the Supreme Court to ban khatna; it was still undecided in November 2026
label.hg: woh saal jab ek petition ne Supreme Court se khatna ban karne ki maang ki; November 2026 tak iska faisla nahi hua tha

claim.en: A small 'nick' by a doctor is harmless.
claim.hg: Doctor ka lagaya 'chhota sa nick' harmless hota hai.

truth.en: WHO opposes every form of female genital cutting, including when health workers do it. A clinic may lower the risk of infection, but a healthy part of a child's body is still cut, for no medical reason, without her consent.
truth.hg: WHO female genital cutting ke har form ka virodh karta hai, tab bhi jab health workers ise karte hain. Clinic infection ka risk kam kar sakta hai, lekin phir bhi ek bachchi ke body ka healthy hissa bina kisi medical reason ke, uski consent ke bina kaata jaata hai.

actions.en: If you were cut as a child, it was not your fault. A gynaecologist can examine you privately, and Tele-MANAS (14416) offers free counselling round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar bachpan mein aapka khatna hua tha, toh isme aapki koi galti nahi thi. Gynaecologist privately aapka examination kar sakti hain, aur Tele-MANAS (14416) din-raat free counselling deti hai.

actions.en: If elders are pressing you to have your daughter cut, you can refuse. Some of the strongest voices against khatna are Bohra women themselves.
actions.hg: Agar ghar ke bade aap par beti ka khatna karwane ka pressure daal rahe hain, toh aap mana kar sakte hain. Khatna ke khilaaf sabse mazboot aawaazon mein se kuch khud Bohra women ki hain.

actions.en: If you fear a girl is about to be cut, call the Child Helpline on 1098, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar aapko darr hai ki kisi ladki ki cutting hone wali hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye, ya emergency mein 112 par.

actions.en: If you are a doctor, nurse or midwife and a family asks you to do it 'safely', say no: WHO opposes the practice in every form.
actions.hg: Agar aap doctor, nurse ya midwife hain aur koi family aapse ise 'safely' karne ko kahe, toh mana kijiye: WHO is practice ke har form ka virodh karta hai.

actions.en: Talk about khatna as harm to a child's body, never as a reason to mock a faith or a community.
actions.hg: Khatna ke baare mein ek bachchi ki body ko hue harm ki tarah baat kijiye, kabhi bhi kisi dharm ya community ka mazaak udaane ke liye nahi.

title.en: 'Get them married and the case ends': why marrying a girl to the man who abused her is not justice
title.hg: 'Shaadi karwa do, case khatam': jis aadmi ne ladki ko abuse kiya, usi se uski shaadi karwana justice nahi hai

dek.en: When a girl under 18 is abused by a 'friend' or a neighbour, elders sometimes offer a wedding as the way out. The law treats that wedding as a fresh offence, and the girl pays for it for years.
dek.hg: Jab 18 se kam umar ki kisi ladki ka abuse koi 'dost' ya padosi kare, to bade-buzurg kabhi-kabhi shaadi ko raasta batate hain. Law ki nazar mein yeh shaadi ek naya offence hai, aur iski keemat ladki saalon tak chukati hai.

label.en: POCSO penetrative-assault cases in 2024 where the accused was a friend, online friend or partner 'on pretext of marriage'
label.hg: 2024 mein POCSO penetrative assault ke cases jinmein accused dost, online dost ya 'shaadi ke bahane' wala partner tha

label.en: of child victims of penetrative sexual assault in 2024 were aged 16 to 18
label.hg: 2024 mein penetrative sexual assault ke child victims jinki umar 16 se 18 saal thi

label.en: maximum rigorous imprisonment, plus a fine of up to Rs 1 lakh, for an adult groom or anyone who performs, promotes or permits a child marriage
label.hg: adult dulhe ko, ya child marriage karwane, badhawa dene ya hone dene wale ko maximum 2 saal ki rigorous qaid aur Rs 1 lakh tak jurmana

label.en: of POCSO trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue POCSO trials mein se bas itne mein conviction hua

claim.en: If the girl marries the man, her honour is restored and the case is over.
claim.hg: Agar ladki ki shaadi usi aadmi se ho jaaye, to uski izzat laut aati hai aur case khatam ho jaata hai.

truth.en: Marrying a girl under 18 is itself an offence, sex with a wife under 18 is rape, and the Supreme Court has told courts never to suggest marriage or compromise in sexual offence cases.
truth.hg: 18 se kam umar ki ladki ki shaadi karwana khud ek offence hai, 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex rape hai, aur Supreme Court ne courts se kaha hai ki sexual offence ke case mein kabhi shaadi ya compromise ka suggestion na dein.

actions.en: Never agree to a 'settlement' wedding. Performing, promoting or permitting the marriage of a girl under 18 is a cognisable, non-bailable offence.
actions.hg: 'Settlement' wali shaadi ke liye kabhi haan mat kahiye. 18 se kam umar ki ladki ki shaadi karwana, use badhawa dena ya hone dena cognisable aur non-bailable offence hai.

actions.en: Report the abuse of a child to 1098, 112 or the police. Under POCSO, keeping quiet is itself punishable.
actions.hg: Bachche ke abuse ki report 1098, 112 ya police ko kijiye. POCSO mein chup rehna bhi punishable hai.

actions.en: If a wedding is being fixed to close a case, tell the district Child Marriage Prohibition Officer before the date.
actions.hg: Agar case band karne ke liye shaadi fix ki ja rahi hai, to date se pehle district ke Child Marriage Prohibition Officer ko bataiye.

actions.en: Ask the District Legal Services Authority about compensation, so the girl never depends on the accused's family.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority se compensation ke baare mein poochiye, taaki ladki ko kabhi accused ki family par depend na rehna pade.

actions.en: If you were married before 18 to the man who abused you, you can ask a district court to annul the marriage until two years after you turn 18.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se pehle aapki shaadi usi aadmi se karwa di gayi jisne aapko abuse kiya, to 18 ki hone ke baad do saal tak aap district court se yeh shaadi cancel (annul) karwa sakti hain.

title.en: 98,375 children went missing in 2024, 75,603 of them girls: what India's missing-child numbers say, and what they hide
title.hg: 2024 mein 98,375 bachche laapata hue, unmein 75,603 ladkiyan: India ke missing-child numbers kya batate hain, aur kya chhupate hain

dek.en: The count rose 7.8% in a year, and more than three in four missing children were girls. Police traced many, but 48,349 children were still missing when 2024 ended. What the law requires the moment a child disappears, and what the numbers cannot tell a family.
dek.hg: Ek saal mein ginti 7.8% badhi, aur har chaar laapata bachchon mein se teen se zyada ladkiyan thi. Police ne kaafi bachchon ko dhoondh liya, lekin 2024 khatam hone tak 48,349 bachche ab bhi laapata the. Bachcha gayab hote hi law kya maangta hai, aur yeh numbers kisi family ko kya nahi bata sakte.

statLabel.en: children reported missing in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: bachche 2024 mein India mein laapata report hue

label.en: children reported missing in India in 2024, up 7.8% from 91,296 in 2023
label.hg: bachche 2024 mein India mein laapata report hue, 2023 ke 91,296 se 7.8% zyada

label.en: of them were girls, against 22,768 boys and 4 transgender children
label.hg: inmein ladkiyan thi; ladke 22,768 the aur transgender bachche 4

label.en: children still untraced at the end of 2024, 36,352 of them girls
label.hg: bachche 2024 ke end tak nahi mile, inmein 36,352 ladkiyan thi

label.en: of the 1,47,175 children on the 2024 missing list were traced during the year
label.hg: 2024 ki missing list ke 1,47,175 bachchon mein se itne usi saal dhoondh liye gaye

claim.en: Police make you wait 24 hours before you can report a missing child.
claim.hg: Laapata bachche ki report likhwane se pehle police 24 ghante intezaar karwati hai.

truth.en: There is no waiting period. Since 2013 the Supreme Court has required every missing-child complaint to be registered as an FIR, treated at first as a possible abduction or trafficking.
truth.hg: Koi waiting period nahi hai. 2013 se Supreme Court ka nirdesh hai ki laapata bachche ki har complaint FIR ke roop mein darj ho, aur shuru mein use mumkin abduction ya trafficking maana jaaye.

actions.en: If a child goes missing, go to the nearest police station at once and ask for an FIR. You do not have to wait, and any station must record it.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha laapata ho, toh turant sabse paas ke police station jaakar FIR maangiye. Intezaar karne ki zaroorat nahi, aur koi bhi thana ise darj karne ke liye bandha hai.

actions.en: Take a recent photo, a description of the clothes the child was wearing and the phone numbers of friends, and ask for your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Bachche ki haal ki photo, usne kaunse kapde pehne the yeh jaankaari, aur doston ke phone numbers saath le jaaiye, aur FIR ki free copy maangiye.

actions.en: Call 112, or the Child Helpline 1098, the moment a child is missing or in danger.
actions.hg: Bachcha laapata ho ya khatre mein ho, toh usi waqt 112 ya Child Helpline 1098 pe call kijiye.

actions.en: If police refuse to record a complaint that a child may have been trafficked, remind them that refusing is an offence under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police aisi complaint darj karne se mana kare jismein bachche ki trafficking ka shak ho, toh unhe yaad dilaiye ki mana karna BNS ke Section 199 ke tahat offence hai.

actions.en: If you are under 18 and thinking of leaving home because of violence or a marriage being fixed, call 1098 first.
actions.hg: Agar aap 18 se chhote hain aur hinsa ya tay ho rahi shaadi ki wajah se ghar chhodne ki soch rahe hain, toh pehle 1098 pe call kijiye.

title.en: 'My child would tell me': why most abused children in India never say a word
title.hg: 'Mera bachcha mujhe zaroor batayega': India mein abuse jhelne wale zyadatar bachche ek shabd bhi kyun nahi bolte

dek.en: Many parents trust a close bond to work like an alarm. India's own data shows that sexually abused children mostly stay silent, and that abusers are usually people the family knows. Here is why, and what makes telling possible.
dek.hg: Bahut se parents maante hain ki close rishta ek alarm ki tarah kaam karega. Lekin India ka apna data dikhata hai ki sexual abuse jhelne wale bachche zyadatar chup rehte hain, aur abusers aksar woh log hote hain jinhe family jaanti hai. Jaaniye kyun, aur kin cheezon se bachche ke liye batana mumkin hota hai.

statLabel.en: of sexually assaulted children in the 2007 government study had told no one
statLabel.hg: 2007 ki sarkari study mein sexual assault jhelne wale bachchon mein se itnon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha

label.en: of sexually assaulted children in the 2007 government study had told no one
label.hg: 2007 ki sarkari study mein sexual assault jhelne wale bachchon mein se itnon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha

label.en: of sexually assaulted children in the same study had reported it to the police
label.hg: usi study mein sexual assault jhelne wale bachchon mein se itnon ne police ko report kiya tha

label.en: of young adults sexually assaulted in childhood had ever told anyone
label.hg: young adults, jinka bachpan mein sexual assault hua tha, unmein se itnon ne kabhi kisi ko bataya tha

label.en: of 2024 POCSO penetrative-assault cases in which the accused was someone the child knew
label.hg: 2024 ke POCSO penetrative-assault cases jinmein accused koi aisa tha jise bachcha jaanta tha

claim.en: We are close. If anyone ever hurt my child, my child would tell me.
claim.hg: Hum itne close hain. Agar kabhi kisi ne mere bachche ko nuksaan pahunchaya, to woh mujhe zaroor batayega.

truth.en: Most sexually abused children tell no one. The abuser is usually someone the child knows, and grooming is built to keep the secret.
truth.hg: Sexual abuse jhelne wale zyadatar bachche kisi ko nahi batate. Abuser aksar koi aisa hota hai jise bachcha jaanta hai, aur grooming ka maksad hi secret ko chhupa kar rakhna hota hai.

actions.en: Teach your child the correct names for every body part, so they have words if something happens.
actions.hg: Bachche ko body ke har hisse ka sahi naam sikhaiye, taaki kuch ho to uske paas bolne ke liye shabd hon.

actions.en: Set one rule for every adult, relatives included: nobody may ask a child to keep a secret about touch, photos or their body.
actions.hg: Har adult ke liye ek rule rakhiye, rishtedaar bhi shaamil: koi bhi bachche se touch, photos ya uski body ke baare mein secret rakhne ko nahi keh sakta.

actions.en: Name two or three safe adults, inside and outside the family, your child can go to if telling you feels too hard.
actions.hg: Ghar ke andar aur bahar do-teen safe adults tay kijiye, jinke paas bachcha ja sake agar aapko batana use mushkil lage.

actions.en: Take hints seriously. If your child says anything, stay calm, believe them and report to 1098 or 112; under POCSO it is a legal duty.
actions.hg: Ishaaron ko seriously lijiye. Bachcha kuch bhi kahe to shaant rahiye, uska yakeen kijiye aur 1098 ya 112 par report kijiye; POCSO ke tahat yeh legal duty hai.

title.en: If your younger brother, sister or cousin is being abused: a guide for older siblings when the adults won't act
title.hg: Agar tumhare chhote bhai, behen ya cousin ke saath abuse ho raha hai: bade bhai-behenon ke liye guide, jab ghar ke bade kuch nahi karte

dek.en: In a 2007 government study, children who told anyone about sexual assault turned first to a parent and next to a brother or sister. What to watch for, what to say when a child begs you to keep the secret, and how to reach 1098, the school or the police if your parents refuse to act.
dek.hg: Sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein jin bachchon ne sexual assault ke baare mein kisi ko bataya, unhone pehle mummy-papa ko bataya aur unke baad bhai ya behen ko. Kin baaton par nazar rakhein, jab bachcha raaz rakhne ki minnat kare toh kya kahein, aur agar mummy-papa kuch karne se mana kar dein toh 1098, school ya police tak kaise pahunchein.

statLabel.en: of sexually assaulted children in the government's 2007 study had told the police
statLabel.hg: sexual assault jhel chuke bachchon ne hi police ko bataya tha, sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein

label.en: of sexually assaulted children in the government's 2007 study had told no one
label.hg: sexual assault jhel chuke bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha, sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein

label.en: POCSO penetrative sexual assault cases in 2024 where the accused was a family member
label.hg: POCSO ke penetrative sexual assault cases (2024) jinmein accused family member tha

label.en: of those cases in 2024 where the accused was a family friend, neighbour, employer or other known person
label.hg: unhi cases (2024) mein se, jinmein accused family friend, padosi, employer ya koi aur jaan-pehchaan wala tha

claim.en: If a younger child trusts you with a secret, keeping it is the loyal thing to do.
claim.hg: Agar koi chhota bachcha bharosa karke tumhe raaz batata hai, toh use chhupa kar rakhna hi wafadari hai.

truth.en: A secret about abuse protects the abuser, not the child. POCSO puts the duty to report on everyone. A child is never punished for staying quiet, but an adult who knows can be.
truth.hg: Abuse ka raaz abuser ko bachata hai, bachche ko nahi. POCSO report karne ki zimmedari sab par daalta hai. Chup rehne par kisi bachche ko saza nahi milti, lekin jaanne wale adult ko mil sakti hai.

actions.en: If a younger child tells you, say: 'I believe you. It's not your fault. I'm going to get help.' Do not promise to keep it secret.
actions.hg: Agar koi chhota bachcha tumhe bataye, toh kaho: 'Mujhe tum par yakeen hai. Tumhari koi galti nahi hai. Hum milkar madad lenge.' Raaz rakhne ka promise mat karo.

actions.en: Write down their exact words and the date. Don't question them again and again, and don't confront the person they named.
actions.hg: Uske exact shabd aur date likh lo. Baar-baar sawaal mat poocho, aur jiska naam liya gaya hai usse seedhe jaakar confront mat karo.

actions.en: Tell one adult who will act: a parent, an aunt, a teacher or the school counsellor. If nobody will, call 1098 yourself, or 112 if the child is in danger now.
actions.hg: Ek aise bade ko batao jo sach mein kuch karega: mummy-papa, mausi, teacher ya school counsellor. Koi na kare, toh khud 1098 par call karo, aur agar bachcha abhi khatre mein hai toh 112 par.

actions.en: Don't post about it anywhere, not even without names. Small details can identify a child.
actions.hg: Iske baare mein kahin bhi post mat karo, naam ke bina bhi nahi. Chhoti-chhoti details se bhi bachche ki pehchaan khul sakti hai.

actions.en: Look after yourself too: Tele-MANAS (14416) offers free counselling, day and night.
actions.hg: Apna bhi khayal rakho: Tele-MANAS (14416) din-raat free counselling deta hai.

title.en: 1,171, then 1,499, then 1,099: why India's count of child abuse material cases swings, and what it misses
title.hg: 1,171, phir 1,499, phir 1,099: India mein child abuse material ke cases ki ginti kyun upar-neeche hoti hai, aur usmein kya chhoot jaata hai

dek.en: Police cases of online child sexual abuse material rose and then fell in three years. The curve follows tips from platforms and the work of police cyber cells far more closely than it can follow abuse. How to read it, and what a real measure would count.
dek.hg: Online child sexual abuse material ke police cases teen saal mein pehle badhe, phir gire. Yeh curve abuse ko kam, aur platforms ki tips aur police cyber cells ke kaam ko kahin zyada follow karta hai. Ise kaise padhein, aur ek sahi measure kya ginega.

statLabel.en: cases of sexually explicit material depicting children registered in 2023, the highest of the three years 2022 to 2024
statLabel.hg: bachchon ke sexually explicit material ke cases 2023 mein darj hue, jo teen saal ka peak tha

label.en: child sexual abuse material cases registered in 2024, 63% of all cyber crimes against children
label.hg: child sexual abuse material ke cases 2024 mein darj hue, bachchon ke khilaaf saare cyber crimes ka 63%

label.en: CyberTipline reports of suspected child sexual exploitation that the US-based NCMEC linked to India in 2024
label.hg: CyberTipline reports, bachchon ke sexual exploitation ke shak wali, jinhe US ki sanstha NCMEC ne 2024 mein India se joda

label.en: of IT Act Section 67B cases were still under police investigation at the end of 2024
label.hg: IT Act Section 67B ke cases 2024 ke end mein bhi police investigation mein atke the

label.en: of Section 67B cases before the courts were still pending at the end of 2024
label.hg: courts ke saamne Section 67B ke cases 2024 ke end mein bhi pending the

claim.en: Fewer child abuse material cases in police data means children are safer online.
claim.hg: Police data mein child abuse material ke cases kam hue, matlab bachche online pehle se zyada safe hain.

truth.en: The count follows tips, detection and police capacity. It fell in 2024, the year platform reports to the US clearinghouse NCMEC also fell, which NCMEC blamed on bundled reports and some platforms reporting less, not on fewer crimes.
truth.hg: Yeh ginti tips, detection aur police ki capacity ke hisaab se chalti hai. 2024 mein yeh giri, aur usi saal US ke clearinghouse NCMEC ko platforms ki reports bhi giri. NCMEC ne iski wajah bundled reports aur kuch platforms ka kam report karna bataya, crimes ka kam hona nahi.

actions.en: Never download, forward or screenshot sexual images of a child, even as 'proof': under Section 67B of the IT Act, collecting or sharing such material is itself a crime.
actions.hg: Kisi bachche ki sexual photo ya video kabhi download, forward ya screenshot mat kijiye, 'saboot' ke liye bhi nahi: IT Act ke Section 67B ke under aisa material jama karna ya share karna khud ek crime hai.

actions.en: Report the link on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930, and report it to the platform as well.
actions.hg: Link ko cybercrime.gov.in pe report kijiye ya 1930 pe call kijiye, aur platform pe bhi report kijiye.

actions.en: If an image of you taken before you turned 18 is circulating, use Take It Down: it can help stop copies spreading on participating platforms, and you never send the image to anyone.
actions.hg: Agar 18 saal se pehle ki aapki koi image ghoom rahi hai, toh Take It Down use kijiye. Yeh participating platforms pe copies ko phailne se rokne mein madad kar sakta hai, aur image kisi ko bhejni nahi padti.

actions.en: If a child you know is being abused or exploited, call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar aapke jaan-pehchaan ke kisi bachche ka abuse ya exploitation ho raha hai, toh 1098 ya 112 pe call kijiye.

actions.en: Say 'child sexual abuse material', not 'child porn': the Supreme Court has told courts to stop using that term.
actions.hg: 'Child porn' mat boliye, 'child sexual abuse material' boliye: Supreme Court ne courts se yeh term band karne ko kaha hai.

title.en: Before a teenager meets an 'online friend': NCMEC logged more than 800 reports in 2025 of offenders travelling to meet a child
title.hg: Kisi 'online friend' se milne se pehle: 2025 mein NCMEC ko 800 se zyada aisi reports mili jinmein offender bachche se milne khud pahuncha

dek.en: Grooming is built to look like a real online friendship, and its most dangerous step is the first meeting. A guide for teenagers and parents: the warning signs, the rules to agree in advance, and what to do if a meeting has already happened.
dek.hg: Grooming ko bilkul asli online dosti jaisa dikhne ke liye banaya jaata hai, aur uska sabse khatarnak step hai pehli mulaqat. Teenagers aur parents ke liye guide: warning signs, pehle se tay karne wale rules, aur agar mulaqat ho chuki hai to ab kya karein.

statLabel.en: reports to NCMEC in 2025 in which an offender travelled to meet a child in person
statLabel.hg: NCMEC ko 2025 mein mili reports jinmein offender bachche se milne khud travel karke pahuncha

label.hg: bachchon ko online fuslaane (online enticement) ki reports jo NCMEC ko 2025 mein mili, 2024 se 158% zyada

label.hg: aisi reports jinmein offender bachche se milne khud travel karke pahuncha

label.hg: 2024 mein India ke POCSO penetrative assault cases jinmein accused friend, online friend ya live-in partner tha

label.en: of child victims of penetrative assault in 2024 were aged 16 to 18
label.hg: 2024 mein penetrative assault ke shikaar bachche 16 se 18 saal ke the

claim.en: An online friend is only dangerous if they are a stranger lying about who they are.
claim.hg: Online friend tabhi khatarnak hai jab woh koi stranger ho jo apne baare mein jhooth bol raha ho.

truth.en: UNICEF warns that online abusers may be strangers or people the child already knows, and that they often win the child's trust, or a parent's, before asking for anything.
truth.hg: UNICEF ke mutabik online abusers anjaan bhi ho sakte hain aur bachche ke jaan-pehchaan wale bhi, aur woh aksar kuch bhi maangne se pehle bachche ka, ya maa-baap ka, trust jeet lete hain.

actions.en: Agree the rules before any meeting: a trusted adult knows, the place is public and busy, and you control your own travel.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi mulaqat se pehle rules tay karo: ek trusted adult ko pata ho, jagah public aur bheed wali ho, aur aana-jaana tumhare apne control mein ho.

actions.en: Treat secrecy, pressure to move to a private app, unexplained gifts and requests for photos as stop signs.
actions.hg: Secrecy, private app pe shift hone ka pressure, bina wajah ke gifts aur photos ki demand ko stop sign samjho.

actions.en: Parents: promise a no-questions pickup at any hour, and keep the promise.
actions.hg: Parents: kisi bhi waqt 'bina sawaal' pickup ka waada kijiye, aur use nibhaiye.

actions.en: If something happened, go to any hospital and call 1098 or 112. Block the account, but keep the chats.
actions.hg: Kuch ho gaya hai to kisi bhi hospital jao aur 1098 ya 112 pe call karo. Account block karo, par chats delete mat karo.

actions.en: Report online enticement at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930.
actions.hg: Online enticement ki report cybercrime.gov.in pe ya 1930 pe karo.

title.en: 'He only touched her, nothing really happened': the myth that only rape counts as child sexual abuse
title.hg: 'Usne bas chhua tha, asal mein kuch hua nahi': yeh myth ki bachchon ke sexual abuse mein sirf rape hi ginti mein aata hai

dek.en: More than a third of India's 2024 POCSO cases were not rape cases. The law, the Supreme Court and children's own reactions all say that sexual touching, exposure and sexual images are abuse.
dek.hg: 2024 mein India ke POCSO cases mein se ek-tihaai se zyada rape ke cases nahi the. Law, Supreme Court aur khud bachchon ke reactions, sab kehte hain ki sexual touch, body dikhana-dikhwana aur sexual images bhi abuse hain.

statLabel.en: of 2024's 69,191 POCSO cases were for penetrative assault; the rest were other forms of abuse
statLabel.hg: 2024 ke 69,191 POCSO cases mein se itne penetrative assault ke the; baaki abuse ke doosre roop the

label.en: POCSO cases in 2024 for sexual assault without penetration
label.hg: POCSO cases 2024 mein, bina penetration wale sexual assault ke

label.en: POCSO cases in 2024 for sexual harassment of a child, a separate offence
label.hg: POCSO cases 2024 mein bachche ke sexual harassment ke, jo ek alag offence hai

label.en: of children in the 2007 government study reported severe forms of sexual abuse, such as fondling, forced exposure or nude photography
label.hg: bachchon ne 2007 ki sarkari study mein sexual abuse ke gambhir roop bataye, jaise fondling, zabardasti body dikhwana ya nude photography

label.en: girls and women worldwide faced sexual violence in childhood once non-contact abuse is counted, against 1 in 8 for rape or sexual assault
label.hg: ladkiyon aur mahilaon ne duniya bhar mein bachpan mein sexual violence jheli, jab non-contact abuse bhi gina jaaye; sirf rape ya sexual assault ginein to 1 in 8

claim.en: If there was no rape, nothing really happened to the child.
claim.hg: Agar rape nahi hua, to bachche ke saath asal mein kuch hua hi nahi.

truth.en: Touching a child with sexual intent is sexual assault under POCSO, even over clothes, and sexual harassment of a child is a separate crime. Police registered 20,845 and 3,502 such cases in 2024.
truth.hg: Sexual intent se bachche ko chhoona POCSO ke tahat sexual assault hai, kapdon ke upar se bhi, aur bachche ka sexual harassment ek alag crime hai. 2024 mein police ne aise 20,845 aur 3,502 cases register kiye.

actions.en: Never tell a child 'nothing happened' because there was no rape. Say: 'I believe you, it was wrong, and it was not your fault.'
actions.hg: Rape nahi hua, sirf is wajah se bachche se kabhi mat kahiye ki 'kuch nahi hua'. Kahiye: 'Mujhe tumhari baat par yakeen hai, jo hua woh galat tha, aur usmein tumhari koi galti nahi.'

actions.en: Stop the person's access to the child at once, whoever they are.
actions.hg: Us insaan ki bachche tak pahunch turant band kijiye, chahe woh koi bhi ho.

actions.en: Report sexual touching, exposure and sexual messages or photos to 1098, 112 or the police. The POCSO duty to report covers every offence under the Act, not only rape.
actions.hg: Sexual touch, body dikhane-dikhwane, aur sexual messages ya photos ki report 1098, 112 ya police ko kijiye. POCSO mein report karne ki duty Act ke har offence par laagu hai, sirf rape par nahi.

actions.en: Watch for changes in sleep, mood, school or fear of a person, and get the child support even if it was 'only' touching.
actions.hg: Neend, mood, school ya kisi insaan se darr mein badlaav par nazar rakhiye, aur bachche ko support dilaiye, chahe 'sirf' chhua hi kyun na gaya ho.

title.en: 69,191 cases, 2,86,903 awaiting trial, a 32.3% conviction rate: POCSO in 2024, by the numbers
title.hg: 69,191 cases, 2,86,903 trial ke intezaar mein, conviction rate sirf 32.3%: 2024 mein POCSO, numbers mein

dek.en: Every key figure from NCRB's 2024 data on the child sexual abuse law, one at a time, with what it means and what it hides: from the principal offence rule to the children who never reach a police station.
dek.hg: Child sexual abuse law par NCRB ke 2024 data ka har bada number, ek-ek karke: uska matlab kya hai aur woh kya chhupa leta hai. Principal offence rule se lekar un bachchon tak jo kabhi police station tak pahunchte hi nahi.

statLabel.hg: cases 2024 mein POCSO ke tahat register hue

label.hg: POCSO cases 2024 mein register hue, yaani har ek lakh bachchon par 15.6

label.hg: penetrative assault cases mein accused koi aisa tha jise bachcha jaanta tha

label.hg: POCSO ke jin trials ka 2024 mein faisla aaya, unmein saza hui

label.hg: POCSO cases 2024 ke end mein trial ke intezaar mein the

actions.en: Before you quote a POCSO figure, check the year, the sections it covers, and whether it counts cases or children.
actions.hg: POCSO ka koi bhi number share karne se pehle check kijiye: kaunsa saal, kaunse sections, aur ginti cases ki hai ya bachchon ki.

actions.en: Treat a rise in cases as a question, not an answer: it can mean more abuse or more reporting.
actions.hg: Cases badhein to use jawab nahi, sawaal samjhiye: iska matlab zyada abuse bhi ho sakta hai aur zyada reporting bhi.

actions.en: If your child has a POCSO case, ask the prosecutor whether the child's evidence was recorded within the 30 days the law sets.
actions.hg: Agar aapke bachche ka POCSO case chal raha hai, to prosecutor se poochhiye ki kya bachche ka bayaan kanoon mein tay 30 din ke andar record hua.

actions.en: If you know or suspect that a child is being abused, call 1098 or 112, or go to the police. Reporting is a legal duty under POCSO.
actions.hg: Kisi bachche ke abuse ka pata ho ya shak ho, to 1098 ya 112 pe call kijiye, ya police ke paas jaaiye. POCSO mein report karna legal duty hai.

title.en: POCSO presumes the accused guilty. So why did 25,476 cases end in acquittal in 2024?
title.hg: POCSO accused ko guilty maan kar chalta hai. Phir 2024 mein 25,476 cases acquittal pe kyun khatam hue?

dek.en: The law tells judges to presume guilt, and police sent 95.3% of the POCSO cases they finished investigating to court. Yet courts acquitted twice as often as they convicted. The reasons lead back to who the accused usually is.
dek.hg: Kanoon judges se kehta hai ki guilt maan kar chalo, aur police ne jin POCSO cases ki investigation poori ki, unmein se 95.3% court bheje. Phir bhi courts ne conviction se do guna acquittals diye. Wajah wahin le jaati hai ki accused aksar kaun hota hai.

statLabel.en: POCSO cases that ended in acquittal in 2024, against 12,672 convictions
statLabel.hg: POCSO cases jo 2024 mein acquittal pe khatam hue, jabki convictions sirf 12,672 the

label.en: POCSO conviction rate in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein POCSO conviction rate

label.hg: 2024 mein police ke dispose kiye POCSO cases jinmein chargesheet file hui

claim.en: If the court acquitted, the child must have lied.
claim.hg: Court ne acquit kar diya, matlab bachcha jhooth bol raha tha.

truth.en: An acquittal means the case was not proved beyond reasonable doubt. NCRB does not record why trials fail, and family pressure, long delays and disputes over age can all end a true case.
truth.hg: Acquittal ka matlab hai ki case reasonable doubt se pare saabit nahi hua. NCRB record nahi karta ki trials kyun fail hote hain, aur family ka pressure, lambi deri aur umar pe vivaad, sab ek sachche case ko bhi khatam kar sakte hain.

actions.en: If a child in your family discloses abuse, report it, and stay beside the child until the verdict, not just until the FIR.
actions.hg: Agar family ka koi bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, to report kijiye, aur sirf FIR tak nahi, verdict tak bachche ke saath khade rahiye.

actions.en: Refuse any offer of a 'settlement' or a marriage. The Supreme Court has barred judges from suggesting either.
actions.hg: 'Settlement' ya shaadi ki har offer thukraiye. Supreme Court ne judges ke liye in dono ka sujhav dena mana kar diya hai.

actions.en: Ask the Special Court for POCSO's protections: questions through the judge, no sight of the accused, a trusted adult in the room.
actions.hg: Special Court se POCSO ki suraksha maangiye: sawaal judge ke zariye, accused nazar na aaye, aur kamre mein ek trusted adult ho.

actions.en: Ask the District Legal Services Authority about victim compensation, so the family does not depend on the accused's goodwill.
actions.hg: District Legal Services Authority se victim compensation ke baare mein poochhiye, taaki family accused ki meharbani pe na tike.

title.en: POCSO, section by section: what the law promises every child under 18, and where it breaks down
title.hg: POCSO, section by section: 18 se kam umar ke har bachche se kanoon ka waada, aur woh kahan toot jaata hai

dek.en: Police registered 69,191 POCSO cases in 2024. Here is the law behind them in plain words: who it protects, what it punishes and how it shields a child in court, set against the 2,86,903 cases still waiting for trial at the end of that year.
dek.hg: 2024 mein police ne POCSO ke 69,191 case register kiye. Unke peeche ka kanoon simple words mein: yeh kise protect karta hai, kis cheez ki saza deta hai aur court mein bachche ko kaise bachata hai, aur saath mein woh 2,86,903 case jo us saal ke end tak trial ka wait kar rahe the.

statLabel.en: years in prison, at the least, for aggravated penetrative sexual assault on a child since 2019
statLabel.hg: saal ki jail, kam se kam: 2019 se bachche par aggravated penetrative sexual assault ki saza

label.en: POCSO cases registered by police in India in 2024
label.hg: POCSO case jo 2024 mein India mein police ne register kiye

label.hg: din, jinke andar Special Court ko case lene ke baad bachche ka statement record karna hota hai

label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue POCSO trials mein se sirf itne mein conviction hua

label.hg: POCSO case jo 2024 ke end tak trial ka wait kar rahe the

claim.en: If the child agreed, it is not a POCSO case.
claim.hg: Agar bachche ne haan kaha tha, toh POCSO case nahi banta.

truth.en: POCSO protects every person under 18, and a child's 'yes' changes nothing in law. A sexual act with a child is an offence whatever the child said.
truth.hg: POCSO 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko protect karta hai, aur bachche ki 'haan' se kanoon nahi badalta. Bachche ke saath koi bhi sexual act offence hai, bachche ne chahe kuch bhi kaha ho.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them, stay calm and call 1098 or 112. You do not need proof before you call.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha aapko abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uski baat par bharosa karein, shaant rahein aur 1098 ya 112 par call karein. Call karne se pehle proof ki zaroorat nahi hai.

actions.en: Never share a child victim's name, photo, school or neighbourhood, not even in a family WhatsApp group.
actions.hg: Kisi victim bachche ka naam, photo, school ya mohalla kabhi share na karein, family WhatsApp group mein bhi nahi.

actions.en: If you run a school, coaching centre, hostel or sports club, make sure every adult there knows that not reporting abuse is itself a crime.
actions.hg: Agar aap school, coaching centre, hostel ya sports club chalate hain, toh pakka karein ki wahan har adult ko pata ho ki abuse report na karna khud ek crime hai.

actions.en: If your family is in a POCSO case, ask the prosecutor whether the Special Court recorded the child's evidence within 30 days.
actions.hg: Agar aapki family kisi POCSO case mein hai, toh public prosecutor se poochhein ki Special Court ne 30 din ke andar bachche ka statement record kiya ya nahi.

title.en: Bihar 5.2, Uttar Pradesh 9.5, Kerala 48.0 POCSO cases per lakh children: why the quiet states should worry us most
title.hg: Bihar 5.2, Uttar Pradesh 9.5, Kerala 48.0 POCSO case per lakh bachche: jo states chup hain, unki fikr sabse zyada honi chahiye

dek.en: Two of India's most populous states register POCSO cases at a fraction of the national rate. Read next to the surveys, the court records and NCRB's own warnings, those numbers look less like safety and more like silence.
dek.hg: India ki sabse zyada aabadi wale states mein se do, Bihar aur Uttar Pradesh, mein POCSO ke case national rate se kaafi kam rate par register hote hain. Lekin surveys, court records aur khud NCRB ki warning ke saath padhein, toh yeh numbers safety kam aur silence zyada lagte hain.

statLabel.en: POCSO cases per lakh children in Bihar in 2024; Kerala recorded 48.0
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein Bihar mein har lakh bachchon par POCSO case; Kerala mein yeh 48.0 tha

label.hg: 2024 mein Bihar mein har lakh bachchon par register hue POCSO case

label.hg: 2024 mein Uttar Pradesh mein har lakh bachchon par register hue POCSO case

label.en: POCSO cases per lakh children across India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein poore India mein har lakh bachchon par register hue POCSO case

claim.en: A state with few POCSO cases is a safer place to be a child.
claim.hg: Jis state mein POCSO ke case kam hain, wahan bachche zyada safe hain.

truth.en: NCRB itself warns that more registered crime does not show a place is less safe. A low POCSO rate can mean that abuse is not being reported, or not being written down.
truth.hg: NCRB khud warn karta hai ki zyada crime register hone se yeh saabit nahi hota ki koi jagah zyada unsafe hai. POCSO ka kam rate yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki abuse report hi nahi ho raha, ya report likhi hi nahi ja rahi.

actions.en: Read rates per lakh children, not raw counts, and remember that NCRB's child rates still use 2011 Census populations.
actions.hg: Raw count nahi, har lakh bachchon par rate dekhiye, aur yaad rakhiye ki NCRB ke child rates abhi bhi 2011 Census ki aabadi par based hain.

actions.en: If a child discloses abuse, call 1098 or 112. You can file an FIR at any police station, whatever the place of the crime, or send it electronically and sign it within three days.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh 1098 ya 112 par call karein. Crime kahin bhi hua ho, aap kisi bhi police station mein FIR likhwa sakte hain, ya use electronically bhej kar teen din ke andar us par sign kar sakte hain.

actions.en: When a leader calls your state 'safe for children', ask what surveys say there about child marriage and violence at home.
actions.hg: Jab koi neta kahe ki aapka state 'bachchon ke liye safe' hai, toh poochhiye ki usi state mein child marriage aur ghar ki violence ke baare mein surveys kya kehte hain.

actions.en: Treat a rising POCSO count in a quiet district as a possible sign that children are finally being heard, and ask what changed.
actions.hg: Kisi 'chup' district mein POCSO ke case badhein, toh ise is baat ka sign bhi maaniye ki shayad bachchon ki baat ab suni ja rahi hai, aur poochhiye ki badla kya.

title.en: From 14 November 2012 to the 2026 court extension: a timeline of India's child sexual abuse law
title.hg: 14 November 2012 se 2026 mein courts ki extension tak: bachchon ke sexual abuse wale kanoon ki poori timeline

dek.en: India's child-protection law has been rebuilt in bursts, often set off by a crime that shook the country or a judgment that read the law too narrowly. Here is what each burst changed, and which promises are still unkept.
dek.hg: Bachchon ko bachane wala kanoon ek baar mein nahi bana. Kai bade badlav ya toh kisi aise crime ke baad aaye jisne desh ko hila diya, ya kisi aise judgment ke baad jisne kanoon ko bahut tang nazar se padha. Jaaniye har baar kya badla, aur kaun se vaade aaj bhi adhoore hain.

label.hg: November 2026 mein approve hue, taaki fast-track courts 2031 tak chalte rahein

claim.en: The death penalty for child rape, added in 2018 and 2019, settled the problem.
claim.hg: 2018 aur 2019 mein child rape par death penalty aa gayi, toh problem solve ho gayi.

truth.en: Punishments rose, but at the end of 2024, 2,86,903 POCSO cases were still waiting for trial, and only 32.3% of completed trials ended in conviction.
truth.hg: Sazaayein sakht huin, lekin 2024 ke end mein bhi 2,86,903 POCSO cases trial ka intezaar kar rahe the, aur poore hue trials mein se sirf 32.3% mein conviction hua.

actions.en: If you know a child is being sexually abused, call 1098 or 112. Under POCSO, anyone who knows must report.
actions.hg: Agar aapko pata hai ki kisi bachche ka sexual abuse ho raha hai, toh 1098 ya 112 par call kariye. POCSO ke under, jise pata hai use report karna hi hoga.

actions.en: Say 'child sexual exploitation and abuse material' (CSEAM), never 'child pornography'.
actions.hg: 'Child pornography' mat boliye. Sahi shabd hai 'child sexual exploitation and abuse material' (CSEAM).

actions.en: Ask your MP or MLA how many POCSO cases are pending in your district's Special Court.
actions.hg: Apne MP ya MLA se poochiye ki aapke district ki Special Court mein kitne POCSO cases pending hain.

actions.en: Share this timeline with anyone who still thinks the age of consent is 16.
actions.hg: Yeh timeline un sabko bhejiye jo aaj bhi maante hain ki age of consent 16 hai.

title.en: 22,308 child-rape cases named a friend, online friend or partner. What is hiding in NCRB's biggest column?
title.hg: 22,308 child rape cases mein accused friend, online friend ya partner tha. NCRB ke sabse bade column mein kya chhupa hai?

dek.en: Half of 2024's POCSO penetrative-assault cases sit in one box that mixes online grooming, false promises of marriage and teenage relationships. The data cannot tell an adult who groomed a child from a teenage boyfriend, and that blind spot distorts how India reads its conviction rate and argues about the age of consent.
dek.hg: 2024 ke POCSO penetrative assault cases ka aadha hissa ek hi box mein hai, jismein online grooming, shaadi ke jhoothe waade aur teenagers ke rishte sab mile hue hain. Data bachche ko groom karne wale adult aur teenage boyfriend mein farq nahi kar sakta, aur isi blind spot ki wajah se conviction rate galat padha jaata hai aur age of consent ki behas andaazon par chalti hai.

statLabel.en: child-rape cases in 2024 that named a friend, online friend or partner 'on pretext of marriage'
statLabel.hg: child rape cases (2024) jinmein accused friend, online friend ya 'shaadi ke bahane' partner tha

label.hg: 2024 ke 44,126 POCSO penetrative assault cases mein se, jinmein accused friend, online friend ya live-in partner tha (50.6%)

label.hg: 2024 mein penetrative sexual assault ke child victims 16 se 18 saal ke the

label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue POCSO trials ka conviction rate

claim.en: Half of all child-rape cases are just teenage love affairs, so POCSO is being misused.
claim.hg: Child rape ke aadhe cases bas teenagers ke love affairs hain, isliye POCSO ka misuse ho raha hai.

truth.en: The 22,308 cases mix adults who groomed children, men who promised marriage and relationships between teenagers. NCRB's table cannot separate them, so it proves neither 'misuse' nor the opposite.
truth.hg: 22,308 cases mein bachchon ko groom karne wale adults, shaadi ka waada karne wale mard aur teenagers ke rishte, sab mile hue hain. NCRB ki table inhe alag nahi kar sakti, isliye yeh na 'misuse' saabit karti hai, na uska ulta.

actions.en: When you quote the 22,308 figure, say what it mixes: grooming, false promises of marriage and teenage relationships.
actions.hg: 22,308 ka figure quote karo toh yeh bhi batao ki ismein kya-kya mila hua hai: grooming, shaadi ke jhoothe waade aur teenagers ke rishte.

actions.en: Know the law: any sexual act with a person under 18 is an offence under POCSO, whatever both people say.
actions.hg: Kanoon jaano: 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath koi bhi sexual act POCSO mein jurm hai, chahe dono kuch bhi kahein.

actions.en: If an older person you met online pushes for secrecy, photos or a meeting, tell an adult you trust or call 1098.
actions.hg: Agar online mila koi bada insaan secrecy, photos ya milne ki zid kare, toh kisi bharosemand bade ko batao ya 1098 par call karo.

actions.en: Ask your MP to press for POCSO data that records the accused's age and splits the 'friend or partner' column.
actions.hg: Apne MP se kaho ki POCSO data mein accused ki umar darj ho aur 'friend ya partner' wala column alag-alag hisson mein baanta jaaye.

title.en: When the abuser works at the institution: what schools, hostels and children's homes must do under POCSO
title.hg: Jab abuser institution mein hi kaam karta ho: POCSO ke tahat schools, hostels aur children's homes ko kya karna hota hai

dek.en: Teachers, wardens, coaches and carers have what an abuser needs most: trust and access. The law makes a head who hides abuse by staff a criminal. What an institution owes your child, the policy to ask for, and what to do when a complaint is buried.
dek.hg: Teachers, wardens, coaches aur carers ke paas woh hai jo ek abuser ko sabse zyada chahiye: trust aur access. Law us head ko criminal maanta hai jo staff ka abuse chhupata hai. Institution aapke bachche ke liye kis baat ka zimmedar hai, kaunsi policy maangni hai, aur complaint dabayi jaye toh kya karna hai.
