claim.en: If a teacher is accused, the school should first hold its own inquiry.
claim.hg: Agar kisi teacher par aarop lage, toh school ko pehle apni inquiry karni chahiye.

truth.en: POCSO requires anyone who knows or suspects child sexual abuse to tell the police. A head who fails to report abuse by staff faces up to 1 year in jail, and the Supreme Court has told courts not to show such institutions leniency.
truth.hg: POCSO kehta hai ki jise bhi child sexual abuse ka pata ho ya shak ho, woh police ko bataye. Jo head staff ka abuse report nahi karta, use 1 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai, aur Supreme Court ne courts se kaha hai ki aise institutions par narmi na dikhayein.

actions.en: Ask your child's school, hostel or home for its written child-protection policy and the name of the person who reports abuse to the police.
actions.hg: Apne bachche ke school, hostel ya home se uski likhit child protection policy maangiye, aur us insaan ka naam bhi jo abuse ki report police ko karta hai.

actions.en: If a staff member is accused, go to the police or call 1098 yourself. You do not need the institution's permission or its inquiry first.
actions.hg: Agar kisi staff member par aarop hai, toh khud police ke paas jaiye ya 1098 par call kijiye. Iske liye institution ki permission ya uski inquiry ka intezaar zaroori nahi.

actions.en: Tell the head in writing what you know: under POCSO, a head who fails to report abuse by staff faces up to 1 year in jail.
actions.hg: Head ko likh kar bataiye ki aap kya jaante hain: POCSO ke tahat, staff ka abuse report na karne wale head ko 1 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai.

actions.en: If one police station will not record it, go to another: a Zero FIR can be filed anywhere, and refusing to record a sexual offence is itself an offence.
actions.hg: Agar ek police station record na kare, toh doosre mein jaiye: Zero FIR kahin bhi file ho sakti hai, aur sexual offence record karne se mana karna khud ek offence hai.

actions.en: Notice staff who single out one child for gifts, private messages or time alone, and speak up early.
actions.hg: Un staff members par nazar rakhiye jo kisi ek bachche ko gifts, private messages ya akele mein time dete hain, aur jaldi bol dijiye.

title.en: The Supreme Court's October 2024 child marriage judgment: 'prevention before protection and protection before penalisation'
title.hg: Supreme Court ka October 2024 ka child marriage judgment: pehle roktham, phir suraksha, saza sabse baad mein

dek.en: A petition filed in 2017 put the enforcement of India's child marriage law before the Supreme Court. Seven years later the court answered with guidelines for officers, magistrates and states. What it found, what it ordered, what it left to Parliament, and how little of it can yet be checked.
dek.hg: 2017 mein daayar ek petition ne India ke child marriage law ke enforcement ka sawaal Supreme Court ke saamne rakha. Saat saal baad court ne officers, magistrates aur states ke liye guidelines ke saath jawaab diya. Court ne kya paaya, kya order kiya, kya Parliament pe chhoda, aur ismein se kitna abhi tak check ho sakta hai.

label.en: FIRs filed in Telangana against 4,440 child marriage cases reported over three years, in state figures the court cited
label.hg: FIRs Telangana mein, teen saal mein report hue 4,440 child marriage cases pe, un state figures mein jo court ne quote kiye

label.en: FIRs in Andhra Pradesh on about 3,400 cases, most of them weddings that were stopped
label.hg: FIRs Andhra Pradesh mein lagbhag 3,400 cases pe; zyadatar cases woh shaadiyan thi jo rok di gayi

label.en: FIRs in Tamil Nadu on 8,966 cases, the contrast in the same data
label.hg: FIRs Tamil Nadu mein 8,966 cases pe, usi data mein dikhne wala contrast

label.en: child marriage cases registered by police across India in 2024, the year of the judgment
label.hg: child marriage cases 2024 mein, judgment wale saal, poore India ki police ne darj kiye

actions.en: Look for your state's quarterly Child Marriage Prohibition Officer reports on its official website: the court ordered them to be published.
actions.hg: Apne state ki official website pe Child Marriage Prohibition Officers ki quarterly reports dhoondhiye: court ne inhe publish karne ka order diya tha.

actions.en: If you cannot find them, file an RTI application asking the state department in charge of child protection for them.
actions.hg: Agar na milein, toh child protection sambhalne wale state department mein RTI daalkar unhe maangiye.

actions.en: If a mass wedding is planned on an 'auspicious day' and you suspect a bride or groom is a child, alert 1098, 112 or the district magistrate days in advance.
actions.hg: Agar kisi 'auspicious day' pe mass wedding plan hai aur aapko shak hai ki dulhan ya dulha child hai, toh kuch din pehle hi 1098, 112 ya district magistrate ko bataiye.

actions.en: Ask your MP where the 2021 child marriage amendment Bill stands, and whether Parliament will act on child betrothals.
actions.hg: Apne MP se poochiye ki 2021 ka child marriage amendment Bill kahan atka hai, aur kya Parliament child betrothals pe kuch karegi.

title.en: 'She said yes' and 'she looked 18': the excuses adults use for sex with minors, and what the law says
title.hg: 'Usne haan kaha tha' aur 'woh 18 ki lagti thi': nabaalig ke saath sex ke liye adults ke bahane, aur kanoon kya kehta hai

dek.en: Indian law does not ask whether a 16-year-old agreed, how old she looked or who messaged first. It asks how old she was. Why each excuse fails, how grooming manufactures a 'yes', and what an adult must do instead.
dek.hg: Indian law yeh nahi poochta ki 16 saal ki ladki ne haan kaha ya nahi, woh kitni badi dikhti thi, ya pehla message kisne bheja. Woh poochta hai ki uski umar kya thi. Har bahana kyun fail hota hai, grooming kaise ek 'haan' banati hai, aur adult ko iske bajaye kya karna chahiye.

label.en: the age below which no 'yes' makes sex legal, under both the BNS and the POCSO Act
label.hg: woh umar jisse kam par koi bhi 'haan' sex ko legal nahi banati, BNS aur POCSO Act dono mein

label.en: POCSO penetrative-assault cases in 2024 that named a friend, online friend or partner 'on pretext of marriage', the largest group of accused
label.hg: 2024 ke POCSO penetrative assault cases mein accused friend, online friend ya 'shaadi ke bahane' wala partner tha, jo accused ka sabse bada group hai

label.en: of child victims of penetrative sexual assault in 2024 were aged 16 to 18
label.hg: 2024 mein penetrative sexual assault ke child victims 16 se 18 saal ke the

label.en: the minimum sentence for penetrative sexual assault on a child under 16
label.hg: 16 se kam umar ke bachche ke saath penetrative sexual assault ki minimum saza

claim.en: If a teenage girl agreed, or looked 18, sex with her is not a crime.
claim.hg: Agar teenage ladki ne haan kaha tha, ya woh 18 ki lagti thi, toh uske saath sex jurm nahi hai.

truth.en: Under the BNS and the POCSO Act, sex with anyone under 18 is an offence whatever they said. The law asks how old she was, not how old she looked or who made the first move.
truth.hg: BNS aur POCSO Act ke tahat 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath sex jurm hai, chahe usne kuch bhi kaha ho. Kanoon poochta hai ki uski umar kya thi, yeh nahi ki woh kitni badi dikhti thi ya pehla kadam kisne uthaya.

actions.en: If someone under 18 flirts with you or says they like you, say no plainly and keep saying it. You are the adult.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ka koi tumse flirt kare ya kahe ki tum use pasand ho, toh saaf mana karo aur mana karte raho. Adult tum ho.

actions.en: Never ask a teenager for photos. If one sends you an intimate image, do not keep it or forward it.
actions.hg: Kisi teenager se kabhi photos mat maango. Agar koi intimate photo bheje, toh use na rakho, na forward karo.

actions.en: Keep contact with teenagers you teach, coach or tutor in the open: no secret chats, no gifts with strings attached, no meetings alone.
actions.hg: Jin teenagers ko tum padhate, coach karte ya tuition dete ho, unse har baat khule mein rakho: koi secret chat nahi, sharton wale gifts nahi, akele mulaqaat nahi.

actions.en: If you know an adult is in a sexual relationship with someone under 18, report it to 1098, 112 or the police. The law requires it.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe pata hai ki koi adult 18 se kam umar ke kisi insaan ke saath sexual relationship mein hai, toh 1098, 112 ya police ko report karo. Kanoon yahi maangta hai.

title.en: Both 17 and both agreed: what POCSO says about teenage relationships, answered plainly
title.hg: Dono 17 ke, dono raazi: teenagers ke rishton par POCSO kya kehta hai, seedhe jawaab

dek.en: Under POCSO, any sexual act with a person under 18 is an offence in India, whatever either person says. What that means for dating, for two teenagers together, for a family that goes to the police, and for a marriage.
dek.hg: POCSO ke tahat India mein 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath koi bhi sexual act jurm hai, chahe koi kuch bhi kahe. Iska dating, do teenagers, police ke paas jaane wali family aur shaadi ke liye kya matlab hai.

statLabel.en: the rise in the age of consent under the 2013 criminal law amendment
statLabel.hg: 2013 ke criminal law amendment ne age of consent itni badhayi

label.en: the age below which POCSO treats anyone, boy or girl, as a child
label.hg: woh umar jisse kam ke har insaan ko, ladka ho ya ladki, POCSO child maanta hai

label.en: of child victims in 2024 POCSO penetrative-assault cases were aged 16 to 18
label.hg: 2024 ke POCSO penetrative assault cases ke child victims 16 se 18 saal ke the

label.en: the age from which a child accused of a 'heinous offence' can be assessed for trial as an adult
label.hg: woh umar jisse 'heinous offence' ke accused bachche ka adult ki tarah trial ke liye assessment ho sakta hai

claim.en: If both people are under 18 and both agree, the law does not apply.
claim.hg: Agar dono 18 se kam hain aur dono raazi hain, toh kanoon laagu nahi hota.

truth.en: It does. Neither POCSO nor the BNS has an exception for partners of the same or a similar age. Below 18, agreeing does not count in law.
truth.hg: Hota hai. Na POCSO mein, na BNS mein, ek jaisi ya milti-julti umar ke partners ke liye koi chhoot hai. 18 se kam umar mein 'haan' ki kanoon mein koi value nahi.

actions.en: Know the line: any sexual act with someone under 18 is an offence, even if you are both under 18 and both agree.
actions.hg: Line samjho: 18 se kam umar ke kisi ke saath bhi koi sexual act jurm hai, chahe tum dono 18 se kam ho aur dono raazi ho.

actions.en: Never take, keep or forward sexual photos of anyone under 18, your partner included.
actions.hg: 18 se kam umar ke kisi ki bhi sexual photos kabhi mat lo, mat rakho, aage mat bhejo, apne partner ki bhi nahi.

actions.en: If anyone is pressuring you, or an older person online wants secrecy, photos or a meeting, call 1098. Asking for help is never a crime.
actions.hg: Agar koi tum par dabaav daal raha hai, ya online koi bada secrecy, photos ya milne ki zid kar raha hai, toh 1098 par call karo. Madad maangna kabhi jurm nahi hai.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 is pregnant and wants to end the pregnancy, go to a registered doctor, never an unqualified provider. The doctor must report to the police, but she and her guardian can ask that her name be left out.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki pregnant hai aur pregnancy khatam karwana chahti hai, toh registered doctor ke paas jao, kisi unqualified insaan ke paas kabhi nahi. Doctor ko police ko report karna hoga, lekin woh aur uske guardian keh sakte hain ki report mein uska naam na likha jaaye.

actions.en: Don't let anyone sell marriage as the solution. A child marriage is no defence, and arranging one is itself an offence.
actions.hg: Kisi ko shaadi ko 'hal' bana kar mat bechne do. Child marriage koi defence nahi hai, aur use karwana khud ek jurm hai.

title.en: 1,384 boys, 913 girls: most children India records as trafficked are boys, and the data cannot say what they were trafficked for
title.hg: 1,384 ladke, 913 ladkiyan: India mein trafficked darj hue bachchon mein zyadatar ladke hain, aur data yeh nahi bata sakta ki unhe kis liye traffic kiya gaya

dek.en: Police records counted 2,297 trafficked children in 2024, and six in ten were boys. The national tables cannot say whether those children were made to work, sexually exploited or married off. Here is what India counts, what it misses, and why that matters.
dek.hg: Police records ne 2024 mein 2,297 trafficked bachche gine, aur inmein har das mein se chhe ladke the. National tables yeh nahi bata sakti ki in bachchon se kaam karwaya gaya, unka sexual exploitation hua ya unki shaadi kara di gayi. Jaaniye India kya ginta hai, kya chhod deta hai, aur yeh kyun maayne rakhta hai.

statLabel.en: boys among the 2,297 children recorded as trafficked in 2024
statLabel.hg: ladke the 2024 mein trafficked darj kiye gaye 2,297 bachchon mein

label.en: children among the 6,018 people recorded as trafficked in India in 2024
label.hg: bachche the 2024 mein India mein trafficked darj kiye gaye 6,018 logon mein

label.en: rescued victims whose purpose of trafficking was recorded in 2024, with no split by age
label.hg: rescued victims jinki trafficking ka maqsad 2024 mein darj hua, lekin umar ke hisaab se koi bantwaara nahi

label.en: conviction rate in human trafficking trials completed in 2024: 43 of 586
label.hg: conviction rate 2024 mein poore hue human trafficking trials mein: 586 mein se 43

label.en: Anti-Human Trafficking Units funded under the Nirbhaya Fund by March 2025
label.hg: Anti-Human Trafficking Units jinka kharcha March 2025 tak Nirbhaya Fund se diya gaya

claim.en: Child trafficking means girls being sold for sex.
claim.hg: Child trafficking ka matlab hai ladkiyon ko sex ke liye bechna.

truth.en: Boys were 1,384 of the 2,297 children recorded as trafficked in India in 2024. Trafficking also covers forced labour, domestic servitude and forced marriage, and India's national data does not say which of these happened to the children.
truth.hg: 2024 mein India mein trafficked darj kiye gaye 2,297 bachchon mein 1,384 ladke the. Trafficking mein forced labour, gharelu gulami aur zabardasti shaadi bhi aati hai, aur India ka national data yeh nahi batata ki in bachchon ke saath inmein se kya hua.

actions.en: If a child is being taken to another town or state for work, call 1098 or 112. A child's 'consent' to go does not make it legal.
actions.hg: Agar kisi bachche ko kaam ke liye doosre shehar ya state le jaaya ja raha hai, toh 1098 ya 112 par call kariye. Bachche ki 'consent' se yeh legal nahi ho jaata.

actions.en: Warn boys as well as girls about job offers, 'training' or travel help from people who want them to leave home or school.
actions.hg: Sirf ladkiyon ko nahi, ladkon ko bhi aagah kariye: naukri, 'training' ya safar mein madad ki aisi offers se, jo log unhe ghar ya school chhudwane ke liye dete hain.

actions.en: Say 'a child who has been trafficked', never 'child prostitute', as the Supreme Court's handbook asks.
actions.hg: 'Child prostitute' mat kahiye. 'Aisa bachcha jise traffic kiya gaya' kahiye, jaisa Supreme Court ki handbook kehti hai.

actions.en: If police will not record a trafficking complaint, tell them that refusing is an offence under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police trafficking ki complaint darj nahi karti, toh unhe bataiye ki aisa mana karna BNS ke Section 199 ke tahat offence hai.

actions.en: Ask your state government to publish trafficking data split by the child's age, sex and the purpose they were trafficked for.
actions.hg: Apni state government se maangiye ki trafficking ka data bachche ki umar, sex aur trafficking ke maqsad ke hisaab se alag karke publish kare.

title.en: Under 18 and being abused? What you can do yourself, today, without waiting for an adult
title.hg: 18 se kam ho aur tumhare saath abuse ho raha hai? Aaj hi, kisi adult ka intezaar kiye bina, tum khud kya kar sakte ho

dek.en: You can report abuse yourself, at any police station or by phone, and the law strictly limits who can learn your name. Straight answers for 15-to-17-year-olds: who to call, what happens next, what a doctor must do, and where to talk if you are not ready.
dek.hg: Tum abuse ki report khud kar sakte ho, kisi bhi police station mein ya phone par, aur kanoon sakhti se tay karta hai ki tumhara naam kaun jaan sakta hai. 15 se 17 saal walon ke liye seedhe jawaab: kise call karein, aage kya hota hai, doctor ko kya karna hota hai, aur agar abhi report ke liye taiyaar nahi ho toh baat kahan karein.

label.en: of POCSO penetrative sexual assault cases in 2024 in which the offender was someone the child knew
label.hg: 2024 ke POCSO penetrative sexual assault cases mein offender bachche ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: of sexually assaulted children in the government's 2007 study had told no one
label.hg: sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein sexual assault jhel chuke bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha

label.en: the 24x7 Child Helpline, linked to the 112 emergency system
label.hg: 24x7 Child Helpline, jo 112 emergency system se judi hai

label.en: Tele-MANAS, the free, round-the-clock counselling helpline
label.hg: Tele-MANAS, free aur din-raat chalne wali counselling helpline

claim.en: If you said yes, went with them or accepted gifts, the abuse is partly your fault and you cannot complain.
claim.hg: Agar tumne haan kaha, unke saath gaye ya gifts liye, toh abuse mein thodi galti tumhari bhi hai aur tum complaint nahi kar sakte.

truth.en: Indian law treats any sexual act with a person under 18 as an offence, whatever they said. The responsibility lies with the person who did it, and you can report it yourself.
truth.hg: Indian law 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath har sexual act ko jurm maanta hai, chahe usne kuch bhi kaha ho. Zimmedari us insaan ki hai jisne yeh kiya, aur tum khud report kar sakte ho.

actions.en: In danger right now, call 112. To reach people who handle child abuse, call 1098, at any hour.
actions.hg: Agar abhi khatre mein ho, toh 112 par call karo. Child abuse sambhalne wale logon tak pahunchne ke liye kisi bhi waqt 1098 par call karo.

actions.en: Walk into any police station, wherever the abuse happened, and ask them to record your complaint. You are entitled to a free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein jao, abuse chahe kahin bhi hua ho, aur complaint record karne ko kaho. FIR ki free copy tumhara haq hai.

actions.en: If it happened in the last few days, go to a hospital today: treatment is free, and medicines that prevent HIV and pregnancy work best when started early.
actions.hg: Agar yeh pichhle kuch dinon mein hua hai, toh aaj hi hospital jao: ilaaj free hai, aur HIV aur pregnancy rokne wali dawaiyan jitni jaldi shuru hon, utna behtar kaam karti hain.

actions.en: Save messages, screenshots, dates and names somewhere the abuser cannot reach. Do not delete chats.
actions.hg: Messages, screenshots, dates aur naam aisi jagah sambhal kar rakho jahan abuser na pahunch sake. Chats delete mat karo.

actions.en: Not ready to report? Call Tele-MANAS on 14416 to talk about how you are feeling.
actions.hg: Abhi report ke liye taiyaar nahi ho? Apni feelings ke baare mein baat karne ke liye Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call karo.

title.en: Bedwetting, nightmares, fear of one person: the signs of child sexual abuse that matter more than injuries
title.hg: Bistar geela karna, bure sapne, kisi ek insaan se darr: child sexual abuse ke woh signs jo chot se zyada maayne rakhte hain

dek.en: Many abused children tell no one, and physical signs of sexual abuse are uncommon. What children show instead is change: in sleep, in mood, around one adult, after time on a phone. How to read those signs, why none of them proves abuse on its own, and how to ask without putting words in a child's mouth.
dek.hg: Abuse jhelne wale bahut se bachche kisi ko nahi batate, aur sexual abuse ke physical signs kam hi dikhte hain. Bachche jo dikhate hain, woh hai badlaav: neend mein, mood mein, kisi ek adult ke aas-paas, phone par waqt bitane ke baad. In signs ko kaise padhein, koi bhi sign akele abuse ka sabut kyun nahi, aur bachche ke munh mein shabd daale bina kaise poochein.

label.en: of sexually assaulted children in the government's 2007 study had told no one
label.hg: sexual assault jhelne wale bachchon ne sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein kisi ko nahi bataya tha

label.en: of sexually assaulted children in the same 2007 study had reported it to the police
label.hg: sexual assault jhelne wale bachchon ne hi usi 2007 ki study mein police ko report kiya tha

label.en: of POCSO penetrative-assault cases in 2024 in which the accused was someone the child knew
label.hg: POCSO penetrative-assault cases mein 2024 mein accused koi aisa tha jise bachcha jaanta tha

claim.en: If a child were being sexually abused, there would be injuries, or the child would say something.
claim.hg: Agar kisi bachche ka sexual abuse ho raha hota, toh chot dikhti, ya bachcha khud kuch kehta.

truth.en: Direct physical signs of sexual abuse are not common, and in the government's 2007 study 72.1% of sexually assaulted children had told no one. Changes in behaviour are the more common signs.
truth.hg: Sexual abuse ke seedhe physical signs aam nahi hote, aur sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein sexual assault jhelne wale 72.1% bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha. Behaviour mein badlaav zyada aam signs hain.

actions.en: Compare a child with their own self a few months ago, and write down what changed and when it began.
actions.hg: Bachche ki tulna kuch mahine pehle wale usi bachche se kariye, aur likh lijiye ki kya badla aur kab se.

actions.en: Never make a child hug, kiss or sit on the lap of any adult, relatives included.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi bachche ko kisi adult ko hug karne, kiss karne ya uski god mein baithne par majboor mat kariye, relatives ke saath bhi nahi.

actions.en: Ask open questions in a calm, private moment. Never ask 'Did he touch you?'
actions.hg: Shaant, private pal mein open questions poochiye. Kabhi mat poochiye 'Kya usne tumhe chhua?'

actions.en: Tell children they will not be punished, or lose their phone, for telling you what happened online.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko bataiye ki online jo hua, woh batane par na unhe saza milegi, na unka phone chheena jaayega.

actions.en: If the signs add up or a child tells you, call 1098 or 112 the same day. You need suspicion, not proof.
actions.hg: Agar signs judne lagein ya bachcha khud bataye, toh usi din 1098 ya 112 par call kariye. Sabut nahi, shak kaafi hai.

title.en: 18 for consent, 21 for a groom, 16 for an adult trial: Indian law has no single age of childhood
title.hg: Consent ke liye 18, dulhe ke liye 21, adult trial ke liye 16: Indian law mein bachpan ki koi ek umar nahi

dek.en: A 17-year-old cannot legally agree to sex, a 20-year-old groom is still a 'child', and a 16-year-old accused of a serious crime can be tried as an adult. All of it is true at once. Here are the main lines in one place, and why the mismatch matters for real families.
dek.hg: 17 saal ka koi bhi bachcha legally sex ke liye haan nahi keh sakta, 20 saal ka dulha abhi bhi 'child' hai, aur kisi serious crime ke aaropi 16 saal ke teenager par adult ki tarah trial chal sakta hai. Yeh sab ek saath sach hai. Yahan saari main lines ek jagah par hain, aur yeh bhi ki yeh mismatch asli families ke liye kyun matter karta hai.

label.en: the age below which POCSO treats every person as a child, boy or girl
label.hg: is umar se kam har insaan POCSO mein child hai, chahe ladka ho ya ladki

label.en: the age below which the child marriage law treats a man as a child
label.hg: is umar se kam ke ladke ko child marriage law child maanta hai

label.en: the age from which a child accused of a heinous offence can be assessed for trial as an adult
label.hg: is umar se upar ke bachche par heinous offence ka aarop ho, toh assess kiya ja sakta hai ki uska trial adult ki tarah ho ya nahi

label.en: of child victims of penetrative sexual assault recorded in 2024 were 16 or 17 years old
label.hg: 2024 mein record hue penetrative sexual assault ke child victims mein se itne 16 ya 17 saal ke the

claim.en: At 18 you become an adult in every Indian law.
claim.hg: 18 saal ke hote hi aap har Indian law mein adult ho jaate hain.

truth.en: No. The child marriage law treats a man as a child until 21, and a 16-year-old accused of a heinous offence can be tried as an adult. Each law draws its own line.
truth.hg: Nahi. Child marriage law ladke ko 21 tak child maanta hai, aur 16 saal ke teenager par heinous offence ka aarop ho toh uska trial adult ki tarah ho sakta hai. Har kanoon ki apni line hai.

actions.en: Keep your child's birth certificate and school records safe. In any case that reaches the police, proof of age decides which law applies.
actions.hg: Apne bachche ka birth certificate aur school records sambhal kar rakhein. Police tak pahunche kisi bhi case mein age proof hi decide karta hai ki kaun sa kanoon lagega.

actions.en: Never arrange or attend a wedding where the bride is under 18 or the groom under 21. Call 1098 to stop one.
actions.hg: Aisi koi shaadi arrange na karein aur usmein na jaayein jismein dulhan 18 se kam ya dulha 21 se kam umar ka ho. Aisi shaadi rukwane ke liye 1098 par call karein.

actions.en: If you are under 18 and someone is pressuring you sexually, call the Child Helpline, 1098, at any hour. POCSO exists to protect you.
actions.hg: Agar aapki umar 18 se kam hai aur koi aap par sexual pressure daal raha hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par kabhi bhi call karein. POCSO aapki hifazat ke liye bana hai.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 needs an abortion, go with a guardian to a registered doctor. If she and her guardian ask, the doctor need not name her in the report to the police.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki ko abortion karwana hai, toh guardian ke saath registered doctor ke paas jaayein. Agar ladki aur uska guardian kahein, toh doctor ko police ko di jaane wali report mein uska naam dene ki zaroorat nahi hai.

title.en: Tutoring, coaching or volunteering with children? The conduct rules that keep them safe and keep you above suspicion
title.hg: Bachchon ko tuition, coaching ya volunteering karwate hain? Woh conduct rules jo unhe safe rakhte hain aur aapko har shak se upar

dek.en: Special attention, gifts, private messages, touch and time alone are how grooming works. They are also habits a warm tutor can slip into without thinking. The rules that separate the two, and what the law expects of you if a child discloses or a colleague crosses a line.
dek.hg: Special attention, gifts, private messages, chhoona aur akele mein waqt: grooming isi tarah kaam karti hai. Yahi aadatein ek pyaar se padhaane wale tutor mein bina soche bhi aa sakti hain. Dono mein farq karne wale rules, aur agar koi bachcha kuch bataye ya koi colleague line paar kare, toh kanoon aapse kya ummeed karta hai.

label.en: child-rape cases in 2024 in which the accused was a family friend, neighbour, employer or other known person
label.hg: child rape cases 2024 mein jinmein accused family friend, padosi, employer ya koi aur jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: maximum prison term on a first conviction for enticing a child into an online sexual relationship (IT Act Section 67B)
label.hg: pehli conviction par maximum jail, kisi bachche ko online sexual relationship mein phansaane ke liye (IT Act Section 67B)

label.en: maximum prison term for the head of an institution who fails to report abuse by someone working under them (POCSO)
label.hg: maximum jail us institution head ke liye jo apne under kaam karne wale ke abuse ki report nahi karta (POCSO)

label.en: minimum sentence under POCSO for penetrative sexual assault on a child under 16, since 2019
label.hg: POCSO mein 16 saal se chhote bachche par penetrative sexual assault ki minimum saza, 2019 se

claim.en: If my intentions are good, it does not matter how much time I spend alone with a student or what I message them.
claim.hg: Agar meri neeyat saaf hai, toh isse fark nahi padta ki main kisi student ke saath kitna akela waqt bitata hoon ya use kya message karta hoon.

truth.en: Grooming is built to look like kindness: special attention, gifts, a listening ear, time alone. Children, parents and colleagues cannot see your intentions, only your behaviour. Rules you follow every time are what show the difference.
truth.hg: Grooming jaan-boojhkar kindness jaisi banayi jaati hai: special attention, gifts, sunne wala koi, akele mein waqt. Bachche, parents aur colleagues aapki neeyat nahi dekh sakte, sirf aapka bartaav. Har baar maane jaane wale rules hi farq dikhate hain.

actions.en: Teach where you can be seen and interrupted: a shared room or an open door, never alone with one child behind a closed door.
actions.hg: Aisi jagah padhaiye jahan aap dikhein aur koi bhi beech mein aa sake: common kamra ya khula darwaza, band darwaze ke peeche kisi ek bachche ke saath akele kabhi nahi.

actions.en: Message students only in groups that include a parent: no private chats, late-night messages or disappearing messages.
actions.hg: Students ko sirf aise groups mein message kariye jismein parent bhi ho: private chats, late-night messages ya disappearing messages nahi.

actions.en: Give praise and rewards to the whole group, openly; no private gifts, money, rides or secrets.
actions.hg: Taareef aur inaam poore group ko, sabke saamne dijiye; private gifts, paise, lift ya secrets nahi.

actions.en: If a child sends you a sexual image, do not save or forward it; report it at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha aapko sexual image bheje, toh use save ya forward mat kariye; cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report kariye.

actions.en: If a child discloses abuse or a colleague crosses a line, write it down and report it to the police or 1098. An internal warning is not enough.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye ya koi colleague line paar kare, toh likh lijiye aur police ya 1098 ko report kariye. Andar hi andar warning dena kaafi nahi hai.

title.en: 'Most 498A cases are fake'? Police closed 3.8% as false in 2024 and charge-sheeted 90.2%
title.hg: '498A ke zyada tar cases fake hote hain'? 2024 mein police ne sirf 3.8% ko false bata kar band kiya aur 90.2% mein charge-sheet file ki

dek.en: The line is everywhere online and at family gatherings. NCRB's 2024 records on cruelty-by-husband cases say something else: few complaints are closed as false, nine in ten are charge-sheeted, and the real failure is how long trials take.
dek.hg: Yeh line online aur family gatherings mein har jagah sunai deti hai. Lekin pati ki cruelty wale cases par NCRB ke 2024 records kuch aur kehte hain: bahut kam complaints false bata kar band hui, das mein se nau mein charge-sheet file hui, aur asli failure hai trials mein hone wali lambi deri.

statLabel.en: charge-sheeting rate in cruelty-by-husband cases disposed of by police in 2024
statLabel.hg: pati ki cruelty wale jin cases ki police jaanch 2024 mein poori hui, unmein charge-sheeting rate

label.en: of cruelty cases disposed of by police in 2024 were closed as 'false' (4,593 of 1,20,390)
label.hg: cruelty cases jinki police jaanch 2024 mein poori hui, 'false' bata kar band hue (1,20,390 mein se 4,593)

label.en: were charge-sheeted, against 77.2% for all crimes against women
label.hg: mein charge-sheet file hui, jabki women ke khilaaf saare crimes mein yeh rate 77.2% tha

label.en: cruelty cases ended in compromise or compounding in court in 2024, more than the 10,689 convictions
label.hg: cruelty cases 2024 mein court mein compromise ya compounding se khatam hue, 10,689 convictions se zyada

label.en: cruelty cases pending trial at the end of 2024, 92.2% of all before the courts
label.hg: cruelty cases 2024 ke end mein trial ke intezaar mein the, courts ke saamne aise saare cases ka 92.2%

claim.en: Most 498A cases are fake: wives file them to harass the husband's family.
claim.hg: 498A ke zyada tar cases fake hote hain: wives pati ki family ko harass karne ke liye case karti hain.

truth.en: In 2024 police closed 4,593 of the 1,20,390 cruelty cases they disposed of as 'false', about 3.8%, and charge-sheeted 90.2%. An acquittal or a compromise in court is not a finding that the complaint was false.
truth.hg: 2024 mein police ne cruelty ke jin 1,20,390 cases ki jaanch poori ki, unmein se 4,593, yaani lagbhag 3.8%, ko 'false' bata kar band kiya aur 90.2% mein charge-sheet file ki. Court mein acquittal ya compromise ka matlab yeh faisla nahi hai ki complaint jhoothi thi.

actions.en: Before you forward a '498A is fake' post, check the number: of the cruelty cases police disposed of in 2024, they closed 3.8% as false and charge-sheeted 90.2%.
actions.hg: '498A fake hai' wali post forward karne se pehle number check kijiye: 2024 mein police ne cruelty ke jin cases ki jaanch poori ki, unmein se 3.8% false bata kar band kiye aur 90.2% mein charge-sheet file ki.

actions.en: If your family faces a cruelty complaint you believe is untrue, take legal advice early and cooperate with the investigation. Police can and do close complaints they find false.
actions.hg: Agar aapki family par cruelty ki aisi complaint hui hai jise aap jhoothi maante hain, toh jaldi legal advice lijiye aur investigation mein cooperate kijiye. Police jhoothi paayi gayi complaints band kar sakti hai, aur karti bhi hai.

actions.en: If you face cruelty, keep a private record of dates, messages, medical visits and money demanded. Call 181 (Women Helpline) for advice, or 112 in danger.
actions.hg: Agar aapke saath cruelty ho rahi hai, toh dates, messages, doctor visits aur maange gaye paison ka private record rakhiye. Advice ke liye Women Helpline 181 par, aur khatre mein 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Never pressure a woman to 'settle' a cruelty case. A compromise made under pressure is not justice for anyone.
actions.hg: Kisi aurat par cruelty case 'settle' karne ka pressure kabhi mat daaliye. Pressure mein kiya gaya compromise kisi ke liye insaaf nahi hai.

actions.en: Push for faster investigations and trials, not fewer complaints: 92.2% of the cruelty cases before the courts in 2024 were still pending at the end of the year.
actions.hg: Kam complaints ki nahi, fast investigation aur fast trial ki maang kijiye: 2024 mein courts ke saamne cruelty ke jitne cases the, unmein se 92.2% saal ke end tak pending the.

title.en: 5,737 dowry deaths in 2024: about 16 women a day, 63 years after India outlawed dowry
title.hg: 2024 mein 5,737 dowry deaths: roz qareeb 16 auratein, dowry ban hone ke 63 saal baad bhi

dek.en: Registered dowry deaths have fallen every year since 2020, but slowly, and the count leaves out women whose deaths were filed as something else. What the 2024 number shows, what it hides, and where families can step in.
dek.hg: 2020 se registered dowry deaths har saal kam hui hain, par bahut dheere. Aur yeh count un auraton ko chhod deta hai jinki maut kisi aur naam se darj hui. 2024 ka number kya dikhata hai, kya chhupata hai, aur family kahan aage aa sakti hai.

statLabel.en: dowry-death cases registered in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein India mein register hue dowry death cases

label.en: women recorded as victims of dowry deaths in 2024 (5,737 cases)
label.hg: 2024 mein dowry death ki victim darj hui auratein (5,737 cases)

label.en: share of India's 2024 dowry deaths registered in Uttar Pradesh (2,038 cases)
label.hg: 2024 mein India ki dowry deaths mein Uttar Pradesh ka hissa (2,038 cases)

label.en: murders in 2024 with dowry recorded as the motive, counted separately
label.hg: 2024 ke murders jinka motive dowry darj hua; yeh alag gine jaate hain

label.en: share of all recorded killings of women in India that were dowry deaths, every year from 1999 to 2016
label.hg: 1999 se 2016 tak har saal India mein recorded auraton ke murders mein dowry deaths ka hissa

claim.en: Dowry deaths belong to the past. Dowry has been illegal since 1961.
claim.hg: Dowry deaths ab purani baat hai. 1961 se toh dowry illegal hai.

truth.en: Police registered 5,737 dowry deaths in 2024, about 16 a day. That counts only deaths booked as dowry deaths, not those recorded as accidents, suicides or murders.
truth.hg: 2024 mein police ne 5,737 dowry deaths register kin, yaani roz qareeb 16. Is ginti mein sirf woh maut hain jo dowry death ke roop mein darj huin; accident, suicide ya murder ke roop mein darj maut ismein nahi aati.

actions.en: If a daughter, sister or friend says her in-laws are asking for money or goods, believe her the first time and write down dates, amounts and who said what.
actions.hg: Agar aapki beti, behen ya dost kahe ki sasural wale paise ya saamaan maang rahe hain, toh pehli baar mein hi uski baat par bharosa kijiye. Date, amount aur kisne kya kaha, sab likh lijiye.

actions.en: Never send her back to 'adjust'. Tell her plainly that she can come home, and make sure she has a phone and some money of her own.
actions.hg: Use kabhi 'adjust karo' bolkar wapas mat bhejiye. Saaf kahiye ki woh ghar aa sakti hai, aur pakka kijiye ki uske paas apna phone aur thode paise hon.

actions.en: Keep every message, call record and payment linked to a dowry demand: a record of demands and harassment is central evidence in any dowry case.
actions.hg: Dowry demand se juda har message, call record aur payment sambhaal kar rakhiye. Kisi bhi dowry case mein demands aur harassment ka record sabse zaroori evidence hota hai.

actions.en: In an emergency call 112; for advice call the Women Helpline on 181. A complaint can be made at any police station (Zero FIR).
actions.hg: Emergency mein 112 call kijiye. Salah ke liye Women Helpline 181 par baat kijiye. Complaint kisi bhi police station mein ho sakti hai (Zero FIR).

actions.en: If you or someone you know is thinking about suicide, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and at any hour.
actions.hg: Agar aap ya aapka koi jaanne wala suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye. Yeh free hai aur kisi bhi time baat ho sakti hai.

title.en: Acid attacks by the numbers: 804 cases in court, 24 trials finished, 13 convictions in 2024
title.hg: Acid attacks by the numbers: court mein 804 cases, sirf 24 trials poore, 2024 mein 13 convictions

dek.en: The law promises at least 10 years in prison for an acid attack. In 2024 Indian courts finished 24 trials in acid-attack cases involving women and left 778 waiting. What each number says about a punishment that mostly exists on paper.
dek.hg: Kanoon acid attack ke liye kam se kam 10 saal jail ka waada karta hai. 2024 mein Indian courts ne auraton par acid attack ke cases mein sirf 24 trials poore kiye aur 778 cases intezaar mein chhod diye. Har number kya batata hai ek aisi saza ke baare mein jo zyada tar kaagaz par hi hai.

statLabel.en: acid-attack cases on women pending trial at the end of 2024
statLabel.hg: auraton par acid attack ke cases jo 2024 ke end mein trial ke intezaar mein the

label.en: acid attacks on women registered in India in 2024, with 126 victims
label.hg: auraton par acid attacks jo 2024 mein India mein register hue, 126 victims ke saath

label.en: acid-attack trials completed in 2024, out of 804 cases before the courts
label.hg: acid-attack trials jo 2024 mein poore hue, courts ke saamne ke 804 cases mein se

label.en: convictions in acid-attack cases on women in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein auraton par acid attack ke cases mein convictions

label.en: of acid-attack cases on women still pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: auraton par acid attack ke cases jo 2024 ke end tak trial ke intezaar mein the

claim.en: Acid attackers face 10 years to life in prison, so the law already deters them.
claim.hg: Acid attackers ko 10 saal se umr qaid tak ki saza hoti hai, isliye kanoon unhe pehle se hi rok deta hai.

truth.en: The sentence exists on paper. In 2024 courts finished just 24 trials out of 804 acid-attack cases involving women, and 13 ended in conviction; 778 cases were still waiting at the end of the year.
truth.hg: Saza kaagaz par hai. 2024 mein auraton par acid attack ke 804 cases mein se courts ne sirf 24 trials poore kiye, aur 13 mein conviction hua; saal ke end tak 778 cases abhi bhi intezaar mein the.

actions.en: If someone is attacked with acid, call 112 and get them to the nearest hospital, public or private: it must treat them free and at once, and inform the police.
actions.hg: Agar kisi par acid attack ho, toh 112 par call kijiye aur use sabse paas ke hospital le jaiye, sarkari ho ya private: use turant aur free mein ilaaj dena hoga aur police ko khabar karni hogi.

actions.en: A woman's complaint of an acid attack must be recorded by a woman officer. An officer who refuses to record an FIR for an acid attack commits an offence under Section 199 BNS.
actions.hg: Kisi aurat ki acid attack ki complaint ek woman officer ko record karni hogi. Jo officer acid attack ki FIR likhne se mana kare, woh BNS ki Section 199 ke under offence karta hai.

actions.en: Survivors can apply for compensation to the State or District Legal Services Authority without waiting for the trial, even if the attacker is never traced.
actions.hg: Survivors trial khatam hone ka intezaar kiye bina State ya District Legal Services Authority mein compensation ke liye apply kar sakte hain, tab bhi jab attacker ka kabhi pata na chale.

actions.en: Ask your MP or MLA how many acid-attack cases in your state are pending trial, and what is being done to finish them.
actions.hg: Apne MP ya MLA se poochhiye ki aapke state mein acid attack ke kitne cases trial ke intezaar mein hain, aur unhe poora karne ke liye kya kiya ja raha hai.

actions.en: When one conviction makes the news, ask how many cases from the same year are still waiting.
actions.hg: Jab koi ek conviction news mein aaye, toh poochhiye ki usi saal ke kitne cases abhi bhi intezaar mein hain.

title.en: If a daughter dies within seven years of her wedding: the family's rights, from the Section 80 FIR to Rs 5-10 lakh compensation
title.hg: Agar shaadi ke saat saal ke andar beti ki maut ho jaye: family ke haq, Section 80 ki FIR se Rs 5-10 lakh compensation tak

dek.en: Grief arrives with a police station, a post-mortem and a court case that can run for years. What the law gives a bereaved family at each step: where to report, what to show, what police must tell you, and compensation that is not tied only to a conviction.
dek.hg: Dukh ke saath police station, post-mortem aur saalon chalne wala court case bhi aata hai. Har kadam par kanoon ek ghum mein doobi family ko kya deta hai: report kahan karein, kya dikhana hoga, police ko aapko kya batana hoga, aur aisa compensation jo sirf conviction par tika nahi hai.

statLabel.en: NALSA compensation range for the family of a woman killed
statLabel.hg: maari gayi aurat ki family ke liye NALSA compensation ki range

label.hg: dowry death cases 2024 mein police ne register kiye, yaani roz qareeb 16

label.en: of dowry-death cases before the courts were still pending at the end of 2024
label.hg: dowry death cases 2024 ke end mein courts mein abhi bhi pending the

label.en: within which police must tell the informant how the investigation is going
label.hg: jinke andar police ko informant ko batana hota hai ki investigation kahan tak pahunchi

label.en: for a legal services authority to finish its inquiry into a compensation claim
label.hg: jinme legal services authority ko compensation claim ki inquiry poori karni hoti hai

claim.en: Compensation is paid only if the in-laws are convicted.
claim.hg: Compensation tabhi milta hai jab sasural walon ko saza ho.

truth.en: Under Section 396 of the BNSS, dependants can apply for compensation even if the offender is never traced and no trial takes place, and the legal services authority must finish its inquiry within two months.
truth.hg: BNSS ke Section 396 ke under, offender ka kabhi pata na chale aur trial hi na ho, tab bhi dependants compensation ke liye apply kar sakte hain, aur legal services authority ko do mahine ke andar inquiry poori karni hoti hai.

actions.en: Report the death at any police station, even one far from where she lived, and keep your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Maut ki report kisi bhi police station mein kijiye, chahe woh uske ghar se kitna bhi door ho, aur FIR ki free copy sambhaal kar rakhiye.

actions.en: Make sure the FIR records every dowry demand, and give police the messages, call logs and payment records you have.
actions.hg: Dhyaan rakhiye ki FIR mein dowry ki har demand likhi jaye, aur aapke paas jo messages, call logs aur payment records hain woh police ko dijiye.

actions.en: If 90 days pass with no word on the investigation, write to the investigating officer and ask for an update.
actions.hg: Agar 90 din tak investigation ki koi khabar na mile, toh investigating officer ko likhkar update maangiye.

actions.en: Ask your District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer and about compensation under your state's scheme.
actions.hg: Apni District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer maangiye, aur apne state ki scheme mein compensation ke baare mein poochiye.

actions.en: If grief becomes too heavy, or anyone in the family has thoughts of suicide, call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Agar dukh bahut bhaari ho jaye, ya family mein kisi ke man mein suicide ke khayal aayein, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye.

title.en: 498A is now Section 85, 304B is Section 80: the home crimes the BNS renumbered on 1 July 2024, and the exception it kept
title.hg: 498A ab Section 85 hai, 304B ab Section 80: 1 July 2024 ko BNS ne ghar ke kaunse crimes ke number badle, aur kaunsa exception rehne diya

dek.en: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita gave cruelty, dowry death, acid attack and abetted suicide new section numbers. It also kept the marital rape exception. A cheat sheet for anyone filing, or reading, a complaint in 2026.
dek.hg: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ne cruelty, dowry death, acid attack aur abetment of suicide ko naye section number diye. Marital rape exception wahi raha. 2026 mein complaint file karne ya padhne wale har insaan ke liye ek cheat sheet.

label.en: cruelty cases registered in 2024 under Section 85 BNS or Section 498A IPC
label.hg: 2024 mein Section 85 BNS ya Section 498A IPC ke under register hue cruelty cases

label.en: dowry deaths registered in 2024 under Section 80 BNS or Section 304B IPC
label.hg: 2024 mein Section 80 BNS ya Section 304B IPC ke under register hui dowry deaths

label.en: acid attacks registered in India in 2024, plus 68 attempts
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein register hue acid attacks, aur 68 attempts alag se

claim.en: The new criminal laws abolished 498A.
claim.hg: Naye criminal laws ne 498A khatam kar diya.

truth.en: The offence moved to Sections 85 and 86 of the BNS, which still punish cruelty by a husband or his relatives with up to three years in prison and a fine.
truth.hg: Yeh offence BNS ke Sections 85 aur 86 mein shift hua hai, jo pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty par aaj bhi teen saal tak jail aur fine ki saza dete hain.

actions.en: Check the date of the offence: anything that happened before 1 July 2024 is registered under the IPC, even if you report it today.
actions.hg: Offence ki date check kijiye: 1 July 2024 se pehle jo bhi hua, woh IPC ke under register hota hai, chahe aap aaj report karein.

actions.en: Ask for your free copy of the FIR and check the sections: cruelty is Section 85 BNS (498A IPC), dowry death 80 (304B) and acid attack 124 (326A).
actions.hg: FIR ki free copy maangiye aur usme sections check kijiye: cruelty Section 85 BNS (498A IPC) hai, dowry death 80 (304B) aur acid attack 124 (326A).

actions.en: Keep proof of cruelty: messages, demands for money or property, medical slips and the names of people you told.
actions.hg: Cruelty ka proof sambhaal kar rakhiye: messages, paise ya property ki demands, medical slips, aur un logon ke naam jinhe aapne bataya.

actions.en: If police refuse to record an acid attack, remind a senior officer that refusing is itself a crime under Section 199 BNS, or file an e-FIR.
actions.hg: Agar police acid attack ki FIR likhne se mana kare, toh kisi senior officer ko yaad dilaiye ki mana karna khud Section 199 BNS ke under crime hai, ya e-FIR file kijiye.

actions.en: If you or someone you know is thinking about suicide, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar aap ya aapka koi jaanne wala suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye; yeh free hai aur din-raat chalta hai.

title.en: 'Excessively harsh': the Centre says cruelty, assault and domestic violence laws protect wives from forced sex. We tested each remedy
title.hg: 'Excessively harsh': Centre kehta hai ki cruelty, assault aur domestic violence ke kanoon biwiyon ko zabardasti sex se bachate hain. Humne har remedy ko test kiya

dek.en: The Union government told the Supreme Court that calling forced sex in marriage rape could be disproportionate, then told Parliament it had no proposal to make it a crime. We read each alternative it named against the law's own text: what a wife must prove, the most a court can give, and what the record will call it.
dek.hg: Union government ne Supreme Court se kaha ki shaadi mein zabardasti sex ko rape kehna disproportionate ho sakta hai, phir Parliament ko bataya ki ise crime banane ka koi proposal nahi hai. Humne uske bataye har alternative ko kanoon ke apne text se milaya: biwi ko kya prove karna padega, court zyada se zyada kya saza de sakti hai, aur record mein ise kya naam milega.

statLabel.en: maximum sentence for cruelty, the main remedy the Centre points wives to
statLabel.hg: cruelty ki maximum saza, wahi main remedy jiski taraf Centre biwiyon ko bhejta hai

label.hg: Section 64 BNS mein rape ki minimum saza, ek aisa charge jo adult biwi ke pati par lag hi nahi sakta

label.hg: ever-married auraton ne kaha ki pati ne unhe physically majboor karke sex kiya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue cruelty-by-husband trials mein conviction rate

label.en: cruelty cases that ended in compromise in 2024, more than the 10,689 that ended in conviction
label.hg: cruelty cases 2024 mein compromise par khatam hue, conviction wale 10,689 cases se zyada

claim.en: Wives don't need a marital rape law. Cruelty and domestic violence laws already cover forced sex.
claim.hg: Biwiyon ko marital rape law ki zaroorat nahi. Cruelty aur domestic violence ke kanoon zabardasti sex ko pehle se cover karte hain.

truth.en: They cover parts of it, under other names. Cruelty carries at most three years and breaking a protection order at most one; rape carries at least ten.
truth.hg: Woh iske kuch hisse cover karte hain, doosre naamon se. Cruelty mein zyada se zyada teen saal, protection order todne par zyada se zyada ek saal; rape mein kam se kam das saal.

actions.en: If your husband forces sex on you, you can file a cruelty complaint at any police station, which must give you a free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Agar pati aapke saath zabardasti sex karta hai, toh aap kisi bhi police station mein cruelty ki complaint kar sakti hain, aur police ko aapko FIR ki free copy deni hogi.

actions.en: Ask a magistrate for a protection order under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act, which names sexual abuse as domestic violence.
actions.hg: 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act ke under magistrate se protection order maangiye; yeh Act sexual abuse ko domestic violence maanta hai.

actions.en: If you are pregnant from forced sex by your husband, you can seek an abortion up to 24 weeks as a rape survivor, without an FIR.
actions.hg: Agar pati ke zabardasti sex se aap pregnant hain, toh aap rape survivor ke roop mein 24 hafte tak abortion le sakti hain, bina FIR ke.

actions.en: Keep a dated record of each incident, with medical papers and messages, somewhere he cannot reach.
actions.hg: Har incident ka date ke saath record rakhiye, medical papers aur messages ke saath, aisi jagah jahan woh na pahunch sake.

actions.en: Call the Women Helpline on 181, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, emergency mein 112.

title.en: A third of the world's 640 million child brides are Indian: the violence that follows them into marriage
title.hg: Duniya ki 640 million child brides mein se ek-tihai Indian hain: shaadi ke baad bhi unka peecha karti violence

dek.en: UNICEF India estimates that at least 1.5 million Indian girls are married before 18 every year. Inside those marriages come violence that starts early, pregnancies they did not choose and almost no one to tell. What the data shows, and how a girl, a friend or a teacher can find the way out.
dek.hg: UNICEF India ka estimate hai ki har saal kam se kam 1.5 million Indian ladkiyon ki shaadi 18 se pehle ho jaati hai. In shaadiyon ke andar hai jaldi shuru hone wali violence, aisi pregnancies jo unhone choose nahi kin, aur bataane ke liye shayad hi koi. Data kya dikhata hai, aur ek ladki, uski dost ya teacher bahar ka raasta kaise dhoondh sakte hain.
