label.hg: 2024 mein poore India mein child marriage law ke under register hue cases

claim.en: Marrying a girl early keeps her safe and settled.
claim.hg: Ladki ki shaadi jaldi kar do, toh woh safe aur settled rehti hai.

truth.en: UNICEF says girls who marry before 18 are more likely to face domestic violence and less likely to stay in school. And in Indian law, sex with a wife under 18 is rape.
truth.hg: UNICEF kehta hai ki 18 se pehle shaadi hone wali ladkiyon ke saath domestic violence ke chances zyada hote hain aur unke school mein tike rehne ke chances kam. Aur Indian law mein 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex rape hai.

actions.en: If a girl you know is about to be married before 18, call 1098 or 112 before the wedding date. A wedding is far easier to stop than to undo.
actions.hg: Agar aapki jaan-pehchaan ki kisi ladki ki shaadi 18 se pehle hone wali hai, toh shaadi ki date se pehle 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye. Shaadi ko rokna, use undo karne se kahin aasaan hai.

actions.en: If you were married before 18, you can ask a district court to annul the marriage until two years after you turn 18. Ask your District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer now, before the deadline passes.
actions.hg: Agar aapki shaadi 18 se pehle hui thi, toh 18 ki hone ke do saal baad tak aap district court se shaadi annul karne ki maang kar sakti hain. Deadline nikalne se pehle, abhi apni District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer maangiye.

actions.en: Teachers and doctors: if a married student under 18 tells you about abuse, the law requires you to report it. Promise her support, not secrecy, and stay with her through what follows.
actions.hg: Teachers aur doctors: agar 18 se kam umar ki koi married student aapko abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh law ke hisaab se aapko report karna hi hoga. Use secrecy ka nahi, saath dene ka promise kijiye, aur aage jo bhi ho, uske saath rahiye.

actions.en: A married woman of any age facing violence can go to a One Stop Centre or call the Women Helpline 181 for help.
actions.hg: Violence jhel rahi kisi bhi umar ki married aurat One Stop Centre jaa sakti hai ya Women Helpline 181 par call karke madad maang sakti hai.

actions.en: If a friend has been married young, stay in touch and help her keep studying. School is often the only place outside the house where someone sees her every day.
actions.hg: Agar kisi dost ki shaadi kam umar mein ho gayi hai, toh usse contact mein rahiye aur padhai jaari rakhne mein uski madad kijiye. School aksar ghar ke bahar ki akeli jagah hoti hai jahan koi use roz dekhta hai.

title.en: 1,20,227 cases in 2024: the crime police record most often against Indian women happens inside marriage
title.hg: 2024 mein 1,20,227 cases: women ke khilaaf jo crime police sabse zyada darj karti hai, woh shaadi ke andar hota hai

dek.en: More than one in four crimes against women that police registered in 2024 was cruelty by a husband or his family. The count has fallen since 2022, but that is not proof of safer homes: most women never go to the police, and NCRB's counting rule leaves cases out.
dek.hg: 2024 mein police ne women ke khilaaf jitne crimes register kiye, unmein har chaar mein se ek se zyada case pati ya uske parivaar ki cruelty ka tha. 2022 ke baad cases ghate hain, par yeh safe gharon ka saboot nahi hai: zyada tar women police tak jaati hi nahi, aur NCRB ka counting rule kai cases ko is ginti se bahar kar deta hai.

statLabel.en: cases of cruelty by husband or relatives registered in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: cases pati ya relatives ki cruelty ke, 2024 mein India mein register hue

label.en: cases of cruelty by husband or relatives registered in India in 2024
label.hg: cases pati ya relatives ki cruelty ke, 2024 mein India mein register hue

label.en: share of all 4,41,534 crimes against women registered in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein register hue women ke khilaaf kul 4,41,534 crimes mein iska share

label.en: cases in 2022, the highest of the last five years
label.hg: cases 2022 mein, pichhle paanch saal mein sabse zyada

label.en: cases per lakh women in Telangana, the highest rate in India (2024)
label.hg: cases per lakh women Telangana mein, India mein sabse zyada rate (2024)

actions.en: Call it what the law calls it: cruelty by a husband or his relatives is a crime under Section 85 BNS, not a 'family matter' to adjust to.
actions.hg: Ise wahi naam dijiye jo law deta hai: pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty BNS Section 85 ke under crime hai, koi 'ghar ka maamla' nahi jise chup-chaap seh liya jaaye.

actions.en: If you face cruelty, keep a private record of dates, messages, medical visits and money demanded, and tell one person you trust.
actions.hg: Agar aapke saath cruelty ho rahi hai, toh dates, messages, doctor visits aur maange gaye paison ka private record rakhiye, aur ek bharosemand insaan ko bataiye.

actions.en: Read a fall in registered cases with care: fewer FIRs can mean fewer women reaching the police, not less cruelty.
actions.hg: Registered cases ghatein toh dhyan se padhiye: kam FIR ka matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki kam women police tak pahunch rahi hain, yeh nahi ki cruelty kam hui.

actions.en: Know the civil route too: under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005 a court can order protection, residence and maintenance.
actions.hg: Civil raasta bhi jaaniye: Domestic Violence Act, 2005 ke under court protection, residence aur maintenance ka order de sakti hai.

actions.en: In danger, call 112. For advice and referrals, call the Women Helpline on 181.
actions.hg: Khatra ho toh 112 par call karein. Advice aur referral ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call karein.

title.en: Why a cruelty complaint can wait 14 days for an FIR when a rape complaint cannot: the BNSS gap every wife should know
title.hg: Cruelty complaint pe FIR 14 din ruk sakti hai, rape complaint pe nahi: BNSS ka woh gap jo har wife ko pata hona chahiye

dek.en: Since July 2024, police may hold a 'preliminary enquiry' of up to two weeks before registering a complaint of cruelty by a husband or his family. What the law allows, what it does not, and how to use those 14 days.
dek.hg: July 2024 se police, husband ya uski family ki cruelty ki complaint pe FIR register karne se pehle, do hafte tak ki 'preliminary enquiry' kar sakti hai. Law kya allow karta hai, kya nahi, aur un 14 dinon ka istemaal kaise karein.

statLabel.en: preliminary enquiry police may hold before registering a cruelty complaint
statLabel.hg: preliminary enquiry, jo police cruelty ki complaint register karne se pehle kar sakti hai

label.en: the longest preliminary enquiry police may hold, with a Deputy Superintendent's prior permission, before registering a cruelty FIR
label.hg: sabse lambi preliminary enquiry jo police, Deputy Superintendent ki pehle se permission lekar, cruelty FIR register karne se pehle kar sakti hai

label.en: cruelty cases registered in 2024, the largest single category of crimes against women
label.hg: cruelty cases 2024 mein register hue, women ke khilaaf crimes ki sabse badi category

label.en: in prison for an officer who fails to record a rape or acid-attack complaint; cruelty is not on that list
label.hg: jail us officer ke liye jo rape ya acid attack ki complaint record na kare; cruelty is list mein nahi hai

claim.en: A cruelty complaint is a 'family matter', so police can sit on it for as long as they like.
claim.hg: Cruelty ki complaint 'family matter' hai, isliye police jitna chahe utna time use daba ke baith sakti hai.

truth.en: Police may delay the FIR only through a preliminary enquiry, with prior permission from an officer of at least Deputy Superintendent rank, and for no more than 14 days.
truth.hg: Police FIR mein der sirf preliminary enquiry ke zariye kar sakti hai, woh bhi kam se kam Deputy Superintendent rank ke officer ki pehle se permission se, aur 14 din se zyada nahi.

actions.en: Hand in a written, signed complaint and keep a copy stamped by the station.
actions.hg: Likhi hui, sign ki hui complaint dijiye aur station ki stamp wali copy apne paas rakhiye.

actions.en: If police say 'we will enquire first', ask which Deputy Superintendent approved it, on what date, and when the 14 days end. Write the answers down.
actions.hg: Agar police kahe 'pehle enquiry karenge', toh poochiye kis Deputy Superintendent ne approve kiya, kis date ko, aur 14 din kab khatam honge. Jawab likh lijiye.

actions.en: When the 14 days are up, go back or write to the station and ask for the FIR.
actions.hg: 14 din poore hote hi station waapas jaiye ya likh kar FIR maangiye.

actions.en: Keep a dated record of every incident, threat and money demand, with messages, bank transfers and medical papers, where he cannot reach it.
actions.hg: Har incident, dhamki aur paise ki demand ka date ke saath record rakhiye, messages, bank transfers aur medical papers ke saath, aisi jagah jahan uska haath na pahunche.

actions.en: In danger, call 112. A protection order under the Domestic Violence Act does not wait for the FIR.
actions.hg: Khatra ho toh 112 pe call kijiye. Domestic Violence Act ka protection order FIR ka intezaar nahi karta.

title.en: Beaten at home by the people meant to care: disabled women, forced abortions and Section 92 of the 2016 disability law
title.hg: Jinhe dekhbhaal karni thi, unhi ke haathon ghar mein maar: disabled women, zabardasti abortion aur 2016 ke disability law ka Section 92

dek.en: When the person who feeds, lifts or speaks for a disabled woman is the one hurting her, the violence stays inside the house. The 2016 disability law names crimes written for that house; in 2024 police registered 56 cases under the entire Act.
dek.hg: Jab disabled woman ko khana khilane, uthane ya uski taraf se bolne wala hi use chot pahunchata hai, toh violence ghar ke andar hi reh jaati hai. 2016 ka disability law usi ghar ke liye likhe gaye crimes ka naam leta hai; 2024 mein police ne poore Act ke under sirf 56 cases register kiye.

label.en: cases registered under the entire Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act in 2024, for all offences
label.hg: cases 2024 mein poore Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act ke under register hue, saare offences milakar

label.en: in prison for sexually exploiting a disabled woman from a position of control, or ending her pregnancy without her express consent (Section 92)
label.hg: jail, control ki position se disabled woman ka sexual exploitation karne ya uski express consent ke bina uski pregnancy khatam karwane pe (Section 92)

label.en: of India's population counted as disabled in Census 2011, against a WHO-World Bank global estimate of 15%
label.hg: India ki population Census 2011 mein disabled gini gayi, jabki WHO-World Bank ka global estimate 15% hai

claim.en: A disabled woman is safest with her own family.
claim.hg: Disabled woman apni family ke saath hi sabse safe hai.

truth.en: Care can also be control. A 2004 Odisha survey found that nearly all the disabled women and girls it reached had been beaten at home, and the law now names abuses committed inside families as crimes.
truth.hg: Dekhbhaal control bhi ban sakti hai. 2004 ke ek Odisha survey mein lagbhag sabhi surveyed disabled women aur ladkiyon ko ghar mein maara-peeta gaya tha, aur law ab family ke andar hone wale aise abuse ko crime ka naam deta hai.

actions.en: When you visit a disabled woman, speak to her directly, in her language or in sign, and if you can, away from the person who controls her care.
actions.hg: Kisi disabled woman se milne jaayein toh usse seedhe baat kijiye, uski bhasha ya sign mein, aur ho sake toh us insaan se door jo uski care control karta hai.

actions.en: You do not have to be family to report abuse: anyone can tell the police, and in an emergency anyone can call 112.
actions.hg: Abuse report karne ke liye family hona zaroori nahi: koi bhi police ko bata sakta hai, aur emergency mein koi bhi 112 pe call kar sakta hai.

actions.en: Remind police that under Section 179 BNSS she cannot be made to come to the station, and that a sexual-offence complaint can be recorded at a place she chooses.
actions.hg: Police ko yaad dilaiye ki Section 179 BNSS ke under use station aane pe majboor nahi kiya ja sakta, aur sexual offence ki complaint uski chuni hui jagah pe record ho sakti hai.

actions.en: Make sure any decision about her pregnancy is hers: ending it without her express consent is a crime under Section 92(f).
actions.hg: Pakka kijiye ki uski pregnancy ka har faisla uska apna ho: uski express consent ke bina pregnancy khatam karwana Section 92(f) ke under crime hai.

actions.en: For a protection order under the Domestic Violence Act, or for free legal aid, contact a Protection Officer, a One Stop Centre or the District Legal Services Authority.
actions.hg: Domestic Violence Act ke under protection order ya free legal aid ke liye Protection Officer, One Stop Centre ya District Legal Services Authority se sampark kijiye.

title.en: 616 criminal cases in 2024, 496 of them in Kerala: what the 2005 Domestic Violence Act is really used for
title.hg: 2024 mein 616 criminal cases, unme se 496 Kerala mein: 2005 ka Domestic Violence Act asal mein kis kaam aata hai

dek.en: The Domestic Violence Act protects women through a magistrate's orders, not arrests. That is why it barely shows up in crime data, why one state registers most of its cases, and why it cannot stand in for a law on marital rape.
dek.hg: Domestic Violence Act auraton ko arrest se nahi, magistrate ke orders se protection deta hai. Isiliye crime data mein woh mushkil se dikhta hai, isiliye uske zyada tar cases ek hi state se aate hain, aur isiliye woh marital rape ke law ki jagah nahi le sakta.

statLabel.en: of India's 616 Domestic Violence Act criminal cases in 2024 were registered in Kerala
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein India ke 616 Domestic Violence Act criminal cases mein se itne Kerala mein darj hue

label.en: criminal cases registered under the Domestic Violence Act across India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein poore India mein Domestic Violence Act ke under darj criminal cases

label.en: cases of cruelty by a husband or his relatives registered in the same year
label.hg: usi saal pati ya uske rishtedaron ki cruelty ke darj cases

label.en: of the Act's 4,017 criminal cases in court were still pending at the end of 2024
label.hg: 2024 ke end mein Act ke 4,017 criminal court cases mein se itne pending the

label.en: the longest prison term for breaking a protection order, the Act's main offence
label.hg: protection order todne par maximum jail, jo Act ka main offence hai

claim.en: Wives don't need a marital rape law: the Domestic Violence Act already protects them.
claim.hg: Biwiyon ko marital rape law ki zaroorat nahi: Domestic Violence Act pehle se unhe protection deta hai.

truth.en: The Act lets a magistrate order the abuse to stop and keep a woman in her home. It does not make forced sex by a husband a crime; its main offence is breaking a court order, with at most a year in prison.
truth.hg: Act magistrate ko abuse rukwane aur aurat ko uske ghar mein rakhne ka order dene deta hai. Woh pati ke zabardasti sex ko crime nahi banata; uska main offence court ka order todna hai, jisme zyada se zyada ek saal ki jail hai.

actions.en: If you are being abused at home, you can ask a magistrate for protection, residence and maintenance orders under the 2005 Act.
actions.hg: Agar ghar mein aapke saath abuse ho raha hai, toh aap 2005 ke Act ke under magistrate se protection, residence aur maintenance orders maang sakti ho.

actions.en: Start through a Protection Officer, a One Stop Centre or the Women Helpline 181, and ask your District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer.
actions.hg: Shuruaat Protection Officer, One Stop Centre ya Women Helpline 181 se karo, aur apni District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer maango.

actions.en: Once you have an order, report every breach to the police: breaking it is a crime under Section 31 of the Act.
actions.hg: Order milne ke baad uske har ullanghan ki report police ko karo: use todna Act ke Section 31 ke under crime hai.

actions.en: If a husband or his relatives are treating you with cruelty, you can also go to the police: it is an offence under Section 85 BNS, with up to three years in prison.
actions.hg: Agar pati ya uske rishtedaar aapke saath cruelty kar rahe hain, toh aap police ke paas bhi ja sakti ho: yeh Section 85 BNS ke under offence hai, jisme teen saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai.

actions.en: When someone says the Domestic Violence Act already covers marital rape, point out that its main offence is breaking a court order, not forced sex.
actions.hg: Jab koi kahe ki Domestic Violence Act marital rape ko pehle se cover karta hai, toh batao ki uska main offence court order todna hai, zabardasti sex nahi.

title.en: 'That happens in villages, not in our society': NFHS-6 finds 17.5% of ever-married urban women faced violence by a husband
title.hg: 'Yeh sab gaon mein hota hai, hamare yahan nahi': NFHS-6 mein shehron ki 17.5% married women ne pati ki violence jheli

dek.en: The newest national survey finds violence by husbands less common in cities than in villages, but far from rare, and police data rank Delhi second in India for cruelty cases per lakh women. Why city violence stays quiet, and why a flat, an office or a housing-society group needs the same watchfulness as any village.
dek.hg: Naya national survey batata hai ki shehron mein pati ki violence gaon se kam hai, par 'kam' ka matlab 'nahi' nahi hota, aur police data mein har ek lakh auraton par cruelty cases ke rate mein Delhi poore India mein doosre number par hai. Shehar mein yeh violence chup kyun rehti hai, aur flat, office aur housing society group ko bhi gaon jitni nazar kyun rakhni chahiye.

statLabel.en: of ever-married women in urban India reported physical or sexual violence by a husband (NFHS-6, 2023-24)
statLabel.hg: shehron ki married women ne pati ki physical ya sexual violence ki baat batayi (NFHS-6, 2023-24)

label.en: of ever-married urban women aged 18-49 had ever faced physical or sexual violence by a husband (NFHS-6, 2023-24, provisional)
label.hg: 18-49 saal ki shehri married women ne kabhi na kabhi pati se physical ya sexual violence jheli (NFHS-6, 2023-24, provisional)

label.en: the same measure for rural women: higher, but the gap is between bad and bad
label.hg: gaon ki auraton mein yahi measure: zyada hai, par farq bure aur bure ke beech ka hai

label.en: cruelty-by-husband cases registered per lakh women in Delhi in 2024, second only to Telangana
label.hg: 2024 mein Delhi mein har ek lakh auraton par pati ya rishtedaron ki cruelty ke itne cases darj hue, sirf Telangana se kam

label.en: crimes against women registered in 2024 in India's 19 metropolitan cities (more than 20 lakh people at the 2011 Census)
label.hg: 2024 mein India ke 19 metropolitan cities (2011 Census mein 20 lakh se zyada aabadi wale) mein auraton ke khilaaf itne crimes darj hue

claim.en: Wife-beating is a village problem. It does not happen in cities, or in families like ours.
claim.hg: Biwi ko peetna gaon ki baat hai. Shehron mein, ya hamare jaisi families mein, aisa nahi hota.

truth.en: More than one in six ever-married women in urban India told NFHS-6 that a husband had been physically or sexually violent. Villages report more, but city homes are not immune. The violence there is quieter.
truth.hg: NFHS-6 mein shehron ki chhe mein se ek se zyada married women ne bataya ki pati ne unke saath physical ya sexual violence ki. Gaon mein yeh number zyada hai, par shehar ke ghar isse bache hue nahi hain. Bas wahan aawaz kam aati hai.

actions.en: Stop saying 'not in our society'. If a woman tells you her husband hurts her, believe her, whatever her address, degree or salary.
actions.hg: 'Hamare yahan aisa nahi hota' bolna band kijiye. Koi aurat bataye ki pati use hurt karta hai, toh us par bharosa kijiye, chahe uska address, degree ya salary kuch bhi ho.

actions.en: If you hear someone being hurt in a neighbouring flat, call 112. You do not have to be family to ask for help.
actions.hg: Padosi ke flat se kisi ko hurt kiye jaane ki aawaz aaye, toh 112 call kijiye. Madad maangne ke liye family hona zaroori nahi.

actions.en: Put 112 (emergency) and 181 (Women Helpline) on your housing society's notice board and in its WhatsApp group, next to the plumber's number.
actions.hg: Apni society ke notice board aur WhatsApp group mein 112 (emergency) aur 181 (Women Helpline) daaliye, plumber ke number ke bilkul bagal mein.

actions.en: Find out where your district's One Stop Centre (Sakhi) is, so you know where to send a friend or colleague who needs help.
actions.hg: Pata kar lijiye ki aapke district ka One Stop Centre (Sakhi) kahan hai, taaki kisi dost ya colleague ko madad chahiye toh aap use sahi jagah bhej sakein.

title.en: Telangana registers 52.8 cruelty cases per lakh women, Bihar 3.0: reading India's map of domestic-violence silence
title.hg: Telangana mein har lakh auraton par cruelty ke 52.8 cases darj, Bihar mein sirf 3.0: domestic violence par chuppi ka India ka map

dek.en: Lay the newest survey of violence by husbands over the police register, state by state, and the gaps show where women are heard. Bihar, where married women report the most violence, registers very little of it as cruelty.
dek.hg: Pati ki violence par sabse naye survey ko police ke register ke bagal mein rakhiye, state by state. Farq se pata chalta hai ki kahan auraton ki baat suni jaati hai. Bihar, jahan married women sabse zyada violence ki baat batati hain, wahan isme se bahut kam hi cruelty case ke roop mein darj hota hai.

statLabel.en: cruelty-by-husband cases registered per lakh women in Bihar in 2024
statLabel.hg: Bihar mein 2024 mein har lakh auraton par darj hue pati ya sasural walon ki cruelty ke cases

label.en: of ever-married women in Bihar reported violence by a husband, the highest share in NFHS-6 (2023-24)
label.hg: Bihar ki married women ne pati ki violence ki baat batayi, jo NFHS-6 (2023-24) mein sabse zyada hai

label.en: cruelty cases registered per lakh women in Telangana in 2024, the highest of any state
label.hg: Telangana mein 2024 mein har lakh auraton par darj cruelty cases, kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada

label.en: dowry deaths registered in Bihar in 2024, second only to Uttar Pradesh
label.hg: Bihar mein 2024 mein darj dowry death cases, Uttar Pradesh ke baad sabse zyada

label.en: cruelty cases registered per lakh women in Tamil Nadu in 2024
label.hg: Tamil Nadu mein 2024 mein har lakh auraton par darj cruelty cases

claim.en: The state with the most domestic violence cases has the most violent homes.
claim.hg: Jis state mein domestic violence ke sabse zyada cases darj hain, wahin ke gharon mein sabse zyada violence hai.

truth.en: Police figures count complaints that became FIRs. NCRB itself warns that more registered crime does not mean a place is less safe. Bihar registered cruelty at 3.0 cases per lakh women against 17.6 nationally, yet it has the highest share of married women reporting violence in NFHS-6.
truth.hg: Police ke numbers woh complaints ginte hain jo FIR bani. NCRB khud kehta hai ki zyada darj crime ka matlab yeh nahi ki woh jagah kam safe hai. Bihar mein har lakh auraton par cruelty ke sirf 3.0 cases darj hue, jabki national rate 17.6 hai; phir bhi NFHS-6 mein sabse zyada married women ne violence ki baat wahin batayi.

actions.en: Look up your state's NFHS-6 spousal-violence figure and its NCRB cruelty rate, and put them side by side.
actions.hg: Apne state ka NFHS-6 wala spousal violence number aur NCRB wali cruelty rate dhoondhiye, aur dono ko saath rakh kar dekhiye.

actions.en: Read a high police count as a sign that complaints are being written down, not as proof that a state has the most violent homes.
actions.hg: Police ke zyada cases ko is baat ka sign maaniye ki complaints likhi ja rahi hain. Yeh saboot nahi ki wahan ke ghar sabse zyada violent hain.

actions.en: Remember that you can report a cognizable offence at any police station, wherever it happened (Zero FIR), and get a free copy of what is recorded. If the station refuses, write to the Superintendent of Police.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye, cognizable offence (yaani aisa crime jismein police bina warrant action le sakti hai) ki complaint aap kisi bhi police station mein kar sakte hain, chahe incident kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR), aur jo likha gaya uski copy aapko free milni chahiye. Agar station mana kare, toh Superintendent of Police ko likhiye.

actions.en: Ask your local representatives whether your police station's women help desk and your district's One Stop Centre are actually working.
actions.hg: Apne local representatives se poochhiye ki aapke police station ka women help desk aur aapke district ka One Stop Centre sach mein kaam kar raha hai ya nahi.

actions.en: Share 181 (Women Helpline) and 112 (emergency) with the women in your family and building.
actions.hg: 181 (Women Helpline) aur 112 (emergency) apni family aur building ki auraton ke saath share kijiye.

title.en: 512 cases in six months at shops, factories and homes: what the POSH Act promises a domestic worker harassed in her employer's house
title.hg: Shops, factories aur gharon mein chhe mahine mein 512 cases: employer ke ghar mein harassment jhelne wali domestic worker se POSH Act kya vaada karta hai

dek.en: Since 2013 Indian law has counted a house as a workplace. A domestic worker's complaint goes to a district committee that must pass a credible case to the police within seven days. Police data still cannot say how often that happens, and in 2025 the Supreme Court could not confirm that every district had such a committee.
dek.hg: 2013 se Indian law ghar ko bhi workplace maanta hai. Domestic worker ki complaint district ki ek committee ke paas jaati hai, jise thos case saat din ke andar police ko bhejna hota hai. Police data aaj bhi nahi bata sakta ki aisa kitni baar hota hai, aur 2025 mein Supreme Court bhi confirm nahi kar paaya ki har district mein aisi committee hai.

statLabel.en: sexual harassment cases police recorded at work premises such as shops, factories and homes, July-December 2024
statLabel.hg: sexual harassment cases jo police ne shops, factories aur gharon jaise work premises par record kiye, July-December 2024

label.en: sexual harassment cases at work premises such as shops, malls, factories and homes, July-December 2024 (NCRB)
label.hg: sexual harassment cases shops, malls, factories aur gharon jaise work premises par, July-December 2024 (NCRB)

label.en: of 270 women domestic workers surveyed in Delhi-NCR had faced sexual harassment in the previous two years (Jagori, 2024 survey)
label.hg: Delhi-NCR mein survey ki gayi 270 women domestic workers ne pichhle do saal mein sexual harassment jhela tha (Jagori, 2024 survey)

label.en: for a Local Committee to forward a domestic worker's complaint to the police once it finds a prima facie case
label.hg: jinke andar Local Committee ko prima facie case milne par domestic worker ki complaint police ko bhejni hoti hai

label.en: people rescued from trafficking in 2024 who had been trafficked for domestic servitude
label.hg: log jinhe 2024 mein trafficking se rescue kiya gaya aur jinhe domestic servitude ke liye traffic kiya gaya tha

claim.en: The POSH Act is for offices. A woman who works in someone's house is not covered.
claim.hg: POSH Act sirf offices ke liye hai. Kisi ke ghar mein kaam karne wali aurat ispe cover nahi hoti.

truth.en: The Act defines a workplace to include 'a dwelling place or a house' and protects a woman of any age employed there. Her complaint goes to the district's Local Committee, or straight to the police.
truth.hg: Act 'workplace' ki definition mein 'a dwelling place or a house' bhi shaamil karta hai, aur wahan kaam karne wali kisi bhi umr ki aurat ko protect karta hai. Uski complaint district ki Local Committee ke paas jaati hai, ya seedhe police ke paas.

actions.en: If you are harassed in a house where you work, write down the date, the time and what was said or done, and tell someone you trust the same day.
actions.hg: Jis ghar mein aap kaam karti hain, wahan harassment ho toh date, time aur jo kaha ya kiya gaya, sab likh lijiye, aur usi din kisi bharosemand insaan ko bataiye.

actions.en: Complain in writing to your district's Local Committee within three months. If it finds a prima facie case, it must send your complaint to the police within seven days.
actions.hg: Teen mahine ke andar apne district ki Local Committee ko likhit complaint dijiye. Prima facie case milne par committee ko saat din ke andar aapki complaint police ko bhejni hogi.

actions.en: You can also go straight to any police station: sexual harassment is a crime under Section 75 of the BNS. Call 181 (Women Helpline) for help, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Aap seedhe kisi bhi police station bhi ja sakti hain: BNS ke Section 75 ke tahat sexual harassment crime hai. Madad ke liye 181 (Women Helpline) par, aur emergency mein 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If you employ someone at home, your house is her workplace under the law. Make sure everyone who lives there knows that sexual remarks, touching or demands are a crime.
actions.hg: Agar aapne ghar par kisi ko kaam par rakha hai, toh law ki nazar mein aapka ghar uska workplace hai. Pakka kijiye ki ghar mein rehne wale har insaan ko pata ho ki sexual remarks, chhoona ya demands crime hain.

actions.en: If a domestic worker is not allowed to leave, is not paid, has had her documents taken or is under 18, call 112 or the Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar kisi domestic worker ko bahar jaane nahi diya jaata, paise nahi milte, uske documents le liye gaye hain ya woh 18 se kam umr ki hai, toh 112 ya Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

title.en: By law, every dowry death follows cruelty. India publishes no count of how many of 2024's 5,811 victims had already asked for help
title.hg: Law ke mutabik har dowry death se pehle cruelty hoti hai. Phir bhi India yeh count publish nahi karta ki 2024 ki 5,811 victims mein se kitni pehle hi madad maang chuki thin

dek.en: Section 80 BNS needs dowry cruelty 'soon before her death', so every case rests on a history. In France, South Africa and Colombia, 22-37% of women killed by partners had already reported the abuse. No comparable figure has been published for India. What a review of every death would look like, and who should run it.
dek.hg: Section 80 BNS ke liye 'maut se kuch hi pehle' dowry cruelty zaroori hai, yaani har case ek history par tika hota hai. France, South Africa aur Colombia mein partner ke haathon maari gayi 22-37% auratein pehle hi abuse report kar chuki thin. India ka aisa koi comparable figure publish nahi hua hai. Har maut ka review kaisa dikhega, aur use kaun chalaye.

statLabel.en: of women killed by partners in France, South Africa and Colombia had already reported the abuse
statLabel.hg: France, South Africa aur Colombia mein partner ke haathon maari gayi auraton mein se jo pehle hi abuse report kar chuki thin

label.en: dowry-death cases registered in India in 2024, with 5,811 victims
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein register hue dowry death cases, jinme 5,811 victims thin

label.en: cases of cruelty by a husband or his relatives registered in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty ke register hue cases

label.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali auraton mein se jinhone kabhi madad maangi (NFHS-5)

label.hg: madad maangne wali auraton mein se jo police ke paas gayin; 60.9% apni hi family ke paas gayin (NFHS-5)

claim.en: Dowry deaths come out of nowhere. Nobody could have seen them coming.
claim.hg: Dowry deaths achanak hoti hain. Koi pehle se andaza nahi laga sakta tha.

truth.en: In law there is no dowry death without earlier cruelty: Section 80 BNS requires proof of dowry-linked cruelty or harassment 'soon before her death'. Every case rests on a history.
truth.hg: Law mein pehle ki cruelty ke bina koi dowry death hoti hi nahi: Section 80 BNS ke liye 'maut se kuch hi pehle' dowry se judi cruelty ya harassment ka proof zaroori hai. Har case ek history par tika hota hai.

actions.en: If a daughter or sister tells you about dowry demands or violence, believe her, note the dates and offer her a way home.
actions.hg: Agar beti ya behen dowry demands ya violence ke baare mein bataye, toh uska yakeen kijiye, dates note kijiye aur use ghar wapas aane ka raasta dijiye.

actions.en: In danger, call 112. For advice, call the Women Helpline on 181 or go to a One Stop Centre.
actions.hg: Khatra ho toh 112 call kijiye. Salah ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye ya One Stop Centre jaiye.

actions.en: Keep copies of messages, medical papers and police receipts: they show the pattern that police and courts need.
actions.hg: Messages, medical papers aur police receipts ki copies rakhiye: inse woh pattern dikhta hai jo police aur courts ko chahiye.

actions.en: Ask your district administration whether anyone reviews dowry deaths for missed warnings, and who sees the findings.
actions.hg: Apne district administration se poochiye ki kya koi dowry deaths ka missed-warnings review karta hai, aur uske findings kaun dekhta hai.

actions.en: If you or someone you know is thinking about suicide, call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Agar aap ya aapka koi jaanne wala suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye.

title.en: Five years minimum, 17.4% convicted: India's dowry law is harsh on paper and weak in court
title.hg: Kam se kam 5 saal ki saza, par sirf 17.4% conviction: India ka dowry law kaagaz par sakht, court mein kamzor

dek.en: On paper, giving or taking dowry carries at least five years in prison. In 2024 police registered 12,343 cases under the 1961 Act, courts recorded 719 convictions, and 83,298 cases sat waiting for trial. How a severe law fell asleep.
dek.hg: Kaagaz par dowry dene ya lene ki saza kam se kam paanch saal jail hai. 2024 mein police ne 1961 ke Act ke under 12,343 cases register kiye, courts mein sirf 719 convictions hue, aur 83,298 cases trial ka intezaar kar rahe the. Ek sakht law aakhir so kaise gaya.

statLabel.hg: 2024 mein Dowry Prohibition Act ke decided trials mein conviction rate

label.hg: 2024 mein Dowry Prohibition Act ke under registered cases

label.en: Dowry Act cases pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: 2024 ke end mein Dowry Act ke pending cases

label.en: Dowry Act cases registered in West Bengal in 2024, a state that recorded 337 dowry deaths
label.hg: 2024 mein West Bengal mein Dowry Act ke cases, jabki wahan 337 dowry deaths darj hui

claim.en: Giving dowry is legal. Only demanding it is a crime.
claim.hg: Dowry dena toh legal hai. Sirf maangna crime hai.

truth.en: The 1961 Act punishes giving, taking and abetting dowry alike, with at least five years in prison and a fine.
truth.hg: 1961 ka Act dowry dena, lena aur usme madad karna, teeno ko barabar crime maanta hai: kam se kam paanch saal jail aur fine.

actions.en: Say no to dowry as a family, out loud, before the match is fixed, so the bride is never the only one refusing.
actions.hg: Rishta pakka hone se pehle hi poori family milkar, khulkar dowry ko na kahiye, taaki dulhan ko akele mana na karna pade.

actions.en: Keep every message, list and payment linked to a demand. A demand is an offence on its own, even if nothing is paid.
actions.hg: Demand se juda har message, list aur payment sambhaal kar rakhiye. Dowry maangna apne aap mein crime hai, chahe ek rupaya bhi na diya gaya ho.

actions.en: If someone is being harassed for dowry after the wedding, report it: call the Women Helpline on 181, or 112 in an emergency. A complaint can be filed at any police station (Zero FIR).
actions.hg: Agar shaadi ke baad kisi ko dowry ke liye pareshan kiya ja raha hai, toh report kijiye: Women Helpline 181 par, ya emergency mein 112 par call kijiye. Complaint kisi bhi police station mein ho sakti hai (Zero FIR).

actions.en: When a complaint is filed, ask police which sections were applied, and make sure the dowry demand is written into the FIR, not only the harassment.
actions.hg: Complaint darj ho toh police se poochhiye ki kaun se sections lage. Pakka kijiye ki FIR mein sirf harassment nahi, dowry demand bhi likhi jaye.

title.en: Is it dowry if they call it a gift? Ten legal questions about dowry, answered under the 1961 Act and the BNS
title.hg: Gift bolkar maanga toh kya woh dowry hai? Dowry ke dus legal sawaal, 1961 ke Act aur BNS ke hisaab se jawab

dek.en: Dowry is rarely called dowry. It arrives as 'gifts', 'expectations' and 'what everyone gives', before the wedding and long after it. Plain answers to the legal questions families actually ask.
dek.hg: Dowry ko shayad hi kabhi dowry kaha jaata hai. Woh 'gifts', 'expectations' aur 'sab dete hain' ban kar aati hai, shaadi se pehle bhi aur shaadi ke kaafi baad bhi. Families jo legal sawaal sach mein poochti hain, unke seedhe jawab.

statLabel.en: minimum prison term for giving or taking dowry under the 1961 Act
statLabel.hg: 1961 ke Act mein dowry dene ya lene par kam se kam itni jail

label.en: cases registered under the Dowry Prohibition Act in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein Dowry Prohibition Act ke under register hue cases

label.en: conviction rate in Dowry Act trials completed in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue Dowry Act trials mein conviction rate

label.en: dowry deaths recorded in 2024, about 16 a day
label.hg: 2024 mein darj dowry deaths, yaani roz lagbhag 16

claim.en: If the groom's side calls it a gift, it is not dowry.
claim.hg: Agar ladke wale use gift kehte hain, toh woh dowry nahi hai.

truth.en: The law looks at the demand, not the word. Demanding dowry is itself a crime, with 6 months to 2 years in prison, whatever the demand is called and even if nothing is ever paid.
truth.hg: Law demand ko dekhta hai, shabd ko nahi. Dowry maangna apne aap mein crime hai, jisme 6 mahine se 2 saal tak ki jail hai, demand ko chahe jo naam diya jaaye aur chahe kuch bhi diya na gaya ho.

actions.en: Say no to dowry as a family before the match is fixed, so the bride is never the only one refusing.
actions.hg: Rishta pakka hone se pehle poori family milkar dowry ko na boliye, taaki dulhan akeli na pade jo mana kar rahi ho.

actions.en: Write down every demand the day it is made: who asked, for what, and who heard it. Save messages and voice notes.
actions.hg: Har demand usi din likh lijiye: kisne maanga, kya maanga, aur kisne suna. Messages aur voice notes save rakhiye.

actions.en: Keep a written list of wedding presents, with each item, its rough value and who gave it, signed by the bride and the groom.
actions.hg: Shaadi ke presents ki likhit list rakhiye, har item, uski andaazan keemat aur dene wale ke naam ke saath, jis par dulhan aur dulhe dono ke sign hon.

actions.en: If harassment over money starts after the wedding, report it at any police station, call the Women Helpline on 181, or call 112 in danger.
actions.hg: Agar shaadi ke baad paison ke liye harassment shuru ho, toh kisi bhi police station mein report kijiye, Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, ya khatre mein 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: To stop a child marriage, call the Child Helpline on 1098.
actions.hg: Child marriage rokne ke liye Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

title.en: 779 fast-track courts for rape and POCSO, none in the scheme for cruelty or dowry deaths: the home crimes left in the slow lane
title.hg: Rape aur POCSO ke liye 779 fast-track courts, cruelty ya dowry deaths ke liye scheme mein ek bhi nahi: ghar ke crimes slow lane mein

dek.en: The Centre has just funded its fast-track courts until 2031. Cruelty, dowry deaths and acid attacks were never part of the scheme, and the court data show the cost: queues that would take more than a decade to clear at the 2024 pace.
dek.hg: Centre ne abhi-abhi apne fast-track courts ko 2031 tak ka paisa de diya hai. Cruelty, dowry deaths aur acid attacks is scheme ka hissa kabhi the hi nahi, aur court data iski keemat dikhata hai: aisi queues jinhe 2024 ki raftaar se khaali hone mein ek decade se zyada lagega.

statLabel.hg: cruelty cases 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending the

label.hg: cruelty-by-husband cases 2024 ke end mein pending the, courts ke saamne aaye aise cases ka 92.2%

label.hg: cruelty cases 2024 mein compromise pe khatam hue, jabki conviction pe 10,689 khatam hue

label.hg: Fast Track Special Courts November 2026 mein chal rahe the, sab ke sab rape aur POCSO cases ke liye

claim.en: Fast-track courts handle the worst crimes against women.
claim.hg: Fast-track courts women ke khilaaf sabse bure crimes sunte hain.

truth.en: The central fast-track scheme covers only rape and POCSO cases. Dowry deaths, cruelty and acid attacks wait in ordinary courts, where more than nine in ten such cases were still pending at the end of 2024.
truth.hg: Central fast-track scheme sirf rape aur POCSO cases cover karti hai. Dowry deaths, cruelty aur acid attacks aam courts mein wait karte hain, jahan 2024 ke end mein aise har das mein se nau se zyada cases pending the.

actions.en: If your cruelty or dowry case is in court, keep one file with the FIR, the chargesheet and every hearing date and order.
actions.hg: Agar aapka cruelty ya dowry case court mein hai, toh ek hi file mein FIR, chargesheet aur har hearing ki date aur order rakhiye.

actions.en: Before you agree to any compromise, get free legal advice from your District Legal Services Authority.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi compromise pe haan kehne se pehle apni District Legal Services Authority se free legal advice lijiye.

actions.en: While the trial waits, ask a magistrate for protection, residence or maintenance orders under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act.
actions.hg: Jab tak trial wait kar raha hai, magistrate se 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act ke under protection, residence ya maintenance orders maangiye.

actions.en: If you survived an acid attack, claim interim compensation from the District Legal Services Authority; it does not wait for the verdict.
actions.hg: Agar aap acid attack survivor hain, toh District Legal Services Authority se interim compensation claim kijiye; yeh verdict ka wait nahi karta.

actions.en: Ask your MP and MLA why the fast-track scheme leaves out dowry deaths, cruelty and acid attacks.
actions.hg: Apne MP aur MLA se poochhiye ki fast-track scheme dowry deaths, cruelty aur acid attacks ko bahar kyun rakhti hai.

title.en: Money as a leash: the salary she never sees, dowry demands that never end, and the laws that reach them
title.hg: Paise ki lagaam: woh salary jo use kabhi dikhti nahi, dowry ki demands jo kabhi khatam nahi hoti, aur woh laws jo inhe pakadte hain

dek.en: A wife whose salary card stays with her husband, whose parents are still paying years after the wedding, or who has to ask for bus fare is facing economic abuse. How to recognise it early, and which law fits which situation.
dek.hg: Jis biwi ka salary card pati ke paas rehta hai, jiske maa-baap shaadi ke saalon baad bhi paise de rahe hain, ya jise bus ke kiraye ke liye bhi haath phailana padta hai, woh economic abuse jhel rahi hai. Ise jaldi kaise pehchanein, aur kis situation mein kaunsa law lagta hai.

statLabel.hg: employed rural auraton mein se itni ke paas July-September 2025 mein regular wage ya salaried job thi

label.hg: employed rural auratein household enterprises mein helpers thi (July-September 2025)

label.hg: 2024 mein Dowry Prohibition Act ke under register hue cases

claim.en: If a husband controls the household money, that is just how marriage works.
claim.hg: Agar pati ghar ka paisa control karta hai, toh shaadi mein yeh normal baat hai.

truth.en: Taking a wife's salary, jewellery or stridhan, or keeping her without money she is entitled to, is economic abuse under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005.
truth.hg: Biwi ki salary, gehne ya stridhan le lena, ya use us paise ke bina rakhna jiski woh haqdaar hai, Domestic Violence Act, 2005 ke under economic abuse hai.

actions.en: Keep at least one bank account in your own name only, linked to your own phone number, with your own card and PIN.
actions.hg: Kam se kam ek bank account sirf apne naam par rakhiye, apne phone number se linked, aur apna card aur PIN apne paas rakhiye.

actions.en: List your stridhan and jewellery with photos and receipts, and note who holds each item.
actions.hg: Apne stridhan aur gehno ki list photos aur receipts ke saath banaiye, aur likhiye ki kaunsi cheez kiske paas hai.

actions.en: Save every demand for money, a car or 'help' from your parents: messages, call logs and bank transfers, with dates.
actions.hg: Paise, car ya maa-baap se 'help' ki har demand save kijiye: messages, call logs aur bank transfers, dates ke saath.

actions.en: Do not sign loan, property or bank papers you have not read, and keep a copy of anything you sign.
actions.hg: Bina padhe koi loan, property ya bank ka kaagaz sign mat kijiye, aur jo bhi sign karein uski copy rakhiye.

actions.en: For free legal advice, contact your District Legal Services Authority, or call the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Free legal advice ke liye apni District Legal Services Authority se contact kijiye, ya Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye.

title.en: 'Your marriage is fixed, you have no say': what an adult forced into marriage by family can do under Indian law
title.hg: 'Tumhari shaadi fix ho gayi hai, tumhari koi marzi nahi': family zabardasti shaadi karwaye toh ek adult ke paas Indian law mein kya raaste hain

dek.en: Arranged marriage is legal. A marriage forced on an adult is not. What the Supreme Court said in 2018, what changes under 18 or 21, who to call, and how to leave home safely.
dek.hg: Arranged marriage legal hai. Kisi adult par thopi gayi shaadi nahi. 2018 mein Supreme Court ne kya kaha, 18 ya 21 se kam umar par kya badalta hai, kise call karein, aur ghar se safely kaise niklein.

statLabel.en: people rescued in 2024 after being trafficked for forced marriage
statLabel.hg: log 2024 mein rescue kiye gaye jinhe zabardasti shaadi ke liye traffic kiya gaya tha

label.en: people rescued in 2024 after being trafficked for forced marriage, out of 5,839 trafficking victims rescued
label.hg: log 2024 mein rescue hue jinhe forced marriage ke liye traffic kiya gaya tha; us saal kul 5,839 trafficking victims rescue hue

label.en: minimum legal age of marriage for a woman and for a man
label.hg: aurat aur aadmi ke liye shaadi ki kam se kam legal umar

label.en: One Stop Centres for women operating across India in July 2026
label.hg: auraton ke liye One Stop Centres jo July 2026 mein poore India mein chal rahe the

claim.en: Once the family has fixed a marriage, an adult son or daughter has no legal right to refuse.
claim.hg: Ek baar family ne shaadi fix kar di, toh adult bete ya beti ko mana karne ka koi legal haq nahi hai.

truth.en: The Supreme Court held in 2018 that the right to choose a life partner is a facet of individual liberty. A choice that is yours to make includes the right to say no to a partner chosen for you.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ne 2018 mein kaha ki life partner chunne ka haq individual liberty ka hissa hai. Jo choice aapki hai, usme aapke liye chune gaye partner ko na kehne ka haq bhi shaamil hai.

actions.en: If you are being locked in, threatened or taken somewhere against your will, call 112. Women can also call the Women Helpline on 181.
actions.hg: Agar aapko band karke rakha ja raha hai, dhamkaya ja raha hai ya aapki marzi ke khilaaf kahin le jaya ja raha hai, toh 112 call kijiye. Auratein Women Helpline 181 par bhi call kar sakti hain.

actions.en: If the bride is under 18 or the groom under 21, call 1098 or 112 before the wedding date: a magistrate can stop it.
actions.hg: Agar dulhan 18 se kam ya dulha 21 se kam umar ka hai, toh shaadi ki date se pehle 1098 ya 112 call kijiye: magistrate shaadi rok sakta hai.

actions.en: Report at any police station as a Zero FIR, or file an e-FIR, and ask for your free copy.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein Zero FIR ya online e-FIR file kijiye, aur FIR ki free copy maangiye.

actions.en: Keep your ID, certificates, phone and some money within reach, with photos of your documents saved where your family cannot open them.
actions.hg: Apna ID, certificates, phone aur kuch paise apni pahunch mein rakhiye, aur documents ki photos aisi jagah save kijiye jahan family na khol sake.

actions.en: Ask the National Legal Services Authority or your district legal services authority for a free lawyer, and ask about a protection order under the Domestic Violence Act.
actions.hg: Free lawyer ke liye National Legal Services Authority ya apni district legal services authority se sampark kijiye, aur Domestic Violence Act ke protection order ke baare mein poochiye.

title.en: Fourth leading cause of ill health among women worldwide: the bodily and economic bill of violence at home, by the numbers
title.hg: Duniya bhar mein auraton ki kharaab sehat ki chauthi sabse badi wajah: ghar ki hinsa ka shareer aur jeb par bill, numbers mein

dek.en: Families call it a private matter. Global health estimates, India's own surveys and WHO's costings describe a public health problem with a bill to match. The key numbers on what violence at home does to women's bodies, minds and money, and what each one hides.
dek.hg: Families ise ghar ka maamla kehti hain. Global health estimates, India ke apne surveys aur WHO ka hisaab-kitaab ise ek public health problem batate hain, jiska bill bhi utna hi bada hai. Ghar ki hinsa auraton ke shareer, mann aur paise ke saath kya karti hai, uske key numbers, aur har number kya chhupata hai.

statLabel.en: of poor health among women worldwide is partner violence (Global Burden of Disease, 2025)
statLabel.hg: partner violence duniya bhar mein auraton ki kharaab sehat ki chauthi sabse badi wajah hai (Global Burden of Disease, 2025)

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence from a husband were injured (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: un auraton mein se jinhone pati ki physical ya sexual violence jheli, chot khayi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of those women reported severe burns; 6% had deep wounds, broken bones or broken teeth
label.hg: un auraton ne jalne ki gambhir chot batayi; 6% ko gehre ghaav, tooti haddiyan ya toote daant mile

label.hg: GDP ka: WHO ke mutabik kuch deshon mein auraton ke khilaf hinsa ki keemat

label.hg: hinsa ke baad madad maangne wali auraton mein se doctor ya medical staff ke paas gayi (NFHS-5)

claim.en: Violence at home is a private family matter.
claim.hg: Ghar ki hinsa family ka private maamla hai.

truth.en: It is a public health problem. Global Burden of Disease estimates cited by WHO rank partner violence as the fourth leading cause of poor health among women worldwide, and its costs reach hospitals, courts and the economy.
truth.hg: Yeh public health problem hai. WHO jin Global Burden of Disease estimates ko quote karta hai, unke mutabik partner violence duniya bhar mein auraton ki kharaab sehat ki chauthi sabse badi wajah hai, aur iski keemat hospitals, courts aur economy tak pahunchti hai.

actions.en: If you are hurt at home, tell the doctor how it happened and ask for your injuries to be written down; keep a copy where the abuser cannot reach it.
actions.hg: Agar ghar mein aapko chot lagi hai, toh doctor ko bataiye ki kaise lagi aur chot ko record mein likhwaiye; uski copy aisi jagah rakhiye jahan abuser na pahunch sake.

actions.en: If you are a doctor, nurse or ASHA worker, ask about violence in private, believe what you hear, and know where your nearest One Stop Centre is.
actions.hg: Agar aap doctor, nurse ya ASHA worker hain, toh hinsa ke baare mein akele mein poochiye, jo sunein us par yakeen kijiye, aur jaaniye ki sabse paas ka One Stop Centre kahan hai.

actions.en: Offer to go with a friend or relative to the doctor if she is afraid to go alone.
actions.hg: Agar aapki dost ya rishtedar akele doctor ke paas jaane se darti hai, toh uske saath chalne ki offer kijiye.

actions.en: For low mood, panic or thoughts of suicide, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Udaasi, ghabrahat ya suicide ke khayalon ke liye Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye, free aur din-raat.

actions.en: In an emergency, call 112; for advice and referral, call the Women Helpline on 181.
actions.hg: Emergency mein 112 par call kijiye; salah aur referral ke liye Women Helpline 181 par.

title.en: 5,737 dowry deaths, 616 Domestic Violence Act cases: India's home crimes of 2024, ranked by how well they are counted
title.hg: 5,737 dowry deaths, Domestic Violence Act ke 616 cases: 2024 mein India ke ghar ke crimes, is hisaab se rank kiye ki unki ginti kitni theek hai

dek.en: Line up India's numbers on violence at home and a pattern appears: the state counts deaths and dowry far better than everyday abuse. Ten figures, what each one measures, and which are only a floor.
dek.hg: Ghar ki violence par India ke numbers ek line mein rakhiye, toh ek pattern dikhta hai: state maut aur dowry ko roz ke abuse se kahin behtar ginta hai. Das figures, har ek kya naapta hai, aur kaunse sirf ek floor hain.

statLabel.hg: 2024 mein poore India mein 'honour killing' motive ke saath record hue murders
