label.hg: kabhi bhi married rahi auraton ne pati ki physical, sexual ya emotional violence jheli thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: cases of cruelty by a husband or his relatives registered by police in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein police ne pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty ke itne cases register kiye

label.en: dowry deaths registered in 2024, about 16 a day
label.hg: 2024 mein register hui dowry deaths, yaani roz lagbhag 16

label.en: criminal cases under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act in 2024, 496 of them in Kerala
label.hg: 2024 mein 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act ke under criminal cases, jinme se 496 Kerala mein

claim.en: If domestic violence were really common, police records would show it.
claim.hg: Agar domestic violence sach mein itni common hoti, toh police records mein dikhti.

truth.en: In NFHS-5, 77.2% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone. Police data counts the few who reach a station, filtered by how each state registers cases.
truth.hg: NFHS-5 mein physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki 77.2% auraton ne na kabhi madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya. Police data sirf un kuch auraton ko ginta hai jo thane tak pahunchti hain, aur woh bhi is par nirbhar hai ki har state cases kaise register karta hai.

actions.en: Before you quote a number on violence at home, check whether it comes from a survey of women or from police records, and for which year.
actions.hg: Ghar ki violence par koi number quote karne se pehle check kijiye ki woh auraton ke survey se aaya hai ya police records se, aur kis saal ka hai.

actions.en: Read police counts as a floor: a low number can mean a state that does not register cases, not a state without violence.
actions.hg: Police counts ko ek floor samjhiye: kam number ka matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki state cases register nahi karta, yeh nahi ki wahan violence nahi hai.

actions.en: If you face violence at home, you can apply to a magistrate for a protection order under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act without first filing a police case.
actions.hg: Agar aap ghar par violence jhel rahi hain, toh 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act ke under protection order ke liye seedhe magistrate ke paas apply kar sakti hain, pehle police case file kiye bina.

actions.en: Keep a record of every dowry demand and every injury: dated messages, bank transfers, medical slips and the names of people you told.
actions.hg: Har dowry demand aur har chot ka record rakhiye: date wale messages, bank transfers, medical slips, aur un logon ke naam jinhe aapne bataya.

actions.en: If you or someone you know is thinking about suicide, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar aap ya aapka koi jaanne wala suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye; yeh free hai aur din-raat chalta hai.

title.en: From the 1961 dowry ban to the December 2026 marital rape hearing: 65 years of Indian law at the door of the home
title.hg: 1961 ke dowry ban se December 2026 ki marital rape hearing tak: ghar ki dehleez par Indian law ke 65 saal

dek.en: Indian law entered the home in stages: a dowry ban in 1961, a civil law against domestic violence in 2005, acid attack named as a crime in 2013, the right to choose a partner in 2018. Each step left a gap the data still shows. One gap was never closed, and it reaches the Supreme Court in December 2026.
dek.hg: Indian law ghar ke andar kadam-ba-kadam pahuncha: 1961 mein dowry ban, 2005 mein domestic violence ke khilaaf ek civil law, 2013 mein acid attack ek naamit crime bana, aur 2018 mein partner chunne ka haq mila. Har kadam ek gap chhod gaya jo data mein aaj bhi dikhta hai. Ek gap kabhi band nahi hua, aur woh December 2026 mein Supreme Court pahunch raha hai.

label.en: cases under the 1961 Dowry Prohibition Act in 2024; 17.4% of the trials courts decided ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein 1961 ke Dowry Prohibition Act ke tahat cases; courts ne jin trials ka faisla kiya, unmein se sirf 17.4% mein conviction hua

label.en: criminal cases under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act in 2024, 496 of them in Kerala
label.hg: 2024 mein 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act ke tahat criminal cases, jinmein se 496 Kerala se the

label.en: acid attacks registered in 2024, 11 years after the Supreme Court regulated acid sales
label.hg: acid attacks 2024 mein register hue, Supreme Court ke acid ki bikri regulate karne ke 11 saal baad

label.en: murders police recorded with 'honour killing' as the motive in 2024
label.hg: murders jinmein police ne 2024 mein motive 'honour killing' darj kiya

actions.en: Facing violence at home? You can ask a magistrate for a protection order under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act. Call 181 (Women Helpline) for help, or 112 in danger.
actions.hg: Ghar mein violence jhel rahi hain? 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act ke tahat aap magistrate se protection order maang sakti hain. Madad ke liye 181 (Women Helpline) par, aur khatre mein 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If dowry is demanded before or after a wedding, note who asked, when and for what. Demanding dowry is itself a crime under the 1961 Act.
actions.hg: Agar shaadi se pehle ya baad dowry maangi jaaye, toh note kijiye kisne maangi, kab aur kya maanga. 1961 ke Act ke tahat dowry maangna apne aap mein crime hai.

actions.en: If you see acid sold without a register or an ID check, report the shop to the police.
actions.hg: Agar aap dekhein ki bina register ya ID check ke acid bik raha hai, toh us dukaan ki report police ko kijiye.

actions.en: If a couple is threatened by family for choosing each other, call 112. Since 2018 the Supreme Court has ordered states to protect such couples.
actions.hg: Agar kisi couple ko ek-doosre ko chunne ki wajah se family dhamki de rahi hai, toh 112 par call kijiye. 2018 se Supreme Court ne states ko aise couples ki hifaazat ka order diya hua hai.

actions.en: Follow the Supreme Court's marital rape hearing, which the court said it would hold on 9 or 10 December 2026, and read what it decides.
actions.hg: Supreme Court ki marital rape hearing follow kijiye, jo court ke mutabik 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko hogi, aur padhiye ki court kya faisla deta hai.

title.en: NCRB recorded no honour killings in Tamil Nadu from 2020 to 2023. The Madras High Court says there were 59 in a decade
title.hg: NCRB ke records mein 2020 se 2023 tak Tamil Nadu mein ek bhi honour killing nahi. Madras High Court kehta hai das saal mein 59 hui

dek.en: Tamil Nadu's police data show one honour killing in five years. A High Court judge put the state's toll at 59 over ten. Here is how a killing slips out of the 'honour' column, who has reasons to keep it out, and what an honest count would take.
dek.hg: Tamil Nadu ka police data paanch saal mein sirf ek honour killing dikhata hai. High Court ke ek judge ne state ka das saal ka aankda 59 bataya. Ek killing 'honour' column se kaise bahar reh jaati hai, kisko use bahar rakhne ki wajah milti hai, aur ek imaandaar ginti ke liye kya chahiye.

statLabel.en: honour killings in Tamil Nadu over ten years, according to the Madras High Court (2026)
statLabel.hg: Madras High Court (2026) ke mutabik das saal mein Tamil Nadu mein hui honour killings

label.en: honour killings in Tamil Nadu over ten years, as observed by the Madras High Court in June 2026
label.hg: Madras High Court ne June 2026 mein kaha ki das saal mein Tamil Nadu mein itni honour killings hui

label.en: honour killing recorded in Tamil Nadu in five years of NCRB data: none from 2020 to 2023, one in 2024
label.hg: NCRB ke paanch saal ke data mein Tamil Nadu ki honour killings: 2020 se 2023 tak ek bhi nahi, 2024 mein ek

label.en: murders recorded with 'honour killing' as the motive in all of India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein poore India mein 'honour killing' motive ke saath darj murders

label.en: murders recorded with 'love affairs' as the motive in India in the same year
label.hg: usi saal India mein 'love affairs' motive ke saath darj murders

claim.en: Honour killings are rare now: police recorded only 36 in all of India in 2024.
claim.hg: Ab honour killings rare hain: 2024 mein poore India mein police ne sirf 36 darj kin.

truth.en: 36 is the number of murders police labelled 'honour killing'. With no separate offence in the penal code, a killing can be filed under another motive or charged as a lesser crime. Tamil Nadu's tables show one in five years; its High Court speaks of 59 in ten.
truth.hg: 36 woh murders hain jin par police ne 'honour killing' ka label lagaya. Penal code mein iska alag offence hi nahi hai, isliye killing kisi aur motive mein darj ho sakti hai ya halke charge mein chalayi ja sakti hai. Tamil Nadu ki tables paanch saal mein ek dikhati hain; uska High Court das saal mein 59 ki baat karta hai.

actions.en: If a couple you know is being threatened by family over who they love or marry, treat it as an emergency: call 112 or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Agar aapke jaan-pehchaan ka koi couple apni pasand se pyaar ya shaadi karne par family se dhamkiyan jhel raha hai, toh ise emergency samjho: 112 ya Women Helpline 181 par call karo.

actions.en: Report every threat to the police in writing, and keep copies of messages, voice notes, names and dates with someone outside the family.
actions.hg: Har dhamki ki police ko likhit complaint do, aur messages, voice notes, naam aur tareekhon ki copies family se bahar kisi bharosemand insaan ke paas rakho.

actions.en: If a killing near you is written off as an accident or a quarrel, tell the police in writing what you know about the family's opposition to the relationship.
actions.hg: Agar aapke aas-paas koi killing accident ya jhagde ka maamla bata kar band ki ja rahi hai, toh police ko likh kar batao ki rishte par family ke virodh ke baare mein aap kya jaante ho.

actions.en: When you quote honour-killing numbers, call them a floor: NCRB's 36 for 2024 is what police labelled, not what happened.
actions.hg: Honour killing ke numbers quote karo toh unhe 'floor' kaho: 2024 ka NCRB ka 36 woh hai jo police ne label kiya, woh nahi jo hua.

actions.en: Ask your MLA whether your state has set up the special cells and district-level monitoring committees the Supreme Court ordered in 2018, and how many couples they have protected.
actions.hg: Apne MLA se poochho ki kya aapke state ne woh special cells aur district-level monitoring committees banayi hain jinka order Supreme Court ne 2018 mein diya tha, aur unhone kitne couples ko protection di.

title.en: 'Husband or his relatives': how Indian law treats abusive in-laws, and the 'disrespect' excuse 32% of women accept
title.hg: 'Husband or his relatives': Indian law abusive sasural walon ko kaise dekhta hai, aur 'disrespect' wala bahana jise 32% auratein sahi maanti hain

dek.en: Indian criminal law names the husband's relatives in the same breath as the husband. Why it does, how power works in a joint family, and what a daughter-in-law and her parents can do, starting with a complaint that says who did what.
dek.hg: Indian criminal law pati ke saath-saath uske relatives ka bhi naam leta hai. Aisa kyun hai, joint family mein power kaise kaam karti hai, aur ek bahu aur uske maa-baap kya kar sakte hain, shuruaat ek aisi complaint se jo saaf bataye ki kisne kya kiya.

statLabel.en: of women said disrespecting in-laws can justify wife-beating (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: auraton ne kaha ki sasural walon ki disrespect karne par biwi ko peetna sahi hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: cases of cruelty by a husband or his relatives registered in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty ke register hue cases

label.en: dowry deaths registered in 2024 under Section 80 BNS and Section 304B IPC
label.hg: 2024 mein Section 80 BNS aur Section 304B IPC ke under register hui dowry deaths

label.en: of women and girls killed by partners or family members outside Europe and the Americas in 2023 were killed by family members, not partners
label.hg: Europe aur Americas ke bahar 2023 mein partners ya family members ke haathon maari gayi auraton aur ladkiyon mein se itni ko partners ne nahi, family members ne maara

claim.en: What happens between a daughter-in-law and her husband's family is a family matter, not a crime.
claim.hg: Bahu aur sasural ke beech jo hota hai woh ghar ka maamla hai, crime nahi.

truth.en: Sections 85 and 86 BNS make cruelty by a husband or any of his relatives a crime, punishable with up to three years in prison and a fine.
truth.hg: BNS ke Section 85 aur 86 pati ya uske kisi bhi relative ki cruelty ko crime banate hain, jiski saza teen saal tak ki jail aur fine hai.

actions.en: Write down each incident with the date and the name of the relative involved, and keep the record where the family cannot reach it.
actions.hg: Har incident ko date aur us relative ke naam ke saath likhiye, aur yeh record aisi jagah rakhiye jahan family ki pahunch na ho.

actions.en: Parents: when your daughter says she is being harassed, believe her, and do not send her back to 'adjust'.
actions.hg: Maa-baap: jab beti kahe ki use harass kiya ja raha hai, toh uski baat par yakeen kijiye, aur use 'adjust' karne ke liye wapas mat bhejiye.

actions.en: Keep a list and photos of her stridhan and jewellery, and note which relative holds each item.
actions.hg: Uske stridhan aur gehno ki list aur photos rakhiye, aur likhiye ki kaunsi cheez kis relative ke paas hai.

actions.en: In danger, call 112; for advice, call the Women Helpline 181 or go to the district One Stop Centre.
actions.hg: Khatre mein 112 call kijiye; salah ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye ya district ke One Stop Centre jaiye.

actions.en: For free help with an FIR or a Domestic Violence Act application, contact the District Legal Services Authority.
actions.hg: FIR ya Domestic Violence Act application mein free help ke liye District Legal Services Authority se contact kijiye.

title.en: Killed by family, filed under 'dowry' or 'honour': India keeps no femicide count, so the UN has to lean on offences like dowry death
title.hg: Family ne maara, file mein likha 'dahej' ya 'honour': India femicide ka koi count nahi rakhta, isliye UN ko dowry death jaise offences ka sahara lena padta hai

dek.en: The UN estimates that about 50,000 women and girls were killed by partners or relatives worldwide in 2024. India publishes no figure of its own. Its records split killings at home across dowry deaths and murder 'motives' that cannot be added up. Here is who falls through, and what a real count would need.
dek.hg: UN ka estimate hai ki 2024 mein duniya bhar mein lagbhag 50,000 auratein aur ladkiyan apne partner ya rishtedaron ke haathon maari gayi. India apna koi figure publish nahi karta. Uske records ghar ke andar hui hatyaon ko dowry deaths aur murder ke 'motives' mein baant dete hain, jinhe jodkar ek total nahi banta. Kaun beech mein chhoot jaata hai, aur asli count ke liye kya chahiye, yeh story wahi batati hai.

statLabel.en: murders in 2024 with dowry recorded as the motive, counted apart from dowry deaths
statLabel.hg: 2024 ke woh murders jinka motive 'dahej' darj hua, dowry deaths se alag gine gaye

label.en: women and girls killed by a partner or family member worldwide in 2024 (UN estimate)
label.hg: auratein aur ladkiyan jo 2024 mein duniya bhar mein partner ya family member ke haathon maari gayi (UN estimate)

label.en: of women killed in the private sphere outside Europe and the Americas were killed by relatives other than partners (2023)
label.hg: Europe aur Americas ke bahar, ghar ke andar maari gayi auraton mein se itni partner nahi, doosre rishtedaron ke haathon maari gayi (2023)

label.en: dowry-death cases registered in India in 2024: a legal category, not a count of women killed by family
label.hg: dowry-death cases jo India mein 2024 mein register hue: ek legal category, family ke haathon maari gayi auraton ka count nahi

label.en: murders recorded with 'honour killing' as the motive in all of India in 2024
label.hg: murders jinka motive 2024 mein poore India mein 'honour killing' darj hua

claim.en: India's dowry-death figure tells us how many women are killed by their families.
claim.hg: India ka dowry-death figure batata hai ki kitni auraton ko unki family ne maara.

truth.en: It counts one legal category: married women who die within seven years of marriage after dowry cruelty. Dowry murders, honour killings and killings logged under other motives sit in separate columns, and some deaths never get a label at all.
truth.hg: Yeh sirf ek legal category ginta hai: shaadishuda aurat ki maut jo shaadi ke saat saal ke andar, dahej ke liye cruelty ke baad hui. Dowry murders, honour killings aur doosre motives wali hatyaein alag columns mein baithti hain, aur kuch mauton par koi label lagta hi nahi.

actions.en: If a woman says her husband, in-laws or own family are threatening her life, treat it as an emergency: call 112 or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Agar koi aurat kahe ki uska pati, sasural wale ya uski apni family uski jaan ke liye khatra hain, toh ise emergency samjhiye: 112 ya Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Keep a dated record of threats, dowry demands and earlier complaints: messages, medical papers, police receipts. Records like these show police and courts the pattern.
actions.hg: Dhamkiyon, dahej ki maangon aur pichhli complaints ka tareekh ke saath record rakhiye: messages, medical papers, police receipts. Aise records police aur court ko pura pattern dikhate hain.

actions.en: If a woman dies at her marital or parental home, ask police to write every earlier complaint and threat into the FIR, not only the cause of death.
actions.hg: Agar kisi aurat ki maut uske sasural ya maayke mein ho, toh police se kahiye ki FIR mein sirf maut ki wajah nahi, har pichhli complaint aur dhamki bhi likhi jaaye.

actions.en: When you share dowry-death numbers, say what they leave out: they are not India's count of women killed by family.
actions.hg: Dowry-death ke numbers share karte waqt bataiye ki woh kya chhod dete hain: yeh is baat ka count nahi ki India mein family ne kitni auraton ko maara.

actions.en: Ask your MP or MLA why India's crime data do not show how many women were killed by partners or relatives.
actions.hg: Apne MP ya MLA se poochhiye ki India ke crime data mein yeh kyun nahi dikhta ki kitni auratein partners ya rishtedaron ke haathon maari gayi.

title.en: Bangladesh 48.9%, India 29.9%, Sri Lanka 17.2%: what South Asia's own numbers say about violence by husbands
title.hg: Bangladesh 48.9%, India 29.9%, Sri Lanka 17.2%: husband ki violence par South Asia ke apne numbers kya kehte hain

dek.en: WHO's newest estimates let us set India beside six of its neighbours. Countries whose languages, faiths and wedding customs overlap differ nearly threefold on violence by husbands and partners. Read with care, that gap is the best answer to 'this is just our culture'.
dek.hg: WHO ke naye estimates se India ko uske chhe padosi deshon ke saath rakh kar dekha ja sakta hai. Jin deshon ki bhasha, dharm aur shaadi ke rivaaz milte-julte hain, unmein husband ya partner ki violence ka number qareeb teen guna tak alag hai. Dhyaan se padhein, toh yahi gap 'yeh toh hamara culture hai' wali baat ka sabse accha jawab hai.

statLabel.en: of Indian women aged 15-49 who have had a husband or partner have faced physical or sexual violence from one (WHO estimate, 2023)
statLabel.hg: India ki 15-49 saal ki woh auratein jinki shaadi hui ya koi partner raha, aur jinhone usse physical ya sexual violence jheli (WHO estimate, 2023)

label.en: Bangladesh: women aged 15-49 who have faced partner violence in their lifetime (WHO, 2023)
label.hg: Bangladesh: 15-49 saal ki auratein jinhone zindagi mein kabhi partner violence jheli (WHO, 2023)

label.en: Sri Lanka: the lowest lifetime figure among the neighbours compared here (WHO, 2023)
label.hg: Sri Lanka: yahan compare kiye gaye padosiyon mein sabse kam lifetime figure (WHO, 2023)

label.en: India: partner violence in the past 12 months, second only to Afghanistan in South Asia (WHO, 2023)
label.hg: India: pichhle 12 mahine mein partner violence, South Asia mein sirf Afghanistan se peeche (WHO, 2023)

label.en: Southern Asia's lifetime figure, against a world average of 25.8% (WHO, 2023)
label.hg: Southern Asia ka lifetime figure; duniya ka average 25.8% hai (WHO, 2023)

claim.en: Violence by husbands is part of South Asian culture. It has always been there and nothing will change it.
claim.hg: Husband ki violence South Asian culture ka hissa hai. Hamesha se rahi hai, aur kabhi nahi badlegi.

truth.en: Among the six neighbours compared here, whose languages, faiths and marriage customs overlap with India's, lifetime figures range from 50.9% in Afghanistan to 17.2% in Sri Lanka. What separates them is not one shared culture, and the risks linked to this violence can change.
truth.hg: Yahan compare kiye gaye chhe padosi deshon mein, jinki bhasha, dharm aur shaadi ke rivaaz India se milte-julte hain, lifetime number Afghanistan ke 50.9% se Sri Lanka ke 17.2% tak hai. Unhe alag karne wali cheez koi ek shared culture nahi hai. Aur is violence se jude risk badle ja sakte hain.

actions.en: If a woman tells you her husband or partner hurts her, believe her and ask what she needs. In India most women who face violence never tell anyone.
actions.hg: Agar koi aurat bataye ki uska husband ya partner use hurt karta hai, toh uski baat par bharosa kijiye aur poochiye ki use kya chahiye. India mein violence jhelne wali zyada tar auratein kisi ko nahi batatin.

actions.en: In an emergency call 112. For support and information about services near you, including One Stop Centres, call the Women Helpline on 181.
actions.hg: Emergency mein 112 call kijiye. Madad aur aas-paas ki services ki jaankari ke liye, One Stop Centres samet, Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye.

actions.en: When someone calls a husband's violence 'our culture', point to the neighbours: the same region's numbers differ nearly threefold.
actions.hg: Jab koi husband ki violence ko 'hamara culture' kahe, toh padosi deshon ka example dijiye: ek hi region ke numbers mein qareeb teen guna ka farq hai.

actions.en: Before you share a ranking of countries or states, check the survey method and the range around each number. A gap of a few points can be no gap at all.
actions.hg: Deshon ya states ki koi ranking share karne se pehle survey ka tareeka aur har number ki range check kijiye. Kuch points ka gap asal mein koi gap na ho, yeh bhi ho sakta hai.

actions.en: Ask your college, employer or panchayat what it spends on preventing violence at home, not only on responding after it.
actions.hg: Apne college, office ya panchayat se poochiye ki woh ghar ki violence rokne par kya kharch karte hain, sirf violence ho jaane ke baad ki madad par nahi.

title.en: Laxmi v. Union of India (2013): the order meant to end over-the-counter acid, and the 207 attacks of 2024
title.hg: Laxmi v. Union of India (2013): woh order jo dukaan ke counter se acid hataane ke liye tha, aur 2024 ke 207 attacks

dek.en: In 2013 the Supreme Court ordered that acid could be sold only to adults who show photo ID and give a reason, and that every survivor must get at least Rs 3 lakh. India still registered 207 acid attacks in 2024, and in October 2026 the Court said the sale guidelines had 'miserably failed'.
dek.hg: 2013 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki acid sirf un adults ko becha ja sakta hai jo photo ID dikhayein aur wajah batayein, aur har survivor ko kam se kam Rs 3 lakh milne chahiye. Phir bhi India mein 2024 mein 207 acid attacks register hue, aur October 2026 mein Court ne kaha ki sale ki guidelines 'miserably failed' ho chuki hain.

statLabel.en: acid attacks registered in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: acid attacks jo 2024 mein India mein register hue

label.en: the maximum fine for a seller who broke the 2013 acid-sale directions
label.hg: 2013 ke acid-sale directions todne wale seller par zyada se zyada itna fine

label.en: minimum compensation the Court ordered for every acid-attack survivor, Rs 1 lakh of it within 15 days
label.hg: har acid-attack survivor ke liye Court ka tay kiya minimum compensation, jismein Rs 1 lakh 15 din ke andar

label.en: acid attacks registered in India in 2024, the same as in 2023
label.hg: acid attacks jo 2024 mein India mein register hue, bilkul 2023 jitne

label.en: attempted acid attacks registered in India in 2024
label.hg: acid attack ki koshish ke cases jo 2024 mein India mein register hue

claim.en: The Supreme Court banned the sale of acid in 2013, so acid attacks are a thing of the past.
claim.hg: Supreme Court ne 2013 mein acid ki sale ban kar di thi, isliye acid attacks ab beete zamaane ki baat hain.

truth.en: The 2013 order did not ban acid; it allowed sales with a register, photo ID and a stated purpose. India registered 202 acid attacks in 2022 and 207 in each of 2023 and 2024, and in October 2026 the Supreme Court said the sale guidelines had 'miserably failed'.
truth.hg: 2013 ke order ne acid ban nahi kiya; usne register, photo ID aur wajah batane ki shart ke saath sale ki ijaazat di. India mein 2022 mein 202 acid attacks register hue aur 2023 aur 2024 dono saal 207, aur October 2026 mein Supreme Court ne khud kaha ki sale ki guidelines 'miserably failed' ho gayi.

actions.en: If a shop sells acid without a register or photo ID, or to anyone under 18, report it to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate's office, where sellers must declare their acid stock. The 2013 order allows a fine of up to Rs 50,000 on a seller who breaks the rules.
actions.hg: Agar koi dukaan bina register ya photo ID ke acid bechti hai, ya 18 se kam umar ke kisi ko bechti hai, toh Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) ke office mein report kijiye, jahan sellers ko apna acid stock declare karna hota hai. 2013 ka order niyam todne wale seller par Rs 50,000 tak fine ki ijaazat deta hai.

actions.en: If someone is attacked with acid, call 112 and get them to the nearest hospital, public or private: it must give first aid and treatment free and at once.
actions.hg: Agar kisi par acid attack ho, toh 112 par call kijiye aur use sabse paas ke hospital le jaiye, sarkari ho ya private: use turant aur free mein first aid aur ilaaj dena hi hoga.

actions.en: Survivors are owed state compensation of at least Rs 3 lakh, with Rs 1 lakh due within 15 days. If it has not come, go to the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA).
actions.hg: Survivors ko state se kam se kam Rs 3 lakh compensation milna chahiye, jismein Rs 1 lakh 15 din ke andar. Agar nahi aaya, toh District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) jaiye.

actions.en: Ask your state government whether its rules on acid sale under the Poisons Act, 1919 are in force, and how many sellers have been fined under them.
actions.hg: Apni state government se poochhiye ki Poisons Act, 1919 ke under acid sale ke rules lagu hain ya nahi, aur unke under kitne sellers par fine laga.

actions.en: Never share photos or videos of a survivor's injuries. Share the numbers, and the demand for enforcement, instead.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ki chot ki photos ya videos kabhi share mat kijiye. Iske bajaye numbers share kijiye, aur enforcement ki maang.

title.en: 77 of 185 countries, two UN requests, one exception: where India's marital rape law stands in the world
title.hg: 185 mein se 77 desh, UN ki do requests, ek exception: duniya ke saamne India ka marital rape law kahan khada hai

dek.en: Exception 2 to Section 63 of the BNS says a husband's sex with his adult wife is not rape, whatever she said. Here is what that sentence does, how it compares with the rest of the world, what the UN has asked India to do, and why the comparison matters before the Supreme Court's December 2026 hearing.
dek.hg: BNS ke Section 63 ka Exception 2 kehta hai ki pati ka apni adult wife ke saath sex rape nahi hai, chahe wife ne kuch bhi kaha ho. Yeh sentence kya karta hai, baaki duniya se iski tulna kaisi hai, UN ne India se kya maanga hai, aur Supreme Court ki December 2026 ki hearing se pehle yeh tulna kyun maayne rakhti hai.

statLabel.en: countries explicitly criminalised marital rape by 2018 (UN Women)
statLabel.hg: deshon ne 2018 tak marital rape ko saaf taur par crime bana diya tha (UN Women)

label.en: countries had laws explicitly criminalising marital rape by 2018 (UN Women)
label.hg: deshon mein 2018 tak marital rape ko saaf taur par crime banane wale law the (UN Women)

label.en: Commonwealth countries still apply some form of marital exemption to sexual offences, India among them (2020 study cited by UNFPA)
label.hg: Commonwealth deshon mein sexual offences par aaj bhi kisi na kisi tarah ki marital exemption hai, India bhi inmein hai (UNFPA ki quote ki gayi 2020 ki study)

label.en: of 131 countries have consent-based rape laws that explicitly criminalise marital rape (UN SDG Report 2026)
label.hg: 131 deshon mein se itnon mein consent par based aise rape law hain jo marital rape ko saaf taur par crime maante hain (UN SDG Report 2026)

label.en: the minimum sentence for rape under Section 64 BNS, from which the exception keeps husbands of adult wives
label.hg: Section 64 BNS ke tahat rape ki kam se kam saza, jiske daayre se exception adult wife ke pati ko bahar rakhta hai

claim.en: Marriage is permanent consent to sex, and that is how the law works everywhere.
claim.hg: Shaadi sex ke liye hamesha ki consent hai, aur duniya bhar mein law aise hi kaam karta hai.

truth.en: By 2018, 77 of 185 countries explicitly made marital rape a crime. India's own code defines consent as an 'unequivocal voluntary agreement' to a specific act, and the UN has asked India since 2007 to stop exempting husbands.
truth.hg: 2018 tak 185 mein se 77 deshon ne marital rape ko saaf taur par crime bana diya tha. India ka apna code consent ko kisi specific act ke liye 'unequivocal voluntary agreement' kehta hai, aur UN 2007 se India se keh raha hai ki pati ko chhoot dena band kare.

actions.en: If your husband forces sex on you, it is not your fault, and you do not have to wait for the Supreme Court to get help. Call 181 (Women Helpline), or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar aapka pati aapke saath zabardasti sex karta hai, toh yeh aapki galti nahi hai, aur madad ke liye Supreme Court ka intezaar karne ki zaroorat nahi. 181 (Women Helpline) par, ya emergency mein 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: The 2005 Domestic Violence Act counts sexual abuse as domestic violence. You can seek protection, residence and maintenance orders under it.
actions.hg: 2005 ka Domestic Violence Act sexual abuse ko domestic violence maanta hai. Iske tahat aap protection, residence aur maintenance orders maang sakti hain.

actions.en: When someone calls marital rape a 'Western' idea, answer with the record: 77 of 185 countries had explicit laws by 2018, and the UN has asked India to act since 2007.
actions.hg: Jab koi marital rape ko 'Western' idea bataye, toh record dikhaiye: 2018 tak 185 mein se 77 deshon mein iske liye saaf law the, aur UN 2007 se India se action maang raha hai.

actions.en: Follow the Supreme Court's hearing, due on 9 or 10 December 2026, and India's next report to the UN CEDAW Committee, due on 3 February 2027.
actions.hg: Supreme Court ki hearing follow kijiye, jo 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko honi hai, aur UN CEDAW Committee ko India ki agli report bhi, jo 3 February 2027 tak deni hai.

actions.en: Talk about consent inside marriage, with your partner and your family: a wedding is not a lifetime yes.
actions.hg: Shaadi ke andar consent ke baare mein baat kijiye, apne partner se bhi aur family se bhi: shaadi zindagi bhar ki haan nahi hai.

title.en: 60% of men in a seven-state survey had been violent to a partner: a guide for the man who wants to stop
title.hg: Saat states ke survey mein 60% aadmiyon ne partner par violence ki baat maani: us aadmi ke liye guide jo rukna chahta hai

dek.en: If you have hit your wife, or are afraid you will, this is written for you. No excuses and no lecture: what the data say about men like you, what the law says, what your children are learning, and where to get help to stop.
dek.hg: Agar aapne apni patni par haath uthaya hai, ya darr hai ki utha denge, toh yeh aapke liye likha gaya hai. Na bahaane, na lecture: data aap jaise aadmiyon ke baare mein kya kehta hai, law kya kehta hai, aapke bachche kya seekh rahe hain, aur rukne ke liye madad kahan milegi.

statLabel.en: of men surveyed in seven states said they had acted violently against a wife or partner (ICRW-UNFPA, 2014)
statLabel.hg: saat states mein survey kiye gaye aadmiyon ne maana ki unhone patni ya partner ke saath violence ki (ICRW-UNFPA, 2014)

label.en: of men in NFHS-5 said a husband can be justified in beating his wife, up from 42%
label.hg: NFHS-5 mein aadmiyon ne kaha ki patni ko maarna kabhi-kabhi sahi ho sakta hai; pehle yeh 42% tha

label.en: of women whose fathers beat their mothers faced violence from their own husbands, against 25%
label.hg: jin auraton ke pita unki maa ko maarte the, unhe khud pati se violence jhelni padi; baaki auraton mein 25%

label.en: of women whose husbands often get drunk reported spousal violence, against 23% where husbands do not drink
label.hg: jin auraton ke pati aksar nashe mein rehte hain, unhone pati ki violence report ki; sharaab na peene walon ki patniyon mein 23%

label.en: maximum prison term for cruelty by a husband under Section 85 BNS, with a fine
label.hg: Section 85 BNS mein pati ki cruelty par maximum jail, saath mein fine

claim.en: Men hit because they lose control: when they are drunk, or when she provokes them.
claim.hg: Aadmi tab maarte hain jab control kho dete hain: nashe mein, ya jab woh uksaati hai.

truth.en: Violence is a choice about whom it feels safe to hurt. Drinking is linked to it but does not explain it: 23% of women whose husbands do not drink still reported violence from them.
truth.hg: Violence ek choice hai ki kise chot pahunchana 'safe' lagta hai. Sharaab isse judi hai, par isko samjhaati nahi: jin auraton ke pati sharaab nahi peete, unme se bhi 23% ne pati ki violence report ki.

actions.en: When you feel the urge to hit, leave the room, then the house. Come back only when you are calm, and never follow her or block her way.
actions.hg: Jab haath uthane ka mann kare, toh kamre se bahar jaiye, phir ghar se. Shaant hone par hi lautiye, aur kabhi uska peechha mat kijiye, na uska raasta rokiye.

actions.en: Say what you did without 'but', and never ask her or her family to keep it secret or withdraw a complaint.
actions.hg: Jo kiya, use bina 'lekin' ke maaniye, aur na use, na uski family ko, baat chhupane ya complaint wapas lene ko kahiye.

actions.en: Call Tele-MANAS on 14416 and say it plainly: I have been violent to my wife and I want to stop.
actions.hg: Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye aur seedha kahiye: maine apni patni ke saath violence ki hai aur main rukna chahta hoon.

actions.en: If drinking is part of the pattern, stop drinking and ask for help with that too.
actions.hg: Agar sharaab is pattern ka hissa hai, toh peena band kijiye aur uske liye bhi madad maangiye.

actions.en: Share the housework in front of your children, and let them see the change.
actions.hg: Bachchon ke saamne ghar ka kaam baantiye, aur unhe badlaav dekhne dijiye.

title.en: You hear it through the wall: what a neighbour can do about domestic violence, from 112 to a Zero FIR
title.hg: Deewar ke us paar se aawaaz aati hai: domestic violence pe ek padosi kya kar sakta hai, 112 se Zero FIR tak

dek.en: Most women who face violence at home tell no one, so the people who know are often the ones next door. What you can safely do that night, the morning after and in the weeks that follow, and what the law already lets you do.
dek.hg: Ghar mein violence jhelne wali zyada tar women kisi ko nahi batati, isliye aksar sabse pehle bagal wale flat ko pata chalta hai. Us raat, agli subah aur aane wale hafton mein aap safely kya kar sakte hain, aur law aapko pehle se kya karne deta hai.

statLabel.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence ever sought help (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali women mein se sirf itni ne kabhi help maangi (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali women ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of the women who did seek help went to the police; 60.9% turned to their own family (NFHS-5)
label.hg: help maangne wali women police ke paas gayi; 60.9% ne apne parivaar ka sahara liya (NFHS-5)

label.en: One Stop Centres operational across India in July 2026
label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein poore India mein chal rahe the

claim.en: What happens inside a neighbour's home is a private family matter.
claim.hg: Padosi ke ghar ke andar jo hota hai, woh unka private family matter hai.

truth.en: Cruelty by a husband or his relatives is a crime under Section 85 BNS, and anyone can report a cognizable offence at any police station, wherever it was committed.
truth.hg: Husband ya uske relatives ki cruelty Section 85 BNS ke under crime hai, aur koi bhi insaan cognizable offence ki report kisi bhi police station pe kar sakta hai, chahe crime kahin bhi hua ho.

actions.en: If you hear someone being hurt right now, call 112 and give the building, floor and flat number.
actions.hg: Agar abhi kisi ko chot pahunchaayi ja rahi hai, toh 112 pe call kijiye aur building, floor aur flat number bataiye.

actions.en: Write down the date, the time and what you heard that same night, and keep the note safe.
actions.hg: Usi raat date, time aur jo suna woh likh lijiye, aur note sambhaal ke rakhiye.

actions.en: Talk to her alone, when he is out, and ask what she wants. Do not confront him or post about it in a group chat.
actions.hg: Usse akele mein baat kijiye, jab woh aadmi ghar pe na ho, aur poochhiye ki woh kya chahti hai. Us aadmi se khud mat uljhiye, aur group chat mein iske baare mein kuch post mat kijiye.

actions.en: Save the Women Helpline number, 181, and your district One Stop Centre's address, and offer her your phone to call from.
actions.hg: Women Helpline ka number, 181, aur apne district ke One Stop Centre ka address save kijiye, aur use call karne ke liye apna phone offer kijiye.

actions.en: If a child is being hurt, call 1098. If you learn that a child is being sexually abused, reporting it is your legal duty.
actions.hg: Agar kisi bachche ko chot pahunchaayi ja rahi hai, toh 1098 pe call kijiye. Agar pata chale ki kisi bachche ka sexual abuse ho raha hai, toh report karna aapki legal duty hai.

title.en: 31.9% of ever-married women, 26.8% in the past year alone: what NFHS-5 found behind India's front doors
title.hg: 31.9% married women ne pati ki violence jheli, 26.8% ne sirf pichhle saal mein: NFHS-5 ne India ke band darwazon ke peeche kya paaya

dek.en: India's own health survey asked women what their husbands had done to them. Nearly one in three described violence, most of it recent. Here is what the three headline numbers mean, where they peak, and why police files show only a sliver.
dek.hg: India ke apne health survey ne auraton se poocha ki unke pati ne unke saath kya kiya. Lagbhag har teen mein se ek ne violence ki baat batayi, aur zyada tar ke saath yeh haal hi mein hua tha. Teen bade numbers ka matlab, kin states mein yeh sabse zyada hai, aur police files mein iska bas chhota sa hissa kyun dikhta hai.

statLabel.en: of ever-married women faced violence from their husband in the 12 months before NFHS-5
statLabel.hg: married women ne NFHS-5 se pehle ke 12 mahinon mein pati ki violence jheli

label.en: of ever-married women have faced physical, sexual or emotional violence from a husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: married women ne kabhi na kabhi pati se physical, sexual ya emotional violence jheli (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of ever-married women in Karnataka reported physical, sexual or emotional violence by a husband, the highest of any state (NFHS-5)
label.hg: Karnataka ki married women ne pati se physical, sexual ya emotional violence ki baat batayi, jo kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: of ever-married or partnered women in India faced physical or sexual partner violence in their lifetime, by WHO's modelled estimate (2023)
label.hg: India ki married ya partnered women ne zindagi mein kabhi na kabhi partner se physical ya sexual violence jheli, WHO ke modelled estimate ke hisaab se (2023)

label.en: cruelty-by-husband cases registered by police across India in 2024
label.hg: pati ya sasural walon ki cruelty ke cases jo police ne 2024 mein poore desh mein darj kiye

claim.en: Violence by husbands is rare, and it happens in other kinds of families.
claim.hg: Pati ki violence bahut kam hoti hai, aur woh bhi 'doosri tarah ki' families mein.

truth.en: NFHS-5 found it in the lives of nearly one in three ever-married women, in cities as well as villages, and among husbands with 12 or more years of schooling too.
truth.hg: NFHS-5 ke hisaab se lagbhag har teen mein se ek married woman ne pati ki violence jheli hai. Shehron mein bhi, gaon mein bhi, aur 12 ya usse zyada saal padhe hue patiyon wale gharon mein bhi.

actions.en: If a woman tells you about violence at home, believe her first. Do not tell her to adjust for the family's sake.
actions.hg: Agar koi aurat aapko ghar mein ho rahi violence ke baare mein bataye, toh sabse pehle uski baat par bharosa kijiye. Usse yeh mat kahiye ki family ki khatir adjust kar le.

actions.en: Save 181 (Women Helpline) and 112 (emergency) in your phone. If she wants them too, help her keep them in a way that stays safe if someone checks her phone.
actions.hg: 181 (Women Helpline) aur 112 (emergency) apne phone mein save kijiye. Agar woh bhi yeh numbers chahe, toh unhe aise rakhne mein madad kijiye ki koi uska phone check kare toh bhi woh safe rahe.

actions.en: Learn the signs that leave no marks: a woman cut off from her friends, her money or her own phone.
actions.hg: Un signs ko pehchaniye jo body par nahi dikhte: aurat ko uske friends se, uske paison se ya uske apne phone se door kar dena.

actions.en: Tell her the 2005 Domestic Violence Act lets her seek protection, residence and maintenance orders without filing a criminal case.
actions.hg: Use bataiye ki 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act ke tahat woh bina criminal case kiye bhi protection, ghar mein rehne aur kharche ke orders maang sakti hai.

actions.en: Say it out loud when relatives excuse violence as a normal part of marriage. Children are listening.
actions.hg: Jab rishtedaar violence ko shaadi ka 'normal' hissa bataayein, toh khul kar tokiye. Bachche sab sun rahe hote hain.

title.en: From 29.2% to 22.3%: did violence by husbands really fall in NFHS-6, or did women stop telling?
title.hg: 29.2% se 22.3%: NFHS-6 mein pati ki violence sach mein ghati, ya auraton ne batana band kar diya?

dek.en: Provisional NFHS-6 fact sheets report a sharp drop in wives describing violence, and police cruelty cases fell too. But Karnataka's figure went from 44.4% to 14.1% while Kerala's nearly doubled. Here is the evidence on both sides, and how to read the next 'violence is down' headline.
dek.hg: NFHS-6 ki provisional fact sheets mein pati ki violence batane wali auratein tezi se kam hui hain, aur police mein darj cruelty cases bhi ghate hain. Lekin Karnataka ka number 44.4% se gir kar 14.1% ho gaya, aur Kerala ka lagbhag double. Dono taraf ke saboot padhiye, aur yeh bhi ki agli 'violence ghati' headline kaise padhein.

statLabel.en: of ever-married women reported violence by a husband in NFHS-6 (2023-24), down from 29.2%
statLabel.hg: married women ne NFHS-6 (2023-24) mein pati ki violence ki baat batayi, pehle yeh 29.2% tha

label.en: of ever-married women aged 18-49 had ever faced physical or sexual violence by a husband (NFHS-6, 2023-24, provisional)
label.hg: 18-49 saal ki married women ne kabhi na kabhi pati se physical ya sexual violence jheli (NFHS-6, 2023-24, provisional)

label.en: the same measure in NFHS-5 (2019-21)
label.hg: NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein yahi measure

label.en: Karnataka in NFHS-6, down from 44.4%, the highest in India in NFHS-5
label.hg: NFHS-6 mein Karnataka, jo NFHS-5 mein 44.4% ke saath India mein sabse upar tha

label.en: average yearly decline in partner violence worldwide over 20 years (WHO)
label.hg: duniya bhar mein partner violence mein pichhle 20 saal ki average saalana giravat (WHO)

claim.en: The survey and the police both show a fall, so violence by husbands has clearly fallen.
claim.hg: Survey aur police dono mein giravat hai, toh pati ki violence pakka ghati hai.

truth.en: Both depend on women speaking up. A measure of violence a woman has ever faced is very unlikely to drop this fast for real, and experts question whether NFHS-6 interviews were private.
truth.hg: Dono is par tike hain ki auratein bolein. 'Kabhi bhi' jheli gayi violence ka number sach mein itni tezi se gire, yeh bahut mushkil hai, aur experts sawaal utha rahe hain ki NFHS-6 ke interviews akele mein hue bhi the ya nahi.

actions.en: Before you share a 'violence is down' headline, check the measure, the years, and whether the data are provisional.
actions.hg: 'Violence ghati' wali headline share karne se pehle check kijiye: kaunsa measure hai, kin saalon ka comparison hai, aur data final hai ya provisional.

actions.en: Remember that an 'ever experienced' figure rarely falls fast for real. A sudden drop may point to how the questions were asked.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye, 'ever experienced' wala number sach mein shayad hi kabhi achanak girta hai. Achanak giravat is taraf ishaara kar sakti hai ki sawaal poochhne ke tareeke mein kuch badla hai.

actions.en: If a woman tells you about violence, believe her. She may never have told anyone, not even a surveyor.
actions.hg: Agar koi aurat aapko violence ke baare mein bataye, toh us par bharosa kijiye. Ho sakta hai usne aaj tak kisi ko na bataya ho, surveyor ko bhi nahi.

actions.en: Save 181 (Women Helpline) and 112 (emergency), and share them with the women around you.
actions.hg: 181 (Women Helpline) aur 112 (emergency) save kijiye, aur apne aas-paas ki auraton ke saath share kijiye.

title.en: Eight cities got more Nirbhaya money than all of India's One Stop Centres: Rs 1,686.73 crore against Rs 1,299.10 crore
title.hg: Aath shehron ko Nirbhaya Fund se India ke saare One Stop Centres se zyada paisa mila: Rs 1,686.73 crore vs Rs 1,299.10 crore

dek.en: Safe City projects aim at streets and public places in eight cities. One Stop Centres are where a woman goes when the danger is inside her home. The Nirbhaya Fund's spending shows which problem India pays for first, and who is still at the door at 2 am.
dek.hg: Safe City projects aath shehron ki sadkon aur public jagahon par focus karte hain. One Stop Centre woh jagah hai jahan ek aurat tab jaati hai jab khatra uske ghar ke andar ho. Nirbhaya Fund ka kharch dikhata hai ki India pehle kis problem par paisa lagata hai, aur raat ke 2 baje darwaze par kaun akela reh jaata hai.

statLabel.hg: July 2026 tak One Stop Centres ke liye release hua Nirbhaya Fund ka paisa

label.en: Nirbhaya Fund money for Safe City projects in eight cities, by July 2026
label.hg: July 2026 tak aath shehron ke Safe City projects ko mila Nirbhaya Fund ka paisa

label.hg: July 2026 mein chal rahe One Stop Centres, 1,033 approved centres mein se

label.en: Garima Greh shelters for transgender persons, in 17 states (November 2025)
label.hg: transgender logon ke liye Garima Greh shelters, 17 states mein (November 2025)

claim.en: Women are mostly in danger on the street, so cameras and patrols are the answer.
claim.hg: Auraton ko zyada tar khatra sadak par hota hai, isliye cameras aur patrolling hi iska solution hai.

truth.en: The largest category of crime against women that police register is cruelty by a husband or his relatives, and 29.3% of ever-married women report physical or sexual violence by a husband.
truth.hg: Police jo crimes against women register karti hai, unme sabse badi category pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty hai, aur 29.3% ever-married auratein pati se physical ya sexual violence report karti hain.

actions.en: Find your district's One Stop Centre (Sakhi) today and save its number, with 181 and 112, in your phone and in a trusted friend's.
actions.hg: Aaj hi apne district ka One Stop Centre (Sakhi) dhoondhiye aur uska number, 181 aur 112 ke saath, apne phone mein aur kisi bharosemand dost ke phone mein save kijiye.

actions.en: If someone has to leave a violent home at night, call 181 or 112 and ask for the nearest One Stop Centre; do not wait for morning.
actions.hg: Agar kisi ko raat mein violent ghar chhodna pade, toh 181 ya 112 par call karke sabse paas ke One Stop Centre ke baare mein poochiye; subah ka intezaar mat kijiye.

actions.en: Ask your MP or MLA how much Nirbhaya Fund money reached your district's One Stop Centre, and how many women it can shelter.
actions.hg: Apne MP ya MLA se poochiye ki aapke district ke One Stop Centre tak Nirbhaya Fund ka kitna paisa pahuncha, aur woh kitni auraton ko shelter de sakta hai.

actions.en: If you are transgender and have lost your home, ask your state's social welfare department or Transgender Welfare Board for the nearest Garima Greh.
actions.hg: Agar aap transgender hain aur aapka ghar chhoot gaya hai, toh apne state ke social welfare department ya Transgender Welfare Board se sabse paas ke Garima Greh ke baare mein poochiye.

title.en: Section 80 BNS explained: when a death within seven years of marriage becomes a 'dowry death'
title.hg: Section 80 BNS explained: shaadi ke saat saal ke andar hui maut kab 'dowry death' banti hai

dek.en: The law asks four questions, then deems the husband or relative who harassed her to have caused the death. In 2024, 46.2% of completed dowry-death trials ended in conviction, far above the rate for crimes against women as a whole, yet 93.6% of cases were still pending.
dek.hg: Law chaar sawaal poochta hai, phir maan leta hai ki maut ke zimmedar wahi pati ya relative hain jinhone use harass kiya. 2024 mein dowry death ke jo trials poore hue, unme se 46.2% mein conviction hua, jo auraton ke khilaf crimes ke overall rate se kaafi zyada hai. Phir bhi 93.6% cases pending the.

statLabel.en: conviction rate in dowry-death trials completed in 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein complete hue dowry death trials mein conviction rate

label.en: dowry-death cases before Indian courts in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein courts ke saamne dowry death ke cases

label.en: dowry-death cases still pending trial at the end of 2024 (93.6%)
label.hg: 2024 ke end mein pending dowry death cases (93.6%)

label.hg: comparison ke liye: 2024 mein auraton ke khilaf saare crimes ka conviction rate

claim.en: If a woman dies at her in-laws' home, her family has to prove exactly who caused her death.
claim.hg: Agar kisi aurat ki maut sasural mein ho, toh uski family ko prove karna padta hai ki maut exactly kisne ki.

truth.en: Under Section 80 BNS, if a woman dies of burns, injury or in other abnormal circumstances within seven years of marriage, and dowry-linked cruelty soon before her death is proved, the law deems the husband or relative who harassed her to have caused the death. No eyewitness to the death is needed.
truth.hg: Section 80 BNS mein, agar kisi aurat ki maut shaadi ke saat saal ke andar jalne, chot ya kisi aur abnormal haalat mein ho, aur prove ho jaye ki maut se kuch hi pehle dowry ke liye uske saath cruelty hui thi, toh law maan leta hai ki maut ke zimmedar wahi pati ya relative hain jinhone use pareshan kiya. Maut ka koi eyewitness zaroori nahi.

actions.en: If a woman is being harassed for dowry now, she or her family can file a police complaint for cruelty under Sections 85 and 86 BNS. In danger, call 112; for support, call the Women Helpline on 181.
actions.hg: Agar kisi aurat ko abhi dowry ke liye pareshan kiya ja raha hai, toh woh ya uski family BNS Section 85 aur 86 mein cruelty ki police complaint kar sakti hai. Khatra ho toh 112 call kijiye; madad ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Keep proof of every dowry demand as it happens: dated messages, call logs, bank transfers and the names of the people she told.
actions.hg: Har dowry demand ka proof usi waqt rakhiye: date wale messages, call logs, bank transfers, aur un logon ke naam jinhe usne bataya.

actions.en: If a woman dies in abnormal circumstances within seven years of her wedding, her family can ask police to register the case under Section 80 BNS, and should hand over that proof.
actions.hg: Agar shaadi ke saat saal ke andar kisi aurat ki maut abnormal circumstances mein ho, toh family police se Section 80 BNS mein case register karne ko keh sakti hai. Woh saara proof police ko dijiye.

actions.en: Ask for your free copy of the FIR and for updates: police must tell the informant how the investigation is going within 90 days. For free legal help, contact your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA).
actions.hg: FIR ki free copy maangiye aur investigation ka update maangiye: police ko 90 din ke andar informant ko investigation ki progress batani hoti hai. Free legal help ke liye apne district ki District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) se contact kijiye.

actions.en: If you or someone you know is thinking about suicide, call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Agar aap ya aapka koi jaanne wala suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye.

title.en: Section 85 and 86 BNS in plain words: what counts as 'cruelty' in an Indian marriage, and what up to three years in prison covers
title.hg: Section 85 aur 86 BNS seedhi bhasha mein: Indian shaadi mein 'cruelty' kise kehte hain, aur teen saal tak ki jail kis cheez ki saza hai

dek.en: India's most-used criminal law against violence at home is two short sections: one defines cruelty, the other punishes it. Labelled examples show what the words cover, what they leave out, and how to put cruelty into a complaint.
dek.hg: Ghar ki violence ke khilaf India ka sabse zyada use hone wala criminal law bas do chhote sections hain: ek cruelty ko define karta hai, doosra uski saza deta hai. Labelled examples se samjhiye ki in shabdon mein kya aata hai, kya chhoot jaata hai, aur complaint mein cruelty ko kaise likhein.

label.en: cases of cruelty by a husband or his relatives registered by police in 2024
label.hg: pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty ke cases jo police ne 2024 mein register kiye

label.en: charge-sheeting rate in the cruelty cases police disposed of in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein police ne jin cruelty cases ko dispose kiya, unme charge-sheet ka rate

label.en: maximum prison term under Section 85 BNS, with a fine
label.hg: Section 85 BNS mein maximum jail, saath mein fine

claim.en: If he never hit her, it is not cruelty in law.
claim.hg: Agar usne kabhi haath nahi uthaya, toh law ki nazar mein yeh cruelty nahi hai.

truth.en: Section 86 BNS covers wilful conduct likely to cause grave injury or danger to a woman's life, limb or health, 'whether mental or physical', and harassment over demands for property. Threats and humiliation can count.
truth.hg: Section 86 BNS mein aisa jaan-boojhkar kiya gaya bartaav aata hai jo aurat ki jaan, ang ya health ko, 'whether mental or physical', gambhir chot ya khatre mein daal sakta hai, aur property ki demand ke liye harassment bhi. Dhamkiyan aur zaleel karna bhi gina ja sakta hai.

actions.en: Write down each incident soon after it happens: the date, who did or said what, who saw it, and how it affected you.
actions.hg: Har incident ke kuch hi der baad likh lijiye: date, kisne kya kiya ya kaha, kisne dekha, aur aap par uska kya asar hua.

actions.en: Save every demand for money or property: messages, voice notes, call logs and bank transfers, with who asked for what and when.
actions.hg: Paise ya property ki har demand ka saboot rakhiye: messages, voice notes, call logs aur bank transfers, aur kisne kab kya maanga.

actions.en: See a doctor or counsellor about injuries, sleeplessness or anxiety, and keep the papers. Harm to mental health counts under Section 86.
actions.hg: Chot, neend na aane ya anxiety ke liye doctor ya counsellor ko dikhaiye aur papers sambhal kar rakhiye. Section 86 mein mental health ka nuksaan bhi count hota hai.

actions.en: File at any police station or as an e-FIR, and ask for your free copy of the FIR. For advice, call the Women Helpline on 181; in danger, call 112.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein ya e-FIR ke through complaint kijiye, aur FIR ki free copy maangiye. Salah ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye; khatre mein 112 par.

actions.en: If you are having thoughts of ending your life, call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Agar aapke mann mein apni jaan lene ke khayal aa rahe hain, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye.

title.en: Leaving does not end it: 14% of married survivors name a former husband, and the law still goes easier on a separated one
title.hg: Chhod dene se khatam nahi hota: 14% married survivors former husband ka naam lete hain, aur law alag rehne wale husband ke saath ab bhi narmi karta hai

dek.en: Moving out ends the shared roof, not always the danger. What the data say about former husbands, why forced sex by a separated husband is a lesser crime than rape, and which legal tools cover the months after a woman leaves.
dek.hg: Ghar alag ho jaata hai, khatra hamesha nahi. Former husbands ke baare mein data kya kehta hai, alag rehne wale husband ka zabardasti sex rape se halka crime kyun maana jaata hai, aur chhodne ke baad ke mahino ke liye law mein kaun se tools hain.

statLabel.en: of ever-married women who faced sexual violence named a former husband (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: ever-married women ne, jinhone sexual violence jheli, former husband ka naam liya (NFHS-5)

label.en: of ever-married women who had faced sexual violence named a former husband as the perpetrator (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: ever-married women ne, jinhone sexual violence jheli thi, former husband ko perpetrator bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women abused only by a former husband had sought help, against 11.3% of those abused only by their current husband (NFHS-5)
label.hg: sirf former husband se abuse jhelne wali women ne help maangi thi, jabki sirf current husband se abuse jhelne walon mein yeh 11.3% tha (NFHS-5)

label.en: for forced sex by a husband while the couple live apart (Section 67 BNS), against a 10-year minimum for rape
label.hg: ki jail, jab husband alag reh rahi wife ke saath zabardasti sex kare (Section 67 BNS), jabki rape ki minimum saza 10 saal hai

label.en: maximum prison term for breaking a protection order under the Domestic Violence Act
label.hg: maximum jail, Domestic Violence Act ka protection order todne pe

claim.en: Once she moves out, she is safe.
claim.hg: Ek baar woh ghar chhod de, toh woh safe hai.

truth.en: In NFHS-5, 14% of married survivors of sexual violence named a former husband, and NCRB lists separated husbands among the known accused in rape cases. Leaving changes the danger; it does not always end it.
truth.hg: NFHS-5 mein sexual violence jhel chuki 14% married survivors ne former husband ka naam liya, aur NCRB rape cases ke known accused mein separated husbands ko bhi ginta hai. Chhodne se khatra badalta hai; hamesha khatam nahi hota.

actions.en: If a husband you live apart from forces sex on you, it is a crime under Section 67 BNS even without a court decree; you do not have to wait for the divorce to go to the police.
actions.hg: Agar alag rehte hue husband aapke saath zabardasti sex kare, toh court decree ke bina bhi yeh Section 67 BNS ke under crime hai; police ke paas jaane ke liye divorce ka intezaar karne ki zaroorat nahi.

actions.en: Ask a Protection Officer, a One Stop Centre or a free legal-aid lawyer whether a protection order under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act fits your situation.
actions.hg: Kisi Protection Officer, One Stop Centre ya free legal-aid lawyer se poochhiye ki 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act ke under protection order aapke case mein fit baithta hai ya nahi.

actions.en: Log every call, message, visit and threat with dates and screenshots, and keep the log where he cannot reach it.
actions.hg: Har call, message, visit aur dhamki ka record date aur screenshots ke saath rakhiye, aur yeh record aisi jagah rakhiye jahan uska haath na pahunche.

actions.en: Hand over children in a public place or through a trusted third person, and tell the school who may collect them.
actions.hg: Bachchon ka handover kisi public jagah pe ya kisi bharosemand teesre insaan ke through kijiye, aur school ko bataiye ki bachchon ko kaun le ja sakta hai.

actions.en: If he threatens to share private images, report it on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930; sharing them without consent is a crime even if you agreed to the photo.
actions.hg: Agar woh private images share karne ki dhamki de, toh cybercrime.gov.in pe report kijiye ya 1930 pe call kijiye; bina consent unhe share karna crime hai, chahe photo aapki marzi se li gayi ho.

title.en: 'Why doesn't she just leave?' The four exits India blocks: family, money, courts and a bed for the night
title.hg: 'Woh chhod kyun nahi deti?' Chaar raaste jo India band rakhta hai: family, paisa, courts aur raat ke liye ek bistar

dek.en: The question blames the woman. The data describe the doors she would have to get through, and how many are shut: a family that says 'adjust', no income of her own, cases that take years, and a few nights' shelter at best.
dek.hg: Yeh sawaal aurat ko hi dosh deta hai. Data un darwaazon ki baat karta hai jinse use guzarna padega, aur batata hai ki kitne band hain: 'adjust karo' kehne wali family, apni koi kamai nahi, saalon chalne wale cases, aur zyada se zyada kuch raaton ka shelter.

statLabel.en: of urban women aged 15 and above were in the labour force in 2023-24
statLabel.hg: urban women (15 saal aur usse upar) 2023-24 mein labour force mein thi

label.en: of women who sought help after violence turned to their own family; 6.3% went to the police (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: violence ke baad help maangne wali women apni family ke paas gayi; police ke paas sirf 6.3% gayi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of urban women aged 15 and above were in the labour force in 2023-24
label.hg: urban women (15 saal aur usse upar) 2023-24 mein labour force mein thi

label.en: of cruelty-by-husband cases before the courts were still pending at the end of 2024
label.hg: husband ki cruelty ke cases 2024 ke end tak courts mein pending the

label.en: cruelty cases ended in compromise in 2024, more than the 10,689 that ended in conviction
label.hg: cruelty cases 2024 mein compromise pe khatam hue, jabki conviction sirf 10,689 mein hua

claim.en: If it were really that bad, she would just leave.
claim.hg: Agar sach mein itna bura hota, toh woh chhod ke chali jaati.

truth.en: Most women who face violence never tell anyone. Leaving needs a family that takes her in, money of her own, a legal system that acts and somewhere to sleep, and in India each of those exits is often shut.
truth.hg: Violence jhelne wali zyada tar women kisi ko batati tak nahi. Ghar chhodne ke liye chahiye ek family jo use apnaye, apna paisa, ek legal system jo kaam kare aur sone ki jagah, aur India mein yeh har raasta aksar band milta hai.

actions.en: Replace 'Why doesn't she leave?' with 'What do you need, and are you safe tonight?'
actions.hg: 'Woh chhodti kyun nahi?' ki jagah poochiye: 'Tumhe kya chahiye, aur kya tum aaj raat safe ho?'

actions.en: If you are her family, tell her she can come home, and mean it. Never tell her to adjust to violence.
actions.hg: Agar aap uski family hain, toh use bataiye ki woh ghar aa sakti hai, aur yeh dil se kahiye. Violence ke saath 'adjust' karne ko kabhi mat kahiye.

actions.en: Help her keep copies of her ID, bank papers, her child's documents and any evidence of abuse where he cannot reach them.
actions.hg: Uske ID, bank papers, bachche ke documents aur abuse ke saboot ki copies aisi jagah rakhne mein madad kijiye jahan uska haath na pahunche.

actions.en: Find the nearest One Stop Centre before a crisis: it offers police help, legal aid, counselling and a short stay.
actions.hg: Crisis se pehle hi sabse paas wala One Stop Centre dhoondh ke rakhiye: wahan police help, legal aid, counselling aur kuch din rukne ki jagah milti hai.

actions.en: If she is in danger now, call 112.
actions.hg: Agar woh abhi khatre mein hai, toh 112 pe call kijiye.

title.en: 84% of women in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh said a husband can be justified in beating his wife: India's state map of excuses
title.hg: Telangana aur Andhra Pradesh ki 84% women ne kaha ki kuch haalaat mein pati ka patni ko peetna justified hai: excuses ka state-wise map

dek.en: In NFHS-5, 45% of Indian women and 44% of men found at least one reason a husband may hit his wife. In some states, more than four in five did. Here is the map, how it lines up with the violence, and how to answer the excuse at home.
dek.hg: NFHS-5 mein India ki 45% women aur 44% men ko kam se kam ek aisi wajah dikhi jis par pati patni par haath utha sakta hai. Kuch states mein toh paanch mein se chaar se zyada log yahi maante the. Yeh raha map, violence se iska rishta, aur ghar par is excuse ka jawab kaise dein.

statLabel.en: of women in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana said wife-beating can be justified (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: Andhra Pradesh aur Telangana ki women ne kaha ki wife-beating justified ho sakti hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: of Indian women aged 15-49 agreed a husband is justified in beating his wife in at least one of seven situations (NFHS-5)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ne maana ki saat mein se kam se kam ek situation mein pati ka patni ko peetna justified hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: of men in Karnataka agreed, the highest share among men in any state (NFHS-5)
label.hg: Karnataka ke men ne yeh maana, kisi bhi state ke men mein sabse zyada (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women accepted 'disrespect for in-laws' as a reason, the most accepted of the seven (NFHS-5)
label.hg: women ne 'sasural walon ki disrespect' ko pitaai ki wajah maana, saaton wajahon mein sabse zyada (NFHS-5)

label.en: of ever-married women aged 18-49 reported physical or sexual violence by a husband (NFHS-5)
label.hg: 18-49 saal ki married women ne pati ki physical ya sexual violence jheli (NFHS-5)

claim.en: A husband hits his wife only when she gives him a reason.
claim.hg: Pati patni par tabhi haath uthata hai jab woh koi wajah deti hai.

truth.en: Most of the 'reasons' NFHS asks about are ordinary adult choices, like going out, arguing or saying no to sex. No reason makes it legal: cruelty by a husband or his relatives is a crime under Section 85 BNS.
truth.hg: NFHS jin 'wajahon' ke baare mein poochhta hai, unmein se zyada tar ek adult aurat ke normal decisions hain, jaise bahar jaana, behas karna ya sex se mana karna. Koi bhi wajah maar-peet ko legal nahi banati: pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty BNS Section 85 ke under crime hai.

actions.en: When someone says 'she must have provoked him', answer plainly: no reason makes hitting a wife acceptable, and cruelty by a husband or his relatives is a crime under Section 85 BNS.
actions.hg: Jab koi bole 'usi ne provoke kiya hoga', toh seedha jawab dein: koi bhi wajah patni ko peetna sahi nahi banati, aur pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty BNS Section 85 ke under crime hai.

actions.en: Check which of the seven 'reasons' you grew up accepting, and say out loud at home that going out, arguing or refusing sex is not a provocation.
actions.hg: Dekhiye in saat 'wajahon' mein se kaun si aapko bachpan se sahi batayi gayi. Ghar par khulkar kahiye ki bahar jaana, behas karna ya sex se mana karna provocation nahi hai.

actions.en: If a woman tells you she is being hit, believe her, ask what she needs, and never send her back to 'adjust'.
actions.hg: Agar koi aurat bataye ki use peeta ja raha hai, toh us par bharosa kijiye, poochhiye use kya chahiye, aur use 'adjust' karne ke liye wapas mat bhejiye.

actions.en: Men: challenge the excuse among other men. Men's agreement rose between NFHS-4 (2015-16) and NFHS-5 (2019-21) while women's fell.
actions.hg: Men, doosre men ke beech is excuse ko tokiye. NFHS-4 (2015-16) se NFHS-5 (2019-21) ke beech men mein yeh soch badhi, jabki women mein ghati.

actions.en: In danger, call 112. For help with violence at home, call the Women Helpline on 181.
actions.hg: Khatra ho toh 112 par call karein. Ghar mein ho rahi violence par madad ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call karein.

title.en: 54 to 88 a year: the 'witchcraft' murders India still records, and what the data cannot tell us
title.hg: Saal mein 54 se 88: 'witchcraft' ke naam par hone wale murders jo India aaj bhi darj karta hai, aur jo data nahi bata sakta

dek.en: Police recorded witchcraft as the motive in 54 murders in 2024, the lowest in five years. The table counts only the killings, not the accusations, fines, beatings and expulsions that come first, and it does not say who died.
dek.hg: 2024 mein police ne 54 murders mein motive 'witchcraft' darj kiya, jo paanch saal mein sabse kam hai. Table sirf killings ginti hai, unse pehle aane wale ilzaam, jurmane, maar-peet aur gaon se nikaale jaane ko nahi, aur yeh bhi nahi batati ki maare gaye log kaun the.

statLabel.hg: 2024 mein murders jinka motive witchcraft darj hua

label.en: murders in India in 2024 with witchcraft recorded as the motive, the lowest in five years
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein murders jinka motive witchcraft darj hua, paanch saal mein sabse kam

label.en: such murders in 2020, the highest of the five years from 2020 to 2024
label.hg: 2020 mein aise murders, 2020 se 2024 ke paanch saalon mein sabse zyada

label.hg: 2024 mein Madhya Pradesh mein darj witchcraft murders, kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada

label.en: witchcraft murders recorded in Chhattisgarh in 2024, the second most
label.hg: 2024 mein Chhattisgarh mein darj witchcraft murders, doosre number par

claim.en: Fewer 'witchcraft' murders means witch-hunting is dying out.
claim.hg: 'Witchcraft' murders kam ho rahe hain, matlab witch-hunting khatam ho rahi hai.

truth.en: The table counts only killings that police record with this motive. Accusations, fines, beatings and expulsions are not counted at all, and a lower number can reflect how cases are recorded as much as what happened.
truth.hg: Table sirf woh killings ginti hai jinme police ne yeh motive darj kiya. Ilzaam, jurmane, maar-peet aur gaon se nikaalna bilkul nahi gine jaate, aur kam number utna hi recording ka asar ho sakta hai jitna asal haalaat ka.

actions.en: If you hear someone being called a witch, do not repeat it, forward it or joke about it.
actions.hg: Agar kisi ko 'daayan' ya witch kehte suno, toh use dohrao mat, forward mat karo, mazaak mat banao.

actions.en: If a 'meeting' is called to judge her, a fine is demanded or a crowd gathers, call 112 straight away.
actions.hg: Agar uska 'faisla' karne ke liye baithak bulayi jaye, jurmana maanga jaye ya bheed jama ho, toh turant 112 par call karo.

actions.en: Help her reach the Women Helpline 181 or a One Stop Centre for police help, medical care, legal aid and a safe place to stay.
actions.hg: Usse Women Helpline 181 ya kisi One Stop Centre tak pahunchne mein madad karo, jahan police help, medical care, legal aid aur rehne ki surakshit jagah milti hai.

actions.en: Report threats and attacks at any police station or online, and ask for the free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Dhamkiyon aur hamlon ki report kisi bhi police station mein ya online karo, aur FIR ki free copy maango.

actions.en: Write down who accused her, who called the meeting and who threatened her, with dates.
actions.hg: Likh kar rakho ki ilzaam kisne lagaya, baithak kisne bulayi aur dhamki kisne di, tareekh ke saath.

title.en: Your intimate image has leaked: what to do in the first hour, now that platforms have two hours to remove it
title.hg: Tumhari intimate image leak ho gayi hai: pehle ghante mein kya karna hai, ab jab platforms ko use 2 ghante mein hatana hai

dek.en: Since February 2026, a platform must take down your nude, sexual or morphed image within two hours of your own complaint, with no FIR needed. Here is how to use the first hour, step by step.
dek.hg: February 2026 se platform ko tumhari complaint ke 2 ghante ke andar tumhari nude, sexual ya morphed image hatani hoti hai, bina kisi FIR ke. Pehla ghanta kaise use karna hai, step by step yahan hai.

statLabel.hg: complaint ke baad platform ko tumhari intimate image itne time mein hatani hogi (20 Feb 2026 se)

label.hg: complaint ke baad platform ko tumhari intimate image itne time mein hatani hogi (20 February 2026 se)

label.en: cases StopNCII had supported by November 2025
label.hg: cases mein StopNCII November 2025 tak support kar chuka tha

label.hg: India ki toll-free cyber crime helpline

label.hg: online bheji gayi police complaint (e-FIR) sign karne ka time, BNSS Section 173 ke under

claim.en: Once it is online, nothing can be done.
claim.hg: Ek baar online aa gaya toh ab kuch nahi ho sakta.

truth.en: Since 20 February 2026, platforms must remove nude, sexual or morphed images within two hours of your complaint, and hash tools can block re-uploads on partner platforms.
truth.hg: 20 February 2026 se platforms ko tumhari complaint ke 2 ghante ke andar nude, sexual ya morphed images hatani hoti hain, aur hash tools partner platforms pe re-uploads block kar sakte hain.

actions.en: Save every link, account name, date and time before you report. Never forward the image, and if it was taken when you were under 18, do not download or screenshot it.
actions.hg: Report karne se pehle har link, account name, date aur time save karo. Image kabhi forward mat karo, aur agar woh tumhari 18 se kam umar ki hai toh download ya screenshot bhi mat karo.

actions.en: Report each link to the platform under Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules and note the time. The platform has two hours.
actions.hg: Har link ko platform pe IT Rules ke Rule 3(2)(b) ke under report karo aur time note karo. Platform ke paas 2 ghante hain.

actions.en: Use StopNCII.org for images taken at 18 or older and Take It Down for images taken under 18.
actions.hg: 18 ya usse zyada umar mein li gayi image ke liye StopNCII.org, aur 18 se kam umar ki image ke liye Take It Down use karo.

actions.en: Call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in, then tell one person you trust.
actions.hg: 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint karo, phir kisi ek trusted insaan ko batao.

actions.en: If panic keeps coming back, call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Panic baar-baar laut raha ho toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo.

title.en: One recorded call, then a fake 'police' follow-up: inside India's video-call sextortion racket
title.hg: Ek recorded call, phir nakli 'police' ka phone: India ka video-call sextortion racket kaise chalta hai

dek.en: Police who have caught these gangs describe one method: a fake profile posing as a woman, a video call that is recorded, a demand for money, and sometimes a call from someone posing as police. Learn the script and it loses much of its power.
dek.hg: Aisi gangs pakadne wali police ek hi tareeka batati hai: ladki ban ke chalayi gayi fake profile, ek video call jo record ho jaati hai, paison ki demand, aur kabhi-kabhi khud ko police batane wale ka phone. Script pehchaan lo, toh iski bahut si taakat khatam ho jaati hai.

statLabel.hg: sextortion cases mein hi FIR register hoti hai, ek senior police officer ka 2022 ka andaaza

label.hg: pakde gaye logon mein minors the, jinki umar 14 se 16 saal thi

label.hg: complaint ke baad tumhari intimate images hatane ke liye platform ke paas bas itna time hai (20 February 2026 se)

actions.en: End the call, do not call back, and do not reply, negotiate or pay.
actions.hg: Call kaato, wapas call mat karo, aur na reply karo, na bargain karo, na pay karo.

actions.en: Before you block, save screenshots of the profile and chat, every number that called, and any UPI ID or bank detail.
actions.hg: Block karne se pehle profile aur chat ke screenshots, call karne wala har number, aur UPI ID ya bank detail save kar lo.

actions.en: Call 1930 or file a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in, and report the profile on the app.
actions.hg: 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint file karo, aur app pe bhi profile report karo.

actions.en: Hang up on any 'officer' who asks for money, then call your local police station yourself.
actions.hg: Jo 'officer' paise maange, uska phone kaato aur phir khud apne local police station ko call karo.

actions.en: If the clip appears online, report it to the platform: it must come down within two hours of your complaint.
actions.hg: Clip online dikhe toh platform pe report karo: tumhari complaint ke do ghante ke andar use hatana hoga.

title.en: If adults sext: the consent, storage and breakup rules that keep a private image private
title.hg: Agar adults sext karte hain: consent, storage aur breakup ke woh rules jo private image ko private rakhte hain

dek.en: For readers aged 18 and over. Indian law comes down on the person who passes on an intimate image, even one that was sent willingly, but it acts after the leak and cannot pull an image back. These are the rules for before you press send, and for the day trust breaks.
dek.hg: 18 saal aur usse upar ke readers ke liye. Indian law us insaan pe sakht hai jo intimate image aage bhejta hai, chahe woh image marzi se bheji gayi ho, lekin law leak ke baad kaam karta hai aur image wapas nahi la sakta. Yeh rules send dabane se pehle ke liye hain, aur us din ke liye jab bharosa toot jaaye.
