claim.en: You sent the photo yourself, so you gave up your rights over it.
claim.hg: Photo tumne khud bheji thi, toh us pe tumhara koi haq nahi raha.

truth.en: The law says the opposite. Under BNS Section 77, sharing a woman's private image without her consent is an offence even if she agreed to the image being taken, and IT Act Section 66E protects any person whose private-area image is captured or shared without consent.
truth.hg: Law iska ulta kehta hai. BNS Section 77 ke under kisi aurat ki private image uski consent ke bina share karna offence hai, chahe image lene ke liye usne haan kaha ho, aur IT Act Section 66E har us insaan ko protect karta hai jiske private area ki image bina consent capture ya share ki jaaye.

actions.en: Ask before you send, every time, and never forward, save or show an image beyond what the sender agreed to.
actions.hg: Bhejne se pehle har baar poocho, aur sender ne jitne ke liye haan kaha usse aage image ko forward, save ya kisi ko dikhao mat.

actions.en: Get on a live video call before sending anything to someone you have only met online.
actions.hg: Jisse sirf online mile ho, use kuch bhi bhejne se pehle live video call karo.

actions.en: Keep your face, tattoos, jewellery and room out of the frame, and switch off cloud backup for those images.
actions.hg: Chehra, tattoos, jewellery aur kamra frame se bahar rakho, aur un images ke liye cloud backup band karo.

actions.en: Agree in writing that images are deleted when either person asks, and ask again at a breakup.
actions.hg: Likh kar tay karo ki dono mein se koi bhi kahe toh images delete hongi, aur breakup pe dobara kaho.

actions.en: If an image leaks or someone threatens to leak it: create a case on StopNCII.org, report to the platform and call 1930.
actions.hg: Agar image leak ho jaaye ya koi leak karne ki dhamki de: StopNCII.org pe case banao, platform pe report karo aur 1930 pe call karo.

title.en: 22.68 lakh complaints, 1,01,928 FIRs: what actually happens after you report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in
title.hg: 22.68 lakh complaints, 1,01,928 FIRs: 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karne ke baad asal mein kya hota hai

dek.en: India's cyber crime portal was built in 2019 with women and children in mind. By 2024 it logged more than 20 complaints for every cyber crime FIR. Where a complaint goes, where it stalls, and how to file so that yours becomes a case.
dek.hg: India ka cyber crime portal 2019 mein women aur bachchon ko dhyaan mein rakh ke bana tha. 2024 tak is pe har cyber crime FIR ke muqable 20 se zyada complaints aa rahi thi. Complaint kahan jaati hai, kahan atakti hai, aur kaise file karo ki tumhari complaint case bane.

statLabel.en: complaints on India's cybercrime portal in 2024, against 1,01,928 cyber crime FIRs
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein India ke cybercrime portal pe aayi complaints, jabki cyber crime FIRs sirf 1,01,928 thi

label.en: complaints registered on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal in 2024, up from 4.52 lakh in 2021
label.hg: 2024 mein National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal pe register hui complaints; 2021 mein yeh 4.52 lakh thi

label.en: cyber crime cases (FIRs) registered by police in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein police ke register kiye cyber crime cases (FIRs)

label.en: complaints about child sexual abuse material and rape or gang-rape content filed on the portal by 30 April 2024
label.hg: 30 April 2024 tak portal pe child sexual abuse material aur rape ya gang-rape content ke baare mein file hui complaints

label.en: chargesheeting rate in cyber crime cases disposed of by police in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein police ke nipataye cyber crime cases mein chargesheet rate

claim.en: Once you file on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, a police case has started.
claim.hg: 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe file karte hi police case shuru ho jaata hai.

truth.en: A portal complaint is not an FIR. It goes to the police of the state concerned, who decide whether to register one. Ask for the FIR number, or file an e-FIR or Zero FIR yourself.
truth.hg: Portal complaint FIR nahi hai. Woh sambandhit state ki police ke paas jaati hai, aur wahi tay karti hai ki FIR register karni hai ya nahi. FIR number maango, ya khud e-FIR ya Zero FIR file karo.

actions.en: Before filing, put screenshots, links, account names, phone numbers, payment IDs and dates in one folder.
actions.hg: File karne se pehle screenshots, links, account names, phone numbers, payment IDs aur dates ek folder mein rakho.

actions.en: File on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930, and save the acknowledgement number.
actions.hg: cybercrime.gov.in pe file karo ya 1930 pe call karo, aur acknowledgement number save karo.

actions.en: Follow up in writing with the police handling it: ask whether an FIR has been registered, and its number.
actions.hg: Jo police case dekh rahi hai, unse likh ke poocho: FIR register hui ya nahi, aur uska number kya hai.

actions.en: If you want a criminal case, file an e-FIR and sign it within three days, or go to any police station for a Zero FIR.
actions.hg: Criminal case chahiye toh e-FIR file karo aur 3 din ke andar sign karo, ya Zero FIR ke liye kisi bhi police station jao.

actions.en: Once there is an FIR, ask for your free copy; police must update you on the investigation within 90 days.
actions.hg: FIR ho jaaye toh uski free copy maango; police ko 90 din ke andar tumhe investigation ka update dena hoga.

title.en: Fake image, real abuse: AI 'nudify' tools and the rise from 4,700 to more than 400,000 AI-linked reports
title.hg: Fake image, asli abuse: AI 'nudify' tools, aur AI se judi reports ka 4,700 se 400,000 ke paar ka uchhaal

dek.en: Reports involving generative AI received by the US child-protection centre NCMEC rose from about 4,700 in 2023 to more than 400,000 in 2025, and NCMEC has identified more than 275 children as victims of AI-generated abuse material. Why 'it isn't real' is no defence under Indian law, and how a target gets the image taken down.
dek.hg: US ke child-protection centre NCMEC tak pahunchi generative AI se judi reports 2023 mein lagbhag 4,700 thi; 2025 mein yeh 400,000 se zyada ho gayi, aur NCMEC 275 se zyada bachchon ko AI se bane abuse material ke victims ke roop mein pehchaan chuka hai. Indian law mein 'yeh asli nahi hai' koi bachav kyun nahi, aur target image kaise hatwa sakta hai, yahan padho.

statLabel.en: reports involving generative AI received by NCMEC in 2025, up from about 4,700 in 2023
statLabel.hg: reports jinme generative AI ka link tha, 2025 mein NCMEC tak pahunchi; 2023 mein yeh lagbhag 4,700 thi

label.en: reports involving generative AI received by NCMEC in 2025, up from about 4,700 in 2023 and 67,000 in 2024
label.hg: reports, yaani 4 lakh se zyada, jinme generative AI ka link tha, 2025 mein NCMEC tak pahunchi; 2023 mein yeh lagbhag 4,700 aur 2024 mein 67,000 thi

label.en: of those 2025 reports involved offenders possessing, generating or trying to generate AI-made child sexual abuse material
label.hg: 2025 ki un reports mein offenders AI se bana child sexual abuse material rakh rahe the, bana rahe the ya banane ki koshish kar rahe the

label.en: child victims of AI-generated sexual abuse material identified by NCMEC since 2023
label.hg: bachche jinhe NCMEC ne 2023 se AI se bane sexual abuse material ke victims ke roop mein pehchana

label.en: cases of 'defamation or morphing' against women registered by police in all of India in 2024
label.hg: 'defamation ya morphing' ke case jo 2024 mein poore India mein police ne auraton ke khilaaf darj kiye

claim.en: An AI nude is fake, so nobody is really harmed and there is nothing to report.
claim.hg: AI se bani nude photo fake hai, to kisi ka asli nuksaan nahi hua aur report karne layak kuch nahi hai.

truth.en: The face, the name and the humiliation belong to a real person. Indian rules have covered artificially morphed images since 2021, publishing sexually explicit material online can bring up to five years in prison on a first conviction, and platforms must remove such images within two hours of a complaint.
truth.hg: Chehra, naam aur beizzati ek asli insaan ki hoti hai. India ke rules 2021 se artificially morphed images ko cover karte hain, online sexually explicit material publish karne par pehli conviction par 5 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai, aur platforms ko complaint ke 2 ghante ke andar aisi images hatani hoti hain.

actions.en: Never forward a nudified image, not even to warn someone or to prove it is fake. Every forward is a new copy.
actions.hg: Nudified image kabhi forward mat karo, kisi ko warn karne ya use fake prove karne ke liye bhi nahi. Har forward ek nayi copy hai.

actions.en: Report it to the platform as an 'artificially morphed image' and ask for removal within two hours. A friend can complain on the target's behalf.
actions.hg: Platform par use 'artificially morphed image' bata kar report karo aur 2 ghante mein removal maango. Target ki taraf se koi dost bhi complaint kar sakta hai.

actions.en: Note the links, usernames, group names and dates, then call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Links, usernames, group ke naam aur dates note kar lo, phir 1930 par call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in par complaint karo.

actions.en: If the person shown is under 18, say so in every complaint and call the Child Helpline 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar image mein dikhne wala 18 se chhota hai, to har complaint mein yeh likho aur Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call karo.

actions.en: If someone offers you a 'nudify' app or link, report it to the platform instead of trying it 'as a joke'.
actions.hg: Agar koi tumhe 'nudify' app ya link de, to use 'mazaak mein' try karne ki jagah platform par report karo.

title.en: Can police wait 14 days before registering your cyber complaint? BNSS Section 173(3) and online sexual offences, answered
title.hg: Kya police tumhari cyber complaint register karne se pehle 14 din ruk sakti hai? BNSS Section 173(3) aur online sexual offences, sawaal-jawaab mein

dek.en: In 2013 the Supreme Court said a complaint about a cognizable offence must become an FIR, with no enquiry first. Since July 2024 the BNSS lets police check first for offences in the three-to-seven-year band, which is where most online sexual crimes sit. What the 14 days allow, what they do not, and how to use them.
dek.hg: 2013 mein Supreme Court ne kaha tha ki cognizable offence ki complaint seedha FIR banegi, pehle koi enquiry nahi. July 2024 se BNSS police ko teen se saat saal wale band ke offences mein pehle jaanch karne deta hai, aur zyada tar online sexual crimes isi band mein aate hain. Yeh 14 din kya allow karte hain, kya nahi, aur inka istemaal kaise karein.

statLabel.en: maximum preliminary enquiry before police register offences punishable with 3 to under 7 years
statLabel.hg: tak ki preliminary enquiry, jo police 3 se 7 saal se kam saza wale offences register karne se pehle kar sakti hai

label.en: the longest preliminary enquiry police may hold, with a Deputy Superintendent's prior permission, for offences punishable with 3 to under 7 years
label.hg: sabse lambi preliminary enquiry jo police, Deputy Superintendent ki pehle se di gayi permission ke saath, 3 se 7 saal se kam saza wale offences mein kar sakti hai

label.en: maximum jail on first conviction for transmitting sexually explicit material under IT Act Section 67A, which puts it inside the window
label.hg: IT Act Section 67A ke under sexually explicit material bhejne pe first conviction mein maximum jail, isliye yeh offence window ke andar aata hai

label.en: FIRs registered under IT Act Section 67A in 2024; complaints held in an enquiry are not counted
label.hg: FIRs 2024 mein IT Act Section 67A ke under register hui; enquiry mein atki complaints is ginti mein nahi aati

label.en: within which police must tell the victim how the investigation is progressing
label.hg: ke andar police ko victim ko batana hota hai ki investigation kahan tak pahunchi

claim.en: Police can keep 'verifying' an online harassment complaint for as long as they like before filing an FIR.
claim.hg: Online harassment ki complaint ko police FIR se pehle jitna chahe utna 'verify' karti reh sakti hai.

truth.en: A delay is lawful only as a preliminary enquiry under Section 173(3) BNSS: the offence must carry three to under seven years, an officer of at least Deputy Superintendent rank must approve it in advance, and it cannot run past 14 days.
truth.hg: Delay sirf Section 173(3) BNSS ki preliminary enquiry ke roop mein legal hai: offence ki saza teen se saat saal se kam ho, kam se kam Deputy Superintendent rank ka officer pehle se approve kare, aur enquiry 14 din se zyada na chale.

actions.en: Hand in a written, signed complaint with screenshots, links and usernames, and ask for a stamped receiving copy.
actions.hg: Likhi hui, sign ki hui complaint do, saath mein screenshots, links aur usernames, aur stamp lagi receiving copy maango.

actions.en: If told 'enquiry first', ask which Deputy Superintendent approved it, on what date, and when the 14 days end. Write the answers down.
actions.hg: Agar kaha jaaye 'pehle enquiry hogi', toh poocho kis Deputy Superintendent ne approve kiya, kis date ko, aur 14 din kab khatam honge. Jawab likh lo.

actions.en: Report the content to the platform and on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in the same day; takedown does not wait for the FIR.
actions.hg: Usi din content platform pe aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo; takedown FIR ka intezaar nahi karta.

actions.en: When the 14 days are up, go back or write to the station and ask for the FIR, or for the enquiry's result in writing.
actions.hg: 14 din poore hone pe station wapas jao ya likh kar FIR maango, ya enquiry ka result likhit mein maango.

actions.en: If the station still refuses, write to the Superintendent of Police under Section 173(4) BNSS, then approach a magistrate.
actions.hg: Agar station phir bhi mana kare, toh Section 173(4) BNSS ke under Superintendent of Police ko likho, phir magistrate ke paas jao.

title.en: She agreed to the photo, not the forward: BNS Section 77's Explanation 2 and the rules of digital consent
title.hg: Usne photo ke liye haan kaha tha, forward ke liye nahi: BNS Section 77 ka Explanation 2 aur digital consent ke rules

dek.en: Indian law says a woman's yes to an intimate photo is not a yes to sharing it. The one sentence that does it, what the 2024 numbers show, and the rules of digital consent anyone with a phone can follow.
dek.hg: Indian law kehta hai ki kisi woman ka intimate photo ke liye haan, use share karne ke liye haan nahi hai. Woh ek sentence jo yeh kehta hai, 2024 ke numbers kya dikhate hain, aur digital consent ke woh rules jo phone rakhne wala koi bhi follow kar sakta hai.

statLabel.en: voyeurism cases registered in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: voyeurism cases 2024 mein India mein register hue

label.en: voyeurism cases registered in India in 2024, under the old IPC section and the new BNS Section 77 together
label.hg: voyeurism cases 2024 mein India mein register hue, purane IPC section aur naye BNS Section 77 ko milakar

label.en: cases in 2024 under IT Act Section 66E, which covers capturing or sharing images of a private area without consent
label.hg: cases 2024 mein IT Act Section 66E ke under, jo bina consent private area ki images capture ya share karne ko cover karta hai

label.en: in prison on first conviction for voyeurism under BNS Section 77; 3 to 7 years on a repeat
label.hg: ki jail, BNS Section 77 ke under voyeurism mein pehli conviction pe; dobara conviction pe 3 se 7 saal

claim.en: She sent me the photo herself, so I can do what I like with it.
claim.hg: Photo usne khud bheji thi, toh main uske saath jo chahe kar sakta hoon.

truth.en: Under Explanation 2 to Section 77 of the BNS, agreeing to an image being captured is not agreeing to its being shared. Sharing it without her consent is voyeurism, punishable with 1 to 3 years in prison on first conviction.
truth.hg: BNS ke Section 77 ke Explanation 2 ke hisaab se image lene ke liye haan kehna, use share karne ke liye haan kehna nahi hai. Uske consent ke bina share karna voyeurism hai, jiski pehli conviction pe 1 se 3 saal ki jail hai.

actions.en: Ask before you take an intimate photo, every time, and delete it when the person asks.
actions.hg: Intimate photo lene se pehle har baar poocho, aur jab woh insaan kahe, photo delete kar do.

actions.en: Never share an intimate image without a clear yes from the person in it, for that share, to that person.
actions.hg: Kisi intimate image ko tab tak kabhi share mat karo jab tak usme dikh rahe insaan ka us share ke liye, us insaan ke liye, clear haan na ho.

actions.en: If someone forwards you one, don't pass it on or keep it: report the post, and tell the person in it if you can do so kindly.
actions.hg: Agar koi tumhe aisi image forward kare, toh na aage bhejo, na rakho: post report karo, aur ho sake toh image wale insaan ko aaram se batao.

actions.en: If your image was shared, call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in, and report every copy to the platform, which now has two hours to remove it.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari image share hui hai, toh 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint karo, aur har copy platform pe report karo, jiske paas ab use hatane ke liye do ghante hain.

title.en: 18,615 cyber crimes against women in 2024, and 14,004 of them filed under 'other': how to read NCRB's table
title.hg: 2024 mein women ke against 18,615 cyber crimes, aur unme se 14,004 'other' mein: NCRB ki table kaise padhein

dek.en: NCRB's cyber crime table names six kinds of online harm against women, from morphing to fake profiles. Most of the 2024 cases fit none of them. How to read the table, what it hides, and what a useful one would show.
dek.hg: NCRB ki cyber crime table women ke against online harm ki chhe categories ke naam leti hai, morphing se lekar fake profiles tak. 2024 ke zyada tar cases inme se kisi mein fit nahi hote. Table kaise padhein, yeh kya chhupati hai, aur ek useful table kya dikhaati.

statLabel.en: cyber crimes against women registered in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: cyber crimes 2024 mein India mein women ke against register hue

label.en: cyber crimes against women registered by police in India in 2024
label.hg: cyber crimes 2024 mein India mein police ne women ke against register kiye

label.en: of those cases filed under 'other crimes against women', with no breakdown
label.hg: cases inme se 'other crimes against women' mein file hue, bina kisi breakdown ke

label.en: cyber crimes against women registered in 2023, up from 14,409 in 2022
label.hg: cyber crimes against women 2023 mein register hue, jabki 2022 mein 14,409 the

claim.en: Cyber crimes against women fell in 2024, so women were safer online.
claim.hg: 2024 mein women ke against cyber crimes kam hue, matlab women online zyada safe thi.

truth.en: Registered cases dipped from 19,510 to 18,615, but NCRB counts police FIRs, not harm, and warns that more or fewer registrations is not the same as more or less crime. Most cases sit in a column it does not explain.
truth.hg: Registered cases 19,510 se 18,615 hue, par NCRB police FIRs ginta hai, harm nahi, aur khud warning deta hai ki registration kam ya zyada hona crime kam ya zyada hone jaisa nahi hai. Zyada tar cases ek aise column mein hain jise woh explain hi nahi karta.

actions.en: Report online abuse on 1930 or at cybercrime.gov.in, even if you mainly want it taken down: what is never reported is never counted.
actions.hg: Online abuse 1930 pe ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo, chahe tumhe bas content hatwana ho: jo kabhi report nahi hota, woh kabhi gina nahi jaata.

actions.en: Describe every part of what happened, such as the morphed photo, the fake profile and the threat, so each harm is on record.
actions.hg: Jo hua uska har hissa batao, jaise morphed photo, fake profile aur dhamki, taaki har harm record mein aaye.

actions.en: Ask which sections were applied in the FIR, and keep the free copy you are entitled to.
actions.hg: Poocho ki FIR mein kaun se sections lage, aur uski free copy apne paas rakho, jo tumhara haq hai.

actions.en: When you quote 18,615, say it counts police FIRs, not the number of women harmed online.
actions.hg: Jab 18,615 quote karo, toh saath mein batao ki yeh police FIRs ki ginti hai, online harm jhelne wali women ki nahi.

actions.en: Ask your MP to press NCRB to break up the 'other' column and count intimate images shared without consent.
actions.hg: Apne MP se kaho ki NCRB pe zor daalein ki 'other' column ko tod kar dikhaya jaaye aur bina consent share hui intimate images alag gini jaayein.

title.en: 1,240 cyberstalking FIRs, 33 convictions: why India's falling cyberstalking numbers are not good news
title.hg: 1,240 cyberstalking FIRs, 33 convictions: India mein cyberstalking ke girte aankde achhi khabar kyun nahi hain

dek.en: Registered cases of cyber stalking or bullying of women and children fell for two years running, to 1,240 in 2024, while cyber crime FIRs overall kept rising. In court, 33 cases ended in conviction and 95.3% were still pending. A falling number here measures registration, not safety. What it hides, and how to build a case that lasts.
dek.hg: Auraton aur bachchon ki cyber stalking ya bullying ke darj case lagatar do saal gire aur 2024 mein 1,240 reh gaye, jabki cyber crime ki kul FIRs badhti rahin. Court mein sirf 33 case conviction tak pahunche aur 95.3% abhi bhi pending the. Yahan girta number safety nahi, registration naapta hai. Yeh kya chhupata hai, aur aisa case kaise banaya jaye jo tike, yahan padho.

statLabel.en: cyberstalking and bullying FIRs (women and children) in 2024, down from 1,471 in 2022
statLabel.hg: auraton aur bachchon ki cyberstalking aur bullying ki FIRs 2024 mein; 2022 mein yeh 1,471 thi

label.en: FIRs for cyber stalking or bullying of women and children in 2024, down from 1,471 in 2022
label.hg: 2024 mein auraton aur bachchon ki cyber stalking ya bullying ki FIRs; 2022 mein yeh 1,471 thi

label.en: cyber crime FIRs of all kinds in 2024, up 17.9% on 2023
label.hg: 2024 mein har tarah ke cyber crime ki FIRs, 2023 se 17.9% zyada

label.en: convictions in 2024 among 4,348 cyberstalking and bullying cases before Indian courts
label.hg: convictions 2024 mein, un 4,348 cyberstalking aur bullying cases mein jo Indian courts ke saamne the

label.en: of those court cases were still pending at the end of 2024
label.hg: un court cases mein se 2024 ke end tak pending the

claim.en: Fewer cyberstalking cases means fewer people are being stalked online.
claim.hg: Cyberstalking ke kam case ka matlab hai ki online kam log stalk ho rahe hain.

truth.en: The count measures FIRs, not stalking. Cyber crime FIRs overall rose every year from 2022 to 2024 while cyberstalking FIRs fell, and surveys have long found harassment far more common than police records show.
truth.hg: Yeh ginti FIRs ki hai, stalking ki nahi. 2022 se 2024 tak cyber crime ki kul FIRs har saal badhin jabki cyberstalking ki FIRs girin, aur surveys lambe samay se dikhate aaye hain ki harassment police records se kahin zyada hota hai.

actions.en: Keep a dated log of every contact: platform, account name, profile link, time, what was said, and each new account after a block.
actions.hg: Har contact ka dated log rakho: platform, account ka naam, profile link, time, kya kaha gaya, aur block ke baad bana har naya account.

actions.en: Screenshot with the date, time and profile link visible, and back the files up somewhere the stalker cannot reach.
actions.hg: Screenshot aise lo ki date, time aur profile link dikhe, aur files ka backup aisi jagah rakho jahan stalker na pahunch sake.

actions.en: Report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, or file a Zero FIR at any police station, and ask for your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo, ya kisi bhi police station mein Zero FIR darj karao, aur FIR ki free copy maango.

actions.en: Keep your phone, or a full backup of it, until the case ends: in 2024, 95.3% of cyberstalking cases in court were still pending at year-end.
actions.hg: Case khatam hone tak apna phone ya uska poora backup sambhal kar rakho: 2024 mein court mein cyberstalking ke 95.3% case saal ke end tak pending the.

actions.en: If a friend is being stalked online, help them keep the log instead of telling them to 'just ignore it'.
actions.hg: Agar kisi dost ko online stalk kiya ja raha hai, to use 'ignore kar do' kehne ki jagah log banane mein uski madad karo.

title.en: Matched, moved to WhatsApp, then the ask: a dating-app safety guide built on India's crime data
title.hg: Match hua, WhatsApp pe shift hue, phir aayi demand: India ke crime data par bani ek dating-app safety guide

dek.en: Police data cannot tell a dating-app match from a college friend, but it shows how much harm comes from people a survivor had come to trust. The script catfishers follow, the new law on sex by deceit, and the habits that stop a match from turning into a case.
dek.hg: Police data ek dating-app match aur college friend mein farak nahi kar sakta, lekin yeh zaroor dikhata hai ki kitna harm unse aata hai jin par survivor bharosa karne lagi thi. Catfishers ki script, dhokhe se sex par naya law, aur woh habits jo ek match ko case banne se rokti hain.

statLabel.hg: 2024 ke rape cases jahan accused friend, online friend, partner ya alag reh raha husband tha

label.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a friend, online friend, live-in partner 'on the pretext of marriage' or separated husband, the largest group of known accused
label.hg: 2024 ke rape cases jahan accused friend, online friend, 'shaadi ke bahane' live-in partner ya alag reh raha husband tha; known accused ka sabse bada group

label.hg: BNS Section 69 (dhokhe se ya shaadi ke jhoothe vaade se sex) ke cases, uske pehle chhe mahine mein, July se December 2024

label.hg: 2024 mein Section 69 ke woh cases jo police ne cyber crime ke roop mein darj kiye

label.en: of 6,000+ young people surveyed in six countries including India said they or their friends were targeted through catfishing or hacking (2023)
label.hg: India samet chhe deshon ke 6,000+ young logon mein se itnon ne kaha ki unhe ya unke friends ko catfishing ya hacking se target kiya gaya (2023)

claim.en: We've chatted every day for weeks, so I know who this person is.
claim.hg: Hum hafton se roz baat kar rahe hain, toh mujhe pata hai yeh kaun hai.

truth.en: Weeks of chat prove only that someone is patient. Catfishing works because the profile feels real. A live video call and a meeting in a public place come before trust, not after it.
truth.hg: Hafton ki chatting sirf itna saabit karti hai ki saamne wala patient hai. Catfishing isliye kaam karti hai kyunki profile real lagti hai. Live video call aur public jagah par milna bharose se pehle aata hai, baad mein nahi.

actions.en: Keep the chat on the dating app until you have seen the person on a live video call.
actions.hg: Jab tak live video call par insaan ko dekh na lein, chat dating app par hi rakhiye.

actions.en: Meet first in a busy public place, travel there on your own, and send a friend the profile, place and time.
actions.hg: Pehli baar kisi bheed wali public jagah par miliye, wahan khud jaiye, aur ek friend ko profile, jagah aur time bhej dijiye.

actions.en: Never send money, OTPs or intimate images to someone you have not met, whatever the story.
actions.hg: Jisse kabhi mile nahi, use paisa, OTP ya intimate photos kabhi mat bhejiye, kahani chahe jo ho.

actions.en: If you are threatened, don't pay: save the chats, numbers and payment IDs, then call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Agar dhamki mile toh pay mat kijiye: chats, numbers aur payment IDs save kijiye, phir 1930 par call kijiye ya cybercrime.gov.in par complaint kijiye.

actions.en: If you are assaulted or in danger, call 112; you can file a complaint at any police station.
actions.hg: Agar assault hua ho ya khatra ho, toh 112 par call kijiye; complaint kisi bhi police station mein ho sakti hai.

title.en: 'Night Play', 'Reloop', 'Kyss': the porn-app ads that I4C says hijack Android phones, and what to do if you installed one
title.hg: 'Night Play', 'Reloop', 'Kyss': woh porn-app ads jo I4C ke mutabiq Android phones hijack karte hain, aur agar tumne install kar liya toh kya karna hai

dek.en: In August 2026 India's cyber crime agency warned that fake pornography apps, pushed through Facebook and Instagram ads, take over Android phones to steal money. How the trap works, the red flags before you tap install, and the first steps if the app is already on your phone.
dek.hg: August 2026 mein India ki cyber crime agency ne warning di ki nakli pornography apps, jo Facebook aur Instagram ads ke zariye failaye ja rahe hain, Android phones pe kabza karke paise churate hain. Yeh jaal kaise kaam karta hai, install dabane se pehle ke red flags, aur agar app pehle se phone mein hai toh pehle steps.

statLabel.en: of India's cyber crime FIRs in 2024 had fraud as the motive
statLabel.hg: India ki 2024 ki cyber crime FIRs jinmein motive fraud tha

label.en: of India's 1,01,928 cyber crime FIRs in 2024 had fraud as the motive (73,987 cases)
label.hg: India ki 2024 ki 1,01,928 cyber crime FIRs mein se itni mein motive fraud tha (73,987 cases)

label.en: complaints on the national cyber crime portal in 2024, most of them about financial fraud
label.hg: complaints jo 2024 mein national cyber crime portal pe aayi, zyada tar financial fraud ki

label.en: India's toll-free cyber crime helpline: call it as soon as money leaves your account
label.hg: India ki toll-free cyber crime helpline: account se paise nikalte hi call karo

claim.en: If an app is advertised on Instagram or Facebook, the platform must have checked it.
claim.hg: Agar koi app Instagram ya Facebook pe advertise ho raha hai, toh platform ne use check kiya hi hoga.

truth.en: I4C's August 2026 advisory is about fake pornography apps promoted through Facebook and Instagram ads. An ad is paid placement, not a safety check.
truth.hg: I4C ki August 2026 ki advisory unhi nakli pornography apps ke baare mein hai jo Facebook aur Instagram ads se promote hue. Ad paise dekar li gayi jagah hai, safety check nahi.

actions.en: Install apps only from the official app store, never from an ad, a link or a file someone sends you.
actions.hg: Apps sirf official app store se install karo, kabhi kisi ad, link ya kisi ki bheji hui file se nahi.

actions.en: Refuse any app that asks for accessibility access, SMS access or device-admin rights it has no reason to need.
actions.hg: Jo app accessibility access, SMS access ya device-admin rights maange aur uske paas iski koi wajah na ho, use mana kar do.

actions.en: If you installed one: go offline, call your bank from another phone, then call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Agar install kar liya hai: offline ho jao, doosre phone se apne bank ko call karo, phir 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint file karo.

actions.en: Screenshot the app name, the ad and every transaction alert before you uninstall or reset the phone.
actions.hg: Uninstall ya reset karne se pehle app ke naam, ad aur har transaction alert ka screenshot le lo.

actions.en: Tell someone and report it. For an adult, looking for adult content is not an offence. The fraud is.
actions.hg: Kisi ko batao aur report karo. Kisi adult ka adult content dhoondhna offence nahi hai. Fraud offence hai.

title.en: Someone made a fake profile of you: how to get it taken down under the IT Rules' impersonation clause
title.hg: Kisi ne tumhari fake profile bana di: IT Rules ke impersonation clause se use kaise hatwayein

dek.en: Police recorded 114 fake-profile cases against women in all of India in 2024. The faster fix is not an FIR: Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules lets you demand removal of an account that impersonates you, and since February 2026 the platform has two hours. Here is the order of steps.
dek.hg: 2024 mein poore India mein police ne women ke khilaaf fake profile ke sirf 114 cases darj kiye. Sabse tez raasta FIR nahin hai: IT Rules ka Rule 3(2)(b) tumhe us account ko hatwane ka haq deta hai jo tumhari nakal karta hai, aur February 2026 se platform ke paas do ghante hain. Yeh rahe steps, sahi order mein.

statLabel.en: fake-profile cases against women registered by police in all of India in 2024
statLabel.hg: fake profile cases women ke khilaaf 2024 mein poore India mein police ne darj kiye

label.en: fake-profile cases against women registered by police in all of India in 2024
label.hg: fake profile cases women ke khilaaf 2024 mein poore India mein police ne darj kiye

label.en: for a platform to remove content impersonating you after your complaint, since 20 February 2026 (was 24 hours)
label.hg: mein platform ko tumhari complaint ke baad tumhari nakal karne wala content hatana hoga, 20 February 2026 se (pehle 24 ghante)

label.en: for a platform to resolve other user grievances (was 15 days)
label.hg: mein platform ko baaki user grievances suljhaani hongi (pehle 15 din)

label.en: of teens and young adults in a 2023 six-country survey including India said they or their friends were targeted through catfishing or hacking
label.hg: teens aur young adults ne, India samet chhe deshon ke 2023 ke survey mein, kaha ki unhe ya unke doston ko catfishing ya hacking se target kiya gaya

claim.en: A platform won't remove a fake profile of you unless the police or a court asks it to.
claim.hg: Jab tak police ya court na kahe, platform tumhari fake profile nahin hatayega.

truth.en: Under Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules, your own complaint, or one made on your behalf, is enough for content that impersonates you, and since 20 February 2026 the platform has two hours to act.
truth.hg: IT Rules ke Rule 3(2)(b) ke under, tumhari nakal karne wale content ke liye tumhari apni complaint, ya tumhari taraf se kisi aur ki complaint, kaafi hai, aur 20 February 2026 se platform ke paas action lene ke liye do ghante hain.

actions.en: Screenshot the fake profile, its username and link, and every post or message, before you report it.
actions.hg: Report karne se pehle fake profile, uske username aur link, aur har post ya message ka screenshot lo.

actions.en: Report it through the platform's impersonation form and write: 'Rule 3(2)(b), IT Rules: this account impersonates me', with every link.
actions.hg: Platform ke impersonation form se report karo aur likho: 'Rule 3(2)(b), IT Rules: this account impersonates me', har link ke saath.

actions.en: Note the time. If the profile is still up after two hours, write to the platform's grievance officer with that record.
actions.hg: Time note karo. Do ghante baad bhi profile dikhe, toh us record ke saath platform ke grievance officer ko likho.

actions.en: Ask friends to report it too: the rule lets anyone complain on your behalf.
actions.hg: Doston se bhi report karwao: rule ke hisaab se tumhari taraf se koi bhi complaint kar sakta hai.

actions.en: If the profile is used to threaten, extort or defame you, file at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930, and save the acknowledgement number.
actions.hg: Agar profile se tumhe dhamkaya, blackmail ya badnaam kiya ja raha hai, toh cybercrime.gov.in par complaint karo ya 1930 par call karo, aur acknowledgement number save karo.

title.en: When the victim is a man or a trans person: which laws cover leaked intimate images, and where the BNS falls short
title.hg: Jab victim ek man ya trans person ho: leaked intimate images par kaun se laws lagte hain, aur BNS kahan peeche reh jaata hai

dek.en: The criminal code's offence for sharing a private image without consent protects women only. A man or a transgender person in the same position has to rely on the IT Act, the takedown rules and one weak section of the Transgender Persons Act. Here is what each one covers.
dek.hg: Bina consent ke private image share karne par criminal code ka jo offence hai, woh sirf women ko protect karta hai. Usi haalat mein ek man ya transgender person ko IT Act, takedown rules aur Transgender Persons Act ke ek kamzor section ka sahara lena padta hai. Yahan dekhiye ki kaun sa law kya cover karta hai.

cover.stat: Up to 3 years or Rs 2 lakh

statLabel.en: in prison or as a fine, or both: the penalty under IT Act Section 66E, which protects any person, not only women
statLabel.hg: jail ya fine, ya dono: IT Act Section 66E ki penalty, jo sirf women ko nahi, kisi bhi person ko protect karta hai

label.en: prison on first conviction under BNS Section 77, which covers only images of women
label.hg: BNS Section 77 mein pehli conviction par jail; yeh section sirf women ki images cover karta hai

label.en: prison, a fine of up to Rs 2 lakh, or both, under IT Act Section 66E, which protects 'any person'
label.hg: jail, Rs 2 lakh tak fine, ya dono, IT Act Section 66E ke tahat, jo 'any person' ko protect karta hai

label.en: penalty for sexual abuse of a transgender person under Section 18(d) of the Transgender Persons Act, unchanged by the 2026 amendment
label.hg: transgender person ke sexual abuse ki penalty, Transgender Persons Act ke Section 18(d) mein; 2026 ke amendment ne ise nahi badla

label.en: time a platform has to remove a nude, sexual or morphed image after a complaint by the person shown, whatever their gender
label.hg: itne time mein platform ko nude, sexual ya morphed image hatani hoti hai, image mein dikh rahe insaan ki complaint ke baad, gender chahe jo ho

claim.en: The new criminal code is gender-neutral, so a man or a trans person whose intimate image is leaked has the same protection as a woman.
claim.hg: Naya criminal code gender-neutral hai, isliye jis man ya trans person ki intimate image leak hui, use wahi protection milti hai jo ek woman ko.

truth.en: BNS Section 77 covers only images of women. Men and transgender people have to use IT Act Section 66E and the takedown rules, and transgender people also Section 18(d) of the Transgender Persons Act, all with lighter penalties.
truth.hg: BNS Section 77 sirf women ki images cover karta hai. Men aur transgender logon ko IT Act Section 66E aur takedown rules use karne padte hain, aur transgender logon ko Transgender Persons Act ka Section 18(d) bhi; in sab mein penalty halki hai.

actions.en: If your intimate image is captured or shared without consent, name IT Act Section 66E in your complaint: it protects any person.
actions.hg: Agar aapki intimate image bina consent ke li ya share ki gayi hai, toh complaint mein IT Act Section 66E ka naam likhiye: yeh kisi bhi person ko protect karta hai.

actions.en: Add Section 67 or 67A if the image was posted or forwarded, and Section 18(d) of the Transgender Persons Act if you are transgender.
actions.hg: Agar image post ya forward hui hai toh Section 67 ya 67A jodiye, aur agar aap transgender hain toh Transgender Persons Act ka Section 18(d) bhi.

actions.en: Report every copy to the platform: it has two hours to remove a nude, sexual or morphed image after your complaint.
actions.hg: Har copy platform ko report kijiye: complaint ke baad nude, sexual ya morphed image hatane ke liye uske paas do ghante hain.

actions.en: File at cybercrime.gov.in, call 1930, or go to any police station, and ask for your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: cybercrime.gov.in par complaint kijiye, 1930 par call kijiye, ya kisi bhi police station jaiye, aur FIR ki free copy maangiye.

actions.en: Under 18? Tell an adult you trust or call 1098: POCSO protects every child, whatever their gender.
actions.hg: 18 se kam umar hai? Kisi bharosemand adult ko bataiye ya 1098 par call kijiye: POCSO har child ko protect karta hai, gender chahe jo ho.

title.en: India's deepfake rules, explained: what 'synthetically generated information' means and what platforms now owe you
title.hg: India ke deepfake rules, simple bhasha mein: 'synthetically generated information' ka matlab kya hai aur platforms ab tumhare liye kya karne ko majboor hain

dek.en: Since February 2026, Indian rules define AI-made content that passes for real. AI tools must refuse to make fake nudes and child sexual abuse material and label other synthetic content, and platforms must act within hours. What the rules say, where they are weak, and what you can demand.
dek.hg: February 2026 se India ke rules us AI content ko define karte hain jo asli jaisa dikhta hai. AI tools ko fake nudes aur child sexual abuse material banane se saaf mana karna hoga, baaki synthetic content par label lagana hoga, aur platforms ko kuch hi ghanton mein action lena hoga. Rules kya kehte hain, kahan weak hain aur tum kya demand kar sakte ho.

statLabel.en: hours to remove unlawful content after a court order or authorised government notice, since February 2026
statLabel.hg: ghante: court order ya authorised government notice ke baad unlawful content hatane ki deadline, February 2026 se

label.en: hours a platform gets to remove unlawful content after a court order or authorised government notice (since 20 February 2026)
label.hg: ghante milte hain platform ko court order ya authorised government notice ke baad unlawful content hatane ke liye (20 February 2026 se)

label.en: minimum share of the screen the October 2025 draft wanted AI labels to cover; the final rules dropped the fixed size
label.hg: screen ka kam se kam itna hissa AI label ko cover karna tha, October 2025 ke draft ke hisaab se; final rules ne yeh fixed size hata diya

label.en: reports with a generative-AI link made to the US child-protection centre NCMEC in 2025, up from about 4,700 in 2023
label.hg: reports, yaani 4 lakh se zyada, jinme generative AI ka link tha, 2025 mein US ke child-protection centre NCMEC tak pahunchi; 2023 mein yeh lagbhag 4,700 thi

claim.en: It is fake, so it is not a real crime and nobody has to take it down.
claim.hg: Photo fake hai, to yeh asli crime nahi, aur ise hatane ki zimmedari kisi ki nahi.

truth.en: Fakes are covered. The IT Rules have named artificially morphed images since 2021, platforms must now remove them within two hours of your complaint, and publishing sexually explicit material online can be a crime under Section 67A of the IT Act.
truth.hg: Fake bhi cover hote hain. IT Rules 2021 se artificially morphed images ka naam lete hain, platforms ko ab tumhari complaint ke 2 ghante ke andar unhe hatana hota hai, aur sexually explicit material online publish karna IT Act ke Section 67A ke under crime ho sakta hai.

actions.en: Report a fake nude or sexual image of you to the platform as an artificially morphed image, and ask for removal within two hours.
actions.hg: Apni fake nude ya sexual image dikhe to platform par use 'artificially morphed image' bata kar report karo, aur 2 ghante mein removal maango.

actions.en: Call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in. Keep links, usernames and dates, not copies of the image.
actions.hg: 1930 par call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in par complaint karo. Links, usernames aur dates sambhal kar rakho, image ki copies nahi.

actions.en: If the person shown is under 18, say so in every complaint: creating or sharing a sexual image of a child, even a fake one, is punishable under Section 67B of the IT Act.
actions.hg: Agar image mein dikhne wala 18 se chhota hai, to har complaint mein yeh likho: kisi bachche ki sexual image banana ya share karna, chahe woh fake ho, IT Act ke Section 67B ke under punishable hai.

actions.en: Before you share a viral clip of a real person, look for an AI label. If it seems fake and carries none, report it instead of forwarding it.
actions.hg: Kisi asli insaan ka viral clip share karne se pehle AI label dekho. Agar fake lage aur label na ho, to forward karne ki jagah report karo.

actions.en: Never forward a fake image to prove it is fake. Every forward is another copy.
actions.hg: Fake image ko fake prove karne ke liye bhi forward mat karo. Har forward ek nayi copy hai.

title.en: No crime head, no count: why India cannot say how much sextortion it has (NCRB 2022-2024)
title.hg: Na koi column, na koi count: India kyun nahi bata sakta ki yahan kitna sextortion hota hai (NCRB 2022-2024)

dek.en: Sextortion has no column in Crime in India. Cases scatter across police 'motives', IT Act sections and a cyber-blackmail line that logged 601 FIRs in 2024, while reports elsewhere keep climbing. Here is where the crime disappears, and what India should count instead.
dek.hg: Crime in India mein sextortion ka koi column hi nahi hai. Cases police ke 'motive' wale khaanon, IT Act ki sections aur ek cyber-blackmail line mein bikhar jaate hain, jismein 2024 mein 601 FIR darj hui, jabki baaki duniya mein reports badhti ja rahi hain. Padho yeh crime kahan gayab hota hai, aur India ko asal mein kya ginna chahiye.

statLabel.en: cases of cyber blackmailing or threatening registered in all of India in 2024
statLabel.hg: cyber blackmailing ya threatening ke cases, jo 2024 mein poore India mein register hue

label.en: cyber blackmailing or threatening cases registered in India in 2024
label.hg: cyber blackmailing ya threatening ke cases, jo 2024 mein India mein register hue

label.en: cyber crimes recorded with a 'sexual exploitation' motive in 2024, down from 4,199 in 2023
label.hg: cyber crimes jinka motive 2024 mein 'sexual exploitation' likha gaya; 2023 mein yeh count 4,199 tha

label.en: reports of financial sextortion of children received by the US-based NCMEC in 2025, from around the world
label.hg: bachchon ke financial sextortion ki reports, jo 2025 mein duniya bhar se US ki sanstha NCMEC ko mili

claim.en: Fewer sextortion cases in police data means the crime is shrinking.
claim.hg: Police data mein sextortion ke cases kam hue, matlab yeh crime ghat raha hai.

truth.en: India's police data have no sextortion category at all. Cases are scattered across other heads, so a fall can reflect how cases were coded, not how many happened.
truth.hg: India ke police data mein sextortion ki koi category hi nahi hai. Cases doosre khaanon mein bikhre rehte hain, isliye number girne ka matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ki cases likhne ka tareeka badla hai, crime nahi ghata.

actions.en: If you are being blackmailed, report it on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in: a crime nobody reports is never counted.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe blackmail kiya ja raha hai, toh 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo: jis crime ki report nahi hoti, woh kabhi gina nahi jaata.

actions.en: When you file, describe both the sexual threat and the money demand, so the record shows what really happened.
actions.hg: Complaint mein sexual dhamki aur paison ki demand, dono saaf likho, taaki record mein asli baat aaye.

actions.en: Keep your complaint's acknowledgement number, and ask whether an FIR was registered.
actions.hg: Apni complaint ka acknowledgement number sambhal ke rakho, aur poochho ki FIR register hui ya nahi.

actions.en: When you quote '500 a day' or '0.5%', say it is one police officer's 2022 estimate, not official data.
actions.hg: 'Roz 500 cases' ya '0.5%' share karo, toh saath mein batao ki yeh ek police officer ka 2022 ka andaaza hai, official data nahi.

actions.en: Ask your MP or MLA why Crime in India has no sextortion category.
actions.hg: Apne MP ya MLA se poochho ki Crime in India mein sextortion ki alag category kyun nahi hai.

title.en: 'India tops the world in child abuse reports': what NCMEC's 89.2 lakh, 22.5 lakh and 19.3 lakh figures really measure
title.hg: 'India child abuse reports mein duniya mein No. 1': NCMEC ke 89.2 lakh, 22.5 lakh aur 19.3 lakh ke figures asal mein kya naapte hain

dek.en: For three years running, a US child-protection centre linked more reports of suspected child sexual abuse material to India than to any other country. The ranking measures platforms, users and uploads, not how many Indian children are abused. How to read it, and the hard thing it does prove.
dek.hg: Lagataar teen saal, US ke ek child-protection centre ne suspected child sexual abuse material ki sabse zyada reports India se jodi. Yeh ranking platforms, users aur uploads ko naapti hai, yeh nahi ki India mein kitne bachchon ka abuse hota hai. Ise kaise padhein, aur yeh kaunsa kadwa sach sach mein saabit karti hai.

statLabel.en: NCMEC reports attributed to India in 2023, the most of any country
statLabel.hg: NCMEC reports 2023 mein India se judi, kisi bhi desh se zyada

label.en: CyberTipline reports NCMEC linked to India in 2023, the most of any country
label.hg: CyberTipline reports jo NCMEC ne 2023 mein India se jodi, kisi bhi desh se zyada

label.en: referrals with enough information for police action linked to India in 2025, more than any other country
label.hg: referrals 2025 mein India se jude, jinme police action ke liye kaafi jaankari thi; kisi bhi desh se zyada

label.en: separate incidents behind NCMEC's 20.5 million reports worldwide in 2024, once bundled reports are counted
label.hg: alag-alag incidents, NCMEC ki 2024 ki duniya bhar ki 20.5 million reports ke peeche, bundled reports ko ginne ke baad

label.en: NCMEC tips passed on to Indian states and union territories by 31 March 2024
label.hg: NCMEC tips 31 March 2024 tak India ke states aur union territories ko bheji gayi

claim.en: NCMEC's data proves India has the most child sexual abuse in the world.
claim.hg: NCMEC ka data saabit karta hai ki duniya mein sabse zyada child sexual abuse India mein hota hai.

truth.en: NCMEC says its country counts do not indicate how much abuse happens in a country. They reflect platform detection, user numbers and location data. What they do show is abuse material detected moving through accounts in India on a vast scale.
truth.hg: NCMEC khud kehta hai ki uske country counts yeh nahi batate ki kisi desh mein kitna abuse hota hai. Yeh platform detection, users ki sankhya aur location data dikhate hain. Yeh jo sach mein dikhate hain, woh hai India ke accounts se bahut bade paimane pe detect hota abuse material.

actions.en: Read 'India tops the world' as a count of detected uploads and reports, not of abused Indian children.
actions.hg: 'India duniya mein No. 1' ko detect hue uploads aur reports ki ginti samjho, India ke abused bachchon ki nahi.

actions.en: Never view, download, store or forward sexual material involving a child: since 2024 even viewing or storing it can be an offence.
actions.hg: Kisi bachche wala sexual material kabhi dekho, download, store ya forward mat karo: 2024 se use dekhna ya store karna bhi offence ho sakta hai.

actions.en: Report child sexual abuse material on cybercrime.gov.in or 1930, and on the platform, without attaching the file.
actions.hg: Child sexual abuse material ki report cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe, aur platform pe karo, file attach kiye bina.

actions.en: If you know a child is being abused or exploited, call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe pata hai ki kisi bachche ka abuse ya exploitation ho raha hai, toh 1098 ya 112 pe call karo.

title.en: 857 websites, 50 streaming platforms, and blocked services back on new domains: India's attempts to block porn, 2015-2026
title.hg: 857 websites, 50 streaming platforms, aur naye domains pe laut aaye blocked services: porn block karne ki India ki koshishein, 2015-2026

dek.en: In 2015 the Supreme Court said it could not stop an adult watching porn in private, and a government order blocking 857 sites was narrowed within days. A decade on, 50 streaming platforms have been blocked and some came back at new addresses. What each attempt achieved, and the line the law actually draws.
dek.hg: 2015 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki woh kisi adult ko private mein porn dekhne se nahi rok sakta, aur 857 sites block karne ka sarkari order kuch hi dinon mein chhota kar diya gaya. Das saal baad 50 streaming platforms block ho chuke hain, aur kuch naye addresses pe laut aaye. Har koshish se kya hua, aur kanoon asal mein line kahan kheenchta hai.

statLabel.en: porn sites India ordered blocked in 2015, an order narrowed within days
statLabel.hg: porn sites jinhe 2015 mein block karne ka order aaya, aur jo order kuch dinon mein chhota kar diya gaya

label.en: porn websites the telecom department ordered blocked in 2015, before narrowing the order within days
label.hg: porn websites jinhe telecom department ne 2015 mein block karne ka order diya, phir kuch dinon mein order chhota kar diya

label.en: streaming platforms, covering 26 websites and 14 apps, blocked in a single order in July 2025
label.hg: streaming platforms, 26 websites aur 14 apps samet, July 2025 ke ek hi order mein block hue

label.en: streaming platforms blocked for obscene content in two years, the government told Parliament in July 2026
label.hg: streaming platforms do saal mein obscene content ke liye block hue, sarkar ne July 2026 mein Parliament ko bataya

claim.en: Watching porn is illegal in India.
claim.hg: India mein porn dekhna illegal hai.

truth.en: Watching adult pornography in private is not an offence. Publishing or sending obscene material is, and anything involving a child is a crime at every step, including viewing or storing it.
truth.hg: Private mein adult pornography dekhna offence nahi hai. Obscene material publish karna ya bhejna offence hai, aur jismein bhi koi bachcha ho, woh har step pe crime hai, use dekhna ya store karna bhi.

actions.en: Never install an app from a social media ad or an unknown link, and do not give accessibility permissions to an app you do not fully trust.
actions.hg: Social media ad ya kisi anjaan link se kabhi koi app install mat karo, aur jis app pe poora bharosa na ho use accessibility permissions mat do.

actions.en: If money leaves your account after installing an app, call 1930 at once or report it at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: App install karne ke baad account se paise kat jaayein, toh turant 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo.

actions.en: If you come across sexual material involving anyone under 18, do not save or forward it: report it at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ka sexual material dikhe, toh use save ya forward mat karo: cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo.

actions.en: Never record, share or sell anyone's intimate images without their consent, even if they agreed to the picture being taken.
actions.hg: Kisi ki intimate images uski marzi ke bina kabhi record, share ya sell mat karo, chahe usne photo khinchwane ke liye haan kaha ho.

title.en: Blocked him and he made a new account: when online pursuit becomes stalking under BNS Section 78
title.hg: Block kiya toh naya account bana liya: online peecha karna kab BNS Section 78 ke under stalking ban jaata hai

dek.en: A clear 'no', a block, then a fresh account in your inbox. Straight answers on when that is stalking in law, what to save before you report, who must record your complaint, who the law leaves out, and what happens in court.
dek.hg: Saaf 'na', ek block, aur phir inbox mein ek naya account. Seedhe jawab: law ke hisaab se yeh stalking kab hai, report se pehle kya save karna hai, complaint kaun record karega, law kise chhod deta hai, aur court mein kya hota hai.

claim.en: If he only messages and never comes near you, it isn't stalking.
claim.hg: Agar woh sirf message karta hai aur kabhi paas nahin aata, toh yeh stalking nahin hai.

truth.en: Section 78 of the BNS names online conduct directly: a man who monitors a woman's use of the internet, email or other electronic communication commits stalking, and so can one who keeps trying to contact her after a clear sign that she is not interested.
truth.hg: BNS ka Section 78 online harkat ka seedha zikr karta hai: jo aadmi kisi woman ke internet, email ya doosre electronic communication ke use ko monitor karta hai, woh stalking karta hai. Aur woh bhi kar sakta hai jo saaf ishaare ke baad bhi baar-baar contact ki koshish karta rahe ki woman interested nahin hai.

actions.en: Save first, block second: screenshot every message with its date, time and username, and copy each profile's link.
actions.hg: Pehle save, phir block: har message ka screenshot date, time aur username ke saath lo, aur har profile ka link copy karo.

actions.en: If it is safe, say no once, clearly and in writing, then stop replying. A block counts too.
actions.hg: Agar safe ho, toh ek baar saaf-saaf likh kar mana karo, phir reply karna band karo. Block bhi gina jaata hai.

actions.en: Report at any police station as a Zero FIR, or online as an e-FIR that you sign within three days; ask for a woman officer and your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein Zero FIR karo, ya online e-FIR karke teen din ke andar us par sign karo; woman officer aur FIR ki free copy maango.

actions.en: Report every new account to the platform and on cybercrime.gov.in or 1930, and save each acknowledgement number.
actions.hg: Har naye account ko platform par aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karo, aur har acknowledgement number save karo.

actions.en: If you ever fear for your physical safety, call 112 at once.
actions.hg: Agar kabhi bhi apni physical safety ka darr lage, toh turant 112 call karo.

title.en: 66E, 67, 67A, 67B: the four IT Act sections that cover online sexual crimes, in plain words
title.hg: 66E, 67, 67A, 67B: online sexual crimes wale IT Act ke chaar sections, simple bhasha mein

dek.en: One protects the privacy of your body, two deal with obscene and sexually explicit material, one covers anything involving under-18s. Police used them very unevenly in 2024, and the section written into an FIR changes what a victim can expect.
dek.hg: Ek tumhari body ki privacy bachata hai, do obscene aur sexually explicit material se deal karte hain, aur ek 18 se kam umar walon se judi har cheez cover karta hai. 2024 mein police ne inka use bahut unevenly kiya, aur FIR mein kaunsa section likha gaya, isse decide hota hai ki victim kya expect kar sakta hai.

claim.en: If I only forwarded it and did not take it, the IT Act cannot touch me.
claim.hg: Maine sirf forward kiya, khud photo nahi li, toh IT Act mera kuch nahi kar sakta.

truth.en: Section 66E punishes publishing or transmitting an image of someone's private area without consent, not only capturing it, and Sections 67, 67A and 67B all cover publishing or sharing material too.
truth.hg: Section 66E kisi ke private area ki image bina consent publish ya transmit karne ko bhi punish karta hai, sirf capture karne ko nahi, aur Sections 67, 67A aur 67B bhi material publish ya share karne ko cover karte hain.

actions.en: When you report, describe everything: the capture, each share, any threat, and the age of the person in the image.
actions.hg: Report karte waqt sab kuch batao: image kaise li gayi, har share, koi bhi dhamki, aur image wale insaan ki age.

actions.en: Ask which sections are in the FIR, and keep the free copy you are entitled to.
actions.hg: Poocho ki FIR mein kaun se sections hain, aur uski free copy apne paas rakho, jo tumhara haq hai.

actions.en: Never forward or keep a sexual image of anyone under 18; report it at cybercrime.gov.in instead.
actions.hg: 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ki sexual image na kabhi forward karo, na apne paas rakho; uski jagah cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo.

actions.en: For any online sexual crime, call 1930 or file a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi online sexual crime ke liye 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint file karo.

title.en: A loan app threatens to send morphed 'nudes' to your contacts: what the law says and what to do first
title.hg: Loan app tumhare contacts ko morphed 'nudes' bhejne ki dhamki de raha hai: law kya kehta hai aur sabse pehle kya karna hai

dek.en: The image is fake, the threat is a crime, and paying buys nothing you can check. How to warn your contacts before the blackmailer does, report on 1930 and use the two-hour takedown rule.
dek.hg: Image fake hai, dhamki crime hai, aur paise dene se aisa kuch nahi milta jise tum check kar sako. Blackmailer se pehle apne contacts ko kaise warn karo, 1930 pe report kaise karo aur 2-ghante wala takedown rule kaise use karo.

label.hg: online sexually explicit material publish karne pe pehli conviction mein maximum jail (IT Act s.67A)

claim.en: If you owe the lender money, you have to pay to stop the photos.
claim.hg: Agar tumne lender se paise liye hain, toh photos rukwane ke liye paise dene hi padenge.

truth.en: No debt makes threats or sexual images legal. Sending a morphed sexual image can be a crime under the IT Act, and paying under threat buys no deletion anyone can check.
truth.hg: Koi bhi karz dhamki ya sexual images ko legal nahi banata. Morphed sexual image bhejna IT Act ke under crime ho sakta hai, aur dhamki ke dabav mein paise dene se aisa koi deletion nahi milta jise koi check kar sake.

actions.en: Do not pay because of a threat. First save every message, phone number, payment ID and the app's name.
actions.hg: Dhamki ki wajah se paise mat do. Pehle har message, phone number, payment ID aur app ka naam save karo.

actions.en: Message your family and close contacts before the blackmailer does: any 'photo' of you is fake, so do not open, forward or reply.
actions.hg: Blackmailer se pehle family aur close contacts ko message karo: tumhari koi bhi 'photo' fake hai, isliye na kholein, na forward karein, na reply karein.

actions.en: Report the money demand and the images together on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, and keep the acknowledgement number.
actions.hg: Paise ki demand aur images, dono ki report ek saath 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe karo, aur acknowledgement number sambhaal ke rakho.

actions.en: If an image is posted on a platform, complain under Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules: it must come down within two hours.
actions.hg: Agar koi image kisi platform pe post ho, toh IT Rules ke Rule 3(2)(b) ke under complaint karo: use 2 ghante mein hatna hoga.

actions.en: Once your evidence is saved, remove the app's access to your contacts and photos, then uninstall it.
actions.hg: Evidence save hone ke baad app se apne contacts aur photos ka access hatao, phir use uninstall karo.

title.en: Mrs X v. Union of India (2023): the Delhi High Court case that told India how to stop leaked intimate images coming back
title.hg: Mrs X v. Union of India (2023): Delhi High Court ka woh case jisne bataya ki leaked intimate images ko baar-baar wapas aane se kaise roka jaaye

dek.en: One woman's petition over intimate images shared without consent produced orders for a complaint tracker, a round-the-clock helpline and search-engine 'tokens' to stop removed images resurfacing. What the court ordered, why it avoided the phrase 'revenge porn', what has changed since, and what is still missing.
dek.hg: Bina consent share ki gayi intimate images par ek aurat ki petition se court ne complaint tracker, round-the-clock helpline aur search engines ke liye 'tokens' ka order diya, taaki hatayi gayi images phir na ubhrein. Court ne kya kaha, 'revenge porn' shabd kyun nahi apnaya, tab se kya badla aur ab bhi kya baaki hai.

statLabel.en: the Delhi High Court's judgment in Mrs X v. Union of India
statLabel.hg: ko Delhi High Court ne Mrs X v. Union of India mein faisla sunaya

claim.en: 'Revenge porn' is the right name for leaked intimate images.
claim.hg: Leaked intimate images ke liye 'revenge porn' hi sahi shabd hai.

truth.en: The Delhi High Court treated 'revenge porn' as only a subset of non-consensual intimate imagery. The crime is the sharing without consent, whoever does it and whatever the motive.
truth.hg: Delhi High Court ne 'revenge porn' ko non-consensual intimate imagery (NCII) ka sirf ek chhota hissa maana. Crime hai bina consent share karna, chahe koi bhi kare aur kisi bhi wajah se kare.

actions.en: Report an intimate image of you, or of a friend on their behalf, to the platform: it must come down within two hours of the complaint.
actions.hg: Apni intimate image ko, ya kisi dost ki taraf se uski image ko, platform par report karo: complaint ke 2 ghante ke andar use hatna chahiye.

actions.en: File on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in and keep any acknowledgement or reference number you are given.
actions.hg: 1930 par call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in par complaint karo, aur jo bhi acknowledgement ya reference number mile, use sambhal kar rakho.

actions.en: List every link where the image appears, including search results, and ask the search engine to remove those too.
actions.hg: Jahan-jahan image dikhe, un sab links ki list banao, search results wale bhi, aur search engine se unhe bhi hatane ko kaho.

actions.en: Say 'non-consensual intimate images', not 'revenge porn': the crime is the sharing, not the photo.
actions.hg: 'Revenge porn' nahi, 'non-consensual intimate images' bolo: crime photo nahi, use share karna hai.

actions.en: Use StopNCII.org for images taken at 18 or older, or Take It Down for images taken under 18, to block re-uploads on partner platforms.
actions.hg: Re-uploads rokne ke liye 18 ya usse zyada age mein li gayi images par StopNCII.org, aur 18 se kam age mein li gayi images par Take It Down use karo.

title.en: Who checks a child's age online? India's age-verification rules for adult content, and the gaps they leave
title.hg: Online bachche ki umar kaun check karta hai? Adult content ke liye India ke age-verification rules, aur unke beech ke gaps

dek.en: Streaming platforms must offer parental locks and verify age for adult titles. A 2023 data law promises parental consent for every user under 18. Between the two sit the websites the age-check clause does not name, the ads that reach feeds anyway, and the phone a child borrows from a parent.
dek.hg: Streaming platforms ko parental locks dene hote hain aur adult titles ke liye umar verify karni hoti hai. 2023 ka ek data law 18 se kam umar ke har user ke liye parental consent ka vaada karta hai. In dono ke beech hain woh websites jinka naam age-check clause mein hai hi nahi, woh ads jo phir bhi feed tak pahunch jaate hain, aur woh phone jo bachcha mummy-papa se maang leta hai.

claim.en: Adult content online is age-gated by law, so a child cannot simply reach it.
claim.hg: Online adult content pe kanoon ne age-gate laga rakha hai, toh bachcha us tak aise hi nahi pahunch sakta.

truth.en: The age-verification duty in India's IT Rules covers streaming platforms only. The rules text we reviewed sets no comparable duty for other websites, and blocked platforms have returned on new domains.
truth.hg: India ke IT Rules mein age-verification ki duty sirf streaming platforms pe hai. Rules ke jis text ko humne padha, usmein doosri websites ke liye aisi koi duty nahi hai, aur block hue platforms naye domains pe laut aaye hain.

actions.en: Set up a supervised child profile on any phone or tablet a child uses, and require approval for app installs.
actions.hg: Jis bhi phone ya tablet ko bachcha use karta hai, us pe supervised child profile banao, aur app install ke liye approval zaroori kar do.

actions.en: Switch on the parental lock and PIN in every streaming app; the rules make platforms offer it, but someone at home has to set it.
actions.hg: Har streaming app mein parental lock aur PIN on karo; rules platforms se yeh lock dilwate hain, par use set ghar mein kisi ko hi karna padta hai.

actions.en: On Android, keep 'install unknown apps' switched off so nothing installs from an ad or a forwarded link.
actions.hg: Android pe 'install unknown apps' band rakho, taaki kisi ad ya forward hue link se kuch install na ho.

actions.en: Tell children they will not be punished for telling you what they saw online.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko batao ki online jo dekha use tumhe batane pe unhe saza nahi milegi.

actions.en: If an adult sends a child sexual material or asks for images, call 1098 or report it on 1930 or at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Agar koi adult kisi bachche ko sexual material bheje ya images maange, toh 1098 pe call karo ya 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo.

title.en: 19 seconds to a grooming chat: how offenders reach children through games and DMs, and what IT Act Section 67B(c) says
title.hg: Grooming chat tak sirf 19 seconds: offenders games aur DMs ke zariye bachchon tak kaise pahunchte hain, aur IT Act ka Section 67B(c) kya kehta hai

dek.en: Risk-intelligence data cited by WeProtect found that offenders in gaming spaces can pull a child into a high-risk grooming chat in as little as 19 seconds after the first message. How grooming works in a game lobby and a private chat, what Indian law calls it, and how to talk to a child without shame.
dek.hg: WeProtect ke quote kiye risk-intelligence data ke mutabik gaming spaces mein offenders pehle message ke sirf 19 seconds baad bhi bachche ko high-risk grooming chat mein kheench sakte hain. Game lobby aur private chat mein grooming kaise kaam karti hai, Indian law ise kya kehta hai, aur bachche se bina sharminda kiye baat kaise karein.

claim.en: If a child sent the picture themselves, they chose to.
claim.hg: Agar bachche ne photo khud bheji, toh yeh uski apni marzi thi.

truth.en: 'Self-generated' images of children are usually produced under grooming or coercion. No child can consent, and Indian law punishes the adult who cultivates or entices a child into an online sexual relationship.
truth.hg: Bachchon ki 'self-generated' images zyadatar grooming ya dabaav mein banti hain. Koi bachcha consent nahin de sakta, aur Indian law us adult ko saza deta hai jo bachche ko online sexual relationship mein phansata ya uksaata hai.

actions.en: Tell children now: anyone online who asks you to switch apps, keep a secret or send a photo is a warning sign, and telling me will never cost you your phone.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko abhi bata do: online koi bhi app badalne, mujhse kuch chhupane ya photo bhejne ko kahe, toh yeh warning sign hai, aur mujhe batane par tumhara phone kabhi nahin chhinega.

actions.en: Keep younger children's gaming in shared rooms, and use the game's settings to limit who can message them.
actions.hg: Chhote bachchon ki gaming shared kamre mein rakho, aur game ki settings se limit karo ki unhe kaun message kar sakta hai.

actions.en: If a child tells you, stay calm, say it is not their fault, and save usernames and chats, but never download or forward a sexual image of a child.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha kuch bataye, toh shaant raho, kaho ki uski galti nahin hai, aur usernames aur chats save karo, lekin bachche ki sexual image kabhi download ya forward mat karo.

actions.en: Report the account to the platform, at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930, and call the Child Helpline 1098; call 112 if a meeting has been arranged.
actions.hg: Account ko platform par, cybercrime.gov.in par ya 1930 par report karo, aur Child Helpline 1098 par call karo; agar milne ka plan ban chuka hai toh 112 call karo.

actions.en: Teachers and coaches: POCSO requires you to report suspected abuse to the police, so never promise a child total secrecy.
actions.hg: Teachers aur coaches: POCSO ke under shak hone par bhi abuse police ko report karna zaroori hai, isliye kisi bachche se poori secrecy ka vaada kabhi mat karo.

title.en: 'It only happened online' is not a defence: what UNICEF's 650 million figure counts
title.hg: 'Yeh sirf online hua tha' koi bahana nahi: UNICEF ka 650 million wala aankda kya ginta hai

dek.en: UNICEF's first global estimates found more than 370 million girls and women were raped or sexually assaulted as children. Count online and verbal abuse too, and the figure rises to 650 million. Indian law already treats the screen as a crime scene. Here is how to answer anyone who says 'it was only online'.
dek.hg: UNICEF ke pehle global estimates ke mutabik 370 million se zyada ladkiyon aur auraton ka bachpan mein rape ya sexual assault hua. Online aur verbal abuse bhi gino, to yeh aankda 650 million tak pahunchta hai. Indian law screen ko pehle se crime scene maanta hai. Jo bhi kahe 'yeh to bas online tha', use kya jawab dena hai, yahan padho.

statLabel.en: women and girls who faced sexual violence in childhood once online and other non-contact abuse is counted (UNICEF)
statLabel.hg: ladkiyan aur auratein jinhone bachpan mein sexual violence jhela, jab online aur baaki non-contact abuse bhi gina jaye (UNICEF)

label.en: girls and women alive today who faced sexual violence as children once online and verbal abuse are counted: 1 in 5

label.hg: aaj zinda ladkiyan aur auratein jinka 18 se pehle rape ya sexual assault hua: lagbhag har 8 mein se 1

label.en: boys and men alive today who faced sexual violence as children, non-contact abuse included
label.hg: aaj zinda ladke aur mard jinhone bachpan mein sexual violence jhela, non-contact abuse milakar

label.hg: POCSO ke under bachche ke sexual harassment ke case jo police ne 2024 mein darj kiye; yeh sexual assault se alag gine jaate hain

claim.en: If nobody touched you, it was not really sexual abuse.
claim.hg: Agar kisi ne chhua nahi, to woh asli sexual abuse nahi tha.

truth.en: UNICEF counts online and verbal sexual abuse as sexual violence. Indian law agrees: the Supreme Court has held that sexual intent, not skin-to-skin contact, makes sexual assault under POCSO, and Section 77 of the BNS and the IT Act punish intimate images captured or shared without consent.
truth.hg: UNICEF online aur verbal sexual abuse ko sexual violence maanta hai. Indian law bhi yahi kehta hai: Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki POCSO mein sexual assault sexual intent se banta hai, skin-to-skin contact se nahi, aur BNS ka Section 77 aur IT Act bina consent li gayi ya share ki gayi intimate images par saza dete hain.

actions.en: Call it what it is: sexual messages, images or video calls forced on someone, or shared without their consent, are sexual violence, not 'drama'.
actions.hg: Jo hai use wahi naam do: kisi par zabardasti bheje gaye sexual messages, images ya video calls, ya bina consent share ki gayi images, sexual violence hain, 'drama' nahi.

actions.en: Before blocking, screenshot the profile, chat, links and threats. Do not forward the image itself to anyone.
actions.hg: Block karne se pehle profile, chat, links aur dhamkiyon ke screenshots le lo. Image khud kisi ko bhi forward mat karo.

actions.en: Report the post to the platform, which must remove nude, sexual or morphed images within two hours of your complaint, then call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Post ko platform par report karo; nude, sexual ya morphed images tumhari complaint ke 2 ghante ke andar hatani hongi. Phir 1930 par call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in par complaint karo.

actions.en: If the person is under 18, POCSO applies whatever their gender: call the Child Helpline 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar woh insaan 18 se chhota hai, to POCSO lagta hai, uska gender chahe kuch bhi ho: Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call karo.

actions.en: If someone tells you it happened to them, skip 'why did you send it?' Say: 'This is not your fault. Let's report it together.'
actions.hg: Agar koi tumhe bataye ki uske saath aisa hua, to 'tumne bheja hi kyun?' mat poochho. Kaho: 'Isme tumhari koi galti nahi hai. Chalo, saath mein report karte hain.'

claim.en: Cyber crime has a conviction rate above 50%, so most online offenders who are caught get punished.
claim.hg: Cyber crime ka conviction rate 50% se upar hai, toh jo online offenders pakde jaate hain unmein se zyadatar ko saza milti hai.

truth.en: NCRB's rate counts only trials that finished. In 2024 courts convicted in 2,596 of the 99,693 cyber crime cases before them, and 90.9% were still pending at the end of the year.
truth.hg: NCRB ka rate sirf un trials ko ginta hai jo khatam ho gaye. 2024 mein courts ke saamne 99,693 cyber crime cases the, saza 2,596 mein hui, aur saal ke end tak 90.9% pending the.

actions.en: If an intimate image of you is online, report it to the platform first: it must come down within two hours of your complaint.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari koi intimate image online hai, toh sabse pehle platform pe report karo: tumhari complaint ke do ghante ke andar use hatana hoga.

actions.en: File the police complaint as well, on 1930 or at cybercrime.gov.in, and collect your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Saath mein police complaint bhi karo, 1930 pe ya cybercrime.gov.in pe, aur FIR ki free copy zaroor lo.

actions.en: Save screenshots, profile links, phone numbers and payment IDs before you block anyone.
actions.hg: Kisi ko block karne se pehle screenshots, profile links, phone numbers aur payment IDs save kar lo.

actions.en: When you see a conviction rate, ask: out of finished trials, or out of all cases?
actions.hg: Jab bhi koi conviction rate dikhe, poochho: khatam hue trials mein se, ya saare cases mein se?

title.en: Lock your phone down: the settings that block the commonest sextortion, hacking and fake-app attacks
title.hg: Phone ko lock down kijiye: woh settings jo sabse common sextortion, hacking aur fake-app attacks ko rokti hain

dek.en: The commonest attacks that end in blackmail need you to open a door yourself: answer a call, type a code, install an app. This one-sitting audit shuts those doors by default, app by app and setting by setting.
dek.hg: Blackmail par khatam hone wale sabse common attacks mein darwaza aap khud kholte hain: ek call uthana, ek code batana, ek app install karna. Ek hi baithak ka yeh audit un darwazon ko default se band kar deta hai, app dar app, setting dar setting.
