claim.en: Only a skilled hacker can get into my phone, so settings don't matter much.
claim.hg: Mere phone mein toh koi skilled hacker hi ghus sakta hai, isliye settings se zyada farak nahi padta.

truth.en: The attacks in the evidence are low-tech. They work when you answer a stranger's video call, share a code or install an app from an ad. Settings that keep those doors shut by default do most of the protecting.
truth.hg: Evidence mein dikhne wale attacks low-tech hain. Yeh tab kaam karte hain jab aap kisi stranger ka video call uthate hain, code share karte hain ya ad se app install karte hain. Jo settings in darwazon ko default se band rakhti hain, zyada tar protection wahi deti hain.

actions.en: Turn on two-step verification for your email first, then WhatsApp and every app that holds private chats or photos.
actions.hg: Two-step verification sabse pehle apne email par on kijiye, phir WhatsApp aur har us app par jisme private chats ya photos hain.

actions.en: In WhatsApp's privacy settings, silence unknown callers and let only your contacts see your photo or add you to groups.
actions.hg: WhatsApp ki privacy settings mein unknown callers ko silence kijiye, aur photo dekhne ya group mein add karne ki permission sirf contacts ko dijiye.

actions.en: On Android, set 'Install unknown apps' to 'Not allowed' for every app, and remove any app you don't recognise from Accessibility.
actions.hg: Android par 'Install unknown apps' ko har app ke liye 'Not allowed' kijiye, aur Accessibility se har woh app hataiye jise aap nahi pehchante.

actions.en: Check which account and devices your photos back up to, and who can see your live location.
actions.hg: Check kijiye ki aapki photos kis account aur kin devices par back up hoti hain, aur aapki live location kaun dekh sakta hai.

actions.en: Save 1930 in your contacts. If you are blackmailed, don't pay: save the evidence and report.
actions.hg: 1930 apne contacts mein save kijiye. Agar blackmail ho toh pay mat kijiye: evidence save kijiye aur report kijiye.

title.en: Is watching porn illegal in India? Five legal myths, from 'private viewing is a crime' to 'if it's on a big site, everyone consented'
title.hg: Kya India mein porn dekhna illegal hai? Paanch legal myths, 'private mein dekhna crime hai' se lekar 'badi site pe hai toh sabki marzi thi' tak

dek.en: An adult watching adult material in private commits no offence. The crimes begin with sending it, with anyone under 18 on screen, and with anyone who never agreed to be filmed or shared. Five common claims, checked against the IT Act, POCSO and the Supreme Court.
dek.hg: Koi adult private mein adult material dekhe, toh yeh offence nahi hai. Crime wahan shuru hota hai jahan use bheja jaata hai, jahan screen pe 18 se kam umar ka koi ho, aur jahan kisi ko uski marzi ke bina film ya share kiya gaya ho. Paanch common daave, IT Act, POCSO aur Supreme Court ke saamne rakh kar check kiye gaye.

statLabel.hg: maximum fine, saath mein 5 saal tak ki jail, online sexually explicit material publish karne ya bhejne pe (IT Act Section 67A)

claim.hg: Agar video kisi badi, mashhoor site pe hai, toh usmein dikhne wale har insaan ne haan kaha hoga.

truth.en: A site's size proves nothing about age or consent. India's cyber crime portal had about 1.94 lakh complaints about child sexual abuse material and rape or gang-rape content by April 2024.
truth.hg: Site kitni badi hai, isse umar ya consent ke baare mein kuch saabit nahi hota. April 2024 tak India ke cyber crime portal pe child sexual abuse material aur rape ya gang-rape content ki lagbhag 1.94 lakh complaints aa chuki thi.

actions.en: Do not forward sexually explicit clips, even in a private group: sending is the offence under IT Act Sections 67 and 67A.
actions.hg: Sexually explicit clips forward mat karo, private group mein bhi nahi: IT Act ke Sections 67 aur 67A ke tahat bhejna hi offence hai.

actions.en: If sexual material showing anyone under 18 reaches you, do not save or forward it. Report it at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ka sexual material tum tak pahunche, toh use save ya forward mat karo. cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report karo.

actions.en: Never record or share anyone's intimate image without their consent, even if they agreed to the picture being taken.
actions.hg: Kisi ki intimate image uski marzi ke bina kabhi record ya share mat karo, chahe usne photo khinchwane ke liye haan kaha ho.

actions.en: Skip anything sold as leaked or hidden-camera footage: you cannot verify age or consent from a screen.
actions.hg: Jo cheez leaked ya hidden-camera footage bol kar bechi ja rahi ho, use chhod do: screen dekh kar umar ya consent verify nahi ho sakta.

actions.en: Keep porn out of offices, classrooms and group chats, where others have not agreed to see it.
actions.hg: Porn ko office, classroom aur group chats se bahar rakho, jahan baaki logon ne use dekhne ke liye haan nahi kaha.

title.en: An assault video lands in your WhatsApp group: why forwarding it is a crime under IT Act 67A and BNS 72, and how to report it instead
title.hg: Assault ka video tumhare WhatsApp group mein aa gaya: use forward karna IT Act 67A aur BNS 72 ke under crime kyun hai, aur uski jagah report kaise karein

dek.en: A video of a sexual assault, or of a child being abused, is evidence of a crime, not news. Every forward breaks the law again and exposes the survivor again. What to do in the minutes after it arrives.
dek.hg: Sexual assault ka video, ya kisi bachche ke abuse ka video, ek crime ka saboot hai, news nahi. Har forward law ko phir todta hai aur survivor ko phir expose karta hai. Video aane ke baad ke pehle kuch minutes mein kya karna hai.

claim.hg: Assault ka video forward karne se awareness failti hai aur justice milne mein help hoti hai.

truth.en: It spreads the survivor's face, not justice. Transmitting sexually explicit material is an offence under IT Act Section 67A, and revealing a rape survivor's identity is a crime under BNS Section 72. Police need a report, not a forward.
truth.hg: Isse survivor ka chehra failta hai, justice nahi. Sexually explicit material transmit karna IT Act Section 67A ke under offence hai, aur rape survivor ki pehchaan zaahir karna BNS Section 72 ke under crime hai. Police ko report chahiye, forward nahi.

actions.en: Do not forward, save or comment on the video, whatever the caption says.
actions.hg: Video ko forward, save ya comment mat karo, caption chahe kuch bhi kahe.

actions.en: Report it on cybercrime.gov.in, which has a route for rape and child abuse content, or call 1930.
actions.hg: cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo, jahan rape aur child abuse content ke liye alag rasta hai, ya 1930 pe call karo.

actions.en: Report the message in the app and ask the admin to delete it for everyone and remove the sender.
actions.hg: App mein message report karo aur admin se kaho ki use sabke liye delete kare aur bhejne wale ko group se nikaale.

actions.en: Once reported, delete the video from your phone and switch off media auto-download for the group.
actions.hg: Report karne ke baad video apne phone se delete karo aur us group ke liye media auto-download band kar do.

actions.en: Never name or hint at who the survivor is. If a child is involved or anyone is in danger, call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Survivor kaun hai, yeh kabhi mat batao, ishaara bhi mat karo. Agar koi bachcha involved hai ya koi khatre mein hai, toh 1098 ya 112 pe call karo.

title.en: 'Pay once and they'll delete it': five sextortion myths, checked against the evidence
title.hg: 'Ek baar pay karo, delete kar denge': sextortion ke 5 myths, evidence ke saath check kiye

dek.en: Sextortion survives on five beliefs that keep people paying and silent. Here is what the evidence says about each one, and which decisions actually protect you.
dek.hg: Sextortion paanch galat beliefs pe chalta hai jo logon ko pay karte rehne aur chup rehne pe majboor karte hain. Har ek ka sach yahan hai, aur woh decisions bhi jo sach mein tumhe bachate hain.

claim.hg: Ek baar pay kar diya toh woh video delete karke peecha chhod denge.

truth.hg: Pay karne se unhe pata chalta hai ki tum pay kar sakte ho. WeProtect ek research cite karta hai: jinhone payment demand ignore ki, unme se 70% ki images share nahi hui.

actions.hg: Reply karna band karo aur pay mat karo. Block karne se pehle chat, profile link, paise ki demand aur phone number save kar lo.

actions.en: Report any intimate image to the platform and ask for removal within two hours under Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules. No FIR is needed for this.

actions.en: Call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in. If you are under 18, tell an adult you trust or call the Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint karo. 18 se kam ho toh kisi trusted adult ko batao ya Child Helpline 1098 pe call karo.

actions.en: Tell one person you trust. Blackmail only works while it stays secret.
actions.hg: Kisi ek trusted insaan ko batao. Blackmail tabhi tak chalta hai jab tak baat chhupi rehti hai.

actions.en: If the fear feels unbearable, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Darr bardasht se bahar lage toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo. Yeh free hai aur 24 ghante chalta hai.

title.en: Sextortion for money mainly targets teenage boys, and India's crime data cannot see them
title.hg: Paison ke liye sextortion ka main target teenage ladke hain, aur India ka crime data unhe dekh hi nahi paata

dek.en: Global evidence says the typical victim of sextortion for money is a teenage boy who believes he is talking to a young woman. India's crime data has no way to see him. Here is why the scam is built for boys, what the silence costs, and what the adults around him should never say.
dek.hg: Global evidence kehta hai ki paison ke liye hone wale sextortion ka typical victim ek teenage ladka hota hai, jise yakeen hota hai ki woh kisi young ladki se baat kar raha hai. India ke crime data ke paas use dekhne ka koi tareeka nahi hai. Padho yeh scam ladkon ke liye hi kyun bana hai, chuppi ki kya keemat hai, aur aas-paas ke badon ko kya kabhi nahi kehna chahiye.

actions.en: If it is happening to you: stop replying, do not pay, screenshot everything, and tell one adult tonight. The blackmailer committed the crime, not you.
actions.hg: Agar tumhare saath ho raha hai: reply band karo, pay mat karo, sab ka screenshot lo, aur aaj raat hi ek bade ko batao. Crime blackmailer ne kiya hai, tumne nahi.

actions.en: Under 18? Call the Child Helpline 1098, round the clock, to get an adult on your side.
actions.hg: 18 se kam ho? Child Helpline 1098 pe call karo, jo din-raat chalti hai, taaki koi bada tumhare saath khada ho.

actions.en: Report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in; for images taken before you turned 18, use Take It Down, which works in Hindi.
actions.hg: 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo; 18 se pehle ki images ke liye Take It Down use karo, jo Hindi mein bhi hai.

actions.en: Parents, brothers, uncles: never say 'be a man' or 'how could you be so stupid'. Say 'we will handle this together'.
actions.hg: Parents, bhai, chacha-mama: kabhi mat kaho 'mard bano' ya 'itni bewakoofi kaise ki'. Kaho, 'hum milke sambhal lenge.'

actions.en: If it feels like too much, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar sab bahut bhaari lage, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo; free hai aur din-raat chalta hai.

dek.en: Demanding passwords, reading chats and secretly installing monitoring apps are control, not care. How spyware gets onto a phone, the signs to look for, which laws apply, and how to get help without alerting the person watching.
dek.hg: Password maangna, chats padhna aur chupke se monitoring apps daalna control hai, care nahi. Spyware phone tak kaise pahunchta hai, kin signs pe dhyaan do, kaun se law laagu hote hain, aur nazar rakhne wale ko bina pata chale help kaise lo.

truth.hg: Fikar ke liye tumhare passwords nahi chahiye. Chupke se tracking control hai, aur police women ki cyber stalking ko crime ke roop mein register karti hai.

actions.hg: Accessibility, device-admin ya notification access wali anjaan apps dhoondho, par kuch bhi delete karne se pehle apni safety ka plan banao.

actions.en: Once you have a plan, change passwords from a safe device, sign out of every session and switch off location sharing.
actions.hg: Plan ban jaaye toh safe device se passwords badlo, har session se sign out karo aur location sharing band karo.

actions.hg: Agar abuse husband kar raha hai ya ghar ke andar ho raha hai, toh kisi lawyer ya Protection Officer se 2005 Act ke protection order ke baare mein poocho: use todna crime hai.

actions.en: Report stalking at a police station, where a woman officer must record it, or on 1930 and cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Stalking ki report police station mein karo, jahan woman officer ko hi use record karna hoga, ya 1930 aur cybercrime.gov.in pe.

Phir partner platforms uski copies block kar sakte hain, aur tumhe photo kisi ko bhejni nahi padti. Kaunsa tool tumhare case mein kaam aayega, use kaise chalana hai aur woh kahan kaam nahi karta, sab yahan hai.

truth.hg: StopNCII aur Take It Down tumhare apne device par photo ka digital fingerprint banate hain aur sirf wahi bhejte hain. Photo tumhare device par hi rehti hai.

actions.en: Make the fingerprint on your own phone or laptop. Never send the image itself to anyone, including people who offer to get it removed for a fee.
actions.hg: Fingerprint apne hi phone ya laptop par banao. Photo khud kisi ko mat bhejo, un logon ko bhi nahi jo paise lekar photo hatwane ka daawa karte hain.

title.hg: 18 se kam ho toh nude photo law mein 'child sexual abuse material' hai: IT Act Section 67B pe teens aur unke bharose ke logon ke liye seedha Q&A

dek.en: A 16-year-old's photo forwarded in a class group is not gossip in Indian law. It is child sexual abuse material, and every forward is an offence. Five straight answers on sending, forwarding, reporting and getting it taken down.
dek.hg: Class group mein forward hui kisi 16 saal ke student ki photo Indian law mein gossip nahi hai. Woh child sexual abuse material hai, aur har forward ek offence hai. Bhejne, forward karne, report karne aur photo hatwane par paanch seedhe jawab.

statLabel.en: maximum jail on first conviction for sharing or downloading sexual images of anyone under 18 (IT Act 67B)
statLabel.hg: first conviction pe maximum jail, 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ki sexual images share ya download karne par (IT Act 67B)

label.en: maximum jail on a first conviction under IT Act Section 67B, plus a fine of up to Rs 10 lakh; up to 7 years on a repeat conviction
label.hg: IT Act Section 67B ke under first conviction pe maximum jail, saath mein Rs 10 lakh tak ka fine; dobara conviction pe 7 saal tak

label.en: rise in 'self-generated' sexual imagery of children aged 7 to 10 recorded by the Internet Watch Foundation, first half of 2020 to 2022
label.hg: badhat 7 se 10 saal ke bachchon ki 'self-generated' sexual imagery mein, Internet Watch Foundation ke records mein, 2020 ki pehli chhamahi se 2022 tak

label.en: maximum jail under POCSO for failing to report child sexual abuse you know about
label.hg: POCSO ke under maximum jail, agar tumhe child sexual abuse ka pata hai aur tum report nahi karte

claim.en: If a teenager took the photo of themselves, it is not abuse material.
claim.hg: Agar teenager ne photo khud li hai, toh woh abuse material nahi hai.

truth.en: The law looks at age, not at who pressed the button. A sexual image of anyone under 18 is child sexual abuse material, and collecting, downloading or sharing it is an offence under IT Act Section 67B.
truth.hg: Law umar dekhta hai, yeh nahi ki button kisne dabaya. 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ki sexual image child sexual abuse material hai, aur use collect, download ya share karna IT Act Section 67B ke under offence hai.

actions.en: Never forward, save or screenshot a sexual image of anyone under 18, not even 'as proof'.
actions.hg: 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ki sexual image kabhi forward, save ya screenshot mat karo, 'proof ke liye' bhi nahi.

actions.en: If an image of you taken before you turned 18 is out, use Take It Down and report every copy on the platform.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se pehle li gayi tumhari koi image bahar aa gayi hai, toh Take It Down use karo aur platform pe har copy report karo.

actions.en: If a friend tells you, believe them, don't ask to see the image, and help them tell an adult or call 1098.
actions.hg: Agar koi friend tumhe bataye, toh uski baat pe yakeen karo, image dekhne ko mat maango, aur kisi adult ko batane ya 1098 pe call karne mein help karo.

actions.en: Adults: report child sexual abuse to the police. Under POCSO it is a legal duty, not a favour.
actions.hg: Adults: child sexual abuse ki report police ko karo. POCSO ke under yeh legal duty hai, koi ehsaan nahi.

actions.en: Report threats or circulating images on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, with an adult you trust if you are under 18.
actions.hg: Dhamkiyan ya ghoomti images 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo; 18 se kam ho toh kisi trusted adult ke saath.

title.en: From 24 hours to two: what India's February 2026 rule forces platforms to do with your intimate images
title.hg: 24 ghante se 2 ghante: February 2026 ka rule platforms ko tumhari intimate images ke saath kya karne pe majboor karta hai

dek.en: Rule 3(2)(b) of the IT Rules lets you, or anyone acting for you, demand removal of nude, sexual or morphed images without an FIR. Since 20 February 2026 the deadline is two hours. What the rule covers, how to use it, and where it stops.
dek.hg: IT Rules ka Rule 3(2)(b) tumhe, ya tumhari taraf se kisi ko bhi, bina FIR ke nude, sexual ya morphed images hatwane ka haq deta hai. 20 February 2026 se deadline 2 ghante hai. Rule kya cover karta hai, use kaise use karna hai, aur yeh kahan ruk jaata hai.

statLabel.en: the old takedown deadline under Rule 3(2)(b), cut to two hours in February 2026
statLabel.hg: Rule 3(2)(b) ke under purani takedown deadline, jo February 2026 mein ghata ke 2 ghante kar di gayi

label.en: to remove intimate images after a person's complaint, since 20 February 2026 (was 24 hours)
label.hg: kisi insaan ki complaint ke baad intimate images hatane ka time, 20 February 2026 se (pehle 24 ghante)

label.en: to act on a court order or authorised government notice (was 36 hours)
label.hg: court order ya authorised government notice pe action ka time (pehle 36 ghante)

label.en: to resolve other user grievances (was 15 days)
label.hg: baaki user grievances resolve karne ka time (pehle 15 din)

label.en: cases under the IT Act's obscenity sections before courts in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein courts ke saamne IT Act ke obscenity sections wale cases mein se itne mein conviction hua

claim.en: You need an FIR or a court order before a platform will take down your intimate image.
claim.hg: Platform se intimate image hatwane ke liye pehle FIR ya court order chahiye.

truth.en: No. Under Rule 3(2)(b), your own complaint, or one made on your behalf, is enough. Since 20 February 2026 the platform has two hours.
truth.hg: Nahi. Rule 3(2)(b) ke under tumhari apni complaint, ya tumhari taraf se ki gayi complaint, kaafi hai. 20 February 2026 se platform ke paas 2 ghante hain.

actions.en: Report through the platform's own form and name the rule: 'Rule 3(2)(b), IT Rules: non-consensual intimate image', with every link.
actions.hg: Platform ke apne form se report karo aur rule ka naam likho: 'Rule 3(2)(b), IT Rules: non-consensual intimate image', har link ke saath.

actions.en: Note the time of each complaint. If the content is still up after two hours, escalate with that record.
actions.hg: Har complaint ka time note karo. 2 ghante baad bhi content upar ho, toh usi record ke saath escalate karo.

actions.en: Escalate on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, where I4C collects complaints about intimate images.
actions.hg: 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe escalate karo, jahan I4C intimate images wali complaints collect karta hai.

actions.en: Use StopNCII.org (images taken at 18 or older) or Take It Down (under 18) to block re-uploads on partner platforms.
actions.hg: Re-uploads block karne ke liye StopNCII.org (18 ya usse zyada umar mein li gayi images) ya Take It Down (18 se kam) use karo.

actions.en: Treat removal and the police case as two separate tracks: neither has to wait for the other.
actions.hg: Removal aur police case ko do alag tracks samjho: kisi ko doosre ka wait nahi karna.

title.en: The unsolicited nude in your DMs is not a joke: cyberflashing and IT Act Sections 67 and 67A, answered
title.hg: DMs mein bina maange aaya nude koi mazaak nahi hai: cyberflashing aur IT Act Sections 67 aur 67A, sawaal-jawaab mein

dek.en: India has no offence called cyberflashing. It does not need one: sending someone an explicit image they never asked for is already a crime under the IT Act, and sexual harassment when it comes from a colleague. What to do in the first minute, and what a complaint can honestly achieve.
dek.hg: India mein cyberflashing naam ka koi offence nahi hai. Zaroorat bhi nahi: kisi ko bina maange explicit image bhejna IT Act ke under pehle se crime hai, aur colleague ki taraf se aaye toh sexual harassment. Pehle minute mein kya karna hai, aur complaint se sach mein kya ho sakta hai.

statLabel.hg: cases 2024 mein India mein IT Act Section 67A (sexually explicit material) ke under

label.en: maximum jail on first conviction for transmitting obscene material under IT Act Section 67, with a fine of up to Rs 5 lakh
label.hg: IT Act Section 67 ke under obscene material bhejne pe first conviction mein maximum jail, saath mein Rs 5 lakh tak fine

label.en: cases police registered under IT Act Section 67 in all of India in 2024
label.hg: cases police ne 2024 mein poore India mein IT Act Section 67 ke under register kiye

label.hg: cases 2024 mein Section 67A (sexually explicit material) ke under register hue

label.hg: Section 67 group ke jo cases courts mein the, unme se itne 2024 ke end tak trial mein pending the

claim.en: An unsolicited nude is a crude joke. Block it, laugh it off; there is no law for it anyway.
claim.hg: Bina maange aaya nude bas ek ghatiya mazaak hai. Block karo, hans ke taal do; iske liye waise bhi koi law nahi hai.

truth.en: Transmitting obscene or sexually explicit material is an offence under IT Act Sections 67 and 67A whether or not the receiver asked for it, and 'showing pornography' has counted as sexual harassment at work since 1997.
truth.hg: Obscene ya sexually explicit material bhejna IT Act Sections 67 aur 67A ke under offence hai, chahe receiver ne maanga ho ya nahi, aur 'showing pornography' 1997 se workplace pe sexual harassment maana jaata hai.

actions.en: Do not reply. Screenshot the sender's profile, username or number, and the message with its date and time.
actions.hg: Reply mat karo. Sender ki profile, username ya number, aur message ka date aur time ke saath screenshot le lo.

actions.en: Report the message from inside the chat first, then block the account.
actions.hg: Pehle chat ke andar se message report karo, uske baad account block karo.

actions.en: Keep the screenshots in a locked folder and do not forward the image to anyone, not even to shame the sender.
actions.hg: Screenshots locked folder mein rakho aur image kisi ko forward mat karo, sender ko sharminda karne ke liye bhi nahi.

actions.en: Report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in; if you want an FIR, take a written complaint to any police station.
actions.hg: 1930 pe ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo; FIR chahiye toh kisi bhi police station mein likhit complaint le jao.

actions.en: If the sender is a colleague or your boss, give a written complaint to the Internal Committee, or file on SHe-Box, within three months.
actions.hg: Agar sender colleague ya boss hai, toh teen mahine ke andar Internal Committee ko likhit complaint do, ya SHe-Box pe file karo.

title.en: UP 633, Maharashtra 544, Telangana's rate of 71.1: the map of India's online sexual crime, and why it shows policing as much as crime
title.hg: UP 633, Maharashtra 544, Telangana ka rate 71.1: India ke online sexual crime ka map, aur kyun yeh crime jitna hi policing bhi dikhata hai

dek.en: NCRB's 2024 state tables put Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra on top for online sexual exploitation and Telangana on top for cyber crime per person. Read them as a map of where victims manage to report, not a map of where it is safe to be online.
dek.hg: NCRB ke 2024 state tables mein online sexual exploitation mein Uttar Pradesh aur Maharashtra sabse upar hain, aur har insaan ke hisaab se cyber crime mein Telangana. Inhe is baat ka map samjho ki victims kahan report kar paate hain, is baat ka nahi ki online kahan safe ho.

statLabel.en: Telangana's cyber crime rate in 2024, the highest of any state
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein Telangana ka cyber crime rate, kisi bhi state mein sabse zyada

label.en: cyber crimes with a sexual-exploitation motive registered in Uttar Pradesh in 2024, the most of any state
label.hg: sexual exploitation motive wale cyber crimes 2024 mein Uttar Pradesh mein register hue, kisi bhi state se zyada

label.en: of India's 3,190 such cases were registered in two states, Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra
label.hg: India ke aise 3,190 cases sirf do states, Uttar Pradesh aur Maharashtra, mein register hue

label.en: cyber crimes per lakh people registered in Telangana in 2024, the highest rate of any state
label.hg: cyber crimes har lakh logon par 2024 mein Telangana mein register hue, kisi bhi state ka sabse zyada rate

label.en: of India's cyber crime FIRs in 2024 recorded sexual exploitation as the motive
label.hg: India ki 2024 ki cyber crime FIRs mein motive sexual exploitation likha gaya

claim.en: The states with the most online sexual crime cases are the most dangerous places to be online.
claim.hg: Jin states mein online sexual crime ke sabse zyada cases hain, wahi online hone ke liye sabse khatarnaak jagah hain.

truth.en: NCRB itself warns that more registered crime is not a sign that a place is less safe. High counts can reflect easier reporting and registration as much as more crime.
truth.hg: NCRB khud chetaavni deta hai ki zyada registered crime ka matlab yeh nahi ki jagah kam safe hai. Zyada numbers aasaan reporting aur registration se bhi aa sakte hain, sirf zyada crime se nahi.

actions.en: Report from where you are: any police station must record your complaint, wherever the offender is, or you can file an e-FIR.
actions.hg: Jahan ho wahin se report karo: offender kahin bhi ho, koi bhi police station tumhari complaint record karega, ya tum e-FIR file kar sakte ho.

actions.en: Call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in, follow up until your complaint becomes an FIR, and collect your free copy.
actions.hg: 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint karo, jab tak complaint FIR na ban jaaye follow up karte raho, aur free copy lo.

actions.en: Do not read a low number for your state as proof of safety: ask how many complaints became FIRs.
actions.hg: Apne state ka kam number dekh ke use safety ka saboot mat samjho: poochho kitni complaints FIR bani.

actions.en: When you share a state ranking, add the rate and NCRB's warning, not just the count.
actions.hg: Koi state ranking share karo toh sirf count nahi, rate aur NCRB ki chetaavni bhi saath mein daalo.

title.en: 1.2% screened, 70% targeted: India's cervical cancer gap in numbers
title.hg: 1.2% ki screening, 70% ka target: numbers mein India ka cervical cancer gap

dek.en: Cervical cancer can be caught years before it becomes cancer. The 2019-21 national survey found that almost no Indian women had ever been tested. The 2026 HPV vaccine campaign protects 14-year-old girls; it is not built for their mothers.
dek.hg: Cervical cancer ko cancer banne se saalon pehle pakda ja sakta hai. 2019-21 ke national survey ne paaya ki India mein lagbhag kisi woman ka test hua hi nahi tha. 2026 ka HPV vaccine campaign 14 saal ki ladkiyon ko bachata hai; wo unki maaon ke liye bana hi nahi hai.

statLabel.en: of Indian women aged 15-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
statLabel.hg: 15-49 saal ki Indian women ki kabhi bhi cervical cancer screening hui thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women aged 15-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ki kabhi bhi cervical cancer screening hui thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: new cervical cancer cases in India in 2024, in the latest GLOBOCAN estimate
label.hg: cervical cancer ke naye cases India mein 2024 mein, latest GLOBOCAN estimate ke hisaab se

label.en: cervical cancer deaths in India in 2024, in the same estimate
label.hg: cervical cancer se maut India mein 2024 mein, usi estimate ke hisaab se

label.en: of women to be screened by 35 and again by 45: WHO's target for 2030
label.hg: women ki screening 35 ki umar tak aur phir 45 tak: 2030 ke liye WHO ka target

actions.en: If you are 35 or older and have never been screened, ask a government health centre or district hospital for a cervical screening test this year. If you are younger, ask a doctor when to start.
actions.hg: Agar tum 35 ya usse zyada umar ki ho aur kabhi screening nahi hui, toh isi saal sarkaari health centre ya district hospital mein cervical screening test ke baare mein poochho. Kam umar ho toh doctor se poochho ki kab shuru karna hai.

actions.en: Do not wait for symptoms. The cell changes that screening finds rarely cause any.
actions.hg: Symptoms ka intezaar mat karo. Screening jin cell changes ko pakadti hai, unmein aksar koi symptom hota hi nahi.

actions.en: See a doctor at any age for bleeding between periods, after sex or after menopause.
actions.hg: Periods ke beech, sex ke baad ya menopause ke baad bleeding ho toh kisi bhi umar mein doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: If you live with HIV, ask your treatment centre about starting screening earlier than other women.
actions.hg: Agar tum HIV ke saath jee rahi ho, toh apne treatment centre se poochho ki screening baaki women se pehle kab shuru karni hai.

actions.en: When you take a 14-year-old for her free HPV dose, ask about a screening test for yourself at the same visit.
actions.hg: Jab 14 saal ki ladki ko free HPV dose ke liye le jao, toh usi visit mein apne liye screening test ka bhi poochho.

title.en: 10,545 pregnant women with syphilis, 212 babies on record: India's congenital syphilis blind spot
title.hg: 10,545 pregnant women mein syphilis, record mein sirf 212 babies: India ka congenital syphilis blind spot

dek.en: Syphilis in pregnancy can end in stillbirth or lifelong harm to a baby, and penicillin can prevent it. In 2024-25 roughly one pregnant woman in four was not tested, roughly one infected mother in seven was not recorded as treated, and the count of affected babies is almost certainly too low.
dek.hg: Pregnancy mein syphilis ka nateeja stillbirth ya baby ko zindagi bhar ka nuksaan ho sakta hai, aur penicillin ise rok sakti hai. 2024-25 mein lagbhag har chaar mein se ek pregnant woman ka test hi nahi hua, lagbhag har saat infected maaon mein se ek ka treatment record mein nahi hai, aur affected babies ki ginti almost pakka kam hai.

statLabel.en: babies recorded with congenital syphilis in 2024-25, against 10,545 infected mothers
statLabel.hg: babies 2024-25 mein congenital syphilis ke saath record hue, jabki infected maayein 10,545 thin

label.en: of pregnant women in India were tested for syphilis in 2024-25, against 84% for HIV
label.hg: pregnant women ka India mein 2024-25 mein syphilis test hua, jabki HIV test 84% ka

label.en: pregnant women found with syphilis in 2024-25; treatment was recorded for 9,065
label.hg: pregnant women mein 2024-25 mein syphilis mila; treatment 9,065 ka record hua

label.en: babies recorded with congenital syphilis in India in 2024-25
label.hg: babies India mein 2024-25 mein congenital syphilis ke saath record hue

label.en: syphilis positivity among pregnant and breastfeeding women in Arunachal Pradesh, against 0.05% nationally (2024-25)
label.hg: Arunachal Pradesh mein pregnant aur breastfeeding women ki syphilis positivity, jabki national average 0.05% (2024-25)

claim.en: A married woman who feels healthy does not need a syphilis test in pregnancy.
claim.hg: Shaadi-shuda aurat jo healthy feel karti hai, use pregnancy mein syphilis test ki zaroorat nahi.

truth.en: Syphilis often causes no symptoms a person notices, and India found 10,545 pregnant women with it in 2024-25. Only the blood test at the antenatal check-up can tell.
truth.hg: Syphilis ke aksar aise koi symptoms nahi hote jo insaan ko mehsoos hon, aur India ne 2024-25 mein 10,545 pregnant women mein yeh infection paaya. Sirf antenatal check-up ka blood test hi bata sakta hai.

actions.en: At the first antenatal check-up, ask for the syphilis test by name along with the HIV test, and ask to see both results.
actions.hg: Pehle antenatal check-up par HIV test ke saath syphilis test naam lekar maango, aur dono results dekhne ko kaho.

actions.en: If the centre has no test kit, ask for a referral to the district hospital the same week instead of waiting for the next visit.
actions.hg: Centre par test kit na ho toh agli visit ka wait mat karo; usi hafte district hospital ka referral maango.

actions.en: If the result is positive, start the penicillin injections as early as possible and take every dose the doctor prescribes.
actions.hg: Result positive aaye toh penicillin ke injections jitni jaldi ho sake shuru karo aur doctor ki batayi har dose lo.

actions.en: Get the husband or partner tested and treated at the same time, so the infection does not pass back during the pregnancy.
actions.hg: Husband ya partner ka test aur treatment usi waqt karwao, taaki pregnancy ke dauraan infection wapas na aaye.

actions.en: After the birth, tell the baby's doctor about the syphilis result so the baby is examined, treated if needed and followed up.
actions.hg: Delivery ke baad baby ke doctor ko syphilis result ke baare mein batao, taaki baby ki jaanch, zaroorat ho toh treatment, aur follow-up ho sake.

title.en: Under 20 with a sexual-health worry? What India's adolescent health centres offer, and what doctors must report
title.hg: 20 se kam ho aur sexual health ki koi tension hai? India ke adolescent health centres kya dete hain, aur doctors ko kya report karna padta hai

dek.en: The government runs health centres for teenagers in hospitals across India. What you can ask there, what stays private, and the one rule, POCSO's reporting duty, that every under-18 should understand before they speak.
dek.hg: Sarkar poore India ke hospitals mein teenagers ke liye health centres chalati hai. Wahan kya pooch sakte ho, kya private rehta hai, aur woh ek rule, POCSO ki reporting duty, jo har under-18 ko bolne se pehle samajh lena chahiye.

statLabel.hg: 15-19 saal ki ladkiyan pehle se maa thi ya pregnant thi (NFHS-6, 2023-24)

label.hg: adolescents ne 2024-25 mein adolescent friendly health services li, Health Ministry ke hisaab se

claim.en: If I see a doctor about anything sexual, they will tell my parents.
claim.hg: Agar main sex se judi kisi baat ke liye doctor ke paas gaya ya gayi, toh woh mere parents ko bata denge.

truth.en: Ordinary questions about your body stay private, and if you are 18 or older your consultation is confidential. The honest exception is POCSO: a doctor who learns that someone under 18 has been sexually abused or is sexually active must report it to the police.
truth.hg: Body se jude normal sawaal private rehte hain, aur agar tum 18 ya usse bade ho toh tumhari consultation confidential hai. Imaandaar exception POCSO hai: agar doctor ko pata chale ki 18 se kam umar ke kisi insaan ka sexual abuse hua hai ya woh sexually active hai, toh use police ko report karna hi padta hai.

actions.en: Ask for the Adolescent Friendly Health Centre (AFHC) at your nearest government health centre or district hospital.
actions.hg: Apne nearest government health centre ya district hospital mein Adolescent Friendly Health Centre (AFHC) ka poocho.

actions.en: Before you share details, ask: "What will stay between us, and what would you have to report?"
actions.hg: Details batane se pehle poocho: "Kya-kya hamare beech rahega, aur aapko kya report karna padega?"

actions.en: If a condom broke or you had unprotected sex, ask about emergency contraception at once. It works best the sooner it is taken.
actions.hg: Condom phat gaya ho ya bina protection sex hua ho, toh turant emergency contraception ke baare mein poocho. Jitni jaldi lo, utna behtar kaam karti hai.

actions.en: If you are under 18 and need an abortion, you and your guardian can ask the doctor to leave your name out of the police report.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 se kam ho aur abortion chahiye, toh tum aur tumhare guardian doctor se keh sakte ho ki police report mein tumhara naam na likhein.

actions.en: If anyone has forced or pressured you, call the Child Helpline 1098 or 112. It is not your fault.
actions.hg: Agar kisi ne zabardasti ki ya pressure daala, toh Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call karo. Isme tumhari galti nahi hai.

title.en: An estimated 32,160 people in India died of AIDS-related causes in 2024, though treatment is free: where the care chain breaks
title.hg: 2024 mein India mein estimated 32,160 logon ki AIDS-related causes se maut hui, jabki treatment free hai: care ki chain kahan tootti hai

dek.en: AIDS deaths in India have fallen from about 1.73 lakh in 2010. The deaths that remain point to breaks in the chain of care: a test that came too late, treatment never started, or treatment stopped. The chain, link by link, and how the people around someone with HIV can help hold it together.
dek.hg: India mein AIDS se maut 2010 ke lagbhag 1.73 lakh se kaafi neeche aa gayi hai. Jo maut ab bhi ho rahi hain, woh care ki chain mein tooti kadiyon ki taraf ishaara karti hain: test jo bahut der se hua, treatment jo shuru hi nahi hua, ya beech mein chhoot gaya. Chain ki har kadi, aur HIV wale insaan ke aas-paas ke log use kaise jod kar rakh sakte hain.

statLabel.hg: India mein 2024 mein AIDS-related causes se estimated maut

label.hg: India mein 2024 mein AIDS-related causes se estimated maut

label.hg: 2010 mein AIDS-related causes se estimated maut
