claim.en: People in India still die of AIDS because there is no treatment.
claim.hg: India mein log AIDS se isliye marte hain kyunki iska koi treatment nahi hai.

truth.en: Antiretroviral therapy is free at 800 government ART centres, and with it people with HIV can live long, healthy lives. AIDS develops mainly when HIV goes undiagnosed or untreated.
truth.hg: 800 government ART centres par antiretroviral therapy free hai, aur iske saath HIV wale log lambi, healthy life jee sakte hain. AIDS zyada tar tab hota hai jab HIV ka pata hi na chale ya uska ilaaj na ho.

actions.en: If you have ever had sex without a condom or shared a needle, get an HIV test now at a government testing centre. Do not wait to fall ill.
actions.hg: Agar kabhi bina condom sex kiya hai ya needle share ki hai, toh abhi kisi government testing centre par HIV test karwao. Beemar padne ka wait mat karo.

actions.en: If someone close to you has HIV, offer to go with them to the ART centre and help them keep a daily routine.
actions.hg: Agar tumhare kisi apne ko HIV hai, toh unke saath ART centre jaane ki offer karo aur roz ki routine banaye rakhne mein help karo.

actions.en: If your partner or parent has HIV, get tested yourself through the centre's family testing service.
actions.hg: Agar tumhare partner ya parent ko HIV hai, toh centre ki family testing service se apna test bhi karwao.

actions.en: Never share anyone's HIV status without their permission.
actions.hg: Kisi ka HIV status uski permission ke bina kabhi kisi ko mat batao.

actions.en: Call NACO's free, confidential helpline 1097 to find the nearest testing or ART centre.
actions.hg: Nearest testing ya ART centre jaanne ke liye NACO ki free, confidential helpline 1097 par call karo.

title.en: India has two HIV maps. On the one that counts new infections, Bihar is first
title.hg: India ke do HIV maps hain. Naye infections wale map par Bihar sabse aage hai

dek.en: Maharashtra has the most people living with HIV, but in 2024 Bihar, Punjab and Uttar Pradesh each had more estimated new infections. In Punjab, shared needles lead. In Bihar, only 1 in 10 young women had comprehensive knowledge of HIV in 2019-21.
dek.hg: HIV ke saath jee rahe sabse zyada log Maharashtra mein hain, lekin 2024 mein Bihar, Punjab aur UP, teeno mein estimated naye infections Maharashtra se zyada the. Punjab mein shared needles sabse aage hain. Bihar mein 2019-21 mein 10 mein se sirf 1 young woman ko HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi.

statLabel.en: estimated new HIV infections in Bihar in 2024, the highest of any state
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein Bihar mein HIV ke estimated naye infections, kisi bhi state se zyada

label.en: estimated new HIV infections in Bihar in 2024, the most of any state
label.hg: 2024 mein Bihar mein HIV ke estimated naye infections, sabse zyada

label.en: people living with HIV in Maharashtra in 2024, the most of any state
label.hg: 2024 mein Maharashtra mein HIV ke saath jee rahe log, kisi bhi state se zyada

label.en: of people newly diagnosed in 2024-25 named a commercial (paid) sex partner as the route
label.hg: 2024-25 mein naye diagnose hue logon ne commercial (paid) sex partner ko route bataya

label.en: of young women aged 15-24 in Bihar had comprehensive knowledge of HIV (2019-21)
label.hg: Bihar ki 15-24 saal ki young women ko HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi (2019-21)

claim.en: HIV is a problem of Mumbai, the South and the North-East, not of states like Bihar.
claim.hg: HIV toh Mumbai, South aur North-East ki problem hai, Bihar jaise states ki nahi.

truth.en: Maharashtra and the southern states have the most people living with HIV, and the North-East has the highest rates. But in 2024 Bihar had more estimated new infections than any other state.
truth.hg: HIV ke saath jee rahe sabse zyada log Maharashtra aur South ke states mein hain, aur sabse ooncha rate North-East mein. Lekin 2024 mein estimated sabse zyada naye infections Bihar mein hue.

actions.en: If you live or work away from home, use a condom every time with any partner whose HIV status you do not know, including a paid partner.
actions.hg: Agar tum ghar se door kaam karte ho, toh jis bhi partner ka HIV status tumhe nahi pata, uske saath har baar condom use karo, paid partner ke saath bhi.

actions.en: Before going home after months away, get a free HIV test at a government hospital, and suggest your partner gets one too.
actions.hg: Mahino baad ghar lautne se pehle government hospital mein free HIV test karwa lo, aur apne partner ko bhi test karwane ko kaho.

actions.en: If a condom broke or you had sex without one in the last 72 hours, go to a government hospital today and ask about PEP.
actions.hg: Agar pichhle 72 ghanton mein condom phata ya bina condom sex hua, toh aaj hi government hospital jao aur PEP ke baare mein poocho.

actions.en: Never share needles or syringes. If you or a friend injects drugs, ask a government doctor about HIV testing and treatment for drug use.
actions.hg: Needle ya syringe kabhi share mat karo. Agar tum ya tumhara koi dost drugs inject karta hai, toh government doctor se HIV test aur drug use ke treatment ke baare mein poocho.

actions.en: Call NACO's toll-free helpline 1097 for confidential advice, round the clock, in 16 languages.
actions.hg: Confidential advice ke liye NACO ki toll-free helpline 1097 par call karo. Yeh din-raat, 16 languages mein chalti hai.

title.en: Breast cancer is India's most common cancer, and only 0.6% of women aged 15-49 have ever been screened
title.hg: Breast cancer India ka sabse common cancer hai, aur 15-49 saal ki sirf 0.6% women ki kabhi screening hui hai

dek.en: The latest estimate counts 2,37,231 new cases and 96,100 deaths in India in 2024. Almost no woman in the national survey had ever had a breast check. What awareness and a clinical examination can and cannot do, which changes need a doctor quickly, and why most lumps in young women are harmless but still deserve a look.
dek.hg: Latest estimate ke hisaab se 2024 mein India mein 2,37,231 naye cases aur 96,100 deaths. National survey mein lagbhag kisi woman ka kabhi breast check nahi hua tha. Awareness aur clinical examination kya kar sakte hain aur kya nahi, kaun se badlaav jaldi doctor ko dikhane chahiye, aur young women mein zyadatar lumps harmless hone ke baad bhi jaanch kyun zaroori hai.

statLabel.en: new breast cancer cases in India in 2024 (GLOBOCAN estimate)
statLabel.hg: breast cancer ke naye cases, India mein 2024 mein (GLOBOCAN estimate)

label.en: new breast cancer cases in India in 2024 (latest GLOBOCAN estimate)
label.hg: breast cancer ke naye cases, India mein 2024 mein (GLOBOCAN ka latest estimate)

label.en: estimated breast cancer deaths in India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein breast cancer se estimated deaths

label.en: of all cancers in Indian women are breast cancers (2024 estimate)
label.hg: Indian women ke saare cancers mein breast cancer ka hissa (2024 estimate)

label.en: of women aged 15-49 had ever had a breast cancer screening test (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ne kabhi breast cancer screening test karwaya tha (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: A breast lump that does not hurt is nothing to worry about.
claim.hg: Breast ki jis gaanth mein dard nahi hai, usse darne ki koi baat nahi.

truth.en: Breast cancer lumps are often painless. Most lumps are not cancer, but nobody can tell by touch, so a lump that stays needs a doctor even if it never hurts.
truth.hg: Breast cancer ki gaanth mein aksar dard nahi hota. Zyadatar lumps cancer nahi hote, par chhoo kar koi nahi bata sakta, isliye jo lump tika rahe use doctor ko dikhana zaroori hai, chahe usme kabhi dard na ho.

actions.en: Learn how your breasts normally look and feel, so that a change stands out early.
actions.hg: Jaano ki tumhare breasts normally kaise dikhte aur mehsoos hote hain, taaki koi badlaav jaldi pakad mein aaye.

actions.en: See a doctor for a new lump or thickening, a change in the breast's shape or skin, a nipple change or fluid from the nipple, even if nothing hurts.
actions.hg: Nayi gaanth ya thickening, breast ki shape ya skin mein badlaav, nipple mein badlaav ya nipple se fluid aaye, toh doctor ko dikhao, chahe kuch dard na ho.

actions.en: At your next visit to a government health centre or a gynaecologist, ask for a clinical breast examination.
actions.hg: Government health centre ya gynaecologist ke paas agli visit par clinical breast examination maango.

actions.en: If you are past your forties, or breast cancer runs in your family, ask a doctor whether and when you need a mammogram.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari umar forties paar kar chuki hai, ya family mein breast cancer raha hai, toh doctor se poocho ki tumhe mammogram chahiye ya nahi, aur kab.

actions.en: Ask your mother, aunts and older sisters when they were last examined, and offer to go with them.
actions.hg: Apni mummy, mausi-chachi aur badi behnon se poocho ki unki last jaanch kab hui thi, aur saath chalne ka offer do.

title.en: India approved its own HPV vaccine, Cervavac, in 2022. The 2026 national campaign uses Gardasil-4
title.hg: India ne 2022 mein apni HPV vaccine Cervavac approve ki. 2026 ka national campaign Gardasil-4 use karta hai

dek.en: A made-in-India vaccine against cervical cancer was unveiled with a promised price of Rs 200-400 a dose. When the free national campaign finally began, it used Gardasil-4, procured with GAVI, and the government has not said why. This is a question about accountability, not about safety.
dek.hg: Cervical cancer ke khilaaf ek made-in-India vaccine Rs 200-400 per dose ke promised price ke saath unveil hui thi. Jab free national campaign aakhir shuru hua, toh usmein Gardasil-4 lagi, jo GAVI ke saath procure hui, aur government ne nahi bataya kyun. Yeh sawaal accountability ka hai, safety ka nahi.

statLabel.en: expected price per dose of India-made Cervavac when it was unveiled in 2022
statLabel.hg: 2022 mein unveil hote waqt India mein bani Cervavac ka expected price per dose

label.en: India's drugs regulator grants Cervavac market authorisation
label.hg: India ke drugs regulator ne Cervavac ko market authorisation diya

label.en: indicative price per dose announced at Cervavac's launch; final prices were to be fixed later
label.hg: Cervavac ke launch par bataya gaya indicative price per dose; final prices baad mein fix hone the

label.en: girls aged 14 a year targeted by the national campaign, which uses Gardasil-4
label.hg: 14 saal ki ladkiyan har saal national campaign ka target hain, jo Gardasil-4 use karta hai

actions.en: If your daughter is 14, do not wait for a different brand: the free Gardasil-4 dose is licensed, recommended and available now.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari beti 14 saal ki hai, toh kisi doosre brand ka wait mat karo: free Gardasil-4 dose licensed hai, recommended hai aur abhi available hai.

actions.en: If she already had Cervavac or another HPV vaccine privately, carry the record so it is entered on U-WIN.
actions.hg: Agar use private mein Cervavac ya koi aur HPV vaccine pehle hi lag chuki hai, toh record saath le jao taaki U-WIN par entry ho jaaye.

actions.en: Ask your MP to raise a question in Parliament on why Cervavac was not used and what India pays per dose.
actions.hg: Apne MP se kaho ki Parliament mein sawaal uthaye: Cervavac use kyun nahi hui aur India per dose kitna deta hai.

actions.en: File an RTI application with the Union Health Ministry asking for the expert advice behind the vaccine choice.
actions.hg: Union Health Ministry mein RTI application file karo aur vaccine choice ke peeche ki expert advice maango.

actions.en: Share this as a question about public decisions, never as a claim that either vaccine is unsafe.
actions.hg: Ise public decisions par sawaal ki tarah share karo, kabhi is claim ki tarah nahi ki dono mein se koi vaccine unsafe hai.

title.en: About 13 in 100 couples relying on condoms have a pregnancy in a year, mostly because of how condoms are used
title.hg: Condom par tike 100 couples mein se lagbhag 13 ko ek saal mein pregnancy ho jaati hai, aur wajah zyadatar condom use karne ka tareeka hai

dek.en: The condom rarely fails on its own. It fails when it goes on late, meets the wrong oil or gets doubled up, in a country where barely half of young women know where to get one.
dek.hg: Condom apne aap kam hi fail hota hai. Woh tab fail hota hai jab der se pehna jaaye, galat tel ke saath use ho ya do ek saath chadha liye jaayein, aur yeh us desh mein jahan mushkil se aadhi young women ko pata hai ki condom milta kahan hai.

statLabel.en: of women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom, against 87.3% of young men (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: 15-24 saal ki women ko pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai, jabki young men mein yeh 87.3% tha (NFHS-5)

label.en: people relying on external condoms have a pregnancy in a year of typical use; about 85 in 100 with no method (WHO)
label.hg: external condom par tike log typical use ke ek saal mein pregnancy face karte hain; koi method na ho toh 100 mein lagbhag 85 (WHO)

label.en: of currently married women reported condom use; 10.3% relied on traditional methods (2019-21)
label.hg: currently married women ne condom use bataya; 10.3% traditional methods par tiki thi (2019-21)

label.en: of young women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom, against 87.3% of young men (2019-21)
label.hg: 15-24 saal ki young women ko pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai, young men mein 87.3% (2019-21)

label.en: of men agreed that contraception is 'women's business' (2019-21)
label.hg: men ne maana ki contraception 'aurton ka kaam' hai (2019-21)

claim.en: Two condoms are safer than one.
claim.hg: Do condom ek se zyada safe hote hain.

truth.en: Two condoms rub against each other, and the friction makes both more likely to tear or slip. One condom, in date and on from start to finish, protects better than two.
truth.hg: Do condom aapas mein ragadte hain, aur is friction se dono ke phatne ya slip hone ka chance badh jaata hai. Ek condom, jo expire na hua ho aur shuru se aakhir tak pehna gaya ho, do se behtar protect karta hai.

actions.en: Put the condom on before any genital contact, pinch the tip, and keep it on until the end.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi genital contact se pehle condom pehniye, tip ko chutki se dabaiye, aur aakhir tak pehne rakhiye.

actions.en: Use only water-based or silicone-based lubricant; never oil, body lotion or petroleum jelly.
actions.hg: Sirf water-based ya silicone-based lubricant use kijiye; tel, body lotion ya petroleum jelly kabhi nahi.

actions.en: Never wear two at once. For extra protection against pregnancy, pair one condom with a pill or an IUD.
actions.hg: Do condom ek saath kabhi mat pehniye. Pregnancy se extra protection chahiye toh ek condom ke saath pill ya IUD jodiye.

actions.en: If one breaks: emergency contraception within 5 days, a doctor about HIV PEP within 72 hours, and a pregnancy test if your period is late.
actions.hg: Condom phat jaaye toh: 5 din ke andar emergency contraception, 72 ghante ke andar HIV PEP ke liye doctor, aur period late ho toh pregnancy test.

actions.en: Women: buy and carry your own. Condoms are sold without a prescription.
actions.hg: Women: apne condom khud khareediye aur saath rakhiye. Condom bina prescription ke milte hain.

title.en: Implant under 1, pill 7, condom 13, withdrawal 20: the main contraceptives compared with what India actually uses
title.hg: Implant 1 se kam, pill 7, condom 13, withdrawal 20: main contraceptives ka comparison, aur India asal mein kya use karta hai

dek.en: WHO ranks methods by how many women in 100 get pregnant in a year of real-life use. India's method mix runs almost the other way: a permanent operation and guesswork first, the most reliable reversible methods last.
dek.hg: WHO methods ko is hisaab se rank karta hai ki real life mein ek saal use karne par 100 mein se kitni aurtein pregnant hoti hain. India ka method mix lagbhag ulti disha mein chalta hai: pehle permanent operation aur andaaza, sabse bharosemand reversible methods sabse aakhir mein.

statLabel.en: of married women used an IUD, one of the most effective reversible methods (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: shaadishuda aurtein IUD use karti thi, jo sabse effective reversible methods mein se ek hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: IUD or implant users get pregnant in a year of typical use; about 7 for the pill, 13 for the external condom, 20 for withdrawal (WHO)
label.hg: IUD ya implant users ek saal ke typical use mein pregnant hote hain; pill mein lagbhag 7, external condom mein 13, withdrawal mein 20 (WHO)

label.en: of currently married women relied on female sterilisation, about two thirds of all modern method use (2019-21)
label.hg: currently married aurton ne female sterilisation par bharosa kiya, jo saare modern method use ka lagbhag do-tihaai hai (2019-21)

label.en: relied on traditional methods such as withdrawal, more than the pill, IUD and injectable combined (2019-21)
label.hg: withdrawal jaise traditional methods par tiki thi, jo pill, IUD aur injectable ko mila kar bhi zyada hai (2019-21)

label.en: used an IUD and 0.6% the injectable (2019-21)
label.hg: IUD use karti thi aur sirf 0.6% injectable (2019-21)

claim.en: Natural methods like pulling out or counting 'safe days' work just as well, and they are healthier.
claim.hg: Pull out karna ya 'safe days' ginna utna hi kaam karta hai, aur yeh natural methods zyada healthy bhi hain.

truth.en: In typical use about 20 in 100 couples relying on withdrawal have a pregnancy within a year, against fewer than 1 in 100 with an IUD or implant. 'Natural' describes how a method works, not how well it works.
truth.hg: Typical use mein withdrawal par tike 100 mein se lagbhag 20 couples ko ek saal ke andar pregnancy ho jaati hai, jabki IUD ya implant ke saath 100 mein 1 se bhi kam. 'Natural' batata hai ki method kaise kaam karta hai, yeh nahi ki kitna achha kaam karta hai.

actions.en: Compare methods by typical-use pregnancies per 100 users a year, not by what relatives or forwards say.
actions.hg: Methods ko rishtedaaron ya forwards ki baaton se nahi, balki typical use mein har saal 100 users par pregnancies ke number se compare kijiye.

actions.en: If you want to delay a pregnancy for a year or more, ask a doctor, ANM or ASHA worker about the IUD and other long-acting methods.
actions.hg: Agar aap ek saal ya usse zyada pregnancy taalna chahti hain, toh doctor, ANM ya ASHA worker se IUD aur doosre long-acting methods ke baare mein poochhiye.

actions.en: Use a condom as well whenever there is any chance of an infection: it is the only method that also lowers STI risk.
actions.hg: Jab bhi infection ka zara sa bhi chance ho, condom bhi use kijiye: yahi akela method hai jo STI ka risk bhi kam karta hai.

actions.en: If a method fails or a dose is missed, emergency contraception works up to five days after sex, the sooner the better.
actions.hg: Agar method fail ho jaaye ya dose chhoot jaaye, toh emergency contraception sex ke baad paanch din tak kaam karti hai, jitni jaldi utna behtar.

actions.en: If side effects bother you, switch methods with a health worker's help instead of going without.
actions.hg: Side effects pareshaan karein toh bina kisi method ke mat rahiye; health worker ki madad se method badal lijiye.

title.en: Repeated erection problems can be an early warning of diabetes or high blood pressure. 'Sex power' capsules hide it
title.hg: Baar-baar erection ki problem diabetes ya high blood pressure ki early warning ho sakti hai. 'Sex power' capsules use chhupa dete hain

dek.en: Doctors treat erectile dysfunction that keeps happening as a reason to check blood pressure, cholesterol and blood sugar. The ads sell it as a 'gupt rog' to be fixed in secret, and a 1954 law already makes those ads a crime.
dek.hg: Jab erectile dysfunction baar-baar ho, toh doctors ise blood pressure, cholesterol aur blood sugar check karne ki wajah maante hain. Ads ise ek 'gupt rog' bana ke bechte hain jo chupchaap theek karna hai, aur 1954 ka ek law aise ads ko pehle se crime bana chuka hai.

statLabel.en: of Indian men had an alcohol use disorder (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)
statLabel.hg: Indian men ko alcohol use disorder tha (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)

label.en: of Indian men had an alcohol use disorder, against 0.5% of women (NMHS 2015-16)
label.hg: Indian men ko alcohol use disorder tha, jabki women mein 0.5% (NMHS 2015-16)

label.en: treatment gap for alcohol use disorders in India: most people who needed help did not get it (NMHS 2015-16)
label.hg: India mein alcohol use disorder ka treatment gap: jinhe help chahiye thi, unmein se zyada tar ko nahi mili (NMHS 2015-16)

label.en: in jail, a fine or both for a first conviction for advertising a drug that claims to treat impotence (1954 Act)
label.hg: jail, fine ya dono: impotence ka ilaaj karne ka daawa karne wali dawa ka ad dene par pehli conviction ki saza (1954 Act)

claim.en: Erection problems are a private 'gupt rog' that a man should fix quietly with 'sex power' capsules.
claim.hg: Erection ki problem ek private 'gupt rog' hai, jise aadmi ko 'sex power' capsules se chupchaap theek kar lena chahiye.

truth.en: Erectile dysfunction is very common and treatable, and when it keeps happening it can be a sign of diabetes, high blood pressure or high cholesterol. A doctor should look for the cause before treating the symptom.
truth.hg: Erectile dysfunction bahut common hai aur iska ilaaj hai, aur jab ye baar-baar ho toh diabetes, high blood pressure ya high cholesterol ka sign ho sakta hai. Symptom ka ilaaj karne se pehle doctor ko cause dhoondhna chahiye.

actions.en: If erection problems keep happening, see a doctor and ask for blood pressure, blood sugar and cholesterol checks.
actions.hg: Agar erection ki problem baar-baar ho rahi hai, toh doctor ke paas jao aur blood pressure, blood sugar aur cholesterol check karwao.

actions.en: Never take erection tablets without a doctor's advice, especially if you take any medicine for your heart.
actions.hg: Doctor ki salaah ke bina erection ki goliyan kabhi mat lo, khaaskar agar tum dil ki koi bhi dawa lete ho.

actions.en: Cut down on alcohol and stop smoking: both are among the lifestyle changes that can help.
actions.hg: Sharaab kam karo aur smoking chhodo: ye dono un lifestyle badlaavon mein se hain jo madad kar sakte hain.

actions.en: Ignore 'sex power' ads. Advertising such cures is a crime under the 1954 Drugs and Magic Remedies Act.
actions.hg: 'Sex power' ads ko ignore karo. Aise ilaaj ka ad dena 1954 ke Drugs and Magic Remedies Act ke under crime hai.

actions.en: If anxiety, low mood or drinking is behind it, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar iske peeche anxiety, udaasi ya peena hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo; free hai aur 24 ghante khula hai.

title.en: Your first cervical cancer screening: VIA, Pap and HPV tests, step by step
title.hg: Tumhari pehli cervical cancer screening: VIA, Pap aur HPV test, step by step

dek.en: Only 2% of Indian women aged 35-49 have ever had this test. Who needs it and from what age, how the three tests differ, what happens in the room, where to go, and why an abnormal result usually means a treatable change, not cancer.
dek.hg: 35-49 saal ki sirf 2% Indian women ne kabhi yeh test karwaya hai. Kise chahiye aur kis umar se, teeno tests mein kya fark hai, room ke andar kya hota hai, kahan jaana hai, aur abnormal result ka matlab aksar cancer nahi balki ek treatable badlaav kyun hota hai.

statLabel.en: of Indian women aged 35-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: 35-49 saal ki Indian women ne kabhi cervical cancer screening karwayi thi (NFHS-5)

label.en: of Indian women aged 35-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 35-49 saal ki Indian women ne kabhi cervical cancer screening karwayi thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: estimated cervical cancer deaths in India in 2024 (latest GLOBOCAN estimate)
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein cervical cancer se estimated deaths (GLOBOCAN ka latest estimate)

label.en: of women should be screened by age 35 and again by 45, under WHO's 2030 target
label.hg: women ki screening 35 aur phir 45 ki umar tak ho jaani chahiye, WHO ke 2030 target ke hisaab se

claim.en: An abnormal screening result means I have cancer.
claim.hg: Screening ka result abnormal aaya, matlab mujhe cancer hai.

truth.en: Screening looks for HPV or for early cell changes that appear years before cancer. An abnormal result usually leads to a closer look and, if needed, a simple treatment that prevents cancer.
truth.hg: Screening HPV ko ya cells ke un shuruaati badlaavon ko dhoondhti hai jo cancer se saalon pehle dikhte hain. Abnormal result ke baad aam taur par ek closer jaanch hoti hai aur zaroorat pade toh ek simple treatment, jo cancer ko hone se rokta hai.

actions.en: If you are 30 or older (25 if you are living with HIV) and have never been screened, ask a government health centre or a gynaecologist for a cervical screening test.
actions.hg: Agar tum 30 ya usse zyada ki ho (HIV ke saath jee rahi ho toh 25) aur kabhi screening nahi hui, toh government health centre ya gynaecologist se cervical screening test maango.

actions.en: Before the test, ask which test it is (VIA, Pap or HPV), when the result will come and how you will be told. Write it down.
actions.hg: Test se pehle poocho ki kaun sa test hai (VIA, Pap ya HPV), result kab aayega aur tumhe kaise bataya jaayega. Likh lo.

actions.en: Say it is your first time. Ask for a woman provider or a companion in the room if you want one, and say 'stop' if it hurts.
actions.hg: Bata do ki yeh tumhara pehla test hai. Chaho toh woman provider ya room mein kisi saath wale ko maango, aur dard ho toh 'ruko' bol do.

actions.en: If the result is abnormal, go to the follow-up visit. Treating early changes is quick and prevents cancer.
actions.hg: Result abnormal aaye toh follow-up visit par zaroor jao. Shuruaati badlaavon ka treatment jaldi ho jaata hai aur cancer ko rokta hai.

actions.en: Bleeding between periods, after sex or after menopause should not wait for a screening date. See a doctor now.
actions.hg: Periods ke beech, sex ke baad ya menopause ke baad bleeding ho, toh screening ki date ka wait mat karo. Abhi doctor ko dikhao.

title.en: One in six Indians with HIV doesn't know it: how to get a free, confidential HIV test
title.hg: HIV wale har 6 mein se 1 Indian ko pata hi nahi: free aur confidential HIV test kaise karwayein

dek.en: A government HIV test costs nothing, needs your consent and stays confidential by law. Where to go, what to say at the counter, when a negative result can be trusted, and what happens if it is positive.
dek.hg: Government centre par HIV test free hota hai, tumhari consent ke bina nahi ho sakta, aur law ke hisaab se confidential rehta hai. Kahan jaana hai, counter par kya bolna hai, negative result par kab bharosa karna hai, aur positive aaye toh aage kya hota hai.

statLabel.en: of people living with HIV in India knew their status in 2024-25
statLabel.hg: HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ko 2024-25 mein apna status pata tha

label.en: of people living with HIV knew their status in 2024-25; roughly 1 in 6 did not
label.hg: HIV wale logon ko 2024-25 mein apna status pata tha; lagbhag har 6 mein se 1 ko nahi

label.en: of HIV tests among people who walked in on their own were positive in 2024-25, nearly three times the 0.40% average
label.hg: khud walk-in karke aaye logon ke HIV tests positive nikle (2024-25), 0.40% average se lagbhag teen guna

label.en: government ART centres giving free HIV treatment (March 2025)
label.hg: government ART centres jahan HIV treatment free hai (March 2025)

label.en: of spouses, partners and children of people with HIV who were tested came back positive (2024-25)
label.hg: HIV wale logon ke jin spouses, partners aur bachchon ka test hua, unmein se positive nikle (2024-25)

claim.en: If I get an HIV test, my family or my employer will find out.
claim.hg: Agar maine HIV test karwaya, toh meri family ya office ko pata chal jayega.

truth.en: Under the HIV Act 2017, no one can test you without your informed consent, and no one can force you to disclose your status except by court order.
truth.hg: HIV Act 2017 ke under tumhari informed consent ke bina koi tumhara HIV test nahi kar sakta, aur court order ke bina koi tumhe apna status batane ke liye force nahi kar sakta.

actions.en: Walk into the HIV counselling and testing centre (ICTC) at a government hospital and say: "I want an HIV test." It is free.
actions.hg: Kisi government hospital ke HIV counselling aur testing centre (ICTC) mein jao aur bolo: "Mujhe HIV test karwana hai." Test free hai.

actions.en: If a possible exposure happened in the last 72 hours, do not wait for a test: go to a hospital today and ask about PEP.
actions.hg: Agar risky exposure pichhle 72 ghanton mein hua hai, toh test ka wait mat karo: aaj hi hospital jao aur PEP ke baare mein poocho.

actions.en: If you test negative soon after a risk, ask the counsellor when to repeat the test, and use condoms until then.
actions.hg: Risk ke kuch hi din baad test negative aaye, toh counsellor se poocho ki test dobara kab karwana hai, aur tab tak condom use karo.

actions.en: If a positive result is confirmed, go to the ART centre you are referred to. Treatment is free there, and counsellors can help you tell a partner.
actions.hg: Positive result confirm ho jaaye, toh jis ART centre par refer kiya jaye wahan zaroor jao. Wahan treatment free hai, aur partner ko batane mein counsellors help karte hain.

actions.en: Call 1097, free and confidential, to find the nearest testing or ART centre.
actions.hg: Nearest testing ya ART centre jaanne ke liye 1097 par call karo, free aur confidential.

title.en: India's cervical cancer deaths did not really halve in two years: how GLOBOCAN 2024 changed the estimate
title.hg: India mein cervical cancer deaths do saal mein sach mein aadhi nahi hui: GLOBOCAN 2024 ne estimate kaise badla

dek.en: The 2022 edition of the world's main cancer database said 79,906 Indian women died of cervical cancer. The 2024 edition says 36,319. No vaccine or treatment did that. The model was rebuilt, and the size of the correction shows how little India actually counts.
dek.hg: Duniya ke main cancer database ke 2022 edition ne kaha tha ki India mein 79,906 women cervical cancer se mari. 2024 edition kehta hai 36,319. Yeh kisi vaccine ya treatment ne nahi kiya. Model dobara banaya gaya, aur correction ka size dikhata hai ki India asal mein kitna kam ginta hai.

statLabel.en: cervical cancer deaths in India in the GLOBOCAN 2022 estimate; the 2024 edition says 36,319
statLabel.hg: India mein cervical cancer deaths, GLOBOCAN 2022 estimate ke hisaab se; 2024 edition kehta hai 36,319

label.en: estimated cervical cancer deaths in India in the GLOBOCAN 2022 edition
label.hg: GLOBOCAN 2022 edition mein India ki estimated cervical cancer deaths

label.en: estimated cervical cancer deaths in India in the GLOBOCAN 2024 edition
label.hg: GLOBOCAN 2024 edition mein India ki estimated cervical cancer deaths

label.en: India's share of the world's cervical cancer deaths in the 2024 edition; it was about 23% in the 2022 edition
label.hg: 2024 edition mein duniya ki cervical cancer deaths mein India ka hissa; 2022 edition mein yeh lagbhag 23% tha

label.en: of women aged 15-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ne kabhi cervical cancer screening karwayi thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: Cervical cancer deaths in India fell by more than half between 2022 and 2024.
claim.hg: 2022 aur 2024 ke beech India mein cervical cancer deaths aadhi se bhi kam ho gayi.

truth.en: The two figures come from two editions of a modelled estimate that use different inputs and methods. One cannot be subtracted from the other, and nothing in screening or vaccination explains a fall that size.
truth.hg: Dono figures ek modelled estimate ke do alag editions se hain, jinke inputs aur methods alag hain. Ek ko doosre se minus nahi kiya ja sakta, aur screening ya vaccination mein aisa kuch nahi hua jo itni badi giravat ko samjha sake.

actions.en: Before you share or compare a cancer number for India, check which GLOBOCAN edition it comes from.
actions.hg: India ka koi bhi cancer number share ya compare karne se pehle check karo ki woh GLOBOCAN ke kis edition se hai.

actions.en: Never subtract one edition's estimate from another's and call the difference a rise or a fall.
actions.hg: Ek edition ke estimate ko doosre se minus karke us farq ko kabhi 'badhna' ya 'ghatna' mat kaho.

actions.en: If you are a student, reporter or health worker, quote the latest estimate with its year and the word 'estimated'.
actions.hg: Agar tum student, reporter ya health worker ho, toh latest estimate ko uske saal aur 'estimated' shabd ke saath quote karo.

actions.en: Do not let a smaller number delay prevention: a 14-year-old girl can get the free HPV dose at a government facility, and adult women should ask a doctor about cervical screening.
actions.hg: Chhote number ki wajah se prevention mat taalo: 14 saal ki ladki ko government facility par free HPV dose mil sakti hai, aur adult women ko doctor se cervical screening ke baare mein poochna chahiye.

actions.en: Register every death in your family and ask the treating doctor to record the cause; deaths that are not recorded cannot be counted.
actions.hg: Parivaar mein har death register karwao aur ilaaj karne wale doctor se cause likhne ko kaho; jo deaths record nahi hoti, woh gini nahi ja sakti.

title.en: Chemist-counter antibiotics for 'discharge' can help gonorrhoea beat medicine
title.hg: 'Discharge' ke liye chemist se li gayi antibiotics gonorrhoea ko dawaon se jeetne mein madad kar sakti hain

dek.en: WHO says drug resistance has cut the treatment options for gonorrhoea. In India, where STIs are mostly treated by symptoms and much of that treatment is never recorded, a strip of tablets bought without a test can be part of the problem.
dek.hg: WHO kehta hai ki drug resistance ne gonorrhoea ke ilaaj ke options kam kar diye hain. India mein STIs ka ilaaj zyada tar symptoms dekh ke hota hai aur us ilaaj ka bada hissa kahin record hi nahi hota. Aise mein bina test ke kharidi gayi tablets ki strip is problem ka hissa ban sakti hai.

statLabel.en: STI/RTI cases managed by India's AIDS programme in 2024-25
statLabel.hg: STI/RTI cases jo India ke AIDS programme ne 2024-25 mein manage kiye

label.en: STI/RTI cases managed by India's AIDS programme in 2024-25, largely by symptoms
label.hg: STI/RTI cases jo India ke AIDS programme ne 2024-25 mein manage kiye, zyada tar symptoms ke basis pe

label.en: government STI clinics (Suraksha Clinics) at district hospitals and medical colleges
label.hg: sarkaari STI clinics (Suraksha Clinics), district hospitals aur medical colleges mein

label.en: jail for a first conviction for advertising a drug as a cure for venereal diseases such as gonorrhoea
label.hg: jail ho sakti hai pehli conviction mein, agar koi kisi dawa ko gonorrhoea jaisi venereal diseases ka ilaaj bata ke advertise kare

claim.en: If the discharge stops after a few tablets from the chemist, the infection is cured.
claim.hg: Chemist ki kuch tablets ke baad discharge ruk gaya, matlab infection theek ho gaya.

truth.en: Symptoms can stop while gonorrhoea stays in the body and keeps spreading. Only the right prescribed drug, taken in full, cures it, and partners need treatment too.
truth.hg: Symptoms ruk sakte hain jabki gonorrhoea body mein bana rehta hai aur failta rehta hai. Sirf sahi prescribed dawa, poori li jaaye, tabhi ilaaj hota hai, aur partners ka ilaaj bhi zaroori hai.

actions.en: For discharge, burning or a genital sore, see a doctor or go to a Suraksha Clinic at a district hospital or medical college. Do not ask the chemist to choose a drug.
actions.hg: Discharge, jalan ya genitals pe zakhm ho toh doctor ko dikhao ya district hospital ya medical college ke Suraksha Clinic jao. Chemist se mat kaho ki wo dawa chune.

actions.en: Take exactly what is prescribed, all of it, even if you feel fine in two days.
actions.hg: Jo prescribe hua hai bilkul wahi lo, poora lo, chahe do din mein theek lagne lage.

actions.en: Tell recent partners, so they can be examined and treated at the same time.
actions.hg: Apne recent partners ko batao, taaki unki jaanch aur ilaaj bhi saath mein ho.

actions.en: If symptoms continue after treatment, go back to the doctor. Never switch to another strip or reuse leftover antibiotics.
actions.hg: Ilaaj ke baad bhi symptoms rahein toh wapas doctor ke paas jao. Doosri strip pe switch mat karo, aur bachi hui antibiotics dobara mat lo.

actions.en: For confidential questions about STIs and HIV, call NACO's helpline 1097.
actions.hg: STIs aur HIV ke confidential sawaalon ke liye NACO ki helpline 1097 pe call karo.

title.en: 'Gupt rog' cures on railway walls and in your feed: the 1954 law that bans these ads, and why it is barely enforced
title.hg: Railway ki deewaron aur tumhari feed pe 'gupt rog' ka ilaaj: 1954 ka wo law jo in ads pe ban lagata hai, aur wo itna kam laagu kyun hota hai

dek.en: Wall paintings and social media reels promise secret cures for impotence, 'night fall' and childlessness. A law more than 70 years old makes most of those ads a crime. In 2025 the Supreme Court found it was not being implemented.
dek.hg: Deewaron pe likhe ads aur social media reels impotence, 'night fall' aur be-aulaadi ke secret ilaaj ka waada karte hain. 70 saal se bhi purana ek law inmein se zyada tar ads ko crime banata hai. 2025 mein Supreme Court ne paaya ki wo laagu hi nahi ho raha.

statLabel.en: in jail, a fine or both for a first conviction under the 1954 Drugs and Magic Remedies Act
statLabel.hg: jail, fine ya dono: 1954 ke Drugs and Magic Remedies Act ke under pehli conviction ki saza

label.en: in jail, a fine or both for a first conviction for publishing a banned 'cure' ad; up to a year for a repeat
label.hg: jail, fine ya dono: banned 'ilaaj' wala ad chhapne par pehli conviction ki saza; dobara pe ek saal tak

label.en: government STI clinics (Suraksha Clinics) at district hospitals and medical colleges
label.hg: sarkaari STI clinics (Suraksha Clinics), district hospitals aur medical colleges mein

label.en: visits to Suraksha Clinics in 2024-25
label.hg: visits Suraksha Clinics mein, 2024-25 mein

label.en: syphilis screenings at government STI clinics that came back reactive in 2024-25
label.hg: syphilis screenings jo 2024-25 mein sarkaari STI clinics mein reactive aayi

claim.en: 'Gupt rog' is a secret disease that only a 'specialist' clinic can cure, often in one visit.
claim.hg: 'Gupt rog' ek secret bimaari hai jise sirf koi 'specialist' clinic theek kar sakta hai, aksar ek hi mulaqat mein.

truth.en: Most 'gupt rog' are either normal body functions or real conditions, such as STIs and erectile dysfunction, that need a proper diagnosis and treatment. STIs can be tested and treated at government STI clinics.
truth.hg: Zyada tar 'gupt rog' ya toh shareer ke normal kaam hain, ya STIs aur erectile dysfunction jaisi real conditions, jinke liye sahi diagnosis aur ilaaj chahiye. STIs ka test aur ilaaj sarkaari STI clinics mein hota hai.

actions.en: Photograph or screenshot a 'gupt rog' or 'sex power' ad and complain to your state's drug control department or the police.
actions.hg: 'Gupt rog' ya 'sex power' wale ad ki photo ya screenshot lo, aur apne state ke drug control department ya police mein complaint karo.

actions.en: For a genital sore, discharge or burning, go to the Suraksha Clinic at a district hospital or medical college.
actions.hg: Genitals pe zakhm, discharge ya jalan ho toh district hospital ya medical college ke Suraksha Clinic jao.

actions.en: Ask for a test, not a 'course': syphilis, gonorrhoea and chlamydia are curable with the right antibiotics.
actions.hg: 'Course' nahi, test maango: syphilis, gonorrhoea aur chlamydia sahi antibiotics se theek ho jaate hain.

actions.en: If you are treated for an STI, make sure your partner is tested and treated too.
actions.hg: Agar tumhara STI ka ilaaj hua hai, toh pakka karo ki tumhare partner ka bhi test aur ilaaj ho.

actions.en: For confidential HIV information and counselling, call NACO's helpline 1097.
actions.hg: HIV ki confidential jaankaari aur counselling ke liye NACO ki helpline 1097 pe call karo.

title.en: Fired, refused treatment or tested without consent for HIV? How to use the HIV Act 2017 and its Ombudsman
title.hg: HIV ki wajah se job gayi, treatment se mana hua ya bina consent test hua? HIV Act 2017 aur Ombudsman ko kaise use karein

dek.en: Since 10 September 2018 it has been illegal in India to sack, segregate or refuse treatment to someone because of HIV, or to test them without consent. Here is what the law covers, who you complain to, what to keep as proof, and where the system is still thin.
dek.hg: 10 September 2018 se India mein HIV ki wajah se kisi ko job se nikalna, alag bithana ya treatment se mana karna, ya bina consent uska test karna illegal hai. Law kya cover karta hai, complaint kisse karni hai, proof mein kya rakhna hai, aur system abhi kahan kamzor hai.

statLabel.en: in prison, a fine of up to Rs 1 lakh, or both, for spreading hatred against people living with HIV (Sections 4 and 37)
statLabel.hg: jail, Rs 1 lakh tak fine, ya dono, HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ke khilaaf nafrat failane par (Sections 4 aur 37)

label.en: in prison, a fine of up to Rs 1 lakh, or both, for spreading hatred against people living with HIV
label.hg: jail, Rs 1 lakh tak fine, ya dono: HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ke khilaaf nafrat failane ki saza

label.en: forms of discrimination named in Section 3 of the HIV Act, from jobs and healthcare to housing and insurance
label.hg: tarah ke discrimination HIV Act ke Section 3 mein likhe hain, job aur healthcare se lekar housing aur insurance tak

label.en: maximum fine for ignoring an Ombudsman's order, plus up to Rs 5,000 for every day the failure continues
label.hg: tak fine Ombudsman ka order na maanne par, aur jab tak order na maana jaaye, har din Rs 5,000 tak aur

label.en: States/UTs had an HIV Ombudsman in March 2025
label.hg: States/UTs mein March 2025 mein HIV Ombudsman tha

claim.en: An employer or a hospital has a right to know your HIV status and to act on it.
claim.hg: Employer ya hospital ko tumhara HIV status jaanne ka aur us par action lene ka haq hai.

truth.en: No one can test you for HIV without your informed consent or force you to disclose your status except by court order, and denying a job or treatment because of HIV is illegal.
truth.hg: Tumhari informed consent ke bina koi tumhara HIV test nahi kar sakta, court order ke bina koi tumhe status batane ke liye majboor nahi kar sakta, aur HIV ki wajah se job ya treatment se mana karna illegal hai.

actions.en: Write down what happened the same day: date, place, names, exact words, witnesses. Keep every letter, message, report and form.
actions.hg: Jo hua, usi din likh lo: date, jagah, naam, exact words, witnesses. Har letter, message, report aur form sambhal kar rakho.

actions.en: Ask for any dismissal, transfer or refusal of treatment in writing, with the reason given. Paper is harder to deny than words.
actions.hg: Job se nikalna, transfer ya treatment se mana, sab likhit mein aur wajah ke saath maango. Kaagaz se mukarna zubaani baat se zyada mushkil hai.

actions.en: Complain in writing to the establishment's Complaints Officer, then to your state's HIV Ombudsman. Keep a copy and an acknowledgement.
actions.hg: Pehle establishment ke Complaints Officer ko likhit complaint do, phir apne state ke HIV Ombudsman ko. Copy aur acknowledgement apne paas rakho.

actions.en: Refuse any HIV test that nobody has explained to you. A job, a hospital or a school cannot make the test a condition.
actions.hg: Jo HIV test kisi ne tumhe samjhaya nahi, uske liye mana kar do. Job, hospital ya school test ko condition nahi bana sakte.

actions.en: Call NACO's helpline 1097 to find services and your state's Ombudsman, and NALSA on 15100 to ask about free legal aid.
actions.hg: Services aur apne state ka Ombudsman dhoondhne ke liye NACO helpline 1097 par call karo, aur free legal aid ke baare mein poochne ke liye NALSA ko 15100 par.

title.en: India's HIV Act took 17 months to start and promises treatment only 'as far as possible'
title.hg: India ke HIV Act ko lagu hone mein 17 mahine lage, aur treatment ka promise sirf 'as far as possible' hai

dek.en: The 2017 law banned discrimination against people with HIV and told every state to appoint an Ombudsman. By March 2025 some States and UTs still had no rules, no national count of complaints heard could be found, and the medicine 18.60 lakh people depend on rests on policy, not on a legal right.
dek.hg: 2017 ke law ne HIV wale logon ke saath discrimination ban kiya aur har state ko Ombudsman appoint karne ko kaha. March 2025 tak kuch States aur UTs mein rules hi nahi the, kitni complaints suni gayi iski koi national ginti nahi mili, aur jis medicine par 18.60 lakh log depend karte hain woh policy par tiki hai, legal right par nahi.

statLabel.en: had notified rules under the HIV Act by March 2025, nearly eight years after it became law
statLabel.hg: ne March 2025 tak HIV Act ke rules notify kiye the, law banne ke lagbhag aath saal baad

label.en: between the HIV Act becoming law in April 2017 and coming into force on 10 September 2018
label.hg: ka gap: April 2017 mein HIV Act law bana, aur 10 September 2018 ko jaakar lagu hua

label.en: States/UTs had notified rules under the Act by March 2025
label.hg: States/UTs ne March 2025 tak Act ke rules notify kiye the

label.en: States/UTs had an HIV Ombudsman in place by March 2025
label.hg: States/UTs mein March 2025 tak HIV Ombudsman tha

label.en: people on HIV treatment in March 2025, under a law that promises it only 'as far as possible'
label.hg: log March 2025 mein HIV treatment par the, ek aise law ke under jo treatment sirf 'as far as possible' promise karta hai

claim.en: The HIV Act gives every person with HIV a legal right to free treatment.
claim.hg: HIV Act har HIV-positive insaan ko free treatment ka legal right deta hai.

truth.en: Section 14 obliges governments to provide HIV treatment only 'as far as possible'. It is free at government centres as a matter of policy, not as an absolute legal right.
truth.hg: Section 14 governments ko HIV treatment sirf 'as far as possible' dene ko kehta hai. Government centres par treatment free hai, lekin policy ki wajah se, kisi absolute legal right ki wajah se nahi.

actions.en: If you face discrimination because of HIV, complain in writing to the Complaints Officer or your state's HIV Ombudsman. A law nobody uses is easy to neglect.
actions.hg: HIV ki wajah se discrimination ho, toh Complaints Officer ya apne state ke HIV Ombudsman ko likhit complaint do. Jis law ko koi use nahi karta, use nazarandaaz karna aasaan hota hai.

actions.en: Ask your State AIDS Control Society who your Ombudsman is and whether your state has notified rules under the HIV Act.
actions.hg: Apni State AIDS Control Society se poocho ki tumhara Ombudsman kaun hai, aur state ne HIV Act ke rules notify kiye hain ya nahi.

actions.en: Ask the Ombudsman's office for the six-monthly complaints report that Section 28 says must be published online.
actions.hg: Ombudsman ke office se woh six-monthly complaints report maango jo Section 28 ke hisaab se online publish honi chahiye.

actions.en: If you are on ART, do not stop because of a problem at your centre. Report it there and call NACO's helpline 1097.
actions.hg: ART par ho, toh centre ki kisi problem ki wajah se medicine mat chhodo. Wahin report karo aur NACO helpline 1097 par call karo.

title.en: Women with HIV are six times more likely to get cervical cancer: why ART centres should screen them first
title.hg: HIV ke saath jee rahi women ko cervical cancer ka risk chhe guna zyada: ART centres ko sabse pehle inki screening kyun karni chahiye

dek.en: HIV weakens the body's defence against HPV, the virus behind cervical cancer. In March 2025, 7.98 lakh Indian women were collecting HIV medicines from government centres. That is the easiest screening queue in the country. Here is the science, the schedule and how to ask for your test.
dek.hg: HIV body ki us defence ko kamzor karta hai jo HPV se ladti hai, yaani us virus se jo cervical cancer karta hai. March 2025 mein 7.98 lakh Indian women government centres se HIV ki dawa le rahi thin. Desh mein screening ki isse aasaan line koi nahi. Science, schedule aur test maangne ka tareeka, sab yahan hai.

statLabel.en: higher risk of cervical cancer for women living with HIV (WHO)
statLabel.hg: zyada cervical cancer ka risk, HIV ke saath jee rahi women ke liye (WHO)

label.en: the risk of cervical cancer for women living with HIV, compared with women without HIV (WHO)
label.hg: HIV ke saath jee rahi women mein cervical cancer ka risk, HIV ke bina wali women ke comparison mein (WHO)

label.en: women on HIV treatment at government ART centres in March 2025
label.hg: women March 2025 mein government ART centres par HIV treatment le rahi thin

label.en: government ART centres in India in March 2025
label.hg: government ART centres March 2025 mein India mein the

label.en: of Indian women aged 15-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki Indian women ne kabhi cervical cancer screening karwayi thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: My HIV is under control with medicines, so I do not need any other check-up.
claim.hg: Meri HIV dawaiyon se control mein hai, toh mujhe kisi aur check-up ki zaroorat nahi.

truth.en: ART lets the immune system recover, but women living with HIV still carry a higher risk of cervical cancer. WHO advises screening for all women living with HIV from age 25, every 3 to 5 years.
truth.hg: ART se immune system wapas strong hota hai, lekin HIV ke saath jee rahi women mein cervical cancer ka risk phir bhi zyada rehta hai. WHO ki advice hai ki HIV ke saath jee rahi sabhi women 25 saal ki umar se, har 3 se 5 saal mein screening karwayein.

actions.en: If you are a woman living with HIV and 25 or older, ask at your next ART visit: 'Where can I get my cervical screening test done?'
actions.hg: Agar tum HIV ke saath jee rahi woman ho aur 25 ya usse zyada umar ki ho, toh agli ART visit par poocho: 'Meri cervical screening kahan ho sakti hai?'

actions.en: Ask for a written referral to the gynaecology OPD, and keep the date and result with your treatment records so the next test is not missed.
actions.hg: Gynaecology OPD ke liye likhit referral maango, aur test ki date aur result apne treatment records ke saath rakho taaki agla test miss na ho.

actions.en: Do not wait for symptoms. But bleeding between periods, after sex or after menopause needs a doctor at any age.
actions.hg: Symptoms ka wait mat karo. Lekin periods ke beech, sex ke baad ya menopause ke baad bleeding ho, toh kisi bhi umar mein doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: Keep taking ART every day. Screening is added to HIV treatment; it never replaces it.
actions.hg: ART roz lete raho. Screening HIV treatment ke saath judti hai, uski jagah kabhi nahi leti.

actions.en: If you do not know where to go, or a health facility treats you badly because of HIV, call the national AIDS helpline 1097. It is toll-free and confidential.
actions.hg: Agar pata nahi kahan jaana hai, ya HIV ki wajah se koi health facility bura bartaav kare, toh national AIDS helpline 1097 par call karo. Yeh toll-free aur confidential hai.

title.en: HIV in India, 2024: 25.61 lakh people, 0.20% of adults, and the five states that carry the most
title.hg: HIV in India, 2024: 25.61 lakh log, rate sirf 0.20%, aur paanch states mein aadhe se zyada

dek.en: India has the second-largest number of people living with HIV in the world. The national rate looks tiny, more than half of them live in just five states, and the headline figures are estimates you need to read with care.
dek.hg: Duniya mein HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ki doosri sabse badi ginti India mein hai. National rate chhota dikhta hai, inmein se aadhe se zyada log sirf paanch states mein hain, aur headline figures estimates hain jinhe dhyaan se padhna padega.

statLabel.en: people estimated to be living with HIV in India in 2024
statLabel.hg: log 2024 mein India mein HIV ke saath jee rahe the (estimate)

label.en: people living with HIV in India in 2024 (estimate, range 21.89-30.67 lakh)
label.hg: log 2024 mein India mein HIV ke saath jee rahe the (estimate, range 21.89-30.67 lakh)

label.en: of adults aged 15-49 living with HIV in 2024 (global average: 0.70%)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ke adults mein HIV rate, 2024 (global average: 0.70%)

label.en: people living with HIV in Maharashtra, the most of any state (2024)
label.hg: log Maharashtra mein HIV ke saath jee rahe hain, kisi bhi state se zyada (2024)

label.en: of people newly diagnosed in 2024-25 reported heterosexual sex
label.hg: 2024-25 mein naye diagnose hue logon ne heterosexual sex ko wajah bataya

claim.en: HIV was a 1990s problem. In India it is basically over.
claim.hg: HIV toh 90s ki problem thi. India mein ab yeh basically khatam ho chuka hai.

truth.en: An estimated 25.61 lakh people in India were living with HIV in 2024. The adult rate has fallen since the late 1990s, but the number of people living with the virus has stayed at roughly 25-26 lakh for years.
truth.hg: 2024 mein India mein andaazan 25.61 lakh log HIV ke saath jee rahe the. 90s ke end se adult rate zaroor gira hai, par HIV wale logon ki ginti saalon se lagbhag 25-26 lakh par atki hui hai.

actions.en: If you have ever had sex without a condom or shared a needle, get an HIV test. It is the only way to know.
actions.hg: Agar tumne kabhi bina condom sex kiya hai ya kisi aur ki needle use ki hai, toh HIV test karao. Pata karne ka yahi ek tareeka hai.

actions.en: Use a condom with any partner whose HIV status you do not know, including a regular partner, until you have both tested.
actions.hg: Jis partner ka HIV status tumhe nahi pata, uske saath condom use karo, chahe woh regular partner hi kyun na ho, jab tak tum dono test na kara lo.

actions.en: If you test positive, start treatment at a government ART centre, where it is free.
actions.hg: Test positive aaye toh government ART centre par treatment shuru karo. Wahan treatment free hai.

actions.en: Call NACO's toll-free helpline 1097 for confidential advice, any time of day.
actions.hg: NACO ki toll-free helpline 1097 par din ho ya raat, kabhi bhi call karo. Baat confidential rehti hai.

actions.en: Before you share an HIV number, check its year, its source and whether it is an estimate.
actions.hg: Koi bhi HIV figure aage bhejne se pehle check karo: kis saal ka hai, kis report se hai, aur kya woh estimate hai.

title.en: Only 1 in 5 young Indian women knows the basics of HIV, and the share has slipped since 2015-16
title.hg: Sirf 5 mein se 1 young Indian woman ko HIV ki basic baatein pata hain, aur 2015-16 ke baad yeh share thoda gira hai

dek.en: India's national health survey checked five basic points about HIV. Only 20.1% of women and 28.5% of men aged 15-24 got them all right, slightly fewer than five years earlier. Who knows, who was never told, and the facts every reader should be able to state.
dek.hg: India ke national health survey ne HIV ke paanch basic points check kiye. 15-24 saal ki sirf 20.1% women aur 28.5% men ke paanchon sahi the, paanch saal pehle se thoda kam. Kise pata hai, kise kabhi bataya hi nahi gaya, aur woh facts jo har reader ko zubaani aane chahiye.

statLabel.hg: 15-24 saal ki young women ko HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
