label.hg: 15-24 saal ki young women ko 2019-21 mein HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi (2015-16 mein 22%)

label.en: of young men aged 15-24 had comprehensive knowledge of HIV in 2019-21 (32% in 2015-16)
label.hg: 15-24 saal ke young men ko 2019-21 mein HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi (2015-16 mein 32%)

label.en: of women aged 15-49 did not know that HIV cannot be transmitted by mosquito bites
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ko nahi pata tha ki HIV machhar ke kaatne se nahi phailta

label.en: of young women in Bihar had comprehensive knowledge of HIV, against 69% in Mizoram
label.hg: Bihar ki young women ko HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi, jabki Mizoram mein 69% ko

claim.en: Young Indians already know all about HIV; the awareness campaigns did their job.
claim.hg: Aaj ke young Indians ko HIV ke baare mein sab pata hai; awareness campaigns ne apna kaam kar diya.

truth.en: In NFHS-5 only 20.1% of young women and 28.5% of young men got five basic points about HIV right, slightly fewer than in 2015-16.
truth.hg: NFHS-5 mein sirf 20.1% young women aur 28.5% young men ne HIV ke paanch basic points sahi bataye, 2015-16 se thoda kam.

actions.en: Learn the basics well enough to say them aloud: how HIV spreads, how it does not, and that only a test can tell who has it.
actions.hg: Basics itne achhe se seekho ki bol kar bata sako: HIV kaise phailta hai, kaise nahi phailta, aur yeh ki kise HIV hai, yeh sirf test bata sakta hai.

actions.en: This week, ask five people around you how HIV spreads, and correct wrong answers without mocking anyone.
actions.hg: Is hafte apne aas-paas ke paanch logon se poocho ki HIV kaise phailta hai, aur galat jawab bina mazaak udaye theek karo.

actions.en: If a possible exposure happened in the last 72 hours, go to a hospital now and ask for PEP.
actions.hg: Agar possible exposure pichhle 72 ghanton mein hua hai, toh abhi hospital jao aur PEP maango.

actions.en: If you have ever had a risk, get tested: call 1097 to find the nearest government testing centre.
actions.hg: Agar kabhi bhi risk hua hai, toh test karwao: 1097 par call karke sabse paas ka government testing centre poocho.

actions.en: Eat, study and live with people who have HIV as you would with anyone else: none of that spreads the virus.
actions.hg: HIV wale logon ke saath waise hi khao, padho aur raho jaise kisi aur ke saath: inmein se kisi cheez se virus nahi phailta.

title.en: PEP: the 28-day medicine that can stop HIV, if you start within 72 hours
title.hg: PEP: 28 din ki wo dawa jo HIV se bacha sakti hai, agar 72 ghante ke andar shuru ho jaaye

dek.en: After a torn condom, a needle-stick or a sexual assault, a course of medicine can stop HIV from taking hold, if it starts within 72 hours. Most young Indians lack comprehensive HIV knowledge. Here is who needs PEP, where to ask, and what the law says about free treatment.
dek.hg: Condom phat jaaye, used needle chubh jaaye ya sexual assault ho, toh medicine ka ek course HIV ko body mein basne se rok sakta hai, agar 72 ghante ke andar shuru ho. Zyada tar young Indians ke paas HIV ki comprehensive jaankari nahi hai. Kisko PEP chahiye, kahan maangni hai, aur free ilaaj par law kya kehta hai.

statLabel.en: people newly infected with HIV in India in 2024 (estimate)
statLabel.hg: logon ko 2024 mein India mein naya HIV infection hua (estimate)

label.en: hours: the latest point to start PEP after an exposure; sooner is better
label.hg: ghante: exposure ke baad PEP shuru karne ki aakhri limit; jitni jaldi, utna better

label.en: days of medicine, taken every day, in one course of PEP
label.hg: din tak roz dawa: yahi hai PEP ka ek poora course

label.en: people newly infected with HIV in India in 2024 (estimate)
label.hg: logon ko 2024 mein India mein naya HIV infection hua (estimate)

label.en: of people newly diagnosed with HIV in 2024-25 reported sex with a regular partner as the route
label.hg: 2024-25 mein naye HIV diagnose hue logon ne regular partner ke saath sex ko route bataya

claim.en: If the condom broke, all you can do is wait a few weeks and get tested.
claim.hg: Condom phat gaya? Ab bas kuch hafte wait karo, phir test karwa lo.

truth.en: PEP started within 72 hours, and the sooner the better, can stop HIV from taking hold. Waiting is what closes that window.
truth.hg: PEP 72 ghante ke andar, aur jitni jaldi ho sake, shuru ho jaaye toh HIV ko body mein basne se rok sakti hai. Wait karne se hi ye mauka haath se nikalta hai.

actions.en: If you may have been exposed to HIV, go to a hospital now: PEP must start within 72 hours, and sooner is better.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe HIV ka risk hua hai, toh abhi hospital jao: PEP 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye, aur jitni jaldi utna better.

actions.en: At the emergency ward, say the words "I need HIV PEP", then take every dose for all 28 days.
actions.hg: Emergency ward mein seedha bolo, "Mujhe HIV PEP chahiye", phir poore 28 din har din ki dose lo.

actions.en: Call NACO's free, confidential helpline 1097 to find out where to get PEP near you.
actions.hg: NACO ki free aur confidential helpline 1097 pe call karke pucho ki tumhare paas PEP kahan milegi.

actions.en: After a sexual assault, ask for PEP and, if pregnancy is possible, emergency contraception; every hospital must treat a rape survivor immediately and free of cost.
actions.hg: Sexual assault ke baad PEP maango, aur agar pregnancy ho sakti hai toh emergency contraception bhi; har hospital ko rape survivor ka ilaaj turant aur free karna hota hai.

actions.en: Go back for the follow-up HIV tests your doctor schedules, and use condoms until the results are clear.
actions.hg: Doctor ne follow-up HIV tests ke liye jo din diya hai, us din zaroor jao, aur results clear aane tak condom use karo.

title.en: PrEP, the pill that prevents HIV: who in India should ask a doctor about it
title.hg: PrEP, HIV se bachane wali goli: India mein kisko doctor se iske baare mein poochna chahiye

dek.en: A daily pill can keep an HIV-negative person negative. Straight answers on who it is for, what it does not do, which tests come with it, and how to raise it with a doctor without shame.
dek.hg: Roz ki ek goli HIV-negative insaan ko negative rakh sakti hai. Seedhe jawab: ye kiske liye hai, kya nahi karti, iske saath kaunse tests hote hain, aur bina sharam ke doctor se baat kaise shuru karein.

statLabel.en: HIV prevalence among men who have sex with men in 2024 (all adults: 0.20%)
statLabel.hg: men who have sex with men mein HIV prevalence, 2024 (sabhi adults mein: 0.20%)

label.en: HIV prevalence among people who inject drugs in 2024, the highest of any group
label.hg: inject karke drugs lene walon mein HIV prevalence, 2024; kisi bhi group mein sabse zyada

label.en: HIV prevalence among hijra and transgender people in 2024
label.hg: hijra aur transgender logon mein HIV prevalence, 2024

label.en: HIV prevalence among men who have sex with men in 2024, more than ten times the adult average of 0.20%
label.hg: men who have sex with men mein HIV prevalence, 2024; adults ke average 0.20% se das guna se bhi zyada

label.en: HIV prevalence among female sex workers in 2024
label.hg: female sex workers mein HIV prevalence, 2024

claim.en: PrEP is only for people who 'sleep around'.
claim.hg: PrEP toh bas unke liye hai jo 'sleep around' karte hain.

truth.en: PrEP is for anyone at real, ongoing risk of HIV, including someone in a faithful relationship with a partner who has HIV and is not yet undetectable on treatment.
truth.hg: PrEP har us insaan ke liye hai jise HIV ka real aur ongoing risk hai, including koi jo poori wafadari se ek aise partner ke saath hai jise HIV hai aur jiska virus treatment se abhi undetectable nahi hua.

actions.en: If your risk of HIV is ongoing, ask a doctor in plain words: "Is PrEP right for me?"
actions.hg: Agar tumhe HIV ka risk lagaataar rehta hai, toh doctor se seedha pucho: "Kya PrEP mere liye sahi hai?"

actions.en: Get an HIV test before starting PrEP, and keep every follow-up test appointment.
actions.hg: PrEP shuru karne se pehle HIV test karwao, aur har follow-up test pe zaroor jao.

actions.en: Take PrEP exactly as prescribed; never start, skip or stop it on your own, and never use someone else's pills.
actions.hg: PrEP bilkul waise lo jaise prescribe hui hai; apne mann se shuru, skip ya band mat karo, aur kabhi kisi aur ki goliyan mat lo.

actions.en: Keep using condoms: PrEP does not prevent pregnancy, syphilis or other STIs.
actions.hg: Condom use karte raho: PrEP pregnancy, syphilis ya doosre STIs se nahi bachati.

actions.en: If a clinic shames or refuses you, call 1097; if you live with someone who has HIV, or your consent or confidentiality was breached, complain to your state's HIV Ombudsman.
actions.hg: Agar koi clinic tumhe sharminda kare ya mana kare, toh 1097 pe call karo; agar tum HIV wale kisi insaan ke saath rehte ho, ya tumhari consent ya confidentiality ke rules tode gaye, toh apne state ke HIV Ombudsman se complaint karo.

title.en: Free, one dose, at 14: what parents ask about India's 2026 HPV vaccine campaign
title.hg: Free, ek dose, 14 saal par: India ke 2026 HPV vaccine campaign par parents ke sawaal

dek.en: Since February, government health facilities across India have offered 14-year-old girls a single free shot against the virus behind most cervical cancers. Straight answers to what parents actually ask: is one dose enough, is it safe, what does consent mean, and what about a son?
dek.hg: February se India bhar ki government health facilities 14 saal ki ladkiyon ko us virus ke khilaaf ek free shot de rahi hain jo zyadatar cervical cancers ke peeche hai. Parents jo sach mein poochte hain, unke seedhe jawaab: kya ek dose kaafi hai, kya yeh safe hai, consent ka matlab kya hai, aur bete ka kya?

statLabel.en: of cervical cancers in India are caused by HPV types 16 and 18
statLabel.hg: India mein cervical cancer ke cases HPV type 16 aur 18 se hote hain

label.en: girls aged 14 in the campaign's yearly target group
label.hg: 14 saal ki ladkiyan, campaign ka har saal ka target group

label.en: HPV vaccine doses given under the campaign by 11 September 2026
label.hg: 11 September 2026 tak campaign mein lagi HPV vaccine doses

label.en: States and UTs where the free dose is offered at government facilities
label.hg: States aur UTs jahan government facilities par free dose milti hai

label.en: of women aged 15-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ne kabhi cervical cancer screening karwayi thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

actions.en: If your daughter is 14, take her to the nearest government health facility and give your consent for the free single dose.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari beti 14 saal ki hai, toh use nearest government health facility le jao aur free single dose ke liye apna consent do.

actions.en: If she was already vaccinated at a private clinic, carry the record so it is entered on U-WIN instead of giving another dose.
actions.hg: Agar use private clinic mein pehle hi vaccine lag chuki hai, toh record saath le jao taaki doosri dose dene ki jagah U-WIN par entry ho jaaye.

actions.en: Tell her in plain words what the shot is for: it protects against a virus that can cause cancer years later.
actions.hg: Use seedhe shabdon mein batao ki yeh shot kis liye hai: yeh ek aise virus se bachata hai jo saalon baad cancer kar sakta hai.

actions.en: If your child is a boy or past the eligible age, ask a doctor about private vaccination and what it costs.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha ladka hai ya eligible umar nikal chuki hai, toh doctor se private vaccination aur uske kharche ke baare mein poocho.

actions.en: Remember the second half: as an adult, she will still need cervical screening.
actions.hg: Doosra hissa yaad rakho: badi hone par use cervical screening ki zaroorat phir bhi padegi.

title.en: 1 in 6 adults face infertility, and it is not always the woman: busting the 'banjh' myth
title.hg: 6 mein se 1 adult ko infertility hoti hai, aur wajah hamesha aurat nahi hoti: 'banjh' wale myth ka sach

dek.en: WHO estimates that 17.5% of adults experience infertility in their lifetime. In Indian families it is still the wife who gets tested, taunted and taken to a baba, while her husband gives no sample. Three myths, checked against the medicine.
dek.hg: WHO ka estimate hai ki 17.5% adults ko zindagi mein kabhi na kabhi infertility hoti hai. Indian families mein aaj bhi test biwi ke hote hain, taane biwi sunti hai aur baba ke paas bhi wahi le jaayi jaati hai, jabki pati ek sample tak nahi deta. Teen myths, medicine ke saamne rakh kar.

statLabel.en: of adults worldwide experience infertility in their lifetime (WHO, 2023)
statLabel.hg: duniya ke adults ko zindagi mein kabhi na kabhi infertility hoti hai (WHO, 2023)

label.en: of adults worldwide, about 1 in 6, experience infertility in their lifetime (WHO, 2023)
label.hg: duniya ke adults, yaani lagbhag 6 mein se 1, zindagi mein kabhi na kabhi infertility face karte hain (WHO, 2023)

label.en: lifetime prevalence in low- and middle-income countries, against 17.8% in high-income ones
label.hg: low- aur middle-income deshon mein lifetime prevalence, jabki high-income deshon mein 17.8%

label.en: of Indian women aged 18-40 have PCOS by the broadest criteria, 7.2% by the strictest (ICMR-funded study, 2024)
label.hg: 18-40 saal ki Indian aurton ko sabse broad criteria se PCOS hai, sabse strict criteria se 7.2% (ICMR-funded study, 2024)

label.en: of men in a seven-state survey said having at least one son is very important; 81% of women agreed (2014)
label.hg: mardon ne saat states ke survey mein kaha ki kam se kam ek beta hona bahut zaroori hai; 81% aurton ne bhi yahi kaha (2014)

claim.en: If a couple has no child, the fault is in the woman. She is 'banjh'.
claim.hg: Agar couple ko bachcha nahi ho raha, toh kami aurat mein hai. Woh 'banjh' hai.

truth.en: Infertility is a condition of the male or female reproductive system. The cause can lie with the man, the woman, both, or stay unexplained, so both partners must be tested from the start.
truth.hg: Infertility male ya female reproductive system ki ek condition hai. Wajah mard mein ho sakti hai, aurat mein, dono mein, ya pata hi na chale, isliye shuru se dono partners ka test hona chahiye.

actions.en: After 12 months of trying without a pregnancy, see a doctor as a couple. Ask a doctor sooner if her periods are irregular or absent, or if age is a worry.
actions.hg: 12 mahine koshish ke baad bhi pregnancy na ho, toh couple ki tarah saath mein doctor se miliye. Agar periods irregular hain ya aate hi nahi, ya umar ko lekar fikr hai, toh doctor se pehle hi miliye.

actions.en: Insist that both partners are tested from the first visit. A semen analysis is a lab test on a sample: no needle, no surgery.
actions.hg: Pehli visit se hi dono partners ke test par zor dijiye. Semen analysis ek sample par hone wala lab test hai: na sui, na surgery.

actions.en: Do not pay for 'guaranteed' powders, tonics or rituals. Ask any clinic what exactly it is treating and what the chances are.
actions.hg: 'Guaranteed' powder, tonic ya totkon par paisa mat lagaiye. Kisi bhi clinic se poochiye ki woh exactly kis cheez ka ilaaj kar raha hai aur chances kitne hain.

actions.en: Stop using the word 'banjh', and say so when a relative uses it.
actions.hg: 'Banjh' shabd bolna band kijiye, aur jab koi rishtedaar bole toh use wahin tokiye.

actions.en: If taunts turn into threats or violence, call the Women Helpline 181. For distress, Tele-MANAS 14416 is free.
actions.hg: Agar taane dhamki ya violence mein badal jaayein, toh Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye. Mann par bojh ho toh Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai.

title.en: Free, immediate, at any hospital: the medical care a sexual assault survivor is owed under Section 397 BNSS
title.hg: Free, turant, kisi bhi hospital mein: Section 397 BNSS ke tahat sexual assault survivor ko kaun sa ilaaj milna hi chahiye

dek.en: Since 2013, Indian law has said a hospital may not turn away a rape survivor, ask her for money or make her wait for the police. What that care must include, who the law still leaves out, and what to do when a hospital refuses.
dek.hg: 2013 se law saaf kehta hai: koi hospital rape survivor ko lauta nahi sakta, usse paise nahi maang sakta, aur use police ke intezaar mein bitha kar nahi rakh sakta. Is ilaaj mein kya-kya aata hai, law kise ab bhi chhod deta hai, aur hospital mana kare toh kya karein.

statLabel.en: jail for a hospital in-charge who refuses free treatment to a rape or acid-attack survivor (s.200 BNS)
statLabel.hg: ki jail: us hospital in-charge ke liye jo rape ya acid-attack survivor ka free ilaaj karne se mana kare (s.200 BNS)

label.en: jail for a hospital in-charge who breaks the free-treatment rule of Section 397 BNSS (s.200 BNS)
label.hg: ki jail, agar hospital in-charge Section 397 BNSS wala free ilaaj ka rule tode (s.200 BNS)

label.en: the latest point to start HIV PEP after an assault; the course then runs for 28 days
label.hg: assault ke baad HIV PEP shuru karne ki aakhri limit; uske baad dawa 28 din chalti hai

label.en: cases police registered under IPC Section 377 in 2023; the BNS dropped the section, and the 2024 data has no such category
label.hg: case police ne 2023 mein IPC Section 377 mein darj kiye; BNS ne yeh section hata diya, aur 2024 ke data mein yeh category hi nahi hai

label.en: One Stop Centres working in July 2026, out of 1,033 approved
label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein chal rahe the, 1,033 approved centres mein se

claim.en: A hospital can make a rape survivor wait for the police, pay a deposit or go to a government hospital instead.
claim.hg: Hospital rape survivor se keh sakta hai: pehle police ko aane do, pehle deposit jama karo, ya sarkari hospital jao.

truth.en: Section 397 of the BNSS orders every hospital, public or private, to treat her immediately and free of cost. Informing the police is the hospital's job, and treatment does not wait for it.
truth.hg: BNSS ka Section 397 har hospital ko, sarkari ho ya private, uska ilaaj turant aur free karne ka order deta hai. Police ko khabar karna hospital ka kaam hai, aur ilaaj uske liye nahi rukta.

actions.en: Go to the nearest hospital, government or private, and ask for free treatment under Section 397 of the BNSS.
actions.hg: Sabse paas ke hospital jaiye, sarkari ho ya private, aur Section 397 BNSS ke tahat free ilaaj maangiye.

actions.en: Ask by name for HIV PEP (start within 72 hours) and emergency contraception (up to 5 days), even if you refuse the evidence exam.
actions.hg: HIV PEP (72 ghante ke andar shuru) aur emergency contraception (5 din tak) naam lekar maangiye, chahe aap evidence wale exam se mana kar dein.

actions.en: Before you leave, ask for STI tests, the hepatitis B vaccine and the date of your follow-up HIV test.
actions.hg: Hospital se nikalne se pehle STI tests, hepatitis B ka vaccine aur agle HIV test ki date maangiye.

actions.en: If a hospital refuses or asks for money, note the name, time and place, go to the next hospital first, and complain later: refusal is an offence under Section 200 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar hospital mana kare ya paise maange, toh naam, time aur jagah note kijiye. Pehle doosre hospital jaiye, complaint baad mein kijiye: Section 200 BNS mein ilaaj se mana karna offence hai.

actions.en: Ask for the nearest One Stop Centre for counselling, police and legal help, and call Tele-MANAS on 14416 whenever you need to talk.
actions.hg: Counselling, police aur legal help ke liye sabse paas ka One Stop Centre poochiye, aur baat karni ho toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call kijiye.

title.en: Hot flushes, dryness and painful sex after 45: the menopause questions Indian women are never asked
title.hg: 45 ke baad hot flushes, dryness aur painful sex: menopause ke woh sawaal jo Indian women se koi nahi poochta

dek.en: Every woman who lives long enough reaches menopause, yet most are told to bear it in silence. Straight answers on what is changing, what can be treated, why contraception still matters, and why these are the years to be screened for the two most common cancers in Indian women.
dek.hg: Jo bhi woman lambi umar jeeti hai, menopause tak pahunchti hai, phir bhi zyada tar se kaha jaata hai ki chupchaap seh lo. Seedhe jawab: kya badal raha hai, kya treat ho sakta hai, contraception ab bhi kyun zaroori hai, aur yahi saal Indian women ke do sabse common cancers ki screening ke kyun hain.

statLabel.en: of all cancers in Indian women are breast cancers (2024 estimate)
statLabel.hg: Indian women ke saare cancers mein breast cancer ka hissa (2024 estimate)

label.en: of Indian women aged 35-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 35-49 saal ki Indian women ne kabhi cervical cancer screening karwayi thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women aged 15-49 had ever had a breast cancer screening test (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ne kabhi breast cancer screening test karwaya tha (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of all cancers in Indian women are breast cancers (GLOBOCAN 2024 estimate)
label.hg: Indian women ke saare cancers mein breast cancer ka hissa (GLOBOCAN 2024 estimate)

label.en: of women should be screened by age 35 and again by 45, under WHO's 2030 target
label.hg: women ki screening 35 ki umar tak aur phir 45 tak honi chahiye, WHO ke 2030 target ke hisaab se

claim.en: Menopause is just something a woman has to put up with.
claim.hg: Menopause toh bas woh cheez hai jo aurat ko sehni hi padti hai.

truth.en: Hot flushes, poor sleep, dryness and painful sex are common and treatable. A doctor can help, and the same visit is a chance to be screened for cervical and breast cancer.
truth.hg: Hot flushes, kharab neend, dryness aur painful sex common hain aur treat ho sakte hain. Doctor madad kar sakta hai, aur usi visit mein cervical aur breast cancer ki screening bhi ho sakti hai.

actions.en: If hot flushes, broken sleep or low mood are disrupting your days, see a gynaecologist or physician and ask what treatment suits you, including whether hormone therapy is safe for you.
actions.hg: Agar hot flushes, tooti neend ya low mood tumhare din kharab kar rahe hain, toh gynaecologist ya physician se milo aur poocho ki tumhare liye kaun sa treatment theek hai, aur hormone therapy tumhare liye safe hai ya nahi.

actions.en: For dryness or painful sex, use a water- or silicone-based lubricant and ask a doctor about vaginal moisturisers or low-dose vaginal oestrogen. Stop whenever it hurts.
actions.hg: Dryness ya painful sex ke liye water-based ya silicone-based lubricant use karo, aur doctor se vaginal moisturisers ya low-dose vaginal oestrogen ke baare mein poocho. Jab bhi dard ho, ruk jao.

actions.en: Keep using contraception until a doctor confirms that your periods have stopped for 12 months in a row.
actions.hg: Jab tak doctor confirm na kare ki periods lagataar 12 mahine se band hain, contraception use karte raho.

actions.en: Ask for a cervical screening test and a breast examination at your next visit, and see a doctor promptly for a new breast lump or any bleeding after sex or after menopause.
actions.hg: Agli visit par cervical screening test aur breast examination maango. Breast mein nayi lump ho, ya sex ke baad ya menopause ke baad bleeding ho, toh jaldi doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: If a husband forces sex, call Women Helpline 181. If low mood will not lift, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar husband zabardasti sex kare, toh Women Helpline 181 par call karo. Agar low mood theek hi na ho, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, free aur din-raat.

title.en: One in 10 babies born to Indian mothers with HIV still gets the virus. That is preventable
title.hg: HIV wali maaon ke 10 mein se 1 bachche ko aaj bhi virus mil jaata hai. Ise roka ja sakta hai

dek.en: India has cut mother-to-child HIV transmission from more than one in four to about one in ten. Testing every pregnant woman, treatment through pregnancy and breastfeeding, and early tests for the baby can stop most of the rest.
dek.hg: India mein maa se bachche ko HIV jaane ki rate chaar mein ek se bhi zyada thi, ab ghat kar lagbhag das mein ek reh gayi hai. Har pregnant woman ka test, pregnancy aur breastfeeding ke poore time treatment, aur bachche ka jaldi test, baaki zyada tar cases ko bhi rok sakte hain.

statLabel.en: estimated rate of mother-to-child HIV transmission in India (2024-25)
statLabel.hg: India mein maa se bachche ko HIV transmission ki estimated rate (2024-25)

label.en: estimated rate of mother-to-child HIV transmission in 2024-25, down from more than 25% in 2020-21
label.hg: maa se bachche ko HIV transmission ki estimated rate, 2024-25; 2020-21 mein ye 25% se zyada thi

label.en: of pregnant women were tested for HIV in 2024-25
label.hg: pregnant women ka 2024-25 mein HIV test hua

label.en: of pregnant women were tested for syphilis in 2024-25
label.hg: pregnant women ka 2024-25 mein syphilis test hua

label.en: children, approximately, on HIV treatment at government ART centres in March 2025
label.hg: ke aas-paas bachche March 2025 mein government ART centres pe HIV treatment le rahe the

claim.en: If a pregnant woman tests HIV-positive, she must have brought HIV into the family.
claim.hg: Pregnant woman ka HIV test positive aaya hai, toh pakka wahi family mein HIV laayi hogi.

truth.en: Pregnancy is often just the first time anyone in the family is tested. In a marriage HIV can travel either way, and a test result says nothing about who had it first.
truth.hg: Aksar pregnancy hi wo pehla mauka hota hai jab family mein kisi ka test hota hai. Shaadi mein HIV kisi bhi taraf se aa sakta hai, aur test result ye nahi batata ki pehle kisko tha.

actions.en: Get tested for HIV and syphilis at your first antenatal check-up, and ask for the results.
actions.hg: Pregnancy ke pehle check-up mein hi HIV aur syphilis test karwaiye, aur results zaroor maangiye.

actions.en: If the HIV test is positive, start treatment as early in pregnancy as possible and keep taking it through breastfeeding.
actions.hg: HIV test positive aaye, toh pregnancy mein jitni jaldi ho sake treatment shuru kijiye, aur breastfeeding ke poore time dawa lete rahiye.

actions.en: Partners: get tested the same week, then start treatment or prevention depending on your result.
actions.hg: Partners: usi hafte apna test karwaiye, phir result ke hisaab se treatment ya prevention shuru kijiye.

actions.en: Take the baby for every early HIV test and give the preventive medicine exactly as prescribed.
actions.hg: Bachche ke har early HIV test ke liye zaroor jaaiye, aur prevention wali dawa bilkul waise dijiye jaise doctor ne likhi hai.

actions.en: If a hospital refuses care, isolates you or pressures you to disclose your status, complain to your state's HIV Ombudsman or call 1097.
actions.hg: Agar hospital ilaaj se mana kare, aapko alag rakhe ya status batane ka pressure daale, toh state ke HIV Ombudsman se complaint kijiye ya 1097 pe call kijiye.

title.en: Legal since Navtej in 2018, still hiding at the clinic: sexual health for men who have sex with men
title.hg: 2018 mein Navtej se legal, par clinic mein aaj bhi chhupana padta hai: men who have sex with men ki sexual health

dek.en: The Supreme Court ended the crime in 2018. Clinic forms, doctors' questions and family gossip stayed as they were, so many men still hide their partners from doctors and miss the tests they need. What the data show, what to say at the clinic, and what the law gives you.
dek.hg: Supreme Court ne 2018 mein crime khatam kar diya. Clinic ke forms, doctors ke sawaal aur family ki gossip wahi ke wahi rahe, isliye men aaj bhi doctors se apne partners chhupate hain aur zaroori tests miss kar dete hain. Data kya dikhata hai, clinic mein kya bolna hai, aur law tumhe kya deta hai.

statLabel.en: of people newly diagnosed with HIV in 2024-25 reported homosexual or bisexual sex as the route, a share that stigma pushes down
statLabel.hg: 2024-25 mein HIV ke naye diagnose hue logon ne route homosexual ya bisexual sex bataya, ek share jise stigma neeche dhakelta hai

label.en: HIV prevalence among men who have sex with men in 2024, more than ten times the 0.20% among all adults
label.hg: 2024 mein men who have sex with men mein HIV prevalence, sabhi adults ke 0.20% se das guna se zyada

label.en: of 1,63,306 people newly diagnosed with HIV in 2024-25 reported homosexual or bisexual sex as the route
label.hg: 2024-25 mein HIV ke naye diagnose hue 1,63,306 logon mein se itnon ne route homosexual ya bisexual sex bataya

label.en: of those newly diagnosed gave no route of infection at all
label.hg: naye diagnose hue logon ne infection ka koi route bataya hi nahi

label.en: government STI clinics (Suraksha Clinics) at district hospitals and medical colleges
label.hg: government STI clinics (Suraksha Clinics), district hospitals aur medical colleges mein

claim.en: Section 377 is gone, so a gay or bisexual man now gets the same care at a clinic as anyone else.
claim.hg: Section 377 ja chuka hai, toh ab gay ya bisexual man ko clinic mein wahi care milti hai jo kisi aur ko.

truth.en: The 2018 judgment ended the crime. It did not change clinic forms, doctors' assumptions or family gossip, so many men still hide their partners and miss the tests and prevention they need.
truth.hg: 2018 ke judgment ne crime khatam kiya. Usne clinic ke forms, doctors ki assumptions ya family ki gossip nahi badli, isliye bahut se men aaj bhi apne partners chhupate hain aur zaroori tests aur prevention miss kar dete hain.

actions.en: Tell the doctor one plain sentence: "I have sex with men, and I want a full STI check."
actions.hg: Doctor se ek seedha sentence bolo: "Main men ke saath sex karta hoon, aur mujhe full STI check chahiye."

actions.en: Ask for an HIV test, a syphilis blood test and, if you have oral or anal sex, throat and rectal swabs.
actions.hg: HIV test aur syphilis ka blood test maango, aur agar oral ya anal sex karte ho toh throat aur rectal swabs bhi.

actions.en: If a possible HIV exposure happened in the last 72 hours, go to a hospital today and ask for PEP; if your risk is ongoing, ask a doctor about PrEP.
actions.hg: Agar possible HIV exposure pichhle 72 ghanton mein hua hai, toh aaj hi hospital jao aur PEP maango; agar risk ongoing hai, toh doctor se PrEP ke baare mein poocho.

actions.en: If a doctor offers to 'cure' your orientation, leave and report it to the state medical council: it is professional misconduct.
actions.hg: Agar koi doctor tumhari orientation 'cure' karne ki baat kare, toh wahan se nikal jao aur state medical council mein report karo: yeh professional misconduct hai.

actions.en: Call 1097 for confidential HIV and STI advice, or Tele-MANAS on 14416 if hiding is wearing you down.
actions.hg: Confidential HIV aur STI advice ke liye 1097 par call karo, aur agar chhupate-chhupate thak gaye ho toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par.

title.en: India cut AIDS deaths by 81% but new HIV infections by only 49%: the NACP-V target it missed
title.hg: AIDS deaths 81% gireen, par naye HIV infections sirf 49%: NACP-V ka woh target jo miss ho gaya

dek.en: India's fifth national AIDS programme promised to cut both new HIV infections and AIDS deaths by 80% from 2010 levels. Deaths fell past the target. New infections fell far short, and the number of people living with HIV in India is still slowly rising.
dek.hg: India ke paanchwe national AIDS programme ne promise kiya tha ki 2010 ke muqable naye HIV infections aur AIDS deaths, dono 80% kam honge. Deaths target se zyada gireen. Naye infections bahut peeche reh gaye, aur India mein HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ki ginti ab bhi dheere-dheere badh rahi hai.

statLabel.en: HIV incidence-mortality ratio in 2024; above 1 means the number of people living with HIV is still growing
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein HIV ka incidence-mortality ratio; 1 se upar matlab HIV wale logon ki ginti ab bhi badh rahi hai

label.en: cut in new HIV infections and AIDS deaths from 2010 levels that NACP-V (2021-2026) aimed for
label.hg: 2010 ke muqable naye HIV infections aur AIDS deaths mein itni kami ka target tha (NACP-V, 2021-2026)

label.en: fall in AIDS-related deaths, 2010 to 2024: target met
label.hg: 2010 se 2024 ke beech AIDS se judi deaths mein girawat: target poora

label.en: fall in new HIV infections, 2010 to 2024: target missed
label.hg: 2010 se 2024 ke beech naye HIV infections mein girawat: target miss

label.en: people newly infected with HIV in India in 2024 (estimate)
label.hg: logon ko 2024 mein India mein naya HIV infection hua (estimate)

claim.en: AIDS deaths have crashed, so HIV is under control in India.
claim.hg: AIDS deaths bahut gir gayi hain, toh India mein HIV control mein hai.

truth.en: Deaths fell 81.4% between 2010 and 2024, but new infections fell only 48.7%. New infections still slightly outnumber deaths among people living with HIV, so the number of people in India with the virus is still slowly growing.
truth.hg: 2010 se 2024 ke beech deaths 81.4% gireen, par naye infections sirf 48.7%. HIV wale logon mein jitni deaths hoti hain, naye infections ab bhi unse thode zyada hain, isliye India mein virus ke saath jee rahe logon ki ginti ab bhi dheere-dheere badh rahi hai.

actions.en: Get an HIV test if you have ever had sex without a condom or shared a needle. You cannot tell from how you feel.
actions.hg: Agar tumne kabhi bina condom sex kiya hai ya kisi aur ki needle use ki hai, toh HIV test karao. Sirf feel karke pata nahi chalta.

actions.en: If a condom breaks or you are exposed to HIV, go to a hospital at once and ask about PEP. It must start within 72 hours.
actions.hg: Condom phat jaaye ya HIV ka risk ho, toh turant hospital jao aur PEP ke baare mein poochho. Ise 72 ghante ke andar shuru karna zaroori hai.

actions.en: If you are at ongoing risk of HIV, ask a doctor whether PrEP is right for you.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe lagatar HIV ka risk rehta hai, toh doctor se poochho ki kya PrEP tumhare liye sahi hai.

actions.en: If you have HIV, ask your ART centre about testing your partner and children, with your consent.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe HIV hai, toh apne ART centre se partner aur bachchon ki testing ke baare mein poochho. Yeh tumhari consent se hi hoga.

actions.en: Call NACO's toll-free helpline 1097 for confidential advice, round the clock, in 16 languages.
actions.hg: NACO ki toll-free helpline 1097 par din-raat, 16 languages mein confidential advice lo.

title.en: Mizoram's HIV rate is nearly 14 times India's: in the North-East, shared needles and sex spread HIV together
title.hg: Mizoram ka HIV rate India se lagbhag 14 guna: North-East mein shared needles aur sex milkar HIV phaila rahe hain

dek.en: Adult HIV prevalence was 0.20% in India and 2.75% in Mizoram in 2024. In Arunachal Pradesh, Tripura and Assam, shared needles are now the most commonly reported route among people newly diagnosed, and people who inject drugs have the highest HIV rate of any group India tracks.
dek.hg: 2024 mein India mein adult HIV prevalence 0.20% thi aur Mizoram mein 2.75%. Arunachal Pradesh, Tripura aur Assam mein naye diagnose hue log ab sabse zyada shared needles ko route batate hain, aur drugs inject karne walon mein HIV rate un sab groups mein sabse zyada hai jinhe India track karta hai.

statLabel.en: adult HIV prevalence in Mizoram in 2024 (India: 0.20%)
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein Mizoram mein adult HIV prevalence (India: 0.20%)

label.en: of people newly diagnosed with HIV in India in 2024-25 reported shared needles or syringes (under 3% in 2017-18)
label.hg: 2024-25 mein India mein naye diagnose hue logon ne shared needles ya syringes ko wajah bataya (2017-18 mein 3% se kam)

label.en: of people newly diagnosed with HIV in Assam in 2024-25 reported shared needles (2.1% in 2017-18)
label.hg: Assam mein 2024-25 mein naye diagnose hue logon ne shared needles ko wajah bataya (2017-18 mein 2.1%)

label.en: HIV prevalence among people who inject drugs in 2024, the highest of any group NACO tracks
label.hg: 2024 mein drugs inject karne walon mein HIV prevalence, NACO jin groups ko track karta hai unmein sabse zyada

label.en: rise in new HIV infections in Tripura between 2010 and 2024, from a small base (an estimated 1,171 in 2024)
label.hg: 2010 se 2024 ke beech Tripura mein naye HIV infections mein badhotri, chhoti ginti se (2024 mein andaazan 1,171)

claim.en: HIV in the North-East only affects people who inject drugs. If you don't inject, you are not at risk.
claim.hg: North-East mein HIV sirf drugs inject karne walon ko hota hai. Aap inject nahi karte, toh aapko koi risk nahi.

truth.en: Needles and sex spread HIV together. In Mizoram, about two-thirds of people newly diagnosed in 2024-25 reported heterosexual sex and about a quarter reported shared needles.
truth.hg: Needles aur sex milkar HIV phailate hain. Mizoram mein 2024-25 mein naye diagnose hue logon mein se lagbhag do-tihai ne heterosexual sex bataya, aur lagbhag ek-chauthai ne shared needles.

actions.en: Never share needles, syringes or any injecting equipment, not even once, not even with a friend.
actions.hg: Needle, syringe ya injecting ka koi bhi saamaan kisi ke saath share mat kijiye. Ek baar bhi nahi, dost ke saath bhi nahi.

actions.en: If you inject drugs, get tested for HIV. Testing needs your consent, and only a court can order you to reveal your status.
actions.hg: Agar aap drugs inject karte hain, toh HIV test karaiye. Test aapki consent se hi hoga, aur sirf court hi aapko apna status batane ka order de sakta hai.

actions.en: If you have shared needles or had sex without a condom, ask about testing for yourself and your partners.
actions.hg: Agar aapne kisi aur ki needle use ki hai ya bina condom sex kiya hai, toh apne aur apne partners ke test ke baare mein poochhiye.

actions.en: If someone you know uses drugs, help them reach testing and treatment instead of shaming them.
actions.hg: Agar aapka koi jaanne wala drugs leta hai, toh use sharminda karne ki jagah testing aur treatment tak pahunchne mein uski madad kijiye.

actions.en: Call NACO's helpline 1097 for confidential HIV advice, or Tele-MANAS on 14416 for mental health support.
actions.hg: HIV par confidential advice ke liye NACO ki helpline 1097 par, aur mental health support ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 par call kijiye.

title.en: Sex should not hurt: painful intercourse and vaginismus are treatable, not a wife's duty to bear
title.hg: Sex mein dard nahi hona chahiye: painful intercourse aur vaginismus ka ilaaj hai, yeh biwi ka 'farz' nahi

dek.en: Pain during sex is a medical symptom with medical answers. In India it is met with 'adjust karo' instead, in a country where 12.2% of men told NFHS-5 that a husband may use force if his wife refuses sex. Five questions, answered plainly.
dek.hg: Sex ke dauraan dard ek medical symptom hai jiske medical jawab hain. India mein iske badle 'adjust karo' sunne ko milta hai, ek aise desh mein jahan NFHS-5 mein 12.2% mardon ne kaha ki biwi sex se mana kare toh pati zabardasti kar sakta hai. Paanch sawaal, seedhe jawab.

statLabel.en: of Indian men say a husband may use force for sex if his wife refuses (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: Indian mard kehte hain ki biwi sex se mana kare toh pati zabardasti kar sakta hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: of men aged 15-49 said a husband has the right to use force if his wife refuses sex (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ke mardon ne kaha ki biwi sex se mana kare toh pati ko zabardasti karne ka haq hai (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of men said he has the right to get angry and reprimand her
label.hg: mardon ne kaha ki pati ko gussa hone aur use daantne ka haq hai

label.en: fall in the share of men who rejected every coercive response, from NFHS-4 to NFHS-5
label.hg: NFHS-4 se NFHS-5 ke beech un mardon ka hissa itna gira jo har zabardasti wale response ko galat maante the

label.en: of ever-married women aged 18-49 have faced sexual violence by a husband
label.hg: 18-49 saal ki ever-married aurton ne pati ke haathon sexual violence jheli hai

claim.en: Pain during sex is normal for women. A good wife bears it, and it settles with time.
claim.hg: Aurton ke liye sex mein dard normal hai. Achchi biwi seh leti hai, aur time ke saath sab theek ho jaata hai.

truth.en: Pain is a symptom, not a duty. Pushing through it can deepen the fear and the tightening. Most causes, including vaginismus, are treatable.
truth.hg: Dard ek symptom hai, farz nahi. Dard ke bawajood zor lagane se darr aur muscles ki tightness aur badh sakti hai. Vaginismus samet zyada tar wajahon ka ilaaj ho sakta hai.

actions.en: If sex hurts, stop. Pain is a reason to find the cause, not something to push through.
actions.hg: Sex mein dard ho toh ruk jaiye. Dard wajah dhoondhne ka signal hai, sehte rehne ki cheez nahi.

actions.en: See a gynaecologist if pain continues over several attempts, is deep, or comes with bleeding or unusual discharge. You can ask for a woman doctor and bring someone you trust.
actions.hg: Agar dard kai baar koshish ke baad bhi rahe, andar gehraai mein ho, ya uske saath bleeding ya ajeeb discharge ho, toh gynaecologist se miliye. Aap mahila doctor maang sakti hain aur kisi bharose wale ko saath le ja sakti hain.

actions.en: If penetration has never been possible, ask the doctor about vaginismus by name, and about pelvic-floor physiotherapy, vaginal trainers and psychosexual counselling.
actions.hg: Agar penetration kabhi ho hi nahi paaya, toh doctor se naam lekar vaginismus ke baare mein poochiye, aur pelvic-floor physiotherapy, vaginal trainers aur psychosexual counselling ke baare mein bhi.

actions.en: If you are the partner, stop the moment she says it hurts, and go to the appointment if she wants you there.
actions.hg: Agar aap partner hain, toh jaise hi woh kahe ki dard ho raha hai, ruk jaiye, aur woh chahe toh appointment par saath jaiye.

actions.en: If 'adjust' turns into force or threats, call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar 'adjust karo' zabardasti ya dhamki mein badal jaaye, toh Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, emergency mein 112.

title.en: Kundli matched, health unchecked: should couples get tested for HIV and syphilis before marriage?
title.hg: Kundli match ho gayi, health check nahi hui: kya couples ko shaadi se pehle HIV aur syphilis ka test karwana chahiye?

dek.en: Indian families check horoscopes, salaries and family background before a wedding, but seldom sexual health. Which tests a couple can take together, why the law says they must be voluntary, how to raise it without an accusation, and what a positive result really means.
dek.hg: Indian families shaadi se pehle kundli, salary aur khandaan sab check karti hain, lekin sexual health shayad hi kabhi. Couple saath mein kaun se tests karwa sakta hai, law kyun kehta hai ki test voluntary hona chahiye, bina ilzaam lagaye baat kaise shuru karein, aur positive result ka asli matlab kya hai.

statLabel.en: syphilis-infected pregnant women identified in India in 2024-25
statLabel.hg: syphilis wali pregnant women India mein 2024-25 mein pehchaani gayi

label.en: syphilis-infected pregnant women identified in India in 2024-25
label.hg: syphilis wali pregnant women India mein 2024-25 mein pehchaani gayi

label.en: of people newly diagnosed with HIV in 2024-25 reported sex with a regular partner as the route
label.hg: 2024-25 mein naye diagnosed HIV cases ne regular partner ke saath sex ko route bataya

label.en: of people living with HIV knew their status in 2024-25; roughly 1 in 6 did not
label.hg: HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ko 2024-25 mein apna status pata tha; lagbhag har 6 mein se 1 ko nahi

label.en: of spouses, partners and children of people with HIV who were tested had HIV (2024-25)
label.hg: HIV wale logon ke jin spouses, partners aur bachchon ka test hua, unmein HIV nikla (2024-25)

claim.en: Asking for a test before marriage means you suspect the other person.
claim.hg: Shaadi se pehle test ki baat karna matlab doosre insaan par shak karna.

truth.en: Many infections cause no symptoms, can be years old, and can be passed on through blood or at birth as well as through sex. A test is a health check, not a character test.
truth.hg: Kai infections ke koi symptoms nahi hote, woh saalon purane ho sakte hain, aur sex ke alawa blood se ya janam ke waqt bhi aa sakte hain. Test health check hai, character test nahi.

actions.en: Before the wedding, ask a government hospital for HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B tests, and go together if you can.
actions.hg: Shaadi se pehle kisi government hospital mein HIV, syphilis aur hepatitis B ke tests maango, aur ho sake toh saath mein jao.

actions.en: Agree in advance that you will share results with each other, and with no one else without consent.
actions.hg: Pehle se tay kar lo ki results ek doosre ke saath share karoge, aur consent ke bina kisi aur ke saath nahi.

actions.en: If one of you has hepatitis B, ask a doctor about vaccinating the other partner.
actions.hg: Agar tum dono mein se kisi ko hepatitis B hai, toh doctor se doosre partner ki vaccination ke baare mein poocho.

actions.en: If a result is positive, start treatment and get the partner tested. Syphilis is curable and HIV treatment is free.
actions.hg: Result positive aaye toh treatment shuru karo aur partner ka test karwao. Syphilis curable hai aur HIV ka treatment free hai.

actions.en: Call NACO's free, confidential helpline 1097 to find the nearest testing centre.
actions.hg: Nearest testing centre jaanne ke liye NACO ki free, confidential helpline 1097 par call karo.

title.en: Finishing too fast? Premature ejaculation is treatable, and the 'timing capsule' ads are illegal
title.hg: Bahut jaldi finish ho jaate ho? Premature ejaculation ka ilaaj hai, aur 'timing capsule' ke ads illegal hain

dek.en: Ejaculating sooner than you or your partner would like is a common sexual problem, and it responds to treatment. What counts, what causes it, what works, and why the capsule ads on your feed break a 1954 law.
dek.hg: Tum ya tumhara partner jitna chahte ho usse pehle ejaculate ho jaana ek common sexual problem hai, aur iska ilaaj hota hai. Kya count hota hai, kyun hota hai, kya kaam karta hai, aur tumhari feed wale capsule ads 1954 ka law kyun todte hain.

label.en: Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline
label.hg: Tele-MANAS, Health Ministry ki free, 24 ghante chalne wali mental-health helpline

label.en: in jail, a fine or both for a first conviction for advertising a drug for 'sexual pleasure' under the 1954 Act
label.hg: jail, fine ya dono: 1954 Act ke under 'sexual pleasure' wali dawa ka ad dene par pehli conviction ki saza

label.en: time the Supreme Court gave states in March 2025 to set up a way for the public to complain about such ads
label.hg: ka time Supreme Court ne March 2025 mein states ko diya, taaki public aise ads ke khilaaf complaint kar sake

claim.en: Lasting longer is a matter of willpower, and a 'timing' capsule is the quick fix.
claim.hg: Zyada der tikna bas willpower ki baat hai, aur 'timing' capsule iska shortcut hai.

truth.en: Premature ejaculation is a common problem with real psychological and physical causes. Techniques, counselling and medicine prescribed by a doctor can help; the capsule ads are illegal under a 1954 law.
truth.hg: Premature ejaculation ek common problem hai jiske real psychological aur physical causes hote hain. Techniques, counselling aur doctor ki prescribe ki hui dawa madad kar sakti hai; capsule wale ads 1954 ke ek law ke under illegal hain.

actions.en: If it happens more often than you would like and it bothers you or your partner, see a doctor. It is common and treatable.
actions.hg: Agar ye tumhari marzi se zyada baar hota hai aur tumhe ya tumhare partner ko pareshaan karta hai, toh doctor ke paas jao. Ye common hai aur iska ilaaj hai.

actions.en: Practise the stop-start technique during masturbation, and give it time: it takes a lot of practice.
actions.hg: Masturbation ke dauraan stop-start technique practice karo, aur ise time do: isme kaafi practice lagti hai.

actions.en: Never buy 'timing' or 'stamina' capsules from ads. Advertising them is a crime under the 1954 Drugs and Magic Remedies Act.
actions.hg: Ads se 'timing' ya 'stamina' capsules kabhi mat khareedo. Inka ad dena 1954 ke Drugs and Magic Remedies Act ke under crime hai.

actions.en: Talk to your partner outside the bedroom, and consider psychosexual counselling together.
actions.hg: Partner se bedroom ke bahar baat karo, aur saath mein psychosexual counselling ke baare mein socho.

actions.en: If anxiety or low mood is behind it, call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Agar iske peeche anxiety ya udaasi hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo.

title.en: The infertility you can prevent: silent chlamydia, gonorrhoea and PCOS found too late
title.hg: Woh infertility jo roki ja sakti hai: chupchaap rehne wala chlamydia, gonorrhoea aur der se pakda gaya PCOS

dek.en: Not all infertility can be prevented, but some of it can. Chlamydia and gonorrhoea often give no warning before they scar the tubes, up to 70% of women with PCOS do not know they have it, and endometriosis takes 4 to 12 years to diagnose. What to check, and when.
dek.hg: Har infertility roki nahi ja sakti, lekin kuch zaroor roki ja sakti hai. Chlamydia aur gonorrhoea aksar bina kisi warning ke tubes ko nuksaan pahuncha dete hain, PCOS wali 70% tak aurton ko pata hi nahi hota ki unhe yeh hai, aur endometriosis ka diagnosis hone mein 4 se 12 saal lag jaate hain. Kya check karwana hai, aur kab.

statLabel.en: of women with PCOS worldwide do not know they have it (WHO)
statLabel.hg: tak PCOS wali aurton ko duniya bhar mein pata hi nahi hota ki unhe yeh hai (WHO)

label.en: of women with PCOS worldwide do not know they have it (WHO)
label.hg: tak PCOS wali aurton ko duniya bhar mein pata hi nahi hota ki unhe yeh hai (WHO)

label.en: of Indian women aged 18-40 have PCOS, depending on the criteria used (ICMR-funded study, 2024)
label.hg: 18-40 saal ki Indian aurton ko PCOS hai, yeh is par depend karta hai ki kaun sa criteria use hua (ICMR-funded study, 2024)

label.en: average time to an endometriosis diagnosis (WHO)
label.hg: endometriosis ka diagnosis hone mein average itne saal lagte hain (WHO)

label.en: STI/RTI cases managed by India's AIDS programme in 2024-25, treated largely by symptoms
label.hg: STI/RTI cases India ke AIDS programme ne 2024-25 mein manage kiye, zyada tar symptoms ke aadhaar par

actions.en: Use condoms, and ask for an STI test if you have symptoms, a new partner or a partner who has been diagnosed. Having no symptoms is not a test result.
actions.hg: Condom use kijiye, aur agar symptoms hon, naya partner ho ya partner ko STI nikla ho, toh STI test maangiye. Symptoms na hona koi test result nahi hai.

actions.en: If you are treated for an STI, make sure your partner is treated too, or the infection comes back.
actions.hg: Agar aapka STI ka ilaaj ho raha hai, toh pakka kijiye ki partner ka bhi ilaaj ho, warna infection laut aata hai.

actions.en: See a doctor about periods that regularly skip months, new facial hair or stubborn acne, and ask about PCOS by name.
actions.hg: Agar periods baar-baar mahinon tak skip hote hain, chehre par naye baal aa rahe hain ya acne jaa hi nahi raha, toh doctor se miliye aur naam lekar PCOS ke baare mein poochiye.

actions.en: Do not accept 'it is normal' for period pain that stops you studying or working. Ask about endometriosis.
actions.hg: Jo period ka dard padhai ya kaam rok de, uske liye 'yeh toh normal hai' mat maaniye. Endometriosis ke baare mein poochiye.

actions.en: After 12 months of trying without a pregnancy, go to a doctor as a couple so that both partners are examined.
actions.hg: 12 mahine koshish ke baad bhi pregnancy na ho, toh couple ki tarah doctor ke paas jaiye taaki dono partners ki jaanch ho.

title.en: 'Only people with many partners get STIs'? In India, 26.5% of new HIV diagnoses reported a regular partner as the route
title.hg: 'STIs sirf unhe hote hain jinke bahut partners hon'? India mein HIV ke naye diagnoses mein se 26.5% ne regular partner ko route bataya

dek.en: Four comforting beliefs keep Indians away from an STI test: that an infection shows, that it happens to other people, that washing helps, that one cure lasts for life. Government data and WHO guidance contradict each of them.
dek.hg: Chaar tasalli dene wale bharose Indians ko STI test se door rakhte hain: ki infection dikh jaata hai, ki ye doosre logon ko hota hai, ki dhone se kaam chal jaata hai, ki ek baar ka ilaaj zindagi bhar chalta hai. Sarkaari data aur WHO ki guidance in chaaron ko galat batate hain.

statLabel.en: of people newly diagnosed with HIV in 2024-25 reported sex with a regular partner as the route
statLabel.hg: log, jinhe 2024-25 mein HIV ka naya diagnosis hua, unhone regular partner ke saath sex ko route bataya

label.en: of 1,63,306 people newly diagnosed with HIV in 2024-25 reported sex with a regular partner as the route
label.hg: 2024-25 mein HIV ke naye diagnosis wale 1,63,306 logon mein se itnon ne regular partner ke saath sex ko route bataya

label.en: reactive results among 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings at government STI clinics in 2024-25
label.hg: reactive results, 2024-25 mein sarkaari STI clinics ki 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings mein se

label.hg: HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ke spouses, partners aur bachche, jo 2024-25 mein test hone par positive nikle

label.en: STI/RTI cases managed by India's AIDS programme in 2024-25
label.hg: STI/RTI cases jo India ke AIDS programme ne 2024-25 mein manage kiye

claim.en: Only people with many partners get STIs.
claim.hg: STIs sirf unhe hote hain jinke bahut saare partners hote hain.

truth.en: One exposure is enough. Of 1,63,306 people newly diagnosed with HIV in India in 2024-25, 26.5% reported sex with a regular partner as the route.
truth.hg: Ek exposure kaafi hai. 2024-25 mein India mein jin 1,63,306 logon ko HIV ka naya diagnosis hua, unmein se 26.5% ne regular partner ke saath sex ko route bataya.

actions.en: Do not judge risk by how someone looks, dresses or lives. Only a test shows an infection.
actions.hg: Kisi ke dikhne, kapdon ya lifestyle se risk ka andaaza mat lagao. Infection sirf test se pata chalta hai.

actions.en: Get tested with a new partner, before you stop using condoms, in pregnancy, or if a partner is diagnosed.
actions.hg: Naye partner ke saath, condom chhodne se pehle, pregnancy mein, ya partner ko diagnosis ho toh test karao.

actions.en: After a possible HIV exposure, go to a hospital within 72 hours and ask about PEP. Washing is not protection.
actions.hg: HIV ka exposure ho sakta hai toh 72 ghante ke andar hospital jao aur PEP ke baare mein poochho. Dhona protection nahi hai.

actions.en: If you are treated for an STI, finish the treatment and make sure your partner is treated too.
actions.hg: Agar tumhara STI ka ilaaj ho raha hai, toh ilaaj poora karo aur pakka karo ki partner ka ilaaj bhi ho.

actions.en: Call NACO's helpline 1097 for confidential advice and the nearest testing centre.
actions.hg: Confidential salaah aur sabse paas ke testing centre ke liye NACO ki helpline 1097 pe call karo.

title.en: No symptoms is not no infection: how to get tested at India's 1,127 government STI clinics
title.hg: Symptoms nahi, toh infection nahi? Galat: India ke 1,127 government STI clinics mein test kaise karwayein

dek.en: Chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis and HIV can all sit in the body without a single sign, and India's clinics mostly treat what shows. When to test, which tests to ask for by name, what a window period means, and why your partner needs treatment too.
dek.hg: Chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis aur HIV, sab bina kisi sign ke body mein baithe reh sakte hain, aur India ke clinics zyada tar usi ka ilaaj karte hain jo dikhta hai. Test kab karwana hai, kaun se tests naam lekar maangne hain, window period ka matlab kya hai, aur partner ka treatment kyun zaroori hai.

statLabel.en: government Designated STI/RTI Clinics (Suraksha Clinics) across India
statLabel.hg: government Designated STI/RTI Clinics (Suraksha Clinics) poore India mein

label.en: government STI clinics (Suraksha Clinics) at district hospitals and medical colleges
label.hg: government STI clinics (Suraksha Clinics), district hospitals aur medical colleges mein

label.en: visits to Suraksha Clinics in 2024-25
label.hg: visits Suraksha Clinics mein 2024-25 mein hui

label.en: of HIV tests on people who walked in on their own were positive in 2024-25, against 0.40% overall
label.hg: khud chal kar aane walon ke HIV tests 2024-25 mein positive aaye, jabki overall 0.40%

label.en: syphilis screenings at government STI clinics in 2024-25; 0.94% were reactive
label.hg: syphilis screenings government STI clinics mein 2024-25 mein hui; 0.94% reactive aayi

claim.en: If I had an STI, I would know.
claim.hg: Agar mujhe STI hota, toh mujhe pata chal jaata.

truth.en: Most STIs cause no symptoms. Chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis and HIV can stay silent for months or years, and only a test can tell.
truth.hg: Zyada tar STIs ke koi symptoms nahi hote. Chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis aur HIV mahino ya saalon tak chup reh sakte hain, aur sirf test se pata chalta hai.

actions.en: Get tested after a new partner, a condom failure or a partner's diagnosis, in pregnancy, or if you notice a sore, discharge or burning.
actions.hg: Naya partner ho, condom fail hua ho, partner ko koi STI nikla ho, pregnancy ho, ya ghaav, discharge ya jalan dikhe, toh test karwao.

actions.en: At a district hospital, ask for the Suraksha Clinic (STI clinic) and say: "I want to be tested for STIs, including HIV and syphilis."
actions.hg: District hospital mein Suraksha Clinic (STI clinic) poocho aur kaho: "Mujhe STIs ka test karwana hai, HIV aur syphilis ke saath."

actions.en: If a possible HIV exposure happened in the last 72 hours, ask about PEP today instead of waiting for a test.
actions.hg: Agar HIV ka possible exposure pichhle 72 ghanton mein hua hai, toh test ka wait mat karo; aaj hi PEP ke baare mein poocho.

actions.en: If you test negative soon after a risk, ask when to repeat the test, and use condoms until then.
actions.hg: Risk ke turant baad test negative aaye toh poocho ki dobara kab karwana hai, aur tab tak condom use karo.

actions.en: If you test positive, finish the full treatment and make sure your partner is treated at the same time.
actions.hg: Test positive aaye toh poora treatment khatam karo aur pakka karo ki partner ka treatment bhi usi waqt ho.

title.en: HIV 2.84%, syphilis 4.12%: why India's transgender people face some of the highest STI rates
title.hg: HIV 2.84%, syphilis 4.12%: India ke transgender logon mein STI rates sabse zyada mein se kyun hain

dek.en: Government data put hijra and transgender people far above the national average for HIV and syphilis. Those numbers follow exclusion from homes, jobs and clinics, and, since May 2026, a law that puts a medical board between trans people and legal recognition. What respectful care looks like, and where to ask for it.
dek.hg: Government data hijra aur transgender logon ko HIV aur syphilis dono mein national average se bahut upar dikhata hai. In numbers ke peeche ghar, naukri aur clinic se exclusion hai, aur May 2026 se ek law bhi, jo trans logon aur legal recognition ke beech ek medical board khada karta hai. Respectful care kaisi dikhti hai, aur use kahan maangna hai.

statLabel.en: syphilis positivity among transgender clients at government STI clinics (2024-25)
statLabel.hg: government STI clinics par transgender clients mein syphilis positivity (2024-25)

label.en: HIV prevalence among hijra and transgender people in 2024, about 14 times the adult average of 0.20%
label.hg: 2024 mein hijra aur transgender logon mein HIV prevalence, adults ke 0.20% average se lagbhag 14 guna

label.en: of syphilis screenings among transgender clients at government STI clinics were reactive in 2024-25 (women: 0.48%)
label.hg: 2024-25 mein government STI clinics par transgender clients ki syphilis screenings reactive nikli (women: 0.48%)

label.en: Garima Greh shelters for destitute transgender persons, across 17 states (November 2025)
label.hg: destitute transgender persons ke liye Garima Greh shelters, 17 states mein (November 2025)

label.en: transgender certificates issued nationwide by June 2026
label.hg: transgender certificates June 2026 tak poore desh mein issue hue

claim.en: Transgender people have high HIV and syphilis rates because of who they are.
claim.hg: Transgender logon mein HIV aur syphilis isliye zyada hai kyunki woh transgender hain.

truth.en: No gender identity carries a virus. Infections spread through specific exposures, and exclusion from homes, jobs and clinics makes those exposures likelier and care harder to reach.
truth.hg: Koi bhi gender identity apne saath virus nahi laati. Infection specific exposures se phailta hai, aur ghar, naukri aur clinic se exclusion un exposures ko zyada likely bana deta hai aur care tak pahunchna mushkil kar deta hai.

actions.en: Ask for an HIV test and a syphilis blood test, not just a look at symptoms: many STIs cause none.
actions.hg: Sirf symptoms dikhane par mat ruko, HIV test aur syphilis ka blood test maango: kai STIs mein koi symptom hota hi nahi.

actions.en: If a condom broke or you were sexually assaulted, reach a hospital within 72 hours and ask for PEP.
actions.hg: Condom phat gaya ho ya sexual assault hua ho, toh 72 ghante ke andar hospital pahuncho aur PEP maango.

actions.en: Give the clinic the name you use. No HIV test can be done without your consent, and no one can force you to disclose your HIV status.
actions.hg: Clinic ko wahi naam batao jo tum use karte ho. Tumhari consent ke bina HIV test nahi ho sakta, aur koi tumhe apna HIV status batane ke liye force nahi kar sakta.

actions.en: If you are refused care or humiliated because of HIV, call 1097 or complain to your state's HIV Ombudsman.
actions.hg: HIV ki wajah se care se mana kiya jaye ya beizzati ho, toh 1097 par call karo ya apne state ke HIV Ombudsman se complaint karo.

actions.en: If you have nowhere safe to live, ask a community organisation or your state's social welfare department about the nearest Garima Greh.
actions.hg: Rehne ki koi safe jagah na ho, toh kisi community organisation ya apne state ke social welfare department se nearest Garima Greh ke baare mein poocho.

title.en: Undetectable = untransmittable: HIV treatment works in India, but what people believe hasn't caught up
title.hg: Undetectable = untransmittable: India mein HIV treatment kaam kar raha hai, par logon ki soch abhi peeche hai

dek.en: A person whose treatment keeps HIV undetectable does not pass it on through sex. In 2024-25, 97.6% of people on treatment in India who had a viral-load test had the virus suppressed. What U=U means for sex, marriage, children and the family dinner table.
dek.hg: Jiska treatment HIV ko undetectable rakhta hai, woh sex ke through HIV aage pass nahi karta. 2024-25 mein India mein treatment par jin logon ka viral-load test hua, unmein se 97.6% ka virus suppressed tha. U=U ka sex, shaadi, bachchon aur family ki dinner table ke liye kya matlab hai.

statLabel.en: of people on HIV treatment who were tested had a suppressed viral load (2024-25)
statLabel.hg: HIV treatment par jin logon ka test hua, unka viral load suppressed tha (2024-25)

label.en: of people on HIV treatment whose viral load was tested had the virus suppressed (2024-25)
label.hg: HIV treatment par jin logon ka viral load test hua, unme virus suppressed tha (2024-25)

label.en: of people on treatment who were tested had the virus suppressed in 2020-21
label.hg: 2020-21 mein treatment par test hue logon mein virus suppressed tha

label.en: people on HIV treatment in India (March 2025)
label.hg: India mein HIV treatment par log (March 2025)

label.en: of women aged 15-49 did not know HIV cannot spread by sharing food with a person who has AIDS (2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ko nahi pata tha ki AIDS wale insaan ke saath khana share karne se HIV nahi failta (2019-21)

claim.en: Once someone has HIV, they are infectious for life and should never marry or have children.
claim.hg: Ek baar HIV ho gaya toh insaan zindagi bhar infectious rahega, aur use kabhi shaadi ya bachche nahi karne chahiye.

truth.en: A person whose treatment keeps HIV undetectable does not pass it on through sex, and treatment started early in pregnancy helps protect the baby, before birth and through breastfeeding.
truth.hg: Jiska treatment HIV ko undetectable rakhta hai, woh sex ke through HIV pass nahi karta, aur pregnancy mein jaldi shuru hua treatment baby ko janam se pehle aur breastfeeding ke dauraan bachane mein madad karta hai.

actions.en: If you have HIV, take your medicine every day, and ask your ART centre for your viral-load result and what it means.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe HIV hai, toh roz medicine lo, aur apne ART centre se viral-load result aur uska matlab poocho.

actions.en: Use condoms until a viral-load test confirms the virus is undetectable. Condoms also cut the risk of other STIs and of pregnancy, which U=U does not prevent.
actions.hg: Jab tak viral-load test confirm na kare ki virus undetectable hai, condom use karo. Condom doosre STIs aur pregnancy ka risk bhi kam karta hai; U=U yeh nahi karta.

actions.en: Planning a pregnancy? Talk to your ART centre early: treatment through pregnancy and breastfeeding helps protect the baby.
actions.hg: Baby plan kar rahe ho? Pehle hi ART centre se baat karo: pregnancy aur breastfeeding ke dauraan treatment baby ko bachane mein madad karta hai.

actions.en: Never isolate a relative with HIV. Eating, living and working together is safe, and segregation is illegal under the HIV Act 2017.
actions.hg: HIV wale relative ko kabhi alag mat karo. Saath khana, rehna aur kaam karna safe hai, aur HIV Act 2017 ke under segregation illegal hai.

actions.en: Call 1097, free and confidential, for advice on treatment, testing and your rights.
actions.hg: Treatment, testing aur apne rights par advice ke liye 1097 par call karo, free aur confidential.

title.en: Nasbandi doesn't make a man weak: the vasectomy myths behind India's 0.3%
title.hg: Nasbandi se mard kamzor nahi hota: India ke 0.3% ke peechhe ke vasectomy myths

dek.en: For every married woman who relies on her husband's vasectomy, more than a hundred have been sterilised themselves. The operation men avoid is the smaller one, and what keeps them away is fear, not medicine.
dek.hg: Har us shaadishuda aurat ke muqable jo apne pati ki vasectomy par tiki hai, sau se zyada aurton ka khud operation hua hai. Mard jis operation se bachte hain woh chhota wala hai, aur unhe door rakhta hai darr, medicine nahi.

statLabel.en: of married women relied on male sterilisation, against 37.9% on female sterilisation (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: shaadishuda aurtein male sterilisation par tiki thi, jabki 37.9% female sterilisation par (NFHS-5)

label.en: of currently married women relied on a husband's vasectomy (2019-21)
label.hg: currently married aurtein pati ki vasectomy par tiki thi (2019-21)

label.en: had been sterilised themselves, about two thirds of all modern contraceptive use (2019-21)
label.hg: ka khud sterilisation hua tha, jo saare modern contraceptive use ka lagbhag do-tihaai hai (2019-21)

label.en: of men agreed that contraception is 'women's business' (2019-21)
label.hg: mardon ne maana ki contraception 'aurton ka kaam' hai (2019-21)

label.en: of men in a seven-state ICRW-UNFPA survey held 'rigid' ideas of masculinity; only 23% were gender-equitable (2014)
label.hg: mard, saat states ke ICRW-UNFPA survey mein, masculinity ke 'rigid' khayal rakhte the; sirf 23% gender-equitable the (2014)

claim.en: Nasbandi makes a man weak and ends his sex life.
claim.hg: Nasbandi se mard kamzor ho jaata hai aur uski sex life khatm ho jaati hai.

truth.en: A vasectomy only keeps sperm out of the semen. It does not affect sexual performance: desire, erections and ejaculation continue as before.
truth.hg: Vasectomy sirf sperm ko semen mein jaane se rokti hai. Sexual performance par iska koi asar nahi padta: desire, erection aur ejaculation pehle jaise hi rehte hain.

actions.en: If your family is complete, ask a doctor at a government hospital about vasectomy before your wife is booked for surgery.
actions.hg: Agar aapki family complete hai, toh patni ka operation book hone se pehle government hospital ke doctor se vasectomy ke baare mein poochhiye.

actions.en: Keep using condoms or another method until a semen test confirms the vasectomy has worked.
actions.hg: Jab tak semen test confirm na kar de ki vasectomy kaam kar rahi hai, condom ya koi aur method use karte rahiye.

actions.en: Treat it as permanent: decide only when you are sure, and never under pressure from anyone.
actions.hg: Ise permanent maaniye: tabhi decide kijiye jab aap sure hon, aur kabhi kisi ke pressure mein nahi.

actions.en: Use condoms whenever there is a risk of infection; a vasectomy gives no protection against STIs.
actions.hg: Jab bhi infection ka risk ho, condom use kijiye; vasectomy STIs se koi protection nahi deti.

actions.en: If erections or desire change at any time, see a qualified doctor, not a roadside 'sex clinic'.
actions.hg: Erection ya desire mein kabhi bhi badlaav aaye toh qualified doctor ko dikhaiye, sadak kinare ke 'sex clinic' ko nahi.

title.en: Women make 60.9% of STI clinic visits, but men test positive for syphilis three times as often
title.hg: STI clinics ki 60.9% visits women ki hain, lekin syphilis test men ka teen guna zyada positive aata hai

dek.en: India's government STI clinics are full of women, yet syphilis is found far more often in the men who do turn up. What 71.95 lakh clinic visits in 2024-25 suggest about the men who stay away, the chemist-counter cures no statistic counts, and the partners left untreated.
dek.hg: India ke government STI clinics women se bhare rehte hain, phir bhi syphilis un men mein kahin zyada milta hai jo wahan pahunch jaate hain. 2024-25 ki 71.95 lakh clinic visits un men ke baare mein kya batati hain jo door rehte hain, chemist counter ke un ilaajon ke baare mein jinhe koi statistic nahi ginta, aur un partners ke baare mein jinka treatment hota hi nahi.

statLabel.en: of visits to government STI clinics in 2024-25 were by women
statLabel.hg: government STI clinics ki 2024-25 ki visits women ki thin

label.en: of the 71.95 lakh visits to government STI clinics in 2024-25 were by women
label.hg: government STI clinics ki 2024-25 ki 71.95 lakh visits mein se women ki thin

label.en: of syphilis tests on men at these clinics were reactive, against 0.48% for women (2024-25)
label.hg: in clinics mein men ke syphilis tests reactive aaye, jabki women ke 0.48% (2024-25)

label.en: reactive results out of 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings at government STI clinics (2024-25)
label.hg: reactive results, government STI clinics ki 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings mein se (2024-25)

label.hg: Arunachal Pradesh mein STI clinic aane walon ki syphilis positivity, jabki national average 0.9% (2024-25)

claim.en: The sore went away after medicine from the chemist, so the infection is gone.
claim.hg: Chemist ki dawai ke baad ghaav theek ho gaya, matlab infection khatam.

truth.en: The first sore of syphilis heals by itself while the infection stays in the body and can still be passed on. Only a test and the right treatment settle it.
truth.hg: Syphilis ka pehla ghaav apne aap bhar jaata hai, jabki infection body mein rehta hai aur aage bhi fail sakta hai. Faisla sirf test aur sahi treatment se hota hai.

actions.en: Men: for a sore, discharge or burning, go to the Suraksha Clinic at a district hospital, not to a chemist or a 'gupt rog' advertiser.
actions.hg: Men: ghaav, discharge ya jalan ho toh district hospital ke Suraksha Clinic jao, chemist ya 'gupt rog' ke ad wale ke paas nahi.

actions.en: Ask for a syphilis blood test and an HIV test, even if the symptom has already gone away by itself.
actions.hg: Syphilis ka blood test aur HIV test maango, chahe symptom apne aap ja chuka ho.

actions.en: If you are treated for an STI, tell your partner and make sure they are treated at the same time.
actions.hg: Agar tumhara kisi STI ka treatment hua hai, toh partner ko batao aur pakka karo ki unka treatment bhi usi waqt ho.

actions.en: If your wife or partner tests positive in pregnancy, get tested that week. Her result does not show who had the infection first.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari wife ya partner ka test pregnancy mein positive aaye, toh usi hafte apna test karwao. Unka result yeh nahi batata ki infection pehle kisko tha.

actions.en: Call 1097, NACO's free and confidential helpline, for advice on testing and where to go.
actions.hg: Testing aur kahan jaana hai, iski salah ke liye NACO ki free aur confidential helpline 1097 par call karo.

title.en: 'She's lying for money or revenge'? What filing a rape complaint actually costs a woman in India
title.hg: 'Woh paise ya badle ke liye jhooth bol rahi hai'? India mein rape complaint karne ki asli keemat

dek.en: The 'false case' forward travels fast. The court record moves slowly: 1,85,785 rape cases waiting for trial, a conviction rate of 24.4%, and a silence far bigger than any lie.
dek.hg: 'False case' wale forwards bahut tezi se failte hain. Court ka record dheere chalta hai: 1,85,785 rape cases trial ke intezaar mein, conviction rate sirf 24.4%, aur sabse badi sachchai hai chuppi.

statLabel.en: compensation a rape survivor is entitled to under NALSA's 2018 scheme
statLabel.hg: NALSA ki 2018 scheme mein rape survivor itne compensation ki haqdaar hai

label.en: rape cases still waiting for trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases jo 2024 ke end tak trial ka intezaar kar rahe the

label.en: conviction rate in rape trials completed in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein complete hue rape trials ka conviction rate

label.en: rape cases police closed as 'false' in 2024: a police label, not a court finding
label.hg: rape cases jo police ne 2024 mein 'false' bolkar band kiye: yeh police ka label hai, court ka faisla nahi

label.en: estimated share of sexual violence victims in India who report it to the authorities
label.hg: India mein sexual violence jhelne walon ka estimated hissa jo authorities tak complaint karta hai

claim.en: Most rape complaints are false, filed for money or revenge.
claim.hg: Zyada tar rape complaints jhoothi hoti hain, paise ya badle ke liye ki jaati hain.

truth.en: Police closed 3,776 rape cases as 'false' in 2024, a label given during investigation, not by a court. Estimates suggest only about 1% of sexual violence in India is ever reported, and those who do report wait years: 1,85,785 rape cases were pending trial at the end of 2024.
truth.hg: 2024 mein police ne 3,776 rape cases 'false' bolkar band kiye. Yeh label investigation ke time police lagati hai, court nahi. Estimate hai ki India mein sexual violence ke sirf lagbhag 1% cases hi report hote hain, aur jo report karti hain woh saalon wait karti hain: 2024 ke end mein 1,85,785 rape cases trial ke liye pending the.

actions.en: Before you forward a 'false case' post, check what a court actually decided: a police closure or an acquittal is not proof that anyone lied.
actions.hg: 'False case' wali post forward karne se pehle check kijiye ki court ne asal mein kya decide kiya. Police ka case band karna ya acquittal, is baat ka saboot nahi ki kisi ne jhooth bola.

actions.en: If someone tells you they were sexually assaulted, believe them first. A delay in reporting is not a sign of lying.
actions.hg: Agar koi aapko bataye ki uske saath sexual assault hua, toh pehle uski baat par bharosa kijiye. Der se complaint karna jhooth ki nishaani nahi hai.

actions.en: Never post or forward a survivor's name, photo or any detail that could identify her. It is a crime under Section 72 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ka naam, photo ya koi bhi detail jisse uski pehchaan ho sake, kabhi post ya forward mat kijiye. BNS ki Section 72 ke under yeh crime hai.

actions.en: Tell survivors they can apply for compensation to the District Legal Services Authority even if the offender is never traced.
actions.hg: Survivors ko bataiye ki offender na mile tab bhi woh District Legal Services Authority mein compensation ke liye apply kar sakti hain.

actions.en: If anyone pushes a survivor to 'compromise' or marry the accused, tell her lawyer and the court. Courts must not suggest either.
actions.hg: Agar koi survivor par 'compromise' ya accused se shaadi ka pressure daale, toh uske lawyer aur court ko bataiye. Courts in dono mein se kuch bhi suggest nahi kar sakte.

title.en: Marriage is not a lifetime yes, and Indian law already admits it in three places
title.hg: Shaadi 'hamesha ki haan' nahi hai, aur Indian law khud teen jagah yeh maanta hai

dek.en: One line of the new penal code still says a husband cannot rape his adult wife. Three other parts of Indian law already accept that her consent matters. In December 2026 the Supreme Court is due to take up the contradiction.
dek.hg: Naye penal code ki ek line aaj bhi kehti hai ki pati apni adult wife ka rape nahi kar sakta. Lekin law ke teen doosre hisse pehle se maante hain ki wife ka consent matter karta hai. December 2026 mein Supreme Court is contradiction par sunwai karne wala hai.

statLabel.en: prison term under Section 67 BNS when a husband forces sex on a wife living separately
statLabel.hg: BNS Section 67 ke under jail, jab pati alag reh rahi wife ke saath zabardasti sex kare

label.en: of Indian men said a husband has the right to use force for sex if his wife refuses (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: Indian mardon ne kaha ki wife mana kare toh pati ko zabardasti sex karne ka haq hai (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of men rejected every coercive response to a wife refusing sex in NFHS-5, down from 77% in NFHS-4
label.hg: mardon ne NFHS-5 mein wife ke mana karne par har coercive response ko galat maana; NFHS-4 mein yeh 77% tha

label.en: of ever-married women aged 18-49 said their husband had physically forced them to have intercourse (NFHS-5)
label.hg: shaadishuda aurton (18-49 saal) ne bataya ki pati ne physically force karke unke saath sex kiya (NFHS-5)

claim.en: Marriage is a wife's permanent consent to sex.
claim.hg: Shaadi ka matlab hai ki wife ne hamesha ke liye sex ko haan bol di.

truth.en: Indian law defines consent as an 'unequivocal voluntary agreement' to a specific act. It already punishes forced sex on a separated wife with 2 to 7 years in prison, treats sex with a wife under 18 as rape, and lets a wife pregnant from forced sex by her husband seek an abortion as a rape survivor.
truth.hg: Indian law consent ko kisi specific act ke liye 'unequivocal voluntary agreement' maanta hai. Alag reh rahi wife ke saath zabardasti par law 2 se 7 saal ki jail deta hai, 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex ko rape maanta hai, aur pati ki zabardasti se pregnant hui wife ko rape survivor ki tarah abortion ka haq deta hai.

actions.en: Ask before sex, every time, including in marriage. A yes last week is not a yes tonight.
actions.hg: Har baar sex se pehle poochiye, shaadi mein bhi. Pichhle hafte ki haan, aaj raat ki haan nahi hai.

actions.en: If your spouse forces sex on you, you can seek protection, residence and maintenance orders under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005. Call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar spouse zabardasti kare, toh Domestic Violence Act, 2005 ke under protection, residence aur maintenance orders maange ja sakte hain. Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, emergency mein 112 par.

actions.en: If forced sex by a husband leads to pregnancy, a woman can seek an abortion up to 24 weeks as a rape survivor. No FIR is needed.
