actions.hg: Agar pati ki zabardasti se pregnancy ho jaaye, toh aurat rape survivor ki tarah 24 hafte tak abortion kara sakti hai. Iske liye FIR zaroori nahi.

actions.en: Talk about consent before marriage: with your partner, and with the relatives who will tell you what a wife 'owes'.
actions.hg: Shaadi se pehle consent par baat kijiye: apne partner se bhi, aur un rishtedaaron se bhi jo batate hain ki wife ka 'farz' kya hai.

actions.en: Follow the Supreme Court's final hearing on the marital rape exception, due to be fixed for 9 or 10 December 2026.
actions.hg: Marital rape exception par Supreme Court ki final hearing par nazar rakhiye, jo 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko fix honi hai.

title.en: One in three pregnancies, one in six adults: why 'my abortion made me infertile' feels true, and isn't
title.hg: Har teen mein se ek pregnancy, har chhe mein se ek adult: 'mere abortion ne mujhe infertile bana diya' sach kyun lagta hai, aur hai kyun nahi

dek.en: Abortion and infertility are both common, so they often meet in the same life by chance. A safe abortion does not normally harm future fertility. Unsafe abortion and untreated infection can, and the myth pushes women straight towards them.
dek.hg: Abortion aur infertility dono common hain, isliye aksar ek hi zindagi mein sirf ittefaq se mil jaate hain. Safe abortion aam taur par aage ki fertility ko nuksaan nahi pahunchata. Unsafe abortion aur bina ilaaj ka infection pahuncha sakte hain, aur yeh myth aurton ko seedha unhi ki taraf dhakelta hai.

statLabel.en: adults worldwide experience infertility in their lifetime (WHO, 2023)
statLabel.hg: adults duniya bhar mein zindagi mein kabhi na kabhi infertility jhelte hain (WHO, 2023)

label.en: estimated abortions in India in 2015, about one in three pregnancies
label.hg: estimated abortions India mein 2015 mein, yaani lagbhag har teen mein se ek pregnancy

label.en: success rate of the approved two-medicine method in early abortion (Health Ministry, 2023)
label.hg: approved do-dawaiyon wale method ka success rate, early abortion mein (Health Ministry, 2023)

label.en: deaths per 100,000 abortions: when abortion is safe, and where unsafe abortion is common (WHO)
label.hg: maut har 100,000 abortions par: jab abortion safe ho, aur jahan unsafe abortion common ho (WHO)

label.en: of women with PCOS, a leading cause of infertility, do not know they have it (WHO)
label.hg: PCOS wali aurtein, jo infertility ki ek leading wajah hai, jaanti hi nahi ki unhe yeh hai (WHO)

claim.en: An abortion makes a woman infertile, so if she cannot get pregnant later, her old abortion is to blame.
claim.hg: Abortion aurat ko infertile bana deta hai, toh agar baad mein woh pregnant nahi ho pa rahi, toh kasoor uske purane abortion ka hai.

truth.en: A safe abortion does not normally affect future fertility. Abortion and infertility are both common, so they often meet in the same life by chance. The real threats are unsafe abortion, untreated infections and conditions such as PCOS that nobody checks for.
truth.hg: Safe abortion aam taur par aage ki fertility par asar nahi daalta. Abortion aur infertility dono common hain, isliye aksar ek hi zindagi mein ittefaq se mil jaate hain. Asli khatre hain unsafe abortion, bina ilaaj ke infections aur PCOS jaisi conditions, jinhe koi check hi nahi karta.

actions.en: If you need an abortion, go early to a registered doctor or a government hospital; an adult woman's own consent is the only consent the law needs.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe abortion chahiye, toh jaldi kisi registered doctor ya government hospital mein jao; adult aurat ki apni consent hi woh akeli consent hai jo kanoon maangta hai.

actions.en: Do not take abortion pills without a doctor's check: someone must confirm how far along the pregnancy is and that it is inside the uterus.
actions.hg: Doctor ke check ke bina abortion pills mat lo: kisi ko confirm karna hoga ki pregnancy kitne hafte ki hai aur uterus ke andar hai.

actions.en: After an abortion, see a doctor at once for very heavy bleeding, fever or pain that keeps getting worse.
actions.hg: Abortion ke baad bahut zyada bleeding, bukhaar ya lagataar badhta dard ho, toh turant doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: If a year of trying brings no pregnancy, see a doctor as a couple; infertility can come from the man too.
actions.hg: Agar ek saal koshish ke baad bhi pregnancy na ho, toh couple ki tarah doctor ke paas jao; infertility mard ki taraf se bhi ho sakti hai.

actions.en: When a relative blames a woman's old abortion for her infertility, say it plainly: safe abortion does not cause it, and the real causes need a doctor.
actions.hg: Jab koi rishtedaar kisi aurat ki infertility ka ilzaam uske purane abortion par daale, toh saaf kaho: safe abortion se yeh nahi hoti, aur asli wajahon ke liye doctor chahiye.

title.en: A film industry's 'power group', a Kolkata hospital, a legislator jailed for life: the myth that sexual abuse is a poor family's problem
title.hg: Film industry ka 'power group', Kolkata ka ek hospital, umrqaid paane wala ek MLA: yeh myth ki sexual abuse sirf gareeb gharon ki problem hai

dek.en: Schooling and city life lower the risk of violence at home, but they do not end it. And the record from cinema, medicine, a state legislature and the national capital shows money and status hiding abuse instead of preventing it.
dek.hg: Padhai-likhai aur shehar ki life se ghar ke andar violence ka risk kam hota hai, khatam nahi. Aur cinema, medicine, ek state assembly aur desh ki capital ke records dikhate hain ki paisa aur status abuse ko rokte nahi, chhupa lete hain.

statLabel.en: girls born per 1,000 boys in Delhi in 2021-23, among India's lowest (SRS)
statLabel.hg: Delhi mein 2021-23 mein har 1,000 ladkon par itni ladkiyan paida hui, desh mein sabse kam mein se ek (SRS)

label.en: of women married to men with 12 or more years of schooling reported violence by their husband, against 43% with no schooling (NFHS-5)
label.hg: un aurton ne husband ki violence report ki jinke pati 12 ya usse zyada saal padhe the; jinke pati kabhi school nahi gaye, unmein yeh 43% tha (NFHS-5)

label.en: directors, producers and actors in the all-male 'power group' the Hema Committee found controlling Malayalam cinema
label.hg: directors, producers aur actors, jinka all-male 'power group' Hema Committee ke mutabik Malayalam cinema ko control karta hai

label.en: the Hema Committee report reached the Kerala government in December 2019 and was made public only in August 2024
label.hg: Hema Committee ki report December 2019 mein Kerala government ke paas pahunchi, par public hui August 2024 mein

claim.en: Sexual abuse and son preference happen in poor, rural, uneducated families, not in families like ours.
claim.hg: Sexual abuse aur beta chahne ki soch gareeb, gaon ke aur kam padhe-likhe gharon ki baat hai, hamare jaise gharon ki nahi.

truth.en: Schooling and city life lower the risk but do not remove it, and cases from cinema, medicine, politics and the national capital show money and status hiding abuse rather than preventing it.
truth.hg: Padhai aur shehar se risk kam hota hai, khatam nahi. Cinema, medicine, politics aur capital ke cases dikhate hain ki paisa aur status abuse ko rokte nahi, chhupate hain.

actions.en: Ask whether your workplace, college, union or association has an Internal Complaints Committee, and who sits on it.
actions.hg: Pata kijiye ki aapke office, college, union ya association mein Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) hai ya nahi, aur usmein kaun-kaun hai.

actions.en: When a complaint names a powerful or respected person, insist on a proper inquiry instead of judging by reputation.
actions.hg: Jab complaint kisi powerful ya respected aadmi ke khilaf ho, toh uski reputation dekh kar faisla mat kijiye. Proper inquiry ki demand kijiye.

actions.en: Stop saying 'not in families like ours'; tell children that abuse can happen anywhere and that they will be believed.
actions.hg: 'Hamare jaise gharon mein aisa nahi hota' kehna band kijiye. Bachchon ko bataiye ki abuse kahin bhi ho sakta hai, aur unki baat par yakeen kiya jayega.

actions.en: Report any clinic that offers to reveal a baby's sex; sex determination is a crime for the doctor and for whoever asks for it.
actions.hg: Jo clinic pet mein pal rahe bachche ka sex batane ki offer kare, uski complaint kijiye. Sex determination doctor ke liye bhi crime hai aur karwane wale ke liye bhi.

actions.en: If a child is at risk, call Child Helpline 1098; for a woman in danger, call 112 or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Bachcha khatre mein ho toh Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye. Kisi aurat ko khatra ho toh 112 ya Women Helpline 181 par.

title.en: 'He's not the type': why abusers rarely look like monsters, from family friends to the men who run institutions
title.hg: 'Woh aisa aadmi nahi hai': abusers monster jaise kyun nahi dikhte, family friends se le kar institutions chalane wale mardon tak

dek.en: When a man is accused of sexual abuse, his reputation speaks first: good husband, respected teacher, helps everyone. Police records, a government study and the penal code show that abusers are usually ordinary, trusted men, and that the 'monster' image protects them.
dek.hg: Jab kisi aadmi par sexual abuse ka aarop lagta hai, toh sabse pehle uski reputation bolti hai: achha pati, respected teacher, sabki madad karne wala. Police records, ek government study aur penal code dikhate hain ki abusers aksar aam, bharosemand aadmi hote hain, aur 'monster' wali image unhi ko bachati hai.

statLabel.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a family friend, neighbour, employer or other known person
statLabel.hg: rape cases 2024 mein, jinmein accused family friend, padosi, employer ya koi aur jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: of rape cases registered in India in 2024 had an offender the victim knew (28,597 of 29,536)
label.hg: rape cases mein, jo 2024 mein India mein register hue, offender victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha (29,536 mein se 28,597)

label.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a member of the victim's own family
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein, jinmein accused victim ki apni family ka member tha

label.en: of abusers in the government's 2007 child abuse study were known to the child or in a position of trust
label.hg: abusers government ki 2007 ki child abuse study mein bachche ke jaan-pehchaan wale ya position of trust mein the

actions.en: When someone names a respected man, reply with 'tell me what happened', never with 'he would never do that'.
actions.hg: Jab koi kisi respected aadmi ka naam le, toh 'woh aisa kabhi nahi karega' mat kahiye; kahiye 'batao kya hua tha'.

actions.en: Judge behaviour, not status: watch for an adult who seeks time alone with one child, gives gifts with secrets, or ignores a child's 'no'.
actions.hg: Status nahi, behaviour dekhiye: jo adult ek hi bachche ke saath akele waqt dhoondhta hai, gifts ke saath secret rakhwata hai, ya bachche ki 'na' ko ignore karta hai.

actions.en: Let children refuse hugs and laps from anyone, relatives included, and back them when they do.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko kisi ke bhi hug ya god mein baithne se mana karne dijiye, relatives ko bhi, aur jab woh mana karein toh unka saath dijiye.

actions.en: Ask any school, hostel, coaching class or shelter you use: who outside the institution can a child complain to?
actions.hg: Jis school, hostel, coaching class ya shelter se aapka waasta hai, wahan poochiye: institution ke bahar bachcha kisse complaint kar sakta hai?

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them and call the Child Helpline 1098; adults can call 181 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uski baat par yakeen kijiye aur Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye; adults 181 ya 112 par call kar sakte hain.

title.en: 'A grown woman could have stopped him': rape trials end in conviction less often for women (23.7%) than for girls (31.4%)
title.hg: 'Badi aurat thi, rok sakti thi': rape trials mein women ke cases (23.7%) girls ke cases (31.4%) se kam baar conviction par khatm hote hain

dek.en: When the victim is under 18, a rape trial asks whether the act happened. When she is an adult, it asks whether she agreed, and that is the question where beliefs about screaming, fighting and 'proper' behaviour get in. The 2024 court data show the gap.
dek.hg: Jab victim 18 se kam ki hoti hai, toh rape trial yeh poochhta hai ki act hua ya nahi. Jab woh adult hoti hai, toh sawaal yeh ban jaata hai ki usne haan kaha tha ya nahi, aur isi sawaal se cheekhne, ladne aur 'sahi' behaviour wali soch andar aati hai. 2024 ka court data yeh gap dikhata hai.

statLabel.en: conviction rate in 2024 rape trials when the victim was an adult woman (31.4% for girls)
statLabel.hg: 2024 ke rape trials mein conviction rate jab victim adult woman thi (girls ke liye 31.4%)

label.en: of rape trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction when the victim was an adult woman
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials conviction par khatm hue jab victim adult woman thi

label.en: ended in conviction when the victim was a girl under 18 (rape head only; most child cases are tried under POCSO)
label.hg: conviction par khatm hue jab victim 18 se kam ki girl thi (sirf rape head; bachchon ke zyadatar cases POCSO ke tahat chalte hain)

label.en: of the 29,742 rape victims police recorded in 2024 were women aged 18 to 30
label.hg: 2024 mein police ke record kiye 29,742 rape victims mein se itni women 18 se 30 saal ki thi

label.en: of rape cases registered in 2024 had an offender known to the victim
label.hg: 2024 mein darj rape cases jinmein offender victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

claim.en: A grown woman could have stopped him. If she did not fight or scream, she must have agreed.
claim.hg: Badi aurat thi, rok sakti thi. Agar woh na ladi, na cheekhi, toh zaroor usne haan kaha hoga.

truth.en: Section 63 of the BNS says a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting. Yet courts convicted in 23.7% of 2024 rape trials with an adult victim, against 31.4% where the victim was a girl and her consent was legally irrelevant.
truth.hg: BNS ka Section 63 kehta hai ki agar woman physically resist nahi karti, toh sirf is wajah se use consenting nahi maana ja sakta. Phir bhi 2024 mein adult victim wale rape trials mein se 23.7% mein conviction hui, jabki girl victim wale trials mein, jahan uski consent legally irrelevant hai, 31.4% mein.

actions.en: Stop asking a survivor why she did not scream, fight or report at once; Section 63 of the BNS says not resisting is not consent.
actions.hg: Survivor se yeh poochhna band kijiye ki woh cheekhi kyun nahi, ladi kyun nahi ya turant report kyun nahi kiya; BNS ka Section 63 kehta hai ki resist na karna consent nahi hai.

actions.en: After an assault, go to any hospital: treatment is free by law, and a medical examination needs your consent.
actions.hg: Assault ke baad kisi bhi hospital jaiye: law ke hisaab se treatment free hai, aur medical examination aapki consent ke bina nahi ho sakta.

actions.en: Write down what happened in your own words as soon as you can, and keep every message, call log and photo.
actions.hg: Jitni jaldi ho sake, jo hua use apne shabdon mein likh lijiye, aur har message, call log aur photo sambhaal kar rakhiye.

actions.en: If you are asked in court about your sexual history, know that the law bars such questions as proof of consent.
actions.hg: Agar court mein aapki sexual history ke baare mein poochha jaaye, toh yaad rakhiye ki law consent saabit karne ke liye aise sawaalon ko rokta hai.

actions.en: For support at any stage call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi stage par support ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, aur emergency mein 112 par.

title.en: Being gay is not an illness: how Indian medicine and law dropped the 'disease' label, and why 'cures' are now misconduct
title.hg: Gay hona koi bimari nahi hai: Indian medicine aur law ne 'disease' ka label kaise hataya, aur 'ilaaj' ab misconduct kyun hai

dek.en: Many families still answer a child's coming out with a doctor, a pill or a wedding. The courts and the medical regulator have rejected the 'cure', and Parliament has barred discrimination over orientation in mental health care. Here is how the label fell, and what a 'cure' really does.
dek.hg: Bahut si families aaj bhi bachche ke coming out ka jawab doctor, goli ya shaadi se deti hain. Courts aur medical regulator 'cure' ko reject kar chuke hain, aur Parliament ne mental health care mein orientation ki wajah se discrimination ko mana kiya hai. Yeh label kaise gira, aur 'cure' asal mein kya karta hai, yeh rahi poori baat.

label.en: the day a five-judge Supreme Court bench unanimously decriminalised consensual sex between adults of the same sex
label.hg: jis din Supreme Court ki paanch-judge bench ne unanimously same-sex adults ke beech consensual sex ko decriminalise kiya

label.en: of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017, which bars discrimination in mental health care on grounds including sexual orientation
label.hg: Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 ka section, jo mental health care mein sexual orientation samet kisi bhi basis par discrimination ko mana karta hai

label.en: the date of the National Medical Commission's letter declaring conversion therapy professional misconduct
label.hg: National Medical Commission ke us letter ki date jisme conversion therapy ko professional misconduct bataya gaya

label.en: Tele-MANAS, the free, round-the-clock mental health helpline
label.hg: Tele-MANAS, free aur chaubees ghante chalne wali mental health helpline

claim.en: Same-sex attraction is a sickness, a phase or a hormone problem, and a doctor, a medicine or a marriage can set it right.
claim.hg: Same-sex attraction ek bimari hai, ek phase hai ya hormones ki gadbad hai, aur doctor, dawai ya shaadi se theek ho sakta hai.

truth.en: Being gay, lesbian or bisexual is not an illness, so there is nothing to cure. In India a doctor who attempts a 'cure' commits professional misconduct, and consensual same-sex relations between adults have not been a crime since 2018.
truth.hg: Gay, lesbian ya bisexual hona koi bimari nahi hai, isliye theek karne jaisa kuch hai hi nahi. India mein jo doctor 'cure' karne ki koshish kare, woh professional misconduct karta hai, aur adults ke beech consensual same-sex relations 2018 se crime nahi hain.

actions.en: If your child, sibling or friend comes out to you, do not book a doctor to 'fix' it. Listen first. There is nothing to treat.
actions.hg: Agar tumhara bachcha, bhai-behen ya dost tumhare saamne come out kare, toh use 'theek' karwane ke liye doctor ka appointment mat lo. Pehle suno. Ilaaj karne jaisa kuch nahi hai.

actions.en: Before any counselling session, ask the professional directly whether they try to change orientation. If the answer is yes, leave.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi counselling session se pehle professional se seedha poocho ki kya woh orientation badalne ki koshish karte hain. Jawab haan ho, toh wahan se nikal jao.

actions.en: If a registered doctor offers a 'cure', you can complain in writing to the state medical council; since 25 August 2022 it is professional misconduct.
actions.hg: Agar koi registered doctor 'cure' offer kare, toh state medical council ko written complaint de sakte ho; 25 August 2022 se yeh professional misconduct hai.

actions.en: Do not push anyone into marriage as a 'solution'. It changes nobody's orientation and harms two people.
actions.hg: Kisi ko 'solution' ke naam par shaadi mein mat dhakelo. Isse kisi ki orientation nahi badalti, aur nuksaan do logon ka hota hai.

actions.en: If you are being confined, threatened or forced into 'treatment', call 112 (1098 if you are under 18). If the pressure is wearing you down, call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe band kiya ja raha hai, dhamkaya ja raha hai ya zabardasti 'treatment' karwaya ja raha hai, toh 112 par call karo (18 se kam ho toh 1098). Pressure bardaasht se bahar ho raha ho, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo.

title.en: 'Boys don't cry' has a cost. Read the data on abused boys, male suicide and violence at home together.
title.hg: 'Ladke rote nahi' ki ek keemat hai. Abuse jhelne wale ladke, men ki suicide aur ghar ki violence ka data saath padhiye.

dek.en: Indian boys learn early that fear and tears are for girls. The lesson shows up later in three sets of numbers that are rarely read together: abused boys who never tell, men who die by suicide, and men who are violent to the women they live with.
dek.hg: Indian ladke bachpan mein hi seekh lete hain ki darr aur aansu ladkiyon ke liye hain. Yeh sabak baad mein teen alag data sets mein dikhta hai, jinhe shayad hi kabhi saath padha jaata hai: abuse jhelne wale ladke jo kisi ko nahi batate, men jo suicide se marte hain, aur men jo apne hi ghar ki aurton par violence karte hain.

statLabel.en: of children reporting sexual abuse in the government's 2007 study were boys
statLabel.hg: ladke the, un bachchon mein jinhone government ki 2007 ki study mein sexual abuse report kiya

label.en: of the children who reported sexual abuse in the government's 2007 Study on Child Abuse were boys
label.hg: ladke the, un bachchon mein jinhone government ki 2007 ki Study on Child Abuse mein sexual abuse report kiya

label.en: boys among the 44,567 child victims of penetrative sexual assault in 2024 police records
label.hg: ladke the, 2024 ke police records mein penetrative sexual assault ke 44,567 child victims mein

label.en: of India's suicide victims in 2022 were men (NCRB)
label.hg: men the, 2022 mein India ke suicide victims mein (NCRB)

label.en: more likely to be violent to a partner: men who frequently faced discrimination as children (ICRW-UNFPA, 2014)
label.hg: zyada chance partner par violence karne ka: woh men jinhone bachpan mein baar-baar discrimination jhela (ICRW-UNFPA, 2014)

claim.en: Boys don't cry. A real man hides fear and pain and handles everything himself.
claim.hg: Ladke rote nahi. Asli mard darr aur dard chhupata hai aur sab kuch khud sambhalta hai.

truth.en: Boys feel pain and fear like everyone else; the rule only stops them saying so. The silence shows up in abuse that is never reported, in men who never ask for help, and in violence at home.
truth.hg: Ladkon ko bhi dard aur darr waise hi mehsoos hota hai jaise kisi aur ko; yeh rule bas unhe bolne se rokta hai. Yahi chuppi us abuse mein dikhti hai jo kabhi report nahi hota, un men mein jo kabhi help nahi maangte, aur ghar ki violence mein.

actions.en: When a boy cries or is scared, ask what happened instead of telling him to stop.
actions.hg: Jab ladka roye ya dare, toh chup karane ki jagah poochiye ki kya hua.

actions.en: Tell boys plainly that sexual abuse happens to boys too and is never their fault; POCSO protects every child under 18.
actions.hg: Ladkon ko saaf bataiye ki sexual abuse ladkon ke saath bhi hota hai aur yeh kabhi unki galti nahi hoti; POCSO 18 se kam ke har bachche ko protect karta hai.

actions.en: If a boy tells you about abuse, believe him, do not promise secrecy, and call the Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar koi ladka abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh yakeen kijiye, secret rakhne ka promise mat kijiye, aur Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If you are struggling or thinking about ending your life, call Tele-MANAS on 14416. It is free and open 24 hours.
actions.hg: Agar aap struggle kar rahe hain ya zindagi khatam karne ke khayal aa rahe hain, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye. Yeh free hai aur 24 ghante khuli hai.

actions.en: Fathers: let your son see you do housework, apologise and admit fear.
actions.hg: Papa log: bete ko dekhne dijiye ki aap ghar ka kaam karte hain, sorry bolte hain aur darr kabool karte hain.

title.en: 'Crimes against women fell in 2024'? The 1.5% dip hides Rajasthan's 19.6% fall and Tamil Nadu's 27.1% jump
title.hg: '2024 mein crimes against women kam hue'? 1.5% ki is giravat ke peechhe Rajasthan ki 19.6% giravat aur Tamil Nadu ka 27.1% jump chhupa hai

dek.en: NCRB's national count slipped and the rate per lakh women fell. Read state by state, the whole national dip is smaller than one state's fall, and NCRB itself warns that registration is not the same as crime.
dek.hg: NCRB ka national count thoda gira aur har ek lakh women par rate bhi kam hua. State-wise padhiye toh poori national giravat akele ek state ki giravat se chhoti nikalti hai, aur NCRB khud warn karta hai ki registration aur crime ek hi cheez nahi hain.

statLabel.en: fall in registered crimes against women in 2024, to 4,41,534 cases
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein registered crimes against women mein giravat, 4,41,534 cases tak

label.en: crimes against women registered in India in 2024, down from 4,48,211 in 2023
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein register hue crimes against women, 2023 ke 4,48,211 se kam

label.en: registered crimes per lakh women in 2024, down from 66.2 in 2023
label.hg: 2024 mein har ek lakh women par registered crimes, 2023 ke 66.2 se kam

label.en: fall in Rajasthan's registrations in 2024, more cases than India's entire national fall
label.hg: 2024 mein Rajasthan ke registrations mein giravat, cases ke hisaab se India ki poori national giravat se zyada

label.en: conviction rate in crimes-against-women trials completed in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue crimes-against-women trials mein conviction rate

claim.en: Crimes against women fell in 2024, so Indian women are safer.
claim.hg: 2024 mein crimes against women kam hue, isliye Indian women ab zyada safe hain.

truth.en: Police registered 1.5% fewer cases, but registrations count complaints, not violence. The national total has barely moved in three years, one state's fall is bigger than the whole national drop, and NCRB itself warns that a change in registration is not a change in crime.
truth.hg: Police ne 1.5% kam cases register kiye, par registration complaints ginta hai, violence nahi. National total teen saal se lagbhag wahin ka wahin hai, ek state ki giravat poore national drop se badi hai, aur NCRB khud warn karta hai ki registration mein badlaav crime mein badlaav nahi hota.

actions.en: Before sharing 'crime fell' or 'crime rose', check whether it means registered cases or actual violence.
actions.hg: 'Crime ghata' ya 'crime badha' share karne se pehle check kijiye ki baat registered cases ki ho rahi hai ya asli violence ki.

actions.en: Look up your own state in NCRB's Crime in India tables and compare rates per lakh women, not raw counts.
actions.hg: NCRB ki Crime in India tables mein apna state dhoondhiye aur raw counts nahi, har ek lakh women par rate compare kijiye.

actions.en: Judge police and courts by what happens after the FIR: charge-sheets, convictions and how long cases wait.
actions.hg: Police aur courts ko FIR ke baad ke kaam se parkhiye: charge-sheets, convictions aur cases kitni der latke rehte hain.

actions.en: You can report at any police station, wherever the crime happened (Zero FIR), or online by e-FIR; a woman's complaint of rape is recorded by a woman officer.
actions.hg: Aap kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakte hain, crime kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR), ya online e-FIR se; rape ki complaint karne wali woman ki baat woman officer hi record karti hai.

actions.en: In an emergency, call 112; the Women Helpline is 181.
actions.hg: Emergency mein 112 call kijiye; Women Helpline 181 hai.

title.en: Rape is 6.7% of India's registered crimes against women: the numbers behind the crimes nobody headlines
title.hg: India mein women ke khilaaf register hue crimes mein rape sirf 6.7% hai: un crimes ke numbers jo headline nahi bante

dek.en: Police registered 4,41,534 crimes against women in 2024. More than a quarter were cruelty by a husband or his relatives, and rape was about one in fifteen. Here is what each large category covers, what NCRB's counting rule hides, and where prevention has to start.
dek.hg: 2024 mein police ne women ke khilaaf 4,41,534 crimes register kiye. Inmein ek-chauthai se zyada pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty ke the, aur rape lagbhag har pandrah mein se ek. Yahan dekhiye ki har badi category mein kya aata hai, NCRB ka counting rule kya chhupa deta hai, aur prevention kahan se shuru honi chahiye.

statLabel.en: share of rape in the 4,41,534 crimes against women registered in 2024
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein register hue women ke khilaaf 4,41,534 crimes mein rape ka share

label.en: crimes against women registered by police in India in 2024
label.hg: crimes women ke khilaaf, jo 2024 mein India ki police ne register kiye

label.en: were cruelty by a husband or his relatives, the largest category (1,20,227 cases)
label.hg: pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty ke the, sabse badi category (1,20,227 cases)

label.en: were rape (29,536 cases)
label.hg: rape ke the (29,536 cases)

label.en: of women aged 18-49 have faced physical or sexual violence (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 18-49 saal ki women ne physical ya sexual violence jheli hai (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: 'Crime against women' mostly means rape by a stranger.
claim.hg: 'Women ke khilaaf crime' ka matlab zyada tar kisi stranger ka kiya hua rape hai.

truth.en: Rape was 6.7% of the crimes against women that police registered in 2024, and in almost all of those cases the accused was known to the woman. The largest category was cruelty by a husband or his relatives. Most of the rest involved girls, abduction and everyday sexual harassment.
truth.hg: 2024 mein police ne women ke khilaaf jitne crimes register kiye, unmein rape 6.7% tha, aur un cases mein bhi lagbhag har baar accused aurat ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha. Sabse badi category pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty thi. Baaki ka bada hissa ladkiyon, abduction aur roz ke sexual harassment ka tha.

actions.en: When someone says 'women's safety', ask about homes, schools and phones as well as streets. That is where most registered cases come from.
actions.hg: Jab koi 'women's safety' bole, toh sadak ke saath ghar, school aur phone ke baare mein bhi poochhiye. Zyada tar registered cases wahin se aate hain.

actions.en: Treat cruelty by a husband or in-laws as the crime it is under Sections 85 and 86 of the BNS, not as a family matter to adjust to.
actions.hg: Pati ya sasural walon ki cruelty ko wahi maaniye jo BNS ke Section 85 aur 86 ise maante hain: crime, koi 'ghar ka maamla' nahi jisme adjust karna pade.

actions.en: Tell children of every gender that no one may touch them sexually, and that telling you will never get them into trouble. Child Helpline: 1098.
actions.hg: Har gender ke bachchon ko bataiye ki koi unhe sexually touch nahi kar sakta, aur aapko batane par unhe kabhi daant nahi padegi. Child Helpline: 1098.

actions.en: Report groping, stalking and sexual comments. Each is a separate offence in the BNS, not harmless 'teasing'.
actions.hg: Groping, stalking aur sexual comments ko report kijiye. BNS mein har ek alag offence hai, koi halka-phulka 'teasing' nahi.

actions.en: In danger, call 112. For advice and referrals, call the Women Helpline on 181.
actions.hg: Khatra ho toh 112 par call karein. Advice aur referral ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call karein.

title.en: 'Bring the death penalty for rapists'? Indian law already allows it in five kinds of cases
title.hg: 'Rapists ke liye death penalty lao'? Indian law paanch tarah ke cases mein pehle se iski ijaazat deta hai

dek.en: The demand returns after every case that shakes the country, as if the law had no such punishment. It has had one since 2013, and Parliament has widened it three times. What has barely moved is the conviction rate: 24.4% of rape trials completed in 2024, against about 24% in 2012.
dek.hg: Jab bhi koi case desh ko hila deta hai, yeh maang laut aati hai, jaise law mein aisi koi saza ho hi nahi. Yeh saza 2013 se law mein hai, aur Parliament ise teen baar aur phaila chuki hai. Jo lagbhag nahi badla, woh conviction rate hai: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials ka 24.4%, jabki 2012 mein yeh lagbhag 24% tha.

statLabel.en: conviction rate in rape trials completed in 2024, despite death-penalty provisions
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials ka conviction rate, death penalty ke provisions ke bawajood

label.en: of rape trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials conviction par khatm hue

label.en: rape cases ended in acquittal in 2024, against 5,032 convictions
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein acquittal par khatm hue, jabki conviction 5,032 mein hua

label.en: rape cases were pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending the

label.en: rape cases registered in 2024 (31,516 in 2022)
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein register hue (2022 mein 31,516)

claim.en: India needs to bring in the death penalty for rapists.
claim.hg: India ko rapists ke liye death penalty laani chahiye.

truth.en: It already has one. The BNS allows death for the rape of a girl under 12, rape that causes death or a persistent vegetative state, gang rape of a girl under 18 and repeat offences, and POCSO allows it for aggravated penetrative sexual assault on a child. Conviction is the weak point: 24.4% of rape trials completed in 2024.
truth.hg: Yeh pehle se law mein hai. BNS 12 se kam umr ki ladki ke rape, maut ya persistent vegetative state tak pahunchane wale rape, 18 se kam umr ki ladki ke gang rape aur repeat offence mein death ki ijaazat deta hai, aur POCSO child par aggravated penetrative sexual assault mein. Kamzor kadi conviction hai: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials ka 24.4%.

actions.en: When someone demands 'death for rapists', tell them the law already allows it, and ask what the conviction rate is.
actions.hg: Jab koi 'rapists ko phaansi do' ki maang kare, toh bataiye ki law pehle se iski ijaazat deta hai, aur poochhiye ki conviction rate kya hai.

actions.en: Judge your state's response by FIRs registered, charge-sheets filed and trials finished, not by the harshest sentence announced.
actions.hg: Apne state ke response ko register hui FIRs, file hui charge-sheets aur poore hue trials se naapiye, sabse sakht saza ke elaan se nahi.

actions.en: Know that a police officer who fails to record an FIR for rape commits an offence under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye: jo police officer rape ki FIR darj nahi karta, woh BNS ke Section 199 ke under khud offence karta hai.

actions.en: Support a survivor's decision to report, most of all when the accused is a relative or family friend.
actions.hg: Survivor ke report karne ke faisle ka saath dijiye, khaas kar jab accused koi relative ya family friend ho.

actions.en: In an emergency call 112. For a child, call the Child Helpline on 1098.
actions.hg: Emergency mein 112 par call karein. Bachche ke liye Child Helpline 1098 par call karein.

title.en: 'Dhat' and the semen-loss panic: why a myth about 'vital fluid' sends young men to quacks instead of doctors
title.hg: 'Dhat' aur semen-loss ka darr: 'vital fluid' wala myth young men ko doctor ke bajaye quacks ke paas kyun bhejta hai

dek.en: Nightfall, 'thin' semen and cloudy urine get read as strength leaking out of the body. Losing semen harms no one. The fear is real and treatable, but in a country with wide mental-health treatment gaps it often ends up at a tonic clinic, not with a doctor.
dek.hg: Nightfall, 'patla' semen aur dhundhla urine dekh kar lagta hai ki body se taakat beh rahi hai. Semen nikalne se kisi ka kuch nahi bigadta. Darr asli hai aur uska ilaaj ho sakta hai, par jis desh mein mental-health treatment gap itna bada hai, wahan yeh darr aksar doctor ke paas nahi, tonic wale clinic par pahunchta hai.

statLabel.en: treatment gap for mental disorders in India (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)
statLabel.hg: India mein mental disorders ka treatment gap (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)

label.en: treatment gap for mental disorders in India: the share of people with a disorder who were getting no treatment (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)
label.hg: India mein mental disorders ka treatment gap: disorder wale kitne logon ko koi treatment nahi mil raha tha (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)

label.en: overall mental morbidity among Indian men, against 7.5% among women (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)
label.hg: Indian men mein overall mental morbidity, jabki women mein 7.5% (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)

label.en: maximum jail term on a first conviction for advertising a drug for conditions such as sexual impotence, under a 1954 law
label.hg: sexual impotence jaisi conditions ki dawa ka ad dene par pehli conviction mein zyada se zyada jail, 1954 ke ek kanoon ke under

label.en: Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline
label.hg: Tele-MANAS, Health Ministry ki free, chaubees ghante chalne wali mental-health helpline

claim.en: Semen is the body's vital fluid. Losing it through nightfall, masturbation or 'dhat' drains strength, memory and future fertility.
claim.hg: Semen body ka 'vital fluid' hai. Nightfall, masturbation ya 'dhat' mein iske nikalne se taakat, memory aur aage ki fertility khatam hoti jaati hai.

truth.en: Semen is mostly fluid from glands, and the body makes and replaces it continuously. Losing it harms nothing. The tiredness, aches and poor concentration blamed on 'dhat' come from anxiety and guilt, which a qualified doctor or counsellor can treat.
truth.hg: Semen zyada tar glands ka fluid hai, jise body lagataar banati aur replace karti rehti hai. Iske nikalne se koi nuksaan nahi hota. 'Dhat' ke naam par jo thakaan, dard aur dhyan na lagna hota hai, woh anxiety aur guilt se aata hai, jiska ilaaj qualified doctor ya counsellor kar sakta hai.

actions.en: If nightfall, 'thin' semen or cloudy urine is worrying you, start with the biology: the body replaces semen continuously, and losing it does not drain strength or fertility.
actions.hg: Agar nightfall, 'patla' semen ya dhundhla urine tumhe pareshan kar raha hai, toh pehle biology samjho: body semen lagataar replace karti hai, aur iske nikalne se na taakat ghatti hai, na fertility.

actions.en: Do not buy a 'dhat', 'nightfall' or 'sex power' course. Advertising such drugs is a crime under a 1954 law.
actions.hg: 'Dhat', 'nightfall' ya 'sex power' ka koi course mat kharido. Aisi dawaon ka ad dena 1954 ke ek kanoon ke under crime hai.

actions.en: If the worry is eating into your sleep, studies or mood, call Tele-MANAS on 14416. It is free and open round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar yeh chinta tumhari neend, padhai ya mood kha rahi hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call karo. Yeh free hai aur chaubees ghante khula hai.

actions.en: See a qualified doctor for burning while passing urine, a discharge or sore, blood in semen, or a lump or pain in a testicle.
actions.hg: Urine mein jalan, discharge ya ghaav, semen mein blood, ya testicle mein gaanth ya dard ho, toh qualified doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: If a friend says he has 'dhat', listen without laughing and point him to a doctor or counsellor, not a tonic.
actions.hg: Agar koi dost kahe ki use 'dhat' hai, toh hanse bina suno aur use tonic ki taraf nahi, doctor ya counsellor ki taraf bhejo.

title.en: Not an abortion, not a 'loose girl' pill: the shame myths that make young women wait on emergency contraception
title.hg: Na abortion hai, na 'loose ladki' ki pill: woh sharam wale myths jinki wajah se young women emergency contraception lene mein der kar deti hain

dek.en: Emergency contraception works better the sooner it is taken. Three beliefs about what the pill says about a girl cost her the hours it needs. Here is the evidence against each one, and how to buy the pill without owing anyone an explanation.
dek.hg: Emergency contraception jitni jaldi li jaaye, utna achha kaam karti hai. Pill ladki ke baare mein kya 'batati' hai, is par teen beliefs usse wahi ghante chheen lete hain jo pill ko chahiye. Har myth ke khilaaf evidence yahan hai, aur yeh bhi ki bina kisi ko safai diye pill kaise kharidein.

label.en: the window for emergency contraception after unprotected sex; the sooner, the better (WHO)
label.hg: unprotected sex ke baad emergency contraception ki window; jitni jaldi, utna behtar (WHO)

label.en: of Indian men agreed that women who use contraception may become promiscuous (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: Indian men ne maana ki contraception use karne wali women 'promiscuous' ho sakti hain (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: young women against young men aged 15-24 who knew where to get a condom (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-24 saal ki young women banaam young men, jinhe pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: estimated abortions in India in 2015
label.hg: 2015 mein India mein estimated abortions

claim.en: The emergency pill is a small abortion, it spoils your chances of having children later, and only a 'loose' girl would ever need it.
claim.hg: Emergency pill ek chhota abortion hai, isse aage chalkar bachche hone mein dikkat aati hai, aur iski zaroorat sirf 'loose' ladkiyon ko padti hai.

truth.en: It delays the release of an egg and cannot end a pregnancy. It does not harm future fertility. Condoms break and pills get missed in every kind of relationship, married or not.
truth.hg: Yeh egg ke release ko delay karti hai aur pregnancy ko end nahi kar sakti. Future fertility ko nuksaan nahi pahunchati. Condom har tarah ke relationship mein phat-te hain aur pills har kisi se miss hoti hain, shaadi ho ya na ho.

actions.en: After unprotected sex, a broken condom or missed pills, get emergency contraception the same day if you can. It works up to five days later, but sooner is better.
actions.hg: Unprotected sex, phate hue condom ya missed pills ke baad, ho sake toh usi din emergency contraception lo. Yeh paanch din baad tak kaam karti hai, par jitni jaldi utna behtar.

actions.en: Ask the chemist for an emergency contraceptive pill by name. You do not owe anyone at the counter a reason, a ring or an apology.
actions.hg: Chemist se seedha emergency contraceptive pill maango. Counter par kisi ko wajah, ring ya sorry dene ki zaroorat nahi.

actions.en: If you cannot face the counter, your partner or a friend can buy it. The risk was created by two people.
actions.hg: Agar counter tak jaana mushkil lag raha hai, toh tumhara partner ya koi dost bhi pill kharid sakta hai. Risk do logon ne banaya tha.

actions.en: If your next period is more than a week late, take a pregnancy test and see a doctor. The pill cannot end a pregnancy that has begun.
actions.hg: Agla period ek hafte se zyada late ho, toh pregnancy test karo aur doctor ko dikhao. Shuru ho chuki pregnancy ko yeh pill end nahi kar sakti.

actions.en: Needed it more than once? Ask a doctor about a regular method. That is planning, not a verdict on you.
actions.hg: Ek se zyada baar zaroorat padi? Doctor se regular method ke baare mein poocho. Yeh planning hai, tumhare character par faisla nahi.

title.en: 'He promised to marry me, so it's rape'? What Section 69 of the BNS covers, and what it doesn't
title.hg: 'Usne shaadi ka promise kiya tha, toh yeh rape hai'? BNS ka Section 69 kya cover karta hai, aur kya nahi

dek.en: One myth says any break-up after sex can now become a rape case. The other says lying to get sex is a private matter. The new law rejects both, and draws its line at what was intended when the promise was made.
dek.hg: Ek myth kehta hai ki ab sex ke baad toota har relationship rape case ban sakta hai. Doosra kehta hai ki sex ke liye jhooth bolna private matter hai. Naya law dono ko reject karta hai, aur line wahan kheenchta hai jahan sawaal hai: promise karte waqt intention kya tha.

statLabel.en: cases under Section 69 BNS (sex by deceit or a false promise of marriage), July to December 2024
statLabel.hg: Section 69 BNS (dhoke se ya shaadi ke jhoothe promise pe sex) ke cases, July se December 2024

label.en: cases registered under Section 69 in its first six months, July to December 2024
label.hg: Section 69 ke pehle chhe mahino, July se December 2024, mein register hue cases

label.en: the maximum sentence under Section 69, and the minimum sentence for rape
label.hg: Section 69 mein maximum saza, aur rape mein minimum saza: 10 saal

label.en: Section 69 cases that NCRB also counted as cyber crimes in 2024
label.hg: Section 69 ke woh cases jinhe NCRB ne 2024 mein cyber crime mein bhi gina

label.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a friend, online friend, live-in partner 'on pretext of marriage' or separated husband
label.hg: 2024 ke rape cases jinme accused dost, online dost, 'pretext of marriage' wala live-in partner ya alag reh raha pati tha

claim.en: Since the new law came in, any relationship that ends after sex can be turned into a rape case.
claim.hg: Naya law aane ke baad, sex ke baad khatam hue kisi bhi relationship ko rape case banaya ja sakta hai.

truth.en: Section 69 is a separate offence that the law itself says does 'not amount to rape'. It punishes a promise that was never meant to be kept, or other deceit, not a relationship that simply ended.
truth.hg: Section 69 ek alag offence hai, aur law khud likhta hai ki yeh 'rape nahi' hai. Yeh us promise ki saza hai jise nibhane ka intention kabhi tha hi nahi, ya kisi aur dhoke ki. Sirf relationship khatam ho jaana crime nahi hai.

actions.en: Never promise marriage, a job or a promotion to get sex. A hollow promise can be a crime with up to 10 years in prison.
actions.hg: Sex ke liye kabhi shaadi, naukri ya promotion ka promise mat karo. Khokhla promise crime ho sakta hai, jisme 10 saal tak ki jail hai.

actions.en: If you were deceived, write down dates, keep the messages and note exactly what was promised, then report it at any police station.
actions.hg: Agar tumhare saath dhoka hua hai, toh dates likh lo, messages sambhaal ke rakho aur exactly likho ki kya promise hua tha, phir kisi bhi police station mein report karo.

actions.en: If there were threats, force or fear, tell the police plainly: that is rape under Section 63, not a broken promise.
actions.hg: Agar dhamki, zabardasti ya darr tha, toh police ko saaf batao: yeh Section 63 ke under rape hai, toota promise nahi.

actions.en: If either person is under 18, no promise and no 'yes' changes anything: it is an offence under POCSO.
actions.hg: Agar dono mein se koi bhi 18 se kam hai, toh koi promise ya 'haan' kuch nahi badalta: yeh POCSO ke under offence hai.

actions.en: Do not let family, police or a panchayat push a woman to marry the man she has accused. The choice is hers.
actions.hg: Family, police ya panchayat ko kisi woman pe usi aadmi se shaadi ka pressure mat daalne do jis pe usne aarop lagaya hai. Faisla uska hai.

title.en: 'Fast-track means fast justice'? 779 courts, 2,45,579 pending rape and POCSO cases, and disposals down 22% in 2025
title.hg: 'Fast-track matlab fast justice'? 779 courts, rape aur POCSO ke 2,45,579 pending cases, aur 2025 mein disposals 22% kam

dek.en: After every case that shakes the country, someone promises a fast-track court, and the phrase sounds like a verdict in weeks. The government's own figures show a queue that keeps growing while the courts decide fewer cases.
dek.hg: Desh ko hila dene wale har case ke baad koi na koi fast-track court ka promise karta hai, aur sunke lagta hai ki verdict kuch hafton mein aa jaayega. Sarkar ke apne figures dikhate hain ki queue lambi hoti ja rahi hai, aur courts pehle se kam cases decide kar rahe hain.

statLabel.en: rape and POCSO cases disposed of by fast-track courts in 2025, down 22% on 2024
statLabel.hg: 2025 mein fast-track courts ne itne rape aur POCSO cases dispose kiye, 2024 se 22% kam

label.en: Fast Track Special Courts working in November 2026, 399 of them only for POCSO cases
label.hg: November 2026 mein chal rahe Fast Track Special Courts, jinme 399 sirf POCSO cases ke liye hain

label.en: rape and POCSO cases pending before these courts on 31 December 2025
label.hg: 31 December 2025 ko in courts mein pending rape aur POCSO cases

label.en: new cases that reached fast-track courts in 2025
label.hg: 2025 mein fast-track courts mein aaye naye cases

label.en: cases they disposed of in 2025, down from 85,595 in 2024
label.hg: 2025 mein dispose hue cases, 2024 ke 85,595 se kam

claim.en: Once a case goes to a fast-track court, the verdict comes in weeks.
claim.hg: Ek baar case fast-track court mein pahunch gaya, toh verdict kuch hafton mein aa jaata hai.

truth.en: A fast-track court gets no deadline of its own: it works under the same time limits as any court hearing a rape or POCSO case, and the queue makes them hard to meet: about 2,45,579 rape and POCSO cases were waiting before these courts at the end of 2025, and they decided fewer cases that year than the year before.
truth.hg: Fast-track court ki apni koi alag deadline nahi hoti: us pe wahi time limits laagu hain jo rape ya POCSO case sunne wale har court pe hain, aur queue ki wajah se woh poori nahi ho paati: 2025 ke end mein in courts mein rape aur POCSO ke lagbhag 2,45,579 cases wait kar rahe the, aur us saal inhone pichhle saal se kam cases decide kiye.

actions.en: When a leader promises a fast-track court, ask how many cases are already waiting in the fast-track courts your state has.
actions.hg: Jab koi neta fast-track court ka promise kare, toh poocho ki tumhare state ke fast-track courts mein pehle se kitne cases wait kar rahe hain.

actions.en: If you are a survivor, ask the police for an update on the investigation: the law gives you a right to one within 90 days.
actions.hg: Agar tum survivor ho, toh police se investigation ka update maango: law tumhe 90 din ke andar iska haq deta hai.

actions.en: Apply for victim compensation at your District Legal Services Authority. You do not have to wait for the trial to end.
actions.hg: Apni District Legal Services Authority mein victim compensation ke liye apply karo. Iske liye trial khatam hone ka wait zaroori nahi.

actions.en: If a child has to testify, ask for the POCSO protections by name: questions through the judge, no facing the accused, a trusted adult present.
actions.hg: Agar kisi bachche ko gawahi deni hai, toh POCSO ki protections naam lekar maango: sawaal judge ke through, accused se aamna-saamna nahi, saath mein koi bharosemand bada.

actions.en: Keep one file with the FIR, the chargesheet date and every hearing date, so your lawyer can press for speed.
actions.hg: Ek file banao jisme FIR, chargesheet ki date aur har hearing ki date ho, taaki tumhara lawyer speed ke liye pressure bana sake.

title.en: 'Ghar ki baat': the privacy myth that hides wife-beating, marital rape and child abuse inside Indian homes
title.hg: 'Ghar ki baat': privacy ka woh myth jo Indian gharon ke andar wife-beating, marital rape aur child abuse ko chhupata hai

dek.en: 'Don't take family matters outside' is a rule many Indian families live by. Survey and police data show what it covers, and the law shows whose privacy it really protects. It is not the person being hurt.
dek.hg: 'Ghar ki baat bahar mat le jao' ek aisa rule hai jis par bahut saari Indian families chalti hain. Survey aur police data dikhate hain ki yeh rule kya dhakta hai, aur law dikhata hai ki yeh asal mein kiski privacy bachata hai. Us insaan ki nahi jise chot pahunch rahi hai.

statLabel.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: women ne, jinhone physical ya sexual violence jheli thi, kabhi help nahi maangi aur kisi ko bataya bhi nahi (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: women ne, jinhone physical ya sexual violence jheli thi, kabhi help nahi maangi aur kisi ko bataya bhi nahi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of ever-married women who had faced sexual violence named their current husband (NFHS-5)
label.hg: ever-married women ne, jinhone sexual violence jheli thi, apne current husband ka naam liya (NFHS-5)

label.en: POCSO penetrative sexual assault cases in 2024 in which the accused was a family member
label.hg: POCSO ke under penetrative sexual assault ke cases 2024 mein, jinmein accused family member tha

label.en: cruelty-by-husband cases ended in compromise or compounding in court in 2024, against 10,689 convictions
label.hg: cruelty-by-husband cases 2024 mein court mein compromise ya compounding par khatam hue, jabki conviction 10,689 mein hui

claim.en: What happens inside a family is private. Taking 'ghar ki baat' outside shames the family and helps no one.
claim.hg: Family ke andar jo hota hai woh private hai. 'Ghar ki baat' bahar le jaane se family ki badnaami hoti hai aur kisi ka bhala nahi hota.

truth.en: Privacy belongs to a person, not to a household's reputation. Cruelty by a husband and sexual abuse of a child are crimes wherever they happen, and silence protects only the person committing them.
truth.hg: Privacy insaan ki hoti hai, ghar ki izzat ki nahi. Pati ki cruelty aur bachche ka sexual abuse crime hain, chahe kahin bhi hon, aur chuppi sirf use bachati hai jo yeh kar raha hai.

actions.en: If you hear someone in immediate danger next door, call 112; do not wait to be sure.
actions.hg: Agar bagal ke ghar se lage ki koi abhi khatre mein hai, toh 112 par call kijiye; pakka hone ka intezaar mat kijiye.

actions.en: Speak to her alone, later: say you have noticed, you believe her and you will help when she is ready.
actions.hg: Usse baad mein akele mein baat kijiye: kahiye ki aapne notice kiya hai, aap uski baat maante hain, aur jab woh ready ho tab madad karenge.

actions.en: Stop telling daughters and sisters to 'adjust'; tell them your door is open and mean it.
actions.hg: Betiyon aur behnon ko 'adjust kar lo' kehna band kijiye; bataiye ki aapka darwaza khula hai, aur sach mein khula rakhiye.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them, do not promise secrecy, and call the Child Helpline 1098 or the police.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh yakeen kijiye, secret rakhne ka promise mat kijiye, aur Child Helpline 1098 ya police ko call kijiye.

actions.en: Share the Women Helpline 181 and the nearest One Stop Centre with a woman who may need them.
actions.hg: Jis aurat ko zaroorat pad sakti hai, use Women Helpline 181 aur sabse paas ke One Stop Centre ki jaankari dijiye.

title.en: 'Good girls are safe' is a broken bargain. Wives, a shelter-home audit and the Supreme Court's own glossary prove it.
title.hg: 'Achhi ladkiyan safe rehti hain' ek tooti hui deal hai. Wives, ek shelter home audit aur Supreme Court ki apni glossary yeh saabit karte hain.

dek.en: Families promise daughters that modesty and obedience will keep them safe, and hint that women who break the rules cannot really be raped. Survey data, a shelter-home audit and the law break both halves of that bargain.
dek.hg: Families betiyon se kehti hain ki dhang ke kapde pehno, kehna maano, toh safe rahogi. Ishaaron mein yeh bhi ki jo rules todti hai, uska 'asli' rape ho hi nahi sakta. Survey data, ek shelter home ka audit aur law, teeno is deal ke dono hisson ko galat saabit karte hain.

statLabel.en: minor girls found sexually abused in a state-run Muzaffarpur shelter home by a TISS audit
statLabel.hg: minor ladkiyon ka Muzaffarpur ke ek state-run shelter home mein sexual abuse hua, TISS audit mein saamne aaya

label.en: of ever-married women who had faced sexual violence named their current husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: married women ne, jinhone sexual violence jheli thi, apne current husband ka naam liya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women said a husband may beat his wife if she shows 'disrespect' to her in-laws, the most accepted excuse (NFHS-5)
label.hg: women ne kaha ki biwi in-laws ki 'disrespect' kare toh pati use maar sakta hai; yahi sabse zyada maana gaya bahana tha (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women whose fathers beat their mothers faced violence from their own husbands, against 25% of other women (NFHS-5)
label.hg: un women ne apne husband ki violence jheli jinke papa unki mummy ko maarte the; baaki women mein yeh 25% tha (NFHS-5)

claim.en: Girls who dress modestly, obey their families and stay home will be safe, and women who break those rules cannot really be raped.
claim.hg: Jo ladkiyan dhang ke kapde pehenti hain, family ka kehna maanti hain aur ghar par rehti hain, woh safe rehti hain. Aur jo aurtein yeh rules todti hain, unka asli mein rape ho hi nahi sakta.

truth.en: Survivors most often name husbands, people they know and people in charge of them, and since 2013 a woman's character or sexual past has been legally irrelevant to whether she consented.
truth.hg: Survivors sabse zyada husband, jaan-pehchaan walon aur apni dekhbhaal karne walon ka naam leti hain. Aur 2013 se law kehta hai ki consent ke sawaal par aurat ka character ya sexual past matter nahi karta.

actions.en: Tell daughters that no rule they follow or break makes violence their fault.
actions.hg: Betiyon ko bataiye ki koi bhi rule maanne ya todne se violence unki galti nahi ban jaati.

actions.en: Teach sons that every woman's consent counts, whether she is a wife, a girlfriend or a sex worker.
actions.hg: Beton ko sikhaiye ki har aurat ka consent matter karta hai, chahe woh wife ho, girlfriend ho ya sex worker.

actions.en: Drop labels like 'characterless' or 'loose'; the Supreme Court has told judges to say simply 'woman'.
actions.hg: 'Characterless' ya 'chaalu' jaise labels chhodiye; Supreme Court ne judges se kaha hai ki bas 'woman' kahein.

actions.en: Ask how children in any hostel, shelter or home you are connected to can complain, and who checks on them.
actions.hg: Jis hostel, shelter ya home se aap jude hain, wahan poochiye ki bachche complaint kaise kar sakte hain aur unki khabar kaun leta hai.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them and call 1098; for a woman in danger, call 112 or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uski baat par yakeen kijiye aur 1098 par call kijiye. Kisi aurat ko khatra ho toh 112 ya Women Helpline 181 par.

title.en: Not from a hug, a plate or a mosquito: the HIV contact myths behind the discrimination India's 2017 HIV Act outlawed
title.hg: Na hug se, na plate se, na machhar se: HIV ke contact myths, aur woh discrimination jise India ke 2017 ke HIV Act ne gair-kanooni banaya

dek.en: In NFHS-5, 55% of women did not know that sharing food cannot spread HIV. That belief is what gets families evicted, children seated apart and workers pushed out. The virus does not travel that way, and the law now forbids the exclusion.
dek.hg: NFHS-5 mein 55% women ko pata nahi tha ki khana share karne se HIV nahi failta. Isi belief ki wajah se families se ghar khaali karwaye jaate hain, bachchon ko alag bithaya jaata hai aur logon ko naukri se nikala jaata hai. Virus is raaste se chalta hi nahi, aur law ab is exclusion ko mana karta hai.

statLabel.en: of women did not know HIV cannot spread by sharing food (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
statLabel.hg: women ko pata nahi tha ki khana share karne se HIV nahi failta (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women aged 15-49 did not know HIV cannot spread by sharing food (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ko pata nahi tha ki khana share karne se HIV nahi failta (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women did not know mosquito bites cannot transmit HIV (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: women ko pata nahi tha ki machhar ke kaatne se HIV nahi failta (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of people newly diagnosed with HIV in 2024-25 reported heterosexual sex as the route
label.hg: yaani lagbhag 74%: 2024-25 mein HIV ke naye diagnose hue logon mein se itnon ne route heterosexual sex bataya

label.en: in jail, a fine of up to Rs 1 lakh, or both, for spreading hatred against people living with HIV
label.hg: yaani teen mahine se do saal ki jail, Rs 1 lakh tak ka fine, ya dono: HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ke khilaaf nafrat failane ki saza

claim.en: HIV can be caught from a hug, a shared plate, a toilet or a mosquito, so keeping your distance from people who have it is only sensible.
claim.hg: HIV hug karne, plate share karne, toilet ya machhar se lag sakta hai, isliye jinhe HIV hai unse door rehna hi samajhdaari hai.

truth.en: HIV passes only through specific body fluids: by sex without a condom, shared needles, unscreened blood, or from parent to baby without treatment. Everyday contact carries no risk, and shutting someone out over it is discrimination that the HIV Act, 2017 forbids.
truth.hg: HIV sirf kuch specific body fluids se pass hota hai: bina condom ke sex, shared needles, unscreened blood, ya treatment na ho toh parent se baby mein. Roz ke contact mein koi risk nahi hai, aur is wajah se kisi ko alag kar dena woh discrimination hai jise HIV Act, 2017 mana karta hai.

actions.en: Eat with, sit beside, hug and share a bathroom with a person who has HIV as you would with anyone. None of it can pass on the virus.
actions.hg: Jise HIV hai uske saath waise hi khao, baitho, hug karo aur bathroom share karo jaise kisi aur ke saath karte ho. Inmein se kisi cheez se virus pass nahi hota.

actions.en: When someone repeats a contact myth, answer with the real routes: sex without a condom, shared needles, unscreened blood, or parent to baby without treatment.
actions.hg: Jab koi contact wala myth dohraye, toh asli routes batao: bina condom ke sex, shared needles, unscreened blood, ya treatment na ho toh parent se baby mein.

actions.en: Never forward, announce or guess at anyone's HIV status. It is theirs to tell.
actions.hg: Kisi ka HIV status kabhi forward mat karo, announce mat karo, andaaza bhi mat lagao. Yeh batana unka haq hai, tumhara nahi.

actions.en: If a school, employer, hospital or landlord shuts someone out over HIV, help them complain in writing to the institution's Complaints Officer or the state's HIV Ombudsman.
actions.hg: Agar koi school, employer, hospital ya landlord HIV ki wajah se kisi ko bahar kar raha hai, toh institution ke Complaints Officer ya state ke HIV Ombudsman ko written complaint dene mein unki madad karo.

actions.en: For confidential information or counselling, call the national AIDS helpline 1097, toll-free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Confidential jaankari ya counselling ke liye national AIDS helpline 1097 par call karo. Toll-free hai aur chaubees ghante chalti hai.

title.en: A cancer vaccine, not a character certificate: the 'promiscuity' myth around the HPV vaccine and cervical cancer
title.hg: Cancer ki vaccine hai, character certificate nahi: HPV vaccine aur cervical cancer ko lekar 'promiscuity' wala myth

dek.en: Because HPV spreads through sex, some families see the free shot for 14-year-old girls as an invitation to have sex, and cervical cancer as the price of a 'loose' life. Here is what the vaccine actually does, and why the dose comes before any risk.
dek.hg: HPV sex se failta hai, isliye kuch families 14 saal ki ladkiyon ki free vaccine ko sex ki 'permission' samajh leti hain, aur cervical cancer ko 'bigdi hui' life ki saza. Vaccine asal mein kya karti hai, aur dose kisi bhi risk se pehle kyun di jaati hai, yeh raha poora sach.

statLabel.en: girls had received the HPV vaccine by 15 July 2026, about 43% of the 1.2 crore target
statLabel.hg: ladkiyon ko 15 July 2026 tak HPV vaccine lag chuki thi, yaani 1.2 crore target ka lagbhag 43%

label.en: estimated cervical cancer deaths in India in 2024 (latest GLOBOCAN estimate)
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein cervical cancer se estimated deaths (GLOBOCAN ka latest estimate)

label.en: of cervical cancer cases in India are caused by HPV types 16 and 18
label.hg: India mein cervical cancer ke cases HPV type 16 aur 18 se hote hain

label.en: of women aged 15-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ne kabhi cervical cancer screening karwayi thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: HPV vaccine doses given under the national campaign by 11 September 2026
label.hg: 11 September 2026 tak national campaign mein lagi HPV vaccine doses

claim.en: The HPV vaccine is for girls who plan to have sex, and cervical cancer is a disease of women with a 'loose' character.
claim.hg: HPV vaccine un ladkiyon ke liye hai jo sex karne wali hain, aur cervical cancer 'characterless' auraton ki bimari hai.

truth.en: HPV is a very common virus passed on through sexual contact, including within marriage. The vaccine is offered to every 14-year-old girl because it works best before any exposure. It prevents a cancer; it says nothing about a girl's character.
truth.hg: HPV ek bahut common virus hai jo sexual contact se failta hai, shaadi ke andar bhi. Vaccine har 14 saal ki ladki ko isliye di jaati hai kyunki yeh virus se kisi bhi exposure se pehle sabse achha kaam karti hai. Yeh ek cancer se bachati hai; ladki ke character ke baare mein kuch nahi kehti.

actions.en: If there is a 14-year-old girl in your family, ask at the nearest government health facility about the free single dose; a parent's consent is needed.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari family mein koi 14 saal ki ladki hai, toh nearest government health centre par free single dose ke baare mein poocho; iske liye parent ka consent zaroori hai.

actions.en: Talk about it like any other vaccine: it prevents a cancer and says nothing about anyone's character.
actions.hg: Iske baare mein waise hi baat karo jaise kisi aur vaccine ki karte ho: yeh cancer se bachati hai, kisi ke character ke baare mein kuch nahi kehti.

actions.en: If you are an older teen or young adult who missed it, ask a doctor whether catch-up vaccination makes sense for you.
actions.hg: Agar tum older teen ya young adult ho aur vaccine miss ho gayi, toh doctor se poocho ki catch-up vaccination tumhare liye theek rahegi ya nahi.

actions.en: Vaccinated or not, adult women should ask about cervical screening; the vaccine does not cover every cancer-causing type.
actions.hg: Vaccine lagi ho ya nahi, adult women cervical screening ke baare mein zaroor poochein; vaccine har cancer wale type se nahi bachati.

actions.en: Bleeding between periods or after sex needs a doctor at any age.
actions.hg: Periods ke beech mein ya sex ke baad bleeding ho, toh kisi bhi umar mein doctor ko dikhao.

title.en: India's myth census: what surveys show Indians still believe about wives, contraception, HIV and sons
title.hg: India ka myth census: wife, contraception, HIV aur bete ke baare mein Indians aaj bhi kya maante hain, surveys ke hisaab se

dek.en: Myths can be counted. The National Family Health Survey asked men and women what a husband may do to his wife, whose job contraception is and how HIV spreads. Here are the answers, question by question, and which beliefs are retreating.
dek.hg: Myths ko gina ja sakta hai. National Family Health Survey ne mardon aur auraton se poocha ki pati apni wife ke saath kya kar sakta hai, contraception kiski zimmedari hai aur HIV kaise phailta hai. Yeh rahe jawab, ek-ek sawaal ke saath, aur yeh bhi ki kaun se beliefs peeche hat rahe hain.

statLabel.en: of men say a husband is justified in beating his wife in at least one situation (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
statLabel.hg: mard kehte hain ki kam se kam ek situation mein pati ka wife ko maarna jaayaz hai (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of men say a husband is justified in beating his wife in at least one of seven situations; among women it is 45% (NFHS-5)
label.hg: mard kehte hain ki saat mein se kam se kam ek situation mein pati ka wife ko maarna jaayaz hai; auraton mein yeh 45% hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: of men say a husband has the right to use force if his wife refuses sex (NFHS-5)
label.hg: mard kehte hain ki wife sex se mana kare toh pati ko zabardasti karne ka haq hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: of men agree that contraception is women's business and a man should not have to worry about it (NFHS-5)
label.hg: mard maante hain ki contraception auraton ka kaam hai aur mard ko iski chinta nahi karni chahiye (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women did not know that HIV cannot spread by sharing food (NFHS-5)
label.hg: auraton ko nahi pata tha ki HIV saath khaana khaane se nahi phailta (NFHS-5)

actions.en: Put the survey's question to your own family or friends: is a husband ever justified in hitting his wife? Do not let a 'yes, if...' pass without a reply.
actions.hg: Survey wala sawaal apne ghar ya doston mein poochiye: kya pati ka wife par haath uthana kabhi jaayaz hai? Koi 'haan, agar...' kahe toh use bina jawab ke mat jaane dijiye.

actions.en: If you are a man, treat contraception as your job as well: buy the condoms, learn the methods, go to the clinic with your partner.
actions.hg: Agar aap mard hain, toh contraception ko apni bhi zimmedari maniye: condom khud khareediye, methods ke baare mein seekhiye, partner ke saath clinic jaiye.

actions.en: Learn how HIV does and does not spread. It does not travel through shared food or mosquito bites. For questions, call the NACO helpline 1097.
actions.hg: Seekhiye ki HIV kaise phailta hai aur kaise nahi. Yeh saath khaana khaane ya machhar ke kaatne se nahi phailta. Koi sawaal ho toh NACO helpline 1097 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If someone you know is being hit or forced at home, help her call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar aapke jaanne wali kisi aurat ko ghar mein maara ja raha hai ya us par zabardasti ho rahi hai, toh Women Helpline 181 par call karne mein uski madad kijiye; emergency mein 112.

actions.en: When a relative says a family needs 'at least one son', say out loud that it does not, especially in front of children.
actions.hg: Jab koi rishtedaar kahe ki parivaar mein 'kam se kam ek beta toh hona chahiye', toh saaf kahiye ki aisa zaroori nahi hai, khaaskar bachchon ke saamne.

title.en: 'It's our tradition': dowry, child marriage and khatna, three harms India defends as culture
title.hg: 'Yeh hamari parampara hai': dahej, child marriage aur khatna, teen nuksaan jinhe India culture keh kar bachata hai

dek.en: 'Hamare yahan aisa hi hota hai' is often where a family argument ends. Here is what the law and the evidence say about three practices that sentence protects, and how fast such 'traditions' have already changed.
dek.hg: 'Hamare yahan aisa hi hota hai' aksar woh jagah hai jahan family ki behas khatam ho jaati hai. Jin teen practices ko yeh line bachati hai, un par law aur evidence kya kehte hain, aur aisi 'paramparayein' kitni tezi se badal chuki hain, yahan padhiye.

statLabel.en: countries, at least, where UNFPA says female genital cutting is documented; India is among them
statLabel.hg: kam se kam itne countries mein UNFPA ke mutabik female genital cutting documented hai; India bhi inmein hai

label.en: dowry-death cases registered in India in 2024, about 16 a day
label.hg: dowry death ke cases 2024 mein India mein register hue, yaani roz kareeb 16

label.en: of women aged 20-24 were married before 18 in 2023-24, down from 47.4% in 2005-06
label.hg: 20-24 saal ki women ki shaadi 2023-24 mein 18 se pehle ho chuki thi; 2005-06 mein yeh 47.4% tha

label.en: of 385 Dawoodi Bohra women in a Sahiyo online survey said they were unlikely to continue khatna on their daughters
label.hg: Sahiyo ke online survey ki 385 Dawoodi Bohra women mein se itni ne kaha ki woh apni betiyon par khatna shayad hi continue karengi

actions.en: When someone says 'it's our tradition', ask the question it avoids: who does this protect, and who pays for it?
actions.hg: Jab koi kahe 'yeh hamari parampara hai', toh woh sawaal poochiye jisse yeh line bachti hai: isse kiski hifazat hoti hai, aur keemat kaun chukata hai?

actions.en: Refuse to give or take dowry, and say so before a match is fixed; under the 1961 Act both giving and taking are crimes.
actions.hg: Dahej na dijiye, na lijiye, aur yeh baat rishta pakka hone se pehle keh dijiye; 1961 ke Act mein dena aur lena dono crime hain.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 is being pushed into marriage, call the Child Helpline 1098 or the police on 112; the wedding can be stopped.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki par shaadi ka pressure hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 ya police ko 112 par call kijiye; shaadi roki ja sakti hai.

actions.en: Do not agree to khatna for a daughter or niece because 'everyone does it'; a child cannot consent and WHO says it has no health benefit.
actions.hg: Beti ya bhatiji ke khatna ke liye sirf isliye haan mat kahiye ki 'sab karte hain'; bachchi consent nahi de sakti aur WHO ke mutabik iska koi health benefit nahi hai.

actions.en: Facing dowry demands or threats at home? Call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Ghar mein dahej ki demand ya dhamki mil rahi hai? Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, emergency mein 112.

title.en: 'She's married, so she's safe from HIV': what testing the spouses and partners of people with HIV found in 2024-25
title.hg: 'Shaadi-shuda hai, toh HIV se safe hai': 2024-25 mein HIV wale logon ke spouses aur partners ke test mein kya nikla

dek.en: HIV is still talked about as a disease of sex workers, truck drivers and 'other people'. NACO's own testing data show it inside marriages and steady relationships, and show why a test taken together is the safest thing a couple can do.
dek.hg: HIV ko aaj bhi sex workers, truck drivers aur 'doosre logon' ki bimari maana jaata hai. NACO ka apna testing data dikhata hai ki yeh shaadiyon aur steady relationships ke andar bhi hai, aur yeh bhi ki saath mein karwaya gaya test kisi couple ke liye sabse safe kadam kyun hai.

statLabel.en: of spouses, partners and children tested through HIV index testing in 2024-25 were positive
statLabel.hg: 2024-25 mein HIV index testing ke zariye test hue spouses, partners aur bachchon mein se positive nikle

label.en: of the 6.6 lakh spouses, partners and children tested through index testing in 2024-25 were HIV-positive
label.hg: 2024-25 mein index testing ke zariye test hue 6.6 lakh spouses, partners aur bachchon mein se HIV-positive nikle

label.en: of people newly diagnosed with HIV in 2024-25 reported sex with a regular partner as the route
label.hg: 2024-25 mein HIV ke naye diagnose hue logon ne infection ka route regular partner ke saath sex bataya

label.en: women were on HIV treatment at government ART centres in March 2025
label.hg: women March 2025 mein government ART centres par HIV treatment le rahi thi

claim.en: HIV is a disease of sex workers, truck drivers and 'other' people. A married woman who is faithful to her husband has nothing to test for.
claim.hg: HIV sex workers, truck drivers aur 'doosre' logon ki bimari hai. Jo married woman apne husband ke prati faithful hai, use test ki koi zaroorat nahi.

truth.en: In 2024-25, 26.5% of people newly diagnosed with HIV reported sex with a regular partner as the route, and 4.1% of the spouses, partners and children tested through index testing were positive, about ten times the rate among all at-risk people tested. Marriage does not protect anyone. Knowing both partners' status does.
truth.hg: 2024-25 mein HIV ke naye diagnose hue logon mein se 26.5% ne route regular partner ke saath sex bataya, aur index testing mein test hue spouses, partners aur bachchon mein se 4.1% positive nikle, jo test hue sabhi at-risk logon ke rate ka kareeb das guna hai. Shaadi kisi ko protect nahi karti. Dono partners ka status pata hona protect karta hai.

actions.en: Get an HIV test together with your partner: before marriage, when planning a child, or now if neither of you has ever tested.
actions.hg: Apne partner ke saath milkar HIV test karwaiye: shaadi se pehle, bachcha plan karte waqt, ya abhi, agar aap dono ne kabhi test nahi karwaya.

actions.en: If you are pregnant, say yes to the HIV test offered at antenatal care, and ask your partner to test too.
actions.hg: Agar aap pregnant hain, toh antenatal care mein offer hone wale HIV test ke liye haan kahiye, aur partner se bhi test karwane ko kahiye.

actions.en: Treat a positive result as a medical fact, not a verdict on anyone's character: start treatment, and ask the counsellor to help with telling a partner.
actions.hg: Positive result ko medical fact maaniye, kisi ke character par faisla nahi: treatment shuru kijiye, aur partner ko batane mein counsellor ki madad lijiye.

actions.en: Call 1097, free and confidential, in 16 languages, to find the nearest testing or treatment centre.
actions.hg: Nearest testing ya treatment centre jaanne ke liye 1097 par call kijiye; yeh free aur confidential hai, aur 16 languages mein chalti hai.

actions.en: Never force a test or demand to know someone's HIV status; the 2017 HIV Act requires consent for testing and bars forced disclosure.
actions.hg: Kisi ka zabardasti test mat karwaiye aur uska HIV status jaanne ki zid mat kijiye; 2017 ka HIV Act testing ke liye consent zaroori karta hai aur forced disclosure ko rokta hai.

title.en: 'Shaadi ke baad sudhar jayega': the myth that a wife can cure a man's drinking, temper or sexuality
title.hg: 'Shaadi ke baad sudhar jayega': woh myth ki biwi mard ka peena, gussa ya sexuality theek kar sakti hai

dek.en: Many Indian families prescribe a wedding for sons who drink, rage or love men, as if a bride were a treatment. Survey data shows who pays for that prescription, and how early the bill arrives.
dek.hg: Jo beta peeta hai, gussa karta hai ya mardon se pyaar karta hai, uske liye bahut si Indian families shaadi prescribe kar deti hain, jaise dulhan koi ilaaj ho. Survey data dikhata hai ki is nuskhe ki keemat kaun chukata hai, aur bill kitni jaldi aata hai.

statLabel.en: of women whose husbands often get drunk reported spousal violence, against 23% of women whose husbands do not drink (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: un women ne spousal violence report ki jinke husband aksar nashe mein dhut hote hain; jinke husband nahi peete, unmein yeh 23% tha (NFHS-5)

label.en: of currently married women, married only once, first faced physical or sexual violence from their husband within two years of the wedding (NFHS-5)
label.hg: currently married women mein se, jinki ek hi baar shaadi hui, itni ne shaadi ke do saal ke andar pehli baar husband ki physical ya sexual violence jheli (NFHS-5)

label.en: of Indian men had an alcohol use disorder in the National Mental Health Survey 2015-16
label.hg: Indian men ko National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 mein alcohol use disorder tha

label.en: treatment gap for alcohol use disorders: most people who needed care were not getting it (NMHS 2015-16)
label.hg: alcohol use disorders ka treatment gap: jinhe care chahiye thi, unmein se zyada tar ko mil nahi rahi thi (NMHS 2015-16)

claim.en: Get him married. Responsibility and a wife's love will end the drinking, cool the temper or 'correct' his attraction to men.
claim.hg: Iski shaadi kar do. Zimmedari aur biwi ka pyaar uska peena chhudwa dega, gussa thanda kar dega, ya mardon ki taraf uska attraction 'theek' kar dega.

truth.en: A wedding treats nothing. Wives of men who often get drunk report far more violence, much spousal violence begins in the first years of marriage, and sexual orientation is not a disorder: a High Court has ordered attempts to 'cure' it prohibited.
truth.hg: Shaadi kisi cheez ka ilaaj nahi hai. Jin aurton ke husband aksar nashe mein dhut hote hain, woh kahin zyada violence report karti hain; spousal violence ka bada hissa shaadi ke shuruaati saalon mein hi shuru ho jaata hai; aur sexual orientation koi bimaari nahi hai: ek High Court ise 'cure' karne ki koshishon par rok ka order de chuki hai.

actions.en: Before saying yes, ask him directly and alone about drinking and anger, and ask people outside his family too.
actions.hg: Haan kehne se pehle usse seedhe aur akele mein peene aur gusse ke baare mein poochiye, aur uski family ke bahar ke logon se bhi.

actions.en: Treat 'he will stop after marriage' as a warning; ask what treatment he has already had.
