actions.hg: 'Shaadi ke baad chhod dega' ko warning samajhiye; poochiye ki ab tak usne kya treatment liya hai.

actions.en: Keep your own bank account, phone, documents and a way to earn after the wedding.
actions.hg: Shaadi ke baad bhi apna bank account, phone, documents aur kamaane ka zariya apne paas rakhiye.

actions.en: Parents: tell your daughter before the wedding that she can always come home, and mean it.
actions.hg: Parents: shaadi se pehle beti se kahiye ki woh kabhi bhi ghar wapas aa sakti hai, aur is baat par qaayam rahiye.

actions.en: For drinking or anger, see a doctor or call Tele-MANAS 14416; a woman facing violence can call 181 or 112.
actions.hg: Peene ya gusse ke liye doctor se miliye ya Tele-MANAS 14416 par call kijiye; violence jhel rahi aurat 181 ya 112 par call kar sakti hai.

title.en: Masturbation does not cause weakness, blindness or infertility: the myth India's schools leave to quacks
title.hg: Masturbation se kamzori, andhapan ya infertility nahi hoti: woh myth jise India ke schools quacks ke bharose chhod dete hain

dek.en: Medicine treats masturbation as common and harmless. India's national education policy does not even use the word 'sex', so teenagers learn about it from forwards, hostel seniors and 'sex power' ads that a 1954 law already bans.
dek.hg: Medicine masturbation ko common aur harmless maanti hai. India ki national education policy mein 'sex' shabd tak nahi hai, isliye teenagers iske baare mein forwards, hostel seniors aur un 'sex power' ads se seekhte hain jin par 1954 ka ek kanoon pehle se ban lagata hai.

label.en: times the words 'sex', 'sexuality' or 'puberty' appear in India's 66-page National Education Policy 2020
label.hg: baar 'sex', 'sexuality' ya 'puberty' shabd India ki 66-page National Education Policy 2020 mein aate hain

label.en: state-run sexuality-education programme UNESCO found working at scale in India: Jharkhand's Udaan
label.hg: state-run sexuality-education programme jo UNESCO ko India mein bade scale par chalta mila: Jharkhand ka Udaan

label.en: age of the law banning 'sex power' drug ads; in 2025 the Supreme Court said it was not implemented 'in its true letter and spirit'
label.hg: umar us kanoon ki jo 'sex power' dawaiyon ke ads par ban lagata hai; 2025 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki yeh 'in its true letter and spirit' laagu hi nahi hua

claim.en: Masturbation drains a young person's strength, ruins eyesight and memory, and causes infertility after marriage.
claim.hg: Masturbation se jawaan insaan ki taakat nichud jaati hai, aankhein aur yaaddaasht kharab hoti hain, aur shaadi ke baad infertility ho jaati hai.

truth.en: Masturbation is common and not physically harmful, in people of any gender. It does not cause weakness, blindness or infertility. It needs attention only if it causes injury or distress, or gets in the way of daily life.
truth.hg: Masturbation common hai aur body ko koi nuksaan nahi pahunchata, chahe gender koi bhi ho. Isse kamzori, andhapan ya infertility nahi hoti. Dhyaan dene ki zaroorat tabhi hai jab isse chot lage, distress ho, ya roz ki zindagi mein rukaawat aaye.

actions.en: If you masturbate, you are not damaging your body. If you don't, that is normal too.
actions.hg: Agar tum masturbate karte ho, toh apni body ko nuksaan nahi pahuncha rahe. Agar nahi karte, toh woh bhi normal hai.

actions.en: Ignore any ad, clinic or video that promises to restore 'lost strength' or 'sex power'. Advertising such drugs is a crime under a 1954 law.
actions.hg: Jo bhi ad, clinic ya video 'khoyi hui taakat' ya 'sex power' lautane ka vaada kare, use ignore karo. Aisi dawaiyon ka ad dena 1954 ke kanoon ke tahat crime hai.

actions.en: If guilt, worry or a habit you cannot control is hurting your sleep, studies or relationships, call Tele-MANAS on 14416. It is free and open round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar guilt, chinta ya koi aisi aadat jo control mein nahi aa rahi tumhari neend, padhai ya rishton ko nuksaan pahuncha rahi hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call karo. Yeh free hai aur chaubees ghante khula hai.

actions.en: For pain, a lump, blood in semen or burning while passing urine, see a qualified doctor at a government hospital or an Adolescent Friendly Health Centre.
actions.hg: Dard, gaanth, semen mein khoon ya peshaab karte waqt jalan ho, toh government hospital ya Adolescent Friendly Health Centre mein kisi qualified doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: Parents and teachers: answer the question when it comes. Silence hands the topic to quacks.
actions.hg: Parents aur teachers: jab sawaal aaye, toh jawaab do. Chuppi is topic ko quacks ke haath mein de deti hai.

title.en: 'Men can't be raped': how India's 'gender-neutral' new penal code ended up agreeing with the myth
title.hg: 'Men can't be raped': India ka 'gender-neutral' naya penal code aakhir isi myth ke saath kaise khada ho gaya

dek.en: In July 2024 the Home Ministry said offences in the new penal code had been made gender-neutral. Its rape section still names only a man as offender and a woman as victim, and the old offence that covered forced sex against men was dropped with nothing in its place.
dek.hg: July 2024 mein Home Ministry ne kaha ki naye penal code ke kai offences gender-neutral bana diye gaye hain. Lekin uska rape section aaj bhi sirf ek man ko offender aur ek woman ko victim maanta hai, aur men ke against forced sex ko cover karne wala purana offence hata diya gaya, uski jagah kuch nahi aaya.

label.en: cases of 'unnatural offences' under IPC Section 377 registered in 2023, the last full year before the BNS deleted the offence
label.hg: IPC Section 377 ke tahat 'unnatural offences' ke cases jo 2023 mein darj hue, BNS ke is offence ko hataane se pehle ka aakhri poora saal

label.en: maximum prison term for voluntarily causing hurt, one of the general offences left when an adult man is assaulted
label.hg: voluntarily causing hurt ki maximum jail; adult man par assault hone par bache general offences mein se ek

label.en: the time the Delhi High Court gave the Centre in August 2024 to decide on restoring the offence
label.hg: August 2024 mein Delhi High Court ne Centre ko yeh offence wapas laane par decide karne ke liye itna time diya

label.en: boys among child victims of penetrative sexual assault recorded under POCSO in 2024
label.hg: ladke, 2024 mein POCSO ke tahat darj penetrative sexual assault ke child victims mein

claim.en: A real man can't be raped. If it happened, he must have wanted it or failed to fight back.
claim.hg: Asli mard ka rape nahi ho sakta. Agar hua, toh ya toh usne khud chaha ya woh lad nahi paaya.

truth.en: Men and boys are sexually assaulted, and strength does not prevent it. But since 1 July 2024 Indian law has no rape offence for an adult male victim: Section 63 of the BNS covers only women, and the old Section 377 was dropped without a replacement.
truth.hg: Men aur boys par bhi sexual assault hota hai, aur taakat ise nahi rokti. Lekin 1 July 2024 se Indian law mein adult male victim ke liye koi rape offence nahi hai: BNS ka Section 63 sirf women ko cover karta hai, aur purana Section 377 bina replacement ke hata diya gaya.

actions.en: If it happened to you, it was not your fault, and it counts, whatever the law calls it.
actions.hg: Agar yeh aapke saath hua, toh isme aapki koi galti nahi, aur yeh count karta hai, law ise chahe jo naam de.

actions.en: Get medical care fast: HIV PEP must start as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after exposure.
actions.hg: Jaldi medical care lijiye: HIV PEP jitni jaldi ho sake shuru honi chahiye, exposure ke 72 hours ke andar.

actions.en: You can still report to the police; for free legal aid, call the NALSA helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Aap phir bhi police ko report kar sakte hain; free legal aid ke liye NALSA helpline 15100 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If the survivor is a boy under 18, POCSO applies in full: call the Child Helpline 1098 or the police.
actions.hg: Agar survivor 18 se chhota ladka hai, toh POCSO poori tarah lagu hota hai: Child Helpline 1098 ya police ko call kijiye.

actions.en: For emotional support, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Emotional support ke liye Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye, free aur 24x7.

title.en: 'India now has more women than men': the 2021 headline that hid 929 girls born per 1,000 boys
title.hg: 'India mein ab mardon se zyada aurtein hain': 2021 ki woh headline jisne har 1,000 ladkon par paida hui 929 ladkiyon ko chhupa diya

dek.en: NFHS-5's estimate of 1,020 females per 1,000 males was shared as proof that India's 'missing women' problem was over. It measured something else. Here is the number that does measure sex selection, and how to read the next viral statistic.
dek.hg: NFHS-5 ke har 1,000 mardon par 1,020 aurton wale estimate ko is baat ka saboot bana kar share kiya gaya ki India ki 'missing women' wali problem khatam ho gayi. Woh number kuch aur naap raha tha. Yeh raha woh number jo sach mein sex selection naapta hai, aur agla viral statistic padhne ka tareeka.

statLabel.en: females per 1,000 males in NFHS-5's population estimate, against 929 girls per 1,000 boys at birth
statLabel.hg: aurtein har 1,000 mardon par, NFHS-5 ke population estimate mein; jabki janam ke waqt har 1,000 ladkon par sirf 929 ladkiyan

label.en: girls born per 1,000 boys in the five years before NFHS-5 (2019-21), the same survey that gave the 1,020
label.hg: ladkiyan har 1,000 ladkon par paida hui NFHS-5 (2019-21) se pehle ke paanch saalon mein; yeh usi survey ka number hai jisne 1,020 diya

label.en: girls born per 1,000 boys in 2021-23, India's official Sample Registration System estimate
label.hg: ladkiyan har 1,000 ladkon par paida hui 2021-23 mein, India ke official Sample Registration System ke estimate ke mutabik

label.en: 'missing' females in India in 2020, out of 142.6 million worldwide (UNFPA)
label.hg: 'missing' females India mein 2020 mein, duniya ke 142.6 million mein se (UNFPA)

label.en: girls went 'missing' at birth in India every year between 2013 and 2017 (UNFPA)
label.hg: ladkiyan India mein 2013 se 2017 ke beech har saal janam ke waqt 'missing' hui (UNFPA)

claim.en: India now has more women than men, so the problem of 'missing' girls is over.
claim.hg: India mein ab mardon se zyada aurtein hain, toh 'missing' ladkiyon wali problem khatam ho gayi.

truth.en: NFHS-5's 1,020 is a household-survey estimate of people of all ages. The same survey found 929 girls born for every 1,000 boys, the official SRS put it at 917 for 2021-23, and UNFPA counted 45.8 million 'missing' females in India in 2020.
truth.hg: NFHS-5 ka 1,020 har umar ke logon ka household-survey estimate hai. Usi survey mein har 1,000 ladkon par 929 ladkiyan paida hui thi, official SRS ne 2021-23 ke liye yeh figure 917 bataya, aur UNFPA ne 2020 mein India mein 45.8 million 'missing' females gine.

actions.en: Before you share a sex-ratio number, ask which ratio it is. Only the ratio at birth, or among young children, can show whether girls are being stopped from being born.
actions.hg: Sex ratio ka koi number share karne se pehle poochiye ki yeh kaun sa ratio hai. Sirf janam ke waqt ka ratio, ya chhote bachchon ka ratio, dikha sakta hai ki ladkiyon ko paida hone se roka ja raha hai ya nahi.

actions.en: Check the source and the years. SRS gives the official three-year birth ratio; one state's survey figure can swing widely between rounds.
actions.hg: Source aur saal check kijiye. SRS teen saal ka official birth ratio deta hai; kisi ek state ka survey figure ek round se doosre round tak bahut upar-neeche ho sakta hai.

actions.en: Telling anyone the sex of a foetus, 'by words, signs or in any other manner', is a crime. If a clinic offers it, report it to your district health officials, who act as the Appropriate Authority under the PC-PNDT Act.
actions.hg: Kisi ko bhi foetus ka sex batana, 'words, signs ya kisi bhi aur tareeke se', crime hai. Agar koi clinic yeh offer kare, toh apne district health officials ko report kijiye, jo PC-PNDT Act ke under Appropriate Authority hote hain.

actions.en: If you are being pushed to find out a baby's sex, or to end a pregnancy because it is a girl, call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 in danger. The law does not punish a woman who was forced.
actions.hg: Agar aap par baby ka sex pata karne ka, ya ladki hone ki wajah se pregnancy khatam karne ka pressure hai, toh Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye, ya khatre mein 112 par. Jis aurat ko majboor kiya gaya, law use saza nahi deta.

title.en: There is no such thing as a 'child prostitute': why a trafficked child can never consent, in law or in language
title.hg: 'Child prostitute' jaisa kuch nahi hota: trafficked bachcha kabhi consent nahi de sakta, na law mein, na zubaan mein

dek.en: The phrase has long turned up in court records, news reports and everyday talk. It hints that a child chose to sell sex, and it hands the shame to the child. Indian law says her 'consent' counts for nothing. Here is why the words matter, and which ones to use.
dek.hg: Lambe samay se yeh shabd court records, news reports aur roz ki baaton mein chalta aaya hai. Yeh ishaara karta hai ki bachche ne khud sex bechna chuna, aur saari sharm bachche par daal deta hai. Indian law kehta hai ki uski 'consent' ka koi matlab nahi. Jaaniye shabd kyun maayne rakhte hain, aur kaun se shabd use karne chahiye.

statLabel.en: conviction rate in human trafficking trials completed in 2024
statLabel.hg: conviction rate 2024 mein poore hue human trafficking trials mein

label.en: children recorded as trafficked in India in 2024, 1,384 of them boys
label.hg: bachche 2024 mein India mein trafficked darj hue, jinmein 1,384 ladke the

label.en: rescued trafficking victims in 2024 who had been trafficked for sexual exploitation (all ages)
label.hg: 2024 mein rescue hue trafficking victims jinhe sexual exploitation ke liye traffic kiya gaya tha (har umar ke)

label.en: minimum prison term under Section 143 of the BNS for trafficking a child
label.hg: BNS ki Section 143 ke tahat kisi bachche ki trafficking par kam se kam itni jail

label.en: trafficking cases that ended in conviction in 2024, out of 586 trials completed
label.hg: trafficking cases 2024 mein conviction par khatam hue, 586 poore hue trials mein se

claim.en: Some children choose to sell sex. They are 'child prostitutes'.
claim.hg: Kuch bachche khud sex bechna chunte hain. Woh 'child prostitutes' hain.

truth.en: A child cannot consent to sex, to being trafficked or to being sold. Indian law makes a trafficked person's consent immaterial, treats sex with anyone under 18 as a crime whatever the child says, and punishes the adults who traffic and pay. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook replaces 'child prostitute' with 'child who has been trafficked'.
truth.hg: Bachcha sex, trafficking ya bikne ke liye consent nahi de sakta. Indian law mein trafficked insaan ki consent ka koi matlab nahi, 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath sex crime hai chahe bachcha kuch bhi kahe, aur traffic karne wale aur paise dene wale, dono adults ko saza milti hai. Supreme Court ki 2023 handbook 'child prostitute' ki jagah 'child who has been trafficked' kehti hai.

actions.en: Say 'child who has been trafficked' or 'sexually exploited child'. Never say 'child prostitute' or 'child sex worker'.
actions.hg: 'Child who has been trafficked' ya 'sexually exploited bachcha' kahiye. 'Child prostitute' ya 'child sex worker' kabhi mat kahiye.

actions.en: Call the men who pay what the law calls them: offenders. A man who pays for sex with a child is not a 'customer'.
actions.hg: Paise dene wale aadmiyon ko wahi kahiye jo law kehta hai: offenders. Bachche ke saath sex ke liye paise dene wala 'customer' nahi hai.

actions.en: If you suspect a child is being trafficked or sold for sex, call the Child Helpline 1098 or 112. You do not need proof to report.
actions.hg: Agar shak ho ki kisi bachche ko traffic kiya ja raha hai ya sex ke liye becha ja raha hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call kariye. Report karne ke liye saboot ki zaroorat nahi.

actions.en: Report online posts, chats or videos that sexually exploit children at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930.
actions.hg: Bachchon ka sexual exploitation karne wale online posts, chats ya videos cybercrime.gov.in par ya 1930 par report kariye.

actions.en: If police refuse to register a trafficking complaint, tell them that refusing is itself a crime under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police trafficking ki complaint darj karne se mana kare, toh unhe bataiye ki yeh mana karna khud BNS ki Section 199 ke tahat crime hai.

title.en: Period blood is not 'dirty blood': the impurity myth behind religious restrictions on 77% of India's adolescent girls
title.hg: Period ka blood 'ganda khoon' nahi hai: impurity ka woh myth jiski wajah se India ki 77% adolescent girls par religious restrictions lagte hain

dek.en: Girls are told their period is the body throwing out bad blood. It is the lining of the womb, and the blood in it is no dirtier than any other. The myth lasts because most girls hear the rules before anyone explains the biology.
dek.hg: Ladkiyon ko bataya jaata hai ki period mein body ganda khoon bahar phenkti hai. Asal mein yeh uterus ki andar wali layer hai, aur iska blood kisi bhi doosre blood se zyada ganda nahi hota. Myth isliye tika hai kyunki zyada tar ladkiyon tak biology se pehle rules pahunch jaate hain.

statLabel.en: of adolescent girls were kept from religious activities during their periods (BMJ Open meta-analysis, 2016)
statLabel.hg: adolescent girls ko periods mein religious activities se roka jaata tha (BMJ Open meta-analysis, 2016)

label.en: of adolescent girls in India were kept from religious activities, such as visiting places of worship or praying, during their periods (2016 meta-analysis)
label.hg: India ki adolescent girls ko periods mein religious activities se roka jaata tha, jaise worship ki jagah jaana ya pray karna (2016 meta-analysis)

label.en: of adolescent girls had been told about menstruation before their first period (2016 meta-analysis)
label.hg: adolescent girls ko pehla period aane se pehle menstruation ke baare mein bataya gaya tha (2016 meta-analysis)

label.en: of adolescent girls missed school during their periods (2016 meta-analysis)
label.hg: adolescent girls periods ke dinon mein school miss karti thi (2016 meta-analysis)

claim.en: Period blood is dirty, impure blood that the body throws out every month, so a menstruating girl pollutes food, kitchens and places of worship.
claim.hg: Period ka blood ganda, impure khoon hai jise body har mahine bahar phenkti hai, isliye periods mein ladki khaane, kitchen aur pooja ki jagah ko ashuddh kar deti hai.

truth.en: A period is the lining of the womb leaving the body as blood and tissue. The blood is no dirtier than any other blood. It is not poison or waste, and it cannot spoil food or make a person or a place impure.
truth.hg: Period mein uterus ki andar wali layer blood aur tissue ban kar body se nikalti hai. Yeh blood kisi bhi doosre blood se zyada ganda nahi hota. Yeh na zeher hai, na gandagi, aur isse na khana kharab hota hai, na koi insaan ya jagah impure hoti hai.

actions.en: Stop saying 'ganda khoon' at home. Say what it is: the lining of the womb, shed because there is no pregnancy.
actions.hg: Ghar mein 'ganda khoon' kehna band karo. Jo hai woh bolo: uterus ki andar wali layer, jo pregnancy na hone par nikal jaati hai.

actions.en: Tell a girl what a period is before her first one arrives, and tell her brothers the same thing.
actions.hg: Ladki ko pehla period aane se pehle hi batao ki period kya hota hai, aur yahi baat uske bhaiyon ko bhi batao.

actions.en: Swap the rule for a question: instead of 'don't touch that', ask whether she needs rest, a pad or something for the pain.
actions.hg: Rule ki jagah sawaal poochho: 'ise mat chhuo' ke bajaye poochho ki use aaram, pad ya dard ke liye kuch chahiye kya.

actions.en: Do not treat heavy bleeding as 'cleansing'. Soaking a pad every one to two hours, or bleeding for more than 7 days, needs a doctor.
actions.hg: Heavy bleeding ko 'safai' mat samjho. Har ek-do ghante mein pad poora bheeg jaaye, ya bleeding 7 din se zyada chale, toh doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: If her school has no working girls' toilet, water or pads, raise it with the principal: the Supreme Court ordered these for all schools in January 2026.
actions.hg: Agar uske school mein ladkiyon ka chalu toilet, paani ya pads nahi hain, toh principal se baat karo: Supreme Court ne January 2026 mein sabhi schools ke liye inka order diya hai.

title.en: The pill and the Copper-T don't make you infertile: the fear that leaves India relying on sterilisation
title.hg: Pill aur Copper-T se infertility nahi hoti: woh darr jiski wajah se India sterilisation par tika hai

dek.en: Many women are warned that the pill or an IUD will 'dry up the womb'. Neither causes infertility. Yet in NFHS-5, 37.9% of married women relied on sterilisation, 5.1% on the pill and 2.1% on an IUD.
dek.hg: Kai aurton ko warning di jaati hai ki pill ya IUD 'bachchedani sukha dega'. Inmein se koi bhi infertility nahi karta. Phir bhi NFHS-5 mein 37.9% shaadishuda aurtein sterilisation par tiki thi, 5.1% pill par aur 2.1% IUD par.

statLabel.en: of married women relied on female sterilisation in NFHS-5, against 5.1% on the pill
statLabel.hg: shaadishuda aurtein NFHS-5 mein female sterilisation par tiki thi, jabki pill par sirf 5.1%

label.en: of currently married women relied on female sterilisation (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: currently married aurtein female sterilisation par tiki thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: used an IUD such as the Copper-T, and 5.1% the pill
label.hg: ne Copper-T jaisa IUD use kiya, aur 5.1% ne pill

label.en: relied on male sterilisation
label.hg: male sterilisation (nasbandi) par tiki thi

label.en: of married women aged 15-19 had an unmet need for family planning, nearly double the national 9.4%
label.hg: 15-19 saal ki shaadishuda aurton ki family planning ki unmet need thi, national 9.4% se lagbhag double

claim.en: The pill and the Copper-T dry up the womb. Use them for long and you will never have a baby.
claim.hg: Pill aur Copper-T bachchedani sukha dete hain. Zyada din use kiya toh kabhi baby nahi hoga.

truth.en: Reversible contraceptives do not cause infertility. Fertility returns soon after the pill is stopped or an IUD is removed; after the injection it can take a few months longer. Untreated infections, not contraceptives, are a real threat to fertility.
truth.hg: Reversible contraceptives se infertility nahi hoti. Pill band karne ya IUD nikalwane ke thode hi time baad fertility laut aati hai; injection ke baad isme kuch mahine zyada lag sakte hain. Fertility ke liye asli khatra contraceptives nahi, bina ilaaj ke infections hain.

actions.en: Before starting any method, ask a doctor or trained health worker how it works, which side effects are common and how to stop it.
actions.hg: Koi bhi method shuru karne se pehle doctor ya trained health worker se poochiye ki woh kaise kaam karta hai, kaun se side effects common hain aur use band kaise karte hain.

actions.en: Treat a side effect as a reason to switch methods, not to stop protection altogether.
actions.hg: Side effect ko method badalne ki wajah samjhiye, protection poori tarah chhod dene ki nahi.

actions.en: Remember that a pill can be stopped and an IUD removed whenever you choose; fertility comes back without any 'cleansing' break.
actions.hg: Yaad rakhiye ki pill jab chahein band kar sakti hain aur IUD jab chahein nikalwa sakti hain; fertility bina kisi 'safai' wale break ke laut aati hai.

actions.en: Use condoms too whenever there is a risk of infection: untreated STIs, not contraceptives, can damage fertility.
actions.hg: Jab bhi infection ka risk ho, condom bhi use kijiye: fertility ko nuksaan bina ilaaj ke STIs se hota hai, contraceptives se nahi.

actions.en: If a year of trying brings no pregnancy, see a doctor as a couple, because infertility affects men too.
actions.hg: Agar ek saal koshish ke baad bhi pregnancy na ho, toh couple ki tarah saath mein doctor se miliye, kyunki infertility mardon ko bhi hoti hai.

title.en: 'Talk about sex and they'll do it'? Silence hands young Indians to porn, which teaches the opposite of consent
title.hg: 'Sex ki baat karoge toh kar baithenge'? Chuppi young Indians ko porn ke hawale kar deti hai, aur porn consent ka ulta sikhata hai

dek.en: Homes and classrooms stay quiet about sex for fear of 'giving children ideas'. The UN's evidence-based guidance says talking does not make teenagers have sex. Silence only leaves the teaching to porn, which edits out everything the law means by consent.
dek.hg: Ghar aur classroom sex par isliye chup rehte hain ki bachchon ko 'ideas' na mil jaayein. UN ki evidence-based guidance kehti hai ki baat karne se teenagers sex nahi karne lagte. Chuppi bas itna karti hai ki sikhane ka kaam porn ko mil jaata hai, aur porn woh sab kaat deta hai jise law consent kehta hai.

label.en: of Indian men aged 15-49 said a husband has the right to use force if his wife refuses sex (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: Indian men (15-49 saal) ne kaha ki biwi sex se mana kare toh pati ko zabardasti karne ka haq hai (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of young women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom, against 87.3% of young men (NFHS-5)
label.hg: young women (15-24 saal) ko pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai, jabki young men mein 87.3% ko (NFHS-5)

label.en: randomised controlled trials, with 22 systematic reviews, in the 2016 review behind the UN guidance that says sexuality education does not increase sexual activity
label.hg: randomised controlled trials, saath mein 22 systematic reviews, 2016 ke us review mein jis par UN ki woh guidance tiki hai jo kehti hai ki sexuality education se sexual activity nahi badhti

claim.en: If you talk to teenagers about sex, they will go and do it.
claim.hg: Teenagers se sex ki baat karoge toh woh jaakar kar baithenge.

truth.en: The UN's evidence-based guidance says sexuality education does not increase sexual activity. Silence does not stop curiosity; it leaves the teaching to porn.
truth.hg: UN ki evidence-based guidance kehti hai ki sexuality education se sexual activity nahi badhti. Chuppi curiosity ko nahi rokti; woh sikhane ka kaam porn ko de deti hai.

actions.en: Assume a teenager with a phone has already seen porn; open with a question, not an accusation.
actions.hg: Maan kar chaliye ki phone wala teenager porn dekh chuka hai; ilzaam se nahi, sawaal se shuru kijiye.

actions.en: Say plainly that porn is scripted acting that leaves out asking, protection, real bodies and everything that happens around sex.
actions.hg: Saaf boliye ki porn scripted acting hai, jismein poochna, protection, asli bodies aur sex ke aas-paas ki har cheez gayab hoti hai.

actions.en: Teach what consent means in law: a clear, voluntary yes to that specific act. Silence or not resisting is not consent.
actions.hg: Sikhaiye ki law mein consent ka matlab kya hai: us specific act ke liye saaf, apni marzi ki haan. Chuppi ya resist na karna consent nahi hai.

actions.en: Never store or forward sexual images of anyone under 18, and never share anyone's private image without consent; report such content at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930.
actions.hg: 18 se kam ke kisi bhi insaan ki sexual images kabhi store ya forward mat kijiye, aur kisi ki private image bina consent share mat kijiye; aisa content cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report kijiye.

actions.en: If viewing feels out of control, talk to a counsellor or call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Agar dekhna control se bahar lage, toh counsellor se baat kijiye ya Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye.

title.en: 'It's only rape if he forced her': fewer than half of 131 countries define rape by consent. India's law does, with one large exception
title.hg: 'Rape tabhi hai jab usne zabardasti ki': 131 mein se aadhe se kam desh rape ko consent se define karte hain. India ka law karta hai, ek bade exception ke saath

dek.en: In 2024 only 63 of 131 countries had rape laws built on the absence of consent instead of proof of force. India's penal code has been on the consent side since 2013, on paper. Here is what that means, where the law still stops, and why the force myth survives in homes, police stations and courtrooms.
dek.hg: 2024 mein 131 mein se sirf 63 deshon ke rape laws consent ki kami par bane the, force ke saboot par nahi. India ka penal code 2013 se, kam se kam kaagaz par, consent wali side par hai. Yahan samjhiye ki iska matlab kya hai, law ab bhi kahan ruk jaata hai, aur force wala myth gharon, police stations aur courtrooms mein kyun zinda hai.

statLabel.en: countries had rape laws based on lack of consent in 2024 (UN SDG Report)
statLabel.hg: deshon ke rape laws 2024 mein consent ki kami par based the (UN SDG Report)

label.en: countries had rape laws based on lack of consent in 2024
label.hg: deshon ke rape laws 2024 mein consent ki kami par based the

label.en: of 131 countries have consent-based rape laws that explicitly criminalise marital rape (SDG Report 2026)
label.hg: 131 deshon mein se itnon ke paas consent-based rape law hai jo marital rape ko bhi saaf-saaf crime maanta hai (SDG Report 2026)

label.en: of married or partnered women in 78 countries said they could refuse sex (2025)
label.hg: 78 deshon ki married ya partnered women ne kaha ki woh sex se mana kar sakti hain (2025)

label.en: of Indian men aged 15-49 said a husband may use force if his wife refuses sex (NFHS-5)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ke Indian men ne kaha ki patni sex se mana kare toh pati force use kar sakta hai (NFHS-5)

claim.en: It is only rape if he used force and she fought back.
claim.hg: Rape tabhi hota hai jab aadmi ne force use ki ho aur aurat ne ladkar virodh kiya ho.

truth.en: Indian law asks whether she agreed, not how hard she fought. Since 2013 consent has meant an 'unequivocal voluntary agreement', and a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting. The law still exempts husbands of adult wives.
truth.hg: Indian law yeh poochhta hai ki usne haan kaha ya nahi, yeh nahi ki woh kitna ladi. 2013 se consent ka matlab hai 'unequivocal voluntary agreement', aur jo aurat physically resist nahi karti, use sirf isi wajah se consenting nahi maana ja sakta. Phir bhi law adult patniyon ke patiyon ko chhoot deta hai.

actions.en: Stop asking survivors whether they screamed, fought or have injuries. The legal question is whether they agreed.
actions.hg: Survivors se yeh poochhna band kijiye ki woh chillayi kyun nahi, ladi kyun nahi, ya chot kahan hai. Legal sawaal yeh hai ki unhone haan kaha tha ya nahi.

actions.en: Treat silence, freezing or giving in after pressure as a no, and stop.
actions.hg: Chuppi, freeze ho jaana ya pressure ke baad haar maan lena, in sabko 'na' samajhiye aur ruk jaiye.

actions.en: Remember the age line: with anyone under 18, sexual activity is an offence whatever they said.
actions.hg: Age ki line yaad rakhiye: 18 se kam umr ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath sexual activity offence hai, chahe unhone kuch bhi kaha ho.

actions.en: If you were assaulted and did not resist, you can still report it. Call 112 in an emergency or the Women Helpline on 181.
actions.hg: Agar aapke saath assault hua aur aapne resist nahi kiya, tab bhi aap report kar sakte hain. Emergency mein 112 ya Women Helpline 181 par call karein.

title.en: Blaming mobiles and 'Western culture': India was counting rape in 1971, decades before the smartphone
title.hg: Mobile aur 'Western culture' ko blame karna: India 1971 mein bhi rape gin raha tha, smartphone se dashkon pehle

dek.en: After every outrage the same suspects are named: phones, jeans, films, 'modern' girls. India's own crime records, court files and surveys show sexual violence long before the smartphone, mostly by men who already had access and power.
dek.hg: Har outrage ke baad wahi naam liye jaate hain: phone, jeans, filmein, 'modern' ladkiyan. India ke apne crime records, court files aur surveys dikhate hain ki sexual violence smartphone se bahut pehle se hai, aur zyada tar un mardon ne kiya jinke paas pehle se access aur power tha.

statLabel.en: rape cases recorded in 1971, the first year NCRB counted them
statLabel.hg: rape cases 1971 mein darj hue, jis saal NCRB ne pehli baar rape gina

label.en: rape cases recorded in India in 1971, the first year NCRB counted rape
label.hg: rape cases 1971 mein India mein darj hue, jis saal NCRB ne pehli baar rape ki ginti shuru ki

label.en: of rape cases recorded in 2012 had an offender known to the victim
label.hg: 2012 mein darj rape cases mein offender victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: of 12,447 children surveyed in 13 states in 2007 reported at least one form of sexual abuse
label.hg: 2007 mein 13 states mein survey kiye gaye 12,447 bachchon mein se itne bachchon ne kam se kam ek tarah ka sexual abuse bataya

label.en: girls and women alive today worldwide were raped or sexually assaulted before 18, UNICEF estimates
label.hg: duniya bhar mein aaj zinda ladkiyon aur aurton mein se itni ka 18 se pehle rape ya sexual assault hua, UNICEF ka anumaan

claim.en: Rape is a modern problem that came with mobile phones, the internet, Western clothes and films.
claim.hg: Rape ek modern problem hai jo mobile phone, internet, Western kapdon aur filmon ke saath aayi.

truth.en: India's records show rape decades before smartphones, and police data show the accused is almost always someone the victim knows. Phones have given abusers new tools, but the abuse is old. What has changed is how much of it gets reported and recorded.
truth.hg: India ke records smartphone se dashkon pehle rape dikhate hain, aur police data dikhata hai ki accused lagbhag hamesha victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala hota hai. Phone ne abusers ko naye tools diye hain, lekin abuse purana hai. Badla yeh hai ki ab usmein se kitna report aur record hota hai.

actions.en: When someone blames phones or clothes for a rape, ask who the accused was and how he had access to the victim.
actions.hg: Jab koi rape ke liye phone ya kapdon ko blame kare, toh poochhiye ki accused kaun tha aur victim tak uski pahunch kaise thi.

actions.en: Tell children that the people most likely to abuse them are people they already know, and that they can tell you anything, even about family.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko bataiye ki unka abuse karne ki sabse zyada sambhavna un logon se hai jinhe woh pehle se jaante hain, aur ki woh aapko kuch bhi bata sakte hain, family ke baare mein bhi.

actions.en: Back consent and body-safety education in schools. 'Our culture' is not a reason to keep children uninformed.
actions.hg: Schools mein consent aur body-safety education ka saath dijiye. 'Hamari culture' bachchon ko anjaan rakhne ki wajah nahi hai.

actions.en: If someone tells you about abuse from years ago, believe them. As the Supreme Court's handbook says, a delay in telling is not a sign of a lie.
actions.hg: Agar koi aapko saalon purane abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uska yakeen kariye. Supreme Court ki handbook ke mutabik, der se batana jhooth ki nishaani nahi hai.

actions.en: Use the phone as a safety tool: save 112, 1098 and 181, and report online abuse at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930.
actions.hg: Phone ko safety tool ki tarah use kariye: 112, 1098 aur 181 save kariye, aur online abuse cybercrime.gov.in par ya 1930 par report kariye.

title.en: Rape is about power, not desire: what India's own penal code and courts say about who gets targeted
title.hg: Rape power ka maamla hai, desire ka nahi: India ka apna penal code aur courts batate hain ki target kaun banta hai

dek.en: The 'uncontrollable lust' story blames attraction. India's penal code points somewhere else: to police stations, hospitals, homes and riots, wherever one person holds power over another.
dek.hg: 'Uncontrollable lust' wali kahani attraction ko blame karti hai. India ka penal code kahin aur ishaara karta hai: police stations, hospitals, ghar aur dange, yaani har woh jagah jahan ek insaan ke haath mein doosre par power ho.

label.en: aggravated forms of rape in Section 64 of the BNS, including rape by police, public servants, jail and hospital staff, relatives, guardians and teachers
label.hg: BNS ki Section 64 mein rape ke aggravated forms, jinmein police, public servants, jail aur hospital staff, rishtedaar, guardians aur teachers ka kiya rape shaamil hai

label.en: rape cases registered in 2024 under the clause for rape by police personnel
label.hg: 2024 mein police personnel ke kiye rape wale clause ke under register hue cases

label.en: of 29,536 rape cases in 2024 were recorded under the clause for raping a disabled woman
label.hg: 2024 ke 29,536 rape cases mein se sirf itne disabled aurat ke rape wale aggravated clause mein record hue

label.en: men jailed for life in the 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape case, released by Gujarat in 2022, ordered back by the Supreme Court in 2024
label.hg: 2002 Gujarat riots gang rape case mein umrqaid paane wale aadmi, jinhe Gujarat ne 2022 mein chhoda aur Supreme Court ne 2024 mein wapas jail bheja

claim.en: Rape happens because men cannot control their desire for attractive women.
claim.hg: Rape isliye hota hai kyunki mard attractive aurat ko dekhkar apni desire control nahi kar paate.

truth.en: Indian law punishes rape more harshly where the offender holds power over the victim: police, jail and hospital staff, relatives, guardians, teachers, and attackers in communal violence. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook says rape and sexual violence have long been used as 'a tool of social control'.
truth.hg: Indian law un cases mein rape ki saza aur sakht karta hai jahan accused ke haath mein aurat par power ho: police, jail aur hospital staff, rishtedaar, guardians, teachers, aur communal violence mein hamla karne wale. Supreme Court ki 2023 handbook kehti hai ki rape aur sexual violence lambe samay se 'a tool of social control' ki tarah use hote aaye hain.

actions.en: Look for risk where one person holds power over another: lock-ups, hostels, hospital wards, classrooms, workplaces and homes, not only dark roads.
actions.hg: Risk wahan dhoondhiye jahan ek insaan ke haath mein doosre par power hai: lock-ups, hostels, hospital wards, classrooms, offices aur ghar. Sirf andheri sadakein nahi.

actions.en: Drop 'what was she wearing' from the conversation. Ask who had power over whom, and who could have stopped it.
actions.hg: 'Usne kya pehna tha' wala sawaal conversation se hata dijiye. Poochhiye ki kiske haath mein kis par power thi, aur kaun ise rok sakta tha.

actions.en: If a disabled person reports abuse, insist that police record the complaint at her home or a place she chooses, with an interpreter or special educator, as the law requires.
actions.hg: Agar koi disabled insaan abuse report kare, toh zor dijiye ki police law ke hisaab se uske ghar ya uski chuni jagah par, interpreter ya special educator ke saath complaint record kare.

actions.en: If police refuse to register an FIR for rape, know that the refusal is itself a crime under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police rape ki FIR register karne se mana kare, toh yaad rakhiye ki yeh mana karna khud BNS ki Section 199 ke under crime hai.

actions.en: Teach children that no relative, teacher or senior may ask them to keep a secret about their body, and call 1098 if a child is at risk.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko sikhaiye ki koi rishtedaar, teacher ya senior unse body se judi koi baat chhupane ko nahi keh sakta, aur kisi bachche ko khatra ho toh 1098 par call kijiye.

title.en: Myths with a section number: how Indian law wrote beliefs about sex and marriage into the statute book
title.hg: Section number wale myths: Indian law ne sex aur shaadi ke baare mein beliefs ko kanoon ki kitaab mein kaise likh diya

dek.en: For 50 years the abortion law pictured contraception as something only married couples used. From 2013 to 2017 the rape law said a husband could not rape his 15-year-old wife. Four myths the legal system carried, how they were removed, and the two that are still law.
dek.hg: 50 saal tak abortion law contraception ko sirf shaadishuda couples ki cheez maanta raha. 2013 se 2017 tak rape law kehta raha ki pati apni 15 saal ki wife ka rape nahi kar sakta. Chaar myths jo legal system mein baithe rahe, woh kaise hate, aur woh do jo aaj bhi law hain.

label.en: years in which the abortion law's contraceptive-failure clause covered only 'any married woman or her husband'
label.hg: in saalon mein abortion law ka contraceptive-failure clause sirf 'any married woman or her husband' ko cover karta tha

label.en: age from which a wife was outside the rape law's protection against her husband, from 2013 until 11 October 2017
label.hg: is umar se wife apne pati ke khilaf rape law ki protection se bahar thi, 2013 se 11 October 2017 tak

label.en: of men told NFHS-5 that a husband has the right to use force if his wife refuses sex
label.hg: mardon ne NFHS-5 mein kaha ki wife sex se mana kare toh pati ko zabardasti karne ka haq hai

claim.en: If something is written in the law, it rests on fact, not on belief.
claim.hg: Jo baat law mein likhi hai, woh fact par tiki hogi, belief par nahi.

truth.en: Indian law has carried beliefs about marriage, 'natural' sex and women's bodies as legal text. Four were removed between 2017 and 2022. The marital rape exception and the man-woman definition of rape are still in Section 63 of the BNS.
truth.hg: Indian law ne shaadi, 'natural' sex aur auraton ke body ke baare mein beliefs ko legal text ki shakal mein rakha hai. Chaar ko 2017 se 2022 ke beech hataya gaya. Marital rape exception aur rape ki 'man-woman' wali definition aaj bhi BNS ki Section 63 mein hain.

actions.en: When someone says 'it is the law, so it must be right', ask when the clause was written and who has challenged it since.
actions.hg: Jab koi kahe 'law mein likha hai, toh sahi hi hoga', toh poochiye ki yeh clause kab likha gaya tha aur tab se use kisne challenge kiya hai.

actions.en: If you are unmarried and need an abortion, the law covers you: since 2021 the contraceptive-failure ground says 'any woman or her partner'. Go to a registered provider; do not self-medicate.
actions.hg: Agar aap unmarried hain aur abortion ki zaroorat hai, toh law aapko cover karta hai: 2021 se contraceptive-failure ground mein 'any woman or her partner' likha hai. Registered provider ke paas jaiye; khud se dawa mat lijiye.

actions.en: No doctor may conduct a two-finger or 'virginity' test after a sexual assault. The Supreme Court has ruled that anyone who does is guilty of misconduct. Say no, and report it.
actions.hg: Sexual assault ke baad koi bhi doctor two-finger ya 'virginity' test nahi kar sakta. Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki aisa karne wala misconduct ka doshi hai. Mana kijiye, aur report kijiye.

actions.en: If a husband forces sex, the rape section does not apply to an adult wife, but the Domestic Violence Act does. Call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar pati zabardasti sex kare, toh adult wife par rape wali section lagu nahi hoti, lekin Domestic Violence Act lagu hota hai. Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye; emergency mein 112.

actions.en: Follow the Supreme Court's marital rape hearing, expected in December 2026. Exceptions in the code have been removed before.
actions.hg: Supreme Court ki marital rape hearing par nazar rakhiye, jo December 2026 mein expected hai. Code ke exceptions pehle bhi hataye ja chuke hain.

title.en: 'She's a sex worker, she can't be raped'? Consent has no price tag in Indian law
title.hg: 'Woh toh sex worker hai, uska rape kaise?' Indian law mein consent ka koi price tag nahi hota

dek.en: The excuse has two halves: she has already agreed, and her word counts for less. Indian law rejects both, from Section 63 of the BNS to the rules of evidence. What the law promises women in sex work, and where that promise stops.
dek.hg: Is excuse ke do hisse hain: woh pehle hi haan keh chuki hai, aur uski baat ka wazan kam hai. BNS ki Section 63 se lekar evidence ke rules tak, law dono ko reject karta hai. Sex work karne wali aurton se law kya promise karta hai, aur woh promise kahan ruk jaata hai.

statLabel.en: people rescued in India in 2024 after being trafficked for sexual exploitation
statLabel.hg: log jinhe 2024 mein India mein sexual exploitation ke liye hui trafficking se rescue kiya gaya

label.en: the age under which sex with a girl is rape, whatever she says
label.hg: is umar se kam ki ladki ke saath sex rape hai, woh chahe kuch bhi kahe

label.en: people rescued in India in 2024 after being trafficked for sexual exploitation
label.hg: log jinhe 2024 mein India mein sexual exploitation ke liye hui trafficking se rescue kiya gaya

label.en: HIV prevalence among female sex workers in 2024, against 0.20% among all adults
label.hg: 2024 mein female sex workers mein HIV prevalence, jabki sabhi adults mein yeh 0.20% thi

claim.en: A sex worker cannot be raped: she has already agreed, and her word counts for less.
claim.hg: Sex worker ka rape nahi ho sakta: woh pehle hi haan keh chuki hai, aur uski baat ka wazan kam hai.

truth.en: Section 63 of the BNS protects every woman, whatever her work: any act against her will or without her consent is rape. Her character and sexual past are irrelevant to consent, and she cannot be questioned about them in court to prove she agreed.
truth.hg: BNS ki Section 63 har aurat ko protect karti hai, uska kaam chahe jo ho: uski marzi ke khilaf ya uske consent ke bina kiya gaya koi bhi act rape hai. Consent ke sawaal par uska character aur sexual past irrelevant hai, aur court mein un par sawaal poochkar yeh prove nahi kiya ja sakta ki usne haan kahi thi.

actions.en: Say 'sex worker', or 'trafficked victim' if she was trafficked, never 'prostitute' or worse. The Supreme Court tells its own judges the same.
actions.hg: 'Prostitute' ya usse bhi bure words kabhi nahi: 'sex worker' kahiye, aur agar uski trafficking hui thi toh 'trafficked victim'. Supreme Court apne judges se bhi yahi kehta hai.

actions.en: If a woman in sex work tells you she was raped, treat it as rape and help her report it at any police station. Refusing to register it is a crime.
actions.hg: Agar sex work karne wali koi aurat bataye ki uska rape hua, toh use rape hi maniye aur kisi bhi police station mein report karne mein uski madad kijiye. FIR register karne se mana karna crime hai.

actions.en: After any rape, get to a hospital fast: HIV prevention medicine (PEP) must start within 72 hours, and every hospital must treat a rape survivor free.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi rape ke baad jaldi hospital pahunchiye: HIV se bachane wali dawa (PEP) 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye, aur har hospital ko rape survivor ka free ilaaj karna hoga.

actions.en: A child under 18 in sex work, girl or boy, is being sexually abused, whatever the child says. Call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Sex work mein dikh raha 18 saal se kam umar ka koi bhi bachcha, ladki ho ya ladka, sexual abuse jhel raha hai, woh chahe kuch bhi kahe. 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Never share the name, photo or any detail that could identify a rape survivor, whatever her work. It is a crime under Section 72 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Kisi rape survivor ka naam, photo ya pehchaan kholne wali koi bhi detail kabhi share mat kijiye, uska kaam chahe jo ho. BNS ki Section 72 ke under yeh crime hai.

title.en: Clothes, drinks, late nights: the 'she asked for it' myth, checked against the ages of India's 2024 victims
title.hg: Kapde, drinks, late nights: 'she asked for it' wala myth, India ke 2024 victims ki umar ke saamne

dek.en: The idea that a woman's dress, drinking or hours 'invite' rape still turns up at dinner tables, in comment sections and, as recently as 2022, in a court order. The ages of the people police recorded as victims in 2024 take it apart.
dek.hg: Yeh soch ki ladki ke kapde, drinking ya late nights rape ko 'invite' karte hain, aaj bhi dinner table par, comment sections mein aur 2022 mein ek court order tak mein dikhi. 2024 mein police ne jinhe victims ke roop mein darj kiya, unki umar is myth ko tod deti hai.

statLabel.en: children under six among India's recorded victims of penetrative sexual assault in 2024 (POCSO)
statLabel.hg: bachche chhe saal se chhote the, 2024 mein POCSO ke tahat darj penetrative sexual assault ke victims mein

label.en: child victims of penetrative sexual assault recorded under POCSO in 2024
label.hg: child victims of penetrative sexual assault 2024 mein POCSO ke tahat darj hue

label.en: of them were aged 6 to 12
label.hg: inmein se itne bachche 6 se 12 saal ke the

label.en: women over 60 among victims recorded under the rape head in 2024
label.hg: women 60 saal se upar ki thin, 2024 mein rape head ke tahat darj victims mein

claim.en: Women who wear revealing clothes, drink or stay out late are asking for it.
claim.hg: Jo ladkiyan revealing kapde pehenti hain, drink karti hain ya late night bahar rehti hain, woh khud 'asking for it' hain.

truth.en: Nobody asks to be raped. Police recorded 831 children under six among victims of penetrative sexual assault in 2024, and the law asks one question only: did she clearly and freely agree to that act? A dress, a drink or the hour is not consent.
truth.hg: Rape ko koi invite nahi karta. 2024 mein police ne penetrative sexual assault ke victims mein chhe saal se chhote 831 bachche darj kiye, aur law sirf ek sawaal poochta hai: kya usne us act ke liye saaf aur apni marzi se haan kaha tha? Dress, drink ya time consent nahi hain.

actions.en: When someone blames a survivor's clothes, ask what clothing has to do with the 831 children under six in the 2024 data.
actions.hg: Jab koi survivor ke kapdon ko blame kare, toh poochiye ki 2024 data ke chhe saal se chhote 831 bachchon se kapdon ka kya lena-dena hai.

actions.en: Say the law plainly: consent is a clear, voluntary yes to a specific act; silence, a drink or a dress is not a yes.
actions.hg: Law saaf boliye: consent matlab kisi specific act ke liye clear, voluntary haan; silence, drink ya dress haan nahi hai.

actions.en: Do not forward posts or jokes that blame survivors; report them on the platform instead.
actions.hg: Survivors ko blame karne wale posts ya jokes forward mat kijiye; unhe platform par report kijiye.

actions.en: If someone tells you they were assaulted, begin with 'it was not your fault', not with questions about what they wore.
actions.hg: Agar koi bataye ki uske saath assault hua, toh 'isme tumhari koi galti nahi' se shuru kijiye, kapdon ke sawaalon se nahi.

actions.en: If you think a child is being abused, call the Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar lage ki kisi bachche ka abuse ho raha hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

title.en: Only 5% of unmarried survivors named a stranger: the dark-lane rape myth, and the curfews that guard against the wrong danger
title.hg: Sirf 5% unmarried survivors ne stranger ka naam liya: 'dark lane' rape myth, aur woh curfews jo galat khatre par pehra dete hain

dek.en: Families answer the fear of rape with curfews, escorts and 'be home before dark'. Survivors and police records point somewhere else: to relatives, husbands, boyfriends, family friends and neighbours.
dek.hg: Rape ke darr se families curfew, escort aur 'andhera hone se pehle ghar aao' wale rules lagati hain. Lekin survivors aur police records kahin aur ishaara karte hain: relatives, husbands, boyfriends, family friends aur padosi.

statLabel.en: of never-married survivors of sexual violence named a stranger (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: sexual violence jhel chuki never-married women mein se sirf itno ne kisi stranger ka naam liya (NFHS-5)

label.en: of ever-married women who had faced sexual violence named their current husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: sexual violence jhel chuki ever-married women mein se itno ne apne current husband ka naam liya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of rape cases registered in 2024 where police recorded the offender as known to the survivor
label.hg: 2024 mein darj rape cases jinmein police ke hisaab se accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: of rape cases recorded in 2012, the year of the Delhi gang rape case, had an offender known to the victim
label.hg: 2012 mein darj rape cases jinmein accused victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha; usi saal Delhi gang rape case hua tha

label.en: cases of sexual harassment in public places registered in July-December 2024
label.hg: July-December 2024 mein public places par sexual harassment ke darj cases

claim.en: Rape is mostly done by strangers in dark lanes, so a girl who is home before dark is safe.
claim.hg: Rape zyadatar dark lanes mein strangers karte hain, isliye jo ladki andhera hone se pehle ghar aa jaaye, woh safe hai.

truth.en: Survivors and police records overwhelmingly name people they know: relatives, husbands, boyfriends, family friends and neighbours. Streets carry a real risk of harassment, but a curfew does nothing about the danger inside the home or on the phone.
truth.hg: Survivors aur police records zyadatar jaan-pehchaan walon ka naam lete hain: relatives, husbands, boyfriends, family friends, padosi. Sadak par harassment ka risk sach hai, lekin curfew ghar ke andar ya phone par baithe khatre ka kuch nahi bigaadta.

actions.en: Replace 'be home before dark' with 'tell me if anyone, even family, makes you uncomfortable', and mean it.
actions.hg: 'Andhera hone se pehle ghar aa jaana' ki jagah kahiye: 'koi bhi, family ka koi bhi, agar tumhe uncomfortable kare toh mujhe batana', aur is baat par tike rahiye.

actions.en: Tell teenagers plainly that relatives, partners, tutors and family friends can commit sexual violence, and that it is still a crime.
actions.hg: Teenagers ko saaf bataiye ki relatives, partners, tutors aur family friends bhi sexual violence kar sakte hain, aur woh bhi crime hi hai.

actions.en: Give daughters and sons the same rules about going out, and the same lessons about consent.
actions.hg: Betiyon aur beton ke liye bahar jaane ke rules ek jaise rakhiye, aur consent ki seekh bhi ek jaisi dijiye.

actions.en: If someone tells you about abuse by a person you both know, believe them first and help them reach support.
actions.hg: Agar koi bataye ki kisi jaan-pehchaan wale ne uske saath galat kiya, toh pehle us par bharosa kijiye aur support tak pahunchne mein uska saath dijiye.

actions.en: In an emergency, on the road or at home, call 112; the Women Helpline is 181.
actions.hg: Emergency mein, sadak par hon ya ghar mein, 112 par call kijiye; Women Helpline ka number 181 hai.

title.en: 'Why doesn't the Supreme Court just fix it?' What judges can and cannot do about the gaps in India's rape law
title.hg: 'Supreme Court khud fix kyun nahi kar deta?' India ke rape law ke gaps par judges kya kar sakte hain, aur kya nahi

dek.en: Courts can strike words out of a law. They cannot write a new crime into one. That one line explains why the marital rape challenge waits on the Supreme Court, while the missing offence for men waits on Parliament.
dek.hg: Court kisi law se words hata sakta hai. Usmein naya crime nahi likh sakta. Yahi ek line batati hai ki marital rape ka challenge Supreme Court ke faisle ka intezaar kyun kar raha hai, aur mardon ke liye missing offence Parliament ke intezaar mein kyun atka hai.

label.en: the age in the marital rape exception, before and after the Supreme Court read it down in 2017
label.hg: marital rape exception mein biwi ki umar, 2017 mein Supreme Court ke read down karne se pehle aur baad

label.en: the time the Delhi High Court gave the Centre in August 2024 to decide on restoring punishment for non-consensual 'unnatural' sex
label.hg: August 2024 mein Delhi High Court ne Centre ko itna time diya, non-consensual 'unnatural' sex ki saza wapas laane par decide karne ke liye

label.en: between the Supreme Court's Vishaka guidelines (1997) and the law Parliament passed to replace them (2013)
label.hg: Supreme Court ki Vishaka guidelines (1997) aur unki jagah Parliament ke banaye law (2013) ke beech ka gap

claim.en: If the Supreme Court wanted to, it could make marital rape and the rape of men crimes tomorrow.
claim.hg: Supreme Court chahe toh kal hi marital rape aur mardon ke rape ko crime bana de.

truth.en: Courts can strike down or read down parts of a law, as the Supreme Court did for wives under 18 in 2017. They cannot create a new offence: in October 2024 the Supreme Court said it cannot direct that a particular act is a crime.
truth.hg: Courts kisi law ka koi hissa strike down ya read down kar sakte hain, jaise Supreme Court ne 2017 mein 18 saal se kam umar ki biwiyon ke liye kiya. Lekin woh naya offence nahi bana sakte: October 2024 mein Supreme Court ne khud kaha ki woh kisi particular act ko crime declare karne ka order nahi de sakta.

actions.en: Before blaming 'the courts' or 'the government' for a gap in the law, ask who holds the power: striking words out is for judges, writing a new crime is for Parliament.
actions.hg: Law ke kisi gap ke liye 'courts' ya 'government' ko blame karne se pehle poochiye ki power kiske paas hai: words hatana judges ka kaam hai, naya crime likhna Parliament ka.

actions.en: Write to your MP and the Home Ministry about the missing offence for men and transgender persons. Parliament's own committee recommended keeping Section 377 in 2023.
actions.hg: Mardon aur transgender logon ke liye missing offence ke baare mein apne MP aur Home Ministry ko likhiye. Parliament ki apni committee ne 2023 mein Section 377 ko rakhne ki recommendation di thi.

actions.en: Follow criminal-law Bills while they are still Bills: that is when a gap is easiest to fix.
actions.hg: Criminal law ke Bills ko tab follow kijiye jab woh abhi Bills hi hon: gap fix karne ka sabse aasaan waqt wahi hota hai.

actions.en: Follow the Supreme Court's marital rape case, which the court said it would fix for final hearing on 9 or 10 December 2026, and read what the judgment actually says, not only the headlines.
actions.hg: Supreme Court ka marital rape case follow kijiye, jiski final hearing court ne 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko rakhne ki baat kahi hai, aur sirf headlines nahi, judgment mein asal mein kya likha hai woh padhiye.

actions.en: If you are a survivor caught in a gap, get help anyway: call 112 in an emergency, the Women Helpline 181, or Tele-MANAS 14416 for counselling.
actions.hg: Agar aap survivor hain aur law ke kisi gap mein phanse hain, tab bhi madad lijiye: emergency mein 112, Women Helpline 181, ya counselling ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416.

title.en: 'There's a law for that': dowry, domestic violence and child marriage laws on paper, and how rarely they reach a verdict
title.hg: 'Iske liye toh law hai': dowry, domestic violence aur child marriage ke laws kaagaz par, aur kitni kam baar woh verdict tak pahunchte hain

dek.en: India has had a dowry law since 1961, a sex-selection law since 1994, a domestic violence law since 2005 and its current child marriage law since 2006. We followed each one from the statute book to the courtroom in the 2024 data, to see where it stalls.
dek.hg: India mein dowry law 1961 se hai, sex-selection law 1994 se, domestic violence law 2005 se aur current child marriage law 2006 se. Humne 2024 ke data mein har law ko statute book se courtroom tak follow kiya, yeh dekhne ke liye ki woh kahan atakta hai.

statLabel.en: convictions under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act in 2024, against 625 acquittals
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein Prohibition of Child Marriage Act ke tahat convictions, 625 acquittals ke muqable

label.en: criminal cases police registered under the Domestic Violence Act across India in 2024
label.hg: criminal cases jo police ne 2024 mein poore India mein Domestic Violence Act ke tahat darj kiye

label.en: of Dowry Prohibition Act trials decided in 2024 ended in conviction; 83,298 cases were pending
label.hg: 2024 mein decide hue Dowry Prohibition Act trials conviction par khatm hue; 83,298 cases pending the

label.en: child marriage cases ended in conviction in 2024, against 625 acquittals
label.hg: child marriage cases 2024 mein conviction par khatm hue, 625 acquittals ke muqable

label.en: police cases registered in 2024 under the PC-PNDT Act against sex selection
label.hg: police cases jo 2024 mein sex selection ke khilaf PC-PNDT Act ke tahat darj hue

claim.en: Dowry, domestic violence, child marriage and sex selection are all illegal now, so the law is dealing with them.
claim.hg: Dowry, domestic violence, child marriage aur sex selection ab sab illegal hain, toh law inse nipat hi raha hai.

truth.en: A law works only when a case is registered, investigated and decided. In 2024 the child marriage law produced 209 convictions against 625 acquittals, dowry trials ended in conviction 17.4% of the time, and police registered 31 cases against sex selection. The Domestic Violence Act's main remedy, a civil protection order from a magistrate, does not appear in crime data at all.
truth.hg: Law tabhi kaam karta hai jab case darj ho, investigation ho aur court faisla de. 2024 mein child marriage law se 209 convictions hue aur 625 acquittals, dowry trials sirf 17.4% baar conviction par khatm hue, aur police ne sex selection ke khilaf 31 cases darj kiye. Domestic Violence Act ka main remedy, magistrate se milne wala civil protection order, crime data mein dikhta hi nahi.

actions.en: If you face violence at home, ask a magistrate for a protection order under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act; call the Women Helpline 181 or go to a One Stop Centre to start.
actions.hg: Agar ghar mein violence ho rahi hai, toh 2005 ke Domestic Violence Act ke tahat magistrate se protection order maangiye; shuruaat ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye ya One Stop Centre jaiye.

actions.en: If a protection order is broken, report the breach to the police: the breach itself is a crime.
actions.hg: Agar protection order toda jaaye, toh police ko breach report kijiye: order todna khud ek crime hai.

actions.en: To stop a child marriage, call Child Helpline 1098 or 112 before the wedding day, with the place and date.
actions.hg: Child marriage rokni ho toh shaadi ke din se pehle Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye, jagah aur date ke saath.

actions.en: Keep dowry demands on record: messages, gift lists and bank transfers are evidence.
actions.hg: Dowry ki demands ka record rakhiye: messages, gifts ki list aur bank transfers evidence hain.

actions.en: When someone says 'there's a law for that', ask how many cases it registered and how many reached a verdict.
actions.hg: Jab koi kahe 'iske liye toh law hai', toh poochhiye ki us law ke tahat kitne cases darj hue aur kitne verdict tak pahunche.

title.en: 736 million, then 840 million: why WHO says violence against women did not simply 'rise', and how to read such numbers
title.hg: 736 million, phir 840 million: WHO kyun kehta hai ki aurton ke khilaaf violence bas 'badh' nahi gaya, aur aise numbers kaise padhein

dek.en: Put two WHO reports side by side and you can write 'violence is rising' or 'India is improving'. WHO says both comparisons are wrong. Its real trend finding is harder to hear: two decades of almost no change.
dek.hg: WHO ki do reports saath rakh dijiye, toh aap 'violence badh raha hai' bhi likh sakte hain aur 'India sudhar raha hai' bhi. WHO kehta hai ki dono comparisons galat hain. Uski asli trend finding sunna zyada mushkil hai: do dashakon mein lagbhag koi badlaav nahi.

statLabel.en: average yearly decline in partner violence over the past 20 years (WHO)
statLabel.hg: pichhle 20 saal mein partner violence mein average saalana girawat (WHO)

label.en: women who had faced partner or non-partner violence in WHO's previous round (2000-2018 data)
label.hg: aurtein jinhone partner ya non-partner violence jhela, WHO ke pichhle round mein (2000-2018 ka data)

label.en: the figure in WHO's 2023 round, which WHO says cannot be compared with the previous one
label.hg: WHO ke 2023 round ka figure, jise WHO ke mutabik pichhle round se compare nahi kiya ja sakta

label.en: ever-married or partnered Indian women aged 15-49 who faced partner violence in the past 12 months (WHO model, 2023)
label.hg: ever-married ya partnered Indian aurtein (15-49 saal) jinhone pichhle 12 mahine mein partner violence jhela (WHO model, 2023)

label.en: average yearly decline in partner violence worldwide over 20 years
label.hg: duniya bhar mein 20 saal mein partner violence mein average saalana girawat

claim.en: WHO's count went from 736 million to 840 million, so violence against women is rising fast.
claim.hg: WHO ki ginti 736 million se 840 million ho gayi, matlab aurton ke khilaaf violence tezi se badh raha hai.

truth.en: WHO says its two rounds cannot be compared because methods and data changed. Its own trend analysis finds partner violence almost flat, falling by only about 0.2% a year over two decades.
truth.hg: WHO kehta hai ki uske do rounds compare nahi kiye ja sakte, kyunki methods aur data badal gaye. Uska apna trend analysis partner violence ko lagbhag flat paata hai: do dashakon mein saal ka sirf lagbhag 0.2% kam.

actions.en: Before you share a violence statistic, check whether it is a count or a share, and which women it covers.
actions.hg: Violence ka koi statistic share karne se pehle check kijiye ki woh count hai ya share, aur kin aurton ko cover karta hai.

actions.en: Never present two rounds of WHO estimates as a trend; WHO itself says they are not comparable.
actions.hg: WHO estimates ke do rounds ko kabhi trend ki tarah mat dikhaiye; WHO khud kehta hai ki woh comparable nahi hain.

actions.en: To know how things are now, look for the past-12-months figure, not only the lifetime one.
actions.hg: Abhi ki situation jaanni ho toh sirf lifetime figure nahi, pichhle 12 mahine wala figure bhi dhoondhiye.

actions.en: When a headline says violence is up or down, ask whether the survey method, or women's willingness to tell, changed first.
actions.hg: Jab headline kahe ki violence badha ya ghata, toh poochiye ki kahin pehle survey ka method, ya aurton ki batane ki himmat, toh nahi badli.

actions.en: If someone you know is being hurt by a partner now, help them reach 181, the Women Helpline, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar aapki jaan-pehchaan mein kisi ko abhi uska partner chot pahuncha raha hai, toh use 181 Women Helpline tak pahunchne mein madad kijiye, ya emergency mein 112 tak.

title.en: The virginity myth is not about the body: how one idea of 'purity' links child marriage, 'honour' killings and the two-finger test
title.hg: Virginity ka myth body ke baare mein nahi hai: 'purity' ki ek soch kaise child marriage, 'honour' killings aur two-finger test ko jodti hai

dek.en: Medicine and the Supreme Court have settled the virginity question: no test can show it. The idea of a daughter's 'purity' as family property survives anyway, and it still decides when girls marry and whether couples who choose each other are safe.
dek.hg: Medical science aur Supreme Court dono saaf keh chuke hain ki koi test virginity nahi bata sakta. Phir bhi beti ki 'purity' ko family ki property maanne wali soch zinda hai, aur yahi aaj bhi decide karti hai ki ladkiyon ki shaadi kab hogi aur apni pasand se saath aaye couples safe rahenge ya nahi.

label.en: of women aged 20-24 were married before 18 in 2023-24 (NFHS-6)
label.hg: 20-24 saal ki women ki shaadi 18 se pehle ho gayi thi, 2023-24 mein (NFHS-6)

label.en: murders police recorded with 'honour killing' as the motive in 2024, a count widely seen as far too low
label.hg: murders jinka motive police ne 2024 mein 'honour killing' record kiya; is ginti ko bahut kam maana jaata hai

label.en: honour killings in Tamil Nadu over ten years, as the Madras High Court observed in 2026; police data showed none there from 2020 to 2023
label.hg: Tamil Nadu mein das saal mein honour killings, Madras High Court ke mutabik (2026); police data mein 2020 se 2023 tak wahan ek bhi nahi

label.en: of women aged 20-24 had been married before 18 in 2005-06; the share has fallen since, but more slowly after 2015-16
label.hg: 20-24 saal ki women ki shaadi 2005-06 mein 18 se pehle ho gayi thi; tab se yeh ghata hai, par 2015-16 ke baad dheere

claim.en: A girl's virginity can be checked, and guarding it protects her and her family's honour.
claim.hg: Ladki ki virginity check ki ja sakti hai, aur use bacha kar rakhne se ladki aur family ki izzat bachti hai.

truth.en: No test can show whether someone has had sex. The 'purity' idea is used to marry girls early and to punish adults who choose their own partners, and the Supreme Court has held that choosing a partner is part of individual liberty.
truth.hg: Koi test nahi bata sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi. 'Purity' wali soch ladkiyon ki jaldi shaadi karne aur apni pasand ka partner chunne wale adults ko saza dene mein use hoti hai, aur Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki partner chunna individual liberty ka hissa hai.

actions.en: Refuse any 'virginity' check, and report any doctor who performs a two-finger test; the Supreme Court has called it misconduct.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi 'virginity check' se mana kijiye, aur two-finger test karne wale doctor ki complaint kijiye; Supreme Court ise misconduct keh chuka hai.

actions.en: If a girl's marriage is being fixed before 18, call Child Helpline 1098 or the district Child Marriage Prohibition Officer before the wedding day.
actions.hg: Agar kisi ladki ki shaadi 18 se pehle fix ho rahi hai, toh shaadi ke din se pehle Child Helpline 1098 ya district ke Child Marriage Prohibition Officer ko bataiye.

actions.en: If a couple is threatened by family for choosing each other, call 112 and ask the police for protection.
actions.hg: Agar apni pasand se partner chunne par kisi couple ko family se dhamki mil rahi hai, toh 112 par call karke police se protection maangiye.

actions.en: When a marriage is being discussed, ask about the bride's age and her consent, never her 'character'.
actions.hg: Shaadi ki baat chale toh dulhan ki umar aur uska consent poochiye, uska 'character' nahi.

title.en: 'It wasn't really rape'? What Indian law has counted as rape and sexual assault since 2013, answered
title.hg: 'Woh asli rape thodi tha'? 2013 se Indian law kise rape aur sexual assault maanta hai, seedhe jawab

dek.en: Many people still think rape means one specific act, and that anything short of it is 'just touching'. Indian law dropped that idea on 3 February 2013. A plain Q&A on what counts, which section applies and why the label decides the punishment.
dek.hg: Bahut log aaj bhi sochte hain ki rape ka matlab sirf ek khaas act hai, aur usse kam jo bhi ho woh 'bas touching' hai. Indian law ne yeh soch 3 February 2013 ko chhod di. Ek seedha Q&A: kya rape maana jaata hai, kaun si section lagti hai, aur label se saza kyun tay hoti hai.

label.en: minimum prison term for rape under Section 64 of the BNS; the maximum is life
label.hg: BNS ki Section 64 ke under rape ki kam se kam saza; zyada se zyada life imprisonment

label.en: prison term for assault to outrage a woman's modesty under Section 74 of the BNS
label.hg: BNS ki Section 74 ke under 'assault to outrage a woman's modesty' ki saza

label.en: cases of assault to outrage modesty registered by police in India in 2024
label.hg: assault to outrage modesty ke cases jo police ne 2024 mein India mein register kiye

label.en: cases registered under the rape head in India in 2024
label.hg: cases jo 2024 mein India mein rape head ke under register hue

claim.en: It is only rape if there was intercourse. Anything else is 'just touching'.
claim.hg: Rape tabhi hai jab intercourse hua ho. Baaki sab 'bas touching' hai.

truth.en: Since 3 February 2013 Indian law has defined rape to include penetration of the mouth, urethra or anus and insertion of any object or body part, to any extent. Other sexual assaults are separate crimes with prison terms under Sections 74 to 79 of the BNS.
truth.hg: 3 February 2013 se Indian law ki rape ki definition mein mouth, urethra ya anus ka penetration aur kisi bhi object ya body part ka insertion shamil hai, 'to any extent'. Baaki sexual assaults alag crimes hain, jinki jail ki saza BNS ki Sections 74 se 79 mein likhi hai.

actions.en: Stop using 'it wasn't really rape' about yourself or anyone else. Describe what happened and let the law name it.
actions.hg: Apne ya kisi aur ke baare mein 'woh asli rape nahi tha' kehna band kijiye. Jo hua woh bataiye, aur naam law ko dene dijiye.

actions.en: After any sexual assault, go to a hospital first: HIV prevention medicine (PEP) must start within 72 hours, and treatment for a rape survivor is free at every hospital.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi sexual assault ke baad pehle hospital jaiye: HIV se bachane wali dawa (PEP) 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye, aur rape survivor ka ilaaj har hospital mein free hai.

actions.en: Report at any police station, wherever it happened. Ask for your free copy of the FIR and read which sections it lists.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein report kijiye, ghatna chahe kahin bhi hui ho. FIR ki free copy maangiye aur padhiye ki usmein kaun si sections likhi hain.

actions.en: If the person hurt is under 18, of any gender, the POCSO Act applies. Call the Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar jiske saath yeh hua woh 18 saal se kam hai, kisi bhi gender ka, toh POCSO Act lagu hota hai. Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Stalking, voyeurism and unwanted touching are crimes on their own. They do not need to be 'as bad as rape' to be reported.
actions.hg: Stalking, voyeurism aur bina marzi ke chhoona apne aap mein crimes hain. Report karne ke liye unka 'rape jitna bura' hona zaroori nahi.

title.en: Killed by someone she knew: worldwide, almost 60% of murdered women and girls die at the hands of partners or family
title.hg: Kisi apne ne maara: duniya bhar mein qatl hui lagbhag 60% aurton aur ladkiyon ki jaan partner ya family ne li

dek.en: We teach women to fear the stranger on a dark road. The global count of killings points closer to home: husbands, fathers, brothers and in-laws. And where the data exist, many women killed by partners had already reported the abuse.
dek.hg: Hum aurton ko andheri sadak par ajnabi se darna sikhaate hain. Duniya bhar ke qatl ke aankde ghar ki taraf ishaara karte hain: pati, baap, bhai aur sasuraal wale. Aur jahan data hai, wahan partner ke haathon maari gayi kai aurtein pehle hi abuse ki report kar chuki thin.

statLabel.en: of women and girls killed worldwide in 2024 died at the hands of a partner or family member
statLabel.hg: aurtein aur ladkiyan jinka 2024 mein duniya bhar mein qatl hua, partner ya family member ke haathon maari gayin

label.en: of male homicide victims worldwide in 2024 were killed by a partner or family member, against almost 60% of female victims
label.hg: 2024 mein duniya bhar ke male homicide victims partner ya family member ke haathon maare gaye, jabki female victims mein yeh hissa lagbhag 60% tha

label.en: women and girls killed by a partner or relative every day worldwide in 2024, on average
label.hg: aurtein aur ladkiyan 2024 mein duniya bhar mein har din, average, partner ya rishtedaar ke haathon maari gayin

label.en: women and girls estimated to have been killed by partners or family members in Asia in 2024
label.hg: aurtein aur ladkiyan 2024 mein Asia mein partners ya family members ke haathon maari gayin, anumaan ke mutabik

label.en: of women killed by partners in France, South Africa and Colombia had already reported abuse by that partner
label.hg: France, South Africa aur Colombia mein partner ke haathon maari gayi aurton ne pehle hi us partner ke abuse ki report ki thi

claim.en: Women are murdered by strangers: robbers, stalkers, men on dark roads. Keep her at home and she is safe.
claim.hg: Aurton ka qatl ajnabi karte hain: chor, stalker, andheri sadkon par ghoomte mard. Use ghar par rakho, woh safe rahegi.

truth.en: Men are most of the world's homicide victims, but women are killed differently: about 60% of women and girls killed in 2024 died at the hands of a partner or relative, against 11% of male victims. For a woman, the most likely killer is someone she calls family.
truth.hg: Duniya mein homicide ke zyada tar victims mard hain, lekin aurton ke saath pattern alag hai: 2024 mein qatl hui lagbhag 60% aurtein aur ladkiyan partner ya rishtedaar ke haathon maari gayin, jabki male victims mein yeh hissa 11% tha. Aurat ka sabse sambhavit qaatil woh hai jise woh apna parivar kehti hai.

actions.en: Treat threats to kill, or violence that is getting worse, as an emergency: call 112, not a family meeting.
actions.hg: Jaan se maarne ki dhamki, ya badhti hui hinsa ko emergency samjhiye: family meeting nahi, 112 par call kariye.

actions.en: If a woman says she is afraid of her husband, in-laws or family, believe her and help her plan. Do not tell her to adjust.
actions.hg: Agar koi aurat kahe ki use apne pati, sasuraal ya family se darr lagta hai, toh uska yakeen kariye aur plan banane mein madad kariye. Use 'adjust karo' mat kahiye.

actions.en: Help her keep copies of ID, bank and marriage papers, some cash and a charged phone with someone she trusts.
actions.hg: Uski ID, bank aur shaadi ke kaagzon ki copies, kuch cash aur charged phone kisi bharosemand insaan ke paas rakhwane mein madad kariye.

actions.en: Find the nearest One Stop Centre (Sakhi) or call the Women Helpline 181 for shelter, legal, medical and counselling help.
actions.hg: Sabse paas ka One Stop Centre (Sakhi) dhoondhiye ya Women Helpline 181 par call kariye: shelter, legal, medical aur counselling madad ke liye.

actions.en: If a couple is threatened by family for choosing each other, report the threat to the police in writing and ask for protection.
actions.hg: Agar kisi couple ko ek-doosre ko chunne ki wajah se family dhamka rahi hai, toh dhamki ki likhit report police ko dijiye aur protection maangiye.

title.en: 'It was just a joke': what counts as sexual harassment at work under Vishaka and the BNS
title.hg: 'Bas mazaak tha': Vishaka aur BNS ke hisaab se kaam ki jagah par sexual harassment kya-kya hai

dek.en: A 'non-veg' joke in the team chat, a comment about a colleague's figure, a porn clip forwarded 'for fun'. If unwelcome, all of it fits the Supreme Court's 1997 definition of sexual harassment. Here is where banter ends, what a complaint can do, and how colleagues can step in.
dek.hg: Team chat mein 'non-veg' joke, colleague ke figure par comment, 'for fun' forward ki gayi porn clip. Agar yeh unwelcome hai, toh yeh sab Supreme Court ki 1997 wali sexual harassment ki definition mein aata hai. Yahan samjho ki banter kahan khatam hota hai, complaint kya kar sakti hai, aur colleagues kaise beech mein aa sakte hain.

statLabel.en: sexual harassment cases registered in India in 2024 (Section 75 BNS / 354A IPC)
statLabel.hg: sexual harassment ke cases India mein 2024 mein register hue (Section 75 BNS / 354A IPC)

label.en: sexual harassment cases registered by police in India in 2024, down from 17,544 in 2023
label.hg: sexual harassment ke cases police ne India mein 2024 mein register kiye, 2023 ke 17,544 se kam

label.en: of those cases recorded at office premises; most workplace complaints never become an FIR
label.hg: cases unmein se office premises par record hue; zyada tar workplace complaints kabhi FIR nahi banti

label.en: conviction rate in sexual harassment trials completed in 2024, while 93.3% of cases were still pending
label.hg: conviction rate, 2024 mein poore hue sexual harassment trials mein, jabki 93.3% cases abhi pending the

label.en: maximum prison term for sexual harassment under Section 75 BNS (up to 1 year for sexually coloured remarks)
