label.hg: yaani teen saal: Section 75 BNS mein sexual harassment ki maximum jail (sexually coloured remarks ke liye 1 saal tak)

claim.en: If it was meant as a joke, it isn't sexual harassment.
claim.hg: Agar mazaak mein kaha gaya tha, toh woh sexual harassment nahi hai.

truth.en: Since 1997 Indian law has defined sexual harassment at work by what was done and whether it was unwelcome. Sexually coloured remarks and showing pornography are on the list. The sender's sense of humour is not a test.
truth.hg: 1997 se Indian kanoon kaam ki jagah par sexual harassment ko is se define karta hai ki kya kiya gaya aur kya woh unwelcome tha. Sexually coloured remarks aur pornography dikhana us list mein hain. Bhejne wale ka sense of humour koi test nahi hai.

actions.en: If a sexual 'joke' at work is unwelcome, screenshot it with the date, time and sender before it is deleted.
actions.hg: Agar kaam par koi sexual 'joke' unwelcome hai, toh delete hone se pehle date, time aur sender ke saath uska screenshot le lo.

actions.en: Ask who sits on your workplace's Internal Committee. A written complaint is due within three months of the last incident, and the committee can extend that by three more.
actions.hg: Pata karo ki tumhare workplace ki Internal Committee mein kaun hai. Written complaint last incident ke teen mahine ke andar deni hoti hai, aur committee ise teen mahine aur badha sakti hai.

actions.en: If you see it happen, don't laugh, react or forward. Say 'not funny', then check privately with the person it targeted.
actions.hg: Agar tumhare saamne aisa ho, toh hanso mat, react mat karo, forward mat karo. 'Not funny' bolo, phir jise target kiya gaya usse akele mein baat karo.

actions.en: Offer to be a witness, and write down what you saw while you still remember it clearly.
actions.hg: Witness banne ka offer do, aur jo dekha use tabhi likh lo jab tak saaf yaad hai.

actions.en: For the criminal route, file an FIR under Section 75 BNS; a woman officer must record it. In an emergency call 112, or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Criminal route ke liye Section 75 BNS ke tahat FIR karwao; ise woman officer ko record karna hota hai. Emergency mein 112 par call karo, ya Women Helpline 181 par.

title.en: A fundamental right, 4,745 toilets short: how states stalled the Supreme Court's 2026 menstrual-health ruling
title.hg: Fundamental right mil gaya, par 4,745 toilets ab bhi nahi: states ne Supreme Court ke 2026 wale periods judgment ko kaise latkaya

dek.en: In January the Supreme Court made menstrual health part of the right to life. By September, the Centre's own affidavit showed thousands of girls' school toilets still not ready, and the court called some states' compliance reports a 'mere formality'.
dek.hg: January mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki menstrual health right to life ka hissa hai. September tak Centre ke apne affidavit mein hazaaron girls' toilets adhure nikle, aur court ne kuch states ki compliance reports ko 'mere formality' bataya.

statLabel.en: girls' school toilets neither built nor under construction (Centre's affidavit, 31 August 2026)
statLabel.hg: schools mein girls' toilets jo na bane the, na ban rahe the (Centre ka affidavit, 31 August 2026)

label.en: girls' school toilets identified as needing to be made functional
label.hg: schools mein girls' toilets jinhe functional banana zaroori paaya gaya

label.en: of them built, according to the Centre's affidavit of 31 August 2026
label.hg: inmein se ban chuke toilets, Centre ke 31 August 2026 ke affidavit ke hisaab se

label.hg: toilets jo us date tak ban hi rahe the

claim.en: Once the Supreme Court rules, schools have to change, so the problem is solved.
claim.hg: Supreme Court ne judgment de diya, toh schools badal hi gaye honge. Problem khatam.

truth.en: A judgment is the start, not the finish. Seven months after this one, the court was still chasing states for honest compliance reports; by October it was warning their Chief Secretaries of contempt.
truth.hg: Judgment shuruaat hai, finish line nahi. Saat mahine baad bhi court states se honest compliance reports maang raha tha; October tak woh unke Chief Secretaries ko contempt ki warning de raha tha.

actions.en: Check whether your school's girls' toilet has a door that locks, running water and a covered bin.
actions.hg: Check karo ki tumhare school ke girls' toilet mein lock wala darwaza, nal mein paani aur dhakkan wala dustbin hai ya nahi.

actions.en: Ask where girls can collect free sanitary napkins at school without having to ask in front of others.
actions.hg: Poocho ki school mein ladkiyan free sanitary napkins kahan se le sakti hain, bina sabke saamne maange.

actions.en: Ask whether the school has an MHM corner with spare uniforms and pads for emergencies.
actions.hg: Poocho ki kya school mein emergency ke liye spare uniforms aur pads wala MHM corner hai.

actions.en: If something is missing, write to the principal and the district education office, with the date, and keep a copy.
actions.hg: Kuch missing ho, toh date daal kar principal aur district education office ko likho, aur ek copy apne paas rakho.

actions.en: Follow the case's next hearing on 14 December 2026 and share what you find with other parents and students.
actions.hg: 14 December 2026 ki agli hearing follow karo, aur jo pata chale woh doosre parents aur students ke saath share karo.

title.en: A 'virginity test' tests nothing: the hymen, the two-finger test courts banned, and the families still demanding proof
title.hg: 'Virginity test' kuch test nahi karta: hymen, woh two-finger test jise courts ne ban kiya, aur families jo ab bhi 'proof' maangti hain

dek.en: The hymen is a rim of tissue that differs from person to person, can stretch without tearing and may never bleed. That is why no doctor, husband or bedsheet can prove anything about a woman's past, and why the Supreme Court had to rule twice against the hospital version of the test.
dek.hg: Hymen tissue ka ek rim hai jo har insaan mein alag hota hai, bina phate stretch ho sakta hai aur ho sakta hai kabhi bleed hi na kare. Isiliye koi doctor, pati ya bedsheet kisi aurat ke past ke baare mein kuch prove nahi kar sakta, aur isiliye Supreme Court ko is test ke hospital wale version ke khilaaf do baar faisla dena pada.

label.en: year the Supreme Court held that the two-finger test violates a rape survivor's privacy and dignity
label.hg: is saal Supreme Court ne kaha ki two-finger test rape survivor ki privacy aur dignity ka violation hai

label.en: year the court said the test has 'no scientific basis' and that anyone conducting it in breach of its directions is guilty of misconduct
label.hg: is saal court ne kaha ki test ka 'no scientific basis' hai aur court ke directions tod kar ise karne wala misconduct ka guilty hoga

label.en: within which police must send a rape survivor for a medical examination, which is lawful only with her consent
label.hg: ke andar police ko rape survivor ko medical examination ke liye bhejna hota hai, aur yeh sirf uski consent se lawful hai

claim.en: A doctor, a husband or a bedsheet can show whether a woman is a virgin.
claim.hg: Doctor, pati ya bedsheet bata sakti hai ki aurat virgin hai ya nahi.

truth.en: The hymen differs from person to person, may stretch instead of tearing and may never bleed. No examination can show whether anyone has had sex.
truth.hg: Hymen har insaan mein alag hota hai, phatne ke bajaye stretch ho sakta hai aur ho sakta hai kabhi bleed na kare. Koi bhi examination yeh nahi dikha sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi.

actions.en: Refuse any 'virginity' check, at a clinic or at home. No doctor can certify virginity, because no examination can show it.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi 'virginity' check ko mana karo, clinic mein ho ya ghar par. Koi doctor virginity certify nahi kar sakta, kyunki koi examination ise dikha hi nahi sakta.

actions.en: If a doctor attempts a finger test on a survivor of sexual assault, say 'I do not consent', note the name, hospital and time, and complain in writing to the hospital head and the State Medical Council.
actions.hg: Agar koi doctor sexual assault survivor par finger test karne lage, toh bolo 'I do not consent', doctor ka naam, hospital aur time note karo, aur hospital head aur State Medical Council ko written complaint do.

actions.en: If you are being forced into an examination, call 112 or the Women Helpline 181; if you are under 18, call Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe zabardasti examination ke liye le jaaya ja raha hai, toh 112 ya Women Helpline 181 call karo; 18 se kam umar ho toh Child Helpline 1098.

actions.en: Before paying for hymen 'repair', ask a qualified gynaecologist about the risks. It has no health benefit and cannot guarantee bleeding.
actions.hg: Hymen 'repair' ke paise dene se pehle kisi qualified gynaecologist se risks poochho. Iska koi health benefit nahi hai aur yeh bleeding ki guarantee nahi de sakta.

actions.en: If you are a groom or a parent, say aloud that you want no 'proof'. The demand ends when the people it is staged for refuse it.
actions.hg: Agar tum dulha ho ya parent ho, toh saaf bolo ki tumhe koi 'proof' nahi chahiye. Yeh demand tab khatam hoti hai jab woh log mana kar dein jinke liye yeh tamasha hota hai.

title.en: Who decides about your body? Indian law from the MTP Act of 1971 to the reversal of 2026
title.hg: Tumhari body ka faisla kaun karta hai? 1971 ke MTP Act se 2026 ke reversal tak Indian law

dek.en: In 1971 the answer was a doctor's opinion and a married woman's contraception. Since then most new freedoms over the body have been won in the Supreme Court, slowly, and in 2026 Parliament took one back with a bill it passed within 12 days.
dek.hg: 1971 mein jawaab tha doctor ki opinion aur married woman ka contraception. Tab se body par zyada tar nayi azaadiyan Supreme Court mein jeeti gayi hain, dheere-dheere, aur 2026 mein Parliament ne ek azaadi wapas le li, aise bill se jo usne 12 din ke andar pass kar diya.

label.en: the 1971 MTP Act's upper limit for an abortion; after 12 weeks, two doctors had to agree
label.hg: 1971 ke MTP Act mein abortion ki upper limit; 12 hafte ke baad do doctors ka raazi hona zaroori tha

label.en: from introduction to passage in Parliament for the 2026 amendment that ended self-identification of gender
label.hg: Parliament mein introduce hone se pass hone tak lage, us 2026 amendment ko jisne gender ka self-identification khatam kiya

label.en: girls' school toilets neither built nor under construction, of 39,439 identified as needing to be made functional (Centre's figures, September 2026 hearing)
label.hg: schools ke girls' toilets na bane the, na ban rahe the, un 39,439 mein se jinhe functional banane ki zaroorat pehchaani gayi (Centre ke figures, September 2026 hearing)

actions.en: If you are an adult, an abortion needs only your consent under the MTP Act. No husband, parent or in-law has to sign.
actions.hg: Agar tum adult ho, toh MTP Act mein abortion ke liye sirf tumhari consent chahiye. Kisi husband, parent ya sasural wale ko sign nahi karna.

actions.en: Unmarried and pregnant? Since September 2022 you have the same access to abortion as a married woman, including between 20 and 24 weeks.
actions.hg: Unmarried ho aur pregnant ho? September 2022 se tumhe abortion ka wahi access hai jo married woman ko, 20 se 24 hafte ke beech bhi.

actions.en: Know that the two-finger test is banned: the Supreme Court has said anyone who conducts it in breach of its directions is guilty of misconduct.
actions.hg: Jaan lo ki two-finger test banned hai: Supreme Court ne kaha hai ki jo bhi uske directions tod kar yeh test kare, woh misconduct ka doshi hoga.

actions.en: If you hold a transgender certificate or ID card issued under the 2019 Act, keep it safe: the Union told the Supreme Court these cards continue while the challenge is heard.
actions.hg: Agar tumhare paas 2019 Act ke under bana transgender certificate ya ID card hai, toh use sambhal kar rakho: Union ne Supreme Court ko bataya hai ki challenge ki sunwai chalne tak yeh cards chalte rahenge.

actions.en: Ask your school, or your child's school, what it has done since January 2026 about free pads, working toilets with water and safe disposal.
actions.hg: Apne school se, ya apne bachche ke school se, poocho ki January 2026 ke baad usne free pads, paani wale working toilets aur safe disposal ke liye kya kiya hai.

title.en: Clitoris, cervix, prostate: the body parts biology lessons skip, and what not knowing them costs
title.hg: Clitoris, cervix, prostate: woh body parts jo biology ki class skip kar deti hai, aur unhe na jaanne ki keemat

dek.en: Reproduction is the chapter families skip and many classrooms rush. Few Indians are told plainly where the clitoris is, what the cervix does or what the prostate is for. The gap shows up later as missed cancer screening, pain nobody can describe and children without words for what happened to them.
dek.hg: Reproduction woh chapter hai jo families skip karti hain aur bahut si classrooms jaldi-jaldi nipta deti hain. Bahut kam Indians ko saaf-saaf bataya jaata hai ki clitoris kahan hota hai, cervix kya karta hai ya prostate kis kaam ka hai. Yeh gap baad mein missed cancer screening, aise dard jise koi describe nahi kar paata, aur un bachchon ki shakal mein dikhta hai jinke paas apne saath hui baat batane ke shabd nahi hote.

label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ne kabhi cervical cancer screening test karwaya tha (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.hg: India ke cervical cancer cases HPV types 16 aur 18 se jude hain

label.hg: cervical cancer deaths India mein 2024 mein, latest GLOBOCAN estimate ke hisaab se

label.hg: women ki high-performance test se screening 35 saal tak aur 45 tak dobara: 2030 ke liye cervical cancer par WHO ka target

claim.en: Teaching young people the real names and workings of their sexual body parts will make them have sex earlier.
claim.hg: Young logon ko unke sexual body parts ke asli naam aur kaam sikhane se woh jaldi sex karne lagenge.

truth.en: The UN's technical guidance on sexuality education, revised in 2018, states that it does not increase sexual activity, sexual risk-taking or STI/HIV infection rates.
truth.hg: Sexuality education par UN ki technical guidance, jo 2018 mein revise hui, kehti hai ki isse sexual activity, sexual risk-taking ya STI/HIV infection rates nahi badhte.

actions.en: Learn the real names and use them: vulva, vagina, clitoris, cervix, uterus; penis, scrotum, testicles, prostate.
actions.hg: Asli naam seekho aur use karo: vulva, vagina, clitoris, cervix, uterus; penis, scrotum, testicles, prostate.

actions.en: Teach children the correct words for their body parts in an ordinary voice, so they can tell you exactly where it hurts or what someone did.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko unke body parts ke sahi shabd normal awaaz mein sikhao, taaki woh tumhe theek-theek bata sakein ki dard kahan hai ya kisi ne kya kiya.

actions.en: Ask a gynaecologist or your nearest government health centre when you should start cervical screening, and go.
actions.hg: Kisi gynaecologist ya apne sabse paas ke government health centre se poochho ki tumhe cervical screening kab shuru karni chahiye, aur jao.

actions.en: If your daughter is 14, ask at a government health facility about the free HPV vaccine.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari beti 14 saal ki hai, toh government health facility mein free HPV vaccine ke baare mein poochho.

actions.en: Before a doctor's visit, write down the part, the feeling, since when, and what you have already tried.
actions.hg: Doctor ke paas jaane se pehle likh lo: kaun sa part, kaisa feel hota hai, kab se, aur tum ab tak kya try kar chuke ho.

title.en: The Supreme Court wants boys taught about periods: what every brother, classmate and boyfriend should know
title.hg: Supreme Court chahta hai ki boys ko periods ke baare mein padhaya jaaye: har bhai, classmate aur boyfriend ko kya pata hona chahiye

dek.en: The January 2026 judgment that made menstrual health part of the right to life also told schools to sensitise boys and male teachers. Here are straight answers to the questions boys are too embarrassed to ask.
dek.hg: Jis January 2026 ke judgment ne menstrual health ko right to life ka hissa bataya, usi ne schools se boys aur male teachers ko bhi sensitise karne ko kaha. Yahan un sawaalon ke seedhe jawab hain jo boys poochhne mein sharmaate hain.

label.en: of adolescent girls in India had been told about periods before their first one (2016 review; estimate pooled from 88 of its 138 studies)
label.hg: India ki adolescent ladkiyon ko pehle period se pehle iske baare mein bataya gaya tha (2016 ka review; uski 138 mein se 88 studies par based estimate)

label.en: of adolescent girls reported missing school during their periods (same review)
label.hg: adolescent ladkiyon ne bataya ki periods ke dauraan unka school chhoota (usi review mein)

label.en: of women aged 15-24 used cloth during their periods in 2019-21
label.hg: 15-24 saal ki women 2019-21 mein periods mein kapda use karti thi

claim.en: Teaching boys about periods and bodies will make them think about sex too early.
claim.hg: Boys ko periods aur body ke baare mein bataoge, toh woh bahut jaldi sex ke baare mein sochne lagenge.

truth.en: UNESCO's guidance, built on reviews of the evidence, states that sexuality education does not increase sexual activity or risk-taking, and that curriculum-based programmes contribute to later first sex and more condom and contraceptive use.
truth.hg: Evidence reviews par bani UNESCO ki guidance kehti hai ki sexuality education se na sexual activity badhti hai, na risk-taking. Curriculum-based programmes pehla sex der se hone aur condom aur contraception ke zyada use mein contribute karte hain.

actions.en: If you notice a stain, tell her quietly and offer a jacket or sweater. Never announce it, photograph it or forward anything.
actions.hg: Stain dikhe, toh use chupchaap batao aur apni jacket ya sweater do. Na announce karo, na photo lo, na kuch forward karo.

actions.en: Buy pads for your sister or mother without hiding them or making a joke of it.
actions.hg: Behen ya maa ke liye pads khareedo, bina chhupaye aur bina mazaak banaye.

actions.en: Call out period jokes in your class or group chat, even when nobody else does.
actions.hg: Class ya group chat mein period jokes hon, toh tok do, chahe koi aur na toke.

actions.en: If her pain stops her normal day, back her in seeing a doctor instead of telling her to bear it.
actions.hg: Agar dard ki wajah se uska normal din ruk jaata hai, toh 'seh lo' kehne ki jagah doctor ke paas jaane mein uska saath do.

actions.en: Ask your school how it is sensitising boys about periods, as the Supreme Court directed.
actions.hg: Apne school se poocho ki Supreme Court ke direction ke hisaab se woh boys ko periods ke baare mein kaise sensitise kar raha hai.

title.en: Breasts and chests, explained: uneven growth, size anxiety, stretch marks and the chest swelling teenage boys hide
title.hg: Breasts aur chest, seedhi baat: uneven growth, size ki tension, stretch marks aur ladkon ki woh chest swelling jo woh chhupate hain

dek.en: Breasts take years to grow and are rarely a matched pair. Many boys' chests swell in puberty too. Nobody explains either, yet knowing your own normal early is the habit that later helps catch India's most common cancer in women.
dek.hg: Breasts ko grow hone mein saalon lagte hain aur dono kabhi ek jaise nahi hote. Puberty mein bahut se ladkon ki chest bhi swell hoti hai. Koi kuch nahi batata, jabki apna normal jaldi samajhna hi woh aadat hai jo aage chalkar Indian women ke sabse common cancer ko time par pakadne mein help karti hai.

label.en: estimated new breast cancer cases in India in 2024
label.hg: India mein 2024 mein breast cancer ke estimated naye cases

label.en: share of all cancers in Indian women that are breast cancer (2024)
label.hg: Indian women ke saare cancers mein breast cancer ka hissa (2024)

label.en: of women aged 15-49 had ever had a breast cancer screening test (2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ne kabhi breast cancer screening test karwaya tha (2019-21)

actions.en: If one breast is growing faster or feels tender, wait and watch: uneven growth is normal in puberty.
actions.hg: Agar ek breast tezi se badh raha hai ya dukhta hai, toh ghabrao mat, thoda wait karo: puberty mein uneven growth normal hai.

actions.en: Learn how your breasts or chest usually look and feel, and see a doctor about a new lump, skin dimpling, a nipple that newly turns inward or bloody discharge.
actions.hg: Apne breasts ya chest ka normal look aur feel samjho, aur naya lump, skin mein gaddha, achanak andar mudta nipple ya khoon wala discharge dikhe toh doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: Boys: chest swelling in puberty is common and usually settles. See a doctor if it is hard, on one side only, growing fast or still there after puberty.
actions.hg: Ladkon: puberty mein chest swelling common hai aur aksar apne aap theek ho jaati hai. Agar lump hard ho, sirf ek side ho, tezi se badh raha ho ya puberty ke baad bhi rahe, toh doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: Wear a well-fitted sports bra for running and games instead of quitting sport.
actions.hg: Running aur games ke liye sahi fit wali sports bra pehno, sport chhodo mat.

actions.en: Never mock a classmate's chest. That joke is why boys hide in two vests and girls stop playing.
actions.hg: Kisi classmate ki chest ka mazaak kabhi mat udao. Isi mazaak ki wajah se ladke garmi mein do baniyan pehente hain aur ladkiyan khelna chhod deti hain.

title.en: 49.6% of young Indian women used cloth during their periods. The real hygiene problem is water, soap and privacy
title.hg: 49.6% young Indian women periods mein cloth use karti thi. Asli hygiene problem paani, sabun aur privacy ki hai

dek.en: India's biggest health survey does not count cloth as a 'hygienic' method. But clean cloth, washed with soap and dried in the sun, can be safe. What makes a period unsafe is no water, no soap and no private place to wash and dry.
dek.hg: India ka sabse bada health survey cloth ko 'hygienic' method nahi maanta. Par sabun se dhula aur dhoop mein sukha saaf kapda safe ho sakta hai. Period ko unsafe banati hai paani, sabun aur dhone-sukhane ki private jagah ki kami.

statLabel.hg: 15-24 saal ki women periods mein cloth use karti thi (2019-21)

label.hg: 15-24 saal ki women 2019-21 mein periods ke dauraan cloth use karti thi

label.hg: schools mein girls' toilets ki kami abhi bhi baaki, kul 39,439 mein se (Centre ka affidavit, August 2026)

claim.en: Cloth is dirty. A girl who uses cloth during her period is putting her health at risk.
claim.hg: Kapda ganda hota hai. Periods mein cloth use karne wali ladki apni health risk mein daal rahi hai.

truth.en: Clean cotton cloth, washed with soap and clean water and dried completely, can be used safely. The real risks are no water, no soap, no privacy and cloth hidden away to dry in the dark.
truth.hg: Cotton ka kapda agar sabun aur saaf paani se dhokar poori tarah sukhaya jaye, toh safely use ho sakta hai. Asli risk hai paani na hona, sabun na hona, privacy na hona, aur kapde ko chhupakar andhere mein sukhana.

actions.en: If you use cloth, wash it with soap and clean water and dry it completely, in sunlight if you can.
actions.hg: Agar tum cloth use karti ho, toh use sabun aur saaf paani se dho kar poora sukhao, ho sake toh dhoop mein.

actions.en: Change cloth whenever it feels wet, keep clean pieces in a clean dry bag, and replace cloth that turns thin, hard or smelly.
actions.hg: Kapda geela lage toh badal lo, saaf kapde ek saaf sookhi thaili mein rakho, aur patla, sakht ya badboo wala kapda replace kar do.

actions.en: Never share period cloth. See a doctor or health worker for itching, a bad smell, unusual discharge or burning while passing urine.
actions.hg: Period ka kapda kabhi share mat karo. Khujli, badboo, ajeeb discharge ya peshaab mein jalan ho toh doctor ya health worker ko dikhao.

actions.en: At home, make space for period cloth to dry in the open sun. A drying line is not something to be ashamed of.
actions.hg: Ghar pe period ke kapde ko khuli dhoop mein sukhane ki jagah do. Dhoop mein sookhta kapda sharam ki baat nahi hai.

actions.en: Ask your school whether the girls' toilet works, locks and has water, soap and a bin. The Supreme Court has ordered toilets with water in every school.
actions.hg: Apne school se poocho: kya girls' toilet chalu hai, lock hota hai, aur usme paani, sabun aur dustbin hai? Supreme Court ne har school mein paani wale toilet ka order diya hai.

title.en: Gori, patli, lambi: how the family habit of grading bodies turns into a mental-health problem
title.hg: Gori, patli, lambi: bodies ko grade karne ki family wali aadat kaise mental-health problem ban jaati hai

dek.en: Indian families grade skin, weight and height like marks on a report card. The comments start at home, an industry sells the cure, and the cost shows up as anxiety, depression and eating disorders that too often go untreated.
dek.hg: Indian families skin, weight aur height ko report card ke marks ki tarah grade karti hain. Comments ghar se shuru hote hain, ek industry uska 'ilaaj' bechti hai, aur keemat anxiety, depression aur eating disorders ke roop mein chukani padti hai, jinka aksar ilaaj hi nahi hota.

statLabel.hg: Indians ko (survey ka estimate: 'nearly 150 million') mental-health care ki zaroorat thi; 30 million se kam log care dhoondh rahe the (2015-16)

label.hg: Indians ko (survey ka estimate: 'nearly 150 million') 2015-16 mein mental-health care ki zaroorat thi; 30 million se kam log care dhoondh rahe the

label.hg: India mein mental disorders ka treatment gap (2015-16)

claim.en: Eating disorders only happen to thin, rich teenage girls.
claim.hg: Eating disorders sirf patli, ameer teenage ladkiyon ko hote hain.

truth.en: Anyone can develop an eating disorder, whatever their age, gender, background or body size, and many people with one do not look underweight.
truth.hg: Eating disorder kisi ko bhi ho sakta hai, chahe age, gender, background ya body size kuch bhi ho, aur jin logon ko yeh hota hai unme se bahut underweight dikhte bhi nahi.

actions.en: Stop commenting on anyone's skin, weight or height, including as a 'joke' or out of 'concern'.
actions.hg: Kisi ki bhi skin, weight ya height par comment karna band karo, 'mazaak' mein bhi aur 'fikar' ke naam par bhi.

actions.en: If a relative comments on your body, say: 'Please don't talk about my body. Ask me how I am instead.'
actions.hg: Agar koi rishtedaar tumhari body par comment kare, toh kaho: 'Please meri body ke baare mein baat mat kijiye. Uski jagah mera haal pooch lijiye.'

actions.en: Never put a child on a diet or a fairness cream, and use steroid creams only on a doctor's prescription.
actions.hg: Bachche ko kabhi diet ya fairness cream par mat daalo, aur steroid creams sirf doctor ke prescription par use karo.

actions.en: Watch for constant worry about weight, skipped meals, eating in secret or compulsive exercise, and see a doctor early.
actions.hg: Weight ki lagataar chinta, meals skip karna, chhupkar khaana ya compulsive exercise jaise signs par nazar rakho, aur jaldi doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: If shame about your body is affecting your sleep, food or studies, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and open round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar apni body ko lekar sharm tumhari neend, khaane ya padhai par asar daal rahi hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call karo; free hai aur din-raat khula hai.

title.en: Four to 12 years to a diagnosis: why endometriosis pain is still dismissed as 'normal'
title.hg: Diagnosis mein 4 se 12 saal: endometriosis ka dard aaj bhi 'normal' bol kar kyun taal diya jaata hai

dek.en: WHO estimates that endometriosis affects 10% of women of reproductive age and takes 4 to 12 years to diagnose. In India, girls are told the pain is normal or will settle after marriage. Here is what the disease is, which pain is not normal, and how to make a doctor take it seriously.
dek.hg: WHO ka estimate hai ki reproductive age ki 10% women ko endometriosis hai, aur iska diagnosis hone mein 4 se 12 saal lag jaate hain. India mein ladkiyon ko bola jaata hai ki dard normal hai, shaadi ke baad theek ho jayega. Jaano yeh bimaari kya hai, kaunsa dard normal nahi hai, aur doctor se apni baat seriously kaise sunwao.

statLabel.en: average time to an endometriosis diagnosis (WHO)
statLabel.hg: endometriosis ka diagnosis hone mein lagne wala average time (WHO)

label.en: average time to an endometriosis diagnosis (WHO, 2025)
label.hg: endometriosis ka diagnosis hone mein lagne wala average time (WHO, 2025)

label.en: of women of reproductive age worldwide have endometriosis, about 190 million (WHO estimate)
label.hg: duniya bhar mein reproductive age ki women ko endometriosis hai, lagbhag 190 million (WHO estimate)

label.en: adults worldwide experience infertility in their lifetime (WHO, 2023)
label.hg: adults duniya bhar mein life mein kabhi na kabhi infertility face karte hain (WHO, 2023)

label.en: of adolescent girls in India had been told about periods before their first one (2016 review)
label.hg: India ki adolescent girls ko pehla period aane se pehle iske baare mein bataya gaya tha (2016 review)

claim.en: Period pain is normal for every girl, and it will settle after marriage or a baby.
claim.hg: Period ka dard toh har ladki ko hota hai, shaadi ya baby ke baad theek ho jayega.

truth.en: Mild cramps are common, but pain that stops normal life is not normal and can be a sign of endometriosis. Marriage does not treat it, and a pregnancy is not a cure.
truth.hg: Halke cramps common hain, par jo dard normal life rok de woh normal nahi hai aur endometriosis ka sign ho sakta hai. Shaadi iska ilaaj nahi hai, aur pregnancy bhi ise cure nahi karti.

actions.en: Keep a pain diary for two cycles: the days that hurt, a score out of ten, what you missed and what you took.
actions.hg: Do cycles tak pain diary rakho: kin dinon dard hua, das mein se kitna, kya miss hua aur kaunsi dawa li.

actions.en: Tell the doctor plainly: 'This pain stops my normal life. I want it investigated.' Ask whether it could be endometriosis.
actions.hg: Doctor ko saaf bolo: 'Yeh dard meri normal life rok deta hai. Main chahti hoon ki iski jaanch ho.' Poocho ki kahin yeh endometriosis toh nahi.

actions.en: If you are told it will settle after marriage or a baby, get a second opinion from a gynaecologist. A government hospital's gynaecology OPD is a low-cost place to start.
actions.hg: Agar bola jaye ki shaadi ya baby ke baad theek ho jayega, toh kisi gynaecologist se second opinion lo. Government hospital ki gynae OPD low-cost mein achhi shuruaat hai.

actions.en: Ignore ads that promise to fix period problems. Advertising such medicines is banned under the 1954 Drugs and Magic Remedies Act.
actions.hg: Period problems 'theek' karne ka daava karne wale ads pe bharosa mat karo. 1954 ke Drugs and Magic Remedies Act ke under aisi dawaon ka ad illegal hai.

actions.en: Go to a hospital the same day if pain comes with fainting, fever or very heavy bleeding.
actions.hg: Agar dard ke saath behoshi, bukhaar ya bahut zyada bleeding ho, toh usi din hospital jao.

title.en: A first period is not a wedding signal: one in five women aged 20-24 was married as a child, and teenage bodies pay the price
title.hg: Pehla period shaadi ka signal nahi hai: 20-24 saal ki har paanch mein se ek aurat ki shaadi bachpan mein hui, aur keemat teenage body chukati hai

dek.en: A first period means a hormone cycle has begun. It does not mean a girl has finished growing, and it changes nothing in law. India's surveys show what follows when families read it as 'ready'.
dek.hg: Pehle period ka matlab hai ki ek hormone cycle shuru hui hai. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki ladki ki growth poori ho gayi, aur kanoon mein isse kuch nahi badalta. India ke surveys dikhate hain ki jab families ise 'ready' samajh leti hain, tab kya hota hai.

statLabel.en: of women aged 20-24 were married before 18 (NFHS-6, 2023-24)
statLabel.hg: 20-24 saal ki women ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui thi (NFHS-6, 2023-24)

label.en: of women aged 20-24 were married before 18 (NFHS-6, 2023-24, provisional)
label.hg: 20-24 saal ki women ki shaadi 18 se pehle hui thi (NFHS-6, 2023-24, provisional)

label.en: of women aged 15-19 were already mothers or pregnant (NFHS-6, 2023-24)
label.hg: 15-19 saal ki women pehle se maa ban chuki thi ya pregnant thi (NFHS-6, 2023-24)

label.en: of 19-year-olds had begun childbearing (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 19 saal ki ladkiyon ki childbearing shuru ho chuki thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of married women aged 15-19 used any contraceptive method (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-19 saal ki shaadi-shuda women koi bhi contraceptive method use karti thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: Once a girl gets her period, her body is ready for marriage and motherhood.
claim.hg: Ladki ko period aa gaya, matlab uski body shaadi aur maa banne ke liye ready hai.

truth.en: A first period only means the monthly cycle has started. Her body is still growing, a marriage before 18 is a child marriage, and sex with a wife under 18 is rape in law.
truth.hg: Pehle period ka matlab sirf itna hai ki monthly cycle shuru ho gayi. Uski body abhi bhi badh rahi hai, 18 se pehle ki shaadi child marriage hai, aur 18 se kam umar ki patni ke saath sex kanoon mein rape hai.

actions.en: Treat a first period as a health event: explain it, hand over pads and keep her in school.
actions.hg: Pehle period ko health event ki tarah lo: use samjhao, pads do aur uska school chalu rakho.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 is about to be married, call Child Helpline 1098 or 112 before the wedding date. You do not have to be family: a friend, teacher or neighbour can call.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki ki shaadi hone wali hai, toh shaadi ki date se pehle Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call karo. Family ka hona zaroori nahi: dost, teacher ya padosi bhi call kar sakte hain.

actions.en: Report a planned child marriage to the district Child Marriage Prohibition Officer or the police. A magistrate can issue an order to stop it.
actions.hg: Planned child marriage ki report district ke Child Marriage Prohibition Officer ya police ko do. Magistrate use rokne ka order de sakta hai.

actions.en: If you were married as a child, ask the District Legal Services Authority about annulment before you turn 20, or call Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari shaadi bachpan mein hui thi, toh 20 saal ki hone se pehle District Legal Services Authority se annulment ke baare mein poochho, ya Women Helpline 181 par call karo.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 is pregnant, take her to a registered doctor or a government hospital, never to an unqualified provider or a chemist.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki pregnant hai, toh use registered doctor ya sarkari hospital le jao, kisi unqualified provider ya chemist ke paas kabhi nahi.

title.en: The first time: no test can prove it, there may be no blood, and pregnancy is possible
title.hg: First time: koi test ise prove nahi kar sakta, blood aana zaroori nahi, aur pregnancy ho sakti hai

dek.en: Blood on the sheet, pain as proof, a body that 'shows', a first time that cannot cause pregnancy: the script Indians inherit about first sex is wrong at every step. For adult readers, here is what bodies actually do, what the law calls consent, and how to prepare.
dek.hg: Bedsheet par blood, pain as proof, body jo 'bata deti hai', aur first time jisme pregnancy 'ho hi nahi sakti': first sex ke baare mein Indians ko jo script virasat mein milti hai, woh har step par galat hai. Adult readers ke liye: bodies asal mein kya karti hain, law consent kise kehta hai, aur tayyari kaise karein.

statLabel.en: estimated pregnancies in India in 2015, nearly half of them unintended
statLabel.hg: 2015 mein India mein estimated pregnancies, jinmein se lagbhag aadhi unintended thi

label.en: estimated pregnancies in India in 2015; nearly half were unintended
label.hg: 2015 mein India mein estimated pregnancies; lagbhag aadhi unintended thi

label.en: of young women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom in 2019-21, against 87.3% of young men
label.hg: 15-24 saal ki young women jinhe 2019-21 mein pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai; young men mein yeh 87.3% tha

label.en: of men aged 15-49 agreed that contraception is women's business and a man should not have to worry about it (2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ke men jo maante the ki contraception women ka kaam hai aur man ko iski tension nahi leni chahiye (2019-21)

claim.en: A woman always bleeds the first time, and a partner or a doctor can tell whether she has had sex before.
claim.hg: First time par woman ko hamesha bleeding hoti hai, aur partner ya doctor bata sakta hai ki usne pehle sex kiya hai ya nahi.

truth.en: Many women do not bleed. The hymen cannot show whether someone has had sex, and the Supreme Court said in 2022 that the two-finger test 'has no scientific basis'.
truth.hg: Bahut si women ko bleeding nahi hoti. Hymen yeh nahi dikha sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi, aur Supreme Court ne 2022 mein kaha ki two-finger test 'has no scientific basis', yaani iska koi scientific aadhaar nahi hai.

actions.en: Talk before you undress: what each of you wants and does not want, which contraception you will use, and that either of you can stop at any point.
actions.hg: Kapde utaarne se pehle baat karo: dono kya chahte ho aur kya nahi, kaun sa contraception use hoga, aur yeh ki dono mein se koi bhi kabhi bhi ruk sakta hai.

actions.en: Buy condoms beforehand, check the expiry date and use one from start to finish. Pulling out is not protection.
actions.hg: Condoms pehle se khareed lo, expiry date check karo, aur shuru se end tak use karo. Pull out karna protection nahi hai.

actions.en: Stop if it hurts. Go slower, use a water-based lubricant, and see a gynaecologist if penetration is painful every time.
actions.hg: Dard ho toh ruk jao. Slow karo, water-based lubricant use karo, aur agar har baar penetration mein pain ho toh gynaecologist ko dikhao.

actions.en: If a condom breaks or was not used, take emergency contraception as early as possible within 5 days, and get tested for infections.
actions.hg: Agar condom phat jaaye ya use hi na hua ho, toh 5 din ke andar jitna jaldi ho sake emergency contraception lo, aur infections ka test karwao.

actions.en: Refuse any 'virginity test' or bedsheet check for yourself or anyone else: no examination can show whether a person has had sex.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi 'virginity test' ya bedsheet check ko mana karo, apne liye bhi aur kisi aur ke liye bhi: koi examination yeh nahi dikha sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi.

title.en: Freezing is not consent, and neither is arousal: what bodies do under threat, and what Indian law has said since 2013
title.hg: Freeze ho jaana consent nahi hai, aur arousal bhi nahi: threat mein body kya karti hai, aur 2013 se Indian law kya kehta hai

dek.en: Many survivors blame themselves because they went still, stayed silent, or because their body responded. These are reflexes, not decisions. Indian law has said since 2013 that not resisting is not agreeing. The new penal code repeats it, and still has no rape offence for adult men.
dek.hg: Bahut se survivors khud ko blame karte hain kyunki woh hil nahi paaye, chup rahe, ya unki body ne respond kiya. Yeh reflexes hain, decisions nahi. 2013 se Indian law kehta hai ki resist na karna agree karna nahi hai. Naya penal code bhi yahi dohrata hai, par adult men ke liye usme aaj bhi rape ka koi offence nahi hai.

label.en: the year the Supreme Court acquitted two policemen accused of custodial rape, noting no injuries on the girl and calling the alleged intercourse 'a peaceful affair'
label.hg: is saal Supreme Court ne custodial rape ke aaropi do policewalon ko bari kiya; court ne note kiya ki ladki par chot ka nishaan nahi tha aur kathit intercourse ko 'a peaceful affair' kaha

label.en: the year Parliament wrote into law that a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting
label.hg: is saal Parliament ne law mein likha ki jo woman physically resist nahi karti, use sirf is wajah se consenting nahi maana jaayega

label.en: the outer limit for starting medicine that prevents HIV after an assault; sooner is better
label.hg: assault ke baad HIV rokne wali medicine shuru karne ki aakhri limit; jitna jaldi, utna better

claim.en: If you did not scream or fight, or if your body responded, some part of you must have wanted it.
claim.hg: Agar tum chillaye nahi, lade nahi, ya tumhari body ne respond kiya, toh kahin na kahin tum yahi chahte the.

truth.en: Freezing and physical arousal are automatic reactions of the nervous system. Indian law has said since 2013 that not physically resisting is not, by itself, consent.
truth.hg: Freeze ho jaana aur physical arousal, dono nervous system ke automatic reactions hain. 2013 se Indian law kehta hai ki physically resist na karna, sirf is wajah se, consent nahi hai.

actions.en: If you froze or your body responded during an assault, say this to yourself as often as you need to: it was a reflex, not consent, and not your fault.
actions.hg: Agar assault ke dauraan tum freeze ho gaye ya tumhari body ne respond kiya, toh khud se jitni baar zaroorat ho utni baar kaho: yeh reflex tha, consent nahi, aur meri galti nahi.

actions.en: Get medical care even if you have no injuries: HIV-prevention medicine must start within 72 hours and emergency contraception works for up to 5 days.
actions.hg: Chot na ho tab bhi medical care lo: HIV rokne wali medicine 72 hours ke andar shuru honi chahiye, aur emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karti hai.

actions.en: You do not need marks, torn clothes or a witness to report. Any police station must record a rape complaint, wherever it happened.
actions.hg: Report karne ke liye nishaan, phate kapde ya gawah zaroori nahi. Koi bhi police station rape complaint record karega, chahe ghatna kahin bhi hui ho.

actions.en: When someone tells you they were assaulted, never ask 'why didn't you shout?' Say 'I believe you' and 'it was not your fault'.
actions.hg: Jab koi bataye ki uske saath assault hua, toh kabhi mat poochho 'chillaye kyun nahi?' Kaho 'main tumhari baat maanta/maanti hoon' aur 'tumhari galti nahi thi'.

actions.en: If the shame or the memories will not let go, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and open round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar sharm ya yaadein peecha nahi chhod rahi, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call karo. Yeh free hai aur chaubees ghante khula hai.

title.en: Is my body normal? Vulvas, penises, intersex variations, and the porn template nobody should measure against
title.hg: Kya meri body normal hai? Vulva, penis, intersex variations, aur porn ka woh template jisse kisi ko khud ko naapna nahi chahiye

dek.en: Genitals vary as much as faces, but many young Indians have never been shown an honest, labelled picture of a real body. Porn fills the gap, and a market of banned advertisements sells the 'cure'. Here is the actual range, and the short list of things that do need a doctor.
dek.hg: Genitals utne hi alag-alag hote hain jitne chehre, lekin bahut se young Indians ko kabhi kisi real body ki honest, labelled picture dikhayi hi nahi gayi. Yeh gap porn bharta hai, aur banned advertisements ka ek market 'ilaaj' bechta hai. Yahan asli range hai, aur un cheezon ki chhoti si list jinke liye sach mein doctor chahiye.

label.en: year India banned advertisements for drugs that promise to improve 'the capacity of human beings for sexual pleasure'
label.hg: is saal India ne un drugs ke ads ban kiye jo 'the capacity of human beings for sexual pleasure' badhane ka promise karte hain

label.en: maximum jail term on a first conviction under that Act; the Supreme Court said in 2025 that it is not implemented 'in its true letter and spirit'
label.hg: tak ki jail, us Act ke under pehli conviction par; Supreme Court ne 2025 mein kaha ki yeh Act 'in its true letter and spirit' implement nahi ho raha

label.en: year the Supreme Court said it could not stop an adult from watching pornography in private
label.hg: is saal Supreme Court ne kaha ki woh kisi adult ko private mein pornography dekhne se nahi rok sakta

claim.en: If my genitals do not look like the ones in porn, something is wrong with me.
claim.hg: Agar mere genitals porn wale genitals jaise nahi dikhte, toh mujhme kuch gadbad hai.

truth.en: Porn shows a narrow, selected and often altered set of bodies. Healthy vulvas, penises and testicles differ widely in size, shape, colour and symmetry, and intersex variations are part of the same natural range.
truth.hg: Porn bodies ka ek chhota, chuna hua aur aksar altered set dikhata hai. Healthy vulva, penis aur testicles size, shape, colour aur symmetry mein bahut alag-alag hote hain, aur intersex variations bhi isi natural range ka hissa hain.

actions.en: Stop using porn as a measuring tape: the bodies in it are selected, posed, lit, edited and sometimes surgically altered.
actions.hg: Porn ko measuring tape ki tarah use karna band karo: usme dikhne wali bodies chuni hui, posed, lit, edited aur kabhi-kabhi surgery se badli hui hoti hain.

actions.en: Wash the vulva on the outside only, with water. Do not wash inside the vagina or use scented washes and sprays.
actions.hg: Vulva ko sirf bahar se, paani se dho. Vagina ke andar mat dho, aur scented washes ya sprays use mat karo.

actions.en: Do not buy enlargement oils, pumps, 'tightening' gels or 'sex power' capsules. None of them changes anatomy.
actions.hg: Enlargement oils, pumps, 'tightening' gels ya 'sex power' capsules mat khareedo. Inme se koi bhi anatomy nahi badalta.

actions.en: See a doctor for pain, a new lump, sores, unusual discharge or a tight, painful foreskin. Sudden severe testicle pain is an emergency: go to hospital at once.
actions.hg: Dard, naya lump, sores, unusual discharge ya tight, dard wali foreskin ho toh doctor ko dikhao. Testicle mein achanak tez dard emergency hai: turant hospital jao.

actions.en: If worry about your body takes up hours of your day, talk to someone you trust or call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Agar apni body ki chinta din ke ghante kha rahi hai, toh kisi bharose wale insaan se baat karo ya Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo.

title.en: India does not know how many women have endometriosis: the blind spots in what the state measures about women's bodies
title.hg: India ko pata hi nahi ki kitni women ko endometriosis hai: women ki bodies ke baare mein state jo ginta hai, uske blind spots

dek.en: India can say, to one decimal place, how many young women in Bihar use hygienic period protection. It cannot say how many women live with endometriosis, how common PCOS really is, or how a 35-year-old manages her period. What is counted gets a policy. What is not counted stays a private problem.
dek.hg: India ek decimal tak bata sakta hai ki Bihar mein kitni young women hygienic period protection use karti hain. Par yeh nahi bata sakta ki kitni women endometriosis ke saath jee rahi hain, PCOS asal mein kitna common hai, ya 35 saal ki woman apna period kaise manage karti hai. Jo gina jaata hai, uske liye policy banti hai. Jo nahi gina jaata, woh ghar ki private problem bana rehta hai.

label.en: average wait for an endometriosis diagnosis worldwide, says WHO; India has no reliable national estimate of the disease
label.hg: WHO ke hisaab se duniya bhar mein endometriosis ke diagnosis mein average itna time lagta hai; India ke paas is bimari ka koi reliable national estimate nahi hai

label.en: PCOS prevalence in India's national study (2024), depending on which diagnostic criteria were applied
label.hg: India ki national study (2024) mein PCOS prevalence, is par depend karta hai ki kaun sa diagnostic criteria lagaya gaya

label.en: the only age group for which NFHS-5 reports use of hygienic period protection
label.hg: sirf isi age group ke liye NFHS-5 hygienic period protection ka data report karta hai

label.en: of women aged 15-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer in 2019-21
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women jinki 2019-21 tak kabhi cervical cancer screening hui thi

claim.en: If period pain, endometriosis or PCOS were big problems in India, the health data would show it.
claim.hg: Agar period pain, endometriosis ya PCOS India mein sach mein badi problems hoti, toh health data mein dikh jaati.

truth.en: Data cannot show what nobody counts. India has no reliable national estimate of endometriosis, one national PCOS study with three different answers, and period-protection figures only for women aged 15-24.
truth.hg: Jo koi ginta hi nahi, woh data mein dikh nahi sakta. India ke paas endometriosis ka koi reliable national estimate nahi hai, PCOS ki ek national study hai jiske teen alag answers hain, aur period protection ke figures sirf 15-24 saal ki women ke liye hain.

actions.en: Keep your own record for three months: dates, pain, how heavy the bleeding is, and days of school or work missed. Take it to the doctor.
actions.hg: Teen mahine apna record rakho: dates, pain, bleeding kitni heavy hai, aur school ya kaam ke kitne din miss hue. Yeh record doctor ke paas le jao.

actions.en: If pain or irregular periods disrupt your life, ask the doctor directly whether it could be endometriosis or PCOS, and ask for the diagnosis in writing.
actions.hg: Agar pain ya irregular periods tumhari life disturb kar rahe hain, toh doctor se seedha poochho ki kya yeh endometriosis ya PCOS ho sakta hai, aur diagnosis likh kar maango.

actions.en: When you see a PCOS percentage, check which criteria it uses: the same Indian study gives 7.2%, 13.6% and 19.6%.
actions.hg: Jab bhi PCOS ka koi percentage dikhe, check karo ki kaun sa criteria use hua hai: ek hi Indian study 7.2%, 13.6% aur 19.6% teeno deti hai.

actions.en: Do not quote NFHS period-protection figures as 'all Indian women': they cover only women aged 15-24.
actions.hg: NFHS ke period protection figures ko 'saari Indian women' ka data mat bolo: yeh sirf 15-24 saal ki women ko cover karte hain.

actions.en: Ask your college, employer or local health office what they record about women's health beyond pregnancy, and for which ages.
actions.hg: Apne college, employer ya local health office se poochho ki woh pregnancy ke alawa women's health ke baare mein kya record karte hain, aur kis age tak.

title.en: Intimate washes, douching and 'white discharge' panic: what a vagina actually needs
title.hg: Intimate wash, douching aur 'white discharge' ka panic: vagina ko asal mein kya chahiye

dek.en: Ads sell pH washes, mothers warn that 'safed paani' drains strength, and girls decide that itching is their own fault. The vagina cleans itself. Here is what is normal, what needs a doctor, and where a government clinic will check you.
dek.hg: Ads pH wash bechte hain, mummy kehti hain ki 'safed paani' se kamzori aati hai, aur ladkiyan maan leti hain ki khujli unki apni galti hai. Vagina khud ko saaf rakhti hai. Yahan padho kya normal hai, kab doctor ko dikhana hai, aur kaunsa government clinic tumhara check-up karega.

label.en: STI/RTI cases managed by India's AIDS programme in 2024-25
label.hg: STI/RTI cases India ke AIDS programme ne 2024-25 mein manage kiye

label.en: of visits to government Suraksha Clinics in 2024-25 were by women
label.hg: 2024-25 mein government Suraksha Clinics ki visits women ki thi

label.en: government Suraksha Clinics at district hospitals and medical colleges
label.hg: government Suraksha Clinics, district hospitals aur medical colleges mein

label.en: of women aged 15-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ki women ki kabhi cervical cancer screening hui thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: White discharge drains a woman's strength, and a clean vagina needs special washes or washing inside.
claim.hg: White discharge se woman ki taakat beh jaati hai, aur saaf vagina ke liye special wash ya andar se dhona zaroori hai.

truth.en: Clear or white discharge is how the vagina cleans itself. Douching and scented washes disturb its balance and make irritation and infection more likely. A change in colour, smell or texture, or itching, needs a doctor, not a product.
truth.hg: Clear ya white discharge vagina ka khud ko saaf rakhne ka tareeka hai. Douching aur scented washes uska balance bigaadte hain aur irritation aur infection ka chance badhate hain. Colour, smell ya texture badle, ya khujli ho, toh doctor chahiye, koi product nahi.

actions.en: Wash only the outside with plain water, or a mild unscented soap on the outer skin. Do not douche, steam, or use scented washes and sprays.
actions.hg: Sirf bahar ka hissa saade paani se dho, ya bahar ki skin par mild, bina khushboo wala sabun lagao. Douching, steam, scented wash aur spray use mat karo.

actions.en: Learn your normal: clear or white discharge that changes through the month is healthy and does not cause weakness.
actions.hg: Apna normal pehchano: clear ya white discharge jo mahine ke saath badalta hai, healthy hai aur isse kamzori nahi aati.

actions.en: See a doctor if discharge turns yellow, green, grey or curd-like, smells strong or fishy, or comes with itching, burning, sores, pain or fever.
actions.hg: Discharge peela, hara, grey ya dahi jaisa ho jaye, tez ya machhli jaisi smell aaye, ya saath mein khujli, jalan, chhaale, dard ya bukhaar ho, toh doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: Do not treat itching with a cream or tablet that a friend or a chemist suggests. Thrush, bacterial vaginosis and STIs need different medicines.
actions.hg: Khujli ka ilaaj friend ya chemist ki batayi cream ya tablet se mat karo. Thrush, bacterial vaginosis aur STIs ki dawaiyan alag-alag hoti hain.

actions.en: For a check-up, go to the Suraksha Clinic at a government district hospital or, if you are a teenager, an Adolescent Friendly Health Centre. You can ask whether a female doctor is available.
actions.hg: Check-up ke liye government district hospital ke Suraksha Clinic jao, ya agar teenager ho toh Adolescent Friendly Health Centre. Tum pooch sakti ho ki female doctor available hai ya nahi.

title.en: 'Safe days' are not safe: the cycle biology behind the 10.3% of married women relying on traditional methods
title.hg: 'Safe days' safe nahi hote: 10.3% married women traditional methods par depend karti hain, aur iske peeche ki cycle biology

dek.en: About one in ten married women in India relies on counting days or withdrawal, twice the share that uses the pill. The rule assumes a 28-day cycle with the egg released on day 14. Here is what the cycle actually does, phase by phase, and why the calendar fails.
dek.hg: India mein lagbhag har das mein se ek married woman din ginne ya withdrawal par depend karti hai, pill use karne walon se dugna. Yeh rule maanta hai ki cycle 28 din ki hoti hai aur egg day 14 ko release hota hai. Cycle asal mein kya karti hai, phase by phase, aur calendar kyun fail hota hai, yahan samjho.

statLabel.hg: married women 'safe days' ya withdrawal jaise traditional methods par depend karti thi (2019-21)

label.hg: currently married women 'safe days' ya withdrawal jaise traditional methods par depend karti thi (2019-21)

label.hg: yaani withdrawal par depend karne wale har 100 couples mein se lagbhag 20 ke yahan typical use ke ek saal mein pregnancy ho jaati hai (WHO)

claim.en: The first week of the cycle and the week before the next period are 'safe'. If you count properly, you need nothing else.
claim.hg: Cycle ka pehla hafta aur agle period se pehle wala hafta 'safe' hota hai. Theek se gino toh kisi aur cheez ki zaroorat nahi.

truth.en: Ovulation moves from month to month and sperm can survive inside the body for several days, so no calendar day is guaranteed safe. Counting days is not reliable contraception.
truth.hg: Ovulation har mahine aage-peeche hota hai aur sperm body ke andar kai din tak zinda reh sakte hain, isliye calendar ka koi bhi din guaranteed safe nahi hai. Din ginna reliable contraception nahi hai.

actions.en: Do not rely on 'safe days', period sex or withdrawal to prevent a pregnancy. Ovulation moves, and sperm can survive inside the body for several days.
actions.hg: Pregnancy rokne ke liye 'safe days', period sex ya withdrawal par bharosa mat karo. Ovulation aage-peeche hota hai, aur sperm body ke andar kai din tak zinda reh sakte hain.

actions.en: Compare methods by pregnancies per 100 users in a year: fewer than 1 for an IUD, about 7 for the pill, about 13 for the condom, about 20 for withdrawal.
actions.hg: Methods ko is number se compare karo ki ek saal mein har 100 users par kitni pregnancies hoti hain: IUD mein 1 se kam, pill mein lagbhag 7, condom mein lagbhag 13, withdrawal mein lagbhag 20.

actions.en: After unprotected sex, emergency contraception can be used up to 5 days later, and the sooner the better.
actions.hg: Unprotected sex ke baad emergency contraception 5 din tak use ho sakta hai, aur jitni jaldi lo utna behtar.

actions.en: Use a condom whenever there is any chance of infection. It is the only method that also lowers STI risk.
actions.hg: Infection ka zara bhi chance ho toh condom use karo. Yahi ek method hai jo STI ka risk bhi kam karta hai.

actions.en: Keep tracking your cycle for your health, and show the record to a doctor if your periods change.
actions.hg: Apni health ke liye cycle track karte raho, aur periods badlein toh record doctor ko dikhao.

title.en: Barred from kitchens and prayer rooms: menstrual exclusion after the Supreme Court tied periods to the right to dignity
title.hg: Kitchen aur pooja room se bahar: Supreme Court ne periods ko dignity ke right se joda, ab in rules ka jawab dena hoga

dek.en: Keeping girls out of the kitchen, the prayer room or a shared bed during their periods is defended as custom. In 2026 the Supreme Court said menstrual health is part of a dignified life. That turns an old rule into a question every family and school now has to answer.
dek.hg: Periods mein ladkiyon ko kitchen, pooja room ya apne hi bed se door rakhna 'rivaaz' bol kar sahi thehraya jaata hai. 2026 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki menstrual health dignity ke saath jeene ka hissa hai. Ab yeh purana rule ek sawaal ban gaya hai, jiska jawab har family aur har school ko dena hai.

label.en: of adolescent girls in India were kept from religious activities, such as visiting places of worship or praying, during their periods (2016 review of studies)
label.hg: adolescent girls ko periods mein religious kaamon se roka jaata tha, jaise worship ki jagah jaana ya pray karna (2016 review study)

label.en: adolescent girls faced no menstrual restriction at all (2016 review)
label.hg: adolescent girls pe periods mein koi restriction nahi tha (2016 review study)

label.hg: adolescent girls ko pehla period aane se pehle iske baare mein bataya gaya tha (2016 review study)

label.en: of adolescent girls missed school during their periods (2016 review)
label.hg: adolescent girls periods ke dinon mein school miss karti thi (2016 review study)

actions.en: Explain to the elders at home, calmly, that period blood is ordinary blood and tissue and cannot make food, water or a person impure.
actions.hg: Ghar ke badon ko aaram se samjhao ki period ka blood normal blood hi hai, jo uterus ki andar wali layer ke saath nikalta hai. Isse khana, paani ya koi insaan impure nahi hota.

actions.en: Drop one rule this month: let her eat with the family, sleep in her own bed or walk into the kitchen.
actions.hg: Is mahine ek rule hatao: use sabke saath khaane do, apne bed pe sone do ya kitchen mein aane do.

actions.en: Separate faith from shame. Whether to pray during a period can be her own choice, but no one should be made to feel dirty.
actions.hg: Faith aur sharam ko alag rakho. Periods mein pooja ya ibaadat karni hai ya nahi, yeh uska apna decision ho sakta hai. Par kisi ko ganda feel nahi karwana chahiye.

actions.en: Teach brothers and sons what a period is, so that a stain is never a joke.
actions.hg: Bhaiyon aur beton ko batao ki period kya hota hai, taaki kapde pe laga daag kabhi mazaak na bane.

actions.en: If a school sends girls home or keeps them out of class or sport during periods, raise it with the principal and in writing with the District Education Officer.
actions.hg: Agar school periods mein ladkiyon ko ghar bhejta hai ya class aur sports se bahar rakhta hai, toh principal se baat karo aur District Education Officer ko likh kar complaint do.

title.en: Your mother's menopause: what is happening to her body, and why nobody at home talks about it
title.hg: Tumhari mummy ka menopause: unki body mein kya ho raha hai, aur ghar mein koi is par baat kyun nahi karta

dek.en: She is awake at 3 am, soaked in sweat, and will still pack the tiffins at 6. A guide for sons and daughters: what perimenopause and menopause do to the body, what helps, which check-ups to nudge her towards, and how to share the load.
dek.hg: Woh raat 3 baje paseene mein bheegi jaag rahi hain, aur subah 6 baje phir bhi tiffin pack karengi. Beton aur betiyon ke liye guide: perimenopause aur menopause body ke saath kya karte hain, kya help karta hai, kaunse check-ups ke liye unhe nudge karna hai, aur ghar ka load kaise share karna hai.

label.en: of Indian women aged 35-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 35-49 saal ki Indian women ki kabhi cervical cancer screening hui thi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.hg: Indian women ke saare cancers mein breast cancer ka hissa (latest GLOBOCAN estimate, 2024)

label.en: of adolescent girls had been told about periods before their first one (2016 review of Indian studies)
label.hg: adolescent girls ko pehle period se pehle periods ke baare mein bataya gaya tha (Indian studies ka 2016 review)

actions.en: Say the word 'menopause' at home once, calmly, and ask your mother or aunt how she has been sleeping.
actions.hg: Ghar mein ek baar, shaanti se, 'menopause' shabd bolo, aur mummy ya mausi se poocho ki unki neend kaisi chal rahi hai.

actions.en: Take over one daily chore completely, ideally an early-morning one, so that she can rest after a broken night.
actions.hg: Roz ka ek kaam poori tarah apne zimme le lo, ho sake toh subah-subah wala, taaki tooti neend wali raat ke baad woh aaram kar sakein.

actions.en: Offer to book a check-up and go with her: a cervical screening test, a breast examination, blood pressure and blood sugar.
actions.hg: Check-up book karne aur saath chalne ka offer do: cervical screening test, breast examination, blood pressure aur blood sugar.

actions.en: Treat bleeding after menopause, periods that stop before 40, or a new breast lump as reasons to see a doctor this week.
actions.hg: Menopause ke baad bleeding, 40 se pehle periods band hona, ya breast mein naya lump ho toh isi hafte doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: If her low mood does not lift, help her see a doctor or call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar unka low mood theek na ho, toh doctor tak pahunchne mein help karo ya Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, free aur din-raat chalu.

title.en: Nightfall, morning erections, a cracking voice: the puberty questions Indian boys never get to ask
title.hg: Nightfall, subah ke erections, phatti awaaz: puberty ke woh sawaal jo Indian ladke kabhi pooch nahi paate

dek.en: A girl's first period forces at least a whispered talk at home. A boy's first wet dream gets nothing, so the explaining is left to friends, porn and 'sex power' ads that a 1954 law already bans. Here are the answers he should have had at 12.
dek.hg: Ladki ke pehle period par ghar mein kam se kam ek dabi-dabi baat toh hoti hai. Ladke ke pehle wet dream par kuch nahi hota, isliye samjhane ka kaam doston, porn aur un 'sex power' ads par chhoot jaata hai jinhe 1954 ka ek kanoon pehle se ban karta hai. Yeh woh jawaab hain jo use 12 ki umar mein mil jaane chahiye the.

label.en: of young men aged 15-24 had comprehensive knowledge of HIV in 2019-21, down from 32% in 2015-16
label.hg: 15-24 saal ke young men ko 2019-21 mein HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi, 2015-16 ke 32% se kam

label.en: uses of the words 'sex', 'puberty' or 'reproductive' in the 66 pages of the National Education Policy 2020
label.hg: baar National Education Policy 2020 ke 66 pages mein 'sex', 'puberty' ya 'reproductive' shabd aaya hai

label.en: maximum jail term on a first conviction under the 1954 law that bans 'sex power' drug ads
label.hg: 'sex power' drug ads ban karne wale 1954 ke kanoon mein pehli conviction par maximum jail

claim.en: Nightfall drains a boy's strength and can leave him weak or infertile.
claim.hg: Nightfall ladke ki taakat kheench leta hai aur use kamzor ya infertile bana sakta hai.

truth.en: A wet dream releases a small amount of semen during sleep, and the body keeps making more. It does not drain strength, does not cause infertility and needs no medicine.
truth.hg: Wet dream mein neend ke dauraan thoda sa semen nikalta hai, aur body use banati rehti hai. Isse taakat kam nahi hoti, infertility nahi hoti aur kisi dawa ki zaroorat nahi hai.

actions.en: After a wet dream, wash, change and carry on. It needs no medicine, no 'treatment' and no guilt.
actions.hg: Wet dream ke baad dho lo, kapde badlo aur aage badho. Ise na dawa chahiye, na 'treatment', na guilt.

actions.en: A random erection goes down by itself in minutes: stay seated, keep a bag or book on your lap, think of something dull.
actions.hg: Achanak aaya erection kuch minute mein apne aap chala jaata hai: baithe raho, god mein bag ya book rakh lo, kisi boring cheez ke baare mein socho.

actions.en: Go to a hospital at once for sudden, severe pain in a testicle, or for an erection that is painful and lasts for hours.
actions.hg: Testicle mein achanak tez dard ho, ya erection dard ke saath ghanton tak rahe, toh turant hospital jao.

actions.en: Do not buy capsules, oils or 'courses' for nightfall or 'sex power'. Ask a doctor or an Adolescent Friendly Health Centre.
actions.hg: Nightfall ya 'sex power' ke liye capsule, tel ya 'course' mat khareedo. Doctor ya Adolescent Friendly Health Centre se poochho.

actions.en: Fathers, older brothers and teachers: explain wet dreams and erections to a boy before they happen, the way a period should be explained to a girl.
actions.hg: Papa, bade bhai aur teachers: ladke ko wet dreams aur erections ke baare mein pehle se batao, jaise ladki ko period ke baare mein pehle se batana chahiye.

title.en: Pad, cup, tampon or period underwear: an honest guide to cost, safety, toxic shock and the 'virginity' myth
title.hg: Pad, cup, tampon ya period underwear: cost, safety, toxic shock aur 'virginity' myth par ek honest guide

dek.en: Sanitary napkin use among young Indian women rose from 41.8% to 64.4% between two national surveys. Here is what each option really costs, how to use it safely, what toxic shock syndrome is, and why a cup cannot take anyone's virginity.
dek.hg: Do national surveys ke beech young Indian women mein sanitary napkin ka use 41.8% se badh kar 64.4% ho gaya. Yahan jaano har option ka asli kharcha kitna hai, use safely kaise karein, toxic shock syndrome kya hai, aur ek cup kisi ki 'virginity' kyun nahi le sakta.

label.en: of women aged 15-24 used sanitary napkins in 2019-21
label.hg: 15-24 saal ki women 2019-21 mein sanitary napkins use karti thi

label.en: of women aged 15-24 used sanitary napkins in 2015-16
label.hg: 15-24 saal ki women 2015-16 mein sanitary napkins use karti thi

label.en: still used cloth in 2019-21 (many women use more than one method)
label.hg: 2019-21 mein bhi kapda use karti thi (kai women ek se zyada method use karti hain)

claim.en: Tampons and menstrual cups are only for married women, because they take away virginity.
claim.hg: Tampons aur menstrual cups sirf shaadishuda auraton ke liye hain, kyunki inse virginity chali jaati hai.

truth.en: Virginity is not a body part. The hymen differs from person to person and cannot show whether someone has had sex. Putting in a cup or a tampon is not sex.
truth.hg: Virginity body ka koi part nahi hai. Hymen har kisi mein alag hota hai aur usse yeh pata nahi chal sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi. Cup ya tampon lagana sex nahi hai.

actions.en: Change a tampon as often as the pack says, and never leave a tampon or cup in longer than recommended.
actions.hg: Tampon utni baar badlo jitna pack par likha hai, aur tampon ya cup ko recommended time se zyada der kabhi mat rakho.

actions.en: If you get a sudden high fever, a rash, vomiting or dizziness while using a tampon or cup, remove it and go to a hospital emergency. Tell the doctor what you were using.
actions.hg: Tampon ya cup use karte hue achanak tez bukhaar, rash, ulti ya chakkar aaye, toh use nikaalo aur hospital emergency jao. Doctor ko batao ki tum kya use kar rahi thi.

actions.en: Try a new product for the first time on a day at home, not on an exam day.
actions.hg: Koi naya product pehli baar aise din try karo jab tum ghar par ho, exam wale din nahi.

actions.en: Wash your hands before and after changing any period product.
actions.hg: Koi bhi period product badalne se pehle aur baad mein haath dho.

actions.en: Ask your school where girls can collect the free sanitary napkins the Supreme Court ordered.
actions.hg: Apne school se poocho ki Supreme Court ke order wale free sanitary napkins ladkiyan kahan se le sakti hain.

title.en: 7.2%, 13.6% or 19.6%? How PCOS is diagnosed, and why one ultrasound is not enough
title.hg: 7.2%, 13.6% ya 19.6%? PCOS ka diagnosis kaise hota hai, aur ek ultrasound kaafi kyun nahi hai

dek.en: An Indian national study got three different answers from the same women, depending on which medical rulebook it used. Here is what each rulebook asks for, why a scan alone can never diagnose PCOS, and what a proper check-up should include.
dek.hg: India ki ek national study ne unhi women par teen alag jawaab nikaale, is hisaab se ki kaunsi medical rulebook use hui. Jaano har rulebook kya maangti hai, akela scan PCOS diagnose kyun nahi kar sakta, aur ek sahi check-up mein kya-kya hona chahiye.

statLabel.en: of women aged 18-40 met the broad Rotterdam criteria for PCOS (2024 study)
statLabel.hg: 18-40 saal ki women broad Rotterdam criteria ke hisaab se PCOS mein aayi (2024 study)

label.hg: 18-40 saal ki women ko strict NIH rulebook ke hisaab se PCOS tha (Indian national study, 2024)

label.hg: unhi women ko broad Rotterdam rulebook ke hisaab se PCOS tha

label.hg: PCOS wali women ko duniya bhar mein pata hi nahi ki unhe yeh hai (WHO estimate)

label.hg: Indian study mein PCOS wali women ke blood lipids abnormal the

claim.en: If the ultrasound shows cysts, you have PCOS. If it does not, you don't.
claim.hg: Ultrasound mein cysts dikhe toh PCOS hai. Nahi dikhe toh nahi hai.

truth.en: No diagnostic rulebook accepts a scan on its own. WHO says ovarian cysts are not required for a diagnosis, and some women with PCOS do not have polycystic ovaries.
truth.hg: Koi bhi diagnostic rulebook akele scan ko nahi maanti. WHO kehta hai ki diagnosis ke liye ovarian cysts zaroori nahi hain, aur PCOS wali kuch women ki ovaries polycystic hoti hi nahi.

actions.en: Write down your period dates for three months before you see a doctor: the day each period started and how long it lasted.
actions.hg: Doctor ke paas jaane se pehle teen mahine tak apni period dates likho: har period kis din shuru hua aur kitne din chala.

actions.en: If you were told you have PCOS or 'PCOD' after a single scan, ask which criteria were used and which signs you actually have.
actions.hg: Agar ek hi scan ke baad tumhe PCOS ya 'PCOD' bata diya gaya, toh poocho ki kaunse criteria use hue aur tumme asal mein kaunse signs hain.

actions.en: Ask for blood sugar, cholesterol and liver tests, not only a hormone test and a scan.
actions.hg: Sirf hormone test aur scan nahi, blood sugar, cholesterol aur liver tests bhi maango.

actions.en: If you are in your teens, ask whether this could still be a normal early cycle, and when to check again.
actions.hg: Agar tum teens mein ho, toh poocho ki kya yeh abhi bhi normal shuruaati cycle ho sakta hai, aur dobara kab check karna hai.

actions.en: If nobody explains your diagnosis, get a second opinion at a government hospital's gynaecology or endocrinology OPD.
actions.hg: Agar koi tumhara diagnosis samjhaata nahi, toh government hospital ke gynaecology ya endocrinology OPD mein second opinion lo.

title.en: 'Shaadi ke baad theek ho jayega': PCOS myths, checked against an Indian study where 91.9% of women with PCOS had abnormal blood fats
title.hg: 'Shaadi ke baad theek ho jayega': PCOS ke myths, ek Indian study ke saamne jisme PCOS wali 91.9% women ke blood fats abnormal the

dek.en: Families treat PCOS as a problem of looks and marriage prospects: weight, chin hair, acne and whether she can have children. India's national study found what a mirror cannot show. Here are four common myths, and what the evidence says instead.
dek.hg: Families PCOS ko looks aur rishte ki problem samajhti hain: weight, chin pe baal, acne, aur kya woh maa ban paayegi. India ki national study ne woh dikhaya jo mirror mein nahi dikhta. Yeh rahe chaar common myths, aur evidence asal mein kya kehta hai.

statLabel.en: of women with PCOS in India's national study had abnormal blood fats (2024)
statLabel.hg: India ki national study mein PCOS wali women ke blood fats abnormal the (2024)

label.hg: ICMR-funded Indian study mein PCOS wali women ke blood fats (lipids) abnormal the

label.en: of the same women had fatty liver disease
label.hg: unhi women ko fatty liver disease thi

label.en: had obesity, which means more than half did not
label.hg: ko obesity thi, yaani aadhe se zyada ko nahi thi

label.en: of women with PCOS worldwide do not know they have it (WHO estimate)
label.hg: PCOS wali women ko duniya bhar mein pata hi nahi ki unhe yeh hai (WHO estimate)

claim.en: PCOS is a weight and marriage problem. Lose weight, get married, have a baby and it will settle.
claim.hg: PCOS weight aur shaadi ki problem hai. Weight kam karo, shaadi karo, baby ho jaye, sab settle ho jayega.

truth.en: PCOS is a long-term hormonal and metabolic condition. Marriage and pregnancy do not cure it, women of every size can have it, and it is managed with regular check-ups and treatment.
truth.hg: PCOS ek lamba chalne wala hormonal aur metabolic condition hai. Shaadi aur pregnancy ise cure nahi karte, har body size ki women ko yeh ho sakta hai, aur ise regular check-ups aur treatment se manage kiya jaata hai.

actions.en: If you have irregular periods with acne or extra facial hair, ask for a PCOS check-up now, not 'after marriage'.
actions.hg: Agar periods irregular hain aur saath mein acne ya chehre pe extra baal hain, toh PCOS check-up abhi karwao, 'shaadi ke baad' nahi.

actions.en: If you have been diagnosed, ask for blood sugar, cholesterol and liver tests, and ask when to repeat them.
actions.hg: Agar diagnosis ho chuka hai, toh blood sugar, cholesterol aur liver tests maango, aur poocho ki inhe dobara kab karwana hai.

actions.en: Treat a PCOS diagnosis like a thyroid diagnosis: a health fact to manage, not a secret that decides a marriage.
actions.hg: PCOS diagnosis ko thyroid diagnosis ki tarah lo: manage karne wala ek health fact, koi secret nahi jo shaadi decide kare.

actions.en: If you want children someday, ask a gynaecologist about treatment to help ovulation. PCOS can make pregnancy slower, not impossible.
actions.hg: Agar aage chal ke bachche chahiye, toh gynaecologist se ovulation mein madad karne wale treatment ke baare mein poocho. PCOS se pregnancy slow ho sakti hai, impossible nahi.

actions.en: Skip any product that promises to 'reverse' or 'cure' PCOS. There is no cure, and ads for drugs that claim to correct menstrual disorders are banned under a 1954 law.
actions.hg: PCOS ko 'reverse' ya 'cure' karne ka daava karne wale kisi bhi product se door raho. Iska koi cure nahi hai, aur period ki gadbad theek karne ka daava karne wali dawaon ke ads 1954 ke ek law ke under banned hain.

title.en: Period leave: if menstrual health is part of the right to life, what does a workplace owe a woman with endometriosis?
title.hg: Period leave: agar menstrual health right to life ka hissa hai, toh endometriosis wali aurat ke liye workplace ki kya zimmedaari hai?

dek.en: In January 2026 the Supreme Court made menstrual health part of the right to life, but its orders were written for schools. The girls it protected will soon be at work, where disabling period pain is still read as weakness or an excuse. The case for period leave, the case against, and what a fair workplace can do either way.
dek.hg: January 2026 mein Supreme Court ne menstrual health ko right to life ka hissa maana, par uske orders schools ke liye likhe gaye the. Jin ladkiyon ko court ne protect kiya, woh jaldi hi kaam pe hongi, jahan period ka tez dard aaj bhi kamzori ya bahaana samjha jaata hai. Period leave ke paksh mein kya hai, khilaaf kya hai, aur ek fair workplace dono haalat mein kya kar sakta hai.

statLabel.hg: women ko duniya bhar mein endometriosis hone ka estimate hai (WHO)

label.hg: women ko duniya bhar mein endometriosis hone ka estimate hai (WHO, 2025)
