label.hg: endometriosis ka diagnosis hone mein lagne wala average time (WHO)

label.en: of Indian women aged 15 and above were in the labour force in 2023-24, against 78.8% of men
label.hg: 15 saal aur usse badi Indian women 2023-24 mein labour force mein thi, jabki mard 78.8%

label.en: of rural women workers had regular salaried jobs in 2023-24
label.hg: rural women workers ke paas 2023-24 mein regular salaried job thi

claim.en: Women who take a day off for period pain are exaggerating ordinary cramps.
claim.hg: Period ke dard ke liye chhutti lene wali auratein normal cramps ko badha-chadha kar batati hain.

truth.en: Mild cramps are common, but some period pain comes from disease. WHO says endometriosis can cause debilitating pain that keeps people from work or school, and it takes 4 to 12 years on average to diagnose.
truth.hg: Halke cramps common hain, par kuch period ka dard bimaari se aata hai. WHO kehta hai ki endometriosis aisa dard de sakta hai jo logon ko kaam ya school jaane se rok de, aur iska diagnosis hone mein average 4 se 12 saal lagte hain.

actions.en: If period pain keeps you from work, see a gynaecologist and ask plainly whether it could be endometriosis.
actions.hg: Agar period ka dard tumhe kaam pe jaane se rokta hai, toh gynaecologist ke paas jao aur saaf poocho ki kahin yeh endometriosis toh nahi.

actions.en: Keep a pain diary for two cycles: the days you missed or struggled at work, a pain score out of ten and what you took.
actions.hg: Do cycles tak pain diary rakho: kaam ke kaunse din miss hue ya mushkil se nikle, das mein se dard kitna tha aur kaunsi dawa li.

actions.en: If you manage a team, accept sick leave for period pain without asking for details, and allow flexible hours where the job permits.
actions.hg: Agar tum team manage karte ho, toh period ke dard ke liye sick leave bina details maange accept karo, aur jahan kaam allow kare wahan flexible hours do.

actions.en: Check your workplace for a clean toilet with water, a bin for pads and a place to rest, and ask for them in writing if they are missing.
actions.hg: Apne workplace mein check karo ki paani wala saaf toilet, pads ke liye dustbin aur aaram karne ki jagah hai ya nahi, aur na ho toh likhit mein maango.

actions.en: When a colleague's pain is mocked as an excuse, say so. That joke is how women learn to stay silent.
actions.hg: Jab kisi colleague ke dard ka bahaana keh kar mazaak udaya jaye, toh bolo. Wahi mazaak auraton ko chup rehna sikhata hai.

title.en: Richest 95.1%, poorest 53.6%: safe period protection in India still depends on how rich your family is
title.hg: Sabse ameer gharon mein 95.1%, sabse gareeb mein 53.6%: periods mein safe protection aaj bhi ghar ke paise par tika hai

dek.en: India's headline number jumped from 57.6% to 77.6% between two national surveys. Split it by wealth, schooling, village and tribe, and you find the girls that progress skipped.
dek.hg: Do national surveys ke beech India ka headline number 57.6% se badhkar 77.6% ho gaya. Par ise paise, padhai, gaon aur tribe ke hisaab se todo, toh woh ladkiyan dikhti hain jin tak yeh progress pahunchi hi nahi.

statLabel.hg: sabse gareeb gharon ki young women hi periods mein hygienic method use karti thi (2019-21)

label.hg: sabse ameer gharon ki 15-24 saal ki ladkiyan aur aurtein periods mein hygienic method use karti thi (2019-21)

label.en: of women aged 15-24 in the poorest households did (2019-21)
label.hg: sabse gareeb gharon mein yahi figure (2019-21)

label.en: of young women who never went to school did (2019-21)
label.hg: jo kabhi school nahi gayi, unmein yahi figure (2019-21)

label.en: the all-India figure in 2015-16, the previous survey round
label.hg: 2015-16 mein poore India ka figure, pichhle survey round mein

claim.en: Girls who use cloth just don't care about hygiene.
claim.hg: Jo ladkiyan kapda use karti hain, unhe hygiene ki parwah hi nahi.

truth.en: Use of hygienic methods follows family wealth and schooling: 95.1% in the richest households, 53.6% in the poorest. Period poverty is about money, water, privacy and information, not character.
truth.hg: Hygienic method kaun use karta hai, yeh ghar ke paise aur padhai ke saath chalta hai: sabse ameer gharon mein 95.1%, sabse gareeb mein 53.6%. Period poverty paise, paani, privacy aur jaankari ka mamla hai, character ka nahi.

actions.en: Ask whether girls in your school or college actually receive the free sanitary pads the Supreme Court ordered in January 2026, and raise it with the head if they do not.
actions.hg: Check karo ki tumhare school ya college mein ladkiyon ko woh free sanitary pads sach mein mil rahe hain ya nahi, jinka order Supreme Court ne January 2026 mein diya tha. Na milein, toh principal se baat karo.

actions.en: If your family can afford it, put pads on the monthly shopping list for every woman in the house, like soap or rice.
actions.hg: Ghar mein gunjaish ho, toh pads ko bhi har mahine ki shopping list mein sabun aur chawal ki tarah daalo, ghar ki har aurat ke liye.

actions.en: Never mock a girl who uses cloth. Washed and properly dried cloth can be safe; what she needs is water, soap and a private place to dry it.
actions.hg: Kapda use karne wali kisi ladki ka mazaak mat udao. Theek se dhoya aur sukhaya gaya kapda safe ho sakta hai; use chahiye paani, sabun aur kapda sukhane ki apni private jagah.

actions.en: Tell younger girls about periods before their first one, not after it.
actions.hg: Chhoti behnon aur bachchiyon ko pehle period se pehle hi sab bata do, baad mein nahi.

actions.en: When someone calls period poverty a hygiene problem, show them the 95.1% and the 53.6%.
actions.hg: Koi kahe ki period poverty bas hygiene ki problem hai, toh use 95.1% aur 53.6% dikhao.

title.en: Bihar 59.2%, Puducherry 99.1%: India's period-protection map, from the bottom five to almost 100%
title.hg: Bihar 59.2%, Puducherry 99.1%: periods protection ka India map, bottom five se lagbhag 100% tak

dek.en: Where a young woman lives decides a lot about how she gets through her period. Five states sat far below the national 77.6% in 2019-21, while Puducherry and Tamil Nadu came close to everyone. Here is how to read the map, and how to use it.
dek.hg: Ek young woman kis state mein rehti hai, isse kaafi had tak tay hota hai ki uske periods kaise guzrenge. 2019-21 mein paanch states national 77.6% se kaafi neeche the, jabki Puducherry aur Tamil Nadu lagbhag har ladki tak pahunch gaye the. Yeh map kaise padho aur kaise use karo, yahan samjho.

statLabel.hg: Bihar ki 15-24 saal ki young women hi periods mein hygienic method use karti thi (2019-21)

label.hg: Bihar ki 15-24 saal ki ladkiyan aur aurtein periods mein hygienic method use karti thi (2019-21)

label.hg: Puducherry ki 15-24 saal ki ladkiyan aur aurtein (2019-21)

label.hg: Tamil Nadu mein, jo India ke sabse bade states mein se ek hai (2019-21)

label.en: the all-India figure (2019-21)
label.hg: poore India ka figure (2019-21)

actions.en: Look up your state's figure in the state table of the NFHS-5 national report and compare it with the all-India 77.6%.
actions.hg: NFHS-5 ki national report ki state table mein apne state ka figure dekho aur use India ke 77.6% se compare karo.

actions.en: Ask your MLA and your state education department what your state has reported to the Supreme Court on free pads and girls' toilets in schools.
actions.hg: Apne MLA aur state education department se poochho ki schools mein free pads aur girls' toilets par tumhare state ne Supreme Court ko kya report kiya hai.

actions.en: In a low-scoring state, check whether the nearest school and anganwadi actually hand out pads, and tell girls who are out of school where to get them.
actions.hg: Low-scoring state mein ho, toh check karo ki paas ka school aur anganwadi sach mein pads baant rahe hain ya nahi, aur jo ladkiyan school nahi jaati unhe batao ki pads kahan milenge.

actions.en: Use your state's number in school, college and panchayat meetings: it is a public benchmark, not a private shame.
actions.hg: School, college aur panchayat meetings mein apne state ka number rakho: yeh public benchmark hai, private sharam nahi.

title.en: When a period needs a doctor: the warning signs Indian girls are taught to ignore
title.hg: Kab period ko doctor ki zaroorat hai: woh warning signs jinhe Indian ladkiyon ko ignore karna sikhaya jaata hai

dek.en: Soaking a pad every hour, months without a period, pain that keeps you at home: these are medical signs, not things to 'adjust' to. Here is a red-flag list, the emergencies that cannot wait, what to note before an appointment, and how to report the ads that promise to 'regulate' periods.
dek.hg: Har ghante pad bhar jaana, mahinon tak period na aana, aisa dard jo ghar pe bitha de: yeh medical signs hain, 'adjust' karne wali cheezein nahi. Yeh rahi red flags ki list, woh emergencies jo wait nahi kar sakti, appointment se pehle kya note karna hai, aur periods 'regular' karne ka promise karne wale ads ko kaise report karna hai.

label.en: of women with PCOS worldwide do not know they have it (WHO estimate)
label.hg: PCOS wali women ko duniya bhar mein pata hi nahi ki unhe yeh hai (WHO estimate)

label.en: average time to an endometriosis diagnosis (WHO)
label.hg: endometriosis ka diagnosis hone mein lagne wala average time (WHO)

label.en: the year India banned ads for drugs that claim to correct menstrual disorders
label.hg: jis saal India ne period ki gadbad theek karne ka daava karne wali dawaon ke ads ban kiye

label.en: maximum jail term for a first conviction under that law, with or instead of a fine
label.hg: us law ke under pehli baar conviction pe maximum jail, fine ke saath ya uski jagah

claim.en: Heavy or irregular periods are just 'garmi' or weakness, and a tonic can regulate them.
claim.hg: Heavy ya irregular periods bas 'garmi' ya kamzori hain, aur koi tonic inhe regular kar dega.

truth.en: Very heavy bleeding, missed periods and disabling pain are medical signs with treatable causes, such as PCOS, thyroid problems and endometriosis. Advertising drugs that claim to correct menstrual disorders has been banned in India since 1954.
truth.hg: Bahut zyada bleeding, periods miss hona aur zindagi rok dene wala dard medical signs hain, jinke treatable causes hote hain, jaise PCOS, thyroid problems aur endometriosis. Period ki gadbad theek karne ka daava karne wali dawaon ka ad India mein 1954 se banned hai.

actions.en: For three months, note the first day of each period, the pads used on the heaviest day and a pain score out of ten.
actions.hg: Teen mahine tak har period ka pehla din, sabse heavy din pe use hue pads aur das mein se dard ka score note karo.

actions.en: Book a doctor this week if you soak a pad every one to two hours, bleed for more than 7 days or miss three periods in a row.
actions.hg: Agar har ek-do ghante mein pad bhar jaata hai, 7 din se zyada bleeding hoti hai ya lagaatar teen periods miss hue hain, toh isi hafte doctor ka appointment lo.

actions.en: Go to a hospital or call 112 for heavy bleeding with fainting, or a fever and rash while using a tampon or cup.
actions.hg: Behoshi ke saath heavy bleeding ho, ya tampon ya cup use karte waqt bukhaar aur rash ho, toh hospital jao ya 112 call karo.

actions.en: Teenagers can visit an Adolescent Friendly Health Centre at a government facility and ask for a woman doctor.
actions.hg: Teenagers kisi government facility ke Adolescent Friendly Health Centre ja sakte hain aur lady doctor maang sakte hain.

actions.en: Screenshot any ad that promises to 'regulate' periods and report it to your state's complaint channel under the 1954 Act.
actions.hg: Periods 'regular' karne ka promise karne wale kisi bhi ad ka screenshot lo aur 1954 ke Act ke under apne state ke complaint channel pe report karo.

title.en: Before the first period: how to prepare a child when nobody prepared you
title.hg: Pehle period se pehle: bachche ko kaise taiyaar karein, jab aapko khud kisi ne taiyaar nahi kiya tha

dek.en: In a 2016 review of Indian studies, only about half of girls had been told about periods before their first one, and boys are often told nothing. A plan for parents and older siblings: when to start, which words to use, what goes in the school bag and how to answer honestly.
dek.hg: 2016 ke ek review ne Indian studies ko jod kar dekha: sirf lagbhag aadhi ladkiyon ko pehle period se pehle uske baare mein bataya gaya tha, aur ladkon ko aksar kuch bataya hi nahi jaata. Parents aur bade bhai-behnon ke liye ek plan: kab shuru karein, kaunse words use karein, school bag mein kya rakhein aur sawaalon ke seedhe jawab kaise dein.

label.en: of adolescent girls in India had been told about periods before their first one (2016 review; pooled from 88 of its 138 studies)
label.hg: India ki adolescent girls ko pehle period se pehle uske baare mein bataya gaya tha (2016 review; 138 mein se 88 studies ka pooled estimate)

label.en: of adolescent girls reported missing school during their periods (same review)
label.hg: adolescent girls ne bataya ki periods ke dauraan unka school miss hota tha (wahi review)

label.en: of women aged 15-24 used sanitary napkins in 2019-21
label.hg: 15-24 saal ki women 2019-21 mein sanitary napkins use karti thi

label.en: of women aged 15-24 still used cloth in 2019-21 (many use more than one method)
label.hg: 15-24 saal ki women 2019-21 mein ab bhi cloth use karti thi (kai women ek se zyada method use karti hain)

claim.en: Telling a girl about periods before they start will frighten her and make her grow up too fast.
claim.hg: Ladki ko period shuru hone se pehle bata diya toh woh dar jayegi aur waqt se pehle badi ho jayegi.

truth.en: What frightens a child is bleeding that nobody explained. UNESCO's guidance states that sexuality education does not increase sexual activity or risk-taking, and that curriculum-based programmes contribute to later first sex.
truth.hg: Bachche ko woh bleeding darati hai jiske baare mein kisi ne kuch bataya hi nahi. UNESCO ki guidance kehti hai ki sexuality education se na sexual activity badhti hai, na risk lena, aur curriculum-based programmes se pehli baar sex der se hota hai.

actions.en: Start at 8 or 9, or at the first signs of puberty, and come back to it in many short talks instead of one big one.
actions.hg: 8 ya 9 saal ki umar mein, ya puberty ke pehle signs dikhte hi baat shuru kijiye. Ek badi baat ki jagah kai chhoti-chhoti baatein kijiye.

actions.en: Use the real words: period, uterus, vagina, pad. Say plainly that period blood is not dirty and a period is not an injury.
actions.hg: Asli words use kijiye: period, uterus, vagina, pad. Saaf kahiye ki period ka blood ganda nahi hai aur period koi chot nahi hai.

actions.en: Pack a pouch for the school bag: two pads, spare underwear and a paper bag. Let her practise with a pad at home first.
actions.hg: School bag ke liye ek pouch banaiye: do pads, ek extra underwear aur ek paper bag. Pehle ghar par use pad lagana practise karne dijiye.

actions.en: Tell your son the same facts and give him a job: fetch a pad, lend a sweater, stop the jokes.
actions.hg: Bete ko bhi wahi facts bataiye aur use ek kaam dijiye: pad la kar dena, sweater dena, mazaak rukwana.

actions.en: Ask the school where a girl can get a pad and a spare uniform. The Supreme Court has ordered both.
actions.hg: School se poochiye ki ladki ko pad aur spare uniform kahan milega. Supreme Court ne dono ka order diya hai.

title.en: When her body changes, the staring starts: puberty, harassment and why girls are told to hide instead of men told to stop
title.hg: Jab uski body badalti hai, ghoorna shuru ho jaata hai: puberty, harassment, aur ladkiyon ko chhupne ko kyun kaha jaata hai jabki mardon ko rukne ko nahi

dek.en: Around puberty, many Indian girls are handed a new rulebook: cover up, come straight home, stop playing outside. The rules arrive because men have started to stare. The data shows how common that is, how little of it reaches the police, and who should be doing the changing.
dek.hg: Puberty ke aas-paas bahut si Indian ladkiyon ko ek nayi rulebook thama di jaati hai: dhang se dhako, seedha ghar aao, bahar khelna band. Yeh rules isliye aate hain kyunki mardon ne ghoorna shuru kar diya hai. Data dikhata hai ki yeh kitna common hai, iska kitna kam hissa police tak pahunchta hai, aur badalna kise chahiye.

statLabel.en: of households said unmarried girls were harassed nearby; police records implied 0.06% (2005)
statLabel.hg: households ne kaha ki aas-paas unmarried ladkiyon ko harass kiya jaata tha; police records ke hisaab se figure 0.06% tha (2005)

label.en: of households said unmarried girls in their neighbourhood were sometimes or often harassed (2005 survey)
label.hg: households ne kaha ki unke neighbourhood mein unmarried ladkiyon ko kabhi-kabhi ya aksar harass kiya jaata tha (2005 survey)

label.en: of households, the figure police records implied for the same year
label.hg: households, usi saal ke police records se nikalne wala figure

label.en: cases of sexual harassment of women registered by police in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein police ne women ke sexual harassment ke itne cases register kiye

label.en: stalking cases registered by police in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein police ne stalking ke itne cases register kiye

claim.en: If a girl covers up and stays indoors, men will leave her alone.
claim.hg: Ladki dhang se dhak kar rahe aur ghar ke andar rahe, to mard use pareshan nahi karenge.

truth.en: Harassment is caused by the person who chooses to harass. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook lists the idea that clothing invites sexual contact among false stereotypes.
truth.hg: Harassment ki wajah woh insaan hai jo harass karna chunta hai. Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook is soch ko false stereotypes mein ginti hai ki kapde sexual contact ko invite karte hain.

actions.en: Explain breast growth and periods to a girl before you hand her any new rule.
actions.hg: Ladki ko koi bhi naya rule dene se pehle breast growth aur periods ke baare mein samjhaiye.

actions.en: Tell her plainly: if anyone stares, comments, follows or touches, the fault is his, and telling you will never cost her her freedom.
actions.hg: Use saaf shabdon mein bataiye: agar koi ghoore, comment kare, peecha kare ya chhue, to galti uski hai, aur aapko batane se uski azaadi kabhi nahi chhinegi.

actions.en: Keep girls in sport and outdoors. Fix the route, the timing or the harasser, not her body.
actions.hg: Ladkiyon ko sport aur bahar ki duniya mein banaye rakhiye. Raasta, timing ya harasser ko theek kijiye, uski body ko nahi.

actions.en: Teach boys the rule directly: do not stare, comment, follow or film, and stop friends who do.
actions.hg: Ladkon ko rule seedha sikhaiye: ghoorna, comment karna, peecha karna ya film karna nahi, aur jo dost aisa kare use rokna.

actions.en: Report harassment: call 112 in an emergency, and 1098 if the person targeted is under 18.
actions.hg: Harassment report kijiye: emergency mein 112, aur target kiya gaya insaan 18 se kam ho to 1098.

title.en: Early, late or on time? A puberty Q&A, and why the body talk has to start before 10
title.hg: Jaldi, late ya time par? Puberty Q&A, aur body ki baat 10 saal se pehle kyun shuru honi chahiye

dek.en: Puberty can begin anywhere in a five-year window, and most 'early' and 'late' is family timing, not illness. But the government's own study found that sexual abuse reported by children gains momentum from age 10, so waiting for 'the right age' to explain bodies leaves children exposed.
dek.hg: Puberty paanch saal ki window mein kabhi bhi shuru ho sakti hai, aur zyada tar 'jaldi' ya 'late' family timing hoti hai, bimaari nahi. Lekin sarkar ki apni study ke hisaab se bachchon ka bataya hua sexual abuse 10 saal ki umar se tezi pakadta hai. Isliye body samjhane ke liye 'sahi umar' ka wait bachchon ko bina suraksha ke chhod deta hai.

statLabel.en: age at which sexual abuse reported by children peaked in the government's 2007 study
statLabel.hg: woh umar jisme sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein bachchon ka bataya hua sexual abuse sabse zyada tha

label.hg: bachchon ke bataye hue sexual abuse ki peak umar (Study on Child Abuse, 2007)

label.en: of children who reported sexual assault in that study had told no one
label.hg: us study mein sexual assault batane wale bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha

label.en: of adolescent girls in India had been told about periods before their first one (2016 review)
label.hg: India ki adolescent ladkiyon ko pehle period se pehle periods ke baare mein bataya gaya tha (2016 review)

label.en: adolescents used Adolescent Friendly Health Centre services in 2024-25, by the Health Ministry's count
label.hg: adolescents ne 2024-25 mein Adolescent Friendly Health Centre ki services li, Health Ministry ki ginti ke hisaab se

claim.en: Telling children about bodies and sex early will make them experiment early.
claim.hg: Bachchon ko body aur sex ke baare mein jaldi bataoge toh woh jaldi experiment karne lagenge.

truth.en: The UN's 2018 guidance says sexuality education does not increase sexual activity, risk-taking or STI/HIV rates. Silence only leaves the explaining to classmates, phones and abusers.
truth.hg: UN ki 2018 guidance kehti hai ki sexuality education se sexual activity, risk-taking ya STI/HIV rates nahi badhte. Chup rehne se samjhane ka kaam bas classmates, phone aur abusers ke haath chala jaata hai.

actions.en: Explain periods, erections, wet dreams and body changes before they happen: start by age 8, using the real names for body parts.
actions.hg: Periods, erections, wet dreams aur body changes hone se pehle samjhao: 8 saal ki umar tak shuru kar do, aur body parts ke asli naam use karo.

actions.en: See a doctor if changes begin before 8 in girls or 9 in boys, have not begun by 13 in girls or 14 in boys, or if periods have not started by 15.
actions.hg: Doctor ko dikhao agar changes ladkiyon mein 8 ya ladkon mein 9 se pehle shuru hon, ladkiyon mein 13 ya ladkon mein 14 tak shuru na hon, ya 15 tak period na aaye.

actions.en: Start with a paediatrician or a government Adolescent Friendly Health Centre. Never give a child hormone tablets, 'height' powders or supplements on your own.
actions.hg: Paediatrician ya sarkari Adolescent Friendly Health Centre se shuru karo. Bachche ko apni marzi se hormone tablets, 'height' powder ya supplements kabhi mat do.

actions.en: Tell every child: nobody may touch or look at your private parts, no adult should ask you to keep a secret about bodies, and you will never be in trouble for telling.
actions.hg: Har bachche ko batao: koi tumhare private parts ko chhu ya dekh nahi sakta, koi bada tumse body ke baare mein secret rakhne ko nahi keh sakta, aur batane par tumhe kabhi daant nahi padegi.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them and call Child Helpline 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, uski baat maano aur Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call karo.

title.en: 'Su-su', 'neeche', 'wahan': why children need real words for their bodies to report abuse
title.hg: 'Su-su', 'neeche', 'wahan': abuse ke baare mein bata paane ke liye bachchon ko body ke asli naam kyun chahiye

dek.en: Indian children learn a name for every body part except the ones abuse targets. In 2024, police recorded 4,269 victims of penetrative sexual assault who were under 12. A child with only nicknames and shame has very little to tell with.
dek.hg: Indian bachche body ke har hisse ka naam seekhte hain, bas un hisson ka nahi jinhe abuse target karta hai. 2024 mein police ne penetrative sexual assault ke 4,269 aise victims record kiye jo 12 saal se chhote the. Jis bachche ke paas sirf nicknames aur sharm ho, uske paas batane ke liye bahut kam hota hai.

statLabel.en: of penetrative sexual assault cases registered under POCSO in 2024 involved someone the child knew
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein POCSO ke under register hue penetrative sexual assault cases jinmein accused koi aisa tha jise bachcha jaanta tha

label.en: of penetrative sexual assault cases under POCSO in 2024 involved someone the child knew
label.hg: 2024 ke POCSO penetrative sexual assault cases jinmein accused koi aisa tha jise bachcha jaanta tha

label.en: recorded child victims of penetrative sexual assault in 2024 who were under 12
label.hg: 2024 mein penetrative sexual assault ke record hue child victims jo 12 saal se chhote the

label.en: of sexually assaulted children in the government's 2007 study had told no one
label.hg: 2007 ki sarkari study mein sexual assault jhelne wale bachchon mein se itnon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha

claim.en: Teaching a small child words like 'penis' and 'vulva' takes away their innocence.
claim.hg: Chhote bachche ko 'penis' aur 'vulva' jaise words sikhane se uski masoomiyat chali jaati hai.

truth.en: They are names of body parts, like 'elbow'. What harms a child is having no words, and a sense of shame, when someone they know touches them.
truth.hg: Yeh body parts ke naam hain, bilkul 'kohni' ki tarah. Bachche ko nuksaan tab hota hai jab koi jaan-pehchaan wala use chhue aur uske paas bolne ke liye words na hon, sirf sharm ho.

actions.en: Teach every child the real names (penis, testicles, vulva, vagina, anus, breasts) in the same tone you use for 'knee' and 'ear'.
actions.hg: Har bachche ko asli naam sikhaiye (penis, testicles, vulva, vagina, anus, breasts), usi tone mein jismein aap 'ghutna' aur 'kaan' bolte hain.

actions.en: Drop 'shame-shame' and 'chhee'. Private does not mean shameful.
actions.hg: 'Shame-shame' aur 'chhee' bolna band kijiye. Private ka matlab sharmnaak nahi hota.

actions.en: Make one house rule: nobody, relative or not, may ask a child to keep a secret about bodies or touching.
actions.hg: Ghar ka ek rule banaiye: koi bhi, rishtedaar ho ya nahi, bachche se body ya touch ke baare mein secret rakhne ko nahi keh sakta.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, say 'I believe you, it is not your fault', and do not promise to keep it secret.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, to kahiye 'Mujhe tum par yakeen hai, tumhari koi galti nahi', aur secret rakhne ka promise mat kijiye.

actions.en: Call Child Helpline 1098, or 112 in an emergency. Adults who know of child sexual abuse are legally bound to report it.
actions.hg: Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye, emergency mein 112. Jis adult ko child sexual abuse ka pata ho, report karna uski legal duty hai.

title.en: Wrapped in newspaper: the shame of buying pads and condoms, in a country where 19.6% of men say women who use contraception may become promiscuous
title.hg: Akhbaar mein lipta packet: pads aur condoms kharidne ki sharam, us desh mein jahan 19.6% men kehte hain ki contraception use karne wali women promiscuous ho sakti hain

dek.en: The chemist's newspaper wrap and black polythene bag teach a lesson: what your body needs is something to hide. National survey data show what that lesson costs and who pays. Here is how to buy what you need without apology.
dek.hg: Chemist ka akhbaar wala wrap aur kaali polythene ek sabak sikhate hain: tumhari body ki zaroorat chhupane ki cheez hai. National survey ka data dikhata hai ki is sabak ki keemat kya hai aur kaun chukata hai. Yahan padho ki jo chahiye woh bina maafi maange kaise khareedein.

statLabel.hg: men ne kaha ki contraception use karne wali women promiscuous ho sakti hain (2019-21)

label.hg: 15-24 saal ki young women sanitary napkins use karti thi (2019-21)

actions.en: Ask for pads, condoms or a pregnancy test by name, in a normal voice. None of them needs a prescription or an explanation.
actions.hg: Pads, condoms ya pregnancy test ka naam lekar, normal aawaz mein maango. Inme se kisi ke liye prescription ya safai nahi chahiye.

actions.en: If you do not want the newspaper or the black bag, say so. It is a small refusal, and shopkeepers notice.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe akhbaar ya kaali thaili nahi chahiye, toh bol do. Yeh chhota sa inkaar hai, aur dukaandaar notice karte hain.

actions.en: Men and boys: buy pads for the women in your home, and buy your own condoms. Contraception is your job too.
actions.hg: Men aur boys: ghar ki women ke liye pads kharido, aur apne condoms khud kharido. Contraception tumhara bhi kaam hai.

actions.en: After unprotected sex, do not wait for courage. Emergency contraception works up to 5 days afterwards, and the sooner the better.
actions.hg: Unprotected sex ke baad himmat aane ka wait mat karo. Emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karta hai, aur jitna jaldi utna behtar.

actions.en: If you are under 18 and anyone has pressured or forced you, tell an adult you trust or call Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 se kam ho aur kisi ne pressure daala ya zabardasti ki, toh kisi bharosemand adult ko batao ya Child Helpline 1098 par call karo.

title.en: 'Just hormones'? How to tell puberty mood swings from depression, and where a teenager can get help
title.hg: 'Bas hormones hain'? Puberty ke mood swings aur depression mein farak kaise pehchanein, aur teenager ko help kahan milegi

dek.en: Puberty really can make feelings louder and bedtimes later. That is exactly why adults miss the teenager whose low mood has stopped lifting. A guide to telling the two apart, for teenagers and parents, and to the free help that exists.
dek.hg: Puberty sach mein feelings ko loud aur bedtime ko late kar sakti hai. Isi wajah se bade us teenager ko miss kar dete hain jiska low mood ab uth hi nahi raha. Teenagers aur parents ke liye ek guide: dono mein farak kaise karein, aur free help kahan hai.

statLabel.en: Tele-MANAS: the Health Ministry's free mental-health helpline, open round the clock
statLabel.hg: Tele-MANAS: Health Ministry ki free mental-health helpline, din-raat khuli

label.en: student suicides recorded in India in 2024, about 80% more than a decade earlier
label.hg: India mein 2024 mein record hue student suicides, ek dashak pehle se lagbhag 80% zyada

label.en: treatment gap for mental disorders among Indian adults (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)
label.hg: Indian adults mein mental disorders ka treatment gap (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)

label.hg: adolescents ne 2024-25 mein sarkari Adolescent Friendly Health Centres use kiye, Health Ministry ki ginti ke hisaab se

claim.en: Teenagers are moody. Sadness and anger at this age are just hormones and will pass.
claim.hg: Teenagers moody hote hi hain. Is umar ki udaasi aur gussa bas hormones hain, apne aap theek ho jaayega.

truth.en: Ordinary mood swings pass in hours or a day or two. Low mood, anger or worry that fills most of the day, day after day, for weeks rather than days is not 'just hormones' and needs help.
truth.hg: Normal mood swings kuch ghanton ya ek-do din mein nikal jaate hain. Jo low mood, gussa ya worry din ke zyadatar waqt, din-ba-din, dinon nahi balki hafton tak bana rahe, woh 'bas hormones' nahi hai aur use help chahiye.

actions.en: Watch the clock, not the drama: low mood, anger or worry on most days, for weeks rather than days, needs help.
actions.hg: Drama nahi, time dekhiye: low mood, gussa ya worry zyadatar dinon mein, dinon nahi balki hafton tak rahe, to help chahiye.

actions.en: Say what you saw, not what you concluded, then listen without fixing, comparing or bargaining with marks.
actions.hg: Jo dekha woh kahiye, apna conclusion nahi; phir suniye, bina fix kiye, bina compare kiye, bina marks ki saudebaazi ke.

actions.en: If you are worried about self-harm, ask directly, stay with them and get help the same day.
actions.hg: Self-harm ki chinta ho to seedha poochhiye, saath rahiye aur usi din help dilaiye.

actions.en: Call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and open day and night. A teenager can call alone; so can a parent.
actions.hg: Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye: free hai aur din-raat khula hai. Teenager akele call kar sakta hai, parent bhi.

actions.en: In immediate danger, call 112 and do not leave the person alone.
actions.hg: Turant khatra ho to 112 par call kijiye aur us insaan ko akela mat chhodiye.

title.en: Testicles, foreskin, steroids: the body checks Indian men skip, and why sudden testicle pain is an emergency
title.hg: Testicles, foreskin, steroids: woh body checks jo Indian mard skip karte hain, aur kyun testicle mein achanak dard emergency hai

dek.en: Boys are taught to ignore their bodies until something breaks. Here is how to check your testicles, which pain cannot wait until morning, what a tight foreskin and gym steroids can do, and where to get checked without a 'gupt rog' clinic.
dek.hg: Ladkon ko sikhaya jaata hai ki body ko tab tak ignore karo jab tak kuch toot na jaaye. Yahan jaano testicles kaise check karte hain, kaun sa dard subah tak wait nahi kar sakta, tight foreskin aur gym steroids kya kar sakte hain, aur 'gupt rog' clinic ke bina check-up kahan karwayein.

label.en: of visits to government STI clinics in 2024-25 were by women
label.hg: government STI clinics mein 2024-25 ki visits women ki thi

label.en: of syphilis tests on men at those clinics were reactive, against 0.48% for women (2024-25)
label.hg: un clinics mein mardon ke syphilis tests reactive aaye, women ke 0.48% (2024-25)

label.en: government Suraksha Clinics (designated STI/RTI clinics) across India
label.hg: India bhar mein government Suraksha Clinics (designated STI/RTI clinics)

actions.en: Check your testicles once a month after a warm bath, and see a doctor about any new lump, swelling or heaviness.
actions.hg: Har mahine garam paani se nahaane ke baad apne testicles check karo, aur koi naya lump, swelling ya bhaaripan lage toh doctor ko dikhao.

actions.en: Sudden severe pain in one testicle is an emergency: go to a hospital emergency now, or call 112. Do not wait for morning.
actions.hg: Ek testicle mein achanak tez dard emergency hai: abhi hospital emergency jao, ya 112 call karo. Subah ka wait mat karo.

actions.en: Never force a tight foreskin back. If it hurts, swells or gets stuck behind the head of the penis, see a doctor; stuck means emergency.
actions.hg: Tight foreskin ko kabhi zabardasti peeche mat khincho. Dard ho, swelling ho ya penis ke head ke peeche phans jaaye toh doctor ko dikhao; phansna matlab emergency.

actions.en: Skip steroid injections and unlabelled gym 'supplements': they can shrink testicles and cut sperm count.
actions.hg: Steroid injections aur bina label wale gym 'supplements' se door raho: inse testicles sikud sakte hain aur sperm count gir sakta hai.

actions.en: For STI tests or sexual-health worries, go to a government Suraksha Clinic or call 1097, not a 'gupt rog' clinic.
actions.hg: STI test ya sexual-health ki kisi bhi chinta ke liye government Suraksha Clinic jao ya 1097 call karo, 'gupt rog' clinic nahi.

title.en: Unmarried at the gynaecologist: what Indian law says about your consent, your privacy and your right to care
title.hg: Unmarried ho aur gynaecologist ke paas jaana hai: tumhari consent, privacy aur care ke haq par Indian law kya kehta hai

dek.en: Many unmarried women put off seeing a gynaecologist for years, expecting judgement, questions about marriage or a call home. Here is what the law protects, what a first visit involves, and how to handle the questions that sting.
dek.hg: Bahut si unmarried women saalon tak gynaecologist ko taalti rehti hain, kyunki unhe judgement, shaadi wale sawaalon ya ghar par phone jaane ka darr hota hai. Jaano law kya protect karta hai, pehli visit mein kya hota hai, aur chubhne wale sawaalon ko kaise handle karein.

label.en: of women with PCOS worldwide do not know they have it (WHO estimate)
label.hg: PCOS wali women ko duniya bhar mein pata hi nahi ki unhe yeh hai (WHO estimate)

label.en: of Indian women aged 18-40 met the broadest (Rotterdam) criteria for PCOS in an ICMR-funded national study (2024)
label.hg: 18-40 saal ki Indian women ICMR-funded national study mein PCOS ke sabse broad (Rotterdam) criteria mein aayi (2024)

label.hg: 15-49 saal ki Indian women ki hi kabhi cervical cancer screening hui thi (2019-21)

label.en: in prison, a fine or both, for a doctor who reveals a woman's abortion to anyone not authorised by law
label.hg: ki jail, fine ya dono, us doctor ko jo kisi woman ke abortion ki baat aise insaan ko bataye jise law ne authorise nahi kiya

claim.en: A gynaecologist is for married or pregnant women.
claim.hg: Gynaecologist married ya pregnant women ke liye hota hai.

truth.en: A gynaecologist treats periods, pain, hormones, infections and contraception at any age. Marriage is not a medical condition, and the law does not make it a condition for care.
truth.hg: Gynaecologist kisi bhi umar mein periods, pain, hormones, infections aur contraception ka ilaaj karta hai. Shaadi koi medical condition nahi hai, aur law ise care ki shart nahi banata.

actions.en: Book the visit for the symptom: periods that come months apart, pain that stops your day, unusual discharge or a question about contraception is reason enough.
actions.hg: Visit symptom ke liye book karo: mahino ke gap se aane wale periods, din rok dene wala pain, unusual discharge ya contraception ka sawaal, itni wajah kaafi hai.

actions.en: If you are asked 'Are you married?', answer the medical question underneath it: say whether you have ever had sex, so you get the right tests.
actions.hg: Agar poocha jaye 'Shaadi hui hai?', toh uske peeche chhupe medical sawaal ka jawaab do: batao ki tumne kabhi sex kiya hai ya nahi, taaki sahi tests hon.

actions.en: Before any internal examination, ask what it is for. You can ask for a woman attendant in the room, or say no and ask about alternatives.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi internal examination se pehle poocho ki yeh kis liye hai. Tum room mein woman attendant maang sakti ho, ya mana karke alternatives pooch sakti ho.

actions.en: Do not accept an HIV test that nobody explained to you. The HIV Act requires your informed consent.
actions.hg: Aisa HIV test accept mat karo jo kisi ne tumhe samjhaya hi nahi. HIV Act tumhari informed consent maangta hai.

actions.en: If a doctor lectures you, see another one. A government hospital's gynaecology OPD is a low-cost start; teenagers can also try an Adolescent Friendly Health Centre.
actions.hg: Agar doctor lecture de, toh doosre doctor ke paas jao. Government hospital ka gynaecology OPD ek sasti shuruaat hai; teenagers Adolescent Friendly Health Centre bhi try kar sakte hain.

title.en: Pad use rose from 41.8% to 64.4%. Where do India's used sanitary pads go?
title.hg: Pad ka use 41.8% se badh kar 64.4% ho gaya. India ke used sanitary pads jaate kahan hain?

dek.en: More young women using pads is a health gain. Nobody planned for the used pad, which ends up in mixed garbage, drains, blocked school toilets and the bare hands of sanitation workers. What the Supreme Court has ordered, what 'biodegradable' means, and how to throw a pad away without passing the problem on.
dek.hg: Zyada young women ka pads use karna health ke liye achhi khabar hai. Par used pad ka kya hoga, yeh kisi ne plan nahi kiya. Woh mixed kachre mein, naaliyon mein, block hue school toilets mein aur sanitation workers ke nange haathon mein pahunchta hai. Supreme Court ne kya order diya hai, 'biodegradable' ka matlab kya hai, aur pad ko aise kaise phenkein ki problem kisi aur par na jaaye.

statLabel.hg: 15-24 saal ki women sanitary napkins use karti thi (2019-21)

label.hg: schools mein girls' toilets ki kami abhi bhi baaki, kul 39,439 mein se (Centre ka affidavit, August 2026)

claim.en: A pad labelled 'biodegradable' can be flushed or thrown anywhere, because it dissolves on its own.
claim.hg: Jis pad par 'biodegradable' likha hai use flush kar sakte hain ya kahin bhi phenk sakte hain, woh apne aap ghul jayega.

truth.en: No pad should be flushed. 'Biodegradable' and 'compostable' describe what a pad can do under the right conditions, not what happens in a drain, a pond or a knotted plastic bag. Every pad still needs a bin and a collection system.
truth.hg: Koi bhi pad flush nahi karna chahiye. 'Biodegradable' aur 'compostable' yeh batate hain ki sahi conditions mein pad ka kya ho sakta hai, yeh nahi ki naali, talaab ya gaanth lagi plastic ki thaili mein kya hoga. Har pad ko dustbin aur collection system chahiye.

actions.en: Wrap a used pad in paper or in the wrapper of the next pad and put it in a covered bin.
actions.hg: Used pad ko paper mein ya agle pad ke wrapper mein lapet kar dhakkan wale dustbin mein daalo.

actions.en: Never flush a pad, and never throw it into a drain, a field or water, whatever the label says.
actions.hg: Pad ko kabhi flush mat karo, aur naali, khet ya paani mein mat phenko, label par kuch bhi likha ho.

actions.en: Do not burn pads in the open with other rubbish.
actions.hg: Pads ko doosre kachre ke saath khule mein mat jalao.

actions.en: Check your school or college toilet for a covered bin that is emptied daily. The Supreme Court has ordered safe disposal systems in schools.
actions.hg: Apne school ya college ke toilet mein dekho ki dhakkan wala dustbin hai ya nahi, aur woh roz khaali hota hai ya nahi. Supreme Court ne schools mein safe disposal systems ka order diya hai.

actions.en: Ask your hostel or housing society for separate collection of sanitary waste and gloves for the staff who handle it.
actions.hg: Apne hostel ya housing society se sanitary waste ka alag collection aur use uthane wale staff ke liye gloves maango.

title.en: Free pads, working toilets, spare uniforms: what the Supreme Court's 30 January 2026 ruling says every school owes girls
title.hg: Free pads, working toilets, spare uniforms: Supreme Court ke 30 January 2026 ke faisle ke baad har school par ladkiyon ka kya haq hai

dek.en: Since January 2026, menstrual health is part of the right to life, and schools have a list of duties to match. Here is that list in plain words, how to check your school against it, and whom to approach when it falls short.
dek.hg: January 2026 se menstrual health right to life ka hissa hai, aur uske saath schools ki zimmedariyon ki ek list bhi aayi hai. Yahan woh list simple shabdon mein hai: apne school ko ispe kaise check karo, aur kami ho toh kiske paas jao.

label.en: of women aged 15-24 used cloth during their periods (2019-21)
label.hg: 15-24 saal ki young women periods mein kapda use karti thi (2019-21)

label.hg: teenage ladkiyan periods ke dinon mein school miss karti thi (Indian studies ki 2016 review)

label.hg: teenage ladkiyon ko hi pehle period se pehle iske baare mein bataya gaya tha (2016 ki review, un 88 studies ko jod kar jinhone yeh poochha tha)

claim.en: Free pads at school are a favour the government hands out when it has the budget.
claim.hg: School mein free pads government ka ehsaan hai, jo budget hone par hi milta hai.

truth.en: Since 30 January 2026, the Supreme Court treats menstrual health as part of the right to life under Article 21, and has directed schools to provide free sanitary napkins, working girls' toilets with water and safe disposal.
truth.hg: 30 January 2026 se Supreme Court menstrual health ko Article 21 ke right to life ka hissa maanta hai, aur usne schools ko free sanitary napkins, paani wale working girls' toilets aur safe disposal dene ka direction diya hai.

actions.en: Walk through your school with the checklist in this guide and write down, with dates, what is missing.
actions.hg: Is guide ki checklist lekar apne school mein ghoomo, aur dates ke saath likho ki kya-kya missing hai.

actions.en: Give the list to the principal in writing and keep a copy; in a government or aided school, copy the two Health and Wellness Ambassador teachers.
actions.hg: Yeh list principal ko likh kar do aur ek copy apne paas rakho; government ya aided school mein dono Health and Wellness Ambassador teachers ko bhi copy do.

actions.en: If nothing changes, write to the District Education Officer, whom the Supreme Court made responsible for inspecting schools.
actions.hg: Kuch na badle, toh District Education Officer (DEO) ko likho; Supreme Court ne schools ki inspection ki zimmedari unhi ko di hai.

actions.en: Photograph only empty dispensers, dry taps and locked doors, never students.
actions.hg: Photo sirf khaali dispensers, sookhe nal aur band darwazon ki lo, kisi student ki kabhi nahi.

actions.en: For period pain or very heavy bleeding, a teenager can visit an Adolescent Friendly Health Centre at a government health centre or district hospital.
actions.hg: Periods mein tez dard ya bahut heavy bleeding ho, toh teenagers sarkari health centre ya district hospital ke Adolescent Friendly Health Centre ja sakte hain.

title.en: 1 in 8 Indian men say a husband may use force for sex. The share rejecting all coercion fell from 77% to 72%
title.hg: Har 8 mein se 1 Indian mard kehta hai ki pati sex ke liye zabardasti kar sakta hai. Har tarah ke dabaav ko galat kehne wale 77% se ghat ke 72% reh gaye

dek.en: NFHS-5 asked men what a husband may do when his wife says no. Between two rounds of the survey, women grew less willing to excuse violence at home and men grew more willing. The rape law still exempts husbands, so what men believe carries more weight than it should.
dek.hg: NFHS-5 ne mardon se poochha ki jab patni mana kare toh pati kya kar sakta hai. Survey ke do rounds ke beech auratein ghar ki hinsa ko kam sahi thehrane lagi aur mard zyada. Rape law ab bhi pati ko chhoot deta hai, isliye mard kya maante hain, iska wazan jitna hona chahiye usse kahin zyada hai.

statLabel.en: of men aged 15-49 say a husband may use force if his wife refuses sex (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: 15-49 saal ke mard kehte hain ki patni sex se mana kare toh pati zabardasti kar sakta hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: of men say a husband has the right to use force if his wife refuses sex (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: mard kehte hain ki patni sex se mana kare toh pati ko zabardasti karne ka haq hai (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.hg: mard kehte hain ki pati ko gussa karne aur patni ko daantne ka haq hai

label.hg: shaadi-shuda ya pehle shaadi-shuda rahi auraton ne kaha ki pati ne unke saath zabardasti intercourse kiya

claim.en: After marriage a wife cannot refuse sex. A husband who insists is only taking what is his.
claim.hg: Shaadi ke baad patni sex se mana nahi kar sakti. Jo pati zid karta hai woh bas apna haq le raha hai.

truth.en: Marriage does not cancel consent. In NFHS-5, 72% of Indian men rejected every way of punishing a wife's refusal, and forced sex in marriage counts as domestic violence under the 2005 Act, even though the rape law still exempts the husband of an adult wife.
truth.hg: Shaadi se consent khatam nahi hota. NFHS-5 mein 72% Indian mardon ne patni ke mana karne pe use saza dene ke har tareeke ko galat kaha, aur shaadi mein zabardasti sex 2005 ke Act ke tahat domestic violence hai, bhale hi rape law adult patni ke pati ko ab bhi chhoot deta hai.

actions.en: If your partner says no, stop. Do not sulk, shout, bargain or cut off money: those are coercion too.
actions.hg: Partner mana kare toh ruk jao. Muh phulaana, chillaana, saudebaazi karna ya paise rokna bhi dabaav hi hai.

actions.en: When a friend jokes that a wife 'has to' agree, say that you disagree. Most men in the room think as you do.
actions.hg: Jab koi dost mazaak kare ki patni ko toh 'maanna hi padega', toh bol do ki tum sehmat nahi ho. Kamre ke zyada tar mard tumhari tarah hi sochte hain.

actions.en: If you are being forced or pressured into sex in your marriage, call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 in an emergency. The Domestic Violence Act covers sexual abuse by a husband.
actions.hg: Agar shaadi mein tumhare saath sex ke liye zabardasti ya dabaav ho raha hai, toh Women Helpline 181 pe call karo, emergency mein 112. Domestic Violence Act pati ke sexual abuse ko cover karta hai.

actions.en: Parents: let your sons see their father cook, clean and take a 'no' calmly.
actions.hg: Parents: beton ko dikhne do ki papa khaana banate hain, safai karte hain aur 'na' ko shaanti se sunte hain.

actions.en: Before a wedding, say it plainly to each other: either of you can refuse sex on any day, for any reason.
actions.hg: Shaadi se pehle ek doosre se saaf keh do: dono mein se koi bhi, kisi bhi din, kisi bhi wajah se sex se mana kar sakta hai.

title.en: Self-identification out, medical boards in: the Transgender Persons Amendment Act 2026, clause by clause
title.hg: Self-identification bahar, medical board andar: Transgender Persons Amendment Act 2026, clause by clause

dek.en: In March 2026 Parliament took 12 days to delete the right to self-identify gender that the Supreme Court upheld in 2014. Here is what each clause changes, who the new definition leaves out, and what the Union has promised about cards already issued.
dek.hg: March 2026 mein Parliament ne sirf 12 din mein woh right hata diya jisse insaan apna gender khud identify karta tha, aur jise Supreme Court ne 2014 mein maana tha. Yahan dekhiye har clause kya badalta hai, nayi definition kise bahar chhodti hai, aur pehle se bane cards par Union ne kya promise kiya hai.

actions.en: If you hold a transgender certificate or ID card, keep the original and a digital copy safe: the Union has told the Supreme Court such cards continue to operate while the case is pending.
actions.hg: Agar aapke paas transgender certificate ya ID card hai, toh original aur ek digital copy sambhal kar rakhiye: Union ne Supreme Court ko bataya hai ki case pending rehne tak aise cards chalte rahenge.

actions.en: Before applying for a new certificate, read the new definition and ask the District Magistrate's office in writing what the medical board will require.
actions.hg: Naye certificate ke liye apply karne se pehle nayi definition padhiye aur District Magistrate ke office se likhit mein poochhiye ki medical board kya maangega.

actions.en: If you are refused, ask for the decision in writing and take it to a legal aid lawyer; the NALSA helpline is 15100.
actions.hg: Agar application refuse ho jaaye, toh decision likhit mein maangiye aur use legal aid lawyer ke paas le jaiye; NALSA helpline 15100 hai.

actions.en: Follow the Supreme Court case through court reporting, not WhatsApp forwards: the rules may change again when the court decides.
actions.hg: Supreme Court case ko court reporting se follow kijiye, WhatsApp forwards se nahi: court ke decision ke baad rules phir badal sakte hain.

actions.en: If the uncertainty is wearing you down, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar yeh uncertainty aapko thaka rahi hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye, free aur 24x7.

title.en: 9% of men, 0.5% of women: alcohol use disorder is Indian men's hidden mental-health crisis
title.hg: 9% men, 0.5% women: alcohol use disorder Indian mardon ka chhupa hua mental-health crisis hai

dek.en: India's national survey found alcohol use disorder in 9% of men and 0.5% of women, and a treatment gap of 86%. It is an illness with a treatment, not a joke, a habit or an excuse, and the people who pay for leaving it untreated are mostly at home.
dek.hg: India ke national survey mein alcohol use disorder 9% men aur 0.5% women mein mila, aur iska treatment gap 86% tha. Yeh ek bimari hai jiska ilaaj hota hai; na joke, na aadat, na bahana. Aur ilaaj na hone ki keemat zyada tar ghar ke log chukate hain.

claim.en: Heavy drinking is a bad habit. A man with enough willpower would simply stop.
claim.hg: Zyada peena bas ek buri aadat hai. Jis aadmi mein willpower ho, woh khud hi chhod dega.

truth.en: Alcohol produces dependence, and alcohol use disorder is a health condition that doctors treat. In India's national survey the treatment gap for it was 86%.
truth.hg: Alcohol dependence paida karta hai, aur alcohol use disorder ek health condition hai jiska ilaaj doctor karte hain. India ke national survey mein iska treatment gap 86% tha.

actions.en: If you drink to sleep, to calm down or to get through the day, say exactly that to a doctor; it is a health problem, not a character flaw.
actions.hg: Agar aap neend ke liye, shaant hone ke liye ya din nikaalne ke liye peete hain, toh doctor ko theek yahi boliye; yeh health problem hai, character ki kami nahi.

actions.en: If you drink heavily every day, do not stop suddenly on your own; ask a doctor how to come off alcohol safely.
actions.hg: Agar aap roz bahut zyada peete hain, toh akele achanak band mat kijiye; doctor se poochhiye ki alcohol safely kaise chhodein.

actions.en: Start with a free call to Tele-MANAS on 14416, or the psychiatry OPD of a government hospital.
actions.hg: Shuruaat Tele-MANAS ke free call 14416 se kijiye, ya kisi government hospital ke psychiatry OPD se.

actions.en: If a husband or father who drinks is violent, safety comes first: call 112 in an emergency or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Agar peene wala husband ya father violent hai, toh safety pehle: emergency mein 112 ya Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Stop laughing at the 'drunk uncle'. Ask him, when he is sober, whether he wants help, and offer to go with him.
actions.hg: 'Sharabi uncle' par hansna band kijiye. Jab woh hosh mein hon tab poochhiye ki kya unhe madad chahiye, aur saath chalne ka offer dijiye.

title.en: 'You just haven't met the right person': asexuality, marriage pressure and the 'A' in LGBTQIA+
title.hg: 'Tumhe bas sahi insaan nahi mila': asexuality, shaadi ka pressure aur LGBTQIA+ ka 'A'

dek.en: Asexual people feel little or no sexual attraction. The national surveys and crime tables do not count them, but relatives, doctors and prospective spouses have plenty to say. What asexuality is, when a doctor helps and when it becomes a 'cure', and what the law does and does not protect inside a marriage.
dek.hg: Asexual logon ko sexual attraction bahut kam ya bilkul feel nahi hoti. National surveys aur crime tables unhe ginte hi nahi, lekin rishtedaar, doctors aur hone wale spouses ke paas kehne ko bahut kuch hota hai. Asexuality kya hai, doctor kab madad karta hai aur kab woh 'cure' ban jaata hai, aur shaadi ke andar law kya bachata hai aur kya nahi.

label.en: of men aged 15-49 said a husband has the right to use force if his wife refuses sex (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ke aadmiyon ne kaha ki agar patni sex se mana kare toh pati ko force use karne ka haq hai (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of men rejected all four coercive responses to a wife refusing sex in NFHS-5, down from 77% in NFHS-4
label.hg: aadmiyon ne NFHS-5 mein patni ke sex se mana karne par chaaron coercive responses ko reject kiya; NFHS-4 mein yeh 77% tha

label.en: date of the National Medical Commission letter declaring conversion therapy professional misconduct
label.hg: National Medical Commission ke us letter ki date jisne conversion therapy ko professional misconduct declare kiya

claim.en: Asexuality is a phase or a defect, and marriage or the right partner will fix it.
claim.hg: Asexuality ek phase ya kami hai, aur shaadi ya sahi partner milte hi theek ho jayegi.

truth.en: Asexuality means feeling little or no sexual attraction. It is an orientation, not a disorder, and a wedding does not change it. A sudden drop in desire is a different thing and is worth a medical check.
truth.hg: Asexuality ka matlab hai sexual attraction bahut kam ya bilkul feel na hona. Yeh ek orientation hai, koi disorder nahi, aur shaadi se yeh nahi badalti. Desire ka achanak gir jaana alag baat hai, aur uske liye medical check karwana theek hai.

actions.en: If your desire has dropped sharply, or comes with pain or low mood, see a doctor to rule out a treatable cause. That is care, not a 'cure'.
actions.hg: Agar aapki desire achanak bahut kam ho gayi hai, ya saath mein pain ya low mood hai, toh doctor ko dikhaiye taaki treatable cause check ho sake. Yeh care hai, 'cure' nahi.

actions.en: Walk out of any clinic, 'sexologist' or baba that promises to make you 'normal' before the wedding. For a registered doctor, conversion therapy is professional misconduct.
actions.hg: Jo bhi clinic, 'sexologist' ya baba shaadi se pehle aapko 'normal' banane ka promise kare, wahan se uth kar chale aaiye. Registered doctor ke liye conversion therapy professional misconduct hai.

actions.en: Tell a prospective spouse before the engagement, in plain words, and agree on what the marriage will and will not include.
actions.hg: Hone wale spouse ko engagement se pehle saaf shabdon mein bataiye, aur tay kijiye ki is shaadi mein kya hoga aur kya nahi.

actions.en: Never agree to sex out of fear, guilt or 'duty'. If a partner uses force or threats, call 112 or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Darr, guilt ya 'farz' ke naam par sex ke liye kabhi haan mat kahiye. Agar partner force ya dhamki use kare, toh 112 ya Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye.

actions.en: For free, confidential support at any hour, call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Free aur confidential support ke liye kisi bhi waqt Tele-MANAS 14416 par call kijiye.

title.en: Ending it safely: a breakup plan for when an ex follows, threatens or turns up at the door
title.hg: Safely khatam karna: breakup plan, jab ex peechha kare, dhamki de ya darwaaze par aa jaaye

dek.en: Most breakups end with a few bad weeks and a blocked number. Some end with an ex at the hostel gate, in your DMs from a new account, or holding your photos over you. A step-by-step plan for those, and the law that backs each step.
dek.hg: Zyada tar breakups kuch bure hafton aur ek blocked number par khatam ho jaate hain. Kuch mein ex hostel gate par milta hai, naye account se DM karta hai, ya tumhari photos ka darr dikhata hai. Unke liye ek step-by-step plan, aur woh law jo har step ke peeche khada hai.

statLabel.en: national cybercrime helpline, for threats to leak images
statLabel.hg: national cybercrime helpline, images leak karne ki dhamki ke liye

label.en: stalking cases registered by police in India in 2024, a fraction of the following that happens
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein police ne itne stalking cases register kiye, jo asal mein hone wale peechhe ka ek chhota hissa hai

label.en: maximum prison term for stalking on a first conviction, rising to 5 on a repeat (Section 78 BNS)
label.hg: pehli conviction par stalking ki maximum jail, dobara conviction par 5 saal tak (Section 78 BNS)

label.en: the deadline for a platform to remove a nude, sexual or morphed image after your complaint, since 20 February 2026
label.hg: tumhari complaint ke baad platform ke paas nude, sexual ya morphed image hatane ki deadline, 20 February 2026 se

label.en: national cybercrime helpline; complaints can also be filed at cybercrime.gov.in
label.hg: national cybercrime helpline; complaint cybercrime.gov.in par bhi file ho sakti hai

claim.en: He is my ex, so if he keeps following me it is a personal matter, not a police matter.
claim.hg: Woh mera ex hai, toh agar woh mera peechha karta rahe toh yeh personal matter hai, police ka matter nahi.

truth.en: Stalking is a crime under Section 78 of the BNS whether the man is a stranger, a classmate or a former boyfriend. A past relationship gives him no licence, and a clear 'no' is all the law asks you to have given.
truth.hg: BNS ke Section 78 ke under stalking crime hai, chahe woh aadmi stranger ho, classmate ho ya ex-boyfriend. Purana relationship use koi licence nahi deta, aur law tumse bas ek saaf 'na' maangta hai.

actions.en: End it by phone or in a public place, and tell one trusted person your plan before you do.
actions.hg: Breakup phone par ya public place mein karo, aur usse pehle ek bharosemand insaan ko apna plan bata do.

actions.en: The same day, change your passwords, log out other devices and switch off live location sharing.
actions.hg: Usi din passwords badlo, baaki devices se log out karo aur live location sharing band karo.

actions.en: Say 'do not contact me again' once, in writing, then stop replying and keep a dated log of everything.
actions.hg: Ek baar likh kar bolo 'mujhse dobara contact mat karna', phir reply karna band karo aur har cheez ka date ke saath log rakho.

actions.en: If he follows you or turns up, call 112; if he threatens to leak images, call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Agar woh peechha kare ya ghar aa jaaye toh 112 par call karo; images leak karne ki dhamki de toh 1930 par call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo.

actions.en: If an ex threatens self-harm, tell their family and call Tele-MANAS on 14416. You can care about them and still leave.
actions.hg: Agar ex self-harm ki dhamki de, toh uski family ko batao aur Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo. Tum uski fikr karte hue bhi rishta chhod sakte ho.

title.en: Can a drunk person consent? Alcohol, spiked drinks and Section 63 of the BNS
title.hg: Kya drunk insaan consent de sakta hai? Alcohol, spiked drinks aur BNS ka Section 63

dek.en: Indian law says a yes given by someone too intoxicated to understand it is not consent. Straight answers on how drunk is too drunk, what changes when both were drinking, and what to do after a spiked drink.
dek.hg: Indian law kehta hai ki jo itna nashe mein ho ki kuch samajh hi na paaye, uska yes consent nahi hai. Seedhe jawab: kitna drunk 'too drunk' hai, dono ne pi rakhi ho toh kya, aur drink spike hone ke baad kya karna hai.

statLabel.en: of women whose husbands often get drunk reported spousal violence, against 23% where husbands do not drink (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: un women ne spousal violence jheli jinke husband aksar drunk rehte hain; jinke husband nahi peete, unmein 23% (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women whose husbands often get drunk reported physical or sexual violence by them (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: un women ne husband se physical ya sexual violence jheli jinke husband aksar drunk rehte hain (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of Indian men had an alcohol use disorder, against 0.5% of women (NMHS 2015-16)
label.hg: Indian men mein alcohol use disorder tha, women mein sirf 0.5% mein (NMHS 2015-16)

label.en: treatment gap for alcohol use disorders in India (NMHS 2015-16)
label.hg: India mein alcohol use disorders ka treatment gap, yaani itne logon tak ilaaj nahi pahuncha (NMHS 2015-16)

claim.en: If she was drinking, she was asking for it.
claim.hg: Agar usne pi rakhi thi, toh woh khud invite kar rahi thi.

truth.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook calls the idea that a woman's drinking invites sexual contact a false stereotype. Drinking is never a yes, and being drunk never excuses the person who acts.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 handbook kehti hai ki 'woman ka drink karna sexual contact ka invitation hai', yeh ek false stereotype hai. Drinking kabhi yes nahi hai, aur drunk hona karne wale ko kabhi excuse nahi deta.

actions.en: If someone is slurring, stumbling, vomiting or drifting off, the answer is no: get them water, a sober friend and a safe ride home.
actions.hg: Agar koi slur kar raha hai, ladkhada raha hai, ulti kar raha hai ya neend mein dhulak raha hai, toh jawab no hai: use paani, ek sober dost aur safe ride home do.

actions.en: Call 112 if someone cannot be woken or their breathing seems wrong.
actions.hg: Agar koi jagane par na uthe ya uski saans theek na lage, toh 112 call karo.

actions.en: If a drink may have been spiked, go to a hospital the same day, say so, and ask about PEP (within 72 hours) and emergency contraception (up to 5 days).
actions.hg: Agar drink spike hone ka shak hai, toh usi din hospital jao, doctor ko clearly batao, aur PEP (72 ghante ke andar) aur emergency contraception (5 din tak) ke baare mein poochho.

actions.en: Remember that any hospital, government or private, must treat a rape survivor at once and free of cost, and cannot examine her without her consent.
actions.hg: Yaad rakho: har hospital, government ho ya private, rape survivor ka ilaaj turant aur free karega, aur uski consent ke bina koi examination nahi kar sakta.

actions.en: If your own drinking brings anger or blackouts, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 for free counselling.
actions.hg: Agar tumhari drinking gusse ya blackouts tak pahunch rahi hai, toh free counselling ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo.

title.en: The wedding night is not a deadline: consent in the first two years of an Indian marriage
title.hg: Suhaagraat koi deadline nahi: Indian shaadi ke pehle do saal mein consent

dek.en: Two near-strangers, a decorated room and relatives waiting for 'good news'. Surveys show how often violence begins early in a marriage, and the law still exempts husbands of adult wives. Here is what couples and families can do differently.
dek.hg: Do lagbhag anjaan log, saja hua kamra aur 'good news' ka intezaar karte rishtedaar. Surveys dikhate hain ki kai shaadiyon mein violence shuru ke saalon mein hi shuru ho jaati hai, aur law aaj bhi adult wife ke pati ko chhoot deta hai. Couples aur families kya alag kar sakte hain, padho.

statLabel.en: of married women first faced spousal violence within two years of marriage (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: married women ne shaadi ke do saal ke andar pehli baar pati ki violence jheli (NFHS-5)

label.en: of married women first faced physical or sexual violence from their husband within two years of the wedding (NFHS-5)
label.hg: married women ne shaadi ke do saal ke andar pehli baar pati ki physical ya sexual violence jheli (NFHS-5)

label.en: of men aged 15-49 said a husband has the right to use force if his wife refuses sex (NFHS-5)
label.hg: 15-49 saal ke mardon ne kaha ki wife mana kare toh pati ko force karne ka haq hai (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women aged 20-24 were married before 18 (NFHS-6, 2023-24, provisional)
label.hg: 20-24 saal ki women ki shaadi 18 se pehle ho gayi thi (NFHS-6, 2023-24, provisional)

claim.en: Once you are married, the wedding night is already agreed. The wedding was the yes.
claim.hg: Shaadi ho gayi, toh suhaagraat ki haan pehle hi ho chuki hai. Shaadi hi haan thi.

truth.en: Consent is needed every time, on the first night and every night after. The Verma Committee recommended in 2013 that the marital rape exception be deleted, and sex with a wife under 18 is already rape.
truth.hg: Consent har baar chahiye, pehli raat bhi aur uske baad har raat bhi. Verma Committee ne 2013 mein marital rape exception hatane ki recommendation di thi, aur 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex pehle se hi rape hai.

actions.en: Before the wedding, talk alone about sex, fears, children and contraception, and agree there is no deadline.
actions.hg: Shaadi se pehle akele mein baat karo: sex, darr, bachche aur contraception par. Aur tay karo ki koi deadline nahi hai.

actions.en: Agree that either of you can say 'not tonight', and that it ends the matter, with no sulking, guilt or force.
actions.hg: Tay karo ki dono mein se koi bhi 'aaj nahi' keh sakta hai, aur uske baad baat wahin khatam. Na ruthna, na taane, na zabardasti.

actions.en: If sex hurts, stop and see a doctor. Pain is not something to push through.
actions.hg: Agar sex mein dard ho, toh ruko aur doctor ko dikhao. Dard sehte rehne ki cheez nahi hai.

actions.en: Tell relatives together that your bedroom is not a family matter: no sheet checks, no questions about 'good news'.
actions.hg: Rishtedaaron ko milkar saaf bolo ki tumhara kamra family ka matter nahi hai: na chaadar ki checking, na 'good news' ke sawaal.

actions.en: If a husband forces sex, call 181 or go to a One Stop Centre. The Domestic Violence Act treats sexual abuse as domestic violence.
actions.hg: Agar pati zabardasti karta hai, toh 181 par call karo ya One Stop Centre jao. Domestic Violence Act sexual abuse ko bhi domestic violence maanta hai.

title.en: Section 63 says not resisting is not a yes: how to ask, check in and stop
title.hg: Section 63 kehta hai, resist na karna 'yes' nahi hai: kaise poochho, beech mein check-in karo aur ruko

dek.en: Since 2013 Indian law has defined consent as an 'unequivocal voluntary agreement'. Here is what that looks like in a hostel room, a car or a chat, and what to do when you are not sure, or think you got it wrong.
dek.hg: 2013 se Indian law consent ko 'unequivocal voluntary agreement' maanta hai. Hostel room, car ya chat mein iska matlab kya hai, aur agar tumhe pakka na ho, ya lage ki galti ho gayi, toh kya karna hai.

statLabel.en: rape victims in 2024 police records were women aged 18 to 30
statLabel.hg: 2024 ke police records mein rape victims jo 18 se 30 saal ki women thi

label.en: women aged 18 to 30 among the rape victims recorded by police in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein police ke record kiye rape victims mein 18 se 30 saal ki women

label.en: victims recorded under the rape head in India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein rape head ke under record hue victims

label.en: of rape cases registered in 2024 where the accused was someone the survivor knew
label.hg: 2024 ke rape cases jahan accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

claim.en: If she didn't push him away or say no, she agreed.
claim.hg: Agar usne dhakka nahi diya ya no nahi bola, toh woh agree thi.

truth.en: Since 2013 the law has said that a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting. Consent is a clear, willing yes to the specific act.
truth.hg: 2013 se law kehta hai ki jo woman physically resist nahi karti, use sirf is wajah se consenting nahi maana jaayega. Consent matlab us specific act ke liye clear, apni marzi wali yes.

actions.en: Ask in plain words before each new step: 'Do you want to?' or 'Is this okay?'
actions.hg: Har naye step se pehle seedhe words mein poochho: 'Tumhara mann hai?' ya 'Yeh okay hai?'

actions.en: Treat silence, a stiff body, a pulled-back hand or a flat 'okay' as a reason to pause and ask, never to carry on.
actions.hg: Silence, stiff body, peeche khinchta haath ya flat sa 'okay' dikhe, toh ruk kar poochho, aage mat badho.

actions.en: Check in midway, and stop the moment someone says stop, goes quiet or changes their mind, without sulking afterwards.
actions.hg: Beech mein bhi check-in karo, aur jaise hi koi 'stop' bole, chup ho jaaye ya mann badle, turant ruko, aur baad mein sulking mat karo.

actions.en: Wait until both of you are sober: someone too drunk to answer clearly cannot say yes.
actions.hg: Dono sober hon tabhi: jo itna drunk hai ki clear jawab na de sake, woh yes nahi bol sakta.

actions.en: If you think you crossed a line, stop, listen without arguing, and never pressure the other person to say it was fine.
actions.hg: Agar lage ki tumne line cross ki, toh ruko, bina argue kiye suno, aur saamne wale par 'sab theek tha' bolne ka pressure kabhi mat daalo.

title.en: Conversion therapy can cost a doctor their licence. Faith healers face no such rule.
title.hg: Conversion therapy se doctor ka licence ja sakta hai. Faith healers par aisa koi rule nahi.

dek.en: A High Court ordered a halt to attempts to medically 'cure' queer people, and the medical regulator made it misconduct for doctors. The rule stops at the clinic door. Here is who it binds, who it misses, and where a complaint can go.
dek.hg: Ek High Court ne queer logon ka medically 'ilaaj' karne ki koshishon par rok ka order diya, aur medical regulator ne ise doctors ke liye misconduct bana diya. Lekin yeh rule clinic ke darwaaze par hi ruk jaata hai. Padho, yeh kis par lagu hota hai, kisko chhod deta hai, aur complaint kahan ki ja sakti hai.

statLabel.en: NMC declares conversion therapy professional misconduct for doctors
statLabel.hg: NMC ne conversion therapy ko doctors ke liye professional misconduct declare kiya

label.en: the Madras High Court orders a halt to attempts to medically 'cure' LGBTQIA+ people
label.hg: Madras High Court ne LGBTQIA+ logon ka medically 'ilaaj' karne ki koshishon par rok ka order diya

label.en: the National Medical Commission tells state medical councils that conversion therapy is professional misconduct
label.hg: National Medical Commission ne state medical councils ko bataya ki conversion therapy professional misconduct hai

label.en: the Centre sets up a committee to recommend measures against involuntary medical treatment of queer people; no report from it has been found
label.hg: Centre ne queer logon ke zabardasti medical treatment ke khilaaf upaay suggest karne ke liye ek committee banayi; uski koi report nahi mili

claim.en: Conversion therapy is banned in India.
claim.hg: India mein conversion therapy banned hai.

truth.en: Only for doctors. Since 2022 it has been professional misconduct for registered medical practitioners. No law makes it a crime, and faith healers and unregistered 'counsellors' fall outside the rule.
truth.hg: Sirf doctors ke liye. 2022 se yeh registered medical practitioners ke liye professional misconduct hai. Koi law ise crime nahi banata, aur faith healers aur bina registration wale 'counsellors' is rule ke bahar hain.

actions.en: If a doctor offers to 'cure' anyone's sexual orientation or gender identity, note the name, registration number and date, and complain to the state medical council, citing the NMC letter of 25 August 2022.
actions.hg: Agar koi doctor kisi ka sexual orientation ya gender identity 'cure' karne ki baat kare, toh naam, registration number aur date note karo, aur NMC ke 25 August 2022 ke letter ka hawala dekar state medical council mein complaint karo.

actions.en: If a psychiatrist or counsellor treats your orientation as the illness, ask for another professional and complain: the Mental Healthcare Act bars discrimination in care on that ground.
actions.hg: Agar koi psychiatrist ya counsellor tumhare orientation ko hi bimaari maane, toh doosra professional maango aur complaint karo: Mental Healthcare Act is basis par care mein discrimination par rok lagata hai.

actions.en: If anyone locks you up, beats you or threatens you to change who you are, call 112; if you are under 18, call the Child Helpline on 1098.
actions.hg: Agar koi tumhe band karke rakhe, maare ya dhamkaaye taaki tum khud ko badlo, toh 112 par call karo; agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call karo.

actions.en: Complain about alternative-medicine practitioners to the body that registered them, even without a specific rule: a complaint on record is how a gap gets noticed.
actions.hg: Alternative-medicine practitioners ki complaint us body mein karo jisne unhe register kiya hai, chahe koi khaas rule na ho: record par complaint hi gap ko nazar mein laati hai.

actions.en: If the pressure is wearing you down, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar yeh pressure tumhe tod raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, free aur 24x7.

title.en: 'She came back to my room, so she agreed': five dating myths, checked against Section 63 and the data
title.hg: 'Room mein aayi thi, toh haan hi thi': dating ke 5 myths, Section 63 aur data ke saamne

dek.en: Most rape accused in India are known to the survivor, and the biggest group is friends and partners. Here is what the law and the Supreme Court actually say about five things young people are taught to believe about dating.
dek.hg: India mein rape ke zyada tar accused survivor ke jaan-pehchaan wale hote hain, aur sabse bada group dost aur partners ka hai. Dating ke baare mein jo paanch baatein humein sikhayi jaati hain, un par law aur Supreme Court asal mein kya kehte hain, padho.

statLabel.en: of never-married women who faced sexual violence named a boyfriend or ex (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: sexual violence jhel chuki unmarried women ne boyfriend ya ex ka naam liya (NFHS-5)

label.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a friend, online friend, live-in partner or separated husband
label.hg: 2024 mein rape cases jinmein accused dost, online dost, live-in partner ya alag reh raha pati tha

label.en: of rape cases registered in 2024 involved an accused the survivor knew
label.hg: 2024 mein darj rape cases jinmein accused ko survivor pehle se jaanti thi

label.en: of never-married women who faced sexual violence named a stranger (NFHS-5)
label.hg: sexual violence jhel chuki unmarried women ne accused ko stranger bataya (NFHS-5)

claim.en: If she came back to my room, kissed me, or we were already dating, she agreed.
claim.hg: Agar woh mere room mein aayi, mujhe kiss kiya, ya hum pehle se date kar rahe the, toh uski haan thi.

truth.en: Section 63 of the BNS says consent is an unequivocal, voluntary agreement to the specific sexual act. A room, a kiss, a past yes or a relationship is not that agreement.
truth.hg: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 63 kehta hai ki consent ka matlab hai kisi specific sexual act ke liye saaf aur apni marzi se di gayi haan. Room, kiss, purani haan ya rishta, inmein se koi bhi woh haan nahi hai.

actions.en: Ask before each new step, and treat silence, hesitation or 'I don't know' as a no.
actions.hg: Har naye step se pehle poocho. Chuppi, hichkichahat ya 'pata nahi' ko na hi samjho.

actions.en: Stop if the other person is very drunk, half asleep or cannot clearly say yes.
actions.hg: Agar saamne wala bahut nashe mein hai, aadhi neend mein hai, ya saaf haan nahi keh pa raha, toh ruk jao.

actions.en: Hear a no the first time. Following or messaging someone again and again after a no can be stalking under Section 78 BNS.
actions.hg: Pehli baar mein hi na sun lo. Na ke baad baar-baar peecha karna ya message karna Section 78 BNS ke under stalking ho sakta hai.

actions.en: Never forward a private photo. Sharing a woman's private image without her consent is a crime even if she agreed to the photo.
actions.hg: Kisi ki private photo kabhi forward mat karo. Kisi woman ki private photo uski marzi ke bina share karna crime hai, chahe photo khinchwane ke liye usne haan kaha ho.

actions.en: If it happened to you, it was not your fault: tell one person you trust, call 181 (Women Helpline) or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar tumhare saath aisa hua hai, toh galti tumhari nahi hai. Kisi bharosemand insaan ko batao, 181 (Women Helpline) par call karo, ya emergency mein 112 par.

title.en: 13,879 rape cases in 2024 named a friend or partner: India's uncounted dating violence
title.hg: 2024 mein rape ke 13,879 cases mein accused dost ya partner tha: India ki dating violence, jise koi ginta hi nahi

dek.en: NCRB's biggest group of known accused folds boyfriends, online contacts, live-in partners and separated husbands into one box. For stalking and online abuse, the relationship is not counted at all. What the numbers show, what they hide and what a policy would need.
dek.hg: NCRB ke known accused ka sabse bada group boyfriends, online dost, live-in partners aur alag reh rahe pati ko ek hi box mein daal deta hai. Stalking aur online abuse mein toh rishta gina hi nahi jaata. Numbers kya dikhate hain, kya chhupate hain, aur policy mein kya chahiye.

statLabel.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a friend, online friend or partner
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein rape ke cases jinme accused dost, online dost ya partner tha

label.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a friend, online friend, live-in partner or separated husband, the largest group of known accused
label.hg: 2024 mein rape ke cases jinme accused dost, online dost, live-in partner ya alag reh raha pati tha; known accused ka sabse bada group

label.en: of 44,126 POCSO penetrative-assault cases in 2024 named a friend, online friend or live-in partner
label.hg: 2024 mein POCSO ke 44,126 penetrative assault cases mein se itne cases jinme accused dost, online dost ya live-in partner tha

label.en: of never-married women who reported sexual violence named a current or former boyfriend (NFHS-5)
label.hg: jin women ki kabhi shaadi nahi hui aur jinhone sexual violence report ki, unme se itni ne current ya ex-boyfriend ka naam liya (NFHS-5)

label.en: of ever-married or partnered girls aged 15-19 worldwide have faced violence from a partner (WHO 2023 estimates)
label.hg: duniya bhar mein 15-19 saal ki married ya partnered ladkiyan jo partner ki violence jhel chuki hain (WHO ke 2023 estimates)

claim.en: What happens between a couple who are dating is a private quarrel, not violence.
