claim.hg: Dating kar rahe couple ke beech jo hota hai, woh unka private jhagda hai, violence nahi.

truth.en: Friends and partners were the largest group of known accused in India's 2024 rape cases. Stalking, threats, image abuse and force by a partner are violence, and many of them are crimes.
truth.hg: 2024 ke rape cases mein known accused ka sabse bada group dost aur partners the. Partner ka stalking, dhamkiyan, photos se blackmail aur zabardasti violence hai, aur inme se kai crime hain.

actions.en: If a partner's checking, threats or pressure frighten you, tell one person you trust this week.
actions.hg: Agar partner ki checking, dhamkiyan ya pressure tumhe darate hain, toh isi hafte kisi bharosemand insaan ko batao.

actions.en: Report online stalking, threats or leaked images at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930.
actions.hg: Online stalking, dhamkiyon ya leaked photos ki complaint cybercrime.gov.in pe ya 1930 pe karo.

actions.en: In danger, call 112. Under 18, the Child Helpline 1098 can help; women can call the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Khatra ho toh 112 pe call karo. 18 se kam umar ho toh Child Helpline 1098 madad kar sakti hai; women Women Helpline 181 pe call kar sakti hain.

actions.en: Ask your school or college to teach consent and the warning signs of a controlling relationship.
actions.hg: Apne school ya college se kaho ki consent aur controlling relationship ke warning signs padhayein.

title.en: 'He never hit me, so it isn't abuse': five myths that hide emotional abuse
title.hg: 'Usne kabhi haath toh nahi uthaya, phir abuse kaise?': paanch myths jo emotional abuse ko chhupa dete hain

dek.en: Constant checking, cruel 'jokes', jealousy and threats of self-harm leave no bruises, so families, friends and even global statistics miss them. Five myths, and what the evidence and the law say instead.
dek.hg: Har waqt ki checking, chubhte 'jokes', jealousy aur self-harm ki dhamkiyan koi nishaan nahi chhodti, isliye family, dost aur global data bhi inhe miss kar dete hain. Paanch myths, aur un pe evidence aur law kya kehte hain.

statLabel.en: of ever-married women faced physical, sexual or emotional violence from a husband (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: ever-married women jinhone pati ki physical, sexual ya emotional violence jheli (NFHS-5)

label.en: of ever-married women in India have faced physical, sexual or emotional violence from a husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: India mein ever-married women jo pati ki physical, sexual ya emotional violence jhel chuki hain (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women afraid of their husband most of the time had faced spousal violence, against 15% of women never afraid (NFHS-5)
label.hg: jo women zyada tar time pati se darti hain, unme se itni spousal violence jhel chuki thi; kabhi na darne walon mein yeh 15% tha (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5)
label.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali women jinhone na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya (NFHS-5)

claim.en: If he has never hit you, it isn't abuse.
claim.hg: Agar usne kabhi haath nahi uthaya, toh yeh abuse nahi hai.

truth.en: Abuse is a pattern of control, fear and humiliation. Indian domestic-violence law reaches well beyond physical harm, and cruelty in criminal law does not need a bruise.
truth.hg: Abuse control, darr aur humiliation ka pattern hai. India ka domestic-violence law sirf physical chot tak seemit nahi hai, aur criminal law mein cruelty ke liye chot ka nishaan zaroori nahi.

actions.en: Name it: insults, threats, isolation and constant checking are abuse even without a single slap.
actions.hg: Ise naam do: insults, dhamkiyan, akela kar dena aur har waqt ki checking abuse hai, chahe ek bhi thappad na pada ho.

actions.en: Keep a private record of incidents, with dates and screenshots, where your partner cannot reach it.
actions.hg: Har incident ko date aur screenshots ke saath aisi jagah likh ke rakho jahan partner na pahunch sake.

actions.en: If a partner threatens self-harm, call 112 or Tele-MANAS 14416 for them, and tell someone you trust.
actions.hg: Agar partner self-harm ki dhamki de, toh unke liye 112 ya Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo, aur kisi bharosemand insaan ko batao.

actions.en: For support, call the Women Helpline 181 or Tele-MANAS 14416, or visit a One Stop Centre (Sakhi).
actions.hg: Support ke liye Women Helpline 181 ya Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo, ya kisi One Stop Centre (Sakhi) mein jao.

actions.en: If a friend confides in you, believe them. Never say 'at least he doesn't hit you'.
actions.hg: Agar koi dost tumhe apni baat bataye, toh uska yakeen karo. Kabhi mat bolo 'kam se kam maarta toh nahi'.

title.en: Sons of fathers who did housework were twice as likely to grow up gender-equal. Boys watch who does the work
title.hg: Jinke papa ghar ka kaam karte the, un beton ke gender-equal banne ke chances dugne the. Ladke dekhte hain ki kaam kaun karta hai

dek.en: A survey of 9,205 men in seven Indian states linked how they treat women to what they watched as boys: who cooked, who decided, who was treated as less. For parents the finding is uncomfortable and useful. The lesson is in what you do, not in what you say.
dek.hg: Saat Indian states ke 9,205 aadmiyon ke survey ne do cheezon ko joda: woh auraton ke saath kaise pesh aate hain, aur unhone bachpan mein ghar par kya dekha tha. Khana kaun banata tha, faisle kaun leta tha, kise kamtar samjha jaata tha. Parents ke liye yeh finding uncomfortable bhi hai aur kaam ki bhi. Sabak aapke kehne mein nahi, aapke karne mein hai.

statLabel.en: more likely to hold gender-equitable attitudes if their father did household chores (ICRW-UNFPA, 2014)
statLabel.hg: zyada chances gender-equitable soch ke, agar pita ghar ka kaam karte the (ICRW-UNFPA, 2014)

label.en: more likely to be gender-equitable: men whose fathers did household chores
label.hg: zyada chances gender-equitable hone ke: woh aadmi jinke pita ghar ka kaam karte the

label.en: more likely to be violent to a partner: men who often faced discrimination as children
label.hg: zyada chances partner ke saath violence karne ke: woh aadmi jinhone bachpan mein aksar bhed-bhaav jhela

label.en: of women whose fathers beat their mothers faced violence from their own husbands, against 25% of women whose fathers did not
label.hg: jin auraton ke pita unki maa ko maarte the, unhone khud pati ki violence jheli; jinke pita nahi maarte the, unme 25%

label.en: of men surveyed in seven states were classed as gender-equitable; 32% were 'rigid'
label.hg: saat states ke survey mein aadmi gender-equitable maane gaye; 32% 'rigid' the

claim.en: Boys will be boys. How a son treats women is his nature, or the work of his friends and his phone.
claim.hg: Ladke toh ladke hi rahenge. Beta auraton ke saath kaisa bartaav karta hai, yeh uska nature hai, ya uske doston aur phone ka asar.

truth.en: In a seven-state survey, what men had seen at home as boys, a father doing chores, parents deciding together, or discrimination, went closely with how they treated women as adults.
truth.hg: Saat states ke survey mein aadmiyon ne bachpan mein ghar par jo dekha tha, pita ka ghar ka kaam karna, maa-baap ka milkar faisle lena, ya bhed-bhaav, wahi bade hokar auraton ke saath unke bartaav se gehra juda mila.

actions.en: Fathers: take over one daily chore completely and do it where your children can see. Do not call it 'helping'.
actions.hg: Fathers: roz ka ek kaam poori tarah apne zimme lijiye aur use wahan kijiye jahan bachche dekh sakein. Ise 'help' mat kahiye.

actions.en: Discuss money and family decisions with your partner in front of the children, and let her view carry weight.
actions.hg: Paise aur family ke faisle apne partner ke saath bachchon ke saamne discuss kijiye, aur unki raay ko wazan dijiye.

actions.en: Give sons and daughters the same chores, rules, food, fees and praise.
actions.hg: Beton aur betiyon ko ek jaise kaam, rules, khana, fees aur tareef dijiye.

actions.en: Never hit or humiliate their mother, or them. If it has happened, say in front of them that it was wrong.
actions.hg: Unki maa ko ya unhe kabhi mat maariye, na zaleel kijiye. Agar aisa hua hai, toh unke saamne kahiye ki woh galat tha.

actions.en: If there is violence at home: Child Helpline 1098, Women Helpline 181, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar ghar mein violence hai: Child Helpline 1098, Women Helpline 181, ya emergency mein 112.

title.en: 'She said no': a guide to handling rejection before hurt turns into harassment
title.hg: 'Usne na keh diya': rejection ko kaise sambhalein, isse pehle ki dard harassment ban jaaye

dek.en: Being turned down hurts, and the days after it are when some men start following, pestering or threatening. This guide is for the person who heard the no: what you are feeling, why 'try harder' is bad advice, where the law draws the line, and who to talk to.
dek.hg: Na sunna dukhta hai, aur uske baad ke dinon mein hi kuch ladke peechha karna, baar-baar message karna ya dhamkana shuru kar dete hain. Yeh guide us insaan ke liye hai jisne na suni: tum kya feel kar rahe ho, 'aur koshish karo' kyun galat salaah hai, law line kahan kheenchta hai, aur kisse baat karni chahiye.

label.en: stalking cases registered by police in India in 2024
label.hg: stalking ke cases police ne 2024 mein India mein register kiye

label.en: maximum prison term for stalking under Section 78 of the BNS on a first conviction; 5 years on a repeat
label.hg: BNS ki Section 78 ke under stalking ki pehli conviction par maximum jail; dobara conviction par 5 saal

label.en: of men in a seven-state survey were classed as holding 'rigid' ideas of masculinity (2014)
label.hg: saat states ke ek survey mein itne mardon ko masculinity ke 'rigid' ideas wala maana gaya (2014)

label.en: murders in 2024 for which police recorded 'love affairs' as the motive
label.hg: murders 2024 mein, jinme police ne motive 'love affairs' likha

claim.en: If she says no, keep trying. Persistence proves you are serious and wins her over in the end.
claim.hg: Agar woh na kahe, toh lage raho. Persistence se saabit hota hai ki tum serious ho, aur aakhir mein woh maan jaati hai.

truth.en: A no is an answer. Following a woman and contacting her, or trying to, again and again after she has clearly shown she is not interested is stalking under Section 78 of the BNS, punishable with up to 3 years in prison.
truth.hg: Na ek jawab hai. Jab kisi aurat ne saaf dikha diya ho ki use interest nahi hai, uske baad uska peechha karna aur baar-baar contact karna ya karne ki koshish karna BNS ki Section 78 ke under stalking hai, jisme 3 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai.

actions.en: Reply once, briefly and politely, or not at all. Then stop contacting her.
actions.hg: Ek baar, chhota aur tameez se reply karo, ya bilkul mat karo. Phir use contact karna band kar do.

actions.en: Mute or unfollow her accounts for your own sake, and do not send messages through her friends, family or new numbers.
actions.hg: Apne hi liye uske accounts mute ya unfollow kar do, aur uske doston, family ya naye numbers ke zariye message mat bhejo.

actions.en: Do not message when you are angry, sleepless or drunk. Write it in your notes app and delete it in the morning.
actions.hg: Jab gusse mein ho, neend poori na hui ho ya nashe mein ho, tab message mat karo. Notes app mein likho aur subah delete kar do.

actions.en: Tell one person who will not say 'keep trying': a friend, a sibling, a teacher or a counsellor.
actions.hg: Kisi ek aise insaan ko batao jo 'lage raho' nahi bolega: dost, bhai-behen, teacher ya counsellor.

actions.en: If you keep thinking of hurting her or yourself, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and open round the clock; in an emergency call 112.
actions.hg: Agar baar-baar use ya khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ka khayal aaye, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, free aur 24x7; emergency mein 112 par call karo.

title.en: More than half the women who died by suicide in 2022 were housewives: 25,309 deaths, and what the label hides
title.hg: 2022 mein suicide se mari auraton mein aadhe se zyada housewives thi: 25,309 maut, aur woh sab jo yeh label chhupa leta hai

dek.en: NCRB files them under one word. That word says nothing about unpaid work, money she does not control, isolation or violence at home. What the data can and cannot tell us, and what families, friends and services can change.
dek.hg: NCRB inhe ek hi shabd ke neeche darj karta hai. Woh shabd bina tankhwah ke kaam, apne paise na hone, akelepan ya ghar ki hinsa ke baare mein kuch nahi batata. Data kya bata sakta hai aur kya nahi, aur family, dost aur services kya badal sakte hain.

statLabel.en: of women who died by suicide in India in 2022 were housewives (NCRB)
statLabel.hg: auratein jo 2022 mein India mein suicide se mari, unmein itni housewives thi (NCRB)

label.en: housewives died by suicide in India in 2022
label.hg: housewives 2022 mein India mein suicide se mari

label.en: of the 48,172 women who died by suicide in 2022 were housewives
label.hg: 2022 mein suicide se mari 48,172 auraton mein itni housewives thi

label.en: cases of abetment of suicide of women registered by police in 2024
label.hg: auraton ke suicide ke liye uksaane (abetment) ke cases police ne 2024 mein darj kiye

label.en: of women were at high suicidal risk in the National Mental Health Survey 2015-16
label.hg: auratein National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 mein high suicidal risk pe thi

claim.en: A housewife has no boss, no deadlines and no job to lose, so she has little to be stressed about.
claim.hg: Housewife ka na koi boss hota hai, na deadline, na naukri jaane ka darr, toh use stress kis baat ka?

truth.en: In 2022, housewives were 52.5% of the women who died by suicide in India. Unpaid work, no income of her own, isolation and violence at home are real pressures, and every one of them can be changed.
truth.hg: 2022 mein India mein suicide se mari auraton mein 52.5% housewives thi. Bina tankhwah ka kaam, apni koi kamaai nahi, akelapan aur ghar ki hinsa asli pressure hain, aur inmein se har ek ko badla ja sakta hai.

actions.en: If you are struggling, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock. In an emergency, call 112.
actions.hg: Agar tum mushkil mein ho, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo, free hai aur din-raat chalta hai. Emergency mein 112 pe call karo.

actions.en: Tell your married daughter or sister in plain words that she can come home at any time, and mean it.
actions.hg: Apni shaadi-shuda beti ya behen se saaf shabdon mein kaho ki woh kabhi bhi ghar wapas aa sakti hai, aur is baat pe kaayam raho.

actions.en: If you are worried about someone, ask her directly whether she is thinking about suicide, then listen without telling her to adjust.
actions.hg: Agar kisi ki fikar ho rahi hai, toh usse seedha poochho ki kya woh suicide ke baare mein soch rahi hai, phir use 'adjust kar lo' kahe bina suno.

actions.en: If she is being hit, threatened or controlled at home, call the Women Helpline 181 with her or for her.
actions.hg: Agar ghar mein use maara, dhamkaaya ya control kiya ja raha hai, toh uske saath ya uske liye Women Helpline 181 pe call karo.

actions.en: Make sure every woman in the family has her own phone, her own bank account and people she can meet outside the house.
actions.hg: Dhyaan rakho ki family ki har aurat ke paas apna phone ho, apna bank account ho aur ghar ke baahar milne wale log hon.

title.en: Intersex is not transgender: what the 2026 amendment gets wrong about people born with variations
title.hg: Intersex ka matlab transgender nahi hai: variations ke saath paida hue logon ke baare mein 2026 ka amendment kahan galat hai

dek.en: Intersex describes a body. Transgender describes an identity. India's amended law puts both under one word, sends certificates through a medical board, and still has no answer on surgery done to babies who cannot consent.
dek.hg: Intersex body ke baare mein hai. Transgender identity ke baare mein. India ka amended law dono ko ek hi shabd ke neeche rakhta hai, certificate ko medical board se guzaarta hai, aur un babies ki surgery par ab bhi koi jawab nahi deta jo consent de hi nahi sakte.

label.en: people recorded as 'other' in Census 2011, the figure the government still uses as the transgender population; the census did not ask about intersex variations
label.hg: log Census 2011 mein 'other' category mein darj hue, aur sarkar aaj bhi isi figure ko transgender population maanti hai; census ne intersex variations ke baare mein poocha hi nahi

label.en: from introduction to passage in Parliament for the 2026 transgender amendment
label.hg: 2026 ke transgender amendment ko Parliament mein introduce hone se pass hone tak itna hi waqt laga

label.en: the day the Centre set up a committee whose terms cover involuntary surgeries on queer persons; no report from it has been found
label.hg: is din Centre ne woh committee banayi jiske terms mein queer logon par involuntary surgeries ka mudda hai; uski koi report ab tak nahi mili

claim.en: Intersex is just another word for transgender.
claim.hg: Intersex bas transgender ka doosra naam hai.

truth.en: Intersex describes how a body developed: variations in chromosomes, hormones or anatomy. Transgender describes gender identity. An intersex person may be a man, a woman, transgender or non-binary.
truth.hg: Intersex batata hai ki body kaise develop hui: chromosomes, hormones ya anatomy mein variations. Transgender gender identity ke baare mein hai. Ek intersex insaan aadmi, aurat, transgender ya non-binary, kuch bhi ho sakta hai.

actions.en: If a baby is born with genitals that are not clearly male or female, get a specialist medical check without delay, and go to hospital at once if the baby vomits, feeds poorly, is very sleepy or cannot pass urine.
actions.hg: Agar baby ke genitals clearly ladke ya ladki jaise nahi hain, toh bina der kiye specialist medical check karwaiye, aur agar baby ulti kare, feed theek se na le, bahut sust rahe ya urine pass na kar paye toh turant hospital jaiye.

actions.en: Ask every doctor two questions and get the answers in writing: what is medically necessary now, and what can wait until the child can take part in the decision?
actions.hg: Har doctor se do sawaal poochiye aur jawab likhit mein lijiye: abhi medically kya zaroori hai, aur kya tab tak ruk sakta hai jab tak bachcha khud faisle mein shaamil ho sake?

actions.en: Do not agree, under pressure from relatives, to surgery done only to make a body look typical. It cannot be undone.
actions.hg: Rishtedaaron ke pressure mein aisi surgery ke liye haan mat kahiye jo sirf body ko typical dikhane ke liye ho. Yeh wapas nahi ho sakti.

actions.en: If you hold a transgender identity card issued before the 2026 amendment, keep it safe: the Union has told the Supreme Court such cards continue to operate while the case is heard.
actions.hg: Agar aapke paas 2026 amendment se pehle bana transgender identity card hai, toh use sambhaal kar rakhiye: Union ne Supreme Court ko bataya hai ki case chalne tak aise cards chalte rahenge.

actions.en: For free legal aid call 15100. For free mental health support at any hour call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Free legal aid ke liye 15100 call kijiye. Free mental health support ke liye kisi bhi waqt Tele-MANAS 14416 par call kijiye.

title.en: Naz to Navtej to the 2026 amendment: 17 years of LGBTQ+ rights won in court and partly reversed in Parliament
title.hg: Naz se Navtej, phir 2026 ka amendment: 17 saal mein LGBTQ+ rights court mein jeete gaye, aur Parliament mein kuch wapas le liye gaye

dek.en: Almost every right LGBTQ+ Indians hold came from a judge. The latest reversal came from Parliament, in 12 days. A dated timeline from 2 July 2009 to the Supreme Court hearing of 17 August 2026, and the pattern behind it.
dek.hg: LGBTQ+ Indians ke paas jo bhi rights hain, lagbhag sab kisi judge ke faisle se aaye. Sabse naya reversal Parliament se aaya, 12 din mein. 2 July 2009 se 17 August 2026 ki Supreme Court hearing tak ki dated timeline, aur uske peeche ka pattern.

statLabel.en: Supreme Court reads down Section 377 in Navtej Singh Johar
statLabel.hg: Supreme Court ne Navtej Singh Johar mein Section 377 ko read down kiya

label.en: Delhi High Court decriminalises consensual gay sex in Naz Foundation
label.hg: Delhi High Court ne Naz Foundation mein consensual gay sex ko decriminalise kiya

label.en: five Supreme Court judges unanimously read down Section 377 in Navtej Singh Johar
label.hg: Supreme Court ke paanch judges ne Navtej Singh Johar mein ek-rai se Section 377 ko read down kiya

label.en: the Supreme Court's split against civil unions for queer couples in Supriyo (2023)
label.hg: Supriyo (2023) mein queer couples ke civil unions ke khilaaf Supreme Court ka split

label.en: from introduction to passage of the 2026 amendment that ended gender self-identification
label.hg: 2026 ke us amendment ke introduce hone se pass hone tak ka time, jisne gender self-identification khatam kiya

actions.en: Know where things stand today: a consensual same-sex relationship is legal; marriage and civil unions are not recognised.
actions.hg: Jaaniye ki aaj kya status hai: consensual same-sex relationship legal hai; marriage aur civil unions recognised nahi hain.

actions.en: Hold a transgender identity card issued under the 2019 Act? Keep it and copies safe: the Union told the Supreme Court that cards already issued will continue to operate while the case is pending.
actions.hg: Aapke paas 2019 Act ke tahat issue hua transgender identity card hai? Use aur uski copies sambhaal kar rakhiye: Union ne Supreme Court ko bataya hai ki pehle se issue hue cards case pending rehne tak chalte rahenge.

actions.en: If a doctor offers to 'cure' anyone's sexual orientation or gender identity, refuse and complain to the state medical council: it is professional misconduct.
actions.hg: Agar koi doctor kisi ki sexual orientation ya gender identity 'cure' karne ki baat kare, toh mana kijiye aur state medical council mein complaint kijiye: yeh professional misconduct hai.

actions.en: Follow the Supreme Court challenge to the 2026 amendment; its orders will decide how certificates are issued.
actions.hg: 2026 ke amendment ke khilaaf Supreme Court challenge par nazar rakhiye; uske orders tay karenge ki certificates kaise issue honge.

actions.en: If the back-and-forth is wearing you down, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar yeh aage-peeche aapko thaka raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye, free aur 24x7.

title.en: Orientation, gender identity, intersex: the LGBTQIA+ basics, and how Indian law keeps mixing them up
title.hg: Orientation, gender identity, intersex: LGBTQIA+ ki basics, aur Indian law inhe baar-baar kaise mila deta hai

dek.en: Whom you are attracted to, who you are and how your body developed are three separate questions. Indian courts answered two of them clearly. The 2026 transgender amendment then folded the categories into each other. A plain-words guide to the letters and to the law.
dek.hg: Tum kiski taraf attract hote ho, tum kaun ho, aur tumhari body kaise develop hui: yeh teen alag sawaal hain. Indian courts ne inme se do ke saaf jawab diye. Phir 2026 ke transgender amendment ne categories ko ek-doosre mein mila diya. Letters aur law, dono ki seedhe shabdon mein guide.

label.en: the Supreme Court upholds the right to self-identify one's gender (NALSA)
label.hg: Supreme Court ne apna gender khud pehchaanne ke right ko barkaraar rakha (NALSA)

label.en: the Supreme Court decriminalises consensual same-sex relations between adults (Navtej)
label.hg: Supreme Court ne adults ke beech consensual same-sex relations ko decriminalise kiya (Navtej)

label.en: the amended definition of 'transgender person' comes into force
label.hg: 'transgender person' ki badli hui definition lagu hui

label.en: people counted in the single 'other' gender category of Census 2011
label.hg: log Census 2011 ki akeli 'other' gender category mein gine gaye

actions.en: Keep the three questions apart: attraction, identity and body. Knowing one tells you nothing about the other two.
actions.hg: Teeno sawaalon ko alag rakho: attraction, identity aur body. Ek ka jawab baaki do ke baare mein kuch nahi batata.

actions.en: Use the name and pronoun a person asks for. If you are unsure, use their name or ask privately.
actions.hg: Insaan jo naam aur pronoun bataye, wahi use karo. Agar sure nahi ho, toh unka naam lo ya akele mein pooch lo.

actions.en: Never guess someone's orientation or gender from clothes, voice or walk, and never tell others what they told you in confidence.
actions.hg: Kapdon, awaaz ya chaal se kisi ka orientation ya gender guess mat karo, aur jo unhone bharose mein bataya, woh doosron ko mat batao.

actions.en: Do not ask about anyone's body, surgery or sex life unless they bring it up.
actions.hg: Kisi ki body, surgery ya sex life ke baare mein tab tak mat poochho jab tak woh khud baat na chhedein.

actions.en: If questions about who you are feel heavy, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and open round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar 'main kaun hoon' wale sawaal bhaari lag rahe hain, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, free aur 24x7.

title.en: 1,391 murders over 'love affairs' in 2024: when possessive love turns lethal
title.hg: 2024 mein 'love affairs' ke naam par 1,391 murders: jab possessive pyaar jaanleva ban jaata hai

dek.en: NCRB's murder tables have a motive column called 'love affairs'. In 2024 it held 1,391 killings, more than 38 times the 36 recorded as honour killings, and it does not say who killed whom. What the column counts, what it misses, and why a threat that sounds like ownership is still a threat.
dek.hg: NCRB ki murder tables mein ek motive column hai jiska naam hai 'love affairs'. 2024 mein isme 1,391 killings thi, honour killing ke naam par darj 36 se 38 guna se bhi zyada, aur yeh nahi batata ki kisne kisko maara. Yeh column kya ginta hai, kya chhod deta hai, aur maalikana haq jaisi sunayi dene wali dhamki phir bhi dhamki kyun hai.

statLabel.en: murders with 'love affairs' recorded as the motive, India 2024
statLabel.hg: murders jinka motive 'love affairs' likha gaya, India 2024

label.en: murders with 'love affairs' recorded as the motive in India in 2024
label.hg: murders jinka motive 2024 mein India mein 'love affairs' likha gaya

label.en: murders recorded with 'honour killing' as the motive in the same year
label.hg: murders jinka motive usi saal 'honour killing' likha gaya

label.en: women and girls killed every day by a partner or family member worldwide in 2024
label.hg: women aur girls jo 2024 mein duniya bhar mein har din partner ya family member ke haathon maari gayi

label.en: stalking cases registered by police in India in 2024
label.hg: stalking cases jo 2024 mein India mein police ne register kiye

claim.en: The more jealous and possessive he is, the more he loves you.
claim.hg: Woh jitna zyada jealous aur possessive hai, utna hi zyada pyaar karta hai.

truth.en: Possessiveness is control, not love. Following or repeatedly contacting a woman after a clear no is stalking under Section 78 of the BNS, and a threat to hurt someone for leaving is a threat, whatever it is called.
truth.hg: Possessiveness control hai, pyaar nahi. Saaf 'na' ke baad kisi aurat ka peecha karna ya use baar-baar contact karna BNS Section 78 ke under stalking hai, aur chhod kar jaane par nuksaan pahunchane ki dhamki, dhamki hi hai, use chahe jo naam diya jaaye.

actions.en: Treat 'if you are not mine, you will be no one's' as a threat, not a dialogue: save it, tell two people you trust and report it.
actions.hg: 'Agar tum meri nahi hui toh kisi ki nahi hogi' ko dialogue nahi, dhamki maano: use save karo, do bharosemand logon ko batao aur report karo.

actions.en: If an ex or a rejected admirer keeps following or contacting you, log every incident and report stalking under Section 78 BNS at any police station.
actions.hg: Agar koi ex ya reject kiya gaya admirer aapka peecha karta rahe ya contact karta rahe, toh har incident ka log rakho aur BNS Section 78 ke under kisi bhi police station mein stalking ki report karo.

actions.en: If you fear you are about to be hurt, call 112. The Women Helpline is 181.
actions.hg: Agar lage ki aapko abhi nuksaan pahunchaya ja sakta hai, toh 112 par call karo. Women Helpline 181 hai.

actions.en: You can refuse a 'last meeting'. If you decide to go, choose a public place and tell a friend where you are.
actions.hg: 'Aakhri baar milne' se aap mana kar sakte ho. Agar jaane ka faisla karo, toh public jagah chuno aur kisi dost ko batao ki aap kahan ho.

actions.en: If a friend talks about hurting an ex or himself, do not keep it secret: tell someone who can act, and share Tele-MANAS 14416.
actions.hg: Agar koi dost apni ex ko ya khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ki baat kare, toh ise secret mat rakho: kisi aise insaan ko batao jo kuch kar sake, aur Tele-MANAS 14416 share karo.

title.en: Love or control? A 12-question relationship self-check, from 'who were you talking to' to 'I'll die if you leave'
title.hg: Love ya control? 12 sawaalon ka relationship self-check, 'kisse baat kar rahi thi?' se 'chhod ke gayi toh mar jaunga' tak

dek.en: Abuse between young partners rarely begins with a slap. It begins with checking, guilt and isolation that look like care. Answer these 12 questions honestly, then read what to do next.
dek.hg: Young couples mein abuse aksar thappad se shuru nahi hota. Woh phone checking, guilt aur doston se door karne se shuru hota hai, jo care jaisa dikhta hai. Yeh 12 sawaal imaandari se padho, phir jaano aage kya karna hai.

statLabel.en: of ever-partnered girls aged 15-19 worldwide have already faced violence from a partner (WHO, 2023)
statLabel.hg: duniya bhar mein 15-19 saal ki married ya partnered ladkiyan, jo partner ki violence jhel chuki hain (WHO, 2023)

label.en: of ever-married or partnered girls aged 15-19 worldwide have faced physical or sexual violence from a partner (WHO 2023 estimates)
label.hg: duniya bhar mein 15-19 saal ki married ya partnered ladkiyan, jo partner ki physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki hain (WHO ke 2023 estimates)

label.en: of Indian women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: Indian women jo physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki thi aur jinhone na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women afraid of their husband most of the time had faced spousal violence, against 15% of women never afraid (NFHS-5)
label.hg: jo women zyada tar time pati se darti hain, unme se itni spousal violence jhel chuki thi; kabhi na darne walon mein yeh 15% tha (NFHS-5)

claim.en: If they check my phone and ask where I am all the time, it means they really care.
claim.hg: Agar woh mera phone check karte hain aur har waqt poochte hain ki main kahan hoon, toh iska matlab unhe sach mein care hai.

truth.en: Care respects your phone, your friends and your 'no'. Constant checking is control, and control is often where abuse begins.
truth.hg: Care tumhare phone, tumhare doston aur tumhari 'na' ki respect karti hai. Har waqt ki checking control hai, aur abuse aksar yahin se shuru hota hai.

actions.en: Go through the 12 questions in private and count your yes answers honestly.
actions.hg: Yeh 12 sawaal akele mein padho aur imaandari se gino ki kitne jawaab 'haan' hain.

actions.en: Tell one person you trust what is happening, even if you are not ready to leave.
actions.hg: Kisi ek bharosemand insaan ko batao ki kya chal raha hai, chahe tum abhi rishta chhodne ke liye ready na ho.

actions.en: Save screenshots of threats somewhere your partner cannot open, and change any passwords they know.
actions.hg: Dhamkiyon ke screenshots aisi jagah save karo jo partner na khol sake, aur jo passwords unhe pata hain, unhe badal do.

actions.en: In danger, call 112. For support, call the Women Helpline 181, or the Child Helpline 1098 if you are under 18.
actions.hg: Khatra ho toh 112 pe call karo. Support ke liye Women Helpline 181, aur 18 se kam umar ho toh Child Helpline 1098 pe call karo.

actions.en: If a partner threatens self-harm, call 112 or Tele-MANAS 14416 for them. Staying is not your job.
actions.hg: Agar partner self-harm ki dhamki de, toh unke liye 112 ya Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo. Rishte mein ruke rehna tumhari zimmedari nahi hai.

title.en: 'Does it count if I'm a man?' What male survivors of sexual assault in India need to know in 2026
title.hg: 'Main mard hoon, toh kya yeh count hota hai?' India mein sexual assault ke male survivors ko 2026 mein kya jaanna chahiye

dek.en: Yes, it counts. Straight answers to the questions men and boys ask after an assault: what a body's reaction means, what the law does and does not offer an adult man since July 2024, how POCSO covers boys, and where to get PEP and support.
dek.hg: Haan, yeh count hota hai. Un sawaalon ke seedhe jawaab jo men aur boys assault ke baad poochhte hain: body ke reaction ka kya matlab hai, July 2024 ke baad law ek adult man ko kya deta hai aur kya nahi, POCSO boys ko kaise cover karta hai, aur PEP aur support kahan milega.

statLabel.en: boys and men worldwide were raped or sexually assaulted in childhood (UNICEF, 2024)
statLabel.hg: duniya bhar ke boys aur men bachpan mein rape ya sexual assault ka shikaar hue (UNICEF, 2024)

label.en: boys and men alive today were raped or sexually assaulted in childhood, by UNICEF's estimate
label.hg: aaj zinda boys aur men bachpan mein rape ya sexual assault ka shikaar hue, UNICEF ke estimate ke hisaab se

label.en: boys among 44,567 child victims of penetrative sexual assault recorded under POCSO in 2024
label.hg: ladke, 2024 mein POCSO ke tahat darj penetrative sexual assault ke 44,567 child victims mein

label.en: maximum prison term for voluntarily causing hurt, one of the general offences left when an adult man is assaulted
label.hg: voluntarily causing hurt ki maximum jail; adult man par assault hone par bache general offences mein se ek

label.en: the latest HIV PEP can start after exposure; sooner is better
label.hg: exposure ke baad HIV PEP shuru karne ki aakhri limit; jitni jaldi, utna behtar

claim.en: If his body responded, he must have wanted it.
claim.hg: Agar uski body ne respond kiya, toh usne zaroor chaha hoga.

truth.en: A physical response, even an erection or ejaculation, can happen without any wanting, under touch, fear or stress. It is not a decision, and it is not consent.
truth.hg: Physical response, erection ya ejaculation bhi, bina chaahe ho sakta hai, touch, darr ya stress mein. Yeh koi decision nahi hai, aur yeh consent nahi hai.

actions.en: Get medical care first and ask for HIV PEP by name: it must start within 72 hours, and sooner is better.
actions.hg: Sabse pehle medical care lijiye aur HIV PEP ka naam lekar maangiye: ise 72 hours ke andar shuru hona chahiye, aur jitni jaldi utna behtar.

actions.en: Tell one person you trust, or call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Kisi ek bharosemand insaan ko bataiye, ya Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye, free aur round the clock.

actions.en: If you are under 18, or it happened to a boy you know, POCSO applies in full: call the Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar aap 18 se kam ke hain, ya yeh kisi ladke ke saath hua jise aap jaante hain, toh POCSO poori tarah lagu hota hai: Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If you want to report as an adult, write down everything that happened and call NALSA on 15100 to ask about free legal aid.
actions.hg: Agar aap adult hain aur report karna chahte hain, toh jo kuch hua sab likh lijiye aur free legal aid ke baare mein poochhne ke liye NALSA ko 15100 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If a man tells you this happened to him, believe him and do not joke about it.
actions.hg: Agar koi aadmi aapko bataye ki uske saath yeh hua, toh uski baat par yakeen kijiye aur is par mazaak mat kijiye.

title.en: 'Men don't talk'? 13.9% of Indian men had a mental disorder in the national survey. Here is where their path to help breaks
title.hg: 'Mard baat nahi karte'? National survey mein 13.9% Indian mardon ko mental disorder tha. Madad tak ka raasta yahan tootta hai

dek.en: India's only national mental health survey found men's rate of mental disorders nearly twice women's, with the widest gap in alcohol use, which mostly goes untreated. The problem is not that men feel less. It is that their distress gets other names, and help is offered in forms many men cannot use.
dek.hg: India ke iklauta national mental health survey mein mardon mein mental disorders ka rate auraton se lagbhag dugna tha, aur sabse bada fark sharaab ki lat mein tha, jiska zyada tar ilaaj hota hi nahi. Problem yeh nahi ki mard kam mehsoos karte hain. Problem yeh hai ki unki takleef ko doosre naam mil jaate hain, aur madad aise roop mein milti hai jo bahut se mard use hi nahi kar paate.

statLabel.en: of Indian men had a mental disorder in the 2015-16 national survey, against 7.5% of women
statLabel.hg: Indian mardon ko 2015-16 ke national survey mein mental disorder tha; auraton mein 7.5%

label.en: Indians estimated to need mental health care; fewer than 30 million seek it
label.hg: Indians ko mental health care ki zaroorat ka andaaza hai; 30 million se bhi kam madad lete hain

label.en: of men had a mental disorder in the survey, against 7.5% of women
label.hg: mardon ko survey mein mental disorder tha, jabki auraton mein 7.5%

label.en: treatment gap for alcohol use disorders, which affected 9% of men and 0.5% of women
label.hg: alcohol use disorders ka treatment gap; yeh 9% mardon aur 0.5% auraton mein tha

label.en: of men surveyed in seven states showed 'rigid' masculinity; only 23% were gender-equitable
label.hg: saat states mein survey kiye gaye mardon mein 'rigid' masculinity thi; sirf 23% gender-equitable the

claim.en: Men don't really need mental health care. They just don't feel things as deeply.
claim.hg: Mardon ko mental health care ki asli zaroorat nahi hoti. Woh cheezein utni gehraai se mehsoos hi nahi karte.

truth.en: India's national survey found a mental disorder in 13.9% of men against 7.5% of women. Men's distress exists; it is more often named drinking, anger or 'tension', and it rarely reaches treatment.
truth.hg: India ke national survey mein 13.9% mardon mein mental disorder paaya gaya, jabki auraton mein 7.5%. Mardon ki takleef hoti hai; bas use aksar peena, gussa ya 'tension' kaha jaata hai, aur woh shayad hi ilaaj tak pahunchti hai.

actions.en: Call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock. You do not need a diagnosis or a crisis to call.
actions.hg: Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo, free hai aur din-raat chalta hai. Call karne ke liye na diagnosis chahiye na crisis.

actions.en: If drinking has become the way you cope with stress, sleep or anger, tell a doctor that plainly; it is a health problem, not a character flaw.
actions.hg: Agar stress, neend ya gusse se nipatne ka tumhara tareeka peena ban gaya hai, toh doctor ko seedhe yahi batao; yeh sehat ki problem hai, character ki kami nahi.

actions.en: Check on a friend with a direct question, 'How are you really doing?', and wait for the real answer.
actions.hg: Dost ka haal ek seedhe sawaal se poochho, 'Sach mein kaisa chal raha hai?', aur asli jawab ka intezaar karo.

actions.en: Fathers, brothers, bosses: say out loud that you have struggled too. It gives other men permission.
actions.hg: Papa, bhai, boss: khule mein kaho ki tum bhi kabhi struggle kar chuke ho. Isse baaki mardon ko bhi bolne ki ijaazat milti hai.

actions.en: Not sure whom to see? A counsellor or psychologist offers talking therapy; a psychiatrist is a doctor who can also prescribe medicine.
actions.hg: Pata nahi kisse milna hai? Counsellor ya psychologist baat karke therapy dete hain; psychiatrist doctor hote hain jo dawai bhi likh sakte hain.

title.en: 71.8% of India's suicides in 2022 were men: reading the breadwinner trap in NCRB's data
title.hg: 2022 mein India ke 71.8% suicides mard the: NCRB data mein 'kamaane wale' ka jaal

dek.en: Most of the men were married, and daily wage earners were the largest group among them. Police records cannot say why a man dies by suicide, but they show where the expectation to provide weighs heaviest, and where help has to reach.
dek.hg: Inmein se zyada tar mard shaadi-shuda the, aur mardon mein sabse bada group daily wage earners ka tha. Police records yeh nahi bata sakte ki koi mard suicide se kyun mara, lekin yeh zaroor dikhate hain ki ghar chalaane ka bojh sabse bhaari kahan padta hai, aur madad ko kahan tak pahunchna hai.

statLabel.en: of people who died by suicide in India in 2022 were men (NCRB)
statLabel.hg: log jo 2022 mein India mein suicide se mare, unmein itne mard the (NCRB)

label.en: suicides recorded by police in India in 2024
label.hg: suicides jo 2024 mein India mein police ne record kiye

label.en: of suicide victims in 2022 were men; about 68% of those men were married
label.hg: 2022 ke suicide victims mard the; inmein se lagbhag 68% mard shaadi-shuda the

label.en: men who died by suicide in 2022 were daily wage earners, the largest group among men
label.hg: mard jo 2022 mein suicide se mare, daily wage earners the; mardon mein sabse bada group

label.en: daily wage earners died by suicide in 2023, the largest single group that year
label.hg: daily wage earners 2023 mein suicide se mare; us saal ka sabse bada single group

claim.en: A man who survives a suicide attempt can be arrested and punished for it.
claim.hg: Jo mard suicide attempt ke baad bach jaata hai, use arrest karke saza di ja sakti hai.

truth.en: No. Since the Mental Healthcare Act 2017, a person who attempts suicide is presumed, unless proved otherwise, to be under severe stress and is not to be tried or punished, and the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, in force since 1 July 2024, has no general offence of attempted suicide.
truth.hg: Nahi. Mental Healthcare Act 2017 se, suicide attempt karne wale ke baare mein maana jaata hai ki woh severe stress mein tha (jab tak ulta saabit na ho), aur us pe na case chal sakta hai na saza ho sakti hai. 1 July 2024 se laagu Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita mein attempted suicide ka koi general offence hai hi nahi.

actions.en: If a man you know talks about being a burden or stops talking about the future, ask him plainly whether he is thinking about suicide, then listen without lecturing.
actions.hg: Agar koi jaan-pehchaan wala mard khud ko bojh bataye ya future ki baat karna band kar de, toh seedha poochho ki kya woh suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, phir bina lecture diye suno.

actions.en: Call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock, for yourself or to ask how to support someone else.
actions.hg: Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo, free hai aur din-raat chalta hai, apne liye bhi aur yeh poochhne ke liye bhi ki kisi aur ki madad kaise karein.

actions.en: In an emergency, call 112 and stay with the person until help arrives.
actions.hg: Emergency mein 112 pe call karo aur madad aane tak us insaan ke saath raho.

actions.en: Treat a lost job, a failed business or a debt as a family problem to solve together, not as one man's private failure.
actions.hg: Naukri chhootna, business doobna ya karza, inhe poori family ki problem samjho jo milke suljhani hai, kisi ek mard ki private haar nahi.

actions.en: Never avoid a hospital out of fear of the police: the law treats a suicide attempt as a sign of severe stress that calls for care, not punishment.
actions.hg: Police ke darr se kabhi hospital jaane se mat bacho: kanoon suicide attempt ko severe stress ki nishaani maanta hai, jise care chahiye, saza nahi.

title.en: 'Western', 'a phase', 'illegal': four myths about queer Indians, checked against the record
title.hg: 'Western', 'phase', 'illegal': queer Indians ke baare mein chaar myths, record se check kiye gaye

dek.en: Families repeat four claims about queer people: it came from the West, marriage will cure it, it is a crime, and 'transgender' just means hijra. Each can be tested against Indian statutes, court rulings and the Census. None holds up, though Parliament has just moved one of them closer to law.
dek.hg: Families queer logon ke baare mein chaar baatein dohrati hain: yeh West se aaya hai, shaadi se theek ho jayega, yeh crime hai, aur 'transgender' ka matlab bas hijra hai. Har baat ko Indian laws, court ke faislon aur Census se check kiya ja sakta hai. Ek bhi nahi tikti, haalanki Parliament ne abhi-abhi inme se ek ko law ke kareeb pahuncha diya hai.

statLabel.en: people counted in Census 2011's 'other' gender category
statLabel.hg: log Census 2011 ki 'other' gender category mein gine gaye

label.en: people recorded in the 'other' gender category in Census 2011, a figure widely seen as an undercount
label.hg: log Census 2011 mein 'other' gender category mein darj hue; is figure ko aam taur par undercount maana jaata hai

label.en: the Supreme Court decriminalises consensual same-sex relations between adults
label.hg: Supreme Court ne adults ke beech consensual same-sex relations ko decriminalise kiya

label.en: the Supreme Court recognises a third gender and the right to self-identify
label.hg: Supreme Court ne third gender aur apna gender khud pehchaanne ke right ko maanyata di

label.en: the National Medical Commission declares 'conversion therapy' professional misconduct
label.hg: National Medical Commission ne 'conversion therapy' ko professional misconduct declare kiya

claim.en: Being queer is a Western idea, a phase or a crime, and 'transgender' is just another word for hijra.
claim.hg: Queer hona Western idea hai, ek phase hai ya crime hai, aur 'transgender' hijra ka hi doosra naam hai.

truth.en: The ban is the old, written-down part: Section 377 sat in the penal code of 1860 and was read down by the Supreme Court in 2018. Doctors who attempt 'conversion' commit professional misconduct. And 'transgender' covers trans men, trans women and non-binary people as well as hijra, kinner, aravani and jogta communities.
truth.hg: Purana aur likha hua toh ban hai: Section 377 1860 ke penal code mein thi aur Supreme Court ne 2018 mein use read down kiya. Jo doctors 'conversion' ki koshish karte hain, woh professional misconduct karte hain. Aur 'transgender' mein trans men, trans women aur non-binary log bhi aate hain, aur hijra, kinner, aravani aur jogta communities bhi.

actions.en: When someone says 'it is illegal', give the date: the Supreme Court decriminalised consensual same-sex relations between adults on 6 September 2018.
actions.hg: Jab koi kahe 'yeh illegal hai', toh date batao: Supreme Court ne 6 September 2018 ko adults ke beech consensual same-sex relations ko decriminalise kiya.

actions.en: Do not agree to, or arrange, a marriage as a 'cure'. It changes nothing about orientation and pulls a second person into the harm.
actions.hg: 'Ilaaj' ke taur par shaadi ke liye na haan karo, na kisi ki karwao. Isse orientation nahi badalta, aur ek doosra insaan bhi nuksaan mein kheench liya jaata hai.

actions.en: If a doctor offers to change anyone's orientation or gender identity, note the name and registration number and complain to the state medical council, citing the NMC letter of 25 August 2022.
actions.hg: Agar koi doctor kisi ka orientation ya gender identity badalne ki baat kare, toh naam aur registration number note karo aur NMC ke 25 August 2022 ke letter ka hawala dekar state medical council mein complaint karo.

actions.en: Use hijra, kinner, aravani and jogta only as the names of communities, never as insults and never as a label for every transgender person.
actions.hg: Hijra, kinner, aravani aur jogta ko sirf communities ke naam ki tarah use karo, kabhi gaali ki tarah nahi aur kabhi har transgender insaan ke label ki tarah nahi.

actions.en: If the pressure at home is wearing you down, call Tele-MANAS on 14416; if anyone confines or hurts you, call 112.
actions.hg: Agar ghar ka pressure tumhe tod raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo; agar koi tumhe band kare ya chot pahunchaye, toh 112 par call karo.

title.en: When your child comes out: a guide for Indian parents, from the first conversation to the 'cure' trap
title.hg: Jab aapka bachcha come out kare: Indian parents ke liye guide, pehli baatcheet se 'cure' ke jaal tak

dek.en: Sex between consenting adults of the same sex has been legal since 2018, a High Court has ordered a halt to attempts to 'cure' queer people, and doctors who try commit professional misconduct. What to say in the first five minutes, what to avoid, and how to keep your child safe.
dek.hg: Same-sex adults ke beech consent wala sex 2018 se legal hai, ek High Court ne queer logon ko 'cure' karne ki koshishon par rok ka order diya hai, aur aisi koshish karne wale doctors professional misconduct karte hain. Pehle paanch minute mein kya kahein, kis cheez se bachein, aur apne bachche ko safe kaise rakhein.

label.en: consensual sex between adults of the same sex stopped being a crime (Supreme Court, Navtej Singh Johar)
label.hg: same-sex adults ke beech consent wala sex crime nahi raha (Supreme Court, Navtej Singh Johar)

label.en: the Madras High Court ordered a halt to attempts to 'cure' sexual orientation or gender identity
label.hg: Madras High Court ne sexual orientation ya gender identity ko 'cure' karne ki koshishon par rok ka order diya

label.en: 'conversion therapy' became professional misconduct for doctors (National Medical Commission)
label.hg: 'conversion therapy' doctors ke liye professional misconduct bani (National Medical Commission)

label.en: Tele-MANAS, the government's free 24x7 mental-health helpline, for children and parents alike
label.hg: Tele-MANAS, sarkar ki free 24x7 mental-health helpline, bachchon aur parents dono ke liye

claim.en: Marriage will settle him down and make him normal.
claim.hg: Shaadi ho jaayegi toh ladka settle ho jaayega aur normal ho jaayega.

truth.en: Marriage does not change whom a person is attracted to. It pulls a second person, the spouse, into the harm. And since 2022, a doctor in India who offers 'conversion therapy' commits professional misconduct.
truth.hg: Shaadi se yeh nahi badalta ki koi insaan kiski taraf attract hota hai. Woh ek doosre insaan ko, yaani spouse ko, is nuksaan mein kheench leti hai. Aur 2022 se India mein jo doctor 'conversion therapy' offer karta hai, woh professional misconduct karta hai.

actions.en: In the first conversation, say 'thank you for telling me' and 'I love you', then ask what your child needs from you.
actions.hg: Pehli baatcheet mein kahiye 'mujhe batane ke liye thank you' aur 'main tumse pyaar karta/karti hoon', phir poochiye ki bachche ko aapse kya chahiye.

actions.en: Do not tell relatives, neighbours or teachers without your child's permission: it is their story to share.
actions.hg: Bachche ki permission ke bina rishtedaaron, padosiyon ya teachers ko mat bataiye: yeh uski kahani hai, wahi share karega.

actions.en: Refuse any doctor, counsellor or baba who offers a 'cure', and report a doctor who does to your state medical council.
actions.hg: Jo bhi doctor, counsellor ya baba 'cure' offer kare, use mana kijiye, aur aisa karne wale doctor ko state medical council mein report kijiye.

actions.en: Do not arrange or push a marriage to 'fix' your child.
actions.hg: Bachche ko 'theek' karne ke liye shaadi arrange mat kijiye, na uska pressure daaliye.

actions.en: If your child seems withdrawn or talks about not wanting to live, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24x7), together if you can.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha gumsum rehne lage ya jeene ki ichchha na hone ki baat kare, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye (free, 24x7), ho sake toh saath mein.

title.en: 840 million women, 137 killed a day: partner violence by the numbers, and where India sits
title.hg: 840 million auratein, roz 137 ki hatya: partner violence numbers mein, aur India kahan khada hai

dek.en: Six figures from WHO, UNODC and UN Women measure violence against women by husbands, partners and family. Each counts something slightly different, and each comes with a caveat. Read properly, they put India in the worst group for violence happening right now.
dek.hg: WHO, UNODC aur UN Women ke chhe figures naapte hain ki patiyon, partners aur family ke haathon auraton par kitni violence hoti hai. Har figure thoda alag cheez ginta hai, aur har ek ke saath ek caveat aata hai. Dhyaan se padho toh yeh India ko us sabse kharab group mein rakhte hain jahan violence abhi, isi waqt ho rahi hai.

statLabel.en: of partnered women in India faced partner violence in the past year (WHO estimate, 2023)
statLabel.hg: India ki partnered auraton ne pichhle saal partner violence jheli (WHO estimate, 2023)

label.en: women and girls who have faced partner violence or non-partner sexual violence in their lifetime (WHO, 2023 estimates)
label.hg: auratein aur ladkiyan jinhone zindagi mein kabhi partner violence ya non-partner sexual violence jheli (WHO, 2023 estimates)

label.en: of ever-married or partnered women aged 15-49 in India faced physical or sexual violence by a partner in the past 12 months (WHO modelled estimate, 2023)
label.hg: India ki 15-49 saal ki ever-married ya partnered auraton ne pichhle 12 mahinon mein partner se physical ya sexual violence jheli (WHO modelled estimate, 2023)

label.en: women and girls killed every day by a partner or family member worldwide in 2024
label.hg: auratein aur ladkiyan 2024 mein duniya bhar mein har roz partner ya family member ke haathon maari gayi

label.en: of global development aid went to preventing violence against women in 2022
label.hg: 2022 mein global development aid ka itna hi hissa auraton par violence rokne par gaya

actions.en: When you quote India's figure, quote its label too: 22.4% of ever-married or partnered women aged 15-49, in the past 12 months, a WHO modelled estimate for 2023.
actions.hg: India ka figure quote karo toh uska label bhi saath do: 15-49 saal ki ever-married ya partnered auraton ka 22.4%, pichhle 12 mahinon mein, WHO ka 2023 ka modelled estimate.

actions.en: Do not present the move from 736 million to 840 million as a rise. WHO says the two rounds cannot be compared.
actions.hg: 736 million se 840 million ko 'badhotri' mat batao. WHO kehta hai ki dono rounds compare nahi kiye ja sakte.

actions.en: If a woman tells you she is being hurt at home, believe her, ask what she needs, and help her reach the Women Helpline on 181.
actions.hg: Agar koi aurat bataye ki ghar par use chot pahunchayi ja rahi hai, toh us par yakeen karo, poochho use kya chahiye, aur Women Helpline 181 tak pahunchne mein uski madad karo.

actions.en: If anyone is in immediate danger, call 112.
actions.hg: Agar koi abhi khatre mein hai, toh 112 par call karo.

actions.en: If you are the one frightening or hitting a partner, stop and talk to someone today: Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free and open round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar tum khud apne partner ko dara rahe ho ya maar rahe ho, toh ruko aur aaj hi kisi se baat karo: Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai aur 24x7 khula hai.

title.en: My family wants to 'fix' me or marry me off: legal options for queer adults in India
title.hg: Meri family mujhe 'theek' karna chahti hai ya meri shaadi karwana chahti hai: India mein queer adults ke legal options

dek.en: A doctor, a baba, a quick wedding or a locked door: for many queer Indians the threat is a family plan. What the law says about adults, how to refuse a 'cure' or a marriage, and how to leave home safely when there are very few shelters to go to.
dek.hg: Doctor, baba, jaldi ki shaadi ya band darwaza: bahut se queer Indians ke liye khatra family ka plan hota hai. Adults ke baare mein law kya kehta hai, 'cure' ya shaadi ko mana kaise karein, aur jab jaane ke liye shelters bahut kam hon tab ghar se safely kaise niklein.

label.en: Garima Greh shelter homes for transgender persons, in 17 states, as of November 2025
label.hg: Garima Greh shelter homes transgender persons ke liye, 17 states mein, November 2025 tak

label.en: transgender persons living in Garima Greh shelters in August 2025
label.hg: transgender persons August 2025 mein Garima Greh shelters mein reh rahe the

label.en: One Stop Centres for women operating across India in July 2026
label.hg: One Stop Centres auraton ke liye July 2026 mein poore India mein chal rahe the

label.en: Tele-MANAS, the free mental health helpline that is open round the clock
label.hg: Tele-MANAS, free mental health helpline jo chaubees ghante khuli rehti hai

claim.en: Parents have the legal right to decide whom their adult child loves, marries or lives with.
claim.hg: Maa-baap ko legal haq hai yeh tay karne ka ki unka adult bachcha kisse pyaar kare, kisse shaadi kare ya kiske saath rahe.

truth.en: Not for an adult. Consensual same-sex relationships have been legal since 2018, the Supreme Court has held that choosing a partner is part of individual liberty, and confining or hurting an adult is a crime even when a parent does it.
truth.hg: Adult ke maamle mein nahi. Consensual same-sex relationships 2018 se legal hain, Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki partner chunna individual liberty ka hissa hai, aur kisi adult ko band karke rakhna ya chot pahunchana crime hai, chahe yeh maa-baap hi kyun na karein.

actions.en: If you are locked in, beaten or being taken somewhere against your will, call 112. If you are under 18, call 1098.
actions.hg: Agar aapko band karke rakha gaya hai, maara ja raha hai ya aapki marzi ke khilaaf kahin le jaya ja raha hai, toh 112 call kijiye. Agar aap 18 se kam hain, toh 1098 call kijiye.

actions.en: Keep your Aadhaar, certificates, bank card and a charged phone within reach, with photos of every document saved where your family cannot open them.
actions.hg: Apna Aadhaar, certificates, bank card aur charged phone apni pahunch mein rakhiye, aur har document ki photo aisi jagah save kijiye jahan family na khol sake.

actions.en: Refuse any 'treatment' for being queer and note the doctor's name and registration number: conversion therapy is professional misconduct.
actions.hg: Queer hone ke kisi bhi 'treatment' ko mana kijiye aur doctor ka naam aur registration number note kijiye: conversion therapy professional misconduct hai.

actions.en: If you leave, give the police a signed statement that you are an adult who left by choice, and keep a copy.
actions.hg: Agar aap ghar chhodte hain, toh police ko signed statement dijiye ki aap adult hain aur apni marzi se nikle hain, aur uski copy apne paas rakhiye.

actions.en: Call 15100 for free legal aid and Tele-MANAS on 14416 for free counselling at any hour.
actions.hg: Free legal aid ke liye 15100 call kijiye, aur free counselling ke liye kisi bhi waqt Tele-MANAS 14416 par.

title.en: India counts student suicides by cause, never by sexual orientation: the blind spot on queer youth mental health
title.hg: India student suicides ko cause ke hisaab se ginta hai, sexual orientation ke hisaab se kabhi nahi: queer youth mental health ka blind spot

dek.en: NCRB counted 14,488 student suicides in 2024 and sorts the deaths by causes that police record. It does not record sexual orientation, so the distress of queer young people cannot show up in the data. What is known, what is not, and what schools, friends and counsellors can do now.
dek.hg: NCRB ne 2024 mein 14,488 student suicides gine aur un mauton ko police ke likhe causes ke hisaab se baanta. Sexual orientation record nahi hota, isliye queer young logon ka dard data mein dikh hi nahi sakta. Kya pata hai, kya nahi, aur schools, dost aur counsellors abhi kya kar sakte hain.

label.en: student suicides recorded in India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein record hue student suicides

label.en: students who died by suicide in India over 2014-2024
label.hg: students jinki 2014-2024 ke beech India mein suicide se maut hui

label.en: Tele-MANAS, the free, round-the-clock mental health helpline, open to anyone
label.hg: Tele-MANAS, free aur 24x7 mental health helpline, sabke liye

claim.en: If queer teenagers were struggling, the numbers would show it.
claim.hg: Agar queer teenagers mushkil mein hote, toh numbers mein dikh jaata.

truth.en: India's suicide records sort deaths by sex, occupation and police-recorded cause, but never by sexual orientation, so the distress of queer young people cannot show up in them.
truth.hg: India ke suicide records maut ko sex, occupation aur police ke likhe cause ke hisaab se baantte hain, par sexual orientation ke hisaab se kabhi nahi, isliye queer young logon ka dard unme dikh hi nahi sakta.

actions.en: If you are queer and struggling, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock; in an emergency, call 112.
actions.hg: Agar tum queer ho aur mushkil mein ho, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, free aur 24x7; emergency mein 112 par call karo.

actions.en: If a friend comes out to you, keep it private unless they ask you to share it, and check in with them again a week later.
actions.hg: Agar koi dost tumhare saamne come out kare, toh baat apne tak rakho jab tak woh khud share karne ko na kahe, aur ek hafte baad phir se haal poochho.

actions.en: Teachers: treat anti-queer slurs and outing in class groups as bullying, and act the same day.
actions.hg: Teachers: class groups mein anti-queer gaaliyon aur outing ko bullying maano, aur usi din action lo.

actions.en: Counsellors: treat the distress, not the orientation; the Mental Healthcare Act bars discrimination in care on the ground of sexual orientation.
actions.hg: Counsellors: dard ka ilaaj karo, orientation ka nahi; Mental Healthcare Act sexual orientation ke basis par care mein discrimination par rok lagata hai.

actions.en: Under 18 and unsafe at home? Call the Child Helpline on 1098.
actions.hg: 18 se kam ho aur ghar par safe nahi ho? Child Helpline 1098 par call karo.

title.en: 'If you loved me, you would': guilt, fear and power, and where Indian law draws the line on coercion
title.hg: 'Agar tum mujhse pyaar karte, toh maan jaate': guilt, darr aur power, aur Indian law coercion par line kahan kheenchta hai

dek.en: Coercion is not only force. It can look like sulking, guilt, a senior's 'favour' or a promise never meant to be kept. Here is the spectrum from persuasion to crime, what the BNS covers, and the gaps it leaves.
dek.hg: Coercion sirf force nahi hota. Woh sulking, guilt, kisi senior ka 'favour' ya kabhi na nibhaya jaane wala promise bhi ho sakta hai. Persuasion se crime tak ka poora spectrum, BNS kya cover karta hai, aur kya chhod deta hai.

statLabel.en: of men say a husband has the right to get angry and reprimand a wife who refuses sex (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: men kehte hain ki sex se mana karne wali wife par husband gussa kar sakta hai aur daant sakta hai (NFHS-5)

label.hg: 15-49 saal ke Indian men kehte hain ki sex se mana karne wali wife par husband gussa kar sakta hai aur daant sakta hai (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: cases registered under Section 69 BNS (sex by deceit or a false promise of marriage), July-December 2024
label.hg: Section 69 BNS (dhokhe ya shaadi ke jhoothe promise se sex) ke under register hue cases, July-December 2024

label.en: years of rigorous imprisonment under Section 68 BNS for abusing a position of authority to get sex
label.hg: saal ki rigorous imprisonment: Section 68 BNS mein authority ka galat use karke sex ke liye

label.en: of men surveyed in a 2014 ICRW-UNFPA study showed 'rigid' masculinity; only 23% were gender-equitable
label.hg: 2014 ki ICRW-UNFPA study mein men ki masculinity 'rigid' nikli; sirf 23% gender-equitable the

claim.en: If she said yes in the end, it was consent.
claim.hg: Agar end mein usne yes bol diya, toh woh consent tha.

truth.en: A yes worn out of someone by guilt, threats or lies is giving in, not agreeing. The BNS already says a yes obtained through fear of hurt, or given while too intoxicated to understand, does not count.
truth.hg: Guilt, dhamki ya jhooth se nikalwaya gaya yes haar maan lena hai, agree karna nahi. BNS pehle se kehta hai ki chot ka darr dikhakar liya gaya yes, ya itne nashe mein diya gaya yes ki baat samajh hi na aaye, count nahi hota.

actions.en: Hear a no the first time. Asking again and again, sulking or going cold after it is pressure, not romance.
actions.hg: Pehli baar mein hi no sun lo. Uske baad baar-baar poochna, sulking ya cold ho jaana pressure hai, romance nahi.

actions.en: Never use marks, money, a job, a role or a room as leverage for sex. If you hold power over someone, do not pursue them.
actions.hg: Marks, paisa, job, role ya room ko sex ke liye kabhi leverage mat banao. Agar tumhari kisi par power hai, toh uske peeche mat pado.

actions.en: If a teacher, senior or boss pressures you, tell someone outside their control: the Internal Committee at work, a trusted adult, or 181.
actions.hg: Agar koi teacher, senior ya boss pressure daale, toh kisi aise insaan ko batao jis par unka control na ho: office ki Internal Committee, koi trusted adult, ya 181.

actions.en: If someone threatens to leak photos or chats, save the evidence and report it at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930.
actions.hg: Agar koi photos ya chats leak karne ki dhamki de, toh evidence save karo aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karo.

actions.en: Keep control of your own contraception, and talk to a doctor if a partner hides your pills or removes a condom without asking.
actions.hg: Apna contraception apne control mein rakho, aur agar partner tumhari pills chhupaye ya bina pooche condom hata de, toh doctor se baat karo.

title.en: 987, then 888, then nothing: how India stopped counting sexual violence against men
title.hg: 987, phir 888, phir kuch nahi: India ne men ke against sexual violence ginna kaise band kar diya

dek.en: One row in the national crime tables was the nearest thing India had to a count of sexual assaults on adult men. In the 2024 data it holds only dashes, marked 'deleted in BNS'. This is how a gap in the law became a gap in the data, and what that gap costs.
dek.hg: National crime tables ki ek row hi woh sabse kareebi cheez thi jisse adult men par hue sexual assaults ka andaza lagta tha. 2024 ke data mein us row mein sirf dashes hain, saath mein note: 'deleted in BNS'. Law ka gap data ka gap kaise bana, aur is gap ki keemat kya hai.

statLabel.en: 'unnatural offence' cases recorded in 2023, the last year the category existed
statLabel.hg: 'unnatural offence' ke cases jo 2023 mein darj hue, is category ka aakhri saal

label.en: cases under IPC Section 377 in 2023; the 2024 tables carry only dashes in that row
label.hg: IPC Section 377 ke cases, 2023 mein; 2024 ki tables mein us row mein sirf dashes hain

label.en: boys among 44,567 child victims of penetrative sexual assault recorded under POCSO in 2024
label.hg: ladke, 2024 mein POCSO ke tahat darj penetrative sexual assault ke 44,567 child victims mein

label.en: of the children who reported sexual abuse in the government's 2007 study were boys
label.hg: sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein ladkon ka share

label.en: of children who said they had been sexually assaulted in that study had reported it to the police
label.hg: us study mein sexual assault batane wale bachchon mein se itnon ne hi police ko report kiya tha

claim.en: If sexual violence against men were a real problem in India, it would show up in the crime statistics.
claim.hg: Agar India mein men ke against sexual violence sach mein koi problem hoti, toh woh crime statistics mein dikhti.

truth.en: The statistics have nowhere to show it. Rape tables record only women and girls, and the one row that could include adult male victims was removed in 2024 along with Section 377.
truth.hg: Statistics mein use dikhane ki jagah hi nahi hai. Rape tables sirf women aur girls ko record karti hain, aur jis ek row mein adult male victims aa sakte the, woh 2024 mein Section 377 ke saath hata di gayi.

actions.en: If it happened to you, it counts, whatever heading the police file it under. See a doctor first: HIV PEP must start within 72 hours.
actions.hg: Agar yeh aapke saath hua hai, toh yeh count karta hai, police ise chahe jis heading mein likhe. Pehle doctor ke paas jaiye: HIV PEP 72 hours ke andar shuru honi chahiye.

actions.en: Under 18? POCSO protects boys exactly as it protects girls. Call the Child Helpline 1098 or the police on 112.
actions.hg: 18 se kam hain? POCSO ladkon ko bilkul waise hi protect karta hai jaise ladkiyon ko. Child Helpline 1098 ya police ko 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If you report as an adult, ask for a copy of the FIR and note the sections used; free legal aid is available on the NALSA helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Adult ke taur par report karein toh FIR ki copy maangiye aur note kijiye ki kaunse sections lage; free legal aid NALSA helpline 15100 par milti hai.

actions.en: When you quote rape figures in class, at work or online, say plainly that they count only women and girls.
actions.hg: Class mein, kaam par ya online jab bhi rape ke figures quote karein, saaf kahiye ki yeh sirf women aur girls ko ginte hain.

actions.en: For someone to talk to, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Kisi se baat karni ho toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye, free aur 24x7.

title.en: Shakti Vahini (2018): the Supreme Court said adults may choose their partners. The protection it ordered never fully arrived
title.hg: Shakti Vahini (2018): Supreme Court ne kaha adults apna partner khud chun sakte hain. Jo protection usne order ki, woh aaj tak poori nahi pahunchi

dek.en: A petition about khap panchayats and inter-caste marriages produced one of the clearest rulings on personal liberty in Indian law, and a list of things every state had to build. More than seven years later, Delhi had no fast-track courts for honour-killing cases and the criminal code still had no such offence. What the ruling gives couples, and how to ask for it.
dek.hg: Khap panchayats aur inter-caste marriages par ek petition se Indian law mein personal liberty ka ek sabse saaf faisla nikla, aur ek list bhi ki har state ko kya-kya banana hai. Saat saal se zyada baad Delhi mein honour-killing cases ke liye ek bhi fast-track court nahi tha, aur criminal code mein aaj bhi aisa koi alag offence nahi hai. Yeh ruling couples ko kya deti hai, aur use maanga kaise jaaye.

label.en: fast-track courts for honour-killing cases set up in Delhi by December 2025, as the Delhi High Court was told
label.hg: fast-track courts jo December 2025 tak Delhi mein honour-killing cases ke liye bane, jaisa Delhi High Court ko bataya gaya

label.en: the year the Law Commission proposed a special law on 'honour' crimes; the BNS of 2023 still has no separate offence
label.hg: woh saal jab Law Commission ne 'honour' crimes par special law ka proposal diya; 2023 ke BNS mein aaj bhi koi alag offence nahi hai

label.en: murders recorded with 'honour killing' as the motive in India in 2024
label.hg: murders jinka motive 2024 mein India mein 'honour killing' likha gaya

label.en: honour killings in Tamil Nadu over ten years, as observed by the Madras High Court in June 2026
label.hg: honour killings das saal mein Tamil Nadu mein, jaisa Madras High Court ne June 2026 mein kaha

actions.en: If you or a couple you know are in immediate danger from family, call 112. The Women Helpline is 181.
actions.hg: Agar aap ya aapke jaan-pehchaan ka koi couple family ki taraf se turant khatre mein hai, toh 112 par call karo. Women Helpline 181 hai.

actions.en: Give the district police chief a written request for protection that cites Shakti Vahini v. Union of India (2018), and keep a stamped copy.
actions.hg: District police chief ko protection ke liye likhit request do jisme Shakti Vahini v. Union of India (2018) ka zikr ho, aur uski stamped copy apne paas rakho.

actions.en: Save every threat (messages, voice notes, names, dates) and keep copies with a friend outside the family.
actions.hg: Har dhamki save karo (messages, voice notes, naam, dates) aur copies family ke bahar kisi dost ke paas rakho.

actions.en: If the police do not act, ask the High Court for protection. Free legal aid is available on NALSA's helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Agar police kuch na kare, toh High Court se protection maango. Free legal aid NALSA ki helpline 15100 par milti hai.

actions.en: Ask your district administration whether the special cell and monitoring committee ordered in 2018 exist, and how a couple can reach them.
actions.hg: Apne district administration se poochho ki 2018 mein order kiye gaye special cell aur monitoring committee bane hain ya nahi, aur koi couple un tak kaise pahunch sakta hai.

title.en: Hero follows heroine: how films sold stalking as love, and what 9,865 stalking FIRs in 2024 say
title.hg: Hero heroine ka peecha karta hai: films ne stalking ko pyaar bana kar kaise becha, aur 2024 ki 9,865 stalking FIRs kya kehti hain

dek.en: On screen, the man who will not take no for an answer gets the girl by the last song. Off screen, the same sequence has been a crime since 2013, police logged 9,865 cases of it in 2024, and the law is still written so that only a man can commit it against a woman.
dek.hg: Screen par jo aadmi 'na' sunne ko tayyar nahi, use aakhri gaane tak ladki mil jaati hai. Screen ke bahar yahi sequence 2013 se crime hai, 2024 mein police ne iske 9,865 cases darj kiye, aur law aaj bhi aisa likha hai ki ise sirf aadmi kar sakta hai, sirf aurat ke khilaf.

statLabel.hg: stalking cases jo 2024 mein India mein police ne register kiye

label.en: stalking cases registered by police in India in 2024
label.hg: stalking cases jo 2024 mein India mein police ne register kiye

label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue stalking trials mein se itne mein conviction hui

label.hg: stalking cases jo 2024 ke end tak courts mein pending the

label.en: maximum prison term for a first stalking conviction under Section 78 BNS; 5 years for a repeat
label.hg: BNS Section 78 mein pehli stalking conviction par maximum jail; dobara conviction par 5 saal

claim.en: If she says no, keep trying. Persistence is romantic, and she will come round in the end.
claim.hg: Agar woh mana kare toh koshish karte raho. Zid romantic hoti hai, aakhir mein woh maan hi jaayegi.

truth.en: A man who keeps following or contacting a woman after she has clearly shown she is not interested is committing stalking under Section 78 of the BNS, punishable with up to three years in prison on a first conviction.
truth.hg: Jo aadmi kisi aurat ke saaf mana karne ke baad bhi uska peecha karta rahe ya use contact karta rahe, woh BNS Section 78 ke under stalking kar raha hai. Pehli conviction par teen saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai.

actions.en: Say no once, clearly, in a message if you can. You do not owe a second explanation, and the message is your record.
actions.hg: Ek baar saaf 'na' bolo, ho sake toh message mein. Doosri baar samjhane ki zimmedari aapki nahi hai, aur woh message aapka record hai.

actions.en: Keep a log of every incident (date, time, place, what he did, who saw it) and store copies of messages and call logs with a friend.
actions.hg: Har incident ka log rakho (date, time, jagah, usne kya kiya, kisne dekha) aur messages aur call logs ki copies kisi dost ke paas rakho.

actions.en: Tell at least two people you trust. If you fear your family will respond by stopping your college or job, call the Women Helpline 181 first.
actions.hg: Kam se kam do bharosemand logon ko batao. Agar dar hai ki family college ya job band karwa degi, toh pehle Women Helpline 181 par call karo.

actions.en: Report stalking under Section 78 BNS at any police station and ask for a woman officer to record it. In immediate danger, call 112.
actions.hg: BNS Section 78 ke under stalking ki report kisi bhi police station mein karo aur kaho ki woman officer ise record kare. Turant khatra ho toh 112 par call karo.

actions.en: If your friend is the one doing the following, do not pass on her number, her route or his messages. Tell him the answer was no.
actions.hg: Agar peecha karne wala aapka dost hai, toh ladki ka number, uska route ya uske liye messages aage mat pahunchao. Use batao ki jawab 'na' tha.

title.en: Student suicides rose about 80% in a decade to 14,488 in 2024. India's total barely moved
title.hg: Ek dashak mein student suicides lagbhag 80% badh ke 2024 mein 14,488 hue. India ka total mushkil se hila

dek.en: India's total suicides have stayed near 1.7 lakh a year since 2022 while student suicides kept climbing. Adults reach for one explanation, exam pressure. A police record cannot show what a student never told anyone, from bullying to abuse to violence at home.
dek.hg: India ke total suicides 2022 se har saal 1.7 lakh ke aas-paas ruke hain, jabki student suicides badhte gaye. Bade log ek hi wajah pakad lete hain: exam pressure. Jo baat student ne kabhi kisi ko nahi batayi, bullying se le ke abuse aur ghar ki hinsa tak, woh police record mein nahi dikh sakti.

statLabel.hg: students 2024 mein India mein suicide se mare (NCRB)

label.hg: students 2024 mein India mein suicide se mare, ek dashak pehle se lagbhag 80% zyada

label.hg: 2023 ke saare suicides mein students ka hissa; 2022 mein yeh 7.6% tha
