label.hg: har tarah ke suicides jo 2024 mein India mein record hue, 2023 se thode kam

claim.en: Students die by suicide because of exam pressure. Fix the exams and the problem ends.
claim.hg: Students exam pressure ki wajah se suicide karte hain. Exams theek kar do, problem khatam.

truth.en: A cause written on a police record after a death is not a full explanation. Bullying, abuse, a forbidden relationship or violence at home may never reach the record if the student told no one, so the exam story is often only the part adults can see.
truth.hg: Maut ke baad police record mein likha cause poori wajah nahi hota. Bullying, abuse, family ka mana kiya hua relationship ya ghar ki hinsa record tak shayad kabhi na pahunche agar student ne kisi ko bataya hi nahi, isliye exam wali kahani aksar sirf woh hissa hai jo bade logon ko dikhta hai.

actions.en: If you are struggling, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock. If you are under 18, you can also call the Child Helpline on 1098.
actions.hg: Agar tum mushkil mein ho, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo, free hai aur din-raat chalta hai. 18 se kam ho toh Child Helpline 1098 pe bhi call kar sakte ho.

actions.en: In an emergency, call 112 and stay with the person until help arrives.
actions.hg: Emergency mein 112 pe call karo aur madad aane tak us insaan ke saath raho.

actions.en: Ask a friend or a student directly and calmly whether they are thinking about suicide, then listen without judging.
actions.hg: Dost ya student se shaanti se seedha poochho ki kya woh suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, phir bina judge kiye suno.

actions.en: Parents: tell your child before the result, in plain words, that no mark changes their place at home.
actions.hg: Parents: result se pehle hi apne bachche se saaf shabdon mein kaho ki koi bhi mark ghar mein uski jagah nahi badalta.

actions.en: Teachers and wardens: if a student under 18 tells you about sexual abuse, do not promise secrecy. The POCSO Act requires you to report it, so say that honestly and stay with them.
actions.hg: Teachers aur wardens: agar 18 se kam ka student tumhe sexual abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh secret rakhne ka waada mat karo. POCSO Act ke tahat report karna zaroori hai, yeh imaandaari se batao aur uske saath raho.

title.en: Supriyo v. Union of India (2023): no right to marry, 3:2 against civil unions, and a committee instead
title.hg: Supriyo v. Union of India (2023): shaadi ka koi fundamental right nahi, civil unions ke khilaaf 3:2, aur badle mein ek committee

dek.en: Five judges agreed that queer couples cannot marry under the law as it stands, then split by a single vote on civil unions and adoption. A review in 2025 changed nothing. What each side held, and where couples stand in 2026.
dek.hg: Paanchon judges ne maana ki aaj ke law ke hisaab se queer couples shaadi nahi kar sakte, phir civil unions aur adoption par sirf ek vote se bat gaye. 2025 ke review ne kuch nahi badla. Kis side ne kya kaha, aur 2026 mein couples kahan khade hain.

statLabel.en: Supreme Court split against civil unions for queer couples (2023)
statLabel.hg: Supreme Court queer couples ke civil unions ke khilaaf 3:2 se bata (2023)

label.en: a five-judge bench unanimously holds there is no fundamental right to marry and leaves same-sex marriage to Parliament
label.hg: paanch judges ki bench ne unanimously kaha ki shaadi ka koi fundamental right nahi hai, aur same-sex marriage ka sawaal Parliament par chhoda

label.en: the vote against a right of queer couples to civil unions, and against their joint adoption
label.hg: queer couples ke civil union ke haq ke khilaaf, aur unke joint adoption ke khilaaf vote

label.en: the Supreme Court dismisses the review petitions, finding no error apparent in the judgment
label.hg: Supreme Court ne review petitions dismiss ki, judgment mein koi galti saaf nazar nahi aayi

claim.en: In 2023 the Supreme Court ruled that same-sex relationships are wrong.
claim.hg: 2023 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki same-sex relationships galat hain.

truth.en: It ruled nothing of the kind. It held that no one has a fundamental right to marry and left marriage law to Parliament. Same-sex relationships between adults have been legal since 2018.
truth.hg: Aisa kuch nahi kaha. Court ne kaha ki kisi ka bhi shaadi ka fundamental right nahi hai, aur marriage law Parliament par chhoda. Adults ke beech same-sex relationships 2018 se legal hain.

actions.en: Before you share a hot take, know what the court held: no fundamental right to marry for anyone, and no ban on queer relationships.
actions.hg: Koi hot take share karne se pehle jaan lo court ne kya kaha: kisi ke liye bhi shaadi ka fundamental right nahi, aur queer relationships par koi ban nahi.

actions.en: Couples: write wills and keep nominations on bank accounts and insurance up to date, because the law gives a partner no claim as a spouse.
actions.hg: Couples: will likho aur bank accounts aur insurance mein nomination update rakho, kyunki law partner ko spouse jaisa koi haq nahi deta.

actions.en: Write to your MP: the Supreme Court left marriage law to Parliament and, in 2025, refused to review that verdict.
actions.hg: Apne MP ko likho: Supreme Court ne marriage law Parliament par chhoda, aur 2025 mein us faisle ka review karne se mana kar diya.

actions.en: If you are transgender and in a heterosexual relationship and are refused marriage, cite the 2023 judgment and ask NALSA (15100) for free legal aid.
actions.hg: Agar tum transgender ho, heterosexual relationship mein ho aur tumhari shaadi se mana kiya jaaye, toh 2023 ke judgment ka hawala do aur free legal aid ke liye NALSA (15100) se baat karo.

actions.en: If isolation or family pressure is wearing you down, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar akelapan ya family ka pressure tumhe tod raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, free aur 24x7.

title.en: Teaching consent before 18: what the Supreme Court recommended in 2024, and what the research shows
title.hg: 18 se pehle consent sikhana: 2024 mein Supreme Court ne kya suggest kiya, aur research kya kehti hai

dek.en: The Supreme Court wants consent taught to children, and the evidence says it does not push teenagers into sex. Five conversations, with words you can borrow, for parents and teachers of 13-to-17-year-olds.
dek.hg: Supreme Court chahta hai ki bachchon ko consent sikhaya jaaye, aur evidence kehta hai ki isse teenagers sex ki taraf nahi dhakele jaate. 13 se 17 saal ke bachchon ke parents aur teachers ke liye paanch conversations, bolne ke liye ready lines ke saath.

statLabel.en: of POCSO penetrative-assault cases in 2024 involved someone the child knew
statLabel.hg: 2024 mein POCSO penetrative assault cases jinmein accused ko bachcha pehle se jaanta tha

label.en: randomised trials in the 2016 Oxford review that underpins the UN's 2018 sexuality-education guidance
label.hg: randomised trials 2016 ke Oxford review mein, jis par UN ki 2018 sexuality-education guidance tiki hai

label.en: child victims of POCSO penetrative assault in 2024 were aged 16-18
label.hg: bachche jo 2024 mein POCSO penetrative assault cases mein 16-18 saal ke the

label.en: of young adults sexually assaulted in childhood had ever told anyone (2007 government study)
label.hg: bachpan mein sexual assault jhel chuke young adults mein se sirf itnon ne kabhi kisi ko bataya (2007 government study)

claim.en: Talking to teenagers about consent will make them start having sex.
claim.hg: Teenagers se consent ki baat karoge toh woh sex karne lagenge.

truth.en: The UN's 2018 guidance, built mainly on two big evidence reviews, states that sexuality education does not increase sexual activity or sexual risk-taking.
truth.hg: UN ki 2018 guidance, jo mainly do bade evidence reviews par tiki hai, kehti hai ki sexuality education se na sexual activity badhti hai, na risky behaviour.

actions.en: Have these talks in small pieces, at dinner, in the car or after a film scene, not as one big lecture.
actions.hg: Yeh baatein chhote-chhote hisson mein karo: dinner par, car mein, ya kisi film scene ke baad. Ek lamba lecture mat do.

actions.en: Tell teenagers plainly that the law does not accept a 'yes' from anyone under 18.
actions.hg: Teenagers ko saaf batao ki 18 se kam umar ke kisi ki 'haan' law nahi maanta.

actions.en: Never forward a sexual image of anyone under 18. If your child's image has leaked, use Take It Down and report it at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930.
actions.hg: 18 se kam umar ke kisi ki bhi sexual image kabhi forward mat karo. Agar tumhare bachche ki photo leak hui hai, toh Take It Down use karo aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karo.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them, do not promise secrecy, and call 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uski baat par bharosa karo, secret rakhne ka promise mat karo, aur 1098 ya 112 par call karo.

actions.en: Share housework in front of your children. Respect is learned by watching.
actions.hg: Bachchon ke saamne ghar ka kaam milkar karo. Respect dekhkar seekhi jaati hai.

title.en: 33,189 certificates for 4.87 lakh people: the paperwork wall facing transgender Indians
title.hg: 4.87 lakh logon ke liye 33,189 certificates: transgender Indians ke saamne khadi kaagazon ki deewar

dek.en: Twelve years after the Supreme Court upheld the right to self-identify, about 7 in every 100 people in the Census's 'other' gender category hold a transgender certificate. Since May 2026 a medical board stands between an applicant and that document.
dek.hg: Supreme Court ne apna gender khud identify karne ka right baarah saal pehle upheld kiya tha. Aaj Census ki 'other' gender category ke har 100 logon mein se kareeb 7 ke paas transgender certificate hai. May 2026 se applicant aur us document ke beech ek medical board khada hai.

statLabel.en: transgender certificates issued nationwide by June 2026
statLabel.hg: transgender certificates jo June 2026 tak poore desh mein issue hue

label.en: transgender certificates issued through the National Portal, per ministry data cited in a June 2026 Supreme Court petition
label.hg: transgender certificates jo National Portal se issue hue; yeh ministry data June 2026 ki ek Supreme Court petition mein cite hua hai

label.en: people counted in the 'other' gender category in Census 2011, itself an undercount
label.hg: log jo Census 2011 mein 'other' gender category mein gine gaye; yeh khud ek undercount hai

label.en: certificates issued by December 2024, four years after the portal opened
label.hg: certificates jo December 2024 tak issue hue, portal khulne ke chaar saal baad

label.en: of India's 36 states and union territories had set up a Transgender Protection Cell by November 2025
label.hg: India ke 36 states aur union territories mein se itnon ne November 2025 tak Transgender Protection Cell banaya tha

actions.en: Hold an identity card issued under the 2019 Act? Keep the original and copies safe: the Union told the Supreme Court that cards already issued will continue to operate while the case is pending.
actions.hg: Aapke paas 2019 Act ke tahat issue hua identity card hai? Original aur copies sambhaal kar rakhiye: Union ne Supreme Court ko bataya hai ki pehle se issue hue cards case pending rehne tak chalte rahenge.

actions.en: Applying now? Keep a record of every step: application number, dates, screenshots and each reply you receive.
actions.hg: Abhi apply kar rahe hain? Har step ka record rakhiye: application number, dates, screenshots aur jo bhi reply aaye.

actions.en: If your application stalls or is refused, ask for the reason in writing and seek free legal aid on the NALSA helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Agar application atak jaaye ya refuse ho, toh reason likhit mein maangiye aur NALSA helpline 15100 par free legal aid lijiye.

actions.en: Colleges, banks and employers: accept a valid transgender identity card without asking for extra medical proof.
actions.hg: Colleges, banks aur employers: valid transgender identity card ko accept kijiye, extra medical proof mat maangiye.

actions.en: If the wait is wearing you down, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar yeh intezaar aapko thaka raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye, free aur 24x7.

title.en: Is my transgender ID still valid? Ten questions after the 2026 amendment
title.hg: Kya mera transgender ID abhi bhi valid hai? 2026 ke amendment ke baad dus sawaal

dek.en: Cards already issued keep working for now, the Union has told the Supreme Court. New applications go through a medical board. Here is what is known, what is not, and where to go if you are refused or unsafe.
dek.hg: Union ne Supreme Court ko bataya hai ki pehle se issue hue cards filhaal chalte rahenge. Nayi applications ab medical board se hokar jaati hain. Yahan padhiye kya pata hai, kya nahi pata, aur refuse hone ya unsafe hone par kahan jaana hai.

statLabel.en: transgender certificates issued through the National Portal, per ministry data cited in a June 2026 Supreme Court petition
statLabel.hg: National Portal se issue hue transgender certificates, June 2026 ki ek Supreme Court petition mein cite kiye gaye ministry data ke hisaab se

label.en: the day the Union told the Supreme Court that cards already issued will continue to operate while the case is pending
label.hg: jis din Union ne Supreme Court ko bataya ki pehle se issue hue cards case pending rehne tak chalte rahenge

label.en: transgender certificates issued nationwide, per ministry data cited in a June 2026 petition
label.hg: desh bhar mein issue hue transgender certificates, June 2026 ki ek petition mein cite kiye gaye ministry data ke hisaab se

label.en: Garima Greh shelters for transgender persons, in 17 states, as of November 2025
label.hg: transgender persons ke liye Garima Greh shelters, 17 states mein, November 2025 tak

label.en: states and union territories with a Transgender Protection Cell as of November 2025
label.hg: states aur union territories jahan November 2025 tak Transgender Protection Cell tha

claim.en: The 2026 amendment cancelled every transgender ID card issued before it.
claim.hg: 2026 ke amendment ne usse pehle issue hua har transgender ID card cancel kar diya.

truth.en: No. On 17 August 2026 the Union told the Supreme Court that identity cards already issued under the 2019 Act will continue to operate while the challenge is pending. What changed is the rule for new certificates.
truth.hg: Nahi. 17 August 2026 ko Union ne Supreme Court ko bataya ki 2019 Act ke tahat pehle se issue hue identity cards challenge pending rehne tak chalte rahenge. Jo badla hai woh naye certificates ka rule hai.

actions.en: Keep your certificate and ID card safe, with photos and a digital copy stored somewhere other than your phone.
actions.hg: Apna certificate aur ID card sambhal kar rakhiye, saath mein photos aur ek digital copy jo aapke phone ke alawa kahin aur bhi save ho.

actions.en: Before applying, ask the District Magistrate's office in writing what the medical board will require from you.
actions.hg: Apply karne se pehle District Magistrate ke office se likhit mein poochhiye ki medical board aapse kya maangega.

actions.en: If you are refused, ask for the decision and the reason in writing, and call the NALSA legal aid helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Agar application refuse ho jaaye, toh decision aur uski wajah likhit mein maangiye, aur NALSA legal aid helpline 15100 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If you are thrown out or in danger, call 112, and check whether your state has a Garima Greh or a Transgender Protection Cell.
actions.hg: Agar aapko ghar se nikaal diya gaya hai ya aap khatre mein hain, toh 112 par call kijiye, aur pata kijiye ki aapke state mein Garima Greh ya Transgender Protection Cell hai ya nahi.

actions.en: For someone to talk to, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Kisi se baat karni ho toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye, free aur 24x7.

title.en: Ten years to life for 'forcing' a trans identity, two years for sexual abuse: the punishment gap in India's transgender law
title.hg: Trans identity 'force' karne par 10 saal se life, sexual abuse par do saal: India ke transgender law ka punishment gap

dek.en: The 2026 amendment created a crime punishable with 10 years to life for forcing someone into a transgender identity. It left the sexual abuse of a transgender person at six months to two years, and rape law still does not count them as victims.
dek.hg: 2026 ke amendment ne ek naya crime banaya: kisi ko transgender identity mein zabardasti dhakelne par 10 saal se life tak ki saza. Transgender insaan ke sexual abuse ki saza chhe mahine se do saal par hi rahi, aur rape law aaj bhi unhe victim nahi ginta.

statLabel.en: punishment for sexual abuse of a transgender person under Section 18(d)
statLabel.hg: Section 18(d) ke tahat transgender insaan ke sexual abuse ki saza

label.en: prison term for sexual abuse of a transgender person under Section 18(d), left unchanged by the 2026 amendment
label.hg: Section 18(d) ke tahat transgender insaan ke sexual abuse par jail; 2026 ke amendment ne ise nahi badla

label.en: minimum sentence for the rape of a woman under Section 64 of the BNS
label.hg: BNS ke Section 64 ke tahat ek woman ke rape ki minimum saza

label.en: states and union territories, out of 36, that had set up a Transgender Protection Cell by November 2025
label.hg: states aur union territories, 36 mein se, jahan November 2025 tak Transgender Protection Cell bana tha

label.en: Garima Greh shelters for transgender persons, in 17 states, as of November 2025
label.hg: transgender persons ke liye Garima Greh shelters, 17 states mein, November 2025 tak

claim.en: The 2026 amendment made the law tougher on violence against transgender people.
claim.hg: 2026 ke amendment ne transgender logon ke khilaaf violence par law ko sakht bana diya.

truth.en: It made the law tougher on one thing: forcing someone into a transgender identity, now punishable with 10 years to life. Sexual abuse of a transgender person still carries six months to two years, the same range as in 2019.
truth.hg: Usne law ko sirf ek cheez par sakht banaya: kisi ko transgender identity mein zabardasti dhakelna, jiski saza ab 10 saal se life tak hai. Transgender insaan ke sexual abuse ki saza aaj bhi chhe mahine se do saal hai, wahi range jo 2019 mein thi.

actions.en: In immediate danger, call 112. You can report at any police station as a Zero FIR, and you must get a free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Agar khatra abhi hai, toh 112 par call kijiye. Aap kisi bhi police station mein Zero FIR ke roop mein report kar sakte hain, aur aapko FIR ki free copy milni chahiye.

actions.en: After a sexual assault, get to a hospital fast and ask for HIV PEP by name: it has to start within 72 hours.
actions.hg: Sexual assault ke baad jaldi hospital pahunchiye aur naam lekar HIV PEP maangiye: ise 72 hours ke andar shuru karna hota hai.

actions.en: If the survivor is under 18, POCSO applies whatever their gender: call the Child Helpline 1098 or the police.
actions.hg: Agar survivor ki umar 18 se kam hai, toh POCSO lagu hota hai, gender chahe jo ho: Child Helpline 1098 ya police ko call kijiye.

actions.en: Ask for free legal aid on the NALSA helpline 15100, and ask whether your state has a Transgender Protection Cell.
actions.hg: NALSA helpline 15100 par free legal aid maangiye, aur poochhiye ki aapke state mein Transgender Protection Cell hai ya nahi.

actions.en: For counselling, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Counselling ke liye Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye, free aur 24x7.

title.en: Legal since 2018, unequal in 2026: what queer Indians still cannot do
title.hg: 2018 se legal, 2026 mein bhi barabar nahi: queer Indians aaj bhi kya nahi kar sakte

dek.en: Eight years after the Supreme Court decriminalised same-sex relationships, a queer couple still cannot marry, form a civil union or adopt a child together. A right-by-right audit of what the law gives, what it withholds and what is still pending.
dek.hg: Supreme Court ne same-sex relationships ko decriminalise kiye aath saal ho gaye, phir bhi ek queer couple na shaadi kar sakta hai, na civil union bana sakta hai, na saath mein bachcha adopt kar sakta hai. Ek-ek haq ka audit: law kya deta hai, kya rokta hai aur kya abhi pending hai.

label.en: the Supreme Court vote against civil unions for queer couples, and against their joint adoption, in Supriyo (2023)
label.hg: Supriyo (2023) mein Supreme Court ka vote, queer couples ke civil unions ke khilaaf aur unke joint adoption ke khilaaf

label.en: cases registered under Section 377 in 2023, its last full year; since July 2024 no offence has taken its place
label.hg: 2023 mein Section 377 ke under registered cases, uska aakhri poora saal; July 2024 se uski jagah koi offence nahi hai

label.en: the maximum prison term for sexual abuse of a transgender person, left unchanged by the 2026 amendment
label.hg: transgender insaan ke sexual abuse ki maximum jail, jise 2026 ke amendment ne nahi badla

claim.en: Since 2018, queer Indians have the same rights as everyone else.
claim.hg: 2018 ke baad queer Indians ke paas wahi rights hain jo baaki sabke paas hain.

truth.en: The 2018 judgment only stopped the state from treating consensual same-sex relationships as a crime. Marriage, civil unions and joint adoption are still closed, and the clearest legal ban on discrimination by sexual orientation covers only mental health care.
truth.hg: 2018 ke judgment ne bas itna kiya ki state consent wale same-sex relationships ko crime nahi maan sakti. Shaadi, civil union aur joint adoption ab bhi band hain, aur sexual orientation ke basis par discrimination par sabse saaf legal rok sirf mental health care tak hai.

actions.en: Couples: write wills and keep your papers in order, because the law gives an unmarried partner no claim as a spouse.
actions.hg: Couples: will likho aur apne papers theek rakho, kyunki law unmarried partner ko spouse jaisa koi claim nahi deta.

actions.en: If a doctor offers to 'cure' you or someone you love, refuse and report it to the state medical council: it is professional misconduct.
actions.hg: Agar koi doctor tumhe ya tumhare kisi apne ko 'cure' karne ki baat kare, toh mana karo aur state medical council mein report karo: yeh professional misconduct hai.

actions.en: If you are sexually assaulted, go to a hospital and the police anyway; for free legal aid, call NALSA on 15100.
actions.hg: Agar tumhare saath sexual assault ho, toh phir bhi hospital aur police ke paas jao; free legal aid ke liye NALSA ko 15100 par call karo.

actions.en: Hold a transgender certificate issued under the 2019 Act? Keep it safe: the Union told the Supreme Court such cards remain valid while the case is heard.
actions.hg: 2019 ke Act ke under bana transgender certificate hai? Use sambhaal kar rakho: Union ne Supreme Court ko bataya hai ki case chalne tak aise cards valid rahenge.

actions.en: If discrimination or family pressure is wearing you down, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar discrimination ya family ka pressure tumhe thaka raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call karo, free aur 24x7.

title.en: 72% of Indian men reject every coercive response to a wife's 'no': a guide to saying so in your group chat
title.hg: 72% Indian men wife ke 'no' par har coercive response reject karte hain: yahi baat apne group chat mein kehne ki guide

dek.en: The loudest man in the group is usually not the majority. Here is what the data say most men think, where 'just forwarding' becomes a crime, and five ways to interrupt, from ignoring the joke to a direct no.
dek.hg: Group ka sabse loud aadmi aksar majority nahi hota. Yahan hai ki data ke hisaab se zyada tar men kya sochte hain, 'bas forward kiya tha' kab crime ban jaata hai, aur tokne ke paanch tareeke, joke ko ignore karne se lekar seedha 'no' tak.

statLabel.en: of men reject all coercive responses to a wife refusing sex (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: men wife ke sex se mana karne par har coercive response reject karte hain (NFHS-5)

label.en: of men in NFHS-5 rejected all four coercive responses to a wife refusing sex, down from 77% in NFHS-4
label.hg: men ne NFHS-5 mein wife ke sex se mana karne par chaaron coercive responses reject kiye; NFHS-4 mein yeh 77% tha

label.en: of men in a seven-state survey were classed as holding 'rigid' ideas of masculinity; 45% were in the middle
label.hg: men ko saat states ke survey mein masculinity ke 'rigid' ideas wala maana gaya; 45% beech mein the

label.en: maximum prison term for transmitting an image of a person's private area without consent (Section 66E, IT Act)
label.hg: kisi ke private area ki image bina consent transmit karne par maximum jail (Section 66E, IT Act)

label.en: cases police registered under Section 66E across India in 2024
label.hg: cases jo police ne 2024 mein poore India mein Section 66E ke tahat register kiye

claim.en: Everyone in the group finds it funny. If I object, I will be the only one.
claim.hg: Group mein sabko yeh funny lagta hai. Agar main tokunga, toh akela pad jaunga.

truth.en: Most men do not share the loudest man's view: 72% of men in NFHS-5 rejected every coercive response to a wife refusing sex. Silence makes a minority opinion look like the group's.
truth.hg: Zyada tar men sabse loud aadmi ki soch share nahi karte: NFHS-5 mein 72% men ne wife ke sex se mana karne par har coercive response reject kiya. Chuppi ek minority opinion ko poore group ki rai jaisa dikha deti hai.

actions.en: Do not laugh, react or reply to a rape joke or a 'rating'. Taking away the audience is the first interruption.
actions.hg: Rape joke ya 'rating' par na hansiye, na react kijiye, na reply. Audience hata dena pehla interruption hai.

actions.en: Say one short line in your own voice: 'Not cool. Delete it.'
actions.hg: Apni awaaz mein ek chhoti line boliye: 'Not cool. Delete it.'

actions.en: Message one other friend privately. Two people objecting changes a group faster than one.
actions.hg: Ek aur dost ko privately message kijiye. Do log tokein toh group ek ke mukable jaldi badalta hai.

actions.en: Never forward or save a private or intimate image; tell whoever posted it to delete it.
actions.hg: Private ya intimate image kabhi forward ya save mat kijiye; jisne post ki hai use delete karne ko kahiye.

actions.en: If a friend describes forcing or threatening someone, tell him plainly it is not okay, and let the person harmed decide the next step; the Women Helpline is 181.
actions.hg: Agar koi dost kisi ke saath zabardasti ya dhamki ki baat kare, toh saaf kahiye ki yeh theek nahi hai, aur agla step us insaan ko tay karne dijiye jise nuksaan hua; Women Helpline 181 hai.

title.en: Delhi recorded 18 cases of sexual harassment on public transport in 2024: eight years of India's bus-and-train numbers, and what they miss
title.hg: Delhi mein 2024 mein public transport par sexual harassment ke 18 cases darj hue: India ke bus-train numbers ke aath saal, aur jo unmein nahi dikhta

dek.en: Police across India registered 459 such cases in 2024, and no year since counting began in 2017 has crossed 730. These figures count complaints that became FIRs. Almost nothing that happens on a crowded bus ever becomes one.
dek.hg: Poore India mein police ne 2024 mein aise 459 cases register kiye, aur 2017 mein ginti shuru hone ke baad kisi bhi saal yeh 730 se upar nahi gaya. Yeh figures un complaints ko ginte hain jo FIR bani. Bheed bhari bus mein jo hota hai, uska lagbhag kuch bhi FIR nahi banta.

claim.en: Only 18 cases in a whole year: Delhi's buses and trains must be safe for women.
claim.hg: Poore saal mein sirf 18 cases: Delhi ki buses aur trains auraton ke liye safe hi hongi.

truth.en: Eighteen is the number of FIRs police registered under one legal heading, not the number of women harassed. A low count says more about reporting and recording than about safety.
truth.hg: Atharah un FIRs ki ginti hai jo police ne ek legal heading ke under register ki, harass hui auraton ki ginti nahi. Kam count safety se zyada reporting aur recording ke baare mein batata hai.

actions.en: Call it what the law calls it: sexual harassment, not 'eve teasing' or 'chhed-chhaad'. Section 75 of the BNS makes it a crime.
actions.hg: Ise wahi kahiye jo law kehta hai: sexual harassment, 'eve teasing' ya 'chhed-chhaad' nahi. BNS ka Section 75 ise crime banata hai.

actions.en: If you are harassed and want it recorded, note the bus or coach number, route, time and stop, tell the conductor or driver, and call 112.
actions.hg: Agar aapke saath harassment hua aur aap ise record karwana chahte hain, toh bus ya coach number, route, time aur stop note kijiye, conductor ya driver ko bataiye, aur 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: You can report at any police station, wherever it happened, or by electronic communication. Ask for a free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Aap kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakte hain, ghatna chahe kahin bhi hui ho, ya electronic communication se. FIR ki free copy maangiye.

actions.en: If you see it happen, stand next to the person, ask if they are okay, alert the conductor and offer your name as a witness. Do not film the person who was harassed.
actions.hg: Agar aap aisa hote dekhen, toh us insaan ke paas khade ho jaiye, poochhiye ki woh theek hai, conductor ko bataiye aur witness ke taur par apna naam dijiye. Jiske saath harassment hua, uska video mat banaiye.

actions.en: If you drive, conduct or manage a route, treat a complaint as an offence to be reported, not a quarrel between passengers. For a child under 18, call the Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar aap bus chalate hain, conductor hain ya route manage karte hain, toh complaint ko report karne laayak offence maaniye, passengers ka aapsi jhagda nahi. 18 se kam umr ke bachche ke liye Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

title.en: 'No place in Indian culture': states banned sex education in 2007, the year 53.22% of children in a government study reported sexual abuse
title.hg: 'Indian culture mein iski koi jagah nahi': 2007 mein states ne sex education band ki, usi saal sarkari study mein 53.22% bachchon ne sexual abuse ki baat batayi

dek.en: As states pushed the new school sex-education course out of classrooms, the government's own survey showed children being abused, often by people they knew, and most telling no one. We tested each argument for the bans against the evidence.
dek.hg: States school se sex education ka naya course hata rahe the. Theek usi waqt sarkar ka apna survey dikha raha tha ki bachchon ka abuse ho raha hai, aksar jaan-pehchaan walon ke haathon, aur zyada tar bachche kisi ko bata nahi pa rahe. Humne ban ke har argument ko evidence par parkha.

statLabel.en: of 12,447 children surveyed in 13 states in 2007 reported one or more forms of sexual abuse, the year states banned sex education
statLabel.hg: bachchon ne 2007 ki sarkari study mein kisi na kisi tarah ke sexual abuse ki baat batayi (13 states ke 12,447 bachche), usi saal jab states sex education ban kar rahe the

label.en: of 12,447 children surveyed in 13 states in 2007 reported one or more forms of sexual abuse
label.hg: bachchon ne 2007 ki sarkari study mein kisi na kisi tarah ke sexual abuse ki baat batayi (13 states ke 12,447 bachche)

label.en: of the children in that study who reported sexual assault had told no one
label.hg: bachchon ne, jinhone us study mein sexual assault ki baat batayi, usse pehle kisi ko kuch nahi bataya tha

label.en: randomised trials, plus 22 systematic reviews, in one of the two evidence reviews behind the UN's 2018 sexuality-education guidance
label.hg: randomised trials aur 22 systematic reviews, un do reviews mein se ek mein jin par UN ki 2018 sexuality education guidance tiki hai

label.en: of young women aged 15-24 had comprehensive HIV knowledge in 2019-21, down from 22% in 2015-16
label.hg: young women (15-24 saal) ko 2019-21 mein HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi; 2015-16 mein yeh 22% thi

claim.en: Sex education puts ideas in children's heads and makes them start having sex earlier.
claim.hg: Sex education bachchon ke dimaag mein ideas daalti hai aur woh jaldi sex karne lagte hain.

truth.en: The UN's 2018 guidance, built mainly on reviews of 87 studies and of 22 systematic reviews and 77 trials, states that sexuality education does not increase sexual activity. It is abstinence-only programmes that the guidance found ineffective.
truth.hg: UN ki 2018 guidance, jo mainly 87 studies aur 22 systematic reviews va 77 trials wale reviews par tiki hai, kehti hai: sexuality education se sexual activity nahi badhti. Guidance ne bekaar sirf un programmes ko paaya jo bas abstinence sikhate hain.

actions.en: Ask your school in writing which adolescence or health-and-wellness sessions it runs, who teaches them and how often.
actions.hg: Apne school se likhkar poochiye ki wahan adolescence ya health-and-wellness ke kaun se sessions hote hain, unhe kaun padhata hai aur kitni baar.

actions.en: Teach children the correct names for their body parts, and that no adult may ask them to keep a body secret.
actions.hg: Bachchon ko body parts ke sahi naam sikhaiye, aur bataiye ki koi bhi bada unse body se judi koi baat secret rakhne ko nahi keh sakta.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them, stay calm and call the Child Helpline on 1098, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar koi bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uski baat par bharosa kijiye, shaant rahiye aur Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye, emergency mein 112.

actions.en: When someone says sex education is against Indian culture, share what the UN's 2018 guidance states: it does not increase sexual activity.
actions.hg: Koi kahe ki sex education Indian culture ke khilaaf hai, toh UN ki 2018 guidance ki yeh baat share kijiye: isse sexual activity nahi badhti.

title.en: Strengthened in 2015, weakened by a 2018 ruling, restored by Parliament within months: the fight over India's Atrocities Act
title.hg: 2015 mein mazboot, 2018 ke ek faisle se kamzor, aur kuch hi mahinon mein Parliament ne wapas laaya: India ke Atrocities Act ki ladaai

dek.en: In 2015 Parliament rewrote the SC/ST Atrocities Act, adding specific sexual offences, deadlines and exclusive special courts. In 2018 a Supreme Court ruling made FIRs and arrests harder; by August, Parliament had written that out of the law. The timeline, the 'misuse' argument, and what the case data actually show.
dek.hg: 2015 mein Parliament ne SC/ST Atrocities Act ko naye sire se likha, aur usmein specific sexual offences, deadlines aur Exclusive Special Courts jode. 2018 mein Supreme Court ke ek faisle ne FIR aur arrest ko mushkil bana diya; August tak Parliament ne use kaanoon se hata diya. Poori timeline, 'misuse' wali bahas, aur case data asal mein kya dikhata hai.

statLabel.en: of disposed atrocity cases against Scheduled Castes were charge-sheeted by police in 2023
statLabel.hg: 2023 mein police ne Scheduled Castes ke khilaaf jin atrocity cases ki jaanch poori ki, unmein itne mein charge sheet file hui

label.en: of crimes against Scheduled Castes disposed of by police in 2023 ended in a charge sheet
label.hg: 2023 mein police ne Scheduled Castes ke khilaaf crimes ke jo cases nipataaye, unmein itne charge sheet tak pahunche

label.en: crimes against Scheduled Castes registered in 2023, up from 50,291 in 2020
label.hg: 2023 mein Scheduled Castes ke khilaaf darj crimes, 2020 ke 50,291 se zyada

label.en: of atrocity cases before the courts in 2023 were still pending at the end of the year
label.hg: 2023 mein courts ke saamne maujood atrocity cases mein se itne saal ke aakhir tak pending the

label.en: the 2015 target for finishing an atrocity trial after the charge sheet, as far as possible
label.hg: 2015 ka target: charge sheet ke baad, jahan tak mumkin ho, itne samay mein atrocity trial khatam ho

claim.en: The Atrocities Act is mostly used to file false cases.
claim.hg: Atrocities Act zyada tar jhoothe case daalne ke liye istemaal hota hai.

truth.en: In 2023 police, after investigating, filed charge sheets in 81.2% of the atrocity cases they disposed of. An acquittal or a closed case is not proof that a complaint was false.
truth.hg: 2023 mein police ne jaanch ke baad apne nipataaye atrocity cases mein se 81.2% mein charge sheet file ki. Acquittal ya band hua case is baat ka saboot nahi ki complaint jhoothi thi.

actions.en: If you are reporting an atrocity, ask police to register the FIR at once. Since the 2018 amendment, the law says no preliminary enquiry is needed first.
actions.hg: Agar aap kisi atrocity ki report kar rahe hain, toh police se turant FIR darj karne ko kahiye. 2018 ke amendment ke baad kaanoon kehta hai ki pehle koi preliminary enquiry zaroori nahi.

actions.en: Note the date of the FIR. The Act expects a charge sheet within 60 days; if it is late, ask the investigating officer in writing why.
actions.hg: FIR ki taareekh note kar lijiye. Act 60 din ke andar charge sheet ki ummeed karta hai; deri ho toh investigating officer se likhit mein wajah poochhiye.

actions.en: Ask the prosecutor for notice of every hearing, including bail hearings. Section 15A makes timely notice a victim's right.
actions.hg: Prosecutor se har hearing ki jaankari maangiye, bail hearings ki bhi. Section 15A ke tahat samay par notice paana victim ka haq hai.

actions.en: If anyone threatens, pressures or offers money to the survivor or witnesses, tell the police and the court in writing. Protecting them is the state's duty.
actions.hg: Agar koi survivor ya gawaahon ko dhamkaaye, dabaav daale ya paise ka laalach de, toh police aur court ko likhit mein bataiye. Unki hifaazat state ki zimmedaari hai.

actions.en: For free legal help, contact the District Legal Services Authority or the NALSA helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Free legal madad ke liye District Legal Services Authority ya NALSA helpline 15100 se sampark kijiye.

title.en: Touch, words, devadasi dedication: what the 2015 Atrocities Act amendment says about sexual offences against Dalit and Adivasi women
title.hg: Touch, words, devadasi dedication: Dalit aur Adivasi auraton ke khilaaf sexual offences par 2015 ka Atrocities Act amendment kya kehta hai

dek.en: Under a 2015 amendment to the Atrocities Act, sexually touching a Dalit or Adivasi woman without consent, or aiming sexual words or gestures at her while knowing her caste, is a separate atrocity. So is dedicating her as a devadasi. Here is what each provision says, and why caste needed its own clause.
dek.hg: Atrocities Act mein 2015 ke amendment ke tahat, kisi Dalit ya Adivasi aurat ko uski marzi ke bina sexual tareeke se chhoona, ya uski caste jaante hue uski taraf sexual shabd ya ishaare karna, ek alag atrocity hai. Use devadasi banakar 'dedicate' karna bhi. Har provision kya kehta hai, aur caste ke liye alag clause ki zaroorat kyun padi, yahan samjhiye.

statLabel.en: punishment for sexual touch, words or gestures towards a Dalit or Adivasi woman by someone who knows her caste (Section 3(1)(w))
statLabel.hg: Dalit ya Adivasi aurat ki caste jaante hue use sexual tareeke se chhoone, ya uski taraf sexual shabd ya ishaare karne ki sazaa (Section 3(1)(w))

label.en: prison, plus a fine, for sexual touch, words or gestures towards a Dalit or Adivasi woman by someone who knows her caste or tribe
label.hg: jail aur jurmaana: Dalit ya Adivasi aurat ki caste ya tribe jaante hue use sexual tareeke se chhoone, ya sexual shabd ya ishaare karne par

label.en: crimes against Scheduled Castes registered by police in India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein police ne Scheduled Castes ke khilaaf itne crimes darj kiye

label.en: crimes against Scheduled Castes per lakh SC population in Madhya Pradesh in 2023, the highest state rate (India: 28.7)
label.hg: 2023 mein Madhya Pradesh mein har lakh SC aabaadi par Scheduled Castes ke khilaaf crimes, sabhi states mein sabse zyada rate (India: 28.7)

label.en: rape cases with Scheduled Tribe victims registered in India in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein Scheduled Tribe victims wale itne rape cases darj hue

claim.en: If she did not fight back, she agreed.
claim.hg: Agar usne virodh nahi kiya, toh matlab woh raazi thi.

truth.en: For this offence the Atrocities Act defines consent as 'an unequivocal voluntary agreement'. Not resisting physically does not, by itself, mean consent, and her sexual history never implies it.
truth.hg: Is offence ke liye Atrocities Act consent ko 'an unequivocal voluntary agreement' kehta hai, yaani saaf aur apni marzi se di gayi sehmati. Sirf physically virodh na karna consent nahi hai, aur uski sexual history se consent kabhi saabit nahi hota.

actions.en: If harassment came with caste slurs, or the man clearly knew her caste, ask police in writing to add the SC/ST Act sections, including Section 3(1)(w), to the FIR alongside the BNS sections.
actions.hg: Agar harassment ke saath caste wali gaaliyan di gayin, ya aadmi ko saaf pata tha ki woh kis caste se hai, toh police se likhit mein kahiye ki FIR mein BNS ke saath SC/ST Act ke sections, Section 3(1)(w) samet, bhi jodein.

actions.en: Write down the exact words, gestures, dates and the names of anyone who saw or heard, as soon as possible. For a 'words or gestures' complaint, the words are the evidence.
actions.hg: Jitni jaldi ho sake, exact shabd, ishaare, taareekh aur jisne bhi dekha ya suna unke naam likh lijiye. 'Words or gestures' wali complaint mein shabd hi saboot hote hain.

actions.en: If anyone is pushing a girl or woman to be dedicated to a temple or deity, report it to police or call 112. If she is under 18, also call the Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar koi kisi ladki ya aurat ko mandir ya devta ke naam 'dedicate' karne ka dabaav bana raha hai, toh police ko bataiye ya 112 par call kijiye. Agar woh 18 se kam hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par bhi call kijiye.

actions.en: For free help drafting or following up a complaint, contact the District Legal Services Authority or the NALSA helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Complaint likhne ya uska follow-up karne mein free madad ke liye District Legal Services Authority ya NALSA helpline 15100 se sampark kijiye.

actions.en: Do not post the woman's name, photo or village online, even to support her.
actions.hg: Us aurat ka naam, photo ya gaon online post mat kijiye, chahe aap uska saath dene ke liye hi kyun na kar rahe hon.

title.en: NEP 2020 says 'strictly enforce' anti-harassment rules. Here is what that means on your campus.
title.hg: NEP 2020 kehti hai anti-harassment rules 'strictly enforce' karo. Tumhare campus par iska matlab yeh hai.

dek.en: The National Education Policy tells every college to 'strictly enforce' its anti-harassment rules. In 2023 the Supreme Court found serious lapses in enforcing the law behind those rules. Five questions a student, research scholar or new lecturer should be able to answer about their own campus.
dek.hg: National Education Policy har college se kehti hai ki anti-harassment rules 'strictly enforce' karo. 2023 mein Supreme Court ne paaya ki un rules ke peeche wale law ko lagu karne mein serious lapses hain. Paanch sawaal, jinka jawab har student, research scholar aur naye lecturer ko apne campus ke baare mein pata hona chahiye.

label.en: to give a written complaint after the incident; the committee can extend this by up to 3 more
label.hg: incident ke baad written complaint dene ke liye; committee yeh time 3 mahine aur badha sakti hai

label.en: for the complaints committee to complete its inquiry
label.hg: mein complaints committee ko apni inquiry poori karni hoti hai

label.en: directions the Supreme Court issued in May 2023 on enforcing the POSH Act
label.hg: directions Supreme Court ne May 2023 mein POSH Act lagu karwane ke liye diye

label.en: maximum fine for an employer with no Internal Committee, doubled on a repeat
label.hg: tak ka fine us employer par jiske paas Internal Committee nahi hai; dobara hone par double saza

claim.en: If the college has no complaints committee, or the principal is the problem, there is nowhere to complain.
claim.hg: Agar college mein complaints committee nahi hai, ya problem khud principal hai, toh complaint karne ki koi jagah nahi hai.

truth.en: A college is an employer, and the POSH Act obliges every employer to set up a committee. Where there is none, or the complaint is against the employer, the district's Local Committee, the SHe-Box portal and the police remain open.
truth.hg: College ek employer hai, aur POSH Act har employer ko committee banane ke liye bound karta hai. Jahan committee nahi hai, ya complaint employer ke hi khilaf hai, wahan district ki Local Committee, SHe-Box portal aur police ka rasta khula rehta hai.

actions.en: Find your college's Internal Committee today: look on the website and notice boards for members' names, email IDs and how to submit a complaint.
actions.hg: Aaj hi apne college ki Internal Committee dhundho: website aur notice boards par members ke naam, email IDs aur complaint dene ka tareeka dekho.

actions.en: If nothing is published, ask the principal or registrar in writing who sits on the committee and whether it hears students' complaints; keep a copy.
actions.hg: Agar kuch publish nahi hai, toh principal ya registrar se likhit mein poocho ki committee mein kaun hai aur kya woh students ki complaints sunti hai; copy apne paas rakho.

actions.en: After an incident, note the date, place, words used and witnesses, and save every message; a written complaint is due within three months.
actions.hg: Incident ke baad date, jagah, kahe gaye words aur witnesses note karo, aur har message save rakho; written complaint teen mahine ke andar deni hoti hai.

actions.en: If the college stalls, go outside it: the district's Local Committee, SHe-Box (shebox.wcd.gov.in), Women Helpline 181 or the police.
actions.hg: Agar college taalta rahe, toh bahar jao: district ki Local Committee, SHe-Box (shebox.wcd.gov.in), Women Helpline 181 ya police.

actions.en: If you are under 18, the POCSO Act applies and staff who know must report: call Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh POCSO Act lagu hota hai aur jis staff ko pata hai use report karna hi hoga: Child Helpline 1098 par call karo.

title.en: Caste and disability myths still shape who is believed about rape. In 2023 the Supreme Court named them.
title.hg: Caste aur disability ke myths aaj bhi is par asar daalte hain ki rape survivor par yakeen hoga ya nahi. 2023 mein Supreme Court ne unhe naam diya.

dek.en: A 1995 Rajasthan verdict doubted a gang-rape complaint partly because dominant-caste men supposedly would not rape an oppressed-caste woman. In 2023 the Supreme Court called that belief, and a twin myth about disabled women, stereotypes. How the 'who would want her?' logic still works, and what the data can and cannot prove.
dek.hg: 1995 mein Rajasthan ke ek faisle ne gang rape ki complaint par is wajah se bhi shak kiya ki dominant-caste aadmi kisi oppressed-caste aurat ka rape 'nahi karenge'. 2023 mein Supreme Court ne us soch ko, aur disabled auraton ke baare mein uske jaise hi ek myth ko, stereotype kaha. 'Use kaun chahega?' wali soch aaj bhi kaise kaam karti hai, aur data kya saabit kar sakta hai aur kya nahi.

statLabel.en: rape cases with Scheduled Caste victims ended in acquittal in 2023, against 508 convictions
statLabel.hg: 2023 mein Scheduled Caste victims wale itne rape cases acquittal par khatam hue, jabki sazaa sirf 508 mein hui

label.en: rape cases with Scheduled Caste victims that ended in acquittal in 2023
label.hg: 2023 mein Scheduled Caste victims wale itne rape cases mein accused bari hue

label.en: rape cases with Scheduled Caste victims that ended in conviction in 2023
label.hg: 2023 mein Scheduled Caste victims wale itne rape cases mein sazaa hui

label.en: documented cases in which police and court officials ignored legal duties to accommodate a disabled survivor (Human Rights Watch, 2018)
label.hg: documented cases jinmein police aur court ke officials ne disabled survivor ke liye zaroori legal suvidhaayein nahi deen (Human Rights Watch, 2018)

claim.en: A dominant-caste man would never touch a Dalit woman, and nobody would want a disabled woman, so their complaints must be false.
claim.hg: Koi dominant-caste aadmi kisi Dalit aurat ko haath bhi nahi lagaayega, aur kisi disabled aurat ko koi chahega hi nahi, isliye unki complaints jhoothi hongi.

truth.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook calls both beliefs stereotypes: sexual violence has long been used to enforce caste hierarchy, and disability does not lower the risk of rape.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook dono soch ko stereotype kehti hai: sexual violence ko lambe samay se caste ki oonch-neech banaye rakhne ke liye istemaal kiya gaya hai, aur disability se rape ka khatra kam nahi hota.

actions.en: When you hear 'he would never touch someone like her' or 'who would want her?', name it: the Supreme Court calls these stereotypes, not evidence.
actions.hg: Jab aap 'woh aisi ladki ko kabhi haath nahi lagaayega' ya 'use kaun chahega?' sunein, toh use naam dijiye: Supreme Court inhe stereotype kehta hai, saboot nahi.

actions.en: If a disabled survivor wants to report, insist that police record her complaint at her home or a place she chooses, with an interpreter or special educator, on video, as Section 173(1) of the BNSS requires.
actions.hg: Agar koi disabled survivor report karna chahti hai, toh zor dijiye ki police uski complaint uske ghar ya uski chuni hui jagah par, interpreter ya special educator ke saath, video par record kare, jaisa BNSS ki Section 173(1) kehti hai.

actions.en: If the survivor is Dalit or Adivasi and the accused knew it, ask police to add the SC/ST Act sections so the caste element is on record from day one.
actions.hg: Agar survivor Dalit ya Adivasi hai aur accused yeh jaanta tha, toh police se SC/ST Act ke sections jodne ko kahiye, taaki caste wala pehlu pehle din se record par ho.

actions.en: Never judge a survivor by whether she resisted, how she behaved afterwards or her past relationships. None of these decides whether she consented.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ko is baat se kabhi mat aankiye ki usne virodh kiya ya nahi, baad mein kaisa bartaav kiya, ya uske pichhle rishte kaise the. Inmein se koi bhi baat yeh tay nahi karti ki usne consent diya tha.

title.en: A checklist for change: what a panchayat, RWA, school, college or company can do about sexual violence this month
title.hg: Badlaav ki checklist: panchayat, RWA, school, college ya company is mahine sexual violence ke baare mein kya kar sakti hai

dek.en: The committees, officers and peer educators meant to prevent and respond to sexual violence mostly exist on paper already. Whether they exist in your village, housing society, campus or office depends on someone asking. Here is what to ask, and whom.
dek.hg: Sexual violence ko rokne aur us par action lene ke liye jo committees, officers aur peer educators chahiye, woh zyada tar kaagaz par pehle se maujood hain. Tumhare gaon, society, campus ya office mein woh sach mein hain ya nahi, yeh is par tika hai ki koi poochta hai ya nahi. Yahan dekho ki kya poochna hai, aur kisse.

label.en: Saathiya peer educators, two boys and two girls, are to be selected per village or 1,000 population
label.hg: Saathiya peer educators, do ladke aur do ladkiyan, har gaon ya 1,000 ki aabadi par chune jaane hain

label.en: teachers in every government and aided school are to be trained as Health and Wellness Ambassadors
label.hg: teachers har government aur aided school mein Health and Wellness Ambassador ke roop mein train hone hain

label.en: for a district Local Committee to forward a domestic worker's prima facie complaint to the police
label.hg: yaani 7 din ke andar district ki Local Committee ko domestic worker ki prima facie complaint police ko bhejni hoti hai

label.en: maximum fine for an employer who fails to set up an Internal Committee; a repeat offence can cost the licence
label.hg: tak ka fine us employer par jo Internal Committee nahi banata; dobara galti par licence bhi ja sakta hai

actions.en: This week, find out who your District Officer under the POSH Act is, and get the Local Committee's address and phone number.
actions.hg: Isi hafte pata karo ki POSH Act ke tahat tumhare district ka District Officer kaun hai, aur Local Committee ka address aur phone number le lo.

actions.en: Post the Local Committee, Internal Committee, Child Helpline 1098 and Women Helpline 181 details on your notice board and in your WhatsApp group.
actions.hg: Local Committee, Internal Committee, Child Helpline 1098 aur Women Helpline 181 ki details apne notice board par aur WhatsApp group mein daal do.

actions.en: Ask the ASHA worker whether your village's four Saathiya peer educators have been selected, and ask the principal who the school's two Health and Wellness Ambassadors are.
actions.hg: ASHA worker se poocho ki gaon ke chaar Saathiya peer educators chune gaye ya nahi, aur principal se poocho ki school ke do Health and Wellness Ambassadors kaun hain.

actions.en: Before the wedding season, save the number of your district's Child Marriage Prohibition Officer. Report a planned child marriage to 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Shaadi ke season se pehle apne district ke Child Marriage Prohibition Officer ka number save kar lo. Koi child marriage plan ho rahi ho toh 1098 ya 112 par batao.

actions.en: Put every request in writing and keep a dated copy. For free legal aid, call the NALSA helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Har request likhkar do aur date wali copy apne paas rakho. Free legal aid ke liye NALSA helpline 15100 par call karo.

title.en: Faith or a child's body? The 'essential religious practice' question nine Supreme Court judges reserved in May 2026
title.hg: Aastha ya ek bachchi ki body? 'Essential religious practice' ka woh sawaal jis par Supreme Court ke nau judges ne May 2026 mein faisla reserve kiya

dek.en: A 2017 petition says khatna, the genital cutting of girls in the Dawoodi Bohra community, violates their rights to equality and bodily autonomy. Community members call it protected religious practice. Nine judges have now heard the question that will decide it, and the answer reaches far beyond one community.
dek.hg: 2017 ki ek petition kehti hai ki khatna, yaani Dawoodi Bohra community mein ladkiyon ki genital cutting, unke equality aur bodily autonomy ke rights ko todti hai. Community ke members ise protected religious practice kehte hain. Nau judges ab woh sawaal sun chuke hain jo iska faisla karega, aur jawaab ek community se bahut aage tak jaata hai.

label.en: judges on the Constitution Bench that heard the religious-freedom reference from 7 April 2026, with the khatna petition tagged to it
label.hg: judges us Constitution Bench mein jisne 7 April 2026 se religious-freedom reference suna; khatna petition isi se tagged hai

label.en: days of hearings before the bench reserved judgment on 14 May 2026
label.hg: din ki sunwai, jiske baad bench ne 14 May 2026 ko faisla reserve kiya

label.en: of 385 Bohra women in an online survey by an anti-khatna group said they had been cut (2017): a self-selected sample, not a prevalence estimate
label.hg: ek anti-khatna group ke online survey mein 385 Bohra women mein se itni ne kaha ki unka khatna hua tha (2017): self-selected sample, prevalence ka estimate nahi

label.en: countries where UNFPA says female genital mutilation is documented; India is on its list for Asia
label.hg: countries jahan UNFPA ke mutabik female genital mutilation documented hai; Asia ki list mein India bhi hai

claim.en: Female genital cutting is already banned by law in India.
claim.hg: Female genital cutting India mein law se pehle hi banned hai.

truth.en: No Indian law specifically bans it. UNFPA counts India among countries where it can be prosecuted through other laws, and the Supreme Court has yet to decide the 2017 petition.
truth.hg: Koi Indian law ise naam lekar ban nahi karta. UNFPA India ko un countries mein ginta hai jahan doosre laws ke zariye iska prosecution ho sakta hai, aur Supreme Court ne 2017 ki petition par abhi faisla nahi diya hai.

actions.en: Talk about khatna as a question of a child's body and consent, not as a verdict on a faith or the people who follow it.
actions.hg: Khatna par baat kijiye toh ek bachchi ki body aur consent ke sawaal ki tarah, kisi dharm ya use maanne wale logon par faisle ki tarah nahi.

actions.en: If you fear a girl is about to be cut, call the Child Helpline on 1098, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Agar aapko darr hai ki kisi ladki ki cutting hone wali hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye, ya emergency mein 112 par.

actions.en: If you are a doctor or nurse, refuse to cut a girl's genitals, whoever asks: about one in four survivors worldwide were cut by health personnel, and a clinic does not make it the child's choice.
actions.hg: Agar aap doctor ya nurse hain, toh kisi ladki ke genitals ko kaatne se mana kijiye, chahe koi bhi kahe: duniya bhar mein lagbhag har chaar survivors mein se ek ki cutting health personnel ne ki thi, aur clinic mein hone se yeh bachchi ki choice nahi ban jaati.

actions.en: When the nine-judge judgment comes, read what it says about the 'essential practice' test, not just the headline about Sabarimala.
actions.hg: Jab nau judges ka judgment aaye, toh padhiye ki woh 'essential practice' test ke baare mein kya kehta hai, sirf Sabarimala wali headline nahi.

title.en: Before your first job or internship: six harassment checks, and a plan for week one
title.hg: Pehli job ya internship se pehle: harassment ke chhah checks, aur pehle hafte ka plan

dek.en: An offer letter gives you the stipend and the notice period. It does not tell you who hears a sexual harassment complaint, whether the office cab counts as the workplace, or how long you have to complain. Find out before day one.
dek.hg: Offer letter mein stipend aur notice period likha hota hai. Yeh nahi likha hota ki sexual harassment ki complaint kaun sunega, office cab workplace mein gini jaati hai ya nahi, aur complaint karne ke liye kitna time milta hai. Yeh sab day one se pehle pata kar lo.

label.en: to file a written complaint after an incident; the committee can extend this by up to 3 more
label.hg: incident ke baad written complaint dene ke liye; committee yeh time 3 mahine aur badha sakti hai

label.en: workers: below this number, complaints go to the district's Local Committee
label.hg: workers: isse kam hon, toh complaint district ki Local Committee ke paas jaati hai

label.en: for the complaints committee to complete its inquiry
label.hg: mein complaints committee ko apni inquiry poori karni hoti hai

label.en: maximum fine for an employer with no Internal Committee, doubled on a repeat
label.hg: tak ka fine us employer par jiske paas Internal Committee nahi hai; dobara hone par double saza

claim.en: An intern or a new joiner on probation cannot file a sexual harassment complaint.
claim.hg: Intern ya probation par chal rahi nayi joiner sexual harassment ki complaint nahi kar sakti.

truth.en: The POSH Act protects any woman 'of any age whether employed or not' who alleges sexual harassment at a workplace. You do not need a permanent contract, or to have finished probation, to complain.
truth.hg: POSH Act us har aurat ko protect karta hai jo workplace par sexual harassment ka aarop lagaye, 'of any age whether employed or not'. Complaint karne ke liye permanent contract ya probation poora hona zaroori nahi hai.

actions.en: Before you sign, ask HR by email for the names of the Internal Committee members, including the external member.
actions.hg: Sign karne se pehle HR ko email karke Internal Committee ke members ke naam poocho, external member ka naam bhi.

actions.en: Count heads: if the workplace has fewer than ten workers, find your district's Local Committee before you need it.
actions.hg: Log gino: agar workplace mein das se kam workers hain, toh zaroorat padne se pehle apne district ki Local Committee dhundh lo.

actions.en: Ask in writing who provides transport on late shifts and work trips, and save cab and travel details each time.
actions.hg: Likhit mein poocho ki late shifts aur work trips par transport kaun dega, aur har baar cab aur travel ki details save rakho.

actions.en: From day one, keep a dated note of anything unwelcome: what was said or done, where, who saw it, with screenshots.
actions.hg: Day one se har unwelcome cheez ka dated note rakho: kya kaha ya kiya gaya, kahan, kisne dekha, saath mein screenshots.

actions.en: Do not wait for it to 'settle down': a written complaint is due within three months of the incident.
actions.hg: Maamla 'thanda hone' ka wait mat karo: written complaint incident ke teen mahine ke andar deni hoti hai.

title.en: The casting couch happens before the job: the POSH gap the Hema Committee exposed
title.hg: Casting couch job milne se pehle hota hai: Hema Committee ne POSH ka jo gap dikhaya

dek.en: The Hema Committee confirmed that junior artists in Malayalam cinema were told work depended on sex. That demand is made at the audition, before any contract, at the point where the Kerala High Court says the workplace harassment law stops. Here is what changed after August 2024, and what protection someone auditioning has today.
dek.hg: Hema Committee ne confirm kiya ki Malayalam cinema mein junior artists se kaha jaata tha ki kaam sex ki demand maanne par hi milega. Ye demand audition par hoti hai, kisi contract se pehle, theek wahin jahan Kerala High Court ke mutabik workplace harassment ka law ruk jaata hai. Jaaniye August 2024 ke baad kya badla, aur audition dene wale ke paas aaj kya protection hai.

label.en: the report stayed with the Kerala government before the public saw it on 19 August 2024
label.hg: tak report Kerala sarkar ke paas rahi, phir 19 August 2024 ko public ke saamne aayi

label.en: when the state police chief was given a copy; the High Court sent the full report to an SIT only on 10 September 2024
label.hg: mein state police chief ko copy mili; High Court ne poori report SIT ko 10 September 2024 ko jaakar dilwayi

label.en: workers: above this, a film's production unit must have an Internal Committee (Kerala High Court, 2022)
label.hg: workers: isse zyada hon toh film ki production unit mein Internal Committee zaroori hai (Kerala High Court, 2022)

label.en: when, Kerala told the High Court on 8 October 2025, a draft entertainment-industry law would go to the state cabinet
label.hg: mein, Kerala ne 8 October 2025 ko High Court ko bataya, entertainment industry ke law ka draft state cabinet ke paas jaana tha

claim.en: The POSH Act protects a woman only after she has got the job.
claim.hg: POSH Act aurat ko tabhi protect karta hai jab use job mil chuki ho.

truth.en: The Act's text covers a woman 'of any age whether employed or not' who is harassed at a workplace. The Kerala High Court has remarked orally that women seeking work fall outside it, so the point is contested. A police complaint never depends on having a job.
truth.hg: Act ka text us aurat ko cover karta hai jo 'of any age whether employed or not' ho aur jise workplace par harass kiya gaya ho. Kerala High Court ne orally kaha hai ki kaam dhoondh rahi aurtein iske bahar reh jaati hain, isliye is point par behes hai. Police complaint ke liye job hona kabhi zaroori nahi.

actions.en: Before an audition, ask in writing which production it is for, who is conducting it and where. Keep every message.
actions.hg: Audition se pehle likh kar poochiye ki ye kis production ke liye hai, kaun le raha hai aur kahan. Har message sambhal kar rakhiye.

actions.en: If anyone asks for sex in return for a role, note the date, place and exact words the same day, and tell one person you trust.
actions.hg: Agar koi role ke badle sex maange, toh usi din date, jagah aur exact shabd note kar lijiye, aur ek bharosemand insaan ko bata dijiye.

actions.en: You do not need a contract to go to the police: sexual harassment is a crime and can be reported at any police station.
actions.hg: Police ke paas jaane ke liye contract zaroori nahi: sexual harassment ek crime hai aur kisi bhi police station mein report ho sakta hai.

actions.en: Unit has fewer than 10 workers, or the complaint is against the producer? Write to your district's Local Committee within three months, or file on SHe-Box.
actions.hg: Unit mein 10 se kam workers hain, ya complaint producer ke khilaaf hai? Teen mahine ke andar apne district ki Local Committee ko likhiye, ya SHe-Box par file kariye.

actions.en: If you cast or produce, name a complaints contact in every audition call, and never hold auditions in private rooms.
actions.hg: Agar aap casting ya production karte hain, toh har audition call mein complaint ke liye ek contact ka naam dijiye, aur private kamron mein audition kabhi mat rakhiye.

title.en: Launched in 2005, banned in 2007, 'so-called sex education' in 2014: India's school sex-education timeline up to the Supreme Court's 2024 call
title.hg: 2005 mein launch, 2007 mein ban, 2014 mein 'so-called sex education': schools mein sex education ki timeline, Supreme Court ki 2024 wali salah tak

dek.en: In under 20 years, India's school sex education has been launched, banned, attacked by a Union health minister and folded into a school 'health and wellness' hour. Here is every turn, where things stand in 2026, and who decides what a teenager is taught.
dek.hg: 20 saal se kam mein school ki sex education launch hui, ban hui, ek Union health minister ke nishane par aayi, aur phir school ke ek 'health and wellness' ghante mein sama gayi. Yahan har mod hai, 2026 ka haal hai, aur yeh bhi ki teenagers kya padhenge, yeh kaun tay karta hai.

statLabel.en: states banned or refused the school sex-education programme after the 2007 backlash: six by Reuters' count in May 2007, 12 by a 2020 study
statLabel.hg: states ne 2007 ke backlash ke baad school sex education programme ban kiya ya lagoo karne se mana kiya: May 2007 mein Reuters ki ginti mein chhe, 2020 ki ek study mein 12

label.en: states banned or refused the Adolescence Education Programme after the 2007 backlash, depending on the count; there is no official list
label.hg: states ne 2007 ke backlash ke baad Adolescence Education Programme ban kiya ya lagoo nahi kiya, ginti ke hisaab se; koi official list nahi hai

label.en: adolescents the national adolescent health programme, RKSK, set out to reach from January 2014
label.hg: yaani 25.3 crore adolescents tak pahunchne ka target lekar January 2014 mein national adolescent health programme RKSK shuru hua

label.en: students reached by Jharkhand's Udaan by September 2019; it became the model for the national school programme
label.hg: yaani 10 lakh se zyada students tak Jharkhand ka Udaan September 2019 tak pahuncha; yahi national school programme ka model bana

label.en: of young women aged 15-24 had comprehensive HIV knowledge in 2019-21, down from 22% in 2015-16
label.hg: young women (15-24 saal) ko 2019-21 mein HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi; 2015-16 mein yeh 22% thi

actions.en: Ask your school which adolescence or health-and-wellness sessions it runs, who teaches them and how often.
actions.hg: Apne school se poocho ki wahan adolescence ya health-and-wellness ke kaun se sessions hote hain, unhe kaun padhata hai aur kitni baar.

actions.en: In a government or aided school, ask for the names of the two teachers trained as Health and Wellness Ambassadors.
actions.hg: Government ya aided school mein un do teachers ke naam poocho jinhe Health and Wellness Ambassador ki training mili hai.

actions.en: If your school runs nothing, write to the district education officer and cite the Supreme Court's 2024 recommendation on sex education.
actions.hg: Agar school mein kuch nahi hota, toh district education officer ko likho aur Supreme Court ki 2024 wali sex education recommendation ka hawala do.

actions.en: When someone says sex education spoils children, share what the UN's 2018 guidance states: it does not increase sexual activity.
actions.hg: Koi kahe ki sex education bachchon ko bigaadti hai, toh UN ki 2018 guidance ki yeh baat share karo: isse sexual activity nahi badhti.

title.en: 'Izzat lut gayi': how the language of honour turns a rape into the survivor's shame, and keeps families silent
title.hg: 'Izzat lut gayi': izzat ki bhasha kaise rape ko survivor ki sharm bana deti hai, aur parivaaron ko chup rakhti hai

dek.en: Hindi and Hinglish still say a raped woman's 'izzat' was looted, a sentence in which the rapist does not appear. Courtroom English said the same thing with 'chaste' and 'fallen' until the Supreme Court told judges to drop those words in 2023. What honour talk costs, and what to say instead.
dek.hg: Hindi aur Hinglish mein aaj bhi kaha jaata hai ki rape hui aurat ki 'izzat lut gayi', ek aisa sentence jisme rapist kahin nahi hota. Courtroom ki English yahi baat 'chaste' aur 'fallen' jaise shabdon se kehti thi, jab tak Supreme Court ne 2023 mein judges ko inhe chhodne ko nahi kaha. Izzat wali bhasha ki keemat kya hai, aur iski jagah kya bolna chahiye.

statLabel.en: of victims of sexual violence in India are estimated to report it to the authorities (estimate cited in BMC Public Health, 2022)
statLabel.hg: sexual violence ke victims hi India mein authorities ko report karte hain, aisa anumaan hai (BMC Public Health, 2022 mein diya gaya estimate)

label.en: of women who had faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: auraton ne, jinhone physical ya sexual violence jheli thi, kabhi madad nahi maangi aur kisi ko bataya nahi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of victims of sexual violence in India are estimated to report it to the authorities (estimate cited in BMC Public Health, 2022)
label.hg: sexual violence ke victims hi India mein authorities ko report karte hain, aisa anumaan hai (BMC Public Health, 2022 mein diya gaya estimate)

label.en: of rape cases registered in India in 2024 in which the offender was known to the victim
label.hg: rape cases mein, jo 2024 mein India mein darj hue, offender victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

claim.en: Rape takes away a woman's honour, and her family's honour with it.
claim.hg: Rape se aurat ki izzat chali jaati hai, aur uske saath parivaar ki bhi.

truth.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook says: 'Rape does not taint the honour of the survivor / victim or her family.' The disgrace belongs to the person who committed the crime.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook kehti hai: 'Rape does not taint the honour of the survivor / victim or her family.' Yaani rape se survivor ya uske parivaar ki izzat par koi daag nahi lagta. Sharm usi ki hai jisne crime kiya.

actions.en: Say 'he raped her', never 'her izzat was looted'. Put the person who did it at the centre of the sentence.
actions.hg: 'Us aadmi ne uska rape kiya' kahiye, 'uski izzat lut gayi' kabhi nahi. Sentence ke beech mein use rakhiye jisne ye kiya.

actions.en: If someone tells you, start with 'It is not your fault' and 'I am with you', not 'don't tell anyone'.
actions.hg: Koi aapko bataye toh shuruaat 'ye tumhari galti nahi hai' aur 'main tumhare saath hoon' se kijiye, 'kisi ko mat batana' se nahi.

actions.en: Never suggest marriage or a 'settlement' with the offender. The Supreme Court's handbook says marriage is not a remedy for rape.
actions.hg: Offender se shaadi ya 'samjhauta' ka sujhaav kabhi mat dijiye. Supreme Court ki handbook kehti hai ki shaadi rape ka ilaaj nahi hai.

actions.en: Help her reach a doctor fast: HIV prevention medicine has to start within 72 hours, and emergency contraception works for up to 5 days.
actions.hg: Use jaldi doctor tak pahunchne mein madad kijiye: HIV se bachaav ki dawa 72 ghante ke andar shuru karni hoti hai, aur emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karti hai.

actions.en: Do not forward a survivor's name, photo or address. Identifying a rape survivor is a crime under Section 72 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Survivor ka naam, photo ya address forward mat kijiye. Rape survivor ki pehchaan zaahir karna BNS ke Section 72 ke under crime hai.

title.en: Rs 10 lakh each: how 12 media houses identified the Kathua child, and how a story can still reveal a survivor without naming her
title.hg: Rs 10 lakh each: 12 media houses ne Kathua ki bachchi ki identity kaise kholi, aur naam ke bina bhi ek story survivor ko kaise identify kar deti hai

dek.en: In April 2018 the Delhi High Court fined 12 outlets that believed a dead child could be named. Months later the Supreme Court spelled out how a report identifies a survivor without printing her name. Here is what that looks like in the phone era, and the checks that stop it.
dek.hg: April 2018 mein Delhi High Court ne un 12 media houses par jurmana lagaya jinhe lagta tha ki mar chuki bachchi ka naam chhapa ja sakta hai. Kuch mahine baad Supreme Court ne saaf bataya ki naam chhape bina bhi koi report survivor ki pehchaan kaise khol deti hai. Phone ke zamane mein yeh kaise hota hai, aur ise rokne ke checks kya hain, yahan padhiye.

statLabel.en: media houses had to pay Rs 10 lakh each for revealing the Kathua child's identity (Delhi High Court, 2018)
statLabel.hg: media houses ko Kathua ki bachchi ki identity kholne par Rs 10 lakh each bharne ka order mila (Delhi High Court, 2018)

label.en: the year disclosing a rape victim's identity became a crime in India (25 December)
label.hg: woh saal jab India mein rape victim ki identity kholna crime bana (25 December)

label.en: years in prison, at most, for publishing anything that identifies a rape survivor (Section 72 BNS)
label.hg: saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai agar aap kuch bhi aisa publish karein jisse rape survivor ki identity khule (Section 72 BNS)

label.en: cases registered under Section 72 in the BNS's first six months, July to December 2024
label.hg: cases hi register hue Section 72 mein, BNS ke pehle chhe mahino mein (July se December 2024)

label.en: rape cases in 2024 in which the accused was a family member: naming him can identify her
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein aise the jinme accused family ka hi tha: uska naam chhapna, uski pehchaan khol sakta hai

claim.en: Once a victim has died, or her family agrees, the media can name her.
claim.hg: Victim ki maut ho chuki ho, ya family maan jaye, toh media uska naam chhap sakta hai.

truth.en: The Supreme Court ruled in December 2018 that her identity stays protected after death, even with her family's consent, unless a Sessions Judge decides otherwise.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ne December 2018 mein kaha ki maut ke baad bhi, aur family ki consent ke saath bhi, uski identity protected rahegi, jab tak Sessions Judge kuch aur decide na karein.

actions.en: Before you post or publish anything about a sexual-violence case, ask: could her neighbours, classmates or colleagues recognise her from this?
actions.hg: Kisi bhi sexual-violence case par post ya publish karne se pehle khud se poochiye: kya isse uske padosi, classmates ya colleagues use pehchaan lenge?

actions.en: Leave out names, photos, school, village, workplace, exam results, FIR copies, and the accused's name if he is a relative.
actions.hg: Yeh cheezein bahar rakhiye: naam, photo, school, gaon, office, exam result, FIR ki copy, aur accused ka naam agar woh rishtedaar hai.

actions.en: Don't share 'justice for' posts that carry her name or photo; share the facts of the case and the system's failures instead.
actions.hg: 'Justice for...' wali aisi posts share mat kijiye jinme uska naam ya photo ho; case ke facts aur system ki failures share kijiye.

actions.en: Report posts that identify a survivor to the platform, and to the police or cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Jo post survivor ki identity kholti hai, use platform par report kijiye, aur police ya cybercrime.gov.in par complaint kijiye.

actions.en: Call her a survivor or a victim as she prefers; if you don't know her preference, either is acceptable.
actions.hg: Woh khud ko survivor kehlana chahti hai ya victim, jaisa woh chahe waisa kahiye; agar nahi pata, toh dono words theek hain.

title.en: Three months to complain, 'even after decades' to speak: the gap between India's POSH Act and #MeToo
title.hg: Complaint ke liye teen mahine, bolne ke liye 'even after decades': India ke POSH Act aur #MeToo ke beech ka gap

dek.en: The workplace harassment law gives a woman three months from the incident to file a complaint, and three more only if a committee agrees. Most people take far longer to find the words. Here is how the clock is counted, what a Delhi court said about speaking late, which routes stay open, and what naming someone can cost.
dek.hg: Workplace harassment ka law aurat ko complaint file karne ke liye incident se teen mahine deta hai, aur teen mahine aur tabhi jab committee maan jaaye. Zyadatar logon ko bolne ke shabd dhoondhne mein isse kahin zyada waqt lagta hai. Jaaniye ye clock kaise gini jaati hai, der se bolne par Delhi ki ek court ne kya kaha, kaun se raaste khule rehte hain, aur kisi ka naam lene ki keemat kya ho sakti hai.

statLabel.en: to file a POSH complaint, counted from the incident or the last of a series; a committee can add up to 3 more
statLabel.hg: milte hain POSH complaint file karne ke liye, incident ya series ke aakhri incident se gin kar; committee 3 mahine tak aur de sakti hai

label.en: to file a written POSH complaint, counted from the incident or the last in a series; extendable by up to 3 more
label.hg: milte hain likhit POSH complaint ke liye, incident ya series ke aakhri incident se gin kar; 3 mahine tak aur badh sakte hain

label.en: when a Union minister of state answered a #MeToo allegation with a criminal defamation case
label.hg: jab ek Union minister of state ne #MeToo ke ilzaam ka jawab criminal defamation case se diya

label.en: of sexual harassment trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: sexual harassment ke jo trials 2024 mein poore hue, unme se itne mein conviction hui

label.en: sexual harassment cases still pending in courts at the end of 2024
label.hg: sexual harassment ke cases 2024 ke aakhir mein courts mein pending the

claim.en: Once the POSH deadline has passed, there is nothing left to do.
claim.hg: POSH ki deadline nikal gayi toh ab kuch nahi ho sakta.

truth.en: The deadline closes one door, the workplace committee. A police complaint, a public account and, if the harassment is continuing, a fresh complaint counted from the latest incident all remain. A Delhi court held in 2021 that a woman may raise her grievance 'even after decades'.
truth.hg: Deadline sirf ek darwaza band karti hai: workplace committee ka. Police complaint, public mein apni baat kehna, aur agar harassment ab bhi chal raha hai toh sabse naye incident se gin kar nayi complaint, ye sab raaste bache rehte hain. 2021 mein Delhi ki ek court ne kaha ki aurat apni shikaayat 'even after decades', yaani dashkon baad bhi, utha sakti hai.

actions.en: If the harassment is still going on, count three months from the latest incident, not the first, and complain in writing to the Internal Committee.
actions.hg: Agar harassment ab bhi chal raha hai, toh teen mahine pehle incident se nahi, sabse naye incident se giniye, aur Internal Committee ko likhit complaint dijiye.

actions.en: Just past three months? Ask the committee in writing to extend the deadline, and explain what stopped you from complaining earlier.
actions.hg: Teen mahine abhi-abhi nikle hain? Committee se likh kar deadline badhane ko kahiye, aur bataiye ki aap pehle complaint kyun nahi kar paaye.

actions.en: Keep a private, dated record now: what happened, where, who saw it, whom you told.
