actions.hg: Abhi se ek private record rakhiye, dates ke saath: kya hua, kahan hua, kisne dekha, aapne kis-kis ko bataya.

actions.en: Before you name anyone in public, speak to a lawyer; free legal aid is available on the NALSA helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Kisi ka naam public mein lene se pehle vakeel se baat kariye; NALSA helpline 15100 par free legal aid milti hai.

actions.en: If a friend tells you years later, believe them. Delay is not evidence of lying.
actions.hg: Agar koi dost saalon baad aapko bataye, toh uska yakeen kariye. Der se bolna jhooth ka saboot nahi hai.

title.en: Women can now work night shifts in factories in around 22 states and UTs: what employers owe them after dark
title.hg: Ab lagbhag 22 states aur UTs mein auratein factories mein night shift kar sakti hain: andhere ke baad employer ki zimmedaari kya hai

dek.en: Night work is opening up to women across India. The permission is the easy part. The law already counts the company cab as the workplace and demands a complaints committee. Whether either works at 2 am is what a worker has to check.
dek.hg: Poore India mein night work auraton ke liye khul raha hai. Permission milna aasaan hissa hai. Law pehle se company cab ko workplace maanta hai aur complaints committee maangta hai. Yeh dono raat 2 baje kaam karte hain ya nahi, yeh worker ko khud check karna hoga.

statLabel.en: states and union territories allowed women to work night shifts in factories by early 2026 (Economic Survey 2025-26)
statLabel.hg: states aur union territories ne early 2026 tak auraton ko factories mein night shift ki ijaazat de di thi (Economic Survey 2025-26)

label.en: states and union territories allowed women to work night shifts in factories by early 2026
label.hg: states aur union territories ne early 2026 tak auraton ko factories mein night shift ki ijaazat di

label.en: states and union territories allowed women to work at night in commercial establishments
label.hg: states aur union territories ne commercial establishments mein auraton ko raat mein kaam ki ijaazat di

label.en: states and union territories had lifted bans on women working in 'hazardous' industries
label.hg: states aur union territories ne 'hazardous' industries mein auraton ke kaam par laga ban hataya

label.en: maximum fine for an employer who fails to set up an Internal Committee under the POSH Act; doubled for a repeat offence
label.hg: tak ka fine us employer par jo POSH Act ke tahat Internal Committee nahi banata; dobara galti par double

claim.en: What happens in the office cab after the shift is not the company's problem.
claim.hg: Shift ke baad office cab mein jo hota hai, woh company ki problem nahi hai.

truth.en: The POSH Act's definition of 'workplace' includes 'transportation provided by the employer'. Harassment in the company cab is workplace harassment, and the Internal Committee must take the complaint.
truth.hg: POSH Act ki 'workplace' ki definition mein 'transportation provided by the employer' shaamil hai. Company cab mein harassment workplace harassment hai, aur Internal Committee ko complaint leni hi hogi.

actions.en: Before you accept a night shift, ask HR in writing for your state's night-shift order and the conditions it sets on transport, security and cameras.
actions.hg: Night shift accept karne se pehle HR se likhit mein apne state ka night-shift order maangiye, aur poochhiye ki transport, security aur cameras par usmein kya conditions hain.

actions.en: Get the names and phone numbers of the Internal Committee members, including the outside member, and ask how to reach one of them during a night shift.
actions.hg: Internal Committee ke members ke naam aur phone numbers lijiye, bahar ke member samet, aur poochhiye ki night shift ke dauraan unmein se kisi tak kaise pahuncha jaaye.

actions.en: If you are harassed in an employer-provided cab, complain in writing to the Internal Committee within three months. The law treats that cab as your workplace.
actions.hg: Agar employer ki di hui cab mein harassment ho, toh teen mahine ke andar Internal Committee ko likhit complaint dijiye. Law us cab ko aapka workplace maanta hai.

actions.en: In danger, call 112. Sexual harassment is a crime under Section 75 of the BNS and can be reported at any police station. The Women Helpline is 181.
actions.hg: Khatre mein 112 par call kijiye. BNS ke Section 75 ke tahat sexual harassment crime hai aur kisi bhi police station mein report ho sakta hai. Women Helpline 181 hai.

actions.en: If you manage night staff, fix the drop order so that no woman is routinely the last passenger alone, and post the committee's contacts where the night shift can see them.
actions.hg: Agar aap night staff manage karte hain, toh drop order aisa rakhiye ki koi aurat roz aakhri passenger ban kar akeli na rahe, aur committee ke contacts wahan lagaiye jahan night shift unhe dekh sake.

title.en: 479 in 2017, 388 in 2024: why sexual harassment at the office almost never becomes a police case
title.hg: 2017 mein 479, 2024 mein 388: office mein hone wala sexual harassment police case kyun nahi banta

dek.en: For eight years India's police have recorded only a few hundred cases a year of sexual harassment at office premises, and three large states recorded none in 2024. The number does not measure harassment. It measures how rarely a complaint leaves the building.
dek.hg: Aath saal se India ki police office premises par sexual harassment ke saal mein sirf kuch sau cases record kar rahi hai, aur 2024 mein teen bade states ne ek bhi nahi kiya. Yeh number harassment ko nahi naapta. Yeh naapta hai ki complaint building se bahar kitni kam baar nikalti hai.

statLabel.en: police cases of sexual harassment at office premises in all of India in 2024
statLabel.hg: police cases, poore India mein 2024 mein office premises par sexual harassment ke

label.en: police cases of sexual harassment at office premises in India in 2024
label.hg: police cases, 2024 mein India mein office premises par sexual harassment ke

label.en: cases at work or office premises in 2017, the first year NCRB counted harassment by place
label.hg: cases 2017 mein work ya office premises par, jis saal se NCRB ne harassment ko jagah ke hisaab se ginna shuru kiya

label.en: cases at shops, malls, factories and homes in July-December 2024, a category that did not exist before
label.hg: cases July-December 2024 mein shops, malls, factories aur gharon mein, ek category jo pehle thi hi nahi

label.en: of sexual harassment trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction; more than nine in ten cases were still pending
label.hg: sexual harassment trials jo 2024 mein poore hue, unmein conviction hua; das mein se nau se zyada cases ab bhi pending the

claim.en: If an office has almost no police cases of sexual harassment, the women who work there are safe.
claim.hg: Agar kisi office mein sexual harassment ke police cases lagbhag hain hi nahi, toh wahan kaam karne wali auratein safe hain.

truth.en: Most workplace complaints go to in-house committees, which the police do not count, and many women never complain at all. A low count measures reporting, not safety.
truth.hg: Zyada tar workplace complaints in-house committees ke paas jaati hain, jinhe police nahi ginti, aur bahut si auratein complaint karti hi nahi. Kam count reporting ko naapta hai, safety ko nahi.

actions.en: Write down each incident with the date, time, place and witnesses, and keep copies of messages and emails somewhere your employer cannot delete them.
actions.hg: Har incident ki date, time, jagah aur gawah likh lijiye, aur messages aur emails ki copy aisi jagah rakhiye jahan se employer unhe delete na kar sake.

actions.en: Give your Internal Committee a written complaint within three months of the incident. The inquiry must finish within 90 days.
actions.hg: Incident ke teen mahine ke andar apni Internal Committee ko likhit complaint dijiye. Inquiry 90 din mein poori honi chahiye.

actions.en: If there is touching, force, stalking or you fear for your safety, go to the police as well. You can report at any police station and must get a free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Agar chhoona, zabardasti ya stalking hai, ya aapko apni safety ka darr hai, toh police ke paas bhi jaiye. Aap kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakti hain aur FIR ki copy free milni chahiye.

actions.en: If there is no committee, or the harasser is the employer, use your district's Local Committee, SHe-Box or the police.
actions.hg: Agar committee nahi hai, ya harass karne wala khud employer hai, toh district ki Local Committee, SHe-Box ya police ka raasta lijiye.

actions.en: Call 181 (Women Helpline) for guidance, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Guidance ke liye 181 (Women Helpline) par call kijiye, aur emergency mein 112 par.

title.en: India's outrage follows the rarest rapes: 266 rape-murders in 2024, against 28,597 cases where the survivor knew the accused
title.hg: India ka gussa sabse rare rapes ke peeche chalta hai: 2024 mein 266 rape-murders, aur 28,597 cases jahan survivor accused ko jaanti thi

dek.en: The cases that fill the streets end in a death and a demand for hanging. The cases that fill police registers involve a friend, a partner, a relative or a neighbour, and most of the trials that finish end in acquittal. How attention picks its cases, what that teaches, and what an outrage that matched the data would ask for.
dek.hg: Jo cases sadkon ko bhar dete hain, woh ek maut aur phaansi ki maang par khatam hote hain. Jo cases police registers ko bharte hain, unmein accused koi dost, partner, rishtedaar ya padosi hota hai, aur jin trials ka faisla aata hai unmein se zyada tar acquittal par khatam hote hain. Attention apne cases kaise chunta hai, isse hum kya seekhte hain, aur data se mel khaata gussa kya maangta.

statLabel.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a friend, online friend, partner or separated husband, the cases that rarely make the news
statLabel.hg: rape cases 2024 mein jahan accused dost, online friend, partner ya separated husband tha, yaani woh cases jo news mein kam hi aate hain

label.en: rape cases in 2024 where the accused was a friend, online friend, live-in partner or separated husband
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein jahan accused dost, online friend, live-in partner ya separated husband tha

label.en: of rape cases registered in 2024 in which the accused was known to the survivor (28,597 of 29,536)
label.hg: 2024 mein registered rape cases jinmein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha (29,536 mein se 28,597)

label.en: cases of murder with rape or gang rape recorded in 2024, the category such headline cases now fall under
label.hg: murder with rape ya gang rape ke cases 2024 mein record hue, aise headline wale cases ab isi category mein aate hain

label.en: of ever-married women who had faced sexual violence named their current husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: ever-married women jinhone sexual violence jhela, unmein se itni ne apne current husband ka naam liya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: The rape cases that make national headlines show what rape in India usually looks like.
claim.hg: Jo rape cases national headlines banate hain, wahi dikhate hain ki India mein rape aam taur par kaisa hota hai.

truth.en: They are the rarest kind. Police recorded 266 cases of murder with rape or gang rape in 2024. In 96.8% of the 29,536 rape cases registered that year, the accused was someone the survivor knew.
truth.hg: Woh sabse rare kism ke cases hain. Police ne 2024 mein murder with rape ya gang rape ke 266 cases record kiye. Usi saal register hue 29,536 rape cases mein se 96.8% mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha.

actions.en: When a case trends, ask who the accused usually is in the cases that do not: a friend, a partner, a relative or a neighbour.
actions.hg: Jab koi case trend kare, toh poochiye ki jo cases trend nahi karte unmein accused aam taur par kaun hota hai: dost, partner, rishtedaar ya padosi.

actions.en: If someone tells you a husband, boyfriend, relative or colleague forced them, believe them first. It is the most common pattern, not the exception.
actions.hg: Agar koi aapko bataye ki husband, boyfriend, rishtedaar ya colleague ne zabardasti ki, toh pehle us par yakeen kijiye. Yeh sabse common pattern hai, exception nahi.

actions.en: Do not cheer an 'encounter'. Ask for an investigation and a trial; a police killing ends both.
actions.hg: 'Encounter' par taali mat bajaiye. Investigation aur trial maangiye; police ke haathon maut dono ko khatam kar deti hai.

actions.en: Ask your MLA, MP and local reporters about the dull fixes: more judges and prosecutors, working One Stop Centres, and the marital rape exception.
actions.hg: Apne MLA, MP aur local reporters se boring fixes ke baare mein poochiye: zyada judges aur prosecutors, chalte hue One Stop Centres, aur marital rape exception.

actions.en: Never share a survivor's name, photo or identifying details, even in support. For help, call 112 or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Kisi survivor ka naam, photo ya pehchaan batane wali details kabhi share mat kijiye, support mein bhi nahi. Help ke liye 112 ya Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye.

title.en: 48,303 cases of 'outraging her modesty': why India's 2023 criminal code still describes sexual assault in the language of 1860
title.hg: 'Outraging her modesty' ke 48,303 cases: India ka 2023 ka criminal code sexual assault ko aaj bhi 1860 ki bhasha mein kyun likhta hai

dek.en: When a man gropes a woman, Indian law does not say he violated her consent. It says he outraged her 'modesty', a phrase carried from the Indian Penal Code of 1860 into the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. Where the word comes from, what Sections 74 and 79 actually cover, and why the vocabulary matters.
dek.hg: Jab koi aadmi kisi aurat ko grope karta hai, toh Indian law ye nahi kehta ki usne uska consent toda. Law kehta hai ki usne uski 'modesty' ko outrage kiya, ek phrase jo 1860 ke Indian Penal Code se Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita mein jyon ka tyon aa gaya. Ye shabd kahan se aaya, Sections 74 aur 79 asal mein kya cover karte hain, aur bhasha se farq kyun padta hai.

statLabel.en: cases of assault 'with intent to outrage her modesty' registered in 2024 (Section 74 BNS / Section 354 IPC)
statLabel.hg: cases 'with intent to outrage her modesty' wale assault ke, jo 2024 mein darj hue (Section 74 BNS / Section 354 IPC)

label.en: cases of assault on women 'with intent to outrage her modesty' registered in 2024
label.hg: cases auraton par 'with intent to outrage her modesty' wale assault ke, jo 2024 mein darj hue

label.en: cases of words, gestures or acts meant to 'insult the modesty of a woman' registered in 2024
label.hg: cases un shabdon, ishaaron ya harkaton ke jinka maqsad 'insult the modesty of a woman' tha, 2024 mein darj

label.en: of completed trials for assault 'to outrage modesty' ended in conviction in 2024
label.hg: 'outrage modesty' wale assault ke poore hue trials mein se itne hi 2024 mein conviction par khatm hue

label.en: of completed trials for 'insulting the modesty of a woman' ended in conviction in 2024
label.hg: 'insulting the modesty of a woman' ke poore hue trials mein se itne hi 2024 mein conviction par khatm hue

claim.en: 'Outraging modesty' is a minor charge for 'eve teasing', and it depends on what kind of woman she is.
claim.hg: 'Outraging modesty' toh 'eve teasing' ka chhota-mota charge hai, aur ye is par depend karta hai ki aurat kaisi hai.

truth.en: Section 74 of the BNS covers assault or criminal force on a woman and carries one to five years in prison. The Supreme Court's handbook says a man who touches a woman without consent cannot defend himself by pointing to how she dressed.
truth.hg: BNS ka Section 74 aurat par assault ya criminal force ko cover karta hai aur isme ek se paanch saal ki jail hai. Supreme Court ki handbook kehti hai ki bina consent aurat ko chhoone wala aadmi uske kapdon ka bahaana bana kar apna bachaav nahi kar sakta.

actions.en: Describe what he did: 'he groped her', 'he sexually harassed her'. Not 'eve teasing', not 'her modesty was outraged'.
actions.hg: Bataiye ki usne kya kiya: 'usne use grope kiya', 'usne use sexually harass kiya'. 'Eve teasing' nahi, 'uski modesty outrage hui' nahi.

actions.en: In a complaint, write the act, the place, the time and that you did not consent. Your clothes and character are not the issue.
actions.hg: Complaint mein likhiye ki kya hua, kahan, kab, aur ye ki aapka consent nahi tha. Aapke kapde aur character mudda nahi hain.

actions.en: You can report at any police station, whatever the area (Zero FIR), or electronically, and you must be given a free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Aap kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakte hain, ilaaka koi bhi ho (Zero FIR), ya electronically, aur FIR ki free copy aapko milni hi chahiye.

actions.en: If anyone asks what she was wearing, quote the Supreme Court's 2023 handbook: clothing is not an invitation to touch.
actions.hg: Koi pooche ki usne kya pehna tha, toh Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook quote kijiye: kapde chhoone ka nyota nahi hote.

actions.en: When a headline says 'modesty', read it as what it is: a sexual assault or sexual harassment case.
actions.hg: Headline mein 'modesty' dikhe toh use wahi padhiye jo woh hai: sexual assault ya sexual harassment ka case.

title.en: Twelve days for one law, 15 years for another: what India's Parliament hurries and what it leaves waiting on gender and sexual violence
title.hg: Ek kaanoon ke liye baarah din, doosre ke liye 15 saal: gender aur sexual violence par India ki Parliament kis cheez mein jaldi karti hai aur kise intezaar karwati hai

dek.en: The 2026 transgender amendment cleared both Houses within 12 days of its introduction. The workplace harassment law came more than 15 years after the Supreme Court's stop-gap guidelines. Put the records side by side and a pattern appears in what moves and what waits.
dek.hg: 2026 ka transgender amendment introduce hone ke 12 din ke andar dono Houses se pass ho gaya. Workplace harassment ka kaanoon Supreme Court ki stop-gap guidelines ke 15 saal se bhi zyada baad aaya. Dono records ko saath rakhiye, toh ek pattern dikhta hai ki kya aage badhta hai aur kya atka rehta hai.

statLabel.en: between the Supreme Court's Vishaka guidelines and Parliament's workplace harassment law
statLabel.hg: yaani 15 saal se zyada: Supreme Court ki Vishaka guidelines aur Parliament ke workplace harassment kaanoon ke beech ka waqt

label.en: from introduction to passage by both Houses for the 2026 transgender amendment (13 to 25 March 2026)
label.hg: 2026 ke transgender amendment ko introduce hone se dono Houses se pass hone tak lage itne din (13 se 25 March 2026)

label.en: between the Vishaka guidelines of 13 August 1997 and the workplace harassment law of 22 April 2013
label.hg: 13 August 1997 ki Vishaka guidelines aur 22 April 2013 ke workplace harassment kaanoon ke beech 15 saal se zyada

label.en: between the Lok Sabha (17 March 2020) and the Rajya Sabha (16 March 2021) passing the abortion-law amendment
label.hg: abortion-law amendment ke Lok Sabha (17 March 2020) aur Rajya Sabha (16 March 2021) se pass hone ke beech lagbhag ek saal

label.en: prison term for sexual abuse of a transgender person, a range the 2026 amendment left unchanged
label.hg: transgender vyakti ke sexual abuse par jail, yaani 6 mahine se 2 saal; 2026 ke amendment ne ise waisa hi chhod diya

actions.en: Before sharing that a law 'has been passed', look up the bill on PRS Legislative Research's bill tracker (prsindia.org) and read the date of each stage.
actions.hg: Yeh share karne se pehle ki koi kaanoon 'pass ho gaya', PRS Legislative Research ke bill tracker (prsindia.org) par woh bill dhoondhiye aur har stage ki taareekh padhiye.

actions.en: Write to your Lok Sabha MP and your state's Rajya Sabha MPs about one stalled protection. Name the bill or report and ask for a question in the House.
actions.hg: Apne Lok Sabha MP aur apne state ke Rajya Sabha MPs ko kisi ek atke hue protection ke baare mein likhiye. Bill ya report ka naam lijiye aur House mein sawaal uthaane ko kahiye.

actions.en: When a parliamentary committee invites public comments on a bill, send a short written note. You do not need to be a lawyer.
actions.hg: Jab koi parliamentary committee kisi bill par public se comments maange, toh ek chhota sa likhit note bhejiye. Iske liye lawyer hona zaroori nahi.

actions.en: If you are a man or a transgender person who has been sexually assaulted, you can still go to a hospital and to the police. The Transgender Persons Act punishes sexual abuse of a transgender person, and anyone under 18 is covered by POCSO.
actions.hg: Agar aap mard ya transgender vyakti hain aur aap par sexual assault hua hai, toh bhi aap hospital aur police ke paas ja sakte hain. Transgender Persons Act transgender vyakti ke sexual abuse par saza deta hai, aur 18 se kam umar ka har vyakti POCSO ke tahat cover hai.

title.en: The pink tax: what unsafe buses and trains cost Indian women in fares, jobs and freedom of movement
title.hg: Pink tax: unsafe buses aur trains Indian auraton se kiraye, naukri aur aane-jaane ki azaadi mein kya vasoolte hain

dek.en: In a Mumbai survey, 31% of women without jobs called the commute a barrier to work, yet only 1.6% blamed unsafe travel. The cost of fear has not vanished. It has been converted into auto fares, shorter journeys and jobs never applied for.
dek.hg: Mumbai ke ek survey mein bina naukri wali 31% auraton ne commute ko kaam ki rukaavat bataya, lekin sirf 1.6% ne unsafe safar ko wajah kaha. Darr ki keemat gayab nahi hui hai. Woh auto ke kiraye, chhote safar aur un jobs mein badal gayi hai jinke liye kabhi apply hi nahi kiya gaya.

statLabel.en: of non-working women in Mumbai said commuting was a barrier to taking a job (World Bank survey, 2019)
statLabel.hg: Mumbai ki non-working auraton ne kaha ki commuting naukri lene mein rukaavat hai (World Bank survey, 2019)

label.en: of 2,388 non-working women surveyed in Mumbai in 2019 said commuting was a barrier to working
label.hg: 2019 mein Mumbai mein survey ki gayi 2,388 non-working auraton ne kaha ki commuting kaam karne mein rukaavat hai

label.en: named unsafe commuting as the reason; domestic duties (19%) and childcare (13%) came first
label.hg: ne unsafe commuting ko wajah bataya; domestic duties (19%) aur childcare (13%) sabse aage rahe

label.en: of income spent on commuting by Delhi-NCR women domestic workers earning under Rs 5,000 a month (2024)
label.hg: income commuting par kharch karti thin Delhi-NCR ki woh women domestic workers jo Rs 5,000 mahine se kam kamaati hain (2024)

label.en: of urban Indian women aged 15 and above were in the labour force in 2023-24
label.hg: 15 saal aur usse upar ki urban Indian auratein 2023-24 mein labour force mein thin

claim.en: Only 1.6% of women said the commute was unsafe, so safety is not what keeps women from working.
claim.hg: Sirf 1.6% auraton ne kaha ki commute unsafe hai, toh safety woh cheez nahi hai jo auraton ko kaam se rokti hai.

truth.en: The same study found women moving to costlier autos and taxis as buses and trains got worse. Safety is being bought with fares and time, so it does not show up as a survey answer.
truth.hg: Usi study ne paaya ki buses aur trains ke kharaab hone par auratein mehenge autos aur taxis ki taraf chali gayin. Safety kiraye aur time dekar khareedi ja rahi hai, isliye woh survey ke jawab mein nahi dikhti.

actions.en: Add up what the women in your home spend on autos and cabs only because the bus or train feels unsafe or unreliable. That is your household's pink tax. Count it when jobs and budgets are discussed.
actions.hg: Jodiye ki aapke ghar ki auratein autos aur cabs par kitna sirf isliye kharch karti hain ki bus ya train unsafe ya unreliable lagti hai. Yahi aapke ghar ka pink tax hai. Jobs aur budget ki baat ho toh ise giniye.

actions.en: Share the cooking, the school run and the care work at home. Domestic duties, not fear, were the first reason Mumbai's women gave for the commute being a barrier.
actions.hg: Ghar mein khana banana, school run aur care work baantiye. Mumbai ki auraton ne commute ke rukaavat hone ki pehli wajah domestic duties batayi, darr nahi.

actions.en: If you are harassed on a bus or train, you can tell the conductor or station staff and report it to the police. In an emergency call 112. The Women Helpline is 181.
actions.hg: Bus ya train mein harassment ho toh aap conductor ya station staff ko bata sakte hain aur police mein report kar sakte hain. Emergency mein 112 par call kijiye. Women Helpline 181 hai.

actions.en: If you employ people, ask how each woman on your team gets home, and count travel time and cost when you fix shifts and pay.
actions.hg: Agar aap logon ko kaam par rakhte hain, toh poochhiye ki team ki har aurat ghar kaise pahunchti hai, aur shifts aur pay tay karte waqt travel ka time aur kharch giniye.

actions.en: Ask your councillor, MLA or transport authority for frequent off-peak buses, lit stops and a staffed complaint number on your route.
actions.hg: Apne councillor, MLA ya transport authority se apne route par frequent off-peak buses, roshni wale stops aur staff wala complaint number maangiye.

title.en: 1 of 36: more than a decade after the POSH Act, only one state or UT was reported to have finished the Supreme Court's survey of harassment committees
title.hg: 36 mein se 1: POSH Act ke ek dashak se zyada baad bhi sirf ek state ya UT ke baare mein report hua ki usne harassment committees ka Supreme Court wala survey poora kiya

dek.en: Since December 2013 the law has required a sexual harassment committee for every workplace, inside it or at the district. In 2023 the Supreme Court called enforcement 'a sorry state of affairs'. In August 2025 it was still waiting for states to count which workplaces had one.
dek.hg: December 2013 se law har workplace ke liye sexual harassment committee maangta hai, ya toh office ke andar ya district level par. 2023 mein Supreme Court ne enforcement ko 'a sorry state of affairs' kaha. August 2025 mein bhi Court intezaar kar raha tha ki states gin kar batayein ki kis workplace mein committee hai.

statLabel.en: states and UTs were reported to have completed the Supreme Court-ordered survey of workplace harassment committees by August 2025
statLabel.hg: states aur UTs ke baare mein August 2025 tak report hua ki unhone workplace harassment committees ka Supreme Court ka order kiya hua survey poora kar liya

label.en: states and UTs reported to have completed the district survey of Internal Committees by August 2025
label.hg: states aur UTs jinke baare mein August 2025 tak report hua ki unhone Internal Committees ka district survey poora kar liya

label.en: maximum fine for an employer who does not set up an Internal Committee
label.hg: maximum fine us employer par jo Internal Committee nahi banata

label.en: of rural women workers had regular salaried jobs in 2023-24 (PLFS)
label.hg: rural women workers ke paas 2023-24 mein regular salaried job thi (PLFS)

claim.en: The law requires a complaints committee, so someone in government must be checking that every workplace has one.
claim.hg: Law complaints committee maangta hai, toh sarkar mein koi na koi zaroor check karta hoga ki har workplace mein committee hai.

truth.en: In August 2025 the Supreme Court was still waiting for states to finish a district-wise count of which workplaces had a committee. Only one of 36 states and UTs was reported to have completed it.
truth.hg: August 2025 mein bhi Supreme Court intezaar kar raha tha ki states district-wise ginti poori karein ki kin workplaces mein committee hai. 36 states aur UTs mein se sirf ek ke baare mein report hua ki usne yeh kaam poora kiya.

actions.en: Ask your HR or head of office, in writing, for the order setting up the Internal Committee and the names of its members, including the external member.
actions.hg: Apne HR ya head of office se likhit mein Internal Committee banane ka order aur members ke naam maangiye, external member ka naam bhi.

actions.en: If you work in a government office, PSU, university or hospital, look for the committee's names, email IDs and complaint procedure on its website. The Supreme Court ordered them published.
actions.hg: Agar aap government office, PSU, university ya hospital mein kaam karti hain, toh uski website par committee ke naam, email IDs aur complaint procedure dhoondhiye. Supreme Court ne inhe publish karne ka order diya hai.

actions.en: If your workplace has fewer than ten workers, or the harasser is the employer, ask the district administration where the Local Committee sits.
actions.hg: Agar aapke workplace mein das se kam workers hain, ya harass karne wala khud employer hai, toh district administration se poochhiye ki Local Committee kahan baithti hai.

actions.en: If there is no committee, you can still complain on SHe-Box or at any police station: sexual harassment is a crime under Section 75 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Committee na ho tab bhi aap SHe-Box par ya kisi bhi police station mein complaint kar sakti hain: BNS ke Section 75 ke tahat sexual harassment crime hai.

actions.en: Call 181 (Women Helpline) for guidance, or 112 in an emergency.
actions.hg: Guidance ke liye 181 (Women Helpline) par call kijiye, aur emergency mein 112 par.

title.en: Harassed at work as a man or a transgender person? What India's 'Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace' Act leaves out, answered
title.hg: Aadmi ya transgender hote hue kaam par harass hue? India ka 'Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace' Act kya chhod deta hai, seedhe jawab

dek.en: India's workplace harassment law hears complaints only from women, and the criminal offences of sexual harassment and stalking can, by their wording, be committed only by a man. Straight answers on what a harassed man or transgender worker can actually use today, and what would close the gap.
dek.hg: India ka workplace harassment law sirf aurton ki complaint sunta hai, aur sexual harassment aur stalking ke criminal offences, apne shabdon ke hisaab se, sirf ek aadmi hi kar sakta hai. Seedhe jawab ki harass hua aadmi ya transgender worker aaj asal mein kya istemaal kar sakta hai, aur ye gap kaise band hoga.

statLabel.en: punishment for sexual abuse of a transgender person under Section 18 of the Transgender Persons Act
statLabel.hg: ki saza hai transgender person ke sexual abuse ke liye, Transgender Persons Act ke Section 18 ke tahat

label.en: prison term for sexual abuse of a transgender person, a range the 2026 amendment left unchanged
label.hg: ki jail hai transgender person ke sexual abuse ke liye; 2026 ke amendment ne ye range nahi badli

label.en: for sexual harassment under Section 75 of the BNS, an offence that by its wording only a man can commit
label.hg: BNS ke Section 75 mein sexual harassment ke liye, ek aisa offence jo apne shabdon ke hisaab se sirf aadmi kar sakta hai

label.en: states and union territories that had set up a Transgender Protection Cell by November 2025
label.hg: states aur union territories ne November 2025 tak Transgender Protection Cell banaya tha

label.en: the day the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act came into force
label.hg: is din Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act laagu hua

claim.en: Sexual harassment at work happens only to women, so the law needs to cover only women.
claim.hg: Kaam ki jagah par sexual harassment sirf aurton ke saath hota hai, isliye law ko sirf aurton ko cover karna hai.

truth.en: The POSH Act hears complaints only from an 'aggrieved woman', and the BNS offences of sexual harassment and stalking can be committed only by a man. That is a limit in the law's wording, not proof that men and transgender workers are never harassed.
truth.hg: POSH Act sirf 'aggrieved woman' ki complaint sunta hai, aur BNS mein sexual harassment aur stalking ke offences sirf ek aadmi kar sakta hai. Ye law ke shabdon ki seema hai, is baat ka saboot nahi ki aadmi aur transgender workers kabhi harass nahi hote.

actions.en: Write down each incident the day it happens: date, place, exact words, witnesses. Save messages and emails outside office devices.
actions.hg: Har incident usi din likh lijiye: date, jagah, exact shabd, gawah. Messages aur emails office ke devices se bahar save kariye.

actions.en: Ask HR in writing whether the harassment policy covers employees of every gender, and who hears such complaints.
actions.hg: HR se likh kar poochiye ki harassment policy har gender ke employees ko cover karti hai ya nahi, aur aisi complaints kaun sunta hai.

actions.en: If you are transgender, ask your employer in writing who handles harassment complaints from transgender staff, and keep the reply.
actions.hg: Agar aap transgender hain, toh employer se likh kar poochiye ki transgender staff ki harassment complaints kaun sunta hai, aur jawab sambhal kar rakhiye.

actions.en: For assault, threats or being followed, go to any police station; free legal aid is available on the NALSA helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Maar-peet, dhamki ya peecha kiye jaane par kisi bhi police station jaaiye; NALSA helpline 15100 par free legal aid milti hai.

actions.en: If it is affecting your sleep, work or mood, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar iska asar aapki neend, kaam ya mood par pad raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kariye, free aur chaubees ghante.

title.en: 0.2% of aid for prevention: what the evidence says stops sexual violence before it starts, and why so little money goes there
title.hg: Prevention ke liye aid ka sirf 0.2%: evidence kya kehta hai ki sexual violence ko shuru hone se pehle kya rokta hai, aur wahan itna kam paisa kyun jaata hai

dek.en: Cameras, crisis centres and fast-track courts mostly act at or after the moment someone is hurt. The evidence on stopping violence earlier points to classrooms and homes. Here is what it shows, where it is thin, and what a prevention budget in India would buy.
dek.hg: Cameras, crisis centres aur fast-track courts zyada tar tab kaam karte hain jab kisi ko chot pahunch rahi hoti hai ya pahunch chuki hoti hai. Violence ko pehle rokne ka evidence classroom aur ghar ki taraf ishara karta hai. Yahan dekho ki evidence kya dikhata hai, kahan kamzor hai, aur India mein ek prevention budget se asal mein kya khareeda ja sakta hai.

statLabel.en: of global development aid went to programmes preventing violence against women in 2022 (WHO)
statLabel.hg: global development aid ka itna hi hissa 2022 mein women ke khilaf violence rokne wale programmes ko mila (WHO)

label.en: of global development aid went to programmes preventing violence against women in 2022 (WHO)
label.hg: global development aid ka itna hi hissa 2022 mein women ke khilaf violence rokne wale programmes ko mila (WHO)

label.en: average decline in partner violence against women over the past 20 years (WHO)
label.hg: yaani saal ka sirf 0.2%: pichhle 20 saal mein women par partner violence itni hi average raftaar se ghata (WHO)

label.en: of Nirbhaya Fund releases went to Safe City projects, One Stop Centres and fast-track courts (Rajya Sabha reply, July 2026)
label.hg: Nirbhaya Fund ke release hue paise ka hissa jo Safe City projects, One Stop Centres aur fast-track courts ko gaya (Rajya Sabha reply, July 2026)

label.en: more likely to be violent to a partner: Indian men who faced frequent discrimination as children (seven-state study, 2014)
label.hg: yaani chaar guna zyada chance partner par violence karne ka, un Indian men mein jinhone bachpan mein baar-baar discrimination jhela (saat states ki study, 2014)

claim.en: The only way to stop sexual violence is more cameras, more police and harsher punishment.
claim.hg: Sexual violence rokne ka ek hi tareeka hai: aur cameras, aur police, aur sakht saza.

truth.en: Those mostly act at or after the moment of violence. The evidence on stopping it earlier points to what children are taught at school and what boys see and experience at home, and that work gets almost no money.
truth.hg: Yeh sab zyada tar violence ke waqt ya uske baad kaam karte hain. Use pehle rokne ka evidence is taraf ishara karta hai ki bachchon ko school mein kya sikhaya jaata hai aur ladke ghar par kya dekhte aur jhelte hain, aur is kaam ko lagbhag koi paisa nahi milta.

actions.en: Ask your school which two teachers run the weekly health and wellness hour, and whether gender equality and safety from violence were taught this term.
actions.hg: Apne school se poocho ki hafte ka health and wellness wala ghanta kaun se do teachers lete hain, aur is term mein gender equality aur violence se safety padhayi gayi ya nahi.

actions.en: Fathers, brothers and uncles: do housework where children can see it. In a seven-state Indian study, sons of such fathers were twice as likely to hold equal views.
actions.hg: Papa, bhai aur chacha-mama: ghar ka kaam wahan karo jahan bachche dekh sakein. Saat Indian states ki study mein aise papa ke beton ke barabari wali soch rakhne ke chances do guna the.

actions.en: Treat children fairly at home. The same study found men who faced frequent discrimination as children were four times more likely to be violent to partners.
actions.hg: Ghar mein bachchon ke saath barabari ka bartaav karo. Usi study ke mutabik jin men ne bachpan mein baar-baar discrimination jhela, unke partner par violence karne ke chances chaar guna the.

actions.en: Ask your MLA, MP or councillor how much of the local women's-safety budget pays for prevention in schools and with men and boys, and how much for cameras.
actions.hg: Apne MLA, MP ya councillor se poocho ki local women's-safety budget ka kitna hissa schools mein aur men aur boys ke saath prevention par jaata hai, aur kitna cameras par.

actions.en: If you or someone you know is facing violence now, call 112 or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Agar tum ya tumhara koi jaanne wala abhi violence jhel raha hai, toh 112 ya Women Helpline 181 par call karo.

title.en: Sexual orientation and gender identity are among the topics sex education skips most. What that silence teaches queer Indian students
title.hg: Sexual orientation aur gender identity un topics mein hain jinhe sex education sabse zyada skip karti hai. Yeh chuppi queer Indian students ko kya sikhaati hai

dek.en: In a UNESCO survey of school curricula, these topics were among the least included, and India's education policy never uses the word 'sexual'. Here is what that silence teaches queer students, and what inclusive teaching sounds like.
dek.hg: UNESCO ke ek survey mein school curriculum mein yeh topics sabse kam shaamil mile, aur India ki education policy mein 'sexual' word ek baar bhi nahi aata. Padho, yeh chuppi queer students ko kya sikhaati hai, aur inclusive teaching kaisi sunai deti hai.

label.en: the Supreme Court recognised transgender people's right to self-identify their gender (NALSA)
label.hg: Supreme Court ne transgender logon ka apna gender khud identify karne ka haq maana (NALSA)

label.en: the Supreme Court decriminalised consensual sex between adults of the same sex (Navtej Singh Johar)
label.hg: Supreme Court ne do adults ke beech consent se bane same-sex relations ko decriminalise kiya (Navtej Singh Johar)

label.en: the National Medical Commission declared 'conversion therapy' professional misconduct for doctors
label.hg: National Medical Commission ne 'conversion therapy' ko doctors ke liye professional misconduct declare kiya

label.en: an amendment replaced self-identification with medical boards for transgender certificates
label.hg: ek amendment ne transgender certificate ke liye self-identification ki jagah medical boards la diye

claim.en: Being gay or transgender is an illness that the right treatment can fix.
claim.hg: Gay ya transgender hona ek bimaari hai jo sahi treatment se theek ho sakti hai.

truth.en: Being LGBTQIA+ is not an illness. Since 2022, India's National Medical Commission has treated 'conversion therapy' by doctors as professional misconduct.
truth.hg: LGBTQIA+ hona bimaari nahi hai. 2022 se India ka National Medical Commission doctors ki 'conversion therapy' ko professional misconduct maanta hai.

actions.en: Teachers: include same-sex couples in your examples when you teach consent and relationships.
actions.hg: Teachers: consent aur relationships padhate waqt apne examples mein same-sex couples ko bhi shaamil karo.

actions.en: Stop slurs in classrooms and corridors the way you would stop any other abuse.
actions.hg: Class aur corridors mein slurs ko waise hi roko jaise kisi bhi aur abuse ko rokte ho.

actions.en: If a doctor offers to 'cure' a student's sexual orientation or gender identity, report it to the state medical council.
actions.hg: Agar koi doctor kisi student ka sexual orientation ya gender identity 'theek' karne ki baat kare, toh state medical council mein complaint karo.

actions.en: Students: if you feel alone, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 for free counselling, 24x7.
actions.hg: Students: agar akela feel ho, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo; yahan 24x7 free counselling milti hai.

actions.en: College students: ask how your institution is sensitising staff and students on gender identity, as NEP 2020 asks it to.
actions.hg: College students: poocho ki tumhara college NEP 2020 ke kehne ke hisaab se staff aur students ko gender identity par kaise sensitise kar raha hai.

title.en: Covering a rape trial: what journalists and creators may publish, what they may not, and the risk of naming the accused
title.hg: Rape trial cover kar rahe hain? Journalists aur creators kya publish kar sakte hain, kya nahi, aur accused ka naam lene ka risk

dek.en: Rape and POCSO trials happen behind closed doors, and publishing what goes on inside without the court's permission is a crime. Serious coverage is still possible. Five questions that reporters, YouTubers and Instagram pages ask, answered with the law and the court record.
dek.hg: Rape aur POCSO trials band kamre mein hote hain, aur court ki permission ke bina andar ki baat publish karna crime hai. Phir bhi serious coverage possible hai. Reporters, YouTubers aur Instagram pages jo paanch sawaal poochte hain, unke jawab law aur court record se.

statLabel.en: years in prison, at most, for publishing rape-case court proceedings without the court's permission (Section 73 BNS)
statLabel.hg: saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai agar aap court ki permission ke bina rape case ki court proceedings publish karein (Section 73 BNS)

label.en: the year India began requiring rape trials to be held in camera, behind closed doors (25 December)
label.hg: woh saal jab India mein rape trials ko in camera, yaani band kamre mein, karna zaroori hua (25 December)

label.en: of rape trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction (5,032 of 20,587)
label.hg: rape trials mein conviction hua, unme se jinka faisla 2024 mein aaya (20,587 mein se 5,032)

label.en: rape cases were still waiting for trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases 2024 ke end tak trial ke intezaar mein the

claim.en: If a case is already all over social media, reposting the survivor's details breaks no law.
claim.hg: Agar case pehle se social media par har jagah hai, toh survivor ki details repost karne se koi law nahi tootta.

truth.en: The Supreme Court's 2018 direction says 'no person' may publish a survivor's name or identifying details, and it names social media. Nothing in the law exempts details that are already circulating.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ka 2018 ka direction kehta hai ki 'no person', yaani koi bhi insaan, survivor ka naam ya uski pehchaan batane wali details publish nahi kar sakta, aur isme social media ka naam saaf likha hai. Jo details pehle se ghoom rahi hain, unke liye law mein koi chhoot nahi hai.

actions.en: Don't quote or describe what was said inside a closed rape or POCSO hearing unless the court has allowed it.
actions.hg: Band kamre wali rape ya POCSO hearing mein jo kaha gaya, use court ki permission ke bina quote ya describe mat kijiye.

actions.en: Write 'accused' until a court convicts; when it does, name the court and the date, and check for an appeal.
actions.hg: Jab tak court convict na kare, 'accused' likhiye; conviction ho toh court ka naam aur date likhiye, aur appeal check kijiye.

actions.en: Leave out the accused's name if he is a relative, neighbour or employer whose name would point to the survivor.
actions.hg: Agar accused rishtedaar, padosi ya employer hai aur uska naam survivor ki taraf ishaara karta hai, toh uska naam mat chhapiye.

actions.en: Cover the system: police deadlines, trial delays and pending cases, not the survivor's life.
actions.hg: System ko cover kijiye: police deadlines, trial delays aur pending cases. Survivor ki zindagi nahi.

actions.en: Before you name anyone in a sexual-violence or harassment allegation, keep your evidence and take legal advice.
actions.hg: Kisi sexual-violence ya harassment allegation mein kisi ka naam lene se pehle apna evidence sambhal kar rakhiye aur legal advice lijiye.

title.en: Two teachers, 11 themes, an hour a week for 24 weeks: what India's School Health and Wellness Programme and RKSK promise teenagers
title.hg: Do teachers, 11 themes, 24 hafte tak har hafte ek ghanta: School Health and Wellness Programme aur RKSK teenagers se kya promise karte hain

dek.en: A weekly school health hour, teenage peer educators and adolescent health centres are the state's main answers to a teenager's questions about health. What they are designed to do, who delivers them, what they cannot do, and how to find out what your school actually runs.
dek.hg: India mein teenagers ko body, relationships, violence aur madad kahan milegi, yeh sikhane ke yahi main sarkari raaste hain. Yeh kis liye bane hain, inhe kaun chalata hai, yeh kya nahi kar sakte, aur tumhare school mein asal mein kya chalta hai, yeh kaise pata karo.

statLabel.en: health themes, in one-hour weekly sessions for 24 weeks a year, to be taught by two trained teachers in every government and aided school (2020 curriculum)
statLabel.hg: health themes, saal mein 24 hafte, har hafte ek ghante ke sessions mein, jo har government aur aided school mein do trained teachers padhayenge (2020 curriculum)

label.en: teachers per government or aided school, preferably a man and a woman, to be trained as Health and Wellness Ambassadors
label.hg: teachers har government ya aided school mein, ho sake toh ek male aur ek female, jinhe Health and Wellness Ambassador ki training milni hai

label.en: adolescents RKSK set out to reach when it launched on 7 January 2014: a target, not a count of those reached
label.hg: yaani 25.3 crore adolescents tak pahunchne ke target ke saath 7 January 2014 ko RKSK shuru hua; yeh target hai, reach ki ginti nahi

label.en: Saathiya peer educators, two boys and two girls, to be chosen for every village or 1,000 people
label.hg: Saathiya peer educators, do ladke aur do ladkiyan, har gaon ya 1,000 ki aabadi par chune jaane hain

label.en: adolescents used Adolescent Friendly Health Centre services in 2024-25, by the Health Ministry's count, which may include repeat visits
label.hg: adolescents ne 2024-25 mein Adolescent Friendly Health Centre ki services li, Health Ministry ki ginti ke mutabik; isme repeat visits bhi ho sakti hain

claim.en: Every school in India has to teach sex education.
claim.hg: India ke har school ko sex education padhani hi padti hai.

truth.en: No. The 2020 School Health and Wellness Programme is meant for government and aided schools only, and UNESCO notes that sexuality education in India is left to the states.
truth.hg: Nahi. 2020 ka School Health and Wellness Programme sirf government aur aided schools ke liye hai, aur UNESCO ke mutabik India mein sexuality education states par chhodi gayi hai.

actions.en: Ask your principal who the school's two Health and Wellness Ambassadors are, and when the weekly hour happens.
actions.hg: Principal se poocho ki school ke do Health and Wellness Ambassadors kaun hain, aur hafte ka woh ek ghanta kab hota hai.

actions.en: Ask for the list of themes covered this term, and whether body changes, consent, violence and where to get help are on it.
actions.hg: Is term mein cover hue themes ki list maango, aur dekho ki usme body changes, consent, violence aur madad kahan milegi, yeh sab hai ya nahi.

actions.en: Ask an ASHA worker or your nearest primary health centre where the Adolescent Friendly Health Centre is and when it is open.
actions.hg: ASHA worker ya paas ke primary health centre se poocho ki Adolescent Friendly Health Centre kahan hai aur kab khulta hai.

actions.en: If a teenager tells you about sexual abuse, believe them and call the Child Helpline on 1098. For stress or low mood, Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free and round the clock.
actions.hg: Agar koi teenager sexual abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uski baat par bharosa karo aur Child Helpline 1098 par call karo. Stress ya low mood ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai aur 24 ghante chalta hai.

title.en: 'Will it spoil them? Isn't it against our culture?' Parents' questions about sex education, answered with evidence
title.hg: 'Bachche bigad toh nahi jayenge? Yeh hamari culture ke khilaf toh nahi?' Sex education par parents ke sawaal, evidence ke saath jawab

dek.en: Parents, teachers and religious leaders hold the keys to sex education in India. Their worries deserve straight answers, not ridicule. Here are five of them, answered with the best evidence available.
dek.hg: India mein sex education ki chaabi parents, teachers aur dharm-guruon ke haath mein hai. Unki chintaon ka mazaak nahi, seedha jawab banta hai. Yahan aise paanch sawaal hain, aur sabse bharosemand evidence ke saath unke jawab.

statLabel.en: of Indian adolescent girls had been told about periods before their first one (2016 meta-analysis)
statLabel.hg: Indian teenage ladkiyon ko pehla period aane se pehle uske baare mein bataya gaya tha (2016 meta-analysis)

label.en: of adolescent girls in India had been told about periods before their first one (88 studies, 2016)
label.hg: India ki teenage ladkiyon ko pehla period aane se pehle uske baare mein bataya gaya tha (88 studies, 2016)

label.en: the ages at which reported sexual abuse peaked in the government's 2007 study; it began as early as 5
label.hg: saal ki umar mein sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein report hua sexual abuse sabse zyada tha; yeh 5 saal ki umar se hi shuru ho jaata tha

label.en: of young adults sexually assaulted in childhood had ever told anyone (2007 study)
label.hg: young adults ne hi kabhi kisi ko bataya, jinke saath bachpan mein sexual assault hua tha (2007 study)

claim.en: Children are too young for any of this until they reach their teens.
claim.hg: Bachche abhi chhote hain. Yeh sab teenage mein bata denge.

truth.en: Abuse reported in the government's 2007 study began as early as age 5. For young children, sexuality education means body names, feelings and safety, not sex.
truth.hg: Sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein bachchon ne jo sexual abuse report kiya, woh 5 saal ki umar se hi shuru ho jaata tha. Chhote bachchon ke liye sexuality education ka matlab hai body parts ke naam, feelings aur safety, sex nahi.

actions.en: Use the correct names for body parts from the start, and tell your child that no adult may ask them to keep a secret about their body.
actions.hg: Shuru se hi body parts ke sahi naam sikhaiye, aur bachche ko bataiye ki koi bhi bada unse unki body se judi baat chhupane ko nahi keh sakta.

actions.en: Talk about periods and wet dreams before puberty, with daughters and sons alike.
actions.hg: Periods aur nightfall ki baat puberty se pehle kijiye, betiyon aur beton dono se.

actions.en: Ask the school what its health sessions cover, and back them up at home instead of opting your child out.
actions.hg: School se poochiye ki health sessions mein kya padhaya jaata hai, aur bachche ko class se hatane ki jagah ghar par wahi baat aage badhaiye.

actions.en: When you do not know an answer, say "let's find out together" and use a trusted source.
actions.hg: Jab kisi sawaal ka jawab na pata ho, toh kahiye 'chalo, saath mein pata karte hain', aur kisi bharosemand source se jaankari lijiye.

actions.en: If a child tells you about abuse, believe them, stay calm and call the Child Helpline on 1098.
actions.hg: Agar bachcha abuse ke baare mein bataye, toh uski baat par yakeen kijiye, shaant rahiye aur Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

title.en: 85% of 155 countries report a sexuality-education policy. India leaves it to the states, and UNESCO found just one state programme at scale
title.hg: 155 mein se 85% desh kehte hain ki unke paas sex education ki policy hai. India ne ise states par chhod diya, aur UNESCO ko bade scale par bas ek state ka programme mila

dek.en: UNESCO's global review shows that most countries report a policy on paper, but curricula often skip the hardest topics. In India the subject is left to the states, and UNESCO could name just one state-run programme at scale: Jharkhand's Udaan.
dek.hg: UNESCO ki global report dikhati hai ki zyada tar desh kaagaz par policy hone ki baat kehte hain, par syllabus aksar sabse mushkil topics chhod dete hain. India mein yeh faisla states ka hai, aur UNESCO ko bade scale par chalta sirf ek sarkari programme mila: Jharkhand ka Udaan.

statLabel.en: of 155 countries with data report a policy or law on sexuality education (UNESCO, 2021)
statLabel.hg: deshon mein sexuality education se judi policy ya law hai (jin 155 deshon ka data mila, UNESCO 2021)

label.en: of 155 countries with data report a policy or law related to sexuality education (2021)
label.hg: deshon mein sexuality education se judi policy ya law hai (data wale 155 deshon mein se, 2021)

label.en: state-run sexuality-education programme UNESCO found working at scale in India: Jharkhand's Udaan
label.hg: state-run sex education programme jo UNESCO ko India mein bade scale par chalta mila: Jharkhand ka Udaan

label.en: of young women aged 15-24 in Bihar had comprehensive knowledge of HIV in 2019-21, against 69% in Mizoram
label.hg: Bihar ki 15-24 saal ki young women ko 2019-21 mein HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi, jabki Mizoram mein 69% ko

claim.en: If a country has a sex-education policy, its children are being taught about sex and relationships.
claim.hg: Agar kisi desh mein sex education ki policy hai, toh wahan bachchon ko sex aur rishton ke baare mein padhaya ja raha hai.

truth.en: UNESCO found that 85% of countries report a policy. But in the 24 sub-Saharan African countries whose curricula it reviewed, only a little more than a quarter had advanced or established content on sexuality and sexual behaviour.
truth.hg: UNESCO ke mutabik 85% deshon mein policy hai. Lekin jin 24 sub-Saharan African deshon ke curriculum review hue, unmein se sirf ek-chauthai se thode zyada mein sexuality aur sexual behaviour par advanced ya established content tha.

actions.en: Ask your school what its adolescence or health-and-wellness sessions actually cover, who teaches them and how often.
actions.hg: Apne school se poocho ki adolescence ya health-and-wellness sessions mein asal mein kya padhaya jaata hai, kaun padhata hai aur kitni baar.

actions.en: In a government or aided school, ask who the trained Health and Wellness Ambassadors are and whether consent and online safety are part of their sessions.
actions.hg: Government ya aided school mein poocho ki trained Health and Wellness Ambassadors kaun hain, aur kya unke sessions mein consent aur online safety ki baat hoti hai.

actions.en: Raise the topics curricula often skip: consent, online safety, the abortion law, and sexual orientation and gender identity.
actions.hg: Un topics ki maang karo jo syllabus aksar chhod deta hai: consent, online safety, abortion ka law, aur sexual orientation aur gender identity.

actions.en: Write to your state education department: in India this subject is decided by the states, so that is where pressure counts.
actions.hg: Apne state ke education department ko likho. India mein yeh faisla states karte hain, isliye pressure wahin kaam karta hai.

title.en: About one in three of India's 'missing' girls is lost after birth: son preference beyond the ultrasound
title.hg: India ki 'missing' ladkiyon mein se lagbhag har teesri janm ke baad khoti hai: ultrasound ke aage ka son preference

dek.en: The debate about son preference usually stops at the scan. UNFPA's estimates do not: about a third of India's missing girls were born and then lost. The same preference follows a daughter to her wedding, in the dowry asked for her and the age at which she is married.
dek.hg: Son preference ki bahas aksar scan par ruk jaati hai. UNFPA ke estimates nahi rukte: India ki lagbhag ek tihaai missing ladkiyan paida hui thi, aur phir kho gayi. Wahi soch beti ke saath uski shaadi tak chalti hai, uske liye maange gaye dowry mein aur us umar mein jis par uski shaadi kar di jaati hai.

statLabel.en: of India's missing girls are explained by excess deaths after birth, not sex selection (UNFPA, 2020)
statLabel.hg: yaani India ki lagbhag ek tihaai missing ladkiyon ki wajah sex selection nahi, janm ke baad hui zyada mautein hain (UNFPA, 2020)

label.en: of women, and 76% of men, said having at least one son was very important (seven-state survey, 2014)
label.hg: women ne, aur 76% men ne, kaha ki kam se kam ek beta hona bahut zaroori hai (saat states ka survey, 2014)

label.en: girls a year, roughly, went 'missing' at birth in India in 2013-2017; deaths after birth are a separate loss (UNFPA estimate)
label.hg: ladkiyan, lagbhag, 2013-2017 ke beech har saal India mein janm par 'missing' rahi; janm ke baad ki mautein alag nuksan hain (UNFPA estimate)

label.en: of women aged 20-24 had been married before 18 in 2023-24 (NFHS-6, provisional)
label.hg: 20-24 saal ki women ki shaadi 18 se pehle ho chuki thi, 2023-24 mein (NFHS-6, provisional)

label.en: dowry-death cases registered in 2024, with 5,811 victims, about 16 a day (NCRB)
label.hg: dowry-death cases 2024 mein register hue, 5,811 victims ke saath, yaani roz lagbhag 16 (NCRB)

claim.en: Son preference is a problem of ultrasound clinics. Once a girl is born, she is safe from it.
claim.hg: Son preference sirf ultrasound clinics ki problem hai. Ladki ek baar paida ho gayi toh woh isse safe hai.

truth.en: UNFPA attributes about one third of India's missing girls to deaths after birth, not to sex selection. The same preference shows up later in dowry and in how early a daughter is married.
truth.hg: UNFPA ke mutabik India ki lagbhag ek tihaai missing ladkiyon ki wajah sex selection nahi, janm ke baad ki mautein hain. Wahi soch aage dowry mein dikhti hai, aur is baat mein ki beti ki shaadi kitni jaldi kar di jaati hai.

actions.en: Treat a daughter's illness, food and vaccinations exactly as you would a son's: same doctor, same day, same spending.
actions.hg: Beti ki bimari, khana aur vaccination bilkul waise hi dekho jaise bete ka: wahi doctor, usi din, utna hi kharcha.

actions.en: Refuse to give or take dowry, and say so before a match is fixed. Both are crimes under the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
actions.hg: Dowry na do, na lo, aur yeh baat rishta pakka hone se pehle hi saaf keh do. Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 ke tahat dena aur lena dono crime hain.

actions.en: If a girl under 18 or a boy under 21 is about to be married, call the Child Helpline 1098 or 112.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ki ladki ya 21 se kam umar ke ladke ki shaadi hone wali hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 ya 112 par call karo.

actions.en: Fathers and brothers: do a fair share of the housework where the children can see it.
actions.hg: Papa aur bhaiyon ke liye: ghar ka kaam barabar baanto, aur aise karo ki bachche dekh sakein.

actions.en: If you are being harassed for dowry or blamed for having daughters, call the Women Helpline 181, or 112 if you are in danger.
actions.hg: Agar tumhe dowry ke liye pareshan kiya ja raha hai ya betiyan hone par blame kiya ja raha hai, toh Women Helpline 181 par call karo, aur khatra ho toh 112 par.

title.en: 16 of 30 national sports federations checked in 2023 broke the POSH Act. Wrestling had no harassment committee at all
title.hg: 2023 mein check kiye gaye 30 mein se 16 national sports federations POSH Act tod rahe the. Wrestling mein harassment committee thi hi nahi

dek.en: The law names stadiums, sports institutes and competition venues as workplaces. An Indian Express investigation found more than half the federations it reviewed had no lawful committee to hear a sexual harassment complaint. In sport, where one coach can end a career, that gap leaves an athlete with nowhere safe to turn.
dek.hg: Law stadiums, sports institutes aur competition venues ko naam lekar workplace kehta hai. Indian Express ki investigation mein paaya gaya ki review kiye gaye federations mein se aadhe se zyada ke paas sexual harassment ki complaint sunne wali koi lawful committee nahi thi. Sport mein, jahan ek coach career khatam kar sakta hai, is gap ka matlab hai ki athlete ke paas jaane ki koi surakshit jagah nahi bachti.

statLabel.en: national sports federations reviewed did not comply with the POSH Act (Indian Express, May 2023)
statLabel.hg: review kiye gaye national sports federations POSH Act ka paalan nahi kar rahe the (Indian Express, May 2023)

label.en: national sports federations reviewed did not comply with the POSH Act (May 2023)
label.hg: review kiye gaye national sports federations POSH Act ka paalan nahi kar rahe the (May 2023)

label.en: federations, including wrestling, had no Internal Complaints Committee at all
label.hg: federations, wrestling samet, jinke paas Internal Complaints Committee thi hi nahi

label.en: federations had a committee with no external member, the one person outside the hierarchy
label.hg: federations jinki committee mein external member nahi tha, yaani woh ek insaan jo hierarchy ke bahar ka hota hai

label.en: maximum fine for an employer that does not set up a committee
label.hg: maximum fine us employer par jo committee nahi banata

claim.en: The POSH Act is for offices. A stadium, an academy or a training camp is not a 'workplace'.
claim.hg: POSH Act offices ke liye hai. Stadium, academy ya training camp 'workplace' nahi hai.

truth.en: The Act's definition of workplace names sports institutes, stadiums, sports complexes and competition venues, and it protects a woman 'of any age whether employed or not'.
truth.hg: Act ki workplace ki definition mein sports institutes, stadiums, sports complexes aur competition venues ka naam hai, aur yeh 'of any age whether employed or not' aurat ko protect karta hai, yaani kisi bhi umr ki, chahe woh employed ho ya nahi.

actions.en: Before joining an academy or camp, ask in writing who is on its Internal Committee, including the woman who heads it and the external member.
actions.hg: Academy ya camp join karne se pehle likhit mein poochhiye ki uski Internal Committee mein kaun-kaun hai, head karne wali woman aur external member samet.

actions.en: Ask how an athlete can complain without going through her own coach, and save that phone number or email.
actions.hg: Poochhiye ki athlete apne hi coach ke through gaye bina complaint kaise kar sakti hai, aur woh phone number ya email save kar lijiye.

actions.en: If the athlete is under 18, any sexual act with her or him is a crime under POCSO, and every adult who knows must report it. Call 1098 (Child Helpline) or 112.
actions.hg: Agar athlete ki umr 18 se kam hai, toh uske saath koi bhi sexual act POCSO ke tahat crime hai, aur jis bhi adult ko pata ho use report karna hi hoga. 1098 (Child Helpline) ya 112 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If there is no committee, complain on SHe-Box or at any police station: sexual harassment is a crime under Section 75 of the BNS. Women Helpline: 181.
actions.hg: Committee na ho toh SHe-Box par ya kisi bhi police station mein complaint kijiye: BNS ke Section 75 ke tahat sexual harassment crime hai. Women Helpline: 181.

actions.en: If you coach or run an academy, set up a lawful committee with an external member and tell every athlete and parent how to reach it.
actions.hg: Agar aap coach hain ya academy chalate hain, toh external member wali lawful committee banaiye aur har athlete aur parent ko bataiye ki us tak kaise pahunchein.

title.en: 549 on Odisha's streets, none in its offices: what India's first count of street harassment reveals about what gets counted
title.hg: Odisha ki sadkon par 549, uske offices mein zero: street harassment ki India ki pehli ginti kya batati hai ki kya gina jaata hai

dek.en: A new row in NCRB's 2024 tables counted 1,469 cases of sexual harassment at public places in six months, and more than a third came from one state. Here is how to read a brand-new crime number without being fooled by it.
dek.hg: NCRB ki 2024 ki tables mein ek nayi row aayi, jisne chhe mahine mein public places par sexual harassment ke 1,469 case gine, aur inmein se ek-tihaai se zyada ek hi state ke the. Ek bilkul naye crime number ko dhokha khaaye bina kaise padhein, yeh samajhiye.

statLabel.en: cases of sexual harassment at public places in July-December 2024, the first count under the BNS
statLabel.hg: July-December 2024 mein public places par sexual harassment ke case, BNS ke tahat pehli ginti

label.en: cases of sexual harassment at public places or pathways registered in India, July-December 2024
label.hg: July-December 2024 mein India mein public places ya raaston par sexual harassment ke darj case

label.en: of them registered in Odisha; Uttar Pradesh: 184, Tamil Nadu: 136
label.hg: inmein se itne Odisha mein darj hue; Uttar Pradesh: 184, Tamil Nadu: 136

label.en: of 2024's 15,609 sexual harassment cases were filed under 'other places'
label.hg: 2024 ke 15,609 sexual harassment cases mein se itne 'other places' ke neeche daale gaye

label.en: conviction rate in Odisha's completed crime-against-women trials in 2024; India: 25.7%
label.hg: 2024 mein Odisha ke poore hue crime-against-women trials mein conviction rate; India: 25.7%

claim.en: Odisha registered the most street harassment cases, so its streets must be India's worst.
claim.hg: Street harassment ke sabse zyada case Odisha mein darj hue, toh uski sadkein hi India mein sabse buri hongi.

truth.en: The count shows where police wrote complaints under a new heading in its first six months. NCRB itself says a rise in registration and a rise in crime are two different things.
truth.hg: Yeh ginti bas itna dikhati hai ki pehle chhe mahinon mein police ne ek naye heading ke neeche complaints kahan likhi. NCRB khud kehta hai ki registration ka badhna aur crime ka badhna do alag cheezein hain.

actions.en: Before you share a new crime number, check three things: how many months it covers, which law it counts, and how much was filed under 'other'.
actions.hg: Koi naya crime number share karne se pehle teen cheezein check kijiye: woh kitne mahine cover karta hai, kis kaanoon ke case ginta hai, aur kitna hissa 'other' mein daala gaya hai.

actions.en: Harassed on a street, at a bus stop or in a market? It is an offence under the BNS. You can give your complaint at any police station, not only the nearest one, and the FIR copy is free.
actions.hg: Sadak par, bus stop par ya market mein harassment hua? Yeh BNS ke tahat offence hai. Aap kisi bhi police station mein complaint de sakte hain, sirf sabse paas wale mein nahi, aur FIR ki copy free milti hai.

actions.en: Ask for a woman officer to record your complaint. The BNSS requires it for a woman's complaint of sexual harassment.
actions.hg: Kahiye ki aapki complaint koi mahila officer record kare. Aurat ki sexual harassment ki complaint ke liye BNSS yahi kehta hai.

actions.en: In an emergency call 112. For support and referrals, call the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Emergency mein 112 par call kijiye. Support aur referral ke liye Women Helpline 181 par call kijiye.

actions.en: If your state shows zero in a harassment table, ask your police how such complaints are being filed.
actions.hg: Agar aapke state ki harassment table mein zero dikh raha hai, toh apni police se poochhiye ki aisi complaints kis heading mein daali ja rahi hain.

title.en: 'Why didn't she speak up earlier?' What Indian courts, the Supreme Court and the Hema Committee have said about silence
title.hg: 'Usne pehle kyun nahi bola?' Indian courts, Supreme Court aur Hema Committee ne chuppi ke baare mein kya kaha hai

dek.en: It is the question survivors who speak late hear again and again, and it is asked as if nobody knew the answer. Indian institutions have answered it on the record, more than once. Four questions people actually ask, and what the record shows for each.
dek.hg: Der se bolne wale survivors se ye sawaal baar-baar poocha jaata hai, aur aise poocha jaata hai jaise iska jawab kisi ko pata hi na ho. Indian institutions iska jawab record par de chuke hain, ek se zyada baar. Chaar sawaal jo log sach mein poochte hain, aur har ek par record kya dikhata hai.

statLabel.en: of sexually assaulted children in the government's 2007 study had told no one
statLabel.hg: sexually assault hue bachchon ne, sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein, kisi ko nahi bataya tha

label.en: of sexually assaulted children in the government's 2007 study had told no one
label.hg: sexually assault hue bachchon ne, sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein, kisi ko nahi bataya tha

label.en: of those children had reported the assault to the police
label.hg: un bachchon ne hi assault ki report police mein ki thi

label.en: of women who had faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: auraton ne, jinhone physical ya sexual violence jheli thi, kabhi madad nahi maangi aur kisi ko bataya nahi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of rape cases registered in India in 2024 in which the offender was known to the victim
label.hg: rape cases mein, jo 2024 mein India mein darj hue, offender victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

claim.en: If it had really happened, she would have said so at the time.
claim.hg: Agar sach mein hua hota, toh woh usi waqt bol deti.

truth.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook lists this belief as a stereotype. In the government's 2007 study, 72.1% of sexually assaulted children had told no one. Silence is the usual response, not the suspicious one.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook is soch ko stereotype maanti hai. Sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein sexually assault hue 72.1% bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha. Chuppi aam response hai, shak ki wajah nahi.

actions.en: Replace 'why didn't you tell anyone?' with 'I believe you' and 'what do you need now?'
actions.hg: 'Tumne kisi ko bataya kyun nahi?' ki jagah kahiye 'mujhe tum par yakeen hai' aur 'tumhe abhi kya chahiye?'

actions.en: Do not treat the years in between, or her messages to him, as proof of anything. The Supreme Court's handbook calls both beliefs stereotypes.
actions.hg: Beech ke saalon ko, ya us aadmi ko bheje gaye uske messages ko, kisi baat ka saboot mat maaniye. Supreme Court ki handbook in dono soch ko stereotype kehti hai.

actions.en: Being harassed at work now? Complain in writing to the Internal Committee within three months of the last incident; it can extend this by three more.
actions.hg: Abhi kaam ki jagah par harass ho rahe hain? Aakhri incident ke teen mahine ke andar Internal Committee ko written complaint dijiye; committee ye waqt teen mahine aur badha sakti hai.

actions.en: A police complaint can be given at any police station (Zero FIR), with a free copy of the FIR. Ask a lawyer before assuming it is too late.
actions.hg: Police complaint kisi bhi police station mein di ja sakti hai (Zero FIR), aur FIR ki free copy milti hai. 'Ab bahut der ho gayi' maan lene se pehle kisi lawyer se poochiye.

actions.en: If a child tells you, do not promise secrecy. Say you will stay with them, and call Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Koi bachcha aapko bataye toh raaz rakhne ka vaada mat kijiye. Kahiye ki aap uske saath rahenge, aur Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

title.en: A woman officer, magistrate and judge 'as far as practicable': how India's rape law depends on women the system may not have
title.hg: Woman officer, magistrate aur judge 'as far as practicable': India ka rape law un women par tika hai jo system ke paas shayad hon hi na

dek.en: India's criminal procedure law asks for a woman at almost every step of a sexual-offence case, from the FIR to the courtroom. Three of those four requests carry the same escape clause. What each one means for a survivor, and what to ask for when no woman is on duty.
dek.hg: India ka criminal procedure law sexual offence ke case mein FIR se courtroom tak lagbhag har step par ek woman maangta hai. In chaar mein se teen maangon ke saath ek hi escape clause juda hai. Survivor ke liye har clause ka matlab kya hai, aur jab duty par koi woman na ho toh kya maangna chahiye.

statLabel.en: of India's 14,658 police-station women help desks were headed by women officers in March 2025
statLabel.hg: India ke police stations ke 14,658 women help desks mein se itne ki head March 2025 mein women officers thi

label.en: women help desks set up in police stations by March 2025
label.hg: women help desks March 2025 tak police stations mein ban chuke the

label.en: rise in police reports of crimes against women after all-women police stations opened in Indian cities, with no change in killings of women
label.hg: badhotri women ke khilaaf crimes ki police reports mein, jab Indian cities mein all-women police stations khule; women ki hatya mein koi badlaav nahi

label.en: of women who faced violence and sought help went to the police; 61% turned to their own family (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: violence jhelne ke baad help maangne wali women mein se itni police ke paas gayi; 61% apni family ke paas gayi (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: rape cases pending trial at the end of 2024, every one of them meant to be heard in camera
label.hg: rape cases 2024 ke end mein trial ke intezaar mein the, aur har ek ki sunwai in camera honi hai

claim.en: A woman who reports rape has to go to the police station and tell her story to whoever is on duty.
claim.hg: Rape report karne wali woman ko police station jaana hi padta hai aur jo bhi duty par ho usi ko apni baat batani padti hai.

truth.en: Police cannot require a woman to come anywhere other than where she lives. Her complaint must be recorded by a woman officer, and her statement is to be taken at her home or a place she chooses.
truth.hg: Police kisi woman ko uske rehne ki jagah ke alawa kahin aur aane ke liye majboor nahi kar sakti. Uski complaint ek woman officer ko hi record karni hai, aur uska statement uske ghar par ya uski pasand ki jagah par liya jaana hai.

actions.en: At the station, ask for the women help desk and for a woman officer to record your complaint: for a woman reporting rape, sexual harassment, stalking, voyeurism or acid attack, the law requires it.
actions.hg: Station par women help desk ke baare mein poochiye aur maangiye ki aapki complaint woman officer record kare: rape, sexual harassment, stalking, voyeurism ya acid attack report karne wali woman ke liye law yeh zaroori karta hai.

actions.en: Ask for your statement to be recorded at home or at a place you choose, on video if you want, with someone you trust nearby.
actions.hg: Maangiye ki aapka statement ghar par ya aapki pasand ki jagah par record ho, chahein toh video par, aur koi bharose ka insaan paas mein rahe.

actions.en: If no woman magistrate is available to record your statement, ask that a woman be present in the room, as Section 183(6) BNSS requires.
actions.hg: Agar statement record karne ke liye woman magistrate available nahi hai, toh maangiye ki kamre mein ek woman maujood rahe, jaisa BNSS ki Section 183(6) kehti hai.

actions.en: Ask your lawyer or the public prosecutor to request a woman judge, and remember that the trial must be held in camera.
actions.hg: Apne lawyer ya public prosecutor se kahiye ki woh woman judge ki request karein, aur yaad rakhiye ki trial in camera hi hona hai.

actions.en: If police refuse to register a rape complaint, note the officer's name and the time: refusal is a crime under Section 199 BNS. Call 112, or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Agar police rape ki complaint register karne se mana kare, toh officer ka naam aur time note kijiye: mana karna BNS ki Section 199 ke tahat crime hai. 112 par call kijiye, ya Women Helpline 181 par.

title.en: 'CCTV will fix it', 'keep her at home', 'it's only eve teasing': five myths about women's safety in public, checked
title.hg: 'CCTV laga do, sab theek', 'ghar par rakho', 'bas eve teasing hai': public mein aurton ki safety ke paanch myths, data se check kiye gaye

dek.en: Safety advice in India tells women to stay in, and safety announcements promise cameras. The data on where harassment and violence happen, and on what actually stops women from moving, points somewhere else.
dek.hg: India mein safety ki salaah aurton ko ghar baithne ko kehti hai, aur safety ke elaan cameras ka vaada karte hain. Harassment aur violence asal mein kahan hoti hai, aur aurton ko bahar nikalne se asal mein kya rokta hai, is par data kisi aur taraf ishaara karta hai.

statLabel.en: of ever-married women aged 18-49 reported physical or sexual violence by a husband (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: 18-49 saal ki ever-married aurtein jinhone pati ki taraf se physical ya sexual violence report ki (NFHS-5)

label.en: of ever-married women aged 18-49 reported physical or sexual violence by a husband (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 18-49 saal ki ever-married aurtein jinhone pati ki taraf se physical ya sexual violence report ki (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of rape cases registered in India in 2024 had an offender known to the victim
label.hg: 2024 mein India mein darj rape cases jinmein offender victim ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: of households said unmarried girls were harassed in their neighbourhood in a 2005 survey; police records implied 0.06%
label.hg: households ne 2005 ke ek survey mein kaha ki unke mohalle mein unmarried ladkiyon ko harass kiya jaata hai; police records ke hisaab se yeh 0.06% tha

label.en: of non-working women in a 2019 Mumbai survey named unsafe commuting as a barrier to work; 19% named domestic duties
label.hg: 2019 ke Mumbai survey mein non-working aurtein jinhone unsafe commuting ko kaam mein rukaavat bataya; 19% ne ghar ke kaam ko bataya

claim.en: Women are safest at home, and cameras will take care of the street.
claim.hg: Aurtein ghar par sabse safe hain, aur sadak ko cameras sambhaal lenge.

truth.en: In NFHS-5, 29.3% of ever-married women reported violence by a husband. A camera can record a street; it cannot make a complaint get written down, and it does not look inside a home.
truth.hg: NFHS-5 mein 29.3% ever-married aurton ne pati ki violence report ki. Camera sadak ko record kar sakta hai; woh na kisi complaint ko likhwa sakta hai, na ghar ke andar dekh sakta hai.

actions.en: Say 'street sexual harassment', not 'eve teasing', at home, in class and in your WhatsApp groups. It is a crime under the BNS.
actions.hg: Ghar par, class mein aur apne WhatsApp groups mein 'eve teasing' nahi, 'street sexual harassment' kahiye. Yeh BNS ke tahat crime hai.

actions.en: If someone is harassed in front of you, stay close, ask if they are okay and offer to be a witness. Do not film them without asking.
actions.hg: Agar aapke saamne kisi ko harass kiya jaaye, toh unke paas rahiye, poochhiye ki woh theek hain ya nahi, aur gawaah banne ki peshkash kijiye. Bina poochhe unka video mat banaiye.

actions.en: Report harassment at any police station or call 112. A woman's complaint of sexual harassment must be recorded by a woman officer.
