actions.hg: Harassment ki report kisi bhi police station mein kijiye ya 112 par call kijiye. Aurat ki sexual harassment ki complaint mahila officer ko hi record karni hoti hai.

actions.en: At home, replace 'don't go out' with a plan: how she travels, who she can call, and what the family will do if she is harassed.
actions.hg: Ghar par 'bahar mat jao' ki jagah ek plan banaiye: woh kaise travel karegi, kise call kar sakti hai, aur harassment hone par parivaar kya karega.

actions.en: When your college, RWA or ward talks about safety, ask about buses, help desks and what was actually spent before asking for more cameras.
actions.hg: Jab aapka college, RWA ya ward safety ki baat kare, toh aur cameras maangne se pehle buses, help desks aur asal mein kitna paisa kharch hua, iske baare mein poochhiye.

title.en: 41.7%, 28.0%, 2.0 points: women, work and harassment in India, by the numbers
title.hg: 41.7%, 28.0%, 2.0 points: India mein women, kaam aur harassment, numbers ki zubaani

dek.en: The share of Indian women in the labour force has risen every year since 2017-18. Much of that rise is rural and self-employed, far from any office or complaints committee. What the numbers say about where women work, where harassment law reaches them, and what the gap costs.
dek.hg: Labour force mein Indian women ka hissa 2017-18 se har saal badha hai. Is badhat ka bada hissa rural aur self-employed hai, kisi office ya complaints committee se bahut door. Numbers kya batate hain: women kahan kaam karti hain, harassment ka law un tak kahan pahunchta hai, aur is gap ki keemat kya hai.

statLabel.en: female labour force participation rate in 2023-24, up from 23.3% in 2017-18 (PLFS)
statLabel.hg: female labour force participation rate 2023-24 mein, jo 2017-18 mein 23.3% tha (PLFS)

label.en: of women aged 15 and above were in the labour force in 2023-24, up from 23.3% in 2017-18
label.hg: 15 saal aur usse upar ki women 2023-24 mein labour force mein thi; 2017-18 mein yeh 23.3% tha

label.en: of urban women were in the labour force in 2023-24
label.hg: urban women 2023-24 mein labour force mein thi

label.en: of employed rural women held a regular wage or salaried job in July-September 2025
label.hg: employed rural women ke paas July-September 2025 mein regular wage ya salaried job thi

label.en: ILO's 2017 estimate of how far abuse, harassment or discrimination lowers a woman's chance of joining the labour market in middle-income countries, the group that includes India
label.hg: ILO ka 2017 ka estimate: middle-income countries mein, jis group mein India hai, abuse, harassment ya discrimination ek woman ke labour market mein aane ka chance itna ghata deta hai

claim.en: More women are working than before, so workplaces must be getting safer for them.
claim.hg: Pehle se zyada women kaam kar rahi hain, toh workplaces unke liye zyada safe ho rahe honge.

truth.en: Much of the rise is rural self-employment: 73.5% of rural women workers were self-employed in 2023-24. In cities, where the offices, commutes and complaints committees are, only 28.0% of women were in the labour force.
truth.hg: Is badhat ka bada hissa rural self-employment hai: 2023-24 mein 73.5% rural women workers self-employed thi. Shehron mein, jahan offices, commutes aur complaints committees hain, sirf 28.0% women labour force mein thi.

actions.en: Read any 'more women are working' headline with two questions: rural or urban, salaried or self-employed?
actions.hg: 'Zyada women kaam kar rahi hain' wali har headline ko do sawaalon ke saath padho: rural ya urban, salaried ya self-employed?

actions.en: If you work in an office, shop, factory or someone's home, find out who your Internal Committee is, or where your district's Local Committee sits.
actions.hg: Agar tum office, shop, factory ya kisi ke ghar mein kaam karti ho, toh pata karo ki tumhari Internal Committee mein kaun hai, ya tumhare district ki Local Committee kahan baithti hai.

actions.en: If harassment is pushing you out of a job, write down dates and details before you resign; a written complaint is due within three months.
actions.hg: Agar harassment tumhe job se bahar dhakel raha hai, toh resign karne se pehle dates aur details likh lo; written complaint teen mahine ke andar deni hoti hai.

actions.en: If you employ ten or more people, set up an Internal Committee with an external member and tell every worker who is on it.
actions.hg: Agar tumhare yahan das ya zyada log kaam karte hain, toh external member ke saath Internal Committee banao aur har worker ko batao ki usmein kaun hai.

title.en: Running a session on bodies, consent and safety: a guide for peer educators, NSS volunteers and college clubs
title.hg: Body, consent aur safety par session kaise chalayein: peer educators, NSS volunteers aur college clubs ke liye guide

dek.en: When schools stay silent, young people end up teaching each other. This session plan turns the evidence into practice: ground rules, an anonymous question box, the topics curricula skip, the myths you will hear, and what to do if someone tells you about abuse.
dek.hg: Jab school chup rehte hain, toh young log ek-doosre se hi seekhte hain. Yeh guide batati hai ki poora session kaise chalana hai: pehle se tay ground rules, bina naam wala question box, woh topics jo syllabus chhod deta hai, common myths, aur agar koi tumhe apne saath hue abuse ke baare mein bataye toh kya karna hai.

statLabel.en: of Indian women aged 15-49 did not know HIV cannot spread through mosquito bites (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: Indian women (15-49 saal) ko nahi pata tha ki HIV machhar ke kaatne se nahi phailta (NFHS-5)

label.en: young people per group in the weekly sessions of RKSK's 'Saathiya' peer educators
label.hg: teenagers hote hain har group mein, RKSK ke 'Saathiya' peer educators ke weekly sessions mein

label.en: of women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom in 2019-21, against 87.3% of young men
label.hg: women (15-24 saal) ko 2019-21 mein pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai; young men mein yeh 87.3% tha

label.en: of adolescent girls had been told about periods before their first one (2016 meta-analysis pooling 88 studies)
label.hg: teenage ladkiyon ko pehle period se pehle hi periods ke baare mein bataya gaya tha (2016 meta-analysis, 88 studies ka data)

label.en: months in jail, at most, for anyone who knows of child sexual abuse and does not report it (POCSO)
label.hg: mahine tak ki jail ho sakti hai agar koi child sexual abuse ke baare mein jaan kar bhi report na kare (POCSO)

claim.en: Talking to young people about sex makes them start having it.
claim.hg: Young logon se sex ke baare mein baat karoge, toh woh sex karne lagenge.

truth.en: UNESCO's 2018 guidance, based on reviews of the evidence, found that curriculum-based sexuality education helps delay first sex and increases condom and contraceptive use.
truth.hg: UNESCO ki 2018 guidance, evidence reviews ke basis par, kehti hai ki syllabus wali sexuality education se pehli baar sex delay hota hai, aur condom aur contraception ka use badhta hai.

actions.en: Agree ground rules before the first question: no names, the right to pass, no laughing at anyone.
actions.hg: Pehle sawaal se pehle ground rules tay karo: kisi ka naam nahi, pass karne ki chhoot, kisi par hasna nahi.

actions.en: Use an anonymous question box and answer every slip, including the awkward ones, at the next session.
actions.hg: Anonymous question box rakho aur agle session mein har slip ka jawab do, awkward waalon ka bhi.

actions.en: Tell the group at the start that what is shared stays in the room, except when someone, especially a child, is at risk.
actions.hg: Shuru mein hi group ko bata do ki yahan ki baat yahin rahegi, bas tab nahi jab kisi ko, khaaskar kisi bachche ko, khatra ho.

actions.en: If someone under 18 tells you they are being abused, listen, don't promise secrecy, and report it to the police or the Child Helpline 1098 the same day.
actions.hg: Agar 18 se kam umar ka koi bataye ki uska abuse ho raha hai, toh dhyaan se suno, secret rakhne ka promise mat karo, aur usi din police ya Child Helpline 1098 ko report karo.

actions.en: Write 112, 1098 and Tele-MANAS 14416 on the board or the last slide of every session.
actions.hg: Har session mein board ya last slide par 112, 1098 aur Tele-MANAS 14416 likh do.

title.en: After a sexual assault: the 72-hour plan for safety, medicine, evidence and the FIR
title.hg: Sexual assault ke baad pehle 72 ghante: safety, dawai, saboot aur FIR ka plan

dek.en: Three clocks start at once: HIV prevention, emergency contraception and evidence. None of them waits for a police decision. Here is what to do, in order, for a survivor or the person beside them.
dek.hg: Usi pal se teen ghadiyan chalne lagti hain: HIV se bachav, emergency contraception aur saboot. Inmein se koi bhi police wale faisle ka intezaar nahin karti. Survivor aur unke saath khade insaan ke liye: kya karna hai, kis order mein.

statLabel.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence ever sought any help (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: women ne hi physical ya sexual violence ke baad kabhi koi help maangi (NFHS-5)

label.en: the latest point to start HIV PEP, which is then taken for 28 days
label.hg: HIV se bachane wali dawai PEP shuru karne ki aakhri hadd; phir yeh 28 din leni hoti hai

label.en: the window for emergency contraception; the sooner, the better it works
label.hg: emergency contraception ka time; jitni jaldi lein, utna better asar

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali women ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: One Stop Centres running across India in July 2026
label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein poore desh mein chal rahe the

claim.en: If you have already bathed or waited a day, there is no point going to a hospital.
claim.hg: Agar naha liya hai ya ek din nikal gaya hai, toh ab hospital jaane ka koi fayda nahin.

truth.en: HIV PEP can still be started up to 72 hours later and emergency contraception up to 5 days later, and every hospital must treat a rape survivor immediately and free of cost.
truth.hg: HIV PEP 72 ghante tak aur emergency contraception 5 din tak shuru ho sakti hai. Aur har hospital ko rape survivor ka ilaaj turant aur free karna hota hai.

actions.en: Go to the nearest hospital, government or private: it must treat a rape survivor immediately and free of cost.
actions.hg: Sabse paas ke hospital jaaiye, sarkari ho ya private. Rape survivor ka ilaaj use turant aur free karna hi hoga.

actions.en: Ask for HIV PEP before 72 hours and emergency contraception before day 5. Sooner is better for both.
actions.hg: 72 ghante ke andar HIV PEP aur 5 din ke andar emergency contraception maangiye. Dono jitni jaldi, utna achha.

actions.en: Carry the clothes worn during the assault, unwashed, in a paper bag, and do not delete any messages or call logs.
actions.hg: Hamle ke waqt pehne kapde bina dhoye paper bag mein le jaaiye. Koi message ya call log delete mat kijiye.

actions.en: Report at any police station, or online, when you are ready; ask for a woman officer and your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Jab aap ready hon, kisi bhi police station mein ya online complaint kijiye. Woman officer aur FIR ki free copy maangiye.

actions.en: Call 112 if anyone is in danger and Tele-MANAS on 14416 when you need to talk, and ask the hospital for the nearest One Stop Centre.
actions.hg: Kisi ko khatra ho toh 112 par call kijiye, baat karni ho toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par. Sabse paas ka One Stop Centre hospital se poochiye.

title.en: Police refused to register your FIR? Lalita Kumari, Section 199 BNS and the escalation ladder
title.hg: Police ne FIR likhne se mana kar diya? Lalita Kumari judgment, Section 199 BNS aur escalation ki seedhi

dek.en: A 'no' at the desk is not the end of the road, and for rape it is itself a crime. How to put the refusal on record, climb from the station to the Superintendent of Police and a magistrate, and name the law the officer is breaking.
dek.hg: Desk par 'na' sunna raaste ka end nahin hai, aur rape ke case mein toh yeh 'na' khud ek crime hai. Refusal ko record par kaise laayein, station se SP aur magistrate tak kaise jaayein, aur officer kaunsa law tod raha hai, yeh kaise bolein.

statLabel.en: of women who sought help after violence went to the police (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: violence ke baad help maangne wali women mein se sirf itni police tak gayin (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women who sought help after physical or sexual violence went to the police (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: physical ya sexual violence ke baad help maangne wali women mein se sirf itni police tak gayin (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of the Supreme Court made FIR registration mandatory for cognizable offences in Lalita Kumari (2013)
label.hg: ki Supreme Court bench ne Lalita Kumari case (2013) mein cognizable offences ki FIR registration ko mandatory kaha

label.en: the longest 'preliminary enquiry' the BNSS allows, only for offences punishable with 3 to under 7 years; never for rape
label.hg: BNSS mein 'preliminary enquiry' ka sabse lamba time, woh bhi sirf 3 se 7 saal se kam saza wale offences mein; rape mein kabhi nahin

label.en: rigorous imprisonment for an officer who fails to record a complaint of rape, sexual assault, acid attack or trafficking (s.199 BNS)
label.hg: ki rigorous imprisonment us officer ko jo rape, sexual assault, acid attack ya trafficking ki complaint record na kare (Section 199 BNS)

claim.en: Police can 'enquire' first and register a rape FIR only if the story checks out.
claim.hg: Police pehle 'enquiry' karegi, baat sahi nikli tabhi rape ki FIR likhegi.

truth.en: For rape the law allows no preliminary enquiry. The BNSS permits a 14-day enquiry only for offences punishable with 3 to under 7 years, and rape carries at least 10.
truth.hg: Rape ke liye law koi preliminary enquiry allow nahin karta. BNSS 14 din ki enquiry sirf un offences mein deta hai jinmein 3 se 7 saal se kam ki saza hai, aur rape mein kam se kam 10 saal ki saza hai.

actions.en: Hand over a written complaint and ask for a stamped receiving copy; if they refuse, note the officer's name, rank, station and the time.
actions.hg: Likhi hui complaint do aur us par stamp wali receiving copy maango; mana karein toh officer ka naam, rank, station aur time note karo.

actions.en: Send the complaint in writing, by post, to the district's Superintendent of Police under Section 173(4) BNSS, and keep the postal receipt.
actions.hg: Section 173(4) BNSS ke under complaint likh kar, post se, district ke SP ko bhejo, aur postal receipt sambhal ke rakho.

actions.en: If the SP does not act, apply to the magistrate; the District Legal Services Authority gives free legal aid.
actions.hg: SP bhi kuch na karein toh magistrate ke paas application do; District Legal Services Authority free legal aid deti hai.

actions.en: Send copies of everything to the National Commission for Women or your state women's commission.
actions.hg: Saare papers ki copy National Commission for Women ya apne state ke women commission ko bhejo.

actions.en: Tell the officer, calmly: refusing to record a rape complaint is an offence under Section 199 of the BNS.
actions.hg: Officer ko shaanti se bolo: rape complaint record na karna Section 199 BNS ke under offence hai.

title.en: Abused as a child, ready to speak as an adult: what you can do now, for your mind and in law
title.hg: Bachpan mein abuse hua, ab bade hokar bolne ko taiyaar ho: apne mann ke liye aur law mein ab kya kar sakte ho

dek.en: Most childhood sexual abuse in India was never told at the time. If you are still carrying it years later, this is what telling someone, finding therapy and going to the law can look like now, including the parts where the system is slow.
dek.hg: India mein bachpan ka zyada tar sexual abuse us waqt kisi ko bataya hi nahi gaya. Agar tum saalon baad bhi ise akele dho rahe ho, toh yeh guide batati hai ki ab kisi ko batana, therapy dhoondhna aur law ka raasta kaisa ho sakta hai. Jahan system slow hai, woh bhi.

statLabel.en: of sexually assaulted children in the government's 2007 study had told no one
statLabel.hg: sexual assault jhel chuke bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha (sarkar ki 2007 ki study)

label.en: of sexually assaulted children in the government's 2007 study had told no one
label.hg: sexual assault jhel chuke bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha (sarkar ki 2007 ki study)

label.en: of young adults sexually assaulted in childhood had ever told anyone, in the same study
label.hg: bachpan mein sexual assault jhel chuke young adults mein se sirf itnon ne kabhi kisi ko bataya tha (wahi study)

label.en: girls and women alive today, about 1 in 8, were raped or sexually assaulted before 18 (UNICEF, 2024)
label.hg: ladkiyan aur auratein, yaani har 8 mein se 1, jinka 18 saal se pehle rape ya sexual assault hua (UNICEF, 2024)

label.en: of POCSO trials that ended in 2024 produced a conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein khatam hue POCSO trials mein se sirf itnon mein conviction hui

claim.en: If it was really abuse, you would have said so at the time. Speaking up years later proves nothing.
claim.hg: Agar sach mein abuse hua hota, toh tum usi waqt bol dete. Saalon baad bolne se kuch saabit nahi hota.

truth.en: In the government's 2007 study, 72.1% of sexually assaulted children had told no one. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook rejects the belief that a survivor who delays reporting is lying.
truth.hg: Sarkar ki 2007 ki study mein sexual assault jhel chuke 72.1% bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha. Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook is soch ko reject karti hai ki der se report karne wala survivor jhooth bol raha hai.

actions.en: Choose one safe person and tell them only as much as you want to. Say what you need first: to be heard, not fixed, and no confronting anyone.
actions.hg: Ek safe insaan chuno aur utna hi batao jitna tum batana chahte ho. Pehle hi keh do ki tumhe kya chahiye: woh bas sune, solution na de, aur kisi se bhidne na jaye.

actions.en: Call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24x7) if you want to talk to someone today, or if the memories bring thoughts of ending your life.
actions.hg: Aaj hi kisi se baat karni ho, ya yaadon ke saath apni jaan lene ke khayal aayein, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo (free, 24x7).

actions.en: Write down what you remember, with dates and places, and keep old diaries, messages and records before you decide about a police complaint.
actions.hg: Police complaint ka faisla karne se pehle jo yaad hai woh date aur jagah ke saath likh lo, aur purani diary, messages aur records sambhaal kar rakho.

actions.en: Ask your District Legal Services Authority (NALSA helpline 15100) for free advice on which law fits the dates of your abuse.
actions.hg: Apni District Legal Services Authority se (NALSA helpline 15100) free advice lo ki tumhare abuse ki dates par kaun-sa law lagta hai.

actions.en: If the person who abused you may be harming a child now, call 1098 or go to the police. The law requires it, and you need suspicion, not proof.
actions.hg: Agar lagta hai ki jisne tumhara abuse kiya woh ab kisi bachche ko nuksaan pahuncha raha hai, toh 1098 par call karo ya police ke paas jao. Law yahi kehta hai, aur proof nahi, shak kaafi hai.

title.en: After an acid attack: free treatment at any hospital, Rs 1 lakh within 15 days, and the officials to chase
title.hg: Acid attack ke baad: kisi bhi hospital mein free treatment, 15 din mein Rs 1 lakh, aur kin officials ke peeche padna hai

dek.en: India registers about 200 acid attacks a year, and the trial takes years. Treatment and money are owed long before any verdict: every hospital must treat first and free, and the first Rs 1 lakh is due within 15 days. A step-by-step guide for survivors and families.
dek.hg: India mein har saal lagbhag 200 acid attacks register hote hain, aur trial mein saalon lag jaate hain. Ilaaj aur paisa kisi bhi faisle se bahut pehle milna chahiye: har hospital ko pehle aur free treatment dena hai, aur pehla Rs 1 lakh 15 din mein due hai. Survivors aur families ke liye step-by-step guide.

statLabel.en: must reach an acid-attack survivor within 15 days of the case reaching the District Legal Services Authority (NALSA scheme, 2018)
statLabel.hg: acid attack survivor ko milna chahiye, case District Legal Services Authority tak pahunchne ke 15 din ke andar (NALSA scheme, 2018)

label.en: acid attacks registered in India in 2024, plus 68 attempts
label.hg: acid attacks 2024 mein India mein register hue, aur 68 attempts alag se

label.en: acid-attack trials completed in 2024, out of 804 cases involving women before the courts
label.hg: acid-attack trials 2024 mein poore hue, jabki women se jude 804 cases courts ke saamne the

label.en: due within 15 days of the case reaching the District Legal Services Authority (NALSA scheme, 2018)
label.hg: case District Legal Services Authority tak pahunchne ke 15 din ke andar due (NALSA scheme, 2018)

label.en: NALSA scheme range for an acid attack that disfigures the face
label.hg: NALSA scheme ki range, jab acid attack se chehra disfigure hua ho

claim.en: Compensation comes only after the attacker is caught and convicted.
claim.hg: Compensation tabhi milta hai jab attacker pakda jaaye aur use saza ho.

truth.en: It does not depend on the trial. A survivor can apply to the District Legal Services Authority straight away, even if the attacker is never traced, and the first Rs 1 lakh is due within 15 days.
truth.hg: Compensation trial par depend nahi karta. Survivor turant District Legal Services Authority mein apply kar sakta hai, chahe attacker kabhi pakda hi na jaaye, aur pehla Rs 1 lakh 15 din mein due hai.

actions.en: Rinse the burn with plenty of clean running water, call 112 and go to the nearest hospital, government or private.
actions.hg: Burn ko khoob saare saaf behte paani se dhoiye, 112 pe call kijiye aur sabse paas ke hospital jaiye, sarkari ho ya private.

actions.en: If a hospital asks for money or turns you away, name Section 397 of the BNSS, note who is in charge and call 112.
actions.hg: Hospital paisa maange ya lauta de, toh BNSS ka Section 397 bataiye, in-charge ka naam note kijiye aur 112 pe call kijiye.

actions.en: Get the FIR registered under Section 124 of the BNS at any police station, and take the free copy.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein BNS ke Section 124 ke under FIR register karwaiye, aur free copy lijiye.

actions.en: Apply in writing to the District Legal Services Authority in the first week, keep the dated receipt and count 15 days.
actions.hg: Pehle hafte mein District Legal Services Authority ko likhit application dijiye, date wali receipt rakhiye aur 15 din giniye.

actions.en: Keep every bill, prescription and discharge paper in one file, with copies outside the house.
actions.hg: Har bill, prescription aur discharge paper ek file mein rakhiye, aur copies ghar ke bahar bhi.

title.en: PEP, the emergency pill, an abortion: what to say at the chemist, hospital or clinic when you fear being judged
title.hg: PEP, emergency pill, abortion: chemist, hospital ya clinic par kya bolein, jab judge kiye jaane ka darr ho

dek.en: Embarrassment burns hours these medicines do not have. Here are the exact words for the counter, the casualty ward, the Suraksha Clinic and the gynaecologist, and the law to quote when someone lectures, refuses or asks for a signature nobody can demand from an adult.
dek.hg: Sharam mein woh ghante nikal jaate hain jo in dawaiyon ke paas hote hi nahin. Yahan counter, casualty ward, Suraksha Clinic aur gynaecologist ke liye seedhe shabd hain, aur woh law bhi jo tab bolna hai jab koi lecture de, mana kare ya aisa signature maange jo kisi adult se maanga hi nahin ja sakta.

statLabel.en: of medication abortions outside health facilities in 2015 used ready-made combipacks
statLabel.hg: 2015 mein health facilities ke bahar hue medication abortions mein se itnon mein ready-made combipack use hua

label.en: the latest HIV PEP can start after an exposure; it is then taken for 28 days
label.hg: exposure ke baad HIV PEP zyada se zyada itni der mein shuru ho sakta hai; phir yeh 28 din chalta hai

label.en: the window for emergency contraception; the sooner it is taken, the better it works
label.hg: emergency contraception ka window; jitni jaldi lo, utna behtar kaam karta hai

label.en: the limit up to which abortion pills are approved in India, on a qualified doctor's prescription
label.hg: India mein abortion pills isi limit tak approved hain, woh bhi qualified doctor ke prescription par

label.en: of young women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom, against 87.3% of young men (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: 15-24 saal ki young women ko pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai, jabki young men mein 87.3% ko pata tha (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: A clinic can refuse an adult woman an abortion until her husband or parents sign.
claim.hg: Clinic kisi adult woman ka abortion tab tak rok sakta hai jab tak uska pati ya parents sign na karein.

truth.en: Under the MTP Act an adult woman's own consent is the only consent required. A guardian's written consent is needed only if she is under 18 or mentally ill.
truth.hg: MTP Act ke under adult woman ki apni consent hi akeli zaroori consent hai. Guardian ki likhit consent sirf tab chahiye jab woh 18 se kam ho ya mentally ill ho.

actions.en: Name the medicine first: 'One emergency contraceptive pill, please' or 'I need to be assessed for HIV PEP.' Explanations are optional.
actions.hg: Pehle dawai ka naam bolo: 'Ek emergency contraceptive pill dijiye' ya 'Mujhe HIV PEP ke liye assess karwana hai.' Explanation dena zaroori nahin.

actions.en: After a possible HIV exposure, reach a hospital emergency ward the same day; if you do not know where to go, call NACO's helpline 1097.
actions.hg: HIV exposure ka shaq ho toh usi din hospital ke emergency ward pahuncho; kahan jaana hai pata na ho toh NACO helpline 1097 par call karo.

actions.en: If a pregnancy test is positive and you do not want to continue, ask a registered doctor, not a counter, and go early.
actions.hg: Pregnancy test positive hai aur pregnancy continue nahin karni, toh counter se nahin, registered doctor se baat karo, aur jaldi jao.

actions.en: If an adult is asked for a husband's or parent's signature, ask the clinic to write its refusal in your file and go to another registered provider.
actions.hg: Adult se pati ya parent ka signature maanga jaaye, toh clinic se kaho ki refusal tumhari file mein likhe, aur doosre registered provider ke paas jao.

actions.en: Do not spend the window arguing with a refusal: move to the next counter or hospital.
actions.hg: Refusal par behas karke window mat gavao: agle counter ya agle hospital chalo.

title.en: You see a woman being harassed on a bus or street: what a bystander can safely do
title.hg: Bus ya sadak pe kisi woman ko harass hote dekha: ek bystander safely kya kar sakta hai

dek.en: Police registered 459 cases of sexual harassment in public transport across India in 2024, a number that says more about who reports than about what happens. A bystander does not need to be a hero: distract, bring others in, call 112 and offer to be a witness.
dek.hg: 2024 mein poore India mein police ne public transport mein sexual harassment ke 459 cases register kiye, aur yeh number yeh zyada batata hai ki report kaun karta hai, yeh kam ki asal mein hota kya hai. Bystander ko hero banne ki zaroorat nahi: dhyaan bhatkaiye, doosron ko saath lijiye, 112 pe call kijiye aur gawah banne ki offer kijiye.

statLabel.en: the gap between harassment of girls reported in a household survey and in police records (2005)
statLabel.hg: yaani lagbhag 200 guna: household survey mein batayi gayi ladkiyon ki harassment aur police records ke beech ka gap (2005)

label.en: cases of sexual harassment in public transport registered in India in 2024
label.hg: public transport mein sexual harassment ke cases India mein 2024 mein register hue

label.en: cases at public places or pathways, July to December 2024
label.hg: cases public places ya pathways pe, July se December 2024 ke beech

label.en: of households said unmarried girls were harassed in their neighbourhood in a 2005 survey; police records implied 0.06%
label.hg: households ne 2005 ke ek survey mein kaha ki unke mohalle mein unmarried ladkiyon ko harass kiya jaata hai; police records ke hisaab se yeh 0.06% tha

label.en: maximum prison term for sexual harassment under Section 75 BNS
label.hg: yaani 3 saal: Section 75 BNS ke under sexual harassment pe maximum jail

claim.en: It is only 'eve teasing', and a stranger who gets involved makes it worse.
claim.hg: Yeh toh bas 'eve teasing' hai, aur koi anjaan insaan beech mein aaye toh baat aur bigadti hai.

truth.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook calls it street sexual harassment and the BNS makes it a crime. A bystander does not have to confront anyone: a question, a seat, a word to the conductor or a call to 112 all count.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook ise street sexual harassment kehti hai aur BNS ise crime maanta hai. Bystander ko kisi se bhidna nahi hai: ek sawaal, ek seat, conductor se ek baat ya 112 pe ek call, sab madad hai.

actions.en: Interrupt without confronting: ask her a question, offer your seat or stand between them.
actions.hg: Bina bhide beech mein aaiye: usse koi sawaal poochhiye, apni seat offer kijiye ya dono ke beech khade ho jaaiye.

actions.en: Tell the conductor, driver or metro staff, and ask one more passenger to back you.
actions.hg: Conductor, driver ya metro staff ko bataiye, aur ek aur passenger se saath dene ko kahiye.

actions.en: Call 112 if he touches her, follows her or will not stop. Give the route number, vehicle number and next stop.
actions.hg: Agar woh use chhue, uska peechha kare ya ruke nahi, toh 112 pe call kijiye. Route number, vehicle number aur agla stop bataiye.

actions.en: Record only if it is safe, film the harasser and not her, and give the video to her or the police instead of posting it.
actions.hg: Record tabhi kijiye jab safe ho, harasser ko film kijiye, use nahi, aur video post karne ke bajaye use ya police ko dijiye.

actions.en: Ask her what she wants, give her your number and write down what you saw the same day. The Women Helpline is 181.
actions.hg: Usse poochhiye ki woh kya chahti hai, use apna number dijiye aur jo dekha woh usi din likh lijiye. Women Helpline ka number 181 hai.

title.en: Read your FIR copy before you leave: the sections that decide a sexual-offence case, and how to fix a wrong one
title.hg: Station chhodne se pehle apni FIR copy padho: woh sections jo sexual-offence case ka faisla karte hain, aur galat section ko theek kaise karwayein

dek.en: The numbers in the 'Acts and Sections' box set the ceiling for everything after: the sentence, the investigation deadline, even what a court must presume. Five questions on reading the free copy, matching it to what happened, and getting it corrected before the case hardens.
dek.hg: 'Acts and Sections' wale box ke numbers aage ki har cheez ki ceiling tay karte hain: saza, investigation ki deadline, yahan tak ki court ko kya maan kar chalna hai. Paanch sawaal: free copy kaise padhein, use apne saath hui baat se kaise milayein, aur case pakka hone se pehle use theek kaise karwayein.

statLabel.en: for rape under Section 64 BNS, against 1 to 5 years for outraging modesty (Section 74)
statLabel.hg: rape ki saza Section 64 BNS ke under, jabki modesty outrage karne par (Section 74) sirf 1 se 5 saal

label.en: for rape under Section 64 BNS, extending to imprisonment for life
label.hg: rape ki saza, Section 64 BNS ke under; yeh life imprisonment tak ja sakti hai

label.en: for assault to outrage a woman's modesty under Section 74 BNS
label.hg: Section 74 BNS ke under, woman ki modesty outrage karne ke liye assault par

label.en: to finish investigating rape and the main POCSO assault offences; Sections 74 and 75 BNS are not covered
label.hg: mein rape aur POCSO ke main assault offences ki investigation poori karni hoti hai; Sections 74 aur 75 BNS is deadline mein nahin aate

label.en: the most that 'voluntarily causing hurt' carries, one of the few sections open to an adult male survivor
label.hg: 'voluntarily causing hurt' ki zyada se zyada saza, un gine-chune sections mein se ek jo adult male survivor ke liye khule hain

claim.en: The sections on the FIR are only police paperwork; the court will sort it out later.
claim.hg: FIR ke sections bas police ka paperwork hain; court baad mein sab theek kar dega.

truth.en: The sections decide the investigation deadline, what the court must presume and the minimum sentence from the first day. They can be corrected, but it gets harder at every stage.
truth.hg: Sections pehle din se tay karte hain ki investigation ki deadline kya hogi, court kya maan kar chalega aur minimum saza kitni hogi. Inhe theek karwaya ja sakta hai, lekin har stage par yeh mushkil hota jaata hai.

actions.en: Take your free FIR copy before you leave the station; read the narrative and the 'Acts and Sections' box.
actions.hg: Station chhodne se pehle apni free FIR copy lo; narrative aur 'Acts and Sections' wala box padho.

actions.en: If the narrative leaves out what you said, ask for it to be corrected before you sign.
actions.hg: Agar narrative mein tumhari kahi hui baat chhoot gayi hai, toh sign karne se pehle use theek karwao.

actions.en: If the sections are wrong, apply in writing to the investigating officer to add the right one and record your further statement; keep a stamped copy.
actions.hg: Agar sections galat hain, toh investigating officer ko likh kar application do ki sahi section jode aur tumhara further statement record kare; stamp lagi copy rakho.

actions.en: Say everything in your statement before the magistrate.
actions.hg: Magistrate ke saamne apne statement mein sab kuch bolo.

actions.en: If the police will not act, write to the Superintendent of Police and ask the District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer.
actions.hg: Agar police action na le, toh Superintendent of Police ko likho aur District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer maango.

title.en: A safety plan for domestic violence: the documents, the code word and the numbers to keep ready before the next attack
title.hg: Domestic violence ke liye safety plan: documents, code word aur woh numbers jo agle attack se pehle ready hone chahiye

dek.en: One in four women who faced violence from a husband was injured by it. A plan made on a calm day, whether you are staying or leaving, is what you reach for when there is no time to think: a safer room, a code word, a bag kept elsewhere, 112 and 181.
dek.hg: Husband ki violence jhelne wali har chaar mein se ek woman ko chot lagi. Shaant din pe banaya gaya plan, chahe aap ruk rahi hon ya nikal rahi hon, us waqt kaam aata hai jab sochne ka time nahi hota: safer room, code word, ghar se bahar rakha bag, 112 aur 181.

statLabel.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence from a husband were injured (NFHS-5)
statLabel.hg: un women ko chot lagi jinhone husband ki physical ya sexual violence jheli (NFHS-5)

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence from a husband were injured (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: un women ko chot lagi jinhone husband ki physical ya sexual violence jheli (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone
label.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali women ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya

label.en: of women whose fathers beat their mothers faced spousal violence themselves, against 25% of other women
label.hg: un women ne khud spousal violence jheli jinke papa unki mummy ko maarte the; baaki women mein yeh 25% tha

label.en: One Stop Centres operating in July 2026, out of 1,033 approved
label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein chal rahe the, 1,033 approved centres mein se

claim.en: A safety plan is only for women who have decided to leave.
claim.hg: Safety plan sirf un women ke liye hai jinhone ghar chhodne ka faisla kar liya hai.

truth.en: Most of a safety plan is for the days you are still in the house: a safer room, a code word, a bag kept elsewhere. It does not commit you to leaving. It keeps that door open.
truth.hg: Safety plan ka zyada hissa un dinon ke liye hai jab aap usi ghar mein hain: safer room, code word, ghar se bahar rakha bag. Isse aap nikalne ke liye bandh nahi jaati. Bas woh darwaaza khula rehta hai.

actions.en: Tell one person you trust what is happening, and agree a code word or missed-call signal that means 'come to my door' or 'call 112'.
actions.hg: Ek trusted insaan ko bataiye ki kya ho raha hai, aur ek code word ya missed-call signal tay kijiye jiska matlab ho 'mere darwaaze pe aao' ya '112 pe call karo'.

actions.en: Keep copies of your documents, some cash and spare keys outside the house, with someone he would not think of.
actions.hg: Documents ki copies, thoda cash aur spare chaabi ghar ke bahar rakhiye, kisi aise insaan ke paas jiska use khayal bhi na aaye.

actions.en: Work out which room has a way out and no knives, stove or gas, and move there when a fight starts.
actions.hg: Pehle se soch lijiye ki kis kamre se bahar nikalne ka raasta hai aur jahan chaaku, stove ya gas nahi hai, aur jhagda shuru hote hi wahin jaiye.

actions.en: Save 112 and the Women Helpline, 181, under ordinary names. Teach children to call 112 or 1098 and to go to a neighbour, never to step in between.
actions.hg: 112 aur Women Helpline 181 ko aam naamon se save kijiye. Bachchon ko sikhaiye ki 112 ya 1098 pe call karein aur padosi ke ghar jayein, beech mein kabhi na aayein.

actions.en: After any injury, see a doctor and keep the paper. It is evidence if you ask a magistrate for a protection order later.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi chot ke baad doctor ko dikhaiye aur parchi sambhal ke rakhiye. Baad mein magistrate se protection order maangte waqt yeh evidence hai.

title.en: Your daughter's in-laws keep demanding money: what her family can do before it becomes a dowry death
title.hg: Beti ke sasuraal wale baar-baar paise maang rahe hain: dowry death banne se pehle uska parivaar kya kar sakta hai

dek.en: Police registered 5,737 dowry deaths in 2024, and the law itself treats the first seven years of marriage as the danger period. Parents and siblings are usually the first people she tells. What to watch for, what to save, when to bring her home and how to file a complaint.
dek.hg: 2024 mein police ne 5,737 dowry deaths register ki, aur law khud shaadi ke pehle saat saal ko khatre ka time maanta hai. Aksar sabse pehle woh apne parents aur bhai-behen ko hi batati hai. Kin baaton pe nazar rakhni hai, kya save karna hai, use ghar kab laana hai aur complaint kaise file karni hai.

statLabel.hg: yaani roz lagbhag 16: India mein 2024 mein register hui dowry deaths (5,737 cases)

label.en: dowry-death cases registered in India in 2024, about 16 a day
label.hg: dowry-death cases India mein 2024 mein register hue, yaani roz lagbhag 16

label.hg: yaani shaadi ke 7 saal: woh time jisme Section 80 BNS dowry death maan ke chalta hai

label.en: of women who sought help after violence turned to their own family (NFHS-5)
label.hg: violence ke baad help maangne wali women apne hi parivaar ke paas gayi (NFHS-5)

label.en: of the cruelty cases police disposed of in 2024 were closed as false
label.hg: cruelty cases, jo police ne 2024 mein niptaaye, unme se itne hi false bata ke band hue

claim.en: Dowry cases are mostly misused, so a family should pay quietly and settle.
claim.hg: Dowry cases zyada tar misuse hote hain, isliye parivaar ko chupchaap paise de ke maamla settle kar lena chahiye.

truth.en: Police closed about 3.8% of the cruelty cases they disposed of in 2024 as false and charge-sheeted 90.2%. Demanding dowry is itself a crime, and paying is not protection.
truth.hg: Police ne 2024 mein jitne cruelty cases niptaaye, unme se lagbhag 3.8% ko false bata ke band kiya aur 90.2% mein chargesheet file ki. Dowry maangna khud ek crime hai, aur paise dena koi protection nahi hai.

actions.en: Tell her in plain words, today, that she can come home at any time and stay.
actions.hg: Aaj hi, seedhe shabdon mein, use bata dijiye ki woh kabhi bhi ghar aa sakti hai aur yahin reh sakti hai.

actions.en: Stop paying. Save every message, voice note and bank transfer that shows a demand, and keep copies outside her marital home.
actions.hg: Paise dena band kijiye. Har message, voice note aur bank transfer jisme demand dikhti ho, save kijiye, aur copies uske sasuraal ke bahar rakhiye.

actions.en: If she is in danger right now, call 112. For shelter, counselling and legal help, call the Women Helpline, 181, or go to the district One Stop Centre.
actions.hg: Agar woh abhi khatre mein hai, toh 112 pe call kijiye. Shelter, counselling aur legal help ke liye Women Helpline 181 pe call kijiye ya district ke One Stop Centre jaaiye.

actions.en: Go with her to give a written complaint under Section 85 BNS and the Dowry Prohibition Act at any police station, and keep the free FIR copy.
actions.hg: Uske saath jaa ke kisi bhi police station mein Section 85 BNS aur Dowry Prohibition Act ke under written complaint dijiye, aur FIR ki free copy sambhaal ke rakhiye.

actions.en: If she speaks of not wanting to live, stay with her and call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
actions.hg: Agar woh jeene ki ichchha na hone ki baat kare, toh uske saath rahiye aur Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call kijiye.

title.en: Can't afford a lawyer? How a survivor gets one free from the Legal Services Authority, and why it matters
title.hg: Vakeel ke paise nahi hain? Survivor ko Legal Services Authority se free vakeel kaise milta hai, aur yeh kyun zaroori hai

dek.en: In a rape trial the public prosecutor speaks for the State, not for the survivor. A lawyer of her own costs nothing through the District Legal Services Authority (helpline 15100), and the law hands a represented victim case papers that an unrepresented one does not get. Five questions, answered.
dek.hg: Rape trial mein public prosecutor State ki taraf se bolta hai, survivor ki taraf se nahi. District Legal Services Authority (helpline 15100) se use apna vakeel bilkul free mil sakta hai, aur law vakeel wali victim ko case ke woh papers deta hai jo bina vakeel wali ko nahi milte. Paanch sawaal, paanch jawab.

label.en: rape cases pending trial in Indian courts at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases 2024 ke end mein India ki courts mein trial ke liye pending the

label.en: from the accused's first appearance for a victim who has a lawyer to get free copies of the police report, FIR and statements (BNSS s.230)
label.hg: accused ki pehli peshi se itne din ke andar vakeel wali victim ko police report, FIR aur statements ki free copies milni chahiye (BNSS s.230)

label.en: within which police must update the victim on the investigation (BNSS s.193(3))
label.hg: ke andar police ko victim ko investigation ka update dena hota hai (BNSS s.193(3))

label.en: compensation range for a rape survivor under NALSA's 2018 scheme
label.hg: NALSA ki 2018 ki scheme mein rape survivor ke liye compensation ki range

claim.en: The public prosecutor is the survivor's lawyer, so she does not need one of her own.
claim.hg: Public prosecutor hi survivor ka vakeel hota hai, isliye use apne alag vakeel ki zaroorat nahi.

truth.en: The prosecutor represents the State. A survivor can have her own lawyer, free through the Legal Services Authority, to look after her interests, from case papers to bail hearings to compensation.
truth.hg: Prosecutor State ko represent karta hai. Survivor Legal Services Authority se free mein apna vakeel le sakti hai, jo case papers se lekar bail hearing aur compensation tak uske apne hiton ka dhyaan rakhe.

actions.en: Ask for a free lawyer as soon as the FIR is registered: go to the District Legal Services Authority in your district court complex, or call NALSA's legal aid helpline, 15100.
actions.hg: FIR darj hote hi free vakeel maangiye: apne district court complex mein District Legal Services Authority jaiye, ya NALSA ki legal aid helpline 15100 par call kijiye.

actions.en: Carry the FIR copy and an ID. A woman or a child does not need an income certificate to qualify.
actions.hg: FIR ki copy aur ek ID saath le jaiye. Aurat ya bachche ko qualify karne ke liye income certificate nahi chahiye.

actions.en: Ask your lawyer to get you the free copies of the police report and statements within 14 days of the accused's first appearance in court.
actions.hg: Apne vakeel se kahiye ki accused ki court mein pehli peshi ke 14 din ke andar police report aur statements ki free copies aapko dilwaye.

actions.en: Apply for victim compensation at the same office. You do not have to wait for the trial or a conviction.
actions.hg: Victim compensation ke liye usi office mein apply kijiye. Trial ya conviction ka intezaar karne ki zaroorat nahi hai.

actions.en: If a legal aid lawyer asks for money or stops turning up, write to the DLSA secretary and ask for another lawyer.
actions.hg: Agar legal aid ka vakeel paise maange ya aana band kar de, toh DLSA secretary ko likh kar bataiye aur doosra vakeel maangiye.

title.en: A friend's intimate photos are going round college: how to help, and why you can report them on their behalf
title.hg: Ek friend ki intimate photos college mein ghoom rahi hain: kaise help karein, aur kyun tum unki taraf se report kar sakte ho

dek.en: You may see it before they do. Don't forward it, tell them gently, and report every copy yourself: the law lets a friend complain, and platforms now have two hours to act.
dek.hg: Ho sakta hai tum use pehle dekh lo. Forward mat karo, friend ko aaram se batao, aur har copy khud report karo: law friend ko bhi complaint karne deta hai, aur ab platforms ke paas action lene ke liye sirf do ghante hain.

statLabel.hg: cases 2024 mein poore India mein women ke against obscene sexual material publish ya host karne par register hue

label.en: cases of publishing or hosting obscene sexual material against women registered in India in 2024
label.hg: cases 2024 mein poore India mein women ke against obscene sexual material publish ya host karne par register hue

label.hg: ghante: 20 February 2026 se, complaint ke baad nude, sexual ya morphed photos hatane ke liye platforms ke paas bas itna time hai

label.hg: IT Act ke obscenity cases 2024 ke end tak courts mein pending the

label.en: cases supported by the StopNCII hashing tool by November 2025
label.hg: cases mein November 2025 tak StopNCII ke hashing tool ne help ki

claim.en: If it is already in every group, one more forward makes no difference.
claim.hg: Jab photo already har group mein hai, toh ek aur forward se kya fark padega?

truth.en: Every forward puts the image on new phones and is a fresh violation. Transmitting an image of someone's private area without consent is itself an offence under Section 66E of the IT Act.
truth.hg: Har forward photo ko naye phones tak le jaata hai aur har baar ek nayi violation hai. Kisi ke private parts ki image bina consent aage bhejna IT Act ke Section 66E ke under khud ek offence hai.

actions.en: Do not forward, save, react to or comment on the image, even to condemn it.
actions.hg: Photo ko forward, save, react ya comment mat karo, use bura bolne ke liye bhi nahi.

actions.en: Tell your friend privately and with facts: where you saw it, since when, and that it is not their fault.
actions.hg: Friend ko akele mein aur facts ke saath batao: kahan dekhi, kab se hai, aur yeh ki isme uski koi galti nahi.

actions.en: Report every copy on the platform yourself: India's IT Rules let a complaint be made on someone's behalf.
actions.hg: Har copy platform pe khud report karo: India ke IT Rules kisi ki taraf se complaint karne dete hain.

actions.en: Keep a list of links, group names, usernames and times instead of saving the image.
actions.hg: Photo save karne ki jagah links, group names, usernames aur time ki list banao.

actions.en: If your friend wants a police case, help them call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in, and go with them.
actions.hg: Agar friend police case chahe, toh 1930 pe call karne ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint karne mein help karo, aur saath jao.

title.en: If a friend says they want to die: what to ask, what to say, and when to call 14416 or 112
title.hg: Agar dost bole ki woh marna chahta hai: kya poochhna hai, kya bolna hai, aur 14416 ya 112 kab call karna hai

dek.en: The first person to hear it is rarely a doctor. It is a roommate, a cousin, a friend on WhatsApp at 1 am. Five questions friends actually ask, answered: how to tell if it is serious, the words to use, what to do with a promise of secrecy, and why calling for help will not get your friend arrested.
dek.hg: Yeh baat sabse pehle doctor nahin sunta. Sunta hai roommate, cousin, ya woh dost jise raat 1 baje WhatsApp aata hai. Dost jo paanch sawaal sach mein poochhte hain, unke jawab: kaise pata chale ki baat serious hai, kaunse words use karein, secret rakhne ke promise ka kya karein, aur help bulane se tumhara dost arrest kyon nahin hoga.

statLabel.hg: Indian adults ne National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 mein high suicidal risk report kiya

label.hg: Indian adults ne high suicidal risk report kiya (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)

label.hg: urban metros ke adults ne isi survey mein high suicidal risk report kiya

label.hg: Tele-MANAS, Health Ministry ki free, 24 ghante chalne wali mental health helpline, October 2022 se chalu

label.hg: Mental Healthcare Act, 2017: suicide attempt karne wale insaan ko severe stress mein maana jaata hai, use care milni chahiye, saza nahin

claim.en: Asking a friend if they are thinking about suicide will put the idea in their head.
claim.hg: Dost se poochhna ki kya woh suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, uske dimaag mein yeh idea daal dega.

truth.en: WHO identifies stigma and silence as what stops people from seeking help. A calm, direct question breaks that silence and opens the door to help.
truth.hg: WHO ke mutabik stigma aur chuppi hi logon ko help maangne se rokti hai. Shaanti se poochha gaya ek seedha sawaal woh chuppi todta hai aur help ka raasta kholta hai.

actions.en: Ask the question in plain words: 'Are you thinking about suicide?' Then listen more than you talk.
actions.hg: Seedhe words mein poochho: 'Kya tum suicide ke baare mein soch rahe ho?' Phir bolo kam, suno zyada.

actions.en: Do not promise secrecy. Say: 'I care about you too much to keep this to myself. Let's decide together who we tell.'
actions.hg: Secret rakhne ka promise mat karo. Bolo: 'Mujhe tumhari itni parwah hai ki main yeh apne tak nahin rakh sakta. Chalo saath mein decide karte hain ki kisko batayein.'

actions.en: Call Tele-MANAS on 14416 together, or call it yourself and ask what to do next.
actions.hg: Saath mein Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, ya khud call karke poochho ki aage kya karna hai.

actions.en: If they have a plan, have hurt themselves or have gone silent after a goodbye, call 112, share the location and do not leave them alone.
actions.hg: Agar plan hai, khud ko hurt kar chuke hain ya goodbye ke baad chup ho gaye hain, toh 112 call karo, location batao aur unhe akela mat chhodo.

actions.en: Tell one trusted adult for your own sake too. You are a friend, not a therapist.
actions.hg: Apne liye bhi ek trusted adult ko batao. Tum dost ho, therapist nahin.

title.en: Your friend's partner controls their phone, money and friends: how to help without pushing them away
title.hg: Aapke dost ka partner unka phone, paisa aur dost sab control karta hai: bina door dhakele madad kaise karein

dek.en: Friends usually see the checking, the cancelled plans and the excuses before anyone else does. The commonest mistake is an ultimatum that leaves the person more alone. What to say, what to keep safe for them, and when to call 112.
dek.hg: Checking, cancel hote plans aur bahaane, yeh sab aksar sabse pehle doston ko dikhta hai. Sabse aam galti ek ultimatum hai, jo us insaan ko aur akela kar deta hai. Kya kehna hai, unke liye kya sambhaal ke rakhna hai, aur 112 kab call karna hai.

label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein poore India mein chal rahe the

claim.en: If it were really that bad, they would just leave.
claim.hg: Agar sach mein itna bura hota, toh woh chhod ke chale jaate.

truth.en: Love, money, housing, family pressure and fear all hold people in place. In NFHS-5, 77.2% of women who faced physical or sexual violence had never told anyone, so silence is the norm, not proof that things are fine.
truth.hg: Pyaar, paisa, ghar, family ka pressure aur darr, sab milke insaan ko wahin rok ke rakhte hain. NFHS-5 mein physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali 77.2% women ne kabhi kisi ko nahi bataya tha, yaani chup rehna aam baat hai, is baat ka saboot nahi ki sab theek hai.

actions.en: Raise it in person and alone, with what you have seen: 'You seem scared of how he will react. I'm worried about you.'
actions.hg: Akele mein, aamne-saamne baat kijiye, aur wahi kahiye jo aapne dekha hai: 'Lagta hai tum uske reaction se darti ho. Mujhe tumhari fikar hai.'

actions.en: Do not give an ultimatum, do not confront the partner, and do not type your worries into a phone the partner reads.
actions.hg: Ultimatum mat dijiye, partner se khud mat uljhiye, aur apni chinta us phone pe type mat kijiye jo partner padhta hai.

actions.en: Offer to be the safe contact: keep copies of their ID, bank and education papers, a spare key and a little cash.
actions.hg: Safe contact banne ki offer kijiye: unke ID, bank aur education papers ki copies, ek spare chaabi aur thoda cash apne paas rakhiye.

actions.en: Agree on a code word that means 'call 112 for me', and save the Women Helpline (181) and your district One Stop Centre's address.
actions.hg: Ek code word tay kijiye jiska matlab ho 'mere liye 112 call karo', aur Women Helpline (181) aur apne district ke One Stop Centre ka address save kijiye.

actions.en: If there is a threat to kill, a weapon, or your friend says they fear for their life, call 112 now. If your friend is under 18, call 1098.
actions.hg: Agar jaan se maarne ki dhamki hai, koi hathiyaar hai, ya aapka dost kahe ki use apni jaan ka darr hai, toh abhi 112 call kijiye. Agar dost 18 se kam umar ka hai, toh 1098 call kijiye.

title.en: 2 hours, 24 hours, 7 days, 2 months: the legal deadlines that work for a survivor in India
title.hg: 2 ghante, 24 ghante, 7 din, 2 mahine: woh legal deadlines jo India mein survivor ke kaam aati hain

dek.en: Indian law puts clocks on platforms, police, doctors, courts and employers, and almost nobody tells survivors about them. Each number here comes with its section, the office it binds, and an honest account of what happens when it is missed.
dek.hg: Indian law platforms, police, doctors, courts aur employers, sab pe ghadi lagata hai, par survivors ko yeh koi nahi batata. Yahan har number ke saath uska section hai, woh office jis pe yeh laagu hota hai, aur saaf-saaf yeh bhi ki deadline miss ho jaaye toh kya hota hai.

statLabel.hg: rape aur POCSO cases 2025 ke end mein fast-track courts mein pending the

label.en: for a platform to remove an intimate or morphed image after the person's complaint (since 20 February 2026)
label.hg: yaani do ghante: insaan ki complaint ke baad platform ko intimate ya morphed image hataane ke liye (20 February 2026 se)

label.en: for police to send a rape survivor for a medical examination after they are told, with her consent
label.hg: yaani 24 ghante: police ko khabar milne ke baad rape survivor ko, uski consent se, medical examination ke liye bhejne ke liye

label.hg: yaani do mahine: police ko rape ki investigation poori karne ke liye, aur chargesheet ke baad trial ke liye 2 mahine aur

label.hg: rape aur POCSO cases 31 December 2025 ko Fast Track Special Courts mein pending the

actions.en: Write down four dates: your complaint, the FIR, the medical examination and the chargesheet. Every deadline is counted from one of them.
actions.hg: Chaar dates likh ke rakhiye: aapki complaint, FIR, medical examination aur chargesheet. Har deadline inhi mein se kisi ek se gini jaati hai.

actions.en: Report an intimate image to the platform first and save the complaint number and time; the two-hour clock starts there.
actions.hg: Intimate image ki report sabse pehle platform pe kijiye aur complaint number aur time save kar lijiye; do ghante ki ghadi wahin se shuru hoti hai.

actions.en: If you file an e-FIR, sign it within 3 days and ask for your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Agar aap e-FIR file karte hain, toh 3 din ke andar use sign kijiye aur FIR ki free copy maangiye.

actions.en: If 90 days pass without news, ask the investigating officer in writing for a progress update, quoting Section 193(3) BNSS.
actions.hg: Agar 90 din bina kisi khabar ke nikal jaayein, toh investigating officer se likh ke progress update maangiye, aur Section 193(3) BNSS ka zikr kijiye.

actions.en: For workplace harassment, give the committee a written complaint within three months of the last incident.
actions.hg: Workplace harassment mein aakhri incident ke teen mahine ke andar committee ko written complaint de dijiye.

title.en: Forced by your husband: the legal options open today while the Supreme Court decides on marital rape
title.hg: Husband ne zabardasti ki: jab tak Supreme Court marital rape pe faisla nahi deta, aaj kaun se legal options khule hain

dek.en: Indian law still does not call forced sex by a husband rape. It does offer a protection order, a cruelty charge, a separate offence if you live apart, and an abortion without an FIR. What each can and cannot do.
dek.hg: Indian law aaj bhi husband ke zabardasti sex ko rape nahi kehta. Lekin woh protection order, cruelty ka charge, alag rehne pe ek alag offence aur bina FIR ke abortion ka raasta deta hai. Har option kya kar sakta hai aur kya nahi.

statLabel.hg: ever-married women ne kaha ki husband ne unhe zabardasti intercourse ke liye physically force kiya (NFHS-5)
