label.hg: ever-married women ne kaha ki husband ne unhe zabardasti intercourse ke liye physically force kiya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: in prison for a husband who forces sex on a wife living separately (Section 67 BNS); rape of any other woman starts at 10
label.hg: jail us husband ke liye jo alag reh rahi wife ke saath zabardasti sex kare (Section 67 BNS); kisi aur woman ke rape pe saza 10 saal se shuru hoti hai

label.en: limit up to which a wife pregnant from forced sex can seek an abortion, without an FIR (Supreme Court, 2022)
label.hg: tak zabardasti sex se pregnant hui wife abortion maang sakti hai, bina FIR ke (Supreme Court, 2022)

label.en: One Stop Centres operating across India in July 2026
label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein poore India mein chal rahe the

claim.en: If the law does not call it rape, a wife has no legal remedy at all.
claim.hg: Agar law ise rape nahi kehta, toh wife ke paas koi legal raasta hi nahi hai.

truth.en: Forced sex in marriage is sexual abuse under the Domestic Violence Act, can support a cruelty case under Section 85 BNS, is a separate offence if the couple live apart, and counts as rape under abortion law.
truth.hg: Shaadi mein zabardasti sex Domestic Violence Act ke under sexual abuse hai, Section 85 BNS ke cruelty case ka aadhaar ban sakta hai, couple alag rehta ho toh ek alag offence hai, aur abortion law mein rape maana jaata hai.

actions.en: If you are in danger now, call 112. For advice and a referral, call the Women Helpline on 181.
actions.hg: Agar abhi khatra hai toh 112 pe call kijiye. Salaah aur referral ke liye Women Helpline 181 pe call kijiye.

actions.en: Keep a dated record of each incident, with messages, medical papers and photos, somewhere he cannot reach.
actions.hg: Har incident ka record date ke saath rakhiye, messages, medical papers aur photos ke saath, aisi jagah jahan uska haath na pahunche.

actions.en: Ask a One Stop Centre or the district Protection Officer for a protection order under the Domestic Violence Act. You do not need an FIR first.
actions.hg: One Stop Centre ya district ke Protection Officer se Domestic Violence Act ke under protection order maangiye. Pehle FIR zaroori nahi hai.

actions.en: If you are pregnant and do not want to continue, see a registered doctor early. You need no FIR and no consent from your husband.
actions.hg: Agar aap pregnant hain aur pregnancy continue nahi karna chahti, toh jaldi registered doctor se miliye. Na FIR chahiye, na husband ki consent.

actions.en: If you are reading this after 10 December 2026, check whether the Supreme Court has ruled on Exception 2 to Section 63.
actions.hg: Agar aap yeh 10 December 2026 ke baad padh rahi hain, toh check kijiye ki Supreme Court ne Exception 2 to Section 63 pe faisla diya hai ya nahi.

title.en: The medical exam after rape: your consent, the banned two-finger test and the doctor's 7-day deadline
title.hg: Rape ke baad medical exam: aapka consent, banned two-finger test aur doctor ki 7 din ki deadline

dek.en: Fear of the examination room keeps survivors away from hospitals. These are the rules before you walk in: what the doctor may do, what you can refuse, and what the report can never be used to say about you.
dek.hg: Examination room ka darr kai survivors ko hospital se door rakhta hai. Hospital jaane se pehle rules jaan lijiye: doctor kya kar sakte hain, aap kis cheez se mana kar sakti hain, aur report aapke baare mein kya kabhi nahi keh sakti.

statLabel.en: days: the deadline for the doctor's report to reach the investigating officer (s.184 BNSS)
statLabel.hg: din: itne time mein doctor ki report investigating officer tak pahunchni chahiye (s.184 BNSS)

label.en: of women who had faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: auraton ne physical ya sexual violence jhelne ke baad na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: hours within which police must send a rape survivor for a medical exam after they receive information (s.184 BNSS)
label.hg: ghante ke andar police ko information milne ke baad survivor ko medical exam ke liye bhejna hota hai (s.184 BNSS)

label.en: days for the doctor to send the report to the investigating officer (s.184 BNSS)
label.hg: din mein doctor ko report investigating officer ko bhejni hoti hai (s.184 BNSS)

label.en: One Stop Centres running across India in July 2026, where a survivor can get help deciding on the exam
label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein poore India mein chal rahe the, jahan exam ka decision lene mein help mil sakti hai

claim.en: A doctor can tell from the hymen, or with a 'finger test', whether a woman was raped or is 'used to sex'.
claim.hg: Doctor hymen dekhkar ya 'finger test' se bata sakte hain ki rape hua ya nahi, ya ladki 'sex ki aadi' hai ya nahi.

truth.en: The Supreme Court has said the two-finger test has no scientific basis and neither proves nor disproves rape. Anyone who performs it is guilty of misconduct.
truth.hg: Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki two-finger test ka koi scientific basis nahi hai. Isse rape na saabit hota hai, na jhootha. Jo bhi yeh test kare, woh misconduct ka doshi hai.

actions.en: Go to the nearest hospital, government or private: by law it must treat you immediately and free of cost.
actions.hg: Sabse paas ke hospital jaiye, sarkari ho ya private. Law ke hisaab se wahan aapka ilaaj turant aur free hona chahiye.

actions.en: Ask the doctor to explain each step before you sign, agree only to what you want, and say 'stop' at any point.
actions.hg: Sign karne se pehle doctor se har step samjhiye. Sirf utne ke liye haan kahiye jitna aap chahti hain, aur kabhi bhi 'ruko' keh sakti hain.

actions.en: Ask for emergency contraception (it works up to 5 days after) and HIV PEP (start within 72 hours), even if you refuse the evidence exam.
actions.hg: Emergency pill (5 din tak kaam karti hai) aur HIV se bachane wali PEP (72 ghante ke andar shuru) zaroor maangiye, chahe aap evidence wale exam se mana kar dein.

actions.en: If anyone attempts a finger test or comments on your hymen or 'habits', refuse, note the name and time, and tell the police officer, a One Stop Centre or your lawyer.
actions.hg: Agar koi finger test karne lage ya aapke hymen ya 'habits' par comment kare, toh saaf mana kijiye. Naam aur time note kijiye, aur police officer, One Stop Centre ya apne lawyer ko bataiye.

actions.en: Ask the investigating officer whether the doctor's report has arrived; the law gives the doctor 7 days.
actions.hg: Investigating officer se poochiye ki doctor ki report aayi ya nahi. Law doctor ko iske liye 7 din deta hai.

title.en: 'No injuries, no case' and other myths that stop survivors from reporting, checked against the law
title.hg: 'Chot nahi, toh case nahi' aur doosre myths jo survivors ko report karne se rokte hain, law ke saamne rakhkar check kiye gaye

dek.en: Most women who face violence in India never report it, and beliefs the law rejected years ago still hold some of them back. Five of them, each set against the section, judgment or number that answers it, with the next step to take.
dek.hg: India mein violence jhelne wali zyada tar women kabhi report nahi karti, aur un mein se kuch aaj bhi un baaton ki wajah se ruk jaati hain jinhe law saalon pehle reject kar chuka hai. Aise paanch myths, har ek ke saamne woh section, judgment ya number jo uska jawaab deta hai, aur agla step.

statLabel.en: in which sex is rape under Section 63 BNS, including consent obtained by fear or given while intoxicated. Injury is not on the list
statLabel.hg: jin mein Section 63 BNS ke under sex rape hai, jaise dar dikhakar li gayi ya nashe ki haalat mein di gayi consent. Chot is list mein nahi hai

label.en: of rape cases registered in 2024 had an offender known to the survivor
label.hg: 2024 mein register hue rape cases mein offender survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali women ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.en: maximum prison term for publishing a rape survivor's identity (Section 72 BNS)
label.hg: rape survivor ki identity publish karne pe maximum jail (Section 72 BNS)

label.en: cases registered under Section 72 in 2024, the new code's first six months
label.hg: cases 2024 mein Section 72 ke under register hue, naye code ke pehle chhe mahine mein

claim.en: Without injuries, a prompt complaint and a stranger as the accused, there is no rape case.
claim.hg: Chot, turant complaint aur ek anjaan accused ke bina rape ka case banta hi nahi.

truth.en: Section 63 BNS asks about consent, not injuries or resistance. A complaint can be given at any police station, a delay does not make it false, and almost every accused is someone the survivor knows.
truth.hg: Section 63 BNS consent ke baare mein poochhta hai, chot ya resistance ke baare mein nahi. Complaint kisi bhi police station mein di ja sakti hai, der se report karne se woh jhoothi nahi ho jaati, aur lagbhag har accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala hota hai.

actions.en: Go to any police station, or to any hospital first: both are bound by law to act, and treatment is free.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station jaiye, ya pehle kisi bhi hospital: dono law se bandhe hain ki action lein, aur ilaaj free hai.

actions.en: Ask for a woman officer to record your complaint, and take your free copy of the FIR.
actions.hg: Kahiye ki aapki complaint woman officer record kare, aur FIR ki apni free copy lijiye.

actions.en: Write down what you remember with dates, and save messages, call logs and clothes, even if time has passed.
actions.hg: Jo yaad hai use dates ke saath likhiye, aur messages, call logs aur kapde sambhalkar rakhiye, chahe kaafi time beet gaya ho.

actions.en: If police refuse, hand over a written complaint and say that refusing is an offence under Section 199 BNS.
actions.hg: Agar police mana kare, toh written complaint dijiye aur bataiye ki mana karna Section 199 BNS ke under offence hai.

actions.en: If anyone publishes or forwards your name or photo, screenshot it and report it: that is a separate crime under Section 72 BNS.
actions.hg: Agar koi aapka naam ya photo publish ya forward kare, toh screenshot lekar report kijiye: yeh Section 72 BNS ke under alag crime hai.

title.en: 985 One Stop Centres: what a Sakhi centre offers a woman facing violence, and how to find yours
title.hg: 985 One Stop Centres: violence jhel rahi aurat ko Sakhi centre mein kya milta hai, aur apna centre kaise dhoondhein

dek.en: A One Stop Centre puts a doctor, the police, a lawyer, a counsellor and a bed for a few nights behind one door, free of cost. Most women who face violence never reach it. Who can walk in, what the first visit looks like, how the Women Helpline 181 connects you, and what to do when your district's centre is far away or short of staff.
dek.hg: One Stop Centre ek hi darwaze ke peeche doctor, police, vakeel, counsellor aur kuch raaton ke liye bistar deta hai, bilkul free. Phir bhi violence jhelne wali zyada tar auratein wahan tak pahunchti hi nahi. Kaun andar ja sakta hai, pehli visit kaisi hoti hai, Women Helpline 181 aapko kaise jodti hai, aur jab aapke district ka centre door ho ya staff kam ho toh kya karein.

statLabel.en: One Stop Centres running across India in July 2026, out of 1,033 approved
statLabel.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein India bhar mein chal rahe the, 1,033 approved mein se

label.en: One Stop Centres running in July 2026, out of 1,033 approved
label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein chal rahe the, 1,033 approved mein se

label.en: women assisted by the centres between April 2015 and June 2026
label.hg: auraton ki centres ne April 2015 se June 2026 ke beech madad ki

label.en: of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5)
label.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali auraton ne kabhi help nahi maangi, na kisi ko bataya (NFHS-5)

label.en: women help desks set up in police stations by March 2025
label.hg: women help desks March 2025 tak police stations mein ban chuke the

claim.en: A One Stop Centre is only for rape cases, and it will not help you until you have an FIR.
claim.hg: One Stop Centre sirf rape cases ke liye hai, aur jab tak FIR na ho, wahan koi madad nahi milti.

truth.en: The centres are for women facing any kind of violence, at home or outside it. You can walk in without a police complaint, and an adult woman decides for herself whether to file one.
truth.hg: Centres har tarah ka violence jhel rahi auraton ke liye hain, ghar ke andar ho ya bahar. Aap bina police complaint ke andar ja sakti hain, aur adult aurat khud tay karti hai ki complaint karni hai ya nahi.

actions.en: Save three numbers today: the Women Helpline 181, the emergency number 112 and your district One Stop Centre's phone number. Use an ordinary contact name if your phone is checked.
actions.hg: Aaj hi teen number save kijiye: Women Helpline 181, emergency number 112 aur apne district ke One Stop Centre ka phone number. Agar aapka phone check hota hai, toh kisi aam naam se save kijiye.

actions.en: If you have to leave home, take your phone, an ID, medicines and your children's papers if you safely can. Never go back into danger for documents.
actions.hg: Agar ghar chhodna pade, toh phone, ek ID, dawaiyan aur bachchon ke papers saath lijiye, lekin tabhi jab yeh safe ho. Documents ke liye khatre mein wapas kabhi mat jaiye.

actions.en: At the centre, say what you need first: a doctor, the police, a lawyer or a bed. Take the case worker's name and a number you can call back.
actions.hg: Centre par sabse pehle bataiye ki aapko kya chahiye: doctor, police, vakeel ya bistar. Case worker ka naam aur ek aisa number le lijiye jis par aap wapas call kar sakein.

actions.en: After a sexual assault, ask to see a doctor the same day: HIV-prevention medicine has to start within 72 hours.
actions.hg: Sexual assault ke baad usi din doctor se milne ki maang kijiye: HIV se bachane wali dawai 72 ghante ke andar shuru karni hoti hai.

actions.en: If the centre is far, shut or unhelpful, go to any hospital or police station, call 181 again, and ask the District Legal Services Authority (helpline 15100) for a free lawyer.
actions.hg: Agar centre door hai, band hai ya madad nahi kar raha, toh kisi bhi hospital ya police station jaiye, 181 par dobara call kijiye, aur District Legal Services Authority (helpline 15100) se free vakeel maangiye.

title.en: Your child's POCSO case: a parent's guide to the Special Court, the 30-day evidence rule and the long wait
title.hg: Aapke bachche ka POCSO case: Special Court, 30 din ka evidence rule aur lamba intezaar, parents ke liye guide

dek.en: The law promises your child a special court, a closed-door hearing and evidence recorded within 30 days. At the end of 2024, 2,86,903 POCSO cases were still waiting for a verdict. What parents ask, answered: the statement, the courtroom, bail, pressure to settle, compensation and school.
dek.hg: Law aapke bachche se ek Special Court, band kamre ki sunwai aur 30 din ke andar evidence record karne ka waada karta hai. 2024 ke end mein 2,86,903 POCSO cases faisle ke intezaar mein the. Parents jo poochte hain, uske jawab: bayaan, courtroom, bail, 'samjhauta' ka pressure, compensation aur school.

statLabel.en: POCSO cases pending trial in Indian courts at the end of 2024
statLabel.hg: POCSO cases 2024 ke end mein India ki courts mein trial ke intezaar mein the

label.en: POCSO cases pending trial at the end of 2024, 87.7% of all POCSO cases before the courts that year
label.hg: POCSO cases 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending the, us saal courts ke saamne aaye saare POCSO cases ka 87.7%

label.en: of POCSO trials that ended in 2024 led to a conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein khatam hue POCSO trials mein conviction hua

label.en: for the Special Court to record the child's evidence after taking cognizance (s.35 POCSO)
label.hg: cognizance lene ke baad Special Court ko itne din mein bachche ka evidence record karna hota hai (POCSO s.35)

label.en: higher compensation limits when the victim is a minor (NALSA scheme, 2018)
label.hg: zyada compensation limit, jab victim minor ho (NALSA scheme, 2018)

claim.en: A child has to stand in an open courtroom and answer the accused's lawyer face to face.
claim.hg: Bachche ko khuli court mein khade hokar accused ke vakeel ke sawaalon ka aamne-saamne jawab dena padta hai.

truth.en: The POCSO Act requires a closed-door trial with a parent or trusted person present, questions put through the judge, and a screen, one-way mirror or video link so the child is not exposed to the accused.
truth.hg: POCSO Act ke tahat trial band kamre mein hota hai, parent ya bharose ka koi insaan saath rehta hai, sawaal judge ke zariye pooche jaate hain, aur screen, one-way mirror ya video link se bachche ko accused ke saamne aane se bachaya jaata hai.

actions.en: Keep one file: the FIR copy, medical papers, every court date, and the names and numbers of the investigating officer and the Special Public Prosecutor.
actions.hg: Ek file banaiye: FIR ki copy, medical papers, har court date, aur investigating officer aur Special Public Prosecutor ke naam aur number.

actions.en: Before the evidence date, ask the prosecutor for a screen or video link, and for you or another trusted adult to sit with your child.
actions.hg: Evidence ki date se pehle prosecutor se screen ya video link maangiye, aur yeh bhi ki aap ya bharose ka koi aur adult bachche ke saath baith sake.

actions.en: If the accused or his family contact you, offer money or threaten you, write down the date and words and tell the police and the prosecutor the same day.
actions.hg: Agar accused ya uski family aapse contact kare, paise offer kare ya dhamki de, toh date aur unke words likh lijiye aur usi din police aur prosecutor ko bataiye.

actions.en: Apply for victim compensation at the District Legal Services Authority; it does not depend on a conviction.
actions.hg: Victim compensation ke liye District Legal Services Authority mein apply kijiye; iske liye conviction zaroori nahi hai.

actions.en: Call Tele-MANAS on 14416 for free counselling for your child, and for yourself.
actions.hg: Bachche ke liye, aur apne liye bhi, free counselling ke liye Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye.

title.en: What police must and must not do after you report a sexual offence: the BNSS rules you can quote at the station
title.hg: Sexual offence ki report ke baad police ko kya karna hi hoga aur kya nahin: BNSS ke rules jo aap thane mein bol sakte hain

dek.en: A woman officer, a statement at your home, no summons to the station, your consent before any medical exam, your name kept out of print and an update within 90 days. Each rule, its section number, and a sentence you can say out loud.
dek.hg: Woman officer, aapke ghar par statement, thane bulane par rok, medical exam se pehle aapki consent, aapka naam kahin nahin chhapega, aur 90 din ke andar update. Har rule, uska section number, aur ek line jo aap thane mein bol sakte hain.

statLabel.en: the deadline for police to update a victim on the investigation (s.193(3) BNSS)
statLabel.hg: ke andar police ko victim ko investigation ka update dena hota hai (s.193(3) BNSS)

label.en: within which police must tell the victim how the investigation is going (s.193(3) BNSS)
label.hg: ke andar police ko victim ko batana hota hai ki investigation kahan tak pahunchi (s.193(3) BNSS)

label.en: within which a rape survivor must be sent for a medical exam, only with her consent (s.184 BNSS)
label.hg: ke andar rape survivor ko medical exam ke liye bhejna hota hai, sirf uski consent se (s.184 BNSS)

label.en: the deadline for police to finish a rape investigation (s.193(2) BNSS)
label.hg: police ke liye rape ki investigation poori karne ki deadline (s.193(2) BNSS)

label.en: rape cases still under investigation at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases 2024 ke end mein bhi investigation mein atke the

claim.en: Once you file a complaint, you must go to the police station whenever they call you.
claim.hg: Ek baar complaint kar di, toh police jab bhi bulaye, thane jaana hi padega.

truth.en: Section 179 BNSS says police cannot require a woman to attend anywhere other than the place where she lives, and a rape survivor's statement is taken at her home or a place of her choice.
truth.hg: BNSS ka Section 179 kehta hai ki police kisi woman ko uske rehne ki jagah ke alawa kahin aur aane ke liye majboor nahin kar sakti, aur rape survivor ka statement uske ghar par ya uski chuni hui jagah par liya jaata hai.

actions.en: Ask for a woman officer, and for your statement to be recorded at your home or a place you choose, on video.
actions.hg: Woman officer maangiye, aur kahiye ki statement aapke ghar par ya aapki chuni hui jagah par, video par record ho.

actions.en: If police call you to the station, tell them Section 179 BNSS does not let them require it; go only if you want to.
actions.hg: Police thane bulaye toh bataiye ki BNSS ka Section 179 unhein aapko majboor karne nahin deta; tabhi jaaiye jab aap khud chahein.

actions.en: Say yes or no to the medical examination yourself, and ask for your consent or refusal to be written down.
actions.hg: Medical examination ke liye haan ya na khud kahiye, aur kahiye ki aapki consent ya inkaar likha jaye.

actions.en: Give police a phone number and email you control, note the FIR date, and ask in writing for an update at 90 days.
actions.hg: Police ko aisa phone number aur email dijiye jo aapke control mein ho, FIR ki date note kijiye, aur 90 din par likh kar update maangiye.

actions.en: If a rule is broken, note the officer's name, rank, date and time, write to the Superintendent of Police, and call 181 or the legal aid helpline 15100.
actions.hg: Koi rule toote toh officer ka naam, rank, date aur time note kijiye, Superintendent of Police ko likhiye, aur 181 ya legal aid helpline 15100 par call kijiye.

title.en: Filing a POSH complaint: the 3-month deadline, the 90-day inquiry and the Local Committee if your workplace has none
title.hg: POSH complaint kaise file karein: 3 mahine ki deadline, 90 din ki inquiry, aur workplace mein committee na ho toh Local Committee

dek.en: The 2013 law gives a woman harassed at work a written complaint, a committee and fixed deadlines, and it covers hospitals, sports venues, office cabs and homes. Enforcement is patchy, so it pays to know the steps better than your employer does.
dek.hg: 2013 ka law kaam ki jagah pe harass hui woman ko ek written complaint, ek committee aur fixed deadlines deta hai, aur ismein hospitals, sports venues, office cabs aur ghar bhi aate hain. Enforcement kamzor hai, isliye steps aapko apne employer se behtar pata hone chahiye.

statLabel.en: national sports federations reviewed did not comply with the POSH Act (Indian Express, May 2023)
statLabel.hg: yaani 30 mein se 16: review kiye gaye national sports federations POSH Act ka paalan nahi kar rahe the (Indian Express, May 2023)

label.en: to give a written complaint, counted from the incident or the last in a series; the committee can extend it by up to 3 more
label.hg: yaani 3 mahine: written complaint dene ke liye, incident se ya series ke aakhri incident se; committee ise 3 mahine tak aur badha sakti hai

label.en: for the committee to complete its inquiry
label.hg: yaani 90 din: committee ko inquiry poori karne ke liye

label.en: national sports federations reviewed did not comply with the POSH Act; five had no committee at all (Indian Express, May 2023)
label.hg: yaani 30 mein se 16: review kiye gaye national sports federations POSH Act ka paalan nahi kar rahe the; paanch mein koi committee thi hi nahi (Indian Express, May 2023)

label.en: state or union territory, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, was reported to have finished the court-ordered survey of committees by August 2025
label.hg: state ya union territory, yaani Andaman and Nicobar Islands, ne August 2025 tak court ke order wala committees ka survey poora kiya tha, aisa Supreme Court ko bataya gaya

claim.en: My workplace has no committee, so there is nowhere to complain.
claim.hg: Mere workplace mein committee hi nahi hai, toh complaint karne ki koi jagah nahi.

truth.en: Every district must have a Local Committee for workplaces with fewer than ten workers and for complaints against the employer. A woman can also file on the government's SHe-Box portal, and go to the police.
truth.hg: Har district mein ek Local Committee honi chahiye, das se kam workers wale workplaces ke liye aur employer ke khilaaf complaints ke liye. Woman sarkar ke SHe-Box portal pe bhi file kar sakti hai, aur police ke paas bhi ja sakti hai.

actions.en: Start a record today: dates, places, exact words, screenshots, and the names of anyone who saw it or was told.
actions.hg: Aaj se record rakhna shuru kijiye: dates, jagah, exact words, screenshots, aur un logon ke naam jinhone dekha ya jinhe aapne bataya.

actions.en: Give the Internal Committee a signed, dated written complaint within 3 months of the last incident. Email it as well and keep a copy.
actions.hg: Aakhri incident ke 3 mahine ke andar Internal Committee ko signed, dated written complaint dijiye. Email bhi kijiye aur ek copy apne paas rakhiye.

actions.en: Ask the committee in writing for interim measures while the inquiry runs, such as a different reporting line, a transfer or leave.
actions.hg: Committee se likh ke maangiye ki inquiry chalne tak interim intezaam ho, jaise alag reporting line, transfer ya leave.

actions.en: No committee, fewer than ten workers, or the harasser is the employer: go to the district's Local Committee or file on SHe-Box (shebox.wcd.gov.in).
actions.hg: Committee nahi hai, das se kam workers hain, ya harasser khud employer hai: district ki Local Committee ke paas jaaiye ya SHe-Box (shebox.wcd.gov.in) pe file kijiye.

actions.en: For touching, threats, stalking or demands for sexual favours you can also go to the police. Free legal aid is on 15100.
actions.hg: Touching, dhamki, stalking ya sexual favours ki demand ke liye aap police ke paas bhi ja sakti hain. Free legal aid 15100 pe milti hai.

title.en: Preserving evidence after sexual assault or online abuse: what to keep, how to store it, and why police closed 1,044 rape cases they called true
title.hg: Sexual assault ya online abuse ke baad saboot kaise bachayein: kya rakhna hai, kaise rakhna hai, aur police ne 1,044 'sach' maane gaye rape cases kyon band kiye

dek.en: In 2024 police closed 1,044 rape cases as true but short of evidence or with the accused untraced. Most evidence is ordinary and easy to lose: clothes, chats, call logs, CCTV, a dated note. Here is what to keep, how to keep it, and what can never be used against you.
dek.hg: 2024 mein police ne 1,044 rape cases yeh keh kar band kiye ki complaint sach hai, par saboot kam hain ya accused mila nahin. Zyada tar saboot roz ki cheezein hain jo aasaani se kho jaati hain: kapde, chats, call logs, CCTV, tareekh wala ek note. Yahan padhiye kya rakhna hai, kaise rakhna hai, aur kya cheez aapke khilaaf kabhi use nahin ho sakti.

statLabel.en: rape cases closed by police in 2024 as true but with insufficient evidence or the accused untraced
statLabel.hg: rape cases 2024 mein police ne yeh keh kar band kiye ki complaint sach hai, par saboot kam hain ya accused untraced hai

label.en: rape cases closed by police in 2024 as true but with insufficient evidence or the accused untraced
label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein police ne band kiye: complaint sach, par saboot kam ya accused untraced

label.en: of the rape trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials mein se itnon mein hi saza hui

label.en: chargesheeting rate in cyber crime cases in 2024
label.hg: 2024 mein cyber crime cases ka chargesheeting rate

label.en: the doctor's deadline to send the medical report to the investigating officer (s.184 BNSS)
label.hg: doctor ke liye medical report investigating officer ko bhejne ki deadline (s.184 BNSS)

claim.en: Without injuries, an eyewitness or a same-day medical report, there is no evidence.
claim.hg: Chot nahin, chashmdeed gawah nahin, usi din ki medical report nahin, toh saboot hi nahin hai.

truth.en: Clothes, chats, call logs, CCTV, the people you told and your own dated account are all evidence, and the law does not read a lack of physical resistance as consent.
truth.hg: Kapde, chats, call logs, CCTV, jin logon ko aapne bataya aur aapka apna tareekh wala note, yeh sab saboot hain. Aur kanoon physically resist na karne ko consent nahin maanta.

actions.en: Put the clothes you were wearing, unwashed, in a paper bag (not plastic) and take them with you to the hospital or the police.
actions.hg: Us waqt pehne kapde bina dhoye paper bag mein rakhiye (plastic mein nahin) aur hospital ya police ke paas saath le jaaiye.

actions.en: Before you block or report anyone, screenshot the message with the username, date and time in the frame, and copy the profile and post links.
actions.hg: Kisi ko block ya report karne se pehle message ka aisa screenshot lijiye jismein username, date aur time dikhe, aur profile aur post ke links copy kijiye.

actions.en: Write a dated account of what happened and a list of the people you told, and email both to yourself.
actions.hg: Jo hua uska tareekh ke saath note likhiye, jin logon ko bataya unki list banaiye, aur dono khud ko email kar dijiye.

actions.en: Name every CCTV camera on the route in your written complaint, and get a receipt for anything you hand over to police.
actions.hg: Raaste ke har CCTV camera ka naam apni likhit complaint mein likhiye, aur police ko jo bhi saunpein uski receipt lijiye.

actions.en: Never download or forward a sexual image of anyone under 18: note the link and report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: 18 saal se kam ke kisi bhi insaan ki sexual image kabhi download ya forward mat kijiye: link note kijiye aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report kijiye.

title.en: A protection order under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act: what it can stop, how to apply, and what to do if it is broken
title.hg: Domestic Violence Act, 2005 ke under protection order: yeh kya rok sakta hai, kaise milta hai, aur toot jaaye toh kya karein

dek.en: A magistrate can order the abuse to stop, keep you in your home and make the abuser pay. Here is what to ask for, where to apply, and what to do the day the order is broken.
dek.hg: Magistrate violence rukwa sakte hain, aapko ghar mein rehne de sakte hain aur abuser se kharcha dilwa sakte hain. Jaaniye kya maangna hai, kahan apply karna hai, aur jis din order toda jaaye us din kya karna hai.

label.hg: ever-married women ne husband ki physical, sexual ya emotional violence jheli hai (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 tak poore India mein operational the

claim.en: The Domestic Violence Act is only for wives who are beaten.
claim.hg: Domestic Violence Act sirf un wives ke liye hai jinhe maara-peeta jaata hai.

truth.en: It covers physical, sexual, verbal, emotional and economic abuse, and protects any woman who lives or has lived with the abuser in a shared home: a wife, a live-in partner, a mother, a sister or a daughter.
truth.hg: Yeh physical, sexual, verbal, emotional aur economic abuse sabko cover karta hai, aur har us woman ko protect karta hai jo abuser ke saath ek ghar mein rehti hai ya reh chuki hai: wife, live-in partner, maa, behen ya beti.

actions.en: Write down every incident with the date and what happened, and keep medical papers, photos and messages where he cannot reach them.
actions.hg: Har incident date aur poori baat ke saath likhiye, aur medical papers, photos aur messages aisi jagah rakhiye jahan uska haath na pahunche.

actions.en: Go to the district Protection Officer, a One Stop Centre or the magistrate's court, and ask for every order you need in one application.
actions.hg: District ke Protection Officer, One Stop Centre ya magistrate court jaiye, aur jitne orders chahiye sab ek hi application mein maangiye.

actions.en: If you are in danger now, ask the magistrate for an interim order straight away.
actions.hg: Abhi khatra hai toh magistrate se turant interim order maangiye.

actions.en: Keep copies of the order on your phone, with someone you trust, and make sure your local police station has one.
actions.hg: Order ki copy apne phone mein aur kisi trusted insaan ke paas rakhiye, aur pakka kijiye ki aapke local police station mein bhi ek copy ho.

actions.en: If the order is broken, call 112 and ask the police to register a case under Section 31 of the Act.
actions.hg: Order toote toh 112 pe call kijiye aur police se Act ke Section 31 ke under case register karne ko kahiye.

title.en: You've received a sexual harassment complaint: what a manager or Internal Committee member must do, step by step
title.hg: Tumhare paas sexual harassment ki complaint aayi hai: manager ya Internal Committee member ko kya karna hai, step by step

dek.en: The Supreme Court says women harassed at work are often reluctant to report, and many quit their jobs. What you do in the first conversation, and in the 90 days after it, decides whether the law works. A guide for team leads, HR staff and new committee members.
dek.hg: Supreme Court kehta hai ki kaam ki jagah par harassment jhelne wali auratein aksar complaint karne se hichkichati hain, aur kai job chhod deti hain. Pehli baatcheet mein aur uske baad ke 90 dinon mein tum kya karte ho, isi se tay hota hai ki law kaam karega ya nahi. Team leads, HR aur committee ke naye members ke liye guide.

statLabel.en: days for the employer to act on the Internal Committee's report (POSH Act)
statLabel.hg: din milte hain employer ko Internal Committee ki report par action lene ke liye (POSH Act)

label.en: days for the Internal Committee to complete its inquiry
label.hg: din mein Internal Committee ko apni inquiry poori karni hoti hai

label.hg: tak ka fine, agar employer committee na banaye ya uski findings par action na le; dobara karne par double saza

label.hg: national sports federations, The Indian Express ne jin 30 ko check kiya unme se, POSH Act follow nahi kar rahe the (May 2023)

label.en: police cases of sexual harassment at office premises in all of India in 2024
label.hg: cases hi 2024 mein poore India mein office premises par sexual harassment ke liye police ne darj kiye

claim.en: The kindest way to handle a complaint is to settle it quietly between the two people.
claim.hg: Complaint handle karne ka sabse accha tareeka hai ki dono ke beech chupchaap settlement kara do.

truth.en: Under the POSH Act, only the committee can try conciliation, only if the woman asks for it, and money can never be its basis. Informal deals also eat into her limited time to file a complaint.
truth.hg: POSH Act mein conciliation sirf committee kara sakti hai, woh bhi tabhi jab aurat khud maange, aur uska basis kabhi paisa nahi ho sakta. Andar-hi-andar ki gayi deals uske complaint karne ke limited time ko bhi kha jaati hain.

actions.en: Listen without judging, write down what she says in her own words, and tell her how to reach the Internal Committee the same day.
actions.hg: Bina judge kiye suno, uski baat uske hi words mein likho, aur usi din batao ki Internal Committee tak kaise pahunchein.

actions.en: Never fix it informally or offer money: conciliation is the committee's job, and only if she asks.
actions.hg: Maamla andar-hi-andar nipatane ya paise dene ki koshish kabhi mat karo: conciliation committee ka kaam hai, aur sirf tab jab woh khud maange.

actions.en: Check your committee: a senior woman presiding, an external member, and at least half its members women.
actions.hg: Apni committee check karo: presiding officer senior woman ho, ek external member ho, aur kam se kam aadhe members auratein hon.

actions.en: Take the respondent out of her reporting line during the inquiry, and watch for retaliation.
actions.hg: Inquiry chalne tak respondent ko uski reporting line se hatao, aur badle ki karwai par nazar rakho.

actions.en: Put the deadlines on the calendar: inquiry in 90 days, report in 10, employer action in 60.
actions.hg: Deadlines calendar mein daal lo: 90 din mein inquiry, 10 din mein report, 60 din mein employer ka action.

title.en: Suspect a child is being sexually abused? How to report under POCSO, and what happens after you call 1098
title.hg: Shak hai ki kisi bachche ka sexual abuse ho raha hai? POCSO ke tahat report kaise karein, aur 1098 par call ke baad kya hota hai

dek.en: Reporting child sexual abuse is a legal duty, not a favour to the family. What to say when a child tells you, what to write down, where to call, and what the system does next, including the parts that are slow.
dek.hg: Bachche ke sexual abuse ko report karna legal duty hai, family par koi ehsaan nahi. Bachcha bataye toh kya kehna hai, kya likh kar rakhna hai, kahan call karna hai, aur uske baad system kya karta hai. Jahan system slow hai, woh bhi.

statLabel.hg: 2024 mein police ne jin POCSO cases ki investigation nipta di, unmein chargesheet file hui

label.hg: child rape (POCSO Section 4 aur 6) ke 2024 ke cases mein accused bachche ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha

label.hg: 2024 mein police ne jin POCSO cases ki investigation nipta di, unmein chargesheet file hui

label.hg: POCSO cases 2024 ke end mein court mein trial ke intezaar mein the

claim.en: Child abuse inside a family is the parents' business. Outsiders should stay out of it.
claim.hg: Family ke andar bachche ke saath jo ho, woh maa-baap ka maamla hai. Bahar walon ko beech mein nahi padna chahiye.

truth.en: Under POCSO, anyone who knows or suspects that a child is being sexually abused must report it to the police or the Special Juvenile Police Unit. Failing to report can mean up to 6 months in prison.
truth.hg: POCSO ke tahat jise bhi bachche ke sexual abuse ka pata ho ya shak ho, use police ya Special Juvenile Police Unit ko batana zaroori hai. Report na karne par 6 mahine tak ki jail ho sakti hai.

actions.en: If a child tells you, stay calm and say: 'I believe you. You did the right thing by telling me. It is not your fault.'
actions.hg: Bachcha bataye toh shaant rahiye aur kahiye: 'Mujhe tum par yakeen hai. Tumne batakar bilkul sahi kiya. Isme tumhari koi galti nahi.'

actions.en: Do not question the child for details or confront the person they named; write down their exact words, the date and who was present.
actions.hg: Bachche se kured-kured kar sawaal mat poochiye, aur jiska naam liya hai usse mat bhidiye. Bachche ke apne words, date aur kaun-kaun maujood tha, yeh likh lijiye.

actions.en: Report the same day: call 1098 or 112, or go to the nearest police station or Special Juvenile Police Unit. You need suspicion, not proof.
actions.hg: Usi din report kijiye: 1098 ya 112 par call kijiye, ya nazdeeki police station ya Special Juvenile Police Unit jaiye. Proof nahi, shak kaafi hai.

actions.en: Never share the child's name, photo, school or family details, not even in a family or residents' WhatsApp group.
actions.hg: Bachche ka naam, photo, school ya family ki koi detail kahin mat daaliye, family ya society ke WhatsApp group mein bhi nahi.

actions.en: If the child needs medical care, take them to any hospital: it must treat them immediately and free of cost.
actions.hg: Bachche ko ilaaj chahiye toh kisi bhi hospital le jaiye. Wahan uska ilaaj turant aur free hona chahiye.

title.en: Dalit or Adivasi survivor? The Atrocities Act adds a chargesheet in 60 days, state protection and notice of every bail hearing
title.hg: Dalit ya Adivasi survivor? Atrocities Act deta hai 60 din mein chargesheet, state ki protection aur har bail hearing ka notice

dek.en: When the accused is not from a Scheduled Caste or Tribe, the SC/ST Atrocities Act sits on top of the rape law and puts extra duties on police, courts and the state. Those duties work only if someone asks for them. A checklist to carry there, and to court.
dek.hg: Jab accused Scheduled Caste ya Tribe se nahi hai, toh SC/ST Atrocities Act rape law ke upar lagta hai aur police, courts aur state par extra duties daalta hai. Yeh duties tabhi kaam karti hain jab koi inhe maange. Ek checklist, thaane ke liye bhi aur court ke liye bhi.

statLabel.hg: ki deadline Atrocities Act police ko investigation karke charge sheet file karne ke liye deta hai

label.hg: rape cases 2024 mein India mein register hue jinme victim Scheduled Caste se the, yaani roz lagbhag 12

label.hg: Atrocities Act ki deadline, jisme police ko investigation karke charge sheet file karni hoti hai

label.hg: conviction rate 2023 mein, un rape cases mein jinme victim Scheduled Caste se the

label.hg: Scheduled Caste victims wale rape cases 2023 ke end tak trial mein pending the

claim.en: The Atrocities Act is about caste abuse and untouchability. It has nothing to do with a rape case.
claim.hg: Atrocities Act caste abuse aur untouchability ke baare mein hai. Rape case se iska koi lena-dena nahi.

truth.en: When the survivor is Dalit or Adivasi and the accused is not, the Act is added to the rape sections in the same FIR. It brings a 60-day charge-sheet deadline, a bar on anticipatory bail, state protection and notice of every hearing.
truth.hg: Jab survivor Dalit ya Adivasi hai aur accused nahi, toh Act usi FIR mein rape sections ke saath judta hai. Isse 60 din ki charge-sheet deadline, anticipatory bail par rok, state ki protection aur har hearing ka notice milta hai.

actions.en: At the station, put the survivor's caste or tribe on record, say the accused is not SC/ST, and ask in writing for the Atrocities Act to be added to the FIR.
actions.hg: Thaane mein survivor ki caste ya tribe record pe likhwaiye, bataiye ki accused SC/ST nahi hai, aur likhit mein maangiye ki FIR mein Atrocities Act joda jaaye.

actions.en: Read the free FIR copy before you leave. If the Act is missing, write to the Superintendent of Police and keep a stamped copy.
actions.hg: Nikalne se pehle free FIR copy padhiye. Act nahi likha hai toh Superintendent of Police ko likhiye aur stamp lagi copy apne paas rakhiye.

actions.en: Write down the FIR date and count 60 days. If no charge sheet has been filed, ask in writing for the reason for the delay.
actions.hg: FIR ki date likh lijiye aur 60 din giniye. Charge sheet file nahi hui toh likhit mein delay ki wajah poochhiye.

actions.en: Report every threat, offer of money or pressure to 'settle' in writing, and name Section 15A.
actions.hg: Har dhamki, paise ka offer ya 'settle' karne ka pressure likhit mein report kijiye, aur Section 15A ka naam lijiye.

actions.en: Give the public prosecutor your phone number and address, and ask to be told of every hearing, including bail.
actions.hg: Public prosecutor ko apna phone number aur address dijiye, aur kahiye ki har hearing ki khabar di jaaye, bail ki bhi.

title.en: Sextortion, step by step: what to do from the first threatening message to the police complaint
title.hg: Sextortion, step by step: pehle dhamki bhare message se police complaint tak kya karna hai

dek.en: The blackmailer's plan runs on panic and a deadline. Here is the order of steps, from the first threat to the police complaint, and the words a parent should say when a child finally tells.
dek.hg: Blackmailer ka poora plan panic aur deadline pe chalta hai. Yahan pehli dhamki se police complaint tak ke steps sahi order mein hain, aur woh words bhi jo parents ko tab bolne chahiye jab bachcha finally bataye.

label.hg: saal ke ladke, jo financial sextortion ka main target hain

claim.en: Delete the chat and your account, and the problem disappears.
claim.hg: Chat aur account delete kar do, problem khatam.

truth.en: Deleting wipes the evidence police need, not the blackmailer's copy. Save the profile, chat and payment demands first, then report and block.
truth.hg: Delete karne se woh evidence mitta hai jo police ko chahiye, blackmailer ki copy nahi. Pehle profile, chat aur payment demands save karo, phir report aur block karo.

actions.en: Stop replying and don't pay, not even a small amount to buy time.
actions.hg: Reply karna band karo aur pay mat karo, time khareedne ke liye thoda sa bhi nahi.

actions.en: Before blocking, screenshot the profile, username, chat, threats and payment details. Never save or send the image itself.
actions.hg: Block karne se pehle profile, username, chat, dhamkiyon aur payment details ke screenshots lo. Photo khud kabhi save ya send mat karo.

actions.en: Report the account on the platform, then call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in.
actions.hg: Platform pe account report karo, phir 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint file karo.

actions.en: If the images were taken under 18, use Take It Down; if at 18 or older, use StopNCII.
actions.hg: Agar images 18 se kam age mein li gayi thi, toh Take It Down use karo; 18 ya usse zyada age ki hon, toh StopNCII.

actions.en: Tell one adult you trust today, and call Tele-MANAS on 14416 if the fear gets too heavy.
actions.hg: Aaj hi kisi trusted adult ko batao, aur darr bahut bhaari lage toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo.

title.en: A job in the city, a quick marriage, a missing teenager: how to spot trafficking and report it fast
title.hg: Sheher mein job, jaldbaazi ki shaadi, ghar se gayab teenager: trafficking ko kaise pehchanein aur turant report kaise karein

dek.en: Trafficking in India does not always start with a kidnapping. It can start with an offer, sometimes from someone the family knows. The warning signs, what to do in the first hours after someone disappears, who to call, and how to treat a survivor who comes home.
dek.hg: India mein trafficking hamesha kidnapping se shuru nahi hoti. Shuruaat ek offer se bhi ho sakti hai, kabhi-kabhi kisi aise insaan ki taraf se jise family jaanti hai. Warning signs kya hain, kisi ke gayab hone ke pehle kuch ghanton mein kya karna hai, kise call karna hai, aur ghar lautne wale survivor ke saath kaise pesh aana hai.

statLabel.hg: bachche 2024 mein India mein missing report hue, jinmein 75,603 ladkiyan thin

label.hg: logon ko 2024 mein India mein trafficked record kiya gaya, jinmein 2,297 bachche the

label.hg: bachche 2024 mein India mein missing report hue, jinmein 75,603 ladkiyan thin

label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue trafficking trials mein se sirf itnon mein conviction hui

label.en: Anti-Human Trafficking Units supported by the Nirbhaya Fund by March 2025
label.hg: Anti-Human Trafficking Units ko March 2025 tak Nirbhaya Fund se support mila

claim.en: Trafficking means a stranger kidnapping someone. If she went willingly, it is not trafficking.
claim.hg: Trafficking ka matlab hai ki koi ajnabi kisi ko kidnap kar le. Agar woh apni marzi se gayi thi, toh yeh trafficking nahi hai.

truth.en: It can begin with an offer: a job, a marriage, help from someone known. Under Section 143 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, the victim's consent is immaterial.
truth.hg: Trafficking ek offer se bhi shuru ho sakti hai: job, shaadi, ya kisi jaan-pehchaan wale ki 'madad'. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ke Section 143 ke tahat victim ki consent se koi farq nahi padta.

actions.en: Check every job or marriage offer yourself: a written offer, an address you can verify, someone who has done the job. Walk away from pressure to decide today.
actions.hg: Job ya shaadi ka har offer khud check kijiye: likhit offer, aisa address jo verify ho sake, koi aisa insaan jisne wahan kaam kiya ho. 'Aaj hi decide karo' wala pressure ho toh mana kar dijiye.

actions.en: Keep your own ID, phone and money, and leave the agent's name, number and photo with someone at home before you travel.
actions.hg: Apna ID, phone aur paise apne paas rakhiye, aur nikalne se pehle agent ka naam, number aur photo ghar par kisi ko de dijiye.

actions.en: If someone is missing, do not wait. Call 112 (1098 for a child) and go to the nearest police station for an FIR. Any station must record it.
actions.hg: Koi gayab ho toh intezaar mat kijiye. 112 par call kijiye (bachcha ho toh 1098) aur FIR ke liye nazdeeki police station jaiye. Koi bhi station ise record karega.

actions.en: Give police a recent photo, the last known location and every name, number, chat and payment linked to the offer. Delete nothing.
actions.hg: Police ko recent photo, aakhri location, aur offer se juda har naam, number, chat aur payment dijiye. Kuch bhi delete mat kijiye.

actions.en: When a survivor comes home, do not ask 'why did you go?'. Never share their name or photo, and ask the District Legal Services Authority about compensation.
actions.hg: Survivor ghar laute toh 'gaye hi kyun the?' mat poochiye. Unka naam ya photo kabhi share mat kijiye, aur compensation ke liye District Legal Services Authority se baat kijiye.

title.en: How to stop a child marriage before the wedding day: 1098, the Child Marriage Prohibition Officer and a magistrate's injunction
title.hg: Shaadi ke din se pehle child marriage kaise rokein: 1098, Child Marriage Prohibition Officer aur magistrate ka injunction

dek.en: A wedding is far easier to stop than to undo. Who to call, what to say, what usually happens after the call, and the two-year window if the marriage has already taken place.
dek.hg: Shaadi ko rokna, ho chuki shaadi ko todne se kahin aasaan hai. Kise call karna hai, kya bolna hai, call ke baad aam taur pe kya hota hai, aur agar shaadi ho chuki hai toh do saal ki window.

label.hg: West Bengal mein, kisi bhi state se zyada (NFHS-6, 2023-24)

label.hg: 18 ka hone ke baad: bachpan mein byahe gaye insaan ke paas court se shaadi annul karwane ka itna hi time hai

claim.en: Once the date is fixed and the cards are printed, nobody can stop a family's wedding.
claim.hg: Ek baar date fix ho gayi aur cards chhap gaye, toh family ki shaadi koi nahi rok sakta.

truth.en: A magistrate can prohibit a planned child marriage with an injunction, and a marriage held in breach of that order is void.
truth.hg: Magistrate injunction dekar plan ki gayi child marriage pe rok laga sakte hain, aur us order ko todkar hui shaadi void hoti hai.

actions.en: Call Child Helpline 1098 as soon as you know the date; if the wedding is today or the child is in danger, call 112.
actions.hg: Date pata chalte hi Child Helpline 1098 pe call kijiye; agar shaadi aaj hai ya bachcha khatre mein hai, toh 112 pe call kijiye.

actions.en: Give the child's name, age, address and school, and the wedding date and venue, and ask that your name not be shared with the family.
actions.hg: Bachche ka naam, umar, address aur school, aur shaadi ki date aur venue bataiye, aur kahiye ki aapka naam family ko na bataya jaaye.

actions.en: Ask for the district Child Marriage Prohibition Officer, and say you want the wedding stopped, by a magistrate's injunction if needed.
actions.hg: District ke Child Marriage Prohibition Officer ke baare mein poochhiye, aur kahiye ki shaadi rukwani hai, zaroorat ho toh magistrate ke injunction se.

actions.en: After the wedding is stopped, stay in touch with the child and call again if the family fixes a new date or sends her away.
actions.hg: Shaadi rukne ke baad bhi bachche se contact mein rahiye, aur family nayi date fix kare ya use kahin bhej de toh dobara call kijiye.

actions.en: If you were married as a child, ask a district court to annul the marriage before you turn 20; call 15100 for a free lawyer.
actions.hg: Agar aapki shaadi bachpan mein hui thi, toh 20 ka hone se pehle district court se use annul karwane ki maang kijiye; free lawyer ke liye 15100 pe call kijiye.

title.en: When someone tells you they were sexually assaulted: the first words, the mistakes to avoid, and how to help next

dek.en: Most survivors who reach out start with family or a friend, not the police. What that first listener says can decide whether they ever tell anyone else. A script for the first conversation, and how to help after it.
dek.hg: Help dhoondhne wale zyada tar survivors pehle family ya kisi dost ke paas jaate hain, police ke paas nahi. Woh pehla insaan kya kehta hai, isi se tay ho sakta hai ki woh phir kabhi kisi ko batayenge ya nahi. Pehli baatcheet mein kya kehna hai, aur uske baad kaise saath dena hai.

label.hg: One Stop Centres July 2026 mein poore India mein chal rahe the

claim.en: A real survivor cries, fights back and reports straight away.
claim.hg: Jiske saath sach mein aisa hua ho, woh roti hai, ladti hai aur turant report karti hai.

truth.en: The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook says there is no 'correct' way for a survivor to behave and that delay is not a sign of lying. The law says not resisting is not consent.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook kehti hai ki survivor ke behaviour ka koi 'sahi' tareeka nahi hota, aur der se batane ka matlab jhooth nahi hai. Law kehta hai ki resist na karna consent nahi hai.

actions.en: Start with 'I believe you', 'It is not your fault' and 'What do you need right now?'
actions.hg: Shuruaat in words se karo: 'Mujhe tumhari baat par yakeen hai', 'Isme tumhari koi galti nahi', 'Abhi tumhe kis cheez ki zaroorat hai?'

actions.en: Never ask what they wore, why they were there or why they did not scream.
actions.hg: Kabhi mat poocho ki unhone kya pehna tha, woh wahan kyun the, ya chillaye kyun nahi.

actions.en: Do not confront the accused, tell others or post about it without the survivor's permission.
actions.hg: Survivor ki permission ke bina accused se mat bhido, doosron ko mat batao, aur social media par kuch mat daalo.

actions.en: Offer to go with them to a hospital, a One Stop Centre or a police station, and let them decide.
actions.hg: Poocho ki kya tum hospital, One Stop Centre ya police station tak saath chalo. Par faisla unhe hi lene do.

actions.en: If they are under 18, the law requires you to report to the police or 1098: tell them first, and stay with them.
actions.hg: Agar woh 18 saal se kam hain, toh law ke hisaab se tumhe police ya 1098 par report karna hoga. Pehle unhe batao, aur unke saath raho.

title.en: Your name or photo was published after a sexual assault: how to get it taken down, and the law that protects you
title.hg: Sexual assault ke baad tumhara naam ya photo chhap gaya: use hatwana kaise hai, aur kaunsa law tumhe protect karta hai

dek.en: A news portal, a neighbour's post or a WhatsApp forward has exposed you. The law gives you two tracks, removal and a criminal complaint, and it is far stricter than most editors and group admins know. Five questions, answered.
dek.hg: Kisi news portal, padosi ki post ya WhatsApp forward ne tumhe expose kar diya hai. Law tumhe do raaste deta hai, removal aur criminal complaint, aur yeh law utna sakht hai jitna zyada tar editors aur group admins ko pata bhi nahin. Paanch sawaal, seedhe jawab.

statLabel.en: for publishing anything that identifies a rape survivor (Section 72 BNS)
statLabel.hg: rape survivor ki pehchaan batane wali koi bhi cheez publish karne par (Section 72 BNS)

label.en: for printing or publishing anything that identifies a rape survivor (Section 72 BNS)
label.hg: rape survivor ki pehchaan batane wali koi bhi cheez print ya publish karne par (Section 72 BNS)

label.en: cases registered across India under Section 72 in the first six months of the BNS, July to December 2024
label.hg: cases poore India mein Section 72 ke under darj hue, BNS ke pehle chhe mahine mein, July se December 2024

label.en: for a platform to resolve a user's grievance under the IT Amendment Rules, 2026, down from 15
label.hg: mein platform ko user ki grievance resolve karni hoti hai (IT Amendment Rules, 2026), pehle 15 din the

label.en: for a platform to remove unlawful content after a court order or authorised government notice, down from 36
label.hg: mein platform ko court order ya authorised sarkari notice ke baad unlawful content hatana hota hai, pehle 36 ghante the

claim.en: If they did not print her name, they have not identified her.
claim.hg: Naam nahin chhapa, toh pehchaan bhi nahin batayi.

truth.en: The Supreme Court barred disclosing, 'even in a remote manner', any fact that could identify a survivor: a college, a village, a relative's face or a blurred photo can be enough.
truth.hg: Supreme Court ne 'even in a remote manner' aisi koi bhi baat batane par rok lagayi hai jisse survivor pehchaani ja sake: college, gaon, rishtedaar ka chehra ya blur ki hui photo bhi kaafi ho sakti hai.

actions.en: Screenshot the post with its link, account name, date and time before you report it.
actions.hg: Report karne se pehle post ka screenshot lo, jismein link, account ka naam, date aur time dikhe.

actions.en: Report in the app, then write to the platform's Grievance Officer citing Section 72 BNS or Section 23 POCSO.
actions.hg: App mein report karo, phir platform ke Grievance Officer ko likho aur Section 72 BNS ya Section 23 POCSO ka naam do.

actions.en: Email the editor and publisher: ask them to remove the name, photo and identifying details from the story, headline and social posts.
actions.hg: Editor aur publisher ko email karo: naam, photo aur pehchaan wali details story, headline aur social posts se hatane ko kaho.

actions.en: Give a written complaint at any police station, attach the screenshots and ask for a takedown notice to the platform.
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein likhi hui complaint do, screenshots lagao aur platform ko takedown notice bhejne ki maang karo.

actions.en: If you choose to speak publicly, give your authorisation in writing and limit it to one outlet and one story.
actions.hg: Agar khud publicly bolna chaho, toh authorisation likh kar do aur use ek outlet aur ek story tak hi rakho.

title.en: Your rights in court as a survivor: a closed courtroom, no questions on your sexual past, and bail that bars contact
title.hg: Court mein survivor ke haq: band courtroom, sexual past par sawaal nahin, aur aisi bail jismein aapse contact mana ho

dek.en: The law promises a rape trial behind closed doors, finished within 2 months of the chargesheet. At the end of 2024, 1,85,785 rape cases were waiting. A stage-by-stage guide to what you are owed in the courtroom, what the defence may not ask, and how to last the distance.
dek.hg: Kanoon ka vaada hai ki rape trial band darwazon ke peeche hoga aur chargesheet ke 2 mahine ke andar khatm hoga. 2024 ke end mein 1,85,785 rape cases trial ke intezaar mein the. Stage-by-stage guide: courtroom mein aapka kya haq hai, defence kya nahin poochh sakta, aur lambe intezaar mein kaise tike rahein.

statLabel.en: from the chargesheet: the time the law gives a court to finish a rape trial (s.346 BNSS)
statLabel.hg: chargesheet ke baad: itne time mein court ko rape trial poora karna hota hai (s.346 BNSS)

label.en: from the chargesheet: the legal time limit for a rape trial (s.346 BNSS)
label.hg: chargesheet ke baad: rape trial poora karne ki kanooni time limit (s.346 BNSS)

label.en: rape cases pending trial at the end of 2024
label.hg: rape cases 2024 ke end mein trial ke liye pending the

label.en: of the rape trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials mein se itnon mein hi saza hui

label.en: for a victim who has a lawyer to get free copies of the police report, FIR and statements (s.230 BNSS)
label.hg: ke andar lawyer wali victim ko police report, FIR aur statements ki free copies milni chahiye (s.230 BNSS)

claim.en: In court, the defence lawyer can ask a rape survivor anything about her past.
claim.hg: Court mein defence lawyer rape survivor se uske past ke baare mein kuch bhi poochh sakta hai.

truth.en: Her character and previous sexual experience are legally irrelevant to consent, and such questions are barred in cross-examination in rape cases.
truth.hg: Kanoon ki nazar mein uska character aur pichhla sexual experience consent ke sawaal se koi lena-dena nahin rakhta, aur rape cases mein cross-examination ke dauraan aise sawaal mana hain.

actions.en: Get a lawyer of your own, free through the District Legal Services Authority (legal aid helpline 15100), and ask for copies of the police report, FIR and statements.
actions.hg: Apna lawyer kijiye, jo District Legal Services Authority se free milta hai (legal aid helpline 15100), aur police report, FIR aur statements ki copies maangiye.

actions.en: Read your own earlier statements before you testify; in the witness box, say 'I don't remember' instead of guessing.
actions.hg: Gawahi se pehle apne pehle ke statements padh lijiye; witness box mein andaaza lagane ki jagah kahiye 'mujhe yaad nahin'.

actions.en: Ask the prosecutor in advance to object to any question about your character or sexual past, and to request a screen or video link.
actions.hg: Prosecutor se pehle hi keh dijiye ki character ya sexual past par koi sawaal aaye toh object karein, aur screen ya video link ki request karein.

actions.en: Report every call, visit or 'settlement' offer from the accused's side, in writing, to the investigating officer and the prosecutor.
actions.hg: Accused ki taraf se aane wala har call, visit ya 'settlement' ka offer likh kar investigating officer aur prosecutor ko bataiye.

actions.en: Keep one file with every hearing date and order, and ask the Legal Services Authority about victim compensation: it does not depend on a conviction.
actions.hg: Har hearing ki date aur order ek hi file mein rakhiye, aur Legal Services Authority se victim compensation ke baare mein poochhiye: yeh saza hone par depend nahin karta.

title.en: Talking to your child about body safety: why 'stranger danger' is the wrong lesson, and how to teach 'no body secrets'
title.hg: Bachche se body safety ki baat: 'stranger danger' galat lesson kyon hai, aur 'no body secrets' kaise sikhayein

dek.en: Police data says the danger is almost always someone the child already knows. Here are the words to use at 3, at 9 and at 15, the one rule about secrets that grooming cannot survive, and the first three sentences to say if your child tells you.
dek.hg: Police data kehta hai ki khatra lagbhag hamesha woh hota hai jise bachcha pehle se jaanta hai. Yahan 3, 9 aur 15 saal ki umar ke liye shabd hain, secrets ka woh ek rule jiske saamne grooming tik nahin paati, aur woh pehle teen sentences jo tab bolne hain jab bachcha tumhe bataye.

statLabel.en: of children reporting sexual abuse in the government's 2007 study were boys
statLabel.hg: sarkar ki 2007 study mein sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein itne ladke the

label.en: of POCSO penetrative-assault cases in 2024 named an unknown or unidentified offender
label.hg: 2024 ke POCSO penetrative-assault cases mein sirf itnon mein offender unknown ya unidentified tha

label.en: of those cases named a friend, online friend or partner
label.hg: un cases mein friend, online friend ya partner ka naam aaya

label.en: of the children who reported sexual abuse in the government's 2007 study were boys
label.hg: sarkar ki 2007 study mein sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein itne ladke the

label.en: the ages at which reported abuse peaked in that study; it began as early as 5
label.hg: yaani 12 se 15 saal: us study mein reported abuse isi umar mein peak par tha; shuruaat 5 saal ki umar se hi ho gayi thi

claim.en: Teach children to stay away from strangers and they are safe.
claim.hg: Bachchon ko strangers se door rehna sikha do, toh woh safe hain.

truth.en: In 2024, only 3.4% of POCSO penetrative-assault cases named an unknown offender. Children need a rule about behaviour, not about strangers: no one may ask a child to keep a body secret.
truth.hg: 2024 mein POCSO ke penetrative-assault cases mein se sirf 3.4% mein offender unknown tha. Bachchon ko strangers ka nahin, behaviour ka rule chahiye: koi bhi bachche se body ka secret rakhne ko nahin keh sakta.

actions.en: Teach the correct names for private parts by age three, the same way you teach 'elbow' and 'knee'.
actions.hg: Teen saal ki umar tak private parts ke sahi naam sikhao, waise hi jaise 'elbow' aur 'knee' sikhate ho.

actions.en: Make one house rule and repeat it for years: surprises are fine, body secrets are not, and nobody gets into trouble for telling.
actions.hg: Ghar ka ek rule banao aur saalon tak dohrao: surprise theek hai, body ka secret nahin, aur batane par kisi ko daant nahin padegi.

actions.en: Never make a child hug or kiss anyone, relatives included; offer a namaste or a wave instead.
actions.hg: Bachche ko kisi ko bhi hug ya kiss karne par majboor mat karo, rishtedaaron ko bhi nahin; namaste ya wave ka option do.

actions.en: Tell your teenager in so many words: if something goes wrong, come to me first, even if you broke a rule.
actions.hg: Apne teenager se saaf shabdon mein kaho: kuch galat ho jaaye toh sabse pehle mere paas aana, chahe tumne koi rule toda ho.

actions.en: If a child tells you, believe them, stay calm, do not confront the person yourself, and call Child Helpline 1098.
actions.hg: Bachcha bataye toh us par yakeen karo, shaant raho, us insaan se khud bhidne mat jao, aur Child Helpline 1098 par call karo.

title.en: Tele-MANAS 14416 after abuse: what happens when you call, and the first steps for your mind
title.hg: Abuse ke baad Tele-MANAS 14416: call karne pe kya hota hai, aur mann ke liye pehle kadam

dek.en: Sleeplessness, panic, numbness and shame after sexual violence, sextortion or abuse at home are known responses to harm, and they can be treated. What a call to India's free, round-the-clock mental-health line is like, who does what in mental-health care, and what the law says you are owed.
dek.hg: Sexual violence, sextortion ya ghar mein abuse ke baad neend na aana, panic, sunn pad jaana aur sharam, yeh sab harm ke jaane-pehchaane responses hain, aur inka ilaaj ho sakta hai. India ki free, round-the-clock mental-health line pe call kaisi hoti hai, mental-health care mein kaun kya karta hai, aur law ke hisaab se aapka kya haq hai.

statLabel.en: Tele-MANAS, India's free mental-health helpline, open round the clock
statLabel.hg: Tele-MANAS, India ki free mental-health helpline, jo round the clock khuli rehti hai

label.en: Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline, launched in October 2022
label.hg: Tele-MANAS, Health Ministry ki free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline, jo October 2022 mein launch hui

label.en: Indians estimated to need mental-health care; fewer than 30 million seek it (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)
label.hg: Indians ko mental-health care ki zaroorat hai, aisa estimate hai; 30 million se kam ise lete hain (National Mental Health Survey 2015-16)

label.en: of Indian women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone (NFHS-5, 2019-21)
label.hg: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali Indian women ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya (NFHS-5, 2019-21)

claim.en: If I still cannot sleep and still feel ashamed weeks later, I am weak or 'going mad'.
claim.hg: Agar hafton baad bhi mujhe neend nahi aati aur sharam aati hai, toh main kamzor hoon ya 'paagal' ho raha hoon.

truth.en: Sleep problems, anxiety, low mood and shame are recognised health effects of violence, not flaws of character. They respond to support and treatment, and a first conversation is free on 14416.
truth.hg: Neend ki dikkat, anxiety, low mood aur sharam violence ke maane hue health effects hain, character ki kami nahi. Support aur treatment se inme farak padta hai, aur pehli baatcheet 14416 pe free hai.

actions.en: Call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and at any hour. Say: 'Something happened to me and I am not coping.'
actions.hg: Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call kijiye, free hai aur kisi bhi waqt. Kahiye: 'Mere saath kuch hua hai aur mujhse sambhal nahi raha.'

actions.en: Before you call, note three things: what you are feeling, for how long, and what you want help with. You do not have to describe the abuse.
actions.hg: Call se pehle teen cheezein note kar lijiye: aap kya feel kar rahe hain, kab se, aur kis cheez mein help chahiye. Abuse describe karna zaroori nahi hai.

actions.en: If you have thoughts of ending your life, call 14416 or 112 now, and stay near someone you trust.
actions.hg: Agar apni zindagi khatam karne ke khayal aa rahe hain, toh abhi 14416 ya 112 call kijiye, aur kisi bharosemand insaan ke paas rahiye.

actions.en: Ask the counsellor where the nearest government psychiatry OPD or counsellor is, and take one person with you to the first visit.
actions.hg: Counsellor se poochhiye ki sabse nazdeeki government psychiatry OPD ya counsellor kahan hai, aur pehli visit pe kisi ek insaan ko saath le jaaiye.

actions.en: If a professional blames you, or offers to 'cure' your sexuality or gender, leave and see someone else. If you are under 18, you can also call 1098.
actions.hg: Agar koi professional aapko blame kare, ya aapki sexuality ya gender ko 'cure' karne ki baat kare, toh wahan se nikal jaaiye aur kisi aur ko dikhaiye. 18 se kam umar ke hain toh 1098 pe bhi call kar sakte hain.

title.en: Rs 4 lakh to Rs 7 lakh: how a rape survivor claims compensation, even if the attacker is never caught
title.hg: Rs 4 lakh se Rs 7 lakh: rape survivor compensation kaise claim kare, chahe attacker kabhi pakda hi na jaaye

dek.en: The money comes from the state, not the accused, and it does not wait for a conviction. A filing checklist for the District Legal Services Authority: who applies, what to attach, how interim relief works, and what to do when the file stops moving.
dek.hg: Yeh paisa state deta hai, accused nahin, aur iske liye conviction ka wait nahin karna padta. District Legal Services Authority ke liye ek filing checklist: kaun apply karega, kya attach karna hai, interim relief kaise milta hai, aur file ruk jaaye toh kya karna hai.

statLabel.en: for the Legal Services Authority to finish a compensation inquiry, even with no trial (s.396 BNSS)
statLabel.hg: yaani do mahine ke andar Legal Services Authority ko compensation ki inquiry poori karni hoti hai, trial na ho tab bhi (s.396 BNSS)

label.en: for a rape survivor under NALSA's 2018 compensation scheme; Rs 5-10 lakh for gang rape
label.hg: NALSA ki 2018 compensation scheme mein rape survivor ke liye; gang rape ke liye Rs 5-10 lakh

label.en: compensation limits when the survivor is a minor
label.hg: yaani survivor minor ho toh compensation ki limits 50% zyada

label.en: of rape trials completed in 2024 ended in conviction, which is why the claim does not depend on one
label.hg: 2024 mein poore hue rape trials mein se sirf itnon mein conviction hui, isiliye claim conviction par depend nahin karta

label.en: one-time Nirbhaya Fund grant from the Centre to help states pay victim compensation
label.hg: Nirbhaya Fund se Centre ka one-time grant, taaki states victim compensation de sakein

claim.en: Compensation comes only after a court convicts the accused.
claim.hg: Compensation tabhi milta hai jab court accused ko convict kar de.

truth.en: Section 396 of the BNSS lets a survivor apply to the Legal Services Authority even if the offender is never traced and no trial takes place. It is also available when a trial ends in acquittal.
truth.hg: BNSS ka Section 396 survivor ko Legal Services Authority mein apply karne deta hai, chahe offender kabhi trace na ho aur trial ho hi na. Trial acquittal par khatam ho, tab bhi compensation mil sakta hai.

actions.en: Get the FIR registered and collect your free copy; the claim is built on it.
actions.hg: FIR register karwao aur uski free copy lo; claim usi par khada hota hai.

actions.en: Apply in writing to the District Legal Services Authority at the district court, and leave with a dated, stamped receipt.
actions.hg: District court mein District Legal Services Authority ko likh kar apply karo, aur date aur stamp wali receipt lekar hi niklo.

actions.en: Ask for interim relief in the same application, and attach the medical report and treatment bills if you have them.
actions.hg: Usi application mein interim relief bhi maango, aur medical report aur treatment ke bills ho toh attach karo.

actions.en: Count two months from the date on the receipt; then send a written reminder to the DLSA Secretary and the State Legal Services Authority.
actions.hg: Receipt ki date se do mahine gino; phir DLSA Secretary aur State Legal Services Authority ko likhit reminder bhejo.

actions.en: For help with filing, call NALSA's legal aid helpline 15100 or the Women Helpline 181.
actions.hg: Filing mein help chahiye toh NALSA ki legal aid helpline 15100 ya Women Helpline 181 par call karo.

title.en: Zero FIR and e-FIR: how to report a crime at any police station, or online, under Section 173 BNSS
title.hg: Zero FIR aur e-FIR: kisi bhi police station mein ya online complaint kaise karein (Section 173 BNSS)

dek.en: 'Not our area' is not an answer the law allows. What Section 173 promises, what to say and carry at the desk, how an online report becomes a real FIR, and what you must walk out with.
dek.hg: 'Yeh hamara area nahin hai' ab law mein koi jawab nahin. Section 173 kya promise karta hai, desk par kya bolna aur kya le jaana hai, online complaint asli FIR kaise banti hai, aur nikalte waqt tumhare haath mein kya hona chahiye.

statLabel.en: women help desks set up in police stations by March 2025
statLabel.hg: women help desks March 2025 tak police stations mein ban chuki thin

label.en: women help desks in police stations by March 2025, 13,743 of them headed by women officers
label.hg: women help desks March 2025 tak police stations mein; inmein se 13,743 ko women officers head karti thin

label.en: to sign information sent electronically, so that the e-FIR is taken on record (s.173 BNSS)
label.hg: online bheji gayi jaankari par sign karne ka time; tabhi e-FIR record par aati hai (Section 173 BNSS)

label.en: within which police must tell you how the investigation is progressing (s.193 BNSS)
label.hg: ke andar police ko batana hoga ki investigation kahan tak pahunchi (Section 193 BNSS)

label.en: more police reports of crimes against women after all-women police stations opened in Indian cities (study)
label.hg: zyada police complaints aayin jab Indian shehron mein all-women police stations khule (study)

claim.en: Police can only register a crime that happened in their own area.
claim.hg: Police sirf apne area mein hue crime ki hi FIR likh sakti hai.

truth.en: Section 173 of the BNSS says information about a cognizable offence can be given 'irrespective of the area where the offence is committed'. Any station must record it.
truth.hg: BNSS ka Section 173 kehta hai ki cognizable offence ki jaankari di ja sakti hai, 'irrespective of the area where the offence is committed', yaani crime chahe kisi bhi area mein hua ho. Har station ko ise record karna hoga.

actions.en: At any police station, say: 'Please register this as an FIR under Section 173 of the BNSS, as a Zero FIR if it happened elsewhere.'
actions.hg: Kisi bhi police station mein bolo: 'Section 173 BNSS ke under meri FIR likhiye; crime doosre area ka hai toh Zero FIR likhiye.'

actions.en: Ask for the women help desk, and for a woman officer to record a complaint of rape, sexual harassment, stalking, voyeurism or acid attack.
actions.hg: Women help desk poochho, aur rape, sexual harassment, stalking, voyeurism ya acid attack ki complaint woman officer se record karwao.

actions.en: If you report electronically, sign it within 3 days, or the information is not taken on record.
actions.hg: Online complaint ki hai toh 3 din ke andar us par sign karo, warna woh record par nahin aayegi.

actions.en: Do not leave without your free copy of the FIR; check the number, date, place, your words and the sections.
actions.hg: FIR ki free copy liye bina mat jao; number, date, jagah, tumhari baat aur sections check karo.

actions.en: For online sexual abuse, also report on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930, and save the acknowledgement number.
actions.hg: Online sexual abuse ke liye cybercrime.gov.in par bhi complaint karo ya 1930 par call karo, aur acknowledgement number save karo.
